novel_info.summary: Reborn in the immortal and demon world where righteousness and evil contend, Song Yan is kidnapped into the Puppet Demon Sect and assigned as a skin-making servant.During working, his system unexpectedly awakens, allowing him to enhance his lifespan and comprehension as long as he engages in skin making.[You absorbed the remaining life span of a stubborn donkey: 10 years][Please choose the lifespan to invest][You invested ten years of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root, you continued to lie there, being penetrated by ghosts...]

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Puppet Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Puppet Sect
Demon Sect, Puppet Sect.
The new servant disciples stood in a line, on the verge of tears, waiting for roll call, among them was Song Yan.
The recruitment of the Demon Sect, which occurs once every five years, is mostly done through abductions, especially for servants.
Song Yan was also taken by force.
However, this was not important.
Because after the abduction, the original owner seemed to have died during transportation, and he happened to transmigrate here, without any memories, without anything, which was actually the best case for him.
A fierce man in black armor held a roster, calling names one by one for assignment.
The assignments were random, as no one would specifically choose slots for servant disciples. Although "recruitment" happens once every five years, the attrition rate of servant disciples in the Demon Sect is relatively high. So, as soon as servants are lacking, the Demon Sect continues to capture more.
Before his transmigration, Song Yan was just a corporate drone, now he listened intently to the black-armored fierce man announce the names of places.
Tannery, Mortuary, Skin Making Room, Washing Room, Kitchen, Spirit Plant Garden, Messenger Room, Procurement Room, Test Chamber...
There were many types of servant roles, but to the newly arrived servants, some places, even by name, were not clear as to their functions.
However, there were, after all, some who had heard the notorious name of the Puppet Sect.
"Ma Lao Zuo."
"Present."
"Report to the Mortuary, assist the Official Disciples."
The named person, a middle-aged man who seemed honest, shivered upon hearing the words, and suddenly fell to his knees with a thud, pleading with tears and snot: "Sir, please assign me somewhere else, I’m willing to be a pig or a dog, as long as you don’t send me to the Paperman Peak, Mortuary, or Tannery! Sir, I beg you!"
The black-armored fierce man nodded and asked, "Have you thought it through?"
The middle-aged man was overjoyed, exclaiming repeatedly, "Thank you, thank you!"
The black-armored fierce man flicked his sleeve, and a white shadow swiftly swept out, growing with the wind, landing behind Ma Lao Zuo. It was a beautiful woman in flowing white clothes, extending her delicate hands up and down onto Ma Lao Zuo’s head.
Crunch!
With a twist of her small hand, Ma Lao Zuo’s head spun around.
Thud!
The corpse fell to the ground, lifeless in an instant.
The black-armored fierce man retrieved his hand, the woman in white transformed into a paperman and flew back into his sleeve. He clapped his hands, soon some old servants came from outside, swiftly carried the corpse away to an unknown place.
Seeing the new servants in front of him, dumbfounded and filled with fear, the black-armored fierce man finally said, "You all heard him, he himself said he wanted to be a pig or a dog. Killing a pig or a dog, isn’t that too much?"
After saying so, the black-armored fierce man continued calling names.
The rest were trembling with fear, not daring to speak more. Those who were named trembled, wishing to turn around and flee, yet not daring to do so.
"Song Yan."
"Present."
A plain-looking young man stepped forward.
"You go to the Tannery, assist the Official Disciples."
Song Yan was stunned for a moment, remembering what Ma Lao Zuo had said earlier.
Ma Lao Zuo had stated that as long as he wasn’t sent to Paperman Peak, Mortuary, or Tannery, he’d be content.
Clearly, these three places held great danger for servants.
But when faced with the situation, Song Yan had no other choice, and only replied with a trembling voice, "Yes."
...
Soon, Song Yan was assigned to a plaque. The body of the plaque was made of Black Wood, and on it were inscribed the words "Song Yan," "Servant," and "Shadow Puppet 527" in either blood or cinnabar, indicating his identity and number.
An old servant led the way in front, taking him across the enormous mountain of the Puppet Sect, finally stopping at a lonely cliff.
Song Yan walked two steps forward, seeing a row of stone chambers perched on the cliff, while beyond the cliff, mist roiled.
Suddenly, Song Yan’s pupils contracted, because he saw transparent floating coffins like teeth growing on the steep cliff.
Looking closer, inside those coffins, there were beds, tables, and chairs, starkly resembling houses.
"Just ahead."
The old servant, who hadn’t spoken or responded the whole way, didn’t care about Song Yan’s confusion and fear, merely pointing ahead before turning and leaving.
Song Yan, holding the token, steeled himself and walked forward.
In the stone chamber, many servants immediately looked up, seeing he was male, many lowered their heads.
However, the female servants continued to look up, scrutinizing him.
Upon seeing his unremarkable appearance, more than half lowered their heads, while a big-eyed woman stepped forward, showing her plaque.
The plaque read: Wang Susu, Servant, Shadow Puppet 675.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Song Yan looked at the number, quite curious why his number was higher than the servant before him. Nonetheless, he raised his token and called out, "Sister Wang."
The woman named Wang Susu wore slippery white silk pants, still possessing some grace. She looked at the young boy and said, "Here, servants lead other servants, it’s up to whom one wishes to follow. You should follow me."
Song Yan had no choice, so he nodded and said, "Thank you, Sister Wang."
Seemingly pleased with his politeness, Wang Susu led the way, introducing as they walked.
"The Puppet Sect has five peaks: Paperman Peak, Shadow Puppet Peak, Blood Corpse Peak, Mechanical Peak, and Bizarre Poison Peak.
There are many servants at each peak. Our tannery belongs to the Shadow Puppet Peak.
The demands made by the Official Disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak must be met.
Besides this, many task lists are sent over monthly. If the tasks aren’t completed, the one who has made the least shadow puppets will be executed."
"As for shadow puppetry, it involves eight processes. One, selecting skin; two, cleansing skin; three, drafting sketches; four, transferring sketches; five, carving; six, coloring; seven, drying; eight, sewing and binding.
Can you draw?"
Before Song Yan could reply, Wang Susu continued, "If you can’t, learn quickly. Tasks will accompany the original artwork, mostly involving livestock.
Once inside the room, watch me perform once."
Song Yan contemplated and asked, "Sister Wang, do we have a chance to become Official Disciples?"
Wang Susu smiled slightly and said, "There’s a chance, and there isn’t."
"Why?"
"Most of us were abducted here; those with good potential have been selected, and those of us here are the less talented.
However, the Puppet Sect knows sometimes the Talent Testing Device might not be entirely accurate. To prevent missing out on talent, they send a disciple every week to teach the Entry Guidance Method.
If someone can meet their requirements within the specified time, they’ll undergo a second test to become an Official Disciple."
"I see..."
Song Yan nodded and looked towards the transparent houses on the cliff.
This time, before he could ask, Wang Susu directly said, "Those are our dwellings.
Here, if you want to live long, remember one thing: before dark, you must be inside, and don’t come out until dawn."

chapters.title: Chapter 2. Remaining Life Dao Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: 2. Remaining Life Dao Fruit
On the solitary cliff, the thick fog seemed never to disperse.
The stone house was single-storied, unlike the pavilion from the previous recruitment. Perhaps to guard against the mountain wind, or perhaps...
Song Yan, newly arrived, asked the large-eyed woman beside him, "Sister Wang, is there anything particular about this stone house?"
Wang Susu leaned close to his ear intimately.
Song Yan was momentarily stunned, then felt a warm breath at his ear.
Her delicate voice whispered softly in a coaxing manner, "I’ll tell you tonight."
She then swayed her hips and walked forward.
Song Yan had the feeling she was deliberately showing off her figure.
"Come on~~"
Wang Susu turned around and beckoned when she saw the young man hadn’t followed.
Song Yan’s expression tightened slightly, then he quickly followed.
He cherished life. Since he transcended here, though he ended up in the Demon Sect, he naturally wanted to live longer if he could.
He carefully observed everything he saw.
After entering, the inside was unexpectedly spacious.
The stone house appeared as a row from the outside, but inside, it turned out to be a long narrow building.
It might have been three or four zhang wide, yet its length was over ten times that, making it perfectly suitable for a hundred-meter dash if you wished.
As for people, there were many, at a glance, seven or eight hundred in total.
Many were in pairs, busy with leather crafting.
Most pairs consisted of a man and a woman; pairs of men or women were fewer, and those working alone were even rarer.
Then, sounds came from outside, and the crowd inside burst into jeers, seemingly shouting, "Quite a few newcomers today."
Song Yan turned to look as well, this time spotting a somewhat attractive woman, nervously glancing around.
Immediately, two men from the tannery stepped out, offering for the woman to choose one. From a distance, faint arguing voices could be heard.
"Stop looking, I’ll teach you."
Wang Susu’s voice came from beside him.
Song Yan nodded.
Wang Susu pointed to a piece of leather and said, "The selection of leather at this stage isn’t our responsibility; it’s brought by the Official Disciples. These leathers are mostly donkey, pig, or cowhide, but sometimes there is demon beast skin. That kind is as tough as rock and hard to work with. It takes half a day just to scrape off the stray hair and leftover grease. We don’t have the skill to carve demon beast skins; that’s for specialists."
As she spoke, she took out a semi-finished piece of leather, which had obviously been processed and was now somewhat translucent.
"Watch me do it once, then try to follow along."
Song Yan listened attentively.
To survive, he had to deal with what was in front of him first.
Very soon, it was his turn.
Song Yan picked a piece of irregularly shaped skin from the pile and laid it flat, meticulously scraping it with a scraper.
The thinner the skin became, the slower he worked, fearing it might tear. Once it turned smooth and translucent, he blew the remaining debris off it with a heavy breath.
Afterward, he hurriedly sketched a draft of an artwork called "Double-headed Wolf" according to the sample.
When he finished, he showed it to Wang Susu. She shook her head, so he tried again, and it wasn’t until the seventh time that she finally nodded.
Thus, Song Yan placed his finished draft under the transparent skin and carefully traced the pattern with a fine needle.
Then, he removed the draft and began carving on the traced pattern with a scalpel.
After that, he applied colors, dried it, and finally stitched it together with a needle and thread.
Having completed the task, Song Yan felt quite exhausted. Raising his head, he noticed dusk had fallen outside the stone door, the twilight sun stretching crookedly between the fog-draped peaks, casting an eerie red glow.
Those mysterious lights twisted and writhed...
Suddenly, Song Yan rubbed his eyes and saw lines of text appear before him.
[Name: Song Yan]
[Life Span: 16/56]
[Talent: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]
[Realm: Non-Flow]
[Profound Root: None (calculated by life span)]
[Cultivation Technique: None (calculated by life span)]
[Magic: None (calculated by life span)]
Note: Remaining Life Dao Fruit: All things in heaven and earth have their life span, and if they suffer a violent death, the remaining life persists in their body. Cause and effect repay each other: by assisting it in reshaping with a knife, it returns its remaining life to you, clearing the slate.
...
Another piece of information popped up immediately afterward.
[You absorbed the remaining life span of a stubborn donkey: 10 years]
Song Yan felt a sudden lightness, as if a lively vitality had surged within him. The [Life Span] field’s value had changed to [16/66].
Song Yan was momentarily stunned.
A donkey skin increased his life span by 10 years?
If it were ten pieces, wouldn’t that be 100 years?
What about demon beasts, would it be more?
Song Yan looked up at the piles of skins within the tannery and suddenly felt a small surge of excitement.
Just then, Wang Susu’s voice reached him again.
"Pack up and hurry into the house."
"But, I haven’t eaten yet."
"Eat? Did you take a black pill when you came over?"
"Yes." Song Yan vaguely remembered being forced to swallow one after being taken to the recruitment hall.
"That’s a Fasting Pill; one can stave off hunger for three days. With no grains entering the body, there’s no need to eat, drink, or use the bathroom. You only need to bathe. But today, there’s no time."
Seeing Song Yan’s hesitation, Wang Susu urged, "Hurry, it’s fall now, and it gets dark quickly. If you’re not inside by nightfall, anything terrible could happen, especially on misty days deep in the mountains!"
While they spoke, many in the tannery had already begun moving. They quickly headed to the cliff’s edge, then into the transparent coffin-like Suspended House above, opening the door and squeezing inside.
And Song Yan noticed what seemed to be an argument happening on the other side.
Although many servant newcomers had arrived earlier, Song Yan had been too focused on leather crafting to notice. But he recognized the arguing parties, especially the woman who had come after him.
The man paired with her was trying to drag her into his house, but she refused no matter what.
The man cursed furiously, quickly finding another single man, and they entered the Suspended House together.
The woman, meanwhile, was cluelessly looking around, then chose an unlocked house and slipped inside. On the table inside, there were two keys, indicating that once inside, one could become the owner of the house.
"Are you going to look for a house yourself?" Wang Susu’s voice was somewhat cold.
Song Yan shook his head. Compared to gender-related avoidance, survival was more important.
He then closely followed Wang Susu into the house.
Once inside, Song Yan’s legs couldn’t stop shaking as he looked down, feeling as if he were suspended thousands of feet in the air. Any minor mishap would mean a shattered body, never to recover.
As soon as Wang Susu entered, she quickly pulled brown blankets over various spots, shielding the house’s transparency, then swayed over to Song Yan’s side, softly saying, "Living here is precarious; no one knows when they’ll die.
Even if you can’t forget worldly matters, you must move forward.
Enjoy yourself when you can and don’t waste the time you’re alive."
Song Yan asked, "So?"
"So..." Wang Susu flaunted an enchanting expression and coquettishly said, "What’s the young man waiting for?"
...
...
Note: Updates with 2 Chapters every day at 5 PM.

chapters.title: Chapter 3. The First Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: 3. The First Night
Song Yan looked at the coquettish woman with large eyes before him, her silk skirt partially slipped off, clothes half undone, like the skin of a juicy water honey peach, slightly torn open, revealing skin that was somewhat plump yet still creamy white.
At this moment, the brown blanket had already been drawn up, twenty-four stone hooks causing the blanket to cover the six sides of the small Suspended Room, only allowing glimpses outside through the gaps in the blanket.
Below was a sheer cliff, outside was mysterious danger, peril at every turn, at times like this, there was no better joy than indulging in the most basic desire of living creatures.
This was also a form of release, a way to ensure oneself didn’t go insane.
The question had become a choice: heart first, or physical pleasure?
Song Yan was a normal, healthy man, if he were in a different environment, he’d surely be willing to opt for physical pleasure, but now... he couldn’t.
First arrival and everything was unfamiliar, for the information about this world, even the Demon Sect, he knew very little. Although the woman before him taught him some skin making knowledge, she might have other intentions, more critical is: the Demon Sect seems quite chaotic. There’s robbing disciples, men and women cohabiting at first sight, killing without blinking, and the taboo of not leaving the house when night falls... In such circumstances, how could he be sure this woman hadn’t messed around previously, ensuring her body was disease-free? Or perhaps, how could he guarantee this woman was problem-free?
Rather than losing one’s mind, opting to think with the lower body and entrusting everything to unfounded trust, Song Yan felt it was better to maintain necessary sanity and vigilance.
"Sister Wang, let’s talk, before you were kidnapped here..."
"Young master, come to me, after we have fun, I’ll tell you everything, hehe."
The woman’s unabashed words could make a youth flush, but she seemed indifferent, even sneaking off more of the silk skirt, showing more skin, then twisted her hips, raised her back to Song Yan, giggling, "Or... does young master prefer horseback riding?"
"Sister Wang, give me some more time, okay?"
"Why?"
The woman’s voice suddenly carried anger, she abruptly straightened up, sat upright, and stared directly at Song Yan, her eyes reflecting the youth’s vitality and strength, showing impatience.
Song Yan’s gaze swiftly scanned, suddenly settling on the small knife on the bedside table.
Only for a fraction of a second before the woman’s gaze followed over.
The atmosphere instantly became dim and tense.
Suddenly, both of them lunged quickly.
Wang Susu was closer to the bedside and grabbed the knife.
However, Song Yan immediately followed, his arm wrapped around, twisted, turning the woman’s arm back, swiftly pressing his elbow, inner grasping, shouted explosively, exerted strength, and snatched the small knife from her hand.
It was a small capture technique taught while participating in military training when the instructor was idle. Song Yan, as a martial arts novel enthusiast since childhood, naturally learned a few moves, but he never thought he’d actually have a chance to use them in his life.
After grabbing the knife, Wang Susu twisted her body, followed with her arm, and subsequently slammed backward.
The slam surprisingly had significant force, Song Yan was directly knocked from the bedside onto the couch, tumbling twice.
Wang Susu swiftly turned, intending to leap again, but saw the youth had already sat up, holding the knife, coolly facing her.
"Sister Wang, let’s talk."
"Put down the knife and let’s talk."
Song Yan showed a friendly smile, then put down the knife, pushing it a bit further away.
Wang Susu breathed out leisurely and laughed, "That’s right, using a knife for..."
Before finishing the last few words, she suddenly lunged out, quickly rushing towards the knife, but she ended up grasping thin air.
Song Yan seemed to have been waiting for her move, so almost as soon as she moved, his arm promptly extended, firmly clutching the knife between his fingers, refusing to let go!
They slowly drew back distance again.
"Why?"
This time it was Song Yan’s turn to ask, because Wang Susu had no reason to grab the knife again, there was no hatred between them, just for physical pleasure, why bother?
However, the woman named Wang Susu no longer answered.
Time wasted nearly a joss stick’s worth, Wang Susu suddenly glanced outside through the gaps, and said, "After autumn, the miasma in the mountains begins to thicken, at night, you and I need to take turns keeping watch, using the body to hold the door to prevent accidents.
This is also why two people live in one room.
If living alone, then one can only seek blessings, either the ghost doesn’t come knocking, or... he can stay awake without nodding off, without relaxing all night."
"Sister Wang, what is miasma? What are ghosts? Why is our Tannery’s stone house only built one story?" Song Yan asked a series of questions.
Wang Susu tied the half-untied clothes properly, pulled up the silk skirt, sneered coldly, and said, "Why should I tell you?"
"You guard the first part of the night."
"Okay."
"Then, Sister Wang, since things are as they are, when we’re keeping watch, let’s stay away from each other."
Wang Susu said softly, "Alright."
Song Yan’s expression hardened slightly, instinctively he felt: Wang Susu truly intended him harm, but fortunately, she wasn’t a good actress, at least her abnormalities soon emerged.
Afterwards, nothing happened in the room, Wang Susu ascended the steps and sat below the entrance of the Suspended Room.
The house had entry from above, hence beneath the door were five steps.
Keeping watch means sitting at the top of the staircase, slightly bent, using the back to hold the door.
Song Yan maintained distance, sitting in the corner resting his mind, but occasionally, he observed Wang Susu’s actions, posture, and details seriously.
The latter seemed to sense his thoughts, let out a cold laugh, "Nothing special, just hold the door when it shakes. I wouldn’t dare lie to you about this. After all, if the door opens, it’s not just you who’ll die."
"Then what did Sister Wang lie to me about?"
"Hmph."
Time ticked by, second by second, and the night seemed long.
Yet, outside the Suspended Room, it wasn’t pitch-dark; instead, an unusual red mist entwined with moonlight, swirling gently. This scene reminded Song Yan of a painting called "Starry Night" from before his transmigration.
On the cliff, the wind was strong, blowing the mist into swirling vortexes, now dense, now thin, occasionally revealing the trembling woods below swaying in the gale.
Suddenly, without any warning, Song Yan heard a knocking on the door.
Wang Susu hurriedly exerted her strength to hold it. The knocking ceased after just two sounds.
"What’s outside?" Song Yan asked.
Wang Susu still didn’t answer.
And after an unknown amount of time, during which there were several more instances of knocking, the strength varied—light ones were easy to hold, but strong ones required full force.
Suddenly, Wang Susu stood up and said, "Your turn."
The two carefully brushed past each other.
Song Yan mimicked Wang Susu’s earlier posture and sat down.
...
...
The night passed.
The red mist dissipated, the moonlight withdrew, and the gray world welcomed the dawn.
The doors of the Suspended Rooms opened, and many servants emerged.
Song Yan also quickly came out.
"Return the knife to me."
Wang Susu shouted, "This was exchanged for with my Contribution Points. If you want one, you can wait until you become a servant for a while and then exchange for it."
In order to reassure Song Yan, she walked closer and said with a cold snort, "I’m giving you some information as a bargain, and including the knowledge I taught you yesterday as a goodwill gesture, so you won’t hold a grudge against me."
Then, she whispered, "There are many remnants in the mountains and forests, and also many lingering souls, accumulating into a river, which is called Earth Demon.
This Earth Demon, especially in the Demon Sect area, is even more abundant.
Once autumn and winter arrive, thick fog arises, and when Earth Demon enters the fog, it becomes a foul mist, appearing red.
This mist is all-pervasive, and if it encounters remnants, even a piece of skin or a bone, it could form a ghost creature.
These ghosts lack intelligence, only instinct.
And their instinct is merely to live again.
Therefore, they desperately approach places with life, knocking on doors.
If the door opens, these ghost creatures will leap onto a person, and then ghost bones would pierce into the body, ghost skin would wrap around the skin, and the Evil Qi would relentlessly invade your body.
Of course, usually, this wouldn’t succeed, but... the attacked would go mad, become dull, indistinguishable from being dead.
As for why the stone house is a single layer, it’s because a single layer is easier to seal up, preventing the skins inside from contacting the foul mist, which would be a significant problem."
"Oh, and if someone in the same room wants to harm another, they can quietly open the door, then either push that person outside or kill them in the room and throw the corpse to the cliff’s bottom.
At night, it’s dark, everyone shuts their doors, no one would see, no one would speak... come morning, they can blame it on the ghost things. However, no one would do such a thing when it’s light.
But if such a situation occurs, afterwards, no one would share a room with that person, since no one is foolish, hence... incidents of killing and throwing bodies are extremely rare."
"So, Song Yan, you can return the knife to me now. Then tonight... you pick another place to sleep. Between us, from now on, we’re strangers."
Song Yan responded with a "Thank you" and then asked, "So what did Sister Wang intend to do yesterday?"
Wang Susu didn’t answer again.
Song Yan tossed the knife back into the room, saying, "From now on, we’re strangers."
Wang Susu nodded, looking at him no more, and quickly entered the Tannery.
Just then, Song Yan suddenly noticed two black dots coming straight up from the cliff. As they got closer, he saw they were two disciples in black robes, riding peculiar Shadow Puppet twin-headed wolves.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
The twin-headed wolves clambered up roofs and walls, running and jumping at great speed.
Upon reaching the cliff top, the pair of disciples didn’t engage in small talk with the servants, instead swiftly inspecting the rooms, then promptly dragging out seven already mad servants; among them were men, women, and even the somewhat good-looking female newcomer who hadn’t entered a room with a man yesterday.
One of the disciples waved his long sleeve, his fingers lightly flicking, releasing a Shadow Puppet Car. He casually killed the seven mad servants, loaded them onto the car, and then left over the mountains.
Song Yan felt a sudden chill in his heart.
In just two days, he had witnessed more untimely deaths than before his transmigration...
He hurriedly turned back into the stone house, found a corner spot, sat down, and began today’s leather crafting.

chapters.title: Chapter 4. Possessed by ghosts for 40 years
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: 4. Possessed by ghosts for 40 years
Song Yan was very serious about skin making, his expression focused, meticulous, and his movements swift. After mastering the knack, he completed the making of a piece of skin in just two hours.
[You have extracted the remaining lifespan of an ordinary wild ox: 15 years]
When others took a break, he continued with skin making.
Two hours later...
[You have extracted the remaining lifespan of an ordinary wolf: 8 years]
After working for four consecutive hours, Song Yan felt a bit tired. He rubbed his brow and glanced at the lifespan on the panel: (16/89).
He then glanced at "Profound Root," "Cultivation Technique," and "Magic" where "Life Span Calculation" was available.
Song Yan sorted out the relationship between these three.
Profound Root should be the entry-level, also the potential.
Cultivation Technique is the method for acquiring power.
Magic is the method for using power.
In this dangerous Demon Sect, he was eager to become stronger, so his gaze swept over "Profound Root," and he focused his attention there.
[Please choose the lifespan to invest]
Song Yan began his attempt.
The maximum number of his lifespan also started to decline.
[You invested one year of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root. Profound Root is innate; it either exists or it doesn’t. To cultivate it after birth is impossible without a great opportunity. You didn’t believe in this evil and pondered deeply. On the third day, you entered the Suspended Room. A neglect in the deep night allowed a ghost to knock open the door, and chaotic spirits drilled into your body. You went mad. After dawn, you groggily crawled out of the Suspended Room and fell off a cliff to your death, returning three hundred and sixty-two days of lifespan.]
Song Yan was stunned for a moment.
What is this?
But upon further thought and reflection, he suddenly gained a deeper understanding of the four words "Life Span Calculation."
This calculation is environmental-based; the environment is the one he is currently in. He can’t leave the vicinity of the Tannery and is only subject to "geographical" and "Profound Qi" influences.
As for such words as "Profound Root is innate," they made him extremely uneasy, but he had no choice. Without Profound Root, all hope would be gone. Even if he had this panel, it would be merely empty lifespan, and even if an official disciple came to teach the Guiding Technique, he would not stand out.
Thinking that he might not survive even a month’s time, the subsequent lifespan would be useless no matter how much it was.
Song Yan nervously continued to invest lifespan.
But whether it took five or six days or just two or three days, he was sure to be exploited by ghosts due to a lapse at night, resulting in a miserable death.
As a result, after calculating for a long time, Song Yan found that he couldn’t even use up one year of lifespan.
Died too quickly.
Song Yan pondered briefly and decided to try "psychological suggestion" to attempt other possibilities.
[You invested one year of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root. At dusk, you did not enter the Suspended Room but lay in the Tannery. You were enveloped by a bloody mist, and ghosts came from outside, sheets of skin transformed into ghosts sticking to you, chaotic spirits drilled into your body, you went mad, insanely mad, you lay quietly on the ground, mad beyond imagination.]
This time, a full year of lifespan was consumed.
Song Yan was somewhat dazed, but he gritted his teeth and continued to invest.
[You invested ten years of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root, you continued to lie there, being penetrated by ghosts...]
[You invested ten years of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root, you still lay there, being penetrated by ghosts...]
[You invested ten years of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root, you remained lying there, being penetrated by ghosts...]
’This...’
Song Yan was somewhat speechless. Clearly, in the process of comprehension and calculation, he could not die from hunger, so even though he was mad, he remained lying on the ground.
However, he lost confidence. He glanced at the lifespan on the panel, and the number had already changed to (16/58).
He continued to look at his hands and felt the state of his body.
His hands were not withered, and his body was not weak. Clearly, the reduction in lifespan did not suddenly change his appearance or make him weak.
Only, an indescribable and mysterious feeling was swirling inside his body, as if he had indeed once lain in the Tannery, visited every night by a bloody mist, entered and exited by countless ghosts. This led him to feel that his body was gradually changing.
’Seems like there’s been a change, so let’s keep trying.’
[You invested another ten years of lifespan to comprehend Profound Root]
[In the eighth year, you got up from the ground. Although Profound Root is innate, you were repeatedly penetrated by countless ghosts, and your physique had changed. With some thoughts in mind, this night, outside the house... no ghosts attacked you again]
[In the ninth year, you comprehended a low-quality Ghost Profound Root]
[Note: Low-quality Ghost Profound Root: Enables cultivation from ghosts and the environment formed by ghosts; cultivation method requires a cultivation technique]
[In the tenth year, you tried to gain further insights by allowing ghosts to enter and exit your body again, hoping to comprehend a stronger Profound Root, but the ghosts ignored you. No progress was made this year...]
Low-quality Ghost Profound Root!
Even though the name sounded off, Song Yan was overjoyed.
This was from zero to one.
Moreover, the way it was accomplished was worthy of the phrase "great opportunity."
Who else in the world could lie in the Tannery for forty years, penetrated by countless ghosts, and not die or go mad?
But the "comprehension calculation" does not lead to starvation, so he went mad but did not die.
And when the "calculation" ended, he would return to the real world, so he neither died nor remained mad.
Thus, he was able to comprehend the "low-quality Ghost Profound Root."
More importantly, carrying the Ghost Profound Root meant that even if he was in the bloody mist at night, nothing would happen to him.
...
Just then, a gentle and serene female voice broke Song Yan’s train of thought.
"Hello, Song Yan."
Song Yan looked up and observed the girl in front of him.
To be accurate, this was not a girl but a long-legged young girl with a ponytail, a pleasant face, and eyes like Shui Xing. Despite being a gentle girl, there was a dignified heroic spirit around her, easily reminiscent of a chivalrous woman from the Jianghu.
Song Yan recalled and recognized this girl; she was a newcomer from the same batch as him, assigned yesterday at the recruiting hall.
The girl raised her sign, showing: Qi Yao, servant, Shadow Puppet 265.
Song Yan lifted his gaze from the sign.
Qi Yao looked at him intently and seriously said, "Last night you entered the house with that woman but separated today. Why?"
Song Yan answered directly, "Because I refused to share the same bed with her."
Qi Yao was more direct, "You don’t like women?"
Song Yan said, "I just don’t want to be forced to do such things when I’m completely ignorant and surrounded by danger."
Qi Yao’s expression softened considerably, saying, "It seems you haven’t lost your mind or given up."
Then she softly added, "Last night, I stayed alone in a room, and I saw this morning’s situation, so I know that in this place, it’s gambling with one’s life to want to stay alone.
I also saw the women who went with other men into houses and vaguely understood what happened there.
I don’t want that, but I must find someone to keep watch together at night.
I can’t trust the old servants here, and you... are from the same batch that was abducted with me.
Song Yan, you also need a roommate, so... shall we team up?"
Song Yan lowered his eyes slightly.
Although he could already stay alone in a room and even leave the door open to watch the stars at midnight, through his simulations in comprehension, he understood that nobody could be lucky every day, never dozing off every night. Sooner or later, something would happen within two or three days or at most five or six days.
If nothing happened, it meant there was a problem.
Not knowing exactly what the "Ghost Profound Root" was, he wouldn’t act rashly.
So, he nodded and smiled, "I was actually worrying about what to do tonight."
Qi Yao also breathed a sigh of relief, smiling sweetly, "I’ll sit across from you. Tonight... together."

chapters.title: Chapter 5. We are all good people
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: 5. We are all good people
In the Skin Making Room, Song Yan and Qi Yao sat quietly facing each other, each taking a new beast skin to start cleaning.
The sky would turn dark soon, but they could prepare a bit ahead for tomorrow.
Song Yan arrived here two days ago. Being in this environment, just by listening to the conversations of other servants with raised ears, he could learn some basic information: Shadow Puppet Peak demands from every servant a "daily production of one regular shadow puppet." Thirty regular shadow puppets yield 1 Contribution Point, which is universally used throughout the Puppet Sect. Hence, if you’re fast enough, you can take on some other errands, connect more with official disciples of the sect, and become familiar with them. This way, if you’re somewhat talented or something good happens in the future, the chance of it falling on you will be slightly bigger.
However, according to his observations, most of the servants here indeed can only achieve "a daily production of one regular shadow puppet."
This is somewhat strange because it’s only his second day here, and he has already made two shadow puppets.
Why can’t those skilled servants do the same?
Watching Song Yan’s swift actions, Qi Yao suddenly spoke softly, "Don’t work too fast, you’ll injure your hand."
Song Yan paused.
Qi Yao slowly scraped the remaining fur off the skin in front of her, speaking in a conversational tone, "Yesterday, I wasn’t sitting with you, and something happened around me. There was a servant whose arm was in unbearable pain, but he kept enduring it. However, during carving, he eventually made a mistake and didn’t hold onto the knife handle tightly, which resulted in the carving knife cutting his hand with blood flowing rapidly, making it impossible for him to complete the shadow puppet work. He completely broke down..."
"And then?"
"Then, I didn’t see him today."
Song Yan was silent for a moment, then he slightly probed and realized it must be an unspoken rule: when working here, you can’t get injured, and if you stop working due to an injury, the Demon Sect won’t wait for you to recover; they’ll dispose of you directly.
Every seasoned servant tries their best to ensure their arms are uninjured and unexhausted before completing their daily shadow puppet work.
Thinking of this, Song Yan put down the scraper and stretched his fingers
Sure enough, there was a faint soreness in the tiger’s mouth area and the sheath tendon.
Even though it was ordinary beast skin, the material was quite hard and resilient. To carve something on it, even just to create a shape, required him to clench his cheeks and muster all his strength.
Eventually, it was unrealistic not to have sore fingers.
Song Yan looked at the girl across from him, smiling, "Thanks a lot."
As he said this, a red glow was already casting down beside them, and Song Yan looked up, seeing the sunset hanging among the mountains outside the window.
"It’s getting dark."
"Yes."
After a brief conversation, Song Yan quickly stood up and followed Qi Yao towards the Suspended Room. They encountered Wang Susu on the way, who was accompanied by another young man. The two of them acted like strangers, not even glancing at each other.
That night, he and Qi Yao took turns keeping watch, remaining quite peaceful.
Unlike the previous night when he was preventing Wang Susu from approaching, tonight it was Qi Yao preventing him from getting close.
This spirited young lady even drew boundaries on the bed, placing their bedding separately on either side, and even during the watch, the other couldn’t cross the line.
So, three days passed in a flash.
In these three days, everything remained peaceful.
To prevent injury to his hands, Song Yan reduced his shadow puppet production speed to one per day, achieving three in three days, and gained 31 years of longevity, increasing his total from 48 to 79.
However, curiously, Qi Yao gritted her teeth and made five shadow puppets in three days.
He was very curious and asked, "Why?"
Qi Yao simply replied, "I want to gather 1 Contribution Point quickly to exchange for something," and provided no further explanation.
Between her and Song Yan, there seemed to be nothing more than a relationship of roommates, companions.
Even if they were a lonely man and woman, staying in the same room, interacting day and night, even if sharing the same bed, no spark of romance ignited between them.
It wasn’t surprising, Song Yan quickly figured out the reason.
He was quite plain-looking, whereas the girl, though not stunning, was rather pretty. Her being with him wasn’t due to fancying him, but for safety and the fact that he still had his sanity.
The possibility of love at first sight happening to him was out of the question.
Thus, he suddenly became curious as to why Wang Susu was so proactive toward him.
That night, he changed shifts and sat on the fifth step of the stairs to keep watch.
As they brushed shoulders, there was no initial wariness.
Clearly, after a few days of interaction, they had built a basic trust with each other, and the conversation became somewhat casual.
Song Yan called out, "Qi Yao."
Qi Yao was lying in the bedding, yawning, and responded casually, "Yes."
Song Yan pondered and said, "That day, when I was with Wang Susu in the room, Wang Susu almost lunged at me to forcibly make me perform rites, and afterward, I grabbed a small knife, allowing us to confront each other until daylight.
You tell me, why would she go to such extremes?"
He wasn’t expecting an answer, simply speaking out his confusion to the one person who could converse with him in the Demon Sect.
Qi Yao was silent for a moment and suddenly said, "Do you know nothing about Profound Root?"
"Of course not."
"I... have heard a bit and can tell you, perhaps once you hear it you’ll understand."
Qi Yao hesitated slightly, then began narrating gently, "Profound Root is the fundamental basis for humans to access Profound Qi, without this, don’t even think about cultivation.
Yet, Profound Root itself is divided into grades.
The lowest is called ’Human Profound Root,’ also known as Miscellaneous Profound Root. These cultivators primarily practice Dual Cultivation, absorbing Yang Primordial or Yin Primordial from their partners to cultivate. They can also take elixirs for cultivation, but elixirs are expensive and hard to come by, making Dual Cultivation more efficient and cost-effective.
These individuals will maintain a partner, nourishing them with heavenly treasures to keep their spirit vibrant and their Yang and Yin Primordial robust.
However, even so, the outcome of Dual Cultivation varies due to differing cultivation techniques.
The Righteous Dao Dual Cultivation method progresses slowly, but when cultivators absorb their partner’s primordial energy, they feedback some, extending their partner’s lifespan for good health.
Yet the Evil Daoist Technique progresses extremely fast, as cultivators treat their partners like drugs, madly absorbing without consideration, despite supplements, their partners cannot live long and often die young... Without supplements, they die even quicker."
After saying this, she stopped and said, "Perhaps Wang Susu is indeed a Miscellaneous Profound Root; she’s practicing Dual Cultivation Technique. If she succeeds in her cultivation, she might escape her servant status and become an official disciple of the Puppet Sect."
Song Yan said, "Then I’ll look at the boy who entered the room with her tomorrow."
Qi Yao said, "No need to look."
"Why?"
"I’ve observed for you, his spirit is weak, yet he clings to Wang Susu, clearly Wang Susu has exchanged Contribution Points for many items, among them perhaps Fanatic Fans or similar."
"Fanatic Fans?"
"Yes, an Evil Sect powder that mixes one’s hair burned to ash into the powder, making the target, upon inhaling it, grow affection for the person who used the powder, wanting to perform those acts with her."
Song Yan:...
He felt a chill of fear, now almost certain that Wang Susu might indeed have been doing this.
Thankfully, he grabbed the knife quickly that day; a moment slower, had he inhaled the Fanatic Fans by accident, he feared he might be on the path to becoming a diminishing dreg.
"These Evil Demons, in cultivation, use every possible extreme, bringing disaster to the world, truly venomous." Qi Yao clenched her fist, her expression full of hatred.
Hearing this, Song Yan froze for a moment.
Qi Yao asked, "Don’t you hate them?"
Song Yan nodded repeatedly, "Yes, I hate them."
Qi Yao beamed with a smile, "I knew you were a good person. You must understand my thoughts. Good night."
"Hey, Sister Qi, you haven’t mentioned other types of Profound Root yet."
"I’m sleepy, let’s talk tomorrow.
Besides... Profound Root or not, it has nothing to do with you.
You were abducted as a servant; surviving is the most important thing. Don’t think about things unrelated to you.
If you can escape the Demon Sect and return to the mortal realm one day, then find a lovely bride, work at sunrise, rest at sunset, and live peacefully."
Saying so, Qi Yao turned over, speaking no further.
The night, deepened...
But, Song Yan wouldn’t let her sleep.
The woman before him obviously knew about Profound Root, and this was a great chance for him to learn about the world, how could he miss it just for being a gentleman?
If she didn’t want to speak, should it just end like this?
So, he shouted boldly, "Sister Qi, tell me, I want to hear. Sister Qi? Sister Qi, don’t sleep!"
Qi Yao:...
Song Yan laughed, "I know, you’re a good person too. We, are good people."

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Refining Profound Level 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Refining Profound Level 1
Qi Yao never expected this young man to have such a rascal side, when he said he would pester her, he really did. She had no choice but to reveal some things about Profound Root in order to get some sleep, as this information was merely common knowledge to her, without any secrets.
"Medium Profound Root is known as ’Earth Profound Root.’ People with this Profound Root Talent, apart from Dual Cultivation and Elixirs, can also absorb Profound Qi from Profound Stones to cultivate.
Elixirs are expensive, but there are quite a few Profound Stones, and some Grotto Heaven Blessed Lands even have Profound Veins, which are underground concealed Profound Stone mines."
"So those with Miscellaneous Profound Root can’t absorb Profound Qi from Profound Stones?"
"They can, but the absorption efficiency is extremely low, essentially a waste.
Above Medium level is Superior.
Superior Profound Root is called ’Five Elements Profound Root,’ consisting of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, totaling five kinds.
Cultivators with this Profound Root, besides Dual Cultivation, Elixirs, and Profound Stones, can also absorb Five Elements Profound Qi for cultivation in certain special environments, and they can better perform techniques in their respective Profound Root realms."
"Beyond that is the legendary Profound Root, known as Celestial Profound Root. Those with this Profound Root can absorb Spiritual Qi anywhere, even in bustling markets, truly monsters among monsters.
The so-called Celestial Profound Root means that under the sky, every place is a cultivation land."
Song Yan heard a complete round but didn’t hear about "Ghost Profound Root," so he asked, "Is that all?"
"Mm."
Qi Yao was already very sleepy.
Song Yan glanced at the red mist outside the gap and asked, "Then... can those ghost entities cultivate?"
Qi Yao yawned and said, "Heaven and Earth, Humans and Five Elements, these Profound Roots are conventional, natural roots. But there are many special Profound Roots in the world, and of what you speak, I happen to know a little.
As long as ghost entities seize the dying or dead cultivators, they can possibly be reborn, combining the original Profound Root inside the cultivator’s body to produce a special root known as Ghost Profound Root. With this Profound Root entering the door of cultivation again, they become Ghost Cultivators.
The status of Ghost Profound Root is actually similar to the Five Elements Profound Root; besides Dual Cultivation, Elixirs, and Profound Stones, they can additionally absorb Profound Qi from an environment, which is Earth Demon."
While speaking, she pointed into the distance, saying, "Outside here is a rolling mist, where any living person would be attacked by ghost entities, but it’s a great place for ghost cultivation.
However, there are very few Ghost Cultivators, because both the Righteous Dao and evil paths pay attention to cleaning battlefields, not allowing cultivators’ corpses to fall into the wild.
This is largely attributed to the terror of Ghost Cultivators.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Ghost Cultivators and Five Elements Profound Root cultivators have significant differences.
Five Elements Profound Root cultivators can enhance their corresponding area’s techniques, whereas Ghost Cultivators will distort those ordinary techniques, causing them to slowly twist and mutate, leaning towards Illusion Techniques and Devouring, these more terrifying aspects."
"I didn’t expect the Cultivation Realm to be this frightening."
"Alright, these are just things I heard before, I don’t know if they’re true or not, don’t bother me anymore."
Qi Yao rolled up in her blanket and fell asleep.
Song Xuan stared at her for a while and slightly closed his eyes.
...
...
Early the next day.
A Profound Robe disciple with a fierce aura appeared on the mountain top.
The back of the Profound Robe was embroidered with a meaninglessly strange shadow puppet double-faced face: a half-smiling and half-weeping face, features delicately ambiguous, indistinguishable between male and female.
This is the uniform for disciples of the Shadow Puppet Peak among the Five Peaks of Puppet Sect.
Disciples wear Profound Robes, Elders wear white robes.
This Profound Robe disciple wasted no words, directly gathering the hundred newcomers brought in two days prior, plainly stating: "I’m the disciple here for Transmission of Skills. There might have been shortcomings in the previous Profound Root testing, so I’m here for a second test."
Having said that, he took out a Jade Scroll from his chest, saying: "This is the most basic ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique.’ Each of you come up and touch this Jade Scroll, after receiving the content, go and cultivate.
The Profound Qi here is scarce, so as long as you can guide even a wisp of Profound Qi within a year, you’ll pass, and then have a chance to go to Shadow Puppet Peak’s main peak.
On the main peak, Profound Qi is abundant, without Earth Demon mists, it’s a safe place for cultivation.
No more talking, come, let’s start with you."
The Profound Robe disciple raised his hand and randomly pointed at a servant closest to him.
The servant stepped forward, holding the Jade Scroll, closing his eyes for a brief moment, then suddenly stiffened, eyes opening wide with a dazed look, seemingly struck by an influx of information causing a temporary dizziness.
The Profound Robe disciple, indifferent to whether or not he absorbed completely, nonchalantly retracted his hand, saying: "Next."
The second servant quickly stepped forward.
The previous servant took quite a while to recover, his eyes revealing slight disappointment, evidently... he had no trace of Profound Root, and his Spiritual Power was weak, which is why he was thrown into chaos by just a hint of impact.
But the performance of the second servant made this servant feel a lot better.
The second servant also fainted.
Song Yan deliberately moved to the back, carefully observing the people’s reactions in front.
The majority of servants would faint, the difference being that some seemed to remember something after fainting, while others only recalled fragments of information.
When it was Qi Yao’s turn, she held the Jade Scroll without dizziness and absorbed it in full.
Just then, a young servant who occasionally lowered his head to cough walked up; Song Yan recognized him as the one who entered with Wang Susu.
This young servant, like the others, placed his hand on the Jade Scroll, but in just a breath or two, his entire body shook as if struck by lightning. He let go, knelt to the ground, covering his mouth as he coughed desperately, his palms full of blood spots.
The Profound Robe disciple from Shadow Puppet Peak coldly looked down at the young servant, fully aware of the situation, revealing a mocking expression in his eyes as he casually said, "Next."
People went one by one, some disappointed, some delighted.
Soon, it was Song Yan’s turn.
Song Yan raised his hand and grabbed the Jade Scroll, feeling a chill, and suddenly a heap of information formed in his mind, but these didn’t impact him.
After observing, he noticed no one let go immediately upon grasping the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique"; the fastest took five to six breaths, while the slowest took over ten.
So, he counted to seven in his mind before letting go.
The Profound Robe disciple continued, "Next."
Song Yan returned to the crowd, and saw Qi Yao looking at him in astonishment, saying, "I didn’t expect this."
Song Yan replied, "Me neither."
...
...
[Name: Song Yan]
[Life Span: 16/79]
[Talent: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]
[Realm: Non-Flow]
[Profound Root: Inferior Ghost Profound Root (capable of Life Span Calculation)]
[Cultivation Technique: Profound Qi Guiding Technique (Reduced Version) (capable of Life Span Calculation)]
[Magic: None (capable of Life Span Calculation)]
Song Yan focused his attention on [Cultivation Technique].
[Please select life span to invest]
Song Yan began his attempt.
His life span maximum quickly started to decrease.
[You invested a year to comprehend the reduced version of "Profound Qi Guiding Technique." Areas scant in Profound Qi for others are ideal cultivation places for you. You cultivate within the foul mist, progressing swiftly, but due to your inferior Ghost Profound Root... the speed is mediocre. In half a year, you finally sense a wisp of evil Qi being extracted from the mist into your body. You continue to comprehend, extracting two more wisps of evil Qi in the next half year.]
Song Yan felt a surge of comfort within, his grip on the carving knife strengthened slightly, and although his physique showed no muscle change, his constitution improved considerably.
Clearly, "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" is a universal technique for absorbing Profound Qi, essentially entry-level cultivation.
It simply records an extremely widespread "Guiding Technique," indicating several places where it can be applied: Dual Cultivation, Elixirs, Exotic Flowers and Herbs, Profound Stones.
The method involves confirming a "target with Profound Qi," then operating this technique, keeping a focused mind, extracting a wisp of Profound Qi from the target.
A hundred wisps form a strand.
Song Yan attempted to set the target as "foul mist," and succeeded.
[You invested twenty years in comprehending the reduced version of "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," harvesting 80 strands of evil Qi.]
[You invested ten years in comprehending the reduced version of "Profound Qi Guiding Technique." In the fifth year, a hundred strands formed a flow that circulated through your body, nurturing your meridians, limbs, and flesh. You continued cultivating; in the eighth year, you sank this flow into your Dantian, stepping into the first layer of the Refining Profound Realm. You continued guiding Profound Qi, improving the Guiding Technique in the tenth year, and realized the full version of "Profound Qi Guiding Technique."]
On the panel, Song Yan’s [Realm] leaped from "Non-Flow" to "Refining Profound Realm Layer One."
However, his life span reverted back to "(16/48)."
The youth retracted his gaze, picked up the beast hide in front, and continued today’s skin-making.
Yet... today was different from yesterday.
Yesterday, after carving a Shadow Puppet on the hide, his fingers would ache, but today this issue was resolved.
Song Yan glanced over these beast hides, a subtle feeling arose within him: he could carve as many as he wanted, his arms would no longer suffer because of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 7. Even a small qualification can lead to an increase in status.
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: 7. Even a small qualification can lead to an increase in status.
After comprehending the complete "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," Song Yan spent another year of life trying the difference between the full version and the reduced version, and found that the evil profound he could absorb each year increased from "4 wisps" to "20 wisps".
This made him quite emotional.
A mere difference in cultivation techniques led to a fivefold efficiency gap; this was just the most basic "Profound Qi Guiding Technique." If it were some other secret technique, who knows how much wider the gap would be.
Even in the same environment and with the same Profound Root talent, different cultivation techniques could result in vastly different outcomes.
In other words, with his inferior Ghost Profound Root, it took him twenty-five or six years in this bloody mist environment to advance to the first layer of Refining Profound. But if he had started with the complete version of the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," it would have taken only five years.
This was just the impact of the cultivation technique alone.
Other influences and variables were undoubtedly more numerous.
Some may achieve in a year or even a few months what took him twenty-five or six years.
After a brief thrill following his breakthrough, Song Yan calmed down. After a brief analysis, he thought of the deep scheming of a servant like Wang Susu and recalled those servants who lost their lives for various reasons. This made him increasingly cautious.
In the Demon Sect, life is very cheap.
People die every day.
If they die, they die.
’This place is full of crises, with too many unknowns. To survive, one must better understand this environment and then consider the future.’
Song Yan glanced at Qi Yao, who had returned to her seat and was furiously making skins, and he picked up the carving knife.
Today, he decided to carve two skins, one tomorrow, two the day after, mixing it up so as not to stand out.
When he collected 30 skins, he would have 1 Contribution Point. By then, using Contribution Points, he could access new environments and gather more information.
...
...
That night...
No moonlight, autumn rain fell on the mountains, instantly enveloping the thousand peaks and valleys,
Inside the Suspended Room, once the six blankets were drawn, it was so dark that one couldn’t see their fingers. Though there were some lighting items in the Demon Sect, newly arrived servants could not own them.
During the night watch, Song Yan moved slightly, making a little noise. From the bed came Qi Yao’s tense and alert voice.
"What are you doing?"
"Itching."
"Where’s itching?"
"Leg."
"Which part of the leg?"
"..."
"Song Yan, I’m telling you, I’ve read the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique,’ just like you have. Whatever you know, I know too. So don’t even think about siphoning my Yin energy!"
"Don’t you want to absorb my Yang energy?"
"I don’t!" Qi Yao answered decisively, then continued, "However, I know this is your only chance.
On this isolated cliff, without Profound Stones, without Elixirs, the overlooked disciples must all have inferior Profound Roots.
In this situation, the only way to cultivate a wisp of Profound Qi in a year is through Dual Cultivation, by siphoning Yin and Yang energy.
The Demon Sect is like this.
Yet, I never thought you’d manage to successfully extract the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ from the Jade Scroll, as even among the servants, inferior Profound Roots aren’t common."
The imposing young girl sighed softly, then said, "Tomorrow, you should move out and find a girl without Profound Root talent to be with."
Song Yan asked, "And what about you."
Qi Yao coldly replied, "I will live alone."
In the darkness, Song Yan narrowed his eyes, his lips moved as if to speak, but he swallowed his words.
Though he had lived in the same room as Qi Yao for several days and they got along well, how much did he really know about her?
Qi Yao’s demeanor made him feel there was something off.
No.
Not strange, but out of place with her identity as a servant.
Servants, whose lives aren’t even guaranteed, would never hate "the Demon Sect" or likely know so much about Profound Root, especially Ghost Profound Root. Nor could they conveniently successfully extract the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique." Her calm attitude seemed to imply she knew she would succeed right from the start.
Qi Yao has secrets.
Songs Yan also has his own.
It’s a grave mistake to speak too deeply in a shallow relationship.
He couldn’t make such a mistake just because she was beautiful.
So it’s better they part ways.
Thus, Song Yan gently advised, "Sister Qi, you are a good person. But you’d better not live alone. Look for someone else."
Qi Yao remained silent.
The two were silent the entire night. At dawn the next day, the rain stopped, and soon it was daylight. After leaving the Suspended Room, they acted like strangers, avoiding eye contact, and even in the Tannery they didn’t sit together.
...
...
Chirr, chirr chirr, chirr chirr chirr...
Song Yan lowered his head, carefully scraping the animal skin on the stone table.
After entering the first layer of Refining Profound Realm, the Profound Qi, like a small stream, meandered within his body, nurturing his flesh and blood.
He was much stronger than before, and when wielding the knife, his wrist and fingers no longer felt pain.
However, he didn’t show ease or speed, working just as he did the previous day.
After a while, he blew away the remaining hairs and was about to proceed to the next step when he noticed a tall girl walking toward him quickly. Behind her, a man suddenly realized and hastily got up to follow.
The tall girl quickened her pace, and the man chased closely.
The girl started running, surprising the man, who then suddenly sped up.
With a scream, the girl dashed toward Song Yan like she was fleeing for her life, then sat down quickly across from him. The man paused, glanced at Song Yan, but dared not approach.
The girl had a quiet demeanor, seemed somewhat knowledgeable and cultured, with a delicate face and rounded hips, not like someone familiar with hardships, suggesting she came from a well-off family before being captured here.
Song Yan vaguely remembered her as one of the new batch of servants who came with him.
Now, panting, the girl looked pitifully at Song Yan, nervously and expectantly saying, "Brother Song, are you now alone?"
Song Yan replied, "Yes."
The girl quickly took out a servant’s Black Wooden Token and showed it hurriedly. On it was carved: Qiu Lianyue, servant, Shadow Puppet 517.
"Brother Song, I want to be with you." Qiu Lianyue said urgently, "I’m still a virgin; I’ve let no other man touch me."
Song Yan asked, "Why choose me?"
Qiu Lianyue replied, "Yesterday among the hundred or more people, only five managed to successfully extract the cultivation technique from the Jade Scroll, and Brother Song, you were one of them. You have the potential to become an Official Disciple of the Shadow Puppet Peak, and I... I have no talent, so I want to follow you."
She clasped her hands tightly, her body slightly trembling.
Song Yan nodded.
He indeed needed a woman; otherwise, he couldn’t explain "how he successfully guided Profound Qi" a year later.
Qiu Lianyue completely relaxed, and the man standing nearby also stopped staring and hurriedly walked away.
With the potential to become an Official Disciple, he was already above what these servants could aspire to, and in terms of status, he was higher.
Even if trouble arose, an Official Disciple wouldn’t care about right or wrong and would directly side with those with potential to become an Official Disciple.
Qiu Lianyue had initially shared a room with him, but during their time together, though the man attempted several times to claim her body, he never got close. She held a sharp stone from the cliff edge, like a dagger, firmly pointed at him, refusing to let him near him.
He once thought this woman might be quite chaste, but now it seems... she was unwilling to let him touch her but actively sought protection from another man; she merely wanted to trade her body for shelter.
As the man walked away, he cursed softly, "Slut."
Naturally, Song Yan understood Qiu Lianyue’s intention and found it amusing.
Indeed, he didn’t require Dual Cultivation, but for someone else, this girl... wasn’t she a sheep delivering itself to a lion, courting death?
Was this girl wrong in her actions?
No, she made what she thought was the best choice. It was merely due to a lack of information.
Song Yan privately felt a sigh in his heart.
Just as this girl inappropriately judged due to lack of information, he knew he could do so as well.
Observing more, listening more, concealing one’s capabilities, and making fewer judgments are the key to survival.
Seeing Qiu Lianyue still trembling all over and emotionally unstable, Song Yan said, "Let’s work, don’t fall behind with today’s Shadow Puppet progress."
Qiu Lianyue sweetly smiled, then took a deep breath as if surviving a disaster, collected her animal skin and the scraping knife, and sat opposite Song Yan, scraping skillfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 8. Foothill Market
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: 8. Foothill Market
[You absorbed the remaining lifespan of a gray donkey: 9 years]
After Song Yan completed the shadow puppet, the information popped up again, his lifespan had once more increased.
Looking at how easily he gained lifespan, feeling the power of the first layer of Profound Refining within him, and knowing his Ghost Profound Root now had no fear of the foul mist, Song Yan felt like he could hide here forever.
But there was a problem that needed solving, and that was concealing his aura.
What would happen if, in a year during the test, the disciples or the Elder discovered that the profound qi in his body was not just a mere "strand" but had formed a spring?
Would they be shocked at his unparalleled talent and fight amongst themselves to take him as their disciple?
Song Yan silently shook his head.
First of all, he was assigned to be a servant because his aptitude wasn’t good; the ability to cultivate profound qi was only due to his inferior profound root.
Among inferior profound roots, the Ghost Profound Root was already on par with the Five Elements Profound Root, ranking as a high-grade profound root.
Above that was only the legendary Celestial Profound Root.
With his Ghost Profound Root, he had cultivated for twenty-five or six years in the foul mist to cultivate a spring’s worth of profound qi, what... kind of great opportunity would it take to cultivate that in just one year?
He couldn’t think of it, nor could others easily imagine it.
Thus, the greatest possibility was that he would be "dissected" and used with techniques like the "Soul Searching Technique" he had read in novels before transmigration, to uncover secrets.
This is the Demon Sect!
However, Song Yan didn’t think he would necessarily be discovered, after all, testing servants was such a minor task, and chances were it wouldn’t be so strict, so perhaps his worrying was unnecessary.
But he didn’t dare gamble, since there was a possibility, he needed to find a solution and then steadily transition to the next level.
A technique for concealing aura!
He urgently needed this!
Within a year’s time, he had to find a way to obtain it.
...
...
In the afternoon, during the unmarked hour, there was a bit of commotion outside the Tannery, Song Yan turned his head to look, and saw more than ten new servants being brought in.
He returned his gaze.
The turnover rate for servants was quite fast, replenishing people was normal.
Qiu Lianyue’s eyes flashed with some fear, she lowered her head and continued skin making.
Soon, it was evening.
In the twilight sunset, as Song Yan stood up, Qiu Lianyue hurriedly leaned close, grabbing his arm as if clutching a lifeline, a soft form pressing onto him.
Song Yan let her cling to him, saying: "Let’s pick a new room."
"Okay." Qiu Lianyue nodded like a hen pecking rice.
The two followed the crowd out of the Tannery.
As they walked, Song Yan’s gaze suddenly flicked over, he just happened to catch sight of Qi Yao, who was speaking with a man at the edge of the cliff behind an old tree.
Recognizing him, Song Yan furrowed his brow slightly, a strange premonition arose in his heart.
Soon after, Qi Yao and that servant walked together towards the Suspended Room.
The new servant suddenly turned his head, seeming to sense being watched, but scanned the crowd without finding the one spying on him.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"What’s wrong?" Qi Yao asked.
"Nothing, we’ll talk inside." The new servant said cautiously, lowering his voice.
After a brief exchange, the two rushed into the Suspended Room.
...
...
Song Yan also entered the Suspended Room, after hanging up the blanket, he lay down comfortably.
In this perilous world, he had already put away all traces of a romantic mindset he might have had before transmigration.
In a place like this, better to act pragmatically.
Qiu Lianyue drew close, her eyes discreetly glanced elsewhere, shyly coming to Song Yan’s side, massaging his shoulders and arms, and as she kneaded, her delicate hands grew bolder, venturing downward, a soft cry, and five fingers caught a dragon...
After events indescribable and colorful occurred, Song Yan took the night shift, while Qiu Lianyue finally had a good sleep.
...
...
Once Song Yan adapted to the Tannery’s environment, the daily routine of skin making turned tedious and monotonous, time sped up.
In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.
In that month, he gained a total of 452 years of lifespan, reaching a maximum of 508.
During this month, to avoid exposure, he occasionally cautiously used the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" to dual cultivate with Qiu Lianyue, causing her body to appear somewhat frail.
Meanwhile, Wang Susu had already changed partners, the previous youth vanished without a trace, Wang Susu simply said "unfit for mountain climate, might have accidentally bumped into evil qi, sigh..."
No one uncovered her lie.
Those unaware naturally didn’t understand dual cultivation.
Those who knew were accomplices, why would they say anything? Even if they did, what could be done? Mountain evil qi was plenty, the foul mist may only appear at night, but it could also pervade the air during the day, causing some unlucky souls to encounter it; it wasn’t uncommon for servants to die this way. Servants had become accustomed.
On this day, an Official Disciple from Shadow Puppet Peak arrived, checking everyone’s skin making count, handing out a small Jade Token to disciples who reached a count of 30, instructing: "The Jade Token records Contribution Points, just hold it to check.
If you wish to use Contribution Points, go down the mountain.
There’s a small low-level marketplace there, outside disciples may set up stalls, as may outsiders, but outsiders can’t take your Contribution Points; they may ask you to use Contribution Points to buy things.
Contribution Points are precious outside the sect, they can buy a lot of gadgets. But remember, if you delay your shadow puppet tasks due to visiting the mid-mountain area, you won’t have good consequences."
Song Yan grasped the Jade Token, examined it; he had exactly 2 Contribution Points in his token, and the Official Disciple’s words made him think the Tannery was likely located at the edge of Shadow Puppet Peak, yet he was curious... how could outsiders do business in a place like the Demon Sect?
He was pondering this, when felt his arm nudged.
Turning his head to see Qiu Lianyue staring at him with beautiful eyes, she softly said: "Brother Song, my Jade Token has 1 Contribution Point too, take it."
Song Yan accepted it.
Qiu Lianyue forced a smile.
Her survival now fully depended on the man before her.
Song Yan feigned curiosity, looked towards the Official Disciple, and asked: "Sir, can I use someone else’s Jade Token too?"
The disciple who gave out the tokens was the same as the Transmission of Skills disciple from that day, looked at Song Yan, then at the weak girl beside him, understanding this could be a future junior brother, said: "Of course you can use it, I didn’t say the Jade Tokens recorded names."
After speaking, he added softly: "But don’t worry too much, in daylight, anyone daring to commit acts on Shadow Puppet Peak hasn’t been born yet; at night... you all return to the mountain top, naturally no trouble."
Song Yan nodded thoughtfully, bowed and said: "Thank you."
...
...
Having obtained Contribution Points, Song Yan didn’t plan to go immediately, preferring to observe others first.
The increase in lifespan endowed him with a previously absent quality, patience.
He had ample time, making him extremely patient.
If spending a day or two could allow him to learn more about a place he was about to visit, he would wait without hesitation.
But this evening, after returning to the Suspended Room and joking with Qiu Lianyue, she lay in his arms, whispering: "Brother Song, before I was taken, I was actually the daughter of a business association, so I know a little about the marketplace that gentleman mentioned.
Though ordinary people may be there, they are all ruthless bandits, selling stolen goods they seized...
You must be careful going there."
She looked nervously at Song Yan, afraid he might encounter danger.
The reason for giving Song Yan her Contribution Points was also out of fear of dying halfway, being a businessperson, she was too accustomed to words like "anyone daring to commit acts on Shadow Puppet Peak hasn’t been born yet."
Trading goods, who doesn’t boast? Especially the cunning Demon Sect?
Song Yan gazed at the girl in his arms, patted her head, saying: "Got it."
Then added: "Your body is weak, I’ll see if there are any tonics, if so, I’ll bring some for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Where do you think this is?
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Where do you think this is?
The next morning, Song Yan hurriedly finished today’s shadow puppets, then came outside the tannery, stretched his arms, and yawned.
In the distance, the mountain peaks stood majestically clustered together, as if they had descended halfway from the sky.
The view towards Shadow Puppet Peak’s main peak was clear, but the other side appeared to have a strange blood-red haze, which was the blood fog.
Over the past month or so, Song Yan had observed that blood fog frequently; it almost never dispersed, even after several nights of continuous autumn rain, yet by daybreak, the fog didn’t subside but instead intensified.
The dense blood fog swirled quietly, intertwining like a crimson python, or a pool of the red sea.
The blood fog encountered during the night at the tannery was quite deadly for the servants but perhaps... it was merely the shallow waves of that red sea at high tide.
No one knew what lay at the center of that blood fog.
Song Yan’s gaze could only reach the outside, yet such a scene was enough to send chills through his heart.
But then he remembered that he might be a Ghost Spirit Root.
Then... no problem.
Having a ghost come and go from the body of a mortal for forty years without dying or going insane had cultivated a Ghost Spirit Root, not for nothing.
While he was gazing into the distance, a voice came from beside him.
"Brother Song."
Song Yan turned his head, seeing a man and a woman standing beside him.
The man was about thirty, slightly plump, appearing very friendly.
The woman was around twenty-five or twenty-six, her expression serious.
Song Yan knew both; they were fellow new servants, two of the five who succeeded in "absorbing the Profound Qi Guiding Technique" that day.
The man’s name was Sheng Dazhu, and the woman’s name was Wen Erniu.
Song Yan returned the gesture.
Sheng Dazhu smiled warmly and said, "Brother Song, we’re from the same group, why not go with us to the market at the foot of the mountain, we can look out for each other."
Wen Erniu’s serious face relaxed and sincerely said, "The situation at the foot of the mountain is unknown; we should stick together, Brother Song. There’s plenty of time in the future, we may even become true brothers and sisters one day, let’s make good relations now."
The reasoning seemed sound from every perspective.
However, Song Yan shook his head and replied with a smile, "I don’t want to go today."
Sheng Dazhu laughed, "Then... no rush, whenever Brother Song wants to go down, we’ll go together."
Song Yan squinted slightly.
He clearly remembered that at night, Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu shared a room, and back when they absorbed the Profound Qi Guiding Technique, they weren’t as nervous as the usual servants.
Moreover, their manner of speaking and acting was quite unlike their names, suggesting that "Dazhu" and "Erniu" were likely aliases.
As they conversed, Wen Erniu became restless, waving and calling to the tannery inside with a smile, "There should be lots of good stuff at the market; anyone with Contribution Points, let’s team up!"
Instantly, many servants rushed out.
The servants already wanted to get close to these "future Official Disciples," plus they were reluctant to go down to the market alone, so they all ran out at once, saying, "We’ll go down with Sister Wen," "And Brother Dazhu, we’ll go together, more safety in numbers."
However, not all servants joined; some didn’t plan to team up and intended to go down alone.
Sheng Dazhu was still grinning at Song Yan, seemingly waiting for his agreementNᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
However... Song Yan decisively declined, saying, "I still have to do some tanning," and walked away.
Sheng Dazhu continued to smile, seemingly unbothered, then turned to the new servants and struck up a conversation in a chatty manner, adding, "Everyone, hurry and finish today’s shadow puppets, then we can head down. If anyone’s running late, I’ll lend a hand."
One servant immediately responded, "We wouldn’t dare trouble Brother Dazhu."
Sheng Dazhu chuckled, "No trouble at all; we’re all here together, let’s help each other, ha ha."
Song Yan returned to his seat.
Qiu Lianyue asked nervously, "Brother Song, you’re not going today?"
Song Yan shook his head, sweeping his gaze over the old servants.
He noticed that aside from the newest servants sent in the past two months, the older servants seemed indifferent to going down the mountain; even with Contribution Points, they had no desire to leave.
He glanced again at Qi Yao.
Qi Yao was sitting back-to-back with a new roommate from the previous day, also unmoved.
Among this batch of servants, only five had successfully absorbed the Profound Qi Guiding Technique: Song Yan, Qi Yao, Sheng Dazhu, Wen Erniu... and a tall, strong servant named Xu Changjun.
Xu Changjun hadn’t moved either.
Song Yan looked further into the distance.
In the distance, Wang Susu sat amongst the old servants, leisurely crafting leather, her large eyes blinking brightly, seemingly indifferent to the excitement outside.
Song Yan glanced again at those old servants with "no desire to spend" and suddenly felt thoughtful.
...
...
In the afternoon, Song Yan leisurely completed a second ordinary shadow puppet.
After finishing, evening had arrived.
The mist resembled a red demon climbing out from the depths of a chasm, using its sharp claws to scale the precipice, inch by inch.
The servants in the tannery swarmed out in droves.
Qiu Lianyue held the arm of her life-saving straw as she walked toward the house.
However, Song Yan frowned because he realized that the group who went down to the city market after lunch hadn’t returned yet, including Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu.
