At that moment, a graceful figure rushed out from the crowd, quickly reaching Song Yan’s side, speaking softly, "Don’t trust anyone. If you must go to the city market, go at the crack of dawn, as early as possible. Go early, return early, and don’t linger!"
Song Yan turned his head to see.
It was Qi Yao!
But Qi Yao simply walked away quickly after saying these words.
Under normal circumstances, that would be all there was to it.
However, Qi Yao suddenly felt someone grab her hand. Startled, her brows furrowed, and her arm twisted instinctively, a technique common among martial artists.
Yet, she couldn’t shake off the person holding her arm.
Qi Yao glared angrily, only to see that it was Song Yan holding her arm.
"What are you doing?"
"Sister Qi, how about... teaming up with me?"
"How shameless can you be?" Qi Yao could hardly believe her ears. She came to warn him out of kindness, and this guy actually held her hand to propose teaming up, which was utterly presumptuous.
Song Yan grinned and said, "Actually, I wanted to say... thank you."
After saying this, he let go of her hand.
Qi Yao was stunned for a moment, snorted coldly, and hurried away.
...
...
At night, in a suspended room, a man sat in the corner, watching Qi Yao guarding the fifth layer of steps, and said, "You shouldn’t have warned him. With dual cultivation of Demon Sect techniques, he has long been a little demon."
Qi Yao lowered her eyes and whispered, "He doesn’t want to be like this either. When he’s with me, he’s a good person... I don’t want to see him die mysteriously."
The man said sternly, "Eliminating the Puppet Palace means fewer people will die. Your task is to secretly infiltrate the Puppet Palace, providing intelligence for our Sword Sect, in hopes of finding an opportunity to destroy the Puppet Palace entirely!"
Qi Yao said, "I know, many senior and junior students, like me, are doing the same thing..."
The man continued, "And my task is to deliver Profound Stones to you and cover for you! I have an incurable disease, with only two or three years of life left. Dying here would be like dying from dual cultivation with you, which can mislead others and allow you to smoothly become an official disciple of Shadow Puppet Peak."
"Senior Brother..."
"Don’t be sad. With your Earth Profound Root, you should have been nurtured by the masters in Sword Sect, yet you voluntarily came here to take on the task of destroying the Puppet Palace. That’s commendable."
The man sighed deeply and said no more, followed by a pained groan from the darkness.
Blood flowed from the man’s chest, but out fell several strange stones.
Pure as jade, and cold as snow, they emitted a faintly glowing sheen.
These were... Profound Stones.
...
...
"Brother Dazhu, Sister Erniu, what do you mean? It’s dark, and we can’t return to the mountain. We’re staying at the foot of the mountain for the night and agreed to climb together at dawn. What are you doing now?"
"Stay back!"
"How could this happen?"
At the foot of Shadow Puppet Peak, in a hidden camp.
Over twenty servants were nervously watching the surroundings, with only the dense, dark forest around them and sturdy men holding torches.
Those sturdy men were the ones who had been selling goods at a stall in the city market during the day, but now... they surrounded Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu.
The two of them wore expressions of mockery, utterly different from how they appeared during the day.
Among the servants, someone seemed to realize something and shouted, "Sheng Dazhu, how dare you collude with bandits? Have you forgotten what the official disciple said?"
Sheng Dazhu smirked and said, "What words?"
The person said, "Don’t you fear the Shadow Puppet Peak’s retribution for committing crimes here?"
The atmosphere grew quiet, and Sheng Dazhu, Wen Erniu, and the others had strange looks, as if they had heard something incredibly funny, followed by erupting laughter, almost bringing them to tears.
One of the sturdy men respectfully said to Sheng Dazhu, "Boss, these are just fools. They actually believe the words of Demon Sect disciples and still think this is the territory of the Righteous Dao. It’s truly no wonder they’re dying."
Sheng Dazhu said, "Hurry up and kill them all, then give me their contribution points. I and your second sister have talent, and we’ve finally mingled our way into the Demon Sect, aiming to become official disciples of the Demon Sect in the future."
Another sturdy man obsequiously laughed and said, "In the future, we’ll live high on the hog with the boss!"
Sheng Dazhu waved his hand.
The sturdy men, wielding knives, rushed forward.
After a series of miserable cries and wails, the sounds gradually ceased.

chapters.title: Chapter 10. Opening the door to kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: 10. Opening the door to kill
The next day, Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu returned disheveled and distraught, saying as soon as they arrived, "The mountain path was long, and we couldn’t make it back last night. We stayed out overnight and encountered something sinister. All the brothers who went with us disappeared, only the two of us narrowly escaped back."
The disciple who came to collect the shadow puppet just nodded faintly upon hearing this and did not ask further or meddle.
The remaining servants witnessing this scene were suddenly somewhat terrified.
Once again, they realized the horrifying fact that "their lives were as insignificant as grass."
And at this moment, the new servants officially became old servants.
...
A few days later, when there were not many people descending the mountain, three to five old servants emerged from the Suspended Room early in the morning and hurried down the mountain.
These people rushed back hastily during the afternoon, feeling like they just narrowly escaped and heaved a sigh of relief. Their waists or bosoms seemed to bulge with something, presumably weapons.
Song Yan also took advantage of an early morning to quickly leave the Suspended Room and head to the market at the foot of the mountain.
Though the journey was somewhat long, it went smoothly.
According to the disciple who transmitted skills, this market was a low-level market.
However, despite being labeled low-level, it seemed quite well-organized.
Wooden high-footed structures, carts, and stalls made up a large trading market resembling a bustling town corner.
Many of the vendors were shouting, with weapons, concealed weapons, poisons, and Jianghu secrets being sold the most.
Several vendors were shouting, "If you can’t use the cultivating profound items, come here to exchange them for some interesting stuff, guaranteed to satisfy you."
Meanwhile, some other vendors sat quietly inside the building without yelling or speaking, seemingly closing their eyes to nap, while a small jade plate was placed on the table in front of them, alongside a sign saying: Brush with a Jade Token.
Song Yan headed straight for the pavilion, saw the sign, and took out his Jade Token to brush.
With this swipe, something wondrous happened.
Information lines floated into his mind.
Evidently, these silent individuals were indeed official disciples of the Demon Sect, seemingly with average wares, which is why they had come to this low-level market to set up stalls.
Even so, to Song Yan, it was somewhat like Grandma Liu’s first visit to the Grand View Garden—an intriguing experience.
Finished shadow puppets, paper figures, poison talismans, rare medicines, flying swords, and even magic spells were all up for trade.
The shadow puppets produced in the tannery were merely the initial "form."
These "forms" were taken by the official disciples and required time to refine before they could become usable shadow puppets.
The damage rate in this process was very high, even exceeding that of talismans, hence the high demand for shadow puppets, necessitating many servant disciples in the tannery.
Among the rare medicines, Song Yan indeed saw the "Fanatic Fans" that Qi Yao mentioned earlier.
[Fanatic Fans]: Burn hair or skin flakes into powder, mix with the powder, let the target smell it, it can make the target infatuated; the weaker the target’s power, the less powder needed, each bottle can be used up to five times; limited effect on cultivators of the Refining Profound level, priced at 5 Contribution Points.
Regarding magic spells, annotations followed each one.
Some carried one annotation, others two.
Those with one noted, "This spell is not exclusive to the Puppet Palace, acquired externally."
Those with two had additional comments such as "already practiced, usable," "never practiced, roughly read, should be usable," "cultivation entry-level, okay," "incomplete, uncertain if practiceable."
Song Yan swiftly scanned through the magic spell section of merchandise.
He needed to find spells that could hide auras or attack, otherwise, he would merely have the realm of Refining Profound level without being able to effectively exhibit it.
He searched store by store and quickly favored two spells.
[Qi Concealment Technique]: Refining Profound spell, popular spell, never practiced but definitely usable, priced at 49 Contribution Points.
[Qi Arrow Technique]: Refining Profound spell, popular spell, never practiced but definitely usable, priced at 39 Contribution Points.
Evidently, these two spells were very common, belonging to spells that weren’t secrets in the cultivation realm. However, practicing spells also requires time and energy, and no cultivator would spend time on practicing these two.
The former...
In the sect, there’s no time for you to perform, what would you conceal Qi for?
You’re not some extraordinary great cultivator, what’s the point of Qi concealment?
The latter...
It seems to be an extremely ordinary, extremely basic attacking spell.
This point can be imagined.
Profound Qi stored within the body, gathered, released from inside to outside, isn’t it similar to the "Six Meridian Divine Sword" and the like?
But the "Six Meridian Divine Sword" is just a martial arts exercise, belonging to the lowest form of power in the cultivation realm.
If you have other options, who would practice this?
However, even though these two spells were ubiquitous, Song Yan still couldn’t afford them.
Such spells were not something a servant could afford.
Song Yan cast a wistful glance at those two spells, then turned and left, going to the mortal vendors, where he spent 1 Contribution Point to get some items traded by bandits.
Three bottles of "Strengthening Ginseng Pill" to replenish Primordial Qi, a top-grade mind-confusing potion "Long Sleep and Clear Wind," and a sharp dagger that mortals would consider a Divine Weapon.
These three items were evidently uncommon in Jianghu, but here they could be exchanged for just 1 Contribution Point.
...
...
That day, he hurried back to the mountain in the afternoon.
Just then, Sheng Dazhu walked over with a smile, clapping his hands and calling out, "What did Brother Song buy?"
Song Yan shook the bottle in his hand and said, "Bought some Strengthening Ginseng Pill."
As soon as these words came out, several of the "talented ones" among the servants froze.
Everyone relies on Dual Cultivation to refine profound energy, how come you’re maintaining your condition, is it worth it?
Sheng Dazhu glanced at the bottle; he certainly recognized the "Strengthening Ginseng Pill," and then smiled, "Brother Song is truly a good person."
Song Yan said, "Yes, sometimes I also think I’m quite good."
Sheng Dazhu no longer paid attention to him.
He turned around, a mocking smile appeared on his lips.
Initially, he intended to eliminate this rival, after all, they were both "talented at the same time." Who knows if there would be competition later on?
To prevent surprises, it’s better to eliminate earlier.
But now it seems, such a person might not even be worth his effort.
Just a useless waste.
He has his underlings waiting below the mountain to kill this opponent; there would be plenty of chances in the future.
However, the other ones named Qi Yao and Xu Changjun seem not as easy to deal with.
Sheng Dazhu frowned, a trace of obscure thinking flashed in his eyes, but soon he appeared smiling again.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
...
...
Night falls.
Qiu Lianyue, who had kept watch for the first half of the night, came down, and Song Yan fed her a Strengthening Ginseng Pill.
This kind of spiritual elixir from the Jianghu is truly effective for mortals.
Miss Qiu felt warmth inside, all her limbs relaxed, drowsiness surged up; she was truly touched since merchants are profit-driven and dismissive of farewells, who cares about emotions? So, even though Song Yan completely disregarded her, she wouldn’t find it strange.
However... Song Yan actually lived up to his words, spending contribution points to buy her this.
"Brother Song, thank you."
Miss Qiu pulled up the quilt, using the twisted red glow filtering through the gaps, watched the young lad, feeling a bit relaxed for the first time at heart.
"Sleep."
Song Yan said.
Miss Qiu nodded.
After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, her breathing became even.
Song Yan descended steps, came to the bedside, took out the Mind-Confusing Potion named "Long Sleep and Clear Wind" from his bosom, uncorked it, and waved it before Qiu Lianyue’s nose.
A colorless and odorless gas dispersed like a gentle breeze brushing against her body, entering her system with her even breathing.
She... fell into a deeper sleep.
Immediately following, Song Yan took a dagger, shed his clothes stained with his scent, placed them behind the door, and swiftly opened it, darting out into the eerie red mist outside like a spectre.
In the bloody mist, countless ghostly creatures would pounce upon seeing life, trying to possess them.
But they completely ignored Song Yan only because Song Yan possesses Ghost Profound Root.
Song Yan glanced around, the lively solitary cliff in the daytime was completely deserted, his gaze swept over, falling upon the distant Suspended Room of Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu.
...
...
"In a few days when new servants arrive, we’ll act once more, wait till we’ve saved enough Contribution Points, then we can go to a better place as official disciples."
"What about Song Yan, Qi Yao, and Xu Changjun?"
"Someday when they go down the mountain, we’ll follow them and then get our brothers to directly slaughter them.
I’ve researched, the tests are all batch by batch, the fewer competitors in the same batch, the more choices we’ll have later."
"Heh, meeting us is just their bad luck."
Wen Erniu said with a mocking smile.
Suddenly, she heard a fierce and abrupt "bang" noise coming from above.
She was stunned for a moment and instinctively asked urgently, "What’s wrong?"
But the only answer she received was a cry of pain.
In the twisted red light, Sheng Dazhu, who was sitting on high, seemed to be suddenly struck by something terrifying, falling straight down in a humiliating posture, while the door had swung open wide!
Outside the door, in the bloody mist, there came the terrifying clattering sound, skins, bones, remnants, ghostly creatures fiercely rushing in greedily, a deep ghostly shadow silhouette standing quietly at the door, forming a stark contrast with those many jostling ghostly beings.
"No!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 11. Don’t delve too deeply, otherwise...
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: 11. Don’t delve too deeply, otherwise...
Song Yan simply pushed the door open, as if he had sliced open a wound in a swarm of deep sea sharks.
Ghosts surged madly, like a dark, furious tide rushing through the door, entering and exiting Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu’s bodies.
The sky was covered, the moon concealed, and ghostly shadows appeared in droves.
Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu, these two bandit leaders, had completely lost their consciousness. Their bodies, occupied by Evil Qi, began to show some bizarre behaviors, such as sitting up, with one eyeball rolling counterclockwise, and the other clockwise...
Song Yan didn’t use his dagger; he carried it just in case. At this moment, he mingled within the crowded horde of ghosts, quickly made his way into this Suspended Room, and with a brief search, found two Jade Tokens in a drawer box. A quick inspection revealed the number of Contribution Points inside.
Quite a find.
One Jade Token held 30 Contribution Points, and the other had 40 Points.
This utterly shocked Song Yan, his hand even trembled as he held the Jade Tokens, because no matter how he calculated, he couldn’t figure out how these two could have 70 Contribution Points.
He only knew that these two most likely swindled the more than twenty new servants, and now they were eyeing him hungrily.
It was precisely this combination, plus "the high price of spells at the Market Square," that motivated his actions tonight.
Yet even so, these two’s Jade Tokens should contain at most just under 30 Contribution Points, where did the 70 come from?
Song Yan naturally couldn’t guess that these two bandit leaders had accomplices down the mountain who earned a bunch of Contribution Points through trade, allowing for the abundance they possessed.
Overwhelmed with shock, he felt a sense of sudden wealth.
He quickly pulled out his own Jade Token, and with those two Jade Tokens, "swiped" a few times onto his own.
Contribution Points can be transferred this way.
From the first Jade Token, he transferred 20 Points, and from the second, 30 Points.
Leaving each with 10 Points and returning them to their place ensured no "wealth was lost," making it likely for those checking the next day to think it was merely an accident.
But after doing so, Song Yan had another thought.
’These Jade Tokens are quite akin to bank cards from before my transmigration, so... could Official Disciples perhaps possess the ability to ’check transaction records’?’
Missing information can lead to completely opposite conclusions.
This was vividly evident in Qiu Lianyue.
Miss Qiu thought attaching herself to a "future Official Disciple" was a blessing, yet she didn’t realize it actually sent her "into the tiger’s mouth." If not for Song Yan, she would have long been ground into medicinal residue.
Song Yan fell silent for a moment, myriad thoughts rushing through his mind.
He made a decision.
He simply pocketed both Jade Tokens, then hoisted the two grotesquely posed bodies, being entered and exited by ghosts, onto his shoulders, climbed up, and placed them atop the Suspended Room, before swiftly departing.
After leaving, he hid behind a rock and quietly observed for a long time, only returning to his room once he confirmed the two had fallen off the cliff on their own.
Since his aura lingered behind the door, the ghosts did not knock.
Inside, Miss Qiu, affected by the "Long Water Gentle Breeze," was still sound asleep.
Only then did Song Yan let out a long sigh of relief and begin anxiously awaiting the next day.
...
...
As it turned out, the lives of the servants were indeed insignificant.
Not just the dead ones.
The living ones as well.
The investigator was still a disciple in a Profound Robe, only now the eerie two-faced Shadow Puppet emblem on his back was not black, but... red.
If a Profound Robe with a Profound Map signifies an Official Disciple, and a white robe denotes an Elder, then this Profound Robe with a red emblem symbolizes an Inner Sect Disciple.
Two people in one house, especially two "people with a chance of becoming Official Disciples" in one house, disappearing was reason enough for Shadow Puppet Peak to send someone to take a look.
But the investigator was unconcerned about the two who died; he was just curious about the process, so he was too lazy to ask questions, instead grabbing the "servant from next door to Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu," closing his eyes, and pointing a finger at the servant’s brow.
After a long time, he withdrew his finger, and the servant whose brow had been touched immediately looked dazed, then was swiftly cleaned up and taken away.
"Senior Brother, what did you find?"
An Official Disciple stepped forward to ask.
The Inner Sect Disciple in the red-emblemed Profound Robe recalled the information he had just gleaned from the Soul Search.
His mind conjured up the sounds of "hearing the ghosts crash open the door" and "vaguely seeing two figures climb to the roof of the Suspended House, twist and crawl there for a moment before disappearing," so he replied: "Last night, the evil fog was thick, and inside hid a formidable ghost. That ghost crashed open the door, causing the two to be possessed, unconsciously climb out of the house, and fall off the cliff."
The Official Disciple whispered: "The two aren’t good people, they just recently lured a flock of fat sheep down the mountain to slaughter. Could it be someone coveted their Contribution Points and made a move?"
Senior Brother, I don’t care about Contribution Points, I’m just curious if it’s really like that, then... how did the person make a move?"
The disciple in the Profound Robe of the Red Map looked at him with a smile that was not a smile and said, "What’s wrong? Do you still want to investigate? Or are you questioning the findings of my investigation?"
The Official Disciple was taken aback and quickly said he didn’t dare.
"I know you don’t dare." The disciple in the Profound Robe of the Red Map patted his shoulder, lowered his voice, and said, "As your Senior Brother, let me remind you: in our Puppet Palace, there are too many secrets. When someone dies, don’t ever delve deeper, or else... you’ll soon become one of the dead.
If you don’t understand these words, then ponder over them."
"Thank you, Senior Brother, thank you."
The Official Disciple wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, bowed, and watched the disciple in the Profound Robe of the Red Map leave.
...Google seaʀᴄh
...
Last night, Song Yan was unperturbed.
Today, when he saw disciples from Shadow Puppet Peak coming to the cliffside, he remained calm.
But when the day ended and he returned to the Suspended Room, once dust had settled, he instead felt a belated fear.
He had no idea how he dared to do what he did.
But recalling the expression of that Shadow Puppet Peak disciple, as if seeing something at a point between the brows, he largely understood: this world must have a Soul-Searching Skill.
If someone used the Soul-Searching Skill on him, it would be all over.
The accumulated pressure suddenly frustrated him, as if a fire was rising in his belly. He embraced Qiu Xiaoniang, pressing their plump bodies together against the couch.
Qiu Xiaoniang didn’t know why, but her reaction today was particularly fierce.
After their whirlwind-like outburst, they both finally calmed down.
Qiu Xiaoniang lay like a pile of mud, her beautiful eyes blinked, looking at the red mist through the gaps, her pupils full of fear as she trembled, "Big Brother Song, during the day, many people were saying the bloody mist became denser, the ghost creatures stronger. If one is not careful, the ghost creatures might break through the door... that’s how Sheng Dazhu and the others died.
We are all just servants, Shadow Puppet Peak won’t care about servants; if a servant dies... they just die.
But I don’t want to die, I really don’t want to die... wuwuwu..."
Qiu Xiaoniang broke down and cried.
Song Yan was momentarily dumbfounded.
He suddenly realized the pressure his breaking the door brought to all the servants in the Tannery last night.
And in this moment of distraction, Qiu Xiaoniang pounced on him again, with the most fearful yet gentle voice, "Big Brother Song, I will serve you well, I’ll do anything you want, I’m very obedient, take me with you, don’t abandon me, alright? Alright?"
Her black disheveled hair, delicate yet fear-stricken face, a look of desperation willing to please with her body in exchange for a chance to live...
Song Yan hugged Xiaoniang tightly in his arms, waiting for her trembling body to calm down slightly, then said, "Since you said you’d do anything, then I want you to do one thing now."
"What is it?" Qiu Xiaoniang was prepared for anything.
Song Yan said, "Take a Strengthening Ginseng Pill and have a good sleep."
Qiu Xiaoniang: ...
She obediently took the Strengthening Ginseng Pill and slowly fell asleep.
Song Yan sat on the fifth-layer steps, slowly entering a "half-awake, half-asleep" state.
He wasn’t worried about the ghost creatures breaking in, but in a place like this, how could he possibly sleep soundly?
...
...
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
New servants were replaced and supplemented in several batches.
The unique "cycle" of the Tannery continued.
In this cycle, both Song Yan and Qiu Lianyue quickly became veteran servants.
They understood the unspoken rules here, and knew how to survive.
For most servants, surviving another day is just another day, as for hope... there simply wasn’t any.
For Qiu Lianyue, it was about "hoping her husband becomes successful," wishing that once Song Yan becomes an Official Disciple, he could pull her out of the abyss. After observing how many servants who followed qualified disciples suddenly became weak and then disappeared, Qiu Lianyue was introspective, and became even more attached to Song Yan.
For Song Yan, a lot happened in these six months, and he... finally was able to spend the Contribution Points he had snatched half a year ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 12. Magic Mutation
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: 12. Magic Mutation
In Song Yan’s arms, there are two Jade Tokens, one of his own containing 83 points, and another belonging to Miss Qiu, containing 7 points.
Miss Qiu, to prove her usefulness, worked tirelessly on skin making, managing to accumulate 7 Contribution Points in half a year, and then... she handed them all to Song Yan.
The youngster skillfully made his way to the low-level market at the foot of the mountain, and along the way, he excavated a bundle under a marked rock, changing into a low-hooded cloak and human skin mask.
These items were purchases he acquired during his trips to the market over the past few months, including three bottles of "Strengthening Ginseng Pill," totaling 1 Contribution Point.
The human skin mask was merely a mask used by Jianghu people, easily identifiable by a cultivator with a slight perception, hence inexpensive, but to Song Yan, it was quite useful, allowing others to mistake him for a bandit or some evil Jianghu figure.
And in the months following his huge acquisition, he acted normally, without causing any suspicion, descending the mountain regularly, which led him to discover that Jianghu people from outside also visit the market below the mountain.
Puppet Sect, in the eyes of evil martial artists from Jianghu, is clearly an emperor towering above, much more advantageous than a mundane Dynasty.
Through conversations with those people and Qiu Lianyue, Song Yan learned that the world to which he had transmigrated seemed vast, with numerous dynasties, and the Puppet Sect he was in was situated in an evil cultivation force at the "Three Kingdoms Border".
The Three Kingdoms, however, were mortal kingdoms, coincidentally named Wei, Shu, and Wu, but these kingdoms seemingly had no relation to the Three Kingdoms Song Yan knew of before his transmigration.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
As a result, whenever the Puppet Sect desired people, it would plunder any of these kingdoms, with an inexhaustible supply.
As for controlling dynasties, the Puppet Sect seemed disinterested; firstly, mortal dynasties lacked Profound Stones and Profound Veins, wasting time meaninglessly; secondly, they still needed mortal dynasties to continually provide "people" as resources.
Song Yan arrived at the foot of the mountain, pretended to wander outside, but today he didn’t purchase "Strengthening Ginseng Pill," nor did he visit the usual stalls, instead, after a while, he entered a pavilion and skillfully swiped his Jade Token on the "Goods Display Board."
A series of goods information instantly appeared in his mind.
Song Yan quickly swiped the Jade Token, spending 88 points to buy "Qi Concealment Technique," "Qi Arrow Technique," then reluctantly gazed at the newly added goods from last month.
"Soul-Searching Skill," a Refining Profound magic, applicable, price: 199 Contribution Points.
The more one fears something, the more one desires it.
Song Yan wanted to buy it very much.
But 199 Contribution Points were still too expensive for him...
Song Yan glanced at it, then quickly left.
He was about to take a few detours, dispose of the human skin mask and cloak before returning to the cliff top, but suddenly heard commotion at the market entrance.
It was clamor, accompanied by some malicious laughter.
He paused his steps, turned his head towards the market entrance, and saw carts of prisoners approaching from afar, though the men and women inside were dusty and despondent, they all bore a noble air, clearly not ordinary people.
The men were handsome, and the women beautiful, all exuding a high-class aura, certainly not common.
Some Jianghu people nearby were laughing wantonly.
"Is Wei Kingdom going to be completely destroyed? Royal females and princes are all captured, even though the Blood Gun Gang revolted, they were sensible enough to send all these people to the Puppet Palace to show reverence to the immortals."
"It’s rumored that the Wei Kingdom’s royal family has a trace of Multi-tailed Fox Race bloodline from the Mountain and Sea Kingdom. Although that bloodline is extremely thin, insufficient for cultivation, it grants them extraordinary beauty, both men and women alike... Now it seems the rumors might be true."
"Look, isn’t that the Eldest Princess Cao Yanran of Wei Kingdom in the lead? Tsk tsk tsk, I’ve heard of her beauty in Jianghu, the most beautiful in Great Wei. But what of it? She’s still sent to the Puppet Palace, from now on... likely only to become a lowly servant."
Song Yan looked at the front cart, the woman indeed exquisitely beautiful, such that any man would be moved upon seeing her. Although Qiu Lianyue had some charm, she was far from comparable to her.
Relating to the words of those Jianghu people, Song Yan sighed lightly in his heart: it seems the world outside is unsafe too.
If this scene was merely "watching TV or a movie," he would feel sympathy, but in such a world, he found it already challenging enough to take care of himself for survival.
In such times, each person should only sweep the snow from their own doorstep.
’Still have to become stronger.’
...
...
That night.
Song Yan recounted to Miss Qiu what he’d seen and heard at the market today.
He recalled that Miss Qiu was also from Wei Kingdom.
And after listening to Song Yan’s words, Qiu Lianyue was dumbstruck for a long while, then quivered as she spoke: "Even the Eldest Princess was captured?"
Song Yan said, "I heard those Jianghu people say, her name is Cao Yanran."
Qiu Lianyue said, "A beauty that captivates the kingdom, the peony of Wei Palace..."
She murmured, then sighed long and deeply, then her eyes reddened, tears streaming down.
Song Yan said, "Do you know her?"
Qiu Lianyue said mournfully, "Our family business’s background in Great Wei is Yanran Eldest Princess. My father took me to see her once.
At that time, standing before her, I felt as if a dazzling light was in front of me. I dared not even raise my head, much less steal a glance at her...
Brother Song, you mentioned the Blood Gun Gang’s rebellion. It hasn’t been more than this half year. Since Yanran Eldest Princess and many royalties were captured, our family business might have also suffered from this calamity."
Originally, Qiu Lianyue still harbored a slight hope of returning home, but now... this faint hope is completely shattered.
Her complexion turned pale, her eyes hollow, murmuring, "Dynasties change, but the lasting ones are these Cultivating Profound sects..."
Suddenly, her expression became excited again, clutching Song Yan’s hand tightly, she said tremblingly, "Brother Song, you must succeed, you’re a good person, you must succeed.
Actually, I guess it, I guess that your cultivation requires drawing from me for it to work, don’t be gentle, you already bought me so many medicines, draw a bit more, you must not fail! I don’t want you to fail! You mustn’t fail!"
Song Yan scratched his head.
In truth, what worried him now was not failure, but concealment.
After Qiu Lianyue finished her watch for the first half of the night, he sat back at the door of the Suspended Room, his expression stirred, panel brought up:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Life Span: 17/3908]
[Talent: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]
[Realm: Refining Profound Level 1]
[Spirit Root: Inferior Ghost Profound Root (can perform Life Span Calculation)]
[Cultivation Technique: Profound Qi Guiding Technique (Mastered) (can perform Life Span Calculation)]
[Magic: (can perform Life Span Calculation)]
"Qi Concealment Technique"(Not entry-level)
"Qi Arrow Technique"(Not entry-level)
In over seven months, he accumulated a considerable amount of life span, and his understanding of the relationship between [Cultivation Technique] and [Magic] deepened a bit.
Cultivation Technique, it is a strange method for cultivation, a tool for cultivation, without any differentiation in levels. Using this method to absorb Profound Qi is the essence of [Cultivation Technique]. But this absolutely does not imply that [Cultivation Technique] is simple, quite the opposite, it is rather complex, like the intricacies within "Profound Qi Guiding Technique", requiring visualization, hearts method, and other details.
But the true Slaughter Technique lies in magic.
Magical Battle, battling is not about Cultivation Technique, but magic.
After purchasing "Qi Concealment Technique" and "Qi Arrow Technique", Song Yan also understood that magic has levels, they are: entry-level, Xiaocheng, Great Success, Perfection.
Now, he focused his attention on "Qi Concealment Technique".
Only if he could hide his aura and not be exposed, would he continue choosing to break through the realm.
[Please choose to invest life span]
Song Yan, adept, began his attempt.
Life span numbers began to change.
[You invested one year to comprehend "Qi Concealment Technique", spent three months effort, you reached entry-level, after another three months, already Xiaocheng, by year-end, you achieved Great Success. You realized that so-called Qi Concealment is actually gathering Qi, hiding Qi. Within the human body, like a maze, muscles, bones, skin, blood, organs, every meridian can hide Qi. Others trying to probe your realm, unless obvious, need to test with Qi, upon touching your Qi, naturally knowing your realm. But if you hide it beforehand, letting them unable to find, then the Qi... will naturally be concealed]
’Achieved Great Success in one year?’
Song Yan was somewhat surprised.
But recalling this is a common technique, and considering his singular focus during comprehension, he felt it acceptable.
Seeing his life span still abundant, he decided on something ambitious, recalling Qi Yao previously stated "The terrifying aspect of Ghost Cultivators is in their ability to mutate ordinary magic, twisting and transforming them into illusion techniques, devouring and such."
[You invested ten years to comprehend "Qi Concealment Technique", after one year, you achieved Perfection, able to gather Profound Qi within your body, hiding it anywhere in your body at will, occupying just one position. Not satisfied, continued trying to conceal Qi, yet showed little results. In repeated experiments, you finally noticed some anomaly, your internal Profound Qi wasn’t ordinary Profound Qi, but Evil Profound. Evil Profound Evil Profound, with evil mixed within, you began pondering how to utilize this unique force. Five years later, you realized "Soul-Collecting Technique", capable of extracting Evil Qi from your Evil Profound within temporarily, anyone daring to use Qi to explore your realm and information can be repelled by your Evil Qi. Still not satisfied, continued trying. After another four years, achieved nothing.
Song Yan glanced at the panel.
[Magic]
"Soul-Collecting Technique"(Perfection)
Clearly, the mutated magic he realized needs no more cultivation.
’Still abundant life span, converting it into power stabilizes further, then... continue.’

chapters.title: Chapter 13. Twice Perfect, Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: 13. Twice Perfect, Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound
[You have spent ten years comprehending the "Soul-Collecting Technique," but have achieved nothing...]
Ten years, wasted.
Achieved nothing?
Song Yan frowned slightly, glancing at the panel’s "[Life Force: 17/3885]", he remained silent momentarily, but he had no intention of stopping nor would he rashly conclude "Since ten years don’t work, it seems spending more time on comprehension might be useless."
He could spend half a year waiting for a "Qi Concealment Technique," without moving any of his life force, but when necessary, he wouldn’t hesitate to "go all-in."
Before transmigration, he had read some stories, those stories always had some villains or other characters who dilly-dally, having means to enhance their power but not properly doing so, even if they enhanced it, they didn’t go all the way to "the peak," just got halfway there and inexplicably stopped, then went out to fool around, only to either die directly or barely survive...
He wouldn’t.
Today, he must enhance as much as possible.
Only when potential turns into power would he find peace of mind.
However, recalling the "psychological suggestion" when comprehending the "Inferior Ghost Profound Root" before, Song Yan suggested to himself again "I hope Qi Concealment Technique will develop toward hiding power."
The mutation of Qi Concealment Technique into Soul-Collecting Technique wasn’t too satisfying.
If it truly comes to the point of having to counter with Evil Qi, it means the knife is drawn at the map’s end.
He needs to hide, needs not to be caught for "dissection," not to be forced into counter-attacking on the "operating table."
[You have spent ten years comprehending the "Soul-Collecting Technique," but have achieved nothing...]
[You have spent fifty years comprehending the "Soul-Collecting Technique," through repeated attempts and efforts, you start to discover a new opportunity you try to grasp, yet it’s always in vain. You do not lose heart, continue day by day with attempts.
In the sixteenth year, you suddenly realized what the opportunity was.
The root cause still lies in the Evil Profound. Besides the fierce offensive nature, Evil Qi shows a devouring characteristic when gathered to a certain extent, this characteristic also manifests in the ghost’s instinct to attack life. By now, you have spent a full forty years on comprehension.
You start to try regrouping, compressing the divided Evil Qi in the Evil Profound.
This process is very complex, but you won’t stop.
In the forty-fifth year, you realize you have reached a crossroads, one side allows the gathered Evil Qi to be released for attack, such magic seems to devour others’ Profound Qi, virtually the "Star Absorption Technique" of the Cultivation Realm;
The other side further restrains the gathered Evil Qi, devouring all Profound Qi within the body so that it no longer takes up space but hides in a corner of the body, thus better concealing one’s aura, while also allowing for a fierce counter during invasions far surpassing the Soul-Collecting Technique.
You chose the latter.
In the fifty-fifth year, you comprehended the "Condensing Evil and Concealing Profound Technique."
This technique cannot undergo a third mutation, returning the remaining nineteen years]
Song Yan glanced over the panel.
The "Magic" column showed a perfected "Condensing Evil and Concealing Profound Technique."
Clearly, the "Ghost Spirit Root" is worthy of being a special Profound Root, and the lack of success in the first ten-year comprehension was because the difficulty of a second mutation of ordinary magic is far beyond the first one.
However, the Qi Concealment Technique is ultimately a common magic, its potential is limited, after two mutations, the deduction has reached its end.
Feeling the mystical new technique within him: "Condensing Evil and Concealing Profound Technique," Song Yan made a small attempt.
Sure enough, he easily gathered the Evil Qi within his body, then used it to devour all the Profound Qi, condensing it into a point, like a tiny particle hidden in the most inconspicuous corner of his body.
He controlled the Evil point to release a strand of Profound Qi, leaving only one strand of Profound Qi flowing within him.
If any official disciple from Shadow Puppet Peak came to test the servants’ cultivation progress, then... he would only see the progress Song Yan wanted him to see.
...
...
The testing crisis half a year later was resolved, Song Yan breathed a sigh of relief.
But he still felt a bit regretful because at the comprehension crossroads, he chose "further restraining the gathered Evil Qi" instead of "releasing attack."
Only children make choices.
He wants everything.
What should he do?
He closed his eyes and contemplated for a long time, discovering it might not be impossible.
[You have spent fifty years re-comprehending the "Soul-Collecting Technique," smoothly arriving at the previous crossroads, this time, you chose the first path.
You tried to release the gathered Evil Qi for attack but found it wasn’t easy, since in the construction of this magic, you had completely accustomed to the other path, now it’s tantamount to reversing the habit, starting anew.
Fifty years, you felt something yet did not comprehend a new magic]
[You have spent five more years continuously comprehending the "Soul-Collecting Technique." With persistence and effort, over seventy-five years, you finally comprehended another mutation of the "Soul-Collecting Technique."
You comprehended the "Condensing Evil and Swallowing Profound Skill."
Ten more years, you fused the "Condensing Evil and Swallowing Profound Skill" and the "Condensing Evil and Concealing Profound Technique."
You comprehended the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique."
This mutation is perfect, no further mutation possible.
Returning remaining time fifteen years]
Song Yan opened his eyes, extending his palm flat.
The divided Evil Qi concentrated in his palm.
If someone were across from him, they would see the boy’s palm turning black, resembling... a monster’s mouth.
Yet if this mouth wished to break out and fly out to devour people, it seemed impossible.
...
...
Song Yan was very satisfied with the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" from the Qi Concealment Technique.
He glanced at the panel.
[Life Force: 17/3761].
’Perhaps it’s good to enhance the "Qi Arrow Technique" first, then the realm.’"
The "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" is comprehensive in attack and defense, sinister and hard to guard against, except it cannot be released outward, whereas the "Qi Arrow Technique" is clearly a magic to externally attack using Profound Qi.
This compensates for his shortcomings in a magical battle.
Simultaneously, he wishes to verify some understanding regarding comprehension time on magic.
...
...
[You have spent two years comprehending the "Qi Arrow Technique," when one month remained, you reached completeness. You began to realize that the so-called Qi Arrow Technique is but a simple gathering technique and blockage technique.
But this gathering compared to your "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" is far lesser; it merely requires redirecting Profound Qi to fingertips, then forcibly blocking it, thereafter releasing blockage at the instant, the Profound Qi shoots out, likened to a mortal bending bow and shooting arrows.
No, it’s akin to mortal archery, its power, range, accuracy are extremely mundane, at the release, it accompanies a noise similar to a bullet leaving the barrel, and significantly consumes Profound Qi. Perhaps its only commendable quality might be stealthiness]
Song Xuan paused slightly.Google seaʀᴄh N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
’Indeed, common refining Profound level magic usually takes two years to perfect, one year to use.’
’And this "Qi Arrow Technique," being the cheapest magic sold in the block of the entire prefecture-level city, truly is "you get what you pay for," if there were no stronger magic, who would want to train this?’
[You have spent five more years continuously comprehending the "Qi Arrow Technique." In daily research, you comprehended the "Killing Arrow Technique." The principle is separating a strand of Evil Qi, mixing it with the Qi Arrow. In this way, it can more easily tear through target Profound Qi defenses, or cause greater damage]
’Indeed, with my inferior Root Bone, refining Profound level magic’s first mutation takes about five years.’
’Continue, see if noise can be eliminated, increased range, prioritize eliminating noise.’
[You have spent fifty years comprehending the "Killing Arrow Technique."
By the thirty-third year, you reached a crossroads.
This time, three paths branched.
One was enhanced range, improved accuracy;
One, eliminate noise and reduce consumption;
One increased power;
You chose the second.
In the forty-eighth year, you comprehended the "Evil Needle Technique."
The principle is using Evil Qi to condense Profound Qi into needles, reducing emission quantity, shot caliber, thus lessening sound, since the impact point is smaller, the overall power does not change.
This technique cannot undergo a third mutation, returning remaining two years]
Song Yan:...
He raised a finger, slightly sensing, it’s evident, however small the noise, it’s still noise, silence is impossible.
Suddenly felt like cursing inexplicably.
This "Qi Arrow Technique," seems an immovable stumbling block.

chapters.title: Chapter 14. Time is up
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: 14. Time is up
[You spent one hundred years continuing to comprehend the ’Killing Arrow Technique’.
This time, you aimed at ’improving range and enhancing accuracy’.
In the seventy-fifth year, you comprehended the ’Slaughter Crossbow Skill’.
This technique could not undergo a third mutation, returning the remaining twenty-five years’]
[You spent two hundred years continuing to comprehend the ’Killing Arrow Technique’.
This time, you aimed at ’increasing power’.
In the ninety-ninth year, you comprehended the ’Evil Gun Technique’.
You then spent twenty years combining the ’Evil Needle Technique’, ’Slaughter Crossbow Skill’, and ’Evil Gun Technique’.
You comprehended the ’Torrential Rain Evil’.
This magic has mutated to perfection and cannot mutate further, returning the remaining eighty-one years’]ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
...
...
Magic cultivation completed, no further enhancement possible.
Song Yan continued to advance his realm.
[You spent one hundred years cultivating the full version of the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’.
In the forty-fifth year, you successfully cultivated 900 strands of mystical energy, merging into nine springs, along with the previous one spring, each flowing into the ten meridians within your body.
Your physical strength further increased, and your perception also improved to some extent.
You entered the Refining Profound Second Layer.
Due to lack of subsequent cultivation techniques, returning the remaining fifty-five years of lifespan]
...
...
Song Yan attempted to conceal the ten springs of mystical energy using ’Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique’, successfully.
He glanced at the panel: [Lifespan: 17/3469].
’Magic cannot be further enhanced, cultivation techniques, spirit root, seem fine...’
’Let’s try again.’
The young man was full of patience.
In this dangerous world, he tirelessly pursued the enhancement of power.
[You spent one hundred years deducing and cultivating the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’.
No matter how you tried, you found the mystical energy within was full.
You vaguely felt that some external medicine might be needed, but you... didn’t have such medicine.
As for cultivation technique, the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ seemed to be the best method for inferior Profound Root in the Refining Profound level.
A hundred years passed, you gained nothing]
[You spent one hundred years deducing ’Inferior Ghost Spirit Root’.
You lay on a lonely cliff, but ghosts were no longer entering your body.
You vaguely felt that improving the spirit root wasn’t easier than creating something from nothing, and this time you didn’t have the luck to succeed inadvertently, you needed some opportunity.
A hundred years passed, you gained nothing]
’Gained nothing, huh? Indeed, it’s not that easy.’
Song Yan thought silently in his heart.
This was his first time using the panel comprehensively.
Soon, he summarized some rules, or rather, experiences:
First, his lifespan deducing panel cannot create something from nothing, cannot conjure medicine when there isn’t any. From this, it’s deduced that as long as he prepares the medicine, he can likely cultivate by completely consuming the medicine. Similarly, he can also utilize the environment. Different environments impact cultivation differently. His ’Inferior Ghost Spirit Root’ was a result of the fishy mist on the cliff of the Tannery.
Second, the magic itself has a potential limit, cannot mutate infinitely. And each mutation requires a significant increase in time spent, with the increase seemingly being an extra half of the first comprehension time. To achieve perfect mutation, all mutations of the same level must be completed and fused, which requires far more time than cultivating the magic itself.
In other words... cultivating existing magic is far easier than comprehending it oneself.
As for the remaining 3269 years of lifespan, Song Yan wasn’t surprised.
After all, the cultivation techniques he practiced were low-level, spending more than six hundred years in total was already quite remarkable, and this included two hundred years of fruitless effort.
After fully digesting the power, Song Yan finally took a long breath of relief.
He looked outside, the originally hazy red mist became much clearer, and the twisted mist meshed into more lines, as if a mentally disturbed artist made chaotic sketches with blood on a black curtain;
He listened attentively, the sounds outside, originally almost mute, entered his ears once again—wind sounds, the sound of the leaves in the forest at the cliff bottom, the terrifying howling of skin and bone ghosts half-awake, the crisp rolling sound of a small stone on the cliff, and even the light conversation between two people in the suspended room next door, he could already hear them.
It was called conversation, but in fact, there was no discussion.
Just some indescribable humming sounds.
This was the only time the servants could escape.
After the humming, the female servant in the adjacent room asked, "When will you do what you mentioned?"
Next, the male servant said, "In two more days."
The female servant said, "I’ve saved 10 contribution points, you also have 10. Can you ask Master Zhang who passed on the skills if giving him all 20 points can let us leave? If 20 points aren’t enough, we can save more... as long as we can leave, it’s all good."
The male servant sighed and said, "I’m afraid it won’t work."
The female servant said, "This doesn’t work, that doesn’t work, what should we do then?"
Then, she began to complain.
The voice gradually faded, because this was a problem with no solution.
Which servant doesn’t want to run away?
But how can they escape?
Song Yan looked towards the bedchamber.
Originally, Qiu Lianyue’s silhouette was barely visible, but now, as his perception strengthened, she became clearer.
It was late spring, and the young lady was covered with a thin blanket, her chest swelling prominently, her long legs revealing the red ribbon of silk at the snow-white thigh’s root, a seductive sight. Yet, her brows were tightly furrowed, as if in a nightmare.
A day ago, Song Yan was equally fearful, but now... he suddenly found himself able to get a good night’s sleep.
Because, even in his dreams, his perception and alertness exceeded that of an awakened mortal.
He yawned, leaned back slightly, and closed his eyes to sleep.
...
...
Time began to accelerate again, and the Tannery became Song Yan’s comfort zone.
Two months quickly passed.
Wang Susu’s group faced testing.
The testing process was secretive.
Of the six who entered, only three successfully passed, Wang Susu being one of them.
At that moment, the elegant woman seemed to gain a new life, her aura shining as she left the Tannery.
As for Song Yan... she had long forgotten him.
There was no love, no hate, no desire to show off—just a passerby.
Of course, if Song Yan’s room had a constant rotation of women, Wang Susu might approach to say, "Junior Brother, I’ll be waiting for you at the Shadow Puppet Peak Master Peak," to forge a good relationship.
However, since the young lady Qiu Lianyue entered Song Yan’s room, she has been living well. Meanwhile, Song Yan foolishly spent Contribution Points on many Strengthening Ginseng Pills for her.
Wang Susu only found this behavior laughable.
Initially, when Song Yan survived her grasp, she thought this young man had some dignity and hastily offered information to settle grievances. But now... she realized she overestimated him.
...
...
As some leave, others arrive.
Of those who left, far more died than those who became Official Disciples.
New arrivals began the cycle anew.
Two months later...
The man in Qi Yao’s room died weakly, and another woman in Xu Changjun’s room disappeared.
These two people of potential moved in together.
As night fell...
Qi Yao and Xu Changjun did not roll onto the bed but sat across from each other solemnly.
Qi Yao sighed softly, tears glistening in her Shui Xing-like eyes, and she spoke sorrowfully, "Senior Brother is dead. He died to protect me..."
Xu Changjun replied with dignity, "To overthrow this Puppet Palace, every sacrifice is worth it."
Qi Yao pursed her lips and took a deep breath.
Xu Changjun said, "A month later, Junior Sister, show your power and pass through."
Qi Yao was startled and asked, "Then what about you, Senior Brother Xu?"
Xu Changjun smiled faintly, "Someone needs to stay everywhere to gather information. I... will continue to remain, hide my ability, and stay in this Tannery."
Qi Yao thought for a moment and said, "That’s right, Senior Brother long ago broke through the Refining Profound First Layer, and with the Qi Concealment Technique, he can easily hide."
Xu Changjun flashed a charming smile and shook his finger, "No, Junior Sister, I have reached the Refining Profound Second Layer."
...
...
"Good man, good man, nourish me, a little more nourishment..."
"Good man, hurry, I beg you."
"Just like this, just like... this..."
With a month until the deadline, Qiu Lianyue was extremely anxious.
Especially when realizing she was still healthy, she nearly went insane.
Her health meant Song Yan gave her less nourishment.
Less nourishment meant fewer chances of passing the test.
If Song Yan couldn’t pass the test and become an Official Disciple, she would never see her fortune...
Song Yan was a good man, she knew.
So, at this moment, the young lady, like a crazed mother leopard, relentlessly demanded the "excessive request" of "being nourished."
...
...
Time slipped away slowly...
A month passed again.
It was time to test the cultivation results...

chapters.title: Chapter 15. One level, one kind of life
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: 15. One level, one kind of life
One early morning, Song Yan, Qi Yao, and Xu Changjun were called to a mountainside at the entrance of the lonely cliff.
Zhang Senior Brother, whom they had met during the transmission of skills and receiving the Jade Token, was sitting in a stone pavilion with an elder and a woman.
The elder had a gaunt face, aged cheeks, and his mouth and eyes were lined with tree bark-like wrinkles. He looked nothing like a cultivator, more like an ordinary person, yet in the "Refining Profound Realm," one cannot increase lifespan, and there are many cultivators who die of old age trapped in this realm.
The woman wore a suitably fitted double-faced Profound Robe, with spring-like eyebrows and eyes. Her demeanor carried a hint of the enticing charm of a young married woman yet unsatisfied. She might not be exceedingly beautiful, but she was by no means plain, and along with her alluring aura, any mortal man who saw her would likely be easily swayed and distracted.
The woman smiled as she looked at the approaching people.
She was Wang Susu.
The elder was also somewhat familiar; Song Yan recalled he was an "official disciple" named Kang Defu who had "passed the test" earlier than Wang Susu.
Gaining the ability to cultivate Profound in old age, who knows if it’s lucky or unfortunate.
"Come, circulate your Profound Qi. If you can manage even a wisp, you pass," Zhang Senior Brother said directly, "Who will go first?"
Although Qi Yao was a woman, she stepped forward boldly and said, "I’ll go."
After speaking, she stretched out her hand.
Zhang Senior Brother, as if checking a pulse, placed his fingers on the back of her hand, closed his eyes briefly, then nodded with them open again, saying kindly, "Junior Sister Qi, step behind me."
Wang Susu and Kang Defu also smiled at Qi Yao, both offering congratulations.
Qi Yao swept a glance at Wang Susu’s eyes, as if they said, "What are you pretending, chaste female knight? Didn’t you siphon off Profound Qi from men through those Yin-Yang techniques? Were you a chaste female knight when you extracted Profound Qi?"
Qi Yao’s face turned frosty, extremely cold.
Wang Susu rolled her eyes but didn’t mind, simply wore a fox-like smile as her gaze shifted to the second person being tested, Song Yan.
"Junior Brother Song, not bad. Your wisp of Profound Qi is quite pure, which means your bones may not be perfect, but your talent is definitely sound." Zhang Senior Brother, having finished assessing Song Yan, showed a slight smile and curiously asked, "Could the Strengthening Ginseng Pill given to the Furnace have this effect?"
Song Yan replied, "Junior Brother simply couldn’t bear to see that woman die, so while taking from her, I also supplemented her, without thinking too much about it."
Successfully passing the test, he felt quite pleased.
It was just that the test wasn’t nearly as difficult as he imagined.
One only needed to guide the Profound Qi within to the arm to pass directly, no need to hide it so deeply...
Zhang Senior Brother was momentarily stunned. Being a disciple of the Demon Sect, his actions were quite indifferent and ruthless, but everyone, no matter how indifferent and ruthless, wished the best for those around them.
He nodded, his impression of Song Yan improved slightly.
Wang Susu’s initially smiling eyes gradually showed an expression of disbelief. She stared at Song Yan, who had passed the test, feeling it impossible, but quickly composed herself and laughed, "I thought all grudges with Junior Brother Song were ended, never expected we had good fortune instead."
She was reminding Song Yan that despite past conflicts, everything had ended on that day.
Song Yan nodded; he had reached the second layer of Refining Profound, why would he care anymore?
Qi Yao was genuinely shocked and stammered, "You... you passed?"
"I passed."
Song Yan responded and then stood by the column at the side of the stone pavilion.
Qi Yao looked around, bypassed Wang Susu, and stood right next to Song Yan.
Compared to those like Wang Susu and Kang Defu, who relied on taking others’ lifespans to cultivate, she felt more favorable towards Song Yan.
Just then, Zhang Senior Brother spoke.
"Xu Changjun, go back. Your cultivation isn’t enough, and you’re likely to never encounter the Profound Dao in this lifetime."
The handsome, tall man seemed unfazed, only pretending to be slightly saddened and bowed, saying, "Thank you, Master Zhang. Then I’ll return to the Tannery."
Zhang Senior Brother ignored him.
Just a servant.
What’s there to care about?
Zhang Senior Brother looked at Song Yan and Qi Yao, saying, "Currently, my Tannery lacks staff. You came from the Tannery as servants, so remain here to cultivate. The Cave Mansion resources that Official Disciples receive won’t be spared from you."
Immediately, he coldly added, "Don’t talk about going to the main peak or other nonsense; such good fortune is not for you."
After glancing at both of them and seeing neither showed discontent, Zhang Senior Brother smiled and said, "Come along, I’ll take you to entry-level, choose a Cave Mansion, and enjoy... certain benefits only Official Disciples can have."
After saying this, his eyes flashed with an odd color and he smiled playfully, "You chose a good time for entry-level; the benefits are truly good, come... let me show you."
...
...
The peak where the Tannery is located is called South Bamboo Peak, an outer peak of Shadow Puppet Peak.
Brother Zhang is named Zhang Yin, the second disciple of Cheng Danqing, the Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak.
This Cheng Danqing holds the position of Internal Affairs Steward at Shadow Puppet Peak, wearing a white robe, but with a double-faced pattern embroidered on the back.
At Shadow Puppet Peak, robes are in two colors: profound and white.
Profound signifies ordinary disciples; white denotes status.
The double-faced pattern on the back of the robes also comes in two variants: profound and red.
Profound represents the outer sect; red signifies the inner sect.
Cheng Danqing’s ability to wear a white robe indicates his considerable status, overseeing a mountain peak; however, the profound pattern suggests he is neither an Elder nor part of the inner sect, thus unable to access the higher-level Unique Cultivation Techniques and Secret Techniques of the Puppet Palace.
From this, it can be entirely deduced that the position of the Tannery is not high within the entirety of Shadow Puppet Peak.
Song Yan and Qi Yao quickly paid their respects to Cheng Danqing, switched to the uniform of Profound Patterned Robes, and simultaneously changed their Identity Tokens.
The material of the tokens also changed from the original Black Wood to Black Jade.
Song Yan glanced at the token: Song Yan, Official Disciple, Shadow Puppet 334.
Qi Yao, on the other hand, was "Shadow Puppet 333."
Zhang Yin continued explaining, "Anonymous Contribution Points Cards are only for servants, henceforth your Identity Tokens will also serve as your Contribution Points Cards. Even if someone picks them up, they can’t use them; if you die, the contribution points within the token will automatically become void."
"As for the disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak, actually there are about six hundred people. If someone falls, their token number will vacate and be sequentially replaced by subsequent disciples.
The tokens you two received belonged to disciples who fell in the past few days."
Unable to restrain himself, Song Yan asked, "Brother Zhang, do you know how those two brothers fell?"
Zhang Yin gave him a deep glance, solemnly saying, "Our Puppet Palace is located in the middle of the Three Kingdoms, Wei, Shu, and Wu. The Nanwu Sword Sect prides itself on being the Righteous Dao and often harbors the intention of destroying our sect. Their disciples wander around our sect’s periphery; if encountered, magical battles are inevitable. Your and Junior Sister Qi’s tokens belonged to disciples who died in such battles."
Nanwu Sword Sect?
Song Yan vaguely heard a bit about it, told to him by Qiu Lianyue, but since Qiu Lianyue was a mortal merchant’s daughter, she only knew the name.
Qi Yao, however, remained silent, with a hint of secret delight in her heart, thinking: ’It would be best to kill all of you evil demons.’
The three continued walking in the mountains for a while longer, and Zhang Yin pointed ahead, saying, "Your Cave Mansions are just ahead. Rest well today, and tomorrow go to learn the cultivation techniques and understand the affairs.
As for the benefits Brother mentioned, having come this far, there’s no harm in telling you.
Great Wei is dying; newly risen is a gang from the Mortal World called the Blood Gun Gang. To curry favor with our sect, they sent numerous royal bloodline members to our sect in numerous batches.
The Empresses, concubines, princesses, princes, as well as sons and daughters of Prince Mansions, were all included.
The Great Wei Royal Family’s bloodline has an exceptionally thin Multi-tailed Fox Race bloodline, thus the men are handsome, and the women charming. Their mutual enjoyment not only brings pleasure but also allows more Profound Qi to be extracted because of their bloodline, making them excellent Furnaces.
You may be able to cultivate, but if your Profound Root is only a subpar Human Profound Root, the cultivation methods you can rely on are none other than Dual Cultivation and Elixirs.
Therefore, the Furnace is extremely important.
Today, you’re also lucky to each have been assigned a member of Great Wei Royal Family bloodline, as you enter the mansion, you’ll see clearly.
There is Fanatic Fans on the stone table, which counts as a daily benefit for Official Disciples, a bottle per month."
Qi Yao blushed slightly at these words, concealing both shame and anger, secretly saying in her heart: ’The Demon Sect is truly damnable.’
Song Yan took the opportunity to say, "Brother Zhang, speaking of the Furnace, I have one at the Tannery, which is handy to use. Plus, I fed her quite a few Strengthening Ginseng Pills, could I bring her with me to the Cave Mansion?"
Qiu Lianyue was eagerly hoping for him to rescue her from the fire pit, hence giving both her body and contribution points; if he passed the test now yet didn’t pull her out, then she’d likely despair to the point of suicide.
Zhang Yin nodded, saying, "Since she’s a Furnace, it’s not against the rules. You can bring her later, transitioning servants’ identities is very easy; Brother will help you register, and you can treat her as your mansion’s person."
Song Yan quietly breathed a sigh of relief, feeling a sense of "finally fulfilling my duty."
And thinking about not needing to sleep in the Suspended Room anymore, his mood eased a bit.
Tanning, it prolongs life, which he quite likes.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
But the identity of the Tannery and servant is like walking on thin ice, he didn’t like it.
How things will go in the future, he’ll take one step at a time.

chapters.title: Chapter 16. Princess Consort, Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox (asking for monthly tickets, asking for continued reading)
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: 16. Princess Consort, Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox (asking for monthly tickets, asking for continued reading)
Qiu Lianyue waited from morning until afternoon.
During this time, she saw Xu Changjun return while Song Yan didn’t, and she knew Song Yan had passed the test.
She began to wait excitedly.
But as time passed, her heart slowly cooled, and a sense of despair and fear began to rise. With trembling hands, she grasped a scraper, "hzz hzz" scraping against the rough beast hide, the empty seat opposite her giving her a sense of suffocation.
She dared not think about the "what if"...
So many "what ifs"...
Yet, in the blink of an eye, the afternoon had passed halfway, and she had already completed making one double-headed wolf puppet.
She had already looked outside the door one hundred and fifty-six times, almost every few minutes, yet still hadn’t seen that figure.
She already felt the mocking stares from the servants around her, and even the man who once shared a room with her and wanted to possess her seemed about to stand, grinning luridly and approaching...
The sunlight waned, and Qiu Lianyue’s heart finally cooled completely.
She took a deep breath, put down the puppet, her complexion pale.
She already heard the surrounding laughter and whispered conversations.
But in the next instant, all that mockery froze.
Just because a young man outside the door called out, "Lianyue, let’s go."
She hurriedly looked up, only to see Song Yan standing in the light outside the door, wearing a Profound Robe.
In an instant, her eyes reddened, she quickly stood up and responded, "Coming!"
As she walked outside the door again, the gazes shot toward her were no longer mocking but filled with jealousy...
She cried, then began laughing, raising her sleeve to wipe away her tears, hastening over.
...
...
Moving, there wasn’t much to move.
Just taking the Strengthening Ginseng Pill, dagger, and such over.
Then, Song Yan led Qiu Lianyue to change her identity.
But when they asked during the change, they realized "it only requires the forfeiture of her servant status," outwardly... it was as if they died.
The Furnace of an Official Disciple inherently has no identity, all they need to do is stay in the Cave Mansion, or follow around the Official Disciple. If they privately escape, they become people without identities... Anyone could cut them down or seize them.
This actually wasn’t much better than being a servant.
Yet Qiu Lianyue refused to be a servant once more.
...
...
A moment later.
Song Yan’s Cave Mansion.
The mechanism stone door "ka-ka" closed, but there was still light inside the cave. Light came from a skylight, which was a natural hole fitted with transparent crystal. The light of the setting sun was obliquely slanting down from above, casting an oval red glow.
In the cave mansion, it didn’t have the kind of "dullness, mildew smell" he remembered from before transmigration, instead it had an extremely fresh atmosphere, where one can clearly sense comfort and peace of mind.
Zhang Yin had told him, Puppet Palace has a strange double helix Profound Vein, which is a large Profound Vein composed of two Profound Veins, one vein’s core above Paperman Peak.
Therefore, Paperman Peak is also the head of Puppet Five Peaks.
There’s another vein core not among the Five Peaks, but scattered in the deep mountain Evil Land, where the foul mist rises, not suitable for cultivation, hence nobody bothers with it.
As for Shadow Puppet Peak, it is also on the main trunk of this Profound Vein, considered rather decent.
South Bamboo Peak, though on the edge, the place it occupies is also considered "remaining vein".
The disciples’ cave mansions are built according to "remaining vein", totaling sixty-two rooms.
The disciples promoted from servants all cultivate here. If one manages to break into Refining Profound First Layer, then one can leave South Bamboo Peak, and be enlisted into the deeper regions of Shadow Puppet Peak.
This period approximately lasts six years.
In other words, the cave mansion Song Yan occupies now, is likely a cave mansion vacated by a disciple who has surpassed Refining Profound First Layer and left, since according to Song Yan’s observation this year, only about ten servant disciples managed to cultivate successfully and become Official Disciples.
Ten per year, sixty in six years; those who break through the Realm leave, and the empty spot is filled by newcomers.
But what if they don’t break through?
Moreover, at this rate, the total number of disciples at Shadow Puppet Peak certainly exceeds six hundred.
Which already implies something not needing further explanation.
The Demon Sect’s death rate in battles are high too, hence... the number tends to maintain at a relatively stable figure.
Simple observation, slightly deeper inference, made Song Yan suddenly understand: he has only six years... afterwards, inevitably changes will occur.
He wasn’t worried about his inability to break through, as he had already reached Refining Profound Second Layer.
He worries about what will happen six years later...?
This lingering concern did not affect his mood today, because today he could finally get a good night’s sleep.
But suddenly, he recalled what Zhang Yin said about a "female with Great Wei Royal Family blood" also being assigned in his cave mansion, so he began searching.
The cave mansion was a two bed one hall, each room with hanging curtains.
He lifted one, not there.
Lifts another, there she was.
Inside, there was an exquisite noble lady, her limbs bound, curled up in the corner of the stone bed,
A stone pillar for prisoners was embedded between the corner walls, as thick as a human arm, with ropes winding through it, making it impossible for the noblewoman to move an inch.
The daylight revealed her appearance: a delicate face, surpassing Lady Qiu, with a natural allure deep within the bloodline of the Multi-tailed Fox Race in her brows and eyes.
Her long legs were curled up, causing the split-colored silk robe to drape down from the root of her legs, revealing fair skin.
Song Yan’s keen perception picked up a faint fragrance, clearly indicating that the noblewoman had bathed before coming.
Upon seeing Song Yan, the noblewoman’s eyes displayed an extreme expression of hatred.
If looks could kill, the noblewoman would have killed Song Yan a hundred, a thousand times by now.
Nearby on the table, a bottle of "Love Powder" was placed.
Both their gazes simultaneously fell on the Love Powder.
The noblewoman showed a look of indifference.
She already knew her fate.
She closed her eyes, waiting with disgust and aversion.
Song Yan asked, "Who are you?"
The noblewoman did not answer, knowing her identity might only fuel the desires of the villain in front of her. So she said coldly, "The Wei King will never let you go, today’s debt, paid in blood!"
Song Yan waved to the back.
Qiu Lianyue approached.
Song Yan asked, "Do you recognize her?"
Qiu Lianyue looked and immediately showed an expression of disbelief, then instinctively said, "Princess Consort!!"
Then she looked at Song Yan and said, "She is the Princess Consort of the Great Wei Prince Zhen Nan, Cao Xuerou... she..."
Song Yan asked, "What about her?"
Qiu Lianyue said, "She... she is the mother of the Crown Prince of Prince Zhen Nan Mansion, and also the First Madam there, she..."
Lady Qiu was already speaking incoherently.
Song Yan directly asked, "How old is she?"
Lady Qiu thought for a moment and said, "The Crown Prince of Prince Zhen Nan Mansion is brave and mighty, nearing thirty, Princess Consort Cao should be at least fifty..."
The noblewoman opposite cried out angrily, "I am not Cao Xuerou, you have mistaken me."
Song Yan was somewhat speechless.
He sorted through it, more or less making sense of it.
The bloodline of the Multi-tailed Fox Race of the Mountain and Sea Kingdom was indeed powerful; a woman in her fifties appeared as a twenty-year-old beauty at first glance, both in looks and skin, though closer inspection revealed some mature signs in her brows and eyes.
Therefore, in the Puppet Palace, the allocation of "Furnaces" to the disciples below wasn’t based on identity. Instead, the upper echelon simply kept the youthful and beautiful bloodlines of the Great Wei Royal Family, while the older noblewomen were distributed among ordinary disciples. After all, even at fifty, they still surpassed ordinary women considerably.
If Lady Qiu hadn’t mentioned it, Song Yan wouldn’t have been able to tell she was a woman in her fifties.
"Princess Consort."
Song Yan felt a headache and rubbed his temples.
But the latter did not respond, instead glaring at him with eyes filled with intense hatred.
"Forget it..."
Song Yan sighed softly, then burned some hair with the cave fire into ashes, mixed it with the Love Powder, and poured it into his hand, then approached the Princess Consort of Prince Zhen Nan Mansion.
Cao Xuerou looked at him coldly.
Song Yan gently blew the Love Powder into her nose.The most update n0vels are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
After roughly the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Cao Xuerou’s previously cold demeanor began to change. She clearly remembered who she was but could not suppress her feelings for the young man in front of her, filled with yearning yet intensely conflicted.
Song Yan observed for a while, seeing she was completely tamed, then quickly untied her ropes and said, "Princess Consort, from now on, you will live in this room. I will not touch you."
He did feel a stirring, but he could not bring himself to act on it against such a woman, whose nation and family were ruined.
The conflict in Cao Xuerou’s heart disappeared instantly, and she couldn’t help but feel an uncontrollable affection for the young man before her.
She was a mortal, completely unable to resist such a peculiar drug mixed with cultivator’s techniques.
After a long time, she sighed deeply and said, "You don’t need to call me Princess Consort; call me Xuerou, and say it outside too."
At this moment, she wanted to think about Prince Zhen Nan and the Crown Prince, but the drug’s power was forcibly twisting her thoughts, making it difficult for her to suppress her focus and care for the young man in front of her.
Song Yan thought for a moment and said, "You just said the Wei King won’t let us go, what do you mean?"
Cao Xuerou said, "I only vaguely know my royal brother, that is, the Wei King, has some sort of connection to the Mountain and Sea Kingdom."
Song Yan said, "Even so, the Mountain and Sea Kingdom wouldn’t make a move for a Mortal Realm, would they?"
Cao Xuerou shook her head slowly; she could know this news due to her high status; the rest... she did not know.
Song Yan asked again, "What is the Mountain and Sea Kingdom?"
Cao Xuerou said, "It is a terrifying Cannibal Demon Country, with dozens of tribes, so also known as the Hundred Demons Country. The trace of bloodline hidden within us belongs to the Multi-tailed Fox Race.
And the Multi-tailed Fox Race, also known as... Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox Race.
Cannibalism means they are extremely fierce and terrifying; Dragon Bo means they are huge in size and strong in vitality.
Therefore, our Great Wei Royal Family, even when old, looks like a young one, maintaining... eternal youth."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 17. Who lives or dies, not necessarily... depends on power
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: 17. Who lives or dies, not necessarily... depends on power
Cannibalistic demons?
Multi-tailed Dragon Lord?
Merely hearing these words sends a chilling sensation up from the heels, like a cold shiver, drowning one in terror and suffocation.
"How does the Puppet Sect compare to this Cannibal Demon Country of mountains and seas?" Song Yan asked this question eagerly.
However, he received only a bewildered shake of the head in response.
How could a mortal know such a thing?
The air suddenly quieted down.
The Princess Consort of the Southern King looked at the young lord in front of her, suddenly feeling a strange itch in her heart. Yet she still retained her reason, resulting in waves of intense guilt and shame trying to quell this peculiar itch.
She took a deep breath, inhaling the air, but smelled the scent from Song Yan’s body. That scent had a strong aphrodisiac effect, making the guilt and shame not extinguish the itch but instead become fuel to the fire, exploding it instantly.
The Princess Consort’s body tightened, her cheeks flushed, and she let out a long "oh~".
Song Yan was startled for a moment, immediately understanding that the "Fanatic Fans" had taken effect.
He said, "Lianyue, you stay here with the Princess Consort; I’ll sleep in another room."
After saying this, the young man hurriedly lifted the curtain and left.
However, the question of "who is stronger, the Puppet Sect or the Cannibal Demon Country" lingered in his mind like an apparition.
But it wasn’t long before the comfort of the bed let him escape from all worries.
