This was no longer the cramped, dangerous Suspended Room on the cliff; here, he... could finally get a truly good sleep.
...
...
"Don’t be afraid."
Qi Yao looked at the handsome man inside the stone house.
The man had long hair draped over his shoulders, a panicked expression, and his chest bared to reveal smooth, strong skin. If Song Yan were here, he’d surely think this man resembled the handsome characters from "some transmigration otome games".
"I know you’re from the Great Wei Royal Family, and that you were kidnapped. But rest assured, I won’t do anything to you," Qi Yao said, rubbing her reddened apricot eyes. She felt these people were truly pitiful.
The country and family destroyed, and he was captured to be a Furnace due to the hidden bloodline within him.
Truly tragic.
The handsome man was obviously stunned for a moment, then said, "Thank you," and added, "I am the Southern King of Great Wei... but unfortunately, I can’t give the Fairy more thanks."
"It’s nothing; just rest assured."
After Qi Yao spoke, she grabbed the "Fanatic Fans" on the table and smashed it fiercely on the ground, saying, "The Prince should act as if he has used it, to deceive others."
The Southern Prince’s expression eased significantly, repeatedly expressing gratitude, "Thank you, Fairy. But I wonder if the Fairy... can help me escape? I... would be eternally grateful."
Qi Yao said warmly, "There will be a chance. The Prince should know... not only will the Prince be able to escape, but many sufferers will also escape."
She clenched her fist, saying hatefully, "Kindness will be rewarded, and evil will reap evil; the time hasn’t arrived yet!"
The Southern Prince smiled and nodded, saying, "I believe in you."
"Rest easy, Prince," Qi Yao said before turning and leaving for another stone cave.
After she left, the Southern Prince behind the curtain let out a long breath. His once panicked eyes showed a glimmer of joy, flickering darkly, as if pondering something.
...
...
At this moment... the top of the sixty-two cave mansions on South Bamboo Peak.
Contrary to Song Yan’s estimation, at least half of these sixty-two cave mansions were empty!
Two figures stood on a cliff, gazing at the thousand miles of red mist surging under the moonlight and the servant’s Suspended Room engulfed by the red mist.
The middle-aged man in a white robe with his hands behind his back was the Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak, Cheng Danqing.
"Zhang Yin."
"Master, disciple is here; what are your orders?"
"Tomorrow, return to the Tannery and offer those servants who were once eligible to cultivate the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ but were not selected, a new choice, saying... they will be given another chance."
Cheng Danqing said in a deep voice, "Just say that Gourd Valley has had more demon wolves recently. If they can bring back a demon wolf’s head, then they can also become Official Disciples."
Zhang Yin was stunned and said, "Master, demon wolves do not travel alone. Any of those who have not entered the realm would surely die... this..."
Cheng Danqing said coldly, "Recently, the Nanwu Sword Sect has become more active, and I fear they might send spies.
Spies can hide their power but not the fact that they can absorb cultivation techniques.
The day you were on-site, did anyone clearly capable of absorbing pretend they couldn’t?"
Zhang Yin shook his head, "The cultivation technique transmission, which I observed, is perceptible; one either can or cannot."
Cheng Danqing replied, "That’s good. Tomorrow morning, just send them directly.
To prevent anyone from escaping, I will oversee it myself. As for those new disciples... you can transmit the complete version of the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ to them on my behalf.
Additionally, assign them some tasks."
"Yes, Master."
...
...
The next morning.
Song Yan walked between the mountains, stretching lazily in comfort, while at this moment, the stone gate opposite also slowly opened. A long-legged girl with a ponytail and a Profound Robe, full of heroic spirit, walked out.
Since they were from the same period, even their cave mansions were assigned very close to each other.
Qi Yao glanced at Song Yan, a complex expression in her eyes, but still approached and asked, "How was last night?"
Song Yan praised, "As expected of a furnace with Multi-tailed Fox Race bloodline; using it is different from ordinary women, it’s very smooth."
Although Qi Yao already knew the answer, hearing this still disgusted her.
She had seen Song Yan fall step by step from an upright youth to the wicked and filthy little devil he was now, yet she still felt that "Song Yan was forced."
"How about you?"
Song Yan asked casually.
Qi Yao casually replied, "Not bad," then, her eyes rolling, she curiously asked, "What is the royal status of the one on your side?"
Song Yan said, "The Princess Consort of the Southern Prince."
Qi Yao: ???!!!
Thinking of the poor man in her own cave mansion, realizing that his wife was being with that person right across the door...
Qi Yao suddenly quickened her pace angrily, no longer walking alongside Song Yan.
Song Yan was puzzled, and turned his head to see Wang Susu.
Wang Susu quickly approached him and said in a low voice, "Junior Sister Qi is still young and doesn’t understand that once you join the Demon Sect, you can only act according to its rules. Not following them means death.
In this way... once in the Demon Sect, you become an evil demon. It’s just fate, who has a choice? It’s all just to survive."
She sighed softly, "Before being captured here, I was also someone else’s virtuous wife, a girl from a good family, and I never thought my life would be like this.
But since things have reached this point, it’s like living a new life.
People have to look forward and always think of ways to survive, that’s all."
Wang Susu wanted to find an ally and, after considering several options, found that the young man who once stood against her was the most reliable, so she came over to start a conversation and show goodwill. Previously, seeing Qi Yao by the boy’s side, she followed from a distance, but after seeing Qi Yao leave angrily, she took the opportunity to approach.
The two didn’t have any major enmity, so Song Yan nodded and said, "Senior Sister’s words make sense."
Wang Susu smiled and stood by his side, then began to show goodwill by sharing some information she had gathered that might be useful to Song Yan.
"For us South Bamboo Peak Official Disciples, in addition to cultivation, we also have some sect-assigned tasks, one is making Demon Beast Shadow Puppets, and the other is going out to buy Demon Beast Skin.
From what I’ve observed, nearly half of the sixty-two cave mansions in South Bamboo Peak are empty, which suggests something has happened... so, going out to buy Demon Beast Skin isn’t safe. If there’s a choice, Junior Brother... be cautious."
Sixty-two cave mansions, half empty?
Song Yan was slightly stunned.
This was indeed very crucial information for him. If he had to confirm the "task" today, without this information, he might have chosen "going out to buy Demon Beast Skin."
Because he was also very eager to know the situation outside, "going out to buy as an Official Disciple of Shadow Puppet Peak" seemed like a great way to understand the external situation.
Lack of information could lead to completely different judgments, and it would drive someone who thought they made the right choice to a dead end.
Song Yan had seen this happen quite a few times.
Often, who lives or dies is not determined by power, but by... choices.
"Thank you."
"No need to be polite, Junior Brother."
Wang Susu waved cheerfully and said, "Ahead is where the Peak Master transmits skills, good luck, Junior Brother."
Like a fox, she stopped and waved, bidding farewell to Song Yan who had been walking with her.
Qi Yao realized that after she left, Wang Susu was now beside Song Yan, and felt secretly disdainful. Then, thinking that Song Yan would use the Princess Consort of the Southern Prince as a furnace for cultivation tonight made her angrier, but she only thought, ’Once the Sword Sect seizes the opportunity, this malignant tumor affecting the Three Kingdoms must be uprooted! So it can no longer harm people!’
After thinking this, she couldn’t help but worry about Xu Changjun, but soon felt reassured: ’Senior Brother Xu has already entered the Profound Second Layer, yet he low-key hides in the Tannery, which should be the safest place in all of South Bamboo Peak.’"
...
...
After a short while, Qi Yao and Song Yan entered the stone building at the peak of South Bamboo Peak, one after the other.
But it was Zhang Yin who greeted them inside the building.
Song Yan asked, puzzled, "Senior Brother Zhang, isn’t Master here today?"
Zhang Yin smiled and said, "Master has some matters to attend to, so I’ll be transmitting the skills on his behalf.
The ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ you learned before was a reduced version, its efficiency five or six times lower than the full version. Now... I’ll pass on the complete version to you.
Once you’ve made some progress, I’ll teach you magic."Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"By the way, besides this ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique,’ we South Bamboo Peak Official Disciples also need to undertake some daily tasks. Choose one..."

chapters.title: Chapter 18. The Skin Master is not inferior to the Talisman Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: 18. The Skin Master is not inferior to the Talisman Master
Gourd Valley.
Shapeshifting wolves, whose consciousness was invaded by ghosts, turned red-eyed, tearing frantically at fresh flesh.
You tear off a piece of thigh, I snatch away a head, red blood splatters, staining the yellow earth, and the head’s face quickly turns into a bloody mess, with the nose, eyes, and ears indistinct, bones exposed, unrecognizable.
These people, just before yesterday, were "disciples with potential" in the Tannery, vaguely holding a higher status, yet just failing one test, they became the dinner of the shapeshifting wolves.
Evil beasts and demon beasts differ.
Evil beasts are ordinary wild beasts invaded by ghosts.
Demon beasts, like cultivators, have entered the realm.
This place seems quite close to the core of the Earth Demon; hence, even though night has not fallen, the ground glows with a faint red hue, which... is the reason for the formation of shapeshifting wolves.
At this moment, although other servants have met a tragic end, Xu Changjun remains unharmed. Though he has not yet mastered Sword Flight, his ten veins inside are filled with Profound Qi, so while running, not even an evil beast can catch up, leaving him unperturbed.
"I never thought that just to hide my power, I’d be forced to undertake such a dangerous mission.
It’s really unlucky.
However, this mission obviously intends for me to die...
Forget it, the mission is considered a failure; better return to the Sword Sect first and report the situation here to the sect."
Xu Changjun remained calm.
He turned around, changed his path, heading in another direction, but hadn’t gone far when the sky suddenly darkened.
Xu Changjun quickly looked up, only to see a shadow elephant grow with the wind, in an instant several zhang high, falling from the sky, crashing into him with a powerful stomp.
An unimaginably exaggerated force transmitted from the shadow elephant’s foot.
’Who’s there?
How is it possible?!!’
Fear flashed in Xu Changjun’s pupils as he felt the Profound Qi throughout his body shatter like frail wood, his flesh torn apart. In almost an instant, he lost all perception.
Bam!!
The broken flesh crashed into the yellow earth of the valley, partially embedded in the cracked ground covered by the red hue.
A middle-aged man in a white robe descended from the sky, landing beside the shadow elephant.
This was none other than the Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak—Cheng Danqing.
But at this moment, Cheng Danqing’s expression was very odd, far from the demeanor of a mentor on the mountaintop, emanating an unspeakable eeriness, a chilling gloom.
If Zhang Yin were here, he would find his master’s appearance so unfamiliar now.
Cheng Danqing’s mind stirred, and the shadow elephant curled up Xu Changjun’s corpse, sending it deeper into the Gourd Valley where the Evil Qi was thicker.
The shadows along the way also hid many ghosts.
However, none of those ghosts attacked Cheng Danqing.
...
...
"Junior Sister Qi, Junior Brother Song, in conclusion, our South Bamboo Peak has only two tasks now.
One is to follow the arrangement of the senior disciple and go to the northwest of our Puppet Sect to the Qingxi Market to purchase demon beast skin.
The Qingxi Market isn’t in our Puppet Sect’s realm; it’s a market where loose cultivators gather. Only such a market can continuously supply a large quantity of demon beast skin.
The other is to stay with me at South Bamboo Peak, making shadow puppets from demon beast skin. This task is quite tedious, no different from previous servant duties, hardly encountering the outside world, and even less able to gain experience."
Alas, but all tasks must be done, right?"
How will you choose?"
After imparting the complete version of the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," Zhang Yin began assigning tasks.
Song Yan felt a silent disapproval in his heart, thinking Senior Brother Zhang was too dramatic; clearly, the safe tasks were unnecessarily concealed and criticized harshly. If he hadn’t previously heard Wang Susu’s words, he might have hesitated.
He discreetly glanced at Qi Yao beside him.
Lady Qi’s apricot eyes widened as if contemplating.
Song Yan had actually noticed Qi Yao’s peculiarity early on.
After all, which servant would know so much about cultivation? Which servant would use a "secret code" method to connect with one’s Furnace? Which servant mourned in the Tannery half a day after their own Furnace died tragically? And which Demon Sect disciple would feel so outraged after hearing him say "very moisturized"?
Lady Qi was most likely genuinely a good person, perhaps even that "foolish cannon fodder little spy" from the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Song Yan did not resent good people, so he opened his mouth, intending to ask Senior Brother Zhang a question like "Is going to the Qingxi Market dangerous" to make Lady Qi realize "Your infiltration plan has not even begun; if you go to a place like that grinder, where identities are indistinguishable, can you still return alive?"
He opened his mouth.
But before he could speak.
Qi Yao already said, "Senior Brother, I want to go to Qingxi Market to buy demon beast skin."
"Good!"
Zhang Yin praised and then turned to Song Yan, "Junior Brother also wants to go to Qingxi Market, right?"
Song Yan waved his hand and said, "No, no, senior brother, I’m planning to make Demon Beast Shadow Puppets."
"It’s very tedious," Zhang Yin said with a frown.
Song Yan replied, "No matter how tedious, someone has to do it."
"Doing this won’t help with training," Zhang Yin advised earnestly.
Song Yan said, "To be honest, senior brother, I... genuinely love this line of work. As the saying goes, love the work you do."
After he finished speaking, he added, "By the way, senior brother, Qingxi Market..."
Zhang Yin snorted, interrupting him, and said, "That’s enough for today. All of you, go cultivate and adapt. Missions start in three months."
After saying so, he drifted away, making the decision final.
In the stone building, only two people were left.
Qi Yao turned to leave as well.
Song Yan said quietly, "Miss Qi, Qingxi Market is dangerous."Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Qi Yao turned her head to look at him and asked, "How do you know?"
"Intuition."
As Song Yan spoke, he also walked outside. When he reached the doorway, he added, "Going to plead with Brother Zhang now, there’s still time."
"No need," Qi Yao replied.
She was about to send out some information, how could she miss such a good opportunity?
...
...
Becoming an Official Disciple on South Bamboo Peak has quite a few benefits.
Monthly fixed Contribution Points: 10 points.
Monthly fixed Cultivation Elixir: 1 Little Profound Spirit Pill.
Each successful creation of a Low-Level Demon Beast Shadow Puppet: 10 points.
Entitled to a cave mansion on the edge of the Profound Vein’s residual branch.
Entitled to benefits like a "Furnace" provided by the Sect.
And as your cultivation time increases, you can also choose techniques to cultivate, including the unique Basic Secret Technique of the Shadow Puppet Sect — Skin Control Technique.
The Official Disciple Song Yan saw previously in the Tannery was riding a Shadow Puppet two-headed wolf, scaling steep cliffs and summoning a Shadow Puppet to transport corpses — that was the Skin Control Technique.
He wasn’t in a rush because he knew he should have another six years.
Three months passed in the blink of an eye, during which time, besides putting on a show of cultivation, Song Yan genuinely practiced "love the work you do" by going to the Chores Room daily to make shadow puppets from beast skins.
Zhang Yin initially thought he was just all talk, but after witnessing Song Yan’s three-month consistency, he was truly shocked...
He had never seen an Official Disciple go to the Chores Room to do their former work during the "rest period."
After three months, Zhang Yin even patted Song Yan on the shoulder, surprised yet warmly asked, "Kid, do you really like skin making?"
Song Yan replied, "This might be my lifelong passion."
Zhang Yin clicked his tongue for a while and repeatedly said, "How rare, how rare. I’ve seen many disciples come out of the Chores Room, and they all want to vomit at the sight of beast skins, but you..."
He paused and continued, "However, skin making isn’t just a hobby, it’s also about Talent.
You know about those who draw talismans, right?
Let me tell you, real skin making is a deeper craft than drawing talismans.
The value of a Skin Master to the Sect far surpasses that of a Talisman Master.
If you not only enjoy it but also have Talent, then senior brother... might be able to recommend you a little, let you try.
If you succeed, it could be another opportunity for advancement."
Song Yan solemnly said, "Then shouldn’t I also help with senior brother’s beast skins?"
Zhang Yin was taken aback.
Song Yan softly said, "The Contribution Points that should be senior brother’s will remain yours."
"Oh~~~" Zhang Yin suddenly realized, staring wide-eyed at this exceptionally capable junior brother, said, "Too late, too late! Let’s go, junior brother, let’s not say more. Try making a Demon Beast Shadow Puppet first. Although I’m just a skilled worker, I can still teach you a few things."
Song Yan nodded and followed Zhang Yin into a cave mansion for skin making.
Zhang Yin led the way, followed by him.
Zhang Yin’s words made him understand the existence of the "Skin Master."
Clearly, a "Skin Master" didn’t just make simple skins but could also create truly mobile, lethal, and magic battle-capable shadow puppets.
This was a "technical craft."
Song Yan was a bit tempted.

chapters.title: Chapter 19. All beginnings are difficult
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: 19. All beginnings are difficult
Rustle~~
A strange beast skin was spread out in front of Song Yan.
This place was exclusively for Official Disciples of South Bamboo Peak to make skins. Compared to the chores room, the environment here was vastly improved. Besides the pleasant atmosphere from being located atop the residual Profound Vein, the lighting and ventilation were also quite good.
Transparent crystals were inlaid in the irregular holes of the dome, and the golden sunlight shone down on the nearly transparent jade tables. But unlike the long tables in the chores room that seated dozens, these tables were exquisite and small, only accommodating two to three people.
This skin was Demon Beast Skin.
But it was different from the few Demon Beast Skins Song Yan had seen in the chores room.
"The ones in the chores room are just old, damaged Demon Beast Skins for the servants to practice on, but ours here are undamaged low-level Demon Beast Skins." Zhang Yin smoothed out the skin and added, "At least this piece here is unbroken. So, we must be extra careful when crafting it.
If successfully made into a Shadow Puppet, it would earn ten Contribution Points.
But if it failed, you’d have to compensate.
Three Contribution Points."
"Understood, Senior Brother Zhang." Song Yan nodded solemnly.
Then, Zhang Yin began instructing him in the basic crafting techniques for Demon Beast Skin.
The process was similar to ordinary beast skin, but to avoid damage, the requirements for handling and carving were much more delicate.
"Junior Brother, pay attention, these are four basic carving techniques."
Zhang Yin focused intently, lightly scraping with a carving knife, "Snowflake."
Changed the scraping to the blade, the blade didn’t move, fingers exerted force, the skin spun in reverse.
"Filament."
The carving knife lifted slightly, tapped down gently, then he picked up a hammer and tapped "thud thud" twice.
"Chisel."
The blade held flat, angled to the skin surface, pushed by hand force.
"Push and Cut."
Song Yan watched carefully, and then Zhang Yin handed him a damaged beast skin to try his hand, saying, "Junior Brother, give it a try. In a few days, you’ll handle the Demon Beast Skin.
Before, in the tannery, you could make one or two Shadow Puppets a day, but with this Demon Beast Skin, if you make one in three days, that’s quite good."
After speaking, Zhang Yin brought over a drawing, saying, "This is the Blood Blade Deer, you try this first."
"Thank you, Senior Brother."
Song Yan began trying on the damaged beast skin.
This attempt immediately gave him a different experience than working in the tannery.
The resistance on the Demon Beast Skin was substantial, and when pressed down with the palm, a distinct stinging sensation occurred; the more force applied, the stronger the sting, as if countless needles hid within the dead demon beast’s skin.
He recalled Zhang Yin’s previous movements.
The palm almost suspended, with the five fingers taut and tense.
It could be said he was practically using only his fingers to craft the skin.
The required strength and effort were evident.
Song Yan asked, "Senior Brother Zhang, what kind of demon beast is this?"
Zhang Yin replied, "The most common low-level demon beast, the White Thorn Deer. They can be seen everywhere on the outskirts of demon beast gathering areas, but they aren’t something ordinary disciples like you, who haven’t even mastered magic, should encounter."
Song Yan nodded, suddenly asking, "Then what level are the demons from the Mountain and Sea Kingdom?"
The question was asked naturally.
After asking, Song Yan even added in a casual tone, "The furnace in the room told me that the Multi-tailed Fox Race is just one of the clans in the Mountain and Sea Kingdom."
But the air suddenly grew silent.
Zhang Yin glanced at him and cautiously said, "That’s not demon beasts, that’s... demons.
Demon beasts are at least beasts, but demons have already transformed into a different existence...
Don’t ask the rest; someone like me, an ordinary disciple, wouldn’t know.
However, Junior Brother needn’t worry. To Great Wei, the Mountain and Sea Demon Country is insignificant, and the Multi-tailed Fox Race might not even know it has such a descendant, so they won’t invade."
Song Yan nodded, continuing to focus as he practiced his skin crafting skills.
He heeded the advice well; since Zhang Yin told him to practice more with damaged demon beast skin, he decided to practice a few more days. Once he was familiar with the techniques and wouldn’t make mistakes, he would then use the "liable for compensation if damaged" demon beast skin.
...
...
Seven days later.
[You extracted the remaining lifespan of a White Thorn Deer: 22 years]
Song Yan looked somewhat speechlessly at the finished "Blood Blade Deer" Shadow Puppet.
In seven days, if luck was on his side, he could have extracted 140 years of lifespan.
This...even if he discounted the first four days of adjusting, he only extracted 22 years in three days.
However, despite extracting less lifespan, in three days he could earn 10 Contribution Points, which was many times more than before.
’It has its advantages and disadvantages.’
Song Yan was not discouraged.
Starting was always tough, and this was his first time crafting Demon Beast Skins.
This kind of crafting was evidently challenging, but if skill improves with practice and if he could eventually craft with stronger demon beast skins, he could reap both lifespan and benefits.
Moreover, he had a keen interest in becoming a "Skin Master" too.
To him, in any world, "technical roles" were safer than "warriors." "Warriors" had to go to battlefields, whereas "technicians developing and researching weapons" stayed in "research labs."
Even if disaster struck, organizations would first evacuate "technicians"; if encountering enemies, they’d send "warriors" to protect "technicians"; if "technicians" were accidentally trapped, they’d even dispatch "warriors" to rescue; if truly unable to rescue, "technicians" wouldn’t be killed, they might be recruited by the enemy, and if they didn’t surrender, they’d most likely be treated well...
How wonderful.
He wanted to be this "technician."
Song Yan’s thoughts were drifting when Zhang Yin had already come to inspect the beast skin he made.
Senior Brother Zhang held the shadow puppet made from beast skin, examining it in the sunlight, clicked his tongue in wonder: "Not bad, not bad. For the first time making it like this, truly talented."
Song Yan smiled. He had already reached the Profound Second Layer, with better control over both perception and power, naturally able to make excellent skins, but he still acknowledged, "It’s because Senior Brother taught well."
Zhang Yin patted his shoulder and said, "Keep up the good work. If you really do well, I’ll keep my word and recommend you."
In the evening, Song Yan sat in the tannery, focused on processing the next beast skin.
A fragrant breeze suddenly blew in from afar.
He did not lift his head.
Wang Susu sat across from him, smiled, and said, "Junior Brother, can I sit here tomorrow?"
She did not show any seductive demeanor but rather sincerity.
Seductive tactics were her means for killing and previously deceiving the furnace, not for seeking partners or allies.
Song Yan replied, "You can."
Wang Susu covered her mouth and laughed, "Junior Brother sat opposite me on the first day you came to South Bamboo Peak.
Today, we’re sitting together again.
It’s fate indeed.
This time, Senior Sister will certainly be sincere. I hope Junior Brother won’t let me down."
Her voice grew softer and softer.
Song Yan nodded gently.
Wang Susu was indeed useful and clever, full of ideas, and with just a few words, helped him avoid a big pitfall. Without her reminder, he might have avoided the pit himself, but it was still good karma.
Wang Susu smiled radiantly, moved her beast skin and tools over, then sat across from Song Yan, bent over the table crafting skin, and said no more.
...
...
More than a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Qingxi Market.
The South Bamboo Peak team, having completed their beast skin procurement, planned to rest for a night at the inn in the small town by the market and return at dawn.
In the dead of night, a slender, masked figure quietly left the inn, swiftly heading towards another residence.
She knocked on the door.
Entered.
Inside, a man wearing a silver-white sword robe looked at the masked figure before him in surprise, cautiously saying, "Coming so late, what might be your business?"
The shadow said, "Are you a brother from the Sword Sect?"
The man paused, then nodded, after all, the sword robe he wore was the disciple attire of Nanwu Sword Sect, then asked puzzledly, "Which Junior Sister might you be?"
The shadow reached into her chest and pulled out a palm-sized map, swiftly handing it to the man, saying, "Senior Brother, this is a map of part of Shadow Puppet Peak’s terrain, a place rich in Evil Qi, differing between night and day. Give it to the sect. Also... Xu Changjun Senior Brother is missing, possibly already sacrificed."
The man unfolded it, looked carefully, then nodded solemnly, "Don’t worry, I will relay it."
The shadow said, "Then, I’ll take my leave."
The man said, "Junior Sister, surrounded by foes, be very careful."Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn
"Thank you, Senior Brother," the shadow replied and turned around.
Behind her, the man in the sword robe suddenly grew cold, flicked his finger, and the flying sword silently unsheathed, with his finger sword technique, shot forth, about to hit the shadow’s back.
The shadow, realizing too late, turned around, her beautiful eyes filled with shock, confusion, fear...
But there was no time to react.
And just then, a male figure leaped down from the nearby wall, gripping a sword, standing behind her.
Clink!
The sound of sword rang crisply.
Clang!!
A sword flew out in reverse.
The figure that appeared was pinned to the ground by the flying sword.
Blood splattered, spraying the shadow’s face.
"Quick... go..." the figure shouted shakily, "Quickly go! He is a spy of the Demon Sect..."
The sword-robed man smiled, strode forward, fingers moved again, with the sword technique, the talking figure’s head was already severed.
The blood-stained flying sword suspended in mid-air.
And just then, not far away, several figures in sword robes flew over.
The sword-robed man was stunned, could not afford to kill the shadow anymore, turned to control his sword and flee.
The shadow stood in place like a fool, the black cloth slipped from her face, revealing a charming oval face, yet the heroism on it turned into extremely complex emotions.
She wiped the blood on her face, the blood on the ground, dumbstruck.
And just then, one figure among those chasing flew back, landed, looked at the shadow, paused upon recognition, then softly sighed, "Lady Qi Yao, being a spy isn’t easy, the battle between good and evil is more intrigue than the straightforward revenge you expect... go home."
Qi Yao looked at the blood in her palm, lips trembling.
She looked at the disciple who died for her, tremblingly asked, "Who is he?"
"Does it matter?"
"It matters, he saved me... he used his life to save me..."
"But many such disciples are dying."
Qi Yao took a deep breath, wiped the blood off her face, turned, and ran away quickly.
She closed her eyes tightly, holding back tears.
In the distance, the sword-robed figure sighed lightly but shook his head, did not pursue.

chapters.title: Chapter 20. Five Elements Silk Binding Hand, Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: 20. Five Elements Silk Binding Hand, Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique
Song Yan was intensely focused on leather crafting, all other matters were beyond his current reach.
With this wholehearted commitment and the foundational support of his "Profound Second Layer" body, his leather crafting speed increased rapidly.
In just six months, he went from making one shadow puppet every three days to one every two days.
Another six months passed, and he was able to make... one every day.
Of course, outwardly it remained two days per puppet because... he helped Zhang Yin by crafting some for him.
Zhang Yin was happy to "earn Contribution Points without working."
After enjoying this benefit for a full year, he finally kept his word and invited an Inner Sect Disciple with red embroidery and a double flower face on his back.
...
"Senior Brother, this Junior Brother of mine truly has talent in leather crafting.
I understand that the entry methods of your Skin Master are only sold to disciples who have entered the realm and have talent...
Is it possible for my Junior Brother to start practicing first?"
"Junior Brother Zhang, let me repeat, it’s not selling.
I am merely helping my master select some talented individuals to pass on our sect’s entry methods. If someone can enter the sect and showcase their talent through this, my master will naturally seek them out, which also helps nurture talent within the sect.
As for the cost... it’s just to make those disciples realize that our sect’s methods are not cheap.
By spending money, they learn to cherish it."
"What Senior Brother said is absolutely right, very reasonable, I am enlightened."
"Forget it, although he hasn’t entered the realm, there are some practices he can start.
It’s also a way to broaden the talent pool for my master.
Oh yeah, you just said... he makes one puppet every two days, with top quality. Let’s calculate it as a year, twelve months, 150 Contribution Points per month. So... I’ll sell my method for 1800 Contribution Points."
"Isn’t that a bit too expensive, considering it’s just entry-level..."
"Ah, this is to make those disciples understand our sect’s methods aren’t cheap. Do you think I really covet those 1800 Contribution Points? If it weren’t for my relationship with Junior Brother Zhang, I wouldn’t even be here." Senior Brother remarked earnestly.
Zhang Yin eyed him.
Senior Brother said, "Otherwise, wait until he has entered the realm to buy it. It will still be this price then, as the seller is me."
Zhang Yin:...
He sighed and said, "Senior Brother, let’s discuss it when we see Junior Brother Song."
...
A moment later.
The Inner Sect Disciple with red embroidery and a double flower face smiled satisfactorily at the young man in front of him. The young man, honest and straightforward, truly spent 1800 Contribution Points to buy his method.
At this moment, he said, "I am Zhao Yijing, from the lineage of Master Shi. The techniques that my lineage needs to learn are not simple.
’Five Elements Silk Binding Hand,’ ’Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique,’ mastering these two will earn you respect as a Skin Master anywhere.
However, what I am teaching you today is only the entry-level ’Little Five Elements Hand’ from ’Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand’ and the entry ’Skin Painting Technique’ from ’Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique.’
"The hide of a demon beast is extremely dangerous, concealing the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth. Not to mention mortals, even those cultivating profound arts could suffer corrosion from touching it. Then forget being a Skin Master, even crafting a few hides could lead to injury. At worst, the hand could rot, or worse... lead to death."
Zhao Yijing presented a box, saying, "So, the things you need are inside, you can start practicing early and get a head start. However, if you secretly give this method to someone else, undiscovered is fine, but if found out... hmph..."
This Inner Sect Disciple snorted coldly.
"I won’t," Song Yan replied, then opened the box to find six compartments within.
One compartment contained two brand-new booklets, while the other five held ten peculiar walnuts.
They were in pairs in each compartment, each emitting a mysterious aura he had never seen before.
These items were definitely not something available in a market.
The market, the market, to put it plainly, is just a derivative of the major sects, an important place for Loose Cultivator trade, but definitely not omnipotent.
Because the major sects first need to ensure that their core cultivation techniques aren’t sold to others, why would they put such things on sale there?
Contribution Points are a joke to the highest ranks of the major sects.
These are merely rules they established.
And rules are meant to serve the sect, the hierarchy cannot be overturned.
Zhao Yijing added, "Junior Brother Song, even though these booklets are handwritten copies, they can indeed help you get started.
If you really manage to enter the sect, you can find me at the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, and I’ll take you to meet Master Shi.
At that time, you will find that spending those 1800 Contribution Points was worth the value.
That’s all I have to say. You must work hard yourself."
With that, the disciple didn’t linger, turned, and left.
He weighed his identity plate, sensing the increased Contribution Points inside, and smiled contentedly.
As for entering the sect?
That’s impossible.
Not because he gave fake goods, but because even with so many disciples on the main peak, under the guidance of famous masters, those who shouldn’t enter, simply won’t.
Being a Skin Master is not something easy.
’Kid, just consider it a lesson bought with money. Daydreaming is not so easy,’ Zhao Yijing chuckled as he summoned a leather beast, mounted it, and flew away.
...
...
In the morning light, Song Yan opened the booklets one by one and studied them closely.
’Little Five Elements Hand’ involves practicing so that both hands are unaffected by the five elements, specifically practicing with the "five pairs of Five Elements Walnuts" gifted in the box.
Water is the gentlest, so start with the Water Element Walnuts.
Switch to Wood Element Walnuts after three days, as water generates wood.
After Wood Element, switch to Fire, Earth, and finally Metal Element.
After half a month, switch back to Water Element.
Repeat this cycle to practice the hands.
The sequence must not be wrong, otherwise, injuries will occur.
The "Five Elements Walnuts" contain balanced Five Elements Profound Qi, this... must be specially crafted by a master and isn’t easily bought.
This also reminded Song Yan of the "Cultivation Method for the Third Layer of Refining Profound," which clearly requires a certain external object.
Even if he gets that external object, he would quickly break through, but without it, he cannot.
His system cannot create something from nothing, nor can it bring forth something that doesn’t exist to help him break through the realm.
’Skin Painting Technique’ requires "Painting to Enter Divinity."
The painting drafts that these disciples received are not original works.
Due to engraving reasons, each painting draft can only make one shadow puppet.
Therefore, "Divine" drafts are very precious.
Song Yan observed for a long time but was startled to find that no new spell had appeared on his panel.
However, these two books didn’t seem fake.
So, he started practicing according to them.
Five Elements Walnuts turning in hand, observing things and searching for divinity, hidden in the heart.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
...
In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
The Five Elements Walnuts had completed a cycle in Song Yan’s palm.
And Song Yan suddenly had a sense that "Little Five Elements Hand" would soon appear on his panel.
Obviously, popular spells just need to be extracted from the Jade Scroll to appear on the panel.
But this kind of secret technique requires you to have a rough understanding and experience before it can appear on the panel.
Realizing this, Song Yan decided to put the cultivation of "Skin Painting Technique" on the agenda.
"Skin Painting Technique" states, "Observing things can search divinity."
Meaning: you must look at living things to know how to paint them to show their true appearance.
Although he didn’t understand what "painting more realistically" meant to a Skin Master, Song Yan knew it must be a crucial step.
And he also chose a good place: Cuique Forest!
Cuique Forest stretches across the main road from South Bamboo Peak to Shadow Puppet Peak, covering a vast area. As it lies over the remnant veins of the Profound Vein, some low-level demon beasts such as White Thorn Deer and Two-Headed Wolves exist here.
The west reaches the Evil Land, so it’s quite safe.
Song Yan asked thoroughly.
Low-level demon beasts correspond to the Human Race’s Realm of Refining Profound from the First to Third Layer, while White Thorn Deer and Two-Headed Wolves are merely trash beasts of the First and Second Layers.
In addition, disciples frequently travel this road between South Bamboo Peak and Shadow Puppet Peak, so it should be alright.
Maybe, he would even have a chance to practice.
After all, he had understood the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" and "Torrential Rain Evil" but hadn’t used them yet, unaware of their practical effectiveness.
...
...
That night, Song Yan lay down, enjoying the service by Miss Qiu, then started pondering about the "Cuique Forest" journey, considering potential dangers.
In another room, the Princess Consort of the Southern Prince was working with ordinary beast skin, also looking for something to do.
Suddenly, Song Yan’s expression changed, as he seemed to hear a faint noise in the distance.
The direction was precisely from Qi Yao’s room.
Speaking of which, since Qi Yao returned from Qingxi Market the year before last, she seemed to have changed.
How she changed, he couldn’t say.
The noise was very faint, and if he hadn’t reached Profound Second Layer, or if Qi Yao’s cave mansion wasn’t nearby, so to speak, "neighbors," he wouldn’t have heard it at all.
At this moment, Song Yan sat up from the bed, opened the stone door, hid behind an evergreen tree, and looked toward the distance.
A chilly wind blew, it was deep winter, and in the dark mountains, a girl with an icy expression stood tall, pointing her sword at a handsome, long-haired young man not far away.
The young man trembled and said, "Fairy Qi, I’m just stepping out... for some air, I meant no harm, nothing else..."
Qi Yao coldly said, "I deliberately left the door open to see if you’d try to escape again and where you’d go.
You’ve been a prince, you should know that here, you have nowhere to run. Even if you escape, it would be a dead end.
Yet you still ran away, not down the mountain, but upward... what are you planning?"
The mountaintop was precisely where South Bamboo Peak Master Cheng Danqing resided.
The Southern Prince said, "I didn’t go to the top; I just wanted some air... I’m heading back now..."
Before he finished, the young man suddenly started sprinting, surprisingly fast, evidently quite skilled. Qi Yao hadn’t reacted yet, and he had already covered several yards with two strides.
As he ran, he yelled, "There’s..."
A stone rapidly shot forward.
"...fine..."
The stone hit the back of his head.
The Southern Prince couldn’t finish the last word "exploration," because his head exploded like a watermelon, with white and red scattering everywhere, the shattered body plunging forward.
Song Yan stepped out from behind the tree, glanced at Qi Yao in the distance.
In the moonlight, they exchanged a brief look.
Song Yan waved his hand, saying, "Miss Qi, I killed your furnace. I hope you won’t blame me?"
Qi Yao said nothing, only staring vacantly at the dead Southern Prince.
Clearly... the country was devastated.
Clearly... she was sincere.
Clearly... she wanted to help him...
She hadn’t even used "Fanatic Fans" on him.
But the result was betrayal.
This time, had Song Yan not intervened, her identity might have been exposed.
Qi Yao asked, "Why did you kill him?"
Song Yan casually replied, "An identity-less servant outside; kill them if need be. Isn’t this our Shadow Puppet Peak’s rule? How... would Miss Qi seek revenge for him?"
Qi Yao took a deep breath, then coldly said, "You killed my furnace; how will I cultivate in the future?
Perhaps... we could engage in dual cultivation.
The complete version of the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" contains a method for dual cultivation by two cultivators, albeit slower but feasible."
She no longer wished for a "furnace."
But she was determined to hide here, to uncover more Puppet Palace secrets.
Thus, she decided to form a cultivation partnership with this unoffensive young man.
Song Yan said, "No, you’re too troublesome."
Qi Yao was taken aback.
Song Yan was already yawning and walking away.
Qi Yao remained silent, her beautiful eyes shutting, and after a long wait opened, seeming to have made a decision.
Now she had experienced blood, death, betrayal, in less than two years yet felt as if she had endured many years.
Qi Yao casually picked up the Southern Prince’s body, tossed it off a cliff, then returned ghostly to her cave mansion, closed the stone door, her face gradually sinking into the darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 21. Do not hide
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: 21. Do not hide
Rumble...
The stone door mechanism closed again.
"Brother Song, has something happened?" Qiu Lianyue asked nervously. Though she had been sleeping peacefully for the past two years, the pressure of confinement almost drove her crazy.
She longed to return to the towns of the mortal world, to experience the hustle and bustle of the market, to hear vendors’ cries at dawn, and to smell the smoke and dust of the evening streets.
But everything that was once ordinary, even annoying to her, had now become incredibly luxurious.
If not for Song Yan, she would have died long ago.
So, any disturbance involving Song Yan sufficed to make her anxious and worried.
Song Yan had never gone out at midnight.
Something must have happened today.
Song Yan was silent for a while, as if pondering something, then said, "Killed someone."
"Brother Song... th-this..." Qiu Lianyue stammered, thinking there was a conflict between fellow disciples.
Song Yan said, "It was Senior Sister Qi’s Furnace."
On the side, Cao Xuerou was abruptly startled, because any Furnace that came here must be of the Great Wei Royal Family bloodline. She might recognize...
Song Yan seemed to notice her small movement and said, "It was your husband. He defected, so I helped Senior Sister Qi kill him."
Pa...
A tender cry from a woman came from the side room, accompanied by the sound of beast skin and a scraper falling to the ground.
Qiu Lianyue was dumbfounded.
Song Yan glanced at the Princess Consort of King Zhen Nan in the side room and sighed softly.
He was not someone who liked taking risks.
Therefore, he would not gamble that "the commotion from killing King Zhen Nan would not be discovered." Rather than being exposed by others, it was better to naturally admit it himself.
After all, killing a fleeing servant is indeed a very normal thing.
As for the Princess Consort of King Zhen Nan.
This poor woman, her husband was dead, yet she was tormented by "Fanatic Fans," driving her to desire to be with her enemy. Such torture... was enough to make her pick up a skinning knife to commit suicide.
For her, this might be a good ending in a bad situation.
And for him, the Princess Consort’s death could prove his evil demon style.
Such... though dark, was a tragically winning situation.
Song Yan drew the curtains, lay back on the couch, and called for Miss Qiu, who had been planning to comfort Cao Xuerou, to serve him.
...ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
...
Many unexpected things will always happen in the world.
For example, early in the morning, Song Yan discovered that the Princess Consort had not committed suicide, but was kneeling before him, saying she was willing to serve him like Miss Qiu.
The Princess Consort said, life is short, make merry while you can. Actually, since being captured by the Blood Spear Sect and sent to this Puppet Sect, King Zhen Nan had already died. It wasn’t Song Yan who killed King Zhen Nan, but the unavoidable disaster of the country’s demise. King Zhen Nan being decisively killed by Song Yan was actually a blessing. The Princess Consort herself had also died, and now she only wanted to experience the joy of being a woman for the rest of her life.
Song Yan intended to refuse, but suddenly he heard a noise in the distance outside the stone door. It seemed someone had gone to the place where King Zhen Nan died last night.
He squinted, showing a thoughtful look, as if calculating something.
Soon, he sighed softly, lay down again, and waved to the Princess Consort.
The Princess Consort came, and after a while of rustling comfort...
Song Yan operated the Absorption Technique within the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," performing it twice in succession.
After a long time, the Princess Consort looked weak, lying limp on the bed.
...
After the affair ended, he walked out of the stone door.
As soon as he did, he hadn’t walked far before he saw a few disciples gathered on the cliff saying "it seems there was a commotion here last night."
Song Yan went straight forward and honestly said he saw a black shadow running around outside, the shadow didn’t respond, he faintly saw it seemed to be a Furnace, to prevent accidents, he struck and killed it.
The disciples laughed, saying "It should be killed, it should be killed."
Song Yan glanced across at Qi Yao’s cave mansion.
The stone door was tightly shut.
And he no longer wanted to be entangled with this woman.
Even though there was some fondness before, and some kindness, everything ceased to exist with that strike last night.
After the disciples dispersed, Wang Susu walked up to him and said softly, "Junior Sister Qi is too righteous. The Furnace defected, certainly not willing to use Fanatic Fans.
In ordinary days it’s nothing, but at this time... she might be suspected.
Junior Brother, you are a smart person. You killed that defected Furnace last night but did not deny it.
However, there are still issues with your conduct style."
After speaking, she lowered her voice, "Qiu Lianyue followed you for almost three years, yet nothing happened. But with the Princess Consort of King Zhen Nan, do you know if you used Fanatic Fans?"
Song Yan didn’t waste words, directly inviting Wang Susu into the cave for a look.
Wang Susu was an old hand with Fanatic Fans, very familiar with the obscene atmosphere in the air. After glancing at the Princess Consort of the South Suppressing King looking weak from being harvested, and the Strengthening Ginseng Pill placed on the table, she couldn’t help but cover her mouth and chuckle charmingly.
She playfully patted Song Yan’s arm and said, "I thought you were more upright, turns out you’re this type too. Want to give it a try with Senior Sister sometime? We won’t harvest each other, just to compensate for the regret back then. Hehehe..."
Song Yan smiled, saying nothing more.
If... the Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak wanted to pick a confidant from the disciples to help monitor things, he would definitely choose Wang Susu.
Because, Senior Sister Wang is a true Demon Sect demoness, ruthless and cunning, and knows how to ride the wind and avoid danger.
She is not one of those inexplicably fake demonesses who claim to be a demon but act like the most righteous Female Knight, even possessing a harvesting cultivation technique yet still remaining a virgin...
Sure enough, Wang Susu continued to laugh, "This matter, Senior Sister will vouch for you, but as for Miss Qi, Senior Sister can’t say for sure..."
Song Yan nodded.
Wang Susu said, "Let’s go to the Tannery together."
The two had been "partners" for almost two years.
This sentence of Wang Susu’s was as natural as "Let’s go have a meal together."
But Song Yan shook his head.
Wang Susu was genuinely stunned.
Song Yan explained, "Today I’m going to Cuique Forest."
Wang Susu asked in bewilderment, "What are you doing there?"
Song Yan replied, "The Skin Painting Technique says that if you want the drafts to preserve their spirit, you must see them with your eyes and observe them with your heart. There are two-headed wolves in Cuique Forest, so I’m going to take a look."
Skin Painting Technique...
Wang Susu was stunned for a long time.
The Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique is the cultivation technique of a Skin Master, and the status of a Skin Master is unimaginably high.
She nodded blankly but then quickly said, "Is it safe for Junior Brother to go alone?"
Song Yan smiled, "Cuique Forest is also an official path of Shadow Puppet Peak, and I’ve been refining profound for a long time. My physique is not like that of a mortal. At that time... I’ll choose a safe location to observe, should be fine.
How about... Senior Sister accompany me?"
Wang Susu hesitated but shook her head, as she had not yet reached the first level of refining profound and dared not wander around outside South Bamboo Peak.
However, she then rolled her eyes and said, "Don’t worry, Junior Brother. If the incident of that furnace’s tragic death last night causes trouble, Senior Sister will handle it for you."
"Senior Sister Wang is truly kind."
Song Yan felt somewhat emotional.
Someone as good as Qi Yao keeps adding trouble for him.
Instead, it’s Senior Sister Wang, this wicked demoness, who helps him solve many "little tails".
He once devoted his heart to the bright moon, but the bright moon illuminated his misfortune...
Wang Susu laughed heartily, "Junior Brother, you must remember Senior Sister’s kindness."
...
...
The lower place is not necessarily safe; when the sky falls, it’s never the tall ones who bear it first. Even a sheet of snow from the high place can be an unbearable weight for those below.
Therefore, when Song Yan was able to jump out from the Chores Room, he did not hesitate. The fact proves... those servants who didn’t jump out are indeed all dead.
Concealing one’s destination is not necessarily clever. Because the people around you are not fools; there will always be eyes watching you, ears hearing you. But when they see and hear that "you want to climb higher, on a path they cannot climb," they will instead elevate you, and offer you green lights everywhere.
Thus, Song Yan not only didn’t hide his intention to go to Cuique Forest, he openly announced it.
Not only did he tell Wang Susu, but anyone who asked along the way, he would candidly tell them.
He’s heading to cultivate the Skin Painting Technique.
...
Crunch, crunch, crunch...
The two water element walnuts in Song Yan’s palm were rapidly rotating, each turn carrying exceptionally rare Water Element Profound Qi into his palm, which was then slowly absorbed by his skin through the secret technique of the Little Five Elements Hand.
After about half an hour, he arrived at a cliff on the outskirts of South Bamboo Peak, beneath which was a lush, wild forest.
This path was most often taken by the official disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak.
But those disciples rode shadow puppets, either flying or traversing the tree tops, never delving deep into the forest.
Hence, the forest was abundant with low-level demon beasts.
Song Yan descended the slope of the mountain, entering the forest.
There was no entrance here, because every place was an entrance, and every place was an exit...
He walked for a long time, luck was on his side; behind a large rock, he spotted two two-headed wolves drinking water from afar, their four big heads clumsily bobbing.
Song Yan began to observe closely, his fingers tracing the outline of the two-headed wolves in the void.
Indeed, seeing the real thing is truly better than seeing a draft.
Much better!

chapters.title: Chapter 22. Silencing
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: 22. Silencing
Nothing happened that day.
In the evening, Song Yan returned to South Bamboo Peak, where Wang Susu found him and said softly, "Junior Brother, nothing over here now."
Song Yan replied, "Thank you, Senior Sister Wang."
Wang Susu laughed, "How’s your comprehension going?"
"Made some small progress."
"Then keep up the good work, Junior Brother. If you need anything, just ask.
Also, Qi Yao has been ordered by the Peak Master to stay confined and is not allowed to leave the mountain for now.
Do you... want to visit her?"
"No need."
"Hehe."
After finishing their conversation, they parted ways.
...
Song Yan returned to his cave mansion, glanced at the Princess Consort, who was still weak from the recent replenishment, but did not ask her to serve him. He simply said, "Xuerou, rest well today and come to me again tomorrow."
The Princess Consort seemed to have completed her self-hypnosis; the seductive aura from the Multi-tailed Fox Race’s hidden bloodline had been thoroughly awakened. At this moment, she was sucking her fingers, completely lost in bewitching poses, sinking into desire, and said, "Rou’er belongs to Song Lang, all of Song Lang’s. Song Lang made Rou’er feel like the first time she became a woman..."
Song Yan looked at her appearance with a complex mood, only feeling that "Fanatic Fans" was terrifying.
When one’s power is even slightly higher, it can completely manipulate those below.
What is integrity, chastity, or willpower when faced with such power, all crumble.
He could do this to mortals.
Those higher-up cultivators could probably do the same to him.
It truly was like walking on thin ice, constantly on edge...
...
...
Thus, for several days.
One day, as usual, Song Yan planned to go to Cuique Forest, but just as he stepped out of his cave mansion, he heard a quarrel from afar.
Looking in the direction of the sound, he saw a skinny, wrinkled old man arguing with Zhang Yin.
Song Yan not only recognized the old man but was also quite familiar with him.
His name was Kang Defu, the oldest among the successful servant cultivators; the day of the test, he had stood behind Zhang Yin.
At this moment, Kang Defu was angrily saying, "Brother Zhang, am I not an official disciple?
Why didn’t you allot me a Furnace from the Great Wei Royal Family?
You said there wasn’t enough before, but yesterday I saw a new batch of royal Furnaces delivered at the market down the mountain!
Why is there still none for me?"
Zhang Yin frowned at him, showing some mockery, and said, "Junior Brother Kang, you’re already in your seventies or eighties, why bother with the finest Furnace from the Great Wei Royal Family? It’s a waste!"
"Brother Zhang..." Kang Defu was so angry he was panting, and said angrily, "But this is what I’m entitled to!"
Slap!!
Zhang Yin slapped him, knocking Kang Defu flying, his mouth full of blood.
Still not satisfied, Zhang Yin stepped forward, stepping on Kang Defu’s face, looking down at him with a half-smile, "You’re this old and still don’t understand the rules.
Learn from Brother Song more.
Get out!"
In the distance, Song Yan who was listening felt a bit speechless.
How did he get dragged into this?
But on second thought, he seemed to be doing quite well here indeed.
Zhang Yin helped him ask the Inner Sect Disciples to teach him the "Little Five Elements Hand" and the "Skin Painting Technique."
Wang Susu spoke on his behalf, actively helping him clear all suspicions.
Kang Defu got up spitefully, spat out some bloody saliva, but didn’t dare to make a sound, and just left.
Song Yan tightened his Profound Robe and headed towards Cuique Forest.
...
...
It is already deep winter now.
Soon, light snowflakes began to drift between the cliffs.
The snow intensified, the mountain birds flew far away, and the desolate forest covered in snow resembled white hair.
Song Yan listened to the howling wind around him, thought briefly, and decided to practice today.
He had observed low level demon beasts for many days, but still felt something was missing, so after much contemplation, he decided to try a method mentioned in the "Skin Painting Technique": kill, dissect, measure.
Kill the demon beast, dissect it, use his hands to perceive every inch of the demon beast’s body, carefully understand.
This... is the quickest way to perceive "Skin Painting."
He needed to get the "Skin Painting Technique" onto his panel as soon as possible so that he could perform a Life Span Calculation.
The weather was clear before, which was not suitable.
But today, with the chaotic sounds of nature, it could cover many movements, and if he went even further, it could work.
...
...
Two double-headed wolves were dashing out from a cave.
The cold weather didn’t bother them much, but it could make some ordinary beasts let their guard down, and they might even come across one that was frozen senseless if they were lucky.
The double-headed wolves might not have much brains, but they had hunting instincts and experience from living in this environment for a long time.
Whoosh whoosh~~
Whoosh whoosh whoosh~~~
The double-headed wolves started sprinting.
They were having decent luck today; shortly they saw a two-legged creature on the snow.
The wolves’ eight eyes glowed darkly. They hunched down slightly, quietly moving closer, but the two-legged creature seemed completely unaware.
Once within a certain distance, the wolves drooled with foul-smelling saliva, exchanged a glance, and suddenly accelerated.
The charge kicked up a flurry of snow fog.
In the eyes of the unfortunate two-legged creature, all it saw was the snow fog blasting apart as two ferocious black shadows shot forward like the wind, pouncing straight at it.
But just then, one of the trailing two-headed wolves heard an odd sound, different from wind, snow, or forest rustle.
As the sound fell, a cold light pierced through its heart.
The two-headed wolf’s vision darkened.
It collapsed.
Dead.
The other two-headed wolf had already leaped up, targeting the two-legged creature’s neck, seeming to slightly raise its hand.
But the creature reacted quickly. The raised hand became a returning hand, blocking the wolf’s mouth.
The wolf unhesitatingly bit at the proffered hand.
But in the next instant, the hand turned black in its eyes.
It was a terrifying, mysterious black.
As the fangs fell, a strong explosive force emanated from the blackness of that hand.
Clearly, that hand didn’t even move, yet inside it was like a cataclysmic explosion had occurred.
Crack!The source of thɪs content is ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Bang!!
Boom!!!
Time seemed to slow down.
The dual-headed wolf’s teeth were the first to shatter, followed by its mouth, and then its head.
Blood, brain matter, shattered bones, and bits of flesh exploded in mid-air.
At this moment, the two-legged creature’s speed suddenly accelerated, darting back two or three zhang, while the exploding flesh and blood fell just short of his feet, sparing his clothes from being soiled.
...
...
This two-legged creature was Song Yan.
Song Yan had fought a bit and felt his combat power should be adequate.
After all, on the hill, he roughly understood that "although dual-headed wolves are low-level demon beasts, only equivalent to Refining Profound First Layer, they cannot be instantly killed even by a Refining Profound Second Layer," yet he easily killed two.
The young man crouched down and began quickly studying the dual-headed wolf.
The scent of blood would soon lure other demon beasts or wild animals, and he didn’t have much time.
Fortunately, "the battle with the dual-headed wolf" indeed gave him more insights into this existence called "dual-headed wolf."
A stick of incense later, noises came from afar, seeming like quite a few things were either approaching or moving away.
Song Yan stood up, washed his hands with snow, and waved at the pairs of green eyes in the snowy bushes not far away, signaling that they could come and eat.
He happily walked back, thinking as he went, and casually took out two Earth Element Walnuts, twirling them in his palm.
As he kept turning them, he suddenly felt something and took another look at the panel.
Goodness gracious.
It wasn’t just a few more, there were suddenly two extra lines.
[Magic: (Life Span Calculation available)]
"Skin Painting Technique" (Not entry-level)
"Little Five Elements Hand" (Not entry-level)
Clearly, whether it’s the "Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand" or the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique," their cultivation is very difficult. Even the entry-level techniques, when disassembled, cannot be mastered in just a few days.
But since they appeared on the panel, Song Yan felt the problem wasn’t significant anymore.
’You reap what you sow.’
The young man was filled with joy.
...
...
After about two sticks of incense, suddenly Song Yan frowned, preparing to dodge something, yet saw two figures riding dual-headed wolf shadow puppets coming through the forest.
Upon closer look, it was the Outer Disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak wearing Profound Robe with profound patterns.
The newcomers did not lower their guard because Song Yan was in uniform; instead, they sternly asked, "Which Peak are you from? What are you doing here?!"
Song Yan calmly replied, "Brother Disciple is from South Bamboo Peak, here to observe demon beasts for the Talisman Master’s ’Skin Painting Technique’ which requires divine insight. This can be proven by everyone up and down South Bamboo Peak."
The two disciples exchanged glances, and suddenly one threw an iron shackle, coldly saying, "Put it on yourself first, go back with us and then talk."
Song Yan furrowed his brows.
Just then, he suddenly tightened his expression, quietly stepped back half a step, protecting the two senior brothers behind him.
The two Outer Disciples also sensed something, instantly becoming tense, scanning the surroundings of the woods with vigilance.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Two gray-clad figures swept out from the woods, one holding a sword, the other with a gourd.
"Hey, three demonic brats..."
"Kill, to avenge for the Great Wei Royal Family!"
The sword-wielding person instantly sent the sword flying.
The one with the gourd shook its mouth, releasing iron pellets flying out, carrying a dark sheen rapidly towards the three.
Originally tense, the Outer Disciples seemed to perceive the other party’s level, and suddenly burst into laughter, lifting one hand slightly, accelerating the dual-headed wolf shadow puppet, and moving the other hand, causing another shadow puppet to fly out.
Upon closer look, it was a bird with a sharp beak like a knife, and the other was the White Thorn Deer, very familiar to Song Yan.
The four clashed together.
In the first instant, Song Yan dodged behind a tree, watching them strangely.
Yes.
Though he lacked experience in battling people, at this moment he could tell, these four, although wielding weapons and shadow puppets he didn’t have, were all just at Refining Profound Second Layer, just like him.
Those holding the sword and gourd, presumably the Loose Cultivators kept by the Great Wei Royal Family as enshrinees, now infiltrating the mountains to kill a few Puppet Palace disciples for some revenge for the Great Wei Royal Family.
And those two Official Disciples were patrolling here, which made Song Yan’s previously anxious heart slightly settle.
Since they were indeed from his own sect, after the fight, he could be shackled, and after explaining, it would be fine.
In no time, suddenly Song Yan heard a scream, seeing a Shadow Puppet Peak disciple’s left arm severed by a flying sword.
The other disciple, distracted, was also hit straight by the iron pellets, falling to the ground. Just as he struggled to get up, he was struck again quickly by the flying sword.
However, the sword-wielding Loose Cultivator was also negligent and got pierced by the severed-arm disciple manipulating a bird shadow puppet.
After a dozen seconds of fierce entanglement...
Four people, one dead, two severely injured, one lightly injured.
The dead and severely injured were from Shadow Puppet Peak.
And the lightly injured was the gourd-wielder.
That just slightly injured gourd Loose Cultivator’s gaze swiftly landed on Song Yan, without wasting words, shouting loudly, hands forming a spell, and the iron pellets poured out once more.
Song Yan suddenly flickered like a whirlwind, instantly reaching the gourd Loose Cultivator.
The Loose Cultivator was stunned, yet unpanicked, raising his hand with two fingers like a sword pointing down, the tips brimming with Profound Qi, falling onto Song Yan’s incoming palm in a flash.
The next moment, the gourd Loose Cultivator’s face changed drastically, shocked, and astonished because he felt a terrifying suction coming from the opposite side, sucking away all the Profound Qi from his fingertips, breaking down his magic naturally without attack.
’What kind of evil art is this?’
’Where did my Profound Qi go?!’
Song Yan, taking advantage, pushed, his palm landing on the gourd Loose Cultivator’s head.
Bang!
The gourd Loose Cultivator, dead!
Song Yan, like a phantom, instantly approached the flying sword Loose Cultivator.
Bang!
The flying sword Loose Cultivator, dead.
Looking at the remaining senior brother, he sighed lightly.
In an instant...
Bang!
Senior brother, dead!
...
The absorbed Profound Qi rippled within, a sensation of becoming more, but merely "impurity."
It made Song Yan quite uncomfortable, but now... he still needed to endure this discomfort, quickly fetch some corpses first.

chapters.title: Chapter 23. Wonderful Use
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: 23. Wonderful Use
Perhaps because it was the first time in both his past and present lives that he had looted a corpse, Song Yan’s hands couldn’t help but tremble slightly.
However, within just half an incense stick of time, he quickly finished searching.
The two Official Disciples from Shadow Puppet Peak only had Identity Tokens on them. There might have been many Contribution Points inside, but when those two died, the Contribution Points became completely worthless; Song Yan couldn’t even see them.
A typical case of "the person dies before the money is spent, and others can’t spend it for them, pure and unstinting dedication to the Puppet Palace."
As for the two Loose Cultivators, there were more things in their arms.
A small pouch of crystal jade, the size of soybean grains, emitting Profound Qi, of which the nature was unknown;
A stack of silver notes from the "Nine Zhi Bank," whereabouts unknown;
A book recording some cultivation insights of Flying Sword Cultivators;
A Jade Scroll; Song Yan stretched out his hand and extracted a spell from it called "Qi Burst Technique," which surprisingly wasn’t a common Technique. It had an "entry-level requirement" of the "Third Layer of Refining Profound," clearly indicating that the Loose Cultivator obtained it externally, intending to cultivate it later after improving his own skill.
Of course...
Apart from the aforementioned items found in the pockets, there were also four Shadow Puppets, a Flying Sword, and a gourd that could release iron pellets.
Song Yan examined those "Shadow Puppet Products" up close, noting the differences from his own Shadow Puppets.
The first impression: Divine!
These Shadow Puppet products appeared more spirited, as if really housing some strange Divine Soul within.
Soon, Song Yan discovered the source of the Divine Soul — the eyes.
Whether it was the two-headed wolf, the Flying Sparrow with beak like knives, or the White Thorn Deer, their eyes all seemed peculiar, full of vitality yet dead and eerie.
Though they were painted using a simple "pigment technique," they gave Song Yan a feeling as if they were staring right at him.
The atmosphere fell silent for a moment.
Song Yan locked eyes with the collapsed two-headed wolf.
Suddenly, he raised his hand quickly and used the second mutation spell ’Torrential Rain Evil.’
Thud!
Thud!
Thud thud!!
After four headshots.
The heads of the four "Shadow Puppet Products" were gone, and naturally, the spirit in their eyes was also gone.
Song Yan continued his onslaught until the Shadow Puppets were blasted apart, finally exhaling a long breath, sighing inwardly: ’That was close, really so close.’
If he hadn’t been looting the corpses and noticed that these four Shadow Puppets could indeed have some form of awareness.
If he hadn’t looted the corpses and turned around to leave, only for someone coming later to use those four Shadow Puppets to find out what happened on site, he’d be doomed for sure.
’Truly, information determines life and death.’
Thereafter, Song Yan hastily bundled those items together, added some stones, and tossed them into the nearby river, turning back to see the Demon Beasts had already reached the four Cultivators’ corpses, beginning to feast on them.
In Cuique Forest, bodies wouldn’t stay long.
And for those items looted from corpses, Song Yan wouldn’t dare to risk carrying them away.
Where would you hide a pouch of "jingling" crystal jade? How to explain if questioned later? It’s better to find out they hold value some day and then seize an opportunity to retrieve them from the river.
Today’s gain was already substantial enough, no need to court additional trouble for mere trifles.
...
...
The Azure Mountain was already snow-laden, yet, fluffy snowflakes continued to descend from the sky.
Song Yan’s Profound Robe quickly turned white, and by the time he returned to South Bamboo Peak, it was entirely snow-covered.
He heaved a long sigh, thoroughly expelling the foreign Profound Qi he had temporarily absorbed before striding forward.
The South Bamboo Peak disciples on duty were well acquainted with his outings, raising a hand in greeting, smiling as they asked, "How’s that ’Skin Painting Technique’ coming along, Junior Brother?"
Song Yan replied, "Not bad..."
After he walked past, the on-duty disciple turned to his companion and chuckled, "This young one, such a stubborn mouth. What’s working? Just daydreaming, really think being a Skin Master is that easy?"
The other on-duty disciple yawned, seemingly uninterested in the topic, suggesting instead, "Shall we head down to the small bazaar later? While it may not offer top-grade goods like the Great Wei Royal Family has in their Furnace, we might still chatter with certain Jianghu folk, perhaps catching the eye of a fine little lady."
"As long as she’s pretty, I’m not banking on cultivating with a Furnace..."
The tasks for South Bamboo Peak disciples ranged from "external purchasing" and "making Demon Beast Shadow Puppets" to "overseeing the Tannery Room," among other scattered duties.
Guard duty was one of them.
Yet, standing guard at the Main Peak of South Bamboo Peak wasn’t a role for the servants.
Here, all were entry-level, Official Disciples who felt advancement was hopeless.
They willingly guarded here because the Contribution Points were relatively higher and stable, a secure way to serve until old age.
...
...
Song Yan entered the Cave Mansion, took off the Profound Robe, and Young Lady Qiu quickly brought a luxurious blanket to keep him warm, taking the Profound Robe to shake off the snow, hanging it under a skylight.
Outside the skylight, heavy snow fell in torrents, piercingly cold.
Inside the Cave Mansion hall, a blazing furnace fire roared, releasing a refreshing pine scent. It was Spirit Wood from the mountain, delivered by some servants, which could warm the body and purify the mind when burned.
"Xuerou!"
Song Yan didn’t see the Princess Consort, so he called out.
On the other side, the Princess Consort swiftly lifted the curtain and walked out. Her pretty face surprisingly showed no trace of anger or resentment; instead, it carried a sort of lingering joy.
"Song Lang, Song Lang! I discovered some mountain chili peppers, growing from a crack in a rock.
Winter peppers, and grown in this Immortal Land, they are quite rare."
Song Yan was also curious. He went to look and indeed saw that on the rocky area of the cave where the Princess Consort was, several pepper-like plants were growing. It was unclear what they were.
However, he cautioned, "When did they appear?"
"Just today."
"Then tonight, you and Lianyue come sleep in my room. Tomorrow, after I’ve checked them, you can return to prevent any potential poisoning."
"Okay, Song Lang.
But... I’m sure they are chili peppers."
"Why are you so certain?"
"I grew up in the Shu Kingdom, where I loved to eat spicy food.
So, I am very familiar with the appearance and taste of peppers.
I was also fortunate enough to have once obtained a Spirit Flower Atlas, supposedly found by my grandfather from who knows where.
The atlas states that these mountain chili peppers grow in the depths of winter, breaking through the stone, and should be a delicacy called ’Fire-Breath Pepper.’
Their spiciness is similar to regular chili peppers, but after ingestion, they warm the body, making them a fine delicacy.
It’s said that eating one Fire-Breath Pepper means even if you sleep naked in the snow overnight, you won’t freeze to death."
Cao Xuerou spoke quite a bit in one breath, then hurriedly continued, "I...I am in a mountain cave mansion, and although I don’t go hungry due to the Fasting Pills, I somehow still crave the delicacies of the mortal world... that’s why I’m so excited. Please don’t mind, my lord."
"Hmm... I don’t mind."Follow current novels on
Song Yan nodded, he understood.
That night.
He shared the bed with the young lady Qiu and the Princess Consort.
After a brief moment of absurd Essence Gathering.
The two women weakly collapsed, snuggling on either side of him in his embrace.
Before gathering, it was fine, but after gathering, Song Yan clearly felt that the ’Profound Qi gathered from the Princess Consort’ was much more.
It was evident that the quality of a furnace was not just talk, and that the Great Wei Royal Family with ’extremely thin blood of the Multi-tailed Fox Race’ was indeed superior to ordinary women.
Song Yan sighed lightly.
Gathering essence was truly not his original intention, and he did not need to practice cultivation through gathering.
Looking at the Princess Consort sleeping soundly in his arms, he slowly withdrew his gaze and stopped thinking further.
How could the weak transcend the rules?
He had no choice.
Nor did the Princess Consort.
A muddled, carefree approach, enjoying the moment.
It was all just to survive.
...
Feeling that both women were asleep, Song Yan glanced at the panel:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 21/16524]
[Magic]
"Skin Painting Technique" (Not entry-level)
"Little Five Elements Hand" (Not entry-level)
"Qi Burst Technique" (Not entry-level) (Threshold: Refining Profound Third Layer)
...
After some thought, he closed his eyes again.
He did not intend to deduce the Skin Painting Technique to the extreme at once. Instead, he planned to spend a month’s lifespan each day to deduce it.
In this way... the talent he exhibited as a Skin Master is thirty times that of a normal person.
This would avoid any abruptness like "leaping forward in one step, making people want to dissect him or use Soul-Searching Skill to question his opportunities," without appearing too ordinary.
Of course, if even thirty times his talent wouldn’t suffice, then... forty times, fifty times were also possible.
...
For his trump card, he would deduce to the extreme in one go, like the previous Qi Arrow Technique and Breath Concealment Technique.
But for those powers that needed to be displayed in front of others, he would operate this way.
Knowing how to make good use of his talent required some skill.
’Tomorrow, let’s see how the sect handles the missing disciples near Cuique Forest, then decide...’
’Also, find an opportunity to go to the market at the foot of the mountain to acquire some more techniques, like the Soul-Searching Skill. If I had that technique today, I might have learned more information.’
Song Yan calculated, feeling fatigue gradually overtake him.
He withdrew his arm from under the heads of the two women, turned to casually embrace one, and pressed closely as he drifted into dreamland.

chapters.title: Chapter 24. Genius
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: 24. Genius
The next day, early morning.
Song Yan sought out Senior Brother Zhang to look at the "red pepper"-like thing growing from the stone crack in the house, and was then informed, "This is indeed a Fire-Breath Pepper." Seeing his interest, Senior Brother Zhang even gifted him a stone flower bed about half a meter in length and width, filled with spiritual soil.
Song Yan gave this flower bed directly to the Princess Consort, letting her play with it as she wished.
While wandering outside casually, the "two missing disciples incident" apparently had not spread, so there was not much commotion.
Song Yan went to Cuique Forest as usual.
But today, he truly "matched his words with actions," only standing at the edge of the forest, rather than delving deep like the day before.
...
...
Like this, for three consecutive days.
