On the fourth day, when he intended to go to Cuique Forest again, Zhang Yin suddenly grabbed him.
"Don’t go for now."
"What’s wrong, Senior Brother?"
"Some loose cultivators supported by the Great Wei Royal Family, along with some disciples of the Southern Wu Jianmen, have quietly infiltrated the outer area of our Puppet Sect. Several patrolling official disciples have gone missing; some corpses were found, others... completely disappeared." Zhang Yin’s expression was grave.
Song Yan showed an appropriate amount of shock and fear: "This... since when?"
Zhang Yin chuckled: "Just these past two days. Even in Cuique Forest, some patrolling disciples have disappeared. You’ve been lucky, but luck won’t always be on your side, so best not to go for now."
Song Yan clenched his fists, exclaiming angrily, "Southern Wu Jianmen, too much bullying!"
"Indeed." Zhang Yin said, "We only capture some servants, make some furnaces, and shield those gangs in the Jianghu that lean towards us, yet they insist on attacking us, it’s outrageous!"
Song Yan: ...
Hmm.
Capturing large batches of slaves, disregarding human lives; forcibly taking beautiful men and women from the mortal world, leading to the ruin of families; shielding the evil sects and crooked paths of the Jianghu, giving them a protective umbrella and creating fertile soil for bad influences to thrive...
Senior Brother, oh Senior Brother, you truly have no shame.
But now he was also a part of the Demon Sect, and in order to survive, his actions had become somewhat demonic too. Though it was not his original intention and done out of helplessness, the affairs of the world have always been judged by deeds, not intentions.
Thinking of this, Song Yan said, "Just as well, during this time I’ve gained some insight into the ’Skin Painting Technique,’ so I’ll stay on the peak to make skins.
The same old rule, I’ll do the share for Senior Brother, and the contribution points can be counted as Senior Brother’s."
Zhang Yin, hearing this, beamed with joy, affectionately embracing his shoulder, and said with a smile, "I just like people like you, Junior Brother. Rest assured, with Senior Brother here, you won’t suffer any loss."
As for the "insight into the Skin Painting Technique," Zhang Yin just pretended not to hear it.
In his view, while the junior brother was diligent and had some talent, he was still far, far away from entering the realm of a Skin Master.
...
...
A month later...
Zhang Yin held the "Double-headed Wolf Shadow Puppet" made from demon beast skin in his hands, repeatedly examining it under the deep winter sunlight.
The mountain wind blew, lifting his temples, but his eyes seemed glued to the shadow puppet, motionless.
Suddenly, his Adam’s apple bobbed, and he swallowed hard, his eyes revealing disbelief.
This Senior Brother Zhang, as a standard disciple of the Demon Sect, rarely lost his composure, but he had done so frequently in the past few days.
He looked at the "Double-headed Wolf Shadow Puppet," recalling the previous ones, and startlingly realized that if the shadow puppet from thirty days ago was ordinary, and the one from fifteen days ago was good, then the current one... was excellent.
Since returning from Cuique Forest, Junior Brother Song has been progressing rapidly in the art of skin making at a "visibly fast pace."
Zhang Yin always believed that "cultivation is a very slow process, everything needs to be subtle and imperceptible," yet... he had heard of certain things.
Realm cultivation is quite lengthy because it mainly depends on the proficiency of the Profound Root talent.
Although Profound Root talent is hard to measure, it can still be assessed through certain tests.
But... magic cultivation is a completely different matter.
Comprehension is unseen and intangible.
The vast majority of cultivators have similar comprehension, but there are a very few with excellent comprehension, and those individuals, when understanding a magic, are indeed worlds apart from ordinary cultivators.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
This doesn’t have much to do with the Profound Root.
Some people may not have good Profound Root talent, and may perform mediocrely in most magical understanding, but in one specific type of magic, they might exhibit exceptionally strong comprehension!
If they lack opportunities, they might never discover this talent throughout their lives.
But if they encounter the right opportunity, they will burst forth with stunning brilliance!
Zhang Yin had only ever heard about such people.
But today, he believed he had truly encountered one.
"This shadow puppet already has a divine resemblance, very lifelike."
"Junior Brother Song truly has the talent to become a Skin Master."
"He just went to wander Cuique Forest by himself, if guided by a famous teacher..."
Zhang Yin dared not think further, taking a deep breath, he ran towards the peak, heading to the Cave Mansion of Peak Master Cheng Danqing on South Bamboo Peak.
Usually, the Master is cultivating inside the cave, and he would not disturb him.
But today, he felt this matter was of no small importance and had to tell his Master.
Knock knock knock...
He lifted his hand and gently knocked on the stone door.
However...
There was no response from inside.
Zhang Yin knocked again.
Still nothing.
It’s as if... the master who was supposed to be cultivating in the cave isn’t here today.
"Where did the master go?" Zhang Yin showed a slight expression of doubt, but he turned and left.
...
...
The next day, Zhang Yin finally met Cheng Danqing.
"I was cultivating in my residence yesterday and perhaps got too absorbed; I didn’t hear your knocking." Cheng Danqing casually explained, "What do you need?"
"Master, please take a look." Zhang Yin took out two "Two-Headed Wolf Shadow Puppets" and excitedly handed them over.
One puppet was unremarkable, the other vivid and lifelike.
Cheng Danqing took them, looked at them, and raised the lifelike one, asking, "Who made this?"
"Song Yan, Junior Brother Song!"
"And this one?" Cheng Danqing slightly raised the unremarkable one.
"Also made by Junior Brother Song Yan, but he made it a month ago."
Zhang Yin immediately explained everything but skipped over the greedy details.
Cheng Danqing, after examining the two shadow puppets repeatedly, suddenly asked, "Do you still have all the puppets he’s made this month?"
Zhang Yin replied, "Yes, recently there’s tension in the sect, and the disciples who came to collect them were delayed; all the puppets are still in the storage and haven’t been sent out."
"Bring them over."
After saying this, Cheng Danqing added, "I’ll go with you to take a look!"
...
...
A moment later.
Thirty pairs of "Two-Headed Wolf Shadow Puppets" were laid out in front of Cheng Danqing.
Cheng Danqing examined each one, and by the end, his unruffled gaze had shifted.
He uttered one phrase: "Genius."
Zhang Yin clapped his hands, "This is a true genius; I never thought I’d encounter one."
Cheng Danqing lowered his eyes, pondered a bit, and said, "Go tell Song Yan that I will personally visit the main peak for him to discuss his matters with Elder Shi."
"Yes, Master!"
...
...
In the evening.
Zhang Yin went to the Skinning Cave Mansion, observing Song Yan’s focused expression, his fluent drawing, and skin-making, patiently waiting on the side. Only after he finished did he come forward and pat him on the shoulder.
Song Yan understood and followed him out of the cave mansion.
Zhang Yin said seriously, "Junior Brother, I discovered you have a significant talent in skin-making. Therefore, I specifically asked Master to go to the main peak for your matter and pay a visit to Elder Shi."
Song Yan replied, "Thank you, Senior Brother."
Zhang Yin waved his hand, "No need for thanks between brothers. Also, from now on, all the skins you make will count towards your own contribution points; no need to give them to Senior Brother anymore..."
Seeing Song Yan about to speak again, Zhang Yin said softly, "Or should Senior Brother return everything to you? Just give me some time, alright?"
Song Yan: ...
...
...
The next day.
The main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak.
In a mysterious dark hall, a strange and huge figure sat with its back to the light, enveloped in a thick aura of death, its face unseen.
Cheng Danqing entered through a side method door and reported respectfully.
That person responded.
The voice was very peculiar, as if two faces were mixed together, chattering away.
"Skin Master is a talent, and we need such talent too.
But the Profound Jade will shine on its own...
This way, Elder Stone Seat will hold a demon beast exhibition in Linglong Valley next month for half a month, to observe the divine nature of demon beasts.
At that time, many Skin Masters, and even those with potential, will be there...
You recommend him to go, let him see the world in Linglong Valley, and also test what level of skill he really has.
The rest... we’ll discuss later."
"Yes."
Cheng Danqing responded respectfully.
The mysterious figure then said, "How’s the task I assigned you to find the spy from Nanwu Sword Sect going?"
Cheng Danqing respectfully replied, "Arrangements have been made; I believe there will be news soon."
The mysterious figure said, "Hurry up, King Wei has already successfully escaped to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, and he should soon see his elder from the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox Race... and our opportunity is arriving soon."
The words ended with a sinister laugh.
Cheng Danqing grinned, following with a "Heheh." laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 25. Omen
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: 25. Omen
That evening, the snow had not ceased.
An invitation was delivered into Song Yan’s hands.
On an unknown piece of beast hide, it was written in red sand: "Linglong Valley Exotic Beast Association", "Song Yan, Shadow Puppet 334".
"Bring this invitation and your identity token, and wait at South Bamboo Peak in half a month.
Master Shi will send someone to take you to Linglong Valley for beast observation.
Among the exotic beasts hides a divine presence; seeing a hundred beasts leads to knowing a hundred beasts. Only skin masters who can paint the divine appearance, or those with sufficient talent, are allowed to go.
This was a request from our senior brother to the master for you, so go see the world."
Zhang Yin finished speaking and then softly added, "However, this spot is a temporary addition.
Master Shi is rigid by nature and likely doesn’t like such things, so he might completely ignore you. If there’s a disciple nearby good at reading the room, they might mock you to curry favor with Master Shi...
All this nonsense, I’m letting you know in advance. Be prepared to prevent things from turning sour or encountering unexpected problems.
In short, remember, even though you have talent, you’re still a junior. This trip is for learning, so speak less, listen and observe more."
Song Yan smiled and said, "Thank you, senior brother, for the advice. I won’t forget this favor."The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
Zhang Yin left, feeling happy and affectionately patted his shoulder.
Song Yan looked at the invitation in his hand, feeling a tinge of anticipation.
These days, he was indeed practicing Life Span Calculation on the "Skin Painting Technique", but upon reaching a certain level, he encountered a bottleneck.
For the "Skin Painting Technique" to reach perfection, it requires one condition: to observe as many demon beasts as possible.
This means the environment must be suitable.
In a place without demon beasts, even if he practiced for hundreds or thousands of years, he couldn’t progress with the "Skin Painting Technique", since he can’t conjure demon beasts out of thin air.
Honestly, this was troubling him.
But unexpectedly, it was as if the pillow was delivered to him just when he needed it the most.
He glanced at the tightly closed stone door of the cave mansion not far across.
He remembered Qi Yao had been confined there for some time.
He really didn’t know how this "Nanwu Sword Sect’s little spy" would break out of her predicament, but he wouldn’t lend any more help.
He didn’t mind helping a good person in need, but if his own safety was at stake, he wouldn’t foolishly get involved.
Returning to his cave mansion, he shut the stone door.
Because of the snowy weather, there was little light inside the cave mansion, giving it a somewhat dismal atmosphere.
Miss Qiu and the Princess Consort were busy sorting "fire-breath pepper", along with some spirit flowers and herbs brought by Wang Susu and Zhang Yin.
These flowers and herbs had little practical use, mainly "air purification", "non-toxic", or even "edible".
The two women sat by the stone table, meticulously arranging the spirit soil in the flower beds and ensuring equal spacing between each flower...
Apart from skin making, tending to flowers was all they could do.
Muddling through life...
Just like that.
...
...
Having received the Linglong Valley invitation, Song Yan felt he could finally breathe a little easier. After dealing with the two ladies at night, he said, "Tomorrow I plan to visit the market at the foot of the mountain. I remember there’s a restaurant there. I’ll bring back some dishes from the restaurant for us to eat together."
Even though Fasting Pills kept them from feeling hungry, they also took away the joy of eating.
The two women brightened up.
Even such a small thing as sharing a meal was something they looked forward to.
...
...
The next day...
Song Yan confidently descended the mountain, firstly purchasing "Strengthening Ginseng Pill", and then heading to the restaurant at the market. He spent 1 Contribution Point to buy a box of three pots of gourmet delicacies, each a supreme culinary masterpiece. According to the restaurant owner, the chef was an Imperial Chef, formerly serving at national banquets.
He then "incidentally" spent 199 Contribution Points to acquire the "Soul-Searching Skill".
Balance: 1324 Contribution Points.
However, what appeared on his panel was "Soul-Searching Skill (not entry-level) (threshold: Refining Profound Third Layer)", clearly showing that this magic requires reaching a certain level of cultivation to execute.
Song Yan shook his head.
Advancing his realm was the most critical task.
But he already knew quite a bit about realms.
Realms aren’t about comprehension, so unless there’s a great fortuitous encounter, it’s impossible to make rapid advances.
Advancing in realm is all about "Profound Root Talent", "Cave Mansion", "Furnace", "Elixirs" and so on... If he suddenly claimed he had achieved perfection in "Refining Profound Second Layer" and sought advice on how to cultivate "Refining Profound Third Layer", he would definitely be in trouble.
Back in the mountains, he opened the lunchbox and placed the three pots of dishes on the spirit wood charcoal furnace to steam and heat.
The aroma and steam filled the air, making the three, who hadn’t eaten a proper meal for a long time, drool.
The two women eagerly watched the delicious food on the charcoal stove, then glanced at Song Yan, who was also waiting expectantly, unable to restrain a knowing smile.
Perhaps at this moment, the three of them truly had an "emotional resonance".
But it was just for this moment.
Upon closer inspection...
There really isn’t any deeper connection.
Song Yan never really believed the Princess Consort didn’t resent him. If he were to hand her a knife in a safe place and tie himself up, he felt the Princess Consort might still stab him.
However, even though he was asleep now, he was more alert than an ordinary mortal due to his high realm.
So, even if he sometimes slept with the princess consort at night, he wasn’t afraid at all.
And the princess consort wasn’t foolish enough to make a move against him in the cave mansion.
"It’s heating up."
Miss Qiu happily watched the furnace while setting the bowls and chopsticks delivered with the lunchbox, swallowing her saliva in anticipation.
The princess consort’s mood also brightened.
Song Yan raised his hand to lift the pot lid.
However, at the instant his fingers touched the lid, a phrase suddenly popped into his mind.
It was the boast of the tavern owner in the market.
"Our chef is an imperial chef, used to cooking state banquets. You are in for a treat, sir."
Pa.
He put the pot lid back down.
"What’s wrong?" Miss Qiu asked in astonishment.
Song Yan casually replied, "Not hot enough yet."
After saying that, he suddenly had an idea. He closed his eyes slightly, focusing his attention on the "[Cultivation Technique: Profound Qi Guiding Technique (Life Span Calculation possible)]".
He added a psychological suggestion: ’Use the contents of this pot as a medicine, spend one year of life span, and start the calculation.’
[You invested one year of life span to cultivate "Profound Qi Guiding Technique". There’s no Evil Element here, and your Evil Element is full, unable to increase further.
But you feel that consuming the delicious food in front of you could serve as an opportunity for cultivation.
You consumed the delicacy from these three pots.
That night, your stomach was in agony.
You died.
Returning the remaining three hundred and sixty-four days of life span]
Song Yan:...
He had once again discovered a method to use his panel: poison testing.
At the same time, he also realized... there really was poison in this dish.
Song Yan sighed, deliberately lifted the pot lid, sniffed, and said, "Poison."
"Poison?" The princess consort was taken aback.
Song Yan said, "The Great Wei remnants, the palace’s imperial chef..."
Princess Consort:...
"Ordinary poison shouldn’t affect you, right?" The princess consort forced a smile.
Song Yan said, "It might not be ordinary poison. The remnants on your side might have already colluded entirely with the Nanwu Sword Sect. They got poison from the Nanwu Sword Sect and launched a suicidal attack on the Puppet Sect. Truly... loyal and righteous."
Princess Consort:...
Song Yan patted her hair and said, "To be fair, I didn’t expect such a thing to happen either. But since it’s happened, I have to report it."
With that, he grabbed the iron pot and went to find Zhang Yin.
...
...
That night...
The leader Zhang Yin, along with Song Yan, Wang Susu, and others, arrived at the market entrance.
The market was already in an uproar because many disciples of the evil sects in the Jianghu had died from poisoning.
Zhang Yin ordered the disciples to block the front and back doors and directly apprehended people.
And that tavern chef hadn’t left, just stood on the rooftop looking north, passionately shouting, "I, Hua Wuxian, have never betrayed the royal grace! Your Majesty, I’m coming!"
After saying this, blood flowed from his seven orifices, and he fell from a height, dying before hitting the ground, with eyes wide open, filled with hatred as he looked at the disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak amidst the firelight in the distance.
Zhang Yin, however, said nothing, continuing to apprehend people, then used Soul-Searching Skill with a "swish swish".
In a short time, they captured a few more suspects and executed them directly.
Wang Susu stood under the lanterns in the snowy night of the market, with a charming smile, twirling a small red oil-paper umbrella, savoring the scent of blood in the air.
Song Yan looked at the tragically dead chef, and then at Senior Brother Zhang, who had returned from the killing, unable to resist asking, "Have you caught King Wei?"
Zhang Yin waved his hand and said, "Escaped, probably died in some desolate mountain or wilderness."
Song Yan, for some reason, suddenly shivered.
Wang Susu leaned close to Senior Brother Zhang, speaking in a voice only the three of them could hear, coquettishly saying, "Senior Brother, my furnace is no longer viable. Can you give me another royal family member?"
Zhang Yin awkwardly glanced at Song Yan beside him, then scanned the other disciples not far away, lowering his voice, "Sure, sure, sure."
Then he said in an even lighter voice, "Junior Brother Song, do you want one? I can get you another one, guaranteed to be younger than the previous one."
Song Yan shook his head, "Thank you for your offer, Senior Brother."
Wang Susu cast a sidelong glance at Song Yan, saying, "Junior Brother Song is such a compassionate person, how about... showing some compassion for Senior Sister too?"
With that, she covered her lips and laughed with a "goose goose goose".
Song Yan smiled speechlessly.
However, he was already used to Senior Sister’s style.
Senior Sister was the standard demoness.
And true demonesses are all shattered shoes.

chapters.title: Chapter 26. Undercurrent
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: 26. Undercurrent
A few days later...
Morning.
Song Yan was still sleeping on the bed when he suddenly heard a rumbling sound from not far away.
He quickly got up.
The quilt slipped off, revealing the smooth white shoulder of Lady Qiu inside.
Song Yan swiftly put on his Profound attire, hurried to the door, and just listened from behind it without stepping outside.
Outside the house, there was some commotion after a short while.
"Qi Yao, without the Peak Master’s order, how dare you leave the cave on your own?!" a disciple questioned.
"I want to see the Peak Master; I can clear my suspicions."
Qi Yao’s voice was as cold as ice, carrying a dark aura that Song Yan had never seen before.
The air quieted down...
Song Yan was also curious about "how this little spy would clear her name."
But he didn’t get an answer, as Qi Yao was taken away shortly after.
...
...
That evening, after Song Yan finished skin making, he ran into Qi Yao, who was just coming down from the hill.
Despite being on the same path, Qi Yao didn’t even glance at him; she just stopped and waited for him to pass first. It seemed that after her previous proposal of "Why don’t we become Dao companions?" was rejected, she had already considered Song Yan a complete stranger.
Wang Susu, on the other hand, was well-informed and seemed to know something. At this moment, she actually smiled and waved, calling out: "Sister Qi."
Qi Yao pretended not to hear, no longer waiting but coldly raising her snow-white neck and descending the steps.
Wang Susu’s smile remained undiminished.
Song Yan wondered, "Sister Wang," what’s happened?"
Wang Susu’s smile vanished, her expression turning colder as she spoke jealously, "Qi Yao isn’t a low-grade Miscellaneous Profound Root; she is a middle-grade Earth Profound Root.
Disciples with such aptitude usually go straight to the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, where they can enjoy better cave mansions, better furnaces, better elixirs, and a rather precious resource called Profound Jade."
She said increasingly ominously, "But, for a middle-grade Earth Profound Root to not pass the disciple examination and mix in with the servants is rather interesting."
After speaking, Wang Susu smiled again.
Song Yan was also a bit astonished.
He never expected Qi Yao to actually be a "middle-grade Earth Profound Root," nor did he expect her to "expose" herself to clear suspicions.
Isn’t this increasing suspicion instead of clearing it?
...
...
However, what shocked both Song Yan and Wang Susu was that Qi Yao’s transfer order actually came, and soon she would go to Shadow Puppet Peak’s main peak and become an official disciple there.
Wang Susu said sourly, "She somehow got out of trouble; she must have already made a pledge."
Song Yan understood.
Spies are hard to catch, but yet some disciples from the Nanwu Sword Sect have fallen into the hands of Shadow Puppet Peak.
If Qi Yao isn’t suspected, then it’s likely she already killed a disciple of the Nanwu Sword Sect with her own hands.
As a complementary measure, the Shadow Puppet Peak would very likely spread this news to make others aware of this event.
...
...
Another night, Song Yan was asleep when he suddenly heard noise from next door again.
The stone door on Qi Yao’s side opened.
Next came a man’s voice.
Song Yan distinguished it and recognized it as Kang Defu’s.
Recently, this senior brother had been very miserable. Since he last sought the "Great Wei Royal Bloodline Furnace," he had been suppressed by Zhang Yin and bullied by fellow disciples; it’s said even his furnace was used by others...
Despite Wang Susu being assigned a second royal furnace, this senior brother still didn’t have one.
The voice filled with endless resentment sounded softly.
"Fairy Qi, I know you are a good person, but in a few days, I’m going to be driven down the mountain to fend for myself. Do you have any messages you want me to take out?"
Kang Defu resentfully said, "I’m willing to do anything that can harm the Puppet Sect!"
The air was silent for a few seconds.
Then came Qi Yao’s cold voice.
"Get out."
Kang Defu wanted to say more, but the stone door had already closed again.
Song Yan could only listen in speechlessness.
Whether Kang Defu was genuine or not, he didn’t know.
But Qi Yao did indeed have a message to send out, which was that she was forced to make a pledge and kill her own.
Yet this was probably a trap, which Qi Yao also noticed, so she wouldn’t let Kang Defu carry a message; even if she had any cryptic words to send, she wouldn’t use them.Follow current novᴇls on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
But...
She still fell into a pit.
Because "telling someone to get out" and "going directly to report" are two completely different attitudes... yet Qi Yao chose the former.
Clearly, she’s not cut out to be a spy.
Song Yan even thought, "If Qi Yao isn’t a spy, I could eat all the tables in my cave mansion."
However, he still only planned to listen and not meddle too much in other matters.
He turned around, embraced a smooth body, and continued to sleep.
...
...
Kang Defu looked at the closed stone cave, reluctantly left, but after a few steps, under the cover of night, he hunched his body and darted towards the top of South Bamboo Peak.
Not long after, he arrived at the cave mansion with the most abundant Profound Qi in the area, gently knocked on the stone door, and respectfully called out, "Peak Master, Peak Master..."
The stone door opened.
He went inside, smiling humbly, "Peak Master, I’ve used the painful strategy, and tested it for you. Now, as promised, can you give me a position in the watchkeeping at South Bamboo Peak? I will definitely be loyal and diligent, hehe..."
Watchkeeping is a great retirement position, after all.
...
...
The next day, Kang Defu left South Bamboo Peak due to "being too old to cultivate." He departed wearing a veiled hat, without much of a send-off nor did anyone really care.
Due to the level of his realm, Song Yan had more perceptive abilities for details, so just a glance at "Kang Defu’s" footsteps revealed to him.
Those were the footsteps of someone pretending to be old.
That was definitely not Kang Defu.
The real Kang Defu was already dead.
Dead after last night’s conversation with Qi Yao!
And the "Furnace" accompanying Kang Defu was trembling slightly.
That "Furnace" had obviously discovered something; she was doomed as well...
Song Yan sighed softly, actually compared to other Furnaces, the two in his cave were really doing quite well.
...
In stark contrast to this tragic senior brother was Qi Yao.
In the afternoon, a Shadow Puppet Celestial Ship stopped on the solitary cliff of South Bamboo Peak.
The ship was over ten zhang long, resembling a sizeable fishing boat, but made entirely of unknown beast skin and exuding a certain mystery.
The chores room in the distance suddenly became noisy, with many people already having run out of the house, gazing intently at the Shadow Puppet Celestial Ship and whispering among themselves.
"Such a big shadow puppet ship, whose handiwork is this?"
"I’ve been here two years, never seen such a ship..."
"I have seen it before; the sect only sends these when bringing in disciples from the main peak, it must be some genius being selected."
The official disciples of South Bamboo Peak also watched with complicated expressions.
The girl once loved to tie her hair in a ponytail, but now it hung naturally down her back, tied at the end with a red ribbon, her valorous righteousness was gone, Shui Xing eyes slightly narrowed, long like a blade, cold and filled with killing intent.
She lifted her chin, not looking at any fellow disciples, and simply strode up the celestial ship.
The celestial ship departed, vanishing into the azure sky.
Wang Susu glanced at Song Yan beside her, saying, "This has overshadowed your trip to Linglong Valley."
Song Yan stared at where the void ship had gone, feeling that the matter with Qi Yao was full of oddities.
Others might not know, but no matter how he looked at it, he felt that girl had been swept into a terrifying undercurrent, and now she was just a pawn in someone else’s game, with no telling what might happen.
But, if Qi Yao was the center of the dark current, then he... wasn’t he at its edge?
But what kind of dark current was it?
As Song Yan was pondering this, he suddenly heard Wang Susu speak, responding casually, "What kind of notoriety is that?
Anyone with a bit of talent can go, it’s only because my brother and master favored me that I got the chance.
If I really went, I’m afraid I wouldn’t be welcomed, it’s just a chance for me to take a look around."
Wang Susu suddenly smirked and said, "And you haven’t squeezed those two little ladies in the cave dry yet?"
Song Yan, who was quite familiar with her, responded speechlessly, "Do I really have to squeeze them dry?"
Wang Susu replied, "Not necessarily.
It’s just... long-term affection develops.
For us, with Furnaces, it’s best not to grow feelings, because these feelings are fake...
Even if Furnaces are obedient due to Fanatic Fans, once the effect wears off, all that’s left is hate.
For such a smart junior, how come you can’t bring yourself to be ruthless?"
Wang Susu surely knew the saying "superficial words, deep meaning," and right now... she was speaking deeply.
There was only one reason—she considered Song Yan to be one of her own.
The world is unpredictable and truly teases one.
Initially, they fought directly, speaking candidly, but ended up like strangers who got along well.
Song Yan smiled and said, "Thank you."
...
...
A few days later, a Shadow Puppet Void Ship heading to Linglong Valley stopped at South Bamboo Peak.
The ship was over twenty zhang long, even more impressive than the previous void ship.
Song Yan held his invitation and boarded the ship.

chapters.title: Chapter 27. Robe and Bowl
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: 27. Robe and Bowl
On the void ship, at a glance, there were about a dozen disciples, all clad in "red."
Most wore profound robes with red patterns, indicating they were Inner Sect Disciples.
However, there was one person in a white robe with red patterns, looking young, clearly an Inner Sect Elder.
These were merely those visible on the deck of the void ship; Song Yan inside the deck had not seen yet.
In such a place, Song Yan’s profound robe with profound patterns appeared quite conspicuous and out of place, like a duck among swans.
He quickly approached the young Elder, respectfully greeting him, "Disciple Song Yan, greets the Elder."
The young Elder glanced at him, nodded casually, made a nasal sound in response, and did not speak further.
Song Yan originally wanted to say he intended to pay respects to Stone Master, not for other reasons but to avoid being impolite. However, it seemed now... there was no need to ask.
No one cared.
No one believed he had the qualifications.
Song Yan didn’t mind; he casually stood in a corner by the ship’s railing.
As the Shadow Puppet Void Ship left the cliff and took off, Song Yan took a deep breath, his eyes lighting up as his vision widened.
But he quickly realized there was no crosswind, and the air didn’t feel thin, as if a strange power spread from the Shadow Puppet Void Ship, protecting the passengers within.
Lone sun and floating clouds, the sky boundless, it lifted the spirits of those on board.
Yet in the northeast direction... the red of the Earth Demon became clearer, like a red, terrifying vortex silently and slowly rotating.
’This is what a true Skin Master is like...’
Song Yan yearned for it.
But soon, he realized no one was talking to him here.
The Skin Masters and prospective Skin Masters clearly had their own circles.
Wherever he looked, Song Yan always saw a similar scene.
Just like on South Bamboo Peak, where Demoness Wang might coquettishly try to please Senior Brother Zhang and ask for favors; here on the deck, two attractive Inner Sect female cultivators clung to two male cultivators, one on each side.
And everything on the deck seemed to revolve around these two men.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Song Yan remained silent, but he listened intently.
Soon, he pieced together a lot from snippets of conversation.
Stone Master, named Stone Seat Elder, was the foremost Skin Master on Shadow Puppet Peak. Obsessed with the Shadow Puppet Dao, he had spent less time on cultivation, thus by now, at eighty, he still hadn’t broken through the Refining Profound Realm.
If he didn’t break through, his lifespan would be of a mortal, living perhaps just over a hundred years, free from major illness.
Naturally, at eighty, Stone Seat Elder had to choose a "heir", considering the complexities of what he studied all his life.
Everyone on this void ship was here for that "heirship."
Yet, these people were clearly split into two factions.
One faction, led by the young Elder "Lv Hong," who wasn’t a disciple of Stone Seat Elder but became a Skin Master through his own opportunity. His Elder title wasn’t due to realm level, but because he was an outstanding Skin Master despite his young age.
The other faction was led by a promising Inner Sect Disciple named "Gu Rufeng," a disciple of Stone Seat Elder and a "second-generation demon" from the Demon Sect’s Puppet Sect, with one of his parents seemingly an Elder in the sect.
Both Lv Hong and Gu Rufeng were initially somewhat curious and wary of Song Yan, who suddenly joined the ship.
But seeing the latter shrinking into a corner so reservedly on the void ship, they didn’t think much more.
He probably just wanted to gild himself, coming here to become a Skin Master.
Neither had the idea of befriending Song Yan.
Stone Master’s personality was rigid and severe; who knew if "befriending" might leave a "negative impression" on the old man?
Thus, Song Yan truly became invisible.
Even when someone glanced in his direction, their gaze went through him as if he didn’t exist.
...
...
After one incense stick of time, the void ship arrived over a small jade-green valley.
In the valley, there were pavilions and towers, peaceful and serene.
As the void ship entered, a dome shimmering with faint silver light suddenly rose, isolating inside and out.
Song Yan had never seen such a thing but could guess it was the legendary — array.
An array covering an entire valley wasn’t small.
Due to the consumption of Profound Stones, such arrays were usually inactive, only activated during sect attacks or when significant individuals arrived.
Clack, clack, clack...
Clack...
The void ship landed smoothly.
Everyone on board promptly stood up solemnly, waiting.
Until the hatch opened, and a serious-looking, short white-robed, red-patterned old man emerged with a cane.
Beside him was a voluptuous, beautiful woman in Inner Sect disciple robes.
"Stone Master!"
"Mistress!"
The disciples outside shouted in unison.
Song Yan joined them in the chant.
The so-called Mistress laughed coquettishly, arm in arm with Stone Seat Elder, as they walked out together.
At the gangway, Stone Seat Elder suddenly stopped, glanced at Song Yan in the corner, and asked, "Who’s the unfamiliar face?"
The Mistress didn’t recognize Song Yan, so she looked to Gu Rufeng on the other side.
Gu Rufeng exchanged a glance with the beautiful Mistress, then smiled elegantly, stepping forward, "Master, a disciple from South Bamboo Peak, recommended by Cheng Danqing, approved by the Peak Master."
Stone Seat Elder closed his eyes, murmuring, "South Bamboo Peak... a servant origin?"
Song Yan respectfully replied, "Yes, Stone Master."
The air suddenly tightened a bit.
Stone Seat Elder opened his eyes, his old eyes showing a gentle smile, "Not easy, truly not easy. Learn more this time, and become a Skin Master soon."
Song Yan hesitated for a moment and said, "Thank you for the encouragement, Stone Master."
With those words, Stone Seat Elder, supported by the beautiful Mistress, disembarked from the void ship.
The disciples followed closely behind.
...
...
The Linglong Valley Exotic Beast Association was essentially a "large animal zoo’s sketching scene," the rare captures and concentration of many demon beasts requiring significant effort.
Song Yan was assigned a temporary cave mansion and given "paper and brush," then went out, immersing himself in this "sketching scene."
Various cages, big or small, unveiling their dark covers, revealed all kinds of demon beasts inside.
There were not only low-level demon beasts but also intermediate demon beasts.
Intermediate demon beasts corresponded to cultivators at the Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Layers of the Refining Profound Realm.
Approaching these demon beasts, Song Yan could feel the horrendous blood aura surrounding them. Stepping one step further, his throat seemed blocked, neck seemingly gripped; behind the barrier of blood aura, a pair of eyes gave him a shivering sensation.
He sensibly "scared" himself down, then sensibly moved toward the low-level demon beasts.
This scene felt perfectly reasonable.
Everyone assumed it should be so.
Song Yan arrived before a half-human-height bird demon beast, with iron-grey feathers that emitted a metallic screeching sound, eyes staring straight at him with a glint of greedy bloodthirst.
He glanced at the nearby signboard: Iron Feather Finch, Third Level Demon Beast, likes eating humans.
He pulled up a chair, began observing the Iron Feather Finch, while focusing on the "Technique" column of the "Skin Painting Technique."
’Dedicate a month’s time, using the Iron Feather Finch as a catalyst, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique."’

chapters.title: Chapter 28. Speak! What moved?
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: 28. Speak! What moved?
’Spend a month of time, using the Knife-beaked Finch before you as an opportunity, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique".’
’Spend a month of time, using the Blood Blade Deer before you as an opportunity, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique".’
’Spend a month of time, using the Earth Escape Lizard before you as an opportunity, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique".’
’Spend a month of time, using the Earth Escape Crab before you as an opportunity, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique".’
...
...
Time passed day by day.
At first, Song Yan lingered only before low level demon beasts. Besides the Double-headed Wolf, the most common ones on Shadow Puppet Peak, the "White Thorn Deer" and "Knife-beaked Finch", were also completed by him.
Later, he began to sit from afar, observing those intermediate level demon beasts.
When there were just a few days left before the half-month period ended, another huge specially made cage was brought over.
This cage was unlike others, as if it was tightly wrapped.
When the black cloth was lifted, it revealed a giant python with short horns, covered in strange patterns all over its body. As it moved, you couldn’t even discern where its eyes were because its body seemed to be riddled with eyes. As it swam, an oddly beautiful sound came through the cage, resembling a melody.
"The Nine-eyed Python is skilled at leading people with its Demon’s Sound, confusing them with its magic patterns, poisoning them with its venom, and then devouring them alive. This python is growing horns, it might turn into a flood dragon soon. It’s impressive that Master Stone was able to obtain one," the young Elder Lü Hong said with a smile.
Gu Rufeng also said, "The Nine-eyed Python is called a top-tier demon beast among intermediate level beasts. Catching one alive, and without harm, is several times harder than killing it directly, but... it’s also the most beneficial for our ’Skin Painting Technique’.
Instantly, a group of cultivators gathered around, set up their drawing boards, and began sketching the Nine-eyed Python.
Song Yan had nothing much to say.
He directly gazed at that demon beast.
’Spend a month of time, using the Nine-eyed Python before you as an opportunity, to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique".’
’Invest another month...’
’Invest again...’
Opportunities like this were rare, and Song Yan did not want to miss them.
Previously, when he went to the Cuique Forest himself, he toiled for quite a while just to experience the "Double-headed Wolf".
Relying solely on himself, seeing so many demon beasts, who knows how many years it would take?
After spending another month, adding up the previous time spent, Song Yan had devoted exactly ten years to comprehending this "Skin Painting Technique".
Before coming here, he had achieved Xiaocheng.
Due to his limited experience and seeing only the "Double-headed Wolf", Xiaocheng was his limit.
Now, after experiencing dozens of demon beasts, his "Skin Painting Technique" had finally reached Great Success.
Seeing other disciples still deep in thought, Song Yan prepared to pack up and return to his cave mansion.
He did not intend to display anything here.
"Gu Rufeng and Lü Hong" clearly belonged to competing factions.
If he were to stand out now, wouldn’t he be stirring up trouble for himself, voluntarily getting involved in the "faction dispute", directly running into their conflict?
At this moment, two figures approached from afar, it was the beautiful master supporting Master Stone, walking towards the Nine-eyed Python.
Master Stone coughed twice, seemingly about to speak.
Song Yan sat down again.
He had only comprehended in ordinary environments for ten years, but Master Stone had spent a lifetime wandering in various places, his experience as a Skin Master must be incredibly rich.
Not to mention other places, such as skyships, were completely out of his reach.
Besides, he had only learned a bit of the "Little Five Elements Hand", "Skin Painting Technique", and was completely unaware of the complete "Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand" and "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique".
Listening a bit more wouldn’t hurt.
The surroundings quieted down at once, and Master Stone began to speak: "To draft first is the essence of skin painting, if one wants to draw the divine features in the drafting, what’s most important?"
Gu Rufeng said: "Undoubtedly, it’s the eyes.
Without a soul, if one desires to summon a soul, you must paint the eyes.
Shadow Puppets are carved from drafts, if the draft lacks spirit, the skin painting will certainly lack spirit.
If the draft has spirit, ultimately the eyes must still be painted... Only if the eyes are painted correctly can a powerful Shadow Puppet be achieved."
Master Stone pointed at the Nine-eyed Python behind him and suddenly said: "Xiaofeng, tell me, what is its spirit?"
Gu Rufeng replied: "The Nine-eyed Python is cunning, seducing people with its Demon’s Sound, confusing them with its magic skin, so its spirit is naturally cunning. When painting the eyes, just visualize cunning, and it will be true."
As soon as he finished speaking, Lü Hong’s voice rang out.
"That statement is incorrect."
Gu Rufeng looked at him with a half-hearted smile and said, "So what is Elder Lü’s insightful opinion?"
Lü Hong said, "Cunning is merely an exterior, ferocity is the interior.
No matter how many methods the Nine-eyed Python uses to lure its prey, once it sees its prey, all disguises disappear, and it pounces with the fastest speed and the fiercest power!
In fact, the Nine-eyed Python is not a demon beast with sufficient endurance; it excels in bursts of strength.
Therefore, I believe one should start with cunning and end with ferocity, to be accurate.
Gu Shidi’s conclusion was a bit biased."
"Elder Lü speaks very well," the female cultivator nearby applauded in praise.
Anyone could hear that Lü Hong indeed gave a better response.
Gu Rufeng’s expression was somewhat displeased.
And just then, Stone Seat Elder suddenly grabbed his cane and heavily struck the cage beside him.
With a resounding boom, the cage did not shatter, but the Nine-eyed Python inside suddenly recoiled, showing a hint of fear.
Then, the Nine-Eyed Serpent flared up with rage, moving swiftly within the cage, its body covered in eye patterns that were dazzling, causing anyone who merely stared to feel dizzy.
Stone Seat Elder said, "Tell me, what is the divine characteristic of the Nine-Eyed Serpent now?"
He pulled his hand from the arm of the elegant master lady and walked with hands behind his back, saying, "Cunning? Ruthless? Does this beast still possess such traits?"
Everyone looked over.
Lv Hong said, "Stone Master, these are just occasional reactions of the Nine-Eyed Serpent and don’t count as its divine characteristic. I believe...it does not have one at the moment, simply because it is hiding its true nature."
As soon as he finished speaking...
Gu Rufeng laughed, "Your words are mistaken.
Elder Lv, I happen to believe this is also a part of its divine characteristic.
Whether it is fear or anger, both can be considered a form of cunning.
If you rashly approach because you think it is fearful, it might suddenly change and devour you; if you retreat due to its anger, perhaps it fears you and is contemplating escape.
Though the demon beast lacks wisdom, it knows how to hunt and kill."
The female cultivator beside him clapped her hands, saying, "Senior Brother Gu, you are so impressive."
Gu Rufeng replied gracefully, "I wonder what the teacher thinks about my words."
Lv Hong furrowed his brows slightly, glanced coldly at Gu Rufeng, then turned to look at the Stone Master.
Just as he was about to speak, the Stone Master raised his hand, indicating he need not speak, then swept his gaze over the disciples, asking, "And what do you all think? Has the divine characteristic of the Nine-Eyed Serpent manifested?"
However, after he finished speaking, no disciple spoke up; everyone either looked at Gu Rufeng or Lv Hong.
Until the two nodded, did the disciples begin to discuss intensely.
Some said, "It has manifested."
Some said, "It hasn’t manifested."
Some said, "It only manifested after being startled, the rest of the time it didn’t."
There was an outlandish theory saying, "Perhaps the true nature of the Nine-Eyed Serpent isn’t cunning or ruthlessness, but rather fear; it’s just using ruthlessness to mask its fear."
In conclusion, there were all sorts of opinions, varied and multi-faceted.
Song Yan never expected it to evolve into a "philosophical" discussion, with "manifested," "didn’t manifest," and similar sayings echoing in his ears.
Suddenly, some distant memories were triggered for him, recalling a small story he had read before transmigration:
A temple where novice monks were observing a tree. A strong wind blew, causing the tree to move. Some monks said, "The tree is moving," but others said, "It’s clearly the wind that’s moving." The monks argued, one side shouting, "The tree is moving," another shouting, "It’s not the tree that’s moving, it’s the wind." And then, an unconventional voice sounded.
That voice said, "The tree isn’t moving, nor is the wind; it’s the heart that’s moved."
Looking at the scene before him, Song Yan linked it to the insight he gained from his contemplation of the Skin Painting Technique, and suddenly found himself enlightened, with his own answer in mind: Whether the divine characteristic manifests or not is irrelevant; what’s relevant is that...in answering this question, your heart moved. When the heart moves, how can one achieve the most perfect finishing touch?
Cunning and ruthlessness are not the divine characteristic.
Fear and anger are also not contained within that cunning and ruthlessness.
The Nine-Eyed Serpent lies right there.
Its divine characteristic is right there.
If a name absolutely must be given, it would be "Nine-Eyed Serpent’s divine characteristic," and nothing else, for once you name it one thing, it is no longer accurate; you mentioned cunning and ruthlessness, but how can you account for everything else?
His thoughts shifted in his mind, suddenly his body shook slightly, as a difficult-to-describe sense of opportunity surged into his heart, which seemed like a path to the perfection of the Skin Painting Technique.
Yet he didn’t plan to answer, instead lowering his head further, intending to return to his cave mansion after this group’s discussion concluded, and after two more days, he could return to South Bamboo Peak.
But at that moment, the voice of Stone Master unexpectedly came from afar.
"Song Yan, you speak."
Song Yan: ???
He was startled, unsure how he had come under attention.
So he hurriedly stood up.
Everyone turned their heads to look at him.
Song Yan scratched his head, saying, "The disciple was contemplating the words of Elder Lv and Senior Brother Gu, for a moment...a moment...no answer yet..."
Stone Seat Elder squinted at him, this elder’s eyes seemingly extraordinary, with the wear and tear of years rendering them aged, yet seemingly granting them the power to see through one’s heart.
"Come forth."
Song Yan lowered his head and stepped forward.Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Stone Seat Elder extended his cane, suddenly shouted sternly, "Everyone is discussing, yet you’re the only one with your head down lost in thought, you deserve a beating! Raise your hand!!"
Song Yan extended his hand.
Stone Seat Elder heavily struck it three times.
Song Yan: ...
Beside him, Gu Rufeng laughed, saying, "Master, this person is merely an auditor, how could he understand our discussions?
Are you...not going down yet?!"
Song Yan nodded, hurriedly descended.
He was still recalling the three strikes from Stone Master in his mind, somewhat dazed.
Nevertheless, tonight at midnight, he would definitely be in his cave mansion asleep, and not go find Stone Master.
...
...
At night, Song Yan slept soundly in his cave mansion, and the Stone Seat Elder did not come to find him.
Two days later, the "Exotic Beast Association at Linglong Valley" officially concluded, and a flying boat returned the disciple of South Bamboo Peak to where he was...

chapters.title: Chapter 29. Stop pretending, time to lay it all out
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: 29. Stop pretending, time to lay it all out
"I heard that you got hit three times by Stone Elder for not paying attention in class?"
Zhang Yin looked at Song Yan with a peculiar expression.
Song Yan sighed, "Stone Elder’s lecture was too profound... I couldn’t understand it."
Zhang Yin patted him on the shoulder and said, "Forget it, go work on skin making. You’re wasting your opportunity here."
Song Yan scratched his head and smiled, "How come even Senior Brother knows about this now?"
Zhang Yin let out a sneer and, coldly raised his voice, said, "It’s not just me who knows?
The entire Shadow Puppet Peak is aware that Stone Elder harshly reprimanded a disrespectful junior!
This junior just happened to be someone South Bamboo Peak had forcibly placed in there!
Such a disgrace...
Don’t say Senior Brother didn’t warn you, go and apologize to the Peak Master."
Song Yan was momentarily stunned, but his thoughts quickly turned, and he immediately understood.
Gu Rufeng and Lv Hong’s factions are vying for Stone Elder’s legacy, and although neither of them holds him, an outsider, in much regard, they tacitly used the incident of him being beaten by Stone Elder and exaggerated it. As a result... he’s completely out of the game, and it will be difficult for him to make a comeback. No matter where he goes, he will be pointed at and even ridiculed.
He could only blame himself for not being associated with Gu Rufeng or Lv Hong, yet being shoved into the "Linglong Valley Exotic Beast Association" at such a sensitive time.
’Truly ruthless.’
Song Yan silently lamented, then went to the mountain’s summit, knelt before Cheng Danqing’s stone gate, and respectfully said, "Disciple Song Yan, here to admit his mistakes."
Cheng Danqing didn’t put on airs, nor did he make Song Yan wait long after he spoke. He directly asked through the stone gate, "Where is your mistake?"
Song Yan replied, "Even though this disciple couldn’t understand Stone Elder’s profound words, I should have paid attention in class and not looked down... losing proper etiquette."
Cheng Danqing was silent for a moment, then coldly laughed, "You are not at fault.
It’s Gu Rufeng and Lv Hong who wronged you.
They are fighting for the legacy, not allowing any variables. Even if you are just an insignificant ant in their eyes, they cannot tolerate you.
Even if you hadn’t stumbled, they would have fabricated something else to make you the butt of a joke.
Do you know why?"
Song Yan: ...
Cheng Danqing said, "Because you have no backing, so anyone who wants to bully you, to step on you, can easily do so."
Song Yan: ...
His thoughts raced, numerous ideas flashed through his mind, and then, with a moment of clarity, he said with a tone suppressing his anger, "From now on, this disciple is under Peak Master Cheng!"
"Heh... hahahaha... Indeed, a genius Skin Master with comprehension." Cheng Danqing laughed heartily, then said, "Don’t think too much, focus on your skin making. You... won’t regret today’s choice."
Song Yan thanked, "Thank you, Peak Master!"
After speaking, he took his leave.
Leaving the mountain path, winter was not yet over, and a cold wind blew, causing his back to feel damp.
He couldn’t understand what Cheng Danqing meant, was it factional strife? Or something else?
"Won’t regret today’s choice" is it just rhetoric?
Since Lv Hong is so against outsiders, then... as an Inner Sect Elder, is Lv Hong higher in status than Cheng Danqing? At least not lower, right?
Cheng Danqing’s request to forcefully place him in the "Linglong Valley Exotic Beast Association", theoretically, Lv Hong could have vetoed it. Moreover, his veto would be easier than Cheng Danqing inserting someone.
But he still managed to enter the Exotic Beast Association smoothly, does this mean... Cheng Danqing has someone behind him.
This person behind the scenes has a status even above an Inner Sect Elder.
Song Yan suddenly looked up and saw a figure ahead.
It was a disciple’s back.
The uniform on the back was embroidered with a double-faced visage, one side crying and one side laughing, mysteriously strange.
And dusk had fallen, with Earth Demon surging in the distance, an eerie red mist climbing up from the steep cliffs, the mountain wind whistling through thousands of caverns, making weird wailing sounds like that of a weeping woman...
Song Yan couldn’t help but show a bitter smile, muttering to himself: ’I really want to run away...’
Caw~
Caw~
A peculiar shadow puppet crow had somehow perched along with the shadows of the night on South Bamboo Peak, standing on a branch of an evergreen old tree, gazing down at the young man wandering afar, silent and motionless.
This crow was obviously not an ordinary creature; when it appeared in a certain environment, it would completely blend into that environment.
Like now, blending completely into the shadows.
Not to mention Song Yan, even if Zhang Yin was here, he wouldn’t notice a thing.
Yet the crow only had its eyes on Song Yan.
...
...
The next day, golden sunlight spilled through the skylight, illuminating the cave mansion where South Bamboo Peak’s skin making was done.
Song Yan once again took out a piece of demon beast skin, put it aside, then picked up paper and brush to start today’s draft.
When he focused his attention on the [Magic] section, his gaze naturally fell on ""Skin Painting Technique" (Great Success) (capable of Life Span Calculation)".
He had arrived very early.
So early that at this moment, there was no one else in the cave.
The cave mansion’s dome was brilliantly lit, leaving shadows only in certain rugged recesses.
Recalling the unsettling feeling from yesterday, Song Yan decided to try it out, hoping to grasp some powers as soon as possible.
[Please choose to invest life span]
[You have invested ten years of life span to comprehend the "Skin Painting Technique," you have sketched dozens of demon beasts, mastering their divine forms, but how should these divine forms be manifested? You recalled a discussion you heard in Linglong Valley that day and naturally came to a conclusion: the eyes.
Only by dotting the eyes can the divine form of a demon beast be granted, the draft must have spirit, and the shadow puppet must have the eyes dotted.
You begin to attempt the final touch.
After a decade of honing your skills, even a casual stroke of your brush yields a divine figure in your sketches. However, when you try to transfer these figures onto the shadow puppets, you find they just won’t appear on the skin.
[The Skin Painting Technique, Perfection]
Song Yan was taken aback.
He clearly had not solved the problem or discovered the method to transfer the divine figure from the sketch to the shadow puppet, so how could it be perfect?
’Continue.’
[You devoted ten years of your lifespan to continue comprehending The Skin Painting Technique, seeking the solution to the problem, day after day, year after year, continuously drawing sketches and carving skins.
In the eighth year, the answer you once thought of abruptly flashed into your mind.
Did the divine figure move?
The divine figure didn’t move; it was your heart that moved.
You naively believed all along that the divine figure resided in the sketch. Even if you carved in perfect adherence to the sketch, you still failed because... the divine figure was never in the sketch.
The tree didn’t move, the wind didn’t move, it was your heart that moved.
You pondered, discarded the sketch, focused on the skin, and directly took up the knife.
You moved the knife like a pen, artfully creating a vividly divine demon beast map in no time.
You raised the knife, contemplating that eye.
What you carved was a Nine-Eyed Zither Boa, covered with eyes all over its body, even visualizing it left you somewhat dizzy.
You brought down the knife but failed...
’Continue.’
[You devoted another ten years of your lifespan to comprehend The Skin Painting Technique. You made some progress, but it never seemed enough...]
[You devoted another ten years of your lifespan to comprehend The Skin Painting Technique. Your progress was considerable, but it never seemed enough...]
[You devoted another ten years of your lifespan to comprehend The Skin Painting Technique. In the tenth year, you exhausted all your energy, entirely forgetting yourself, becoming like the Nine-Eyed Zither Boa itself. You brought down the knife; this time, as if divinely aided, you carved the eye, completing the final touch.
Just as you admired your masterpiece, a cold gust enveloped you, and the pupils of the Nine-Eyed Zither Boa turned with eerie life.
Then... the shadow puppet of the Nine-Eyed Zither Boa leaped up and devoured you.
You died.
[You comprehended the Soul Summoning Technique]
[The Soul Summoning Technique, Entry-level; Cultivation prerequisite: Fourth Layer of Refining Profound Realm]
Song Yan opened his eyes, slightly puzzled.
The Soul Summoning Technique should have been a part of The Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique, which is likely its most crucial component.
Compared to the Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand, The Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique is the most important.
The role of the Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand is to make your hands more agile, allowing you to handle the dangerous skins of demon beasts.
But how to make the skin relies on The Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique.
Yet surprisingly, Song Yan didn’t need anyone to pass it down to him; he comprehended it himself.
However, the Soul Summoning Technique has a cultivation threshold, and having grasped a Fourth Layer Refining Profound Realm magic with his Second Layer state led to an immediate backlash.
By giving the shadow puppet its eyes, it came to life and killed him.
That was quite a rarity.
’Realm, still need to find a way to elevate the realm.’
Song Yan sighed softly. In fact, all this time, he had attempted numerous times, only to become further convinced that "breaking through to the Third Layer of Refining Profound Realm requires certain medicinal substances."
’In a while, perhaps go to the marketplace to see if there are any clues.’
As he contemplated, other disciples arrived at the cave mansion.
Song Yan greeted them, then buried himself again in skin making.
He once more took up his sketch, drawing a two-headed wolf. Yet when the pen hovered above the hollow eyes of the wolf, he instinctively paused before hastily bringing it down with his previous level of skill.
The crow perched quietly on the dome of the cave mansion, observing this scene...
...
...
In the following days, the crow witnessed nothing unusual.
This crow, of course, was a special shadow puppet manipulated by Stone Seat Elder using a Secret Technique.
Though merely a crow, it was an intermediate-level demon beast known as the "Bodyless Illusory Crow," acclaimed for being among the best in self-concealment among its kind—a skill that could virtually deceive all cultivators in the Refining Profound Realm.
Therefore, it was naturally impossible for Song Yan to discover the presence of the "Bodyless Illusory Crow Shadow Puppet."
Stone Seat Elder, of servant origin, was obsessed with shadow puppet art throughout his life and felt a mystical connection to matters related to shadow puppets.
For example, one day, he felt that the little disciple from South Bamboo Peak seemed to have realized something but didn’t dare to speak because of the circumstances. Therefore, he deliberately knocked three times to see if the other was clever enough to visit during the dead of night.
But in the end, nothing happened.
Yet he still sensed something was amiss, so he purposely used the shadow puppet secret technique to control the "Bodyless Illusory Crow" to spy on him.
But after days of spying, there was still nothing out of the ordinary.
Logically, Stone Seat Elder should have left.
However, he stubbornly felt something was not quite right; the boy’s brush stroke and final touch for eyes seemed inconsequential to him, merely beginner’s dabbling...
Nonetheless, something indescribable lingered about the way the boy held the brush.
In the past, he wouldn’t have had the leisure to follow a junior. But as he aged, approaching his life’s end, a bit of childish curiosity arose, finding the act of trailing this young one rather intriguing.
Nonetheless, Stone Seat Elder’s patience had finally been depleted.
’Forget it, no more pretending, time to lay our cards on the table and directly ask.’

chapters.title: Chapter 30. Stunning talent and beauty, thrilling at every step
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: 30. Stunning talent and beauty, thrilling at every step
A gentleman is cautious even in solitude.
Therefore, even when he was alone, Song Yan would maintain necessary vigilance, never allowing anyone to find a single flaw. He carried the great secret of the "Remaining Life Dao Fruit," and if anyone noticed anything unusual, he would at best be "searched in soul," at worst, "dissected and studied."
On this day, as usual, he greeted his "partner" Wang Susu and then returned to the cave mansion.
As the stone door closed, he suddenly heard two "pattering" sounds, as if someone had fallen to the ground.
Song Yan frowned, without a moment of hesitation, nor any curiosity to explore what had happened.
He quickly raised his hand to press the mechanism.
Rumble...
As soon as the stone door opened a crack, Song Yan had already tensed his whole body, assuming the posture of a "hundred-meter sprint."
Anyone could sense that this young man would dash out as soon as the stone door lifted to a certain height.
At this moment, a hoarse, strange voice emerged from the darkness of the cave mansion.
"Don’t go out."
"Yes, senior."
Song Yan didn’t ask who it was, politely responded, and then, as the stone door lifted, dashed out in a flash, not forgetting to press the mechanism to close the door behind him.
A shadow puppet raven followed closely behind him with a swift movement, its lifelike bird eyes looking at him weirdly and silently, its beak opening and closing with an elder’s unmasked voice: "Are you that timid?"
This time, Song Yan recognized it was the voice of the Stone Seat Elder.
He awkwardly scratched his head and respectfully said, "Junior..."
"Enter the cave and speak."
The raven said, "The noise you heard was merely me putting your two furnaces to sleep.
The feathers of the bodyless illusionary raven are mixed with innate sleep-inducing toxins, which may only cause slight dizziness to cultivators but can instantly put mortals to sleep.
I only entered the cave mansion when you opened it, just to ask you some questions.
You need not worry."
"Yes, senior."
Song Yan obediently followed the Stone Seat Elder into the cave mansion.
In his heart, however, he felt a heavy weight: high-realm cultivators can indeed manipulate lower-realm cultivators at will.
...
...
In the cave mansion, at dusk, the sky light was like blood, hanging down.
The raven and the young man sat facing each other at a stone table.
The raven asked, "The question I want to ask you remains unchanged."
"What question?"
Song Yan has always been adept at playing dumb.
The raven looked at him sternly, its pupils seemingly transforming into the elder’s eyes, then asked word by word: "Did the divine semblance of the nine-eyed harp python move?"
Song Yan’s eyes showed a look of contemplation, giving one the impression of careful consideration, as if not wanting to miss an opportunity.
The raven watched him expectantly.
Song Yan finally spoke, earnestly, "It should have moved, Stone Master, that’s what I think..."
He integrated what Gu Rufeng and Lv Hong had said and crafted a story from it.
At this moment, high above the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, the elder’s face was already iron blue.
Listening for a long time, he heavily sighed.
Certainly, he could pass down his legacy, and both Gu Rufeng and Lv Hong could successfully receive it.
But... in the end, he was unwilling.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
If he dies, if his body perishes and his Dao dissipates, what does it matter about young elders or the second generation of demons? What does it matter about human relationships and worldly matters?
What Stone Seat Elder wanted was a genius who could use his legacy as a stepping stone to climb higher; not someone ordinary who would cherish his legacy and progress no further.
He merely thought that one day, someone would be able to see the unseen sights for him, and that comforted him immensely, making him feel he could die with a smile even in death.
He sensed some special quality in Song Yan, so he nurtured a faint expectation.
But this expectation was slowly collapsing.
Bang!!
Stone Seat Elder fiercely smashed the glazed cup on the table to the ground and stood up angrily.
He didn’t even know why he was so angry over a junior.
Perhaps because this junior had given him baseless hope, only to take it away again.
Outside the cave mansion, the beautiful mistress was sitting opposite Gu Rufeng, listening to the articulate young man’s words, occasionally being amused to laughter, her laughter trembling.
Upon hearing the commotion inside the cave mansion, the beautiful mistress suddenly became quiet, looked at Gu Rufeng, and said, "Rufeng, I’ll go in and have a look."
Gu Rufeng looked at her and said, "I’ll trouble you, mistress."
Saying "mistress," yet his eyes hid a kind of aggressive fervor.
The beautiful mistress boldly responded to this fervor.
That lingering gaze only broke in mid-air with difficulty.
The beautiful wife entered the cave mansion, her expression suddenly changed, she hurriedly stepped forward and asked with concern, "Elder, what’s wrong? What happened?"
Stone Seat Elder coughed heavily, "It’s just some inexplicable restlessness."
The beautiful wife sat in his lap, her long legs tightly together, hugging his neck, softly saying, "Take it slow."
Stone Seat Elder suddenly said, "Xiao Xi, all these years, it’s actually me who has wronged you... If you have a beloved Dao companion outside, you may go, I will do my utmost to compensate you."
The beautiful wife, called Xiao Xi, softly said, "For men, talent is most important, especially for someone as talented as you, Elder."
Stone Seat Elder nodded, then put down the Dao companion and turned, seeming to contemplate something else.
The beautiful wife disdainfully brushed off her long legs and turned to exit the cave mansion.
...
...
A month later...
Stone Seat Elder came to the main peak’s shadow studio, seemingly casually flipping through the shadow puppets sent from outside.
These shadow puppets were offered by South Bamboo Peak, meant for the disciples to practice casually, not valuable.
As he flipped through them, his hand brushed past a double-headed wolf shadow puppet.
His old eyes squinted slightly, focusing on that shadow puppet, suddenly lost in thought.
...
...
Half a year later...
As if growing old and wanting to guide the younger generation, Stone Seat Elder often visited the shadow studio.
And the shadow studio was also packed with people from Gu Rufeng and Lv Hong.
But nobody knew this elder, in fact, had "a different purpose than wine," he was quietly watching the double-headed wolf shadow puppet sent from South Bamboo Peak.
That day, upon seeing the double-headed wolf shadow puppet again, he suddenly sensed something, curved his mouth in a smile, but restrained it, only to burst into laughter once back in the cave mansion.
He laughed so joyfully that even the beautiful wife came to ask what happened.
But Stone Seat Elder casually mentioned something else, not revealing the true reason for his happiness.
Which novice skin master would start with the perfect penmanship of sheer genius, then seemingly sense wrongness, blotting it elsewhere with "entry-level" skill shadow puppet technique?
Stone Seat Elder observed for a full half year, during which he caught such an occurrence twice.
The first time could still be coincidence.
The second time... that was absolutely not.
The chance for the Celestial Pen to appear on a novice was infinitesimal, appearing twice was definitely not coincidence.
The young man named Song Yan is a true genius, a talent surpassing even him.
’The big river pushes the waves forward, an astounding dazzling talent, truly a choice of the moment.’
’I understand your heart, yet you do not comprehend the old man’s intention.’
That night, Stone Seat Elder opened a jar of Profound Brew, drinking under the moon.
However, he deeply understood Song Yan’s concerns, directly passing him the mantle would be akin to sending him toward death, no matter how secretly the mantle was handed over wouldn’t help, for Lv Hong and Gu Rufeng would inevitably quickly grasp it.
He... needed to wait for an opportunity.
And he felt that opportunity might not be far off.
...
...
Shadow Puppet Peak main peak.
In the mysterious dark hall.
That strange massive silhouette exudes eeriness.
Cheng Danqing respectfully stepped forward, handing over a scroll with several names written on it, said, "These few should all be spies from Nanwu Sword Sect."
The silhouette glanced at it, said, "The Multi-tailed Fox Race finally has a Great Demon.
The old folk do not want the flames of war to spread to their home grounds, I slightly guided and provoked, and they decided to secretly go to the border to intercept that Great Demon, whereas I... will stay here to guard."
Cheng Danqing said, "What do I need to do?"
The silhouette said, "Unintentionally leak the news that Puppet Sect is sparsely guarded to the spies you can, and I... will also give this news to Miss Seven of the Su Family. Her words should still carry some weight.
At that time, Nanwu Sword Sect will surely strike, and I will lead the young experts of Puppet Sect into battle."
The silhouette said while rising, the side profile faintly visible as an eerie smiling face, the tone imbued with hints of a mocking sneer.
"Then, kill them, kill them, you kill one of mine, I kill two of yours, you kill three of mine.
With rivers of blood, and cultivators’ corpses everywhere...
We will become more formidable, with more companions.
Hehehehehehehe..."
Cheng Danqing also followed with a sinister laugh.
...
...
Appendix: As long as a ghost creature seizes a dying or deceased cultivator, it might regain a new life, and then combine with the cultivator’s original Profound Root, forming a special Profound Root called Ghost Profound Root. With this root, one re-enters the realm of cultivation, thus becoming a Ghost Cultivator (Chapter 6).

chapters.title: Chapter 31. The golden wind has not moved, but the cicada senses it first.
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: 31. The golden wind has not moved, but the cicada senses it first.
Rumble...
The stone gate opened.
Song Yan entered the cave mansion as usual.
It was midsummer, and a sudden rainstorm was outside the cave.
The gray gale and the pale torrential rain almost drowned the whole mountain, making visibility narrow.
It was just like the completely unclear situation Song Yan faced.
Yet life had to go on.
Escape was not even an option.
As he entered the cave mansion, Lady Qiu joyfully raised her head, called out "Brother Song," and hurried over with a towel.
Song Yan wiped his slightly wet hair and looked around the cave.
In other cave mansions, the furnace had long been replaced, yet in his, the two women were still lively and energetic.
The strong vitality of the Multi-tailed Fox Race was vividly manifested in the Princess Consort; although she was older, she remained charming and attractive, her skin taut and elastic, even more delightful than Lady Qiu when they were intimate.
Not far away, in the flower bed, the Profound Flowers and Profound Grass had long flourished, prompting Song Yan to walk over and pause, listening to Cao Xuerou’s detailed explanation of each flower and each grass.
Cao Xuerou seemed quite skilled at tending these plants and was familiar with them.
Song Yan had asked her about this.
She merely said that when she was a maiden in Western Shu Kingdom, her grandfather had once gotten her a book on Profound Flowers from somewhere unknown that explained these things.
Previously, when she was a Princess Consort, dealing with intrigues, handling royal affairs left her no time and energy to manage these, but surprisingly, now that she was here, she had the time and opportunity.
"Song Lang..."
The Princess Consort spoke, her eyes moist, rising like a small woman to lean closer to Song Yan, her face full of joyful happiness, brought by the "Fanatic Fans and the dual effect of wanting to forget pain."
Song Yan held her waist and suddenly said, "Tomorrow I’ll go to the market at the foot of the mountain, is there anything you want?"
"Nothing."
The Princess Consort gently shook her head.
Song Yan suddenly asked again, "Want to drink?"
The Princess Consort hesitated but gently nodded.
Song Yan laughed, "I’ll bring you some."
"Song Lang... Thank you," the Princess Consort tightly hugged the man in front of her.
If there’s fine wine, then one can better indulge in pleasure, immerse in desires, and not think of other superfluous pains.
Wine and lust certainly harm people.
But if a person is already deeply hurt, wine and lust become the last solace.
...
...
The next day...
Song Yan went down the mountain and went to the low-level market around Shadow Puppet Peak, familiar and unimpeded.
Today he didn’t hide but wore the official disciple uniform in profound color.
Over the years, he had figured out one thing: in the sect-run marketplace, you should absolutely not expect to buy any core items, whether it’s Skin Masters, Talisman Masters, Pill Masters’ magic techniques, or the unique Skin Control Technique of Shadow Puppet Peak.
Items for promoting realms are even more out of the question.
Apart from "Fasting Pills," this place primarily sells a kind of elixir called "Profound Qi Pill."
Profound Qi Pill, to put it bluntly, is an "unsuccessfully refined Little Profound Spirit Pill."
"Little Profound Spirit Pill" is given one each month to Song Yan and other official disciples, used with the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," better than the furnace.
The inferior so-called "Profound Qi Pill" due to its sparse profound qi can help Jianghu people improve their skills, even directly breakthrough certain bottlenecks.
Even without a breakthrough, this pill can solve many unsolvable strange poisons in Jianghu, making it an "all-purpose elixir."
However, "Profound Qi Pill" can only be purchased with Contribution Points.
This makes "Contribution Points" a "high-end currency" in the eyes of Jianghu people coming here.
Simply put, this is a marketplace deceiving servants and Jianghu people, mainly serving to connect with external mortal forces.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
The goods here for trading naturally do not reveal any sect secrets and are all standard items.
The real marketplace is likely the "Qingxi Market where Shadow Puppet Peak goes to purchase beast skins."
But Qingxi Market is a chaotic mix.
If you want to go to such a place, either a major force goes in a group or you are a fierce person with adequate power, otherwise, once you leave the market, you might end up empty-handed.
Nonetheless, Song Yan returned to this market, ostensibly shopping and spending contribution points, but actually he was listening to Jianghu talk to understand the outside situation.
Previously, he understood how Blood Spear Sect was cleaning Great Wei remnants, how they sent the Great Wei Royal Family to Puppet Palace, and how they established a new Dynasty, named "Jin."
But in the past six months, he heard some unusual information.
First was the "Demon Beast tide" invading from the Desolate Wilderness north of Jin Kingdom, and Jin Kingdom’s frontier defense army was actually overwhelmed, even the leading general was trampled to death by demon beasts.
Now there was news of "Jin Kingdom planning to relocate its capital."
A new dynasty that has only been established for two years, and it wants to relocate the capital?
What is it hiding from?
Song Yan’s information channels are limited.
Yet, because of the Princess Consort, he knew a piece of information early on: King Wei still has contact with the Shanhai Cannibal Demon Country, which is located north of Great Wei.
These pieces of information combined gave him an inexplicable sense of suffocation, a kind of anxiety that creatures like birds in the forests and insects on the ground feel before a great disaster.
Song Yan spent 3 Contribution Points to buy a cart of the finest mortal wines, which Jianghu people would deliver to the mountain gate of the main peak of South Bamboo Peak, conveniently.
Afterwards, he continued to stroll, looked up at a small wooden pavilion on the edge of the marketplace with a sign that read "Hidden Skills Tower," and stepped inside.
The "Hidden Skills Tower" is a rather special place in this market.
But this specialty is not that the stuff it sells is good, but that... it is a place in the Immortal Market that deals with Jianghu trades.
What is sold here are all the mortal techniques of the Jianghu.
Of course, the techniques that can be sold here can be considered top techniques in the Jianghu, even exaggerated as "Divine Skills."
But no matter how powerful a divine skill is, it can’t withstand a simple "Qi Arrow Technique."
