This is the saying "no matter how high your swordsmanship, a single arrow can bring you down"...
Therefore, this "Hidden Skills Tower" could only exist on the edge of the marketplace, and it is rare for any cultivator to visit.
Before Song Yan stepped into the pavilion, he heard various conversations inside.
"The Cyan Blade Manor was exterminated, but its ultimate technique never appeared in the world; I didn’t expect it to be hidden in this Immortal Land."
"Here, we don’t take gold or silver, only Contribution Points. If you want to buy, go do some business and exchange for Contribution Points first."
"The ultimate technique of the Old Man of the South Mountain, ’Great Hand Seal’, only costs 6 Contribution Points."
"The ’Sword Drawing Skill’ of the Purple Thunder Saber, 5 Contribution Points, no gold or silver accepted."
These shouts paused slightly due to Song Yan’s entrance.
Many eyes were fixed on him, landing on his Official Disciple uniform.
Immediately, someone came out from the inner hall, slightly plump, with a face full of flesh, with a bit of friendliness hidden in his fierce expression—a clear indication of a ruthless character in the outside world.
At this time, however, the person respectfully said: "Sir, what brings you here? What would you like? But in our small shop, we only sell Jianghu techniques."
Song Yan glanced around.
After reaching the second layer of Refining Profound and mastering magic techniques, he clearly understood: the execution of magic is actually environment-dependent. Simply put, if you want to perform magic in a place with very little Profound Qi, you might find that it stops working after a few attempts. After that, you can only rely on the physical strength brought by your realm.
Jianghu skills actually focus on "physical strength."
These are techniques developed utilizing the power of the body, lethal moves.
Song Yan believed that if he lost his magic techniques and purely relied on physical strength, he might not be able to match up to a Jianghu expert skilled in lethal moves. If that Jianghu expert was proficient in some kind of weapon, then he would definitely not be a match.
Therefore, based on the principle that "if you can’t improve the ceiling, then lift the shortcoming," he wanted to buy a few Jianghu techniques, practice them to perfection, for unforeseen circumstances.
Just in case... someday he escaped to the Jianghu?
If a natural disaster occurs, a flood surges, who knows where the fish in the water will be swept away by the big wave?
...
...
After picking and choosing.
Song Yan spent 187 Contribution Points and bought 23 Jianghu ultimate techniques, including fist techniques, palm techniques, weapon techniques, hidden weapon techniques, movement techniques, poison techniques, special skills like clever tricks, and an extraordinary technique called "Turtle Breath Technique."
Song Yan glanced at the remaining Contribution Points: 2984 points.
Since Senior Brother Zhang no longer accepted his shadow puppets, his monthly Contribution Points doubled directly, from 160 to 310.
Adding the 2 Contribution Points provided monthly by the two furnaces in the cave mansion, they were quite sufficient.
He packed up the 23 Jianghu ultimate techniques, slung them over his shoulder, and left the Hidden Skills Tower.
...
...
Much later, a young man in red brocade came out of the building. He glanced at the fat man who had greeted Song Yan earlier and frowned, asking: "Laughing Butcher, who was that person who looked about my age?"
The fat man known as Laughing Butcher said, "Young Master, he is the Official Disciple of South Bamboo Peak, named Song Yan."
The one addressed as Young Master is the youngest son of the Blood Spear Sect Leader, named Ma Zhao.
At this moment, Ma Zhao sneered and said, "Buying so many Jianghu ultimate techniques, it seems he’s not doing well in the sect."
Laughing Butcher quickly said, "Young Master, this is not something we should concern ourselves with."
Ma Zhao laughed heartily and said, "What’s there to be afraid of? Let me tell you a secret; these days, I’ve sent many furnaces to esteemed figures in the Puppet Sect, and my connections are vast. Mere ordinary disciples are beneath my notice. Furthermore, this Song Yan is a laughingstock of the Puppet Sect."
He then boasted about the incident where Song Yan was spanked three times by Master Shi in Linglong Valley.
Afterwards, he said, "Now that my father has ascended the throne and is the Emperor of Great Jin, if my elder brother, who is in poor health, passes away, then I will be the Crown Prince. These people, having a bit of Profound Root, act superior. In my opinion, he should bow his head and pay his respects to me."
Laughing Butcher was stunned for a moment, his mouth opened a few times, wanting to say something, but he also knew that in recent years, the Young Master had been visiting the Puppet Sect and mingling among cultivators, flaunting his success, arrogance and pride... are also normal.
Whatever he said must be correct, I guess.
"The Young Master is right."
Laughing Butcher responded with a chuckle.

chapters.title: Chapter 32. Great chaos!
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: 32. Great chaos!
In the blink of an eye, winter had arrived again.
During this time, Song Yan attempted more than once to gain more information from Senior Brother Zhang about the North and the "Great Wei Remnants," yet Senior Brother Zhang paid it no mind, merely saying things like, "If the sky collapses, the Five Great Peaks’ Masters will hold it up, what do the Great Wei Remnants count for?"
That day, Wang Susu also keenly sensed Song Yan’s worries and comforted him, "Junior Brother, you’ve always been obsessed with Skin Making and haven’t interacted much with our fellow disciples, so you might not be aware of how vast our Puppet Palace is. Even if the Multi-tailed Fox Race truly arrives, what’s the problem?"
Song Yan nodded in agreement.
Perhaps he really was overthinking things.
He needed to keep a calm mindset.
However, information did remain his weak point.
All he could do was keep his ears open, while Wang Susu, being an "all-around social butterfly type of demoness," naturally grasped more.
Suddenly, he seemed to remember something and asked, "Sister Wang, how is Qi Yao doing?"
Upon mentioning Qi Yao, Wang Susu’s charming eyes turned, and she spoke with a hint of jealousy, "She has already broken through to the first layer of Refining Profound, and because of her potential, she was accepted as an Inner Sect Disciple and went to attend lectures from our Shadow Puppet Peak’s Peak Master. She’s doing quite well."
Song Yan nodded without saying more, looking up at the sky.
Outside the window, the snow flew again, resembling last year’s.
The mountains have always been this way, and Cultivating Profound is even more monotonous.
"Sister, we should return to the Cave Mansion."
"Hmm, stop overthinking it," Wang Susu said, "You’ve been back from Linglong Valley for almost a year, and your Skin Making skills haven’t changed much since a year ago. You are always thinking too much, about everything.
How long has it been since that event? Can’t you let it go?"
Song Yan was taken aback.
This year, he controlled his Skin Making Skill, making little progress.
Firstly, it was to avoid those "two factions competing for the legacy."
He was interested in the legacy, after all, Master Shi, the first Skin Master of Shadow Puppet Peak, had dedicated his life to creating flawless Secret Techniques.
But that legacy obviously wasn’t his.
Secondly, it was to avoid Cheng Danqing’s recruiting.
For some reason, he always felt that Cheng Danqing had significant problems.
Indeed, this lack of progress also made Peak Master Cheng, who initially was enthusiastic and said, "You will be my person in the future, and you won’t regret it," lose interest in him.
Wang Susu saw him in a daze and thought her words might have touched a sensitive spot, so she said, "I know, a reprimand from an elder can harm you significantly, but it’s time to move on."
Song Yan regained his composure and said, "Thank you, Sister."
...
...
A moment later...
Inside the Cave Mansion.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs
Song Yan had not gathered energy today.
He generally did it periodically.
After sending away Lady Qiu and the Princess Consort, he sat alone on the stone bed in the master bedroom, cross-legged, regulating his breath.
He spent 440 years of lifespan easily cultivating 23 Jianghu Ultimate Techniques to Perfection.
Afterward, still unsatisfied, he purchased 9 more Jianghu Ultimate Techniques, but this time, it took him only 80 years to cultivate them all to Perfection.
Even if he were thrown into a place without Profound Qi, he could rely on his skills and terrifying Refining Profound Second Layer physique to become a formidable Jianghu elder.
In Jianghu, there exists "True Qi."
But this "True Qi" mainly relies on taking one deep breath, then using that breath to unleash power, compared to "Profound Qi," it falls far short.
Of course, his greatest acquisition was the "Turtle Breath Technique."
If the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" he perfected from twice-mutating "Qi Concealment Technique" can make him appear as an ordinary person by concealing all his Profound Qi...
Then, the "Turtle Breath Technique" can make others think he isn’t just ordinary, but a breathless ordinary person.
A breathless ordinary person is a dead person.
No one cares about the dead.
Numerous thoughts flashed by, Song Yan suddenly opened his eyes, aligning two fingers together and swiftly pointing outward.
The speed of this pointing was unimaginable, dreamlike, it was the "Sword Drawing Skill" from a swordsmanship master known as the "Purple Thunder Saber" in Jianghu, Song Yan practiced it to Perfection, naturally making his pointing as swift as drawing a saber;
Immediately, the near-dreamlike fingers reached further, with an extremely peculiar angle, and speed fluctuating, creating a most eerie feeling, this move is a Jianghu Ultimate Technique from the evil sect Blood Hand Sect ———— Slaughter Finger;
Upon reaching the farthest point, the hand suddenly flipped, transforming the finger into a palm, powerfully descending, it seemed to shift from being a venomous snake to a furious bear rising upright, this palm technique is the exclusive ultimate technique of the Nanshan Elder ———— Great Hand Seal.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh...
In the Cave Mansion, Song Yan’s hands, like magic, changed unpredictably, various Killing Techniques displayed themselves one by one on his body, more fluid and harmonious than ever.
Having completed the series of moves, Song Yan let out a long breath, lay quietly, looking at the falling snow outside the skylight, and slowly closed his eyes.
...
...
Several days later, at night, somehow, the great snow continued falling for several consecutive days, never stopping.
Song Yan held Lady Qiu with his left arm, the Princess Consort was on his right arm, sharing a single quilt, their six legs intertwined, they slept soundly.
Suddenly, the entire Cave Mansion shook abruptly.
Song Yan felt even his back was jolted, and the two women, frightened, immediately opened their eyes.
But it was pitch black, and nothing could be seen.
Boom!
Another shake.
The Cave Mansion shivered, if it weren’t situated above the remnants of a Profound Vein, the rocks might have tumbled long ago.
"Song Lang, what happened?"
"Brother Song?"
The two women hurriedly grabbed onto this lifeline.
Song Yan didn’t know what was happening, but he couldn’t afford to worry about it. He ran straight off the bed in his undergarments, quickly opening the stone door and rushing to the open area outside the Cave Mansion.
In such a life-and-death situation where they had no idea what was going on, one woman wrapped herself in a quilt, the other in a blanket, slipping into their shoes as they followed Song Yan outside.
In the distance, the two women couldn’t see clearly, but could only sense the abrupt vibration continuously rising, as the distant dark sky seemed to crack open, with terrifying sounds echoing like thunder.
Song Yan had much stronger perception and could see somewhat clearly.
This wasn’t thunder at all; it was many cultivators engaged in a magical battle.
Several core areas were like unimaginably powerful flying beasts colliding with each other. The strong aftershocks shook the mountain, producing a deafening noise.
Outside the core areas, several shadow puppets and flying swords intertwined.
Song Yan stared at the flying swords for a while, thoughts racing like lightning.
Though he didn’t understand why the Nanwu Sword Sect suddenly attacked, his reaction was swift.
Suddenly, he picked up the two women and ran back into the Cave Mansion, throwing clothes and pants hanging there to them, urging quickly, "Put these on fast!!"
"Song Lang..."
"Talk while you dress!"
The young maiden and the Princess Consort said no more, rustling to put on their clothes in the dark of the harsh winter.
Song Yan quickly said, "In a moment, if it’s the Puppet Sect disciples who come, tell them I went out to fight and you are hiding inside the Cave Mansion.
If it’s cultivators claiming to be from the Nanwu Sword Sect, saying they’re here to slay the Evil Sect and Evil Demon, cry and say you are furnaces who have finally been saved.
Xuerou, you must say you are the Princess Consort of the Southern Border King and plead for the cultivators to avenge the King."
The two women, especially the Princess Consort, were not foolish. They instantly understood what was happening outside.
As Song Yan spoke, he himself finished dressing, but instead of the Shadow Puppet Peak disciple’s uniform, he wore a cloak, which contained many Fasting Pills and Healing Pills.
He tightened the cloak around himself and hurriedly walked towards the entrance of the Cave Mansion.
Just as he reached the door, a voice came from behind.
"Brother Song!"
It was the voice of the young maiden.
Song Yan slightly turned his head.
The young maiden shouted, "Take care of yourself, you must live!"
The Princess Consort said nothing, just gazed at him with a complex expression.
Song Yan was silent for a moment, then shot into the night like the wind, instantly concealing his Profound Qi and activating the Turtle Breath Technique.
He sprinted madly, avoiding the normal path, slowly climbing down the cliff on the side.
South Bamboo Peak was very high, almost like two different worlds from top to bottom, with even perception unable to fully reach.
Yet, before Song Yan touched the ground, two flying swords floated out from the forest, observing him like onlooking monkeys.
A white-robed figure laughed, "I told you, some little devil must be trying to escape from here."
"Senior brother, let’s attack together. It’s just this little devil’s aura feels a bit strange," another figure said.
"Probably some special way of hiding his aura, but it’s not important. Attack!"
Song Yan felt his hair stand on end as if his blood were set ablaze!
He let go with both hands, dropping straight to the ground.
Two flying swords shot from the sky.
With a roll, he barely dodged them.
The two swords relentlessly pursued him.
Song Yan raised his hands abruptly, pushing them towards the flying swords.
The swords were incredibly fast.
But Song Yan’s hand movements were odd.
This was a footwork naturally used by him after amalgamating many Jianghu Ultimate Techniques, an attack employed with the power of a cultivator at the level of an old Jianghu monster!
In an instant, he absorbed all the Profound Qi from the flying swords.
The swords plunged into the snow-covered ground.
He flipped over, rolled, and raised his head.
The two white-robed cultivators uttered a strange "Eh?" and swiftly descended.
Song Yan’s eyes turned red, as he dashed through the snow, taking the initiative to attack, slamming a heavy palm towards the nearby cultivator.
The cultivator countered with some unknown method to block.
But with his Controlling Profound fully activated, Song Yan directly absorbed the cultivator’s Profound Qi, striking from a highly intricate angle in a manner "almost impossible to appear on a cultivator," hitting the target’s ribs intricately.
His palm instantly turned black, and Condensing Evil exploded.
Boom!!
The cultivator didn’t even have time to react, nor understand how his Profound Qi vanished, before half his body was blown apart, blood and entrails flying chaotically!
Song Yan turned, quickly using Sword Drawing Skill, then unleashed Slaughter Finger with Torrential Rain Evil striking swiftly.
Boom!!
The white-robed cultivator who was about to join in from the side was pierced through the chest, dumbfoundedly lowered his head to look for a moment, before crashing to the ground.
Song Yan gasped for breath, the newly absorbed external Profound Qi rampaging within him.
He quickly rifled through the fallen cultivators’ belongings but found nothing, so he grabbed the two flying swords and dashed into the dense forest.
After sprinting over a hundred zhang, he suddenly veered off, heading towards the Earth Evil Land.
He couldn’t believe it.
The Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique, the Turtle Breath Technique, coupled with the ghosts’ cover, who could find him!!

chapters.title: Chapter 33. The net-closers emerge one by one
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: 33. The net-closers emerge one by one
Swish, swish, swish~~
The flying snow on both sides cut like bone-scraping flying sabers, but Song Yan felt no chill.
At that moment, it felt like his blood was burning.
Fear, excitement, and doubt wove together like fuel, spurring him to run faster and faster.
It was unclear how long he had been running, but he could already see the evil qi mixed in with the heavy snow ahead, with some eerie debris and even decayed flesh writhing as if alive.
’Arrived!’
Song Yan took a few more steps, quickly finding a rock to lean on.
He buried two flying swords under the snow and leaned his back against the cold stone.
He had been moving constantly before, but now that he stopped, a suffocating feeling emerged, his heart pounding fiercely.
Taking several deep breaths, he retrieved a fasting pill from his cloak and swallowed it, then started the qi concealment technique, entered a turtle breath state, reaching a death-like condition.
Before long, the accumulating snow transformed him into a snowman, looking like just a part of the rocky landscape from the outside.
Only if someone dug through the snow, or if a strong cultivator above the Refining Profound Realm noticed, they might discover him.
...
...
Time began to slow down.
Song Yan had hidden five full bottles of fasting pills in his cloak, each containing thirty pills, which meant he could remain in one place for more than a year without starving.
Suddenly, he felt a tinge of regret: if he hadn’t deliberately suppressed his talent this past year, but instead showcased more of his skill in skin making, then... would Cheng Danqing have offered him protection?
Such an invasion by the Nanwu Sword Sect, Cheng Danqing, as the South Bamboo Peak Master, wouldn’t be as oblivious as him, a mere disciple, right?
But this "small regret" quickly passed.
Song Yan calmed his mind, expanded his perception as much as possible, and adjusted his mentality, ’If the situation turns dire, then I’ll just spend the winter in this position’.
Time ticked by, second by second.
That night turned unexpectedly long.
The distant energy clashes were palpable, even from far away.
Song Yan felt a bit of self-mockery: truly, it’s like a divine battle, and the insects scurry away.
Just as he was thinking aimlessly, a sudden tension gripped him.
Because there was movement from afar.
Not just a tiny bit of movement.
The evil qi suddenly roiled, and the woods shook violently!
Yet amidst these grand sounds there were hidden footsteps, roughly twenty people.
’Who are they?’ Song Yan wondered, ’At this time, why would so many people come to the evil land?’
Just then, an unexpectedly familiar voice from afar reached his ears.
"Red Mist True Man, weren’t you dead long ago? Where... where are you taking us?"
It was Lv Hong’s voice!
Then another voice followed.
"Red Mist True Man? Were you the Righteous Dao cultivator who was slain by the combined efforts of three Puppet Palace Peak Masters forty years ago? How could you possibly still be alive? And... how have you changed like this?"
"No one should know about the secret room we were in, how... how did you discover it?"
These voices, Song Yan carefully recognized them, finding them quite familiar.
Reflecting further, they were the voices of the Skin Masters on the Shadow Puppet Void Ship that day!
Considering their words, Song Yan roughly deduced an order of events.
As the "technical professions," the Skin Masters would naturally be protected.
So before the battle began, they were quietly sent to a secluded safehouse.
Yet, as the battle erupted, a Righteous Dao cultivator who had died forty years ago suddenly appeared, deftly extracting the secret room and capturing all the Skin Masters hidden within, leading them to the evil land.
The unfolding of these events was quite bizarre.
However, Song Yan suddenly thought of something:
The so-called ghost cultivator, is when a ghost successfully occupies a cultivator’s body, reincarnating with a combination of Profound Root.
’Ghost cultivator, Red Mist True Man is a ghost cultivator!
After he died in battle, his corpse fell in the evil land and was invaded by ghosts, becoming a ghost cultivator!’
Song Yan almost instantly made the connection.
Then, a chill crept over him.
If "Red Mist True Man can precisely locate the Skin Masters," does that mean... there’s a terrifying ghost cultivator hiding within Shadow Puppet Peak, and their status is quite high?
Who could it be?
...
"Cheng! Dan! Qing!!"
Lv Hong shouted, "Who are you really? Why are you here?"
The instant those three words were out, Song Yan’s mind exploded.
All doubts in his mind were almost immediately resolved.
’Cheng Danqing is a ghost cultivator! No wonder he said I wouldn’t regret that day’s choice! The high-ranking figure who temporarily arranged for me to join the Linglong Valley journey is also a ghost cultivator! To achieve such a level... throughout Shadow Puppet Peak, there could only be... the Peak Master!!’
Elders are all Ghost Cultivators!
It must be!
Who benefits most from the clash between Nanwu Sword Sect and Puppet Palace?
Of course, it’s the Ghost Cultivators.
Because many cultivators who die in battle have their corpses taken to the Evil Land, and some become new Ghost Cultivators.
The Skin Masters of Shadow Puppet Peak are very skilled.
The Ghost Cultivators take them away, imprison them in the Evil Land, and force them to craft skins for them.
The Peak Master, under the guise of protecting the Skin Masters before the war, sent Lv Hong and the others to a secret chamber, and then his accomplices swept in and took them away cleanly.
Countless thoughts flashed through Song Yan’s mind, and he suddenly felt a sense of "survival after a disaster".
If it hadn’t been for his poor performance over the past year, Cheng Danqing wouldn’t have abandoned him. Otherwise, he might have been "protected" early, sent to that secret chamber, feeling rather smug, and then... now standing with Lv Hong and the others?
...
"Where’s Gu Rufeng?"
Cheng Danqing’s voice suddenly rang out, with a hint of confusion.
Another unfamiliar voice, presumably from the Scarlet Mist Elder, responded, "These are all the people from the secret chamber. I’ve brought them all."
Cheng Danqing frowned and said, "That’s not right, Gu Rufeng should also be in the secret chamber."
The Scarlet Mist Elder replied, "Maybe he went to the front line with the Stone Seat Elder? Stone Seat Elder is quite a character, engaging in the battle and unwilling to hide in the rear."
Cheng Danqing said, "He’s nearing his end and wants to leave a name, I suppose. Unfortunately, the success rate of becoming a Ghost Cultivator isn’t high, and even if successful, some powers of the original body might be lost."
That’s why they took the Skin Masters instead of killing them.
"Ghost Cultivators!" A disciple among the Skin Masters finally realized.
Cheng Danqing snorted coldly and said, "Be glad you are Skin Masters. In the future, you’ll be here in the mountains, just as outside, except you’re not allowed to leave. You won’t be killed."
...
...
The voices gradually faded, far enough that Song Yan could no longer hear them.
He let out a long breath and continued to wait.
...
...
"Gu Rufeng is missing?"
At the frontline of the Puppet Palace and Nanwu Sword Sect battle, a dark, eerie figure was holding a "Communication Jade," listening to a report from afar.
This eerie figure was the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak.
The voice from the Communication Jade was Cheng Danqing’s.
"A small Gu Rufeng shouldn’t matter."
However, the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak remained silent, stepping back as if pondering something.
Then, suddenly, as if he realized something, he began to retreat further, flipping his hand to produce a mysterious artifact, starting to cast a spell.
...
A little while later...
The entire battlefield suddenly experienced unimaginable changes.
Four terrifying auras appeared in the sky, pressing down massively, scattering all energies on the battlefield like a fog being cleared, and all sounds fell silent.
Someone from the Southern Wu Sword Sect exclaimed in shock.
"Why are those four old undying ones from the Puppet Palace back?!"
"Weren’t they supposed to confront the Multi-tailed Fox Race?"
Among the four auras, an elderly voice full of authority suddenly spoke.
"Everyone, today we discovered a Ghost Cultivator within our Puppet Palace, holding a high position,
we four would not leave, he wouldn’t reveal himself.
With Ghost Cultivators here, further battle is pointless. How about a truce?!"
As the elderly voice spoke, the other three auras strangely shot towards a certain location.
And at that location, the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak had already completed a certain spell, with his form disappearing.
The three auras gave chase relentlessly, but the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak seemed to have been on guard for a long time, and this time... he truly escaped far away.
When the three auras reached the depths of the Evil Land, looking down at the red jade-like sea of blood at the center, they frowned but ultimately didn’t go in.
...
...
"What’s going on? Why was he on guard?"
"It seems Elder Gu secretly brought his grandson back."
"And how did Elder Gu find out?"
"You’ve practiced that skill too much and it’s messed up your brain... Elder Gu went to the border with us, of course he knew."
"Ridiculous!! Ridiculous!!!"
"For now, let’s leave it at this. Unexpectedly, that double-faced one from Shadow Puppet Peak turned out to be a Ghost Cultivator. He’s fled back to the Evil Land; it’s not wise to go deeper. Let’s plan long term."

chapters.title: Chapter 34. I know your heart, you understand my intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: 34. I know your heart, you understand my intentions
The arrival of the four powerful cultivators caused quite a commotion, with thunderous sounds rolling from afar, even reaching Song Yan’s ears faintly.
He could roughly deduce the situation through mental deduction.
Nanwu Sword Sect wanted to eliminate the Puppet Palace, a major malignancy.
Meanwhile, the ghost cultivators were also plotting, hoping to provoke a conflict between Nanwu Sword Sect and Puppet Palace.
Thus, the Shadow Puppet Peak Master, as a ghost cultivator, accepted Qi Yao, such a half-baked spy, into the inner sect to act as a messenger.
Then, seizing the opportunity, she timely spread the news of the "four elders secretly departed to fight the Multi-tailed Demonic Fox at the border" through the messenger.
Among this...
Truth and falsehood mingled, hard to discern...
They thought Qi Yao and others would send false messages, but they conveyed the truth. Otherwise... Nanwu Sword Sect wasn’t foolish; they would verify from multiple sources before taking action.
You thought she was telling the truth, but this was actually the design of the four elders of Puppet Palace.
The four elders of Puppet Palace suddenly returned, but their target wasn’t the Nanwu Sword Sect; it was the Shadow Puppet Peak Master, who was a ghost cultivator.
However, the Shadow Puppet Peak Master seemed to have detected some unknown clues and narrowly escaped the killing trap, safely returning to the center of the Evil Land.
’Too dangerous.’
Song Yan couldn’t help but sigh.
The countless schemes, numerous plots intertwined, all erupted tonight.
Among these machinations, he almost got involved, but he narrowly escaped, avoiding disaster. Otherwise... he might also be on the way to the center of the Evil Land by now.
His identity as a ghost cultivator would be exposed.
Of course, he could try to use the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique and Turtle Breath Technique" to make himself seem dead... but it’s merely an appearance.
Among those ghost cultivators, each one is more cunning than the other; could they not see the flaw?
At that time, the consequences would be unimaginable.
But Song Yan estimated, at worst, it would be the Soul-Searching Skill; it’s unlikely they would naively think "fellow villagers meeting each other," right?
He, too, narrowly escaped the killing trap.
...
...
At this moment, somewhere outside the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, the fighting cultivators were slowly separating.
At a certain spot...
A spirited female cultivator in a red-edged Profound Robe stood with legs together, a sword slanted, snowflakes falling heavily.
A dark figure approached.
"Seventh Miss, let’s go. After this, your identity will surely be exposed, no need to stay at Shadow Puppet Peak."
"The Su Family cares little whether I’m around or not; no matter what I do, no one cares. They wish I would die at the Demon Sect, don’t they?"
"Someone will care."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"Who?"
"You’ll meet them."
As the words fell, Qi Yao... or rather Su Yao sighed, then picked up her sword and followed the dark figure towards the Nanwu Sword Sect’s camp.
The "Qi" in Qi Yao was simply because she was the Seventh Miss, using a homophone for "Seven."
...
...
The night passed.
The snow stopped as well.
Rumbling...
The stone mechanism door slowly opened.
Golden sunlight burst through the widening gap from outside.
The Princess Consort, Qiu Xiaoniang, clenched her fists tightly, nervously looking out, only to see a familiar man standing at the door. Who else could it be but Song Yan?
"It’s over." Returning to South Bamboo Peak, Song Yan waved to the distance.
The expression of the Princess Consort was one of mixed emotions, neither joy nor sorrow.
The same went for Qiu Xiaoniang.
They were still under the control of the Fanatic Fans; true feelings or fake ones, regardless, they didn’t wish harm upon Song Yan. But they equally longed for freedom.
The dark, eternal days as a Furnace in the Cave Mansion were unbearable for them.
"Yes." Qiu Xiaoniang smiled.
The Princess Consort also forced a smile.
After delivering the news to the two women, Song Yan hurriedly went out to investigate the situation.
Meanwhile, the entire South Bamboo Peak was in chaos. Cheng Danqing had betrayed them, the senior brother frequently going to Qingxi Market to buy demon beast skins had died tragically at the mountain gate, and Zhang Yin had gone missing. The entire scene was one of post-battle chaos.
...
...
Three days later.
The chaos finally subsided slightly.
Zhang Yin was confirmed dead, falling forward on the ground, head twisted back, with a conspicuous penetrating sword mark on his back, clearly the victim of an ambush.
Beside him, the Shadow Puppet of a Blood Blade Deer was also covered in blood, the antlers impaled with part of a body, all evidence that on that night... he killed at least two or three disciples of Nanwu Sword Sect; otherwise, there wouldn’t be so much blood.
Song Yan couldn’t help but sigh, ’It’s really like the taller ones standing at the front, only to end up dead...’
Though Zhang Yin was a standard evil demon, brutal and tyrannical, bullying the weak, he was pretty good to him.
He collected Zhang Yin’s body, found a nice scenic spot to cremate him, then buried the urn in the soil.
Due to the ghost cultivators, "cremating deceased disciples" was a necessary task.
Bam.
Song Yan opened a jar of fine wine previously bought at the market and poured it before the tombstone.
Watching the wine seep into the earth, he softly said, "Brother Zhang, have a safe journey."
The cold wind rises,
In the distance, the sunset also rolls with red Evil Qi, climbing and clinging.
Desolate and chilling, remnants of snow still cover the green mountains, like rivers and mountains with white hair...
Song Yan remained silent, not because he mourned for Zhang Yin, but rather he felt a bewildered sense of "lips gone, teeth cold, not knowing where to go from here."
This battle deeply impressed upon him the importance of "Breaking Realm."
But "Refining Profound Third Layer" requires a certain external object, without which one cannot break through.
The sect’s rules are strict, and he couldn’t purchase that object even if he went to the market. Unless... he could reach an outside market of the sect. That would offer a glimmer of hope.
Otherwise... he could only wait quietly for time to pass, wait for others to break through, and then follow, to avoid exposing his possession of the "Remaining Life Dao Fruit."
As he was thinking, a familiar voice came from not far away.
"Junior Brother, quickly return to South Bamboo Peak, the Sect Leader has arrived!!"
Song Yan turned his head; it was Wang Susu.
Wang Susu was also very cunning, it was unclear how she survived that night.
He responded, and quickly followed Wang Susu.
This Sect Leader was naturally the Puppet Sect Leader, also the Peak Master of Paperman Peak, the first among the five great peaks of "Paperman, Blood Corpse, Shadow Puppet, Mechanism, and Strange Poison."
Paperman Peak was situated right above one of the only two swirls of the Profound Vein, with an advantageous geographical position, and thus its Peak Master was the Sect Leader.
The other swirl was naturally the center of the Evil Land.
Like a red jade, like a Blood River, a place even the three Peak Masters dared not delve into despite pursuing it.
...
...
A paperman stood upon the high platform of South Bamboo Peak.
It was a beautiful paperman, and with a slight sway in the wind, it transformed into a beautiful woman in white, with flowing ribbons and billowing sleeves.
"You are low-level disciples within the sect, but you also possess a Profound Root, and in the future, someone may achieve success."
The woman in white spoke faintly, yet her voice was that of an old man.
"Hence, you should not perish here."
"Currently, the situation within the sect is not good. The Ghost Cultivators no longer hide, and the Multi-tailed Fox Race has driven straight in. Fortunately, we have temporarily reached a ceasefire agreement with Nanwu Sword Sect."
"I have decided that all disciples below the fourth layer of Refining Profound will be scattered; you go to the Mortal Dynasty to seek refuge, hide wherever you like."
"Within five years, things will surely improve, and it will be appropriate to return by then."
After speaking, the woman in white waved her hand, and a box flew out from her wide sleeve.
The box snapped open, revealing countless dense elixirs inside.
In the red light of the dusk, the elixirs exuded a somewhat sinister blood color.
"These elixirs will aid your cultivation, so even where Profound Qi is scarce in the mortal world, your realm will not decline.
However, these elixirs are also poison.
If you do not return within five years, then die outside."
"Come and collect them one by one, after which quickly descend the mountain!!"
The woman in white spoke no more, floating up, coldly overlooking each disciple.
Anyone who refused to take them would immediately be killed by her.
This sudden change stunned all the disciples.
In fact, most of the disciples on South Bamboo Peak were once servants.
The servants were abducted, they all had families.
Returning home was also a good thing!
Instantly, a disciple rushed forward, quickly grabbed an elixir, and tossed it into his mouth.
Subsequently, others stepped forward.
Song Yan had no choice but to join the queue, step forward to take an elixir, and then consume it under the burning gaze of the paperman overhead.
...
...
Early the next morning.
A carriage appeared at the foot of the mountain.
The carriage was "taken" directly from the market.
Song Yan, wrapped in a cloak and pressing down a bamboo hat, sat in the carriage with mixed feelings, alongside the excited yet nervous Miss Qiu and the Princess Consort.
On the side, Wang Susu emerged on horseback, the furnace or whatever... likely already drained by her in a frenzy.
"Senior Sister, are you taking the same road?"
"Where are you going?"
"Western Shu."
"Western Shu? There is the least Profound Qi of the Three Kingdoms, I’m not going."
"Then take care, Senior Sister."
"You take care as well."
Wang Susu nudged the horse’s belly, galloped away, turned beyond the valley, and vanished without a trace.
...
...
A few more days passed...
The carriage continued westward, as a pitch-black crow carrying a bundle landed on the roof, took a few steps forward, and placed the bundle lightly at the driver’s feet.
Song Yan quickly turned his head, but the crow had already flown away.
The bundle’s opening lay open, and on it was a letter.
The letter began with a phrase: I know your heart, you understand my intention, my teachings will only be passed to the most suitable person, if you acknowledge me as master, bow three times toward the Puppet Sect, there is no need to admit it in front of others.
Signed: Stone Seat Elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 35. Hundred Forms Divine Control, The First Pot of Gold
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: 35. Hundred Forms Divine Control, The First Pot of Gold
The azure sky was vast, with the sound of birds fluttering their wings gradually fading into the distance among the clouds.
Song Yan held the letter tightly.
At first, there was surprise and wonder, then followed by a complex emotion that arose from the depths of his heart.
In his mind, scenes of his interactions with Stone Seat Elder flashed like a carousel.
"South Bamboo Peak... you’re from a servant background? It’s not easy, really not easy. Learn as much as you can this time and become a Skin Master soon."
"Everyone is discussing, yet you are daydreaming with your head down, you deserve to be punished!! Extend your hand!!"
"My question to you remains, has the Divine Form of the Nine-eye Grand Python moved?"
...
’It hasn’t moved.’
Song Yan smiled, looking towards the direction of the Puppet Sect, softly saying in his heart, ’The Divine Form hasn’t moved, it’s the heart that moved. If the heart moves, how can one paint an unmoving Divine Form? That’s the... disciple’s answer. I hope, teacher, you are satisfied.’
After quietly finishing his thought, he recalled the appearance of the raven that turned dumb as a wooden chicken and left angrily after he hastily fabricated an answer back then.
Reflecting further, he roughly understood the location of his flaw: the Double-headed Wolf Shadow Puppet.
His Skin Painting Technique was already perfectly mastered. Even if he misplaced a dot during the spirit-imbuing moment, if time extended, some tiny flaw would inevitably reveal itself in the minutest detail.
The flaw was very small, extremely small, and if not for someone with a strong will observing continuously, it would be impossible to discover.
Stone Master cared about him deeply, yet also considered his situation, so at the best timing, he sent him the Cloak and Bowl Skill.
’I know your heart, you understand my intention...’
Though not spoken face-to-face, everything was conveyed in silence.
Unspeakable gratitude arose from the bottom of Song Yan’s heart.
...
...
As night fell.
The carriage stopped in a desolate forest, and a blazing campfire rose high. Two women wrapped in blankets slept in the carriage.
Song Yan stood by the campfire, gazing towards the direction of the Puppet Sect, knelt down, and respectfully performed three loud kowtows, then unwrapped the parcel.
Inside the parcel, besides the letter placed on top, there were four items:
Another letter;
Four jade bottles, one black, one green, one white, one red;
A brocade box;
A palm-sized silk pouch that seemed to contain something heavy.
He opened the silk pouch, inside were two pieces of egg-sized Crystal Jade emitting Profound Qi.
He had touched similar Crystal Jade in the embrace of a Loose Cultivator with a gourd Profound Artifact before, but those jade were only the size of soybeans, compared to these two the difference was vast.
He glanced at the brocade box and jade bottles but did not open them rashly, instead, he first took the letter from the bottom, opened it, and quietly read.
The letter stated: In the Mortal World where Profound Qi is thin, you can only cultivate using the Dual Cultivation method, these two Great Profound Jade can aid your cultivation, equivalent to providing you with the Profound Qi of four years of cultivation in the Cave Mansion of South Bamboo Peak, helping you to break into the Refining Profound Realm sooner.
The brocade box contains a Storage Ring, old man’s Cloak and Bowl Skill is within.
The ring’s sole restriction is your breath, which was applied using a strand of your hair from South Bamboo Peak Cave Mansion. Once you enter Refining Profound, you can break into the ring with Profound Qi to obtain the cultivation technique. In the meantime, ensure you safeguard it carefully!
Inside the Black Jade Bottle, there is the antidote. The Sect Leader may not be able to resolve the trouble within five years, and if he falls before then, awaiting you all will be only death.
However, even if you take the antidote, if the Sect Leader has not died, you must return within five years. The pill given to you by the Sect Leader not only contains toxin but also a thread of his breath, if you do not return, he will surely kill you. Our sect’s style does not tolerate a slight.
However, if the Sect Leader truly dies, then you need not return, and may carefully cultivate elsewhere.
The "Qi Manipulation Technique" of my Shadow Puppet lineage requires at least the Fourth Layer of Refining Profound to be utilized.
The Green Jade Bottle contains twenty-four Great Profound Spirit Pills, consume one every two months, sufficient for four years of cultivation.
The White Jade Bottle contains the Skin-Stripping Ointment needed for the Third Layer of Refining Profound, apply it all over the body after achieving perfection in the Second Layer before continuing cultivation to assist in breakthrough;
Inside the Red Jade Bottle is the Flame Marrow Pill required for the Fourth Layer of Refining Profound, consume when encountering a bottleneck, digest the medicinal power to assist in breakthrough.
...
Having finished reading the letter.
Song Yan placed it into the campfire, then quickly retrieved the Storage Ring.
This item indeed filled him with excitement, because even Zhang Yin did not have such a ring, clearly it was incredibly precious, its function naturally being "storing and retrieving items at will."
Stone Master assumed he needed some time to cultivate before breaking into Refining Profound, yet he had actually already reached the Second Layer of Refining Profound.
He grasped the ring, a strand of Profound Qi passed through his fingertip into it, as if arriving at a "Automatic Sensing Door with Breath Recognition," sensing his breath, the restriction opened directly, revealing an interior space roughly the size of a drawer.
Though the space was small, the contents inside were quite abundant.
First, five booklets.
These were evidently compiled or transcribed by Stone Master, as lacking a Jade Scroll would be easily noticeable.
Song Yan glanced around, then took them out one by one, and carefully began to read.
The first booklet: Stone Master’s experience in skin making.
The second booklet: Skin Control Technique, a secret technique from Shadow Puppet Peak in Puppet Sect, although not an exclusive secret technique, it’s more "confidential" compared to the low-level market common techniques. The entry-level threshold for cultivation is: Fourth Layer of Refining Profound.
And this... perhaps explains why the Puppet Sect Leader "dismissed those below Fourth Layer of Refining Profound" because "Fourth Layer of Refining Profound" is the minimum combat disciple threshold.
The third booklet: Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand, a technique exclusive to Skin Masters.
The fourth booklet: Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique, a technique exclusive to Skin Masters.
The fifth booklet: Hundred Forms Divine Control, Stone Master’s Cloak and Bowl Skill.
Having reviewed the Skin Control Technique, Song Yan roughly understood that skin control requires first taming the "Shadow Puppet," low-level Demon Beast grade "Shadow Puppets" are at the Refining Profound First to Third Layer, so you need at least "Fourth Layer of Refining Profound" to successfully tame them.
After taming, use Profound Qi as silk threads to manipulate the "Shadow Puppet," strengthening it, with the normal limit being "two."
Left hand one Shadow Puppet, right hand another Shadow Puppet.
This matched the several battles previously observed by Song Yan.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Those Official Disciples from Shadow Puppet Peak mostly manipulated one "mount" Shadow Puppet and one "combat" Shadow Puppet.
These Shadow Puppets cannot leave the operator’s side too far.
For someone like Stone Master to send a bodiless phantom raven hundreds or even thousands of miles away is purely impossible.
And this is the essence of Hundred Forms Divine Control.
Hundred Forms Divine Control not only uses Profound Qi to control shadow puppets but also integrates them with spirit, though the recorded methods are extremely complex: different shadow puppets require different integration methods.
"Hundred Forms" is even an exaggeration because Hundred Forms Divine Control only records integration methods for low-level beasts like Double-headed Wolf, White Thorn Deer, Knife-beaked Finch, Iron Feather Finch.
For intermediate beasts, it only includes the bodiless phantom raven.
This Cloak and Bowl Skill represents Stone Master’s lifetime of research, yet his lifespan was limited, so he only studied this much and passed it all to Song Yan.
But this was already excellent...
Normal Skin Control Technique can only manipulate two shadow puppets, with a use range limited to around oneself.
Hundred Forms Divine Control, however, allows the manipulation of multiple shadow puppets, with the number increasing as your spirit strengthens, and the range extending beyond, from "around oneself" to hundreds or even thousands of miles...
Such technique truly deserves to be called a secret art of Cloak and Bowl Skill.
Possibly worried about Song Yan’s difficulties in skin making, the Storage Ring still contains a total of nine "low-level Demon Beast Shadow Puppet" finished products and one "no-bodied phantom raven" finished product, yet beside them written in blood: "Once you enter the Fourth Layer of Refining Profound, you can take them" and "Once you enter the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, you can take them."
Clearly, these shadow puppets were intended by Stone Master to be heirlooms passed to Song Yan, he held onto some hope, yet also was not entirely convinced Song Yan would truly succeed in using them.
After all, everything was still uncertain, the worldly Profound Qi was scarce, for someone like Song Yan who hadn’t even reached "First Layer of Refining Profound," breaking through to "Fourth Layer of Refining Profound" was akin to nightmare difficulty.
...
...
Song Yan raised his hand, touched the white bottle, and the two pieces of Great Profound Jade.
The white bottle contained the Skin-Stripping Ointment.
Although the name sounded poisonous, Song Yan felt no fear, as he would use it during life span calculation.
He slightly perceived his surroundings.
There was no Evil Qi here, and though the Profound Qi was quite thin, perhaps due to being relatively close to Puppet Palace, it wasn’t so thin as to be nonexistent.
Different environments result in stark differences in cultivation speed.
In life span calculation, both "cultivation environment" and "personally held items" greatly influence the calculation progress.
Clearly, spending a year calculating here would yield far less progress compared to South Bamboo Peak.
However, it doesn’t matter.
He initially planned to search the external market for an opportunity to break through to the Third Layer of Refining Profound, but he hadn’t expected Stone Master to thoughtfully provide it directly.
He quickly focused his attention on Cultivation Technique.
’Invest six years, comprehend realm.’
The upper limit number for life span "17956" began to retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 36. Terror Rises, Outshining the Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: 36. Terror Rises, Outshining the Master
[You devoted six years to cultivating the complete version of "Profound Qi Guiding Technique",
you applied Skin-Stripping Ointment all over your body, your skin felt an opening sensation, becoming capable of absorbing Profound Qi.
You consumed the antidote from the Black Bottle, in the fifth year, when you should have died, nothing occurred.
At the end of six years, you accumulated a harvest of 106 strands of Profound Qi.
You have broken through the constraints of Refining Profound Second Layer, you believe with enough accumulation you can reach the Third Layer]
Song Yan let out a long breath, skin feeling as though it was completely renewed, Profound Qi flowing over it like an invisible armor, subtly connecting with the ten meridians of Profound Qi within, poised to form a whole.
Meanwhile, in front of him, the two pieces of Great Profound Jade, the bottle of Great Profound Spirit Pill, the antidote in the Black Bottle, and the Skin-Stripping Ointment in the white bottle had all vanished without a trace.
’Continue.’
Song Yan glanced at his still abundant remaining life, and continued using it without pause.
Here, outside the sect, the future was unpredictable. The further he traveled, the less Profound Qi there was. Naturally, he had to convert "potential" into "power" while still in this Qi-rich environment.
After losing the "Great Profound Jade" and "Great Profound Spirit Pill", his cultivation speed severely slowed.
On average, he could only harvest 3 strands of Profound Qi per year.
Having spent 298 years, he successfully broke through to "Refining Profound Third Layer", a thousand strands of Profound Qi circulating on his skin.
Then after consuming the "Flame Marrow Pill" and spending 334 years, he successfully broke through to "Refining Profound Fourth Layer", a thousand strands of Profound Qi entered the marrow.
He continued calculating and pushing forward.
Another 334 years, he broke through to "Refining Profound Fifth Layer", a thousand strands of Profound Qi exchanged for new blood.
Yet another 334 years, he broke through to "Refining Profound Sixth Layer", a thousand strands of Profound Qi performed a second exchange of blood.
No matter how thin the Profound Qi became, as long as there was still some Profound Qi, he could pile it with life force, relentlessly piling.
Others could only live for a hundred years, while he, with a grand gesture, could spend hundreds of years.
However, it seemed Refining Profound Sixth Layer had reached a new bottleneck.
Song Yan spent 30 years attempting, but had no progress.
During this period, he faintly understood the situation.
Refining Profound Sixth Layer, Profound Qi already circulated throughout his body, connecting the ten meridians, bones, skin, blood; the next step was likely to touch the "internal organs".
He intentionally suggested himself to guide Profound Qi into the "internal organs" during cultivation.
Yet compared to Profound Qi, "internal organs" were too fragile, resulting in "body explosion" with each attempt, as the internal organs burst, directly spitting blood.
Clearly, some kind of secret medicine was needed to protect the "internal organs", creating a buffer, similar to the function of "Skin-Stripping Ointment" and "Flame Marrow Pill".
Song Yan halted realm cultivation and began cultivating magic, calculating magic, and mutating magic...
Using vast amounts of life force.
One after another, profound insights into magic rapidly formed in his mind, the mysterious feeling exploding uncontrollably, filled with an indescribable and intense sense of rewarding satisfaction.
"Soul-Searching Skill", Threshold: Refining Profound Third Layer; 5 years to perfect; 25 years to derive single mutation magic "Soul-Devouring Technique"; 525 years to derive secondary perfect mutation magic "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique".
Soul-Searching Skill could only search others’ memories, and through scrambling everything in those memories renders them foolish, while "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique" can directly swallow others’ souls, then mix with Evil Qi and expel, returning to the original body, transforming into a mindless, anger-filled, and frenetic killing machine.
"Qi Burst Technique", Threshold: Refining Profound Third Layer; 5 years to perfect; 24 years to derive single mutation magic "Evil Burst Technique"; 527 years to derive secondary perfect mutation magic "Evil Tide Skill".
Qi Burst Technique compared to Qi Arrow Technique has notable increases in power, differing just like the difference between "cannon" and "bow arrow", while "Evil Tide Skill" is a technique that can transform into something akin to a "River God" within an Evil Land.
Evil Qi like a sea, you push Evil into a tide, its power is exceedingly terrifying, not to mention being undefeated at the same level, even surpassing levels is quite normal.
"Skin Control Technique", Threshold: Refining Profound Fourth Layer; 6 years to perfect; 33 years to derive single mutation magic "Five-Finger Control Technique", 687 years to derive secondary mutation magic "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique".
Normally, disciples practicing Skin Control Technique can only manipulate two shadow puppets, while "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique" not only allows manipulation of ten shadow puppets but can also have the summoned ghosts within them dispersed outward, creating illusions.
"Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique", Threshold: Refining Profound Fourth Layer; 50 years to perfect; 150 years to derive single mutation magic "Skin Painting Slave Soul Technique"; 3020 years to derive secondary perfect mutation magic "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique".
If Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique still focused on "skin creation, then carefully summoning souls, to prevent backlash from summoned souls", then... "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique" had reached the level where all summoned souls are directly enslaved, and multiple souls stuffed within a single shadow puppet, transforming the puppet into a "multi-soul skin" grotesque painted skin.
"Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand", Threshold: Refining Profound Fourth Layer; 50 years to perfect; 152 years to derive single mutation magic "Five Elements Hand".
Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand allowed hands to adapt to the Five Elements erosion from Demon Beasts, facilitating long-term skin creation and avoiding becoming crippled. Yet "Five Elements Hand" enables hands to become highly compatible with the Five Elements, disregarding erosion, even if placed over fire or sliced by Flying Sword, no harm befalls them.
"Hundred Forms Divine Control", Threshold: Refining Profound Fourth Layer; 75 years to perfect; 400 years to derive single mutation secret technique "Divine Swallowing Hundred Forms"; 8211 years to derive secondary perfect mutation secret technique "Hundred Forms Demon Body".
This is truly remarkable.
Hundred Forms Divine Control is the Stone Seat Elder’s lifelong research essence, where the divine can merge with shadow puppets and traverse thousands of miles, centered on linking one’s divine soul with the summoned divine souls in the shadow puppets to a certain extent, which is quite dangerous, with the risk of being overwhelmed by the summoned divine souls. But "Divine Swallowing Hundred Forms" allows Song Yan to temporarily swallow all summoned divine souls, momentarily enlarging his own divine soul. "Hundred Forms Demon Body", as the secret technique he spent 8211 years deriving, not only swallows divine souls but can also temporarily swallow the shadow puppets themselves, causing his body to reach a terrifying level, becoming the "Hundred Forms Demon Body".
...
...
After a set of frenzied calculations concluded.
Song Yan swept away.
This time, he directly consumed 15,281 years of lifespan.
His lifespan changed from "[Lifespan: 22/17,956]" to "[Lifespan: 22/2,675]".
To be honest, he couldn’t deduce any further, and the "Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand" had only achieved a single mutation in deduced evolution, not yet reaching a secondary perfect mutation.
But this was already the limit of Song Yan’s ability to "transform potential", and the gift from Elder Shi was almost completely digested by him.
Though time spent was over ten thousand years, external conditions greatly limited the possibility of enhancement, which Song Yan understood very well. It’s similar to locking an ordinary person in a study room where they won’t starve or die of thirst but have nothing else at hand. Even after ten thousand years, they won’t become superhuman because of this. Beast evolution for millions of years still results in beasts. If humans hadn’t happened to stand upright freeing their hands, hadn’t happened to learn to use tools, they would also be beasts.
The world... there’s always similarity.
Time itself won’t make one stronger.
Ten thousand years, a million years, ten million years, none of these will.
This time, he spent almost all of his accumulated years.
Glancing at the panel.
The panel changed significantly:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 22/2,675]
[Talent: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]
[Realm: Refining Profound Sixth Layer]
[Spirit Root: Inferior Ghost Profound Root (can be deduced with lifespan)]
[Cultivation Technique: Profound Qi Guiding Technique (can be deduced with lifespan)]
[Magic]
Hundred Forms Demon Body (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Five Elements Hand (Perfection) (Single Mutation)
Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Evil Tide Skill (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
Torrential Rain Evil (Perfection) (Secondary Perfect Mutation)
...
...
Morning sunlight penetrated through the bare tree gaps in the jungle, falling onto the ground.
After a night of enlightenment, he didn’t realize the sky had turned bright.
The gift from Elder Shi only left the storage ring.
But the things Song Yan comprehended himself already far surpassed the "mantle" within the storage ring, which can’t even be described as "out of blue and beyond blue", but rather feels like stepping directly from the Stone Age into an industrial revolution.
The youth didn’t sleep all night, yet felt refreshed, and the previous night’s panic, as if a bug avoiding celestial thunder, was greatly diluted by the increase in strength.
A look of contemplation began to appear in his eyes.
Although Puppet Sect and Nanwu Sword Sect reached a "truce agreement", Song Yan deeply understood one thing: between these two sects, with so many people killed, and even that True Man Chixia was killed by Puppet Sect decades ago... such deep enmity is not something a mere "truce agreement" can influence.
The "truce agreement" at most maintains peace on the surface, meaning "big figures don’t act, but if someone below acts and it gets exposed, then just shrug it off and drink three cups as self-punishment."
In fact, if someone below seizes an opportunity, they’ll kill regardless because... unnoticed, unknown.
And these little demon bastards among them would very likely become Nanwu Sword Sect disciples’ training objects.
He was still near the Puppet Sect, in a safe zone.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
But if he fully enters Western Shu, perhaps... danger will come.
He doesn’t fear trouble now, but doesn’t want to get caught in this needless kill.
"Hidden in Jianghu, posing as a Jianghu person, peacefully crossing these five years, while figuring out a way to explore the Independent Cultivator Market outside and seeing if he can find another opportunity for further advancement" is his best choice.
Song Yan turned to look at the carriage.
In the carriage, Miss Qiu and the Princess Consort were still asleep, and "Fanatic Fans" hadn’t been used on them for a while...

chapters.title: Chapter 37. Entering Shu
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: 37. Entering Shu
The light of dawn pierced through the gap in the carriage curtains.
The morning breeze blew, moving the curtains, and the light moved along with it...
Miss Qiu was not considered a great beauty, and although the Princess Consort appeared youthful due to the Multi-tailed Fox Blood, she still showed traces of age in the corners of her eyes and her expression.
At this moment, the two women were already awake but lay quietly under the blankets, watching the light flickering on the wall of the carriage, their expressions complex.
Though Song Yan treated them well, the past few years had been like living in Hell for them.
On the mountain, Song Yan was their protective umbrella.
As long as they were Song Yan’s furnaces, they could stay safely in the Cave Mansion without encountering danger.
But now, they had left the Puppet Sect for several days.
At this moment, the relationship between Song Yan and them had changed. It was no longer "protective umbrella," but... "Prison Guard."
A guard watching over them, preventing them from obtaining freedom.
If they did not die within these five years, they would still have to follow him back into that hell after five years.
As for emotions, perhaps there were some.
But if you call this emotion "love" or "romance," it’s the biggest joke!
The Puppet Sect was the root cause of their family’s ruin!
As for Song Yan, he was the direct murderer of Prince Zhen Nan.
Where’s the "love"?
It was nothing more than being lost in a drunken dream, helplessness, indulgence in desire, a choice of escaping reality.
And just at that moment, the curtain lifted slightly, revealing a young man’s face, and the two women immediately adjusted their expressions.
Miss Qiu smiled and called out, "Song Big Brother..."
The Princess Consort suppressed her myriad emotions and called out, "Song... Song Lang."
Song Yan said, "It’s bright now, let’s set off."
...
...
At the end of winter, small snowflakes fell.
After more than ten days...
The carriage stopped once more.
The surrounding mountains towered, imposing with their presence. They had arrived within the borders of the Western Shu realm.
Upon arrival, the Profound Qi was even more scarce.
Whereas on the periphery of South Bamboo Peak, with complete Cave Mansions and a monthly Elixir supply, it took five or six years to accumulate a hundred strands of Profound Qi to break through the Refining Profound Mirror;
But within a few days’ journey from the Puppet Sect, it would take over three hundred years to absorb a thousand strands of Profound Qi and break through the Profound Three Mirrors... yet in a place like this, attempting to break through forcefully would not be possible without a thousand or even several thousand years.
Even for a Profound Cultivator, dreaming of easily using magic in such a "barren land" is just a dream.
This is not a place for cultivation.
Here, it is a desert for cultivators and a domain for mortals.
Song Yan found a spot and lit a campfire, the three of them sat around it, chatting idly.
The Princess Consort suddenly asked, "Has Song Lang broken the mirror?"
After asking, she seemed to realize the question was inappropriate, so she gently added, "I’m worried the journey might be dangerous, if Song Lang hasn’t broken the mirror yet, you should be careful.
Even though the two Sects have reached a ceasefire agreement, between Sects, in certain aspects, it’s no different than between a Dynasty, saying one thing and doing another.
Previously, it was fine near the Puppet Sect, but now that we’re within the borders of the Western Shu, Lang Jun should be more cautious."
Song Yan slowly shook his head, showing regret, "I was close to breaking through the first layer of Refining Profound, but unfortunately encountered a Ghost Cultivator’s disturbance and a Fox Demon invasion, I had to leave the Sect."
Although he had broken through to the sixth layer of Refining Profound, he did not plan to brag about it to everyone he met.
Miss Qiu said, "Then let’s avoid the main roads, let’s..."
Song Yan raised his hand and said, "The byways have many bandits, and the treacherous hills and waters, if there are many people, my two fists can’t fight against four hands, it’s difficult to deal with them. It’s better to take the main road."
With that, he looked at the Princess Consort and asked, "Xuerou, you mentioned your family was in Western Shu’s Mountain Mist City, is it reliable to go there now?"
The Princess Consort nodded heavily and said, "When I was the Princess Consort of Prince Zhen Nan, to guard against war, I had managed Mountain Mist City in advance, there are many of my confidants there...
It’s only been a little over three years, I’m sure as long as those people are still alive, they will definitely recognize me. We will be able to find peace there."
The air suddenly quieted down.
The Princess Consort’s lips moved slightly, she wanted to say "Song Lang, why not give me some more Fanatic Fans," but swallowed the words.
Song Yan seemed not to notice this small gesture, and added, "You mentioned your grandfather once found a Spirit Flower Atlas for you somewhere, allowing you to recognize the Fire-Breath Pepper and even know how to cultivate it. Could there be an Independent Cultivator Market near Mountain Mist City?"
The Princess Consort shook her head and said, "To be honest, Song Lang, back when I was at Prince Zhen Nan Mansion, we wanted to attract more Loose Cultivators for service, so we searched everywhere, but could not find any...
My grandfather has long passed away, it is difficult to ask him again."
Song Yan looked at Qiu Lianyue and asked, "Once we reach Mountain Mist City, what do you plan to do, Lianyue?"
Qiu Lianyue replied, "I am merely a humble merchant girl, I will follow Song Big Brother and Sister Cao."
The snow fell quietly.
The area illuminated by the campfire grew smaller.
"Let’s get in the carriage to sleep, it will still take some time to reach Mountain Mist, and we need to inquire about the road when we reach the next town."
"No worries, Song Lang, I recognize all the roads here."
The Princess Consort finished speaking, yawned, and got up to enter the carriage, finding a blanket to cover herself.
Miss Qiu followed her and lay down by her side.
Soon, the two women heard footsteps on the driver’s seat.
It was Song Yan getting on the carriage.
Miss Qiu was alright, just suddenly a bit nervous.
The Princess Consort, however, clenched her left arm with her right hand’s five fingers, her nails digging in deeply, a manifestation of fear, anger, excitement, and countless complex emotions mingled together.
As the Fanatic Fans gradually lost their effect, she felt that Song Yan getting into the bed again, forcefully spreading her legs for intimacy, was tantamount to assault.
Fortunately, there were only a few sounds from the driver’s seat before it fell silent again.
Song Yan leaned against the wall of the carriage, gazing upwards into the falling snowflakes, slowly drifting into a dreamland.
Now that he had entered the sixth layer of Refining Profound, his perception range had expanded significantly, and even in his dreams, he could never let petty people approach.
...
...
Several more days passed.
The carriage continued its journey, moving through the wilderness of the Western Shu Kingdom.
Due to Song Yan’s perception abilities, even though far away, he could sense the circumstances around them, so they did not encounter any danger.
According to the Princess Consort, it’s no more than a two-day journey from here to Mountain Mist City.
This day, at noon.
The carriage was moving as usual when Song Yan suddenly perked up his ears because he vaguely caught the words "Prince Zhen Nan."
He slowed the carriage, quickly focused his perception, and followed the sound.
The voices became clearer, coming from a small valley beside a mountain path.
From the valley came the uniform sounds of swords and spears clashing, along with the clatter of armor, clearly indicating a troop of elite soldiers in training.
Amidst the sounds of training, several people were discussing something.
"The rebels have established the Jin Dynasty, and now forced to move the capital southward. With the King of Shu’s support, this might be our chance to reclaim the throne."
"Is this really orchestrated by His Majesty?
Has His Majesty gone to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country?"
"My Cao Family and the Mountain and Sea Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Demonic Fox lineage have an intertwined relationship." The man responded flatly, offering no further explanation, then continued, "Grand General, what do you think?"
The man addressed as Grand General paused and said, "My father, Prince Zhen Nan, was long ago captured by the rebels and offered to the Puppet Demon Sect.
I hate those rebels, wishing I could devour their flesh and blood, so of course I have no objections! But we must wait for the right time!
Now that Mr. Qiu is controlling the merchant routes, we must also use this to gather external information."
"Naturally, Mr. Qiu’s wife is dead, and his little daughter is missing... What’s left now is this hatred for revenge!"
After that, the group continued to conspire about the details of counterattacking the Jin Dynasty.
Song Yan listened silently for a while, somewhat surprised.
From the conversation, he naturally discerned that the "Grand General" was the Crown Prince of Prince Zhen Nan.
Cao Xuerou had told him her son was valiant and formidable.
As for "Mr. Qiu," it seemed to relate to Qiu Lianyue, if not her father, then a relative.
Song Yan initially planned to drop the two women off in Mountain Mist City before leaving, but now there seemed to be a new option.
The title "Princess Consort" was too conspicuous; once they reached Mountain Mist, others would undoubtedly know a little demon brat had arrived with them.
Then, he would likely face countless troubles.
As for his feelings for the two women?
Apart from pity, it was probably just the desire during moments of pleasure.
Now that he could set them free and leave peacefully himself, it was a win-win, and Song Yan was happy to do it.
...
...
A quarter of an hour later.
"Halt!"
A soldier sternly shouted towards the direction of the valley.
With his shout, many bowmen drew their bows, aiming at the carriage.
Seated in the driver’s seat was a young lady.
The young lady shouted, "I am the Princess Consort of Prince Zhen Nan! Who dares act presumptuously!"
The soldier was taken aback by her words. Though skeptical, he dared not make a decision on his own, just as... the person who could decide was indeed here today.
He slightly restrained his expectations, cautiously saying, "Stop the carriage. If you truly are the Princess Consort, someone will recognize you, please wait!"
Cao Xuerou stopped the carriage.
...
...
A moment later...
A handsome and valiant man, clad in silver armor, hurried over from afar. Seeing the lady on the driver’s seat, tears fell from his tiger-like eyes, and his strong body trembled.
"Mother... Mother!!"
The dignified Grand General utterly lost composure, rushing forward in excitement.
Shortly after, the second prince of Great Wei led a group from behind.
When the curtain of the carriage was lifted, among the crowd was an elder who couldn’t help but lose his composure.
"Lianyue?!"
Little Miss Qiu looked at the elder as if in a dream, calling out, "Father?"
"Lianyue!"Google seaʀᴄh ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Father!"
The father and daughter hugged and wept, then began recounting the events of the past years.
...
...
Another moment later.
The Grand General, supporting his mother, suddenly spoke coldly, "Mother Consort says that little demon brat heard the commotion here and specifically sent you over?"
Cao Xuerou nodded.
The Grand General wore a fierce expression, a murderous intent rising.
Cao Xuerou hurriedly said, "He’s already gone far, don’t pursue him."
The Grand General coldly replied, "The carriage is here, and there are only a few mountain paths around, how far could he go?"
Cao Xuerou said with a hint of anger, "Don’t pursue!"
Her feelings for Song Yan were complex, but at least... she didn’t want him to die, nor did she want him to get into trouble for setting them free.
Moreover, outside, the wife of Prince Zhen Nan wasn’t just a vase; even after years, she still wielded quite the influence.
The Grand General, helplessly, could only say, "Listen to mother."
However, he also knew that it was difficult for a Cultivator to hide among mortals because the government had pass documents and other forms of identification that could be checked.
The only hope was to enter the Jianghu.
The Jianghu and the court, each governed themselves, neither could suppress the other.
Jianghu matters are beyond the court’s control.
However, a Cultivator couldn’t possibly have time to train in martial arts.
That Demon Sect disciple entering the Jianghu would have no skills beyond some brute strength from his body!
The people of Jianghu aren’t foolish, they would quickly deduce his identity.
How could he possibly stay hidden?

chapters.title: Chapter 38. Temporary Retreat to Jianghu
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: 38. Temporary Retreat to Jianghu
Three months later...
Western Shu, Celestial Cloud City...
In the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, the Solitary Bamboo Gang and the Cyan Robe Tower are the two major gangs in the Jianghu across the three cities and twenty-six counties, both headquartered in Celestial Cloud City.
As the saying goes, "Two tigers cannot share one mountain," these two gangs naturally have many conflicts.
It’s impossible for anyone to stop these two gangs from fighting each other.
Not even the government!
Just like when tigers fight, whoever intervenes will only end up dead for nothing.
Yet at this moment, the scheduled battle between the two major gangs has come to an unexpected halt.
Everyone looks in disbelief at that spot.
"Miss... Miss... Are you alright?"
A wild man with disheveled hair and a face full of stubble is holding the leader of Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower for today—Hua Linglong.
Hua Linglong holds a prestigious position in the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower. Perhaps her personal power isn’t strong, but the group of old subordinates left by her late father all belong to her faction.
Moreover, she is quite famous in the Jianghu as a beautiful lady, known as the "Snow Jade Peony."
The phrase "Celestial Cloud Mountain City, Ghostly Cyan Robe, Snow Jade Peony" is enough to stir the hearts of all men in this area.
Hua Linglong likes to wear white clothes, white skirts, and white socks, her demeanor pure and pitiful, with extremely elegant speech, always evoking a strong protective instinct in others.
No one is willing to kill such a woman.
But in today’s battle, the Solitary Bamboo Gang has set up a trap to kill Hua Linglong.
Because the Solitary Bamboo Gang discovered that Hua Linglong is not only beautiful but also one of the Core Figures of the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower.
If she were killed, then... the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower could very likely fall into chaos.
However, just as two top experts of the Solitary Bamboo Gang, along with an inside man they painstakingly bribed, launched a combined attack to kill Hua Linglong, a wild man suddenly emerged from the woods nearby.
This wild man moved in bizarre ways, with strange postures, yet he skillfully defused the deadly strike against Hua Linglong and held her by the waist, retreating backward.
At this moment...
Outside the city, the winter snow has melted, and the early spring rain from last night knocked down a lot of peach blossoms.
With a gust of wind, the petals began to flutter.
The Solitary Bamboo Gang and the inside man refused to stop, quickly closing in, with a saber, a sword, and an axe all continuing toward Hua Linglong.
The wild man placed Hua Linglong aside, bowing his head to search for something.
Having narrowly escaped death, Hua Linglong, still in shock, quickly untied her belt, pushed it forward, and said, "Use mine!"
The wild man did not refuse, directly taking the sword, drawing it.
The blade emerged an inch, glistening coldly, and when fully drawn, shone bright.
In the brightness, the wild man struck someone with one slash, and after three dances of the blade, all three of the top experts in Jianghu lay injured on the ground, their eyes wide with shock as they looked at the wild man.
Hua Linglong’s eyes also shone brightly.
She could see that the wild man’s swordsmanship was terrifyingly powerful, the peak of technique, naturally seamless.
The wild man, disheveled and dirty, yet the more she looked, the happier she became.
Because after those three people fell, the Solitary Bamboo Gang advanced again, but this wild man stood in front of her, and no matter who... could not bypass this wild man to harm her.
Initially, she suspected that this wild man might be a Loose Cultivator, but after a few slashes, she completely dismissed that possibility.
No cultivator could possibly have such formidable martial arts mastery.
Her eyes burned with passion.
That was the fire of ambition...
Heaven had sent this wild man to her, and she would definitely seize this opportunity well.
Amidst the flashing blades and swords, she slowly touched a Jade Bottle hidden in her bosom.
The bottle contained a mysterious poison in the Jianghu—"Blood-Burning Divine Water".
This "Blood-Burning Divine Water" is colorless and tasteless, allowing those who practice martial arts and body forging to achieve more with less, but if not taken with an antidote monthly, the blood burns itself, leading to a painful death.
"Blood-Burning Divine Water" was originally a secret poison from Cold Water Manor...
It’s said that the old master of the manor discovered a recipe by chance in his early years and concocted it.
However, although Cold Water Manor possessed this poison, they rarely used it, living a low-profile life in the mountains and forests.
But at the beginning of last year, the manor was suddenly massacred, men and women, old and young, not even chickens and dogs were spared. And the secret poison disappeared without a trace; some said Cold Water Manor never had the poison, and it was all just a rumor.
But the one who spread the rumor was Hua Linglong.
The one who massacred Cold Water Manor was also Hua Linglong.
