The one who killed all those in the know was Hua Linglong.
In today’s Jianghu, no one knows she possesses the "Blood-Burning Divine Water."
It is precisely by relying on this divine water that she has been able to "win over" a group of elders in the tower.
This young woman, who appears as pure and immaculate as icy jade, actually harbors incredibly ruthless intentions.
At this moment, she suppresses the urge to retch within her, looking all the more tenderly at the savage.
Males are always attracted to beautiful females, and this savage is undoubtedly drawn to her.
Then... she will use her allure to bring this savage back, feed him the "Blood-Burning Divine Water," and have him completely under her control.
Her exquisite eyes glance at the dirty fingerprints on the white sash at her waist, which prompts another wave of nausea, yet she carefully conceals her disdain, steadily playing the role of a "protected person."
Males like to display themselves in front of beautiful females.
Then... she must demonstrate her "protected" demeanor well.
...
...
Three days later.
Celestial Cloud City was quite shaken as word spread in Jianghu of a savage’s sudden emergence, exhibiting extraordinary martial arts, and then... being taken away by the "Snow Jade Peony" Hua Linglong.
At this moment, a beautiful woman dressed in pure white, immaculate as ever, was calmly seated at the table, smiling warmly as she pushed a glazed cup over, resting her chin in her hand while softly saying, "Taste my handiwork."
Seated across from her was the savage from three days prior.
Except the savage was now clad in a brocade robe, his hair tied up, revealing rough skin and a few scars on his cheeks, which hinted at a certain ferocity amidst his otherwise unremarkable appearance.
The savage was none other than Song Yan.
Song Yan had learned various martial arts in Jianghu, which naturally included the Disguise Technique.
Cultivators identify people by their aura, so once the Qi Concealment Technique is used, one can avoid detection.
Additionally... people look at faces.
Song Yan used the simplest method to change his face.
Even if it were Miss Qiu or the Princess Consort face-to-face, they wouldn’t recognize him.
Since the day he bade farewell to the two women, he had already planned his course.
Celestial Cloud City is practically at the edge of Western Shu; the Profound Qi here is in a "barren area within a barren area," with few cultivators coming here.
Poor mountains and rivers produce troublesome people, and even the King of Shu cannot control this place.
Because... this is entirely Jianghu.
He needs to hide in Jianghu, needs eyes and ears, and also requires a certain amount of power, so after observing the surroundings of Celestial Cloud City several times, he targeted "Hua Linglong" as his point of entry.
Why Hua Linglong?
Firstly, she lost her father the previous year, her situation is difficult, and she was in need of help;
Secondly, she is quite capable, even though her father is gone, she still holds a place in the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, indicating she is a clever and competent woman who can assist him;
Thirdly, Hua Linglong is a beautiful woman, her appearance even reminds Song Yan of those pure, white-clad images like "Xiao Long Nu," and her shrewdness in handling matters makes him think of "Huang Rong."
Song Yan, in past and present lifetimes, had never seriously fallen in love, and as a transmigrator, he harbored a dream of chivalry in his heart.
Immortal couples, roaming Jianghu together.
With mutual understanding, there is no deceit between them.
"In five years, hide in Jianghu, quietly awaiting the ultimate success or failure of the Puppet Sect," is this not an opportunity for him to fulfill this small dream and make up for regrets?
The deeper he got into Jianghu, the less likely anyone would suspect him of being a cultivator.
Therefore, he initially came with a bit of "infatuation"...
But at this moment... he looked at the glazed cup that was pushed toward him.
The chicken soup smelled delicious, with fresh mushrooms accompanying the chicken wings, and the meat was stewed to tenderness, emitting an enticing aroma.
Yet, being at the Sixth Layer of Refining Profound, Song Yan could distinctly smell... another scent amidst the fragrance, a scent that would slightly draw the qi blood upon whiffing.
Jianghu’s "colorless and tasteless" could not fool him.
Whether it’s poison, he could discern that in a sniff.
Raising his eyes again to look at the face opposite him, that charming face was waiting expectantly for him.
Suddenly, Song Yan let out a heavy sigh.
"What’s wrong?" Hua Linglong asked.Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
When asking, her red lips parted slightly, revealing an appropriately placed expression of surprise and disappointment, a look that would make a man unable to resist immediately doing what she asked.
Song Yan flipped his palm and took out a bottle of Fanatic Fans from his storage ring, tilting it towards her, swiftly delivering it to her open red lips.
With a tilt, a turn, the powder entered her mouth.
In the Cultivation Realm, Song Yan might have been timid, but in Jianghu, couldn’t he strike a hard blow?

chapters.title: Chapter 39. Legend
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: 39. Legend
Hua Linglong, in order to lure this wild man into drinking poison, deliberately brought him into her boudoir and dismissed everyone else to create an illusion of "I am also infatuated with you".
At that moment, the situation suddenly changed.
Clearly, she was the one who poisoned, yet the wild man across from her directly took out some unknown bottle and poured powder into her mouth.
Hua Linglong’s pretty face immediately tightened, she wanted to retreat swiftly and call for help outside.
However, just as she was about to move, that wild man ghostly appeared behind her, gently placed his palm on her celestial cover, and said, "Don’t move."
Knowing she couldn’t escape, Hua Linglong instead calmed down.
She took a deep breath, her snow-white broad sleeves fluttering, overlapping on her powerful thighs, and calmly praised, "Good scheme!
So you’re from the Solitary Bamboo Gang. Your real purpose is not to kill me, but to control me.
The tragic deaths of those three were just to pave the way for you to approach me and attack me, right?"
Song Yan:...
"Yes, yes, you are right."
Suddenly, Hua Linglong’s delicate eyebrows furrowed; she was born with a pure, clean, and pitiful appearance. Not possessing the fullness and ripeness of a beautiful woman, nor the youthful exuberance of a little girl, yet she had a certain charm similar to a "kept high-positioned green tea fox spirit."
Her hair, like clouds, with an ancient wooden hairpin, slanted inserted, her pure melon-seed face features were all exquisite, neck snow-white, dressed flawlessly, with no hint of seductive exposure. She sat quietly there, as though bringing a bit of Zen to the boudoir.
In Jianghu, no one knew her heart was ruthless, and certainly, no one knew she slaughtered the entire family of Cold Water Manor, who had long stayed away from worldly affairs, for the Blood-Burning Divine Water.
At that moment, the effect of "Fanatic Fans" seemed to be rapidly taking hold.
Hua Linglong also noticed the acceleration of her heartbeat, and springs of water began to ripple in her eyes. She mused briefly and said coldly, "Quite the excellent love drug, acts quickly.
Before long, I expect to completely lose consciousness.
Once I awaken, I should have lost myself to you.
However, I, Hua Linglong, am not an ordinary woman. Even if you take my body, you want to manipulate me, to control me, that’s impossible."
As she spoke, she gradually tightened her legs, creating some wrinkles in the snow-white skirt as if a valley nestled between two rounded hills.
She raised her pretty face, her cheeks blushed as if intoxicated, and even the toes within the embroidered shoes were tensely strained, showing she was exerting strength to resist.
Yet, though Hua Linglong was a "little BOSS level" presence in Jianghu, how could she withstand such a cultivator-configured drug?
In just a few breaths, she was utterly consumed, exhaling hot air from her throat, panting rapidly, "Darling, don’t wait... whatever you wish to do, I will help you, come, take this red pill from my maiden heart."
Song Yan bent over, picked her up horizontally, and threw her onto the bed.
Hua Linglong’s expression was already incredibly bewildered, her hips touched the soft bed, impatiently shed her embroidered shoes, her legs like long whips wanting to entwine the figure in front.
She was completely lost in reason, submerged in desire.
...
...
A long time passed...
Hua Linglong opened her eyes.
The bed was a mess, but... there was no mixed scent of a man, it was only her own mess.
In the silent room, the "wild man" was sitting at the table, drinking the chicken soup she previously stewed, the one laced with "Blood-Burning Divine Water".
The "wild man" was drinking while drawing in chilly breaths, yet his expression was joyful as if the soup contained "chili peppers".
Chili can be spicy, but those who enjoy it find it savory.
"Excellent craft." Song Yan "sizzled" as he inhaled the cool air.
Refining Profound Sixth Layer physique was immensely strong, such a poison that could kill ordinary martial artists was merely a "special flavor" for him.
Hua Linglong felt complex emotions, speechless, "You mean you didn’t know the soup was poisoned?
Then... who is controlling whom, between you and me now?"
"No one controls anyone." Song Yan said. "I just hope the young lady can temporarily be infatuated with me, sincerely towards me. Afterward, everything leaves no trace."
Upon hearing this, Hua Linglong felt even more complex, "You knew it was poisoned yet drank it? Are you mad?"
Song Yan replied, "I am a wild man, but also need a name. You took me as a sworn brother, gave me the name Hua Rong."
Hua Linglong bewilderedly said, "You’re not from the Solitary Bamboo Gang?"
"No."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Then... you must be from the Flying Swallow Quick Sword Sect.
Haha, have you finally realized the culprit behind the scenes is me?"
"Ah... you’re rather capable." Song Yan was slightly surprised, yet denied, "No."
"Could it be you have a connection with Cold Water Manor." Hua Linglong showed contemplation, then sudden realization, "This can explain why you can easily recognize Blood-Burning Divine Water and dare to drink it because... you have the antidote.
And you gave me a love potion without touching me, simply because you loathe me from the bottom of your heart, you don’t want to touch a demoness who slaughtered Cold Water Manor.
But you hope through harsher means, to let me live in eternal pain, worse than death. My suffering will bring the greatest pleasure to your revenge.
Am I right?"
Song Yan was dumbfounded, but upon reflection, felt the other’s words surprisingly held some truth.
He couldn’t help but laugh, "This soup can stir Qi Blood, can cause sweating, that thing called Blood-Burning Divine Water?"
Hua Linglong:...
She suddenly sat up and said: "You are a cultivator!"
But immediately, she continued, "Impossible! You cannot be a cultivator!
Cultivators only refine their own techniques, which already exhausts their time and energy. It’s absolutely impossible for them to cultivate the Martial Dao, and furthermore to such a masterful level!
Besides... there’s no Profound Qi around Celestial Cloud City, so it’s impossible for a cultivator to come here!
You must have consumed some Genius and Earth Treasures and received inheritance from some old monster to have this physique and such martial arts."
Song Yan gently nodded, as if acknowledging her words.
Hua Linglong looked at him with a complex expression. Although she clearly knew it was the effect of the medicine, she couldn’t help but feel deeply attracted to the man in front of her.
Yet this man did not take advantage of her at this vulnerable moment, which instead tempted her to take advantage of him under the cover of night, even if he looked ordinary, with scars on his face...
"Hua Rong... I understand, I’ll do as you said."
"I knew Miss Linglong was a smart person."
"However, my position in Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower is still unstable. Currently, I’m just one of the two major factions inside the tower. The tower leader is old and wants us to decide strength and weakness through martial competition. Even subordinates can fight, and the final winner will be the tower leader..."
...
...
One month later.
The Silver Waterfall flowed straight down, trickling afar, gradually returning to tranquility.
Spring waters buoyed peach blossoms, merging into a grand lake shining like gold under the sky.
By the lakeside, there was silence, no sound of swords clashing, yet a battle that shocked the Martial World had already ended.
One side was the first swordsman of Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower - "Lion King" Li Kuangzhan.
The other side was the recently acknowledged sworn brother of "Snow Jade Peony" from Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower - Hua Rong.
The two represented their loyal elder brothers in a duel by the Silver Waterfall Lake outside of Chuyun City.
The purpose - the position of the tower leader.
If Li Kuangzhan wins, his elder brother becomes the tower leader.
If Hua Rong wins, his sworn sister Hua Linglong becomes the tower leader.
This great battle attracted the attention of nearly all the Martial World people nearby, with thousands watching from the outskirts.
To all, this was bound to be a fierce, even brutal, unprecedented battle.
However...
This duel ended without even clashing swords.
"Hua Rong’s" saber, with an unusual, lightning-fast, inconceivable posture, broke through Li Kuangzhan’s sword stance without a collision, then placed on his neck when his sword was still three to four inches away.
Martial Artists in the Martial World, unlike cultivators, emphasize "fast is the key to breakthrough."
What is fast?
Distance divided by speed.
The shorter the distance and the faster the speed, then... the shorter the time.
In fact, the speed of top saber and sword masters is almost the same; what remains is the distance.
Now, "Hua Rong’s" saber was incredibly three to four inches faster than Li Kuangzhan’s, showing how eerily masterful his saber trajectory was!
At this moment, even Li Kuangzhan was left stunned, as if still absorbed in the opponent’s moves, and it took him a long time to murmur: "The Sword Drawing Skill of Purple Thunder Saber, the Jianghu Saber Technique...
The Slaughter Finger of Blood Hand Sect transformed from finger to saber...
Also, the flavor of Wind Willow Twelve Swords, though those twelve swords have already been reduced to some movement within the single saber, bringing agility to its pinnacle...
No, also the Autumn Remnant Spear of Lonely Mountain Guest, the Great Hand Seal of South Mountain Elder...
And more essence blended within...
Impossible, impossible, absolutely impossible! You...
In this world...
You...
Absolutely no one in this world can cultivate martial arts to this degree and still integrate them!
Impossible! Impossible!!"
Li Kuangzhan was a martial arts fanatic; otherwise, he couldn’t have become the top martial master in Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower.
At this moment, with experience, he discerned the terrifying techniques contained within his opponent’s seemingly ordinary single saber.
Any one of these techniques alone could take a Martial Dao genius over ten years to comprehend, yet this person not only mastered them all but also integrated them, enhancing each martial art beyond its original level!
Li Kuangzhan suddenly dropped his sword, raised his arms, clawed at his head with his ten fingers, tore at his hair, lost focus in his eyes, muttering, "Impossible, impossible!! Absolutely impossible!"
Li Kuangzhan turned and ran, shouting "Absolutely impossible" like a madman while quickly jumping into the nearby Silver Waterfall Lake.
The many Martial Artists were all in uproar.
In Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, a middle-aged man sighed deeply, then stepped out, saluted "Hua Rong" with praise, "Master Hua, truly impressive skills," then respectfully approached Hua Linglong, saying, "Tower Leader Hua."
Hua Linglong smiled: "From now on, we work hand in hand to dominate the Lone Bamboo Gang and expand our influence together."

chapters.title: Chapter 40. Unification
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: 40. Unification
Western Shu, Celestial Cloud Mountain City was originally a lawless land, a paradise for the people of the Jianghu.
There has always been a saying here, "Cloud City is treacherous, one lion and three wolves."
The "one lion" refers to "Lion King" Li Kuangzhan.
And the "three wolves" refer to the three strongmen of the Solitary Bamboo Gang.
But after the battle at Silver Waterfall Lake, the saying "Cloud City is treacherous, one lion and three wolves" suddenly changed to "Cloud City is treacherous, one lion, three wolves, and without the Divine Dragon, who can contest?"
The "Divine Dragon" is the nickname the people of the Jianghu gave to Song Yan.
Song Yan felt it was quite exaggerated.
However, when in Rome, it’s all just for show...
...
...
The new master of the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, Hua Linglong, in order to consolidate her prestige, redirect internal conflicts, eliminate dissidents, and settle her confidants, launched an attack on the Solitary Bamboo Gang as soon as she took power.
Her reliance was naturally her sworn brother "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong.
"Divine Dragon" Hua Rong did not disappoint this pure-looking yet ambitious woman.
No matter what terrifying defenses the Solitary Bamboo Gang set up, as long as he appeared, he could break through with his superb martial arts.
However, two fists were eventually no match for four hands, and a few times, the Solitary Bamboo Gang laid heavy ambushes that caused the "Divine Dragon" some trouble, almost costing him his life once.
But this did not diminish the "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong’s reputation; instead, it made the people of Jianghu admire him even more.
Because those few ambushes by the Solitary Bamboo Gang were full force efforts.
The time they nearly killed the "Divine Dragon," the Solitary Bamboo Gang even called back their elders who were retired outside. Yet despite this, "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong still fought his way out of the encirclement with only minor injuries.
...
...
Time flew by, and it was already winter.
It was almost a year since Song Yan left the Puppet Sect.
The Solitary Bamboo Gang had been beaten back to only the last remaining county, a county named after the Solitary Bamboo Gang itself — Guzhu County.
Snow filled the sky, the mountains and rivers were one vast expanse of white.
A luxurious palanquin was by the river, across the river facing the distant Guzhu County.
In the palanquin, a tender hand lifted the curtain, revealing a pretty and pure, yet slightly pale face in the light, her gaze fixed on the man beside the palanquin, a gaze full of complexity, yet with a hint of subtle warmth.
"Come inside, it’s cold outside."
Hua Linglong said.
By now, she was close to completely unifying the Jianghu.
The ruler of the Jianghu over three cities and twenty-six counties was essentially the local tyrant, and even the City Lord sent by the King of Shu had to listen to her.
Song Yan shook his head, looking towards the east.
Across the river to the east was Guzhu County, but it was also the direction of the Puppet Sect.
His first step was to blend into the Jianghu;
The second step was to investigate, especially the information on the Puppet Sect and Nanwu Sword Sect; and to search for the "Independent Cultivator Market mentioned by the Princess Consort."
He firmly believed that the "Independent Cultivator Market" existed, because Hua Linglong had told him about the "Blood-Burning Divine Water."
The "Blood-Burning Divine Water," a strange poison of the Jianghu, was a prescription found by an old man from Cold Water Manor from God knows where, which sounded similar in some ways to the "Spirit Flower Manual found by the Princess Consort’s grandfather."
Besides, the Princess Consort’s grandfather found the Spirit Flower Manual about forty years ago.
The old man from Cold Water Manor only emerged about ten years ago.
A few years ago, the Princess Consort searched everywhere near Mountain Mist City for the Immortal Market but found no news, yet Mountain Mist City is still quite a distance from Celestial Cloud City.
Additionally, at the beginning of last year, when Hua Linglong sent people to annihilate Cold Water Manor, someone in the manor shouted, "I am willing to trade an immortal secret for my life," yet the killers sent were not interested in information about cultivators and slaughtered the person with one blow.
This intelligence naturally allowed Song Yan to deduce that there is a cultivator market in Western Shu, but this market is mobile, near Mountain Mist City forty years ago, and now near Celestial Cloud City.
As for why a place like Western Shu, devoid of Profound Qi, has such a market, and why it moves, he was quite curious.
But these questions he would leave for "phase two" of his plan to resolve.
Song Yan was quite eager to take another step forward, so he had an inexplicable obsession with these "wild independent cultivator markets."
He knew that only in such places could he truly find what he needed, rather than in markets of large forces, where there were "technology blockades" everywhere.
Having practiced Cultivating Profound for so long, he also understood that "Cultivating Profound" was essentially "breaking through the human body, defying the heavens and changing fate."
This step necessarily required external support.
Such as the "Skin-Stripping Ointment" and "Flame Marrow Pill."
He was directly using Life Span Calculation, so he couldn’t feel the "skin-stripping" pain of applying the "Skin-Stripping Ointment" nor experience the bone-burning agony of swallowing the "Flame Marrow Pill."
It is precisely these external things that help ordinary human bodies break limits, step by step, in the practice of Refining Profound, gradually rising, allowing Profound Qi of heaven and earth to fill a body where it was originally impossible to exist.
Without these external things, even in ten thousand years or a hundred thousand years, it would be impossible to break through unless... you had already evolved from a "human" into "another species."
Just as Song Yan was lost in thought, a playful voice came from the palanquin.
"Hua Rong!"
"Hmm?"
"Get in!"
"Hmm?"
"I order you to get on the palanquin!"
The voice, filled with anger, added softly, "It’s quite cold outside."
Silence ensued in the air for a moment.
The four strong men carrying the palanquin, along with the experts from the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower following nearby, all pretended as if they neither saw nor heard anything, their eyes looking downward, minds wandering elsewhere.
Song Yan was also momentarily stunned, but he still got onto the palanquin and sat next to Hua Linglong.
He was a bit puzzled. He seemed not to have used the Fanatic Fans powder this year.
The key thing about "Fanatic Fans" is that once its effect wears off, the best outcome is "friends turn into strangers."
But he hoped to turn the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower into his own private garden, becoming his eyes and ears outside, so... he tried to stop using Fanatic Fans once he felt everything was under control.
Logically speaking, the drug’s effect should have nearly worn off by now.
Hua Linglong should have almost awakened by now.
He glanced sideways. The pure and charming mistress of the Flower Tower, dressed in a dark golden robe, sat upright, half-leaning against the window, pondering something, seemingly indifferent to him.
Soon after, quite a few scouts began to appear outside, each coming to report intelligence concerning Guzhu County.
The experts of the Cyan Robe Tower were all eager to get ready to accomplish this "final battle to unify the Jianghu."
...
...
"Outrageous, outrageous!"
"The foundation of our Solitary Bamboo Gang cannot be destroyed by my hand!"
In the county, a strong and imposing man was pacing back and forth, and at this time a disciple reported from outside, "Leader, they’re here!"
The leader of the Solitary Bamboo Gang showed some hesitation but quickly made a decision, saying, "Invite him in!"
Moments later, a yellow-robed man bearing a sword swept in from outside, landed in the hall, and bowed with a smile, "Has the leader made a decision?"
The yellow-robed man immediately added, "Leader, you know that I am originally a consecrated of the Great Wei, a mere loose cultivator, unable to break through, just wanting to enjoy some peace. I’m no threat to you."
The leader of the Solitary Bamboo Gang hurriedly said, "Elder Huang, you speak too severely. I’ve made up my mind.
If you can help me kill the dragon and the lion of the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, once I reclaim the three cities and twenty-six counties, I will definitely offer half to Elder Huang."
The yellow-robed man said, "Why not just let me personally kill Hua Linglong?"
The leader of the Solitary Bamboo Gang asked, "How much Profound Jade does Elder Huang have left?"
The yellow-robed man replied, "None."
"Then in this land devoid of Profound Qi, how many times can Elder Huang still use his magic?" The leader of the Solitary Bamboo Gang said, "Moreover, Jianghu has its own rules. Using a cultivator’s hand to seize power, you won’t be able to suppress the people below.
Where Hua Linglong is, there must be countless experts. Whether Elder Huang can prevail upon entering is one issue; even if you win, you might not come out unscathed. Even if you retreat, others will know our Solitary Bamboo Gang invited a cultivator.
But the dragon and the lion are different. They must have moments when they are alone outside. When the time comes... please act, Elder Huang."
The yellow-robed man nodded.
The leader of the Solitary Bamboo Gang said, "That Divine Dragon Hua Rong, his martial arts mastery is terrifying. Elder Huang, please be careful."
The yellow-robed man couldn’t help but laugh, stroking his beard arrogantly, he said, "It’s just a matter of one sword stroke."
...
...
Several days later...
Winter night.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Impossible... no... impossible..."
The yellow-robed man stared in horror at the man in front of him, his legs kicking frantically, but that man’s big hand clamped around his neck like an iron hoop, lifting him half into the air.
Near Celestial Cloud City, there is hardly any Profound Qi, so Song Yan generally doesn’t use magic here.
But today, he inexplicably encountered an assassination attempt by a loose cultivator.
At this moment, his left hand holding the yellow-robed man, his right hand casually pointing, Evil Qi surged from his finger, striking the yellow-robed man’s forehead, swirling and expanding within, transforming into a terrifying ghastly ghost mouth, plunging deeper inside.
The ghost mouth swallowed, directly devouring the bit of Primordial Spirit in the yellow-robed man’s forehead, only to spit it back out moments later.
However, the regurgitated Primordial Spirit was already tainted with Evil Qi.
This was an evolution of "Soul-Searching Skill," forming the "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique."
This technique not only allows for a more detailed search of the opponent’s memories but can also directly swallow their soul, then spew it out mixed with Evil Qi, returning it to the original body, turning it into an obedient killing machine devoid of much thought but overflowing with rage and madness.
Smack!
Song Yan released his hand.
The yellow-robed man fell to the ground, his eyes red, filled with fury as he crazily and irrationally glared around.
Song Yan pondered over the memories he had just seen, breathing out lightly.
A stray dog, just a lone loose cultivator...
Not a big trouble.
"Go, whoever sent you, go kill them, then cause chaos in the Solitary Bamboo Gang until you’re killed."
The yellow-robed man’s eyes brightened as if he had received a decree, promptly picking up his flying sword, turned, and headed toward Guzhu County.
...
...
The next day, while the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower was still discussing how to attack the Solitary Bamboo Gang, they received news that last night a loose cultivator caused havoc within the Solitary Bamboo Gang, leading to the tragic death of their leader and several top members. It was said... this loose cultivator was invited by the Solitary Bamboo Gang’s leader, only to inexplicably turn against them.

chapters.title: Chapter 41. You will revere him as divine
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: 41. You will revere him as divine
Late winter.
The Lone Bamboo Gang was completely annihilated, and the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower unified the area around Celestial Cloud City.
The "Tower Master" Hua Linglong’s prestige reached an unprecedented height, becoming the Crowned Queen.
Even the King of Shu specially sent an envoy with congratulatory gifts, and the surrounding Jianghu forces came to offer their congratulations.
Firecrackers exploded, splendid fireworks blossomed in the snowy night sky, and guests crowded Celestial Cloud City. The fluffy snow was compacted into hard, cold ice by the countless carriages going to and fro.
After midnight, Hua Linglong returned to the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower.
This tower had nine layers, with the Ninth Layer being the residence of the Tower Master, also the highest point in Celestial Cloud City.
The Eighth Layer, however, was a heavily mechanized restricted area with mechanisms that were endlessly variable and extremely dangerous. It was said that no one in Jianghu could pass through alive.
Unless a cultivator descended from the heavens, no one could directly attack and assassinate while the Tower Master held the Ninth Layer.
Yet at this moment on the Eighth Layer, by the side of the corridor, there sat a man in a profound robe on the windowsill, his legs dangling as he gazed distantly at the human world’s fireworks, watching the lanterns reflect off the white snow and gradually fade to darkness as the world sank into silence.
The man’s profile was cold, his eyes deep in thought, though no one knew what he was pondering.
When Hua Linglong walked to this spot, no one accompanied her, yet she wasn’t surprised to see the man here.
Everyone in Celestial Cloud City knew that the "sibling name" between Hua Linglong and "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong was false; the "lovers’ name" was true.
Therefore, "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong also knew all the mechanisms of the Eighth Layer and would not trigger them as he walked through.
"Finally unified... like a dream," Hua Linglong stood behind the man, "But the world knows we’re not siblings, tonight..."
Song Yan said, "If I’m not mistaken, the drug’s effects have long worn off."
"Of course it has."
"Oh?"
"I know you’re not an ordinary person, you approached me because you need me, you have your motives.Thɪs
So you need to strengthen our connection, only then will you trust me more.
And I too need to strengthen our connection, otherwise... even if you’re in front of me, you’ll remain elusive and might suddenly disappear anytime.
We both need to go a step further.
Certain things have to be done.
For the sake of mutual benefit."
A rustling sound came.
Song Yan turned his head, the red light from the unsnuffed lantern outside cast upon a full, vigorous body, a pure yet commanding face.
The robes of the "Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower Master," more unapproachable than hard ice, slipped to the ground, spreading around like dark leaves, and the elegant, slender legs stood like flower stems.
Flowers should be plucked while they bloom...
At midnight, the lanterns on the street finally went out.
Even Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower was plunged into darkness.
Song Yan turned, embracing the absolute protagonist of today’s events, the "Crowned Queen" who had received "congratulations from thousands of dynasties" in Celestial Cloud City, and stepped forward, avoiding all the mechanisms on the Eighth Layer.
The queen’s toes hooked the fallen robe, and feeling the man’s intense heat, she quickly rushed into the pavilion of the Ninth Layer.
The door swung open with a "snap", and with a "thud," the soft couch sank.
Night...
grew deeper.
Or perhaps it was just beginning.
...
...
A month later.
The cold winter had yet to pass.
Several fast horses came from afar, arriving at this border city of Shu Land.
The envoy of the King of Shu confidently reached the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, bringing along a proudly smiling envoy to visit the local Jianghu leader.
Hua Linglong sat with composure and elegance in an ancient root-carved chair, a quiet swordsman standing beside her, with four keen-eyed, veiled female warriors behind the swordsman.
Everyone in Celestial Cloud City believed that as long as these five were present, no one could assassinate Hua Linglong.
Because these five were the "One Dragon" and "Four Sparrows."
The "Four Sparrows" were four highly skilled female martial artists selected from the Three Cities and Twenty-Six Counties of Celestial Cloud. They replaced the original "One Dragon, One Lion, Three Wolves," and their role was not only as Hua Linglong’s guardians but they also secretly controlled the most powerful information system under the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower.
It was said that these "Four Sparrows" had also received guidance from "Divine Dragon" Hua Rong, achieving rapid progress in martial arts.
As for the "Divine Dragon," he was known by everyone far and wide in these parts.
The envoy of the King of Shu respectfully saluted Hua Linglong, then saluted Song Yan beside her, and proceeded to speak with a smile, "Tower Master Hua, allow me to introduce you to someone; this gentleman is from a loose cultivator family and he is here hoping you could provide some assistance."
Upon hearing "loose cultivator family," Hua Linglong immediately replied, "No need to be so formal. What assistance might you need?"
The envoy of the King of Shu stepped aside slightly, allowing another man to step forward. He offered a casual bow and said, "I am a member of a loose cultivator family, named Zhao Sisan.
Upon hearing that Tower Master Hua is the local leader of Jianghu, and Master Hua Rong is a man of extraordinary martial prowess, we hope that you two could help investigate if any strange people have appeared in the past year."
"Strange people?"
"Indeed, appearing in the recent year.
They might possess considerable brute strength, with a physique not likely to be weak.
And their behavior could be unsavory.
However, they might have arrived suddenly, but they’ve been extremely low-key, neither doing business nor mingling with Jianghu, yet they lack nothing in gold and silver and seem to just idly spend their days, waiting for something."
The man described meticulously, suddenly clapped his hands, and asked, "Have there been any disappearance cases? Especially... young, beautiful women or handsome young men vanishing."
Hua Linglong clapped her hands, and one of the "Four Sparrows" stepped forward.
Hua Linglong leaned down and whispered a few words to her, and the woman immediately took Zhao Sisan to the government office to check files and then to the tower to search through their records.
The envoy of the King of Shu did not dare to slack off and accompanied him all the way.
Song Yan squinted at Zhao Sisan, who was leaving in the distance.
As expected...
The so-called ceasefire agreement is bullshit.
What Loose Cultivator family, this is the envoy of the Nanwu Sword Sect, waiting for a year to kill the exiled disciples of the Demon Sect.
...
...
A few days later...
"Injustice, injustice." A man shouted loudly.
But soon, a basement was found in his home, and a girl who had been abused beyond recognition was brought out.
The evidence was clear, and the governmental officers stepped forward to handcuff him, but the man suddenly erupted with strange strength, and with a fierce rush, he knocked one officer flying.
The other officer stood frozen, and the man no longer cared, turning to rush out of the house, but as soon as he reached the door, he saw a sword coming straight at him.
The man hurriedly gathered his strength, a stream of Profound Qi shot out from his fingers, but only managed to slightly deflect the flying sword.
Swoosh!
The flying sword pierced into the man’s left shoulder, causing him to step back several paces and pinning him against the wall of the house.
The man looked at the flying sword and then at the Sword Control cultivator approaching, gritting his teeth, he said: "Nanwu Sword Sect! You treacherous scoundrels!"
The Sword Control cultivator frowned and said: "I am Zhao Sisan of the Loose Cultivator family, not of the Nanwu Sword Sect. Your Puppet Sect has done too much evil, and everyone gets to punish you. Pay with your life!"
Saying this, he formed a Sword Technique with his fingers, and with two swipes, the man’s head was severed from his body.
In the distance...from the sedan chair, Hua Linglong watched this display of cultivator techniques, somewhat secretly alarmed.
Song Yan was as well.
But Song Yan’s shock was not because of the man’s flying sword, but because...there was actually someone from the same sect hiding here.
...
...
More than ten days later.
A total of two Demon Sect seedlings were uncovered around the Three Cities and Twenty-Six Counties of Celestial Cloud City.
Both were very low-key, one was caught because a missing girl was found in the basement; the other because "living alone, doing nothing, yet having money, and when checked, got scared and fled at night, but was ambushed and exposed immediately."
...
...
After Zhao Sisan killed the two Demon Sect seedlings, he came with the envoy of the Shu Kingdom to bid farewell at the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower.
"Thank you Master Hua of Flower Tower for your cooperation," Zhao Sisan said, taking out a wooden box from his sleeve and handing it over, "Inside is a token of our Loose Cultivator family. If you encounter any problems in the future, you can have someone bring this token to us. If we can help, our family will do so once."
One of the "Four Sparrows" took the wooden box and was about to open it, but Zhao Sisan smiled and said: "This matter is confidential, please let Master Hua open it herself."
The Four Sparrow hurriedly handed it to Hua Linglong.
Hua Linglong slightly lifted the lid and saw a Muddy Jade token inside, inscribed with "Nanwu Sword Sect" on the top and "Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower Hua Linglong" on the bottom.
She was momentarily stunned, but then quickly understood, closing the lid swiftly, saying: "Thank you, Mr. Zhao."
Zhao Sisan smiled and said: "It’s just mutual assistance."
After speaking, he bowed again and said: "Then, Zhao will take his leave now."
"Take care, Mr. Zhao," Hua Linglong rose to see him off.
By the time they reached the door, a carriage was already waiting with an old man who appeared to be dozing, with his head lowered at the reins. He was Zhao Sisan’s own man.
Zhao Sisan walked over to the carriage but suddenly paused, taking a sharp breath, and turned his head abruptly, looking with a faint smile at the swordsman beside Hua Linglong, and said: "Although I cultivated Profound, I have seen many experts in the Jianghu, but these days I keep hearing the name of the undefeated Flower Divine Dragon in the Jianghu, I’m really quite curious..."
Hua Linglong was slightly taken aback, then quickly turned cold and said: "Mr. Zhao, my sworn brother is not of the Demon Sect."
Zhao Sisan lowered his gaze and thought for a moment, saying: "Just one move."
After speaking, he looked at the old man in the driver’s seat and said: "Go ahead."
The old man suddenly opened his eyes, a sharp light flashing, his body moving gracefully like a falcon, as he stepped down from the carriage with a knife, addressing Song Yan in the distance with a voice that could not be refused: "This old man, Wang Siwu, requests to learn one move."
Just as Hua Linglong was about to say something, Song Yan had already stepped up.
One old and one young, approaching each other, each gripping a sword, each drawing a sword, and then...slashes.
...
...
...
Half an hour later.
The carriage left Celestial Cloud City.
Zhao Sisan leaned against the carriage compartment, asking: "Old Wang, you are a leading figure in the Jianghu of Southern Wu, was that man’s martial arts truly superior to yours? Was it really not magic?"
In his words, there was still a hint of disbelief.
In the realm of martial arts, to defeat the leader of Jiangnan in Southern Wu with a single strike, such a thing...is really hard to believe.
The old man said: "Mr. Su San, please do not doubt him anymore."
"Oh?"
"You don’t understand martial arts, but if you did..."
"How so?"
"You...would revere him like a god."
Zhao Sisan, or Mr. Su San, was momentarily stunned, then burst into hearty laughter, and said: "Such an extraordinary talent, it’s truly a pity."

chapters.title: Chapter 42. Bizarre Market, Seventh Grade Elixir (Request for Follow-up Reading)
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: 42. Bizarre Market, Seventh Grade Elixir (Request for Follow-up Reading)
At the edge of Shu Land, Celestial Cloud City was just a microcosm.
The secret sect envoy from Nanwu Sword Sect, relying on good relationships with various forces, was searching everywhere for the exiled disciples of the Puppet Palace, and upon encounter... kill them!
However, none of this mattered to Song Yan anymore.
He had completely disappeared into the Jianghu, with no one able to know his true identity and power.
After more than half a year, Hua Linglong began dispatching disciples to search for traces of cultivators around because she "admired cultivators’ flying swords after witnessing them," hoping to establish some "trading" channels with them.
At the same time, the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower started proactively gathering information about external matters such as the major tides of the Three Kingdoms.
And all this was what Song Yan needed.
Hua Linglong was indeed doing this for Song Yan.
This woman had quite the tactics, deploying her forces, extending Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower’s reach in all directions.
If Song Yan controlled her using the "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique," she would become an utterly irrational madwoman, only knowing how to execute "kill, kill, kill" orders.
If Song Yan continued to control her using "Fanatic Fans," then once the medicine’s effect wore off, the only outcome would be "Song Yan killing her to prevent future troubles, and at the same time leaving traces of a false death to avoid others finding out." Of course, there are no lack of clever people in Jianghu, and the actions of a "Crowned Queen" who consumed "Fanatic Fans" would reveal flaws, thus being noticed by others, bringing endless unpredictable variables.
Now, it was the best ending.
...
...
This search lasted for over a year.
The winter snow fluttered down once more.
In a certain courtyard, "Four Sparrows" was cooking lamb soup, competing to deliver it to "Teacher Hua."
Soon, warm lamb soup was placed in front of Song Yan.
At South Bamboo Peak, consuming a Fasting Pill daily gradually became tiresome, while the wine and meat of the mortal world were more to his liking.
He lifted a bowl and drank, casually instructing the martial arts of the "Four Sparrows."
It was at this moment that Hua Linglong entered from outside, glanced around, and surprisingly dismissed the "Four Sparrows" with a wave. Watching the man sipping lamb soup, she said, "The Independent Cultivator Market has been found."
Song Yan drank the lamb soup to the bottom, then put it down and asked, "Where is it?"
Hua Linglong replied, "I’ve already sent someone to attempt trade. If things are stable, you can go there later. Since that market can trade with the old man from Cold Water Manor, why shouldn’t it trade with us?"
Song Yan chuckled, "You certainly are thorough."
Hua Linglong sat across from him, somewhat entranced by his empty bowl, suddenly saying, "It’s getting late, and the snow is falling so heavily."
Song Yan said, "Then I should be going."
Hua Linglong shouted, "Bai Que, close the door!"
The door was soon closed.
Hua Linglong looked at him, eyes filled with gentle waters, "You should know I’m a woman, and I have only one man, and will only ever have one man — you. After seeing you, others cannot catch my eye."
Beneath the stone table, she lifted her embroidered shoe, lightly yet boldly nudging Song Yan...
Song Yan didn’t care whether her words were true or false, because it didn’t matter.
He was a psychologically normal and healthy man, and being teased, he directly stood up and carried Hua Linglong horizontally, turning into the house.
In the cold winter, warmth began to rise.
...
...
After several months of testing, that market indeed had no issues.
Song Yan had not yet arrived, but he had already roughly grasped the situation over there.
In the spring, he slightly disguised himself, adding some white hair, and went to the market. After slightly demonstrating his power and expressing his identity as a loose cultivator, he skillfully secured an identity card and entered.
Unlike the low-level market beneath South Bamboo Peak, there were no Jade Tokens to earn contribution points here. The stall owners sat meditatively in their stalls, but they were not cultivators, just ordinary people with relatively strong physiques.
Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower had already sorted it out clearly for him.
These people were all "stall watchers," and their identities were either servants or family members of loose cultivators. It was precisely because of this that this market could conduct transactions with ordinary people outside.
This was clearly a "gathering place for loose cultivators with families."
Since they had families, the danger level was evidently not as high as "Qingxi Market," which was why Song Yan dared to come here alone.
This was the advantage of having influence; there was no need for personal risk to explore, as someone would naturally do all the preliminary work for you.
He didn’t need to scour the goods here to know what was sold.
There were more herbs, elixirs, and prescriptions, while talismans, mechanisms, and even shadow puppets were surprisingly available here.
Why?
This was something that Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower’s spies couldn’t find out.
But it certainly wasn’t because there was some divine treasure land nearby, otherwise, the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower would have unearthed it long ago.
Walking along, Song Yan stopped at a stall filled with bottles and jars because he saw the words "Flame Marrow Pill" on a bottle towards the inside.
His pupils slightly contracted, as he looked up, seeing a young girl still wearing a cotton coat, dozing off as if she had no fear of someone stealing her stuff and running away.
Seemingly sensing someone had stopped, the young girl opened her eyes and said, "What do you want to buy?"
Song Yan pointed at the bottle of "Flame Marrow Pill" and asked, "Excuse me, miss, who refined this elixir?"
The young girl said, "Why do you care so much?"
Song Yan said, "I need a better elixir."
The young girl was stunned, asking, "You need it?"
Song Yan nodded.
The little girl quickly stood up, heading towards the back room while shouting, "Daddy, daddy, a Great Cultivator who wants a custom-made elixir is here!"
Song Yan: ...
A moment later, a keen-eyed middle-aged man strode out, glanced at Song Yan, and smiled politely, "What are you looking for?"
Song Yan said, "An elixir for Breaking through the seventh Realm of Refining Profound."
The middle-aged man scratched his head as if pondering and asked after a while, "What will you exchange for it? Gold and silver are not acceptable; if it’s Profound Jade, it would require a lot."
Song Yan was startled, a feeling of wild joy rising in his heart. He glanced at the other party and noticed the little girl leaning curiously against the middle-aged man, watching him. So he said, "Shadow Puppet."
The middle-aged man said, "Shadow Puppets are good, but I don’t need low-level ones. What tier do you have?"
Song Yan said, "Intermediate Demon Beast, Illusionary Body Raven."
This was the best thing he could offer.
Although the Illusionary Body Raven’s shadow puppet was also excellent, compared to the elixir that could help him break through his Realm, it was insignificant.
"Illusionary Body Raven?"
The middle-aged man was taken aback, then said, "That’s acceptable."
Song Yan said, "Then let’s make the exchange."
The family’s presence there surely increased the "seller’s credibility."
The middle-aged man said, "I need to inform you first. The elixir for breaking through the sixth layer of Refining Profound is called ’Refining Organ Pill,’ but I’m not sure you can use it because it might be very old."
"What does that mean?"
"Do you want it?"
"Let me smell it."ᴛhis ᴜpdated by
"Just a sniff."
The middle-aged man handed it over, Song Yan took it, inhaled slightly, and silently recited, "Invest one month’s lifespan, use a wisp of breath as a catalyst, cultivate the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’."
After a moment, he opened his eyes, reached into his backpack, then took the Illusionary Body Raven’s shadow puppet from the Storage Ring, saying, "It’s a deal."
The middle-aged man took the shadow puppet and inspected it carefully, saying, "Deal."
After speaking, he looked at Song Yan with a much more amiable expression and started to promote other items.
Song Yan seized the opportunity and asked, "Fellow Daoist, when I entered here, I felt a lot of Profound Qi. Is there a Profound Vein here?"
The middle-aged man smiled, "If there were a Profound Vein, we would have established a sect long ago."
He shook his head, saying, "There’s no Profound Vein here, only a huge demon snake corpse.
Even after the demon snake died, it still emits Profound Qi. We sensed it and came here...
We don’t even know why such large demon corpses suddenly appear in these areas.
The snake corpse emits quite a bit of Profound Qi, enough for us to cultivate for thirty or forty years.
After thirty or forty years, we’ll have to look for new demon corpses again."
Song Yan’s expression slightly tensed.
He suddenly understood the reason for the market’s "mobility."
Decades ago, this market must have been on another demon corpse. That demon corpse’s Profound Qi was depleted, so they sought another one.
But the problem is, why are there so many large demon corpses at the edge of the Land of No Profound in the Shu Land?
Suddenly, he seemed to think of something and asked, "Fellow Daoist, is it safe here? I see potential here and am considering settling down."
The middle-aged man became more enthusiastic, thumping his chest, "Of course it’s safe, feel free to settle. Many here were like you, intruding boldly to trade and then gathering their families here.
Coming here has another benefit as well."
It seems this "benefit" is not a secret. The middle-aged man said directly, "Once every ten years, a place called Demon Swamp opens, and we Independent Cultivators of the market team up for exploration.
It seems many cultivators died in the Demon Swamp, leaving many items scattered outside... The ’Refining Organ Pill’ you got was what I found in the enchantment."
"Demon Swamp, enchantment?"
"Yes, funny enough, the enchantment always opens near our market. It’s this enchantment that attracts many Loose Cultivators. I was attracted here back then."
"So... is it dangerous inside?"
"There are opportunities, but of course there’s danger." The middle-aged man pointed to the vast market, "Every ten years, some people are missing, but new people join because even mortals can enter, and if they find an opportunity, they might become cultivators."
Seeing Song Yan’s expression, the middle-aged man laughed, "But as long as you don’t enter the Demon Swamp, it’s very safe here. Everyone is here for the opportunities in the Demon Swamp, then run their own business based on their skills.
The next opening time of the Demon Swamp is three months later...
How about it, do you want to join us?"
Song Yan inwardly rejected it but said, "I’ll think about it."
His gaze suddenly fixed on a spot, a cracked ground he hadn’t noticed before; a closer look revealed strange patterns in the deep darkness.
The patterns were those on snake skin, but for some reason, they inexplicably "expanded," appearing violently torn, like an overinflated balloon bursting.
This was contrary to common sense.
Corpse decomposes and shrinks, but it was his first time seeing a "corpse expanding after death."
The escaping Profound Qi carried a strong, indescribable vitality, causing the corpse not to decay; its texture couldn’t withstand that vitality, leading to exaggerated expansion and tearing.
For some reason, perhaps due to Song Yan’s limited experience.
Upon sensing "strong vitality," he instantly thought of the "Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Demonic Fox" bloodline in Princess Consort’s body...
He remained calm, saluted the middle-aged Loose Cultivator, and swiftly left with the ’Refining Organ Pill.’

chapters.title: Chapter 43. When water flows, a channel is formed, Ninth Layer of Refining Profound
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: 43. When water flows, a channel is formed, Ninth Layer of Refining Profound
In the Shu Land, Profound Qi is scarce, and there’s even less around Celestial Cloud City, but... that "Snake Corpse Market" is like an oasis in the desert of Profound Qi.
Song Yan’s breakthrough could be achieved in just a few breaths, so naturally, after leaving the market’s gate, he quickly stopped behind an old hidden tree nearby, focusing his attention on "[Cultivation Technique]".
’Invest 10 years of life force, taking the Refining Organ Pill as an opportunity to cultivate the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique".’
Life force began to change immediately.
[You invested ten years of life to cultivate the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique". In the first year, you cautiously absorbed the medicinal power of the Refining Organ Pill, but this pill seemed to have been made long ago, with its efficacy barely effective at first, but it quickly showed signs of insufficient potency. You continued to cultivate, and in the third year, due to a mistake, your lung exploded, you died, and the ten years of life were returned.]
Song Yan: ...
’Continue.’
[You invested ten years of life, and your heart exploded...]
[Your liver exploded...]
[Your liver exploded again...]
Song Yan: ...
’Continue.’
This is the benefit of the simulation system.
After so many simulations, Song Yan has roughly figured out the system.
The system seems to lock you in a "closed little black room," with only "the surrounding environment," "the Profound Qi in the environment," and "the elixirs available for your breakthrough," while everything else does not exist.
To attempt to reach the peak with just one cultivation technique or by blindly pondering is akin to "being locked in an empty little room, trying to create a nuclear bomb out of nothing." Before transmigration, humans on Blue Star relied on external objects, accumulation, and research to eventually make nuclear bombs, but...there were various factors like clashes of knowledge and historical opportunities influencing this. Creating something from nothing is impossible. The way of cultivating Profound is similar.
However, this system has another hidden benefit: ’No matter how many times you fail, it will return your life force and resources, allowing you to restart.’
For instance, now, the chance of this outdated Refining Organ Pill "aiding in breaking through to the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound" is pitifully small.
Insufficient medicinal power results in not enough "protection of the organs."
When absorbing Profound Qi, if done too violently, it will cause "internal organs to explode."
Within just over ten breaths, Song Yan had already failed more than ten times in the "simulation."
However, for him, it’s only a matter of restarting once more.
In the blink of an eye, there were more failures.
Finally...
[You invested ten years of life to cultivate the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique". In the first year, you cautiously absorbed the medicinal power of the Refining Organ Pill. Although this pill has been made long ago and its potency is insufficient, your luck was exceptionally good. You successfully guided Profound Qi to initially cover your internal organs. In the tenth year, you absorbed 150 strands of Profound Qi, feeling that the remaining task was just accumulation.]
...
[In the sixty-seventh year, a thousand strands of Profound Qi merged into your organs. You broke through the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound. Your entire body, from hair to fingers, was filled with Profound Qi, rendering you nearly impervious to blades, spears, water, and fire to ordinary people.]
...
[You invested ten years of life to continue cultivating the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique", but your body was already full of Profound Qi, and you did not experience any enhancement. But you did not entirely gain nothing, as you began to realize that the eighth layer of Refining Profound might be a process of further controlling the Profound Qi throughout your body.]
[You invested ten years to meditate, gaining nothing.]
[You invested ten years to meditate, starting to attempt things randomly. In the third year, you entered a state of madness, died, and the ten years of life were returned.]
[You died...]
[You died again...]
Song Yan came back to reality, and since this step was unrelated to Profound Qi, he decided to return to Celestial Cloud City to try again.
The impact of the environment is indeed enormous. Near the Puppet Sect, it would take him 334 years to climb one layer, whereas in this market it only took 67 years.
However, these scenarios included not taking any elixirs. If he added elixirs, along with Profound Jade, scattered resources from the Furnace and chose a place with Evil Qi, it would surely be much faster.
...
...
Time slipped by, and four months had passed.
The cicadas of midsummer were overwhelmingly noisy.
Celestial Cloud City, ten steps away from a luxurious sedan chair, where a man in blue was pinned to the ground by a long sword, with blood gushing out, staining his back crimson.
But the man looked at the distant sedan chair with eyes full of hatred, shouting, "Hua Linglong, return the lives of the thirteen Zhang Family members to me!"
The Black Sparrow, one of the "Four Sparrows", twisted his longsword, causing the man’s body to twitch and fall silent.Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Black Sparrow gave a brief examination, quickly approached the sedan chair, and said, "Caretaker, it should be someone from the Zhang Family that previously supported the Lone Bamboo Gang. At that time, Protector Si Tu made an example by killing them to quickly suppress the Lone Bamboo Gang..."
"There’s no need to say more. Jianghu grudges are precisely like this. Bury him, no need to provoke new animosities."
Hua Linglong said no more, putting down the curtain, and gazed at the man opposite her, "Hua Rong, I feel that I understand you less and less... You’ve changed so much in these few months."
Song Yan looked through the gap in the curtain at the bloody corpse being dragged away, then turned his gaze back, "It’s nothing, just a deeper understanding of martial arts."
This "point" is the transition from the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound to the Ninth Layer.
Indeed, with the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, Profound Qi permeates the whole body.
The following two layers require no external objects but are purely reliant on cultivation.
Or perhaps external objects are needed, but in any case... Song Yan, in his muddled state, managed to break through these two realms by himself.
Ninth Layer of Refining Profound.
First Layer, a hundred strands of Profound Qi form a flow, connecting the main meridian, nurturing the body.
Second Layer, all ten meridians are connected.
Third Layer, Profound Qi attaches to the skin.
Fourth Layer, Profound Qi enters the bone marrow, enriching Qi and blood, thus enabling mastery over yin-infested objects like "Puppet, Shadow Puppet, Paper Figurine."
Fifth Layer, blood exchange.
Sixth Layer, another blood exchange.
Seventh Layer, enters the organs.
Eighth Layer... Profound Qi converges around the body, effortlessly taking form like a Flood Dragon, winding around the body, expanding the meridians, gradually opening the Dantian.
Ninth Layer... Tens of thousands of strands of Profound Qi converge in the Dantian, forming a vast sea, with Profound Qi surging like a tidal wave, allowing the Flood Dragon to ride the tide into the Vast Sea, with no obstruction throughout the body.
At the Eighth Layer, Song Yan spent a full fifty years deducing, finally finding the method of convergence after numerous failures, and then spending 2 years successfully converging.
This step, for others, undoubtedly requires a cultivation technique, as well as understanding and practice, along with external aids to prevent Qi deviation and chaotic Profound Qi.
At the Ninth Layer, Song Yan again spent fifty years deducing, and upon discovering the method, quietly ran to the "Snake Corpse Marketplace" and spent a total of 667 years to fully fill his Dantian, then spent 2 years successfully converging the Profound Qi Flood Dragon into the Dantian.
Thus... the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, reached the pinnacle.
...
After reaching the pinnacle, Song Yan slightly sensed his various spells.
Overall, all spells have strengthened with his enhancement of realm.
Not only that, even more absurdly, almost all spells were suddenly elevated to the level of the "Ninth Layer of Refining Profound" without seeming out of sync with the realm due to their "initial cultivation threshold only being the Third or Fourth Layer."
"Hundred Forms Demon Body," after swallowing a Shadow Puppet, also strengthened, but the number and strength of Shadow Puppets that can be swallowed increased significantly... Unfortunately, Song Yan only had "nine types of low-level Demon Beast Shadow Puppets" in his possession. Obviously, he is currently unable to unleash the full power of the "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
"Skin Painting Deformity Technique," "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique," "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique," "Evil Tide Skill," and "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique," these spells that underwent secondary perfect mutation, also all became stronger.
"Five Elements Hand," however, showed no change.
Yet, various spells brought many new detailed changes during the casting process.
For example, the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique," this spell was derived from the most basic "Qi Concealment Technique," and the "Qi" in "Qi Concealment Technique" refers merely to the Qi of "one meridian."
This resulted in the conceptual level of "Qi Concealment Technique" not being high, therefore, when Song Yan’s realm was lower, he could instantly utilize the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" to hide his aura. But now... he needs to spend nearly a stick of incense’s time in advance to gather all the Profound Qi around his body.
Even so, in terms of concealment, it’s significantly worse than before. After all, with so much Profound Qi... relying solely on Evil Qi to swallow it and completely hide it is pure fantasy.
Thus, while the power of "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" has increased, the "casting animation" has lengthened greatly, and its "concealment" has drastically declined.
...
The same issue exists with the "Torrential Rain Evil."
If the past "Torrential Rain Evil" was like firing a shot...
Then the current "Torrential Rain Evil" is like "charging and lasering."
Similarly, while the power has increased, the "casting animation" has also lengthened.
...
As for "Skin Painting Deformity Technique," "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique," and "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique," they purely strengthened...
For instance, Song Yan can swallow the soul of an entity of a stronger realm, imbue it with Evil Qi, and then release it back.
For example, the Shadow Puppet manipulated by ten fingers has also increased, and he can even manipulate regular advanced Demon Beast Shadow Puppets.
...
Song Yan carefully contemplated the changes brought to him by the realm elevation.
Due to the initial investment, all his identities in the place he currently resides are very secure.
Therefore, his breakthrough in realm and spell testing proceeded so smoothly to an absurd extent, encountering no enemies, nor was he inexplicably targeted by anyone, thus narrowly breaking through in a dire situation.
Glancing at "[Life Span: 25/1817]," Song Yan carefully pondered again, deciding he still needs to go to "Snake Corpse Marketplace" to procure a spell "higher tier than ’Qi Concealment Technique,’" then use the remaining lifespan to conduct a mutation deducing, ensuring that if he needs to return to Puppet Sect, his powers that "require dissection research" won’t be detected.
A month ago, the "Demon Swamp Restriction" at "Snake Corpse Marketplace" was activated. According to the middle-aged loose cultivator Dan Lazi who sold him the "Refining Organ Pill," "a month" is the duration of the "Demon Swamp" being active.
If he goes in these days, he will surely see many new goods.
Likewise, he can also verify the mortality rate of the "Demon Swamp," to see how many people have died.

chapters.title: Chapter 44. The return date has arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: 44. The return date has arrived
A few days later...
Snake Corpse Market.
On one side, there is gloom and desolation; on the other, there is joyous laughter, various chuckles mixed with cries. Glancing around, one moment it’s weeping with bowed heads, the next it’s hearty laughter.
Song Yan, familiar with the place, arrived at Dan Lazi’s stall.
Dan Lazi, the same loose cultivator who sold him the "Refining Organ Pill".
These visits, he intentionally sought out the same person, partly because he felt Dan Lazi had considerable power, and also because Dan Lazi brought his daughter to the market, suggesting he was in business for the long haul. He wanted to establish a connection.
Today, with a glance, he noticed that there were many more items on the stall: elixirs, profound artifacts, and even jade scrolls. Beside the jade scrolls were inscriptions with "Spell Name", along with the price required for inheritance.
He looked up at the little girl watching the stall.
This little girl was called "Little Red Chili", and she seemed to have a profound root as well.
At this moment, Little Red Chili was pouting.
Song Yan originally wanted to congratulate "such a rich harvest", but when Little Red Chili glanced at him, she didn’t say anything, turned away, and called out, "Dad, Dad, Tai Yi is here."
Tai Yi...was the Taoist name Song Yan gave himself under this identity as a loose cultivator. It was analogous to "Hua Rong".
Soon, the door opened, and Dan Lazi walked out.
Song Yan was startled, the sharp-eyed middle-aged loose cultivator had actually lost his left arm, and his face was deathly pale, looking very weak.
"Fellow Daoist Tai Yi, I have to thank you," Dan Lazi approached, speaking with deep emotion.
Song Yan expressed concern, "Brother Dan, what happened to you?"
Dan Lazi sighed, "Let’s talk inside."
Song Yan nodded.
Seeing he did not hesitate, Dan Lazi nodded secretly in his heart, his expression became increasingly friendly.
Moments later, the two reached inside the house.
From the outside, it looked like an ordinary house, but inside it was extremely luxurious. A beautiful woman poured them spirit tea.
Dan Lazi introduced directly, "Fellow Daoist Tai Yi, this is my Dao partner, Chun Yun. Chun Yun, this is the Fellow Daoist Tai Yi I mentioned earlier."
The beautiful woman bowed slightly and smiled, "Fellow Daoist Tai Yi, my husband has been thinking about you, suggesting that you might be a capable Skin Master.
We’re thinking of becoming neighbors with you.
Now you’re at the Sixth Layer of Refining Profound. My husband is slightly better, having already reached the Seventh Layer.
If we become neighbors, we can still help you a bit."
Dan Lazi said, "Yes, Fellow Daoist Tai Yi, this time at Snake Corpse Market we suffered heavy losses, many experts are gone.
Even I, even though I lost an arm, am now amongst the top three in the market.
If you were to join, you could become top five in the market, which holds some significant influence. Furthermore..."
He lowered his voice, "We have a beautiful female cultivator here, whose realm is at the Fifth Layer of Refining Profound. Her Dao partner just died in the Demon Swamp... If Fellow Daoist Tai Yi were to stay, my wife could act as a matchmaker."
He chuckled, saying, "Dao partners in dual cultivation, cultivation progresses quickly."
Song Yan was momentarily stunned and asked, "Brother, is the Demon Swamp really that perilous? How did we incur such losses?"
Dan Lazi replied with a bitter smile, "This time, a group of us who are quite advanced in the Refining Profound realm teamed up to delve into the Demon Swamp, trying to reclaim and explore some new areas.
As a result...all those companions of mine died. I only managed to escape thanks to your bodiless phantom crow."
Then, he explained everything in detail.
The two sat together.
Song Yan listened to him while sipping spirit tea.
This interaction made even Chun Yun look at him much more kindly.
Entering the house and drinking tea without hesitation or vigilance indicates the relationship between the parties might be rather closely-knit.
Dan Lazi concluded, saying, "The giant crocodile demon was terrifying; it was only at the critical moment that I used the bodiless phantom crow to block one attack, allowing me to escape in a sorry state. However, the gains were quite substantial."
Song Yan said, "I see from the market that the stalls have not decreased but increased, what’s the reason?"
Dan Lazi replied, "Isn’t it because of the rich resources in the Demon Swamp? Several people have found opportunities and even managed to grow a ’Miscellaneous Profound Root’ from ’No Profound Root’. The rewards for those little cultivators with low realms were even richer.
This Demon Swamp is indeed good, but delving deep... would spell trouble."
It was the first time Song Yan heard that a "profound root" could grow from external sources...
Though it was just the lowest of profound roots, the "Miscellaneous Profound Root", it was still incredible.
It took him forty years of torment by ghosts just to grow the Ghost Profound Root...
This clearly demonstrates the numerous treasures hidden within the "Demon Swamp", and it’s no wonder these high-realm Refining Profound cultivators dare to venture deep within.
With such heavy losses now, Snake Corpse Market is eager to replenish its high-combat loose cultivators.
Therefore, Dan Lazi and Chun Yun were so enthusiastic in trying to win over Song Yan, even contemplating matchmaking him with a Dao partner.
Truth be told, Song Yan was indeed slightly tempted.
After all, although the Snake Corpse Market seemed strange, not venturing into the Demon Swamp might afford some relative stability, at least... a bit better than the ghostly aura of the Puppet Sect.
However, upon asking for the price of "Demon Beast Fur", his face turned green.
First of all, there was very little demon beast fur at Snake Corpse Market, and one piece of fur comparable to that of a low-level beast like the two-headed wolf was priced at 10 Profound Jade Beans.
These Profound Jade Beans were the size of soybeans and if larger, could be measured by weight.
Profound Jade Beans were roughly equivalent to 1 tael in size.
Twenty Profound Jade Beans can similarly buy a copy of "Entry-Level Magic of the First Layer of Refining Profound" at the Snake Corpse Market.
This expensive price directly crushed his hopes.
He suddenly felt that the Puppet Sect had its advantages.
In the Puppet Sect, he never had to worry about the matter of "Demon Beast Fur"; he only needed to continuously make Skin, make Skin, make Skin, and that was enough.
He loved Skin Making.
He regarded it as the career of his life.
But outside, it was too difficult...
But whether he returns to the Puppet Sect does not depend on him, but rather on whether that Sect Leader is still there in five years.
...
...
Song Yan did not agree to "stay" nor reject it, merely saying there were unresolved matters.
Dan La Zi and his wife did not insist, only saying he was welcome at any time.
Afterward, Song Yan wandered in the Snake Corpse Market for a while longer, only to find that high-level Breath Concealment Techniques were not for sale at all.
He thought carefully and realized why.
With Profound Qi flowing throughout your body, how can you conceal it?
But the problem was, Song Yan had to prepare for "hiding," otherwise... he would never return to the Puppet Sect.
Soon, Song Yan considered the problem from another angle: instead of concealing it, can it be temporarily sealed?
This change in thinking led him to a good item — Sealing Talisman.
The Sealing Talisman is considered a low-level common talisman with only one purpose: after subduing a ghost, this talisman is attached to the ghost to bind it. The principle is that the Sealing Talisman can absorb the Evil Qi of the ghost, imprisoning it at the point where the talisman meat conjoins. If some mischievous child were to tear the talisman, the Evil Qi instantly returns, and the ghost revives.
Due to its limited effect, not many draw it, and it can be traded for gold and silver.
Song Yan spent a silver note of 100 taels to get one Sealing Talisman and then left.
...
...
Back in Celestial Cloud City, he found a quiet place and attached the Sealing Talisman below his navel. Instantly, he felt the Evil Qi around him being drawn towards his navel by a small force, then residing at the place conjoined with the talisman meat.
Even if someone uses Qi to probe, they cannot detect this part of the Evil Qi concealed by the Sealing Talisman.
Though the Sealing Talisman cannot conceal all his Evil Qi, coupled with the Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique, it can.
’It works!’
Song Yan’s eyes brightened.
Days later...
He withdrew a large sum of silver notes from Celestial Cloud City and went to the Snake Corpse Market to buy all 50 Sealing Talismans.
However, the entry-level methods of a Talisman Master are like the Skin Master, belonging to a kind of inheritance. He could not find it at the marketplace and had to give up.
...
...
Several days later, the outside news began to trickle into Celestial Cloud City.
Pieces of intelligence were brought to Song Yan.
Great Jin relocated their capital, the Second Prince of Wei Kingdom along with the Grand General, former Crown Prince of the South Town King, struck a surprise from Shu Kingdom, taking the opportunity to attack the Imperial Capital.
...
Wei Kingdom was restored, the Second Prince showed traits of a wise ruler, and the Grand General managed the army well.
...
The Wei King actually returned, and the Second Prince returned the throne to his father.
...
The Imperial Capital of Wei Kingdom seemed to be in a state of demonic disaster, with the citizens fleeing in panic.
...
The Imperial Capital closed its gates.
...
More refugees appeared, fleeing south in panic.
People fleeing from Northern Land Jianghu said demons now rampaged in the north.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Those demons either took human form and forcibly mocked young men and women or directly snatched children and strong men to feast on in the streets, the scenes tragic and indescribable, truly a human purgatory.
The Great Wei army initially intervened and captured, but soon for unknown reasons, they retreated one by one.
...
...
Song Yan stood detached, watching the messages from a safe position.
And as time moved forward, three months remained from five years.
No earth-shattering news came from the Puppet Sect; evidently, the Sect Leader was still alive.
He... had to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 45. Facing death, recruiting new members
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: 45. Facing death, recruiting new members
"Are you going on a journey?"
"Yes."
"Over the past five years, you have taught the Four Finches without reservation. Though named Four Finches, each of them now surpasses the Lion King in power."
"Yes."
"So..."
Hua Linglong took a deep breath, her expression heavy, weary, and on the verge of discomfort as she looked at the man in front of her and asked, "When will you return?"
Song Yan paused in silence.
Yet Hua Linglong already showed a smile, a peaceful smile, an expression that quickly gathered all emotions, leaving no trace of heaviness, fatigue, or discomfort. One might even think the emotions seen in her eyes were an illusion.
She was inherently someone skilled at acting, mixing truth with falsehood, making it difficult for others to discern.
She asked lightly, "Will you come back?"
This time, Song Yan nodded, saying, "It’s just that the time might be long, I’m not sure.
Continue to maintain contact with the Snake Corpse Market, establish a long-term relationship by providing some necessary help. Although there are many ordinary people in the market, due to the need for secrecy, they won’t actively contact outsiders, making them extremely hard to find. But they do need a lot of supplies.
The Snake Corpse Market opens the Demon Swamp Restriction every ten years, with the last opening being two years ago. Once you’re familiar with them, you can try sending some trusted people into their Demon Swamp Restriction; although dangerous, there is a chance they could become cultivators. In this way, the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower may evolve from a mortal force to a cultivator force."
Hua Linglong showed a thoughtful expression and no longer dwelled on the matter of ’parting,’ nor did she worry about ’how Song Yan knew this information.’ As the ’Crowned Queen’ around the three cities and twenty-six counties near Celestial Cloud City, even though she was mortal, she was not a small woman swayed by emotions.
Even without Song Yan, she was a heartless, scheming, and good at acting ’female antagonist.’Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
She meticulously inquired about the situation of the Snake Corpse Market, having already formed some ideas in her mind.
Song Yan left behind a porcelain bottle containing the "Refining Organ Pill" and a box holding the "Knife-beaked Finch Shadow Puppet."
The former, once seen by the Danla family, would make them aware that "Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower" was backed by him.
The latter already carried a wisp of his divine soul through the wondrous technique of "Hundred Forms Divine Control," making it hardly distinguishable from a real Knife-beaked Finch, corresponding to a demon beast of the Profound Second Layer cultivator.
Having done these, Song Yan took a knife, a bamboo hat, a gourd, a pouch of gold beans, and also took ten thousand taels of Shu Country silver notes into his storage space before riding off.
Though reaching the Puppet Sect didn’t really take three months, it was better to return a bit early, observe the surroundings, and understand the situation rather than rashly dive back in.
The deep autumn leaves finally withered, falling from the branches, passing before the eyes of the one who saw him off.
Bai Que stepped forward, draping a cloak over the delicate figure standing roadside, watching the swiftly disappearing horses.
Hua Linglong said blandly, "Retire for now. I need some peace."
Bai Que retreated.
More than ten accompanying guards also retreated.
