Only the Crowned Queen of the Western Shu Border City remained standing alone, her hands behind her back, looking up into the distance, sighing softly, "Ah, you might as well have used Fanatic Fans on me all along..."
...
...
Song Yan rode, leisurely crossing through Jianghu, indeed seeing many refugees along the way.
With a little inquiry, they were all from the north, speaking of demon disasters there, making it impossible to survive.
Song Yan was unsurprised.
Presumably, the King of Wei summoned reinforcements but promised them that if the kingdom is restored, they could plunder the realm for several days."
Without allowing plunder, who would help you fight? Of course, these matters... would be glossed over in history, vile deeds described as "plundering people’s clothes," and so on.
Yet, what actually happened, he didn’t understand. But he knew... the Puppet Sect shouldn’t be weak, winning or losing wasn’t evident in this war.
He urged his horse forward.
He somewhat longed for the skin-making days at the Puppet Sect.
That life of daily skin crafting, without caring about the origins of the skins, those were the good days.
...
...
"Father!"
"Father!!"
The handsome Second Prince burst into the room, looking at the King of Wei who had collapsed onto the table.
The King of Wei’s face was pale, no breath left from his nose, and there was an empty wine glass by his hand.
The Second Prince quickly opened the cap of the nearby wine pot, sniffing it slightly.
It was poison.
The room wasn’t in disarray.
The guards were tight last night.
The King of Wei... committed suicide.
The Second Prince sighed deeply but didn’t indulge in grief; instead, he sat beside the King of Wei’s body, staring blankly, muttering as if talking to a living person or to himself, "Not of our kind, their hearts must be eradicated... I never imagined it could be this cruel. Are they still human? Are they still human?!!"
He became more agitated, even panting.
But soon realized "that’s not human," that’s a demon.
"It’s not your fault, no one expected it, it’s not your fault..."
"Father!!"
The Second Prince buried his face on the table and cried, his fists clenched tightly, while flames rose in his tearful eyes.
...
...
Crackling...
Crackling crackling...
Grease dripped from the deer meat above, the flames crackling and popping.
Song Yan grilled a freshly hunted deer, the gamey smell was strong, not fragrant at all.
After roasting, Song Yan carelessly ate a few bites, no longer inclined to eat more.
It tasted terrible...
He truly couldn’t imagine why his cooking was so bad!
Song Yan finished eating and lay down to sleep.
This place was still within the Shu Realm, a place with weak Profound Qi where even a demon beast was absent.
The empty forest was serene, though there were some bugs, but once he slightly released his Qi Blood pressure, they dared not come near.
The next morning.
Clear skies.
Song Yan continued on his journey.
...
...
"Second Prince, are you mad!
You want to lead troops into the busy market... to kill a Fox Demon?!
This... this is the Ancestor... this is the fundamental power on which our Great Wei can stand! In the future, we won’t be a mere Mortal Realm, but a realm with a great power presiding!
How can you send the Ancestor to their death?
What you should do now is report the situation to the Ancestor, then ascend to the throne!"
"Grand General!
Do you want me to help the Demon raise the people as its food supply?"
"That’s not a Demon,
that’s the Ancestor!"
"Cao Zhengjing! Is this what the King of the South taught you?"
"My father taught me that those who adapt to the times are wise!
No matter what, one must understand the situation; when it’s time to bow, then bow!
Moreover, what does the Second Prince have to fight against the Ancestor?"
"Although the Northern Land is troubled by demon disasters, many of the people still have faith in our Royal family.
Over the centuries, we, the Great Wei, have done much for the people.
They believe in the legitimacy of the Great Wei Royal Family!
Even if I die in the street fight, the people should understand... this is not the fault of the Great Wei Royal Family, but that the Demon has arrived!
If they understand this point, those people will no longer be deceived.
Nowadays, the Demon occasionally sends some small Demon Beasts for our Wei Kingdom’s army to slay and comfort the people, but the fact is... these are all tricks!
Today, I, Cao Shiyin, will expose these."
With that, Cao Zhengjing, the former Crown Prince of the South and now the Grand General, silently retreated.
The "Second Prince" Cao Shiyin silently glanced at him, stretched out his arms, and while walking out, said: "Forbidden Army, bring the armor, follow me out of the Palace!!"
...
...
More than an hour later...
In the bustling market, a long spear pierced through Cao Shiyin’s heart.
The Second Prince stared in a daze at the person holding the spear.
He recognized this man, a fierce general under the Grand General’s command.
He looked further into the crowd and saw the Grand General.
The fierce general suddenly twisted the long spear, sending Cao Shiyin flying, preventing him from uttering another word, leaving his lifeless body on the ground, refusing to rest in peace.
...
...
Days later, King Wei first passed, then the Prince collapsed, and "Grand General" Cao Zhengjing, after avenging the Prince, took command in a crisis, stepped onto the grand hall of the Imperial Palace, sat on the Dragon Throne, and looked down at the many officials below, raising both hands slightly, saying with authority: "Rise."
At the same time, dozens of fast horses galloped out from the city.
If one commits evil, their kin will inevitably betray them; these dozens were those disgusted by Cao Zhengjing’s actions.
The Northern Land’s Imperial Capital of Great Wei was in the utmost chaos.
...
...
Tat-tat-tat...
Song Yan circled around the Puppet Sect several times, finally confirming that aside from numerous casualties, everything was normal and relatively safe.
Seeing the five-year term had arrived, he entered South Bamboo Peak from the market entrance, presenting his Identity Token as he continued deeper.
By coincidence, after a few steps, he saw from afar a graceful and voluptuous figure.
That figure seemed to sense something, turned and looked, and called out, "Junior Brother!"
"Senior Sister Wang?"
"You’re still alive?"
"Not easy at all..."
Song Yan sighed and went up to meet her.
Riding side by side, Wang Susu asked, "In these five years, has your cultivation fallen behind?"
"What about Senior Sister?"
"I have reached the first layer of Refining Profound."
"Impressive!" Song Yan genuinely praised, considering how fiercely Nanwu Sword Sect had been searching for people before, Wang Susu breaking realm in these circumstances clearly showed her Furnace-based cultivation hadn’t stopped.
"What about Junior Brother?"
"I... I have also reached the first layer of Refining Profound."
"Junior Brother is quite impressive too." Wang Susu couldn’t help but praise, then glanced left and right, saying, "I knew it, Junior Brother took those two Furnaces alive from South Bamboo Peak to squeeze them dry down the mountain, right?"
The Demoness laughed, saying, "Indeed, Junior Brother knows how to cultivate, using that top-grade Furnace with Multi-tailed Fox Race Blood, feeding them medicine, taking it slowly down the mountain, unlike me, who only knows to gorge, hehe."
Song Yan:...
The two Senior and Junior walked as they talked, but before reaching the top of South Bamboo Peak, they saw a sparse group of people flying over, led by a white-robed Elder, followed by Profound Robe disciples.
Before they were close, the white-robed Elder called from afar, "Are you disciples of our Puppet Sect?"
Wang Susu laughed and raised her Identity Token, saying, "Yes, Elder. The five-year term has arrived, and we have just returned."
The white-robed Elder asked, "Have you entered Refining Profound?"
Wang Susu said, "Yes!"
The white-robed Elder said, "That’s perfect, the recruitment still lacks personnel, follow me first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 46. More Demon Than Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: 46. More Demon Than Demon
"Sob sob~~"
Soft arms gently shook an elder’s shoulders, a beautiful face rested on his shoulder, her charming eyes carefully concealing extreme disdain, her red lips parted as she said, "Old man, why have you come to South Bamboo Peak... let’s go back to the main peak. Rufeng is also at the main peak, and he is very filial to you."
The elder was none other than the Stone Master.
And the beautiful woman was his Dao companion—Bi Huayi.
Stone Master said, "This place is closer to the Tannery. I’m getting old and want to see if there are any talented disciples."
Bi Huayi said, "You should just enjoy peace and stability and leave these matters to Rufeng."
Stone Master fell silent for a moment.
Bi Huayi, hooking his neck, continued, "That precious inheritance of yours might as well be handed to Rufeng.
I know... that inheritance is very important to you.
So if you pass it to Rufeng sooner, you’ll be able to breathe a sigh of relief sooner, right?
I’m just thinking of you."
The beautiful woman playfully coaxed, but the Stone Master remained silent.
Finally, even Bi Huayi seemed to tire of it, walking out of the cave mansion, looking outside, and sneering in her heart, "Old fool, guarding that thing so tightly, who knows if he’s already passed it to someone.
Could it be Lv Hong?
No, if it were given to Lv Hong, he would have said so long ago, and his attitude would not be like this.
He’s really holding back and hiding!
If he doesn’t pass it to Rufeng, does he intend to take it to the grave with him? Damn old fool! Maybe it’s time to use some means or perhaps... poison?"
...
...
"Song... Song..."
The young Elder in the white robe looked at Song Yan, pointed, seeming to ponder, then smiled, "Song Yan!"
Song Yan recognized this Elder as well, clasped his hands and saluted, "Congratulations Brother Gu on becoming an Elder!"
The white-robed Elder leading the group out to capture servants was unexpectedly Gu Rufeng, which was truly beyond his expectations.
The white-robed Elder smiled, "Nowadays, talents at Shadow Puppet Peak are scarce, which is why Gu has become an Elder. It’s also worth congratulating that Junior Brother Song has now entered Profound Cultivation."
After some simple pleasantries, Gu Rufeng no longer paid attention to Song Yan. After all, a novice in Refining Profound was still far beneath him.
The group exited the market gate of South Bamboo Peak, and shortly thereafter, thousands of cavalry gathered, dense and dark, with elites in the front and numerous carts dragged by oxen carrying cages in the back. The leader clasped his fist and said, "General Dong Tongshan of Great Jin, under the orders of our emperor, is at the command of the Immortal Masters."
Gu Rufeng said, "Accompany us to capture people, and escort them back after capture."
With that, he raised his hand and summoned a Shadow Puppet Void Ship.
The disciples boarded the ship one after another.
The Void Ship took to the air, heading far away, with the cavalry in close pursuit behind.
...
...Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Time flashed by, and several days passed.
Song Yan still remembered how he was "recruited" back then, but never expected that in the blink of an eye... he would also be out recruiting.
The so-called recruitment basically involved capturing all able-bodied young men and women along the way, throwing them into cages, and then preparing to take them back for testing.
Those who could be tested for aptitude would directly become disciples, while those who were not would be thrown into various chores rooms for a second test later.
The Puppet Sect recruited in such a manner because of the heavy casualties.
This was not even the first recruitment of the year, nor was it the only group out recruiting.
While Gu Rufeng led a raid on one side, there were also Demon Sect elders leading captures elsewhere.
The Puppet Sect required a large influx of fresh blood.
In matters like these, Song Yan was helpless and could only go along with local customs, drifting with the tide.
However... there was one thing he was very concerned about.
He remembered the "inheritance dispute" from back then very clearly.
The parties involved in that "inheritance dispute" were precisely Lv Hong and Gu Rufeng.
Now, Lv Hong had been captured by a Ghost Cultivator and taken to the small dark room to make Shadow Puppets... Gu Rufeng was arguably the strongest among the younger generation of Skin Makers left.
But the Stone Master had passed the inheritance to him.
Over the years, Gu Rufeng would have certainly tried every way possible to dig out the Stone Master’s inheritance.
After all, in Gu Rufeng’s view, he had no competition anymore, and the Stone Master would inevitably pass the inheritance to him.
But the result... was obviously not.
What would Gu Rufeng think?
Perhaps he was uncertain if the Stone Master had already passed the inheritance to someone else, but he was very likely to stop at nothing to find out.
For instance...
Soul Search.
All the Skin Makers or quasi-Skin Makers from the Linglong Valley Exotic Beast Association back then could become his targets.
Of course, before a Soul Search, he would use his authority to exert pressure, because he was already an Elder, and his grandfather was also an Elder.
Although he, Song Yan, was only in the first level of Refining Profound, he would not be an exception.
This was almost an inevitable situation.
Song Yan could almost imagine the subsequent developments.
Returning to South Bamboo Peak, he would likely be taken for questioning, then detained, using "Soul Search" as a threat to coerce him, much like "violent interrogation." And he would have to use his power to escape, causing quite a commotion in the process, leading to everything spiraling completely out of control.
When contemplating these matters, Song Yan kept his head down, not looking at the Elder in the white robe in front of the Shadow Puppet Void Ship.
However, he already deeply felt the "cause and effect" between him and Gu Rufeng.
This "cause and effect" started because of Stone Master, and it cannot be severed.
If Stone Master were still alive, he might protect him, but that protection would cause issues.
If Stone Master had indeed passed away, then Gu Rufeng would undoubtedly exert every effort to uncover the whereabouts of his legacy.
In the distance, Gu Rufeng held a Communication Jade, seemingly communicating with someone.
After the exchange, his face turned pale, his eyes filled with resentment, and he coldly snorted, cursing under his breath, "Old bastard!"
Song Yan’s pupils slightly contracted, understanding in his heart: it seems the master is still alive...
However, he had to find an opportunity to kill Gu Rufeng.
Though not yet revealed, the malicious bond was too deep, and he had to act.
Since he inherited Stone Master’s legacy, these causes and effects... must be taken on and handled together.
...
...
The recruitment concluded smoothly.
A group of people returned to Shadow Puppet Peak.
One by one, iron cages were transported up the mountain.
After bidding farewell to everyone, Gu Rufeng left alone.
Time entered deep winter, with small snowflakes filling the sky.
It was dusk, and in the distance... the Earth Demon rose with the cold wind.
Gu Rufeng mounted a Blood Blade Deer Shadow Puppet, quickly advancing regardless of the terrain, and when he reached above Cuique Forest, the shadow puppet trod on the treetops.
Clearly, he intended to return to the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak at this moment.
Suddenly, he seemed to sense something, slightly turning his head, but all he saw was snow falling with the wind, nothing else.
"Hmm?"
Gu Rufeng frowned, thought briefly, and quickly maneuvered the shadow puppet to land in Cuique Forest.
From the high ground, he was too conspicuous; if he encountered enemies, he’d be like a sitting duck.
Though this white-robed elder was young, he possessed a considerable degree of vigilance and battlefield experience. Even if he couldn’t confirm whether his perception was mistaken, his battlefield struggles had instilled in him a profound caution.
Once on the ground, regardless of whether there were enemies or whether his perception was wrong, he immediately dismounted the Blood Blade Deer Shadow Puppet and pulled out a Shield Profound Artifact.
The Blood Blade Deer was an Intermediate Demon Beast; due to its physique and Qi Blood, even when corresponding to a certain rank of Cultivating Profound practitioner, it would generally be stronger.
And with the Shield Profound Artifact, he could ensure his safety, watching the Blood Blade Deer fight with the enemy, and then... take the opportunity to use other Profound Artifacts and Talismans for attack.
This was the correct technique for a Skin Master’s Magical Battle: release the shadow puppet, protect oneself, exploit openings, weaken the enemy, and strike with a lethal blow.
Just as Gu Rufeng pulled out the Shield Profound Artifact and simultaneously released his perception, his perception spread over several dozen zhang instantaneously touched a gigantic black shadow.
Gu Rufeng was so terrified he almost exploded in shock.
What was that?
Three heads, body covered in armor, spikes on the armor, and two relatively small wings outside the spikes, each feather like a steel blade...
This appearance inexplicably reminded Gu Rufeng of the common appearances of "Two-headed Wolves," "White Thorn Deer," "Iron Feather Finch," and other Low Level Demon Beasts.
These Low Level Demon Beasts weren’t frightening, but... strung together in such a bizarre manner, they became terrifying.
Demon... Beast?
Had the demon beast invaded here already?
But, what kind of demon beast is this!!!
At the moment he perceived that bizarre demon beast, he suddenly felt as though the demon beast was smiling.
All three heads were smiling.
In an instant.
Swoosh!
A streak of black light flashed past.
The demon beast appeared several dozen zhang before him, with a massive, hard hand tearing through the air, the sonic boom making his mind buzz to a blank, followed by a sensation of his face being firmly grasped by those rough fingers, his neck tightened, legs dangling, kicking instinctively.
Before he could react, he only felt extreme pain in his Primordial Spirit between his eyebrows.
"B-..."
Gu Rufeng opened his mouth, but couldn’t even utter the word "No" before he became a living corpse devoid of a Divine Soul, his struggling arms and kicking legs drooping down, swaying in the cold forest wind.
But in the blink of an eye, those unfocused eyes regained their luster.
Filled with the luster of Evil Qi!
The demon beast released him, instructing in a low voice, "Go to the Evil Land, then... commit suicide."
Gu Rufeng, without a word, remounted the Blood Blade Deer, veering westward.
Tonight, he would die in the Evil Land and then be possessed by a ghost.
The Puppet Sect and Ghost Cultivators already had grudges, one more was not too few, one less was not too many...

chapters.title: Chapter 47. First Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: 47. First Day
After killing Gu Rufeng, Song Yan immediately returned to the cave mansion.
The Soul-Searching Skill, after all, is a common magic at the Refining Profound Level. Once one reaches the third layer, they can practice it. By this principle, even if you devour a Divine Soul, you can only perceive "recent events, main thoughts in the heart, and a few impressive images." As for subconsciousness, cultivation techniques, or distant vague memories... those can’t be seen.
The principle is also easy to understand: If you want to see more, more details, then it’s not soul searching, but soul fusion. When you merge others’ subconsciousness, techniques, vague memories, you naturally also merge others’ joys, anger, sorrows and happiness, dislikes and likes, seven emotions and six desires, obsessions, etc...
In that case, you might go mad.
As for things like the Shadow Puppet Profound Artifact, in order to maintain the scene of Gu Rufeng’s death, he naturally did not take them.
To covet small profits and plant a root of disaster, that’s something he wouldn’t do.
At this time, the cave mansion was cold and empty.
Song Yan looked around and walked slowly.
Because he returned late today, it wasn’t suitable to do anything, so he decided to rest for the time being.
As for tomorrow... there were many things to be done.
First, he had to meet the new Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak.
Of course, from Gu Rufeng’s memories, Song Yan also learned that the current new Peak Master is actually Elder Shi.
Secondly, he had to seek the antidote to remove the poison placed by the Sect Leader five years ago.
Then he had to see if there were any "post adjustments" and what he needed to do.
Although he returned from the "recruitment" after sunset, Song Yan could still feel that South Bamboo Peak was rather desolate. Clearly... not many disciples had returned, and even the guards at the gate were replaced.
Back on that night when there was an ambush at Nanwu Sword Sect, many had already died. This time, even more were wiped out, leaving possibly only two or three disciples out of the sixty-two cave mansions in South Bamboo Peak whom he still recognized.
Incorporating the fact that the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak himself was a Ghost Cultivator, and a large number of Skin Masters having been looted by Ghost Cultivators, "Shadow Puppet Peak" was actually nearly in a paralyzed state, which was also the reason Gu Rufeng could become an Elder.
Song Yan lifted the curtain while thinking and checked around the cave mansion, finding it unchanged, and then lay down on the stone bed with peace of mind.
An empty mountain, a solitary bed.
Outside the skylight, the wind and snow mixed with the night, like a cross of black and white dots.
Song Yan tossed and turned a few times, finding it difficult to sleep.
It wasn’t because there was no woman to warm the bed, but because returning to this dangerous environment naturally invoked some instinctual vigilance. Coupled with the excitement from killing Gu Rufeng and the uncertainty of tomorrow, it was hard to rest easy.
...
...
Gu Rufeng’s "lover-martial arts mistress" Bi Huayi was similarly uneasy.
This woman, under a pretext, went to the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak to have a private meeting with her lover and to plot how to poison Stone Seat Elder, and how to force him to hand over his teachings.
But she waited until midnight and still didn’t see Gu Rufeng.
She went to check around and found that the disciples who went to the "recruitment" with Gu Rufeng had already returned.
She was restless and uneasy.
...
...
One night passed, and the news of Gu Rufeng’s disappearance spread completely.
Currently, Gu Rufeng’s grandfather, Gu Tianyang, is the acting Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak.
Without saying a word, Gu Tianyang suspended all activities, mobilizing all disciples to search everywhere. Seeing no news, he even set out himself.
Even Song Yan and Wang Susu, who had just returned, were all put into the queue for finding "Elder Gu."
Shadow puppets were flying in the sky, running on cliffs covered with white snow.
Disciples expanded their perception, searching the surrounding area.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
But Song Yan and Wang Susu trudged bitterly through the snow.
Song Yan felt a bit speechless: He had just killed Gu Rufeng yesterday, and today the entire day had to be spent "looking for Elder Gu."
Unlike the disciples riding shadows in the sky, he frequently heard calls around him.
"Elder Gu, where are you?"
"Elder Gu~~~"
"Elder Gu, is that you? Elder Gu!"
"Ah! No! Be careful, everyone, it’s the two-headed wolf! It’s the two-headed wolf!!"
After a fierce battle, that two-headed wolf demon was finally killed by several disciples who had reached the first layer of Refining Profound together.
Song Yan put away his saber; Shadow Puppet Peak disciples generally didn’t carry weapons, but those who hadn’t yet mastered riding shadows usually carried sabers.
At this moment, he let out a long breath, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and sighed, "Demon beasts are really terrifying."
Wang Susu poked the wolf with her small boot, then showed a cruel look, raising her knife to stab into its skull again.
Clang!
The demon beast’s skull was very hard.
Wang Susu applied more force downwards.
Splash!
The skull cracked, brain matter flowing out.
Wang Susu curled her lips, kicked to the side with her boot, pushing the wolf’s head askew, and said, "Meaningless."
Song Yan knew she was "commenting on an issue by discussing another," saying that the wolf was meaningless, but actually referring to the fact that "without obtaining the antidote, having to come out and search for Gu Rufeng" was very meaningless.
Gu Rufeng is an Elder after all, what could possibly happen to him?
For just one person, everyone stops what they’re doing to come out and look for him.
Does that make any sense?
Song Yan walked closer, glanced at the unfamiliar faces around, and said, "Senior Sister, I couldn’t tell last night, but today it seems like there are a lot more fellow disciples."
Wang Susu replied, "We left five years ago, but during these five years there has been a constant influx of new blood from outside, though the attrition is quite high. From our batch, it seems only you and I are left."
After saying that, she chuckled, leaned closer, and said, "Junior Brother, shall we get closer? To be honest, Senior Sister hasn’t tasted your flavor yet... how about trying tonight? Senior Sister promises to make you comfortable, more so than any of your Furnaces."
"Forget it."
"Shy, huh?"
"Yeah, a bit."
Wang Susu was startled, covering her mouth with a coquettish chuckle, then said, "Senior Sister is too," after which she walked playfully beside Song Yan, her eyes keenly observing the surroundings.
The crowd walked in groups of three or five, each in their own little circles.
Wang Susu and Song Yan, despite their high status, found themselves somewhat isolated without anyone calling them Senior Brother or Sister.
The group of disciples continued searching in the Cuique Forest.
Suddenly, the disciple at the front stopped abruptly.
With that halt, those behind also stopped in unison.
Wang Susu pushed through the crowd to the front, her eyes widening in shock as she stopped.
Even though it had snowed overnight, the terrifying depressions in the ground were still visible, marking a straight track spanning dozens of feet, several feet deep, with shattered rocks and cracked trees around it.
"What kind of Demon Beast is this?" a disciple muttered in fear.
Immediately after, someone replied, "It can’t be a two-headed wolf, at least... it’s at least an Intermediate Demon Beast."
Wang Susu’s pupils constricted, and she silently retreated as her thoughts raced.
Being meticulous, her years in the Tannery had equipped her with the ability to recognize Intermediate Demon Beasts clearly, and conversations with Senior Brother Zhang Yin and others had given her a rough idea of an Intermediate Demon Beast’s destructive power.
This level of destruction...
Was obviously the result of a simple leap.
This is not an Intermediate Demon Beast, but... an Advanced Demon Beast!!
She kept retreating, safeguarding the people in front of her, and then looked to the side to see Song Junior Brother there.
Wang Susu was surprised to see him.
Song Yan gave her a knowingly smile.
Wang Susu smiled in return, finally understanding why Junior Brother was still alive...
However, after Song Yan put away his smile, a strong sense of dissatisfaction arose in his heart.
Last night, to kill Gu Rufeng, he manifested the Hundred Forms Demon Body, but this "Hundred Forms Demon Body" was only the form of "eight low-level little Demon Beasts." If not for that... it wouldn’t have left such obvious marks during the action.
Despite heavy snowfall overnight, the marks were not fully covered!
Once things settle here, he needs to find a way to obtain some Advanced Demon Beast skins.
The "Hundred Forms Demon Body," a magic he had spent thousands of years refining, although self-invented, its power and growth were unparalleled.
The stronger the Shadow Puppet, the stronger he becomes.
He needs better Demon Beast skins!
...
...
After a day of searching, Gu Rufeng’s corpse was finally found.
At this moment, the corpse lay at the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, filled with flowing Evil Qi, with ghostly creatures hidden deep within its flesh.
Gu Tianyang angrily raised a finger, causing many ghosts to flee, but they weakened in the sunlight.
The strike to the chest was the fatal wound.
Gu Tianyang lowered his head, brushing over the wound, his eyes thoughtful.
"Any discoveries?"
Stone Seat Elder stood by, whether truly or feigned, his expression deeply pained, feeling the sorrow of an elder sending off a younger, as Gu Rufeng was his disciple...
Gu Tianyang said, "Stone Master, can’t you tell?"
Stone Seat Elder replied, "Though the body was attacked by Evil Qi, the fatal wound is on the chest, this is... a sword wound. Five years ago, I remember, Peak Master, you gave him a sword."
Gu Tianyang said, "That was a very good Flying Sword, a trophy I seized! This wound matches that sword’s width exactly!!"
Suddenly, flames surged in his eyes, and he said, "It can only be someone closest to Little Feng who killed him when his guard was down!!"
Stone Seat Elder was stunned.
Gu Tianyang said, "It wasn’t you!"
Stone Seat Elder was even more stunned: "Not me?"
Gu Tianyang patted his shoulder, saying, "Stone Master, some things need offending."
He clicked his tongue and then, with fierce eyes, said, "It’s your Dao companion — Bi Huayi. I suspect her, and I want to search her soul!!"
Stone Seat Elder was unsurprised, simply sighed and said, "I know about her and Little Feng. I owe her a lot... Peak Master Gu, could you spare her life? She would never harm Little Feng."
Gu Tianyang looked at him oddly, then shook his head, saying, "Sorry for this one, consider it me owing you a favor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 48. Senior Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: 48. Senior Brother
Late at night...
Shadow Puppet Peak, dungeon.
The terrified Bi Huayi faced a direct "Soul Search."
If it were someone else, they wouldn’t escape a round of torture beforehand.
But after all, this was the Dao companion of Stone Master, respect was still needed.
Stone Seat Elder stood aside, coldly watching.
Gu Tianyang withdrew his finger, raised his head, frowned, as if digesting the information he just saw, then turned his head and glanced at Stone Seat Elder, saying, "Don’t worry, I’m very measured. She’s not demented, but from now on she can’t cultivate, occasionally her mind will have some minor issues."
Stone Seat Elder said with a grim face: "That still needs to thank Gu Peak Master for your mercy."
Gu Tianyang suddenly couldn’t help laughing, laughed until the fire in the corner trembled, making the shadows of the people on the stone wall flicker and distort.
Stone Seat Elder said: "Gu Peak Master, are you still mocking this old man?"
Gu Tianyang laughed and said, "If you knew what I saw in her memory, you would wish I had killed her."
Then, he suddenly frowned, squinted towards the serious old man not far away, asked, "Do you know she wanted to poison you? And it was just in these few days."
Stone Seat Elder was stunned in place, his pupils somewhat frozen, slowly revealing sadness, then lowered his head with a self-mocking sigh, shook his head, said "I truly didn’t know," then asked: "Have you found out the cause of Feng’Er’s death?"
Gu Tianyang’s expression was profound, but he shook his head, saying: "No."
The air became silent.
Gu Tianyang waved his hand suddenly, said: "Stone Master, don’t think too much, you are getting older, you should go rest well, Sect Leader is still expecting you to cultivate a new generation of Skin Masters for the sect."
Stone Seat Elder nodded slightly, stepped forward to support Bi Huayi, said gently: "Let’s go."
Bi Huayi trembled violently, her unfocused pupils looked around in panic, her fingers flailing like a drowning person, after touching the old man’s clothes, she grabbed tightly, not letting go.
Stone Seat Elder smiled gently, then led her away slowly from this eerie dark dungeon.
In the dungeon...
Gu Tianyang’s expression was sinister, murmured: "Bi Huayi and Feng’Er wanted to poison you, and what they were after was your legacy.
If I asked why you didn’t pass on the legacy to Feng’Er, you would surely say it’s not the right time, or some nonsense like just a few days.
Why didn’t you pass it on to Feng’Er?
With Feng’Er dead, the one who benefits most is you!
You escaped disaster in those few days.
What secrets do you have?"
For a long time...
"You still need to cultivate Skin Masters now, if I moved against you, Sect Leader wouldn’t go easy on me.
But wait for two more years, until you’re a bit older... I’ll certainly give you a Soul Search too, see what’s really going on! Filthy old thing!"
...
...
The next day.
Antitoxic Elixir was delivered to Song Yan, he casually placed it into the Storage Space, then went with Wang Susu to pay respects to the current South Bamboo Peak Master — Stone Seat Elder.
However, they did not meet him.
So, Song Yan and Wang Susu easily went to the Skinning Cave Mansion, but at the door, Wang Susu went in while Song Yan was stopped.Thɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
The disciple blocking the door smiled looking at him, said: "Song... Song what was it again? I don’t remember, that’s not important! I’ve heard about you, you were distracted in Stone Master’s class, Stone Master hasn’t forgiven you yet! Wait until he forgives you, then you can enter."
He was trying hard to flatter Peak Master, while trying to establish his authority here through small matters.
Wang Susu had just stepped through the door when she paused.
At her pause, three or four disciples in the Tannery stood up together.
These disciples all emerged during wartime, naturally bonded together, full of hostility.
In their eyes, people like Song Yan and Wang Susu who went out to avoid disaster were from another circle, needing to be stepped on. After all... who is the senior brother and who is the junior brother on this mountain, has not been decided yet.
The air became somewhat stagnant.
And just at this moment, a disciple’s voice suddenly came from outside the door.
"Stone Master is calling everyone!"
Song Yan and the guard disciple exchanged glances, then turned and left.
...
...
After Stone Master returned with Bi Huayi, he directly called the disciples, then took paper and brush and quietly waited, he didn’t look at Song Yan.
Disciples gathered in a circle waiting, not daring to speak.
Before long, quite a few Official Disciples arrived using Shadow Puppets, then walked to a place near Stone Master, respectfully saluting. These were the new Skin Masters or provisional Skin Masters of Shadow Puppet Peak, all trained during wartime.
Stone Master saw everyone was present, then pasted the paper on the stone wall, began to personally teach the "Skin Painting Technique."
"Skin painting requires divine insight, only by comprehending the divine likeness can it be rendered perfect, let me demonstrate, watch carefully..."
Saying that, he grasped the brush.
At this moment, he seemed to transform from a declining old man into one filled with strength.
Everyone quietly watched.
After the painting was finished, there was a round of questions and answers.
Then Stone Master said: "I came to South Bamboo Peak because it is filled with the new blood of my Shadow Puppet Peak, but ultimately we need to establish a hierarchy of seniority. No time like the present, let’s settle it today."
Saying that, he clapped his hands, and aside from the disciples from Shadow Puppet Peak, each disciple from South Bamboo Peak was given a set of paper and brush.
Stone Master said: "The double-headed wolf is what you all have painted the most. Today, let this painting determine rank. In one hour, the best painting wins."
...
The topic was announced.
Everyone bowed their heads and began painting with all their might.
Song Yan thought about his skill from five years ago, added one or two points to that, and then slowly painted. He barely finished near the end of the hour and hastily "submitted" it, with a look of regret. When Wang Susu asked, he only said, "I didn’t paint well." The disciple blocking the door sneered at him, then looked expectantly into the distance.
But soon, the evaluation results came out. Stone Master picked up a piece of paper and commented, "This is the best!" Everyone looked and saw it was indeed Song Yan’s. The gatekeeping disciple turned pale, muttering, "Impossible, impossible"... but then took a deep breath, ran over, and bowed his head, calling out, "Brother Song." Song Yan nodded, and the previous grudge was considered resolved.
Not far away, Stone Master was scrutinizing Song Yan, as if recalling something, and after a while, furrowed his brows and said, "I remember now, aren’t you the disciple who wasn’t paying attention in Linglong Valley that day?"
Song Yan, ashamed and fearful, said, "Disciple knows his mistake."
Stone Master snorted coldly and said, "Forget it, right now the sect needs people. You must work diligently and become a Skin Master as soon as possible."
"Yes!"
"Come, let me introduce you to some fellow disciples." Stone Master beckoned.
Three Official Disciples from Shadow Puppet Peak immediately stepped forward, two men and one woman.
"Eldest brother, Wen Shu."
The person was just like their name, gentle and refined.
"Second sister, Jin Yuntian."
Her face was lovely, though it was unclear whether she was like Wang Susu, a demoness.
"Third brother, also my adopted son, Shi Peng."
A simple-looking face, most respectful towards Stone Master.
"These are ones I’ve taken in over the years; the previous ones... have all gone to the Evil Land. You... have some talent, so get close to your senior brothers and sisters in the future."
...
...
Several days later...
Late at night.
The moon dark, the wind high...
After returning to the Cave Mansion, Song Yan saw a black crow flying out from the shadows and landing on the stone table.
Song Yan knew this bodiless phantom crow had just entered the cave with him.
He sat down by the stone table and looked at the crow.
The crow spoke in an old voice, "Don’t recognize me?"
Song Yan affectionately called, "Teacher."
The crow said coldly, "Redraw the double-headed wolf!"
Song Yan smiled, took up paper and pen, made a few brush strokes, expanding slightly on the skill he had shown earlier, then exhaled a long breath and said, "I didn’t expect to be noticed by the teacher that day."
The crow frowned and said, "Draw again!"
Song Yan quickly drew again, this time increasing his skill slightly, then said, "This is all my skill can do."
The crow squinted at him and said, "Keep drawing!"
Song Yan thought for a moment, cautiously increased by one more level, concentrated, and meticulously finished, then wiped his sweat and looked at the crow, then eagerly at his drawing, excitedly said, "I didn’t expect to perform beyond normal in front of the teacher... Is this really something I can draw?!"
The crow: ...
He always remembered those many, many double-headed wolf drawings from five years ago, with two starting strokes that were stunning and perfect.
It was those two strokes that passed on the legacy.
However, what Song Yan painted now was excellent, but not at that level.
Its eyes fixed quietly on the drawing, then sighed, "The old man has one foot in the grave, can’t you make me happy?"
Song Yan was silent for a moment, took up the pen, and drew, a circle appeared.
Half a wolf’s eye leaped onto the paper, eerie and cold, like the eyes of a real demon beast in the snow forest.
But unfortunately, what followed was a case of a "dog’s tail continuing it."
The "dog’s tail" was starting to show.
The crow suddenly realized the disciple’s intention, swatted with a claw, sending Song Yan’s pen flying, and then jumped up angrily saying, "Stop drawing, stop drawing! The old man understands!"
Song Yan innocently scratched his head.
The crow perched again, admiring that half eye.
At this moment he understood: the legacy was not wrongly passed! This kid, talented and knew how to conceal his strength, indeed the best candidate to inherit his legacy! The heights he could reach in the future were sure to surpass his own!
Subsequently...
The crow continued instructing, "Wen Shu, Jin Yuntian have backgrounds in the sect, my arrangement is to give you some backing, to avoid being bullied in the future. As for Shi Peng..."
It sighed slightly, a complex tone, "I saved him from a pile of corpses, his life was given by me.
He has talent, but not much.
I took him as an adopted son for other reasons, you don’t have to befriend him."
Song Yan did not ask the reason, directly replied, "Yes, Teacher."
The crow showed a soft expression, kindly looking at the "little fellow" before him, saying, "Your Cave Mansion is too desolate, tomorrow take a simplified version of the ’Profound Qi Guiding Technique’ to the chores room for transmission of skills, and bring back a Furnace by the way.
Use that Furnace, and when it’s done, choose a new one. If you don’t choose first, no one else is allowed to choose."
Song Yan was stunned...
Fortune’s wheel is turning, he... is about to become a stronger, more unscrupulous version of Brother Zhang...
```

chapters.title: Chapter 49. Revisiting
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: 49. Revisiting
Once again, it was an empty Cave Mansion, only this time Song Yan was somewhat more accustomed to it than when he first arrived. At least the threats he could see on the surface had temporarily vanished, and he had become the senior brother of South Bamboo Peak.
However, he soon found some annoyances.
Because he learned that Gu Rufeng’s body was eventually found. After that, he didn’t know what happened. He only vaguely knew that the "mistress" seemed to be somewhat deranged, which was evidently due to Soul Search.
It seemed that the Peak Master Gu indeed doted on Gu Rufeng, even daring to perform Soul Search on Shi Shi’s partner.
This matter hadn’t ended and instead...led to some direction he couldn’t discern clearly.
What could that be?
In fact, he had considered killing Gu Rufeng during the "recruitment" period, but doing so would have dragged the accompanying disciples, including himself, into it. He also thought about destroying Gu Rufeng’s corpse in Cuique Forest, but because the last people to interact with Gu Rufeng were "recruitment disciples," he might still get caught up.
Therefore, he chose to have Gu Rufeng die at the Earth Demon.
At this moment, Song Yan lay alone on the stone platform in the Cave Mansion, looking up at the skylight.
After some time, he murmured to himself: ’Still have to strive to become stronger.’
...
...
The next day, it was sunny.
As soon as Song Yan stepped out of the Cave Mansion, he saw five strong disciples gathered at the door.
These five disciples were the same group who blocked him a few days ago.
Song Yan frowned slightly, and the leading disciple suddenly smiled obsequiously, nodded, bowed, and ran over, respectfully calling out, "Senior Brother Song."
The other four big guys laughed awkwardly as they scratched their heads and called out, "Senior Brother."
Song Yan asked, "What’s the matter?"
The leading disciple rubbed his hands, exhaled and approached, smiling, "Senior Brother Song, it’s like this. We juniors have thought things over and would like to formally apologize to you.
Of course, this isn’t just an empty apology! From now on, we will hand over thirty percent of our Contribution Points from the Tannery to you."
As he spoke, he showed a pained expression.
Song Yan said, "Lu Haiyi, right?"
"Exactly, exactly, Senior Brother knows my name," the leading disciple said with a smile.
Song Yan replied, "Just give ten percent."
"Thank you, Senior Brother!" Lu Haiyi and his group quickly expressed their gratitude.
Originally, they wouldn’t have gone to such lengths, but early that day, they heard that from now on, the daily affairs within South Bamboo Peak would be managed by this Senior Brother Song. They panicked and thus hurried to offer their flattery to completely smooth over past grievances.
What does "daily affairs" mean?
It’s about the distribution! For example, when good Furnaces become available, if your senior brother takes one, but doesn’t share it with you, what can you do? Go cry to the Peak Master?Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Or you try to "persuade" him with your fists? But Senior Brother Song was admitted under Shi Shi! Who dares?
At this moment, Lu Haiyi pounded his chest proudly, saying, "Senior Brother is so righteous! Only taking ten percent, which truly makes me admire Lu."
Lu, today, swear an oath right here!
From now on, I’m just a dog for Senior Brother!!
Anyone who offends Senior Brother has to go through me first! Woof! Woof woof!"
The group of disciples followed up fiercely, "So are we, woof woof!"
Song Yan:...
He had a slight feeling of sentimentality: The waves behind push the waves ahead in the Yangtze River. Back then, he only gave some Contribution Points to Senior Brother Zhang, but this group of people was even more intense.
Sycophancy, bullying the weak and fearing the strong, cronyism, without bottom-line seemed to be the traditions of the Demon Sect.
Unless you become the Puppet Sect Leader, trying to "keep yourself clean" here meant severing oneself, that is... courting death.
He glanced at them, smiling warmly, and said, "We are all senior and junior brothers here. Be courteous to each other daily. If you have the energy, direct it outside, don’t harm our own people."
Lu Haiyi praised, "Profound wisdom! Senior Brother Song’s words have truly opened my eyes. Reflecting on the past, I feel really ashamed and have nowhere to hide, sigh!"
The group of disciples also showed expressions of embarrassment.
Song Yan:...
He lost interest in chatting, casually exchanged a few words with them, and went to look at the Tannery.
Even though there were wars in these years, there still were quite a few Demon Beast Skins. But, these Demon Beast Skins weren’t purchased from Qingxi Market but obtained during the wars.
Unfortunately, all the complete ones were low-level Demon Beast Skins.
As for intermediate ones, there were some, but most were tattered, indicating the person handling them had difficulty controlling their strength.
Using such tattered skins to make Shadow Puppets results in compromised quality, and the success rate of Summoning would be relatively low.
...
...
After a brief patrol, Song Yan took a reduced version of the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," and then, accompanied by Wang Susu, Lu Haiyi, and a disciple named Shangguan Jian, went to test it at the Tannery.
Lu Haiyi and Shangguan Jian were two "big brothers" of South Bamboo Peak over the past five years.
Now, since Peak Master Shi officially appointed a "senior brother."
These two "big brothers" naturally knew better and voluntarily adjusted their "self-perception," descending to become the "second brother."
But there can be only one second brother.
Who would be the "second brother"... this annoying thing, Song Yan didn’t want to overly interfere.
Keeping the balance, let the two fight it themselves, he would just uphold fairness and act as the referee.
Before he transmigrated, he had watched plenty of palace dramas and dynasty dramas; he was familiar with such "balancing" tactics.
As expected, on the way to the Tannery’s Chores Room, these two "former big brothers" began to compete with each other.
Shangguan Jian’s face was gloomy, showing a "you all owe me three million gold taels" expression, saying things like "Lu Haiyi is a scoundrel, all smiles in front, stabbing in the back, Senior Brother be careful."
Lu Haiyi, with a face full of evil aura, repeatedly declared, "Shangguan Jian is ambitious, long coveting the position of Senior Brother, while I just want to cultivate properly. Brother Song is so righteous, I’m sticking with Brother Song."
Wang Susu looked at this former junior brother, now senior brother, and quickly adjusted her position, listening to the quarrel between the two "former big brothers," giggling coquettishly, fueling the fire, making their argument even fiercer.
When Song Yan was alone, he felt that even though he was in the Demon Sect, he was actually quite normal.
But now, being surrounded by three "proper Demon Sect disciples," thinking about what he was about to do, he couldn’t help but feel a bit dazed.
He, Song, is this also being tainted by the mud while being in the mud?
...
...
The Tannery hasn’t changed much from before.
After Song Yan arrived at the mountaintop, Lu Haiyi moved a large rock for the Senior Brother to sit down, then glared at Shangguan Jian, saying, "Are you the senior brother? Doing nothing? Why don’t you transmit the skills instead?"
Shangguan Jian snorted coldly, respectfully saying, "Brother Song, I’ll go call those servants."
He had just taken two steps when Wang Susu enthusiastically ran off, waving her hand and coyly shouting, "Newcomers, those who haven’t undergone the second test, come on~~"
She was enchanting in the mountain wind, swaying with a unique charm. Though not young, perhaps due to cultivation or the abundance of Furnace Ji Yuan, she seemed even younger and more alluring compared to when Song Yan first saw her.
Many male servants, hearing this enthusiastic voice and seeing her seductive figure, couldn’t keep their eyes from flying towards this demoness.
Meanwhile, Wang Susu was swiftly selecting a new "Furnace."
Soon, she set her sights on a tall, strong young lad, beckoning him over. The young lad, feeling flattered and shocked, came forward, and the two started chatting. Before long, they were holding hands, the young lad’s face filled with excitement, his speech becoming breathless.
Song Yan then began to emulate Senior Brother Zhang from years ago, testing everyone.
The sights of the past reappeared.
Also allowing him to once again realize the sensitivity and fragility of the Divine Soul.
Those without a Profound Root couldn’t even withstand the extremely weak "Spiritual Shock" of a weakened Cultivation Technique, let alone the full version... wouldn’t that drive a lot of people mad?
After half a day, the testing was over.
Only four people successfully acquired a Cultivation Method.
Song Yan then methodically explained the rules and began selecting Furnaces.
He glanced at Senior Sister Wang, who was still "pretending to be a pure little girl falling in love," and then at Shangguan Jian and Lu Haiyi, who were also scanning the surroundings.
Clearly, the privilege of picking the first fresh one belonged to these "big brothers and second brothers" of South Bamboo Peak.
However, no matter who wanted to pick someone, they all needed to consult him.
And those three also occasionally glanced at him, seemingly waiting for him to announce the rules.
Song Yan summoned the three and softly said, "You all should know my past, I’m not one to waste Furnaces, remember a rule no matter who you pick today."
"Once taken, they need to be cherished. Remember to use things like Strengthening Ginseng Pill to supplement them. If someone squeezes them dry or forces them to suicide in haste, then wait three months to find a new Furnace."
The three Demon Sect disciples fell silent hearing the rule.
Shangguan Jian showed a difficult expression.
Lu Haiyi forced a smile, saying, "I told you Brother Song is righteous."
Wang Susu blinked her big eyes and said, "Senior Brother, what if... they want me to squeeze them dry hastily?"
Shangguan Jian: ???
Lu Haiyi: ???
Wang Susu waved at the distance, and though the young man looked afraid, seeing Wang Susu’s pretty face, he mustered the courage to come over.
Wang Susu showed a sorrowful expression, gently saying, "Are you willing to give your all for me, go through fire and water?"
The young man said, "Willing!!"
Wang Susu waved again, and the young man went further away, but his eyes stayed glued to Wang Susu.
Wang Susu covered her mouth, giggling, "Oh Senior Brother, and I haven’t even used Fanatic Fans yet."
Song Yan said helplessly, "Just don’t let me see or hear anything bad."
The three hurriedly replied respectfully, "Yes."
Song Yan waved and said, "Alright, you guys can go back for now. Today I’ll finish searching, you can come back tomorrow."
The three weren’t surprised.
At South Bamboo Peak, the Senior Brother gets the first taste, and these three, very evidently, get the second.
Not bad either.
So, the three left first.
Song Yan began his search.
His goal was simple: newly arrived single women who weren’t dead yet, or pairs of women living together. He would then pick the one he felt a connection with.
He knew himself well, whoever he chose wouldn’t die, at least not from "Furnace matters," and would still have a chance to return to the mundane world and reunite with family.
But he also didn’t know if this was good or bad for the woman.
Perhaps being abducted to South Bamboo Peak was already misfortune.
Or perhaps being born in this chaotic world was the source of misfortune.
Song Yan’s mind wasn’t really here, but he had to find a Furnace, otherwise, he couldn’t explain his cultivation.
He planned to finish this quickly, then figure out where to get "advanced Demon Beast Skin."
That was the main issue he was eager to solve.
If it didn’t work out, he was considering earning more Profound Jade and resorting to the "Snake Corpse Market" route.
Relying on distant means for urgent issues wasn’t sensible, too many turnovers, unstable supply, too many variables.
Unless absolutely necessary, Song Yan didn’t plan to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 50. Master and Servant
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: 50. Master and Servant
Song Yan quickly determined his target.
At dusk, he intercepted the two women on their way back. Before he could speak, one of them volunteered, "Immortal Elder, whatever it is, find me, just don’t harm our young lady!"
Song Yan looked and saw that the woman had a slightly dark face, with a not too appealing mole on her cheek, and a tuft of short hair sprouting from its center.
The woman she referred to as young lady, however, had fair skin and a pristine face. Despite being a servant, her hair was intricately coiled and pinned with a wooden hairpin. Her appearance was exquisite and delicate, and while not curvy, she could still be described as a modest beauty.
The two women shared a room, it was evident that both the servant and the young lady had been captured together, and the servant was still loyally defending her mistress.
At this moment, the servant stepped forward and said, "Immortal Elder, if there is something, let it be me."
Song Yan raised his hand and placed it on the servant’s shoulder.
Logically, with such an annoying and unsightly servant blocking the way, anyone looking for a furnace would probably push her aside, and if short-tempered, would even shout "Get lost, ugly thing."
But Song Yan gently patted the servant’s shoulder and said, "Alright, it’s you, come with me."
Servant: ???
Young Lady: ???The source of thɪs content is ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
The previously silent young lady suddenly stepped forward and mournfully said, "Huan’Er, you’ve been with me for years. I can’t let you take my place today. I... I’ll go myself."
The young lady suddenly moved in front of the servant, looked at Song Yan, and calmly said, "I’ll go with you."
Song Yan paused briefly, then smiled and said, "Forget it," before walking away.
The two women looked at each other, then quietly sighed in relief and quickly returned to the Suspended Room, pulling up the curtain.
As darkness fell, the woman dressed as a young lady showed a puzzled expression and said softly, "That person..."
The dark-faced servant made a "shh" gesture and then said, "Young lady has had a long day, let this servant massage your shoulders."
...
...
Night fell.
Blood-red Evil Qi spread with the mountain mist, gradually filling the massive space between the cliffs, and swallowed the Suspended Room atop the cliff.
In one of the Suspended Rooms.
The woman who had been dressed as a young lady during the day now sat vigilantly on the roof, her back against the door, and softly said, "Empress, the King of Wei didn’t say you escaped, only that you are bedridden in the back palace, convalescing."
"King of Wei? He’s not! He’s unworthy!"
The woman who had been dressed as a servant during the day now washed away the dust and wiped off the mole, looking extremely charming. Her fierce temperament was like a wild horse, yet she sighed, "He... changed. He was so talented and promising in his youth, guarding the frontier and counterattacking Great Jin.
But he killed Cao Shiyin on the street, then stooped to become a traitor, deceiving the Northern Land’s people, rearing humans for demons!
I misjudged, I wish I could kill him!
He needs the support of my maternal family, so naturally, he wouldn’t admit I ran away.
I tried to warn my family, but fate brought me here, captured by the Puppet Sect."
"It’s okay, Empress, I’ve already found out that due to the war, the entrances and exits of the marketplace at the foot of the mountain aren’t well-guarded...
If we take advantage of the day to go down the mountain to purchase goods, then sneak away at night, there is still hope.
By then... I’ll cover for you, you’ll definitely be able to escape.
During this time, I’ve secretly memorized the map outside, I’ll draw it for you to remember."
The two women cautiously talked through the night but were unaware of a figure nearby spreading his perception, silently listening.
The red mist passed by, ghosts brushing past yet ignoring that figure.
The figure had completely melted into this mournful ghostly mist.
This was Song Yan.
He heard the two women’s plan and silently shook his head.
Outside the marketplace, the canyon was long, the roads singular, and Evil Qi hovered, escaping by night was impossible... and there were secret sentries on the mountainside, with troops from Jin Dynasty waiting to deploy outside.
The Empress might go through immense hardship passing through the market but wouldn’t survive the next obstacle, ending up as nothing more than a mound of yellow earth, leaving only pitiful bleached bones.
As for this Empress’s identity, he had already understood.
The former Crown Prince of the South Tranquilizing King, later the Grand General, now the wife of the King of Wei, and current Empress of Great Wei — Fu Shirong.
During the day, she disguised herself as an ugly servant, while her bodyguard posed as the young lady, trying to avoid some calamities.
Song Yan lowered his head in thought.
These days, he also attempted to learn about the Northern Land situation.
But even Lu Haiyi and Shangguan Jian, who participated in combat, couldn’t clearly explain the Multi-tailed Fox Race, let alone others.
In wartime, what they did was merely oppose some small Demon Beasts.
Yet, the words "Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox" inexplicably attracted Song Yan.
He was both fearful and eager to know more, even wondering if he could skin a fox to make Shadow Puppets, adding some power to his "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
And this... is there a better way than asking the person involved directly?
...
...
Before dawn.
Fu Shirong put on simple, ugly makeup, carefully sticking the mole, then lowered her head and followed the "young lady" out of the Suspended Room.
She had just stepped out when she noticed the "young lady" stopped walking.
Fu Shirong was about to inquire when she suddenly saw the figure of the man who blocked their way yesterday evening.
"Ordinary looking, secretly cunning"...
Fu Shirong gave this evaluation in her heart but took a deep breath and stepped forward, "Immortal Elder..."
This time, before she could speak, Song Yan said, "Both of you, come with me."
Fu Shirong: ???
Female Guard: ???
The two women wanted to say more, but Song Yan had already said, "Follow along."
Fu Shirong quietly clenched her fist, then released it.
The female guard took the initiative, saying, "Immortal elder, if there’s anything, I can accompany you."
She then continued, "Huan’Er, you help me finish today’s shadow puppet work, don’t delay the main task, now go!"
Song Yan interrupted, "I said, come together."
The two women turned pale.
From a height, Wang Susu supported her chin, giggling, "Interesting, there are still people who don’t want to follow. But it’s understandable, Brother Song’s face is really plain. If it’s... Lu Junior Brother, what are you doing?"
Next to her, Lu Haiyi was quickly jotting down notes, writing "Wang Susu says Brother Song is ugly"?
Seeing Wang Susu looking, he didn’t put away the notebook, lightly saying, "Show some respect to Brother Song, don’t badmouth him behind his back."
Wang Susu asked curiously, "Are you really the one who stopped Brother Song that day?"
Lu Haiyi replied, "No."
"No?"
"The Lu you knew that day is dead, the Lu here now is a reborn Lu."
"Hehe..." Wang Susu covered her mouth laughing, "Tear up the paper, or if things get messy, we’ll see who has a better relationship with Brother Song, you or I."
Lu Haiyi gave a sly smile, "Come on."
Wang Susu squinted at him, when she saw Shangguan Jian appear, she beamed and ran over, saying, "Shangguan Junior Brother is here too."
Shangguan Jian glanced at the two of them, that "deadpan face" also broke into a shady smile, stepping forward to reply, "Yes, Wang Senior Sister."
...
...
Song Yan, while talking to the two women, also heard the "three-person confrontation" not far away.
He felt quite emotional inside.
Indeed, there is controversy everywhere, but fortunately, he doesn’t need to get involved in it...
Elsewhere...
After a powerless commotion, Fu Shirong and the female guard reluctantly followed Song Yan away.
Once Song Yan left, the three eager to take a second sip of the soup impatiently walked into the Tannery Chores Room.
...
...
Golden sunlight slanted through the skylight of the Cave Mansion, casting a faint, serene light.
Profound Qi diffused from the stone, bringing a sense of calm to the heart.
Song Yan said "Forgive me," then directly administered Fanatic Fans powder to the two women.
The two women had extraordinary martial arts, especially Fu Shirong, whose power had already reached the level of the "Four Sparrows of Celestial Cloud City."
However, after a few breaths, they still couldn’t escape the clutches and were successfully drugged.
"Scoundrel!"
Fu Shirong shouted angrily, raising her hand elegantly, her two fingers like scissors, stabbing towards Song Yan’s neck.
The female guard also attacked from the other side, but only halfway through, she weakly withdrew her hand, a strange, dreamy thought swirling in her heart.
Song Yan didn’t display martial arts, only using rough power to dodge Fu Shirong’s attacks.
He ran, she chased.
One must say, the will of this Great Wei Empress is truly the strongest he’s ever witnessed, whether it was the Princess Consort of the South Suppressing King before, or the later Hua Linglong, none could endure as long as she.
This battle surprisingly lasted for nearly half an incense stick’s time.
Fu Shirong finally stopped, glaring hatefully at Song Yan, but she no longer attacked.
The Fanatic Fans powder crafted by cultivators ultimately overpowered her mortal will.
The two stared big eyes at small, while the female guard was already twisting her long legs, tearfully looking at Song Yan.
Song Yan pointed to the stone cave bedroom on the side, saying, "From now on, you will sleep there."
Fu Shirong gritted her teeth, forcibly suppressing the itch in her heart, she dragged the female guard hastily into the cave.
...
...
In the blink of an eye, several days passed.
Fu Shirong and the female guard also confessed their identities.
It turned out Fu Shirong was indeed the Great Wei Empress, and also an important figure in the "Fu Clan Faction."
The "Fu Clan Faction" was a large family, bridging politics, business, and Jianghu, and wielded influence in both black and white realms, even housing loose cultivators within.
The female guard, named Fu Hongmian, though sharing the surname Fu, was vastly different from Fu Shirong in identity, status, talent, and power.
Song Yan then said, "If you want to escape from the market, that’s impossible. Outside lies a long serpent path in the gorge with Evil Qi and hidden sentries, and beyond that, Jin Dynasty’s army."
Fu Shirong looked at him, forcing out a cold voice, "Thank you, Song Lang, for the rescue anyway."
Song Yan asked, "I want to know about the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox, what’s happening in the Northern Land...?"
Fu Shirong remained silent.
Fu Hongmian, however, said, "Madam, Song Lang has actually been quite kind to us, just tell him."
Her willpower was weak, and newly influenced by the Fanatic Fans, over the few days, she had already completely succumbed. Though she was consciously clear it was wrong, she couldn’t help but constantly think about being intimate with Song Yan, and thus, at this moment, she found herself directly siding with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 51. Grandma Fox
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: 51. Grandma Fox
Even though Fu Hongmian assisted, the Empress still refused to reveal any information.
...
That night...
"Scoundrel!"
"Stop, scoundrel!"
"Mmm...mmm..."
After a long while, the sudden downpour ceased. "Everyone thinks the Empress who is still in the Imperial Capital" lay paralyzed here, her pretty face filled with hatred, her almond-shaped eyes burning with fire, yet her long legs were tightly entwined with a man she had known for only a few days.
"Scoundrel!"
The Empress closed her eyes, cursing hatefully.
Song Yan quite admired her; she was the only one who could, after taking the fanatic fans potion, still let her strong will overpower the power of a cultivator. It was a victory of personal will.
If it were him, he couldn’t do it.
She was a wild and unruly flaming rouge horse.
No wonder, after the Grand General became the King of Wei, she not only didn’t enjoy wealth and stability but also took a life-risking decision to leave the Imperial Capital indignantly, aiming to awaken the people of the Northern Land, while provoking her family’s hostility against the King of Wei and that Fox Ancestor.
These events were long told to him by the Empress’s guard, Fu Hongmian, but the more secretive matters... Fu Hongmian did not know.
Song Yan said, "You..."
In the darkness, the Empress angrily said, "Scoundrel!"
Song Yan wasn’t angry, he just continued, "Tell me, why did you get caught? If you hadn’t been caught, you wouldn’t be in this situation now."
The Empress said coldly, "It was fate, falling into your hands, I have no words to say."
Song Yan said, "In the tannery servant room, if I don’t take you away, do you think you could survive?"
The Empress was silent for a moment.
If this young demon disciple was telling the truth, then her and Hongmian’s plan was truly a dead end. The Earth Demon, the hidden sentries, and the cavalry, each was enough to take her life.
Song Yan said, "If I took you away, doesn’t it mean I saved your life?"
The Empress’s phoenix eyes opened wide, angrily saying, "Scoundrel!"
Song Yan said calmly, "I am just reasoning with you, we need to talk about reason, don’t we?"
After finishing speaking, he continued, "You and Hongmian have been evasive, unlike others who, after being taken by an Official Disciple, are extremely happy, it is because you hold high status in the Mortal World, so you know many things, and also know... the only outcome of being brought here is to be harvested.
However, have you ever considered things from another angle?
If I bring you here, and if I don’t harvest you, then... how do I perform cultivation?
And if you don’t appear weakened by the harvesting, how do I explain it to my fellow disciples?
In this matter, you have no choice.
The same goes for me.
I saved your lives, but I also need to do what I must do, isn’t that the truth?"
The Empress was silent for a moment, then suddenly said, "Then why don’t you let go?"
Song Yan reminded, "Pay close attention, is it you entangling me, or me entangling you?"
The Empress was momentarily stunned, in the darkness, it was uncertain if her cheeks turned rosy, but she answered with actions.
She suddenly withdrew her legs, raised them, lightly kicked Song Yan’s chest with her small foot, and with the momentum of this kick, she wrapped herself in the quilt and spun down to the ground, then quickly put on her shoes and swiftly speeded towards another stone cave.
...
...
The next day, early.
Because Song Yan had casually mentioned once that he "quite missed the taste of rice from avoiding disasters in the Mortal World," Wang Susu directly led her tall and handsome "little puppy" to deliver grains.
When the stone door opened, Song Yan saw Wang Susu standing in the doorway, and the "little puppy" carrying a bag of rice, and couldn’t help saying, "Junior Sister Wang, you..."
Wang Susu sweetly said, "Junior Sister suddenly missed the aroma of rice in the mortal world, so I went down to the market at the foot of the mountain yesterday and bought two bags of pearl rice. I had some last night and it left a lingering aroma, so I thought of Senior Brother and came first thing this morning."
After speaking, she gently coughed.
The little puppy quickly brought in the rice, his steps unsteady as he walked, with a dazed look.
Wang Susu laughed, "Senior Brother, you should try some too."
Song Yan lowered his voice and said, "Senior Sister, we don’t need to do this."
Wang Susu was taken aback, gave Song Yan a profound look, and sighed lightly, "You..."
During this conversation, the little puppy had already placed the rice on the stone table in the hall, then hurriedly retreated outside, standing behind Wang Susu.
Song Yan said, "Thank you, Junior Sister, for the rice delivery."
Wang Susu giggled, "As long as Senior Brother likes it."
...
...
Fu Hongmian took the rice and cooked some porridge.
The rice was new, exuding a fresh fragrance.
The Empress gazed at the rice, but did not eat. Even though Fu Hongmian called her several times, she remained sullenly leaning against the stone wall in the cave, looking up at the skylight, lost in thought.
After a long time, she suddenly said, "What I know, your Puppet Sect’s Sect Leader and Peak Master must also know. If you want to use this information to earn credit, it’s a futile effort."
Song Yanqi said, "Who said I was trying to earn credit?"
The Empress frowned and said, "Then what do you intend to do?
Although you are a disciple of the sect, to put it bluntly, you are just at the very bottom of this sect.
Whereas I, though a mortal, have the world at heart and play with the winds and clouds.
You are stronger than me, and you enslaved me, but my vision and temperament are not something you can compare to."
She raised her fair neck, like a proud plum blossom in snowy cold.
Fu Hongmian didn’t speak, just lowered her head to eat the porridge, but in her heart, she felt the same.
The Demon Sect disciple named Song Yan may have control over their lives, but within the Sect, he’s just at the bottom tier, so it’s impossible for his perspective to match that of the Empress.
Song Yan couldn’t help but laugh.
The Empress asked, "What are you laughing at? Are you mocking me for being like a phoenix stranded on a shallow shore, being toyed with by shrimp, and yet refusing to adapt, unable to see the situation clearly?"
Song Yan laughed and said, "Alright, alright, Your Majesty is correct.
What’s with the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox? What happened in the Northern Land? What’s the current situation?"
The topic shift was abrupt, but it clearly showed Song Yan’s indifference to her sarcasm.
The Empress praised, "I take back what I said before; your temperament isn’t that bad. But even if you understand the bigger picture, what can you do?"
The tone of praise turned into ridicule by the end.
She evidently looked down on this little Demon Sect brat.
Song Yan laughed and said, "I could escape early."
The Empress heard such an honest answer and couldn’t help but scoff, then said, "Then you’d better escape now, head south, far away, change your name, and hide in the wilderness further south than Southern Wu to live as a savage."
Song Yan asked, "Why?"
The Empress said, "Because the old Fox Grandma needs to eat a lot of people, and for you cultivators, your bodies mixed with Profound Qi are a great supplement for it."
Song Yan nodded, calmly asking, "Why does the old Fox Grandma need to eat so many people? Wouldn’t something else suffice?"
The Empress responded, "Because the Fox Grandma is having offspring, many, many offspring. Human women need to rest and nourish themselves after childbirth, let alone the old Fox Grandma, who is constantly giving birth."
"Constantly giving birth?" Song Yan was taken aback. "Isn’t that absurd?"
He recalled that, in his impression, the gestation period for foxes was about two months, so where did this "constantly" come from?
The Empress said, "That’s how it is! Every few days, the old Fox Grandma has to give birth again."
Song Yan: ...
He wondered, "Then why does the old Fox Grandma need to have so many offspring?"
The Empress said, "I don’t know, but I know that those offspring will soon need to eat. At first, just chicken, duck, and goose, then pigs, cows, and sheep, but eventually, it’ll be humans.
To them, humans are the finest delicacy. When a fox cub can eat human flesh, it means they’ve awakened the talent in their bloodline."
"What talent?"
"Illusion technique."
The Empress took a deep breath and said, "You haven’t seen it, so you can’t believe the horror of that bloodline’s illusion technique. Even a tiny fox cub can use an illusion technique to deceive you cultivators.
It can disguise itself as a charming beauty, walk down the street, brush past a cultivator, and the cultivator won’t detect its demon qi at all."
Song Yan pondered, "Maybe, that’s just a weak cultivator."
The Empress said, "That was a Great Cultivator from the Fu family, already at the eighth level of Refining Profound.
He had just left when someone got eaten. We asked if he noticed anything, and he said that if he looked carefully, he should have detected it.
That... that was just a newly-born fox cub!
What a terrifying demon!"
Song Yan said, "That Cao Zhengjing is really quite perceptive."
This Cao Zhengjing is now the King of Wei.
The Empress said angrily, "He’s a despicable man; I misjudged him!
He secretly sent his confidant to kill the second prince in broad daylight!ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
The second prince was full of bravery and justice, willingly sacrificing himself to awaken the people of the Northern Land, making them realize the royal authority was gone, and demons were in charge!
But this shameless Cao Zhengjing spun it as a farce of discontent between ruler and minister!
He personally killed his confidant to avenge the second prince and then ascended the throne himself.
Feigning good deeds, he ordered porridge shops and rice halls all over to keep the people in the cities and declared the outside dangerous, thus sealing off the cities.
Feeding the Northern Land’s lives like pigs and dogs, just to satisfy that old Fox Grandma’s taste. Unfilial! A shameless traitor!"
Song Yan thought for a moment and asked, "What does ’Multi-tailed’ mean?"
Having come this far, the Empress straightforwardly replied, "The more tails, the more powerful. The old Fox Grandma has three tails."
Song Yan curiously asked, "The maximum is nine tails?"
The Empress said, "I don’t know because only one Fox Grandma came, so there’s no comparison."
Song Yan asked again, "What does Dragon Bo mean?"
The Empress said, "I’ve vaguely heard, it’s a mysterious special bloodline."
Song Yan asked, "How big is the old Fox Grandma?"
The Empress accurately understood his meaning and directly said, "Not bigger than you."
Song Yan became even more puzzled.
Because before he transmigrated, he had the impression that the term "Dragon Bo" referred to a group of giants in mythology, standing thirty feet tall, with feet spanning the Five Mountains, fishing six coelacanths, causing mountains to sink into the sea.
So initially, when he heard "Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox", he thought this demonic fox was extraordinarily big.
The Empress continued, "But I’ve heard a loose cultivator in my family guess, he said... the little fox cubs might not have Dragon Bo blood, only the old Fox Grandma does. Thus, it’s evident that Dragon Bo blood isn’t an innate inheritance, but a special acquired bloodline."
Song Yan fell into silence.
The Empress and her servants, they truly are not to be underestimated.
These secret bits of information have made him understand the terror of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
But it’s apparent, in the eyes of the other side, the Three Kingdoms might just be a speck of land, usually ignored. It’s only because the King of Wei courted disaster for national vendetta, seeking out the old Fox Grandma, reminding the other side, "there’s a big dining hall here, come and eat."
"Inviting wolves into the house" doesn’t even describe the King of Wei’s action of seeking out the old Fox Grandma.
But how could the King of Wei have known in advance?
With just a little gap in information, the judgment made can be vastly different, resulting in completely different outcomes.
Song Yan lowered his gaze in deep thought.
After a long while, he suddenly asked, "Since there are so many fox cubs, and they’re extremely good at illusion techniques, do you think... it might be possible they..."
Before he finished, the Empress gave him a cold smile, glanced at him with disdain, and said, "So, you can start fleeing now."

chapters.title: Chapter 52. Fox Fur
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: 52. Fox Fur
The incident rate at the Chores Room of Shadow Puppet Peak in the Puppet Sect is actually not low.
Yet no Official Disciple is willing to be on night patrol there.
First, it’s dangerous, requiring constant resistance against ghost entities, which is noisy and consumes a lot;
second, it’s unnecessary.
It’s a deserted place despised by all, even ghost cultivators are unwilling to attack at midnight.
The reason is simple: Ghost cultivators don’t seek dead people but dead cultivators, especially Great Cultivators.
And this requires a stable and healthy growing sect.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Ghost cultivators would rather protect the talent reserve base of the Puppet Sect, so why would they slaughter?
However, even so, incidents are still frequent at the Chores Room, with ghost entities breaking in from time to time.
The reason for setting the Chores Room in such a place is equally simple: it reduces runaway attempts and lowers guard costs.
People can’t run away at night, and due to the night watch, they expend so much energy that combined with daytime skin-making, they are drained, leaving no energy to think about escaping.
Everyone has gotten used to it.
Even as recent as ten years ago, when Song Yan opened the door and committed murder at midnight, it was left unresolved.
Let alone now?
In the mountain ranges here, spanning thousands of miles north to south, there are two Profound Vein spirals, one at Paperman Peak, and the other in the Evil Sea as thick as red jade at the Evil Land.
