Since there are ghost cultivators, the Red Mist Ghost Master, and the Double-faced Ghost in the Evil Sea, ghost entities running amok at night and occasional incidents are inevitable.
Thus, no one has ever paid much attention to the ’midnight deaths.’
Song Yan himself didn’t care either.
But after hearing the Empress’s information, a strange sense of awareness arose in his heart.
No!
It’s not awareness but an inexplicable excitement and anticipation.
It even made him feel as though he were about to fall in love, accompanied by a nervous thrill of gain and loss.
’Since there are so many fox cubs, since the bloodline illusion techniques of those fox cubs are so terrifying, since cultivators are the best food for those fox cubs, then...’
’The Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox cubs should be of high grade but not overly powerful demons, right?’
...
...
"The easy acquisition of longevity" granted Song Yan tremendous patience, a highly stable style, and strong action power.
He began "staking out," going to the Chores Room every few nights, hiding far away under the tree shadows in the bloody mist, expanding his perception.
But nothing was gained.
Ten days...
Twenty days...
Winter passed, yet he still found nothing.
With the arrival of early spring showers, the mountains bloomed in peach pink and apricot white, dazzling with colors.
On this day, an incident suddenly occurred at the Chores Room.
This time, it was a "consecutive door-breaking" event.
Throughout the night, three Suspended Rooms in the Chores Room were simultaneously broken into, and among the six people inside, four disappeared, leaving two dumbfounded and stupefied.
An Inner Sect Disciple in red from the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak came, and Song Yan, as the senior brother of South Bamboo Peak, naturally accompanied him.
The Inner Sect Disciple wasted no words, directly capturing the servants around the incident room to begin a soul search. After finishing, he concluded that "last night was a rare peak period of bloody mist, with some powerful ghost entities breaking in, which is normal."
These words instantly solved Song Yan’s confusion from years ago.
He still remembered that day, during the day, he was nervously skin-making, nervously watching the Inner Sect Disciple investigate "the cause of death of Sheng Dazhu and Wen Erniu," yet nothing came of it...
Song Yan suddenly had a look of realization and praised, "So that’s it, senior brother, you are wise."
The Inner Sect Disciple was pleased with his realization, smiling as he looked at him and said, "I know you, you’re the junior brother of Wen Shu and Jin Yuntian, a registered disciple of Master Shi, and the future Great Skin Master."
Song Yan awkwardly scratched his head and said, "Junior brother’s knowledge is shallow, and I didn’t even recognize senior brother in person, shameful, shameful."
The two exchanged brief pleasantries before the Inner Sect Disciple intended to kill all the servants rendered stupefied due to soul searching, but after another disciple whispered a few words, he only killed half and then took them all away.
This time, Song Yan also understood the role of "corpses" and "stupefied servants" within the Puppet Sect.
As servants, if they become stupefied... they are sent to "Bizarre Poison Peak" for drug testing; if they die... they are sent to "Blood Corpse Peak" for new disciples to practice making flesh puppets, extremely evil and cruel.
Song Yan watched the Inner Sect Disciples leave, sighed lightly, looking at the eyes of awe and the shrinking attitudes of the surrounding servants, waved his hand and said, "At night, keep your doors reinforced, there’s invigorating powder in the market at the foot of the mountain, if it comes to that, buy a bottle! Don’t be stingy with contribution points, when you’re dead, nothing’s left!"
He left somewhat irritably.
But he... did not believe that last night’s "consecutive door-breaking" incident was an accident.
Just as he knew that the "door-breaking" on that day was not caused by ghost entities, but by him.
...
...
That night.
Song Yan staked out.
Nothing happened.
...
The second day.
The third day.
Still nothing.
Fourth day...
Song Yan still came patiently, not growing tired or skeptical despite the uneventful days before; he spent his time on stakeouts rather than sleeping or cultivating furnaces.
He crouched in the long grass shrouded in miasma, lowering his body to watch the distance.
Once again, a whole night passed.
...
...
In a flash, half a month went by.
On this day, at midnight, spring rain blurred everything, mingling with mountain winds and miasma to dance wildly in the dark.
In one suspended room after another, curtains were drawn early, blocking outside view; only through the gaps did rotting skin and bones occasionally attach, filtering in eerie surveillance.
Sheng Guochun was a robust male servant, a servant who had successfully absorbed cultivation techniques from the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" more than two months ago. Now he was filled with expectations for the future, his big face often adorned with smiles, even his eyes hid satisfaction, and he frequently showed pride while making skins.
Living with him was a pretty lady named Ahua.
Like Qiu Lianyue before her, Ahua hoped she could leave this ghastly place through becoming an "Official Disciple".
Previously, she had seen official disciples coming to pick people and had tried to dress herself prettily, but unfortunately... she wasn’t chosen.
On her face hung worry, and...weakness.
At this time, it was shift change.
Ahua descended from the fifth step, while Sheng Guochun climbed up.
As they passed each other, Sheng Guochun showed a smile, raised his hand, and touched Ahua.
Ahua didn’t resist either, she sat weakly, allowing Sheng Guochun to act.
"Sit up."
Ahua clung tightly to him.
Both faced each other.
Sheng Guochun’s eyes widened in horror, his mouth opened wide, and goosebumps surged across his body.
Sitting on him and making love was not Ahua; it was clearly a fox!
A fluffy sharp-nosed fox faced him, grinning with a sinister smile and revealing sharp teeth!
Sheng Guochun’s throat rolled, terror erupted from the depths of his heart, a scream rose from his chest, but before it could sound, it was suddenly stifled...
The fox turned its head and swiftly bit his neck.
Snap...
Snap...
Bone chewing.
Gulp, gulp...
Frenzied blood drinking.
The Fox Demon savored the meal, soon after it would randomly kick open a room door, let the ghost rush in, drive two servants mad, then return to this room, secretly leaving at dawn. A few days later, it would stealthily consume a solitary servant, then transform into their guise and mix back in.
The Fox Demon ate happily, burping after finishing, before climbing onto the steps, watching intently as its eyes rolled around, pushing the door open, its hind legs leaping to shoot out.
But just as it poked its head out, it felt a sudden tightness around its neck.
From the unknown darkness, a giant hand extended like a hunting python, instantly fastening tightly onto the prey.
Snap...
Without any pause, the crisp sound of bones cracking echoed.
The fox’s head tilted, falling down weakly, its pupils protruding, fear still lingered.
It hadn’t seen anything clearly.
And the terrifying demon shadow, carrying the fox, swiftly leaped several times into the nearby woods, then hunched and darted further away; first raising its hand for Soul Search, then reaching into the void to extract a skinning knife, commencing the skinning process.
The next day, however, would just be another event of "thicker miasma, ghost crashing the door," nothing surprising.
...
...
At dawn, Song Yan, drenched in rainwater, returned to the cave mansion.
The two women hadn’t woken up, for he had thoughtfully let them smell "Long Sleep and Clear Wind" before leaving.
The less they know, the better they live.
He was never stingy with kindness towards those around him.
After a brief check, the two women were sleeping soundly.
He then let them smell "Long Sleep and Clear Wind" once more, before taking out the "Fox Demon Skin" from the darkness.
A tail, gray fox, the hideous fox head already gone.
He pulled out a skinning knife and began to work on the skin, then took a drawing, closed his eyes, and focused on recalling the fox demon’s pose he had just observed, his brush moving as if inspired, soon presenting a vivid, nearly leaping-out-of-the-page Demonic Fox.
He raised his hand, among the five fingers profound qi was abundant, steaming blood qi made his palm like an iron, swiftly drying the demon skin, rendering it semi-transparent, then skillfully pasting it onto paper, fetching a carving knife to start the skin making.

chapters.title: Chapter 53. Deformed Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: 53. Deformed Soul
Sha sha sha...
The engraving knife alternately chiseled and pushed, pulling out strands of "snowflakes" on the fox demon skin.
This skin was incredibly tough, if Song Yan hadn’t infused the engraving knife with Profound Qi, it probably wouldn’t even make a mark.
At times, the "sha sha" sound turned into the teeth-gnashing "ka ka" sound, as if the blade might snap at any moment.
Clearly, this fox demon was not something a low-level demon beast like the "Two-Headed Wolf" could compare to, yet it still fell short of a strong intermediate demon beast like the "Bodiless Phantom Crow".
However...
Song Yan paused slightly, stroking the skin of the demon.
He could feel that the skin was not yet fully developed.
This was a fox cub that hadn’t matured yet.
If it had matured, it might surpass the "Bodiless Phantom Crow".
Since Fox Grandmother arrived in the Northern Land, it’s been no more than four or five years. If every few days a litter could be born, over time this would accumulate into a "fox cub army" of one or two thousand.
And the fox demon in his hand was merely one among them, and one that hadn’t matured.
Song Yan closed his eyes slightly, recalling the results from the previous Soul Search.
The memory of this man-eating fox demon was quite simple: birth, dominated by "hunger", with a forever echoing gentle and enchanting voice in its mind, "eat, eat, eat, grow quickly, become strong, and return to mother’s side".
The owner of the voice cared not for their life or death.
It relied on some inherent knowledge within its bloodline: deceit, man-eating, growth, and quickly gained wisdom.
Then one day, with a large batch of "brothers and sisters", it broke into the Puppet Sect, swarming from dark corners of deep mountains and thick forests to remote locations to feed on humans.
They were sensitive in perception, flexible in movement, and excelled at changing their appearance with Illusion Techniques. Without specific Magic, few could detect them in the same Realm.
This caused them... in low-level Realm areas, they were completely without natural predators.
Song Yan couldn’t help but think of a description — invasive alien species, ecological disaster outbreak.
In the world before his transmigration, humans stood high, atop the ecological chain, not partaking in the competitive selection of species, treating events like "crayfish invasion" and "rabbit invasion" with a mocking attitude. But in this otherworld... it seemed not to be the case.
Without cultivators, or if the cultivators couldn’t stop them, these "high ecological niche foxes" would eat all the "indigenous humans", turning the place into a demon country solely of fox demons.
In this vast unknown world, humans were just one of many species, neither inferior nor superior, without the privilege of arrogance.
That’s all there was to it.
...
...
Swoosh~
Song Yan raised his hand, shook the crafted shadow puppet, then formed a gesture as if offering incense, bowed slowly towards the shadow puppet, then with one hand pressed it and with the other hand raised and lightly beckoned to the darkness of the void.
The shadow puppet, which should have long been cooled, suddenly gained temperature, its hard surface even having the warm soft touch of a living being.
Yet the hand that summoned the soul became incomparably cold.
Unfathomable chilling ink-like color flowed from Song Yan’s fingertips, stopping on the shadow puppet’s surface, gradually solidifying.
This was the "Summoning" in the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique".
When combined with Skin Master’s "Skin Making Experience", there were three sources for the "soul" in "Summoning".
The first, which was also the most common: the remnant soul of the original owner.
Even after death, the original owner might have shattered remnant souls mingling with the skin. Besides, newly dead souls would linger in the human world for a few days, rapidly shattering and discarding all soul fragments containing this life’s cause and effect before leaving this realm.
The saying "with the body’s death, the Dao disappears, and cause and effect vanish" reflects this logic, subtly implying concepts like "Seven Days" and "Meng Po Soup", which Song Yan understood well.
These fragments are the best source for "Summoning".
To put it plainly, it’s... "must make skin while it’s hot, emphasizing originality".
The second is: solitary souls from the wild.
The Divine Soul Fragments containing cause and effect do not ascend to reincarnation, thus scattered here, combining with Profound Qi to form Evil Qi, or creating some invisible and untouchable "wandering ghosts" that can cause severe illness if bumped into.
Such wandering ghosts are scattered everywhere in this world. When they feel the flesh power from the "shadow puppet", they’ll instinctively come close and be absorbed within, then cluelessly bond with the remnant souls on the "shadow puppet", believing themselves as what the "shadow puppet" depicts.
This is the most common.
But because "it’s not original", the crafted shadow puppet would naturally be a bit inferior.
The third, as speculated by Skin Master: Great Power Remnant Soul.
Skin Master thought, if the death of a being leaves behind Divine Soul Fragments, then if a great power dies, would such fragments also remain? Summoning a great power’s remnant soul into a shadow puppet would unleash a much stronger power.
...
As the Divine Soul gradually coalesced.
Song Yan’s gentle soul-summoning hand suddenly turned violent, tightly grasping the solidifying soul and pressing it into the skin.
This step was the "Skin Painting Slave Soul Technique", evolved from a single mutation of the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique".
The Soul Summoning Technique allowed the soul to enter the skin voluntarily, but it carried risks, and skin masters could very likely fail at this step, leading to the destruction of the shadow puppet and the escaping of the summoned soul.
But Slave Soul entailed no such problem, for regardless of the soul’s willingness, Song Yan would directly press it in.
With the remnant soul of the original owner entering the body, a wisp of Profound Qi shot from Song Yan’s left fingertips, connecting like the strings of a "marionette", controlling the fox demon shadow puppet. The fox demon shadow puppet inflated as if filled with air, rising sharply on the table and moving its legs in a rustling, swaying motion.
But, Song Yan’s right hand did not stop.
That hand continued summoning in the darkness.
If any skin master were to see this scene, they’d be frightened into shouting, "Stop, stop, stop, hurry up and stop, don’t you want to live".
Because this is the forbidden "Soul Summoning".
"One skin, one soul" is already quite dangerous, let alone "one skin, many souls", which is just asking for the shadow puppet to riot, devour its owner, and kill.
Sure enough, another solid ghost appeared above the shadow puppet.
But this ghost seemed to sense that there was already a soul within the shadow puppet, and so it began to become restless.
However, before it could fully act out, that pitch-black hand grabbed it with an even more intense ferocity, forcing it into the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet.
Two divine souls, one shadow puppet.
Instantaneously, a sound similar to "boiling water, water entering hot oil" emerged from the shadow puppet, and the originally delicate and magnificent Fox Demon Shadow Puppet began to deform.
Although deformed, one could still discern it was a fox.
Yet...
The summoning hand did not cease, continuing to lure lonely wandering ghosts in the air, then stuffing the condensed ghosts into the shadow puppet.
This was the first time Song Yan truly tried using the Secondary Perfect Mutation "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique". It was a magic second only to the "Hundred Forms Demon Body", one he had spent over 3000 years comprehending.
As the ghosts within the shadow puppet mutated and deformed, Song Yan felt the shadow puppet also growing stronger, surpassing its former self, climbing step by step toward a higher realm.
If one said that the previous fox demon was merely no match for an "Intermediate Level Bodiless Illusion Crow", now... it had surpassed the "Bodiless Illusion Crow", even... rapidly approaching the level of an advanced demon beast.
A Great Power Remnant Soul entering the shadow puppet, perhaps it was nothing more than this.
"Heh..."
"Mwahaha..."
In the darkness, Song Yan let out a deep laugh.
Outside the crystal skylight on the ceiling of the cave, a night of spring rain had ceased, and golden light descended from the sky, illuminating the man’s ink-black hair, yet casting his face into complete darkness.
He put away the recently crafted "Deformed Soul One-tailed Fox Demon Shadow Puppet" infinitely close to the level of an advanced demon beast, then exhaled a long breath.
A sense of exhaustion washed over him, he shed his clothes, burrowed into the side stone cave, embraced the two women of the Fu Family, and fell asleep.
...
...
Several hours later.
Song Yan opened his eyes, he slept soundly, and his spirit recovered quite well, yet the moment he opened his eyes, he met the Empress’s eyes burning with anger.
"Can you not be like this?!"
Song Yan smiled and said, "Like what?"
If he didn’t have a peculiar hobby, it would be difficult to explain why he gave the two women such a high dose of hypnotic powder.
The previous few stakeouts, he returned at midnight without increasing the dose, so it could be explained as the Profound Qi Cave Mansion being a "sleep-aiding" place allowing a full night’s rest till daylight.
But last night, to craft the shadow puppet, he added considerably more.
Fu Shirong, unlike Qiu Lianyue, was extremely smart and perceptive, she would certainly suspect she was drugged, and thereafter guess Song Yan was secretly up to something.
Thus, Song Yan might as well let her speculate he was merely orchestrating a clandestine romantic tryst.
After all, what else could he be doing?
On the other hand, due to Ji Yuan, Fu Hongmian lay weakly.
Song Yan got up, placed the Strengthening Ginseng Pill on the table, then turned and left. After taking a few steps, he recalled the Empress’s fiery temper, so he pulled out a Martial Arts Manual, put it on the stone table, and said, "If you’re really bored, practice a bit."
The cover of this Martial Arts Manual used some old book covers, but the content was compiled by himself.
His martial arts skills, which allowed him to defeat the Jiangnan Capital with one stroke, considered godly, had long since been unrivaled, and the teachings in this manual were the essence surpassing the "Four Sparrows".
Fu Shirong turned up her nose, initially unwilling to touch the manual, but out of curiosity, Fu Hongmian flipped through it slightly, and with this flip... the young guard was instantly taken aback.
Her wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression sparked curiosity in the Empress as well.
Fu Shirong couldn’t help but peek too.
With just a glance, she couldn’t pull her eyes away.
...
...
Song Yan exited the Cave Mansion, the afternoon’s brilliant sunlight shone upon him, yet could not impart any warmth, as he had already learned through soul searching... many Fox Demons had infiltrated the Puppet Sect.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Among these, there were even some "Mature Bodies", which is to say, Fox Demons at the advanced demon beast level.
He thought the Puppet Sect’s higher-ups should be aware.
But why had the higher-ups... done nothing to address it?
A strange feeling welled up in Song Yan’s heart.
Or perhaps because his status was too low, he was uninformed?
Just as he was considering this, a disciple suddenly came running from a distance, stopped before him, and respectfully bowed saying, "Brother Song, the Peak Master is teaching on the peak, and all disciples who have reached the first layer of Refining Profound should go."
"What art is being taught?"
"It seems like there’s post-Entering Profound magic, as well as some cultivation basics, the rest... I don’t know either."
Song Yan nodded, responded with "I’m coming," then headed toward the mountaintop.
This indeed seemed more like a sect...
He also seized the opportunity to brush up on his knowledge.

chapters.title: Chapter 54. Make-up classes
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: 54. Make-up classes
South Bamboo Peak summit.
Large clouds floated, the sky was clean and deep.
The peaks stretched out one after another, each towering, with the air mixed with the distant fragrance of hundreds of flowers...
In this dreadful chaotic world, today can truly be described as a leisurely and lovely day.
Stone Master sat on a wheelchair with a smile, Bi Huayi stood behind him.
The beautiful woman had a frightened look, her hands tightly clutching the wheelchair, as if she dared not let go.
When Stone Master saw Song Yan arrive, he said, "Take a seat."
Song Yan respectfully saluted, then walked to the front row.
Wang Susu moved aside a little.
Lu Haiyi took his sleeve and wiped the floor, then placed a cushion in the center when Song Yan arrived.
Song Yan sat cross-legged.
Stone Master, with a solemn expression, began to speak.
"There is Profound Qi in heaven and earth, the key for a cultivator practicing profound arts is the Profound Root, harnessing Profound Qi to nourish oneself; you are all cultivators who have stepped into the Refining Profound, first layer, and are undergoing the tribulation of Fox Demons.
As the Peak Master, I hope to nurture a new batch of Skin Masters and also hope each of you can live well.
Now, who can tell me what is the most important thing in cultivating profound arts?"
Saying this, Stone Master casually pointed at several people, his gaze fell on Song Yan, saying, "Little Song, you have a try."
Song Yan was about to stand up, but Stone Master pressed down and said, "Speak while seated."
Only then did Song Yan say, "I believe the emphasis lies in the three words ’nourish oneself.’ Refining Profound means refining this mortal body into Heaven and Earth Profound Body, breaking the shackles of mortals."
Stone Master showed an appreciative expression, saying, "That’s right, Refining Profound is about forging the mortal body to break the shackles of mortals; once broken, lifespans can be doubled, reaching over two hundred years.
The ten veins, skin bones, bloodline, organs, one Qi transforming into a flood dragon, riding the storm to expand the Dantian of Profound Qi, these... might be the levels you need to pursue all your life.
Your Profound Root quality is not high, so if you wish to achieve something, you absolutely must not be distracted, every second counts in cultivation; only then... can you have the possibility of a breakthrough."
As the words fell, there was a clamor below, prompting questions one after another.
Stone Master answered them one by one.
His teaching philosophy was, "Unveiling the subsequent realms for you, so you know the direction in cultivation, thereby avoiding a dead end."
Some disciples who initially had differing opinions also understood after hearing Stone Master’s explanation.
Song Yan posed a question, "Teacher, what realm follows after the Refining Profound Realm?"
Stone Master smiled and said, "That’s too far ahead.
Oh well, I’ll tell you.
After the Refining Profound Realm comes the Crimson Palace Realm."
"Crimson Palace Realm?"
"One Qi transforming Jiao into a dragon, breaking the sea soaring into the heart.
Why enter the heart?
Because the core of the Crimson Palace Realm is your heart.
Various cultivation methods are also centered around the heart.
It’s said that at this realm, even your Divine Soul becomes no longer Qi but like liquid water, much more condensed and substantial. And your body will erupt with unbelievable power."
"The heart?"
"No need to ask further." Stone Master coughed twice; since even he hadn’t reached the Crimson Palace Realm, naturally there was nothing much to teach, then thought again and said, "You only need to remember, in the practice of profound cultivation, don’t be blinded by external things, forgetting the core of cultivation.
Know that oneself is the priority.
Alright, let’s talk about external things now.
Though you may possess a strong body in the mortal world, in the Cultivation Realm, you are still merely toddlers taking tentative steps; even the aftermath of a battle between strong cultivators might easily kill you.
In such times, learning to use external things, instead of one’s fists, becomes particularly important."
...
As this was spoken, Song Yan listened carefully.
He understood only half, entirely unlike a person at the "Ninth Layer of Refining Profound."
Stone Master said, "First is, Profound Artifact.
Profound Artifact to us is like a weapon to mortals.
However, while Profound Artifacts are more varied, disciples from different sects are suited for different Profound Artifacts.
For example, Nanwu Sword Sect, their Profound Artifacts are Flying Swords, for their cultivation technique system culminates in the Sword Array, mastering Flying Swords is fundamental.
While in our Puppet Sect’s Five Peaks, each is different.
Our Shadow Puppet Peak’s suitable Profound Artifacts are the simplest, being Shields and Flying Sabers.
Because we do not need to attack, engage in Magical Battles, only need to use shields for self-protection, and control Shadow Puppets to attack, as for Flying Sabers, these are complements to the Shadow Puppets.
Regarding these short-handled sabers, I imagine each of you is already very familiar, right?"
There was a burst of laughter below.
Whether it’s skinning knives or carving knives, they are all short-handled knives, things handled every day.
Stone Master said, "As for the remaining four peaks...
Paperman Peak likes heavy armor because it can constantly strengthen them, making themselves powerful, thus their paper figures also become strong;
Blood Corpse Peak uses banners, for banners can usually stir up great winds, in the dust and sand, allowing them to hide among them, thus enabling blood corpses to kill;
Mechanical Peak uses hammers because hammers are their tool for sustenance, they are very skilled with them, and the Profound Artifacts provided by our sect are generally made by them;
Besides refining elixirs and poisons, Bizarre Poison Peak also requires dual cultivation in escape techniques and related talisman drawing skills."
With that, he paused slightly.
Wang Susu asked, "Peak Master, how do our Shadow Puppets from Shadow Puppet Peak compare to Papermen and Blood Corpses?"
Everyone was quite curious about this answer.
Although the Puppet Sect has Five Peaks, its puppets are of three types: Shadow Puppets, Papermen, and Blood Corpses.
Which is superior or inferior?
Everyone wanted to know the answer.
Stone Master seemed to know what they wanted to ask and said with a smile, "Let’s take your senior brother as an example.
The Paperman is like a weakened version of little Song, with far less physical strength, but only slightly inferior magic power.
The Blood Corpse is made from little Song’s body through special production to become a monster controlled by a Corpse-Driving Profound Cultivator.
However, with your senior brother’s current realm, even if the Peak Master of Blood Corpse Peak personally took action, they could at most create a second-to-last-ranked Purple Corpse. Of course, the physical strength of this Purple Corpse would certainly be stronger than your senior brother’s, but it wouldn’t be able to use profound artifacts or spells.
As for Shadow Puppets, they are essentially beasts under control. If a Shadow Puppet is formidable, it can even be stronger than when the demon beast was alive, and may even develop new magic due to the divine soul and the techniques of the controller.
So...
Who is strong or weak depends not on power, but on the person."
Stone Master spoke with great enthusiasm.
As they watched the evening gradually approach, Stone Master quickly pulled out two Jade Scrolls from his robe and said, "Little Song, starting with you, those of you who’ve entered the realm can now learn these two spells.
Previously, you had to wait, but now... the sect has made an exception to let you learn earlier because the current world is not safe, and learning a bit earlier gives you a bit more power for self-defense.
As for the ’Qi Arrow Technique’ and the like from the mountains below, they’re just to hoodwink loose cultivators; these two spells are more suitable for you.
Once you reach the Fourth Layer of Refining Profound Realm, and learn ’Skin Control Technique’, controlling two Shadow Puppets, that is when you truly become a profound cultivator of Shadow Puppet Peak."
Song Yan quickly stepped forward and absorbed the spells from the two Jade Scrolls.
One: "Profound Qi Shielding Technique"
One: "Profound Blade Transformation Technique"
Meanwhile, Bi Huayi stood at a small stone table at the cliff’s edge, not knowing when he had gotten there, piling half-arm-sized dark shields and palm-length sabers on the stone table’s legs.
Bi Huayi flicked his hand, clearly retrieving egg-sized pouches from his storage space.
Stone Master looked from afar at Song Yan, who had finished absorbing the spells, and said, "Starting today, each of you will receive one small Profound Jade every six months in addition to your original benefits.
The use of small Profound Jade is quite special; it’s the third absorption channel for enhancing a Human Profound Root’s realm.
Apart from dual cultivation and elixirs, small Profound Jade provides the equivalent of half a year’s cave mansion cultivation, and this power doesn’t conflict with Profound Stones.
Main Peak’s disciples use it consistently. This greatly speeds up cultivation.
Because of its properties, Profound Jade is also known as Empowerment Jade.
Little Song, take one.
Remember, practice with the shield and flying saber as well, these are the sect’s allocations for you."
Song Yan nodded, received the pouch from Bi Huayi, weighed it slightly, and estimated it to contain about a hundred Profound Jade Beans, which could exchange for the ten lowest-grade pieces of demon beast skin at the Snake Corpse Market previously.
Indeed, cultivation truly is a costly affair...
And the Puppet Sect, facing the Fox Demon invasion, has started allocating resources to speed up disciple development.
"Thank you, Mistress."
"Mm..." Bi Huayi responded nervously, then timidly handed small Profound Jade to the disciples coming up from behind.
Song Yan bowed his head, picked a shield, a flying saber, and walked away into the distance.
For these two spells, he didn’t plan to use life span calculation but to train alongside his junior brothers and sisters as an ordinary cultivator...
...
...
Several days later.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Piff...
Crack, crack, crack...
Wang the demoness showed an excited expression, shouting, "It’s up, it’s up."
In front of her, a practice flying saber was rising.
She pinched a technique, causing the flying saber to shoot forward suddenly, but unfortunately, it fell to the ground with a "pop" not far away.
In the distance, Lu Haiyi and Shangguan Jian didn’t make a sound, as neither had mastered it yet.
As for the senior brother...
Initially, Lu Haiyi and Shangguan Jian thought "even the senior brother is just talented in skin skills," but now they realized senior brother’s magic talent was also high.
Two days ago, senior brother had already achieved today’s result of Wang Susu, and even the flight distance of the flying saber was farther.
This made them finally grasp that "senior brother will always be senior brother," and they ought to cling to his coattails well.
Stone Master was similarly attentive to Song Yan’s progress, and the bodiless phantom crow hidden in the treetop also nodded frequently after observing Song Yan’s progress, thinking: Wang Susu has talent, but this Song kid is even more impressive. Though his talent in attack techniques isn’t as high as in skin skills, it is still barely considered genius within the sect, but...
For some reason, an ominous shadow suddenly loomed in Stone Seat Elder’s heart.
He gazed north.
Few in the sect truly knew that the battle against the Fox Demon had actually ended in defeat... and now the Fox Demons had infiltrated the mountains far and wide.
But he couldn’t speak of it.
Because the Sect Leader himself had issued a gag order to him.
Interestingly, Sect Leader’s confidant in the Puppet Sect, Gu Tianyang, didn’t know about this.
He didn’t know what Gu Tianyang intended, and even more so, he didn’t know what the Sect Leader... had in mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 55. Spring breeze in triumph, observe chess without speaking
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: 55. Spring breeze in triumph, observe chess without speaking
The spring breeze is gentle, at least during the day.
The mountains nourished by Profound Qi are home to exotic flowers and herbs, even the slightest sniff along the cliffs or paths brings a refreshing fragrance that seeps into the heart.
Before the outbreak of the war, South Bamboo Peak disciples had only two ways to earn Contribution Points: going out to acquire Demon Beast Skin, or processing them in the Cave Mansion.
But now...
It has turned into one way: Skin Making.
This is strange. At least, what Song Yan originally thought was "additional patrol duties, night watch duties," etc.
"Patrol" and "night watch" are very necessary. The fox demon he killed in the tannery is proof of that.
And just a simple soul search made him understand the "invasion of the fox demon."
Lu Haiyi, Shangguan Jian, and others not knowing is one thing, but could the Sect truly be unaware?
How could it possibly be unaware?
Since they know, then why not make arrangements?
If he were only at the Profound Second Layer or Third Layer, he might think, ’maybe the Sect arranged it, but he doesn’t know.’ But he is at the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, the highest level of the Refining Profound Realm, with strong perception. He staked out so many times at night and never saw any "Sect’s arrangements."
In the morning, sunlight falls from the irregular crystal skylight at the top of the Cave Mansion, casting patches of blurry light fields. But this light field not only fails to brighten the cave, it makes the corners even darker and more shadowy.
Song Yan came to the tannery after practicing the Shield Technique and Flying Knife Skill in the morning.
He skillfully drew drafts while contemplating and analyzing what he had seen and heard since returning to the Sect.
This anomaly made him feel inexplicably uneasy.
And at that moment, he felt the sunlight vanish suddenly.
Then came a rustling sound from above the skylight, and the mountain wind blowing in from the cave entrance became slightly moist.
It was raining.
The mountain climate is inherently changeable and impermanent; this is normal.
Raindrops fell on rocks, paths, flowers, forests, creating sources of sound, spreading ripples, overlapping, making the world seem to resonate in unison.
Drip-drip, patter...
The sound of rain falling on an umbrella came from the cave entrance.
A pure and graceful white figure withdrew a small red umbrella, gently stomped her embroidered shoes, then walked in with her legs together, placed the shields and knives by the table, and then sweetly called out, "Senior Brother Song."
Song Yan turned his head and saw it was Wang Susu.
Wang Susu had changed her "skin," wearing something both pure and conservative. If he didn’t know what kind of person Junior Sister Wang was, Song Yan might think she was a maiden.
Song Yan was truly speechless. Was this demoness giving herself a "pure" buff? What normal young man with raging hormones could resist?
"Nice clothing style."
He complimented.
Wang Susu seemed to know that seducing Song Yan was futile and did not tease him, but instead, like a well-behaved family girl, sat opposite him, took out some beast skin, and began Skin Making.
After a while, she suddenly said, "Senior Brother, it seems like South Bamboo Peak is going to completely become a place for nurturing Skin Masters, but Junior Sister... thinks Skin Making is pretty difficult."
Saying this, she sighed and said, "Am I very stupid?"
Song Yan, speechless, said, "Don’t use the way you talk to your home puppy here."
After speaking, he looked up at Wang Susu’s drafts and immediately spotted the problem.
So he directly grabbed the drafts and started guiding her simply.
After some "this and that," Wang Susu felt a sense of sudden enlightenment and sincerely said, "Thank you, Senior Brother Song."
...
...
Days later...
The tannery.
Late at night...
A handsome servant pushed open the door, poked his head out, and ghosts swarmed in, but the servant was surrounded by a layer of strange Profound Qi, resisting the ghosts.
The servant was about to whisk away quickly, when suddenly a black hand clutched and pinched tightly.
Crack...
The Protective Profound Qi formed cracks but was not completely shattered.
The black hand clenched tighter, turning the entire fist into darkness, which was condensed Evil Qi.
Boom...
Amid a slight explosion, the servant’s Protective Profound Qi shattered entirely, his neck broke, and his head twisted down.
Upon closer inspection, this was no handsome servant’s face—this was clearly an unusual foxhead with a beard stained in blood and meat between the teeth, and the room still held the unswept smell of blood, like a slaughterhouse.
The dark figure skillfully dragged the fox demon away, soul searched, skinned, returned to the mansion, crafted into a malformed shadow puppet, then stored it in the Storage Space, secretly pondering: ’This fox demon likely stepped into the level of an advanced demon beast.’
He nestled against, who knows which of the two women, slowly entering into a dreamland.
...
...
The next day, a batch of Little Profound Spirit Pills was distributed in the sect. As the senior brother, Song Yan went to the cliff top to wait. When the Shadow Puppet Void Ship arrived, he took the elixir and prepared to distribute it to the junior disciples.
The Peak Master’s Cave Mansion is right at the top of the cliff.
But Song Yan had been cautioned: unless summoned by Master Shi, he was not to approach proactively.
He adhered to this rule, so even though he passed by Master Shi’s Cave Mansion, he did not enter, and many people noticed that "he seemed like just a token disciple."
Today, as he descended the mountain, he saw from afar a figure riding a "Blood Blade Deer" shadow puppet approaching; it was Master Shi’s adopted son — Shi Peng.
Seeing him from afar, Shi Peng smiled wide, clasped his fists from a distance.
Song Yan returned the gesture but did not stop, continuing down the mountain.
After walking a few steps, he glanced back slightly, only to see Senior Brother Shi excitedly knocking on Master Shi’s Cave Mansion door, which opened with a loud rumble, allowing Shi Peng to walk inside.
...
...
A few days later.
The spring rain was misty.
Song Yan, Wang Susu, and others were making skins in the cave mansion when a figure suddenly appeared at the door.
"Senior Brother?!" Song Yan was the first to look up and stand up.
The others looked and saw a Shadow Puppet Peak Inner Sect Disciple in a red robe standing at the door, with a simple, honest face and a smile. Who else could it be but Shi Peng?
So, all the disciples hurriedly stood up.
Shi Peng chuckled and said, "Skin Master is an important talent of our Puppet Sect, and all of you at South Bamboo Peak are the future Skin Masters.
I... have gained some insights recently, and my master asked me to come and see all of you. If anyone has any questions, just ask."
However, no one dared to ask questions.
After all, who knows if this Inner Sect Disciple is just putting on a show.
Although Shi Peng was simple-minded, he understood everyone’s intentions, so he took the initiative to come down, first going to Song Yan’s side, looking at Song Yan’s sketches, and then touching the demon beast skin, sighing, "Junior Brother’s talent is truly high. When I was your age, I wasn’t as good as you, haha."
Song Yan quickly said, "Senior Brother overpraises me."
Shi Peng smiled and said, "But, there is a small problem here."
Song Yan looked and saw that Shi Peng was pointing right at the eye of the "Blood Blade Deer," so he smiled sheepishly, "The Blood Blade Deer is an intermediate demon beast, perhaps I was aiming too high."
Shi Peng said, "This eye is where the Shadow Puppet Divine Physiognomy resides, so ’painting demons without dotting the pupil, dotting the pupil consumes life,’ is praise for a great Skin Master. Without the eyes, no matter how good the shadow puppet is, it can’t live or summon the soul. Come, let me show you how your senior brother paints it."
With that, Shi Peng genuinely began to instruct Song Yan meticulously.
Song Yan found it somewhat amusing, but he could also feel Senior Brother Shi’s sincerity, so he earnestly "learned," and then showed a look of sudden enlightenment.
With Song Yan taking the lead, the other disciples understood that Shi Peng wasn’t just putting on a show and really started asking questions.
After all, being a "Skin Master" was quite good; they didn’t need to be on the front line in battle.
Wang Susu asked questions very earnestly.
Shi Peng seemed unaware of this Wang demoness’s true nature and taught very seriously as well. In the end, he even said, "Junior Sister looks pure, so her heart must be pure too. Pure people are the easiest to perceive the Divine Physiognomy, but... perhaps experiencing more of the cruelty of this world will allow one to blend it into their strokes and better grasp the Divine Physiognomy."
Wang Susu sweetly thanked him and then asked with a slight blush, "How can I perceive the cruelty of this world?"
Shi Peng seriously thought about it and said, "In a few days, Senior Brother plans to arrange a hunting expedition in Cuique Forest to observe demon beasts up close. Since it’s just a trial, only two or three people will go in the first batch. Junior Sister, would you like to join?"
"Thank you, Senior Brother," Wang Susu softly replied.
Lu Haiyi ran over immediately, shyly saying, "Senior Brother, can... can I go too?"
Shi Peng frowned and said, "You’re a grown man, why so effeminate? How can you paint the Divine Physiognomy well?"
Lu Haiyi: ...
Song Yan: ...
Suddenly, he realized that this Senior Brother Shi might have quite the talent; he obviously hadn’t struggled in the lower ranks.
On the other side, Wang Susu with a "Senior Brother Shi" here and a "Senior Brother Shi" there, actually had Shi Peng sit next to her and teach her carefully.
Of course, Shi Peng didn’t just teach her; he answered any questions from the surrounding disciples.
...
...
A few days later.
Shi Peng took Song Yan, Wang Susu, Lu Haiyi, Shangguan Jian, and others on a trip to Cuique Forest, where they even wandered around the edge of the Evil Land but didn’t encounter any ghosts, only some low-level demon beasts.
The three of them benefited greatly.
...
...
Since the trip to Cuique Forest, Shi Peng seemed to have become a frequent visitor at South Bamboo Peak.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Originally, such Inner Sect Disciples basically stayed at the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, so why would they frequently come to South Bamboo Peak?
One day, in the evening.
Wang Susu whispered, "I heard that Senior Shi seems to have a secret technique as part of his legacy, but he hasn’t passed it on to anyone despite considering it for a long time."
After saying that, she sighed softly.
The reason for the sigh was obvious.
Previously, Shadow Puppet Peak had many Skin Masters, including geniuses like Lv Hong and Gu Rufeng. Unfortunately, now the talent pool had dwindled, and only a few remained; there were hardly any true Skin Masters left.
Master Shi had no choice and was nearing the end of his life, and that’s why he chose to pass on his legacy to his relatives.
Song Yan said, "I’ve heard about it too, but such matters can’t be forced..."
Wang Susu agreed, "True," and the next day she was even more flattering towards Shi Peng.
...
...
But Song Yan felt something was odd.
Recalling Shi Peng’s words, "I pulled him out from a pile of corpses. His life is mine; you don’t have to befriend him," made it even stranger.
Song Yan had understood Shi Peng’s character very clearly by now.
For those with ulterior motives looking to rise in ranks, he was a... good pawn.
But if this was Shi Pong’s arrangement, what could he say?
Goodwill is a knife, and if it is destined to be thrust out, it must draw blood. But if it has not been thrust at the intended target, then... someone is bound to suffer.
Song Yan didn’t want Shi Peng to suffer.
Though they didn’t meet often and barely spoke when they did, he still remembered the words "I know your heart, you understand my intentions."
A true acquaintance is hard to find, both a mentor and a friend; he hoped Master Shi could enjoy his old age peacefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 56. Accidents will never be unexpected.
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: 56. Accidents will never be unexpected.
The weather was gradually getting warmer, and at the top of South Bamboo Peak, the green grass was lush, swaying neatly to one side in the wind...
A beautiful woman in green pushed a wheelchair to the edge of the cliff, watching as the honest disciple departed, her skirt fluttering in the breeze.
A moment ago, that disciple had sincerely called her "teacher’s wife."
But the words "teacher’s wife" seemed particularly grating, causing her pain, fear, and the feeling that she was nothing but a prostitute...
"Huayi..."
The old man called softly.
"Shi Lang!" Bi Huayi responded hastily with nervousness.
The old man chuckled gently and said, "I truly don’t blame you for what happened with Feng’Er. I had already told you that if you’d taken a liking to some young lad, I would even be willing to help him..."
"Shi Lang, I was wrong, wrong."
Bi Huayi, frightened, immediately knelt down and clutched the old man’s leg tightly.
Stone Seat Elder sighed softly and said, "Your Divine Soul is fragile now, but whether you believe it or not, what I’m saying is true.
However, I truly didn’t expect you and Feng’Er to poison me. Had I known this... I might have had a good talk with Feng’Er."
He gazed into the distance and murmured, "You know, I’ve come from hardship, and I value legacy greatly. Naturally, I must choose carefully, for this... is my most precious thing."
"It’s just a pity..."
He looked at the gradually fading figure, showing a painful expression.
Bi Huayi said nothing, nor did she respond.
Stone Seat Elder gently patted her hair and said softly, "I owe you much as my young wife, and you’ll be fine, nothing will happen to you.
Once I’m gone, your fears should ease considerably, and you can start anew.
It won’t be long now."
He looked into the distance, as if he had already glimpsed the conclusion.
He taught Shi Peng a part of the "Hundred Forms Divine Control," nine parts true, one part incomplete.
Before his death, he would have Shi Peng leave the sect.
Shi Peng was very obedient; whatever he said, Shi Peng would do, especially since it was his dying wish.
Gu Tianyang was petty and lacked a sense of the bigger picture.
With his grandson’s death, Gu Rufeng would surely not forget.
By then, he would come for me, but I would die cleanly.
Then he would definitely seek out Shi Peng.
And Shi Peng would inevitably be found by him.
The incomplete "Hundred Forms Divine Control" might also be extracted through torture.
After that, Gu Tianyang would definitely perform a Soul Search, extracting Shi Peng’s memories and discovering Shi Peng had received his legacy, as he "had no other choice but to pass on his inheritance to a relative."
Thus, the matter of the "inheritance" would be considered finished.
No matter how crazy Gu Tianyang was, he wouldn’t dare to perform a Soul Search on everyone close to him, as that would destroy the entire line of the Shadow Puppet.
...
...
A month later...
In the height of summer, at dusk...
A newcomer of great beauty among the servants at the Tannery attracted a lot of attention. The servants, living in "male-only accommodation," rushed forward, hoping to partner with her to improve their "living conditions."
The beauty seemed to have sniffed around carefully, chosen one person, and after sitting together for a short while, the man proposed to take her out for a stroll and walked out of the Tannery.
A man and a woman walked along the back mountain.
The servant’s quarters were located on the edge of the Evil Land, where even during the day, they might encounter spirits, so no one usually ventured there.
However, the beauty playfully gestured with her fingers, smiling enchantingly.
The man, mesmerized, eagerly followed her closely.
The two talked and laughed.
Suddenly, a downpour began.
The beauty exclaimed in surprise.
The man hurriedly took off his clothes, holding them high above his head. The two hurriedly ran under the cover of the "clothing umbrella" to a small cave in the back mountain to take shelter from the rain.
"Oh no, it’s getting dark soon," the man suddenly realized.
The beauty replied, "What happens when it gets dark?"
"The foul mist, there will be foul mist!" The man quickly tried to stand up and said, "We should leave!"
The beauty grabbed him and said softly, "My clothes are all soaked, would you help me take them off?"
The man looked over and indeed saw that the wet clothes clung to her snow-white skin, thinly like green leaves against red flowers, accentuating the enticing, voluptuous curves...
The beauty let out a soft moan and lunged into the man’s arms, grinning, revealing her teeth, ready to bite down, but suddenly heard the man’s chuckling voice.
"Haven’t you figured it out yet?"
The beauty was taken aback: "What?"
The next moment, she suddenly felt the man embrace her.
It was as if she was caught between two massive iron doors, being crushed into a pulp.
Crack...
Bang!!
The beauty was instantly squashed flat, her entire skeleton shattered. When she fell, she was a shriveled Fox Demon.
The man swayed, no longer appearing as a man.
He was clearly a strange, massive fox demon, with odd protrusions all over, like a colossal dead fox demon preserved in water.
"Hoo~~~"
With a gentle exhale, two shadow puppets flew out of the "monster’s" mouth, appearing as two "deformed one-tailed grey fox shadow puppets," then disappeared into the storage space with a casual wave.
The "monster" then immediately transformed back into an unremarkable-looking man. Who else could it be but Song Yan?
Today, luck was on his side too. He saw from afar a batch of new servants, and noticed a woman among them being swapped by the Fox Demon during a roadside break, which sparked his idea to try out his "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
Thus, he swallowed two Fox Demon Shadow Puppets.
The strength of the Shadow Puppet lies in its ability to inherit, and even surpass, the power of the "Demon Beast inits lifetime."
However, for most Skin Masters, "surpassing" is quite an absurd notion; being able to barely match the Demon Beast’s former power is already impressive.
But this certainly does not apply to Song Yan, who has mastered the "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique".
Having swallowed two "Deformed One Tail Grey Fox Shadow Puppets," Song Yan was equivalent to additionally inheriting part of the strength and technique of those two Fox Demons on top of his own.
In front of another Fox Demon, he tested the illusion technique that the Fox Demon touted with pride, and surprisingly...that Fox Demon was truly deceived.
At this moment, he was in a rather good mood.
He skinned the fox with ease, fled, and returned to his cave mansion.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Two women from the Fu Family were practicing martial arts; Fu Hongmian seemed to be facing difficulties and just as she was about to speak, the Empress directly interjected, "Don’t ask him; what could he possibly know?"
Song Yan said, "Why are you practicing so seriously?"
Fu Hongmian replied, "Song Lang, the martial arts here are truly amazing, you wouldn’t understand since you don’t practice... for us, it’s quite a big opportunity."
Song Yan retorted, "Sounds like you guys can leave this place."
The Empress, hands on her hips, snapped, "Mind your own business!"
Fu Hongmian hastily pulled the fiery Empress and gently said, "Song Lang, we all know you’re a good person...
Otherwise, the Empress and I wouldn’t have been able to be nourished for so long and have so much energy to cultivate martial arts.
Not only that, our martial arts progress has been incredibly fast lately."
Song Yan replied, "You misjudge people."
After saying this, he yawned, returned to the cave mansion, lay down, and reminisced about the details of "tricking the fox" and the application of "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
...
...
Rumble...
Thunder rumbled through the mountains, a serpentine lightning bolt descended from the sky, illuminating everything in white.
On the main peak of Shadow Puppet Peak, Gu Tianyang had an uncertain expression, his mind still echoing that woman’s cries.
"Feng’er couldn’t have died for no reason; someone must have killed him!
You mentioned he was competing for inheritance; that old scoundrel didn’t give him the inheritance and didn’t let Feng’er kill him properly.
So... Feng’er’s death must be related to him.
I’ve heard over the past few days that the scoundrel has already passed the inheritance to his adopted son, Shi Peng!
Feng’er’s death must be related to Shi Peng!"
"Wait?!
Why wait!
Did they wait when they killed Feng’er?
You’re scared, you want to consider the bigger picture, but you’re ignoring your only offspring, you’re going to be without descendants, do you know that?
Gu Tianyang, you coward!"
Voices echoed in Gu Tianyang’s mind until a sound came from outside the door.
"Peak Master, Shi Peng is here."
Gu Tianyang then opened his eyes, glanced madly into the distance, and coldly said, "Let him in."
...
...
Moments later.
The utterly dazed Shi Peng collapsed on the ground, drooling from his mouth.
Gu Tianyang stood, sighing, and frowned, saying, "He really doesn’t know about Feng’er’s death?
Could it truly be unrelated to the inheritance?
Could it... really be Ghost Cultivators who killed Feng’er?
Or perhaps those sly Fox Demons secretly infiltrated, killed Feng’er, and wanted to frame Ghost Cultivators to stir conflict between us and the Ghost Cultivators?"
"Could it really be so coincidental, coincidental enough that as Feng’er was trying to harm Stone Seat Elder, he died?"
"Stone Seat Elder, still Stone Seat Elder! As long as we search his soul, we can definitely know the truth!"
Gu Tianyang’s expression grew colder and colder.
Suddenly he clapped his hands, a disciple walked in from outside, saw Shi Peng lying on the ground, and was immediately terrified, eyes wide open.
Shi Peng, who is the inheritance heir of Stone Master...
This...
This...
"Take him away."
Gu Tianyang coldly spoke, and then with his arms crossed, sat in place, lost in thought, as though making a difficult decision, his eyes already red; he cannot let Gu Rufeng die unjustly!
Torrential rain fell wildly, with streams flowing across mountain paths...
Amidst the green branches and leaves, a pitch-black crow silently watched Shi Peng being carried out, its pupils round and wide, seemingly in disbelief.
...
...
"...Deplorable...
enough!!"
"Deplorable enough!!"
At South Bamboo Peak, Stone Seat Elder’s voice trembled as he furiously stood, summoned a skin boat, and headed straight towards Paperman Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 57. A lone boat in the vast raging sea, rocking and swaying—where is it heading?
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: 57. A lone boat in the vast raging sea, rocking and swaying—where is it heading?
The Stone Seat Elder knew that he was close to death. He was stuck at the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, always feeling that he was just a step away from breaking through to the "Crimson Palace Realm." However, the "Crimson Palace Realm" required, besides continued absorption of Profound Qi, a suitable "external blood" as the main ingredient to refine the "Crimson Palace Pill."
This blood could be from advanced demon beasts or others.
Of course... if it’s not suitable, you can try, but the success rate will be very low.
The Stone Seat Elder tried twice and failed both times.
Not only did he fail, but it also left him nearly on his last breath.
The path of cultivation is inherently a defiance against the heavens, full of obstacles—this is common.
The Stone Seat Elder resigned to fate, all he sought for the rest of his life was to find a worthy successor for his legacy.
But... there were many twists and turns. Because of a very personal thought, unexpected complications arose, leading to a pile of messy, unsolvable affairs.
He was about to die.
The backup plans he prepared inexplicably vanished.
Full of anger, he went to Paperman Peak to meet with the Puppet Sect Leader.
However, it seemed the Puppet Sect Leader knew he would come and dismissed everyone, waiting for him in a not-so-spacious but odd Paperman Pavilion.
In front of the pavilion, a row of red lanterns dimly illuminated the paper mannequins crafted into red men and green women underneath, eerily smiling.
Behind the screen, a paper figure sat and spoke in an aged voice, "You’ve come?"
The Stone Seat Elder was astonished and said, "You’ve come?"
The paper figure waved its hand, and the doors and windows of the pavilion closed with a "bang, bang."
The aged voice continued: "Gu Tianyang is almost insane; it was my doing. Otherwise... Although he’s narrow-minded and lacks the big picture, he wouldn’t be so muddleheaded to attack your adopted son at this time, let alone... dare to attack you."
The Stone Seat Elder: ...
The aged voice eerily said: "I used to trust him, but that year, after a long setup, I finally provoked the ghost cultivator hidden within the sect, but because of him... it fell short!
Now there must be ghost cultivators still lurking within the sect. At this time, he actually wants to secure an elder position for his grandson. Do you think he deserves to die?"
The Stone Seat Elder, having experienced much, suddenly understood it was just another layer to the situation; all he believed in was manipulated by others, making him see only what they wanted him to see.
"Leader, what should this old man do?"
The aged voice suddenly said: "Actually, normally, your life limit, when reached, cannot be reversed. But now, there’s still a slight chance if you cross it, you can enter the Crimson Palace Realm."
The Stone Seat Elder was taken aback, suddenly lifting his head, and the deadening in his heart started showing traces of new life.
The aged voice said: "I can’t, but deep within the Evil Land resides an old earth-binding ghost cultivator.
I plan to offer you and the entire line of Shadow Puppet Peak, now useless, to the ghost cultivator.
The shadow puppets are significant for Evil Land, and you have endless ghosts to summon there, a perfect match."
The Stone Seat Elder: ...
He deliberated for a long time and then said, "I understand, the Leader wishes to ally with the ghost cultivator."
The aged voice said: "I intended to eliminate them, but unfortunately, I discovered that deep within the Evil Land is that old demon; although the demon cannot leave the core of the Earth Demon, it makes the ghost cultivators invincible.
Moreover, we lost the war with the fox demons, and we need allies.
The multi-tailed man-eating fox demons’ power is beyond imagination, so we need to establish the Fox Slaying Alliance.
Shadow Puppet Peak is what was agreed upon."
The Stone Seat Elder said, "Then... Leader, how will you explain to all the sect disciples?"Thɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The aged voice said: "It was the fox demons, the fox demons killed Gu Tianyang, the fox demons killed everyone, we were too late to support Shadow Puppet Peak, and the ghost cultivators took the opportunity to rescue you, that’s the truth."
The Stone Seat Elder said, "No wonder... no wonder you don’t care about the infiltrating fox demons..."
The aged voice said: "Though Shadow Puppet Peak will be given away, I still need to leave a seed.
Seat Elder, tell me, to whom did you pass on your legacy?
I simply do not believe you only passed it to Shi Peng."
The Stone Seat Elder sighed gently and slowly revealed the name "Song Yan."
The paper figure behind the screen seemed slightly surprised but nodded nonetheless, then beckoned.
The Stone Seat Elder approached.
The two whispered secrets.
When the Stone Seat Elder left, the aged look on his face had slightly faded, his skin was still wrinkled, his hair still gray, but his eyes held a hint of "hope" and "expectation."
If one can live again, who would refuse?
...
...
Clap clap clap...
Gu Tianyang felt extremely uneasy, a sense of inexplicable irritation pounding in his chest.
He got up and was about to fly to South Bamboo Peak when he suddenly saw an Inner Sect Elder from Paperman Peak arrive, dropping off three corpses.
Gu Tianyang recognized the corpses as disciples of the Puppet Sect!
And there was still ghostly aura lingering on these corpses, but the wounds had a strangely familiar feel.
He examined them closely and suddenly remembered.
Although the wounds on these corpses were different, they were inflicted in the fastest and most direct way through the chest, just like his deceased grandson, and the ghostly aura confirmed...they were retrieved from the Evil Land.
His expression began to change.
He suddenly looked up, seeing an Inner Sect Elder from Paperman Peak watching him, saying, "The cause of death has been identified."
Gu Tianyang shouted angrily, "Who?!"
The Inner Sect Elder from Paperman Peak said, "Fox demon."
"Fox demon?"
"The fox demons enchanted these disciples, leading them to commit suicide in the Evil Land, trying to incite conflict between us and the Evil Land. They want to fish in troubled waters and observe the two sides suffer."
"Damn fox demons!"
Gu Tianyang’s anger burned fiercely. He always knew there were infiltrating fox demons, but he never connected it to his grandson’s death.
"Peak Master Gu, it’s tonight." After the Inner Sect Elder spoke, he handed over a map, "The Sect Leader has discovered the fox demons’ location, and tonight we launch a surprise attack to let those fox demons pay with blood."
"I understand." Gu Tianyang nodded.
The Inner Sect Elder said, "Quick decisions."
Two streaks of rainbow light shot away into the distance, reaching a remote area, Gu Tianyang indeed saw that figure far away.
That figure seemed to merge into the ominous fog, into the darkness.
The figure turned around, his pair of eyes revealed a gentle smile.
"Tianyang, you’re here, the fox cubs are over there..."
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Gu Tianyang felt an intense agitation within, his rationality somewhat blurred, as he swiftly darted forward, just reaching the side of the Sect Leader, when suddenly a fearsome force from an absolutely unexpected angle, and an absolutely unexpected person attacked.
"Sect... Sect Leader?"
In the darkness, those blood-red eyes embedded in shadows showed a playful smile.
"Old Gu, actually I have quite a few things to say to you, but I’ll wait until you’re dead to say them to your corpse."
"Your body, I... shall gladly accept it."
Boom!!!
...
...
Thunder roared, exploding at dawn, even the cave mansion trembled slightly.
Song Yan rose from the couch, pushed aside the two long legs draped across his waist, looked up at the sky, yawned and lay back down.
A little while later, Fu Hongmian got off the bed to cook porridge, and when the aroma of rice filled the cave mansion, Song Yan woke the Empress.
Fu Shirong glared at him fiercely.
Song Yan simply loved watching this fiery-tempered woman’s tantrums.
He smiled and ruffled the Empress’s hair.
"Why have you not gathered recently?"
Fu Shirong asked.
Song Yan lifted her chin and said, "Have you thought about it?"
"Pah!"
The Empress displayed a look of disgust and disdain.
Not far away, Fu Hongmian shouted, "Song Lang, stop deliberately provoking the Empress. We all know you’re a good person, you’d rather slow down your cultivation than harm us."
Song Yan laughed heartily, then got out of bed, dressed, ate, and practiced Shield and Blade Xuan Skill for a while in the cave, before grabbing an oil-paper umbrella and heading to the Skinning Cave Mansion as he did every day.
Mountain rain flowed freely through the gaps in the stone steps, hanging like small waterfalls.
Song Yan heard footsteps not far away, turned his head, and called, "Junior Sister."
Wang Susu, somewhat lost in thought, raised her head at the sound, then quickly walked to Song Yan’s side, walking alongside him.
Song Yan asked, "What’s wrong? You seem down."
Wang Susu lowered her head and said, "Nothing."
Song Yan asked, "What’s really going on?"
Wang Susu said softly, "My thoughts are... even someone as talented and wise as our Skin Master eventually shows signs of aging, with their time coming to an end, unable to break the mortal’s lifespan limit.
Then... for us with such inferior Profound Roots, will we ever have a chance to reach the end of the Refining Profound Realm and glimpse the scenery on the other side?"
Then, without waiting for Song Yan to answer, she continued, "Even if there is a chance, it’s probably on the main peak of Paperman Peak, above the main vein of the Profound Vein, with abundant Profound Qi, Spirit Pills... too bad we cannot go there.
We servants from birth, how can we ever have a chance to reach the main vein?"
Of the Puppet Five Peaks, only Paperman Peak is on the main vein, the rest are on the secondary veins, and South Bamboo Peak is a remnant of the secondary vein...
Wang Susu finished speaking, then said no more, changing to a routine smile.
Her umbrella was red.
A small red umbrella, like a boat in the stormy sea during the abrupt rain, swaying.
The two walked silently, soon arriving at the Skinning Cave Mansion.
"We’re here."
Wang Susu smiled and put away her umbrella.
Song Yan looked inside and said, "Your Skin Master hasn’t arrived yet today."
Wang Susu giggled and said, "He’s our Skin Master."
They sat opposite each other and began working on today’s shadow puppets.
Soon, a red figure appeared at the door.
Wang Susu thought Shi Peng had come, turned her head to look, but was surprised to see an unfamiliar Inner Sect Disciple.
This Inner Sect Disciple scanned the interior, his gaze landing on Song Yan, and said, "Are you Song Junior Brother?"
Song Yan rose, puzzled, "Senior Brother, are you looking for me?"
The Inner Sect Disciple smiled and said, "The Sect Leader found a rare Exotic Beast and wants to invite some potential Skin Masters to take a look. Skin Master recommended you, come with me."
Song Yan was taken aback.
This was very sudden.
The Inner Sect Disciple said, "The Void Ship is at the cliff top, the Skin Master is also there, let’s go."
Wang Susu looked at Song Yan with envy.
Song Yan nodded.
Since the teacher is there too, it’s not a big issue, just go and see.
"Thank you, Senior Brother."
"You’re welcome."

chapters.title: Chapter 58. Ten thousand ghosts roam at night, each going their separate ways.
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: 58. Ten thousand ghosts roam at night, each going their separate ways.
South Bamboo Peak, cliff top.
The old man sat solemnly in the wheelchair, and only when he saw the man slowly appear on the stone steps did he show a smile.
"Yan’er has come."
Song Yan was taken aback, because he always remembered that in front of outsiders, Stone Elder would never show intimacy towards him, at most only calling him "Little Song." Why did the address change today?
"Master."
He responded and was about to ask about the exotic beast when he saw the old man beckon and say, "Come here."
Song Yan approached, and the old man tightly grasped his hand, staring at him intently, and said in a deep voice, "This exotic beast is rare, and I have struggled hard to secure a spot for you. Do not disappoint me!"
Song Yan nodded and said, "Thank you, Master."
The Stone Seat Elder released his hand and then said, "Huayi, Yan’er is now going to the main peak of Paperman Peak. I’m worried he might not quite understand the rules, so accompany him."
"Stone... Lang..." Bi Huayi nervously clutched the wheelchair.
The Stone Seat Elder smiled and said, "Go ahead."
With that, he looked at Song Yan and said seriously, "Your master-mother was once soul searched by Gu Tianyang; her condition isn’t so well. On this journey... Yan’er, remember to look after her."
Seeing Song Yan hesitate, the Stone Seat Elder showed slight annoyance and said, "Seeing your master-mother is like seeing me!"
Only then did Song Yan nod. Since the soul search had been conducted, it seemed the Master already knew Bi Huayi intended to harm him. The Master truly took care of this woman with every means.
But he didn’t understand why the Master wanted Bi Huayi to accompany him.
"Go on."
The old man leaned back against the wheelchair, smiling and waving his hand.
Bi Huayi released her hand, bowing her head nervously as she followed behind Song Yan, and then boarded the Void Ship with him.
The solitary ship was a distant silhouette, disappearing into the blue sky.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
The old man gazed afar, for a long time... before he got up, shook his long sleeves, and his hunched body seemed to regain vitality. With sparkling eyes, he looked west and murmured, "Come."
In the distance...
Song Yan stood on the deck, looking back at South Bamboo Peak. As the Void Ship flew over the peak of a green summit, his sleeve moved, and a small shadow puppet silently dropped down, hiding among the forest leaves.
This shadow puppet was his strongest, "the Deformed Soul One-Tailed Fox Demon with power already at the advanced Demon Beast level."
...
...
Night fell.
No rain...
Dark moon, high winds.
"Today’s bloody fog is so thick!"
In the servant tannery room of the Suspended House, a servant crouched by the crevice.
He had been here for more than a year, yet he had never seen such a dense bloody fog. The mist almost seemed to penetrate the house through the crystal.
...
...
Red lanterns flew and collided wildly in the fierce wind.
The disciple on duty at the Shadow Puppet Peak’s main peak had been dozing off, but suddenly woke up, startled because a silhouette appeared in the darkness not far away.
The bloody fog, never having submerged this area, was surging up step by step along with that silhouette.
"Who!!"
The duty disciple, clutching a shadow puppet, stood up warily, shouting from a distance.
Strange hybrid laughter came from the bloody fog, one laughed madly, the other mournfully.
Sad and joyful voices mingled, evoking an incredibly eerie and chilling feeling.
The duty disciple was stunned.
Suddenly, the laughter stopped, and a mighty voice came from the fog, "Dear disciple, it’s only been a while, and you can’t even recognize your master?"
The duty disciple stood there dumbfounded, only to see a two-faced strange man approaching from afar.
Wasn’t he the former Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak, who had already fled?
And behind the two-faced man, shadow puppets were swelling and brimming one after another.
Various demon beasts... were all present.
...
...
Rumbling...
On South Bamboo Peak, a stone door opened.
The disciple inside was frightened and hurriedly scrambled up from his cot, and when he looked outside, he saw an old man and a middle-aged man standing at the doorway.
"Stone... Stone Peak Master, why... why have you come at midnight?"
The middle-aged man beside him smiled and said, "Stone Elder, these new disciples don’t recognize me anymore."
The old man said indifferently, "Get up, the Demonic Fox is attacking, and the Ghost Cultivator has come to save us."
Demonic Fox attacking?
Ghost Cultivator saving?
That disciple’s mind went blank.
The Stone Elder didn’t explain and simply said, "You have twenty breaths of time; if you can’t follow, then die."
The disciple glanced outside the cave and saw ghostly energy everywhere. The bloody fog had somehow spread to South Bamboo Peak, and ghosts and strange shadow puppets were flying and running wildly in the fog, creating a malevolent scene of a night parade of thousands of ghosts.
He quickly dressed, and although the furnace on the side didn’t understand what was happening, it also hurriedly put on clothes and then followed behind the Stone Elder.
And that middle-aged man was naturally the former South Bamboo Peak Master Cheng Danqing.
...
On South Bamboo Peak, stone doors were being knocked open one by one, and the disciples followed closely behind.
However, there were also some disciples who didn’t know better, angrily shouting accusations like "Master Shi, have you been possessed by an evil spirit?" or "Master Shi, you betrayed South Bamboo Peak."
But these disciples were all knocked out by Cheng Danqing and thrown onto the giant shadow puppet behind them.
As for throwing them to the shadow puppets in the eerie mist, that wouldn’t work.
Skin Masters and the Evil Land are a perfect match because the Skin Master creates the skin, and the Evil Soul directly charges in to possess the body.
But these shadow puppets are chaotic, uncontrollable puppets that are filled with disorder like ghostly creatures.
If you throw living people to them, the next moment...they would be torn apart, devoured, becoming a feast as if a starving mad dog had found a meat bone after three days and nights.
...
Rumble...
Another stone door opened.
A strong seductive atmosphere burst out from within, followed by a man’s "scream."
And then, a long-haired beauty with porcelain white skin stepped out in the candlelight, boldly and fearlessly, showcasing her alluring curves.
She immediately saw the Stone Seat Elder and the group of disciples behind him, then slightly tilted her head to meet the eyes of a middle-aged man.
Cheng Danqing looked at her with a faint smile.
Wang Susu suddenly bowed and said, "Susu still remembers the Peak Master’s care in the past, privately wishing to repay you, but had no opportunity. I am very happy to meet again now."
Cheng Danqing grinned and laughed heartily, pointing distantly at Wang Susu and said, "Master Shi, I told you, the most sensible here is Susu, didn’t I? Haha!"
Wang Susu quickly put on her dress, asked no questions, and followed behind Cheng Danqing and Master Shi.
The Furnace behind was still nervously yelling, "Sister Wang, my...my legs are sore, don’t leave me. I’ll...I’m almost ready, almost!"
Wang Susu giggled and said, "The road ahead is long, sister, worried you might not adapt to different climates and die on the way, becoming a burden. You...don’t want to drag sister down, right? So...don’t go. Be good."
She tiptoed, waved her hand, and then followed the group without hesitation.
She had just left when a swarm of ghostly creatures flooded into the cave mansion, engulfing the handsome young man who was nearly drained dry.
...
A group continued walking, and then slowly stopped in front of a cave mansion.
Cheng Danqing looked at this cave mansion and said, "If I remember correctly, doesn’t this belong to the disciple named Song Yan?"
Master Shi said, "Unluckily, he was summoned away by the Sect Leader this morning."
Cheng Danqing sneered, "That is very unfortunate indeed."
Master Shi said, "Let’s go, we don’t need him."
Wang Susu glanced with surprise at the stone door of the cave mansion, then went far with the group.
...
...
High above...
In the ominous mist, a deformed eerie figure was overlooking it all.
He saw Cheng Danqing at the forefront, saw Master Shi’s calm demeanor, saw Wang Susu’s elation, saw all the South Bamboo Peak disciples heading towards the Evil Land.
’I see...’
Song Yan sighed lightly.
He was sharp-minded, and although not well-informed, he pieced things together with clever deduction.
A demonic fox infiltrated but was not dealt with, meant to foster anger in the disciples’ hearts, so they could blame everything on the demonic fox.
In secret, a treasonous exchange was made to sell out Shadow Puppet Peak.
Because the original Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak was a Ghost Cultivator, and the Skin Masters accumulated for years inside had already been rounded up, it made sense to trade the now-useless branch entirely to the Ghost Cultivators, in exchange for an alliance against that Fox Matriarch.
As for why Master Shi was willing to go to the Evil Land voluntarily, he could vaguely guess: perhaps the teacher had found a new opportunity.
And why Wang Susu was so elated was because: besides the Paperman Peak being above the Profound Vein Main Vein, the center of the Evil Land is also above the Profound Vein Main Vein; wouldn’t this be entering an even better place for cultivation?
’This doesn’t seem like something the teacher would orchestrate, but rather that Sect Leader...’
Song Yan closed his eyes, watched everyone go far away, and silently wished: Have a safe journey.
After saying this, suddenly, he sensed something and used the technique of "Hundred Forms Divine Control" to manipulate the deformed fox demon, leaping towards his own cave mansion.
...
...
Song Yan’s Cave Mansion.
Inside the cave, two women were pressed against the stone gate, listening to the commotion outside, so tense that they didn’t even dare to breathe.
After Cheng Danqing, Master Shi, and the others went far away, the shadow puppets in the eerie mist outside seemed to receive some command and suddenly started "booming" against the stone door.
Inside the cave, it was like the ground and mountains were shaking.
The Empress and Fu Hongmian were panicking.
And just at this moment...
Bam!
The stone door exploded, and a group of ghostly creatures surged inside.
The two women knew they couldn’t escape their fate and tightly shut their eyes.
But the expected pain and death didn’t come. An eerie giant "Guan" fox was standing outside the door, the ghostly creatures avoiding it because the fox also emitted their aura.
But, in the eyes of the two women, this fox had already used an Illusion Technique, appearing as a faceless person.
"Let’s go." Song Yan rasped.
Fu Hongmian was so frightened that she didn’t dare to speak, but the Empress asked, "Where to?"
Song Yan replied, "I’ll take you away from here."

chapters.title: Chapter 59. Favor is scarce, righteousness is thin.
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: 59. Favor is scarce, righteousness is thin.
Below South Bamboo Peak, the mountain path was narrow.
Nine turns and eighteen bends, everywhere shrouded in bloody mist.
The ghosts clung to blood and bones, rampant and unruly, flying and colliding wildly; even if the disciples of South Bamboo Peak moved with the ghost cultivators, many wild beasts in the mountains couldn’t escape.
