Under the trees, an old wolf rolled in pain; on the branches, a squirrel’s eyes glowed red; in the cave, a rabbit bared its fangs...
As the bloody mist passed, unless resisted with Profound Qi, one would be invaded by ghosts.
In the summer, the mountains were already filled with moisture, and now, with this unprecedented tidal wave of evil, it was dark and red everywhere. Between the red and black, it seemed as if it was no longer in the mundane world, but on the endless path of the Netherworld.
On the winding path of the Netherworld, three figures were walking.
All three carried swords. These were taken by Song Yan, who was possessed by the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" method on the "Deformed Fox Demon", as he casually took them from the guardroom.
He took one for himself and threw two to Fu Shirong and Fu Hongmian.
The three walked in silence, quickly leaving the area of South Bamboo Peak.
The ghosts did not attack them.
Fu Shirong was astonished at the current situation.
This mysterious man who appeared suddenly seemed to have an invisible aura around him, blocking the ghosts.
However, the Empress, experienced and knowledgeable, had clearly thought of another possibility.
But even she, fiery and bold, dared not speak of that possibility at this moment.
Fu Shirong suddenly asked, "Does Senior know Song Yan?"
"Song Yan?"
Song Yan replied in confusion, then said, "I am a ghost cultivator, Song Yan should be the owner of your Cave Mansion, right?"
Fu Shirong: ...
The words she dared not ask were admitted by the man in front of her.
After a slight pause, the Empress replied "Yes," then asked, "Does Senior really intend to take us away?"
Song Yan said, "Yes."
The Empress asked, "Why?"
Song Yan said, "To escape together."
After speaking, he suddenly seemed to sense something, quickly grabbed the collars of both women, and swiftly darted into the shadow of a large boulder nearby.
A dangerous roaring sound swept across the sky, the two women couldn’t see clearly, but he could see strange shadow puppets flying by. Upon recognition, he remembered having seen these things in the Stone Elder’s notebook.
Four-eyed vulture, intermediate-level demon beast, sky wolf pack...
If spotted by these, one wouldn’t die cleanly even if they managed to survive.
These demon beasts were extremely difficult to hunt, even if captured, their own scarce flesh made it hard to create perfect shadow puppets.
Imperfect shadow puppets raised the risk of backlash during summoning.
However... in the Evil Land, it seemed the Skin Masters weren’t at all worried about being "backlashed," as they only needed to symbolically summon, then the ghosts would rush in by themselves.
Thus, with more "Skin Masters" in the Evil Land, the dreadful level of the bloody mist was "upgraded", from merely having ghosts to having chaotic, shadow puppet-bodied ghost skins...
Ordinary ghosts might not trouble Song Yan, but encountering those hordes of four-eyed vultures, he was unsure, so he hid with the two women behind the boulder.
When the fierce wing flapping sounds faded into the distance, they emerged once more and continued on their way.
...
The day grew bright, and the three had completely left South Bamboo Peak, even the low-level market town below, not far from the exit.
At this moment, the sky suddenly grew chillingly cold.
Fu Hongmian looked up and saw two white objects gently drifting down.
They seemed like paper.
Looking closer...
The paper turned into white sleeves.
As the white sleeves gradually completed, they formed into a Celestial Maiden holding a sharp sword.
The Celestial Maiden descended from the sky, blocking their path.
Immediately, two figures floated down, surveying the three, one in amazement said, "There are still people who managed to escape?"
The other coldly demanded, "How did you escape?"
The Fu family women nervously grasped their blades.
The two disciples stationed from Paperman Peak sneered at their tightly gripped fingers and then turned their gaze to Song Yan.
In their eyes, Song Yan appeared as a somewhat ugly man with even scarred cheeks.
Even the demonic fox could not discern Song Yan’s "Deformed Soul Shadow Puppet" illusion technique, let alone them?
"Speak up."
A disciple looked at Song Yan, "Looks like you’re the leader."
Then he saw the man nod, and in a blur, a shadow mixed with a vile wind assaulted him.
Before he could react, a sharp pain pierced his chest, then a tremendous force swept across his body, nearly shattering his bones, and he found himself weightlessly flying backward.
The scenery rushed away, and in his eyes, he only saw the man’s strike unsatisfied, suddenly turning back, slashing out a crescent arc of light.
The other disciple’s head flew into the air.
The man paused not for a moment, leaping forward, another blade cutting down as he arrived before him.
The disciple just landed, hands propping the ground, looking up in horror, shouting "Spare me, Senior," but the blade did not slow for a moment due to his plea.
In a moment, the disciple saw nothing but darkness.
With the deaths of the two Paperman Peak sentry disciples, the white-sleeved Celestial Maiden seemed to have lost some power, reverting to an ordinary paperman, falling into the grass.
Song Yan picked it up, inspecting the paperman.
The paper was unusual, exuding a faint, dizzying scent of blood.
He tried to crush it and failed, until exerting more force, the paper shattered into black smoke.
Song Yan squinted slightly, this was his first close encounter with papermen, resembling shadow puppets in some ways but quite different in others.
He pondered while quickly tossing the two deceased disciples into the nearby grass.
Many wild beasts roamed the mountains, and after last night, there were more Evil Beasts.
The scent of blood would attract them, aiding in "disposing of the bodies."
After finishing these things, he looked ahead again, but didn’t continue walking down. Instead, he slightly observed the surroundings before picking up the two women and swiftly darting between the mountain rocks using the agility of a Fox Demon.
As the senior disciple of South Bamboo Peak, he was already very familiar with the terrain here.
With a bit of detour, they could escape through a secluded path.
...
...
Clap, clap, clap...
At dusk, three figures swept down from a high cliff and landed on the ground.
Song Yan glanced around and said, "We should have escaped now."
The Empress felt as if she was in a dream and suddenly said, "What plans does Senior have?"
Song Yan gave a self-mocking laugh and said, "I am a Ghost Cultivator, aren’t you afraid?"
The Empress shook her head and said boldly, "Senior saved me and Hongmian. If I were to fear Senior just because he is a Ghost Cultivator, then Fu Shirong would truly be worthless."
"Ha."
Song Yan chuckled again, then sighed and said, "My name is Hua Rong, from Western Shu Celestial Cloud City. Last autumn, I went out traveling and encountered a Demonic Fox. I was indignant and fought with the Demonic Fox. I killed the Demonic Fox but was gravely injured.
On my way back, I was inadvertently captured into the Chores Room of the Puppet Sect.
I tried to escape but died in the back mountain, and by some twist of fate, I became a Ghost Cultivator and regained my soul..."
He knew Fu Shirong and Fu Hongmian very well, knowing what they would believe and what they wouldn’t.
Fu Hongmian was a guard, lacking much initiative.
But Fu Shirong was different.
Moreover, Fu Shirong liked straightforward people.
His words could easily win the Empress’s favor, increasing her "trust level" in him.
As expected, after he spoke, Fu Shirong said, "I am Fu Shirong, from Great Wei. Forced southward due to the Demonic Fox disaster, I was unintentionally captured into the Chores Room, and then was..."
She paused slightly and said, "Taken into a Cave Mansion by a Demon Sect disciple who was reasonably good-hearted as a Furnace, for over half a year. Until last night, I don’t know what happened, then I was saved by Senior Hua."
Having said that, she continued, "If Senior Hua wants to return to Western Shu, why not come with me to the Fu Family, where I will arrange transportation to send Senior Hua west. If you don’t wish to return to Western Shu, my Fu Family also welcomes you."
The Empress smiled and said, "After all...we all hate the Fox Demon, don’t we?"
After speaking, she suddenly saw Song Yan lower his head, revealing a somewhat troubled expression.
"Senior Hua, what’s the matter?"
"..."
"If Senior is unwilling, I won’t force you, but I will always remember Senior’s life-saving grace and will definitely repay it."nᴇt
"..."
Song Yan was silent for a moment, then let out a long sigh and waved his hand, saying, "Miss Fu is straightforward. If it were the past, I would certainly have made you a friend, but now..."
Fu Shirong smiled and said, "Is Senior still worried about being a Ghost Cultivator? I can still speak for you in the Fu Family, let alone Senior has slew the Fox Demon and killed a Demon Sect disciple, which proves your identity. Don’t worry."
Song Yan waved and said, "Come with me."
Fu Shirong nodded and followed him into the small forest nearby.
Song Yan’s figure flickered, revealing the strange Deformed Fox Demon Shadow Puppet form.
Fu Shirong:...
Song Yan said, "My soul inadvertently entered this thing’s body, that’s how I came back to life. How can I show my face again?"
Fu Shirong was silent for a moment, then looked up and said openly, "Senior is sincere with me, and I will be sincere with Senior. This matter is known only by heaven, earth, you, and I, and Shirong will never betray Senior.
Come on, let’s return to the Fu Family together."
...
...
In the quiet room, Song Yan felt the abundant Profound Qi pouring in from all directions. Even a gust of passing wind carried an indescribable freshness.
He even thought that if one could inhale a breath of air here, mortals would probably be less likely to get sick. If they inhaled more, they would certainly live healthily and pass away without illness.
This place was Paperman Peak.
Due to an unexpected incident, the Exotic Beast summoned by the Sect Leader had a slight problem, and he was arranged to wait in a room on Paperman Peak.
He knew that the news from Shadow Puppet Peak would arrive quickly.
And soon, he would face that Sect Leader.
He certainly didn’t think he would be "pampered to the skies" for being the "sole heir of Stone Master’s legacy."
If he were the Sect Leader, he would demand the legacy be handed over or...given directly to some cultivators who had reached the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound to quickly become Skin Masters.
How could Stone Master not know about this situation?
This time, he was actually betrayed by "Stone Master," thrown into a beautiful, luxurious cage, becoming the caged bird, singing and at the mercy of others.
Now he was placed under the "spotlight," and it became increasingly difficult to hide all his secrets.
Moreover, there was also the death of "Gu Rufeng"...
He didn’t believe the Sect Leader wouldn’t suspect again...
He had even left behind the Shadow Puppet, wanting to protect Stone Master silently, only to see the truth.
Fortunately...he saw the truth, so he could quickly respond: finding an alternative path into the Fu Family, during the time before the ten-sided ambush was fully closed, had managed to make a surprising move.
After all, Stone Master was still a member of the Demon Sect.
South Bamboo Peak was engulfed in the reinforced bloody mist, the Suspended Room shattered by the demon Shadow Puppets, with no chance of survival for the servants.
He didn’t know what the Sect Leader and Stone Master talked about, but in the end, Stone Master must have compromised.
Ultimately, Stone Master initially chose him for the legacy, but for something else... seemed to give him a good direction, in fact... abandoned him.
No.
No longer call him Stone Master.
He should be called... "Ghost Cultivator" Stone Seat Elder.
The Sect Leader chose to "leave alive Stone Seat Elder’s legacy," rather than "Stone Seat Elder choosing to send him to a safe place," that’s all.
If he couldn’t see the situation clearly, thinking that Stone Seat Elder cared for him, loved him, then he’d be helping to count the money after being sold, which would truly be a great misfortune.
Recalling the gentle "Yan’er" from Stone Seat Elder before departing, Song Yan’s eyes narrowed slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 60. Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: 60. Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet
The night did not simply pass.
Because news from Shadow Puppet Peak arrived quickly.
"The Fox Demon invaded and actually launched a surprise attack on Shadow Puppet Peak!"
"Uncle Master Gu went out to eliminate the fox but disappeared."
"What is going on? Didn’t we... didn’t we win the war against the Fox Demon? How could there be so many Fox Demons invading?"
"What about the disciples at Shadow Puppet Peak? Aren’t they all dead?"
"Not necessarily, because last night a sinister mist surged with unprecedented intensity. It’s very likely that a Ghost Cultivator invaded..."
"Could Ghost Cultivator and Demonic Fox be mixing together?"
The disciples were in a state of panic.
That night, the guard was tight.
The Sect Leader personally took action.
...
...
Early the next day...
After a day and night of investigation, the direction of the discussions suddenly shifted.
"The Ghost Cultivator actually rescued the disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak."
"However, the Ghost Cultivator needs Skin Master very much, and from now on, our Puppet Sect probably won’t have Shadow Puppet Peak, while the Ghost Cultivator will be even stronger like a tiger with wings."
Song Yan listened silently, looking outside.
At Shadow Puppet Peak, not a single disciple was brought back.
Whether Shi Peng, or his previously acknowledged Senior Brother Wen Shu, and Second Senior Sister Jin Yuntian, it was all the same...
Regardless of their connections, this time... as long as they belonged to Shadow Puppet Peak, all were "bundled" and sent away.
Except for him, the "living inheritance of Stone Master."
As he was thinking, a disciple came from outside, saying that the Sect Leader wanted to see him.
Song Yan followed and entered a strange paper doll house.
The disciple seemed fearful and only said: "You go in by yourself."
Song Yan stepped cautiously over the threshold, walking through a corridor resembling a memorial hall, where twisted and tall, bizarre paper figures could be seen everywhere on either side.
Red male and green female paper figures, faces ghostly white, cheeks painted with rouge, mouths with eerie smiles, all towering up to the ceiling, yet because they were too tall, had to bend over, lowering their heads, overlooking the people walking in the corridor.
The air was filled with a cold eerie atmosphere. He pretended to be timid as he walked. When he passed an open door, he saw a screen.
On the screen, a beautiful figure was seen sitting elegantly.
"Greetings to the Sect Leader."
Song Yan knelt and then couldn’t help but cry, "Master... Master he..."
From behind the screen came a slow and aged voice.
"Seat Weng is fine, he has found a new breakthrough opportunity and may truly step into the Crimson Palace Realm, you... need not worry."
Song Yan wiped his tears, muttering, "That’s good, that’s good," then as if remembering something, he smiled bitterly and said, "Now that things have come to this point, Shadow Puppet Peak is gone. The disciple has nothing to hide anymore.
The inheritor of Stone Master’s teachings is actually the disciple, which is a method called ’Hundred Forms Divine Control.’ The disciple is willing to offer it to the sect to revive our Shadow Puppet lineage."
Behind the screen, there was a moment of silence.
Song Yan continued, "It’s just that what Stone Master conveyed, he was pursued by Nanwu Sword Sect back then and so it was lost. The disciple remembers some of it and after Stone Master’s guidance, although not reaching the realm..."
Suddenly, his words were interrupted.
"Come closer."
Song Yan stood up as instructed.
"Closer."
Song Yan stepped towards the screen.
"Closer..."
"One more step."
When Song Yan was face to face with the screen, a deathly pale hand suddenly shot out like a snake, clamping tightly onto his arm, and then... a strand of cold air penetrated into his body.
Shortly after, the hand retracted.
Song Yan feigned surprise and fear, trembling.
From behind the screen, the aged voice chuckled, "Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, Nanwu Sword Sect really went all out.
Gu Rufeng, you were quite prompt in your actions...
If you were a bit late, this seat’s plan might have changed.
You see, people’s hearts are indeed twisted. All for inheritance, Gu Rufeng actually wanted to poison Seat Weng."
"I... I..."
Song Yan stepped back in shock and fear.
The aged voice said, "Are you from the Su Family? I carefully investigated you, you stayed with the Su family girl, and even helped her kill someone.
You killed the Wei Kingdom’s Southern Wu King.
The Su family girl is indeed naive, destined to be taken advantage of.
That old fox of Southern Wu King was surely intending to report to escape, and you found out... you resolved this trouble."
Song Yan remained silent, but said, "I’m not from the Su Family."
The aged voice said, "Do you still have unresolved matters with Nanwu Sword Sect?"
Song Yan was silent for a moment.
The old voice chuckled sinisterly and said, "Since things have come to this, we might as well turn mistakes into fortune. Join my Puppet Sect; this old man wishes to take you as an apprentice and announce it to the world."
Seeing that Song Yan did not move, the old voice laughed again and said, "Or are you, like those hypocrites of the Nanwu Sword Sect, concerned with some notion of integrity?"
Song Yan bowed down, "Disciple Song Yan, greets Master."
"Hehehe... hehehe..."
"Hahaha..."
"Hehe..."
"Heh heh..."
The laughter of an old woman, a young woman, an old man, and a child chimed together.
It was as if a whole family was hysterically laughing.
A flawlessly carved white bone bracelet flew out from behind the screen, intricate and pure as jade.
"I am Gu Huangzi, and this is the profound artifact I became famous for before stepping into the Crimson Palace Realm—Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet.
The Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet is a treasure for nurturing the spirit. The longer you wear it, the stronger your spirit becomes. It is exceedingly rare for our Puppet Sect, whether it is the Shadow Puppet Lineage, the Paper Man Lineage, or the Blood Corpse Lineage.
Besides, you can throw this item to attack, with the force equal to a strike from a strong person at the early stage of the Crimson Palace Realm, enough for your self-defense.
This is the token of acceptance from your master."
Song Yan received the white bone bracelet and respectfully said, "Thank you, Master."
The old man behind the screen waved his hand and said, "Go now, but do not stop cultivating.
In a few days, I’ll have resources arranged for you.
As for the rest... we’ll discuss later.
Continue refining shadow puppets diligently."
"Yes..."
...
...
When Song Yan stepped out of the bizarre paper-man house, he was drenched in cold sweat.
He faintly smelled a scent of blood wafting from the house, accompanied by a trickling sound.
He hurried back to his quarters.
Today’s dangerous confrontations were far beyond what he expected.
He initially thought the Sect Leader would coerce him to hand over his knowledge, then perhaps dispose of him afterwards, so he prepared to claim the knowledge was lost, with only he remembering it.
But the Sect Leader suddenly and without reason investigated his power.
The motive for this was clear to him.
He understood that the Sect Leader suspected him of killing Gu Rufeng.
Thus, he adapted by displaying his Seventh Layer of Refining Profound power.
Such power could fully inherit and utilize the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" and was also capable of killing Gu Rufeng.
At the same time, he had to show this power.
Because he did not know the Sect Leader’s realm, but he knew that even with the Sealing Talisman and Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique, he may not hide his strength, so... he had to proactively reveal it.
At this point, the situation spiraled out of control.
Unexpectedly, the Puppet Sect Leader Gu Huangzi assumed he was a high-level spy for Nanwu Sword Sect and accepted him as an apprentice, even granting him this "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet."
This was a fortuitous miscalculation given his past actions... conveniently helping to complete his deception.
...
...
Now, Song Yan took out the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" and gazed at it.
The bracelet’s surface was smooth with intricate raised patterns, primarily made of unknown white bone. Upon closer look, one could see many naked figures raising their hands amid jagged ice spikes, faces twisted, eyes upturned in cries for help... clearly depicting a scene where sinners struggle in an icy hell.
This item, given by Gu Huangzi, surely had traps set within it.
As for the "blast of an early-stage Crimson Palace," Song Yan believed it to be true.
But he also believed if he used it to attack Gu Huangzi, even a heavily wounded Gu Huangzi would meet a gruesome end.
Yet, he could not avoid wearing it.
He closed his eyes slightly.
Opened the panel:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Life Span: 27/5057]
[Talent: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
[Realm: Ninth Layer of Refining Profound]
In this half-year since he returned, his lifespan had increased by three thousand years.
He concentrated on the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" and started investing his lifespan into it.
[You have invested ten years of lifespan into the ’Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet’ to nurture your spirit. The spirit is mysterious but can manifest through external objects, such as how currently, you can only control one additional shadow puppet with ’Hundred Forms Divine Control’ while maintaining your activities, but enhancing your spirit can increase your control count]
[In ten years, your spirit will strengthen, allowing you to control up to two shadow puppets]
Song Yan was slightly dazed.
’Nothing happened?’
’It seems the bracelet’s restriction leans more towards functions like a tracker or a listening device... but which exactly, can only be tested in the future.’
’However, since nothing happened, and it can nurture my spirit, then... let it continue nurturing.’
’Perhaps with a strengthened spirit, I might be able to detect what kind of restriction it holds.’

chapters.title: Chapter 61. The Little Guide of Paperman Peak
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: 61. The Little Guide of Paperman Peak
[You consume lifespan to nourish your spirit with the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet"]
[You close your eyes and hold the bracelet, the enhancement of your spirit leads to a new discovery.
Previously, you only felt that as long as you tightly held this bracelet, a wisp of spirit naturally emanated from it, nourishing you.
But now, you vaguely sense as if the bracelet truly harbors an ice hell within.
It may not be a hell, but it’s at least a huge cage.
Inside, the people are filled with grim ferocity, twisted pain, worse than death, raising heads and stretching hands as if calling for help, as if cursing.
Wisps of energy seem to emanate from them, soaring, then like a trickling stream converging, flowing into your divine soul, enhancing your spirit]
[In the thirtieth year, you feel your spirit has once again improved, allowing you to control the upper limit of shadow puppets to become three]
[You continue cultivating, as your spirit once again enhances, you see more.
You discover yourself overlooking from above, like a greedy demon drooling three feet...
And those wisps of energy that nourish the divine soul are like you greedily opening your mouth wide, revealing fangs, absorbing the power of the living in the hell]
[In the ninety-ninth year, your spirit elevates again, and the upper limit of shadow puppets you can control becomes four]
[The enhancement of spirit allows you to see more.
You greedily gaze at the strugglers within the ice cage, absorbing their power.
By chance, when you looked up, you suddenly found that there was also a vast gray mist around you]
[In the two hundred and eighty-ninth year, you feel an increasing amount of spirit is needed for the next qualitative change, even a hundred years cannot yield enough spirit from this bracelet, you patiently continue nourishing. Finally, in this year, you achieve an improvement, and the upper limit of shadow puppets you can control becomes five]
[In the three hundredth year, you continue nourishing spirit, yet find it only scratching the surface regarding the breakthrough to the next level, you have not improved much.
Your spirit is now strong enough, and you start to realize that spiritual power seems subtly related to the divine soul, and you finally discover the restriction on the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" — tracking.
No matter where you are, a wisp of energy seems faintly attached to you.
Upon careful discernment, you discover the source of that tracking energy.
When you drip essence blood into the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," the energy adheres to your essence blood, and you only need to sever the connection with the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," to remove this tracking energy.
However, besides that, you find another tracking energy attached to your left arm, even if you sever the connection with the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," they can still track you through this energy]
...
...
The deduction temporarily ends.
Song Yan feels that his spirit has strengthened considerably, and even the "Knife-beaked Finch Shadow Puppet" far away in Celestial Cloud City suddenly opens its eyes within the secret box, vaguely hearing familiar voices outside the door.
Upon careful discernment, it is Hua Linglong.
She seems to be discussing some business with someone.
On the other side, there’s the "Deformed One-tailed Fox Demon Shadow Puppet."
Its perceptions traveling along with Fu Shirong and Fu Hongmian are all transmitted over.
In the past, Song Yan could barely endure one, feeling dizzy and swollen.
But now, the dual perceptions sent at the same time already feel more than sufficient.
He can freely manipulate the shadow puppets from both sides without affecting his own thoughts or actions.
A good thing.
Lowering his head, he glanced at the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet."
Despite deducing, Song Yan has not worn it yet, nor dripped essence blood into it.
’This bracelet is very strange, but I have no choice... And compared to this bracelet, the wisp of tracking energy on my left arm is the most deadly.’
Before he completely falls out with "Puppet Sect Leader" Gu Huangzi, this energy cannot be removed.
Song Yan gazes at this Bone Jade Bracelet, flicking his fingers to squeeze out a drop of essence blood.
Clearly crimson blood, as it falls on the bracelet surface, turns into a drop of ink in a pool, spreading with a "boom" into black smoke, mixed with distant screams.
These voices, if not for Song Yan’s enhanced spirit, would be impossible to hear.
Song Yan furrows his brow, then stops thinking about internal conflicts.
Since Gu Huangzi accepts him as a disciple and gave him this object, he probably needs him for a while, naturally not intending harm. He still has time to observe.
As for the role of "Nanwu Sword Sect" which Gu Huangzi himself has imagined, he can only play it by ear.
Song Yan takes a deep breath, lying as relaxed as possible on the bed.
Paperman Peak and Shadow Puppet Peak, even South Bamboo Peak are different, here, even if you stand at the cliff edge and gaze afar, you cannot see that strange red blood mist.
Perhaps due to the abundance of caves here, whenever the wind blows, it brings eerie howling across the mountain, like many women crying and laughing in mournful speech.
Although the profound qi is fresh, the longer you stay, the more you can smell that indescribable bloody odor.
...
...
In the evening, dusk descends.
Song Yan has not gone out yet, he lies on the bed, thinking, while his vision follows the "Knife-beaked Finch of Celestial Cloud City" and the "Deformed One-tailed Fox by Fu Shirong" as they move.
’Since Gu Huangzi gave me a bracelet capable of delivering a strike of the Early Stage Crimson Palace, then his power must exceed the Early Stage of this realm, but perhaps not beyond the entire realm.’
’At this moment, it’s best for me to seek ways to break through the Crimson Palace Realm using the shadow puppets outside.’
As he pondered, stealthy footsteps suddenly approached the door.
Song Yan’s expression swiftly changes, warily looking towards the door.
Knocking sounds, accompanied by a timid female voice, emerge.
"Song... Master Song, are you there?"
Song Yan looked out through the window and saw a petite and delicate girl standing outside.
Her cloud-like hair slightly bound, a jade hairpin meticulously inserted, her elegant figure resembling a little spirit among the green mountains and clear waters; a pale skirt wrapped around her curvy hips, while her upper body adorned with embroidered brocade revealing her shapely form.
Her small face was indescribably beautiful, yet carried a sense of humility, nervousness, and a trace of numbness.
’Fox blood?’
’Wei Kingdom’s royalty?’
Song Yan opened the door.
The girl gave a shallow bow and said, "Slave Cao Yuzhuang, greets the master."
"Did the Sect Leader send you?"
"Yes... yes..." The girl named Cao Yuzhuang responded cautiously, then said, "Slave came here when eight years old, now sixteen..."
Song Yan instantly understood that this girl was also one of the Wei Kingdom royals sent here years ago, kept young for "cultivation reserves," and now directly gifted to him.
From the perspective of appearance and figure, this girl named Cao Yuzhuang far exceeded the previous Princess Consort Cao Xuerou, no wonder she was kept by Gu Huangzi.
Cao Yuzhuang suddenly knelt down, exceedingly humble, "Please, master, grant Yuzhuang Fanatic Fans... Yuzhuang grew up on Paperman Peak, quite familiar with the environment there, will take the master to see later.
Afterwards, will lead the master to the new cave mansion."
If it were a newcomer, Song Yan might hesitate somewhat.
But at this moment, he knew well that in this environment "neither has a choice," so he took out Fanatic Fans, hardly pouring out a bit yet saw Yuzhuang girl crawl to him to extend her little pink tongue to lick the powder on his finger.
Song Yan was startled, hurriedly holding up the girl, asked, "What are you doing?"
Cao Yuzhuang stared with big eyes, looking at him confusedly, then nervously said, "Did slave... do something wrong?"
Her whole body trembled, looking fearfully at Song Yan, her beautiful eyes brimming with tears, pitifully.
Song Yan was silent for a moment, suddenly pulling the girl’s dress sleeve, saw faint tiny needle marks on her arm.
He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, then picked up Fanatic Fans, was about to pour when saw the girl again reach her little tongue over.
This time, he softly poured a bit on her tongue, then said, "From now on, under the master’s orders, don’t kneel, nor extend your tongue for food."
Cao Yuzhuang hurriedly said, "Slave took note, slave will not kneel or extend tongue for food, whatever the master says."
After speaking, she dutifully stood aside, her pretty face looking at her chest, and her tiny feet’s toes nervously moving in the embroidered shoes.
The drug’s effect quickly made her cheeks blush.
Song Yan said, "Can you take me around Paperman Peak?"
Cao Yuzhuang quickly replied, "Yes, master... Sect Leader instructed, as long as you don’t leave Paperman Peak, you can go anywhere."
Song Yan said, "Alright, then show me around."
...
...
Cao Yuzhuang, being cultivated as a "high-tier furnace" from young, though pitiful, knew quite a lot.
Evidently, Gu Huangzi has his magnanimous side, having applied tracking restriction on both the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" and Song Yan, disdaining to play tricks in these little places anymore.
Cao Yuzhuang said, "Master, making paper figures is quite a hassle.
And the core lies in paper production.
Take tree bark, dry it, then soak it in essence blood, following normal papermaking procedures...
Different bark with different essence blood can produce different paper.
The higher tier the strong, the better the essence blood effect.
As for the tree, usually White Snake Eucalyptus on Paperman Peak is used."
She explained in detail.
These are not secrets on Paperman Peak.
But for Song Yan, it was quite novel.
He recalled Stone Seat Elder’s words, suddenly feeling the phrase "a corpse’s whole body is treasure" is spot on in Puppet Sect.
Skin, made into shadow puppet.
Meat, made into blood corpse.
Blood, soaking paper figures.
No wonder the "blood smell" on Paperman Peak is so rich.
’Then the divine soul?’ Song Yan couldn’t help but think.
For shadow puppets, the divine soul used is merely leftover fragments of the divine soul, not consuming the divine soul itself. Because during most summonings, the divine soul itself is long gone, and what gets summoned are just fragments."
Thinking of this, Song Yan said, "That’s for making paper, what about paper figures?"
Cao Yuzhuang fearfully glanced at the bone jade bracelet on his left hand and said, "Master, your brothers and you all have similar profound artifacts... but theirs aren’t as refined as yours, usually engraved on heavy armor.
Thus, tempering the body through heavy armor, simultaneously extracting divine soul from the heavy armor, nurturing the divine soul...New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Then, a portion of the divine soul can be split to awaken the paper figures."
Song Yan understood.
So, "paper figures" are "mecha" after all...
Making "mecha" with strong essence blood, nurturing the divine soul with "profound artifact," then dividing into several "personal little divine souls" to activate "mecha."
This... is Paperman Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 62. Lord Song
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: 62. Lord Song
Song Yan still very much wanted to "operate a mecha."
But evidently, the old demon Gu Huangzi wasn’t about to let him touch it.
Cao Yuzhuang led him on a brief tour of the "paper-making production line," then mentioned she’d be returning to her Cave Mansion.
Then... the two arrived at the edge of a cliff.
"Where is the Cave Mansion?" Song Yan asked.
Cao Yuzhuang hastily said, "Master, someone is coming."
Song Yan turned his head and saw an Inner Sect Disciple approaching from afar, staring at him with a strange expression, and then reached behind to hand him a carried box.
"The Sect Leader asked me to deliver this to you."
Song Yan accepted it, and said, "Thank you, Senior Brother."
Then he smiled and asked, "What’s this?"
The Inner Sect Disciple’s expression grew even stranger, and upon hearing the address, he waved his hand quickly, saying, "I dare not accept the title of Senior Brother, the Sect Leader has already instructed to take you as a disciple, which will be announced shortly. From now on, you are my Martial Uncle..."
Song Yan narrowed his eyes slightly.
The Inner Sect Disciple continued, "As for what’s inside this box, it’s an unowned Flying Sword. Its original owner was an expert from the Nanwu Sword Sect, who has already fallen. The Sect Leader said... you need to use this."
Song Yan: ...
The Inner Sect Disciple pushed the box into his hands and took his leave.
Song Yan opened the box.
He never imagined he would wield a sword?
And a Flying Sword, no less.
As for the reason, he understood it now: the Sect Leader wanted him to openly display the identity of a Nanwu Sword Sect disciple before everyone.
’Again... Although the righteous and evil cannot coexist, if an external enemy invades, the Human Race must unite, right?’
’But I’m not actually a Nanwu Sword Sect disciple...’
’However, if I’m not a Nanwu Sword Sect disciple, the problem would be significant...’
Today, Song Yan felt like he had been dreaming too much, encountering too many impossibilities.
Yet, at this moment, he had to marvel, "Back then, sharing a room with Qi Yao, and later helping Qi Yao defeat the Duke of Zhen Nan" unexpectedly... helped weave a natural excuse for him years later, giving him a unique identity.
Though it’s only temporary.
So, he must find a way to swiftly resolve this issue.
...
At this point, Cao Yuzhuang said, "Master, the Cave Mansion is on that mountain top over there. I will guide you, and you can bring me over."
That mountain top?
Song Yan nodded, then looked towards the Flying Sword.
It was a Flying Sword with a deep, cold gleam, its blade reflecting strands of rainbow light under the dim moonlight, evidently no ordinary item.
For an unowned Flying Sword, manipulating it simply wasn’t complex.
Since Song Yan had already revealed his identity as being at the "Seventh Layer of Refining Profound," he no longer concealed anything.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
He pointed a finger on the Flying Sword, channeling Profound Qi to establish a connection, then lifted his finger and clumsily manipulated the Flying Sword, stepping onto it.
He reached out and pulled Cao Yuzhuang along, flying into the distance.
Though it was his first time using the sword, since his true power was already at the "Ninth Layer of Refining Profound," his abundant power fully compensated for the lack of skill.
Under Cao Yuzhuang’s guidance, it wasn’t long before they arrived at the Cave Mansion.
...
...
The elevation in status not only significantly improved the quality of the Furnace Song Yan received but also greatly enhanced the level of his Cave Mansion.
Previously, at South Bamboo Peak, it was merely a cave with a simple stone door mechanism, and the only lighting facility inside was a skylight. On days of continuous wet and gloomy weather, the cave would be pitch-black, so much so that playful antics with a young lady would be like the blind groping each other...
And opposite the cave, above and below, there were other caves, the whole thing like a collective dormitory in the Cultivation Realm...
But the Cave Mansion here had become a mansion on a small mountain top.
This mansion wasn’t a typical two-bedroom townhouse, but a sprawling large house with bright lighting.
Inside were a bedroom and a study. Outside, there was a courtyard, a garden of Spiritual Soil flowers, and a scenic corridor based on the mountain’s contour.
With red lacquered pillars, glazed tiles, encountering exotic flowers and rare plants with every step, seeing clouds and mist rising with every turn, it had a secluded feel away from the mundane world.
For most disciples of Paperman Peak, however, they still lived in "collective dormitories."
As for the Chores Room of paper servants, the accommodations for those servants were even worse than the "Suspended Room" of Shadow Puppet Peak, as they lived underground...
The kind of underground house where once the door is sealed, no one could escape.
Differences in status make everything different.
And for Cultivators, an independent small mountain top around the main peak, while extremely troublesome for mortals who need to climb over mountains, was just a matter of "stepping on the gas"...
With a "boom," Shadow Puppets, Flying Swords, and such could already reach another mountain top.
After Song Yan landed, he entered the house and conducted a thorough inspection, finding no danger, he then climbed onto the bed.
Before long, Yuzhuang girl arrived at the bedside, and after inquiring "whether the master wanted her to undress" and receiving a negative answer, she voluntarily changed into a gauzy garment and climbed onto the bed like a cat, frowning gently, slowly merging with Song Yan.
The crimson plum blossoms slowly bloomed...
The night deepened.
...
...
A little over half a month later.
Song Yan’s identity was revealed.
He was a disciple from the Nanwu Sword Sect who came to the Puppet Sect, and also a disciple accepted by the Puppet Sect Leader.
A standalone pavilion on Paperman Peak was cleared out, and a large amount of demon beast skin was moved in. Song Yan, the "little martial uncle" to most of the Puppet Sect disciples, also entered and began making shadow puppets within.
Because he was at the "Seventh Layer of Refining Profound," he now needed to make complete shadow puppets instead of just semi-finished products.
In the spacious pavilion, besides him, there was only the Yuzhuang girl doing chores.
As for the "former master’s wife" Bi Huayi, she was simply settled in a cave mansion, where servants attended to her daily needs.
Thus the pavilion was named, with a plaque inscribed: Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
During the day, no disciple from Paperman Peak would enter this Shadow Puppet Pavilion, because everyone knew Song Yan’s special identity. But soon, a Puppet Sect recruitment brought newcomers into the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
"Song... Song Pavilion Master, hello, I... I’m called Yueyang Luo, I’m... a Lower Grade Earth Profound Root." A big-eyed boy with thick eyebrows, claiming to be from Yueyang Tower, nervously introduced himself.
"Song Pavilion Master, my name is Shen Nongjia, also a Lower Grade Earth Profound Root, and the sect assigned me to learn shadow puppetry from you." The girl was clear and articulate, deeply bowing to Song Yan.
Yueyang Tower?
Shennongjia?
Song Yan nodded... such names, they seemed to have some fate with him as well.
But just these two?
He was slightly puzzled.
But then he quickly understood: the Shadow Puppet Lineage doesn’t hold much significance for the whole Puppet Sect now, so a "production line" wasn’t necessary. Gu Huangzi Old Devil had chosen disciples with decent talent for him to teach.
As for why there were only two, perhaps these two were already among the best in this new batch.
Lower Grade Earth Profound Root, indeed, quite good.
One might say they were the best two of this batch.
Thus, he casually pointed to two spots, saying, "Sit down."
The two respectfully complied, and Shen Nongjia suddenly said, "In the future... can we call you teacher?"
Song Yan said, "Since the sect arranged for you to learn the art, you are my disciples. No need for too many formalities, just address me directly."
"Teacher." Shen Nongjia bowed again.
The thick-eyed Yueyang Luo also quickly called out, "Hello Teacher!"
Then, the two noticed Cao Yuzhuang nearby.
Previously, they had seen this stunningly beautiful young lady very close to their teacher, so they respectfully saluted.
Shen Nongjia said without flattery or arrogance, "Mistress."
Yueyang Luo, full of vigor, also said, "Hello Mistress! Beautiful!"
"Um... um... the beautiful Mistress and... and the powerful Master truly make a fine couple!"
After saying these, the big-eyed disciple secretly breathed a sigh of relief, his back soaked through with sweat, for he was an honest person, just inclined to speak the truth thoughtlessly.
Song Yan was momentarily stunned.
Cao Yuzhuang hurriedly waved her hand, saying repeatedly, "It’s not, it’s not, I... I’m just the master’s servant, I..."
Seeing her stammering, pitiful, helpless, and panic-stricken appearance, Song Yan sighed and said, "Mistress is just a title, no need to correct it. Yuzhuang, stand straight please."
He was now a person of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Being a bit more righteous and sympathetic was not out of place.
Having said that, Song Yan led the two new disciples to sit by his side and began teaching.
"Our Puppet Sect has four peaks: Paperman Peak, Blood Corpse Peak, Mechanical Peak, Bizarre Poison Peak.
And this Shadow Puppet Pavilion is a special place, what it teaches is completely different from elsewhere.
But here, there are no tasks, you need to devote all your efforts to learning skin making.
This skin making is divided into eight processes. First, selecting the skin; second, cleansing the skin; third, drafting.....
Song Yan taught.
He suddenly felt a bit dazed.
It was as if he had returned to the day he first came to the Puppet Sect. Sister Wang Susu Wang was teaching him like this before...
But time has changed things.
If Shadow Puppet Peak still had a head, this might count as Shadow Puppet Peak, or rather... he might be the Peak Master of South Bamboo Peak.
Since disciples have arrived, it seems he is temporarily safe.

chapters.title: Chapter 63. Stabbing the Fox (4.2K words - Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: 63. Stabbing the Fox (4.2K words - Subscribe)
A few days later...
Amid the autumn rain, the white mist over the hills came and went, thickening and thinning, lingering between the mountains and rivers, much like lost and restless wandering souls.
Song Yan held a deep black umbrella, looking down at the tombstones before him.
Each stone was inscribed with the names of the disciples who died in battle during the attack on the Puppet Sect.
Back then, when the four elders suddenly returned, the battle was forced to end. Even with the truce, the Nanwu Sword Sect dared not linger long in the enemy’s territory; thus, many disciples’ bodies were cremated nearby and buried for peace.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Plop...
Plop...
Raindrops fell upon the umbrella’s surface, splashing off onto the tombstones, flowing across the stone faces.
Song Yan held the umbrella, his gaze swiftly scanning the names on the tombstones, occasionally flying by sword to the next tombstone, continuing his search.
He needed to find a "superior" who could not confirm or deny his story and insist it was a "single-line contact."
Once a lie is admitted, it must be completely covered.
No amount of preparation is too much for this purpose.
He would no longer truly trust anyone.
The actions of the Stone Seat Elder seemed to show concern for him, which is why he didn’t take him to the Ghost Cultivation Land to suffer, but left him at Shadow Puppet Peak.
But life is never such a simple choice.
A cultivator of the first layer of Refining Profound, with a legacy but low aptitude, facing the enormous sect, the only option was to submit the "legacy."
If it were the Righteous Dao, the sect might still nurture such a minor cultivator.
But in the Demon Sect, "a crime because of possession, to prevent leaks" would be enough for death; the best outcome would be "keeping one’s life, being grounded, and diligently practicing skills to serve the sect."
The Stone Seat Elder, of course, knew these things.
If he had little lifespan left, his choice would have been what he wrote in the letter: Do not return, cultivate outside, and pass on the legacy.
But the Stone Seat Elder did not.
He didn’t even give Song Yan any preparation, just made the choice for him.
The Sect Leader might suspect that "Song Yan killed Gu Rufeng," and could such an old wise man like Stone Seat Elder not have considered this possibility?
Of course, he had.
He thought about it.
But he didn’t ask at all; he just acted.
A thought of kindness, a thought of malice; when kindness and malice tangle, people often see things differently.
Yet, if you’re not a person in the situation, how could you understand its harm? How could you tell the difference?
Plop.
Song Yan suddenly stopped in his tracks, his eyes resting on a tombstone.
That tombstone was perched on a lonely cliff, overlooking the rain-covered mountains with a magnificent view.
It was not easy for someone to position the tombstone high during the hasty burial.
The inscription on the tombstone was far more elaborate than elsewhere.
Engraved horizontally: May generations prosper, may souls return home.
Vertically inscribed: Tomb of Su Changyi, of Nanwu Sword Sect.
On the side were many names related to this "Su Changyi."
Among them, one was "Seventh Sister, Su Yao."
Su Yao?
Qi Yao?
Qi Yao?
So that’s it...
Song Yan gazed for a long time, then suddenly summoned a pre-prepared bouquet of white flowers from the storage space, looking at the names he had never seen before, he sighed deeply, speaking with a complex tone: "Old sir, I’m... visiting you..."
Then, he bent down, trembling as he placed the white flowers before the tombstone.
Because he didn’t know whether this Su Changyi drank alcohol... he hadn’t bought any wine.
After placing the flowers, he continued to look at the tombstone with grief, murmuring: "Now, with demons causing chaos and invading our human race, Yan can only lay down the obsession with righteousness and evil to seek cooperation and unity to resist external shame. I hope the old sir... doesn’t mind."
Though he said this aloud, he deeply understood within his heart: A seemingly legitimate title means nothing; to firmly establish his identity with the Nanwu Sword Sect, he had to master its swordsmanship.
...
...
The Fu Family.
This great family of the mortal world, with deep roots in the Three Kingdoms, thrived in both black and white worlds; even in the Independent Practitioner Realm, it held a prominent position. Though it couldn’t compare to the Puppet Sect or the Nanwu Sword Sect who occupied the Profound Veins, it was undoubtedly a significant force within the Three Kingdoms.
The family, having operated for hundreds of years, extended its influence beyond the Wei Kingdom, with many family members in Wu Shu and even the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Due to this relationship, the Fu Family and the Nanwu Sword Sect were almost inseparable, which was why Su Yao felt such an affinity when she first saw the Wei Kingdom’s royal family.
Fu Shirong, once the Lady General and now the Empress, her sudden return left many in the clan shocked, each saying things like "Your Highness, weren’t you always in the Imperial Palace?"
Fu Shirong began to narrate the situation in the Imperial Capital.
The older generation of the Fu Family were all stunned.
They had always believed "The Second Prince indeed died from internal strife, and the Grand General, upon a critical mandate, decisively took the throne to restrain the Scheming Lady, stabilizing the political situation, enduring humiliation, was a display of responsibility."
But unexpectedly, the truth was entirely the opposite!
A middle-aged man with firm brows and rugged muscles spoke: "Fortunately, fortunately, you returned, Shirong; otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable."
This was Shirong’s third uncle—Fu Baoniu, also a rare master in the Fu Family who had cultivated to the seventh layer of Refining Profound; now, he was filled with fear.
Fu Shirong’s expression shifted, and she said: "Third Uncle, did Cao Zhengjing set traps for you?"
Third Uncle Fu Baoniu replied: "We thought the King of Wei was enduring humiliation, so we invited heroes from across the land and let the King of Wei act as the insider in the Imperial Capital, creating an opportunity for us to assassinate the Scheming Lady.
Even though the Scheming Lady is a demon of the Crimson Palace Realm, she has long been weakened from giving birth to offspring, otherwise, she wouldn’t be hiding in the Imperial Capital’s myriad places, leaving people unclear about her exact location.

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 63. Stabbing the Fox (4.2K words - Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: 63. Stabbing the Fox (4.2K words - Subscribe)_2
As long as the Wei King is willing to help, we can get close to it, and then... with everyone’s joint effort, we can finish the task in one go and eliminate the chief culprit that harms the Human Race.
But if the Wei King openly helps while secretly... has already become the Fox Grandmother’s dog, then our group is doomed.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
If we die along the way, it doesn’t matter.
After all, your uncle never intended to break through the Crimson Palace Realm.
To do something worthwhile and without regret in this mere hundred-year life is enough.
But I’m just afraid of dying without accomplishing our mission.
However, Shirong, do you think... is it possible the Wei King made this move to gain the Fox Grandmother’s trust?"
Fu Shirong shook his head coldly and said, "You didn’t see how ecstatic he was after killing the Second Prince; if you had seen it, you wouldn’t think this way."
Fu Baoniu sighed, "You can know someone’s face but not their mind; it seems we need to plan longer..."
Fu Shirong’s expression changed, and he said, "It’s unnecessary. He wants to lure the enemy into the trap and capture us all in one go. So why not turn his trap on its head? I’ll return to the Imperial Capital to feign betrayal..."
"Will this actually work?" A white-bearded elder of the Fu family asked, leaning on his cane.
Fu Shirong said bitterly, "After escaping from the Imperial Palace, I was mistakenly captured by the Puppet Sect and was taken by a Demon Sect disciple to be a Furnace. Thus, my mindset changed, and I realized that power is everything, intending to co-create a Divine Dynasty sheltered by great power with him."
The Empress raised her neck high and straightforwardly spoke of "being used as a Furnace," with a demeanor that seemed resigned to death.
The Fu family fell into silence.
After a while, an elder in the clan sighed, "That truly was hard on you."
After saying these, they remembered the person who returned with the Empress.
A plain man with a scar on his face.
They all knew if Fu Shirong was captured by the Puppet Sect, she couldn’t escape on her own.
It seemed that the man was the one who rescued the Empress.
Fu Shirong, sensing something, said directly, "His name is Hua Rong, from Western Shu Celestial Cloud City... He has a complicated past, but thanks to him, I was able to escape."
"Western Shu Celestial Cloud City, Hua Rong?" an elder muttered, "That’s easy; your second grandfather is on his way back from attempting to assassinate the Fox Grandmother, and with him are experts from Nanwu Sword Sect. It is said that Nanwu Sword Sect has connected many forces everywhere, leaving Communication Stones behind, and this Cloud City happens to be one of them. It will be clear upon investigation."
Fu Shirong nodded and then hesitated a bit before returning to discuss with Hua Rong, then explained his background and experiences clearly to the Fu family elders.
...
...
Two days later...
"Hua Rong! Do you have news of him?"
The cold-as-ice Crowned Queen of Cloud City surprisingly sounded a bit excited, listening to the voices on the other side of the Communication Stone, responding one by one.
"Yes."
"Yes."
"That’s right."
"Unusual?" Hua Linglong pondered a moment, her thoughts leaping over the name "Tai Yi" and then she said, "No, he’s just an extraordinarily talented martial artist."
After another round of conversation, Hua Linglong put down the Communication Stone and gently exhaled.
Being able to hear news of that man again was truly wonderful.
However, having lived with that man day and night, she could feel a hard-to-describe mystery surrounding him.
There was no evidence, just pure intuition.
Yet she wasn’t some "woman seeking a husband," and besides, that man never admitted he was her husband.
Thus, everyone went about their own business.
...
...
The next day...
The sound of carriage wheel axle slowly settled.
The elderly driver lifted his sleepy eyes, pulling the reins to stop the carriage in front of Fu Mansion.
The person on the carriage was dressed in a white robe, brushed aside the curtain, and alighted from the horse.
In front of Fu Mansion, many people were already waiting.
Seeing the arrival, they all saluted, shouting, "Sir Su San, it’s an honor to have you here; we’ve failed to welcome you adequately, forgive us."
The white-robed man smiled and said, "I just paid a grand visit last month, and now I come again. Aren’t you tired of me?"
Everyone laughed heartily.
The two were Zhao Sisan and Wang Siwu, who previously went to Cloud City to hunt down the "Puppet Sect remnants."
And their true identities, one is the third-ranking member of the current generation of the Su Family from the Nanwu Sword Sect—Su Canli.
The other is the leader of Southern Wu’s Jianghu—Wang Shuangdao.
The two of them have come to participate in the "Assassination of the Great Fox Granny" matter.
At this moment, the two entered Fu Mansion, not sitting down, but headed straight to a place, stopping only when they reached a courtyard and looked inside it.
They saw a man sitting at a stone table, lost in thought.
As if sensing someone approaching, the man suddenly raised his head, meeting the gaze of the two outside.
Eyes met, and silence spoke volumes.
Wang Shuangdao smiled and cupped his hands, saying, "Farewell at Celestial Cloud, I never thought we would meet here again. I went by the false name Wang Siwu, but my real name is Wang Shuangdao."
Song Yan immediately stood up, returned the gesture, and with a bitter smile, cupped his hands again.
Su Canli’s eyes were sharp, fingers pressing profound techniques, he stepped forward and waved his long sleeves, sending a chill towards Song Yan like dancing snow in the returning wind.
The profound qi swept over, causing Song Yan’s appearance to blur slightly, revealing a vague outline of black for a moment before returning to normal.
Wang Shuangdao quickly raised his hand and said, "Brother Hua Rong, don’t be nervous. We know your background, now... Mr. Su is just testing, no need to worry."
Su Canli looked steadily at Song Yan, saying gravely, "Your fortune, I truly do not know if it’s a blessing or a curse.
Even our Sword Sect’s purification technique cannot break your illusion, only showing slight anomalies... Your illusion is incredibly powerful, it seems this is indeed the body of that Multi-tailed Fox Demon."
Song Yan shook slightly, revealing the abnormally One-tailed Fox Demon form of the "Giant Observation," then with a bitter smile, he mocked himself, "Mr. Su, where’s the fortune you mentioned?"
"This..."
Wang Shuangdao was suddenly shocked, stepping back two steps in fear.
What the heck is this terrifying ghost thing?!!
This is just a giant fox corpse soaked in water for too long!!
But he quickly composed himself, feeling ashamed, he cupped his hands too.
Su Canli circled around Song Yan once, marveling, "Remarkable, Brother Hua Rong’s fortune is truly rare in this world.
Mastery of martial arts, travels outside, battles fox demons, severely injured entering Puppet Sect, accidentally escaping to the back mountain, falling and then merging with this fox demon corpse in the Evil Land, becoming a ghost cultivator.
It’s just..."
Suddenly, Su Canli’s eyes shot with electric light, staring intensely at Song Yan, asking word by word, "But you, a martial artist, where did you get the courage to battle a fox demon? And after slaying one, to escape severely injured?"
The air tightened for an instant.
Song Yan responded in surprise, "Didn’t you go investigate?"
Su Canli asked, "What do you mean?"
Song Yan replied, "If you really went to Celestial Cloud City to investigate my background, you should know from the Flower Tower master... I actually have a loose cultivator identity, back then hiding my power, only fearing being caught up in the disputes of your Cultivator Realm.
This can be verified at Snake Corpse Market. I once bought a bottle of Refining Organ Pill from a fellow named Dan Lazi."
Su Canli:...
Wang Shuangdao:...
Song Yan:...
He was speechless, it seems that little girl Hua Linglong really has feelings and righteousness, taking it upon herself to keep some matters hidden for him.
But if he wasn’t a cultivator, with a weak divine soul, how could he have such a chance to become a ghost cultivator in the Evil Land?
Su Canli coughed awkwardly twice, cupping his fists, saying, "Then Brother Hua Rong should wait here for a few days more, I’ll return in a couple of days."
Song Yan said, "Certainly."
...
...
Two days later.
Su Canli returned awkwardly again.
This time, he had investigated thoroughly, and with Fu Shirong’s endorsement, his perception of this Hua Rong naturally changed significantly.
Taking the opportunity, Song Yan said, "Originally a loose cultivator, only knew some small magic techniques like Qi Arrow Technique, now with this ghost fox demon’s body, although it’s added some innate fox demon illusions and agility, it is ultimately still wicked.
I have long admired the Nanwu Sword Sect, having now become a ghost cultivator and fortunate enough to meet Mr. Su, I wonder if I might be so lucky to be taken into the Nanwu Sword Sect to learn Sword Sect techniques?"
Su Canli was taken aback, suddenly asked, "This action, will you join?"
The matter of "Assassination of the Great Fox Granny" was spoken of by Fu Shirong.
Song Yan nodded.
Su Canli clapped his hands, eyes shining, saying, "Good man! If so, why would Nanwu Sword Sect withhold techniques? Just that, with the day of the fox slaying approaching, let me ask the sect first, then teach you a powerful quick-to-learn swordsmanship."
Song Yan bowed deeply, saying, "Thank you very much!"

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 64. My Sword (3.0K words - Subscribe requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: 64. My Sword (3.0K words - Subscribe requested)
A few days later, Song Yanru finally obtained a cultivation technique and a spell from the Nanwu Sword Sect.
This exceeded his initial expectations.
The Righteous Dao indeed acts with integrity.
Once they recognize you, what they give is plentiful and generous.
It’s clear that in this world, at least in the land of the Three Kingdoms, righteousness is righteousness, evil is evil, and perhaps the so-called hypocrite by the old Demon Gu Huangzi truly possesses some unyielding real integrity.
The cultivation technique is named: "Profound Transformation Sword Manual."
To Song Yan’s surprise, it turned out to be a technique for absorbing Profound Qi.
Initially, Song Yan thought the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" was the technique used by all cultivators in the Refining Profound period, as the Puppet Palace concealed it so thoroughly, not letting you know that the full version of the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" was still incomplete.
This incompleteness lies in the two words "visualization".New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
While guiding Profound Qi to nourish their body, cultivators also consciously guide themselves, using the strength of their body to nurture their Divine Soul.
The usefulness of the Divine Soul, Song Yan had also witnessed.
Whether it was the "Shadow Puppet" or "Paperman," a powerful Divine Soul could always utilize more of them.
The "Profound Transformation Sword Manual" allows you to visualize a Heaven-Reaching Divine Sword in addition to guiding.
This sword is directly transmitted to your mind through a Jade Scroll, and although it might be somewhat blurred because it’s a "Stone Rubbing Jade Scroll," visualizing it is still not a problem.
Sword patterned flying rainbow, light like a long waterfall.
Shooting up three thousand feet, piercing into the boundless sea of clouds.
Even though the sword tip cannot be seen, this is precisely the mystery within the visualization.
The "Profound Transformation Sword Manual" explains this truth: if you can see a sword with complete imagery, visualizing this sword means you haven’t obtained your own sword.
The sharpest part of a sword is the tip; everything else is nearly a preparation for the tip.
If you visualize the Heaven-Reaching Divine Sword but can’t see the tip, you will naturally visualize a sword tip that matches that sky-piercing sword.
And what you visualize out is your own sword.
Thus named: My Sword.
This "sword formed from Profound Qi" is also "My Sword."
The cultivation technique states that this "My Sword" can slightly enhance "sword-class spells" at the Refining Profound Level, and lay a good foundation for future realms.
Song Yan remembered that during a lecture, Stone Seat Elder had once mentioned, "The ultimate in the Nanwu Sword Sect’s cultivation system is the sword array; mastering the flying sword is essential," but he never mentioned "visualization."
...
The spell is named: "White Snake Sword Technique."
The entry-level requirement is the fifth layer of Refining Profound, a swordsmanship in the Nanwu Sword Sect slightly better than the "mainstream goods," and nearly all disciples practice it.
This spell excels in "easy entry."
However, it is also a spell that is "easy to start, hard to master."
Su Family’s third son, Su Canli, naturally considered that the "wild Ghost Cultivator" had little time, so he provided him with a cultivation technique to form a strand of "My Sword" in Profound Qi; the spell was to enable him to enter, to utilize sword-system techniques.
It wasn’t for anything else but to increase the odds of success in the "Fox Stabbing Mission."
Considering anyone upon seeing Song Yan in his current state would think having someone adept at Illusion Techniques in the "Fox Stabbing Mission" would make the operation itself smoother.
Song Yan would inevitably play an important role in the "Fox Stabbing Mission."
As for mastering it, Su Canli didn’t think this wild Ghost Cultivator could completely master it in a short time.
And if the mission succeeded, this Ghost Cultivator would naturally join the Nanwu Sword Sect in a special capacity.
Thus, it wouldn’t be considered a disclosure of cultivation techniques, but merely acting "extraordinary measures for extraordinary times."
...
...
Paperman Peak, Shadow Puppet Pavilion...
Song Yan’s "true body" lowered his head and eyes, resembling a meticulous old craftsman perhaps wearing "reading glasses," meticulously working on the Intermediate Demon Beast Skin in front of him.
There still remained some corrosion within the skin, but his hands had long harbored the Five Elements’ counteracting power, unharmed.
As for the two young disciples, they were starting with ordinary beast skins, concurrently practicing the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" to break the realm soon.
In comparison to Song Yan on South Bamboo Peak, these two had better conditions.
Profound Vein Main Vein Cave Mansion, extra absorption of Profound Qi with Profound Jade, Little Profound Spirit Pill all complete...
As for the "Furnace," these two would soon come into contact with it.
Sizzle...
Sizzle sizzle...
Another few wisps of snowflake-like texture were scraped off.
While thinking of practicing Nanwu Sword Sect’s techniques tonight, Song Yan blew away these scraps, then held up the Demon Beast Skin and looked at it in the sunlight.
Just then, hurried footsteps came from outside the door, and Yueyang Luo rushed in, sat on the chair heavily, clenching his fists, not knowing what frustration he was expressing.
"What happened?" Song Yan asked flatly without raising his head.
Yueyang Luo grunted coldly: "Master, Liu Wenzan, he’s merely a poor-quality Earth Profound Root, entered the sect with me, and now he ridicules me, a lower-grade Earth Profound Root! Is his brain turned stupid? Sooner or later, I’ll kill him!"
Song Yan:...
This disciple, adapting to the Demon Sect environment rather quickly.
However, without this disciple saying, he already knew the reason.
The "Shadow Puppet Pavilion" is a special place within Paperman Peak, and he is even more special among the special.
Practicing here, simply put... means "no one above, future prospects worrisome," and the cultivation techniques practiced will inevitably be different from others.
Those disciples probably learned something, so they came here to show off. Yueyang Luo fought back, and the disciple laughed loudly, saying things like, "Your master belongs to Nanwu Sword Sect, and you still want to follow him."
He lowered his eyes and pondered for a moment, then said, "If there’s a fight next time, then fight. You are valued by the Sect Leader, one of the only two such talents in this sect. They... are not as good as you. If you really cause trouble, you... will be fine."
Yueyang Luo hesitated, thought for a while, and nodded thoughtfully.
...
...
Night falls.
Song Yan brought Miss Yuzhuang back to the cave mansion.
Ji Yuan, seeking pleasure...
Miss Yuzhuang collapsed on the bed, lifelessly lying on the edge, her large white bosom half-pressed and half-exposed.
Long legs like lotus stems protrude from the "pool" of the mandarin duck embroidered quilt, with one side revealing the lotus stem under the hip and the other just the tip of the golden lotus, really cute and beautiful.
The little face behind is mysterious and tired, like a confused, playful child unwilling to sleep.
Her red lips slightly parted.
She asked at one point, "Did Master have fun today?"
Then she asked again, "Did Yuzhuang make any mistakes today?"
Song Yan covered her with the quilt and said seriously, "I had fun and didn’t make any mistakes."
"That’s great." The girl let out a long sigh of relief.
Song Yan said, "Master’s order is to sleep until dawn."
"Hmm!" The girl nodded vigorously again and then obediently closed her eyes to sleep seriously.
Song Yan took off the Bone Jade Bracelet, casually tossed it on the bedside, then went to the study, sat cross-legged, took out a piece of demon beast skin, pretending to think, while concentrating on "[Cultivation Technique: Profound Transformation Sword Manual]" and "[Magic: White Snake Sword Technique]".
Information popped up:
[Please choose to invest life essence]
...
...
At this time, Wu Kingdom.
Nanwu Sword Sect...
The Immortal Lake is vast, with several immortal mountains like ink spots on the clear, water and sky-merged surface.
In the cloud and mist pavilion of an immortal mountain, whispered conversations are heard.
"Did you check everything? Do we have Song Yan, this secret agent, in the Puppet Sect?"
"Checked, no."
"What is Gu Huangzi, the old demon, up to? He inexplicably claimed he took one of our people as a disciple, yet this person is not one of our sect members, what’s the explanation?"
"Wait, there are still some deeply hidden secret agents that are contacted single line, maybe... Song Yan is one of them?"
"One of them, one of them?"
So many one of them!
The key is, does anyone know this person named Song Yan?
Go ask those secret agents who have returned, ask them."
In the pavilion, two people were talking when suddenly an outer disciple came to report, "Elder, Miss Su Seven seeks an audience."
"Su Yao?" The voice was cold, snorted, and said, "This rebellious girl doesn’t cultivate properly, what is she doing here?"
The disciple said, "Miss Su Seven said she knows something about Song Yan."
The Great Elder sat in the pavilion’s clouds and mist, wearing a white robe, with two wisps of white hair, wide sleeves fluttering, seemingly hiding dragons and tigers.
"Let her in."
Soon, a dignified lady stepped into the pavilion, wearing a pure silver sword robe with impeccable posture.
Her bearing was proud, with long legs, her loosely bound long hair swaying as she walked, and her Shui Xing eyes were filled with unapproachable coldness.
The initial heroic righteousness and subsequent icy killing intent all dissipated, turning into pure, indifferent coldness.
Just like the most inaccessible blade on a sword, so sharp it seemed it had already become a sword.
The Great Elder glanced at the person beside him and said, "This girl is rebellious, being used as a secret agent, killed her own people to throw in her lot, then refused to marry upon returning. Didn’t expect her to really develop after two years of seclusion."
The other person said, "The sharpness of a treasured sword comes from repeated grinding, if not broken, then naturally sharp."
The Great Elder looked at the sword-robed lady opposite and said, "Speak."
Su Yao narrated the events about Song Yan, from their initial meeting in the servant tannery, to living together, then separating, to both going to South Bamboo Peak, advising her to make skin rather than going out to Qingxi Market, to exterminating the Southern Warlord.
The Great Elder asked some details, and Su Yao spoke frankly without any emotional fluctuation.
Regarding Song Yan, she remembered the time he saved her life. Yet, as the two gradually drifted apart, she thought he would never appear before her again, but unexpectedly came in such a peculiar manner...
The Great Elder tasted this matter and said, "It seems, Song Yan actually knew you were one of our Sword Sect members long ago, not only did he not expose you, but he proactively helped you. That night, if the Southern Warlord had shouted your identity, you would have died."
Su Yao said, "Indeed. And in my impression, Song Yan is definitely not the ruthless and vicious disciple of the Demon Sect. Please consider thoroughly, Great Elder."
The Great Elder pondered again, waved his hand and said, "I will deliberate, you may leave."
Su Yao excused herself.
The Great Elder looked at the person beside him and suddenly asked, "Does our Sword Sect have secret agents on Paperman Peak?"
"We do."
"Have them look for an opportunity to leave a message, and let Song Yan publicly demonstrate our Sword Sect Techniques," the Great Elder said, "If he truly is one of our Sword Sect members, this... shouldn’t be difficult for him, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 65. Transforming into Rainbow (5.2K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: 65. Transforming into Rainbow (5.2K words - Please subscribe)
[You begin cultivating "Profound Transformation Sword Manual"]
[Like the "Profound Qi Guiding Technique," the "Profound Transformation Sword Manual" is merely a technique for absorbing Profound Qi. You only need to follow the guidance for regular cultivation, without the distinction of Xiaocheng or Great Success]
[Ten years later, your Profound Qi has not increased, but you feel that a trace of Sword Intent has been nurtured within your Divine Soul.
That trace of Sword Intent is mysterious and intangible, yet you can sense that your Divine Soul is indeed becoming sharper]
[One hundred years later, as usual, you visualize the Heaven-Reaching Divine Sword, seeing only the sword’s body beneath the clouds, not its tip.
In your heart, a strong, indefinable emotion is born.
The surging Sword Intent begins to merge with the Spirit you nurtured over three hundred years through the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," causing those Spirits to seem to take shape.
The sword tip slowly forms from your accumulated Spirit, eventually piercing the sky, dispersing the clouds, becoming a complete Heaven-Reaching Sword]
[You have comprehended the ultimate Secret Technique of the "Profound Transformation Sword Manual"—Human Sword Unity]
In the Cave Mansion’s study, Song Yan came to his senses and slowly put down the animal skin he was holding, looking at the Flying Sword on the other side.
Previously, even though he possessed this ownerless sword, it was still "the sword is the sword, he is he," with no connection between the two.
When he controlled the sword, it was like a child picking up a brick, wielding power in vain, not able to unleash deeper power.
He reconnected his Profound Qi to the Flying Sword.
This time, he felt his Divine Soul merge into the Flying Sword in a peculiar way.
The Flying Sword burst into a brilliant light, his figure moved, and he merged into that light, shooting out like a long rainbow with a slight movement.Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Fortunately, Song Yan only used a little power and kept enough caution, so the rainbow swiftly rotated dozens of times in the study before settling down.
The radiant light dissipated, and the person and sword separated again.
This time, the person is the person, and the sword is the sword.
Yet, with a single thought, Song Yan merged with the Sword’s radiant light again.
In this instant, he felt more.
He became stronger because of the sword, and the sword became sharper because of him.
Song Yan closed his eyes, pondering carefully for a long time before understanding.
’So that’s how it is...’
’Whether it is Flying Sword, paper figure, or shadow puppet, they all involve the cultivator’s Divine Soul to some extent.’
’However, the three have their differences.’
’A Flying Sword involves complete fusion with the sword, enhancing both the sword and the person, but if the sword is damaged, it can harm the person as well.
Because it is Human Sword Unity, the person and sword cannot separate.
Wherever the person is, the sword is there too.’
’A paper figure involves splitting a wisp of the Divine Soul into the paper figure, and no matter how strong the paper figure becomes, it won’t affect the main body. If the paper figure falls, the main body merely retrieves that wisp of the Divine Soul, harmlessly. It’s much safer than Human Sword Unity.
And because the paper figure is entirely a part of the main body’s Divine Soul, it cannot stray too far from the main body.’
’Originally, shadow puppets did not involve the Divine Soul, but were controlled externally. Their strength depended entirely on the shadow puppets themselves.
If no control is imposed, a shadow puppet does not become scrap metal like a Flying Sword, nor does it go out of control like a paper figure, as there are inherent evil souls within them, driven by those Evil Souls. This can be well demonstrated in the current Evil Land.
The Stone Seat Elder was indeed talented, using the Painted Skin Divine Physiognomy to simulate myriad forms, and then merging a wisp of Divine Soul into the shadow puppet, achieving a paper figure effect.
However, shadow puppets are more dangerous compared to paper figures.
Because a paper figure holds only a wisp of the main body’s Divine Soul, while the core of a shadow puppet is an invited Evil Soul, posing the risk of backfire if the merging is improper.
That’s why the Stone Seat Elder values Divine Physiognomy so much.
If you haven’t grasped the true essence of Divine Physiognomy, it becomes challenging to safely handle the shadow puppet’s Divine Soul, increasing the risk of backfire during merging.
’But I... can spend thousands of years, utilize Evil Qi, to perfect the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique," turning Summoning into Slave Soul, then into Deformed Soul.
While others cautiously avoid the backfire risk when merging the Divine Soul into a shadow puppet, I need not worry.
Because the invited Evil Soul is already under my control.
Therefore, I can control a shadow puppet from thousands of miles away, like an avatar, with just a bit of Divine Soul.’
’This is quite the... BUG...’
Song Yan snapped his finger gently, and the Flying Sword fell lightly back into its sheath.
...
...
[You begin cultivating the "White Snake Sword Technique"]
[Seven years later, you perfect this Magic]
[Forty years later, you deduce a Single Mutation spell, "Profound Snake Sword Technique"]
[Seven hundred and twenty-five years later, you deduce a Secondary Perfect Mutation spell, "Black and White Double Evil"]
To this point.
The deduction ends.
Song Yan glanced at the panel.
His lifespan changed from [27/5947] to "[27/5122]".
He closed his eyes and slightly perceived the newly comprehended Magic.
If the "White Snake Sword Technique" involves merging one’s Profound Qi and Divine Sword Intent into a Flying Sword, attacking like a serpent and slaying enemies,
Then the "Profound Snake Sword Technique" forms a layer of Evil Qi on top of this Profound Qi, greatly enhancing its power, turning the white rainbow into a black one.
And the Perfect Mutation spell, "Black and White Double Evil," is an elevation of two Single Mutation possibilities. It requires a certain level of Spiritual Power, and with sufficient Spiritual Power, the number of Flying Swords Song Yan can control increases from "one" to "two."
