Two swords unsheathed, one is an enhanced version of the Profound Snake, thus called Black Death, and this sword can be driven by Evil Qi without the person merging with it;

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 65. Becoming a Rainbow (5.2K words - Subscribe Request)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: 65. Becoming a Rainbow (5.2K words - Subscribe Request)_2
Another sword possesses the devouring ability of a white serpent, known as the White Sha; when this sword strikes, it can tear apart and absorb others’ Profound Qi, shattering their magic.
After completing his cultivation, Song Yan let out a small sigh of relief, turned around, and climbed back onto the mat, embracing the young maiden, Yuzhuang.
The young maiden stirred awake and drowsily asked, "Does Master still need Yuzhuang to serve you?"
Song Yan felt the shyness in his embrace and said, "Didn’t I give you an order to sleep until dawn?"
The young maiden, Yuzhuang, was stunned.
It was as if she froze.
"Being touched by Master requires asking if service is needed" conflicted with "Master’s previous order"...
The young maiden, Yuzhuang, began to tremble all over, her eyes turning red, showing a look of fear.
Just as she was about to speak, Song Yan said, "The new order from Master is to sleep until dawn from now on; the previous one’s void."
The young maiden began to "restart" and this time, she didn’t freeze up again.
She sweetly responded, then obediently lay on her side, her waist slightly bent, her ample hips closely pressed against Master’s body, then closed her eyes and earnestly fell asleep. During this time, no matter how Master moved, she strived to sleep soundly until dawn.
But Song Yan was not so dull.
He sensed the young maiden’s thoughts and understood that she might have suffered much hardship and abuse to be trained to this level.
He gently ruffled the young maiden’s hair but couldn’t find the words to say.
...
...
Some days later.
The "Fox Stabbing Alliance" on the Fu Family’s side was in full swing, with many experts gathering there.
These messages were also fully relayed to Song Yan through the shadow puppet.
However, with his "Hua Rong" identity, he could only pretend to be slow-witted in aptitude, since... shadow puppets cannot progress through learning. Fortunately, cultivation is not a matter of a day or two, and no one would be surprised at his inability to comprehend Sword Intent.
He began to try obtaining some information about the "Crimson Palace Realm" and "Nanwu Sword Sect."
These actions in no way affected his skin making at the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
Shen Nongjia studied diligently and would ask questions if any arose. Song Yan also shared all he knew, as what he was currently teaching was only the basics of the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique"...
Even if he taught this entirely, it wouldn’t matter because he still had the "Skin Painting Slave Soul Technique" and the "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique," but the latter two couldn’t be learned by Shen Nongjia; they were exclusive to ghost cultivators.
As for Stone Seat Elder’s "Hundred Forms Divine Control," he would occasionally mention it while teaching the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique."
Since Gu Huangzi sent these two people to him, it was to ensure that Stone Seat Elder’s teachings were passed down.
He would certainly teach.
He would teach bit by bit.
If he weren’t worried about "retiring the donkey after grinding the mill," he wouldn’t mind imparting everything. The principle was the same because he had long deduced the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" to the levels of "Divine Swallowing Hundred Forms" and "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
...
Hiss hiss hiss...
Whoosh...
Song Yan’s daytime life was always simply plain, even appearing incredibly tedious to outsiders.
At this moment, after completing a Blood Blade Deer’s shadow puppet, he didn’t stop but continued with a second one before going to the small dark room behind the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
He raised his hand, summoned souls, and casually used the "Deformed Soul Technique" to construct a shadow puppet, storing it in the storage ring.
Then he used the ordinary "Soul Summoning Technique" to construct another shadow puppet, carefully folding it and placing it in a sealed jade box.
The complete "Soul Summoning Technique" includes a step to temporarily put evil souls to sleep, which is also the most challenging part of the technique. If the skin master detects danger, the soul must be dispersed immediately.
This would lead to the failure of "shadow puppet creation," and the puppet would be torn apart due to the rampage of the divine soul.
Everything would need to be done all over again.
Thus, skin masters had a fairly high failure rate.
However, if successful, the shadow puppet would enter a "sleeping" state until someone used the "Skin Control Technique" to activate it.
At this point... it depends on the level of the disciple controlling the skin.
Lack of strength would lead to being backfired upon.
Therefore, the Puppet Sect had very strict requirements for disciples controlling the skin.
It’s not that you can’t control "low-level demon beast shadow puppets" while on the second or third layer of Refining Profound, but it’s not stable, and the backlash might be significant.
However, controlling it upon reaching the fourth layer would be nearly foolproof.
After completing a piece of "intermediate-level demon beast shadow puppet," dusk had settled...
He walked to the front door of the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, yawning.
The young maiden, Yuzhuang, ran over from behind, asking considerately, "Senior Brother, would you like some hot tea? I just brewed a pot with Moonlight Grass."
At the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, Song Yan corrected her address, prohibiting her from calling him "Master" and referring to herself as "slave." So... the young maiden, Yuzhuang, racked her brain and came up with "Senior Brother."
As for Moonlight Grass, it’s one of the main ingredients for making the Little Profound Spirit Pill, though pills focus solely on effects, not taste. Yet, when used for brewing tea, Moonlight Grass is still quite delicious.
"Hmm, I’ll have a cup."
"Senior Brother, please wait a moment."
The young maiden, Yuzhuang, went to pour the tea.
Meanwhile, another Inner Sect Disciple from the paper doll lineage arrived outside.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
This disciple’s name was Guan Wu, seemingly the relative of some Elder in the sect. His aptitude was ordinary, and he was previously responsible for escorting shadow puppets to Shadow Puppet Peak and similar tasks.
After all, shadow puppets were tools that everyone in the Puppet Sect could use.
Song Yan handed over the completed shadow puppet jade box, and Guan Wu couldn’t help but praise, "Elder Song can complete an intermediate shadow puppet every day; it’s incredibly strong. Before, when I went to Shadow Puppet Peak to collect finished shadow puppets, I never saw a skin master like you, not even someone as skilled as Elder Stone."

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 65. Transforming into Rainbow (5.2K words - Please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: 65. Transforming into Rainbow (5.2K words - Please subscribe)_3
"Furthermore, all the fellow disciples praise Master Song’s craftsmanship."
Song Yan waved his hand with a smile, "I’m not as good as the teacher; I often fail and lose quite a few shadow puppets, just a bit quicker with my hands."
Guan Wu said, "Master Song, no need to be modest. Master Shi passed his teachings to you, surely believing you can surpass him. To be honest, I, Guan Wu, didn’t know you well before, but after getting to know you... I feel this mantle truly should be passed to you."
Song Yan smiled lightly.
The two bid farewell.
Behind them, Yuzhuang maiden hurriedly brought tea.
Song Yan took it, sipped, and relaxed.
Even though "Hua Rong" over there was surrounded by crises, he himself was on a normal ’nine-to-five’.
And in this ’nine-to-five’ routine, it’s most leisurely when ’close to finishing work’.
During this time, he had proven his terrifying talent in the shadow puppet art with his own power.
His title had evolved from the initially slight "Uncle Master," "Master Song," "Little Song" to a uniform "Master Song."
Just then, not far away, Yueyang Luo hurriedly returned, with a disciple chatting and laughing beside him. Upon reaching the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, that disciple clasped his fists to Yueyang Luo and said, "Brother Yue, remember to come."
Yueyang Luo laughed heartily, "Bro Liu, you’re too polite, I’ll definitely come."
That disciple also respectfully called "Master Song" to Song Yan before leaving.
Yueyang Luo remarked, "Master, this is Liu Wenzan; he is quite sensible, willingly backed down today, and even invited me to join the recruitment in a few days."
Speaking the words "recruitment," he chuckled, clearly understanding the intricacies involved.
Song Yan said no more, waved his hand, "Don’t neglect your skin making."
Yueyang Luo entered the pavilion, and upon seeing Cao Yuzhuang, no longer greeted her as "Mistress" as before, but merely scanned her with contempt and hint of evil, then sat down to make skin.
Shen Nongjia didn’t lift his head, saying blandly, "Why don’t you call her Mistress anymore?"
Yueyang Luo replied, "Got it wrong! It’s merely a furnace from the sect, a tool, why call her Mistress? Is she worthy of Master? Humph!"
Shen Nongjia said, "Even so, since Master acknowledges her, you shouldn’t be outspoken."
"Oh!"
Yueyang Luo suddenly stood up, "When is it your turn to lecture me?"
Shen Nongjia gave a faint smile, remaining silent.
Song Yan sighed softly.
These two disciples, one has a fiery temper, inclined to kill; the other is deep and cunning.
Truly neither is easy to deal with.
He turned his head, saw Yuzhuang maiden looking tense and said, "Little Yue, in this room, she is your Mistress, understood?"
Yueyang Luo saw Song Yan’s back, couldn’t help but secretly roll his eyes, saying, "Understood, Mas...ter..."
Shen Nongjia said, "Master, Yueyang Luo just rolled his eyes at you."
Yueyang Luo was startled, hurriedly said, "Don’t talk nonsense, how dare I disrespect Master?"
Song Yan said, "Enough! Stop arguing!"
They both fell silent, bowing their heads to skin making.
...
...
That night.
Song Yan controlled the sword, bringing the Yuzhuang maiden back to the cave mansion.
Just as he opened the door, a sheet of paper fell from the crack.
Song Yan grabbed the paper and looked.
It read: Friend Song, could you showcase Sword Sect techniques in public to confirm your identity?
No signature was given, nor who might have left it.
Song Yan pondered.
...
...
The next day, Song Yan only opened the door at the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, then carried his sword to the cliff’s edge crowded with disciples.
During this period, although his days were peaceful, Puppet Sect and Ghost Cultivators worked together to eliminate infiltrating the fox demon.
Outside the cliff, many disciples saw Song Yan there, feeling utterly strange.
Song Yan said, "Regarding the fox demon, it’s time for me, Song, to give my utmost."
After saying that, he cast the White Snake Sword Technique, flying sword unsheathing, transforming into a white rainbow rushing afar, he melded within, soon disappearing over the horizon.
All disciples watched in amazement.
...
...
After a long time...
Within a valley, noisy sounds were echoing.
That was numerous disciples besieging the fox demon.
But the fox demon was sly, with considerable power, and this time... Puppet Sect disciples seemed to have poked a fox’s den, bringing out three or four fox demons simultaneously, now struggling to cope.
The disciples, on the verge of failing, suddenly sensed a white rainbow crossing the sky, then saw that rainbow light fly down, slicing a fox’s head clean off.
"What profound artifact?!"
"No! It’s not a profound artifact, it’s... Master Song!"
"Master Song? Impossible, isn’t he only skilled in skin making?"
"How is this possible?"
Song Yan transformed into rainbow in public, amidst many people, chose the weakest fox demon, and swiftly assassinated it, then returned.
On Shadow Puppet Pavilion, rainbow came from afar, abruptly stopped.
A white-robed man descended from heaven, one man one sword, sword flowers twirling lightly, sheathed, body upright, eyes like electricity, seemingly absorbing and concentrating the sharpness around into himself.
...
...
"Master?"
Yueyang Luo stood at the door, having gone outside upon seeing the rainbow approaching, now seeing the descendent was indeed his master, stood dazed.
Then looking at his master’s eyes, felt the sharpness scalding, hurriedly lowered his head, heart pounding, recalled yesterday’s disrespect, increasing his fear.
He suddenly felt his legs weak, turned inside the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, lifted his head to see Yuzhuang maiden shrinking and serving tea, hurriedly lowered his head, respectfully said, "Mistress... Master, he’s back."
Yuzhuang maiden was surprised, nodded, responded, "Hmm."
Song Yan strode into the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
He wasn’t hurried or worried.
After today, the name of a Seventh Layer of Refining Profound Sword Dao Cultivator, Master of Skin Making would spread.
His Sword Sect disciple identity and explanation for this power would reach a perfect conclusion.
Although the power he displayed today was formidable, it should only be considered an intermediate talent that any disciple who painstakingly nurtured sword intent and arduously practiced the "White Snake Sword Technique" could wield.
Sword cultivators are inherently excellent in individual destructive power.
All these, naturally, did not touch upon his actual power.
Song Yan raised his hand, retrieved two sheets of beast skin, continued crafting.
Every now and then, he would ’ruin’ a sheet of beast skin, firstly to make his success rate not a hundred percent, secondly... to hide another ’already ruined’ "Intermediate Demon Beast Shadow Puppet" in the storage space.
With more shadow puppets, the stronger, his ’Hundred Forms Demon Body’ would wield increasingly terrifying power.
These days, he had stored as many as nine "Intermediate Demon Beast Shadow Puppets."
Today, it’s the tenth one.
As he accumulated more, in the future when truly driven to desperation, he might have to escape, he could swallow one hundred forms, merge those over a hundred "Intermediate Demon Beast Deformed Soul Shadow Puppets," manifest the demon body, increasing a bit of vitality, right?ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 66. Crimson Palace (2.0K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: 66. Crimson Palace (2.0K words - Please subscribe)
Song Yan’s actions did not bring much change to his life.
For disciples of the Sword Sect to use Sword Sect Techniques seems a matter of course.
And everyone knows that Song Yan is a spy for the Nanwu Sword Sect.
His days remained "nine to five."
However, Song Yan was often out of the loop, previously learning things from his "classmate" Junior Sister Wang, but now he could only get information from his own disciples.
His identity was special. Besides the matter of the "shadow puppet," no one else would actively engage with him, fearing that associating too closely might bring disaster later.
But Yueyang Luo and Shen Nongjia were different.
Anyone with insight knew that, barring unexpected events, the two of them would likely become future pillars of the sect.
Thus, they were quite popular outside.
Yet the two were also different.
Yueyang Luo was boisterous, often shouting "kill this one, kill that one," but he easily turned foes into friends. He frequently visited Song Yan to "ask for leave," sometimes to recruit new members, other times claiming to pick up rare finds at a certain market, or seeking fated encounters.
Song Yan, worried that the seedlings sent by the Sect Leader might falter under his care, would issue "grounding orders" for anything he deemed too dangerous.
Once Yueyang Luo had seen his master’s "battle mode," he became much more subdued.
When Song Yan issued a grounding order, Yueyang Luo stayed obediently at the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, making leather crafts.
But even so, he brought back quite a bit of news from outside for Song Yan.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Shen Nongjia, no longer the youthful girl she first appeared to be, grew increasingly brooding, yet she also befriended several demonesses in the sect.
Although she had information, if Song Yan didn’t ask, she wouldn’t volunteer it. But when she did speak, her information was more accurate and detailed than Yueyang Luo’s.
...
One day, Young Lady Yuzhuang was beside him brewing tea and burning incense while Song Yan made shadow puppets.
The two disciples suddenly began discussing the same topic.
"Master, something big has happened!"
"What is it?"
"There’s news that the Nanwu Sword Sect wants to ally with our Puppet Sect to stand against the Fox Demon," Yueyang Luo said brightly. "Tsk tsk tsk, this way, Master might see many of his old friends again."
Shen Nongjia said coldly, "Seeing the wind and making it rain, Yueyang Luo, you know a little bit and dare to boast in front of the teacher?"
Song Yan said, "You tell me, Xiao Shen."
Shen Nongjia said, "Teacher, it’s like this. Our Puppet Sect plans to co-host a market at Cold Pool Valley with the Nanwu Sword Sect, open to loose cultivators as well.
At that time, disciples from both sects can browse the market, spending Profound Jade to purchase each other’s cultivation techniques, elixirs, and so on. It seems both sides will offer good items, not just common goods."
After speaking, she paused before adding, "In my view, our Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect have deep grudges, but now that there is an external enemy, both sides are preparing to attempt cooperation. Opening a market at Cold Pool Valley is a test."
Song Yan nodded.
It seems that the other day when he launched a rainbow, he was indeed seen by spies from the Nanwu Sword Sect, validating his likely identity as a spy for them.
The Puppet Sect Leader taking him as a disciple was a gesture of goodwill.
Once his identity was confirmed, the Nanwu Sword Sect accepted this gesture.
Hence, the Cold Pool Valley Market.
However...
He knew something else.
The reason for the "Cold Pool Valley Market" test is that there are still quite a few in the Nanwu Sword Sect who are unwilling to cooperate with the Puppet Sect because they simply cannot trust Gu Huangzi.
Many strong individuals from this group have already gathered at the Fu Family, planning to assassinate Mistress Fox.
If Mistress Fox dies, there’s no need to cooperate with the Puppet Sect.
Besides, they seem to stand to gain quite a bit.
...
...
Mid-autumn, approaching winter.
The cultivators abandoned Sword Control, disguised themselves as various identities, and rode toward the Imperial Capital.
The twisted one-tailed fox shadow puppet of Song Yan traveled with Su Canli and Fu Shirong.
Song Yan asked, "What benefits come from killing Mistress Fox?"
Su Canli said, "Frankly speaking, Mistress Fox is also a demon, and its blood can be used to break through the Crimson Palace Realm...
I had previously investigated, and the blood from the line of the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox is alien blood, which can be absorbed by the Fox Demon and potentially by humans as well.
If we could acquire the blood and try it, it would be great.
If it succeeds, then... then..."
Su Canli was excited but lacked confidence, as the chance of success in such matters was exceedingly low.
Unless someone had the luck of all lucks, there might be the slightest chance of success.
Song Yan curiously asked, "Can the Crimson Palace Realm be achieved just by absorbing strong demon blood?"
For Su Canli, this wasn’t a secret.
He directly replied, "Not exactly. Demon blood is just a primary ingredient. Many auxiliary substances are needed to remove its toxins and increase the success rate, thus making the Crimson Palace Pill, a realm-breaking elixir.
But most Crimson Palace Pills are made from high-level demon beast blood similar to the ninth-tier Refining Profound, and it’s likely no one has used Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox blood for a Crimson Palace Pill."
Song Yan asked further, "Then... what if someone directly drank demon blood, could it succeed?"
Su Canli was taken aback but then chuckled, "Brother Hua, demon blood is highly toxic. If a cultivator drinks it, it’s lethal upon contact; if you use it for direct cultivation, you’d need ten thousand lives... But if luck is on your side and you avoid the toxins while merging with its power, theoretically, there’s still a tiny hope."
"The Crimson Palace Realm is all about external blood merging with one’s essence, transforming a dragon into a coiling serpent in the heart. Once done, you’ve stepped into the Crimson Palace Realm, after which you can continue absorbing more Profound Qi, transforming it into Profound Liquid, thereby making various techniques more powerful."
As they spoke, dusk fell, and the three found a ruined temple nearby to stay in...
Traveling further north, they reached the Wei Kingdom’s territory.
For outsiders, towns may not necessarily be safer than the wild.
Moreover, Fu Shirong needed to appear as if he had fled the Puppet Sect, roving outside, to gain the Wei King’s trust.
After settling into the ruined temple, the three quietly discussed their plans in the Imperial Capital.
This three-person team wasn’t an "assassination team," but rather resembled "scouts."
Fu Shirong was responsible for locating Mistress Fox, Su Canli for relaying information, while Song Yan, skilled in Illusion Techniques, joined as needed.
After all, someone who could transform into anyone would make things much easier.
"Once I figure out how the current Imperial Palace operates and understand who’s involved with Mistress Fox, we’ll immediately kill Wei King, then let Brother Hua disguise as the Wei King to figure out where Mistress Fox is,"
Fu Shirong was already adjusting his title, getting used to his new identity.
Su Canli said, "Whether this assassination succeeds hinges on the Empress. But... the Empress might also be the most dangerous."
Fu Shirong said, "If we can kill this villain, dying is worth it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 67. First Kill (4.1K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: 67. First Kill (4.1K words - Please subscribe)
The dilapidated temple’s morning was accompanied by light snowfall.
Early in the morning, Fu Shirong had already finished practicing a round of swordsmanship, then sheathed the sword and regulated her breathing.
Su Canli praised, "Excellent swordsmanship."
Fu Shirong replied, "It was something to pass the time with while at the Puppet Sect, given to me by a disciple of the Demon Sect."
Su Canli asked, "Brother Hua is a martial arts expert as well. What do you think of this swordsmanship?"
Song Yan complimented, "Wonderful."
Su Canli asked curiously, "Do you know the name of that Demon Sect disciple?"
Fu Shirong, with a complex expression, said, "Song Yan."
"Song Yan?"
Su Canli almost jumped up in surprise, then asked again, "Song Yan?! Which Song Yan?"
Fu Shirong replied in surprise, "Song Yan from the Cave Mansion on South Bamboo Peak with the Shadow Puppet. He is quite valued, seems to be the disciple of someone called Master Shi from the Demon Sect. He... what’s wrong?"
Su Canli, with a peculiar expression, said, "He... he might be a spy within our ranks, secretly infiltrating the Demon Sect for many years..."
Fu Shirong was bewildered, "Impossible, right?"
Su Canli said, "I received communication from the sect, his White Snake Rainbow Transformation couldn’t possibly be mastered without over a decade of nurturing Sword Intent. The Heart Method and Techniques are both ours."
He then briefly recounted various matters concerning Song Yan.
As Fu Shirong listened, memories of the shameless days she spent with Song Yan flooded her mind, leaving her even more conflicted.
But soon, she surprisingly came to terms with it and said with a smile, "No wonder he treated Hongmian and me so well.
After all, I didn’t really lose my dignity to a disciple of the Demon Sect; the humiliation we suffered was something we both helplessly endured.
The thorn in my heart is somewhat relieved...
If I meet him again in the future, I wonder how he will face me."
With that said, the Empress lifted her head, her eyes glinting with determination, "This time, I must save the people from disaster and chaos."
Su Canli said, "It can definitely be done."
Song Yan thought for a bit and silently stepped forward, raising his hand.
The two were startled.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Su Canli was the first to place her hand on his.
Then, the Empress placed her hand on top.
The three hands clasped together tightly, a gleam in their eyes, as if speaking of a shared dream: eliminate the Fox Demon and restore the bright universe of the Northern Land!
...
...
Paperman Mountain...
The frost had frozen the branches of the ancient trees at the mountain’s peak, breaking a few in the cold wind, which fell into the deep ravine with a snap.
The mountain fog spread, the light snow filling the sky, and the heavens and earth of the deep mountains were a vast expanse of blinding white.
But early in the day, Song Yan had already left the Cave Mansion under the guise of cultivation, sword in hand, and came to a secluded place in the mountains, releasing two "Deformed Soul One-tailed Fox Demon" Shadow Puppets and one "Deformed Soulless Phantom Crow" Shadow Puppet.
The Soulless Phantom Crow was rare, but since the skins of the Puppet Sect’s Demon Beasts had all been delivered to him, he had an opportunity to select this piece.
The three Shadow Puppets flew directly toward the Imperial Capital.
Song Yan was deeply enticed by the "Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox Demon Blood" of Granny Fox.
Though he didn’t know how to refine the Crimson Palace Pill, as long as he could get the blood, he could attempt unlimited calculations of his lifespan.
Since Granny Fox’s blood was so venomous, sealing the throat upon contact, whenever he failed in calculations, he would die instantly, and it wouldn’t take much time.
Unlimited calculations mean that no matter how low the success rate, as long as he had enough lifespan, there was always a chance of success.
Where others might try, perhaps one in ten thousand would succeed, but he... could succeed by trying ten thousand times, a hundred thousand times.
This is the unique point of his "Remaining Life Dao Fruit."
The release of these three Shadow Puppets had already pushed him to his limit.
Heading to the Imperial Capital was to remain adaptable to the situation.
His motive was not fueled by Fu Shirong’s composure, but rather by Su Canli’s confidence.
Their perspectives were different.
The latter’s confidence was not the product of idealism...
When the three hands united, Song Yan was convinced that "the Su Family must have other arrangements," which instilled confidence in Su Canli.
And Su Canli’s confidence allowed him to glimpse a chance to acquire "Granny Fox’s Demon Blood."
Therefore, he doubled down.
After releasing the three Shadow Puppets, he stood silently.
Flicking his left sleeve, a black light shot out in a burst, and upon closer inspection, it was a flying sword.
The flying sword circled around him before returning to his sleeve’s storage space with a "swish," hauntingly undetectable.
Song Yan strapped the flying sword to his back once more.
He was still short of a flying sword.
But procuring a good flying sword from the current market of the Puppet Sect was a sheer fantasy, as the Profound Artifacts forged at Mechanical Peak were not of the "flying sword" variety.
However, the upcoming Cold Pool Valley Market co-hosted by the two sects should offer a chance to acquire a good sword.
By then, with one sword on his back and one hidden in his storage space, in an actual fight, suddenly drawing two swords would likely catch opponents by surprise.
Song Yan continued his experiments, discovering that the "Black and White Double Evil" derived from the mutation of the "White Snake Sword Technique" had far surpassed the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" mutated from the "Qi Concealment Technique" and the "Torrential Rain Evil" mutated from the "Qi Arrow Technique."
In both the "casting animation" and "power," the "White Evil," which could absorb enemy Profound Qi, and the "Black Death," which could unleash ferocious attacks, were unrivaled.
’I still need to conserve my lifespan. Despite having thousands or tens of thousands of years, I’m only at the Refining Profound Level now; much more lifespan will be needed later.’

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 67. First Kill (4.1K words - Please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: 67. First Kill (4.1K words - Please subscribe)_2
’High-level magic mutations, their effects far surpass the ordinary. Now, this "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" and "Torrential Rain Evil", except for some remaining Qi Concealment effect by the former, can basically be completely eliminated.’
Upon finishing, Song Yan made a sign for the White Snake Sword Technique, transformed into a rainbow, broke through the mist, and returned to the mountaintop where the Cave Mansion was located.
Little Lady Yuzhuang had already risen, slowly stewing rice porridge in front of the fire under the eaves.
Although Song Yan had taken a Fasting Pill, he still cherished a taste for mortal delicacies, so Little Lady Yuzhuang made sure to prepare breakfast.
Snow fell continuously, the beauty kneeled, steam rose, and the cold air carried a fragrance.
Song Yan put on the Bone Jade Bracelet.
The moment he put it on, he suddenly felt an inexplicable "neuropathic spasm" on his left wrist, a pain that came and went.
He frowned slightly and immersed himself into the ’Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet’.
In an instant, he found himself overlooking the "Ice Cage", observing the prisoners of all ages within stretching their hands upward, their faces twisted in savage agony, crying out for help.
Strands of Divine Soul Power flew out from those prisoners, converging toward him, nurturing his Divine Soul.
The surrounding was covered in dense gray fog, but at this moment, the fog seemed to slightly disperse due to some movement, revealing a thick, black object not far away.
It appeared to be an iron pillar of the cage!
Just now, it was a strand of his dissipating Spiritual Power that touched that iron pillar, causing the "neuropathic spasm", like an octopus tentacle accidentally touching a hot iron rod.
Now, as the Spiritual Power retreated,
the gray fog closed in again, concealing everything beyond once more.
Everything returned to normal.
Song Yan looked up, yet saw nothing.
Such a scene was something a disciple at the Refining Profound Level shouldn’t have been able to notice, because although his power was mentioned, his spirit was weak.
The weakness of spirit should not allow him to notice the surrounding gray fog, let alone its dispersal or the appearance of the black pillar.
As his spirit grew with nurturing, even though his spiritual power slowly expanded, he could only notice "the struggling people in the Ice Cage" and "the fact that his Divine Soul’s nurturing came entirely from those prisoners", leading to either secret delight or disgust, never producing other emotions.
But now he not only used the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" to nurture his Divine Soul but also visualized Sword Intent with the "Profound Transformation Sword Manual", thus naturally able to perceive many things.
’Gu Huangzi... this old demon truly harbors ill intentions.’
’Besides the Tracking Spell on my left arm, this "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" indeed harbors deeper traps.’
’I also roughly understand why Puppet Sect disciples aren’t taught the complete "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" at low realms.’
’As expected... from the Demon Sect.’
Song Yan’s expression was icy.
Suddenly, he began to realize that the situation he was in might be more dangerous than he had imagined.
Once Gu Huangzi completed his use of Song Yan’s "spy identity in Nanwu Sword Sect", once he acquired the complete Shadow Puppetry Inheritance, he would most likely make his move.
At that time, Song Yan might indeed become one of the "prisoners" in some "cage", providing Divine Soul nurture for the old demon, or end up as a blood-soaked paper, transforming into a flesh corpse...
The Demon Sect recruited many new people each year, yet the number remained relatively fixed.
It seems not only due to battle deaths but also because some... became "food".
"Master, breakfast is ready."
A timid voice of the young lady came from the side, Song Yan composed himself and responded, "Prepare an extra set of bowls and chopsticks, let’s eat together."
...ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
...
In the blink of an eye, another half month passed.
Little snowflakes fell continuously, covering the thousands of palaces and halls of the Imperial City.
The glazed tiles and hidden black ridges were all dyed white.
Surprisingly, there were many people on the streets of the Imperial Capital, the markets were bustling, taverns and tea houses, incense and medicine shops, each lit with lights, the lamp designs novel, not just lanterns...
Occasionally, joyous laughter from passersby came from various places, as if this Imperial Capital was truly the capital, not a city plagued by demon disasters.
Song Yan and Su Canli were waiting for news at an inn, while Fu Shirong had ventured alone into the Imperial Palace.
If all went well, she would bring out a young eunuch or palace maid in a few days.
Needless to say, the young eunuch or palace maid would inevitably be someone monitoring her, at that time, Song Yan and Su Canli would perform a Soul Search.
Then Song Yan would transform into that young eunuch or palace maid and enter the palace with the Empress.
After that, they would seize the opportunity to clarify the connection to the Fox Grandmother.
The Fox Grandmother needed to be served, and there were surely many people along that line.
At that time, Fu Shirong would strive to uncover the contacts and means of communication with Prince Wei and those people.
After figuring all this out, she would decisively kill Prince Wei, then have Song Yan disguise as him, and thereafter... arrange for the "Assassination Alliance" to come in and kill the Fox Grandmother.
Su Canli stood with hands behind his back, looking at the people walking on the street below, not speaking, he glanced at Song Yan.
Without a Purification Technique, he truly couldn’t tell if the people on the street were humans or demons.
But as a "high-level Fox Demon", Song Yan naturally had the advantage in Illusion Techniques, thus seeing that there were many beasts in disguise among the people on the streets.
In brocade robes, carrying oil-paper umbrellas, walking upright like humans, but the heads protruding from the collars were fox heads with sharp snouts, long whiskers, and grinning teasing.
Those fox heads carried rich facial expressions, chatting and laughing with the people beside them, yet the people were completely unaware.
Song Yan sighed lightly.
Su Canli instantly understood, he snorted coldly, his eyes like lightning, shooting into the distance, brimming with sharpness, mixed with a bit of confidence.
Song Yan saw his confidence and immediately guessed: Ten to one, there was a powerful figure from the Nanwu Sword Sect involved.
And that figure hidden in the shadows, unknown even to the "Fox Stabbing Alliance", was the source of this Master Su’s confidence.
Just as he was thinking, Su Canli suddenly said, "Brother Hua, there may be many times when language might be inconvenient in the future, how about... we agree on some signals to pass messages?"
Song Yan nodded, and said, "That would be good."
...
...
Fu Shirong only breathed a sigh of relief after returning to Fengning Palace.
Today, she had already met Prince Wei.
After one round of description, she managed to temporarily muddle through.
After all, the Empress Dowager, currently recuperating in the Shu Land, had once had an experience similar to hers.
Prince Wei was deeply disdainful of the Puppet Sect, and upon learning the name of the Puppet Sect disciple who violated her, Fu Shirong, to prevent slipping up, candidly mentioned the name "Song Yan".
As a result, Prince Wei froze in place for a while, and then astonishingly did not pursue questions like "how did you escape".
He became furious, wielding his sword wildly in a rage before sending someone to take her back to rest in Fengning Palace.
Fu Shirong felt that Prince Wei’s anger was not only because she was taken to the Puppet Sect as a Furnace, but also for other reasons.
But in any case, she finally returned to Fengning Palace, successfully completing the first step.
After bathing and changing clothes, she sat quietly for a long time, with her heart pounding.
Thinking of the plan and the people of the Northern Land, she once again found courage, and swiftly began calculating the next steps of the plan.
Cold winds wrapped in snow approached dusk, growing stronger.
The snow seemed to whirl, mixing with ice crystals, swirling rapidly around the palace, creating wailing sounds, as if weeping and complaining.
A surging sea of snow, a pale vortex...
Bang!
Suddenly, a window was blown open by the wind.
The cold swept in, dispersing the warmth from the dragon heater.
Fu Shirong was momentarily stunned, quickly getting up to close the window.
Once shut tight, she rubbed her hands, turned around.
Swish... swish swish swish...
Inside Fengning Palace, all the lit branched candleholders abruptly went out.
She was astonished to see a small shadow standing behind her...
The shadow slowly and weirdly expanded, Fu Shirong’s pupils gradually enlarged, her small mouth gaped open in shock.
The air was silent for a moment, and Fu Shirong suddenly turned, dashing toward the window she had just closed at her fastest speed, attempting to escape!
However... she stopped several inches before the window, then slowly, slowly... merged into the encroaching shadow behind her.
An intense pain engulfed her body, her senses rapidly fading, her mind beginning to swirl into chaos...
Even though she was prepared, at this moment, Fu Shirong realized how laughable it was to think a mortal could contend with the mighty...

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 68. Always by Your Side (2.8K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: 68. Always by Your Side (2.8K words - Please Subscribe)
A few days later, early in the morning...
The door of the inn was knocked on, and a eunuch arrived, asking for "Li Fan’s" name and, after a brief comparison of appearances, took Song Yan away.
Li Fan was, of course, the pseudonym previously agreed upon with Fu Shirong.
"Are you the Empress’s savior? Listen, ask for your reward later and leave as soon as possible, got it?" The eunuch said sharply.
Song Yan nodded and replied, "Understood, understood."
Before long, the two of them arrived at a nearby carriage.
The curtain was lifted, and a snow-white delicate hand reached out and beckoned.
The eunuch frowned and said, "Madam, if the Wei King knows..."
A voice from inside the carriage interrupted, "Just a brief conversation."
A chill flashed in the eunuch’s expression, and he said, "Then make it quick."
Song Yan boarded the carriage, lifted the curtain, and entered.
The eunuch stood obediently to the side. Today, the Wei King knew the Empress wanted to meet some savior and ordered him to follow, and afterwards... he was still responsible for quietly dealing with this so-called savior.
The Empress had suffered misfortune and was rescued by a man, who knows what happened between them. Therefore, the eunuch received a secret order: to torture the Empress’s savior to death, making him regret ever coming into this world!
Inside the carriage, the Empress, dressed in a pale golden phoenix robe, held a warm bottle. Her pinky finger was adorned with a gold phoenix patterned claw, exuding an indescribable nobility and grace. She slightly raised her snow-white neck, her pretty face tilted upwards, carrying an air of arrogance.
"Brother Li, was I not truthful with you?"
"You... you really are the Empress..."
"Go ahead, what reward do you desire? I promised you that as long as you could escort me back to the Imperial Capital, I would fulfill your wish."
"Really... fulfill anything?"
"I keep my word, no reneging."
"Then..."
The eunuch listened from outside.
He listened secretly.
He was also quite eager to know what this savior of the Empress wanted.
However, suddenly there was no sound from inside the carriage, followed by the urgent rustling, and then a soft "hmm" sound came, suppressed and impatient.
The eunuch’s face changed greatly, guessing that the audacious man might have said something outrageous like "I want you," his eyes burned with anger, and he shouted, "Audacious!!"
Saying that, he swiftly moved, stepping into the carriage to catch them in the act.
However... nothing had happened inside the carriage. The Empress and the man were sitting upright, neatly dressed, calmly watching him.
...
A few moments later...
The eunuch returned to the driver’s seat, whipping the horse, and arrived at a secluded place. He moved the bodies from the carriage, tied them to rocks, submerged them in the water, then got back on the horse and drove towards the Imperial Palace.
The Empress adjusted her position, sitting closer to the driver’s seat, and sincerely praised, "Your Illusion Technique is truly excellent; even I couldn’t tell."
Song Yan focused solely on driving the carriage.
The Empress lowered her voice, explaining the eunuch’s identity to prevent Song Yan from exposing himself.
Finally, she said, "I’ve long been short-handed, so you, Eunuch Shan, are now one of my people at Fengning Palace."
Eunuch Shan, huh?
Song Yan nodded and replied, "Yes."
However, his eyebrows slightly furrowed in an extremely subtle manner.
He and Fu Shirong had once been intimately acquainted, and he was familiar with the Empress’s temperament, actions, posture, even her breathing rhythm, and which leg she used to get off the carriage.
But today’s Empress... seemed a bit strange.
Anyone else might not have noticed at all.
But he was Song Yan.
Fu Shirong had once been his Furnace.
Was he overthinking it?
Or did the Empress naturally change in some small ways when dressed in the phoenix robe? After all, different attire and occasions could change one’s demeanor and behavior.
Yet, despite having some minor doubts, Song Yan didn’t ask or probe, he simply drove the carriage quietly into the Imperial Palace.
The snow remained unmelted, and a gust of wind blew silver flecks everywhere...
...
...
...
In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
The Empress, being highly capable, had mostly figured out the personnel and arrangements of Grandmother Fox’s line, but there were still some gaps.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Tonight was the last opportunity to fill those "gaps."
Since returning to the Imperial Palace, "Wei King" Cao Zhengjing had never touched her.
But now it seemed that he had investigated many matters and regained trust in her, thus he decided to come to Fengning Palace tonight to relive old memories.
As for safety, the Imperial Palace was filled with his people, and his trusted Eunuch Shan was guarding outside, so how could anything go wrong?
At the third watch...
The royal carriage arrived at Fengning Palace.
Wei King hurriedly stepped into the palace.
The palace seemed to be filled with voices of conversation.
After a while, the style of the conversation changed.
"Bitch, do you know who that Demon Sect bastard who fucked you is?"
"Did he make you feel good?"
"Did he come on to you, or did you go to him?"
"Today, use all the tricks you used to please him on me!"
The frenzied words were mixed with extreme lewdness. King Wei had been suppressing a strand of sinister fire in his heart ever since he heard the name "Song Yan."
Now, he hadn’t truly regained trust in the Empress; he still needed her status to do some things for him, to help him consolidate the "Demon Dynasty" he was building.
To him, it was merely the lives of some lowly people, but in exchange, he could have the grand presence of the First Lady Fox, thus establishing a powerful Demon Dynasty capable of crushing surrounding sects.
What harm was there in that?
In this day and age, only those with the biggest fists have a say.
If Great Wei weren’t weak, how could it have been overthrown by the Blood Spear Sect? How could the royal family be sent to the Puppet Sect to suffer humiliation? The Nanwu Sword Sect was also extremely hypocritical. They spoke of benevolence and righteousness, but where were they when Great Wei fell?
Only the ancestors are reliable!
Only a fool like Cao Shiyin would think of pleading for the people.
Millions, tens of millions of commoners dying, what does it have to do with the Cao family?
"King Wei" Cao Zhengjing thought, as he violently threw the Empress to the ground like a thug.
The ground was warm, so the palace floor wasn’t cold.
"King Wei" Cao Zhengjing mounted her harshly, reaching out to tear the golden silk ribbons of her phoenix robe. The Empress seemed resigned to her fate, alluringly calling out, "Your Majesty, whether on the ground or the bed, best turn off the lights first~ How about it?"
"King Wei" Cao Zhengjing, driven by her seductive voice to a fever pitch, quickly rolled over, blew out the nearby candle flame, then pressed down again.
The door suddenly opened a crack, and from outside... a black shadow swiftly darted in, delivering a chop to the back of "King Wei" Cao Zhengjing’s neck.
Cao Zhengjing only felt his vision go black as he passed out.
Slap.
The Empress held the forehead of the fallen head with her five fingers and gently turned it aside.
Cao Zhengjing immediately toppled to the side.
The shadow that flew in was Song Yan.
He raised a finger, proficiently executing a soul search.
The Empress asked, "How is it?"
Song Yan was silent for a moment, then said, "Indeed... nothing.
It must be that the First Lady Fox applied a technique in advance to ward off the Soul-Searching Skill from being detected by others."
The Empress said, "Then hurry and act. I’ve figured out the last part of the First Lady Fox’s plan. Let’s proceed according to plan."
Song Yan nodded, quickly handling Cao Zhengjing, then his figure flickered as Illusion Technique shrouded him, changing his facial features and body.
At his core, he still resembled the "Deformed Soul One-tailed Demon Fox Shadow Puppet," but as long as no one saw through his Illusion Technique, he was "King Wei" Cao Zhengjing.
In the darkness, the Empress watched him quietly and said, "Your Illusion Technique is really good; it seems we make quite the pair."
Song Yan didn’t waste words, proceeding according to plan to deal with King Wei’s corpse.
The next morning, he pretended to be King Wei unable to get up from the bed, while also instructing Eunuch Shan to go out for business. Then, he disguised himself as Eunuch Shan, drove a carriage over, carried King Wei’s body out of the palace to handle it, and subsequently snuck back into the palace, reverting to his King Wei disguise to join the Empress in investigating the location of the First Lady Fox.
...
...
Several days passed.
Everything was thoroughly investigated.
Song Yan also used the Communication Stone, about to send the information to Su Canli.
Since the day he left the inn, Su Canli’s whereabouts had been unknown, and their only method of contact was this Communication Stone.
Then, Mr. Su San would pass the message down again.
He was about to activate the Communication Stone when he suddenly felt a tightness around his head. The Empress’ face peeked from the side and casually said, "Just say... three days later, the First Lady Fox will be in Fox Kui Palace."
Song Yan seemed not surprised and nodded.
Soon, the Communication Stone connected.
"Three days later, the First Lady Fox will be in Fox Kui Palace."
Su Canli’s voice swiftly came through: "Got it, you and Shirong be extra careful."
The communication ended.
Song Yan slightly tilted his head, only to see the Empress’ profile.
The Empress’ five fingers were lightly placed on his head, and upon seeing the communication end, she smiled and said, "At least you were obedient, passing on the message exactly as I said.
But really, what sort of strange thing are you, wearing my children’s skins, using my children’s abilities, how fascinating, ha-ha-ha-ha..."
A silvery, bell-like laugh rang out.
Song Yan calmly said, "I’ve met the First Lady."
"Oh, sensible you are."
"Don’t you hate me for killing your children?"
"There’s as many as needed... why hate?" the Empress said indifferently, "But junior, what on earth are you? If it weren’t for your novelty, you’d be dead by now.
However, my patience is also limited; if you won’t say, I can still kill you."

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 69. Treasure Vault (3.1K words - Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: 69. Treasure Vault (3.1K words - Subscribe)
"To be honest with you, madam, I am but a humble ghost cultivator..."
Before Song Yan could finish his sentence, he felt his body lose weight, his feet beginning to dangle in mid-air.
The Empress’s figure, like a nightmare ghost, suddenly grew taller and taller, until she reached the high palace ceiling, bending slightly at the back, with her head leaning forward, looking down.
Her body instantly swelled hundreds of times, transforming into a terrifying giant; her beautiful facial features ripped apart, as if the skin could not withstand the immense force, with her eyes, nose, and lips skewed in every direction, terrifying beyond words.
The once brightly lit Fengning Palace was suddenly plunged into darkness.
The light... was entirely blocked by this gigantic body.
Two sharp fingers, grabbing Song Yan like a small ant, showed a ghastly smile on her distorted face, her voice hoarse and strange.
"Young one, what you said, I saw it all in the Empress’s memory. Do you think I spared your life because of that?"
"Certainly not," Song Yan replied, "Madam needs my assistance, a lure into the trap."
The Empress’s ghastly face peered down at him, her eyes, as large as Song Yan, stared intently at him, contemplating something unknown.
Song Yan looked up, meeting those eyes.
He had no intention of having an in-depth conversation with such an ancient demon who had lived for countless years and feasted on countless lives, nor did he intend to deceive her with vapid trickery.
When you tentatively question this old demon, you reveal more than you hide.
When you bask in self-satisfaction, thinking you have fooled this demon, you unknowingly expose yourself to her perception due to your verbosity.
Seeing him so composed, the Empress suddenly spoke up, "Tell me, what is it you desire?"
Song Yan said, "I wish for madam to spare my life."
The Empress shook him slightly.
Yet, perhaps due to expertise in different fields,
The Fox Madame truly couldn’t comprehend what kind of ghostly entity she was holding.
It felt an evil spirit occupying the "shadow puppet crafted by its child," but the puppet was empty inside, not a ghost cultivator at all. Moreover, there had been no talk of a ghost cultivator "roaming for the country and the people, willing to sacrifice their life for the masses."
Such a scenario was as absurd as her becoming a vegetarian.
The Empress said flatly, "I am a person who cherishes talent, you still have a chance."
Song Yan said, "As long as madam spares my life, I am willing to be a horse or a cow, to repay madam."
Bang!!
As he spoke, the five fingers gripping his skull suddenly tightened, the shadow puppet unable to withstand the pressure, burst apart, loose souls within losing control, screeching and scattering.
The substantial "ghost cultivator" promptly revealed its true form, the plain, scarred man disappeared, replaced by a flat, wrinkled, lumpy-tailed, bizarre fox shadow puppet.
"Do you think I have time for your nonsense?
Or are you afraid that if you tell the truth, I’ll still kill you?"
"You humans, so full of schemes, even as ghosts it’s the same, always reluctant to trust others."
"Although... I really will still kill you."
"But not speaking is simply better to die right away."
The Empress mumbled, then rapidly shrank back to her original form, clutching the "bizarre one-tailed fox shadow puppet," examining it left and right, filled with curiosity, reluctant to discard it.
She turned and left Fengning Palace, walked for a while in the complex palace, until she reached a secluded Cold Palace, stepping inside, fiddled with switches, opened a secret room storing various things, placed the shadow puppet into an empty box, then put it onto a treasure shelf, awaiting further study.
After finishing, she returned to Fengning Palace, where a new Prince Wei was already waiting for her.
For the Fox Madame with many offspring, finding someone to impersonate Prince Wei was no trouble at all.
As for Prince Wei...
The children, it did not care for, would it... truly care for a descendant with a trace of its bloodline?
...
...
"Three days later, at Fox Kui Palace..."
Su Canli looked at an elder beside him, sighed deeply and said, "Great-grandfather, I agreed on a secret code with Brother Hua, planning to set some substitute words to convey information. But Brother Hua thought more thoroughly, and he did the opposite, besides the secret code, he also set a small rule."
"What rule?" the elder asked calmly.
Su Canli said, "Brother Hua said that actually the key information is just one sentence: when and where to act.
Since that’s the case, the word order doesn’t matter.
He said if he didn’t say this sentence in the agreed order, then ... he was already threatened.
In other words, he had fallen into the hands of the Fox Madame. And the time and place he relayed are a trap."
The elder looked at him quietly.
Su Canli sighed heavily and said, "According to the agreement, Brother Hua’s sentence should be said this way."
"Fox Kui Palace, will be three days after the Fox Madame."
"But he didn’t say that.
At this moment... Brother Hua and the Empress Fu are probably in grave danger.
The one delivering information to us might just be the Fox Madame’s henchman, or even herself."
The elder fell silent for a moment and said, "What a pity."
Su Canli deeply closed his eyes.
The elder said, "Does Hua Rong have any descendants?"
Su Canli said, "He is related to Hua Linglong of Western Shu Celestial Cloud City, a person in the Jianghu; apparently, the two should be lovers..."
The elder said, "Let the sect take more care of her."
Su Canli said, "Grandfather, in three days, are we still going to Fox Kui Palace?"
The elder laughed, "Since we already know it’s a trap, why not go? We might as well use their strategy against them..."
Su Canli nodded heavily, then couldn’t help but sigh, "Empress Fu’s fervor and Brother Hua’s loyalty and righteousness, the fact that these two are leading the charge, it’s really a matter of life and death. They both know it, yet they still went..."
"Ah, Grandfather, why is it that we, a group of cultivators, let a woman who hasn’t even started cultivating profound rush to the front, ah..."
The elder patted his shoulder and said, "Seek kindness and you’ll gain kindness, no need to be too sentimental, hurry and pass on the message."
Su Canli nodded and said, "According to the plan, I’ve classified the members of the Fox Stabbing Alliance into three layers based on the level of trustworthiness. Each layer will receive different information, and only you and I will know that ’in three days, the Old Madam Fox in Fox Kui Palace’ is a trap."
The elder said, "Once the Old Madam Fox is dead, the rest will scatter like a pack of monkeys. No need to worry. I’ve spent a hundred years honing my skills, just to eliminate such monstrosities that harm our human race!"
...
...
Whoosh...
Whoosh whoosh...
Faint perception, pitch-black vision, emanated from the secret box.
The biggest difference between ghost cultivators and ghost entities is the former possesses a profound root, while the latter does not.
The biggest difference between shadow puppets and ghost entities is the former is controlled by cultivators, while the latter is not.
But regardless of ghost cultivators, shadow puppets, or ghost entities, once the evil soul within them dissipates, they are destined to become scrap...
Thus, this strange thing had already turned into a "trophy" for the Old Madam Fox.
A trophy that... no longer requires vigilance.
However, she absolutely could not have imagined that every wisp of ghost within the shadow puppet had been enslaved, nor could she have imagined that someone had even merged a wisp of their divine sense into the shadow puppet.
At this moment, the wisp of Song Yan’s divine sense still remained hidden in the already damaged, shriveled shadow puppet, stored together in the secret box.
The destruction of his body left him unable to do anything.
But he knew one thing: it seemed like there were still quite a few things hidden inside this vault.
Three days later, the Old Madam Fox would definitely confront the Fox Stabbing Alliance.
From his understanding of Mr. Su San, the latter would definitely not withdraw just because it was false information, but rather use this opportunity to turn the strategy against them.
By then, it would be utter chaos.
And the two "malformed single-tailed demonic foxes" and "formless phantom crows" he secretly dispatched had almost reached the Imperial Capital.
If the Fox Stabbing Alliance succeeds, he will have to find a way to get some of the Old Madam Fox’s blood...
But regardless of success or failure, he would come to "search this vault" to see if he could gain anything.
The Old Madam Fox would never dream that this ghost thing still retained a little awareness, and it was precisely this bit of awareness... that inadvertently exposed the location of her "small treasury."
Enduring dark protraction, patiently waiting in the form of a broken shadow puppet.
What was happening outside, what was about to happen, was temporarily not his concern.
Hua Rong... was already dead.
Arising from Celestial Cloud City, journeying out to slay fox demons; heavily injured and imprisoned within the Puppet Sect, falling onto the back hills during escape becoming a ghost cultivator, then proceeding to the Imperial Capital only to die tragically at the hands of the Old Madam Fox.
Needless to say, Fu Shirong was also dead.
Song Yan still remembered that Empress Fu.
A spirited fiery red steed, clearly able to enjoy a peaceful life, but because of her fervor, diverging from her husband, likely to be dealt with by the Old Madam Fox as soon as she entered the palace.
Prince Wei met the same fate.
The two of them, one with integrity, preferring death over dishonor; the other with ambition, by any means necessary.
Yet they died so simply.
Song Yan silently lamented in his heart: Behind every plan, every scheme, if there is no power to support it, it is all just a joke...
...
...
Three days later.
Suddenly, a strong wave of energy burst forth from the Fox Kui Palace in the suburbs of the Imperial Capital.
The earth trembled in response, the myriad palaces of the Imperial Capital quaking like they’re experiencing an earthquake, citizens either pale-faced or fleeing in desperation...
Then stronger and denser energy waves exploded, the daytime skies seemingly ignited with fireworks, bursting into a spectacle of colors.
Whirlwinds swept the ground, uprooting trees and branches.
Merchants selling various items hurriedly closed their doors, the dancers and singers of the brothels gathered in one room, the women from wealthy families hurriedly inquired about the events happening far away...
Chaos reigned everywhere.
The Imperial Capital descended into chaos!
A figure took advantage of the chaos, quickly heading towards the Imperial Palace.
That figure, before entering the city, was a finely dressed man.
After passing a group of patrol guards, he transformed into one of the patrol guards and proceeded deeper into the palace.
After passing through a gate, he saw palace maids fleeing in fear, and the patrol guard’s figure blurred like ink dispersing in water, slightly distorting, transforming into the perfect image of a palace maid, identical in attire and appearance.
Upon reaching the inner gate, a eunuch spotted the palace maid and sternly admonished, "Where are you going?"
The palace maid repeatedly apologized and turned to leave.
But after the eunuch walked away, the palace maid transformed again, turning into the figure of the eunuch, entering the inner palace, and then... headed straight towards the direction of the Cold Palace where the Old Madam Fox kept her items.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
A bizarre crow followed the eunuch’s head like a phantom, while behind him... someone else was replicating the eunuch’s "entry procedure" into the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 70. Success (3.4K words - asking for subscriptions)
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: 70. Success (3.4K words - asking for subscriptions)
Paperman Peak, Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
"Brother Dao... have some tea..."
Seeing Song Yan rest, little lady Yuzhuang brought him a steaming cup of Moonlight Tea.
The temperature on the mountain was cold, and the snow that had fallen a while ago had never melted. In the distance, the wind occasionally carried bits of snowflakes, bringing a unique coldness imbued with the scent of earth and wood.
Song Yan took the tea, sipped a mouthful, and the slightly sweet hot tea entered his stomach. The subtle Profound Qi within refreshed his spirit, making the next breath of air feel much fresher.
"Did you add ginger today?"
"Yes, it’s cold. I... saw in the ’Spirit Tea Chapter’ that Moonlight Grass is a versatile mystical herb, and it pairs well with anything. So I added some ginger to warm Brother Dao’s hands and feet."
In order to serve her master better, little lady Yuzhuang was allowed to read some books related to "serving tea and pouring water."
Song Yan smiled and said, "Then this must be Moonlight Ginger Tea."
"Yes!"
Little lady Yuzhuang nodded vigorously, her adorable little face resembling a fine jade sculpture, her big eyes sparkling as she looked at Song Yan.
Perhaps because of the Furnace, Song Yan couldn’t help but think of the tragically killed Empress Fu. Looking at the little lady Yuzhuang in front of him, he affectionately stroked her cheek and said, "You should sit and drink with me. Safety and peace are all that matter."
Little lady Yuzhuang hesitated for a moment.
Song Yan pulled her to sit down and poured her a cup.
Little lady Yuzhuang sat respectfully, not daring to make a sound. After spending some time together, she understood that the "master" truly cared for her to some extent.
This gave her a slight sense of safety and reliance amidst her overwhelming fear.
Song Yan held the Moonlight Ginger Tea, feeling the warmth from the cup, and his heart found a moment of peace and rest.
The ’Hundred Forms Divine Control’ combined with the ’Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique’ truly was something. Without it, he wouldn’t be able to control the shadow puppet on the front lines, risking life against death, while sipping tea with the little lady in the rear.
Anyone else, even the Stone Seat Elder who invented the ’Hundred Forms Divine Control,’ would carefully manipulate their shadow puppet, cautious to the utmost. Not to mention multiple puppets, even controlling just one would require their full effort.
...
...
Great Wei Imperial Palace, deep within the palace, in front of an extremely secluded Cold Palace.
The eunuch stopped in his tracks only because a palace maid suddenly emerged from a side room of the Cold Palace, watching him from afar, and said, "What brings you here, sir?"
Song Yan didn’t waste words, his form shifted, and he transformed into the palace maid.
The deformed soul inside his shadow puppet utilized a level of illusion technique stronger than that of ordinary Fox Demons. But there were higher ranking Demonic Foxes that could see through it, though it seemed... this did not include the one in front of him.
The palace maid froze for a moment, displaying an "oh, one of our own" expression, and then said, "Did the Great Mama send you?"
Outsiders called her the Great Granny.
The fox cubs called her the Great Mama.
Song Yan said, "The Great Mama sent me to deliver some important information. Gather everyone."
The palace maid clapped her hands, and soon, another palace maid emerged.
Of course, to Song Yan, they both appeared as their true Fox Demon forms.
The palace maid looked at him and said, "Speak then, what’s the matter? It seems the Great Mama has some important task today, taking many brothers and sisters with her."
Song Yan also clapped his hands, and another eunuch stepped out from behind him.
That eunuch’s form shifted, transforming into a palace maid.
"Everyone’s here,"
Song Yan said.
Then, he gestured with his hand.
The two Fox Demons approached.
Once they were a little closer.
Song Yan’s two shadow puppets suddenly struck, but instead of one-on-one, it was two against one.
Two shadow puppets, one on the left and one on the right, suddenly raised their claws, swiftly grabbing at the foremost Fox Demon.
That Fox Demon reacted quickly, instinctively raising a paw, but could only barely block one side, while the other paw already pierced through its chest, gripping the heart and crushing it with a "bang."
The Fox Demon opened its mouth wide, baring fangs, but an overwhelming sense of powerlessness surged through it, and it... slumped.
However, a strong sense of confusion and resentment flashed in its eyes.
It could sense that the two foxes who attacked it weren’t much stronger. If an actual fight occurred, one-on-one, it would be "if it wanted to escape, the other couldn’t stop it," and once it fled, it would cry out for help, and in this deep palace, other foxes would soon arrive to support. Then they could find out why these two Fox Demons turned aggressive.
But... there was no chance anymore.
Two against one, a sudden attack, coupled with slightly stronger power, had already cut off all its paths to survival.
Surprisingly, after the two shadow puppets killed the Fox Demon, they directly stopped.
One of them then looked at the other remaining Fox Demon and said calmly, "Don’t worry, it’s by the Great Mama’s arrangement."
The other Fox Demon was stunned by this sudden turn of events, but seeing that these two indeed didn’t intend to attack, it frowned and replied, "Impossible. Both it and I were placed here by the Great Mama. The Great Mama trusts us the most; how could she send you to kill it?"
A shadow puppet said, "You know what the Great Mama is doing today, right?"
The Fox Demon frowned slightly but shook its head.
Fox Granny is cautious in her actions. Those not brought by her to the magical battle have no idea what she’s doing. Even those brought only find out on-site.
Another shadow puppet lowered its voice and said, "We have a traitor among us."
The Fox Demon looked at the already dead Fox Demon, puzzled, and said, "It’s a traitor?"
The shadow puppet said, "Yes, and there are more, you must be careful. Those traitors are very cunning."
The Fox Demon cautiously asked, "Does the Great Mama know who it is?"
The shadow puppet said, "The Great Mama doesn’t know yet, but we’ve already found out. The Great Mama said, today she’s handling important matters, and the traitor will surely reveal themselves out of impatience. We were left behind just for this."
The Fox Demon asked in confusion, "Then... who is it?"
A shadow puppet stepped forward half a step, leaned a bit closer, then lowered its voice and said, "It’s me."
The Fox Demon suddenly lifted its head.
Two shadow puppets "swish swish" shot out.
Once again, it was two against one.
Again, the power was slightly stronger.
In an instant, the fox demon also collapsed into a pool of blood, dying unwillingly.
Then, two shadow puppets separated to work.
One quickly handled the corpses to prevent the scent of blood from spreading, after all, the fox demon’s perception is strong, and as soon as they smell something off, they will appear immediately.
Another swiftly entered the Cold Palace, starting to fiddle with the mechanisms.
The mechanism had five metal ring-swallowing beast heads protruding from the wall, seemingly needing to be pressed in a certain order to open.
Song Yan watched for a while. Back then, his wisp of divine sense only vaguely knew the way. How could he dare to watch it "enter the password" in front of the Elder Fox?
He scanned around and searched the bodies of the two fallen fox demons.
Indeed, reality is not a game; there is no "no matter how complex the mechanism, there must be a password within seven steps" situation...
Returning once more to the password wall, he tried pressing the middle metal ring-swallowing beast head, pushing inward.
With that press, the beast head instantly bounced back, causing the Cold Palace to be bathed in red light.
Song Yan was stunned for a moment but quickly reacted, raising his fist and starting to forcibly smash the mechanism.
Two shadow puppets, comparable to advanced demon beasts, acted swiftly.
The "No-Body Illusion Crow" hidden in the dark also flew down.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the joint attack of the three shadow puppets.
The mechanism broke a hole.
But footsteps were also heard from afar.
Clearly, they had been discovered.
Song Yan controlled a shadow puppet to quickly enter through the hole.
Fortunately, this is a mortal world; setting up a long-lasting barrier or prohibition is impossible, hence why it’s this easy.
Inside the hole, he quickly scanned the situation in the secret chamber.
The secret chamber was just a small room, with a treasure rack on the left side, storing large items that couldn’t fit into narrow storage spaces.
There were profound artifacts that seemed like trophies, unknown massive beast bones, a peculiar stone stele engraved with twisted characters, and some trinkets made of unidentified jade material resembling artworks... Trying to take these items would be as conspicuous as someone carrying a TV out of a community after sneaking in...
In contrast to the dazzling array on the left, the right side appeared extremely simplistic.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
It was just a specially made metal cage.
Inside the cage was a vague outline of a crawling black shadow, small in size, with ghastly white mottled patterns that merely looking at made one shiver.
Song Yan looked closer and found that he could only see the patterned ensemble vaguely blurred, unable to make out specific details... Yet a nameless fear arose in his heart.
He stared at the patterns as if gazing into hell.
Each pattern was a fierce ghost crawling aimlessly forward, cursed, hesitating, head drooping, with limbs.
But the black shadow seemed to be asleep, and so the numerous crawling ghosts didn’t notice him.
Song Yan’s gaze quickly swept over, noting that the shadow’s limbs in the cage were shackled, with strange talismans affixed, and besides this, incense was burning before the iron cage.
The incense emitted an odd scent that made one drowsy and sapped vitality, evidently no ordinary product.
He never imagined seeing such a thing in Elder Fox’s little treasury.
’It looks like a demon at least... but why would Elder Fox imprison it?’
Meanwhile, the approaching footsteps grew nearer, and in no time, many fox demons hiding in the palace would converge here... and more after that.
Song Yan’s three shadow puppets could deal with a few fox demons, but against so many... the only outcome would be them all being dismantled.
’Can’t make this trip for nothing! What should I take?’
Song Yan’s thoughts raced.
His eyes swiftly flashed over the large items on the treasure rack, quickly settling on a profound artifact longsword.
Whoosh!
He drew the longsword and swiftly grabbed a jade product that could be used as a container.
Then...
The longsword suddenly stabbed into the mottled shadow lying dormant in the cage.
The mottled shadow’s form shuddered.
Swoosh!
A spurt of blood shot out immediately.
Song Yan hurriedly caught it in the jade container.
The mottled shadow slowly opened its eyes, pupils filled with long-lost confusion, but in an instant... it seemed to recall something, immediately turning to bitter hatred. Those eyes suddenly flipped, casting a curiously thoughtful look at the person outside the cage drawing its blood.
At this moment, Song Yan suddenly noticed a few droplets in the gushing blood like ruby-red thick blood, heavy in the container.
In no time, the container was full.
Song Yan hastily found something to stopper the jade container.
The No-Body Illusion Crow swiftly darted in, wrapping the jade container tightly with its wings, then soared away fast.
When the two shadow puppets exited the secret chamber, they saw bared fox heads on the high walls outside the Cold Palace gate.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The two shadow puppets immediately split and fled.
The fox demons gave chase.
The No-Body Illusion Crow, among the most stealthy of intermediate demon beasts, augmented by the Deformed Soul, hid briefly among tree shadows, then intermittently flew, eventually escaping the Imperial Palace, out of the Imperial Capital, heading towards the Puppet Sect.
Didn’t get Elder Fox’s "Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox blood," but obtained unknown blood...
After all, it wasn’t a total loss.
But the three fox demon puppets might be remaining behind at the Imperial Capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 71. Getting Rich (3.3K words - asking for subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: 71. Getting Rich (3.3K words - asking for subscription)
Floating clouds like accumulated snow, piled on the mountain peaks.
Under the vast, clear sky of deep winter, a hawk shrieked sharply, flapping its wings as it flew by...
A lone feather spiraled down from the sky, landing on the frozen black earth of a desolate forest.
Beneath the shade of the trees, an invisible crow glanced once more in the direction of the Imperial Capital, then concealed its body entirely into the shadows, swiftly skimming low.
...
Outskirts of the Imperial Capital, Fox Kui Palace.
The setting sun lay desolate like the remnant of blood, casting a chilling light, making the scene of corpses appear cruel, bloody, and frozen.
Blood flowed everywhere, with flesh scattered all around, and heads rolled about, eyes wide open as if witnessing something incredibly horrifying before dying.
Of course, there were also many fox demon corpses.
Piling upon each other, layer upon layer.
A fox demon’s claw pierced through a cultivator’s back, its furry sharp claws clutching a heart, while a flying sword was also thrust into the fox demon’s back. A large pool of fresh blood mixed with flesh and fox fur indicated that a cultivator self-destructed before death, taking a fox demon with them...
Scenes of tragic and solemn desolation were ubiquitous.
Yet the battle had not completely ended, for an old man with wild hair and beard still stood leaning on his sword.
Though he stood under the sunset, for some reason... his surroundings bore no light.
That was a shadow of a demon, obscuring all his brightness.
The demon’s form was indistinct, only its grotesque twisted eyes, mouth, and sharp teeth could be seen glaring down from above.
The old man looked up at the shadow, full of resentment: "Why... Both you and I are at the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace, why?"
He couldn’t comprehend.
Despite giving it his all, he only managed to inflict a minor injury on Granny Fox...
While he, he was on the brink of death.
His lifespan was ending, he could not break through, he was here to fight desperately.Thɪs
In terms of momentum, in determination, Granny Fox could never match him with his resolve to fight to the death.
As for the situation.
He made a plan, and while Granny Fox had schemes of her own, in this confrontation, he emerged half a step ahead, making him the first to strike and attack.
But the outcome was beyond his imagination, so tragic.
"Why?"
"Why!!"
The old man looked up, his aged eyes full of pain and rage, the flames running beneath his skin seemed ready to blaze anew.
Yet from the sky came only a contemptuous silver bell-like chuckle.
The fox’s head with a playful expression watched him, three grim white massive tails swaying in the air like white smoke...
"Fool, in this small outskirts, even broken blood can contend with me?"
"I’m not breaking through because I seek the True Nine Palaces, and you... you’re just an almost passing False Crimson Palace."
"Hehe... devouring you would be quite a tonic."
Granny Fox opened her mouth wide, revealing a huge maw surrounded by black fumes, full of jagged teeth, descending towards the old man.
Fear struck the old man’s heart, yet he quickly gathered his strength, intending to self-destruct.
As the ancestor of the Su Family of the Nanwu Sword Sect, how could he accept such disgrace?
However, the next moment, he froze, for the blood surging within him rapidly cooled, an indescribable shiver crawling over his body. Self-destruction aside, he could hardly move.
But he had already set life and death aside, filled with fervor and readiness to die, how could he fear?
The old man sensed the inexplicable shiver pervading his body, and reflecting on his earlier clash with Granny Fox, suddenly his expression showed realization, then turned to astonishment.
He seemed to understand something, murmuring with disbelief and immense regret: "Dragonbo Blood, so... the flaw is so simple..."
Yet, despite this realization, it was evidently too late for him to act.
The foul-smelling gaping mouth descended rapidly.
"Bastard! Beast!!"
The old man roared in anger, unable to move, finally overwhelmed.
Much later...
Granny Fox sat on the grand chair brought by the fox cubs, savoring the blood and flesh of the strong man with relish, but seemingly disdainful of the old man’s tainted blood, she did not adopt the posture of "cultivation" to absorb the old man’s flesh and blood, merely supplementing herself instead.
Licking her furry paws, Granny Fox leaned back comfortably against the chair.
Her body curled entirely on the chair, her eyes a bit lost, gazing northward with her cunning eyes slightly narrowed, pondering something unknown.
Suddenly, a little fox demon came flying swiftly from afar, landing in front of Granny Fox, stammering: "Grandmother, the Imperial Palace... the Imperial Palace..."
"What about the Imperial Palace?"
Granny Fox asked.
The little fox demon said: "The Imperial Palace... was robbed... it’s the Jingyang Palace..."
"Jing? Yang? Palace?"
Granny Fox was momentarily stunned before reacting, suddenly becoming urgently anxious.
She leapt up, anxiously exclaiming, "Jingyang Palace?!!"
Was that not the place where she stored important treasures?
The little fox demon wanted to speak further, but felt a rush of ill wind pass by its side, and upon looking again... the chair was empty, Granny Fox was gone.
...
...
Jingyang Palace, precisely the Cold Palace.
The mechanism wall had a hole, everything inside seemed normal, except for a puddle of blood outside the metal cage.
Granny Fox darted inside at high speed.
The fox cubs had never seen Grandmother so hurried, so frantic, seemingly... with a trace of inexplicable fear.
