In the cage, the colorful shadow, awakened by the stab, now lay weak, looking at the fox in front of the cage with a mocking expression.
Granny Fox wasted no words, bending down, dipping a finger in the blood on the ground, sniffing it, then asked with a trembling voice: "Did you give your essence blood... to that thief?"
"Yes." The colorful shadow’s voice unexpectedly carried a hint of joy.
"Did you give your essence blood... to that thief?"
"Yes."
"Do you recognize that thief?"
"Mm."
"Who is he?"
"Mm."
"Tell me, it’s not like I can’t let you go."
"Mm."
...
Grandmother Fox anxiously asked.
The mottled shadow happily responded tirelessly, and then finally couldn’t hold back, bursting into hearty laughter.
"Heh heh, ha ha ha ha..."
In the next moment, Grandmother Fox kicked over the cage, then furiously charged out of the Cold Palace, killing madly along the way, even her own young ones weren’t spared, as she snapped their necks and discarded them at will.
"Find!"
"Dig three feet deep and find that thief for me!"
"Everyone, go search!!"
She leaped onto the glazed roof ridge of the highest palace in the Imperial Palace, her sharp anger echoing everywhere, as a shadowing Demon Shadow enveloped the entire palace like an immense demon overlooking the palace clusters as if they were mere ants.
Each Fox Demon no longer concealed themselves, swiftly darting in every direction.
And soon enough, two more Fox Demons rushed back to report to Grandmother Fox about the previous incident in the Imperial Palace.
Immediately, two torn and ripped Fox Demon Shadow Puppets were placed in front of Grandmother Fox.
Grandmother Fox looked at the two Fox Demon Shadows with an uncertain expression, as if suddenly understanding something, her eyes flashed with anxiety, regret, and a murderous anger.
"Don’t let me find you!"
"Don’t let me find you!!"
...
...
Paperman Peak, Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
Another day of skin making passed, another day of holding hot tea watching the sunset slowly fall behind the mountains.
No matter how thrilling and perilous things were in the distance, it had little to do with him.
At least, for now, it didn’t matter.
Song Yan held the warm Moonlight Ginger Tea, glancing at the young lady Yuzhuang by his side.
The young lady seemed in good spirits, even though it was nearing evening.
Suddenly, a thought crossed his mind, holding the tea in his left hand, and grasping the young lady’s hand with his right, as a trace of Profound Qi probed inside, made a slight round trip, and then withdrew.
Surprisingly, he discovered a sliver of Profound Qi inside Cao Yuzhuang.
The presence of Profound Qi was indicative of possessing a Profound Root.
Cao Yuzhuang, being sent from the Wei Kingdom royal family, was meant to be a Furnace.
A Furnace, wouldn’t last long before being drained to dregs, naturally one wouldn’t waste time to test for a Profound Root, and Yuzhuang’s previous environment wasn’t a Cave Mansion, no chance to absorb Profound Qi.
But now, she lived in a separate hilltop Cave Mansion with Song Yan, shared Spirit Tea and Spiritual Food, even... engaged in Dual Cultivation together.
As Song Yan siphoned energy, he also paid attention to supplementing her.
Moreover, since Song Yan had reached his limit of Profound Qi, he would sometimes instill some Profound Qi back into young lady Yuzhuang.
All these factors together unexpectedly brought a sliver of Profound Qi to her.
In other words, young lady Yuzhuang was actually capable of cultivation!
"What’s the matter, Brother Dao?"
"Nothing."
Song Yan worried that the young lady’s disposition was unstable, fearing she might give herself away right after he said it.
A Furnace did not require a Profound Root.
But a Furnace with a Profound Root would elevate in status even further.
By that time, young lady Yuzhuang might attract more attention.
Don’t be deceived by him being Gu Huangzi’s direct disciple, but no one other than himself understood... he was walking a tightrope.
Just as he was pondering, Yueyang Luo barged in energetically, and said, "Master, the Sect has opened the exchange for Profound Jade, one can exchange Contribution Points for Profound Jade at a ratio of three to one."
"Three Contribution Points for a small piece of Profound Jade?" young lady Yuzhuang asked in surprise.
Yueyang Luo replied, "Mistress, you wish.
Three Contribution Points for one Profound Jade Bean.
A hundred Profound Jade Beans are equivalent to one small Profound Jade.
I’ve heard this Cold Pool Valley Market will have plenty of good things for sale, since it can almost be a grand meeting for sects and loose cultivators from the Three Kingdoms, by then... you can buy anything you want.
So, the more Profound Jade the better."
Song Yan’s eyes lit up.
Outside, Profound Jade was the common currency.
But within the Sect, whether carrying out missions or daily rewards, everything was settled with "Contribution Points", and there was no interexchange between the two.
Though only the respective Sect’s "Contribution Points" could buy some of the Sect’s specialties, none were as convenient as Profound Jade.
As for this "three-to-one" exchange rate...
He quickly contemplated.
He remembered that in the low-level market at the foot of South Bamboo Peak, a no-threshold, entry-level magic technique was 49 Contribution Points, while at Snake Corpse Market, it was sold for around 20 Profound Jade Beans, close to a 2.5-to-1 ratio.
So this "three-to-one" was still black, but considering that someone might exchange in large amounts, it was manageable.
Since joining the Puppet Sect, Song Yan had always been diligent, practically a workaholic, and his skin-making efficiency was formidable. After showing his seventh layer of Refining Profound realm, he could produce one intermediate demon beast-level shadow puppet daily.
The prices for intermediate demon beast finished shadows differed; those similar to the fourth layer of Refining Profound were 1200 Contribution Points, the fifth layer 2250 Contribution Points, and the sixth layer 3600 Contribution Points.
Added to the unfinished puppet shadows he had previously made in South Bamboo Peak...
So...
He glanced at his identity plate.
There, Contribution Points totaled: 256,484 points.
Yueyang Luo glanced at Song Yan, and enviously said, "Master must have many Contribution Points, right?"
Song Yan patted him on the shoulder and said, "Young man, don’t always focus on what others have, but think more about your own issues, reflect if you’ve studied hard today? Have you been diligent in skin making?
One day, you’ll be like your master too."

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 72. Last Chance (3.8K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: 72. Last Chance (3.8K words - Please Subscribe)
In the deep winter, the sky darkened early.
After locking up the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, Song Yan walked on the mountain path of Paperman Peak.
The biting wind blew eerily cold, the shadows of the mountains swiftly slanted with the setting sun in the west, large patches of shadows rushing forward with the piercing air, while on withered branches, carrion vultures and crows lingered, making strange calls.
Yuzhuang Xiao Niangzi followed behind Song Yan with her arms hanging down, carrying a small bag of fragrant wood that swayed as she walked. The aroma released when this fragranced wood was burned was pleasant, calming the mind and settling the spirit. She obtained Contribution Points from Song Yan and exchanged them at the Paper Money Tower on the main peak.
The Paper Money Tower was essentially the "finance department" and "basic tool exchange center" of Paperman Peak.
At that moment, many disciples lined up in front of the Paper Money Tower, with the one at the very front presenting an identity plate, discussing the exchange of Profound Jade and other items with the steward at the window, while the disciples behind urged impatiently.
"Such a long queue," sighed Xiao Niangzi, and added, "Master, do you need to exchange something today? I can queue for you, no matter how long it takes!"
"It’s Daoist Brother, not Master," Song Yan corrected.
Xiao Niangzi nodded repeatedly, agreeing, "Okay, Master."
Song Yan raised his hand and gently flicked her forehead.
Xiao Niangzi immediately had tears welled up in her eyes.
However, Song Yan already knew what she wanted to say, and stated, "You haven’t done anything wrong. It’s late today, we wouldn’t get a chance in the queue. We’ll come back when there are fewer people in a couple of days."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Yes, Daoist Brother."
The late return together gave Song Yan a rare sense of warmth.
Though he was aware, such emotions should not exist because... separation, even life and death, was the destined end for him and every woman around him.
"It’s too cold."
He rubbed his hands together.
Xiao Niangzi hurried towards him, saying, "Daoist Brother, I’m warm."
Thud.
Song Yan gave her another flick on the forehead.
The flick activated a "rule," and Xiao Niangzi’s eyes started to turn red again.
Song Yan was very accustomed to this and promptly said, "You didn’t make a mistake."
"Oh." Xiao Niangzi returned to normal.
Song Yan couldn’t help but laugh.
As they walked and talked, they reached the edge of a cliff.
Song Yan tapped a sword technique, and the Flying Sword transformed into a rainbow, carrying them to the front of the cave mansion.
After a bustling period, they loosened their garments and went to practice Dual Cultivation...
After cultivation, Yuzhuang Xiao Niangzi lay in Song Yan’s arms, marveling, "Master, I’ve seen other furnaces that are almost half-dead, very weak... but why, after being harvested by you, I am still... still..."
She couldn’t find a word to describe the comfort she felt.
Song Yan replied, "That’s the effect of the elixir. If someone talks to you, don’t reveal your condition."
Yuzhuang Xiao Niangzi nodded vigorously, then shifted her body, the silky underwear forming enticing creases as she tentatively adjusted herself into a position that would be most comfortable for her master, preparing to sleep.
Soon, her breathing became steady.
But Song Yan could not fall asleep.
The bodiless phantom crow was still flying in the wilderness, carrying that extremely important "spoils of war." How could he sleep?
He had too many things on his mind.
’I wonder if the Fox Stabbing Alliance succeeded and how Mr. Su San and the others are doing.’
’Forget it, no matter what, Hua Rong is cut off from them.’
’But that mottled black shadow, even though it’s far inferior to Grandmother Fox, it shouldn’t be an ordinary demon beast if Grandmother Fox secretly hid it, right?
Its blood should barely help me step into the Crimson Palace Realm.
Though the effects might be average, it is still worth enhancing my realm first.
Yet, I wonder what will happen once I break through to the Crimson Palace. Will it render my Qi Concealment techniques ineffective? If so, that would be a big problem.
I need to learn more.
If possible, I should prepare higher skillful concealment techniques in advance and seek cultivation techniques and magic for the post-Crimson Palace Realm.’
’Granted, I can use Life Span Calculation.
But deriving a cultivation technique from scratch consumes too much, and it may not even succeed.
Having a ready-made one would be best.’
’Cold Pool Valley Market, that’s my opportunity.’
’On that day, many cultivators will be there, with a mix of fish and dragons. Many people might not even show their true faces since everyone has their own secrets.
An anonymous auction, a masquerade exchange, and the like, should all be there...
At that time, I can attempt to control the shadow puppet to go for transactions.’
"I need to purchase a new flying sword, a more advanced Qi Concealment technique, any information about the Crimson Palace Realm, cultivation techniques, magic..."
"Also, the Nanwu Sword Sect will surely come looking for me. Then, I need to complete initial contact with them and get by unnoticed.
That’s relatively doable.
I’ve talked so much with Mr. Su San that I know far more about the Nanwu Sword Sect, Su Changyi, and the Su Family than before, I should be able to manage."
’However, the most crucial is that my Fox Demon Shadow Puppet has all been used up... I must find an opportunity to hunt at least one more before the Cold Pool Valley Market opens, and then make some more.’
...
...
The next day, as soon as Song Yan opened the door of the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, a row of shadow puppet carriages came flying close to the ground outside.
Shadow puppet vehicles, like carts and the Void Ship, are not within the "domain of skin making" but rather "secondary processed shadow puppet products," with the "secondary processing peak" being Mechanical Peak.
Stone Seat Elder should know about these things, but perhaps he felt it unrelated to the legacy and didn’t discuss it with him.
And after the Stone Seat Elder left, Gu Huangzi must have thought Song Yan only needed to make skins, so there was no need to learn this "excessive" knowledge, hence he didn’t let him know either.

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 72. The Last Chance (3.8K Words - Subscription Request)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: 72. The Last Chance (3.8K Words - Subscription Request)_2
The shadow puppet car carried a load of corpses.
Judging by the appearance, they were all newly deceased servants.
This stirred up some memories in Song Yan.
Previously, when he was at the Tannery on South Bamboo Peak, anyone who died nearby would be carted away like this.
To mortals, even after death, the soul remains for seven days... and seven days’ time is enough for the Puppet Sect to perform many dirty deeds.
Truly, in life, one serves the Puppet Sect; in death, one becomes its ghost.
Song Yan sighed, ready to tackle the day’s tasks, when he saw that the last shadow puppet cart had stopped right in front of the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
The disciple controlling the car dismounted and clasped his fists, saying, "Master Song, there’s a batch of new skins, and the Sect Leader wants to know if you can use them."
Song Yan asked curiously, "What new skins?"
The disciple lifted the thick cloth.
Song Yan’s pupils slightly contracted.
By a stroke of luck, the cart was carrying heaps of bloody "One-Tailed Fox Demon Skins."
The disciple said, "These were all hunted by our brothers in recent days. However, these fox demons vary greatly in power; some still at Intermediate Demon Beast level, while others have reached High Tier... Master Song, can you work with them? If you can, I’ll leave them here."
Song Yan’s thoughts flashed like lightning.
A test?
Unlikely.
Yet "One-Tailed Fox Demon Skin" was indeed something he desperately needed. If he were to replicate his old trick of "making a fox demon shadow puppet, while hiding one," it would remain undiscovered.
However...
He squinted slightly and said, "I’ll give it a try!"
The car disciple laughed, "I knew a skin-making genius like Master Song wouldn’t refuse."
Song Yan smiled and nodded, eagerly staring at the pile of skins. Once unloaded, he quickly cleaned them up. He then purposely selected a "one-tailed demon fox shadow puppet similar to a high-tier demon beast" and excitedly began crafting.
...
...
By evening.
A sharp scream pierced the air in Shadow Puppet Pavilion from Yuzhuang, the Little Maiden.
Chaos followed shortly after.
Song Yan’s two disciples rushed out the door, swiftly seeking out the Elder on duty. By the time the Elder arrived at the pavilion, many had already gathered outside.
The Elder stepped inside, only to find Song Yan lying weakly on the bed inside the pavilion, his face pale as gold paper.
"What happened?" The Elder was both hurried and shocked.
He knew of Song Yan’s importance; as the "bridge connecting the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect," nothing could go wrong with him. Otherwise, any bad signal could ruin major plans.
Yuzhuang, the Little Maiden, sobbed, "Master was shadow puppeting, and suddenly seemed to be cursed. Then Master rushed out from the room used for soul summoning, locked the door tightly, and became like this..."
The Elder looked at the bed again and saw Song Yan opening his eyes, weakly rasping, "Don’t... open the door..."
The Elder squinted, dismissed the disciples, and opened the soul summoning room door.
As soon as the door opened, a dark figure lunged forward.
The Elder raised his hand, grabbed fiercely, and crushed it instantly.
Upon a closer look, it was a broken One-Tailed Demon Fox Shadow Puppet.
The Elder instantly understood.
Master Song couldn’t yet craft a "Demon Fox Shadow Puppet," and hence suffered backlash. But it seemed the backlash occurred immediately upon summoning, so the puppet with an evil soul wasn’t strong.
Dealing with the trouble, the Elder approached Song Yan.
Song Yan weakly whispered, "I... am fine... just need some rest..."
The Elder said, "You must not strain yourself like this if you can’t manage it."
Song Yan fell silent.
The Elder continued, "That batch of fox skins is material designated by the Sect Leader for the upcoming battle. I... will send someone to retrieve them later. It’s none of your concern."
"Retrieve... them?" Song Yan rasped, eyes showing reluctance, "Retrieve... to where?"
The Elder laughed, "Here’s some good news: Although Master Shi hasn’t broken through the Crimson Palace Realm, he successfully extended his life, though he can’t leave the Evil Land. This batch of fox skins is meant for him, to make what he needs for the alliance with the Ghost Cultivators. He will craft for us."
Only then did the reluctance in Song Yan’s eyes fade away, and he sighed, "If it were Teacher, he certainly could do it... Teacher is far superior to me."
The Elder said, "You shouldn’t underestimate yourself, you’re still young. Rest well first, recover your health, and then continue skin-making."
With that, the Elder left.
Shortly thereafter, more disciples arrived with an empty shadow puppet cart to take away all of the One-Tailed Fox Demon Skins from the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
Song Yan silently watched the cart leave.
He thought of Grandma Fox, and how he’d once scavenged in her little treasury.
Though he didn’t know if his scavenging was too harsh, he felt that, at times like these, making a "One-Tailed Fox Demon Shadow Puppet" didn’t seem to be auspicious...
...
...
In the following days, Song Yan recuperated in his Cave Mansion, occasionally wandering the nearby mountain peaks alone.
During this time, he found an opportunity and, with some luck, managed to hunt a demon fox akin to a high-tier demon beast, then crafted a "Deformed Soul Shadow Puppet."
...ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
After two more days, Song Yan was "recovered."
He returned to the main peak of Paperman Peak.
At this point, there were already very few disciples exchanging Profound Jade in front of Paper Money Tower, so Song Yan directly stepped forward, presented his identity plate, and said, "Exchange for Profound Jade."
The disciple looked and blinked wide-eyed.
"All of your 256,000-plus Contribution Points exchanged?"
"Exchange."
"Then I should exchange Profound Crystals for you, Master Song. One Profound Crystal is worth ten small Profound Jades, five Great Profound Jades. How does that sound?"
"Agreed."
Song Yan understood well the basic exchange rates.
A small Profound Jade can provide 1 year of normal Cave Mansion cultivation even where there is no Profound Qi, and also offers additional Profound Qi during cultivation sessions in a Cave Mansion.
A Great Profound Jade, 2 years.
Profound Crystal, 10 years.
Elsewhere, Profound Crystals might need to be weighed, but those from Puppet Sect are standardized.
The Paper Money Tower disciple muttered calculations: "256,484 Contribution Points, I’ll exchange them for 80 Profound Crystals, 20 Great Profound Jades, 16 Small Profound Jades, and half of the Small Profound Jades will be with Profound Jade Beans, so that’s 800 beans."
Song Yan nodded.
Though his storage space isn’t large, it is enough to hold those Profound Crystals and Jades alongside the shadow puppets.
Just as he was waiting, someone walked out from Paper Money Tower, dressed in a white robe, exuding a chilling aura with a touch of inexplicable nervousness.
Song Yan looked over and clasped his hands, "Brother Yin."
The person was none other than Gu Huangzi’s other direct disciple — Yin Wutai.
Yin Wutai sneered, "Junior Brother, you’re exchanging so many Profound Crystals, are you planning not to return?"
Song Yan replied, "Skin-making is my lifelong passion; I’ve already regarded this place as home. Why would Brother Yin say such a thing? Moreover, with the upcoming alliance between Nanwu Sword Sect and our Puppet Sect, how could I possibly not return?"
Yin Wutai frowned, "Then what are you planning to buy with all those Profound Crystals?"
Song Yan said, "That’s none of Brother Yin’s concern."
Yin Wutai said no more, smirking and nodding, as he noticed the disciple watching him eagerly, Yin Wutai waved and said, "Don’t you help your uncle with the exchange?"
Finally the disciple hastily fetched a box and handed it to Song Yan.
After counting the contents, Song Yan saluted and swiftly left.
Yin Wutai watched his retreating figure, chuckled bizarrely, and refrained from further commentary, turning back and only after several steps murmuring, "Junior Brother, buy what you can, because afterward... there may be no chance to go out, hehehe..."

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78: 73. The teacher is erudite, and I am far inferior (3.6K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
A few days later...
Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
The Inner Sect Disciple Guan Wu stared in astonishment at the box in his hand, bewildered, and asked, "Master Song, why are the shadow puppets these past few days all... intermediate level demon beasts of Refining Profound level four?
And besides... aren't there fewer?"
Song Yan was about to speak, but first coughed twice, then said, "My touch hasn't been good these past few days, it should improve after a while."
Guan Wu paused, but recalling the recent incident where Master Song was counterattacked by a shadow puppet, he figured it might have left a psychological shadow on Master Song, making him even hesitant to touch slightly more advanced demon beast skins.
Guan Wu sighed and comforted, "Master Song, I looked into that matter. You were unfortunate to have grabbed a Fox Demon Skin that had already reached the advanced demon beast level, which is why it counterattacked."
Song Yan just gave a bitter smile and said nothing.
Once bitten by a snake, one becomes afraid of ropes for ten years.
If you're going to act, you have to follow through, you can't forget about it halfway through.
These days, he just picked the most ordinary type among intermediate demon beasts, and his efficiency changed from producing "one finished shadow puppet skin in a day" to "one every two days."
Shadow puppets are weapons.
With his weapon production declining, the Inner Sect Disciples coming to pick up goods were naturally anxious.
While they were chatting, a woman's seductive laughter was heard from afar: "Fellow Daoist Song, hasn't it been long?"
Guan Wu turned his head and saw a beautiful woman in a black robe standing at the end of the street, smiling as she looked over.
The beautiful woman was like a juicy, plump peach, quite voluptuous, her amorous eyes slightly narrowed, vaguely revealing a hint of sinister deep blackness, both alluring and demonic, yet filled with a chilling ghostly aura.
"Who are you?" Guan Wu immediately became wary.
At this moment, a white-robed cultivator quickly stepped out from behind the beautiful woman, and said, "Nephew, do not be rude."
Guan Wu looked and saw it was none other than Master Yin Wutai from the Paper Money Tower, and quickly paid his respects.
Yin Wutai said, "This is Sister Wang from South Bamboo Peak, who has come from the Evil Land to specially deliver finished Fox Demon Shadow Puppets to us. She heard that our Master Song was actually from the Nanwu Sword Sect, and was quite surprised, so she wanted to come over for a look and catch up."
Guan Wu suddenly understood, then bowed again, and quickly left with the shadow puppets made by Song Yan.
This beautiful woman in the black robe was of course Wang Susu.
Wang Susu and Yin Wutai whispered a few words, Yin Wutai nodded, then turned and left.
Meanwhile, Wang Susu walked towards Song Yan with a smile on her face.
Song Yan lowered his head and coughed twice, then said, "Yuzhuang, serve tea."
...
...
Moments later...
In a quiet room of the Shadow Puppet Pavilion.
Song Yan and Wang Susu sat facing each other.
Wang Susu smiled and said, "Sitting like this really reminds one of the days at South Bamboo Peak, sitting together every day with Fellow Daoist Song, making skins.
But Fellow Daoist Song deceived me so badly. Even when Brother Song helped the eldest daughter of the Su Family kill the King of Southern Regions, I vouched for him, saying Fellow Daoist Song was definitely not a spy, hee hee hee..."
Song Yan noticed that Wang Susu had changed quite a bit.
Her eyes were very black and large, incredibly deep, and there was an overwhelming ghostly aura around her, as if her entire body was enveloped in a faint black smoke, exuding a kind of sinister allure.
Ghost Cultivators cannot send Skin Masters or any South Bamboo Peak disciples out, as it's like putting a fish in water, it's very likely to be a one-way trip, not to mention... this fish also carries important shadow puppets.
It seemed like Wang Susu had noticed Song Yan's confusion, and she smiled seductively, "I've become a Ghost Cultivator now."
Song Yan was shocked and said, "You... you died?"
Wang Susu burst out laughing, leaning forward and backward, then said, "You're the one who's dead. I have transformed into a Ghost Profound Root."
Song Yan paused for a moment.The most update n0vels are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
He understood.
This old acquaintance in front of him must have been interacting with ghostly entities for a very long time, but this was a very dangerous, tremendously terrifying thing.
He wouldn't die in the life span calculation, but others might not be so fortunate.
"Then those Disciples Lu, Disciples Shangguan, and everyone else..."
Wang Susu said, "Those unlucky ones all died, died miserably.
I was lucky and succeeded."
After saying this, she rolled her eyes, propped her chin, and said, "Fellow Daoist Song, I came this time to see if I could make up for past regrets, hee hee... Being thoroughly used by a Righteous Dao disciple like you, who hides so deeply, would surely be unforgettable, right?"
Wang Susu spoke while getting closer, then actually climbed onto the table, twisted her whole body and sat between Song Yan's legs, her hands hooking around his neck, then whispered in his ear, "I transformed my Profound Root and survived, Master Shi accepted me as his disciple.
So... actually, I should call you Brother Song again.
The Master said that he has always valued you, if you have nowhere else to go, you can come to the Evil Land.
Paperman Peak is not a place for you to stay long.
Gu Huangzi took you in as a disciple, but his intentions are not good."
Wang Susu's voice got softer and softer, as if she were passing on a secret message, yet her hands became unruly.
Song Yan grabbed her hand.
Wang Susu chuckled softly, did not continue, and simply continued, "The Master has already found an opportunity to break through the Crimson Palace Realm, and also, during these days in the Evil Land, he has comprehended a lot of new shadow puppetry techniques... we all hope you'll come over."
After saying this, she flipped her long legs, moved her hips out from between Song Yan's legs, tugged at her black robe, then took a few steps away, turned back with a sweet smile, and swiftly left.
Song Yan was somewhat speechless.
Sister Wang truly had some luck, having transformed into a Ghost Profound Root, and being in the Evil Land, her cultivation speed must have significantly increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79: 73. The teacher is a scholar with great virtues, I am far less than him (3.6K characters - please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
As for her invitation...
Song Yan thought for a moment, then narrowed his eyes.
He figured it out...
Whether to accept or believe it actually didn't matter.
The important thing was, Old Demon Gu Huangzi definitely knew that Wang Susu had privately met with him and had a long talk in a quiet chamber.
Yin Wutai might casually chat about him with Wang Susu, even if he doesn't, Wang Susu might accidentally reveal a "flaw."
This alone would be enough to make Old Demon Gu Huangzi worry that his "Shadow Puppet Maker" might run away.
If thinking of the worst-case scenario, perhaps someone had used Divine Sense to eavesdrop just now, and everything Wang Susu said might have been overheard.
He faced three possible outcomes:
One, escape back to the Nanwu Sword Sect, but the hope was slim, and the consequences numerous. Moreover, given the current special situation, the Nanwu Sword Sect wouldn't break the grand alliance plan for him;
Two, escape to the Evil Land;
Three, be imprisoned more harshly by Gu Huangzi, perhaps even having his legs broken.
This was the real intention behind Wang Susu's visit.
As for what Stone Seat Elder's real motive was, he still couldn't see clearly, but since Stone Elder himself had hopes of breaking through the Crimson Palace Realm, he naturally didn't want his unique Secret Technique to be spread outside...
"Using another's hand to kill" couldn't be ruled out.
Describing the brother-sister affection gently was actually hiding ghostly thoughts.
Song Yan was somewhat speechless.
After working together for so many years, who doesn't know each other?
But this was really pressing him hard...
...
...
The next day.
An Elder displayed the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet sent by Stone Elder.
The shadow puppet was connected to the fingertips with Profound Qi, yet it suddenly changed into all sorts of forms through Illusion Techniques, sometimes a charming beauty, sometimes a bent old elder, sometimes a strong man, sometimes a naïve child...
Endlessly variable, mesmerizing.
For a time, Paperman Peak was in an uproar.
After all, everyone knew the value of such a Fox Demon Shadow Puppet.
It could fight, kill, and disguise, its functionality was far superior to those pure "big demon beasts."
With this Fox Demon Shadow Puppet, the Puppet Sect's "infiltration capabilities" would become particularly alarming, almost omnipresent. Against forces like the Nanwu Sword Sect, one could easily sneak in and cause huge destruction by exploiting a moment of inattention.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The disciples began to chat amongst themselves.
"I didn't expect the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet to be this good."
"Yes, dealing with those Fox Demons was such a headache for us because of their Illusion Techniques, but if they became shadow puppets, that power could be used for us."
"These days, we teamed up with Ghost Cultivators to kill quite a few Fox Demons."
The voices of the disciples were filled with both emotions and excitement.
At this moment, someone glanced at Song Yan on the other side.
"Song Master is here too," a disciple remarked.
However, Song Yan remained silent, his eyes fixed on that Demonic Fox Shadow Puppet, and after a long while, he let out a long sigh, "The teacher's mastery is divine, I'm far inferior..."
Some disciples comforted him, others had a mocking glimmer in their eyes, but most were silently indifferent.
In their hearts, "Song Master, who made an intermediate Demon Beast Shadow Puppet daily," was nearly surpassing "Stone Master," but now... Song Master was suddenly knocked down.
Truly, comparison reveals differences.
Still, the old ones have their edge.
...
...
Time flew by, and soon a month had passed.
The No-Body Phantom Crow delivered that bottle of blood to Song Yan with unwavering accuracy.
Song Yan quickly stored the blood in his Storage Space, leaving everything for action after the visit to the Cold Pool Valley Market.
The Cold Pool Valley Market... finally opened too.
Song Yan wasn't among the first to enter the market; he waited a few days before entering along with some fellow disciples from the Puppet Sect.
When they reached the market gate, they found cultivators already guarding it, and more cultivators at the Crimson Palace Realm stationing in a pavilion not far away.
To everyone's surprise, there was a small crystal cage hanging in front of the gate.
Inside the cage, nearly a hundred small snowy white insects were fluttering around.
As everyone took a glance, intending to step into the market, a guarding cultivator hurriedly approached, blocking them, "Fellow Daoists, please go to that cage first and wave, then enter the market."
Guan Wu, being familiar with Song Yan, naturally walked with him, stepping forward to ask, "What is the reason for this?"
The cultivator replied, "It's decreed by the Sect Leader and the elders."
Guan Wu furrowed his brows, his voice a bit wicked, "What Sect Leader and elders?"
The cultivator calmly replied, "It's also decreed by your Sect Leader, Gu Huangzi."
Guan Wu fell silent, stepped forward, waved his face in front of the cage, and said, "Is this acceptable now?"
The cultivator nodded with a smile.
Thus, everyone followed suit, and when all were done, the cultivator said, "Apologies, fellow Daoists, this cage contains a type of rare insect called Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants, which are extremely sensitive to Illusion Techniques. If anyone attempts to use Illusion Techniques to sneak into the market, these Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants will quickly attach themselves to the crystal wall.
This Cold Pool Valley Market is of great significance, so to prevent Fox Demons from sneaking in, this is necessary. Apologies."
Song Yan curiously asked, "If each person had a few of these insects, how could a Fox Demon hide?"
The cultivator replied, "You're joking, fellow Daoist. Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants are scarce, and acquiring so many is no easy feat. It's only because of the market opening that some seniors were willing to bring them out."
Song Yan nodded and entered, with Yuzhuang tightly clutching his hand.
Upon reaching the market, Puppet Sect cultivators immediately headed towards the Profound Artifact Elixir area.
Song Yan, however, halted and said, "I'm not going that way."
Guan Wu, curious, asked, "What is Master Song intending to buy?"
Song Yan smiled and said, "I'm buying some supplements for my little Yuzhuang… I'm going to stroll around the Mortal Area."
Everyone chuckled, and Guan Wu cheerfully said, "Master Song truly is a man who cherishes beauty. So, Master Song, do enjoy strolling with your little lady."
Yueyang Luo and Shen Nongjia were together as well; they were about to follow their master but really didn't want to go to the Mortal Area, so they each said, "Master, do have a good stroll..."
Song Yan nodded with a smile and then parted ways with a few people.
Gu Huangzi had imprinted a tracking mark on him, so there was no worry about him getting lost, especially with such a burden like little Yuzhuang beside him.
The meeting with people from the Nanwu Sword Sect didn't concern Gu Huangzi either.
No matter what he did after this stroll around the market, he would likely be placed under house arrest upon returning.
The only thing Gu Huangzi worried about was him leaking "Stone Seat Elder's Shadow Puppet Secret Technique," but both Gu Huangzi and Song Yan knew: if Song Yan dared to send it out, his return would hold consequences far beyond mere confinement...
Gu Huangzi could vaguely guess what kind of person Song Yan was.
He just didn't believe Song Yan was someone who would "sacrifice his life for righteousness."
It must be said, he was pretty accurate with his insights...

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 80: 74. Cold Pond City, Reunion with an Old Friend (3.3K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Cold Pool Valley Market, a mixing pot of fish and dragons, yet its vast scale and numerous participants are unparalleled in the history of the Three Kingdoms.
Song Yan estimated in his mind, feeling there must be at least ten thousand people here.
Among these ten thousand people, a large portion were Jianghu folks.
The alliance between Nanwu Sword Sect and Puppet Sect is a significant event, naturally, the "little brothers" below must come to "support."
The righteous and evil sects within the Jianghu also need to temporarily make peace, uniting against external enemies.
Song Yan walked around, only quietly placing the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet in a shady spot after finding a few secluded corners. Once he left, the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet expanded from the shadow, transforming into an ordinary-looking cultivator that wouldn't attract attention even upon a glance.
After wandering a few circles, on one of the occasions when it coincided with Song Yan again, Song Yan discreetly handed him a storage bag.
Although a storage bag is precious, on Paperman Peak, it is not impossible to exchange one.
After completing these tasks, Song Yan led Yuzhuang Little Lady to indulge in delicious food and drink.
Cao Yuzhuang was captured at eight, entering the Demon Sect, and has been living in fear every day. Today, following Song Yan into this top-tier market, witnessing the aroma wafting from the food district, her craving was already stirred.
Song Yan joined her, feasting heartily.
Meanwhile...
The Fox Demon Puppet was executing Song Yan's true purchasing intentions.
Song Yan initially intended to buy a mask, but unexpectedly stumbled upon a stall hawking "Anonymous Suits."
He went forward to take a look.
Goodness, this one has a business acumen.
Masks, cloaks, Qi Concealment Talismans, all prepared in a set.
The stall owner saw him linger, standing up with a smile: "Cultivators harbor many secrets, and no one wants to be exposed easily. Although fighting is prohibited in the Cold Pool Valley Market, who knows once outside. For safety, would the friend like to buy this outfit?"
As he explained, a cultivator passing by suddenly turned back, purchased a set, wore it, and marched off proudly.
Only then did Song Yan cautiously count out 4 Profound Jade Beans from the storage bag, placed them in his palm, counted them again, and then reluctantly handed them out, asking: "Can't it be just a bit cheaper?"
The stall owner sighed: "Small business, it's difficult for me too."
Song Yan sighed along, then exchanged money for goods, quickly putting on the set, testing its effect, grumbled over trivial things, saying words like "not worth the price, bought at a loss" before leaving.
After he moved away, the stall owner couldn't help but mutter: "Penniless... didn't even bring enough money to the market, what can one buy?"
...
...
After changing into the suit, Song Yan started eyeing flying swords.
Currently, his main offensive technique is indeed the "Black and White Double Evil."
One hand with White Evil Devouring Profound, one hand with Black Death Fury.
Moreover, a "Two-Handed Sword" can catch people off guard, after all... no one knows he uses two swords, and there are hardly any in the entire Nanwu Sword Sect who use two swords.
As for, "Hundred Forms Divine Control," "Divine Swallowing Hundred Forms," "Hundred Forms Demon Body," "Skin Painting Slave Soul Technique," these all belong to the "Soul Control" class of techniques.
Not to mention those "Manufacturing Class" techniques, even "Hundred Forms Demon Body," the action is quite conspicuous, with plenty of "Casting Animation"... it's not very agile nor suitable for small area magical battles. Once used, regardless of power or appearance, it immediately puts oneself in the "spotlight."
"Hundred Forms Demon Body" suits for instant kill, decisive hit, and going all out, but not quite for battles.
Therefore, he needs a flying sword.
After walking some distance, he had already left the bustling area of the Cold Pool Valley Market.
Here, the vendors were quite spaced apart, the lighting was dim, and the goods sold at the stalls were items only usable by high-tier cultivators within the Refining Profound Realm.
Song Yan soon selected a stall selling flying swords.
The stall owner directly asked: "Do you want high-tier or middle-tier?"
High-tier refers to the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound and above.
Middle-tier is from the fourth to sixth layer.
Song Yan said: "High-tier."
The stall owner glanced at him, noticing the other's well-hidden aura, without saying much, directly took out several flying swords beginning introductions one by one.
Song Yan pointed to the best among them, saying: "This one."
The stall owner stated: "My friend, 28 small Profound Jades, rest assured about the quality, among the high-tier also considered top-grade, usable throughout the entire Refining Profound Realm."
Song Yan pointed again: "This one."
The stall owner said: "This one is 22 small Profound Jades..."
Finished speaking, he raised an eyebrow, slightly furrowed: "Which one do you want?"
Song Yan said: "Both."
Then, decisively paid 5 Profound Crystals, placed both flying swords into his storage space, swiftly departing.
The stall owner stared dumbfounded at his back, scratching his head.
Buying two flying swords in one go, it was the first time he encountered this...
Song Yan's thought was simple.
If Old Demon Gu Huangzi intends to confine him, it's possible he may seize his only flying sword.
After all, as a sword cultivator, being without a flying sword is akin to a tiger without teeth.
Hence, buying two is prudent.
If it were not for insufficient money and storage space, he might have bought more.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Walking a few more steps, he suddenly noticed a stall with "Array Flag" floating behind.
Array Flags, once laid out, can harness Profound Qi to create an array.
The biggest difference between arrays and talismans is, the latter usually targets individuals and has a time limit; whereas arrays target areas, and can function endlessly as long as there is enough Profound Qi.
Talismans are available in almost every market, but Array Flags are rare indeed...
Only a marketplace of Cold Pool Valley's stature could harbor such things.
Song Yan saw someone in front of the stall, so he patiently waited until the person left before swiftly approaching.
...
...
"Eat slowly."
Song Yan's "main body" watched as Yuzhuang, the young lady, devoured her food ravenously.
He also liked such places filled with the aroma of human life.
Tossing a Profound Jade Bean, Song Yan shouted, "Waiter, whatever your signature dishes are, just bring them out."
The waiter, upon seeing the Profound Jade Bean, came running with bright eyes, took the bean, giggled, and said, "I will surely satisfy the guest," before running off.
Yuzhuang, the young lady, looked up at him with her face blank.
Song Yan laughed, "What's the matter?"
The young lady replied, "Master, I'm thirsty..."
Song Yan scanned the surroundings and noticed a place selling drinks not far away, so he prepared to get up but stopped just as he moved.
As he stopped, a woman came to a halt on the road ahead.
Dressed in a Pure Silver Sword Robe, her face was dignified, her chest open, her long legs proud and strong, her expression cold as frost, yet she seemed troubled for some reason, unclear what had happened...
Though her temperament had changed, wasn't this former Qi Yao, and who was Su Yao now?
Song Yan took a gold bean and handed it to Yuzhuang, the young lady, saying, "Go buy some drinks, buy a lot."
He still had a lot of gold and silver stored in the storage space, mainly for convenience when spending outside. Large denominations were mostly in the form of beans. As for drinks and such, they were cheap outside, but here, who knew what rare ingredients they might contain, requiring gold.
Yuzhuang, the young lady, wiped her mouth, took the gold bean, and left the seat.
On the other side, Su Yao suddenly turned and walked away.
Song Yan called out, "Don't recognize me?"
Su Yao turned back, unexpectedly bowed, and said, "Senior Brother Song, there are instructions from the sect; if we see you, we are to notify immediately, and then an elder will come to see you."
Listening to her extremely formal tone, Song Yan nodded and said, "Then you go notify."
Su Yao turned, walked a few steps, and suddenly stopped, turned her head, and said, "Actually... Senior Brother did save my life back then. So, if Senior Brother has any requests, I will try my best to fulfill them."
Song Yan looked at her and suddenly said, "There is indeed something."
Su Yao came back, sat in the seat Yuzhuang, the young lady, had just occupied, and asked, "What is it?"
Song Yan observed her, noticing her anxiety had grown, and said, "What happened?"
Su Yao said, "Just a major upheaval within the clan... Senior Brother should tell me what you want me to do."
Song Yan said, "Previously, I was actually following Elder Changyi."
Su Yao's pretty face immediately showed surprise, "You were following my big brother?"
Song Yan nodded softly, then looked at her complexly, beginning to tell her about Su Changyi.
These... were all things he had learned when he was with Mr. Su San.
And based on these words, he naturally crafted a tale to explain his identity.
Su Changyi was the eldest of the seven siblings of the Su Family and an elder of the Nanwu Sword Sect, coincidentally in charge of some of the Nanwu Sword Sect's spies operating outside.
Listening, Su Yao lowered her head silently and suddenly said, "Our Su family's old patriarch is gone... and so is Third Brother..."
Song Yan was stunned, immediately realizing: the backing of the Fox Stabbing Alliance must have been the Su family's old patriarch, now... they've been completely defeated?
Unclear whether the First Lady Fox was injured...
But then again, the death of the Su family's old patriarch would undoubtedly have a significant impact within the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Every force has factions for war and conservative factions...
And the Su family was the faction for war.
For a moment, he was also silent.
Due to the connection with Su Changyi, plus their previous special relationship, Su Yao spoke a bit more, sighing, "Big Brother was deep in thought, yet I didn't expect you were with our family... Just that in the future, our Su family won't have much voice in the Nanwu Sword Sect, even if you achieve great merit, there won't be much benefit.
Later, the ones who will inevitably question you will be the elders of the Sun family; a wise bird chooses a tree to nest. If you have the chance, switch to them."
After speaking, she smiled bitterly, an indescribable sadness.
Song Yan also felt the enormous change in her.
When first met, she was the lively figure of a female knight, then later, seemed filled with murderous intent after turning dark... until now, in her words, there was maturity and worldly wisdom, no longer naive.
Time, indeed, ages people...
"Alright, tell me what you want to do then." Su Yao composed herself and said calmly, "I don't like leaving favors unrepayed."
Song Yan slightly turned his head, glanced at Yuzhuang, the young lady, waiting for drinks, and said softly, "If there comes a day she appears in the Nanwu Sword Sect, give her a place to stay."
After speaking, he added in an even softer voice, "She has a Profound Root, can cultivate."
Su Yao said, "Wei Kingdom Royalty?"
Song Yan nodded and said, "Cao Yuzhuang, taken up the mountain when she was eight."
Su Yao looked at him strangely and said, "Do you always treat your Furnace so well?"
Then she said, "I met Qiu Lianyue in the Wu Kingdom... She's now one of the managers of a large caravan and has not remarried."
Song Yan remained silent...
Su Yao glanced at him and continued, "I promise you, as long as she comes to the Wu Kingdom, I will treat her like my own sister and teach her to cultivate."
After speaking, she took out a jade pendant from her bosom, handed it to Song Yan, and said, "Let her bring this to Nanwu; be it Jianghu, government, or sect, others will recognize it upon seeing, and they will send her to the Su family."
A starved camel is still bigger than a horse; even if my Su family no longer has the old patriarch, we still hold some prestige."

chapters.content:
Not long after, Little Miss Yuzhuang returned with drinks, three portions of a hundred-fruit drink. Because it included some rare fruits and used some secret recipe from a famous Jianghu doctor, the soup base required days and nights of simmering, so it was quite expensive.
She had already noticed Su Yao and thought she was a friend of the master, so she took the liberty of bringing a portion for her as well.
But Su Yao shook her head, as she had not had anything sweet for a long time.
The bitterness in her heart couldn't be swallowed with sweetness, could it?
"I will notify the Elders of our sect first." Su Yao stood up.
Song Yan said, "Don't forget the matter you promised me."
Su Yao coldly replied, "I guarantee it with my life."
Song Yan said, speechless, "Don't make it about life or death... just take it seriously."
Su Yao turned and left.
Song Yan took out a jade pendant he had previously and handed it to Cao Yuzhuang, leaned over, and whispered, "Her name is Su Yao, the seventh Miss of the Southern Wu Sword Sect's Su Family. If you enter the Wu Kingdom with this jade pendant, someone will take you to see her, and she will take care of you."
Little Miss Yuzhuang, who was focused on enjoying her fruit mix, was suddenly presented with "an extremely unexpected piece of information," leaving her wide-eyed and confused.
Song Yan said, "Remember what I said."
Little Miss Yuzhuang nodded blankly.
Song Yan said, "Repeat it."
Little Miss Yuzhuang was only mentally frozen, not foolish, so she lightly repeated what Song Yan had just said.
Song Yan was finally satisfied, saying, "Hide the jade pendant well."
Little Miss Yuzhuang nodded and carefully hid the jade pendant, then furrowed her brows tightly and began to ponder deeply. She really didn't know under what circumstances she would need to use this jade pendant or what the master meant by giving it to her.
Eight years of hellish life had long made her give up any thoughts of escape; anything that could help her escape seemed like a test.
In the early years, she had tried to escape. Once, there was no one on the road down the mountain, her sister leading her step by step. They were about to reach the mountain gate when a commotion arose behind them.
Her sister knew some martial arts, so she desperately protected her, waving a weapon while shouting, "Run, run fast."
She ran desperately, escaping in panic, but in the end... she was still caught and brought back. The wicked Demon Sect female disciple pricked her skin bit by bit with a needle. The needle was laced with a poison that was excruciatingly painful, and she screamed in agony while the Demon Sect disciple mockingly smiled and told her, "It's all a test for you, if you didn't run, nothing would happen."
Gradually, she adapted. She had long thought of herself as a humble, lowly ant that was afraid of death, living day by day. As for how long she could live, it entirely depended on the master's will, so she must earnestly please the master and listen to his words.
She believed she had tried very hard to please Song Yan, and Song Yan's attitude towards her showed that "she had scored very high in this exam of pleasing," and she was sure she could live a long time.
But what did this jade pendant mean?
Was it the master trying to test if she would run away?
Cao Yuzhuang's little mind began complex deliberations.
Song Yan glanced into the distance, suddenly thinking of something. He looked around, stopping at a single-plank bridge in Cold Pool Valley not far away.
Due to the layout of the market, many stone benches were set up around the bridge, surrounded by colorful lights crafted by ingenious Jianghu artisans. The five-color lights illuminating the surrounding Profound Grass Spirit Flowers added a touch of elegance.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by
"Yuzhuang, there will be guests later, sit over there and eat." Song Yan said as he took out some gold beans and a Profound Jade Bean, "Once you're done eating, wander around the area. Come back when I call you."
Cao Yuzhuang felt it was likely because the master found her a nuisance, so she hurriedly took her fruit mix and the "spending money given by the master" and walked away.
She had not walked far when several people rushed to the end of the street.
Leading them was a middle-aged man, dressed in fine robes with a jade belt, kindly and smiling, while Su Yao hung at the end among the few behind him.
The middle-aged man approached Song Yan, examined him briefly, then collected his smile and earnestly said, "Brother Song, you've had it hard."
Song Yan got up and said, "Greetings to Elder Sun."
The two immediately sat down.
Elder Sun said nothing more, only lamenting the difficulties Song Yan had endured, then expanded to the hardships of undercover operatives, occasionally self-reproachfully expressing that "the sect owes these old brothers and will certainly make amends in the future."
Song Yan was a bit speechless...
The person in front of him lacked sincerity.
He still preferred the way Su Yao spoke.
Cold as she was, when such a person spoke insincere and hypocritical words, first and foremost, they would reflect self-disdain in their own eyes.
Previously, his impression of the Nanwu Sword Sect remained with people like "Su Yao" and "Mr. Su San," and these people matched his understanding of the Righteous Dao, thinking, "It truly is a sect with integrity that is admirable."
Because of this, even after he entered the Imperial Capital and fell into the hands of Grandma Fox, he still helped the "Fox Stabbing Alliance" dig a pit for Grandma Fox as best as he could. In fact, afterward, the "Fox Stabbing Alliance" indeed gained the upper hand, but due to inferior skills, they failed.
Now, Elder Sun's behavior made him realize: there are never only one voice in any force.
On the other side, after saying a lot of what he thought could express sincerity, Elder Sun waved his hand, signaling the surrounding people to step back, then leaned closer and lowered his voice, "Little Song, it's time."

Song Yanqi asked, "When?"
Elder Sun whispered, "The secret technique of Stone Seat Elder, although it originates from the Demon Sect, can save many lives if applied properly.
Hurry and give it to me. I'll take it back to our sect, and your efforts won't be in vain. The Sword Sect will remember your contributions as well."
Song Yan: ...
He smiled wryly, "Elder, aren't you aware of Gu Huangzi's nature? How could I possibly bring that thing out?"
Elder Sun frowned and said, "Then write down as much as you remember. We also have a Skin Master in our sect who can research it, such as the name of the secret technique, its effects, what counters it, and its core incantation..."
Song Yan took a deep breath and began the long "tug-of-war", as he was still outwardly a spy of the Nanwu Sword Sect and couldn't afford to break face here.
However, as the conversation progressed, his goodwill towards the Nanwu Sword Sect was rapidly declining.
At least the Demon Sect knows to make an equivalent exchange, or to simply grab it outright.
The Sun Family wants to take the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" with some empty promises, moral coercion, and without regard for his safety or situation?
What kind of sword technique is that?
Has their mind gone mad?
...
...
In the distance, at a pavilion far from the market.
A white-robed cultivator and a paper figure sat facing each other.
The cultivator had two strands of white hair hanging by his ears, with broad sleeves fluttering, giving a somewhat free-spirited and unrestrained impression.
The paper figure sat eerily with rouge-colored cheeks and dressed in green.
The Great Elder unceremoniously said, "Gu Huangzi, during such a day of planning to attack foxes, your true body is still hiding nearby? How can I trust your sincerity?"
The paper figure strangely replied, "Isn't your Sect Leader also absent? What sincerity do you have?"
The Great Elder said, "The Sect Leader is in seclusion."
The paper figure laughed sinisterly, "Trying to reach the late stage of the Crimson Palace Realm? Does he have enough foundation? Can he manage it? Or is it... that he failed to breakthrough and got injured?"
The Great Elder said, "No need to probe. Since we are attacking the foxes, the two of us should cooperate well. Everything will be discussed after the foxes are dealt with."
His gaze turned icy, like two sharp swords, "We will inevitably have a confrontation, but not now."
"Alright, alright..."
The paper figure swayed as it laughed, then suddenly stopped smiling, saying, "Let's talk about the focus of the alliance.
The Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox, although fearsome, is also an extremely valuable resource because it is a demon.
Granny Fox has two types of blood within her.
One is the blood of the Multi-tailed Fox Race, which is said to be able to store Profound Qi. Three tails mean it can instantly restore Profound Qi three times, which is why we cannot defeat it alone.
The other is Dragon Bo blood...
This is an external bloodline, how much do you know about it?"
The Great Elder pondered, "Do you know the Blood Seed Ancient Pool?"
The paper figure said, "So even if we kill Granny Fox, we cannot obtain the Dragon Bo blood. Since this race is called the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Cannibal Fox in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, their clan must have a Dragon Bo Blood Seed Ancient Pool, which is the place to extract Dragon Bo blood."
The Great Elder nodded, saying, "What I am puzzled about is, why did Granny Fox come here?"
The paper figure said, "Isn't it because that fool King Wei went and told it that there is another dining hall here?"
The Great Elder shook his head slowly, with a cautious expression, "The land of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country... I have some understanding.
They lack no food, especially the Multi-tailed Fox Race, which has already absorbed Dragon Bo blood. They are considered a middle-tier level in that country, definitely not on the lower end of the food chain.
It's actually unnecessary for it to come to a place like ours...
But why did it come?"
The paper figure snorted, "Who knows?
Let's discuss the realistic issues.
I will be direct, if we kill Granny Fox, we can give you half of its essence blood, but... we want all of its flesh."
The Great Elder laughed, "Dragon Bo blood isn't easy to deal with. Do you know its weakness?"
The paper figure fell silent.
Though Gu Huangzi was a sect leader who commanded the Three Kingdoms, he still found it unbelievable when thinking of the giant shadow of the fox demon that darkened the sky, and the three blazing white giant tails, because it fundamentally didn't look like the power of the Crimson Palace Realm.
Too terrifying...
So terrifying that he still held some fear just recalling it.
He was the Puppet Sect Leader, who killed countless people.
The Great Elder also seemed to recall that scene, his heart heavy as if tied with iron. He said solemnly, "Since you mentioned taking the largest share of the spoils, the Puppet Sect Leader must have a battle plan, let's hear it."
The paper figure thought for a while, then whispered, "I have received news that the Su Family's batch of people went to the Imperial Capital to assassinate Granny Fox and they didn't return empty-handed.
Someone took something extremely important from Granny Fox with them. Granny Fox is searching everywhere for it, do you know what it is?"
The Great Elder shook his head, "As allies, I won't hide it from you, not a single person from the Fox Stabbing Alliance returned alive, let alone took anything away. I truly don't know."
The paper figure was annoyed, "Then no matter what this thing is.
Since Granny Fox is desperately looking for it, why don't we release false information, saying that Granny Fox's wanted object is in the Evil Land behind my Puppet Sect.
The Evil Land is dangerous, and ghostly creatures are endless.
If Granny Fox falls into it, plus an ambush by our two sects, even if it has three tails, restoring Profound Qi three times instantly, it has to die there.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Since the battle takes place in my sect, it's not excessive for us to take the largest share of the spoils, is it?"
The Great Elder said, "Apart from the two-faced one and Scarlet Fiery Real Person in your Evil Land, who else is there?"
The paper figure whispered a name, "Zhang Han."
"Zhang Han, he... he..."
The Great Elder was rendered speechless.
Only because the owner of this name once dominated the Three Kingdoms, and after his death, the chaotic scene of righteous and demonic forces emerged, but who would have thought a ghost has resurrected using this body.
Logically speaking, a body with expired longevity, even carrying a Profound Root, should be extremely unlikely to be usurped.
And even if it was usurped, the realm would greatly fall, being able to maintain at the early stage from the late stage of the Crimson Palace would already be considered not bad.
The paper figure said, "The matter of Ghost Cultivators, I don't quite understand, but Zhang Han seems to have indeed become a Ghost Cultivator through some secret technique, but... he is no longer Elder Zhang, he's an unrelated ghost.
Fortunately, the secret technique's side effects are quite heavy, at least... he cannot leave the core area of the Evil Land.
Can't take even a step away.
He's like a tethered evil ghost."
The Great Elder thought for a moment and said, "Then let's follow this plan, our two sects make preparations and set up an ambush in the Evil Land..."
He was about to say more when he was suddenly interrupted by the paper figure's strange expression.
The paper figure froze with a thoroughly shocked look, not moving its eyes, mouth agape, and the rouge on its cheeks appeared eerie due to creases. It seemed to have suddenly received some incredibly shocking, unbelievable news.
But how could a Sect Leader be so easily shocked?
The Great Elder couldn't help but curiously ask, "What happened?"
The paper figure mechanically turned its head, using a voice like seeing a ghost, "Granny Fox... is already in the Evil Land..."
The Great Elder: ???
The paper figure said, "It... it snuck in while we were all drawn to the market when the Cold Pool Valley Market opened."
The Great Elder asked, "But why would it go to the Evil Land? Could it be... its treasure is really in the Evil Land?"
The paper figure was silent for a moment, its expression drastically changed, then it shrieked.
Immediately, several streaks of rainbow light flew out from the market, it was the Peak Masters and Elders of the Puppet Sect who came to the market.
These rainbow streaks joined the paper figure, rushing swiftly towards the Evil Land of the Puppet Sect.
"Out at the market, home being ransacked", this feeling was profoundly unpleasant.
The Great Elder also hurriedly gathered his people and followed closely.
In any case, this was the best opportunity to defeat Granny Fox.
On the other side, "Sek Leader's direct disciple" Yin Wutai was wandering the market when his communication stone suddenly lit up.
Inside, Gu Huangzi's icy and chilling voice entered his divine sense:
"There's been a change in the sect, the fox demon is attacking, watch your junior brother, don't let him run off!"
Yin Wutai grinned savagely.
He knew, "junior brother" or not, once the market was over, he would be placed under house arrest, so he had to keep a close watch.
