chapters.content:
Puppet Sect...
Evil Land.
The rolling blood-colored evil Qi crawled at the center like red jade, but it had lost its former terror.
Just because a giant fox demon shadow blocked the sky and covered the evil land's red jade, the falling shadow suppressed the churning of the evil Qi.
Figures of demon foxes darted from the darkness; even though ghosts flew chaotically and shadow puppets ran rampant, facing so many intermediate and advanced demon creatures, they were still inferior.
In the red jade of the evil land, a pair of eerie eyes stared straight at the sky-covering giant shadow, and there was fear in those eyes.
Thus, the owner of those eyes only lay in wait, not daring to charge up and engage in a life-or-death battle with the multi-tailed Dragon Bo Fox.
The two had already fought with magic.
Zhang Han lost, heavily injured.
Perhaps the Great Lady Fox was also hurt, but it was not apparent, Zhang Han dared not go up again.
After all, he had realized that the Great Lady Fox's target was neither the evil land nor him.
Since that was the case... why risk his life?
At this moment...
An old man emitting black smoke all over was being firmly pinned by five sharp claws onto the bloody soil of the evil land.
The old man was none other than Stone Seat Elder.
Yesterday at this time, he was still worried that his unique secret art had been leaked by Song Yan, pondering how to use others to kill, or deceive him into coming to the evil land.
But today, he was contemplating breaking through to the Crimson Palace Realm, when suddenly... disaster struck from the sky.
Fox soldiers and generals appeared all over the mountains and plains, and the terrifying Great Lady Fox also appeared.
The Great Lady Fox tore up the former Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak and then confronted the formidable figure deep within the ghost cultivator's territory—Zhang Han the old ghost.
Zhang Han was actually defeated.
He was just about to hide deeper in the evil land, but only because of a cry of "Stone Master" from some ghost cultivator, he was surrounded tightly by the demon foxes and then sent to...
Stone Seat Elder looked at the Great Lady Fox in front of him with fear.
Even though she was close at hand, he couldn't clearly see the Great Lady Fox's appearance at all.
She was just a distorted ghost shadow, the kind that only appears in the deepest nightmares.
Just seeing those ghostly eyes made him feel cold to the limbs, his breathing difficult.
"Speak, is it you!?"
The strange, sharp voice fell, and Stone Seat Elder felt a tremor in his divine soul, then his whole body shook, saying: "Great... Great Lady, to be honest, I... I'm very confused..."
"I'm also very confused."
The ghost shadow sternly said, "How dare you steal my things?!"
Stone Seat Elder was terrified to the point of his soul almost dissipating, he hurriedly said: "Even if... even if you give me a hundred guts, I wouldn't dare... steal your... things."
"Ghost cultivator, the one-tailed fox demon shadow puppet, needs to break through the Crimson Palace Realm, and... was it your secret technique controlling the bodiless phantom crow?" The ghost shadow spat out each word with gritted teeth, as if pronouncing Stone Seat Elder's crimes.
"If it's not you, then who else?!!"
The angry Great Lady Fox suddenly pressed with her five fingers.
Stone Seat Elder panicked, quickly saying: "Yes! Yes!"
"Song Yan?"
The Great Lady Fox's voice sounded mocking.
Stone Seat Elder quickly said: "Yes! Yes!"
The Great Lady Fox teased, "I will count to three, then use the Soul-Searching Skill."
"One..."
Stone Seat Elder was dumbfounded, he struggled to maintain his composure, recalling the words the Great Lady Fox had just spoken.
Clearly, what the Great Lady Fox just said matched the characteristics of the "thief."
But every sentence she spoke fit him perfectly.
"It's not me, someone... someone is framing me."
"Two..."
The Great Lady Fox completely ignored him.
For so long now, it had been secretly searching and waiting for the right moment, in the end, after all this investigation, the one whose characteristics matched the "thief" was precisely this ghost cultivator called Stone Seat Elder.
It even had prematurely come to be lurking around, probing for a while, and found that wandering "bodiless phantom crow."
Clearly, Stone Seat Elder had the power to "externally control shadow puppets."
So, taking advantage of the Cold Pool Valley Market opening, it led the fox children and grandchildren in a fierce attack on the evil land.
How could it possibly give up because of a single sentence from Stone Seat Elder at this point?
People can lie, memories cannot.
But to be safe, it was still determined to interrogate a bit first.
Stone Seat Elder was also thinking rapidly.
Suddenly, a thought burst in his mind.
If... if that renegade disciple was not just at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, but held greater power, then... then wouldn't it also match the characteristics given by Great Lady Fox?
But still, it was not right.
That renegade disciple was a spy for the Nanwu Sword Sect, how could they be a ghost cultivator?
Why did it have to be a ghost cultivator?
"Three..."
The Great Lady Fox ran out of patience.
Stone Seat Elder knew there would be no escape, but as he faced death not knowing who was ultimately plotting against him, he shouted madly: "Help... me... take... revenge!!"
The voice rolled on, spreading far.
No one knew whom he was speaking to.
Perhaps it was the ghost cultivator.
Or perhaps it was another who inherited his teachings.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
In the distance...
Wang Susu dashed away quickly, hearing the faint whispers of her teacher's dying wishes in the wind. She rolled her eyes and muttered under her breath, "Old thing, dying just like that, who has the time for revenge for you? I wonder if there's anything you didn't teach me. I earned your legacy through my own skills, hmph!"
...
...
"Whew..."
Song Yan finally managed to send off that Elder Sun. At this moment, he took out the Hundred Fruits Drink and started eating it with satisfaction.
Meanwhile, his Deformed Soul Fox Demon Shadow Puppet also had some good gains.
Firstly, he spent 9 Profound Crystals to acquire a set of Array Flags.
The flags were four in number, and the array was named "Traceless Array".
The method to use it was very simple; insert with Profound Qi into the landscape to naturally form an array.
However, the covering range of the array was not large, at most the size of a house including its courtyard.
The function of the array was concealment.
Should outsiders pass by this place, they would not see you, nor hear you speak, as if you were invisible.
The energy consumption of the array was related to the "size of the array area". If it was only to hide one person, then even one small Profound Jade could maintain it for a year, making it very "energy efficient".
...
Secondly, he spent as much as 10 Profound Crystals, equivalent to 100 small Profound Jades, to purchase a variety of Talismans, each stored with dozens of sheets. Although most were low-level Talismans, the effects truly astonished Song Yan.
Among these Talismans were ones that could calm one's mind, allowing you to sit down and enjoy life with a cup of tea no matter how bad the situation, like the "Heart Cleansing Talisman".
There were Talismans that could evoke a strong Killing Intent, filling you with rage, eager to slaughter everything you see, like the "Slaughter Talisman".
There were Talismans that could speed up your movement, like the "Wind Charm".
Some could manipulate local ranges of Five Elements Profound Qi to produce various effects, and so on...
Although Five Elements Profound Qi was the exclusive domain of the Five Elements Profound Root, ordinary cultivators could also utilize those powers through Talismans.
...
Besides these, he also purchased some miscellaneous items, such as Human Skin Masks made by cultivators and replenished some "Fanatic Fans", which were very useful in the Mortal World...
...
At this time, while eating and drinking with the returned Yuzhuang maiden, Song Yan watched as the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet searched everywhere for places like "swap meets" or "auctions".
He intended to find Magic, Cultivation Techniques related to the "Crimson Palace Realm".
However, while there were "auctions", upon inquiring, he learned that items related to the "Crimson Palace Realm" only included "Advanced Demon Beast Blood".
It was said that to break through realms, "Advanced Demon Beast Blood" was required as a catalyst.
Song Yan had long known about these things.
However, he still had the blood of that mysterious variegated black shadow stored in his Storage Space, rendering these Advanced Demon Beast Blood unappealing to him.
...
...
Just then, a figure in white robes appeared in the distance, with a cold aura and slightly eerie eyes.
Song Yan looked up to see it was Senior Brother Yin Wutai.
He bowed from afar, initially thinking Yin Wutai was merely passing by, but the latter did not leave. Instead, he walked straight over and sat next to Song Yan, laughing, "Has Junior Brother Song seen any fellow sect members from the Sword Sect?"
"I have seen them."
Song Yan replied, then added, "I know all the rules."
"It's good that you understand." Yin Wutai seemed uninterested in entangling in this matter and said, "In a while, you still have to return to the sect, right? I'll go with you, Junior Brother."
A hint of concealed doubt appeared in Song Yan's eyes, but he nodded and said, "Alright, I'll go along with Senior Brother. So... when is Senior Brother planning to depart?"
Yin Wutai leaned back and chuckled, "What's the rush? There's no hurry."
...
...
Sizzle...
Granny Fox raised her hand, coldly gazed at Stone Seat Elder, and killed him effortlessly. She squinted her long fox eyes.
Her eyes were filled with a deep sense of disappointment and a trace of unexplainable fear.
It seemed that the lost Essence Blood was not just a cultivation resource, but something of more special significance, something that could push her to a desperate situation, to a life-threatening dead end.
She had to desperately fight for it.
At this time, Granny Fox had completed the soul search, but was quite dissatisfied with the results.
She coughed lightly twice, taking several deep breaths...
Evidently, the previous battle with the two-faced creature and Zhang Han was not without harm, causing considerable expenditure, far surpassing the light injuries previously sustained from the fierce fight with the Fox Stabbing Alliance.
But now was not the time to stop.
Granny Fox's fox eyes rolled briskly, thoughts racing.
Suddenly, a name popped into her mind: Song Yan!
Except for not being a Ghost Cultivator, and not matching the realm, Song Yan fitted most of the conditions.
Moreover, Song Yan had a rather intimate relationship with the killed Fu Empress.
She learned some things from the memories of Stone Seat Elder.
On the day Shadow Puppet Peak fully joined the Ghost Cultivator camp, nearly all furnaces on South Bamboo Peak died, except for the two women of the Fu Family.
In the recent days, Song Yan suffered a backlash while making the "One-Tailed Fox Demon", then publicly stated, "The teacher's knowledge is vast and profound; I fall short in many aspects."
All these leads interconnect somewhat indirectly but are... too coincidental!
If Song Yan was hiding something; if Song Yan intentionally diverted her attention to focus on Stone Seat Elder.
Then, it was still possible.
This was exactly the kind of thing that cunning, damned little thief would do.
Feign death, pretend to be a treasure, get sent into someone else's treasury, then, when they go out, rob the treasury.
Is this something a person could do?!
Granny Fox's thoughts moved lightning fast, suddenly clenching her fangs, she howled, swooping towards the Cold Pool Valley Market.
If Song Yan really was that cunning little thief, then today's death of Stone Seat Elder would be enough to alert him. She had to find him before that, kill him, then see what kind of secrets were hidden in his mind!!

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 84: 77. Exchange Meeting, Blood Fusion Technique (4.1K characters - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
The Evil Land of Puppet Sect was in chaos, yet the Cold Pool Valley Market remained bustling with activity.
Many cultivators from the Three Kingdoms gathered here, and those few Crimson Palace level experts who received the news had no intention of disturbing the atmosphere.
Because to both the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect, the Cold Pool Valley Market was not only a symbol of "alliance" but held unprecedented deep significance.
That significance was unification.
The opportunity to unite all cultivators of the Three Kingdoms lay in this Cold Pool Valley Market.
If this market were to continue for long, would not those who control the market hold all cultivators in their grasp and bring them under their door?
The most difficult thing in the world is "from zero to one."
The Cold Pool Valley Market is this "one."
Therefore, neither Gu Huangzi nor the Grand Elder wished for any accidents during this market opening.
Besides, how could Granny Fox's appearance in the Evil Land have anything to do with this side of the Cold Pool Valley Market?
Thus, elite experts were dispatched to assist Puppet Sect's Evil Land secretly.
...
...
Almost everyone was kept in the dark, except for a very few who received the news.
Yin Wutai was one of them.
At this moment, he had already taken Song Yan to lodge in an inn at the market. Although there were two adjacent rooms, outside the inn, his trusted followers kept watch to prevent Song Yan from fleeing.
Song Yan tested a few times, and whenever he wanted to go out, Yin Wutai would inevitably find an excuse to join him.
But if he sent Cao Yuzhuang out, no one would care.
Song Yan couldn't help but become curious.
However, no matter how quick-witted he was, he never imagined that "Granny Fox had also played a trick, sneaking back home while others were out."
So he focused his probing on "whether the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect have fallen out."
After all, he was a spy for the Nanwu Sword Sect, and his presence here was to act as a "public lubricant between the righteous and evil paths." But if the two sects had fallen out, the Puppet Sect would inevitably worry about his escape.
Yin Wutai, being sharp, naturally guessed Song Yan's thoughts, and thus, with a smirk, cooperated with the junior brother's mind, coldly saying a few words: "Remember, you are my junior brother now. Even if you return to the Sword Sect, can you compare to the prestige in my Puppet Sect?"
With that, he even patted Song Yan's shoulder with a "from the heart" stance, his slightly nervous blood-reddened pupils slightly lowered, saying in a low voice: "I must admit, there are indeed some righteous fools in the Nanwu Sword Sect, but most are hypocrites... You should make plans for yourself, don't foolishly take the wrong side."
Upon seeing Senior Brother Yin so concerned for him, Song Yan immediately understood that they hadn't "fallen out."
Then... what was it?
For a moment, he couldn't guess.
At this time, he was in the room of the inn, but the Deformed Soul's tail of the Shadow Puppet was still active outside.
In the evening, the puppet finally found a "swap meeting."
This "swap meeting" was temporarily organized, and its members seemed to be cultivators interested in the "Crimson Palace Realm," including loose cultivators, as well as disciples from the Nanwu Sword Sect and the Puppet Sect.
In total, there were 7 people in the swap meeting.
Two were disciples from the Sword Sect.
Two were disciples from the Puppet Sect.
One was from the Blood Corpse Peak, followed by a bulkily wrapped figure, with a glimpse of rigid purple visible through the cloth strips. This was a Purple Corpse with power comparable to about the Eighth Layer of Refining Profound.
Another was clad in heavy armor, which exuded a peculiar aura that Song Yan immediately recognized as a talented disciple personally taught by an Elder from Paperman Peak, already in the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound.
The other two, like him, were wearing "anonymous suits."
The Cold Pool Valley Market opening was under the banner of "do not ask where you come from, do not ask for identity, as long as you are of the human race, then welcome," so... as long as you pass the entry-level test, no matter how you hide your identity in the market, no one will care.
The Sword Sect disciples glanced at the Puppet Sect disciples, the two sides snorted coldly and standoffish as they separated.
Then, the seven each brought up their own issues, and if anyone could accept them, they would exchange and trade in pairs privately.
The concerns of the Sword Sect and Puppet Sect disciples were basically about "which advanced demon beast blood would be suitable as Foundation Establishment Blood for the entry-level to the Crimson Palace Realm, and what are its effects," "where there are some high-level demon beasts' nests," and "are there any other Crimson Palace Realm demon beasts or demons besides Granny Fox."
The other two with hidden identities were asking about "how to break through to the Crimson Palace Realm" and "are there Crimson Palace Realm Techniques or Magic available for exchange," etc.
Clearly, these two, like Song Yan, were at a "dead-end with no further path."
Thus, Song Yan also posed the same question with these two.
After posing the question, it led to private two-person discussions and transactions.
To Song Yan's surprise, those two loose cultivators seemed to have unique encounters, bringing many treasures.Googlᴇ search
And a Blood Corpse Peak disciple, after trading with a loose cultivator, looked towards Song Yan, exchanged a glance, and moved to the side.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple straightforwardly said: "I have a fragment of a Crimson Palace Realm Cultivation, guaranteed to at least get started, but it's not from my Puppet Sect. What do you have to exchange?"
Song Yan replied: "Profound Jade."
"Nothing else?" The Blood Corpse Peak disciple frowned slightly.
Song Yan said: "You wouldn't find anything else useful."
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple thought about it; after all, it's just a copy, giving it to one more person and one less person makes no difference, and it could only be sold among these unascribed loose cultivators. So he said: "One-time price, two hundred small Profound Jade, or two pieces of Profound Crystal."

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 85: 77. Exchange Meeting, Blood Fusion Technique (4.1K characters - Please subscribe) _2
chapters.content:
Song Yan hesitated a bit.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "It's a bit expensive, but I'm from the Puppet Sect, and this market is organized by our sect. Since I dare to show my face here to sell it, it won't be fake."
Song Yan said, "Then you must tell me where you got it."
His information was quite limited.
He had no idea how fellow cultivators of the same realm encountered opportunities and collected treasures outside.
Like this Blood Corpse Peak disciple... where did he get a cultivation fragment?
The Puppet Sect doesn't even have this for exchange.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple thought for a moment and said, "Alright."
Then, Song Yan took out two slightly broken Profound Crystals.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple was taken aback and said, "Why are they damaged?"
Song Yan said, "Unlike your large sect, but the weight is correct."
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple weighed them twice and took out a fairly new paper copy from his robe and handed it over.
Three characters were written on the copy: "Blood Fusion Technique."
Song Yan quickly flipped through and examined it.
This item would be time-consuming and laborious to deduce on his own, so having a ready-made version would be much better.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "Don't worry, I've shown it to our Peak Master, and there's no problem with this cultivation technique."
After speaking, he chuckled and said, "The Cold Pool Valley Market will be our trademark in the future, I dare not ruin it."
Song Yan briefly flipped through and asked, "Why doesn't it have the Contemplation Method?"
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "If it had a Visualization Map, it wouldn't be at this price."
Song Yan helplessly put it away, but fortunately, the cultivation technique did contain a lot of important information, which he planned to study carefully later.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple continued, "I got this 'Blood Fusion Technique' in a secret realm called 'Giant Elephant Plain.' That 'Giant Elephant Plain' is not a secret; it's about six to seven hundred miles west of here.
The place is guarded by a restriction, which opens in summer and closes in the fall, so you must go in and out quickly.
When the time comes, you will meet fellow cultivators and form a team."
Giant Elephant Plain?
Secret Realm?
Restriction?
Song Yan suddenly thought of the Demon Swamp Secret Realm at the "Snake Corpse Market," so he asked again, "Does this secret realm change location?"
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "You don't know this?"
Song Yan said, "Please enlighten me."
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "The secret realm certainly doesn't change location."
After speaking, he waved his hand, indicating that the transaction was complete.
Song Yan frowned; he remembered... that the Demon Swamp Secret Realm at the "Snake Corpse Market" moves with the market, so what's going on here?
...
...
Guan Wu and Song Yan, after finishing their stroll, came to the restaurant, intending to find Master Song to return together, but were stopped.
Yin Wutai appeared, somewhat forcefully, and said, "If you want to return to the sect, you go first; Brother Song must come with me."
Guan Wu wanted to ask more questions, but Yin Wutai waved his hand and directly returned.
On the loft above, Song Yan quietly watched this scene, his heart filled with more doubts.
Clearly, Yin Wutai had imprisoned him here.
But what was he waiting for?
...
...
The pages of the 'Blood Fusion Technique' were flipped.
The handwriting on them was neat and graceful, with a lingering scent of ink, clearly freshly copied by some servant.
Thinking of the Blood Corpse Peak disciple's words, Song Yan suddenly realized: This might be deliberately released by the Puppet Sect to enhance the status of 'Cold Pool Valley Market.' After all, after this, outside cultivators would know that this market even sells 'Crimson Palace Realm Techniques.'
The influence, naturally, would be vastly different.
As for the contents of the cultivation technique, it was verbose, yet perfectly suited for someone like Song Yan, who was clueless about the 'Crimson Palace Realm.'
After carefully studying it,
Song Yan roughly understood.
The essence of the Crimson Palace Realm should be "using powerful external bloodlines to enhance one's life level."
For humans, the "Foundation Establishment Blood" is crucially important.
Foundation Establishment Blood is the first blood ingested into the body.
This blood occupies the core palace position in the Crimson Palace Initial Realm, once confirmed, it cannot be changed unless the realm is abolished and rebuilt.
For safe ingestion, each blood needs a Pill Master to assist with Spirit Medicine Profound Flowers to refine it, removing toxins, increasing efficacy, and making it suitable for consumption by cultivators of the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound as 'Crimson Palace Pills.'
The higher the level of external blood, the more complex the refinements of Crimson Palace Pills, and some... never seen by Pill Masters, they can only fumble along.
Thus, for cultivators of the Three Kingdoms, using some 'common Demon Beast Blood' as a foundation is the safer approach.
But for demons, it's not that complicated.
Because demons don't need Foundation Establishment Blood.
They already have it.
Their innate bloodline is their Foundation Establishment Blood.
Therefore, while humans hold no distinction of nobility, demons are inherently ranked.
The strength of their life level naturally makes their flesh powerful, such that while in the Refining Profound Level, they need Profound Qi to maintain their invulnerability, in the Crimson Palace Realm, they can unleash immense power without Profound Qi.
This realm is a realm that elevates "body strength."
Profound Qi serves as mere support.
But different "external blood" brings effects that are highly variable.
The 'Blood Fusion Technique' also gives several common examples.
For instance, if you use the blood of a 'Silver Armored Elephant,' a high-level demon beast comparable to the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, your skin can become incredibly hard, and if you practice Crimson Palace level Body Refining Techniques, your entire body can be said to be a defensive Profound Treasure.
The items at the Refining Profound Level are called Profound Artifacts.
At the Crimson Palace Level, they are called Profound Treasures.
Moreover, using 'Wind Profound Crane' blood as Foundation Blood occupying the core palace position, one can become remarkably agile, and paired with Concealing Form and Trace, Agility Class techniques, one can become elusive, ghost-like.
Considering wearing the 'Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet' on his wrist, Song Yan further searched in the 'Blood Fusion Technique' for information related to 'Divine Soul.'
Although the booklet doesn't have a Visualization Map, it does have explanations.
The cultivation technique mentions "the mutual support and counteraction of flesh and soul."
Mutual support naturally means strong flesh can feed back to the Divine Soul, transitioning it from the "ethereal and shapeless gaseous state" to a "liquid state" in Crimson Palace Realm.
But this transition doesn't happen automatically, requiring a Visualization Map and external augmentations for the soul.
Counteraction means that a powerful Divine Soul can directly harm the weak flesh, and strong flesh can directly burn the feeble Divine Soul.
Here, it uses 'Evil Qi' as an example.
Even though a cultivator at the Refining Profound Level entering an 'Evil Qi Concentrated Area' needs to consistently resist with Profound Qi, the Crimson Palace Realm doesn't need it.
Seeing this, Song Yan squinted his eyes slightly.
If the book's description is accurate, the 'Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet' is precisely the kind of external item that nourishes the Divine Soul, but given that this item was bestowed upon him by Gu Huangzi the old demon, there's obviously a big problem...
The reason the problem hasn't erupted yet is merely because he has not triggered the "mechanism."
According to the book's description, strong flesh can burn weak Divine Soul, so... strong flesh most likely is that "mechanism."
When flesh reaches a certain "threshold," the trap on the 'Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet' will activate, Gu Huangzi the old demon will immediately notice.
If he doesn't perish in the trap, Gu Huangzi the old demon will come to "finish him off" if he's nearby, trapping him in a place of no return.
However, Gu Huangzi didn't give him this to finish him off.
Because on the surface, he's merely at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound.
Song Yan squinted his eyes thoughtfully, a terrifying speculation flashed in his mind: if the "cage" inside is pyramid-shaped, what he saw in the "cage" is at the bottom level providing soul nourishment, while he at the middle level...
Eventually, at some point, this middle level will disperse the mist, making him realize he's trapped in a cage, like the struggling Divine Souls at the bottom, continuously providing soul nourishment for the one at the top level.
That one...
Is probably Gu Huangzi.
And that point in time...
Is probably after this return to the sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 86: 78. Tearing Face, Changwang Tiger Race (3.1K words - Beginning of the Month Request for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
During these two days, Song Yan enjoyed good food and drink, while also comprehending the "Blood Fusion Technique," successfully transferring it to the 'Cultivation Technique' section of the panel.
On the other hand, he had been trying to discover something through Yin Wutai, but to no avail.
...
That noon, Song Yan was sitting in the side room when hurried and urgent footsteps suddenly echoed from the veranda outside.
Then...
With a "bang," the door was brutally shoved open from the outside.
Yin Wutai appeared agitated, with bloodshot eyes cautiously fixed on Song Yan, and barked sharply: "Follow me!"
Lady Yuzhuang was preparing fragrance nearby; upon seeing this, she was directly terrified.
Song Yan noticed brother Yin's urgency, and calmly asked, "Why is brother in such a hurry?"
Yin Wutai said, "Follow me immediately!"
Song Yan leisurely bowed, saying, "Brother, give me half an hour to pack up."
"What things do you have?"
"Even if I don't need to pack, my little Yuzhuang has bought quite a few things."
"Don't bring her, follow me alone!"
Seeing that Song Yan remained unmoved, Yin Wutai rushed forward, flicking his long sleeve, sending out a paper-made beauty.
A threatening voice simultaneously emitted from Yin Wutai and the paper figure, "Go."
Song Yan was momentarily stunned but did not resist; instead, he glanced at Lady Yuzhuang and said, "Remember what I said before."
Having said this, he promptly followed Yin Wutai outside.
Only then did Lady Yuzhuang realize and hurriedly put down the fragrance in her hand, rushing to the window, but no one was visible anymore.
"Master..."
She murmured softly.
Suddenly, she tightly clutched the jade pendant against her chest.
During these two days, the Master had instructed her that if separated from him due to any incident, she should use the jade pendant to find the Seventh Miss of the Su Family.
...
...
On the other side, Song Yan had already followed Yin Wutai out of the Cold Pool Valley Market.
After a few turns, they were in the desolate mountain paths.
"Why doesn't Brother use the Shadow Puppet Void Ship?" Song Yan suddenly asked.
Just as he finished speaking, the paper figure seemed to instantly appear behind Song Yan, with sharp nails like knife tips pressing against Song Yan's throat.
Yin Wutai responded neurotically, "Stop rambling! Asking this and that, do you want to die?"
Song Yan frowned and said, "Does the Master know about this?"
Yin Wutai said, "This is the Master's order."
Song Yan asked, "Then why didn't the Master tell me personally?"
Yin Wutai, somewhat agitated, yet sternly replied, "Now you only need to know that the Master has entrusted you to me. From now on, you must listen to me in everything, even on what to eat and drink!"
With these words, he moved his mind, controlling the paper figure to forcefully push against Song Yan's back.
But...it didn't push.
Yin Wutai was momentarily stunned.
The next moment, a sudden sense of unspeakable danger arose in his heart as he saw a strip of white light burst from within the sleeve of his Junior Brother, who was only at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound.
The white light was as thick as an adult's thigh, resembling a great serpent twisting and shooting in the air, extremely swift!
Yin Wutai was slightly incredulous.
This lad dares to fight back?
And what kind of sword technique is this?
He did not dare to be negligent, quickly moving his mind; suddenly, black-scaled profound armor enveloped his body, while another hand flicked, and a paper figure swelled with the wind into a tufted doll grasping daggers with both hands.
The paper figure doll and the paper beauty simultaneously charged toward Song Yan like two avatars of Yin Wutai wielding profound artifacts, both launching an attack.
Song Yan's expression did not change as he pinched the sword technique.
The white light instantly arrived before Yin Wutai.
Yin Wutai operated profound qi, expanding an invisible eggshell-like shield outside the armor, which was only needed to barely resist the white light for the two paper figures to capture Song Yan.
In an instant, his eyes caught sight of the flying sword hidden within the white light.
The flying sword approached.
The next moment, it touched the shield's surface.
The profound qi on the shield's surface melted away like snow meeting hot soup, seemingly devoured by the white light.
Yin Wutai's pupils constricted in disbelief, revealing an "impossible" expression.
Bang!
The shield shattered.
The flying sword continued forward, piercing into Yin Wutai's profound armor.
The latter stumbled, was struck, thrown out, landed, blood dripping from the mouth.
And due to this interruption, the paper figure lost control, pausing slightly.
Song Yan beckoned from afar, but a black silhouette wearing a "Hidden Suit" suddenly flashed from behind the desolate mountain woods, sending out a streak of black light.
The black light instantly traveled dozens of meters, striking Yin Wutai.
Bang!!
Boom!
The point where the black light hit triggered a violent "explosion," and the profound armor couldn't withstand the force and directly cracked.
The black light continued falling steadily, piercing into Yin Wutai's chest, pinning him to the ground.
And his chest was already an indistinct mess of flesh and blood.
Yin Wutai helplessly looked up, horrified, with shock reflecting in his bloodshot eyes, seeing the figure of the usually honest and straightforward Junior Brother quickly walking toward him.
The Junior Brother held sword techniques in each hand, with black and white sword lights swirling around him forming two halos; they appeared to be swords, but also exuded an indescribable strange evil aura, a domineering malevolent qi.
Black light flashed, the paper beauty died!
White light turned, the doll paper figure perished!
Song Yan did not waste words and instantly descended, pointing decisively at Senior Brother Yin's brow the moment his lips only barely moved, seemingly to beg for mercy or inquire.
Evil qi surged, ghostly malevolence soul searching, devouring souls, reviving.
Scenes of fragmented events from recent times accompanied by sounds appeared before Song Yan.
He quickly searched through the key points.
...
Two days ago...
The Communication Stone lit up.
From within came the sinister voice of Gu Huangzi.
"There's turmoil in the sect, a fox demon is attacking, make sure you keep an eye on your junior brother, don't let him run!"
...
Yesterday...
The Communication Stone lit up, a cold voice came from within.
"Upon returning to the peak this time, your junior brother will be placed under house arrest, he must have noticed by now. Remember, Gu Rufeng was killed by him, be careful, don't waste words with him, don't let him trick you, and definitely don't let him escape!"
...
Two incense stick times ago...
The Communication Stone lit up again, a frustrated and ferocious voice came from within.
"The Fox Mistress has gone all out, for some reason, after killing Stone Seat Elder, it left, it most likely headed towards Cold Pool Valley. We probably crossed paths with it without encountering it.
Once you receive the message, immediately hide with your junior brother, then bring him back to the peak. If he doesn't behave, break his legs, just live to bring him back."
...
...
Whoosh~
Song Yan raised his finger, quickly finished off Yin Wutai, handled the situation, then took the Storage Bag without looking, and tossed it into his embrace.
The Deformed Soul One-tailed Fox Demon Puppet walked to his side, delivering the spoils from this "market shopping spree" into his hands.
He suddenly decided to act because the situation was too bizarre, too passive.
He could patiently wait and observe, but it was impossible for him to bury his head like an ostrich in the sand, covering his ears and pretending nothing happened when the situation was clearly out of control and heading into the unknown.
Song Yan's thoughts raced, quickly arranging numerous crucial pieces of information.
'First of all, the Fox Mistress suddenly killed Stone Seat Elder and headed towards Cold Pool Valley, does this mean it's been secretly searching?
The essence blood I took is actually very important to it?'
For quite some time, Song Yan hadn't seen any reaction from the Fox Mistress and assumed the essence blood he took from that "small treasure trove" was nothing special.
Now, a sudden realization caused his heart to tremble, spreading a chilling fear.
'Where has the Fox Mistress gone? Yin Wutai hurriedly brought me away, Gu Huangzi notified urgently, does this mean the Fox Mistress is already nearby?'
'If I leave alone and encounter the Fox Mistress, it's over.
Should I return to Cold Pool Valley?
After all... there are many people in Cold Pool Valley.'
Song Yan took a deep breath and looked towards the distant mountain path.
The mountain path was thick with shadows from the trees under the early spring sunlight, and a strong wind gusted intermittently, sweeping strongly and weakly as if the whole mountain had gone mad, tossing its hair frantically and screaming wildly.
He calmed his mind and then thought:
'From another perspective, now that Gu Huangzi the old demon has returned to the sect, it means that even though he perceives my anomaly through the 'Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet,' he cannot reach me.
Since I have unknown demon beast blood, the Crimson Palace level technique 'Blood Fusion Technique,' although missing the Crimson Palace Pill, I can rely on lifespan to infinitely simulate attempts.
In other words, although now dangerous, it's also a great opportunity for my breakthrough.
Cold Pool Valley is one of the few places with Profound Qi in the Three Kingdoms outside of the sect. Breaking through here will not be like in the mortal world where the lack of Profound Qi forced a breakthrough, wasting considerable lifespan.'
Song Yan's thoughts fluctuated, he quickly collected the "Deformed Fox Demon Shadow Puppet" into the Storage Ring, then put on the "Anonymous Suit," and returned to Cold Pool Valley.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
He did not seek out Yuzhuang nor Su Yao again, but instead chose a tavern run by Jianghu people for quick lodging.
Releasing his Divine Sense, sensing that he was surrounded by Jianghu people, he felt a bit safe, immediately closed the door, and swiftly took out the "Traceless Array."
Array flags in the corners, instead of the bed or any prominent place, set up an area just big enough for him to fit.
Even if someone else checks into this room again, as long as they don't walk to the sides, they won't discover him.
Subsequently, Song Yan placed a piece of the Great Profound Jade in the array as the "Energy Source," then glanced at the panel:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 28/7522]
[Realm: Ninth Layer of Refining Profound]
He immediately focused on the [Cultivation Technique].
A line of information emerged:
[Choose lifespan to invest]
...
'With unknown blood, fragments of "Blood Fusion Technique" as a foundation, aiming at breakthrough realm, commencing cultivation...'
...
...
[You drink unknown blood, a lethal poison erupts, you died...]
[You died...]
[You died again...]
Almost as soon as Song Yan began cultivation, lines of information emerged one after another.
In a blink, he had died dozens of times.
However, because the death time was extremely fast, each time only consumed a minimal lifespan.
Finally, after he died over a hundred times, a slightly different piece of information popped up.
[You successfully absorbed a trace of "Changwang Tiger Race" blood, but only a trace, you died...]
'Changwang Tiger Race?'
When this unfamiliar name entered Song Yan's mind, he paused slightly.
Upon recalling, it was indeed the first time he heard this name.
'Don't know if it's good or bad.'
Song Yan felt a bit uneasy inside.
Crimson Palace "Foundation Establishment Blood" is extremely important, if he could choose a good one, who would want to choose a bad one?
However, he clenched his teeth shortly.
With an arrow on the bow, one must shoot, his Foundation Establishment Blood could only be this unknown "Changwang Tiger Race" blood.
He heard stories about Changwang ghosts.
It's a different type of "puppet"...
Thinking of this, Song Yan couldn't help but laugh self-mockingly.
He really does have a fate with puppets...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 87: 79. Breaking Realm, Breaking Cage (4.6K words - Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Cold Pool Valley Market, tavern...
Song Yan sat within the array, focused on his enlightenment.
In the Life Span Calculation, messages of "death" kept "flooding the screen."
Sometimes it only consumes a few breaths of lifespan, sometimes it takes an hour.
Yet, as the number of successful attempts increased, the Demon Beast essence from the Changwang Tiger Race was being rapidly absorbed.
After consuming a whole year of lifespan and dying nearly ten thousand times, Song Yan finally absorbed the Demon Beast essence completely.
This was based on his Ninth Layer of Refining Profound level cultivation; imagine... if an ordinary Ninth Layer of Refining Profound cultivator encountered such essence, they would probably die upon contact.
The Crimson Palace Pill is an essential elixir for every regular Human Race cultivator aspiring to enter the Crimson Palace Realm.
Who else could die ten thousand times just like him?
[After absorbing the Changwang Tiger Race's Demon Beast essence, you feel your blood boiling, urgently employing the remnants of the Blood Fusion Technique, while simultaneously drawing Profound Qi from your surroundings and stirring up your Dantian Profound Qi]
[The Dantian Profound Qi meets meteor-like impacts, waves of Profound Qi soar to the sky, each thread aiming at the foreign Demon Beast essence, trying to assimilate and digest it]
[But the accumulated Profound Qi of the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound is insufficient for such a task; you have to continue drawing Profound Qi from the outside world, and only then you discover that your body, which could no longer store any Profound Qi, is now capable again]
[You perceive that the Profound Qi density of Cold Pool Valley Market is several times lower than that of Paperman Peak, but considering you might have to flee soon, you refrain from using the 59 Profound Crystals in your storage bag, instead taking out some remaining Great Profound Spirit Pills for consumption during this cultivation]
[Even with the remnants of the Blood Fusion Technique, the efficiency of drawing Profound Qi far surpasses cultivation techniques of Refining Profound level; you swiftly absorb Profound Qi and repeatedly capture foreign Demon Beast essence, then, according to the Blood Fusion Technique, channel them to the Central Palace of the Crimson Palace]Thɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
[The Central Palace of the Crimson Palace is the core of the heart; human essence blood is pumped from there and converges back here]
[In the first year, you drew 30 threads of Profound Qi and successfully digested one thread of Changwang Tiger Race essence blood]
[In the hundredth year, totaling 3000 threads of Profound Qi absorbed, Changwang Tiger Race essence blood fully integrated into your body, situated at the Central Palace of the Crimson Palace, merging with your essence blood.
During heartbeats, the strengthened essence blood quickly transforms your body structure, though this process occurred during previous cultivation, it lacked order. Now you need time to sort out the Qi Blood and adapt to your new body.
You sense a vast difference from the blood exchange at the Refining Profound level, then the blood exchange was still confined to purification of the Human Race bloodline, whereas now... your life level has elevated]
[In the hundred and first year, you feel reborn, your flesh undergoing a complete overhaul]
[You've entered the early stage of the Crimson Palace Realm]
[The early stage of the Crimson Palace requires external blood to fill the Middle Three Palaces of the Crimson Palace; only after achieving Perfection can you progress further. You've filled the core Central Palace, but still need the Left Palace and Right Palace]
Song Yan slowly opened his eyes.
He recalled some information he heard during the previous "exchange gathering"; most cultivators in the Three Kingdoms use advanced Demon Beast blood of the Refining Profound level to fill the early stage Crimson Palace Middle Three Palaces.
He could also do this; after all, Cold Pool Valley Market has places selling advanced Demon Beast blood.
By simply doing this, he could quickly fill this "early stage of the Crimson Palace" just like filling a bottle with water, regardless of what water it was, as long as it was full.
As for what happens later, sellers are not responsible.
The Central Palace needs essence blood, while the Left and Right Palaces only need ordinary blood; even if essence blood is placed there, it only exhibits the effect of "ordinary blood," known as "minister assisting the monarch."
Yet, even for the Left and Right Palaces, he does not want to be so casual.
As for the cultivation time...
If he had something more advanced than the Great Profound Spirit Pill, such as the Little Profound Liquid Pill, a cultivation method higher than remnants of the Blood Fusion Technique, was conducting cultivation at the core of the Ghostly Land or even at Paperman Peak's Cave Mansion, the speed would be tenfold or more faster.
Moreover, using "Profound Jade" recklessly, a century's time might be completed in less than a decade.
'But the conditions aren't met...' Song Yan sighed lightly.
There's no way he could run to the Evil Land or break through at Paperman Peak now.
However, leveraging "lifespan" to compensate for external deficiencies is his greatest advantage.
...
...
Song Yan no longer dwelled on these issues, quickly comprehending the changes in his surroundings, rapidly understanding the Crimson Palace Realm from his body condition.
The first aspect is the Divine Soul.
Though his Divine Soul cannot leave the body, Song Yan has cultivated many Divine Soul techniques, so he has some sensation.
It feels like a mass of Qi, hiding behind the "Flesh Castle" as a "weak little princess."
The essence of the Soul-Searching Skill is to break into the opponent's "Flesh Castle," then enter the opponent's "Flesh Castle" with one's Divine Soul, directly capturing and interrogating that "weak little princess."
However, this "princess" is so fragile that a few touches would cause her complete chaos, thus... ordinary people become dazed if subjected to soul searching.
Ninth Layer of Refining Profound cultivators fare better; as long as the Soul Searcher is careful, the Divine Soul will be damaged but not necessarily result in a daze.
The Ghost's Reincarnation involves using Evil Qi to impact the opponent's body, then snatching the opponent's Divine Soul back to one's side, adding new information before sending it back.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 88: 79. Breaking Realm, Breaking Cage (4.6K words - please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
But once you enter the Crimson Palace Realm, your Divine Soul becomes stronger and more substantial, as if transitioning from a gaseous to a liquid state—it can be disturbed but not easily dispersed. If you wish to use the Soul-Searching Skill on a cultivator in the Crimson Palace Realm, you must be prepared for their counterattack with the determination of the dying.
Cultivators in the Crimson Palace Realm can mobilize their Divine Soul to fiercely retaliate, causing you severe mental confusion at worst, or at least leaving a soul wound.
Therefore, unless something unforeseen happens, in battles in the Crimson Palace Realm, this series of spells based on the Soul-Searching Skill is mostly ineffective...
...
Next is the body.
The powerful blood and flesh bring about a fearsome, burning Qi Blood.
Song Yan mobilizes his Essence Blood, gathering it in the palm of his hand, which instantly turns crimson, like a furnace of molten iron.
His gaze shifts to a small copper brazier in the inn's guest room.
He swiftly picks it up, gripping it with his five fingers.
Instantly, a hissing sound fills the air, and waves of high temperature rise, accompanied by a piercing odor that fortunately is confined within the array.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
The patterns on the surface of the copper quickly blur, and its hard copper body melts like ice meeting a hot iron, forming several viscous, thread-like imprints.
Subsequently, a drop of the molten copper rolled from Song Yan's finger onto the back of his hand.
Song Yan clasped his hands together and kneaded.
Between his ten fingers, the copper brazier transformed into a lump of molten metal.
Casually shaping it, then reclaiming his Qi Blood, the copper brazier morphed into the shape of a flying saber like one made by a "newbie blacksmith."
Song Yan gazed at the flying saber he had crafted and immediately understood.
'A being in the Crimson Palace Realm, once it mobilizes Qi Blood, can heat part of its body like a furnace, allowing it to forge weapons with bare hands, but those in the early stage can only summon Mortal Fire, thus crafting only Mortal Soldiers.'
Casually retrieving the flying saber, Song Yan begins to test the other powers of his body.
He recalls that different "foreign blood" brings a variety of effects.
So what effect does the "Changwang Tiger Race Blood" have?
Although he has not yet mastered any techniques of the Crimson Palace Realm, he can feel the basic effects of the "Changwang Tiger Race Blood."
As he wills it, his Essence Blood moves with Profound Qi, gathering in his arms, where black patterns abruptly appear, interspersed across his skin like the stripes of a White Tiger or chains of bizarre curses.
This reminds him of the mysterious mottled black shadow he saw in the Fox Grandmother's "Treasure Vault" that day.
The black patterns on him now resemble the markings on that black shadow.
But unlike the black shadow's seemingly cursed, crawling ghost-like patterns...
His remain static.
Song Yan can't help but ponder.
The new level of life gives him the feeling of a "newborn stumbling to walk, understanding what he can do."
...
...
Bang!
Bang!
Bang Bang!
As Song Yan ponders, he realizes these patterns must be "Soul-Capturing oriented," having a terrifying restriction on unsheltered Divine Souls, especially ghostly beings.
The demons of the "Changwang Tiger Race," even in their infancy, must be a natural enemy to Divine Souls.
But his contemplation is interrupted by an indescribable sense of danger.
His heart suddenly skips a beat.
Though he isn't wearing the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," he feels an extreme cold.
The cold feels like a dead hand clenching his wrist, tightening.
'Indeed, strengthening the flesh stimulates the 'Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet,' bringing backlash.'
Although Song Yan's heartbeat quickens, he remains calm because he expected this all along.
He must face it!
In the next instant, a cold, icy Yin Qi swirls up from below, blooming before his eyes.
In the cage beneath him, men and women, young and old, each stretch out in twisted agony, reaching up in imploring torment.
The surrounding environment is covered in an overwhelmingly uncomfortable gray fog.
The surge of his blood and Qi enters this gloomy, misted ice fog like a darting flame, and for a moment, the ice fog condenses, and visibility clears...
Song Yan sees the environment around him.
The men and women under his feet, now visible due to the dispersing mist, gape in bewilderment, then filled with malice, scream hysterically before rising into the air, as if the hindering mist and iron bars have lost their effect.
The ghostly spirits stare intently at Song Yan, seeming intent on shredding him to pieces!
Around him, thick iron bars form a perfectly square cage, binding him within. Looking up, he locks eyes with a face glaring at him in greedy malevolence.
...
...
Gu Huangzi rushes back toward the Cold Pool Valley Market.
He has already informed the sect's high-ranking members still in the Cold Pool Valley to promptly activate the array and secure it.
Along the way, he sees many corpses—cultivators, ordinary people—and many more people trembling but clinging to life.
Stopping to inspect, Gu Huangzi is taken aback.
Fox Grandmother's surprise attack was unexpected, but as time goes on, her purpose becomes slowly apparent to all.
"Dig three feet if you must, find Song Yan!"
"Where is Song Yan?!"
"Song Yan!!!"
"Cunning little thief!"
Gu Huangzi, absorbing each bit of soul-searched information, is truly shocked.
Why did Fox Grandmother kill Stone Seat Elder first and then urgently seek Song Yan?
And why in such haste?
What's truly happening here?
Gu Huangzi doesn't understand, but he increasingly realizes Song Yan's importance. Fortunately, he had already ordered Yin Wutai to keep an eye on the boy and withdraw in advance. Meanwhile, Fox Grandmother would be distracted by the activation of the Cold Pool Valley Market's grand array.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 79. Breaking Realm, Breaking Cage (4.6K words - please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: 79. Breaking Realm, Breaking Cage (4.6K words - please subscribe)_3
Once he returned to Paperman Peak this time, he would completely imprison the boy.
As for the boy escaping, that was impossible.
He had placed two tracking restrictions and had even bound the boy in the "Ice Hell" in advance.
The "Ice Hell" was famously created by a Sect Leader of the Puppet Sect, who excelled at Artifact Refining. This Sect Leader used the "Ice Hell" to wreak havoc, dominate the Three Kingdoms, seize the Profound Vein, and establish the Puppet Sect at the core of the Three Kingdoms as its dominator.
Unfortunately, the "Ice Hell" was destroyed in an accident.
Later, the Peak Master of Mechanical Peak used the damaged "Ice Hell" as raw material, pondered for a long time, and either repaired it or made it into a high-quality imitation.
This imitation ended up in his master’s hands.
Ice Hell, comprising four bracelets, was crafted as four distinct types.
The lower three bracelets, named the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," each refined with Divine Souls, could imprison many Divine Souls, continuously nurturing the soul of the bracelet bearer.
Most of these Divine Souls were from disciples at the Refining Profound Level, either from Loose Cultivators, other sects, or even within their own sect...
Above the three bracelets was a master bracelet named the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet," which his master wielded back then.
The lower three bracelets imprisoned Divine Souls to nurture themselves, but everything they absorbed had to be offered to the master bracelet’s holder.
Gu Huangzi saw through this and knew that if he didn’t strike back, he would surely become nourishment for his master.
Hence, he seized an opportunity to betray and overthrow his master.
Now, as fate turned, it was his turn to bestow the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," one of which he gave to Song Yan.
As a former owner of the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," Gu Huangzi naturally knew how terrifying this bracelet was and had absolute confidence.
Back then, even after he seized a once-in-a-lifetime chance to kill his master, he barely succeeded with nine out of ten chances leading to death.
What power or competence did Song Yan have to break the situation?
Even if he fled thousands of miles away, as long as he remained in the "Ice Hell," in life, he would be Gu Huangzi’s man; in death, he would be Gu Huangzi’s ghost.
As he was contemplating, Gu Huangzi suddenly felt a burning sensation on his wrist.
He introspected his Divine Soul and glanced into the Ice Hell, only to see an anomaly in the prison where "Song Yan" was held.
The dark mist was dispersed by scorching Qi Blood, revealing a brightly lit path, clearly visible from top to bottom.
"Crimson Palace?"
Gu Huangzi’s expression abruptly solidified.
Meanwhile, on the other side of his Shadow Puppet Void Ship was the Escape Light of the Elder of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
He sternly said, "Elder, come aboard for a discussion."
The swirling rainbow light descended and settled on the Void Ship.
The Elder frowned and said, "Why are we not rushing? What now..."
Before he could finish his sentence, he noticed that Gu Huangzi’s expression had drastically changed.
In the Ice Hell, the upper and lower prisons opened up simultaneously, with a roaring sound that caused one’s Divine Soul to tremble, as if a vortex had formed underground, drawing everything towards a cage on the Third Layer.
The lower-level Yin Souls were all flying away, their expressions no longer resentful but terrified, as if centipedes had seen a rooster or rabbits had seen a tiger—a kind of innate fear...
Gu Huangzi, in shock, quickly withdrew the wisp of soul he had stationed in the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet." Standing at a distance with uncertainty, he looked into the bracelet, but Song Yan’s cage was already empty, and the hundreds of vengeful spirits that were nurturing Divine Souls beneath Song Yan’s cage were also gone.
He looked at the Elder angrily and shouted, "Who exactly is Song Yan?"
The Elder was somewhat stunned by the question.
Seeing his expression, Gu Huangzi said coldly, "He broke through the Crimson Palace and my restriction!"
The Elder: ???
The top cultivators of the two opposing sects of the Three Kingdoms exchanged glances. Recalling how Grandmother Fox was frantically searching for Song Yan, both were profoundly stirred.
The Elder said solemnly, "Shouldn’t he have been closely watched by you?"
Gu Huangzi no longer concealed the truth and said directly, "I had a close disciple watching him and withdrew early from the Cold Pool Valley Market. But since he has broken through to the Crimson Palace Realm, my close disciple must already be dead. Now, I also do not know where he is."
The Elder pondered for a moment and said, "To be honest, it was also you acknowledging him as a disciple and claiming he was an informant from our Nanwu Sword Sect that led us to investigate him. In fact, there is no record of him in our sect. I thought he was a covert agent..."
Gu Huangzi paused, his face alternating between dark and light, then coldly stated, "Find him first!"
...
...
Whew~~~
In the time it took for Song Yan to take a deep breath, he had already devoured the terrifying Yin Souls from that cage.
Looking again at his arms, the dark patterns had already become a blurred mosaic, each resembling a writhing ghost.
With a thought, he stirred his Qi and blood.
On his left arm, the last tracking restriction left by Gu Huangzi was burned away and instantly vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 80. Fight to the Death (4.1K words - seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: 80. Fight to the Death (4.1K words - seeking subscription)
Crack...
Plop.
Another corpse was flung aside, immediately torn apart and devoured by the Fox Demons.
The Fox Matriarch hid beneath the violently swaying dense tree cover, her eyes revealing extreme irritation and frenzy.
Another Soul Search...
Another worthless one...
Even though the Divine Soul in the Crimson Palace Realm had strengthened considerably, "repeatedly performing Soul Search" was still very damaging.
Think about it, "If you continually integrate others’ memories into your Divine Soul, how can you discern what is truly yours and what belongs to another?"
The Fox Matriarch had long laid out her strategy.
First, she seized the opportunity when the Cold Pool Valley Market opened to launch a surprise attack on the Evil Land.
Following the Soul Search of the Stone Seat Elder, she quietly slipped away but left the fox cubs to continue wreaking havoc, pretending she hadn’t left—a classic diversionary tactic. She knew Song Yan had ventured to the Cold Pool Valley Market, so she hoped to lure back the strong ones from Cold Pool Valley.
Then, she actually arrived near the Cold Pool Valley Market long ago but did not attack immediately, aware that nearly all the Profound Cultivators of the Three Kingdoms were assembled in the market. If she were in full strength, a confrontation would not be out of the question.
But having previously engaged with the Fox Stabbing Alliance and then clashing head-on in the Evil Land, followed by a rushed journey, she had expended much energy and her injuries remained unhealed.
Her plan was: once Gu Huangzi and his men returned to the Puppet Sect and understood her intentions, and learned of her purposely released misinformation about "finding Song Yan," they would probably have someone take Song Yan away. She only needed to wait patiently in ambush.
Today, several cultivators had left the market, all of whom she slaughtered, then performed Soul Search on their memories...
Yet, up to this point, she hadn’t found a trace of memory related to Song Yan, except for one insignificant recollection that the "Song Master of the Puppet Sect seemed to reside in a cultivator tavern in the market."
After tossing aside yet another body, the Fox Matriarch took several deep breaths, looking anxiously and angrily at the distant market.
Even if everything else in the treasure trove were lost, she wouldn’t be this impatient...
But why was it specifically the last remaining tiger cub of the Changwang Tiger Race?
She wanted to privately hoard the Changwang Tiger Essence Blood, so she took the chance to leave the Multi-tailed Fox Race under the pretext of "the Wei King seeking aid."
Over the years, she had feigned establishing a clan branch outside and spreading her lineage, but it was merely preparation for absorbing the "Changwang Tiger Essence Blood."
She cares not about the chaos in the Wei Kingdom.
She also doesn’t care how recklessly the fox cubs prance or perish.
Her goals were only twofold:
Firstly, to nurture and devour the strongest among the fox cubs, raising her own racial blood purity via Secret Technique, solidifying the "Central Palace Blood" within her;
Secondly, to mislead, deliberately creating the appearance that she intended to root herself in the Three Kingdoms, engaging local cultivators in life-and-death struggles.
Seeing the time nearing, as she was about ready, the "Changwang Tiger" carelessly got snatched by that cunning little thief!
She was anxious indeed.
Not only was she concerned for her critical resources, but she feared the Fox and Wolf Races would discover it was she who stole the last bloodline of the "Changwang Tiger Race."
If she lost her resources, at most her progression would stall.
But if the Fox and Wolf Races knew about it, she would be utterly finished.
A pair of fox eyes glimmered faintly, scanning the distant Cold Pool Valley Market.
The Fox Matriarch finally gritted her fangs, and with a wave, the following Fox Demons surged forward.
Today, even if she exhausts everything, she must find the "Changwang Tiger Essence Blood"!
...
...
In the corner of a tavern run by Jianghu folk in the Cold Pool Valley Market...
After a moment of thought, he took a Human Skin Mask and put it on, then applied several "Sealing Talismans" and "Qi Concealment Talismans" on his body. Next, he changed into a blue gown of a Jianghu knight, swapped his Flying Sword for a sabre, tidied up the room, and headed downstairs.
Downstairs was bustling, the Jianghu people gathered table by table, discussing matters of the Immortals, boasting about Immortal Techniques, or bragging about connections with someone from the Immortal family...
Most often, a pretty female knight would be among the table where boasting was most intense.
Song Yan had now already broken through and had completely severed ties with the Puppet Sect, and Gu Huangzi must have learned through the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" that he broke through to the Crimson Palace Realm.
If the Puppet Sect coordinated with the Nanwu Sword Sect, his identity as a spy would become even more suspicious...
In other words, now outside... the Fox Matriarch, Puppet Sect, and Nanwu Sword Sect all wanted to find him!
"Waiter, wine and meat."
Song Yan contemplated while sitting in the corner of the main hall, tossing out a gold nugget.
Soon, wine and dishes were served.
Feigning solitude with his drink and food, Song Yan swiftly pondered his next steps.
"Mingling with Jianghu sects and heading to regions without Profound Qi" seemed indeed a viable option, but any place he’d once been, even if as "Hua Rong" in Celestial Cloud City, was no longer a possibility.
If he escaped outside and lay low for a while, he could start a small business, perhaps a "butchery business."
Collecting beast hides arouses suspicion.
But if he butchered them himself and kept the hides, nobody would notice.
Anyway, his "Remaining Life Dao Fruit" had granted him extended lifespan, and now with the heat so intense, he plans to hide in a Profound Qi-free zone for twenty or thirty years, calmly amassing lifespan before venturing out again.
Now, he differs from the past in Celestial Cloud City.
Back then, he was powerless, tracked by Gu Huangzi, and constantly hunted by the Nanwu Sword Sect; now... he has broken through to the Crimson Palace Realm and is unburdened.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 80. Fight to the Death (4.1K words - seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: 80. Fight to the Death (4.1K words - seeking subscription)_2
First, we need to leave Cold Pool Valley.
Song Yan picked up a slice of roasted goose with his chopsticks and put it into his mouth, then poured himself a cup of wine.
He swallowed in one gulp and let out a comfortable sigh.
He casually placed the wine cup down.
But as soon as it touched the table, the wooden table suddenly trembled violently.
The wine cup, which was a copper three-legged style, was slightly jolted into the air by the tremor.
Then, continuous vibrations followed.
All the cups, bowls, plates, and chopsticks on the tables of the restaurant bounced rapidly up and down like falling yellow peas, and the fruits, vegetables, and meats in each dish were ejected from their platters, sliding off the tables and falling onto the floor, creating a chaotic mess.
People from the Jianghu rushed outside, each holding a weapon, their faces heavy with concern.
Song Yan also ran out with the crowd.
Looking outside, he saw a transparent barrier that had appeared unknowingly in mid-air—a stream of energy was striking the barrier, creating ripples.
In the cultivator area, there was utter chaos, with glimmers of profound artifacts flying by occasionally, accompanied by cries of "The fox demon has intruded!" or something similar.
Then, suddenly, someone shouted: "It’s the fox grandmother, the fox grandmother is here!!"
As soon as the words fell, fear appeared on the faces of some in the Jianghu, and seeing others were confused, they quickly explained: "This Cold Pool Valley Market was established to counter the fox grandmother. She is a great demon who eats people like beans!"
At this moment, everyone was struck with fear.
As if in response to their fear, a gigantic demon shadow began rising outside the transparent barrier.
The demon shadow blocked the light, casting many areas within the barrier into shadows.
The sharp fox face moved downward, emitting a sharp, eerie laugh of "hee hee hee."
Three pale fox tails rose like a blazing sky fire, arrogant and fierce, reaching directly into the firmament.
There were many brave people in the Jianghu, but inexplicably, at this moment, some were so frightened they wet their pants, while others stood trembling, too scared to move.
Song Yan looked up, watching as the fox grandmother raised her hand and struck down fiercely.
Bang!
The array shield shook violently.
Bang bang bang!
Several more strikes, and cracks unexpectedly started appearing on the barrier.
A few more "bang bang" sounds followed.
Suddenly, a crisp "crack" was heard.
A hole was drilled in the barrier, and the fox cubs that had been kept out by the array rushed in together, heading towards the cultivators.
The cultivators also engaged in battle with their weapons.
"Escape..."
"Escape..."
"Run for your lives!"
People in the Jianghu were driven mad with fear, each running towards the back of the market with no regard for anything else.
When they entered, they used the main gate since the road there was wide, but there were still narrow paths at the back.
Song Yan mingled with the Jianghu people, his face showing fear as he ran away.
He neither ran fast nor slow, just staying in the middle of the crowd while running out.
This pace was no different from a leisurely stroll for him, so he subtly glanced sideways, quietly observing the distant battle, as if noticing something.
Suddenly, his eyes narrowed slightly.
He noticed a wisp of white crack at the edge of the overwhelming demon shadow of the fox grandmother.
Perhaps to others, that crack seemed obscure, maybe just a ray of sunlight.
But Song Yan had noticed.
Moreover, he noticed dozens of tiny snow-white insects flying within the crack.
They were Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants!
They were used at the market entrance to detect illusion techniques.
Now it seemed the cage had been broken, hence they flew out.
This strange insect is extremely sensitive to illusion techniques. If they detect an illusion, they will instinctively fly to it and tear it apart.
In the next instant, that wisp of white crack vanished, and the little insects were gone.
Song Yan thoughtfully withdrew his gaze.
Previously, Su Canli had discussed the fox grandmother with him.
Su Canli said that the fox grandmother’s "Dragon Blood" is external blood, dreadfully powerful, because the power it can unleash even exceeds the Crimson Palace Realm level. This perplexed him greatly. His final conclusion was that there must be a secret, a weakness, hidden within the Dragon Blood. If this weakness could be discovered, the fox grandmother’s power would significantly plummet.
Of course, that Su Family elder certainly didn’t find the fox grandmother’s "Dragon Blood" weakness, otherwise, they wouldn’t have been wiped out.
Just as Song Yan was pondering, a calm voice of a cultivator suddenly came from a distance.
"Everyone, don’t be alarmed. I just saw the Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants break through the Demon Shadow! This enormous Demon Shadow should just be an Illusion Technique by Old Madam Fox. She has fought against many strong individuals and is now actually at the end of her strength. There’s no need to fear..."
As the words fell, a giant hand of the Demon Shadow in the sky suddenly grabbed and snatched up the speaking cultivator.
Old Madam Fox’s bell-like laughter descended.
It was a mocking sound.
"Clever, so clever!"
Saying this, the giant sharp snout revealed its fangs and with a "chomp," it bit the cultivator in half at the waist. Blood spurted, dyeing the Demon Shadow red, and then slowly slid down from the corner of the shadow’s mouth, indescribably real, indescribably terrifying.
The air was filled with a frightening shriek of laughter.
Plop...
Beside Song Yan, a person from Jianghu was so terrified that his knees gave out, and he directly knelt down.
Song Yan quickly raised a hand to support him, asking, "Brother, are you alright?"
The person from Jianghu was apparently still a youngster, dressed in splendid clothing, with a dignified appearance. It seemed he had some fame and status outside, but at this moment, he was stammering, his teeth chattering, unable to speak.
It wasn’t until Song Yan helped him up that he gasped, "Thank you, thank you..."
"Let me help you."
Song Yan propped up his arm.
Even when mingling among the people of Jianghu, being alone meant an unclear identity.
And if he chose a woman, she might think he had ulterior motives and wanted to take advantage of her, which would be troublesome instead.
So, he chose this "young hero of Jianghu" nearby.
The youngster was completely limp and clung to his neck like a lifeline, jumping along like a zombie while repeatedly thanking him.
Song Yan supported him and ran forward quickly.
"Shen... Shen Liao, if I don’t die today, I’ll be forever grateful..." the young hero murmured.
Song Yan said, "I am Han Hu, in Jianghu, it’s proper to look out for each other. Brother Shen, no need to be formal."
Having said that, he also "when in Rome" gasped heavily, putting on a terrified look like a drowning man.
After a while, the sound of weapons and screams suddenly came from the back of the crowd.
The young hero named Shen Liao turned his head to look and was scared out of his wits, shouting, "Brother Han, Brother Han! The Demonic Fox is attacking!"
Without him shouting, Song Yan already knew.
A few ordinary Fox Demons had been dispatched here to hunt down this group of fleeing people from Jianghu.
The Fox Demons moved faster than the wind, their claws like Divine Soldiers; the slower ones among the people of Jianghu were instantly killed...
Song Yan quickly joined in the quick "zombie jump".
Not far away at the stables, horses neighed as someone released them and began to flee.
Song Yan assessed the situation, waited until a few Fox Demons pursued others, and mounted a horse himself, then threw Shen Liao onto another horse, and the two of them galloped away.
Clip-clop, clip-clop...
The horse hooves sounded as rapid as cicadas in a summer rain.
Shen Liao had some skills too. Gritting his teeth, he turned over and hung upside down on the horse’s belly, hoping that if the Fox Demons relied on sight to chase people, not seeing anyone on the horse might delay their pursuit.
Song Yan clicked his tongue in amazement, mimicked him, flipping upside down as well to hold onto the horse’s belly.
He glanced into the distance and saw Old Madam Fox fighting fiercely with the defending cultivators of Cold Pool Valley, the surroundings bursting with a kaleidoscope of energies.
The cultivators were continuously dying and getting injured...
The horses raced out of the Cold Pool Valley and onto a winding path, and from the direction of the market in the distance came the sound of people dispersing.
Song Yan squinted, seeing many cultivators guiding Profound Artifacts and beginning to flee as well.
As he was watching, he suddenly froze. From the distance came Shen Liao’s scream, and he saw the latter suddenly had a Fox Demon hanging under him, which bit down, instantly severing the young hero’s neck.
Song Yan only glanced before sensing an evil wind coming from beside him.
A Fox Demon finally fixated on him, also pouncing over.
Song Yan’s pupils slightly contracted, but he didn’t react, allowing the Fox Demon to pounce on him.
The Fox Demon opened its mouth wide, biting toward his neck.
Crunch...
The fangs shattered.
The Fox Demon only felt excruciating pain in its jaw and was momentarily bewildered.
The next instant, it felt itself clamped down tightly, being forcibly pressed against this neck.
The Fox’s eyes rolled around, seeing the man using one hand to hold it firmly against his neck, while the other hand gestured "hush."
The Fox Demon wanted to move, but at the slightest movement, it felt a terrifying heat from the hand, as if it would turn him into "grilled fox head."
The Fox Demon dared not move, maintaining the posture of biting the man’s neck, hanging upside down under the horse’s belly, slipping away out of the valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 81. Final Encounter (3.3K words - Requesting Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: 81. Final Encounter (3.3K words - Requesting Subscription)
The Cold Pool Valley Market had already turned into a battlefield, full of pits and hollows, hilltops cut down, and hillsides blown up, with rubble and broken wood everywhere, and the air mixed with a trace of pungent blood scent.
Whether it was cultivators or fox demons, they both suffered heavy casualties...
The demon shadow of the Old Granny Fox had disappeared, replaced instead by a hunchbacked, panting three-tailed white fox.
This white fox was barely over half a person tall, standing upright at this moment on a lone cliff at dusk.
"Huff..."
"Huff..."
"Huff..."
Old Granny Fox looked fiercely and unwillingly at the distance. After this desperate battle, seventy to eighty percent of its fox cubs had perished, and it was unknown how long it would take to cultivate a new batch.
The Multi-tailed Fox Race excelled in Illusion Techniques, the most suitable enemy tactic being a slow infiltration, sowing discord, and cutting flesh with a blunt knife.
Such aggressive assaults were entirely inappropriate.
Old Granny Fox knew this, but... it never expected that cunning little thief to be so hard to find!
Initially, it thought it was Stone Seat Elder.
After an ambush, it would be caught easily.
Then, it assumed it might be Song Yan.
Song Yan, such a big cultivator, was in the Cold Pool Valley Market; how could it not find him?
But the reality far exceeded its expectations.
The ambush turned into a siege battle.
But when the great battle ended, with heavy losses and its own injuries, it nearly turned the entire Cold Pool Valley Market upside down, glancing at nearly every cultivator there, yet still did not find that little thief.
With its eyes, if it saw that little thief, it would certainly recognize them.
But it truly couldn’t find them!
At this moment, it could almost confirm that "Song Yan is the little thief who stole the Changwang Tiger Race Essence Blood," otherwise it wouldn’t be so hard to find.
The sunset was like blood, inch by inch churning.
Old Granny Fox clutched its left shoulder wound, which was injured by the Evil Land Ghost Cultivator earlier, especially severe, needing to suppress it with Profound Qi at all times, or else the curse would immediately spread.
’First return to the Wei Kingdom Imperial Capital, somewhat tidy up my collection, quickly deal with that Changwang Tiger, and then... I should flee.’
’As long as the Changwang Tiger disappears, even if the Fox and Wolf Races follow, they won’t be able to confirm that I stole the last seedling of the Changwang Tiger Race in a short time.’
’I still have an ancient map, with an Ancient Teleportation Array on it... although I don’t know where it will transport me, it’s better than staying here.’
’The Fox and Wolf Races will eventually discover the truth, but by then... I won’t be on this continent anymore.’
Having failed to retrieve the "Changwang Tiger Essence Blood," Old Granny Fox instantly had the idea to escape.
Once the thought settled, it immediately swallowed an elixir for a bit of recovery, then proceeded rapidly north.
Along the way, it stopped and started, constantly using divine sense to explore the happenings ahead.
Confirming safety, it would then continue forward.
After all... at this point, it truly was at the end of its strength. If it encountered Gu Huangzi, Elder, or others returning to kill, it would be over.
Divine Sense and perception are different.
Perception relies only on body organs, but Divine Sense relies on Profound Qi, exclusive to those at the Crimson Palace Level...
With the spread of Profound Qi, distant scenes can unfold before one’s eyes.
But typically, if your spread Divine Sense touches an existence of the same realm, they too will feel you.
So... this is actually a dilemma.
If you don’t use Divine Sense, you cannot ascertain the surrounding environment; yet using it, should you encounter a great enemy, they would instantly discover you and understand you are of Crimson Palace Realm...
At that point, you wouldn’t even be able to hide.
If it could be avoided, Old Granny Fox certainly would not want to use it, but at this time, it had to, because its appearance was too distinct, and if Gu Huangzi, Elder, and others used Divine Sense to observe, it would be noticed instantly.
