Yet, no matter how cautiously Old Granny Fox proceeded, half an hour later, while passing through a mountain forest, its expression suddenly changed...
In the distance, an elder of the Nanwu Sword Sect, flying with Sword Control and full-fledged Divine Sense, suddenly stopped and uttered an odd "Hmm?" sound, then fully covered the area with Divine Sense.
Old Granny Fox knew it was identified and no longer pretended, turning around and fleeing desperately.
In its current state, it was too bedraggled to even put up a facade.
That elder hastily pulled out a Communication Stone and reported, "I’ve found that old demonic fox!"
On the other end of the Communication Stone, the voice of the Nanwu Sword Sect Grand Elder gritted, "This time, don’t let it come and go as it pleases."
Along the way, he and Gu Huangzi had already understood the situation in the Cold Pool Valley Market.
Also, they realized Old Granny Fox might be returning north.
Therefore, the two coordinated, sending out troops themselves to Cold Pool Valley, but set up a vast network along the path north of Cold Pool Valley.
This net was widespread and expanding, with many cultivators embedded at various points, ready to respond immediately to any attack.
However, what pained the Grand Elder was... the Cold Pool Valley Market battle caused significant loss to the Nanwu Sword Sect, whereas the Puppet Sect also lost many disciples, but far fewer than them.
Obviously, though the Righteous Dao has some who lack courage, most instinctively stand up against demons because their usual "education" demands them to do so.
Even if panic-stricken, the first response is to slay demons, not abandon comrades and flee.
The Demon Sect is different.
The Grand Elder’s heart was bleeding...
The Fox Stabbing Alliance was first to fall, followed by the Cold Pool Valley Market; it truly was a disaster upon disaster.
...
...
Clop clop clop...
Song Yan rode a fast horse, swiftly escaping Cold Pool Valley.
He quickly dealt with the fox demon hanging on him, temporarily tossing the body into a spare Storage Bag, while he surveyed his surroundings.
This was a desolate mountain area, with no village in front and no shop behind.
Song Yan found a patch of grass to tie his horse but did not light a bonfire, instead resting against an old tree temporarily.
In Jianghu, it’s those who ride horses; so... riding by day, a most secure way to travel.
Yet traveling by night remained too conspicuous.
It’s still close to Cold Pool Valley here, who knows how many cultivators and demonic foxes are nearby.
Song Yan adjusted his clothes. Though the spring night was cold, it couldn’t make him feel the slightest chill.
Never mind that, even if he were thrown into an icy cave or placed in a furnace, he would be fine.
Chirp chirp...
Hiss hiss...
Insect and bird calls occasionally echoed from the surroundings, and occasionally there were distant howls from wild animals, the sounds spreading far through the moist earth-scented forest air.
The moonlight gradually rose up high, casting down, while the shadows of trees danced in the spring night’s breeze with incessant rustling.
Song Yan fed some grass to his horse, watching it chomp on the wild grass with a "crunch crunch," and his heart gradually relaxed.
’So many things happened today.’
’And after today, I’m afraid I might be wanted by the Elder of the Multi-tailed Fox Race, Puppet Sect, and Nanwu Sword Sect.’
’The Wei Kingdom is definitely out of the question; not only is there conflict between Wei and Jin, but also the fox demon and cultivators... it’s too chaotic.’
’Shu Kingdom is indeed a good place, but if someone with the intention investigates a little, they’ll know Hua Rong is problematic; if I go there, I’m afraid I’ll be ambushed.’
’Then go to Wu Kingdom, find a village on the outskirts, preferably find a place to settle down in a butcher’s shop, and live a few years before speaking further.’
Song Yan thought for a while and then slightly checked his surroundings, confirming nothing was wrong before wrapping himself in his clothes, slightly closing his eyes, and resting.
...
...
For several days, Song Yan continued traveling south.
On this day, while passing a wide river, its currents relentless, he began searching for a ferry crossing. As the sky darkened, he temporarily settled in the wilderness again.
During this time, he also saw some cultivators.
But those cultivators merely glanced at him from afar or from the sky before moving on.
What was there to care about with just another common Jianghu wanderer?
In the middle of the night, he gradually fell asleep, dazed.
As he distanced himself from the Puppet Sect and Cold Pool Valley, his heart began to relax, feeling as if shackles had snapped apart, making the sky and sea open wide.
But suddenly, he heard sounds in the distance.
The sound of a petite woman walking, heavy at times, light at others, stepping through the muddy wild ground, seemingly limping, maybe injured.
In Jianghu, such situations aren’t common, but they aren’t surprising given how common vendettas and assassinations are.
Song Yan briefly opened his eyes, looking into the distance through gaps in the trees.
There, a woman quickly appeared on the riverside path.
The woman’s body was almost entirely drenched in blood, her head hung low, her long hair falling and covering her face.
Her left foot dangled, while her right elbow propped an unsheathed sword like a crutch.
In the moonlight, blood still dripped from her temples and chin, drop by drop, into the dusty yellow earth below.
It seemed as if she had just killed someone...
Or perhaps... she herself was injured.
Song Yan quickly deduced the woman must have killed.
Because that wide and long sword wasn’t suited for such a petite woman.
That petite woman had killed someone and taken the sword.
Song Yan couldn’t help but feel some sentiment.
In such a cruel world, such a cold spring night, a woman in such a sorry state easily evoked sympathy, making one wonder what had happened to her. Was she in need of help now?
Song Yan was a normal person, and he couldn’t help but start thinking, even considering... if it wasn’t too troublesome, maybe he could lend a hand, boil some hot water with hollow rocks, hunt some wild game, and boost her strength.
He was far from cultivators and demons here.
He was... in Jianghu.
Song Yan’s thoughts passed, and he considered getting up to lend a hand, to help.
But suddenly... he stopped.
An indescribable, peculiar feeling rose within his heart.
That woman on the muddy riverside path evoked an inexplicable sense of familiarity and... danger.
Song Yan was always someone who trusted his instincts.
Even though he had reached the Crimson Palace Realm, meaningless and unpredictable conflicts were something he avoided if they didn’t actively provoke him.
He began to retreat.
And at that moment, the small woman on the path, using the sword as support, seemed to notice him.
She slightly turned her head, revealing in the moonlight the "source of the blood."
It wasn’t from her temples, but from her mouth!
That small woman’s mouth was actually chewing on a finger.
The blood was dripping from the finger!
In Song Yan’s eyes, the small woman’s beautiful face began to blur, and her eyes turned fierce.
This small woman had seen Song Yan many times through Soul Search.
Song Yan’s shape, movements, habits—every tiny detail was deeply engraved in its mind.
Blocked from heading north, chased relentlessly, gravely injured, it had given up plans to return to the Imperial Capital, detouring south, planning to escape...
On the way, when hungry, it would transform into a beauty in the wild, merely flickering in front of people to have men come forward, providing it with food.
Tonight, it had just eaten a man, thinking about when to cross the river, when it suddenly sensed an indescribable peculiar feeling.
Just tens of feet away...
Their gazes met in mid-air.
This meeting was inseparable!
Grinding teeth sounds echoed...
"Song Yan..."
"Elder..."

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 82. Please Go to Your Death (3.5K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: 82. Please Go to Your Death (3.5K words - Please Subscribe)
"Song Yan, hand over what you stole." The Grandmother Fox didn’t pounce immediately but said, "Return it to me, and we’ll call it quits. You and I have no deep-seated hatred."
She spread her hands, spat out the finger she had been chewing, and transformed into a pitiful beauty. She raised her sleeve to cover her face and said miserably, "You’ve seen my state now. I’ve become so pitiable. Even if I wanted to deal with you, I don’t have the strength."
"Besides, you’re capable of so many things. Your power surely isn’t weak. I’m just focused on escaping now and conserving my strength. How could I risk dealing with you?"
With that, the beauty’s head quickly morphed back into a fierce fox head. The fox’s head looked menacingly at Song Yan and said viciously, "But if you remain stubborn and don’t give it back to me, I’ll drag you to hell with me!!"
The ruthless gaze was locked on Song Yan.
Song Yan said, "What kind of essence blood is that thing?"
The Grandmother Fox said, "That’s not your concern...
You little thief, the less you know, the better you live.
I’m not telling you for your own good.
Because if you knew, I’d have to kill you.
See how sincere I am?"
The light words were as crisp and enticing as a lark, yet they ended with a harsh threat.
"But keeping it will only invite endless disaster! Why bother? Why go through the trouble?"
The Grandmother Fox vacillated between sweet talk and threats, then suddenly stepped forward and sternly said, "Quickly give it to me!!"
Song Yan said, "Grandmother, clarify what kind of disaster?"
The Grandmother Fox said coldly, "I’ve said enough. Don’t push me...
If you’re not assured, I’ll let you leave three miles first. You can place the thing three miles away and then escape immediately.
You little thief are extremely cunning. If you want to escape three miles away, you can hide your presence and disappear where no one knows.
If I get entangled with you, it’ll only delay my own escape.
You and I are alike now; both the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect are looking for you, and you have to escape.
We shouldn’t waste each other’s time, alright?"
Song Yan lowered his gaze slightly.
He indeed knew that both the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect were looking for him, which was why he needed to lay low for a while.
But what was the Grandmother Fox escaping from?
He didn’t think the Grandmother Fox was also avoiding these two sects.
Because normally, as a member of the Multi-tailed Fox family in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, if she suffered a setback in the Three Kingdoms’ territory, she surely would’ve gone back to rally help.
Since the Grandmother Fox not only didn’t call for help but fled in the opposite direction, it could only mean... the Grandmother Fox had, for some reason, betrayed the Multi-tailed Fox family, or at least couldn’t return.
So, he thought for a moment and asked, "Then... Grandmother, where do you plan to escape to in the south? As far as I know, south of Southern Wu is a vast swamp filled with miasma. I happen not to know where to go; Grandmother, why not give me some pointers?"
The Grandmother Fox coldly stared at him and suddenly said, "Little thief, are you really not handing it over?"
Song Yan scratched his head and grinned sheepishly, "I will, I will! Is it not that I want to gather more information? After all, I don’t have Grandmother’s vast powers, and even if I flee, I don’t know where to go."
The Grandmother Fox said patiently, "There are some hidden ancient teleportation arrays in this world, and I happen to have a map of one of those places.
After you return the item to me, I’m willing to take you with me.
After all... you and I are now wanderers of the world, helping each other is reasonable.
What’s more, I don’t know the situation at the ancient teleportation array, an extra human might not be a bad thing."
Song Yan nodded slightly.
So that’s how it is...
It was his first time encountering the concept of an "ancient teleportation array."
The Grandmother Fox said, "Boy, quickly give it to me."
Song Yan’s fingers moved slightly, bringing out various Demon Beast Abnormal Soul Shadow Puppets from his storage space...
Blood Blade Deer, Earth Walking Corpse Crab, Earth Escape Lizard, Bodiless Phantom Crow, Spiked Armored Blue Wolf, Nine-eyed Qina Python, Single-tailed Demonic Fox...
Most of these shadow puppets were obtained from the Shadow Puppet Pavilion of the Puppet Sect.
The Grandmother Fox glanced at his fingers and said coldly, "Boy, do you not trust me?"
Song Yan silently muttered "only an idiot would trust you" in his heart. Meanwhile, he rapidly activated the shadow puppets while chatting nonsense to buy time to get through the "casting animation" and gain an advantage.
"Believe you? How could I not? I’m showing my sincerity to Grandmother.
I want to show Grandmother my cards so... we can enhance our mutual trust. In our human world, there’s a saying called mutual honesty. Grandmother, do you trust my sincerity?"
"Grandmother, look, these are shadow puppets."
"Though they may seem rustic, I made them all by myself."
With that, Song Yan also took out some talismans and started frantically sticking them on himself.
As for the previous "Sealing Talisman," he had secretly removed it long ago.
"Here, these are talismans."
"Look at this talisman; isn’t it beautifully painted?"
The Grandmother Fox: ...
She was dumbfounded by the shameless actions of this little thief.
The Grandmother Fox laughed angrily and harshly said, "You sly little thief... I don’t believe you at all!! You still need to die!!!"
Bam!!
The Grandmother Fox struck the ground with a long sword.
The sword’s sheath instantly cracked, revealing the blade.
Song Yan stopped talking, his keen and vigilant eyes locked on that sword.
An indescribable fear suddenly rose in his heart...
The sword radiated with a glaring brilliance, thick with moonlight, but almost instantly, the moonlight was shrouded by darkness, from the towering shadows rising up.
The Grandmother Fox grew taller, her features blurred, and flames burst around her with a "boom."
She instantly transformed from a short figure to a giant more than ten feet tall, the sword in her hand growing from several feet to several yards.
The sword vanished, leaving only flames!
Boom!!
With terrifying power and an overwhelming demon shadow, accompanied by blazing flames, a crimson arch of moonlight was drawn across the night sky, aiming to slash directly at Song Yan’s head.
But immediately, the Grandmother Fox’s fox eyes contracted fiercely. Disbelievingly, she saw that the little thief on the ground was also starting to grow taller, transforming into an over a dozen feet tall figure.
The little thief inhaled deeply, opened his mouth wide, and the dozens of shadow puppets he had taken out and activated were all sucked into his mouth. His body began to undergo a more bizarre transformation than hers.
He grew horns, armor covered his body, snake heads grew from his shoulders, pincers grew from his ribs, and black wings spread open from his back, while a gray fox tail extended from behind...
A variety of features, indescribably grotesque.
Like a monstrous demon, so bizarre that it couldn’t appear in even the worst nightmares, suddenly manifesting on the earth.
Moreover, a circle of attribute-enhancing talismans was pasted around the waist of that demon.
The fire sword slashed down.
The demon’s face was grave, and it swiftly raised its arm to block.
Boom!!
The tremendous sound spread, shaking the surrounding trees until they snapped, and sand and stones flew.
Granny Fox continued her slashes.
Each strike seemed like a fire tornado falling from the sky.
Song Yan swung his arms fiercely, dispersing the fire tornadoes one by one.
Nearby rivers were stirred into waves, fish and shrimp respectfully shrank to the bottom, insects burrowed into the ground in silence, the wild forest flattened into plain land in an instant.
Boom!
Boom!
Another fierce confrontation.
Granny Fox and Song Yan were both slammed apart, gazing at each other from afar.
"You little thief, Crimson Palace Realm, the Stone Seat Elder was truly deceived by you."
"Can’t compare to Granny."
After a brief dialogue, Granny Fox seemed to have made a decision, bit her lip, and a thread of blood seeped from her mouth.
In the black and red world, a pair of cold fox eyes stared directly at Song Yan.
Even though Song Yan had transformed into the form of the Hundred Forms Demon Body, his heart still skipped a beat, a sudden chill spreading quickly through his limbs and bones.
And Granny Fox’s demon shadow abruptly rose again, growing from over ten yards to dozens of yards.
Song Yan, who was originally not a tall figure, appeared instantly as a small ant that could be crushed by a foot compared to that demon shadow.
At this moment, Song Yan suddenly made a strange move.
He seemed to understand something, reaching into his storage bag once more, he pulled out over a dozen Slaughter Talismans.
Song Yan’s grasp emptied the storage bag of these talismans completely!
Pa pa pa pa pa pa!
In the next moment, the Slaughter Talismans quickly adhered to his body, and Song Yan felt all fear in his heart dissolve.
"Little thief, die!!"
Granny Fox disregarded her opponent, swiftly wielding the sword; that crescent red arc formed a cascading tsunami across the sky, fiercely covering and spanning the heavens, even the crescent moon above appeared as a tiny boat rocking amidst the furious tides within the sword’s red light!
Yet, in her eyes, the strange demon the little thief transformed into had blood-red eyes full of overwhelming anger and boundless killing intent...
Granny Fox’s heart suddenly conceived a strange feeling.
This feeling expanded rapidly as she swung her sword.
Growing larger and larger...
And seemingly responding to this feeling, Granny Fox’s height quickly shrank, and the demon shadow covering the sky rapidly diminished.
When the sword dropped a yard above Song Yan’s head, Granny Fox had turned from a dozens-yard-tall demon shadow to merely a yard-tall demon shadow.
And the sword had shrunk from over ten yards back to mere feet.
The shortened sword naturally couldn’t strike Song Yan anymore.
This slash broke without attack!!
Granny Fox was stunned, hastily raised her hand, only to see that strange demon looking toward her, grinning sinisterly.
The strange demon stamped the ground, causing cracks.
Spider webs exploded into yellow mud.
Gas roots lifted off, breaking apart...
With a thunderous sound, amid the smoke and dust of the exploding deep pit, the strange demon crossed dozens of yards in an instant, the ground behind him thumping upward as though a ground dragon had awakened, clinging closely.
The demon appeared before Granny Fox.
With a grimace, he revealed a mouth of already mutated fangs and snorted: "Please, Ancestor, meet your end!"
Granny Fox paused...
Those words...
She remembered.
That boy from the Cao Family named Cao Shiyin, and later the Empress named Fu Shirong, seemed to have said similar words...
The little thief saying these words now was no different from telling those humans who died trying to kill her: "I’ve avenged them, may they rest in peace."
As this thought flashed by, two demon hands filled with thorny scales and phantasmal patterns fiercely gripped her neck.
At this moment, Granny Fox had lost her final "height," reverting back to a small size.
Boom!
The demon hands grasped her neck and violently smashed downward, even the air boiled.
Granny Fox felt the intense pain and looming death, her eyes suddenly sharp, and in a flash, she glared fiercely at the demon close at hand.
’Drag you to burial!’
’Cunning little thief, die with me!!’
Granny Fox’s brow suddenly brightened, her liquid Primordial Spirit recklessly surged out, at close range transforming into an invisible sharp arrow shooting toward Song Yan’s brow.
It’s a "both jade and stone will burn" tactic of Crimson Palace Realm masters when they are strong enough and close to their enemy.
When the liquid Primordial Spirit breaches into the opponent’s Primordial Spirit, it results in both parties suffering divine soul damage instantly, regardless of their physical state.
Of course, the attacker almost certainly dies.
The attacked at least suffers divine soul injuries, making recovery extremely difficult.
If luck is slightly worse, being rendered senseless is quite normal.
Granny Fox thought herself far stronger than Song Yan, if this attack succeeded, Song Yan would at least become a dullard.
However, when her divine soul breached Song Yan’s brow, she witnessed an unbelievable scene: one sinister ghost after another was standing guard at the entrance, while numerous dark patterns suddenly shot out from that divine soul world.
Whoosh!
Swish!
A pattern swiftly locked Granny Fox’s divine soul’s wrist.
Granny Fox’s divine soul paused for a moment, turned to flee, only to be tightly entangled by the following pattern, then... hung upside down.
Before this, no matter what happened, even if that little thief figured out the weakness of her ’Long Bo Blood,’ she hadn’t panicked.
But at this moment, she truly panicked.
Fear all but dissipated her soul as bitter thoughts flashed across her mind.
’Little thief, how... how could you have digested the Changwang Tiger Essence Blood?!!’

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 83. Slave... Fearful (4.0K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: 83. Slave... Fearful (4.0K words - Please subscribe)
"The Changwang Tiger Race," truly the overlord of the Divine Soul World...
Even though the Fox Matriarch was a presence at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace Realm, and once a dominant force galloping through the Three Kingdoms, after it plunged into the "big mouth" of the "Changwang Tiger," it too became a fish in a barrel.
Though it was hung upside down, it writhed like a cat being pulled by its tail, frantically tearing at the black spots entwining its body.
But the black spots became more and more numerous.
Soon, it was tied up tightly.
It continued to struggle madly.
But as the entire fox was wrapped up like a dumpling, only the surface of the black spots rose and fell, like a weak girl futilely resisting with her tiny fists the size of bean paste buns.
The final scene was the hateful expression of the Fox Matriarch leaking through the gaps between the black spots, but then... another black spot covered even that hatred completely.
Song Yan was also secretly amazed. After digesting the "Changwang Tiger Blood" and locating the Central Palace, he understood many things.
For example, every stripe he saw on that variegated black shadow before could be considered a "Divine Soul Shackle." Once shackled by it, one would become a ghost under the command of the "Changwang Tiger."
In simpler terms, it’s equivalent to a "growing high-tier enhanced version of fanatic fans"...
These ghosts can help you "defend your home," with other uses still to be tried. What’s predictable is that there will be significant enhancement effects in various magical arts like "shadow puppets, paper figures, illusion techniques," but correspondingly... the essence blood brings almost zero improvement in "physical strength, physical attack," and so on.
Normally, one shackle is enough to bind a ghost, turning it into a vengeful ghost.
But the Fox Matriarch took dozens of shackles to be bound.
And still, it continued to struggle powerlessly.
In the blink of an eye, numerous thoughts flashed by...
Boom!
The Fox Matriarch’s body fell to the ground, but without a soul, it had already become a corpse.
Song Yan carefully searched inside the Matriarch’s embrace, found a storage ring, and tossed it into his embrace, then picked up the Matriarch’s body...
Upon seeing it, he discovered that the Matriarch’s body was riddled with wounds, especially on the left shoulder, which had a "black bruise spreading visibly to the naked eye," not knowing who left it during battle.
He had no way of dealing with the black bruise for the moment and didn’t want to touch it, so he tore off the Matriarch’s left arm and the wound with all his might, as if removing bad meat.
The black wound quickly spread, instantly covering the Matriarch’s left arm.
With a gust of wind, the left arm turned to ashes and scattered, leaving not a trace in this world.
Song Yan’s pupils narrowed, and he secretly rejoiced.
If it weren’t for the Matriarch being covered in wounds and extremely weak, if he hadn’t broken through the Crimson Palace Realm and left some trump cards, the outcome of this battle... could have been completely overturned.
His thoughts turned, and he quickly stuffed the Matriarch’s one-armed body into the storage space, then spread his divine sense abruptly, starting to search the surroundings.
At times like this, if there were other cultivators nearby, he would not hesitate to silence them.
However, this place was where he and the Matriarch both chose to flee, quite desolate. Not to mention cultivators, there were hardly any ordinary people, except for an old man trembling in fear from the sounds of battle in a riverside cabin several miles away.
Outside the cabin, there was a black awning boat, evidently a ferry service.
Song Yan moved slightly in thought, not bothering to pretend to be mortal.
The commotion here was huge, and if he didn’t leave quickly, he might soon face encirclement from all sides.
He pinched a sword technique, boldly transforming into a rainbow to break through the sky to the west, then quickly turned around and returned to the riverside, then with a "splash," jumped into the river, quickly swimming to the opposite bank, then sped towards the "Profound Qi Wilderness" to the south, changing direction along the way and heading elsewhere.
Thus, he neither went west nor south.
Considering the previous "spy detection methods" of the Nanwu Sword Sect, Song Yan decided not to mingle with mortals to get an identity, but intended to hide in the deep mountains and forests for a while, and digest the gains from this battle.
...
...
The next day, before dawn, several cultivators arrived, coming to a halt far away on the northern bank of the big river.
As time passed, more and more cultivators gathered.
The old man from the ferry was also found.
Faced with these god-like figures, the old man was both fearful and seemed to have found a rock to cling to, so he recounted everything he saw last night exactly as it was.
The cultivators listened to the old man’s description, looking at each other.
Fearsome tall demonic shadow," "battle like a natural disaster," "rainbow light heading west," and other such terms combined, giving them a sense of "though not at the scene, it’s as if witnessing what happened" déjà vu.
One communication stone after another lit up...
Within two days, Crimson Palace level cultivators from the Northern Land also rushed to this place...
Gu Huangzi and the elder landed and exchanged a glance.
"It’s the Fox Matriarch," the elder pondered, "as for that rainbow light heading west... though it’s hard to believe, it’s very likely Song Yan. Song Yan... actually escaped from the Fox Matriarch. This one, he hides many secrets."
Gu Huangzi snorted coldly, then said, "I will send disciples from the sect to search. The elder doesn’t mind, does he?"
The elder paused at these words, then said, "Your disciple went west, why are you searching in my Wu Kingdom?"
Gu Huangzi said, "Little tricks of diversionary tactics, even a three-year-old in our Puppet Sect would know how. Just because he went west, does that mean it’s west?"

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 83. Slave... Fearful (4.0K words - Please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: 83. Slave... Fearful (4.0K words - Please subscribe)_2
The Great Elder glanced around.
Among the Crimson Palace realm cultivators gathered here, his Southern Wu Sword Sect had only one person, but the Puppet Sect had a full three...
In this great battle, his Sword Sect suffered heavy losses.
The Great Elder’s expression suddenly turned gloomy, and he spoke, "The Great Fox Mother has not yet been found, and Song Yan is also missing, his fate uncertain. Do you really want to turn against my Sword Sect at this time?"
The atmosphere immediately became tense...
Gu Huangzi chuckled eerily, then said, "That cunning boy might have fled to your Wu Kingdom. If he ends up in your hands and you privately take the secret, wouldn’t I suffer a great loss?
Turn against each other?
Even if we must, haha... you’re the ones forcing it!"
The Great Elder’s expression was uncertain, his fist clenched tightly in his sleeve. He then took a deep breath and said, "Then let’s search together, find the Great Fox Mother and Song Yan first, and then we’ll discuss the rest."
"Fine," Gu Huangzi responded, then seemed to recall something, saying, "I remember Song Yan used to have a furnace companion named Cao Yuzhuang, but after the great battle at Cold Pool Valley, many were killed or wounded, and it’s unknown if she’s still alive... If you have information about this woman, remember to tell me."
The Great Elder said, "The Great Fox Mother still has remnants in the Imperial Capital, so let’s join forces and conquer the Imperial Capital first."
Gu Huangzi said, "Great Jin is about to attack anyway, that’s mundane affairs, we shouldn’t bother."
The Great Elder said angrily, "Gu Huangzi! You want to take everything for yourself?!"
Gu Huangzi asked in surprise, "Take everything for myself?"
The Great Elder snorted coldly, "The Great Fox Mother went out to battle and never thought not to return; how much can her storage bag hold?"
Gu Huangzi, seeing his bluff called, said impatiently, "If there are benefits then, I’ll let you have some, why rush?"
"You old demon!"
"Alright, alright, together then, stop being so anxious, haha..."
Gu Huangzi was at ease, and the Great Elder was furious.
The balance between both sides was also broken after the Great Fox Mother’s battle...
...
...
Three months later...
Within the Wu Kingdom, in a desolate mountain cave devoid of Profound Qi and devoid of human presence.
Song Yan exhaled deeply and slowly opened his eyes.
In his sight, a waterfall cascaded down.
With the thaw of spring and the gradual abundance of water, it was now early summer, so the waterfall’s flow grew stronger, crashing down upon the green rocks below and splashing countless water drops, shimmering vividly in the daylight.
This place is near snake nests and poisonous insect nests, but Song Yan hadn’t dealt with it because those snakes and insects did not dare to provoke him; even this cave he occupied was originally a huge python’s lair.
But by merely releasing his aura and standing in front of the lair, the python obediently relocated.
Wild beasts are more sensitive to Qi Blood than humans, so seeing Song Yan, they knew he was the top predator of the food chain to be avoided.
Song Yan had holed up in this cave for three full months without going anywhere, and on seeing the sunshine and feeling the heat, he suddenly got interested.
He stood at the cave entrance, took off his outer garment, revealing his muscular physique.
And on his back, there were vaguely mysterious and colorful patterns.
Each black line forming the pattern seemed to writhe, like a ghost creeping slowly, and in the center of all these patterns, a more terrifying image emerged, a bizarre fox head.
The fox head looked like a mad artist had sketched it randomly, with craftsmanship that seemed created by a master painter, though the lines were wildly crazy and eerie. Even a mere glance would make ordinary people’s legs weak and their hearts tremble with unspeakable fear.
The man leaped down from the height along with the waterfall, into the deep pool below.
The water pythons were startled, scrambling to escape.
The man swam comfortably in the water, stretching out, after swimming a circle, he went to the shore naked, picked some unknown fruits, washed them briefly in the water, and sat cross-legged to eat.
With a slight thought, a transparent white fox spirit floated down beside him, and the "fox head" on his back naturally disappeared.
’Master.’
The Great Fox Mother respectfully addressed him in his Divine Sense with a voice only Song Yan could hear.
Song Yan looked at the white fox spirit, and with a smile in his Divine Sense, replied: ’Feeling unwilling?’
After speaking, he didn’t wait for a response, continued on his own: ’Although Crimson Palace cultivators are powerful, as you have demonstrated being able to dominate forces at the same realm level, there are no others. Especially in the Puppet Sect’s Evil Land, there exists someone so formidable that even Gu Huangzi is wary.
That place, you could also dominate, it’s incredibly unbelievable.
Therefore, your Dragon Vein Blood is likely to have a flaw.
If the flaw isn’t exposed, you are unbeatable.
If it’s exposed, like a balloon pricked by a needle.’
’I initially thought your Demon Shadow was an Illusion Technique, as in Cold Pool Valley Market, Phantom-Devouring Flying Ants once left a trace in your Demon Shadow, and you responded quickly by eliminating the cultivator who uncovered it, while deliberately using the Demon Shadow to consume him.
It was as if declaring that your Demon Shadow was an Illusion Technique.
Thus, it was a classic case of covering things up.’
’Later on, I started to find something amiss, because wherever you went, everyone exhibited a fear far exceeding expectations.
Including me...
Understand that at Cold Pool Valley, I had digested the Essence Blood of the Changwang Tiger Race, so I’d be sensitive to changes in my Divine Soul.
If no external factors affected me, fear would be impossible.
Thus, I began suspecting you could cast large-scale Fear Secret Technique.’
’Then later, when we met and battled, such a scenario, I was even less likely to feel fear... Yet when you transformed, I was afraid.
Subsequently, when I sensed fear, you grew from elusive stature to monstrous size.
I decided to take a gamble and applied all the Slaughter Talismans purchased onto my body.
The surge from numerous talismans instantly dispelled all my inner fear.
You, indeed... returned to normal.’
Song Yan finished eating the wild fruit in his hand, tossed it away, watching the current carry it away as he comfortably lay back, bathing in the sun.
The Great Fox Mother had already become his Changwang Tiger Spirit, and her secret was naturally no longer a secret.
The Crimson Palace realm consists of Early Stage, Middle Stage, and Late Stage.
The Early Stage encompasses the Middle Three Palaces.
The Middle Stage encompasses the Lower Three Palaces.
The Late Stage encompasses the Upper Three Palaces.
This is called the "Nine Palaces."
Within the Nine Palaces, the "Left and Right Two Palaces" also require external blood, but the power exerted by these external blood is only a portion of the strength of the blood itself. As little as thirty to forty percent, as much as sixty to seventy percent.
Only Central Palace Essence Blood can fully exert its power and possesses potential for growth.
The Great Fox Mother was of the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace with six palaces of blood.
The Central Central Palace consists of "Multi-tailed Fox Blood," and the more pure it is, the more tails can be grown, each tail like an "Instant Mana Potion," able to fill its own Profound Qi instantly.
However, the Great Fox Mother’s Lower Central Palace does not contain "Dragon Vein Blood."
Dragon Vein Blood comes from a secret location of the Multi-tailed Fox Race — "Dragon Vein Blood Seed Ancient Pool."
In the ancient pool there are "Normal Dragon Vein Blood" and "Dragon Vein Essence Blood."
The majority of the Multi-tailed Fox Race can only absorb normal Dragon Vein Blood.
The Great Fox Mother was the same.
The Great Fox Mother’s Lower Central Palace Essence Blood comes from a rare Demon Beast at the Crimson Palace level — "Six-winged Horror Bat."
The biggest feature of the Six-winged Horror Bat is the "Fear Secret Technique."
The more Profound Qi, the more terrifying the "Fear Secret Technique," and fear has a contagious property.
This makes it a perfect match for the Great Fox Mother.
The Great Fox Mother with three tails can provide a massive amount of Profound Qi instantly, naturally making "Fear Secret Technique" rise with the tide.
The characteristic of "Dragon Vein Blood" is: the more the target fears, the larger you’ll become, displaying more dreadful power.
Thus, "Multi-tailed Fox Race Blood," "Six-winged Horror Bat Blood," "Dragon Vein Blood," and the innate "Illusion Technique Proficiency" of the Multi-tailed Fox Race constitute a perfect cycle.
The Great Fox Mother utilized multiple tails to activate the Fear Secret Technique, absorbs fear with Dragon Vein Blood, and misguides and disguises through Illusion Technique, making others believe that the enormous Demon Shadow naturally results from Illusion Technique...
Even if someone suspected it might be "Fear," the "Fear Secret Technique" could forcibly implant fear into one’s heart, making fear compulsory.
Without certain power, preparation, coincidence, even if the flaw is discovered, death is inevitable.
’This time, it truly was fortunate...’
Song Yan breathed a long sigh of relief.
Beside him, the white fox spirit trembled, saying, "Slave... fearful."

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 84. Chao Li County, Old Master Li (2.5K words - seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: 84. Chao Li County, Old Master Li (2.5K words - seeking subscription)
A few months later, autumn began...
Song Yan also started to wander around the deep mountains, sometimes learning about the outside world through the conversations of villagers in small villages.
He learned quite a bit about the Crimson Palace Realm through Old Grandmother Fox.
The main thing was the source of "blood."
Killing a person, even if it’s a cultivator at the Crimson Palace Realm, cannot obtain the essence blood within them.
And what Old Grandmother Fox offered him was only the "Multi-tailed Fox Essence Blood" of her own race.
But Song Yan had no immediate plans to place the "Multi-tailed Fox Essence Blood" in the "Left and Right Two Palaces."
Firstly, through Old Grandmother Fox, he learned about the importance of "essence blood combination." A good combination can put one at a crushing advantage in magical battles of the same realm.
Secondly, once "Multi-tailed Fox Essence Blood" is placed in the Left and Right Two Palaces, the power it can exert is only sixty to seventy percent of its original, and "Three-tailed" might even turn into "Two-tailed."
Thirdly, after Old Grandmother Fox became a ghost, she told him a lot. One thing is that "Central Palace Essence Blood" can continue to be refined. The method of refining is by extracting similar blood, but the number of refinements is limited, generally in single digits, some people only three or four times, others as many as eight or nine times, varying from person to person.
Previously, she was raising fox cubs to breed strong ones through the nurturing method, and then she would have them devoured to refine the blood. As for the ability to "give birth to fox cubs," it was due to the blood in her other palace called " Pig Queen Ant," whose characteristic, to put it bluntly, is "eating human flesh and bearing offspring."
Since the "Central Palace Essence Blood" could be refined, Song Yan naturally held onto a sliver of hope: by killing Multi-tailed Foxes, extracting their blood, refining it, and transforming "Three-tailed" into "Seven-tailed."
As for why seven tails?
Because in Old Grandmother Fox’s impression, the strongest of the "Multi-tailed Fox Race" is the Seven-tailed.
Nine-tailed?
That is a legendary count.
...
...
Today, the leaves fell in chaos, and autumn rain was bleak.
As usual, Song Yan casually patrolled at the mountain’s edge.
However, the village’s communication was closed-off, with some villagers having never been farther than the nearby small county, treating cultivators as nothing but ethereal immortals, tales from afar.
Even if Song Yan were here, he couldn’t gather any useful information.
Through Old Grandmother Fox, he also learned the origin of "Changwang Tiger Race Essence Blood."
In short, the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, though called a country, is more like an alliance of demon races.
And the "Changwang Tiger Race" originally ruled over the "Multi-tailed Fox Race" and "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race."
But the Fox and Wolf Races had long plotted to revolt when the Tiger Race was injured, suddenly launching a coup to annihilate the Tiger Race and devour their essence blood.
They succeeded, and yet they failed.
The success was that they indeed wiped out the "Changwang Tiger Race."
The failure was that... they couldn’t capture the "Changwang Tiger Race" essence blood.
The Great Demon King of the Changwang Tiger Race destroyed his entire race.
Leaving only a small cub...
The cub had no essence blood, so it was raised with the Fox Race, meant to be slaughtered when older, the distribution of essence blood and common blood to be decided by the Fox Demon King.
Old Grandmother Fox wasn’t guarding the cub but unexpectedly found an opportunity to escape with the "Changwang Tiger Race" cub.
Then... because the tiger cub resented the Fox and Wolf Races, it saw the unfamiliar human Song Yan and voluntarily gave its essence blood to him.
That’s how it happened.
Old Grandmother Fox planned to escape using the ancient teleportation array.
But she didn’t know where that ancient teleportation array led, and was even unsure if "that teleportation array wouldn’t lead to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country."
Isn’t this nonsense?
Song Yan was determined that unless all hope was lost, he wouldn’t gamble his life using that teleportation array.
Just then, his gaze suddenly shifted to a certain spot.
This path, not really a mountain road, he had traveled many times before, and today... there was a corpse on the slope not far away.
A man’s body, plump, of average appearance, stripped of clothes, with a deep wound in the chest, the blood almost entirely drained...
Song Yan swiftly approached, raised a finger, and performed a quick soul search.
The body is dead, but the soul lingers for seven days.
Judging by the appearance of this fresh corpse, there must be memories.
Scenes of memory fragments flashed through.
Song Yan roughly understood.
This man was named Li Fusheng, a merchant from the Northern Land.
Currently, the Northern Land was in great chaos as the Jin Kingdom had completely swallowed Wei, under the guise of "pleasing the Immortal Sects and eradicating demons," extorting money and taking women everywhere, leaving the people in misery...
As a result, Li Fusheng took all his wealth, his wife, and loyal servants and fled south.
Upon reaching here, the loyal servant claimed to know a shortcut to a stable city.
Li Fusheng listened to this.
As a result, in the desolate mountains, the loyal servant ended his master with a single knife from behind, then took the master’s money, stripped off the master’s clothes, and ran off dragging the mistress.
Song Yan pondered slightly.
Wealth and such, he didn’t care, but from Li Fusheng’s information, he could tell that "the Fox and Wolf Races hadn’t come over yet," because the timing when the great fox grandmother stole the tiger cub was perfect. It’s estimated that the fox demon guarding the tiger cub was still covering this up, desperately searching for the tiger cub, and thus hadn’t fully exposed...
On the other hand, in Li Fusheng’s luggage, there were genuine household registration certificates and passage documents.
Considering Li Fusheng’s appearance was also exceedingly ordinary, with no particular features...
Song Yan had an idea in mind.
Staying in the deep forests and old woods like this was not a solution. While the Fox and Wolf Races hadn’t yet come looking, he would assume an identity to gain a foothold in a mortal town, and then make plans.
He quickly buried Li Fusheng, then extended his divine sense, scanning the surroundings, and found traces of movement around, which he then pursued.
...
...
A moment later...
A ghost appeared on the black spot on Song Yan’s back and then disappeared again, as if sinking into "water."
The servant’s body lay to the side, while a somewhat beautiful young woman was weeping and begging for her life.
"I only did it to survive.
If he killed the master, and if I didn’t follow him, I would die too..."
"Spare me, I’m willing to do anything, absolutely anything."
Saying this, the woman hurriedly unbuttoned her clothes with one hand, while reaching for Song Yan’s hand with the other, intending to guide his hand to her chest.
However, Song Yan had already learned the truth from the soul search of that servant.
It was merely a story of "the master taking a concubine, the concubine becoming the wife, the wife eloping with the servant, framing the master."
He paused not because of this, but because he felt the "Divine Soul of the great fox grandmother" stirring restlessly.
The divine soul at the Crimson Palace level is different from ordinary people and Refining Profound cultivators; it can seize a body.
The great fox grandmother could possess this young woman.
’Master, I want to possess it.’
’This can’t be done.’
’Does Master still worry that I might harm you?’
’No, you are at the Crimson Palace level; although you can possess a body, you can only do it once.’ Song Yan replied.
The great fox grandmother was overjoyed: ’Master, you mean you actually want to help me possess a Refining Profound cultivator with decent aptitude?’
Song Yan said: ’Let’s see the opportunity.’
The great fox grandmother immediately sank again.
Song Yan then raised his hand to kill the woman, proficiently capturing her soul, turning it into a ghost slave.
Subsequently, he changed his outfit, took the passage documents, household registration certificates, and so on...
The place Li Fusheng was originally going to was called Hanlin City.
It is a place, though barren, far from disputes.
And the place Song Yan planned to go was south of Hanlin City — Chao Li County.
Before leaving, he took the "Skinning Experience Notes" that Master Shi had previously given him, the "Hundred Forms Divine Control," the "Little Five Elements Silk Binding Hand," the "Skin Painting Soul Summoning Technique," and burned them to ashes, then buried them at a scenic spot, erecting a stone tablet with the words "Rest in Peace."
Great fox grandmother had searched Stone Seat Elder’s soul, thus becoming Song Yan’s ghost slave; naturally, Song Yan understood his teacher more deeply, knowing that while he was sincerely good to him, he also had genuine harmful intentions.
Previously he only suspected, now he had confirmation, and felt deeply moved.
At this moment, burning the books into dust, burying them underground, was akin to an eccentric tomb of clothes and crown.
"You were a good teacher..."
"You not only taught me magic but also showed me the deceitful hearts of people in the Cultivation Realm..."
"The last words you called out before dying ’avenge me’ were probably not meant for Junior Sister Wang to hear, were they?"
"But how could you not see? Junior Sister Wang would never avenge you."
"Never mind, your divine soul has long flown away, I wish you well on your journey, become a craftsman in your next life... don’t become a cultivator."
...
...
More than half a month later...
Chao Li County welcomed a Lord Li.
Lord Li came from the Northern Land, encountered bandits on the way, and both his wife and servants perished.
He set up a tomb with clothes and crown for his wife, wailed for a while, then took over a butcher shop, started raising pigs, slaughtering pigs...

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 85. Can’t enjoy it yet, right? (3.5K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: 85. Can’t enjoy it yet, right? (3.5K words - Please subscribe)
Chao Li County...
As dawn breaks, Master Li of the "Peach Orchard Butcher Shop" is dragging a black pig that’s "squealing" out.
The black pig weighs at least two to three hundred pounds, its four large hooves furiously plowing backward, with its big backside ready to sit down, shaking its head stubbornly refusing to move forward.
This combined force is no small matter!
However, Master Li, with a brutally forceful stance, drags the pig in front of the butcher shop, then slightly releases his grip. The pig gets its relief, turns around and runs. Master Li shouts "Where do you think you’re running to?" Then he swiftly embraces and lifts the pig up onto the chopping block, presses it down with one hand, and lets the knife fall with the other.
The knife tip punctures, blood gushes out, the black pig screeches and struggles nonstop, yet Master Li holds it down alone, until its hooves stop kicking, he then releases his hand, glaring at the assistant beside him, saying, "What are you gawking for?"
The assistant is dumbfounded by Master Li’s strange strength, even though this isn’t the first time he’s seen it, he’s still in awe. Upon hearing this, he hurriedly fetches water and a bucket, shouting, "Master, I’m on it I’m on it."
...
A moment later.
Master Li expertly tosses the pig head, ribs, small ribs, tenderloin, belly, fat, trotters, innards, etc., on the white cloth, while rolling the pig skin separately aside, and the two assistants quickly get busy too, doing a light wash, hanging the meat up, then shouting: "Peach Orchard Butcher Shop, freshly slaughtered pig~~"
Master Li slightly exhales, placing the pointed knife aside, and then picks up the bone chopping knife and starts playing with it.
He appears plain and unremarkable, yet with a bit of makeup, he can look fierce.
It must be said, "plain and unremarkable" also means "easy to blend into any kind of temperament."
Naturally...
This Master Li is Song Yan.
Song Yan had secretly surveyed the situation of Chao Li County well before entering.
Only by "prescribing the right medicine" did he establish such an image of himself.
Under a dynasty where Immortal Sects and the Jianghu exist, its constraints aren’t strong, let alone this Chao Li County, at the edge, remote and isolated.
A place at the edge isn’t a utopia, but rather a lawless zone.
The local government is rough, gangs rampant, any house with a pretty girl soon catches attention, and the whole county knows "who’s interested in whom."
But these people, although bullying, are truly cowardly; when boasting they look fierce, but when seeing someone more terrifying, they immediately admit their mistakes decisively.
Song Yan, as an outsider merchant, had he shown any weakness, trouble would have been relentless, either getting chewed up leaving not even bone residues, or having to fight out a bloody path.
Not to mention, even the two ruffians he recruited were sent by the local gangs, just to see whether this Master Li could be provoked.
Turns out, just a glance.
Oh wow...
A body full of strange strength, rough and fierce, knife raising and falling, pig slaughtering incredibly neat, perhaps this is some Great Thief who killed Master Li then impersonates him.
...
"A good fellow!"
Across from Peach Orchard Butcher Shop, a ruffian with a face full of fierce flesh pretends to sip tea yet quietly observes Master Li, seeing such actions, cannot help but praise aloud.
A scholar beside him leans closer, asking, "Did you see clearly?"
The ruffian gestures, lowering his voice, "You delicate little guy, what do you know?
Look at the expression when slaughtering pigs, without killing over a dozen people, those downcast eyes wouldn’t appear.
Moreover, look at the swift technique of pig slaughtering, swordsmanship is truly superb, superb indeed."
The scholar says, "Then let’s recruit him into the gang, on this patch of land in Chao Li County, he also has qualifications to partake.
This Master Li is possibly fake, regardless of how, we can help polish his identity, make it authentic."
Saying this, the scholar is about to get up to find Master Li.
But as soon as he moves, the ruffian yanks him down.
"Don’t go, if you go, people might think our gang is full of your kind—a weakling." The ruffian says.
The scholar’s face turns red, angrily saying, "What did you say?!"
"Angry? Angry so easily? Hehe..." The ruffian pats his shoulder, saying, "Just kidding, better let me go."
Song Yan looks at the bone chopping, distributing meat, serving those buying it, but long noticed the two across and heard their conversation.
And this, is precisely the purpose he’s after.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do, merely "running off to some unfamiliar place living alone" isn’t called "secluded living."
As long as one isn’t blind or foolish, who wouldn’t see you, an outsider, has issues?
If either the government or Sect seeks the odd one out, the first to find would be you, let alone any theft or murder case arises in the city, you’d be the prime suspect.
Back in Celestial Cloud City, even miles away from the Southern Wu Sword Sect, they flipped out two hidden Demon Sect disciples effortlessly, teaching him quite a lesson.
When living somewhere new, one must assimilate.
Hide within the secular world, one must become mundane.
...
...
That day, Song Yan directly joined a small gang in Chao Li County called the "Flying Knife Gang," even securing a title of Inner Sect Disciple.
The Flying Knife Gang immediately took his registration documentation, ran to the government, and in the "character depiction" section, thoroughly enhanced it, mending any possible flaws for him.
Subsequently, Song Yan’s days turned normal.
Eat and drink when needed, gift as required, show brute when necessary.
And after getting familiar with the gang members, he casually demonstrated some martial prowess, instantly... transforming from "Inner Sect Disciple" to "Hall Master."
Whenever people passed by the Peach Orchard Butcher Shop, they’d either respectfully call "Master Li" or "Hall Master Li."
And merely three months have passed...
...
...
Winter chill.
Snow falls like a dense curtain, engulfing heaven and earth.
Pedestrians on the streets seldom seen, yet Peach Orchard Butcher Shop remains bustling.
It’s because Master Li is taking a concubine.
At this moment, in the Li residence, there is a charming young lady sitting upright in the side room, covered in a red bridal veil, with rouge on her cheeks, bright eyes full of spring, tightly clasped long legs, and a full chest.
The young lady’s name is Lin Xianxing, a newly-grown daughter of an ordinary family in Chao Li County.
That shadow is a rogue warrior from the Jianghu who had previously pursued her. The warrior had no power or influence locally, but fortunately, he possessed some martial arts skills. After their accidental eye contact, he started pursuing her. She never agreed and kept him at arm’s length, yet a few days ago when the Li residence proposed, after a discussion with her parents, she accepted the proposal.
The reason is simple, the Taolin Meat Shop had power and influence locally, and although Master Li was crude, marrying into his household was still better than following a destitute rogue warrior.
It’s just... Lin Xianxing didn’t expect that rogue warrior to dare follow her to outside the bridal chamber.
And she knows this Jianghu guest’s nature very well, knowing that at heart... he is a desperate man.
As she sees the window being lifted slightly, and hears the sound of a sword being drawn outside the door, she shudders in fright, quickly rubbing her eyes, crying out, "I don’t want to marry him, I don’t want to... sob sob sob..."
Only then did the corner slowly lower.
Lin Xianxing let out a deep breath.
Not long after, a maid’s shout came from the front.
"Bride, come to bow to heaven and earth~"
After a circuit.
The drunken Song Yan entered the bridal chamber, lifting the bride’s red veil, tearing away her clothes, and directly pressed on top of her.
It was late at night...
But the creaking sound demonstrated that Song Yan had little affection for this bride.
The reason he proposed to "Lin Xianxing" was only because he knew... she was not a good girl worth cherishing.
Lin Xianxing flirted outside, attracting many men, pretending to be pure, and making other men fight for her.
But once Lin Xianxing saw him having money and power, she immediately cast all those people aside, and eagerly wanted to marry over.
He said to settle it next month, but Lin Xianxing’s parents directly said, "Three days later," they were rushing to climb into his bed, to secure the status.
Song Yan was not afraid of bad girls, he was afraid of good girls.
She had no feelings for him, nor could she have feelings, she was purely after his money, thus... if one day he suddenly leaves, he could do so without a burden.
Contrarily, those worth cherishing, good girls with fine qualities, he couldn’t just leave, disregarding everything.
His concubinage,
First, was to satisfy his physical needs, "After wandering the Demon Sect for so many years, shouldn’t he enjoy?"...
Secondly, it completed the last piece of his identity puzzle.
Lin Xianxing was ideal for this.
Their relationship was merely a match of wealth and beauty.
...
While the red candles were extinguished in the bridal chamber, merging in clouds and rain, a rogue warrior on snowy ground held a fierce face, furiously chopping and piercing in the woods, at the thought of his cherished belonging underneath another, he couldn’t help but burn with anger...
Suddenly, as if tired from chopping, this Jianghu guest huddled, pondering profoundly for a moment, then as if making a certain resolution, murmured, "Jianghu should be for seeking pleasure and settling grievances, if this place doesn’t retain me there’re places that do."
Once decided, he immediately started walking.
He planned first to kill Lin Xianxing’s parents, then take advantage of Master Li’s exhaustion to sneak in and slay him, then flee far with Xing’Er for a carefree and joyful life together.
After merely a few steps, he suddenly heard a crying sound from afar.
Upon approaching, his eyes lit up instantly.
It was an enormously beautiful young lady in green.
The warrior immediately forgot what he originally intended to do, stepped forward and asked, "Young lady, why do you cry?"
The young lady in green protested tearfully, saying her husband ran away with another woman, leaving her alone, and so on and on...
The warrior rejoiced immensely, and after a moment of pouring his heart out, intended to seize the young lady’s hand.
The young lady in green also played hard to get, then walked and stopped with the warrior, reaching a secluded place.
Looking around and seeing no one, the warrior immediately yanked down his belt, pouncing on the young lady.
But he pounced on nothing.
The young lady was still there, but her figure grew transparent.
And on either side of the young lady, suddenly many men and women, old and young, appeared, each hovering above the ground, watching him fadedly with sinister countenances, among which one even resembled a standing fox...
Just then, a vile wind blew, with a bizarre tiger’s roar seemingly in the air.
Following this, a pain struck his neck, his vision went black, and he lost all consciousness.
In the darkness, within a cloak, Song Yan lowered his head, looking at this person, deftly performing soul capturing to transform him into a minion, then tied the corpse to a stone and sunk it in water...
In a short time, the warrior also transformed into a spirit wandering by Song Yan’s side.
A stray ghost normally doesn’t reveal itself, but a "transformed minion" is a special case.
Only due to the "Changwang Tiger Race" black streaks infused into the minion’s divine soul, the "Soul Shackles," those shackles bind them yet grant them shape-shifting deceptive abilities.
Thereafter no matter what, even if these transformed minions seize another body, they could never escape Song Yan’s control, nor would they have thoughts of harming him, purely because Song Yan’s "Soul Shackles" have entirely merged into their souls.
Once a transformed minion, unless Song Yan voluntarily unbinds them, otherwise... they remain a transformed minion eternally.
Song Yan rose, waved a hand, and numerous transformed minions dissipated, reentering the hidden patterns under his skin.
At this time, these transformed minions were in a "sleeping" state, unless the master wished them to see, to hear, they could see or hear, otherwise... discussion is moot.
...
A moment later...
Bridal chamber.
"Master, where did you go?"
"Went outside for a big call."
"In such cold, let me warm you up... sob sob, you’re terrible."

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 86. Escape to the Frontier Town, Unexpected Visitor (3.5K Words - Subscribe Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: 86. Escape to the Frontier Town, Unexpected Visitor (3.5K Words - Subscribe Requested)
In Chao Li County, people come and go, some starve, some die of illness, and the disappearance of a knight with no significant background went unnoticed.
Lin Xianxing, after realizing the knight had disappeared, thought he left because he saw no hope ahead, and quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
...
More than a month passed in the blink of an eye...
The backyard of the Li residence.
The door was locked, and Song Yan grabbed a pigskin, took out a skinning knife and carving knife, and began his old trade.
Even though it was a mundane place devoid of Profound Qi, once this meat shop’s business got on track, Song Yan’s lifespan would increase, adding several years every day or every other day.
Others may worry about "the fleeting passage of time" or fret about "no Profound Qi here, hindering cultivation time," but Song Yan didn’t care at all.
Because his lifespan only increased over time.
This granted him an extraordinary patience.
Swipe, swipe, swipe...
"Phew, phew~"
Song Yan blew away the debris on the pigskin, then lifted and shook it off.
[You absorbed the remaining lifespan of a black pig: 14 years]
After doing this, Song Yan placed the black pigskin shadow puppet back on the chopping board and swiftly sliced it into strips with a knife.
These shadow puppets made from ordinary animal skins had long lost their appeal to him, so after extracting the lifespan, he used them for cooking, thereby concealing his true intent of hoarding pigskin.
He painstakingly practiced his culinary skills during this period, perfecting two signature dishes.
The first — Spicy Pigskin.
The second — Grilled Pig Neck Meat.
The first dish was to handle the shadow puppets by "destroying the evidence"; the second was to divert attention.
Even if no one watched or noticed, Song Yan made sure everything left no flaws.
He meticulously prepared the pigskin and took the pig neck meat, cut it into thick strips, and placed it on a fruitwood rack to roast...
After less than half an hour, the "pigskin shadow puppet" had turned into a plate of spicy pigskin, lustrous and transparent; the "grilled pig neck meat" was also ready, crispy outside, tender inside.
Song Yan looked at these two delicious dishes with some sentiment.
Back then, he couldn’t even roast meat to be barely edible, it was an utter disaster.
Now, he actually had his special dishes.
He chuckled lightly, shook his head, opened the door, and carried the plates out.
After taking a few steps, a maid ran over and respectfully said, "Master, Protector Du is waiting for you in the front yard."
Song Yan said, "Got it, bring a jug of wine."
The maid said, "Madam... asked you to drink less."
Song Yan was speechless.
Lin Xianxing asked him to drink less not out of concern for his health, but because he had stored fine wine in the cellar, and drinking those was like consuming silver, which Lin Xianxing naturally felt reluctant about.
Lin Xianxing was cunning and quickly realized during this time that the Peach Garden Meat Shop, although profitable, didn’t earn that much, most of it was money brought by Master Li from the Northern Land.
Master Li’s money was her money, so how could she not feel distressed?
"Bring it!"
"Yes, Master." The maid hastily went down.
Song Yan then carried the two plates of food to the front yard.
In that courtyard, a fierce man was sitting beside a stone table; this was the same fierce man who had "interviewed" and "invited Song Yan to join the gang" that day.
The Flying Knife Gang was just a small local gang.
But although the gang was small, it had everything, including Protectors and Hall Masters.
"Fragrant, so fragrant!" Protector Du said while fanning himself and exclaiming strangely.
Song Yan placed the dishes on the table.
Protector Du picked up a pair of chopsticks and was about to start eating.
Song Yan, however, also grabbed a pair of chopsticks and blocked him.
The two pairs of chopsticks crossed in the air, entangling like a contest of skill, until with a "snap," they separated.
Protector Du laughed mischievously, "Good, good, good!"
Clearly, the two had performed this "pre-meal ritual" before.
Though fierce, Protector Du was still a man who enjoyed martial arts.
At this time, the maid came up with a wine jug.
Song Yan opened it, poured a bowl for each of them.
As the wine poured into the porcelain bowls, it shimmered with an amber hue, mingling with the descending light from the sky, turning into splintered gold, very tempting.
"Good wine!"
Protector Du couldn’t wait to start eating; he took a piece of spicy pigskin, put it in his mouth, and while chewing, said, "Great dish!"
Song Yan also began to eat.
Before long, they had consumed more than half the jug of wine and almost finished the dishes.
Only then did Protector Du say, "Brother Li, actually, I’m here today to bid farewell."
"Farewell?"
Song Yan laughed, "Where to?"
With a fierce look in his triangular eyes, Protector Du scanned around the surrounding archways and windows; seeing no one, he leaned in closely and said in a low voice: "Just to let you know, chaos is rampant outside, many righteous sects from the Jianghu are fleeing from north to south, and the Demon Dao is pursuing them, people are dying almost every day.
To exaggerate a bit, Jianghu skills, Divine Weapon Secret Manuals, those things can be picked up with just a hand.
Our Flying Knife Gang is planning to join forces with the surrounding gangs, especially with the eldest brother from Hanlin City’s Iron Bear Gang, to go and try our luck.
I’m representing our Flying Knife Gang to go over there."
Song Yan sighed, "When I fled last year, the Northern Land was already in chaos, I didn’t expect the Jianghu to be so turbulent."
Protector Du said, "It’s not just the Wei Kingdom, even the Shu Kingdom is in chaos."
"The Shu Kingdom is in chaos too?"
Song Yan was stunned, "What does this have to do with the Shu Kingdom?"
Protector Du said, "Have you heard of the Heavenly Cloud Queen?"
"Heavenly Cloud Queen?"
Song Yan thought and shook his head.
Protector Du gave a thumbs up and said, "That woman is someone, can be considered the big sister of the Shu Kingdom’s Jianghu."
Then, he lowered his voice and said, "Last year, she actually accepted an invitation from an Immortal from the Wu Kingdom, to visit the Wu Kingdom. But somehow she suddenly disappeared, and it’s said even the Immortal is looking for her.
In the Shu Kingdom, without the Heavenly Cloud Queen keeping things in check, Jianghu became chaotic immediately, and hearing that Immortals went there made it even more tumultuous."
Song Yan understood.
The Heavenly Cloud Queen was Hua Linglong.
"Being invited by an Immortal from the Wu Kingdom" was probably because "Hua Rong died in battle and helped the Nanwu Sword Sect before dying," so the Nanwu Sword Sect wanted to compensate, hence inviting her to Wu.
"Disappearance" probably means that the Nanwu Sword Sect and the Puppet Sect suspect "Hua Rong" might also be one of Song Yan’s tricks. Unable to find him, they started looking for Hua Linglong. However, Hua Linglong is quite slippery and disappeared quickly.
"The Immortal running to Western Shu" likely refers to someone from the Puppet Sect going there for a Soul Search.
The Demon Sect entered the scene, initiating a Dimensional Reduction Strike, naturally causing chaos in the Western Shu Jianghu.
Who would have thought that stealing a single drop of Changwang Tiger Blood would cause such a massive upheaval...
...
...
Very soon, another four months passed.
Song Yan’s lifespan increased by 1254 years, making it overall "[Lifespan: 29/8776]".
This absurd yet safe enhancement was quite thrilling.
Song Yan also found it rather delightful.
On a spring night, cats cried outside.
Bamboo leaves rustled in the midnight breeze, producing a "susu" sound.
But in the master bedroom of the Li Mansion, separated by only an oil-paper window, two beauties snuggled in Song Yan’s arms, vying for favor and acting coy...
Why two women?
Because last month, Master Li took another concubine.
This concubine was young and beautiful, with a voluptuous figure, and literate. Upon seeing Master Li’s wealth and status, she pretended to be a "talented woman of elegance" hoping to ensnare Master Li and discuss serious emotions while pocketing "unimportant money" for herself.
However, Master Li, uninterested in romance, directly made her his concubine, throwing her onto the bed...
Seeing her intentions exposed, the concubine stopped pretending.
Then, Lin Xianxing faced her "life-long rival."
The two women quarreled and bickered day and night, and no one dared question where Master Li spent his money anymore.
Now, the two women lay on the same bed, jointly serving Song Yan, striving earnestly in their competition.
Both showed their divine powers, their means so enticing that Song Yan was a bit stunned.
Even though it was midnight, peace had yet to be restored.
Not until the fourth watch sounded, accompanied by the night watchman’s cry of "Dry weather, beware of fire" passing by outside, did the women finally collapse with fatigue. Their long legs entwined with Song Yan’s in a crisscross fashion, then they fell asleep amidst the languid aura and the scent of red candles and incense.
Song Yan gazed at the hanging bed canopy above, murmuring to himself: ’These days truly pass in obscurity...
However, now I am entirely Master Li of Chao Li County; even if someone comes looking, they won’t find the slightest flaw.
Where there is Profound Qi, disputes are endless, and dangers abound; such a worthless, mortal border town really is a foolproof hiding place...’
...
A few days later, Protector Du returned from outside, bringing back some news and carrying an unknown swordsmanship manual, treasuring it dearly. Only members at the Hall Master level and above in the gang are qualified to cultivate it.
Song Yan casually practiced along with them, mainly to "accompany everyone" while getting some outside information.
...
Another two months passed.
Protector Du took a team out again.
Half a year later, they returned.
In this manner... two years slipped by lightly.
...
...
During these two years, around Song Yan’s mansion, peach blossoms withered and bloomed again, time over time.
Now in deep spring, the blossoms once again danced in the wind, brilliantly captivating.
And across from the Peach Garden Butcher Shop, "Peach Garden Restaurant" opened.
Of course, this restaurant was also opened by Song Yan.
Initially, the restaurant was nothing special, but because Protector Du of the Flying Knife Gang frequently went out and brought Jianghu people back to the county, bragging "My brother Li’s craft is fantastic, his spicy pigskin and roasted pig neck are simply unparalleled in this world."
Just like that...
The Peach Garden Restaurant initially caught fire within a small circle.
And when the Second Gang Leader of the Iron Hero Gang in Hanlin City made a special trip to secretly taste Master Li’s craft, then went back to spread the word, Peach Garden Restaurant became completely famous.
Song Yan had to showcase some martial arts, then... when small fries showed up, he wouldn’t cook anymore.
Later, finding it bothersome, he set a rule of "only cooking once a day, the destined ones shall obtain it."
However, many people in the Jianghu continued to come, and tasting Master Li’s "spicy pig skin and roasted pig neck" became a bragging right.
And that’s not without reason.
What realm is Song Yan in, and how great is his knife skill?
When truly focusing on making two dishes, it’s simply perfect.
Through these Jianghu people, Song Yan became more and more aware of the external situation.
Although there’s not much information on the Cultivator Realm, the Jianghu is the lower layer of the Cultivator Realm. Any event in the Cultivator Realm ripples significantly through the Jianghu.
Over the years, Song Yan learned a lot.
First, the Wei Kingdom ceased to exist, turning into the Jin Kingdom.
The Jin Kingdom used "the Puppet Sect’s search of Celestial Cloud City" to aggressively annex Western Shu, mostly accomplishing it now.
Meanwhile, Southern Wu seemed heavily wounded, holding the south defensively, no longer taking the initiative to attack.
Secondly, the Demon Dao forces in the Jianghu held an unprecedented "tribute event," each bringing their most precious gifts to the Puppet Sect, standing at the center of the Three Kingdoms, ostensibly to attend an extremely important grand wedding.
The groom of the wedding is said to be the offspring of a Peak Master from the Puppet Sect.
And the bride was addressed as "Lady Wang."
People in the Jianghu called her "Lady Wang," yet their expressions and demeanor... were no different than addressing the exalted Immortal Empress.
...
...
On this day, after Song Yan finished making his daily shadow puppets, he was watching guests come and go in the restaurant when suddenly a galloping horse approached from afar, the "dadada" sound coming swiftly yet steadily.
Protector Du dismounted and ran to Song Yan’s side, whispering, "Brother Li, get ready, show us your skills."
Song Yan said, "Brother Du, you know I only make one a day."
Protector Du, looking pleased, whispered, "There’s a cultivator, a loose cultivator; they heard about your craft and want to try it."
Song Yan was taken aback.
A cultivator wants to try a mortal’s craft?
Is this an excuse?
He suddenly became wary.
Protector Du lowered his voice and said, "It’s Lady Ling’s little gathering."
Song Yan asked in astonishment, "Who is Lady Ling?"
Protector Du replied, "Lady Ling is Lady Ling. She’s gathered several loose cultivators. Besides coming to taste your dish, they also want to do something else. Hurry, Brother Li, hurry, they’re almost here."

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 87. Numerous Abnormalities, Secret Realm Candle Land (4.1K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: 87. Numerous Abnormalities, Secret Realm Candle Land (4.1K words - Please Subscribe)
Since the "esteemed loose cultivators" were coming, Song Yan had nothing more to say. He immediately ran to the "Peach Orchard Restaurant" to inform them, asking for an elegant spread of dishes. Then, he himself began preparing "spicy pig skin and aromatic roasted pig neck".
The spicy pig skin was a cold dish, and it was finished first.
The pig neck was placed in a sealed wooden box, garnished with herbs, sprinkled with some caramel, and then slowly cooked with residual heat...
Both dishes were secret recipes, so after finishing them, he opened the courtyard gate.
Looking outside, he saw his two beautiful concubines eagerly watching him.
Seeing him emerge, one asked, "Master, is it true that an Immortal is coming? I have never seen an Immortal," while the other said, "Master, later, let me go with Elder Sister to serve the dishes and get a glimpse of the Immortal’s splendor, wouldn’t it be wonderful."
Song Yan understood these two women’s intentions clearly and directly said, "Are you seeking some elixirs?"
Lin Xianxing said happily, "Master, do you already have arrangements?"
The other concubine, usually called Pei’Er, was also joyfully looking at him, saying, "Master, it’s rare to encounter an Immortal. Since we have such an opportunity today, let’s not let it slip away.
I heard that the Profound Qi Pill is incredibly magical, sought after by people in the Jianghu who can’t even get one, but for a cultivator, it’s probably given with a flick of the wrist.
If the cultivator gives us one today, even if we don’t use it, it would be a valuable asset for our future generations. Afterwards, our Peach Orchard Meat Shop Li Family will also gain great fame in the Jianghu, which would indeed be an undertaking to prosper the family."
Song Yan said rather speechlessly, "The books you read make you more eloquent than Xing’Er."
Lin Xianxing said coquettishly, "I can’t compare to my sister’s cleverness; I’m afraid I’ll be bullied, boohoo."
Pei’Er said, "Master, should we rehearse a bit first?"
"Rehearse what?"
Song Yan was truly baffled.
Pei’Er said, "In a while, we’ll definitely have to kneel and beg the Immortal for elixirs. Master will certainly kneel in the middle, and I and Sister Xing’Er have to decide who stands on the left and who on the right."
Lin Xianxing said, "I was the first to get entry, so I should be on the right."
Pei’Er laughed, "That’s how it should be, but when the Immortal looks over, the first glance would naturally fall on the right. If they ask some questions, can you answer fluently like I can? If something goes wrong, could Elder Sister bear the blame?"
Lin Xianxing was immediately hesitant.
She hadn’t read much, and indeed couldn’t speak as well as Pei’Er. However, if she yielded the right-hand kneeling spot, wouldn’t she be considered lesser in the household from then on?
Song Yan waved his sleeve and left.
The two women were taken aback, hurriedly caught up, each tugging at his sleeve, twisting their hips coquettishly and saying, "Master, Master, who’s on the left and who’s on the right..."
Song Yan said, "Both of you stay at home, you’re not allowed to go!"
With that, he directly left through the inner courtyard gate.
The two women showed annoyed expressions, hummed softly, crossed their arms over their chests, turned their bodies, and each walked back to their own rooms.
...
Just as Song Yan stepped out, outside the door stood a fierce man, "laughing heartily", none other than Protector Du.
As soon as Protector Du saw Song Yan come out, he hurriedly approached, pulling his sleeve, saying, "Brother Li, is the food all arranged?"
Song Yan said, "It’s arranged."
Protector Du looked around, with a mysterious expression, said, "The arrival of the Immortal is a chance hard to come by. After three rounds of wine, our leader plans to personally come over to greet the Immortal and then... plead for some elixirs.
At that time, the vice-leader will kneel on the right, I on the left. But since the food is prepared by you, brother, you should kneel next to me. The four of us together seek elixirs from the Immortal, how about it?"
After speaking, he looked full of anticipation and excitement, then said, "This is a great opportunity."
Song Yan, looking at this usually fierce Protector Du, didn’t know what to say, just replied, "I... don’t have a high status in the gang, so I’d rather not."
Protector Du said, "That won’t do! That cultivator surely came because he heard of your culinary skills, Brother Li! Our Flying Knife Gang is benefiting from your blessing. If you don’t get a kneeling spot, I, Old Du, would be the first to object!"
