The two of them pushed back and forth a bit. Protector Du, seeing Song Yan truly uninterested in seizing this opportunity, secretly admired Brother Li’s integrity, thinking of reporting to the leader later to offer more compensation or something.
...
...
About an hour later.
Six cultivators arrived at the elegant room of Peach Orchard Restaurant.
Among them were three men and three women, with Lady Ling sitting in the center.
She was a female cultivator with a knife, wearing a Profound Ghost Mask and wrapped in a Profound Robe. If not for her graceful figure and long hair, it would indeed be hard to distinguish her gender.
But Song Yan could not only tell she was a woman but also that she was a very beautiful woman.
Because... Song Yan was too familiar with women who had once been intimate with him.
This Lady Ling turned out to be Hua Linglong!
After years of not seeing her, she had become a cultivator.
Song Yan recalled how, before leaving years ago, he had told her about the "Snake Corpse Market, and the existence of Profound Root opportunities in the Demon Swamp Secret Realm". Clearly... Hua Linglong had ventured into the Demon Swamp Secret Realm and acquired a Profound Root, before beginning her cultivation journey.
Yet, this matter was quite ridiculous to Song Yan.
Since when was acquiring a Profound Root such an easy feat?
Besides, he was now at the Crimson Palace Realm, a whole level higher, which allowed him to easily discern Hua Linglong’s level to be around the Third Layer of Refining Profound, as Hua Linglong seemed not to have learned techniques like Qi Concealment.
In just over five years, she possessed a Profound Root and had stepped into the Third Layer of Refining Profound, a progression... uncommonly swift.
In fact, when Song Yan recalled the "Snake Corpse Market" and the moving "Demon Swamp Secret Realm", he found them similarly extraordinary.
As for the other five individuals, they were also at levels between the Third and Fifth Layers of Refining Profound.

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 87. Full of Abnormalities, Secret Realm Candle Land (4.1K Words - Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: 87. Full of Abnormalities, Secret Realm Candle Land (4.1K Words - Please Subscribe)_2
While contemplating, he introduced the dishes briefly.
The cultivators grew impatient, and soon an elder waved his hand, indicating for him to hurry up and leave.
Lady Ling calmly said, "Let the servants outside leave as well."
The voice was still Hua Linglong’s at its core, but it was noticeably disguised.
This wasn’t a magical disguise but a deliberate change of tone through "damaging the throat."
At this moment, she sat upright in the central position among the six cultivators, clearly the leader...
However, she did not recognize Song Yan.
Song Yan hurriedly saluted and rushed out, seeing the maids waiting outside the door, he said, "Stay further away," and they immediately scattered and ran outside the main gate.
Outside the main gate, the Feidao Gang’s leader and vice-leader, along with Protector Du and a group of people, were already waiting anxiously. Upon seeing Song Yan exit, they asked about the situation before continuing to wait, while shooing people away, saying, "Don’t eavesdrop on the immortals’ conversation."
Song Yan, meanwhile, directly extended his divine sense.
Divine Sense, exclusive to the Crimson Palace Realm, was like a "Dimensional Reduction Strike" for those at the Refining Profound Level, nothing to worry about.
Although there was very little Profound Qi here, Song Yan did not probe too far away.
At such a close distance, only separated by a wall, a gate, it was still possible.
...
The voices from inside the room clearly reached his ears.
"Lady Ling, are you sure?"
"The surrounding area is barren of Profound Qi; how could there be a secret realm?"
A cultivator inquired.
Lady Ling replied, "I accidentally entered it once. There are only a few low-level demon beasts inside, nothing to worry about. If any of you are concerned, I can lead with Zhu’Er, and you can follow behind us."
Beside her, a small female cultivator with a somewhat dazed expression nodded vigorously.
Lady Ling continued in a calm tone, "Zhu’Er is mute; she cannot speak, but her power exceeds mine by a small margin."
The other four cultivators exchanged glances, and one said, "We naturally trust Lady Ling, but the cultivation realm is perilous, hence our inquiries."
Another suddenly said, "There’s no need for Lady Ling to explore first; when the time comes, let the local gang gather a dozen skilled hands to help us scout the way first. If there’s danger, we’ll be able to see it too and then decide whether to act."
Subsequently, they discussed the details of the secret realm.
Lady Ling did most of the talking, while the four beside her listened attentively.
Of course...
Song Yan was also listening.
He was particularly curious about this "secret realm," both its origin and the demon beasts within intrigued him.
In the vicinity of Chao Li County, he had actually investigated before becoming Master Li, finding no trace of any "secret realm," yet he had no idea how Hua Linglong knew of it or stumbled into it.
During the conversation, he also learned that the secret realm was named "Candle Land," simply because the demon beasts inside were a low-level demon beast called "Night Candle Worm."
These demon insects slumber during the day and awaken at night, yet even when awake, they pose no threat to anyone protected by a Profound Artifact sect shield or similar—easily dealt with, so to say.
Such a secret realm is practically a haven for loose cultivators, as secret realms often yield treasures, sometimes even cultivation techniques.
While pondering, the inside cultivators concluded their conversation, and the food on the table was nearly consumed.
A cultivator called out, "Clean it up."
The four words passed outside, and the leaders of the Feidao Gang, along with Protector Du, hurriedly rushed in after waiting for some time, knelt, pleased them with flattery, and then sought opportunities.
A cultivator looked at the three and suddenly said, "Leader, rise. We actually have a favor to ask."
The Feidao Gang’s leader did not rise but smiled ingratiatingly and respectfully said, "Please, Immortal Master, speak."
That cultivator said, "Three days from now at the hour of the dragon, gather skilled hands from your gang to accompany us to a nearby place, back and forth in one day. You will have benefits then."
Saying this, he pulled a small bottle from his pocket and tossed it directly, saying, "For now, here’s three Profound Qi Pills."
The Feidao Gang’s leader caught the bottle, his body trembling slightly, stammering, "Immortal Master, I wonder... I wonder what’s at that place?"
The cultivator turned a finger, and a flying sword leapt from its sheath behind him with a clang, whirling twice in mid-air, gleaming fiercely with cold light.
Shñk!
The flying sword returned to its sheath.
The Feidao Gang’s leader and his men knelt on the ground, throats moving yet afraid to take a single deep breath.
The cultivator said, "We just need some manpower, with us here, what is there to worry about?"
"Yes, yes, yes..." The Feidao Gang’s leader felt the cold sweat trickling down his back.
Another cultivator gently said, "We need skilled hands, do not be perfunctory with us."
Speaking, he squinted his eyes in thought, smiled, and said, "Leader, you should lead the team. Only with you leading can we be sure you’ve really brought skilled hands.
By the way, the three of you, and anyone with any position in the gang, cannot be missing."
"This..."
The Feidao Gang’s leader regretted it bitterly inside.
If he had known it’d be like this, why bother coming in?
However, even if he didn’t come, these cultivators, having decided on certain matters, would not allow him to resist.
The Feidao Gang’s leader looked up, squeezing a smile from his fat-strewn face.
"To follow Immortal Masters and broaden one’s horizons is something to wish for, something to wish for indeed..."
...
...
That day, the six cultivators temporarily stayed in Chao Li County.
And the Feidao Gang’s leader began gathering skilled hands.
The leader, vice-leader, two protectors, and six hall masters were unavoidably included...
And to increase the chances of survival, the Feidao Gang leader gritted his teeth and began gathering more people, saying things like following the immortals to find opportunities, without danger.
As a seasoned Jianghu figure, although uncertain, the Feidao Gang’s leader felt that his group might become cannon fodder for the cultivators, so he needed to find more people to serve as their cannon fodder.
If there was danger, layers of death would not reach him.
If everyone before him died, and it reached him, that was fate, inevitable.
...
...
Because the "hall master" was appointed, Song Yan couldn’t avoid it.
He never expected himself to be caught in this mess.
But it didn’t matter.
He was not nervous.
A secret realm that even Hua Linglong’s led cultivator squad dared to enter, if he dared not, he might as well just smash himself with tofu.
Moreover, he had never entered a secret realm before, this time... was just a great opportunity.
...
...
That night...
The two beautiful concubines in Master Li’s household had learned that the master would follow the cultivators to a certain place. That night, the two women showcased their divine powers, using their enchantresses’ tricks on the master.
Until both were utterly exhausted, they cuddled in Master Li’s arms, long legs entwined with his, tender hands caressing his body, whispering sweetly, placing hints like, "Master, the key to the small coffer at home should temporarily be in someone’s care."
Both women were cunning, knowing everything related to cultivators was dangerous, and in case the master would not return, it would later evolve into a "battle for the inheritance."
At this time, in the night, came the mournful sound of a pipe.
Song Yan swept with his divine sense and saw Hua Linglong sitting at a bridgehead in the county, playing the pipe, eyes slightly lowered, deep in thought.
Clearly, in these past few years... Hua Linglong’s life has been colorful, ever since she "miraculously" sprouted a "Profound Root," ever since the disaster she got caught in due to him, her life was destined to be extraordinary.
For this unintentional burden, Song Yan could do nothing.
This time entering the secret realm, he would not deny having a few thoughts of "protecting if possible."
The tune from the pipe gradually waned...
The Profound Robe female cultivator turned over, her icy pure beautiful face sealed behind the ghost face.
’Have you ever heard of conjuring a Profound Root from nothing?’ Song Yan asked inwardly.
The voice reached the Chong Soul of Granny Fox, who said, "Yes."
Soon after, she organized her thoughts and added, "I’ve heard of two kinds."
"One is using an Innate Spiritual Object to refine an elixir and nurture the body, but this method is overly expensive, and the cost does not match the gain at all..."
"The other involves certain special demon beast embryos or demon insect eggs hidden within the human body, capable of absorbing Profound Qi, creating the illusion of having produced a Profound Root."
Song Yan squinted his eyes.
Then he returned Granny Fox’s Chong Soul into the black spot.
Gotta say, having such an "old demonic fox" always at one’s side is quite convenient.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 88. A Different Kind of Reunion (3.4K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: 88. A Different Kind of Reunion (3.4K words - Please Subscribe)
Three days later, at Chen time...
Song Yan never expected that his first entry into a Secret Realm would be under such circumstances.
Without a doubt, this Secret Realm called "Candle Land" should be quite ordinary, at least not comparable to the "Demon Swamp", nor to the Giant Elephant Plain he had heard of before at the Cold Pool Valley Market.
The entrance to the Secret Realm was a transparent film slightly emanating Profound Qi.
Song Yan had explored this place before, but he hadn’t discovered it then.
At this moment...
Protector Du was at the front, Song Yan following behind.
Protector Du turned back, giving a wry smile to Master Li behind him.
Master Li also returned a helpless smile to him.
Protector Du gritted his teeth and rushed forward.
The film rippled, and Protector Du had already disappeared.
Song Yan then awakened Granny Fox, watching the film together until she nodded, then he took a step forward and entered.
When Granny Fox was an enemy, she exerted strong pressure, but now that she’s his spirit ghost, she gives a sense of reassurance.
After the ripples, the scenery suddenly changed.
A moment ago, it was still the wasteland outside Chao Li County, now two towering green mountains rose on both sides, the thin morning mist in the canyon carried the scent of earth and stone.
There were many plants, but the silence was terrifying.
It felt like a dead mountain with no living creatures.
"Ah... Achoo!"
A member of the Flying Knife Gang sneezed, the sneeze rebounding off the narrow canyon cliffs, creating a deep and strange echo.
The surrounding group of cutthroat men were startled, the continuous sound of knives and swords being drawn could be heard, as everyone vigilantly looked in all directions.
Seeing nothing moved, Protector Du went up and slapped that member’s shoulder hard, saying, "Make another sound and I’ll kill you."
The member nodded hastily.
Everyone fell silent.
The gang leader had brought a full thirty people in, and now gathered at the valley entrance, staring at the distant gorge like a thread of the sky, feeling the deathly silence around them, everyone’s faces were not looking good.
Fortunately, six cultivators soon followed inside.
Lady Ling and the petite female cultivator named Zhu’Er walked in the middle.
"Master Chief, please have the people walk ahead," Lady Ling said calmly.
Upon sensing some of the people in front turning back to look, Lady Ling added, "The exit is one-way, coming in here does not mean you leave from here."
The Flying Knife Gang leader gritted his teeth and stepped forward, saying, "Lady Ling, since we’ve come this far, can you give us some honesty?
Can we... leave here alive?"
Lady Ling nodded, replying gently, "Of course you can."
Her voice, though somewhat hoarse, had a convincing power.
She had once ruled the Jianghu, her every move exuding a queenly aura.
The crowd, after hearing this, felt inexplicably relieved.
But Song Yan was somewhat speechless.
He was too familiar with Hua Linglong.
Whenever Hua Linglong’s tone became gentle, that definitely meant she was lying.
"Of course you can" meant "of course you can’t."
This was somewhat beyond Song Yan’s expectations.
But on second thought, Hua Linglong was never a kind soul, nor a pure-hearted good lady, but a ruthless, unscrupulous heroine.
He somewhat had a bias seeing her as a "vulnerable group."
If he didn’t have the Remaining Life Dao Fruit, and he was placed in the same place as Hua Linglong to compete and battle, he feared he would be utterly defeated.
His initial thoughts of "reuniting secretly" and "rescuing the beauty" paths were immediately overturned because... "the beauty in that clichéd plot" might just still be a "scheming little BOSS."
...
...
’Can you see any danger around here?’ Song Yan asked.
Granny Fox replied, "Master, for now, I cannot see any."
She then added, "The demon beasts in the Secret Realm are usually very singular, but their numbers are vast.
Singular means they have fixed patterns and habits, as long as you pay attention to these patterns and habits, the chances of survival are high.
The large numbers mean that these demon beasts have varying levels of growth, weaker on the outskirts and stronger inside.
At the deepest part of the Secret Realm... there is usually a Blood Pool.
That is an extremely pure Blood Pool.
How it forms is unknown, but I guess it may have originally been a burial ground for these singular demon beasts after their deaths, then due to some strange changes, it turned into a pure Blood Pool.
My previous Six-winged Horror Bat Blood was obtained from a Blood Pool deep within a Secret Realm."
"By the way, Master, this Lady Ling’s claim about the exit being one-way, hmm... she probably used some Secret Technique to seal the entrance. Then she bullied these little cultivators, Jianghu people, saying the exit is on the other side."
"I wasn’t sure before, but with what she said, I guess she’s leading the cultivators here to feed the demon beasts in the Secret Realm."
As Granny Fox described, Song Yan felt like he was reading a "strategy guide."
Before the other party could implement their conspiracy, the old Demonic Fox had almost stripped the opponent bare.
And Granny Fox continued to speak: "Before in the Mountain and Sea Kingdom, I heard of some mysterious cultivators who, for unknown reasons, would actively feed demon beasts in Secret Realms.
Some would even intentionally gather cultivators to certain places, as if farming. When the cultivators became powerful, they would be sent batch by batch into the Secret Realm."
Song Yan’s expression slightly shifted.
What Granny was describing was exactly like "Snake Corpse Market", wasn’t it?
He thought and asked, "Could it be that the Secret Realm demon beasts implanted false Profound Roots to control the cultivators?"
Although he regretted it, he had to understand Hua Linglong’s current state.
In his subconscious, he hoped Hua Linglong had not completely lost consciousness.
Grandmother Fox said, "Master, it can’t be done to such a degree; at most one can control the body but not the divine sense, so... the servant says the purpose of these mysterious cultivators is unknown.
They are completely awake in their divine souls when doing these things."
Song Yan said, "Wanting to seal the entrance to the Secret Realm, even I can’t do that, how did Madame Ling accomplish it?"
Grandmother Fox said, "That group of cultivators are quite familiar with the Secret Realm, going in and out as if returning home, the rest... the servant doesn’t know... after all, it’s the first time the servant has seen such cultivators."
After saying this, it spoke deeply again, "Since Madame Ling said such things, then she must be such a cultivator."
The private conversation between man and fox was unknown to outsiders.
...
...
At this moment, the team composed of cultivators and Jianghu people began to move forward.
Two unlucky gang members were picked to become scouting scouts.
They looked ashen-faced, nervously gripping knives, they ventured forward, soon disappearing in the winding mountain path.
Song Yan slowed down with the crowd, waiting for the scouts ahead to return.
There’s no sense of time in the Secret Realm, it’s unclear how long has passed, but at least two incense sticks’ time has gone by, and sure enough, those two unlucky gang members haven’t returned.
One of the cultivators suddenly stopped, speaking coldly, "Madame Ling, didn’t you say, there’s no danger here during the day?"
Madame Ling remained calm, responding, "Maybe they wandered into some caves or places like that, where even during the day, it’s pitch black and might encounter demonic insects."
"What kind of demonic insects?" The Flying Knife Gang leader hurriedly asked.
The crowd was also in an uproar.
They don’t fear blades licking blood, after all, they know that they only have to be wary of the opponent’s blade and sword.
But now, unknown terror surrounds them.
What’s terrifying is not even knowing how one dies.
At this point, the cultivators didn’t hide it, revealing the "Night Candle Demonic Insects" matter, then said, "In any event, even if you scout, be cautious and stay away from dark places, and you’ll be fine.
Now it’s early, no harm done."
From the crowd’s edge, Protector Du smiled bitterly at Song Yan, muttering, "My property will be cheap for my wife now, Brother Li, you too... your two wives should be happy now."
Song Yan smiled helplessly, saying, "What can we do?"
Protector Du soon relieved himself, acting carefree, "But it’s okay, last night I sowed a lot, even if I die, there will be a son. Brother Li, how about you?"
Song Yan casually replied, "I sowed both sides, not sure if it took?"
The two exchanged glances, but only smiled bitterly in helplessness.
...
...
The crowd moved through the canyon, walking and stopping intermittently.
After a while, someone cried out in joy.
There was a skeleton ahead, clutching Profound Jade, elixir, and a book of cultivation technique...
The harvest made the cultivators’ initial complaints disappear.
Yet it’s unclear how much time passed, the sky unexpectedly showed a dark hue, what was thought to be an easy exit was nowhere to be found.
The cultivators became anxious, deploying more Flying Knife Gang disciples to scout.
However, nowadays two groups are sent out, with only one returning...
The remaining Flying Knife Gang disciples dwindled more and more.
The evening wind blew past, and the Secret Realm seemed to undergo some inexplicable change, becoming dangerous.
"Someone over here, go!"
A cultivator looked irritably at the shadows cast down the cliff walls.
Those shadows grew thick, in the chilling evening wind wriggled like living beings, but upon closer inspection, appeared to be mere illusion.
The Flying Knife Gang leader’s gaze fell on Protector Du’s side, he sighed helplessly, about to speak, when a figure flashed out.
"I’ll go." Song Yan said.
The Flying Knife Gang leader was stunned for a moment, and so was Protector Du.
Before the latter had a chance to speak, Song Yan patted his shoulder, saying, "Old Du, it’s been nice knowing you in this life."
"Li... Brother..."
Protector Du’s triangular eyes instantly turned red, glancing again, but saw Song Yan already far away, tears could no longer be contained, he cried out, "Brother Li! Walk slowly on the Yellow Spring Road, old Du will meet you soon! Soon... will meet... boohoo..."
The crowd heard, showing a few shades of sadness.
Sure enough...
Another incense stick’s time passed, and the dispatched Mr. Li hadn’t returned.
The setting sun in the west, its rosy hue blocked by canyon’s cliffs, the mountain path complex like a labyrinth, yet the exit remained elusive.
The cultivators grew more anxious.
Seeing they were about to send another Jianghu person scouting, the Profound Robe Ghost Face female cultivator boldly stepped forward, calmly saying, "Gentlemen Daoists, this is all my fault... At this point, Zhu’Er and I will scout, you follow closely."
If it were usual times, the cultivators might exchange pleasantries a bit, but at this moment, all agreed.
Madame Ling, along with the silent and delicate female cultivator by her side, promptly emerged, her profound sleeve swirling, while she quickly flew up.
Their speed was initially regular, then began to quicken, moving from the main path to side paths, swirling, heading toward mist-rising, shadow-thickening areas.
After about one incense stick’s time, the two women suddenly felt something, abruptly stopped, simultaneously turned their heads, behind unexpectedly appeared two rolls of gale.
A black and a white serpent-like radiance arrived instantly, hovering at the neck of the two women.
Mr. Li was naturally no longer Mr. Li, reverting to Song Yan’s appearance.
The man wielded black and white twin swords, looked distantly at the two women, his gaze moved and stopped on Madame Ling, frowning, asked, "Hua Linglong, what exactly are you planning?"
Madame Ling stared at his face in surprise, exclaimed, "Song Yan!"
But then, she looked at the taciturn delicate female cultivator beside her, her expression fearful and pleaded, "I beg you, don’t kill him..."
The taciturn female cultivator hearing the name "Song Yan", inexplicably smiled brightly, her stiff eyeballs rolled around, then softly said, "Junior, I have some excellent essence blood here, would you like it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 89. Soul-Eating Insect Tide (4.2K characters - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: 89. Soul-Eating Insect Tide (4.2K characters - Subscription Requested)
The one known as the mute started to speak.
And the one who could speak became mute.
Song Yan narrowed his eyes slightly and stopped talking.
In his mind, thoughts flashed like lightning as he quickly connected several key pieces of information.
Raising cultivators to feed secret realm demon beasts, mysterious cultivator, the time when Hua Linglong was asked to find Profound Root at Snake Corpse Market after leaving Celestial Cloud City, and so on...
An inexplicable thought surfaced, perhaps this mysterious female cultivator was "nurturing that Snake Corpse Market for decades to feed that hidden old demon in the Demon Swamp Secret Realm," and this visit here had other objectives, just happened to meet him, and then developed other schemes.
As he was thinking, the voice of Granny Fox came: "Master, be careful of traps."
To increase fault tolerance, Song Yan had already activated "Granny Fox’s external perception" before the fight started, so when he was interacting and confronting others, it was actually "he and Granny Fox" countering together.
Granny Fox naturally heard this as well.
She continued, "This sentence carries a preset information trap. If you answer it, you’ll unwittingly confirm many things for her. How does she know you need essence blood? And why does she want to give you the essence blood? Where did the essence blood she gives you come from?
People outside should know that I have fought with you and also know you broke through the Crimson Palace Realm.
Therefore, needing essence blood can barely be explained...
But why give you essence blood is very intriguing.
This female cultivator certainly knows a lot.
Round and round, I’m worried it revolves back to the bloodline of the Changwang Tiger Race.
Back then, I accidentally got an opportunity and hastily stole the blood out, but I don’t know if this blood is also linked to something deeper."
Song Yan remained silent.
The Changwang Tiger Race is a ruler-level demon in the Divine Soul World and an advanced race of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, with only one single descendant left, making this essence blood extremely precious.
However, no matter how precious the essence blood is, once consumed by someone, it loses its significance. If they’re just rehashing old issues, what are these people after?
"If we make a move..."
"Master, the other party knows you are in the Crimson Palace Realm and survived a fight with me, so they’re clearly not benevolent.
This type of cultivator should be the Secret Realm Cultivator I mentioned before, and this is the secret realm, her home ground, her abilities... I’m not sure either. But they must be related to the secret realm itself.
Master, be cautious."
"This secret realm is called Candle Land, where night candle insects are dormant during the day and active at night, but there must be something they’re holding back, though what is being held back is unknown..."
The strange female cultivator named Zhu’Er barely asked a question, yet in Song Yan and Granny Fox’s minds, layers of thoughts flashed rapidly as they began to uncover her intentions.
The thoughts exchanged rapidly between the man and the fox, outwardly only a moment had passed.
Song Yan lifted his eyes, looked at the wooden female cultivator opposite, and clasped his fists politely: "If there’s essence blood suitable for me, I... naturally would want it."
The wooden female cultivator smiled charmingly and said, "It must be suitable for you."
Song Yan did not bring up what his Central Palace Blood was, but curiously asked, "How exactly is it suitable?"
This time, it was the wooden female cultivator’s turn to fall silent, tilting her head to glance at the sky.
The secret realm’s sky was the same as the outside weather, with the sun and moon bringing dusk or dawn. At this moment... the sky was becoming dark, with gray clouds already obscuring the glow of the horizon, and perhaps in the next breath, the entire world would suddenly fall into darkness.
This timing seemed quite satisfactory to the female cultivator.
She said, "The demon beasts here are called night candle soul insects. Once night falls, they wake up and are drawn to living souls, which they see as light, rushing towards them like moths to flame, until they dissipate the living soul.
A single night candle soul insect is not frightening, and they’re simply categorized as ’weak in body but possessing special power’ as advanced demon beasts. However, the terror is... there are many, many night candle soul insects here.
This many night candle soul insects together, even a Crimson Palace Cultivator would have to take a detour.
The human soul is protected by the body, and wanting to break the body to dissipate the soul is very difficult...
However, the characteristic of these night candle soul insects is their extremely strong divine soul regenerating ability. As long as it’s nighttime, even if their bodies are scorched while impacting the target’s soul, they recover swiftly and continue their assault.
I wonder... whether the blood of such a soul-benefiting demon beast would suit you?"
After saying this, she added, "The insect blood is very, very rare, and perhaps it takes several night candle soul insects to squeeze out even one drop, so... gathering a portion that a Crimson Palace Realm cultivator can absorb is quite difficult.
Junior, do you want it?"
The night candle insect suddenly transformed into the soul-attacking night candle soul insect, and its level of peril skyrocketed.
If those few loose cultivators knew this information, they probably wouldn’t dare enter this secret realm even if their lives depended on it.
Just because an attacking soul demon beast, this method... truly seems unsolvable.
...
On the other side, Granny Fox immediately said, "She inadvertently exposed herself; indeed, she’s here for the Changwang Tiger Blood.
She’s testing whether I was the one who stole out the Changwang Tiger Blood, and also testing if you stole the Changwang Tiger Blood, and even testing whether you’ve digested it."
In fact, Song Yan realized this himself without needing Granny Fox to say it.
He raised his head, thought for a moment, and said, "The blood of the night candle soul insect is indeed very rare, but it’s not quite suitable for me. To be truthful to the senior, I have entered the Crimson Palace Realm, but my Central Palace Blood is that of a mutated nine-eyed harp python’s essence blood."
"Nine-eyed harp python? That demon beast that bewitches with skin and sound? However... isn’t this demon beast merely an intermediate level demon beast?"

chapters.content:
Chapter 103: 89. Soul-Eating Insect Tide (4.2K characters - Subscription Requested)_2
The reserved female cultivator was taken aback.
Song Yan nodded seriously and said, "This one of mine is a mutant, its essence blood has reached the level of an advanced demon beast, yet even so, refining the Crimson Palace Pill cost me a great deal of effort."
The air suddenly became quiet, eerily silent.
The reserved female cultivator suddenly said, "Enough, Song Yan, there’s no point in saying more. Without trying, I can’t tell if you’re speaking the truth or not, and you... would surely be unwilling to work for me."
Song Yan did not make a move, merely asked curiously, "I wonder what task the senior wants me to do, I naturally enjoy helping others, perhaps I’m willing to help you too?"
The reserved female cultivator said, "I want you to accompany me to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country."
Song Yan nodded thoughtfully and then asked, "To do what?"
The reserved female cultivator was obviously not fooled. She directly took out a green bottle from her bosom and said, "Song Yan, there’s a pill in here. You take it, and I’ll tell you."
Song Yan glanced at the green bottle, but before he could speak, Hua Linglong had already opened her mouth.
"Song Lang, this is an Immortal Pill. After taking it, mortals can develop a Profound Root, and cultivators can enhance their Profound Root Talent. This is a blessing you earned from your previous life."
The reserved female cultivator glared fiercely at Hua Linglong.
Hua Linglong bowed her head in fear and mumbled, "Master, I... I was just advising him..."
Song Yan interrupted, "The senior is right."
The reserved female cultivator looked up at him, her stiff eyes oddly shifting.
Song Yan continued, "It’s just that... if the senior doesn’t demonstrate some ability, this junior cannot take the pill."
The air instantly became still.
Neither knew the other’s abilities, and after circling around, they both chose to first test each other.
As in the story of the "The Donkey of Guizhou," watchers only sigh at the donkey’s foolishness, daring to act brazenly in front of the tiger; laugh at the tiger’s silliness, actually being bluffed by a mere donkey; but how many people noticed the tiger’s caution? If the tiger didn’t test, how would it know the donkey was something it could eat?
"Very well."
The reserved female cultivator gave a strange smile and then surprisingly floated into the air without using a Profound Artifact, her hands gesturing mechanically, and the dark clouds in the sky, the shadows of the mountains all "hissed" and began to wriggle, a fine, weird high-pitched sound that could make someone with a fear of holes instantly go mad, covering their ears and breaking down hysterically.
...
...
At this moment, in the canyon, the team composed of the Flying Knife Gang and the remaining four loose cultivators was still advancing.
Suddenly, one of the gang’s hall masters exclaimed, "What the hell is that?"
"Don’t panic, it’s just a night candle bug."
An elderly loose cultivator’s calm voice sounded, and along with it, a gleaming golden small bell rose up, floating in the air four or five feet high, slowly rotating, scattering faint golden rays about the length of fingernails.
The rays scattered, forming a small light domain covering about ten feet.
The other three loose cultivators immediately gathered around, and the remaining ten or so members of the Flying Knife Gang rushed into the light domain, squeezing closely together, looking exceedingly ludicrous but no one dared laugh, only fearfully watching the writhing shadows outside.
One loose cultivator said, "Madam Ling and Zhu’Er haven’t returned, it’s probably not looking good for them."
Another snorted, "I think there’s something shady about them."
"Stop arguing, now we must work together, find the exit first," the elderly loose cultivator said, "I’ll use the Profound Artifact for now, later when it’s exhausted, you take turns."
As the words left his mouth, the shadows instantly rose into the air, like a black wave slightly gathered mid-air.
"Here it comes."
The old man’s expression tightened, struggling to control the bell-shaped Profound Artifact more rigorously.
In the next moment, the black wave slammed down violently onto the golden light shield, exploding rapidly into black mist.
But this was just an initial strike, quickly followed by waves of black pounding down.
At the periphery, one gang member in the pushing couldn’t stand stable, taking a slight misstep, leaving half a leg outside. This leg was brushed by a black wave, and that gang member felt a sting in the nerves throughout his body, instantaneously kneeling down on one knee, raising his hand in agony, crying "Help me," but before he could finish, his entire body was covered in blackness.
The crowd finally saw clearly, they were actually black, strange bugs.
And that gang member, instantly stopped moving, oddly without a single wound on his body.
It seems that those insects don’t eat people.
This left everyone in a daze.
But just in that moment of hesitation, the Profound Artifact small tower of the old man couldn’t hold on anymore. The golden light shield instantly cracked, and a black insect tentacle quickly reached in from the outside. With a gentle stroke, it touched a cultivator’s left arm, and that cultivator’s pupils contracted. Just with that touch...his left arm completely lost all sensation, exhibiting exactly the same symptoms as the ordinary gang members before!
Fortunately, at this moment, another cultivator quickly stepped in and took out an umbrella, tossing it into the air.
The umbrella’s light expanded, pushing the insects away, but it only shone for four or five seconds before it started making cracking sounds, as if it was about to shatter under the impact of the black insects.
Everyone was horrified, cold sweat streaming down, feeling a strong sense of suffocation and despair in their hearts.
A sharp-eyed cultivator suddenly said, "These insects are not actively attacking us; they’re like they’re on their way somewhere. We must avoid the main road! Otherwise, we’ll all die!!"
As soon as the words were spoken, everyone hurried to the side...
The loose cultivators hastily took out their Profound Artifacts.
But as loose cultivators, their resources were not abundant, the number of Profound Artifacts was limited, and they didn’t know how long they could hold out.
From time to time, there were loose cultivators grabbing a member of the Flying Knife Gang, throwing them out to distract the insects.
And those gang members, once they fell into the black insect swarm, would immediately become immobile, but their bodies... showed no injuries.
...
...
When the black insect swarm started moving, Song Yan felt a strong divine soul threat, a unique sensitivity brought by his "Chang Wang Tiger Blood."
In fact, he could also feel that even if these insects really fell on him and attacked his divine soul, he wouldn’t be affected much for the time being.
Because his divine soul still housed many transformed minions, coupled with those soul-capturing black spots, it was more than enough.
At least, the Night Candle Soul Insects attacking divine souls would need an assault battle to deal with him.
"Master, she is still probing you," said the Grandmother Fox. "If you have the Chang Wang Tiger Blood, you won’t die immediately; but if you die, it means you don’t have the Chang Wang Tiger Blood and are of no value to her, so if you die, you die."
Song Yan looked up at the dull female cultivator suspended in mid-air, and at Hua Linglong who was standing in the distance but ignored by the insects. Moving his hands, his ten fingers immediately linked to ten Demon Beast Shadow Puppets, most of which were intermediate.
The advanced one was a one-tailed fox demon.
And the highest level... was a one-armed shadow puppet made from the body of the Grandmother Fox.
The multi-tailed fox race essence blood of the Grandmother Fox, Song Yan had kept it, and after being in the wilderness for such a long time, naturally made her skin into a three-tailed shadow puppet.
To ensure the restoration of power, he didn’t trim much and maintained the original one-armed appearance to use as much skin as possible.
To mislead others, he deliberately bundled the three tails into a "fake tail," making it appear at first glance as just an ordinary one-tailed demonic fox.
This technique, for other Skin Masters, would be impossible, but for him... it was completely doable.
In addition, generally speaking, the skin of a demon at the Crimson Palace level requires many special handling techniques to make a shadow puppet. Song Yan, wanting to create such a level, still needs to learn more advanced magic... However, the "Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique" is indeed somewhat absurd.
The "Deformed Soul" can make up for such shortcomings.
Although it did not, like other demon beasts, "exceedingly perform beyond the power of the original body before death," it could however manifest the power of the one-armed Grandmother Fox without essence blood.
And this... was already the power level of the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace.
It could be said, if not using essence blood, nor using techniques, just relying on physical and talent alone for a battle, Song Yan with this one-armed Grandmother Fox at the Crimson Palace middle stage could only hold a 50-50 chance, even possibly being suppressed in terms of illusion technique.
In making his move, Song Yan not only concealed his trump card; among these ten shadow puppets, he even hid a "nuclear bomb."
Instantly launching the "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique" mutated twice from ordinary "Skin Control Technique," the deformed soul scattered outwards. Illusions immediately appeared, amidst the hazy ghostly air, flickering with many ghostly figures.
From high above came a heavy exclamation, "This... what is this?!"
Beside, Hua Linglong’s beautiful eyes lit up, and she applauded with praise, "As expected of the teacher! Can drive away almost all the Night Candle Soul Insects in the secret realm!
Song Lang, although your methods are not bad, you better concede quickly.
Even if you become ten times stronger, it’s useless. The Night Candle Soul Insects are immortal creatures in the night; you will soon be exhausted by these insects."
Above, the dull female cultivator paused for a moment, then coldly glanced at Hua Linglong, no longer pretending to be shocked.
Hua Linglong also quickly shut up and said no more.

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 90. Secret Realm Insect Cultivator, Mysterious Thoughts (3.8K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: 90. Secret Realm Insect Cultivator, Mysterious Thoughts (3.8K words - Please subscribe)
The taciturn female cultivator, once exposed by Hua Linglong for her tactics, stopped pretending. She soared higher and then raised her hand to press down heavily. The pitch-black swarm of insects fell like a water column directly onto Song Yan.
Song Yan hurriedly dodged while manipulating the shadow puppets with his ten fingers.
The shadow puppets spun around him like a carousel. Supported by Profound Qi, they collided with the black column, emitting a continuous "sizzling" sound, reminiscent of a water mill spinning wildly or a dark waterfall plunging into a deep pool.
Wherever Song Yan dashed, the insect swarm followed.
The insects themselves were not particularly strong and many shattered upon colliding with Song Yan’s ten shadow puppets, bursting into pieces and scattering in all directions.
But Song Yan soon noticed that those insects which should have died after exploding quickly flapped their wings again. Even though they appeared deformed, it did not hinder their continued attack. As for the ones turned to dust, an eerie force reassembled them into the "insect form," and they continued to attack.
It was like a super zombie from the Insect Realm, capable of moving even after being shredded or exploded...
This kind of attrition warfare was extremely unfair, and soon, it seemed like a lapse on Song Yan’s part allowed a Blood Blade Deer shadow puppet to lag slightly and get struck by the black tide due to insufficient Profound Qi.
In an instant, Song Yan felt the complete severance of his connection with that shadow puppet.
The Blood Blade Deer shadow puppet, which had seemed alive, turned into a lifeless piece of skin, fluttering to the ground. No matter how much Profound Qi he infused, it remained motionless.
In just a moment, the deformed soul within had been dispersed by the black insect tide.
In his moment of surprise, Song Yan could only focus more, controlling the remaining nine shadow puppets in a state of "barely holding on."
High in the sky, the taciturn female cultivator looked at him dully and coldly said, "If this is all you have, there’s no need for you to accompany me to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country. Die."
In the next moment, another black insect tide fell from the sky.
Boom!
Another shadow puppet exploded.
Song Yan’s expression froze instantly, shouting in shock, "Why can you control all the insects in the Secret Realm? Wh... why?!"
The taciturn female cultivator remained expressionless, though anyone could sense her profound disappointment.
She did not answer but continued maintaining the magic.
The black night candle soul insects converged from all directions within the Secret Realm. From the sky, they appeared as numerous long pythons, twisting and winding, rubbing against the mountains with strange scales, producing a ceaseless clamor of overlapping dense noise.
Hua Linglong saw Song Yan struggling desperately, on the brink of death, and her eyes showed an unwillingness to look. Biting her lip, she took a deep breath, intending to beg for Song Yan’s life, but was suddenly interrupted by a sudden "boom."
The black insect tide that nearly engulfed Song Yan exploded unexpectedly. Everything near the center turned into black powder and then swiftly burned.
A searing, indescribable force, like a molten furnace, erupted from the dense red-black burning insect carcasses.
Hua Linglong could barely make it out, but she recognized a red meteor soaring into the sky, colliding with the taciturn female cultivator, then dragging her down with it. Amidst the loud echoes and vibrations, the earth and insect tide were reduced to water, spreading to the surroundings.
Dust surged immediately.
When it cleared, Hua Linglong hurried closer, only to see that the taciturn female cultivator was being pressed to the ground by Song Yan with one hand.
The female cultivator’s skin was gone, and so was her face, leaving only a bizarre human-faced insect.
The insect’s four limbs were intact, but they had turned into strange insect legs, and the suckers at the bottom reinforced the adhesion of the human skin.
The human-faced insect screeched in anger, "You deceived me?!"
The entire insect was trembling.
Shaking with rage!
Hua Linglong had never seen it so angry.
Yet, upon reflection, she understood.
Before, the insect pretended to be shocked to deceive Song Yan, but was exposed by her, so it stopped. But who would have thought it would fall for the same trick by Song Yan in the blink of an eye?
It had been lulled into complacency and didn’t even have time to escape...
It wasn’t originally Song Yan’s match in solo combat. It relied on manipulating the Secret Realm to contend with Song Yan...
The gap between it and Song Yan was actually enormous, but it realized too late...
In the moment it underestimated Song Yan due to his "shock performance," it had already lost.
If it had realized sooner, it would have kept its distance and used the night candle soul insects to grind Song Yan down.
Recalling Song Yan’s mere semblance of struggle and shocked shouting, Hua Linglong couldn’t help but twitch at the corner of her mouth... and remembering his "performance" in Celestial Cloud City, her mouth twitched even more.
Nonetheless, Song Yan was exceedingly terrifying, and his explosive power far exceeded her imagination.
...
...
Song Yan looked at the bizarre human-faced giant insect without speaking, raising his finger to jab forcefully.
But he chose not to use the "Changwang Hu’s" power, instead employing the "Ghost Slayer Soul Revival Technique."
Instantly, initiating the Soul Search...
But just as he was about to devour the soul, he suddenly felt the soul he touched explode rapidly, dissipating instantly into nothingness.
Soon after, the human-faced giant insect began to decay rapidly.
Song Yan pulled back to a safe distance.
Amid the decaying human-faced giant insect, a strange golden dot emerged slowly, sesame-sized, hovering motionlessly in mid-air.
Grandmother Fox’s voice echoed in Song Yan’s mind, "Master, one day, if I were to be possessed and then soul-searched, I would also disappear like him."

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 90. Secret Realm Insect Cultivator, Divine Mysterious Thoughts (3.8K words - Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: 90. Secret Realm Insect Cultivator, Divine Mysterious Thoughts (3.8K words - Subscribe)_2
Song Yan mused as he looked at the golden glow and asked, "Are you saying it’s also controlled from the soul level? Just like the Changwang Spirit?"
Grandma Hu replied, "If that’s truly the case, the Changwang Tiger Essence Blood wouldn’t be so precious.
In fact, in the world as I know it, the Changwang Tiger Essence Blood is a unique existence among all creatures, and now only the master possesses it.
A creature like this human-faced giant insect is likely under a Divine Soul Restriction, and touching it would cause it to explode...
Or perhaps it’s a technique I don’t know.
After all, these Secret Realm Cultivators, or as they should now be called, Secret Realm Insect Cultivators.
The origin and purpose of these Secret Realm Insect Cultivators are extremely mysterious."
Song Yan squinted at the golden glow.
He carefully reached out to touch it, but his hand passed through it. Trying with his finger, black patterns spread to the fingertip, and lightly touched it...
Ping!
The golden glow was not restrained but was magically pushed away, as if despising and avoiding the black patterns.
Song Yan thought curiously, "It’s something on the soul level."
If that’s the case...
He immediately raised his hand, reaching out with five fingers toward the golden glow, with the black patterns spreading in his palm.
And with a grab, the golden glow was like falling into a cage of five fingers, crashing back and forth, yet unable to escape.
However, if Song Yan wanted to collect it, it was extremely difficult.
He tried to hide it within his Changwang Tiger black pattern, but the golden glow flickered like a "faulty light bulb" and couldn’t be hidden.
He thought of putting it into his Storage Space, but the thing was too slippery, completely unable to be placed inside.
Looking back and forth, the golden glow seemed neither like a "wandering ghost" nor "Evil Qi," nor was it a "soul fragment," making him utterly confused about how to handle it.
Sweeping his gaze around, he saw that the soul insects, although having lost control, were so densely packed that they crashed towards him like moths to a flame, forcing him to gather Profound Qi for defense at all times.
Song Yan took out a Profound Crystal from his Storage Bag, absorbing the Profound Qi to prevent any mishaps or the consumption of Profound Qi from falling below the safety line.
Chi chi chi...
The soul insects kept flying towards him, burning up and reforming, continuing their assault.
With a thought, Song Yan opened a small gap in his Profound Qi shield, allowing the soul insects to hit his body.
With the impact, he felt his soul being slightly contacted, and the insects were instantly shattered, but... they rapidly reassembled in the night.
Song Yan was left dumbfounded at the sight.
It seemed that not only were their bodies hard to destroy, but even their souls were too.
Looking around, he realized this place was not one to linger in.
His mind was occupied with what the insect cultivator said about the "Blood Pool."
He had to admit, he craved the Essence Blood of these "Night Candle Soul Insects," even considering placing it in the "next Central Palace position."
This thing was terrifying at night and was soul-related, making it a perfect match with "Changwang Tiger Blood."
However...
He looked at the golden glow, troubled. Surely he couldn’t just wear it and let it keep flashing all the time?
Or keep it grasped, imprisoning it with the Changwang Tiger’s power? That would mean wasting a hand, wouldn’t it?
...
Just then, the swarm of Night Candle Soul Insects parted, and a graceful figure approached through the swarm.
The figure walked up to Song Yan, bowed slightly, and called out, "Brother Song."
Song Yan turned to look at Hua Linglong and asked, "Brother Song?"
Hua Linglong replied earnestly, "Since Brother Song is unharmed, I would like to propose a transaction with you."
"A transaction?" Song Yan looked at her with a strange expression, yet he still asked, "What kind of transaction?"
Hua Linglong calmly said, "If you give this item to me, I will share all the information I receive with you and assist you in gaining the greatest benefits in this Secret Realm’s Candle Land.
If you still feel that’s not an equivalent exchange, we can negotiate further."
Song Yan asked curiously, "What is this?"
Hua Linglong looked intently at the golden glow and said, "It hasn’t said, but I’ve been in contact with it for a long time, and I can barely guess what it is."
She paused slightly and said, "A thought."
"A thought?"
Song Yan was taken aback.
Hua Linglong said, "But this thought is just an object containing a certain will, equally tied to the Secret Realm. If I obtain this thought, I should... learn a lot of information.
At that time, I will convey all this information to you and use the power I gain to help you profit in this Secret Realm."
Song Yan said, "You... I..."
Hua Linglong smiled and said, "If you say you’re willing to grow old with me, soar together like a pair of birds, then I will go with you, riding on a white horse, across the Jianghu. I shall heed only you, as a wife supporting her husband, raising children with you."
Song Yan said, "I have too many troubles, following me may not be a good thing. Like before, I barely escaped, hurriedly settled the people around me, and don’t even know if she’s alive or dead, or what’s happened to her. Now... I may have even greater troubles."
Hua Linglong didn’t seem surprised. She folded her hands slightly, raised her face, and looked at the mountain peaks engulfed by the black tide, speaking softly, "When my father died, I was at a loss. The rival forces of the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, even my father’s subordinates, could have turned me into a plaything at their whim...
I cried alone for a long, long time in the dark, playing the same tune on my flute through sleepless nights. Then, I told myself to be ruthless.
Afterward, I used any means necessary, with bloody hands, finally gaining control of my father’s forces, only to find things hadn’t improved—I had to become the master of the Ghostly Cyan Robe Tower, had to compete for dominance and unite the Celestial Cloud.
In Jianghu, one must always swim against the current.
If you don’t advance against the current... you can only be swept into the abyss by the vortex, lost forever."
"However, no matter how hard you try, achieving your goal is not guaranteed.
During the battle with the Lone Bamboo Gang, we had a traitor. I thought I was about to die, but then, someone suddenly appeared and took everything for me.
I was accustomed to fear, tried using drugs to control him, but he fed me the Fanatic Fans.
But this person was strange—he didn’t take advantage of me or force me to do anything. Instead, he helped me accomplish what I wanted, and my restless and fearful heart finally found peace."
She took a deep breath, closed her eyes, and smiled sweetly, as if recalling those beautiful times.
"On the day we united Celestial Cloud, when the King of Shu came to congratulate, I gave myself to him.
He... is my husband.
Then, he left.
I know he won’t come back; he’s a cultivator, and the path he treads will never intersect with a mortal’s."
Later, I went to the Snake Corpse Market, dared to enter the Demon Swamp Secret Realm, obtained what they called a Profound Root, and met it... this insect cultivator, who became my teacher.
She told me my Profound Root was excellent, the best she’d seen. I could become a great insect cultivator. I knew there was an issue with my Profound Root, but I was not afraid, instead, I was very happy."
Hua Linglong slowly opened her eyes, looking earnestly at Song Yan, and said, "My father is gone, my husband left... and now, I’m also on the path of a cultivator.
Instead of staying together amid worldly troubles, it’s better to forget each other across the Jianghu.
Brother Song, nice to meet you for the first time.
I am... Lady Ling."
Song Yan glanced at the decaying insect corpse with a human face and asked, "Have you made up your mind?"
Hua Linglong smiled slightly and said, "This path is an arrow, once drawn, there’s no turning back. Life and death are destined; if I give it my all and still die, I... will never regret it."

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 91. Lady Ling, Two-Headed Bilian Devouring Proud Insects (3.1K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: 91. Lady Ling, Two-Headed Bilian Devouring Proud Insects (3.1K words - Subscription Requested)
A moment later...
Candle Land, Secret Realm.
Hua Linglong sat cross-legged, a tiny golden light akin to a firefly fell into her abdomen, its glow radiant, making Hua Linglong’s body resemble a human skin lampshade.
The glow continued upwards, slowly spreading towards the area of the heart, but after just an inch, it completely lost its golden light, at least from the outside, Song Yan could no longer see it.
This indicated that the enigmatic relic left by the Insect Cultivator had been successfully digested by Hua Linglong.
It was at this moment that Song Yan noticed, almost miraculously, that the Night Candle Soul Worms which had been relentlessly attacking him suddenly ceased.
Above the sky, the swarm that seemed like tidewater also began retreating slowly, clearly Hua Linglong had enormous control over this place.
As the insect tide receded, the moonlight finally beamed down, spilling over the two of them.
Song Yan glanced at Hua Linglong, the latter was still with eyes closed, appearing to be in the midst of digesting.
Thus, he grasped the Profound Crystal, leaping up and landing on a nearby hilltop where he sat cross-legged, swiftly absorbing Profound Qi to replenish his strength...
...
...
"Exit, exit..."
"Is it... an illusion?"
In the distance, a half-dead loose cultivator, along with two bloodless martial artists were sprawled on the muddy ground.
Around the mud scattered numerous fragments of Profound Artifacts, and before the mud, a ring of transparent ripples suddenly appeared.
Beyond the ripples, lay a wilderness.
They paused for a moment, recalling that wilderness to be outside Chao Li County.
"Exit..."
The loose cultivator gasped, raised a hand, struck down, embedded his fingers into the mud, and started dragging his heavy body forward slowly.
Even though they were only grazed by the edges of the insect tide, even though they had hidden in a cave, even though they had exhausted all their trump cards, only three remained...
The others lay strangely on the ground, faces rigid and waxy white, yet without a single wound.
The loose cultivator even had no idea how they died.
Now having seen the exit, regardless of whether it was an illusion, he must try.
And just as he reached the exit, a chill struck his back, followed by piercing pain.
He turned his head, only to see a vicious face staring at him.
Facing his gaze, the owner of the face seemed fearful.
Yet the fear quickly turned into hysterical fury.
"Die, die, die, die!!"
Du Protector grabbed fragments of the shattered Profound Artifact Sword, crying and roaring as he relentlessly stabbed into the loose cultivator’s body.
Under normal circumstances, Du Protector wouldn’t stand a chance against the loose cultivator, yet now... with each stab, the loose cultivator gradually lost consciousness.
Du Protector continued stabbing until the spine and skull were fully pierced through, then he dropped the sword, gasping for breath, and fiercely swallowed, wiping the mud, tears, and snot off his face with his sleeve, snatched a nearby pill bottle from the ground, and ran towards the exit.
If it weren’t for these loose cultivators, his brothers wouldn’t have died.
Especially Brother Li!!
Brother Li, you died so miserably, Old Du... Old Du owes you his life!
Stumbling to the door, Du Protector lunged forward, slamming into the rippling circle, landing onto a patch of grass.
Though still mud, it was entirely different from that bizarre secret realm.
Du Protector struggled to flip over, facing the sky, yet after waiting awhile, no other surviving brother emerged, glancing again, the door to the secret realm had vanished.
Du Protector remained silent for a long time, tightly gripping the pill bottle, recalling the days of eating and drinking freely together, tears uncontrollably trickled down his cheeks.
...
...
The morning light dispelled Candle Land’s chill, Soul Worms retreated back into the shadows.
The bright morning breeze blew through the valley, refreshing through the forest.
Song Yan glanced down at Hua Linglong.
The latter was still not awake, seemingly still digesting the golden light she referred to as "thought."
He furrowed his brows, but feeling his own depletion replenished, he stood upright, internally asking, "Have you ever seen such a situation?"
Fox Granny replied, "I’ve never seen it, but if speaking of thought, it likely pertains to a Purple Mansion Realm powerhouse."
"Purple Mansion Realm..."
"Profound Qi circulates through the body, transforming flesh to reach human limits, then establishes a Dantian, this is Refining Profound.
Using the power of external objects, blood converges at the heart, elevating life levels, this is Crimson Palace.
And Purple Mansion extends beyond Crimson Palace Realm, achieving profound life levels enables spirit upliftment, it is the blossoming of a Divine Soul seed in the new flesh soil.
However... if life levels are even slightly weak, Purple Mansion Realm remains unattainable.
The Nanwu Sword Sect, and even many cultivators within the Puppet Sect, due to the Crimson Palace Pill formula, can only seek stability by absorbing the blood of Refining Profound Level demon beasts.
Thus, even if the Nine Palaces are complete, they are merely false Nine Palaces... because Crimson Palace Realm is the utmost they can reach."
Song Yan glanced at Hua Linglong, suddenly asking, "Having absorbed someone else’s thought, especially possibly a thought of a Purple Mansion Realm powerhouse, is she still herself?"
Fox Granny answered, "I believe it’s much like a person undergoing significant change, their nature becomes more adaptable.
"But even if that were the case, it would only be temporary; if her own will and thoughts grow stronger in the future, they will change again. How could one say she is not herself?"
Song Yan had a deep understanding of this point.
Human thoughts can change in an instant, in one thought a friend, the next an enemy.
Master Shi taught him a valuable lesson.
He would not gamble on human nature.
At this moment, he certainly wouldn’t make a move against Hua Linglong, but to truly trust her wholeheartedly was difficult... just as Hua Linglong herself mentioned before, "On our first meeting, I was Lady Ling."
Thus, Song Yan glanced once more at Lady Ling, then, without a word, stood up and shot into the depths of the Secret Realm.
He intended to find the Blood Pool himself, take the Essence Blood, and leave swiftly.
This search took up an entire day, yet the Secret Realm was eerily vast; if the Blood Pool was hidden underground somewhere, Song Yan simply couldn’t find it.
As dusk began to settle, Song Yan grew hesitant.
Should he remain in the Secret Realm, or temporarily leave?
Just then, he heard undisguised movements behind him. With a slight tilt of his head, he spotted a figure in a Profound Robe with a Ghost Face mask floating closer and stopping mid-air. The eyes hidden behind that Ghost Face mask appeared somewhat stiff and wooden.
"Brother Song, I will keep my promise to you, please follow me."
Lady Ling’s demeanor changed, as did her voice, becoming colder.
Song Yan’s expression slightly tensed, as he secretly commanded ten Puppets.
Now, although he was in the Early Stage Crimson Palace, he had only secured one of the Nine Palaces Blood.
While the Changwang Tiger Blood was indeed supreme in the Divine Soul World, its performance elsewhere was mediocre; the abilities it provided were merely "strong Divine Soul defense power" and "control over the Changwang spirits." As it stood, these offered little to enhance Song Yan’s "Magic system."
Therefore, Song Yan’s strongest means of attack remains the "Hundred Forms Demon Body," but... with the addition of Granny Fox’s Shadow Puppet, the power provided by the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" was also on the rise.
After ensuring these preparations, Song Yan then followed the fleeting Lady Ling ahead.
The two of them flitted through the dim mountains.
Mountain shadows loomed impressively, black clouds shrouding the moon...
In the darkness, large patches of squirming began to emerge.
Lady Ling said, "Brother Song, I have gained a lot of additional memories, though still chaotic, I have organized some useful to you."
Song Yan replied, "Please proceed."
Lady Ling said, "Brother Song must be puzzled about the origins of these Secret Realms.
From my memories, I vaguely understand that these Secret Realms were opened by ancient cultivators for unknown purposes.
Later, among the cultivators, there were Purple Mansion powerhouses who utilized these Secret Realms to foster Demon Beasts and Demon Insects.
The Purple Mansion Realm is a level above the Crimson Palace Realm.
Those Purple Mansion powerhouses would modify the Secret Realm’s environment, then use a Secret Technique to integrate their Divine Souls into the initial Demon Beasts and Demon Insects, ensuring the Demon Beasts and Demon Insects within these Secret Realms remained under their control, even after thousands of years.
"Furthermore, they discovered that these Secret Realms were extraordinarily sensitive to Spirit, so they refined them further, turning the Secret Realm into a weapon. They could open and close the Secret Realm at will with a thought, and even carry it with them.
During confrontations, they could open the Secret Realm, letting Demon Insects and Demon Beasts out to kill, or deceive enemies into the Secret Realm.
In short... the Secret Realm is an extraordinary weapon of attack and defense for Purple Mansion level cultivators."
"The golden thought I absorbed was the remaining thought of an Insect Cultivator Purple Mansion powerhouse.
I derived this thought from the Profound Root of the Demon Swamp Secret Realm, using it as a foundation for cultivation, enabling me to absorb the legacy left by Granny Pearl.
This Candle Land Secret Realm was previously controlled by that powerhouse.
Granny Pearl brought me here because the emergence of this Secret Realm caught her attention. She meant to acquire this Secret Realm and incidentally brought some cultivators here for the Demon Insects to feed on.
But she truly didn’t expect you to be here."
Song Yan processed this information.
To be frank, he couldn’t help but develop a yearning towards the Secret Realm.
However, if he were to absorb someone else’s thoughts to control the Secret Realm, that was impossible.
"Lady Ling, do you know what she plans to do with me at the Mountain and Sea Demon Country?"
Lady Ling said, "This thought does not contain that information, but having stayed with her for a long time, I know a little.
It seems you took something from Granny Fox, and now, it’s known almost by every cultivator out there... Granny Pearl has me under duress, partly looking for you.
But as to what she wants to take you to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country for, I’m not really sure."
Although Lady Ling wore a Ghost Face mask, and her expression was unseen, she seemed to be in contemplation, recalling. After a long while, she suddenly said, "Mountain and Sea Demon Country, Pingfeng Mountain, Dual-Headed Vilan Worm clan.
Granny Pearl... appears to be connected with that clan."
Dual-Headed Vilan Worm?
Song Yan had already regarded Granny Fox as the substitute for his past life’s "Du Niang," directly asking in his mind, "What is this?"
Granny Fox remained silent for a moment.
Song Yan could feel its fear.
After a long while, Granny Fox said in a trembling voice, "This matter, it’s gotten severe..."
"But why is this happening?"
"Master, many things must have happened in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country that I am unaware of."
"The full name of the Dual-Headed Vilan Worm is... Dual-Headed Vilan Man-Eating Proud Worm."
"Proud Worm is the destination of all demon bees, with the Dual-Headed ones as elites among them. The infusion of Vilan Blood into their clan is especially mysterious, I don’t even know what that is..."
"The Dual-Headed Vilan Man-Eating Proud Worm is a race at the top of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, far from us of the Multi-tailed Fox Race, with hardly any interactions. Why would they meddle in our affairs..."

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 92. Brand New ’Cave Mansion’ (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: 92. Brand New ’Cave Mansion’ (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
After an incense stick’s time...
Candle Land.
...
"Gurgle, gurgle, gurgle..."
The small blood-colored pool, only about a foot in diameter and half an arm deep, contained only a few crystalline blood crystals floating inside.
Song Yan unceremoniously collected all those blood crystals into his prepared bottle, then continued to fill it.
Madam Ling kept her promise and brought him to the deepest part of the Secret Realm’s blood pool in Candle Land.
From the outside, this place looked like a shadow, wrapped inside and out by countless Night Candle Soul Insects.
Song Yan filled his container to the brim with the insect blood of the Night Candle Soul Insects.
This blood pool was really small, and who knows how many years it had accumulated so much insect blood, but now he had taken away the core part of it.
However, this part was really too little, and Song Yan estimated it could only be used for the "left and right palaces" blood.
Once he finished collecting, Song Yan put away the insect blood bottle and then looked at Madam Ling, asking, "What are your plans afterward?"
Madam Ling said, "I will first handle matters here in Candle Land, then return to Snake Corpse Market, and then cultivate diligently in the Secret Realm for a long time. Whether it takes ten years or decades, I will buy the necessary items for cultivation from the market, hoping to break through to the Crimson Palace Realm as soon as possible."
Having said that, she stood quietly, her graceful figure long concealed by the cloak, her delicate face also veiled behind the sinister ghost face.
"Once I break through to the Crimson Palace Realm, there will be a day we meet again, my friend."
The two exchanged a silent farewell and then parted ways.
Madam Ling waved her hand to open the exit of the Secret Realm. Song Yan stepped forward...
One step, two steps, three steps...
Suddenly, Song Yan stopped his pace.
He slightly turned his head. Madam Ling had already turned around, walking into the depths of the insect swarm. The dense, rustling shadows parted like tidal waves, allowing her passage... yet they quickly closed again behind her.
However, seemingly sensing Song Yan’s pause, Madam Ling turned back with some surprise, asking, "Friend, is there something else?"
Song Yan asked directly, "I know you’ve absorbed that mighty thought, and your nature might have changed, but I still want to ask you something."
Madam Ling said, "Please, go ahead."
Song Yan said, "Do you want to harm me?"
Madam Ling was taken aback, then shook her head, saying, "You’re overthinking it. I’ve merely absorbed some memories, gained more common knowledge, and my heart has developed a fondness for insects, while my desire for power has grown more intense. But, I am still me."
Song Yan said, "Then why don’t I go back to Snake Corpse Market with you?"
Madam Ling: ????
"Frien...friend, aren’t you going out to seek opportunities?"
The cold Madam Ling suddenly stammered a bit.
A feeling suddenly welled up in her heart, as if "this shouldn’t be the case."
Song Yan said, "Centering around Snake Corpse Market, I will search for external blood that suits me to fill the Nine Palaces.
If you need any cultivation items, in my travels, I can help you keep an eye out.
You know, so many people out there are looking for me. Staying in Chao Li County was just to hide. Is there anywhere better to hide than in your Secret Realm?"
Madam Ling remained silent.
But, isn’t this the best outcome?
The person she longed for suddenly decided not to leave.
She gained a strong ally and newfound hope of breaking through to the Crimson Palace.
However, in the next instant, Madam Ling suddenly removed the ghost face, revealing the pretty face behind it.
The face was still delicate, but her pupils had undergone a strange change, becoming somewhat blurry, matte, and upon close inspection... were actually bizarre compound eyes.
The pupils were wooden, only covered with a thin film outside the ghost face, concealing the compound eyes, but as the pupils lacked focus, they naturally appeared stiff.
Madam Ling said, "Do you remember the human-faced worm you killed? You asked if I had thought it through... Now, it’s my turn to ask you."
Song Yan nodded, "Of course."
Saying this, he looked toward a place on the mountainside of the Secret Realm with a good view, "Let’s build a small log cabin there."
Then he looked at a clearing, "This area can be used to raise some demon beasts, and here, you can raise some pigs, but can you control these insects not to eat them?"
After learning from Granny Hu that the "Changwang Tiger Blood" matter had blown up for some inexplicable reason, even involving clans too daunting to provoke merely by name, he dismissed any thoughts of venturing out.
He wanted to find a safe place to settle for a few decades before considering anything else.
And Chao Li County obviously couldn’t provide the seclusion he needed anymore.
Hua Linglong was going to cultivate in the Secret Realm, and he happened to hide there, isn’t it just perfect?
Madam Ling was utterly speechless, or perhaps stunned, her mind a blank.
The direction of events had completely exceeded her expectations...
She found that this man was actually already thinking about how to build a house.
She had decided to never trust anyone in her future path of cultivation, but if she had to choose someone to trust, this man would undoubtedly be the one.
Madam Ling couldn’t help it and gently grinned, then bowed, "My friend wants to stay, and I naturally can’t ask for more. But standing before you now is Madam Ling, not Hua Linglong. If you want to interact with me as you did before, that’s not possible."
Song Yan chuckled, "In the past, it was Hua Rong who interacted with you; now it’s Song Yan.
Madam Ling, pleased to meet you.
My name is... Song Yan.
By the way, is there a blood pool in the Demon Swamp Secret Realm?"
Madam Ling covered her mouth and laughed, "Yes, but after I return, it will take some time before I can control it, and even then, I’m not sure if that blood will suit you.
There will also be some risks on the way because the Puppet Sect has been sending people to search for you around Celestial Cloud City, and we might encounter them on the way back."

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 92. Brand New "Cave Mansion" (4.3K Words - Seek Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: 92. Brand New "Cave Mansion" (4.3K Words - Seek Subscription)_2
...
...
Candle Land Secret Realm, the insect tide like a sea tide, rising and falling, carried a peculiar dark allure.
Song Yan sat on a cliff. The mountain he was on had no insect tide.
The boundary was a winding stream...
In the secret realm, the rivers were generally stagnant, but this river was exceptionally clear, with hints of exotic flowers and herbs purifying the source.
East of the river was where Ling Lady controlled the realm, gathering the insect tide there.
West of the river was the dwelling Ling Lady assigned to Song Yan.
This river, like a boundary, separated the two. During daily cultivation, neither was allowed to cross to avoid mutual disturbance.
Song Yan settled down, crossing his legs and focusing on the cultivation technique section on the Remnant of the Blood Fusion Technique.
After a moment...
An information line popped up:
[Please Select Life Force Investment]
...
...
[You successfully extracted a thread of Night Candle Soul Worm Blood, simultaneously operating the Blood Fusion Technique. This time, since your physique has greatly improved, the poison did not kill you. But as the blood extraction increased, a subtle pain began to emerge in your heart, which you struggled to suppress. Three days later, you were poisoned to death.]
Song Yan opened his eyes.
Indeed, directly and brutally extracting this foreign blood was extremely lethal. It was like continuously directing poison into one’s heart. Human Race cultivators, without the formula for the Crimson Palace Pill of this blood, absolutely dare not consume it.
The level of pill masters in a certain region also greatly restricts the power of cultivators in that area.
However, he was an exception.
Song Yan continued his attempts.
After dying hundreds of times, he finally completely extracted the Night Candle Soul Worm Blood.
[You skillfully operate the Blood Fusion Technique, simultaneously extracting profound qi, accommodating, and digesting the Night Candle Soul Worm Blood...]
[In the first year, you extracted 30 threads of profound qi, digesting a thread of Night Candle Soul Worm Blood...]
[In the hundredth year, you extracted 3000 threads of profound qi, the Night Candle Soul Worm Blood had merged into your body and was positioned in the Central Right Palace together with the Changwang Tiger Race Blood.]
Song Yan opened his eyes and glanced at the panel.
[Life Force: 31/14626]
Slaughtering pigs in Chao Li County added quite a bit of life force to him, now a hundred years was really insignificant.
He surveyed the surroundings.
The profound qi in this secret realm was quite ordinary, probably comparable to places like Cold Pool Valley and South Bamboo Peak.
Moreover, he hadn’t used elixirs, furnaces, or profound jade, nor was he in an Evil Land or using secret medicines or techniques commonly utilized at the Crimson Palace Realm, but simply relied on extracting profound qi from the surrounding environment for cultivation, naturally progressing extremely slowly.
Now, he could feel two different mystical forces permeating around him, and although his body hadn’t undergone significant changes, it was obviously stronger than before.
Once he finds suitable Central Left Palace Blood, he will breakthrough to mid-stage Crimson Palace in one go.
By then, Granma Fox’s Multi-tailed Fox Race Essence Blood would be the fixed palace blood.
...
...
Several days passed.
The trust between Song Yan and Ling Lady began to gradually increase.
formerly Song Yan appeared before Hua Linglong using a fake face, and now Hua Linglong absorbed a single thought from the insect cultivator, it could be said that both are no longer "Hua Rong" and "Hua Linglong."
Though neither spoke about it, there was always a silent vigilance in their hearts.
After successfully absorbing Night Candle Soul Worm Blood without any obstruction, Song Yan left the secret realm several times, but he encountered no obstacles entering and exiting.
Ling Lady controlling the secret realm did experience a noticeable weak state once, collapsing on the ground motionless, upon seeing it, Song Yan rushed over to offer assistance as much as possible.
The trust between them was rebuilt in these small daily details.
On this day, seeing Ling Lady nearly fully control the realm, Song Yan thought about gazing at Chao Li County from afar, then departed, standing on a distant hilltop, releasing his divine sense.
Upon releasing it, he couldn’t help but frown.
...
...
"I am the main wife, the master’s property should be divided by me."
"We are all concubines, who is nobler than whom? Haha..."
"The master’s money is mine."
"Mine!"
"I erected a clothes mound for him, what about you?"
"I even built a Changsheng shrine for him immediately!"
