The two beautiful concubines of Master Li, regardless of how intimate they were with Master Li before, manipulating things on the bed, clearly had no feelings for Master Li.
After his death, neither cared, but now they were arguing fiercely for the family property.
While the two women quarreled, two officials approached outside of the Peach Garden Meat Shop.
The left-side official stroked his beard, looking stealthily at the shop door, glanced around, and whispered with the one on the right.
"Master Li is dead, only two unstable concubines are left in the residence. Why not... shall we go in and have a look?"
"Sure, let’s go!"
If Master Li were alive, these officials wouldn’t dare be so bold; but now, they walked enthusiastically, prepared to take advantage of the situation and perhaps even collect the two beautiful concubines.
However, the two officials had only taken a few steps when several people rushed out of the alley, blocking the door.
The officials looked closely at the newcomers, frowned, and said, "Flying Knife Gang people... why stop us?"
One person said, "On the orders of Leader Du."
"Leader Du?" The officials were puzzled for a moment, then burst into laughter.
The other laughed so hard he leaned forward and back, saying, "Which Leader Du, haha!!"
As soon as the words fell, footsteps were heard from afar, accompanied by an eerie sound like metal and stone.
"It’s this Leader Du."
The officials turned to look, only to see a vicious man with protruding temples wrapped in brocade, approaching from a distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 92. Brand-New "Cave Mansion" (4.3K Words - Request Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: 92. Brand-New "Cave Mansion" (4.3K Words - Request Subscription)_3
The former Protector Du transformed into Leader Du, and with the elixir obtained from the cultivator, combined with the residual Profound Qi Pill from the previous leader, his power advanced by leaps and bounds in just a few days.
"Do you think our Flying Saber Gang lost many experts, so we can be easily bullied by small fry like you guys?"
Leader Du asked coldly.
Saying this, he grabbed the official’s saber and examined it. Suddenly, with a point of his finger, a "ding" sounded, and the saber snapped.
The official, terrified, scrambled away in panic.
From afar, Leader Du shouted, "The Taoyuan Meat Shop is under my protection. Next time you want to do anything here, you’d better come to the Flying Saber Gang first! Understand?!"
Moments later...
Lin Xianxing and two other concubines hurriedly exited the mansion, bowed respectfully, and thanked repeatedly.
Leader Du glanced at them, his expression softened significantly, and in a hoarse voice said, "Rest assured, as long as I am alive, no one will dare trouble you as you tend to the meat shop and the inn business."
The two concubines expressed their gratitude repeatedly.
Leader Du then gave a cold snort and said, "But let me make it clear, Brother Li and I are of one mind, and this time he saved my life.
So, I am only protecting his concubines.
If there ever comes a day when you’re not, I’ll be the first to kill you!"
His fierce triangular eyes were filled with violent light, scaring the two concubines so much they fell to the ground, watching Leader Du leave, at a loss for words.
...
...
Song Yan watched this scene and chuckled lightly, having not expected such an outcome.
In the forest, he walked leisurely, spreading his Divine Sense, found two wild boars, knocked them out, and planned to take them back to the Secret Realm to raise them. Once the scale was large, he could resume his skin making work there.
The sun was setting, and dusk was falling.
Song Yan was about to return to the Secret Realm when he suddenly sensed intense footsteps several miles away on a small path.
That path led from Hanlin City to Chao Li County.
What kind of people could be coming at this time?
And in such a hurry?
Song Yan frowned slightly, enveloped the area with his Divine Sense, and saw a group of more than thirty black-clad masked men with hidden deadly weapons, moving swiftly.
There seemed to be a conversation between the two leading figures.
"Boss, you’re so wise, strike when the enemy is weak. The Flying Saber Gang suffered heavy losses, this is the perfect time to take over, and in doing so... our Silver Axe Gang will have expanded our territory."
"Haha, no need to flatter, I’ll make you the Hall Master of this place when the time comes."
"Thank you, boss."
"Hm? Who’s there?"
The leading masked man suddenly noticed a figure standing under an old tree in front of them.
That figure raised a hand with a wave, and the sky turned murky, with ghostly mist enveloping them, chilling winds blowing. The distorted figures of men and women, young and old, like stretched noodles, shrieked as they flew out from the sleeve, and the ghastly forms launched at the group with the wind.
In an instant, all thirty black-clad masked men stood motionless.
The figure snapped its fingers lightly.
The black-clad masked men uniformly drew their knives and began hacking at each other until they were dead.
The figure waved its sleeve again, and the ghosts returned.
The "Night Candle Soul Worm Blood" gave his ghosts the terrifying regenerative ability of "Night Candle Soul Worms" in the dark.
They dared to confront living souls now.
Where they once dared not possess living bodies, they could inhabit briefly now.
Even if scorched or shattered, as long as it was night, they could quickly... reassemble and recover.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 93. Yin and Yang Cultivation, People Leave Shadows Remain (4.1K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: 93. Yin and Yang Cultivation, People Leave Shadows Remain (4.1K words - Please Subscribe)
The chang ghost strikes the divine soul, seizing possession and committing suicide...
This kind of unusual divine soul attack, Song Yan is also using for the first time.
After he finished casting, he grabbed the two still-dazed wild boars and gracefully departed, walking through the forest path that wasn’t quite a mountain trail, stepping on last winter’s fallen leaves and old vines.
The crisp sound of "kacha kacha" relaxed his mood while he started contemplating his current power.
He now actually has three "spell systems," with three corresponding attack methods.
...
First, the magic based on "Shadow Puppet."
This is based on puppetry, the Shadow Master methods in "Hundred Forms Divine Control," and his own understanding of "Hundred Forms Demon Body." It can be said to be a combination of offense and defense, but to be blunt... this is a "summoning spell" with a long "casting animation."
He must first activate the shadow puppet to use "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
And "Hundred Forms Demon Body" also involves a brief process of devouring and self-transformation.
If he truly encounters a strong enemy, the opponent may not give him the time to complete the spell.
This determines that his immediate emergency outburst capability is a shortcoming.
However, because of the strength of the shadow puppet, the upper limit of "Hundred Forms Demon Body" is extremely high, at least Song Yan feels that using it for the entire Crimson Palace Realm is no problem.
This is a kind of bug spell that can be learned at the Refining Profound level, yet remains powerful in the Crimson Palace.
...
Second, the sword system spell.
This is based on the "Illusionary Sword Transformation Manual," further modified by his own Evil Qi with the Sword Control Technique.
Fast explosion, quick action, straightforward and direct, although not very functional, it only serves to "kill kill kill," but its virtue lies in having no "casting animation," being simple, and ready to use anytime, anywhere.
Song Yan’s "Black and White Double Evil" is still pretty good, but after all, this is a spell intended for the Refining Profound level...
...
Third, divine soul offense and defense.
Using "Changwang Tiger Blood" as the core, it makes him invincible in resisting divine soul attacks while also accumulating cheng ghosts.
The acquisition of "Night Candle Soul Worm Blood" has given the chang ghosts the ability to strike brutally at night.
This method is the most effective in killing without a trace.
But... in battles of the same realm, except for the bizarre attack method, it is considered weaker.
...
During his time in recluse at Chao Li County, Grandma Fox had talked to him about "Crimson Palace Realm" spells.
Obtaining "essence blood" is of course the first step, which is similar to the realm improvement at the Refining Profound level.
Further mastering spells can maximize the power of the realm.
In this regard, demons and the human race differ.
Demons, any race that can become demons, are inherently superior to humans in "physical quality." This is evident from the fact that their bodily organs and skin can be made into Profound Artifacts, while humans’ cannot.
Therefore, demons will develop a set of "essence blood secret techniques" suitable for themselves based on their own racial blood.
The human race, on the other hand, needs to use the Crimson Palace Pill to break through the realm, so in terms of "blood" itself in the Crimson Palace Realm, it is inevitably weaker than demons.
However, the human race does not limit itself to researching "secret techniques of the race’s essence blood" like demons. They broadly utilize external objects like weapons, talismans, arrays, and shadow puppets.
Hence, the human race focuses on "spells," with integrated essence blood as supplemental.
Although Song Yan has obtained ’Changwang Tiger Blood,’ to move further, he can either spend thousands of years in a "black room" with "no practice, no communication, making things behind closed doors" to comprehend spells, or he can "stand on the shoulders of giants" to seek the "essence blood secret techniques" of the Changwang Tiger Race and the human race’s "Crimson Palace Level spells."
History and power progress in practice, in the life-and-death collisions of various geniuses and races, and even in various accidental coincidences; making things behind closed doors for a hundred million, a billion, five billion years still results in a nautilus remaining a nautilus, and a monkey remaining a monkey.
The greatest role of his "Remaining Life Dao Fruit" is not creating from nothing, but skipping "others’ cultivation time," avoiding "others’ potential cultivation errors, and even going into deviation," as well as a certain extent of "spell mutation," creating stronger spells.
...
...
Returning to the Candle Land Secret Realm, Song Yan felt similar to when he was on the South Bamboo Peak, returning to the Suspended Room, and returning to the Cave Mansion.
It was about working all day, then going home to sleep at night.
The winding brook trickled, flickering like a jiggling silver ribbon in the moonlight.
Soil, tree-leaf moisture from the primordial forest mixed together and wafted into his nose.
He chose a woodland by the river, tossed the two wild boars there, and then leapt to the top of the cliff.
Here, he had already built a wooden house facing the sea of clouds, witnessing the tides rising in the morning, falling in the evening...
However, even though the fog rises at night, it’s no longer a bloody mist, nor does it hide specters anymore.
Inside the wooden house, there’s only a hard wooden bed.
If any bedding, daily necessities, or household items were needed, one would have to go to the town to purchase them.
He entered the house, lay down on the wooden bed immediately, rested his head on his arms, stretched his legs comfortably, and was taking a short nap when suddenly he heard noise in the distance.
Song Yan darted out for a look, only to see the two wild boars he left in the woodland by the river had woken up and were now frantically running around, making "oink oink" sounds.
Suddenly, the two wild boars made "I’m about to be killed" noises, screaming sharply, their legs turning soft as they madly dashed westward.
In the east, on the small river, a Profound Robe maiden was seen supporting a bamboo pole, standing on a small log, with her eyes covered by a black veil, flanked by a clump of black clouds, coming in this direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 93. Yin-Yang Cultivation Together, A Person Leaves but the Shadow Remains (4.1K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: 93. Yin-Yang Cultivation Together, A Person Leaves but the Shadow Remains (4.1K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
"Thud," the wooden boat docked on the shore.
The graceful lady put down the bamboo pole, looked up towards Song Yan on the cliff and asked loudly, "Is it convenient, fellow Daoist?"
Song Yan said, "Come up and talk."
Madam Ling stepped onto the black cloud, and the numerous "Night Candle Soul Worms" acted like Profound Artifacts, carrying her to the cliff and then buzzing away.
Madam Ling bowed and said, "Brother Song, do you have any plans regarding dual cultivation?"
Song Yan: ???
Madam Ling said, "Little sister doesn’t know much about fellow Daoist, but according to my knowledge of the Puppet Sect, it usually involves abducting women to serve as furnaces, discarded as dregs if unsuccessful. Brother, do you still intend to act this way?"
Without waiting for a response, she continued, "If that’s the case, brother need not worry about my presence. Just bring girls from outside here for dual cultivation."
Song Yan shook his head and said, "This is not my intention; since I’ve come here... naturally, it won’t be so."
Madam Ling’s lips slightly curved as she said, "Little sister has a copy of the Nanwu Sword Sect, a righteous Yin Yang cultivation method. Although not as domineering as the Puppet Sect’s guiding art, it complements rather than plunders.
If a man and woman cultivate together, both can benefit.
Since brother doesn’t intend to use the old Puppet Sect method, would you be willing to try this righteous dao dual cultivation method with little sister?
Although dual cultivation doesn’t compare to the absorption of profound Qi and profound jade, it’s still a method to increase one’s profound Qi.
Having a cultivation partner is always a good thing.
Little sister, though focused on cultivation, holds no dislike for brother; it’s just unknown what your intentions are?"
Song Yan nodded, this could help Madam Ling.
At the same time, for him, it’s like revisiting the old path.
...
...
A moment later...
Madam Ling’s quiet reading voice came from the small room.
She seemed to have taken out a booklet and read according to it.
"A person shouldn’t lack the interaction of Yin and Yang, lest illness ensues sitting idle. If indulging in desires without moderation brings harm to one’s lifespan. Those skilled in techniques can reverse energy to nourish the brain..."
After a long time, Madam Ling asked, "Brother, did you understand?"
Song Yan slightly perceived and felt that what was mentioned was indeed gentler than the Puppet Sect’s techniques.
The Puppet Sect emphasized unilateral absorption, the faster and more aggressive the better, leaving the absorbed side extremely weakened afterward.
While this righteous sect one stresses slow and steady progress, moderation and cannot be rushed, thus... compared to the Demon Sect’s "anytime, anywhere, full absorption" notion, the righteous dao’s side limits to "once a day, succeed or not must end."
A moment...
There were movements in the dark.
"Brother, don’t move, please activate the incantation of this righteous sect’s guiding method."
"Brother, do you feel it? Ah... it counts as a failure today..."
...
...
The next day, evening...
"Brother, to prevent failure, we should agree on the count of three."
A moment later...
"Almost... just a little bit more."
...
...
The third day...
"Brother, today we should refrain from any unnecessary actions, since it’s cultivation, then just focus on cultivation!
Misstep by a millimeter results in a thousand-mile error, if we fail again, then this day would be wasted."
Madam Ling’s voice was somewhat cold.
The previous two days of failure had brought a slight irritation to her heart.
Song Yan nodded, straightening her up, though the latter’s eyes were covered with black gauze, Song Yan could still feel a gaze, perceive seriousness in her demeanor.
"Let’s begin then."
"Brother, please start first."
After a long time...
Madam Ling murmured, "Wonderful, finally... succeeded."
Then she swiftly rose, composed and dignified, saying, "Brother Song, little sister’s control is complete.
Only now does she feel the great opportunity. If it weren’t for brother’s help, I wouldn’t know what the Granny with Pearls planned to do to me."
Song Yan wasn’t interested in this method of "absorbing others’ thoughts, thereby controlling a portion of their inheritance," as such opportunities were fraught with endless troubles and unpredictability, thus he wasn’t particularly envious of Madam Ling’s control over Candle Land, at this moment he merely showed concern: "Do you feel any unusual thoughts arising in your mind that don’t belong to you?"
Madam Ling shook her head, then said, "Brother Song, do you have any matters unfinished here?"
"None."
"Then tomorrow morning, let’s set out for Snake Corpse Market Town.
It’s a long journey, and both of us are wanted around the world...
Therefore, little sister plans to take a detour, skirting from the southernmost edge of Barbaric Land in Southern Wu to Western Shu.
This will take more than twice the usual travel time, brother ought to be patient."
Song Yan pondered for a moment, curiously asking, "Can I keep hiding in your secret realm throughout the journey and not show up?"
Madam Ling nodded.
Song Yan couldn’t help but marvel to himself: the methods of Purple Mansion level cultivators are truly unimaginable. Compared to attacking with "profound Qi profound treasure," using "secret realm" as a magical treasure is like a "groundbreaking industrial revolution." Someone like Madam Ling, amongst Refining Profound cultivators, is definitely considered powerful.
The previous Granny with Pearls, able to establish Snake Corpse Market Town with a Refining Profound level body, overseeing an entire market town of cultivators, wasn’t without reason...
...
...
The facts proved, even though the world was chaotic, its effect on the corners of Barbaric Land was actually rather insignificant.
But this desolate territory, unnoticed by cultivators and nobles, was countless times worse than Chao Li County. Here, not even Jianghu factions bothered to occupy the land, and the people might only have partial knowledge of which dynasty ruled them...
Yet despite this... this place was not a sanctuary of good men but a paradise for bandits.
The bandits hid in the mountains, exterminated without end, killed endlessly;
Similarly, the bandits wouldn’t descend the mountains to attack the surrounding villages and counties.
Although there might be suspicions of the government raising bandits to boost itself and repeatedly going rural to meet quotas, isn’t it rather the bandits ’farming’ the villages and counties?
Half a month later, in a mountain wilderness under the moonlight...
Madam Ling was surrounded by thirty or more vile bandits.
The leading bandit shrewdly shouted, "Though you are wrapped tightly, that posterior of yours is quite protruding, surely a pretty young lady skin! Why not return to the mountain with the lord, enjoy the good life, the lord promises you comfort."
A bandit behind chimed in with a jest, "Little lady, after tasting the flavor of grandpas, you won’t want to leave, why bother walking away?"
Madam Ling said no more and barely moved her fingers.
Another bandit, seemingly knowledgeable, warned, "Don’t move! We’re over thirty people, and you’re alone, even if skilled in hidden weapons as a martial artist, today you still should resign to fate!"
However, his words had just fallen when the bandits heard a buzzing sound.
Around the Profound Robe young lady a black cloud instantly enveloped her, upon closer examination, it was rustling with tiny black dots, each a peculiar insect smaller than a wild bee.
The black cloud spread instantly, exploded into black mist, engulfing all over thirty vile bandits.
The next moment...
Every single one of the thirty-plus bandits fell to the ground without any injuries, yet they had...completely stopped breathing!
The Profound Robe young lady’s mind shifted, the black mist contracted, forming a black cloud, and dissipated like flowing water around her.
She was about to continue forward but abruptly halted, as a man suddenly appeared beside her.
Madam Ling curiously asked, "Brother, why did you come out?"
"Wait a moment."
Song Yan said and then squatted next to a bandit, raised his finger, and began soul searching.
But upon searching, he found he couldn’t proceed...
The souls of these mortals had been completely shattered by the soul worms Madam Ling released.
Madam Ling said, "These bandits deserved death, they wouldn’t have any useful information either. Brother should refrain from excessive soul searching, as engaging too much leads to cluttered thoughts, unfavorable for cultivation."
Song Yan nodded, he was used to soul searching, and wanted to acquire information, but the most important thing... was to find two suitable identities for leaving behind the "Granny Fox" and another Fox Demon Shadow Puppet.
Although the "Granny Fox" shadow puppet couldn’t perform any magic, its innate illusion techniques and body techniques were at the middle stage of the Crimson Palace, already top-notch on these lands.
When the "Granny Fox" casts illusions, unless the Puppet Sect or Nanwu Sword Sect high levels are watching her, she is completely undetectable.
This is excellent.
Even though he wanted to retreat to Snake Corpse Market Town, he also needed to leave a shadow puppet in Wu Kingdom for remote control, to search for suitable techniques and find blood suitable for placing in his "Central Right Palace."
"Next time, leave one alive," Song Yan said.
Madam Ling responded, "Since brother requests, little sister will comply."

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 94. Secret Realm Construction, Two Identities (3.1K Words - Subscribe Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: 94. Secret Realm Construction, Two Identities (3.1K Words - Subscribe Requested)
A few days later...
"Ouch, ouch, ouch~~~"
The shrill sound of pigs echoed at the top of the cliff.
But the sound soon faded and then disappeared.
Song Yan swiftly killed with a single blow, then took a bucket to catch the fresh pig blood, and skillfully skinned and cut the meat. After hanging the pig skin aside, he began to process the meat.
As luck would have it, a few days ago, after being robbed by bandits, they ventured to the mountaintop and actually found a bandit’s hideout, pretending to be vagabonds of Jianghu, robbing the bandit’s mountain.
It turns out this bandit hideout was quite wealthy, so... they got pigs, got sheep, got pots and pans, and also collected quite a bit of alcohol.
Although these drinks were not as good as the fine wine from the city, many were self-brewed from mountain villages, mostly fruit wine, and had a unique taste.
Song Yan built pigsties and sheepfolds, leaving enough pigs and sheep, letting males and females live separately, and every few days bringing them together to mate and give birth. And today... he decided to first try his hand on a pig.
By evening, besides cooking ribs and meat soup, he also completed the pig skin shadow puppet, and after successfully seeing "[You have absorbed the remaining lifespan of a pig: 10 years]" such information, Song Yan continued to make. However, he did not make it into a living shadow puppet through summoning, but instead turned it into "spicy pig skin," and also made a portion of "pig skin jelly" to accompany the drink.
"So it is... Old Master Li..."
Madam Ling was stunned to see those familiar dishes.
Song Yan said, "Did I not tell you before?"
"No..."
Madam Ling had previously thought that Song Yan had sneaked into the secret realm team, but she did not expect him to actually be Old Master Li.
As for others related to the Flying Knife Gang, she might not know much, but she initially went for Old Master Li’s famous skills, knowing more or less that the old master was a decent and honest local, with unrivaled grilled pork and pig skin, considered an old brand.
This...
Turns out it’s Brother Song.
"Come, sit. After eating, you still have to hurry on your journey." Song Yan placed the delicious food on the table, casually sitting aside, and gathered the chopsticks made from secret realm wood.
Due to the characteristics of the "night candle soul worm," Madam Ling always traveled at night and rested during the day, even in the extreme southern wilderness.
Madam Ling sat down, took a bite of the spicy pig skin, then picked a piece of the skin jelly, complimented, and then gulped down soup.
The two sat facing each other, looking at each other, both somewhat speechless.
At this moment, memories of many years ago were brought back.
Back then, when he and she were still in Celestial Cloud City, there were four sparrows in the mansion, and the sparrows stewed lamb soup, the soup was delicious and warm, just like the rib soup now.
Only, things have changed dramatically, their identities have undergone earth-shattering changes, they are no longer people of Jianghu, but cultivators.
Fortunately, still not deviated, still on the same path.
Madam Ling said, "Brother Song, I heard that Old Master Li was an elderly rooted in Chao Li County, but there is no Profound Qi in Chao Li County, how do you usually cultivate?"
Song Yan pulled out a handful of Profound Crystal, scattering it on the table, and said, "I previously made a lot of shadow puppets on Puppet Peak, later exchanged them all for Profound Crystals."
"I see."
Madam Ling said, "Brother’s actions are truly remarkably cautious. Just..."
She glanced at Brother Song’s pigsties and sheepfolds, plus the wild boars, wild wolves, bears running along the riverside cliffs below, somewhat amusedly said, "Brother raising these, aren’t you still making skins?"
Song Yan said, "A lifelong love, it’s a habit."
Madam Ling suddenly recalled the scene when Song Yan fought Grandmother Zhu, manipulating ten shadow puppets with both hands, and finally used powerful magic to defeat Grandmother Zhu, she couldn’t help but feel moved, exclaiming: ’Perhaps only someone as obsessed with a technique as Brother Song can have such deep mastery.’
She had a great opportunity, accidentally blending with the thoughts of a powerful insect cultivator, while Brother Song relied on his own two hands to struggle to this point. Thinking of this, Madam Ling couldn’t help but admire more.
While eating, Madam Ling suddenly said, "Brother, it’s close to summertime now, long days and short nights, it’s still not dark at this time. To save some time, why don’t we dual cultivate, and then I go out and hurry on my journey, how about it?"
Song Yan said, "Sounds good."
...
After the meal...
In the small wooden house.
For a long time...
"Brother, are you ready?" Madam Ling’s dignified, calm voice suddenly came.
Song Yan asked, "You?"
Madam Ling coldly said, "I’ve always been waiting for Brother."
Song Yan said, "Come on."
...
Soon...
Madam Ling adjusted her clothes comfortably, put on the ghost face, left the secret realm, and continued her journey.
Originally fleeing everywhere, plus Grandmother Zhu’s blade hanging high over her head, her mindset also became somewhat twisted to a certain extent, but now... it has become smoother in such peaceful dual cultivation and life.
...
...
Traveling along the edge of the Southern Wilderness all the way westward, finally arriving at a city on a sweltering summer day.
This city is called Linwu City, extremely barren, but in these ten miles around, it’s the place with the most people.
Further west from Linwu City, is a place called "Hundred Thousand Mountains" of dense towering mountains.
The mountain is high and the terrain is steep, and it is the only passage to Western Shu.
This winding and rugged path is called "Coiling Silk Mountain Road" by the locals.
Since they were about to enter Snake Corpse Market, the two planned to stock up here.
This replenishment was mainly what Song Yan needed.
He planned to buy some pigs, sheep, horses, and the like, to keep in the Secret Realm, along with some daily necessities like tea, rice, oil, salt, and wine.
By then, he would have it transported by cart outside the city, and put it all into the Secret Realm, all without anyone noticing.
The two walked along the road to Linwu Mountain City, which was truly primitive compared to the northern towns... one stall after another lined up at the head of the road, with many displaying beautiful small gems, dried mushrooms, unknown bundles of grass, animal horn products, and so on...
Soon, Song Yan struck a deal with a local, preparing to obtain some cattle, sheep, and horses.
While discussing, a woman’s scream suddenly rang out from the street, and the stallholders seemed accustomed to it, merely frowning, looking dejected, and with an expression as if observing their noses with their eyes, and their hearts with their noses.
Song Yan asked, "What’s wrong?"
The person he made the deal with hurriedly pulled him, saying, "Young man, your companion may be wearing a ghost face, but she must be a pretty woman, right? That figure can’t be hidden even in a black robe... trust the old man’s advice, hide quickly. It’s not good, they’re coming!"
Saying this, the elder quickly ran inside the house.
Song Yan wisely took the advice, pulling Lady Ling’s hand, and also slipped into the elder’s house.
He spread his Divine Sense, covering the area.
On the street, a man with black cloth tied over his eyes, reeking of alcohol, was laughing carelessly, chasing after someone, shouting things like "Beautiful, don’t run."
Ahead, a young lady with tattered clothes, sleeves partially exposed, was running in terror.
Even with his eyes covered, the man’s Perception was extremely keen; no matter how silently the young lady tried to hide, he could always catch up.
Finally, this game of cat and mouse ended.
The man staggered and tackled the young lady to the ground, starting to do that thing right on the street.
The onlookers dared not watch, nor dared they move away, pretending they were non-existent while continuing their haggling and trading.
Song Yan’s expression darkened.
Because, with just one glance, he saw this man’s Profound Qi was almost depleted, yet he was unmistakably at the "Refining Profound Sixth Layer" Realm, and despite his disorganized moves, faint traces of Nanwu Sword Sect’s Cultivation Technique could be glimpsed.
Song Yan was truly surprised, just as he was about to leave Southern Wu, he encountered such a person...
He became intrigued.
...
...
Bai Xiuhu, originally from a small city on the edge of Southern Wu called "Linwu City," relied on his Talent and a stroke of fortune to become a disciple of Nanwu Sword Sect, then helped his father become the City Lord of Linwu City.
He was emotionally and morally bound to his fellow Sword Sect brothers, always claiming with each drink that he had a clear conscience, loyal and valiant.
But after Puppet Sect and Nanwu Sword Sect tore their ties apart, battles between cultivators frequently erupted.
Bai Xiuhu, a Refining Profound Sixth Layer Cultivator, was also sent with his partner-brothers to execute patrol missions, and during one such encounter with Demon Sect disciples, in a brutal fight... his brothers died tragically, he intended to sacrifice himself but found himself suddenly cowardly. Had he acted, the captured junior sister might have had hope, but he was so terrified that he turned and fled.
Upon returning to the Sect, he spoke not of it, and the Sword Sect reassigned him to another team...
Months later, the same scene repeated.
And he made the same choice.
He didn’t even dare to draw his sword, turned and escaped.
His Dao Heart completely collapsed.
He didn’t return to Nanwu Sword Sect, fled to Linwu City like a madman, then behaved imperiously using his "cultivator status" and "City Lord’s son status," indulging himself in debauchery as a form of venting.
At this moment, in that luxurious and secluded courtyard, Bai Xiuhu was brutally abusing a young girl, then, in a neurotic state, crying, "It’s all my fault, it’s all my fault."
The young girl trembled... after a while, unable to bear the torment, she fainted.
Bai Xiuhu’s breathing gradually calmed, standing up, he glanced at the fainted young girl, checked her breath, and found she was dead, he was momentarily astonished, then coldly said, "I did nothing wrong, nothing!"
He sat alone in the courtyard, with a variable expression, pondering who knows what.
But whatever it was, he was like an overlord in this place, no one could do anything to him.
What’s wrong with casually killing a few people?
And just then, his expression suddenly changed, a ghostly figure swiftly moved from afar to near, crossing a distance of over a hundred zhang in an instant, pointing at his forehead.
"You..."
Bai Xiuhu was utterly terrified, yet instantly lost consciousness.
Absorbing this information, Song Yan nonchalantly pointed to kill him, capturing his Divine Soul, turning it into a wandering ghost, then dropped a "Fox Grandmother" Shadow Puppet, imparting a strand of Divine Soul onto the "Fox Grandmother" Shadow Puppet using the technique.
The Grandmother Shadow Puppet shook and transformed into Bai Xiuhu’s appearance, standing with hands behind back, coldly murmuring in the summer breeze, "I did nothing wrong, I did nothing wrong."
Having done all this... Song Yan glanced at the dead young girl and sighed softly, stepping forward to Soul Search, upon discovering the young girl’s information, he did not capture her Soul, letting it depart, immediately fetching another Fox Demon Shadow Puppet, making it transform into the young girl’s fainted form.
...
The next day...
Everything was calm.
Song Yan and Lady Ling had finished their shopping, embarking on the Coiling Silk Mountain Dao to Western Shu.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)
Coiling Silk Mountain Dao, located within the Hundred Thousand Mountains, is a small path connecting the southernmost barren land of Southern Wu with the southeastern corner of Western Shu. This was nearly the furthest Song Yan had ever traveled.
Thinking carefully, he had practically traversed the entire Three Kingdoms on his own two feet... the Puppet Sect, Celestial Cloud City, Imperial Capital, Southern Wu, and now, like a little ant, he slowly moved along the fringes of the Three Kingdoms’ territory.
The area where Coiling Silk Mountain Dao lay had quite a high terrain. Even in the summer, there was an extreme snowstorm one night...
This long journey made Song Yan involuntarily recall walking on the small paths of South Bamboo Peak when he first arrived in this world.
At that time, he didn’t know what lay ahead and was fearful... Now, it is not much different.
Fortunately, the accommodation has improved...
From the Suspended Room of the skin-making servants, to the cold small Cave Mansion of South Bamboo Peak, to the independent hilltop at Paperman Peak, and now to a spacious Secret Realm.
And the days have become leisurely...
From the daily tasks of "complete or die," to working nine-to-five with colleague "Wang Shimei," to leading two apprentices in the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, and now to a life where he can choose whether to make skin without urgency, even sleeping in if he wishes.
As for life...
"Phew..."
Song Yan rubbed his hands, turning a wooden stick on which an entire cleaned snow deer was skewered.
The deer’s body had not only been bled out and blanched in boiling water but also marinated for a long time in sauce. At this moment, as the stick turned, the fat sizzled and dripped, releasing an enticing fragrance.
Summer, mountaintop, heavy snow, sitting across from a beautiful lady eating roasted meat, coupled with a jug of wild brew beside him—Song Yan couldn’t imagine anything more comfortable than this life.
Madam Ling wasn’t a gourmand. She had been indulging in earthly delicacies since childhood, so exquisite dishes mattered little to her, and the Fasting Pill was just right for her.
But seeing Song Yan enjoy it so much, she took a deer leg, slowly tearing off some meat, putting it into her small mouth, chewing and swallowing slowly, finding it just so-so.
Yet Song Yan ate with great pleasure.
It was a feeling of freedom, as if one were beyond the heavens, free of all shackles, without any need for pretense.
He admired the snow, ate meat, drank wine, and then drunkenly leaned towards Madam Ling, tugging at her clothing, murmuring, "After being full, one thinks of..."
Before he could finish, Madam Ling coldly said, "Brother Song should focus on restraint and not let the word ’desire’ disturb your mind."
Though she said that, she still voluntarily straightened herself, letting her long dress fall, entwining with Song Yan. She constantly reminded him to avoid overstepping in drunken stupor and ruining the cultivation.
The rustling sounds mixed with the heavy snow on the mountaintop, luxurious silk dresses were occasionally disheveled but quickly straightened by Madam Ling, accompanied by a few gentle reminders.
After the cultivation, both felt refreshed; perhaps their bodies were slightly tired, but their moods were undisturbed, calm and peaceful.
The Dual Cultivation Technique of the Demon Sect made the Absorber full of energy and fervent with desire, which, if not restrained, would constantly boil over.
But the technique of the Righteous Dao didn’t benefit much in terms of energy, yet it clearly helped in terms of temperament.
Recalling the time when Bai Xiuhu’s Dao heart collapsed and how he became a different person, Song Yan vaguely felt that this Sword Cultivator truly valued temperament extraordinarily.
...
...
A month later...
On the branches outside Snake Corpse Market, a pitch-black raven swayed—a bodiless Illusion Raven.
The eyes of the Illusion Raven stared at the empty barren expanse not far away, leaving only some vacant houses, the "Ghost Market".
The swollen skins of snake corpses under the exposed ground were gone, and naturally, the Profound Qi here had disappeared as well.
Pat...
The branch trembled, the bodiless Illusion Raven took flight, swirling around, yet saw not a single living soul!
Suddenly, the Illusion Raven lightly landed, glanced at the fragmented pieces of the Profound Artifact Gourd obscured by fallen leaves, and then quickly flew off... continuing its patrol.
During this patrol, traces of battles were discovered everywhere.
In some places, coagulated blood from cultivators still remained, prolonging its existence, thus it hadn’t dispersed yet.
But there were no cultivator corpses in sight.
Suddenly, the raven’s pupils spun quickly, focusing on a flicker of firelight between the forested mountains not far away, and then flapped its wings to fly over.
The firelight was candlelight within a mountain wooden house.
The Illusion Raven had just made it halfway there when a hoarse, eerie laughter echoed from the wooden house, followed by the faint sound of banners swaying, and the previously calm forest suddenly whipped up a storm of sand and rock.
Trees uprooted, stones and debris flew wildly, the sky darkened, the entire scene turned into a vortex that enveloped the bodiless Illusion Raven within.
A colossal purple figure nearly a yard high emerged from the ground, reaching for the Illusion Raven.
The Illusion Raven, like a small boat caught in a swirling vortex, struggled desperately but inevitably drifted toward the center.
The gigantic purple figure, unaffected by the wind and sand, lunged at the Illusion Raven in no time.
The figure was not a person but a purple corpse with bizarrely floating hair all over its body, purple skin, bulging eyes, and a bloated form!
Of course, the Illusion Raven wasn’t actually a raven but a Shadow Puppet.
In the blink of an eye, the giant hands of the Purple Corpse clapped like hammers.
The Illusion Raven hurriedly flapped its wings, flipping to dodge.
Snap!!
The hands clapped firmly.
The Illusion Raven narrowly avoided the blow but was thrown off balance by the ensuing gust, as if a kite with its string cut, spinning head over heels in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)_2
The purple corpse continued to grab fiercely at the bodyless phantom raven.
Just as this strike was about to land, suddenly... the purple corpse stopped moving, and the wind and sand halted.
A few miles away from this mountain, an old man exuding a fishy odor was being held by the neck by a man.
The old man looked at the man in horror, his face squeezing out a fearful smile, and shouted, "Song... Song Master... Master Uncle... spare..."
Crack.
Song Yan did not hesitate at all, directly twisting the neck, while his other hand joined, pointing to the old man’s forehead, soul-searching, soul-devouring, all in one...
After a long while, he discarded the old man’s corpse.
In the Puppet Sect, from top to bottom, there wasn’t a single innocent person...
Then, the figure of the Profound Robe Ghost Face came from afar, lightly spinning and landing beside him.
Madam Ling said, "The snake corpses at Snake Corpse Market are all gone, and the market has dispersed. It seems... the Puppet Sect has bloodied this place, even more ruthlessly than we imagined."
Song Yan looked at the old man on the ground and said, "He was a disciple of the Puppet Sect’s Blood Corpse Peak, holding a purple corpse. It seems he was also an advanced Refining Profound practitioner, sent here to guard because there was no hope of him breaking through due to old age...
Just now, he was able to quickly detect the bodyless phantom raven and immediately responded.
He commanded the purple corpse to act, while he fled using a Profound Talisman, intending to escape and report back."
Madam Ling said in surprise, "Then this place... isn’t safe anymore."
Song Yan carefully pondered the information he had just extracted, murmuring, "Not necessarily..."
Madam Ling looked at him curiously.
Song Yan said, "If it were before last year, it would be unsafe, but now... it’s still fine."
Madam Ling thought briefly and said, "Did the Puppet Sect and Nanwu Sword Sect go to full-scale war?"
Song Yan said, "To be precise, after the Jin Dynasty annexed most of Western Shu, they now march southward again, with cultivators from both sides hidden within the military. Whenever it comes to crucial city battles, the duels between generals are replaced by magical battles between cultivators.
Nanwu Sword Sect has been retreating continuously, but the Puppet Sect seems to have discovered something in the Northern Land and has not fully responded to the south, leaving the south with a bit of breathing room.
As for this Blood Corpse Peak disciple, he was here because he didn’t want to be involved in the disputes and magical battles in the south, so he took the task to guard here."
After speaking, Song Yan casually disposed of the corpse and then asked, "What exactly is the snake corpse? Why hasn’t it been taken away?"
Madam Ling said, "These were all created by Mama Zhu, and I indeed don’t know.
Mama Zhu has rooted here for decades, doing many things... and I only inherited the thought of that insect cultivator from her.
Now that the Snake Corpse Market has been completely cleared out, naturally Mama Zhu’s house is empty too.
All I can do is control the Demon Swamp Secret Realm.
However, I am currently only in the Third Layer of Refining Profound, my Divine Soul power is exceedingly weak, and even having the thought of a great power, I cannot simultaneously control two secret realms.
If I can’t control the Demon Swamp Secret Realm, I won’t be able to transfer its entrance.
To enter, I’d have to linger around the periphery.
I remember before Mama Zhu also only went to Candle Land after reaching the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, so... I’m afraid I’ll need to cultivate to the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound to start controlling the Demon Swamp Secret Realm."
Song Yan said, "There should be quite a few resources in the Demon Swamp Secret Realm, you should first go see if there’s any Skin-Stripping Ointment, while I go check out the Blood Pool there. Then we will temporarily hide in the secret realm surrounding here.
Later, even if Puppet Sect disciples come looking, they won’t be able to find us."
From daily chats with Madam Ling, Song Yan learned that "if a secret realm is unowned, its opening might follow some rules," but if it has an owner, it’s entirely controlled.
The rumor that the "Demon Swamp Secret Realm" opens once every ten years for only a month was merely the "harvest time" set by the shepherding Mama Zhu herself.
And such hidden places as secret realms, although there may be flaws and could be detected, should absolutely not be discovered by someone in the Refining Profound, or Crimson Palace level, certainly not by Song Yan himself.
Once hidden inside, it’s as if stepping into another world.
No matter how dangerous the outside is, Song Yan is always in a safe place.
Because of the Shadow Puppet from the demon matriarch, the Skin Painting Strange Soul Technique, and plus the Hundred Forms Divine Control, it’s essentially created a physical incarnation that even common cultivators of the Crimson Palace Realm cannot see through, it’s extremely useful.
...
...
A few days later...
"Father, I have understood; avoiding is not right, the mistakes made in the past should be compensated for with the future."
"I, Bai Xiuhu, once a sword cultivator, will always be a sword cultivator."
In front of Linwu City, the man carried a sword, donned the silver-white sword robe again, then deeply bowed to his fathers and villagers here, and then did not use Sword Control, just with hands behind his back, long sleeves fluttering, walked out of the city.
His beautiful concubine followed behind him, leaving together...
Once far away from Linwu City, they quickly headed north.
...
These two were naturally both Song Yan’s shadow puppets.
Along this way, Song Yan planned to explore the secret realm and seek out Demon Blood suitable for himself.
As for the Demon Swamp, he and Madam Ling had already entered it and seen it.
Everywhere in the Demon Swamp were giant crocodiles, and the Essence Blood of these crocodiles was obviously inclined towards "quick healing of physical injuries," "increased strength," and so on. While not bad, it belonged to a different category than "Changwang Hu" or "Night Candle Soul Insect."
If Song Yan were to absorb this Crocodile Demon Essence Blood, it would be like "a hammer on the east, and a mallet on the west," slightly strengthened in every aspect, but nowhere achieving the extreme.
And a "good Essence Blood combination" is many times stronger than a "poor one."

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: 95. The Good Days are Over (4.3K words - Subscribe please)_3
Madam Fox is a living example. She dominates her peers at the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace, and it’s nothing for her to challenge those above her rank.
However...
The deeper Song Yan understood Madam Fox, the more he felt the terror of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
He still didn’t know what role the "Changwang Tiger Race" played or what kind of mess they stirred up, after all... even Madam Fox didn’t know.
But whether it was him, Madam Fox, or Ling Madam, they all understood... The issues tied to the "Changwang Tiger Race" were plentiful, massive, and terrifying.
Back to the topic, within the Multi-tailed Fox Race, Madam Fox isn’t really the "Madam", she might just be a "Miss".
The domineering title of "Madam" was far from her reach...
...
In the mountains, time is lost, days pass without knowing the years.
No matter how the Shadow Puppets outside laboriously trek over mountains and rivers, Song Yan lived his life as he pleased.
Pigsties, sheepfolds, horse troughs, cow shelters, nests for chickens, ducks, geese, even birdhouses, were all built. Even by the river, there were many more fierce beasts.
Considering that demon beasts are difficult to control, none were kept here.
During the day, Song Yan made shadow puppets, cooked a few dishes, drank some fine wine, and at night, earnestly engaged in Dual Cultivation with Ling Madam on the bed.
Whether heartfelt or lustful, Ling Madam was a good partner.
His days were too comfortable to be true.
Others needed to snatch every moment for cultivation, but he only needed to be in a safe place to own an increasingly longer lifespan.
However, it was just lifespan...
...
Half a year later...
Evening.
This evening looked no different from usual.
In the small house in the Secret Realm, the unabashed sounds of two people echoed again.
"Ling Madam, today I want to..."
"No way! The Guiding Technique states that the posture must be proper, eyes aligned, two noses, two mouths, two hands, making sure the heart aligns with Yin and Yang, following the path of Heaven and Earth, it cannot be changed."
After saying this, Ling Madam lay down very seriously, putting herself in the correct posture.
Suddenly, she let out a surprised cry: "No way!"
But the sound was quickly drowned out.
...
After a long while, Ling Madam coldly said: "Not again!"
"Got it, just indulging occasionally." Song Yan replied.
Ling Madam sat up cross-legged, carefully adjusting her Profound Qi, then lay back down.
One on the left, one on the right, their minds tranquil, like innocent children, without the slightest evil thought...
At this moment, Ling Madam suddenly shuddered.
"What’s wrong?" Song Yan asked.
Ling Madam didn’t answer, but her red lips quivered, as if chanting, possibly uttering some complex and obscure spell, or perhaps resembling the frequency of a strange insect vibrating its wings.
Song Yan stopped speaking, quietly waiting.
A moment later...
Ling Madam was drenched in cold sweat, she took deep breaths as if drowning, and only calmed down after a long while.
Song Yan leaned in from behind, stroking her hair.
Ling Madam, pale-faced, said: "The Biluojiao Insect Clan just contacted me...
Human communication stones need to be used in a place with continuous Profound Qi.
But the Insect Race has a far greater transmission range, maintaining a connection on a spiritual level.
Previously, Grandma Zhu and the Biluojiao Insects connected through a spiritual link, established on the thoughts of an Insect Cultivator in the Purple Mansion Realm.
Now that I have integrated this thought, the Biluojiao Insect Clan has directly contacted me..."
After finishing the sentence, she suddenly shivered and turned to look at Song Yan, saying: "Dao brother, do you know what this means?"
Song Yan said: "I know... this means the one contacting you might be a true old demon of the Purple Mansion Realm."
Ling Madam trembled as she said: "It said the deadline for the trade is only five years left, it asked... have you been found..."
Song Yan: ...
At this moment, he suddenly felt that his good days were over.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 96. Current Situation of Sword Sect: The "Blind Box" That No One Dares to Open (2.6K Words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: 96. Current Situation of Sword Sect: The "Blind Box" That No One Dares to Open (2.6K Words - Please Subscribe)
The identity of a Nanwu Sword Sect sword cultivator serves as a good cover.
For over half a year, Song Yan’s "Granny Fox" shadow puppet, in this guise, has entered no less than three secret realms. She made the acquaintance of many loose cultivators but was unable to find blood suitable for Song Yan.
However, it wasn’t entirely fruitless. At least, through everyday interactions, Song Yan heard some things about the "Ancient Teleportation Array."
...
Cultivators told him that, a long, long time ago, the North and South of this continent were connected. The so-called "Wu, Shu, Wei" Three Kingdoms were merely a small nation that split from the continent’s southern part. In the past, there seemed to be teleportation arrays that could directly connect the North and South, but now it’s all shrouded in the mists of time.
This piece of information roughly provided Song Yan a possible direction for the "Ancient Teleportation Array" — the North.
He didn’t know what the North was, but there’s a ninety percent chance it already spans across the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
The "Wu, Shu, Wei" Three Kingdoms are a "dead end." One option is to go to sea, but no one knows what lies abroad;
the other is to go north through the "Desolate Wilderness," from where Granny Fox was invited by the Wei King. Clearly... that direction directly leads to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
Therefore...
Song Yan began to delve into the Ancient Teleportation Array again.
The Crimson Palace can still be hidden, but faced with the Purple Mansion Realm’s blue-headed cannibal devouring locusts, he felt there’s nothing at all that could be hidden.
The Purple Mansion Realm was a realm he had no understanding of whatsoever.
Becoming stronger was necessary, but he also had to prepare a backup plan for himself.
Upon hearing this news, he split the two shadow puppets.
Granny Fox continued to do what a sword cultivator should, helping him find more secret realms.
The other began to secretly head toward the direction of the Ancient Teleportation Array.
...
After a month of trekking, Song Yan finally found the array in a secret cave southeast of Nanwu Sword Sect, following Granny Fox’s map.
"Ancient" wasn’t a lie...
The three layers of overlapping vines surrounding the cave were enough for one to overlook it, not to mention it was in a barren wilderness void of Profound Qi, a place no woodcutters or hunters would ever tread.
Song Yan lit the fire stick, maneuvered sideways through the vine gaps in his fox demon shadow puppet form, and proceeded into the dark cave. At the depths, he indeed found something of interest.
The array was about the size of a courtyard landscape pond, with a vertical span of over twenty steps, and six stone steles approximately seven feet tall standing in six directions, with the array pattern at the center.
Spanning untold years, the array pattern remained as new, with its thickness and detailing intact, clearly indicating that the stone materials used to cast the array were extraordinary.
However...
Song Yan furrowed his brow slightly, his figure flickering to the northwest of the array.
There, shockingly, was a trail the thickness of an adult’s arm!
This trail seemed to have erased part of the array pattern as if an eraser had been used.
Song Yan followed the trail further and saw a rusty broken sword standing at its end.
It appeared that the array wasn’t deliberately destroyed but was affected by a battle, during which the broken sword had slashed across the entire array, thereby ruining it.
Song Yan stepped forward to grab the broken sword, slightly channeling Profound Qi, only to find the broken sword was like a bottomless pit, incessantly absorbing his strength. As it absorbed more, the surface of the sword started to tremble, and the rust quickly shook off. However, as the Profound Qi of his shadow puppet was nearly depleted, he hastily stopped, threw the broken sword into his storage bag, and continued examining the teleportation array.
Evidently, to restore this ancient teleportation array, at the very least, the "array pattern" needed to be repaired somehow.
’Broken sword...’
’Residual array...’
’It’s time to visit Nanwu Sword Sect.’
Although Song Yan also worried about Granny Fox being exposed, as a shadow puppet cannot truly perform the Sword Control Technique, Granny Fox relied entirely on her body’s strength, power, and speed to wield a sword. Nevertheless, he had to make a trip to Nanwu Sword Sect.
Previously, he was concerned about others using some secret technique to track him through the shadow puppet, but now... first, he’s within the secret realm, and second, there’s no time to worry about such things.
...
...
After a little over a fortnight...
Nanwu Sword Sect.
The Immortal Island hid among the clouds, its peaks not towering, but treasured for their innate spiritual grace. The mountains, amidst the ocean of clouds and mist, are akin to brush strokes by a grand master, rising and falling with a certain charm.
Da...
The bamboo pole stopped at the shore, the bow of the boat slightly dipped, and the water rippled with a few mournful sounds between rising and falling.
Song Yan secured the cable and stepped onto the outermost Observing Mist Island of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
As soon as he landed, a disciple from the Nanwu Sword Sect rushed over. Upon seeing his appearance, the disciple was both surprised and delighted, saying, "Brother Bai! You... you’re still alive?!"
Although Song Yan had undergone a soul search, he only had a slight impression of who this disciple was. Luckily, over the past six months, he had been accustomed to Bai Xiuhu’s temperament and way of speaking, and now he skillfully imitated his tone and sighed, "It’s a long story..."
The disciple sighed, "Many things have happened over the years. The fellow brothers who practiced swordsmanship together suddenly disappeared one by one. Some are known to have died, while others... their fates remain unknown."
Song Yan suddenly asked, "Has the Sect Leader exited his seclusion?"
The disciple sighed deeply and said no more.
Song Yan didn’t ask further. In fact... during this time, he had heard many rumors while he was outside.
The rumors claimed that "the Sect Leader of the Nanwu Sword Sect hadn’t appeared since going into seclusion years ago, not even for the critical battle at Cold Pool Valley, because the Sect Leader had already passed away."
In fact, the reason the Nanwu Sword Sect could confront the Puppet Sect was entirely because of this Sect Leader.
This Sect Leader was renowned as the "Water Uncle Sword Emperor," with an Innate Five Elements Water Profound Root, sitting along the rivers and seas of the Jianghu, making him an unbeatable force.
Years ago, the Water Uncle Sword Emperor went into closed-door training on Luoxia Bamboo Island at the deepest part of the Sword Sect, aiming to break through to the late stage of the Crimson Palace Realm, and has not emerged since.
Gu Huangzi dreaded him, just as he feared Zhang Han, who sat at the center of the Evil Land.
Such entities, already powerful and occupying favorable positions, are nearly invincible when fighting on their home ground.
No one knows what the blood of the Water Uncle Sword Emperor’s "Third Central Palace" holds, but it’s likely he risked taking a Crimson Palace Pill to strengthen it. And that... the Crimson Palace Pill might still have lingering toxins.
Whether he can overcome the crisis, no one can predict.
To prevent anyone from disturbing the Sect Leader, the Great Elder strictly forbade anyone from approaching Luoxia Bamboo Island.
Even now... it remains the same.
However, the rumors circulating outside are truly frightening.
Song Yan himself couldn’t determine the truth, whether it was just the Puppet Sect’s fabrication, or if it was both fabrication and truth. Thus, he asked after landing on the island.
But since he didn’t get a definite answer, he had a rough idea in his heart.
The current "Water Uncle Sword Emperor" is like a "blind box"...
Neither the Great Elder nor any high-ranking members of the Nanwu Sword Sect dared to open this blind box.
As long as the blind box remains unopened, the Water Uncle Sword Emperor is in closed-door training, and the Nanwu Sword Sect might anytime have a powerful late stage Crimson Palace expert.
But if it’s opened, it’s like a gambler going all-in, pushing all his chips forward and betting it all.
...
Song Yan walked a few steps forward and saw another disciple hurrying through the mist. That disciple also recognized him, clasped his fists from a distance, and shouted, "Brother Bai."
This person, Song Yan recognized and returned the greeting with a smile, "Brother Su."
The disciple nodded, then with a flick of his sleeve, took out a jade bottle, poured out some powder, and scattered it over Song Yan’s head, sternly saying, "If you have nothing to hide, don’t move!"
Song Yan didn’t move, his expression calm.
The powder fell, ice-cold with a feeling as if it was about to tear apart his illusion technique.
However, the illusion technique of the old Fox Demon could not be compared to that of young foxes.
The powder failed to tear it open.
Brother Su breathed a sigh of relief, then explained, "During the previous battle, the Puppet Sect eliminated many Fox Demons and made a batch of Fox Demon Shadow Puppets.
Those shadow puppets are highly skilled in illusion techniques. Without scattering this Illusion-Dispersing Powder, they’re impossible to distinguish.
However, I knew you couldn’t be a Fox Demon Shadow Puppet, otherwise, you wouldn’t approach me so defenselessly."
Song Yan asked curiously, "Why?"
Brother Su whispered, "They usually travel in pairs, one is the Fox Demon Shadow Puppet, the other a Skin Master from the Puppet Sect, not too far apart from each other. Since you returned alone, how could you be a Fox Demon Shadow Puppet? But Brother, it was just an extra precaution."
Song Yan praised, "You’re cautious, Brother."
Brother Su waved his hand, saying, "Hurry back to your Cave Mansion. Many major things have happened in the Sect, and it’s uncertain when you might be deployed to the frontlines again."
Song Yan said, "Since I fled last year, my mind was stained by the escapade, and now I’ve understood. Only by slaying demons and eliminating evil can I cleanse my heart!"
After speaking, he coughed heavily a few times, a bitter smile on his face, "Alas... my serious injuries haven’t healed, perhaps I’m willing but unable."
Brother Su comforted, "As long as you have the will, there’s no need to overthink the rest."

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 97. Can you still get out? (4.1K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: 97. Can you still get out? (4.1K words - please subscribe)
Song Yan followed his memory and returned to the Cave Mansion on Red Leaf Island.
Compared to the cave-like Cave Mansions of the Puppet Sect, the Sword Cultivators’ Cave Mansions were mostly bamboo shelters by the water.
At dawn and dusk, the bamboo shelter would reflect together with the breaking dawn and the evening clouds into the Misty Sea, creating slight ripples with the waves, forming creases. But when the wind calmed, it would return to clarity.
This architectural layout was established by the first Sect Leader of the Sword Sect.
The Sect Leader intended to tell every Sword Cultivator that when thoughts arise, there is no need to panic or hurry, for they will eventually pass, and the heart will return to equanimity, just like the rippling reflections seen daily.
As for the Misty Sea, it was the name of this rather large inland lake where the Southern Wu Sword Sect was located.
It is named a "sea" rather than a "lake," which was also decided by that first Sect Leader.
The Sect Leader said, "A flower can contain the world, a lake too is the Vast Sea. The sword held by a Sword Cultivator may seem ordinary, but who knows if it doesn’t contain the roar of a tiger or the cry of a dragon, the winds and frost, purple lightning?"
As Song Yan walked through the paths of Red Leaf Island, various thoughts and memories naturally surfaced.
Even on the plaza upon entering the island, despite it being winter and amidst war, there were still dozens of Sword Cultivators seated cross-legged, both men and women. They sat quietly, seemingly engaged in visualization and circulating their qi, their white robes fluttering, exuding a sense of transcendence.
Even as Song Yan walked by and made a noise, no one opened their eyes, wholly immersed in their own world of cultivation.
Song Yan recalled the daily exploitation of the Furnace in the Puppet Sect and the scenes of cultivation within their dark Cave Mansions, unable to help but reflect, "The cultural atmosphere between sects is truly different."
As he thought, he returned to the bamboo shelter, took out the Sword Sect’s identity plate from his bosom, which glimmered slightly, and then the door of the shelter opened.
...
This was Bai Xiuhu’s bamboo shelter.
Inside, it was clean, yet somewhat messy. The bed lay at the end, a wooden table stood beneath the window, and a few strands of morning light still slanted over, illuminating some pieces of Xuan paper on the table, upon which many "sword" characters were scrawled crookedly.
The first "sword" character looked fairly neat, but the further along it went, the more disordered and scrawled it became, eventually turning into indistinct ghostly symbols...
Song Yan envisioned before his eyes a scene of "writing while crying, tears falling on newly written characters."
He glanced at the floor again and found crumpled balls of Xuan paper scattered everywhere.
Song Yan bent down, picked one up, spread it open, and it again bore the character for "sword."
A slight search through his memory allowed him to roughly understand that Bai Xiuhu had, after initially fleeing, locked himself in his room, practicing calligraphy in a state of both collapse and a desire to pull himself together, hoping to "calm his mind through writing, and restore his courage."
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but feel quite a connection.
A Skin Master must have a profound understanding of Painting Skill.
Painting faces and skins also requires painting bones. Without this, it is impossible to grasp what is now regarded as the core Secret Technique of a Skin Master—the "Divine Face Hundred Defenses."
Yet a Sword Cultivator enjoys practicing calligraphy.
Through characters, they calm the mind, illuminate the heart, and see within themselves.
The crooked "sword" character showed how shattered Bai Xiuhu’s Dao heart was at the time, and his inclusion in the group a second time was essentially his sect’s way of taking care of him.
Bai Xiuhu was a Sword Cultivator of decent talent, and his sect hoped he would "get back up where he fell," thus sending him out again to patrol and combat the Demon Sect.
However... Bai Xiuhu profoundly embodied the truth of "where you fall, you lie down." The second time, his Dao heart truly shattered, causing him to madly flee back to the southern Linwu City, transforming into the state Song Yan witnessed.
The human heart is truly peculiar.
Thirty years of cultivating the sword, yet a single thought turned to devilry.
He thought slightly and recalled that Bai Xiuhu once had a Dao companion, but it seemed she perished during his first escape, which was another reason for his breakdown.
Song Yan swiftly cleaned the room and then prepared to pay a visit to his "master."
In terms of teaching and imparting knowledge, Southern Wu Sword Sect and Puppet Sect were entirely different.
The Puppet Sect’s approach was more "here’s stuff, practice on your own," and the relationship between master and disciple wasn’t as close.
There was Gu Rufeng cuckolding Stone Seat Elder and even wanting to kill him, Stone Seat Elder deceiving an adopted son, and Gu Huangzi making a comeback after difficult challenges to betray his mentor—all commonplace occurrences.
There is an inherent wariness between master and disciple in the Demon Sect.
However, the Southern Wu Sword Sect was nothing like that.
The only way to obtain a Cultivation Method at Southern Wu Sword Sect was through a "master."
And "masters," when treating disciples, often were pure-hearted, without complex intentions.
As for the Sun Family Sun Elder Song Yan had met before, they were the rare exception within the entire Sword Sect, as most Sword Sect members were not adept at interacting with others.
He had met the likes of Mr. Su San, Sun Elder, who were outstanding among them...
Most, in fact, were much like Su Yao.
Therefore, Song Yan had to seek out his master to obtain a Cultivation Method.
He lay on the bed, pondering all night, and the next morning... as dawn broke, he mounted his Flying Sword and stepped towards a bamboo shelter deep within Red Leaf Island.
...
Before the shelter, an old man lay on a rocking rattan chair, a book in his hand, reading.
One could vaguely see some herbal illustrations on the book.
This old man was Bai Xiuhu’s teacher—Sun Kuye.
Sun Kuye was naturally from the Sun Family, and his original name was not Kuye. He only took this name due to feeling his age, akin to the red leaves on Red Leaf Island, which wither and flourish annually, thus self-titled "Kuye," and the Sword Cultivators on the island called him the "Kuye Sword Master" or simply "Sword Master."
Sun Kuye was undoubtedly a master of the Crimson Palace Realm, but it seemed he took risks with Essence Blood while setting the "First Central Palace," absorbing residual poison, leading to an unstable foundation, making advancement difficult, and hence, he remained at the Early Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 97. Can you still make it out? (4.1K words - please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: 97. Can you still make it out? (4.1K words - please subscribe)_2
These pauses lasted over a century, and he never managed to break through the Middle Stage, while wave after wave of his disciples came and went, some even becoming rising stars as Elders, yet he remained unchanged.
So, in his twilight years, he ceased delving into the Sword Dao and began researching pill recipes instead.
To become a powerful cultivator in the Crimson Palace Realm, one must take risks and consume some of the less stable Crimson Palace Pills, otherwise... they can only take the standardized elixirs.
Stable they may be, but much weaker as well.
"Erysipelas" is a disaster every Crimson Palace cultivator faces.
This is evident from how Song Yan died tens of thousands of times while digesting the "Changwang Tiger Blood."
Sun Kuye felt that "cultivating the sword on one’s own" was short-sighted, while alchemy aimed at the thousand-year grand enterprise of the Sword Sect, focusing on the future sword cultivator talents.
Although he himself had not been able to become a top sword cultivator, he felt a great sense of "no regrets in this life" in thinking that future generations could reach the peak through his pill recipes.
So, he was currently painstakingly researching methods to remove the different demon blood toxins in the Crimson Palace Pills.
Upon hearing a noise, the old man suddenly stood up, but instead of looking at the visitor, he hurriedly turned around and entered the room, leaving the door open as he eagerly leaned over the table, grabbing a sheet of paper and scribbling on it, before rushing to the backyard to fetch and weigh the herbs, embodying a state of "sudden inspiration, act when ready."
Song Yan did not disturb him and waited outside.
The Sword Sect respects teachers and their teachings.
Waiting for the teacher for a while is nothing.
However, Song Yan hadn’t waited long before the voice of the Sword Master Kuye came from the backyard.
"Kid, bring in two pieces of the dried Manji Grass from outside!"
The sudden shout genuinely stunned Song Yan for a moment.
He quickly glanced at the drying rack in the Sword Master Kuye’s yard and the more than thirty bamboo trays of drying herbs and fell into a brief contemplation.
He only had superficial information from Bai Xiuhu’s mind, which did not include details such as whether he recognized Manji Grass...
If the Sword Master Kuye was testing him, taking the Manji Grass might lead to suspicion.
"Hurry up, kid, stop dawdling!"
The sword master urged again.
Song Yan’s gaze quickly scanned over the bamboo trays, picking out two pieces of black medicinal materials resembling tree root pieces, and quickly walked into the room.
These years, he hadn’t been idle either, reading many miscellaneous books, and he recognized Manji Grass.
He took a gamble on "a gentleman’s openness."
If the Sword Master Kuye truly wanted to test him, he wouldn’t do it this way.
Besides, if he claimed it was something he learned over the years, what would be odd about that?
He stepped into the backyard, a mixed scent of medicinal herbs and fierce flames hit him, seeing a medicine cauldron over half a zhang tall set up in the yard, with the wood under the cauldron not being ordinary timber.
"Cut three qian!" Sword Master Kuye, while flying high with sword control, tossed the herbs into the medicine cauldron, giving instructions.
Song Yan hurriedly took a knife from the side, calculating the weight as he cut slightly, measured it on the scale, adjusted a bit more, then quickly came to the medicine cauldron, presenting it with both hands.
Sword Master Kuye raised his hand, a gust of wind lifted the three qian of Manji Grass and scattered it into the cauldron.
With another flick of his sleeve, the cauldron lid whistled towards Song Yan with a terrifying "whoosh" sound.
Song Yan didn’t move.
The lid flew past in front of him and landed on the cauldron.
Sword Master Kuye descended from the sky, muttering to himself: "Though Manji Grass is an ordinary herb, it can cure men’s night terror losing energy. I’ve planted a lot in Profound Land soil, yet I don’t know if it can be enhanced to resist Yin-evil invasion, dilute soul poison. If it can... that would be good, very good indeed."
When he stopped mumbling and turned to look at Song Yan, only then did Song Yan bow deeply and call out, "Teacher."
Sword Master Kuye said: "You stayed in Linwu City for a year, your mental realm was broken, and tainted, can you still come out of it?"
Song Yan said: "Disciple... wishes to try."
Sword Master Kuye said: "Can’t control the sword? Can’t use techniques?"
If he could control the sword, he wouldn’t have rowed a boat to the island.
If he could use techniques, he wouldn’t have had to give medicine just by hand.
Song Yan had long thought of a coping plan, at this moment he bowed his head hard to speak, eyes showing some struggle, and his arms hung down with fists clenched as he bit his teeth.
Seeing his appearance, Sword Master Kuye’s voice showed no mercy, instead, it was even more stern: "If it weren’t for you not disgracing my Sword Sect’s name outside these six months, I would have killed you with one sword long ago.
Your conduct in Linwu City, how is it different from the Demon Sect?!!"
"Disciple knows his fault, willing to be punished."
Song Yan said.
Sword Master Kuye said: "Then how do you wish to be punished?"
Song Yan said: "Willing to be grounded to reflect and clean the island."
Sword Master Kuye said: "Now it is not only the Puppet Sect invading, but more is the northern evil Jianghu, you go help the Wang Family in the Southern Wu Jianghu."
"This..."
Song Yan was a bit dumbfounded.
His intention was to be punished, assigned to "some building or pavilion" to sweep the floor or something similar.
The colder, the more unnoticed the pavilion, the better, preferably a "Cold Palace" type place, for him to maintain cleanliness alone, or maybe with an almost "retired" old man, that would be just fine.
By then, he could establish a foothold there, understand the situation, survey the terrain, inspect situations, restrictions, mechanisms, the distribution of experts, and could begin plotting the heritage of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
In an era of peace, he simply wouldn’t have the opportunity.
But now in such "seemingly calm, but outside long in shambles" wartime, anything was possible.
His "Granny Fox" shadow puppet though lacking in techniques, was at least of Middle Stage Crimson Palace Power, with an illusion technique no ordinary Crimson Palace Realm could perceive. If he truly had patience to lie low, plot for something, there was considerable hope.
The precondition though, was to settle down, with no one watching.
Now, he already said he wanted to "be confined," to "clean the island," yet Sword Master Kuye still wanted to send him out.
However, he did not resist or confront directly, attempting to rely on speechmanship to make Sword Master Kuye change his mind... he simply responded respectfully with "yes," then turned and left the place.
Indeed, relying solely on a status, it’s hard to earn the trust of Sword Sect cultivators. Even if he trusts you, he still won’t use you.
As he walked to the gate, about to leave, the voice of Sword Master Kuye finally came again from behind the door.
"You are too tainted by the worldly life, go train your heart, and when you’ve found it again, control the sword back."
Song Yan paused his steps, turned back to bow, and respectfully said, "Yes."
...
...
Gurgle gurgle gurgle...
At the Blood Pool end of the Demon Swamp, Song Yan filled a Jade Bottle with "Changwang Crocodile" Essence Blood.
In adulthood, such a demon beast could barely enter the Crimson Palace Realm, but most could only be counted as at the Refining Profound Level.
At this moment, the Changwang Crocodiles circled around, watching the unfamiliar human collecting the Essence Blood, each squinting but not approaching, only because another woman in a Profound Robe stood by his side.
That woman in Profound Robe had an aura that was inherently reverable and inherently submissive to them...
Song Yan filled up a bottle with the "Changwang Crocodile" blood.
This blood, for body recovery, might be quite good material for refining Crimson Palace Pills for the Three Kingdoms Human Race cultivators, yet for Song Yan, it only belonged to the category of "take it if available."
Speaking of whether he would use this blood, maybe not.
After using "Changwang Tiger Blood," "Night Candle Soul Worm Blood," such blood... already seemed inadequate.
After collecting, he directly tossed it into a Storage Bag.
The matter of Nanwu Sword Sect vexed him quite a bit.
Currently, his two shadow puppets outside, one was guarding that ancient teleportation array, the other had already begun helping the Wang Family at the Nanwu Sword Sect, guarding Jianghu.
Really just "things do not go as you wish, what you want, not so easy to have."
...
After collecting the "Changwang Crocodile" Essence Blood, Song Yan and Lady Ling returned to the Secret Realm.
After dining, just before entering the room to rest, a strand of "tentacle" emerged in the darkness.
The "tentacle" caressed to where Song Yan stood, dancing in a changing form.
Lady Ling laughed and said: "They all recognize you now."
Song Yan lifted a hand, a Night Candle Soul Worm landed on his fingertip, flapping its wings, baring fangs, its big eyes staring directly at his small ones.
Song Yan curiously asked: "Do they possess intelligence?"
Lady Ling replied: "They do not, but these insects are extremely sensitive to aura, and these soul worms are not only sensitive to aura, they are especially attuned to perceived Divine Souls."
"Is that so..."
Song Yan lifted his hand lightly, and the soul worm flapped its wings and flew away.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 98. Wind and Thunder Rise, Trapped Flood Dragon Enters the Vast Sea (3.3K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: 98. Wind and Thunder Rise, Trapped Flood Dragon Enters the Vast Sea (3.3K words - Please Subscribe)
A few days later...
