"Immortal Bai, you will reside in this house for the time being. If you need anything, please let the servants know. Your fellow disciples are staying in the courtyard next door."
The head of the Wang family from Southern Wu personally led Song Yan to arrange his accommodation.
This Wang family was not entirely unfamiliar to Song Yan.
Previously, the elder Wang beside Mr. Su San was the most skilled in martial arts within this Wang family, holding a status equivalent to... the old master.
But after the battle with the Fox Demon, the Su family lost their patriarch, and the Wang family lost their old master as well.
Nevertheless, the Wang family remained a prominent force in the Jianghu of Southern Wu and received special attention from the heretics of the Northern Land.
In Jianghu, it is to some extent the outer rim of the sect, and on the other hand... it’s the hardest bone embedded within the Dynasty.
Song Yan settled in.
Before long, his fellow disciples from next door came to meet him.
After some brief introductions, a straightforward-looking female disciple suddenly stepped forward, directly bowed, and said, "Senior Brother Bai, I’ve been away from the sect for a while. How is Senior Sister Su Tangyu?"
Song Yan reminisced for a moment, recalling that "Su Tangyu" was Bai Xiuhu’s former Dao companion, who tragically died at the hands of Puppet Sect disciples during their first outing. At that time, Bai Xiuhu fled in fear.
Just as the words fell, a male disciple beside them said, "Junior Sister Xiaojiu, Senior Sister Su died in battle last year. Didn’t you know?"
The female disciple raised her head and stepped forward vehemently towards Song Yan, coldly saying, "I know. I just want to hear Senior Brother Bai’s own response... Is Senior Sister Su Tangyu... okay?"
She enunciated each word, her eyes flashing coldly, undaunted by Song Yan, whose power realm exceeded hers.
Song Yan immediately understood.
This woman should be Bai Xiuhu’s Dao companion’s friend. She knew how Su Tangyu died, and now seeing Bai Xiuhu dare to return with such impudence, she was here, teeth gritted, to demand an explanation.
In truth, not just her, even Song Yan thought Bai Xiuhu was scum. Going on a mission with his wife and friend, but the moment things turned unfavorable, he sold out his wife and friend; yet he always prided himself on being loyal and righteous, always having a clear conscience.
Thus, he sighed lightly, lowered his head, and clenched his fists, saying, "I, Bai Xiuhu, am ashamed beyond measure..."
As the eight words landed, silence fell around them, with various gazes of distinct emotions falling upon them.
A rather kind-hearted disciple comforted him, "Senior Brother, don’t dwell on it. Everyone makes mistakes. It’s in the past now."
"In the past?"
Junior Sister Xiaojiu shouted sharply, "Can the living just move on? What about the dead? Who can forgive on their behalf?"
That disciple said, "Junior Sister, you saw how Senior Brother Bai is now, he..."
"So what? Can it bring back Senior Sister Su Tangyu?" Xiaojiu raised her head, looking at Song Yan, half a head taller than herself, and yelled in a small voice, "Senior Brother Bai, tell me, if it happened again, would you still run away?!"
Song Yan started to tremble all over. He lowered his head, feeling everyone’s eyes on him, and suddenly... he pushed through the crowd and ran off into the distance, disconsolate.
Xiaojiu didn’t relent, shouting after him, "You can’t even control your sword! Your mental realm can’t be mended! You deserve it! You liar! Big liar!!"
...
...
Song Yan couldn’t help but sigh: The difference between the righteous and the demonic paths is indeed vast.
He still remembered the shock when he learned from Granny Fox that "Stone Teacher’s second legacy inheritor"...
The second heir of Stone Seat Elder... was Wang Susu.
Susu Junior Sister used to flirt with Shi Peng, and after Shi Peng died, she didn’t show a hint of sadness and then climbed into Stone Seat Elder’s bed, trading "skills" for new skills.
In the Demon Sect, who would get angry like Junior Sister Xiaojiu for a deceased senior sister? Dead is dead.
Thinking of this, Song Yan then swung his knife, killing the pig that was pressed on the wooden table, skillfully performing a series of actions to extract its lifespan.
Afterward, he went to the river to wash his hands.
During the day, Lady Ling practiced on the east riverside and only came over at night.
However, the words from last night lingered in his mind.
"Insects are very sensitive to breath, and these soul insects are especially sensitive not only to breath but also to the Divine Soul they recognize."
Song Yan turned his head to look at the shadows cast by the trees on the east riverside.
He could clearly see that those shadows were filled with soul insects, asleep.
...
...
That night.
After dual cultivation, the two lay flat on the couch.
Song Yan suddenly said, "Do you think... five years from now, where can I go?"
Just as the words fell, a soft voice came from beside him, "You... finally asked."
Lady Ling gently rested her hands on her stomach, gazing at the canopy overhead, calmly saying, "I can roughly pick out those soul insects that can detect your Divine Soul. Once you leave, I’ll destroy them all.
I know that the Purple Mansion cultivators can search through Divine Souls. This way, even if five years later, they discover the night candle soul insects, they can’t find anything unusual from these soul insects.
We... indeed are at a crossroads.
You must leave.
And I... must stay.
The Vilan Jiao Insect Race’s Purple Mansion cultivator is a mortal enemy to you.
But to me, it’s a great opportunity.
After you leave, I will become Grandmother Zhu.
I have many more things to do; I absolutely cannot let that great cultivator know... that I am Hua Linglong."
Song Yan also remained calm. In fact... when he discovered the "Fox Granny Shadow Puppet" wandered around Nanwu Sword Sect unscathed, he considered going to the Nanwu Sword Sect himself.
One reason was to acquire more advanced magic techniques; the other was to repair the ancient teleportation array.
These days, though he was in Candle Land, his heart was at Nanwu Sword Sect.
Indeed, as Lady Ling said: they had reached a crossroads, one with different opportunities and paths ahead.
Song Yan asked, "Can you give those soul insects to me? Or rather, do you have the Insect Control Technique, can you teach me?"
Lady Ling replied, "The Insect Control Technique is not something I perform, but something I execute through the thoughts of the great power I have fused with. You cannot take it away..."
The two continued to talk.
...
Several days later.
Song Yan left the Candle Land Secret Realm. During this period, the longevity gains he accumulated totaled 2746 years, with the [Longevity gains] tab showing [32/17372]. Even if he stopped making skin for a while, it would be enough to last him a long time.
He did not leave Lady Ling a shadow puppet, nor did Lady Ling give him any gifts, neither was there any drama; instead, it was all quite plain... Lady Ling saw him off at the entrance to Candle Land and said, "Take care, Dao brother."
He also smiled and gently replied, "Take care."
Then, the two of them turned around.
Lady Ling looked at those crushed soul insects, then stood in front of the wooden house Song Yan had built, gazing at the pig pens and sheep pens one by one. Although she wanted to wave her hand to command the soul insects to destroy these things, she didn’t act; instead, she turned and rode the clouds toward Hedong, her gaze confused and vacantly horrified.
She came from Jianghu, having gone through much love, life, and death, her romance was also dramatic. Now, she inadvertently stepped onto the path of Cultivating Profound, henceforth it would be like rowing against the current, not progressing means dying.
...
...
Over a month later...
Southern Wu.
In a dense forest, three figures crossed, yet only one remained.
Song Yan directly used the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" to swallow the shadow puppets of "Grandmother Fox" and the "Fox Demon", then used Illusion Technique to transform into the appearance of Bai Xiuhu, and turned back toward the Wang Family.
After this, he would need to spend time understanding many, many things to transform himself into the "real" Bai Xiuhu.
...
...
Half a year later...
Night Capital City, Midsummer Rain Alley, figures were crisscrossing and darting around, every household’s doors were tightly shut, mothers covered their children’s ears, hiding their own heartbeats, cowering silently under blankets.
The city where the Wang Family was situated was a major city of Southern Wu – Jianshui Capital.
The battles grew increasingly fierce, this capital city, once nightfall came, turned into a Chaotic Scene.
People from Jianghu and enemy forces swarmed in, there were Demon Sect cultivators waving large banners, stirring up flying sand and rocks, hiding blood corpses; Demon Sect disciples pulling Fox Demon Shadow Puppets, able to impersonate anyone, passing through unhindered; beautiful women in white dancing on rooftops, but with bloodless faces, upon closer look found to be paper figures...
On this night, the wind howled, torrential rain poured down, sand and gravel rose from the streets and alleys.
The brutal clash between cultivators and people from Jianghu proceeded simultaneously.
Dang!
Dang dang!
In the distance, layers of radiance clashed and collided, only to retreat and disperse.
One sword cultivator landed, staggered back a few steps, looked at his fellow disciples, and exclaimed, "Not good, tonight the Demon Sect sent more experts, we... We might all..."
"What are we afraid of?" another sword cultivator, unflinching, flexed his fingers and controlled his sword, laughing heartily, "Then let’s take out a few demon brats before dying!"
"Together!"
"Then let’s fight together!"
These sword cultivators, tempered by adversity, although their Realm hadn’t improved, their Mental Realm had grown much stronger. This made their Sword Spells even more powerful.
At this moment, everyone gathered, even though rain pounded down on them, yellow sand flying through the air, yet they felt their blood was burning.
The sword cultivators were about to take flight with their swords, when a female voice came from behind.
"I will join too!"
Little Jiushu Junior Sister stepped forward, head held high, a stance of gallantly facing death.
The sword cultivators exchanged glances, their eyes filled with smiles.
"Rise!"
"Rise!"
"Rise!"
Accompanied by determined shouts, flying swords unsheathed, person and sword fused into one, becoming a rainbow that pierced through the rain curtain.
But no sword cultivator called Song Yan.
Because, they all knew what kind of person this "Brother Bai" was, so they held no expectations for him, whether he fought or fled, no one cared.
Song Yan stepped into the pouring rain, looked up at the battle in the sky, murmuring to himself, "It’s about time, I should head back, I don’t have the time to linger here anymore."
The next instant, he took a step forward, uttering an intense shout, "Rise!!"
Keng!
Sword light instantly fused with him, slicing through the rain, thunderously crushing towards all sides.
The overwhelmingly large Sword Rainbow spun high in the air, wildly slashing, occasionally exploding in blood, all of it the blood of Demon Sect experts...
At the height of summer, wind and thunder arose suddenly.
The white rainbow patrolled the sky, like a flood dragon finally gaining the opportune moment, moving into the sea, devastating everything, divinely unstoppable, indomitably thrashing.
Song Yan stood out conspicuously, naturally attracting many Demon Sect experts’ siege, but soon... those Demon Sect experts all became corpses, flung onto the streets.
The sword cultivators, originally seeing death as home and fighting desperately, also noticed that extraordinarily fierce white rainbow, their pressure greatly relieved, even pausing to meet each other’s eyes in surprise, asking, "Which senior came to support us? Truly impressive!"
And some sword cultivators who saw clearly rushed over, saying in a disbelieving tone, "It’s... it’s Brother Bai."
Little Jiushu Junior Sister stared up in shock, looking at that rainbow like a flood dragon, her mood inexplicably complex...
The honest junior brother jumped and shouted, excitedly yelling, "It’s Brother Bai! Brother Bai, he can control the sword again! His Mental Realm, it’s recovered...
No, not recovered, but reached a whole new level!
What kind of heart, what kind of understanding of Sword Dao, is needed to execute such a White Snake Sword Technique? Is this still the White Snake Sword Technique?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 99. Do not seek the Secret Technique, the technique will naturally come (4.7K words - seek subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: 99. Do not seek the Secret Technique, the technique will naturally come (4.7K words - seek subscription)
A few days later...
The snow was light, and the sullen sky was filled with mourning clouds. Over the Misty Sea of the Nanwu Sword Sect, a rainbow light shot across the sky, landing directly on Red Leaf Island, stopping in front of a bamboo hut, and then quietly descending at the door.
In the courtyard, the vine chair was not taken in, but the medicine rack was empty, and the exotic flowers and herbs were all covered in white.
Song Yan raised his hand, cupped it respectfully, and said loudly, "Disciple has come again."
A response quickly came from the back of the courtyard: "Boy, quick, quick, quick, fetch me a dried piece of Purple Crow Grass from the bamboo plaque at the top right entrance of my room!"
Song Yan quickly entered, following the instructions, took the herb, and went to the backyard, only to see Kuye Sword Master still controlling his sword, hovering over the medicine cauldron, busy casting herbs into it, muttering incantations, with tightly furrowed brows.
He lightly flicked his sleeve.
The long wind carried the herb, landing it in Kuye Sword Master’s hand.
Kuye Sword Master busied himself again, finally closing the cauldron lid, then landing on the ground, dusting off his hands, and nervously staring at the medicine cauldron, muttering: "The taste of the Purple Crow is sweet and salty, and its qi is cold, it can cool and invigorate the blood. Even though the Manji Grass is hot in nature, it should be neutralized, and the effect should be more stable... ahem... ahem ahem ahem..."
He coughed violently, causing his hair to tremble.
Among the black hair, a few strands of frost-like white had somehow mixed in.
Song Yan saluted: "Teacher."
Kuye Sword Master said: "I heard you emerged, and it’s only been half a year, tsk..."
The elder gently stroked his beard, pondering, lifted his head, his eyes like two cold swords stabbing straight at Song Yan, and said sternly: "Sword control, let me witness."
Just like in the Demon Sect, reasoning and bullshit are the same, the dead are the ones without reason; in the Sword Sect, eloquent words are akin to bullshit, a hundred words are not as good as a single display of sword control.
Sword Heart, Sword Intent, are inherent, why argue?
"Yes."
Song Yan had truly practiced the "Profound Transformation Sword Manual", where his visualization sword had already emerged from the clouds, the sword belonging to him was extremely clear, and as for the "White Snake Sword Technique", he was beyond proficient.
With a pinch of his fingers, he formed a seal, and his flying sword unsheathed, the rainbow light merged with him, spinning over the bamboo house in an instant for more than ten circles, swirling the snow and wind into whirlpools like those on a white lake.
Pa.
After completing this, he landed back on the ground, standing in his original position, and saluted the elder again.
Kuye Sword Master seemed to still be savoring the sword heart, sword intent, and after contemplating with closed eyes for a good while, he opened them and said: "Human Sword Unity, the final secret technique of the ’Profound Transformation Sword Manual’, you have comprehended it.
If so, it would be a waste of your excellent sword potential..."
He paused again, then suddenly said: "The Puppet Sect is aggressively pressuring, and the Great Elder has to confront Gu Huangzi, the two have agreed to a duel at Konglan Mountain next year on Jingzhe...
Time is running out, the Great Elder wishes to personally instruct some outstanding younger members of our Sword Sect.
Your realm may be lacking a bit, but it’s enough, I’ll vouch for you, would you like to meet the Great Elder?"
Song Yan did not want to meet the Great Elder.
Besides the Sect Leader, who is in seclusion on Luoxia Bamboo Island, the Great Elder is the strongest master in the entire Nanwu Sword Sect. His illusion technique could deceive an average early stage or even a middle stage Crimson Palace cultivator if not looked at carefully. But that kind of... should not be fooled.
Kuye Sword Master saw his hesitation and laughed: "You rascal, others would jump at such an opportunity, why are you hesitating?
Let me tell you, the Supreme Ultimate Techniques of our Sword Sect might just be secretly passed on by the Great Elder to some disciple this time."
With that, he waited confidently.
Song Yan shook his head directly.
If he were truly Bai Xiuhu, he would have gone.
But he’s an imposter, you see.
Besides, even thinking with his feet, he knew that if he were taught this ultimate technique by the Great Elder, countless people would be watching him afterward. Among them, there would be seniors from the Nanwu Sword Sect secretly protecting him, masters from the Puppet Sect attempting to capture or assassinate him, and all kinds of ridiculous affairs.
If the Great Elder defeats Gu Huangzi in the duel, all would be well. But if defeated, then this disciple who inherits the Supreme Ultimate Techniques of the Sword Sect would instantly jump into the spotlight.
He refused to do it.
Kuye Sword Master said: "Opportunities are rare, before, you wanted it but didn’t have it."
Song Yan continued to shake his head.
Kuye Sword Master asked: "Why?"
Song Yan said: "I’m not worthy."
Kuye Sword Master frowned: "Even if you’ve made mistakes in the past, your mental realm has broken through now, you should have been able to move on. Why not put your mind to our Sword Sect, slay demons and exorcise evil, carry on our legacy!?"
Song Yan said: "My heart is already withered, I only seek to close my eyes and ears, and find a place of tranquility."
Kuye Sword Master was stunned for a moment, finally understanding what state of mind this disciple had realized.
He was happy before, thinking the Sword Sect had produced a genius tempered through hardship.
But this was not tempered through hardship, it was evidently a complete fall into the extreme mental state of "melancholic despair, escapism, unwilling to heed worldly matters"...
But once an extreme mental state is achieved, it is still an achievement.
Kuye Sword Master raised his eyes to Song Yan, and saw that his disciple had his gaze slightly lowered, devoid of any hope, truly a posture of having cut ties with the mortal world.
He could not contain himself, brutally asking: "Are you really not going?"
Song Yan shook his head.
"Are you going or not?"
Song Yan kept shaking his head.
Kuye Sword Master’s lips moved, wanting to speak but stopping, finally he reprimandingly barked: "Get lost!"
Song Yan saluted, turned, and "got lost".
But as soon as he "got lost" to the door, Kuye Sword Master’s voice came again from behind: "From tomorrow, come here to learn alchemy!
If you don’t practice swordsmanship, surely you can practice alchemy?

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 99. Not Seeking Secret Technique, Technique Comes Naturally (4.7K characters - Subscribe Request)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: 99. Not Seeking Secret Technique, Technique Comes Naturally (4.7K characters - Subscribe Request)_2
It’s quite tranquil on my side, especially the Spirit Garden behind the house; apart from this old man, no one visits it all year round.
So, are you satisfied now?"
There was a hint of provocation and mockery in his words.
After all, which hot-blooded sword cultivator is willing to farm?
He was here because of erysipelas, unable to advance further, so he degraded himself to cultivate the Profound Field, hoping to develop some pill recipes to give later generations a stronger chance and not end up suffering like him from erysipelas day and night.
However, Song Yan stomped his foot and said, "Yes, teacher."
Kuye Swordmaster felt inexplicably angry when he heard that Song Yan actually agreed, his beard trembling, pacing back and forth. Suddenly, he sniffed his nose as if he smelled something burning, only to find that the burnt smell was coming from the medicine cauldron.
Kuye Swordmaster jumped in rage; he realized he had been so distracted by this brat that he forgot about the timing. The more he thought about it, the more agitated he became and couldn’t help but shout angrily, "Get out, get out! You brat!! Bad luck!"
"Yes, teacher."
Song Yan’s tone was calm, and he quickly left.
He was quite satisfied with this arrangement.
After all, wasn’t he here to fish in troubled waters? It was obvious the Kuye Swordmaster was nearing the end of his lifespan at the early stage of the Crimson Palace, and this place was... just right for him.
...
...
The next day...
Slam.
Kuye Swordmaster tossed a booklet over, saying, "See for yourself, don’t mess up my precious flowers and plants."
He couldn’t even be bothered to glance at Song Yan.
Song Yan took the booklet and saw that the cover read "Hundred Examinations of Profound Grass." Upon opening it, he found the contents detailed, from the "appearance and medicinal properties of Profound Grass" to the "compatible elixirs," all described.
The first entry he saw was a Profound Grass he was familiar with.
[Moonlight Grass]: With a sweet nature, it often grows on high grounds of the Profound Vein, gathering Profound Qi into its stems and leaves. It can be roasted into tea or sun-dried for alchemy. The grass is cold-tolerant and heat-averse, planted in winter and harvested in summer.
The subsequent pill recipes included were "Little Profound Spirit Pill," "Great Profound Spirit Pill," and even "Little Profound Liquid Pill," all elixirs Song Yan was quite familiar with.
As he flipped further, he saw that even "Manji Grass" and "Purple Crow Grass" were described.
Clearly, "Hundred Examinations of Profound Grass" was compiled by Kuye Swordmaster, synthesizing information from various books and his own years of experience.
Song Yan had always been very patient, so he held the booklet in his hands, studying it seriously at the table beside him.
Kuye Swordmaster threw the booklet to him and later sneaked a glance at him again, only to see that the brat was seriously reading, leaving him at a loss for words.
For a sword cultivator to engage in alchemy was a real test of patience, akin to ruining one’s future.
Kuye Swordmaster sighed inwardly: ’Maybe, after a few days, this brat will get bored, and that would be good.
Then, I can recommend him to the Grand Elder....
After a year of seclusion, he suddenly achieved enlightenment, glimpsed my sword, and comprehended Human Sword Unity, which is extremely rare.
With such talent, at such an age, he really shouldn’t be wasted here with this old man.’
...
...
A little more than half a month later...
Song Yan was not only studying "Hundred Examinations of Profound Grass" but also started to earnestly tend to the Profound Field behind the bamboo hut.
He took off the silver sword robe and put on a gray work outfit, bending over in the Profound Field at the far right of Red Leaf Island to pull weeds while driving away some demon birds and demon rats.
The demon birds, called "Mist Sparrows," were low-level demon beasts among low-level demon beasts; their power was weak, but they were numerous, often living in the Profound Vein Wetland, sleeping by day and active by night.
The demon rats, named "Burrowing Mice," were even lower-level demon beasts than Mist Sparrows, but they had a special ability: as long as they hid in the earth without moving, they were extremely hard to detect, sleeping by day and active by night, loving to burrow underground and eat the roots of Profound Flowers and Profound Grass clean.
These two were impossible to eradicate completely, being akin to "cutting weeds but not removing the roots, only for them to regrow with the spring breeze"...
For someone like Kuye Swordmaster in the Crimson Palace Realm, even he was irritated, so he built a "special shelter" in the Profound Field specifically to grow precious Profound Flowers and Profound Grass, while the other less critical plants could be placed outside.
Then, periodically, he initiated operations to "slay demon birds, exterminate demon rats."
But perhaps due to the rarity and concentration of Profound Flowers and Profound Grass grown by Kuye Swordmaster, not only these two demon beasts, but even other magical creatures were drawn to visit.
Diverse and assorted.
The most marvelous was a peculiar thing called the "Strange Tail Shadow Rat"...
This peculiar creature was categorized as an intermediate-level demon beast, with its favorite activity being "digging others’ fields, eating others’ flowers and plants, then quietly planting seeds from who-knows-where it got them, hoping the owner would take care of these seeds, so it could return to harvest them when matured."
Utterly despicable!
Once, Kuye Swordmaster wasn’t paying attention, and something weird grew in the field, nearly driving him mad with anger.
At this moment, Kuye Swordmaster paused his work and quietly looked towards the Profound Field, releasing his Divine Sense...
One look.
He was stunned.
"Don’t run!"
"Stand still for me!"
The gray-clothed sword cultivator, covered in dust, stood in the fields, rolling up his sleeves, and used sword control to chase away the Mist Sparrows. However... the Mist Sparrows were numerous, falling like a swarm and rising like a swarm, covering the sky and earth.
But with Song Yan stationed here, these Mist Sparrows naturally wouldn’t gain any advantage, so they began to flee.
And Song Yan pointedly chased them with sword control...
As the Mist Sparrows swooshed to the ground, many still managed to escape.
Song Yan even used sword control to take flight, relentlessly pursuing, yelling "Stop, stand still for me" and such along the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 99. Not Seeking Secret Technique, Technique Comes Naturally (4.7K characters - Subscribe Request)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: 99. Not Seeking Secret Technique, Technique Comes Naturally (4.7K characters - Subscribe Request)_3
"I..."
The Kuye Sword Master couldn’t help but cover his eyes, truly unable to look.
When evening came, after Song Yan’s busy day, he called Song Yan back again, earnestly saying, "Xiuhu, your talent shouldn’t be wasted here. The past is bygone, and the future... is what you should cherish."
Song Yan looked at him with clear eyes and said, "Teacher, I have already thought it through. If you can remain at the Crimson Palace Realm, dedicating your life to the younger generation of the Sword Sect, why can’t I?"
Kuye Sword Master said, "That’s because..."
His lips moved, thinking of his imminent demise, so he did not continue with "I have erysipelas," but instead sighed long, then smiled and said, "Stay if you wish, after all, this garden needs someone to tend to it.
Otherwise, if this old man leaves one day, many experiences... will be gone just like that.
Rather than finding several disciples in the end, might as well you.
Though I am in the Crimson Palace Realm, I have a certain arrogance in my heart, and I don’t wish to casually pass on what I’ve learned to disciples with ordinary talent.
Since you have come, and at this time, very well, very well... you and this old man are destined."
...
...
From that day on, the Kuye Sword Master no longer tried to drive Song Yan away, thinking of sending Song Yan to the great elder, but instead patiently taught him to identify herb properties.
Song Yan learned earnestly.
In the blink of an eye, another half month passed.
Kuye Sword Master called Song Yan over, "Today, I will teach you alchemy."
Song Yan curiously looked around.
Kuye Sword Master asked, "What are you looking for?"
Song Yan replied, "I thought there would be an alchemy manual."
Kuye Sword Master laughed, "Alchemy relies on timing, and the rest is the pill recipe. The formation of a pill recipe relies on pharmacology and experiment results, where would a manual come from?
Didn’t you think that by following a book, you’d learn alchemy?"
Song Yan said, "Isn’t there still pharmacology?"
The old face of Kuye Sword Master turned red, "I will first teach you timing, and once you can refine the Little Profound Spirit Pill yourself, I will teach you pharmacology."
"Yes, teacher."
Song Yan nodded.
An old one and a young one, one teaching and one learning.
The elder eagerly imparted his knowledge wholeheartedly, while the young one was immensely intelligent, learning by analogy.
Soon it was dusk, and in a blink, the stars filled the sky.
On the Misty Sea, a fog began to rise, thin white vapor drowning Red Leaf Island deep in this sea of mists, making it difficult to see your own fingers.
Reluctantly, the two stopped, still wanting more.
Kuye Sword Master said, "You learn quickly, this heart of mine... truly bleeds. With your talent, oh... no point in talking further."
Song Yan said, "It’s just my choice as a disciple."
Then he glanced at the panel where "Cultivation Technique" displayed "Mortal Fire Refining Technique" and "Magic" displayed "Pill Formula: Little Profound Spirit Pill" (entry-level proficiency), then bid farewell and turned to leave.
Once back in his room, he spent 10 years of lifespan to change the "entry-level proficiency" of "Pill Formula: Little Profound Spirit Pill" to "perfection level proficiency".
However, a "pill formula" is not magic and does not have the possibility of mutation due to the Ghost Profound Root, so it stops here.
There is no doubt, "Mortal Fire Refining Technique" just like "Profound Qi Guiding Technique" is a "know it, then can use it" technique, and the key lies in visualization objects of the guiding technique and the fire used for alchemy.
Different fires have different ways of control, and what Song Yan mastered was just the most ordinary "mortal fire".
...
Three days later.
Song Yan successfully refined the Little Profound Spirit Pill, with a pill formation rate of thirty percent.
...
In the following days...
Each day, the pill formation rate increased by ten percent, finally resting at eighty percent.
And that’s already a terrifying success rate.
Kuye Sword Master himself, when refining pills, was only at this level.
...
That day, Kuye Sword Master called Song Yan over, "You want to learn pill formula pharmacology, don’t you?"
Song Yan said, "Yes, teacher."
Kuye Sword Master showed a subtly cunning look, "Then, I will give you a token, you go to the Library Pavilion yourself and get it."
"Yes." Song Yan took the token, turned around, and was about to leave.
Kuye Sword Master said behind him, "Um..."
"What is it, teacher?"
"You... if you..." Kuye Sword Master stammered, "find a swordsmanship or cultivation technique you like, don’t be shy, just take it yourself. The gatekeeper of the Library Pavilion is an old acquaintance of mine. Got it?"
"Understood, teacher."
Song Yan bowed again and sword flew off into the distance.
During these days on Red Leaf Island, he had become quite familiar with the distribution of buildings on the island.
Kuye Sword Master watched the retreating rainbow light, stroking his beard, thinking secretly: ’You brat, don’t let me down.
For you to practice sword again, I specifically sought out my nemesis, bowed my head, and had her place a few secret techniques next to the alchemy pharmacology in the Library Pavilion.
You brat better not miss them!’

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 100. Meng Po Po, Profound Sword Scripture (2.9K words - seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: 100. Meng Po Po, Profound Sword Scripture (2.9K words - seeking subscription)
Nanwu Sword Sect has two Library Pavilions, one in the Su Family in Misty Sea West, and one in the Sun Family.
Because the Great Elder is from the Sun Family, and the Su Family’s ancestor died in the Battle of Thorn Fox, the important books in the Su Family’s Library Pavilion were all moved to the Sun Family.
The island where the Sun Family is located is named: Copper Sparrow.
On Copper Sparrow Island, Sword Rainbow hung down. After Song Yan presented his Identity Token and the token given by Sword Master Kuye, he smoothly entered the island.
He looked around, and saw here pavilions and towers, like a forest towering, sitting amidst the water mist, truly as beautiful as a fairyland.
Observing Mist Island is the entry-level island of Nanwu Sword Sect, while Red Leaf Island and other scattered large islands are the middle barrier. The islands at the rear are only three: Copper Sparrow Island of the Sun Family, Golden Fish Island of the Su Family, and Luoxia Bamboo Island.
In terms of size, these three islands are smaller than the previous islands, but their importance and the masters within them far surpass other islands.
Therefore, when Song Yan entered, he was extra cautious, and extra low-key, fearing to bump into the Great Elder or other Middle Stage of Crimson Palace masters...
Fortunately, the place where the Sun Family’s Library Pavilion is located is extremely secluded, and there are array flags set up around to isolate exploration.
When Song Yan stepped into the array boundary, all the sounds outside disappeared.
Inside the Library Pavilion, there were quite a few disciples coming and going, borrowing books.
Books are divided into two kinds.
One kind is Jade Scrolls.
The Jade Scrolls usually store systematic magic techniques.
The other kind is books.
Books mostly contain experiences and insights from predecessors.
Because magic and cultivation are different. The latter only requires time accumulation, and is only related to talent, Profound Root, and resources; the former requires comprehension, so these books are particularly important.
The experiences of others, especially the successful experiences left by family ancestors, can help descendants avoid a lot of detours.
...
...
Song Yan looked up at this five-floor tall Library Pavilion, then stepped inside.
Along the way, some disciples seemed to recognize him, some even smiled and saluted, but did not speak...
The caretaker of the Library Pavilion here is a very strict old woman, and whoever makes a loud noise in the Library Pavilion area, will be directly driven out by the old woman.
Few of the younger generations know her name or surname, and Song Yan only vaguely knew from his memories that this old woman does not seem to be from the Sun Family.
Not being from the Sun Family, yet watching over the Sun Family Pavilion, it shows that her identity is quite special.
And here, those who come to read the books call her...
"Granny Meng..."
Song Yan respectfully saluted and showed the token given by Sword Master Kuye.
The old woman was initially hanging her head in a sleepy posture, but upon seeing the token, she abruptly raised her eyes, which were as sharp as lightning, looking at Song Yan for a long time, then snorted coldly, and "snap," she flung out a Jade Scroll from her sleeve, speaking in a tone that brooked no denial: "Here, take the secret technique inside away!"
Song Yan was momentarily stunned.
Granny Meng frowned and said: "Wishy-washy, really carved out of the same mold as your teacher.
One wants to give me the Sword Sect’s secret technique yet does it sneakily, one is still so indecisive...
I, this old woman, say it right here today, this secret technique you must take, whether you want it or not!"
Song Yan was greatly shocked. He raised his hand to press on the Jade Scroll, and as he perceived it slightly, information was transmitted from within.
After a long while...
A new piece of information appeared in his Cultivation Technique section.
[Cultivation Technique]: "Profound Sword Scripture"
And upon accepting the information, he roughly understood what this "Profound Sword Scripture" was.
This is the true Secret Technique of Nanwu Sword Sect, which is a subsequent cultivation technique that uses the "Profound Transformation Sword Manual" as a prerequisite, only cultivable by those who have seen "my sword" and comprehended "Human Sword Unity," and is a cultivation technique that can be cultivated to the Late stage Of Crimson Palace.
As a cultivation technique, it has quite a rich function, teaching three things:
First, transform your entire body of Profound Qi into Sword Qi.
What is Sword Qi?
This Qi is gold-biased within the Five Elements, yet does not require Innate Golden Profound Root, it is incomparably sharp, inherently with attack power, once deployed, far surpasses Profound Qi, and if paired with a sword-type Profound Treasure, its power multiplies.
Of course, learning Sword Qi will not make you lose anything, the magic techniques that could be performed with Profound Qi before can still be performed normally.
Second, refine special Sword Qi.
In the Realm of Crimson Palace, although it is based on "Nine Palace Blood," that Nine Palace Blood is also fixed in the Crimson Palace through Profound Qi.
And Profound Qi turns into Sword Qi.
The Sword Qi is then nurtured by that Nine Palace Blood, forming "extremely special, even unique" special Sword Qi.
The more special the Nine Palace Blood, the harder it is to nurture the Sword Qi, but its "specialness" is also stronger.
Third, forge special Flying Swords.
Although "special Sword Qi" can be used solo, if it can be deployed with corresponding "special Flying Swords," the power can double or even multiply.
As for how to forge "special Flying Swords," it is also described in "Profound Sword Scripture."
Song Yan also doesn’t know if forming "special Sword Qi" is difficult, but he was delighted in his heart as this was the kind of Sword Dao technique he was looking for that belongs to cultivators of the Crimson Palace Realm.
Afterward, he hurriedly picked up a book on "pharmacology" and then left.
...
...
Returning to Red Leaf Island.
Kuye Sword Master asked, "Brat, did you get..."
Song Yan replied, "Grandma Meng gave me the ’Profound Sword Scripture’."
Kuye Sword Master was stunned for a moment.
He had asked Grandma Meng to place some secret techniques, but he didn’t ask for the ’Profound Sword Scripture’.
The ’Profound Sword Scripture’ is considered the core cultivation technique of the Nanwu Sword Sect. Although it is a cultivation technique, it can evolve into countless magic techniques. It may not be the supreme ultimate techniques of the Nanwu Sword Sect, but... the supreme ultimate techniques evolved from this ’Profound Sword Scripture’.
It can be said that the ’Profound Sword Scripture’ is the main trunk of the great tree that is the Nanwu Sword Sect, and the supreme ultimate techniques are just the most luxuriant fruits on this main trunk’s branches.
Very few in the entire Nanwu Sword Sect have the authority to pass down the ’Profound Sword Scripture’, and Grandma Meng happens to be among them.
But even this "transmission quota" has its limitations.
If nothing unexpected occurs, only one person can be taught every three years.
Grandma Meng transmitted it to Song Yan this year, so for the next three years, she cannot pass it to others.
Considering the current special situation, being wartime, perhaps... Song Yan is her last student she will ever pass it to.
In a sense, Grandma Meng can be entirely regarded as Song Yan’s "master of teachings".
Kuye Sword Master asked, "Did she have you call her Master?"
Song Yan shook his head and then asked, "Teacher, you know Grandma Meng, don’t you?"
Kuye Sword Master showed a look of reminiscence, the corners of his mouth curling up with a hint of bitterness, letting out several sighs, then coldly said, "Who doesn’t know her? Stubborn, bad-tempered, strict old woman!"
After speaking, he added, "Tomorrow, I’ll...I’ll casually grab two boxes of inferior Profound Tea for you. You take them to call her Master."
Seeing Song Yan stunned, he continued, "That old woman has passed you the ’Profound Sword Scripture’, she’s worth your call, go ahead."
Song Yan asked, "But, teacher, shouldn’t we bring some good tea?"
Kuye Sword Master replied, "Nonsense! Anyway, when you see her, make sure to say that tea is just something this old man took casually, it’s... it’s something this old man doesn’t want to drink anymore!"
Song Yan: ...
This...
Isn’t this old guy being tsundere?
...
...
That night...
Kuye Sword Master took out two boxes of Profound Tea he had treasured for many years and couldn’t bear to drink, carefully hung them with silk strings, inspected them repeatedly before finally stopping.
...
And after returning to the bamboo hut, Song Yan was closing his eyes, perusing the content of the ’Profound Sword Scripture’, feeling more and more the ingenuity of it. It was apparent that this content was created by a power with extremely deep foundations, over a long period and through generations of geniuses.
Thinking of the broken sword at the ancient teleportation array, the south-north pathways of the ancient teleportation array, Song Yan couldn’t help but wonder: Could the Nanwu Sword Sect be a branch of some sect from the Northern Land? Just that with the disappearance of the ancient teleportation array, the connection was entirely severed?
But he immediately shook his head. This kind of speculation... has no basis or significance.
Tonight, he had no intention of cultivating the ’Profound Sword Scripture’. Because, he had set his sights on a piece in the Library Pavilion, ’Hidden Sword Technique’.
It was a technique inclined towards Qi Concealment, but the entry threshold was far higher than the ordinary technique ’Qi Concealment Technique’.
The realm requirement was merely the sixth layer of Refining Profound, but the hidden requirement was still "Human Sword Unity".
As a Sword Cultivator, if one cannot unite with the sword, all techniques are superficial, not even having entered the basics, and the advanced techniques corresponding to that system naturally cannot be practiced.
His gathering of Qi, even in combination with talismans, had already reached saturation...
He needed a new Qi Concealment Technique.
And the Library Pavilion of the Nanwu Sword Sect... gave him the opportunity.
...
...
The next day.
Song Yan, carrying the Profound Tea, appeared again in the Library Pavilion on Copper Sparrow Island, respectfully greeted the old woman, and said, "Teacher said, since you have passed me that cultivation technique, you are also my Master. This is... some tea to show respect to you."
Grandma Meng snorted coldly, glanced at the tea, and asked, "What tea?"
Song Yan replied, "It’s... what Teacher Kuye has cherished for a long time, and he couldn’t bear to drink it himself. He specifically took it for you. He thought I didn’t know, but I actually understood everything."
Grandma Meng: ...
Song Yan slapped his forehead and continued, "Oh, right. Teacher Kuye also specifically asked me to convey to you that these two boxes of Profound Tea were just something he casually took, that he didn’t want to drink anymore."
Grandma Meng: ...
Song Yan lightly coughed, imitating the tone and demeanor of Kuye Sword Master, said, "Nonsense! Anyway, when you see her, make sure to say that tea is just something this old man took casually, it’s... it’s something this old man doesn’t want to drink anymore!"
Grandma Meng’s expression began to grow peculiar, the lines that often sagged down at the corners of her mouth started to tremble, and she couldn’t help but laugh heartily.
She was in a great mood and said, "Boy, go inside and borrow some books, today your Granny is in a good mood, you can take another book of techniques, consider it passed on by your Granny."
"Thank you, Teacher Meng."
Song Yan bowed slightly, placing the tea leaves on the table, catching a glimpse of the reminiscent look in Grandma Meng’s eyes.
He quickly stepped inside, feigned looking around, glanced here and there, and finally chose the ’Hidden Sword Technique’, and then brought it to register with Grandma Meng at the front.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 101. Peaceful Residence, Sword and Shadow Both Follow the Heart (3.2K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: 101. Peaceful Residence, Sword and Shadow Both Follow the Heart (3.2K words - Please subscribe)
On Red Leaf Island.
After returning, Song Yan silently grabbed the flying sword and went to Valley Profound Field to clear weeds and chase away birds and beasts.
Sword Master Kuye, as usual, was in the front yard reading books and attempting elixirs in the backyard.
As for what happened in the Library Pavilion, the old and the young, these two men, stubbornly did not mention it.
One intentionally did not speak.
The other held back from asking.
And so they both stubbornly waited.
...
Afternoon...
In front of the courtyard, three sword cultivators in silver robes came together, bowing outside Sword Master Kuye’s door.
"Disciple Zhu Sengzhi, here to bid farewell to the teacher. I must head north to patrol the Luo River."
"Disciple Qu Huayan, here to bid farewell to the teacher. I must head north to patrol the Luo River."
"Disciple Sun Rufu, here to bid farewell to the teacher. I must head north to patrol the Luo River."
The Luo River is a great river quite near the Puppet Sect, and relatively close to Konglan Mountain, indicating that this journey is extremely perilous.
Sword Master Kuye shouted, "The three of you, come in, and fetch me a sprig of Purple Crow Grass, two Iron Broom Flowers, and one dried Sweet Osmanthus Fruit from the medicine plaque at the door."
The three sword cultivators exchanged a knowing smile, retrieved the herbs, and walked into the backyard, watching the elder bustling around.
Once Sword Master Kuye finished his tasks, the three paid their respects again.
The atmosphere was strangely quiet, until it was broken by Sword Master Kuye’s hearty laugh.
"Good children, this is your opportunity."
One of the sword cultivators laughed heartily, "What the teacher said is true, this is the perfect time to wash my blade with the blood of the demon followers, to enlighten my Sword Heart."
Another sword cultivator said, "I’ve always awaited such an opportunity. A sword cultivator should hone themselves in danger, only then can the sword become sharper!"
The last sword cultivator, a female, bowed again, saying, "Teacher, take care of yourself."
Sword Master Kuye nodded slightly, gave the three some guidance, and watched as three sword rainbows flew away from the bamboo house.
He looked up, watching until the lone shadow in the distance disappeared, then lowered his head, looking somber for a long while before laughing heartily again, and continued to busy himself...
Over the past year, especially in the last two months, more and more disciples have come to bid farewell...
...
...
In the evening, a thin layer of mist from the Misty Sea once again enveloped the islands and hills.
Beyond the mist, the clouds glowed with the warm orange light of the sunset, dispersing in the mist, making everything not only hazy but also stained with a yellowish tone.
Song Yan once more approached the bamboo house’s entrance, intending to bid farewell.
Sword Master Kuye finally couldn’t resist asking, "Shu Hu... you... at the Library Pavilion... did you call that old lady?"
Song Yan replied, "I did."
Sword Master Kuye made a sound of acknowledgment, acting as if he didn’t want to ask more.
But immediately, Song Yan continued, "Teacher Meng asked me what kind of tea I brought her."
Sword Master Kuye perked up his ears, but snorted coldly, smiling indifferently, "Just some Profound Tea I grabbed casually, you should know better not to say that."
Song Yan gave a thumbs up, nodding in approval, "The teacher knows me well."
After speaking, he added, "I told her it was something Sword Master Kuye cherished for a long time, reluctant to drink it himself, and specially sent it to Teacher Meng. I also said, Sword Master Kuye thought I didn’t know, but I actually understood everything."
Sword Master Kuye: ???
"You..."
Song Yan slapped his forehead and said, "I even mimicked the way the teacher spoke to me that day."
Sword Master Kuye’s face twisted, unclear what strange syllables he was muttering.
Song Yan pretended not to notice, coughed twice, cleared his throat, then mimicked Sword Master Kuye’s tone from that day, "Nagging! Anyway, when you see her, you must say that tea was just something I casually gave, didn’t want to drink it myself!"
Sword Master Kuye’s face turned completely hideous, he jumped up in rage, shouting, "Get out! Get out!"
Song Yan nonchalantly acknowledged, "Oh," and jogged away, disappearing into the fog.
Sword Master Kuye stood in place with a complex expression, and suddenly the wind from afar carried the disciple’s voice again.
"By the way, teacher, when I was leaving, I saw Teacher Meng eagerly brewing the tea you gave her.
She looked like she enjoyed it very much, but... also seemed inexplicably lost, I don’t understand why either."
The clear voice reached Sword Master Kuye’s ears.
The old man was momentarily stunned, then gave a gentle sigh.
His back slightly arched, leaning on the bamboo fence, his eyes showing a glimpse of nostalgia for the past, muttering, "How did it pass so fast, that I’m old?
You have grown old too... in the past, you wouldn’t have been like this..."
The muttering had just ended when a cold voice suddenly echoed from mid-air.
"What will happen then?"
Swordsman Kuye suddenly raised his head, only to see a spirited old woman standing amidst the mist in mid-air, her cold gaze falling from above.
Who else could this old woman be but Meng Po?
The two elders locked eyes.
Meng Po said, "That young man said you invited me today, so I even closed the Library Pavilion early to come over."
With that, the old woman floated down, as if oblivious to the old man’s extremely shocked expression, she stretched her arms and walked towards the fence gate, and before the door, she turned back and said, "I’ve been tired all day, you invited me here, and didn’t even cook a decent meal? I’m quite disappointed."
Swordsman Kuye turned around and said, "Rong’Er, that matter was my fault, I... I shouldn’t have coveted the power of the Crimson Palace Demon Beast and recklessly made us both take that Crimson Palace Pill, claiming we could explore the path forward together. As a result... we both remained at the Early Stage of the Crimson Palace, suffering from the erysipelas."
Meng Po was silent for a moment and then smiled, "You really know how to bring up the pot that doesn’t boil. Even the young man is smarter than you. If I still cared about that, would I have come today?
We’ve grown old, those things are in the past."
Swordsman Kuye’s old eyes grew red, then he laughed and slapped his head, "Look at my memory, just mentioned you coming over and didn’t prepare any food.
Rong’Er, wait a moment, I have plenty of Profound Flower and Profound Grass in my Profound Field that I can cook up, I’ll just fetch them, you sit down, sit down."
Meng Po entered the house, looking around, "The layout here is almost unchanged from when we were together, you really are..."
Swordsman Kuye’s old face flushed, and employing Sword Control and Rainbow Transformation, he flew swiftly towards the Profound Field, though over a hundred years old, his heart began to pound once more.
...
...
Song Yan walked alone along the path, bamboo cottages on both sides hidden in the water mist.
This kind of mist was quite refreshing, vastly different than when he was at South Bamboo Peak, like heaven and earth apart.
Yet, he keenly noticed that compared to when he first arrived, the residents of the bamboo cottages on Red Leaf Island had noticeably decreased.
Some houses stood empty, their occupants gone... it was uncertain if they would return.
’I must hurry.’
Feeling slightly heavy-hearted, Song Yan returned to his bamboo cottage, shutting the doors tight, and quickly focused his attention on the "Magic" section’s "Hidden Sword Technique", while his gaze also glanced towards the "Cultivation Technique" section’s "Profound Sword Scripture".
Today, he intended to first cultivate the "Hidden Sword Technique", and then, using its hidden effect, proceed with the practice of the "Profound Sword Scripture".
Familiar information surfaced.
[Please choose to invest life span]
...
...
[In the first year, through diligent practice, you have reached an entry-level understanding of the "Hidden Sword Technique." Upon perceiving the principle of this technique, you couldn’t help but feel hopeful when you slightly compared it to the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" because the fundamental principles of the two techniques are entirely different]
The "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" is a magic derived from the "Qi Concealment Technique" after two instances of perfect mutation, allowing evil qi to partially conceal and devour internal profound qi, then explode it suddenly. Mastery of this magic requires relentless practice to proficiently control the devouring of profound qi, thus achieving spontaneous command.
Yet, the "Hidden Sword Technique" is entirely different.
The primary focus of the "Hidden Sword Technique" is not "proficiency," but "mental realm".
The opening line states, "If the heart hides the sword, there’s no need to wield it, letting go and retract, and operate as desired."
The essence of this magic emphasizes "relaxation," allowing oneself to enter a state of "extreme tranquility" through letting go.
In this state, all sword qi will quiet down, just as a strong man relaxes his body and muscles while sleeping.
If the "Qi Concealment Technique" is about hiding "existing things" into a drawer by any means, then the "Hidden Sword Technique" is about temporarily reducing the number of these things.
Mental ideas act as switches.
If anger arises, sword qi will suddenly burst out; if the heart is calm, sword qi will temporarily remain quiet likewise.
If tranquility is achieved, one naturally hides the sword, making it undiscoverable.
[In the twenty-first year, you have mastered the "Hidden Sword Technique" to perfection, allowing all sword qi to rest peacefully within the body, seemingly hidden when calm, eruptive when active, controlled entirely by your thoughts]
Song Yan continued investing life span, seeking mutation.
[In the one hundred and twenty-fifth year, you leveraged the Ghost Profound Root’s uniqueness to comprehend the "Profound Evil Sword Swallowing Skill". Not only can you hide sword qi through the mental realm, but you can also devour all exposed sword qi with internal evil qi, albeit transforming it completely into evil qi after devouring]
[In the two thousand and eighty-fifth year, you deduced the secondary perfect mutation secret technique, the "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique". One thought for enlightenment, one thought for demonic, sword qi and evil qi— the former requires clarity of mind, while the latter chaos and evil— switch at will, where sword qi can become evil qi, and vice versa]
Song Yan exhaled deeply, briefly perceiving the discovery that the "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique" was indeed a perfect magic based on both the "Hidden Sword Technique" and the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique".
Once employed, all internal qi can be rapidly concealed through two channels and seamlessly switch between evil qi and sword qi.
Moreover, the various clever moves from the "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique", such as "devouring others’ profound qi," "condensing qi for a sudden burst," etc., could also be utilized freely, combined with the intrinsic sharpness of sword qi, it became incredibly versatile and quite outrageous.
If the first mutation made sword qi and evil qi stiff and somewhat "self-binding," this secondary perfect mutation utterly resolved that problem.
In addition, the notion of "one thought sword qi, one thought evil qi" implicitly meant "one thought sword cultivator, one thought ghost cultivator," truly remarkable.
However, Song Yan quickly noticed a problem.
Currently, most of the qi within him was ordinary profound qi, with only a small portion being evil profound qi. If he were to cultivate "ordinary profound qi" into "sword qi," in the future... he could only switch between sword and evil, losing the ability to revert to ordinary profound qi.
Sword qi is sharp, evil qi is bizarre, but... without the option to return to ordinary profound qi, Song Yan was uncertain whether this was good or bad.
However, he had no choice.
’Since it’s not bad, I might as well go all out and cultivate the "Profound Sword Scripture".
It’s time to progress further.’

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 102. Both Righteous and Evil, Array Dao News (3.9K words - Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: 102. Both Righteous and Evil, Array Dao News (3.9K words - Seeking Subscription)
[Year one, you operate the "Profound Sword Scripture," transforming three hundred strands of Profound Qi into Sword Qi...]
[Year thirty, you’ve converted all of the Profound Qi in your body into Sword Qi...]
Song Yan perceived.
He found that all the ordinary Profound Qi in his Refining Profound Realm had turned into Sword Qi.
He continued his cultivation.
[Year one hundred and thirty, you’ve converted all the Profound Qi wrapped around the "Changwang Tiger" Essence Blood in the Central Palace into Sword Qi]
[The Sword Qi interacted with the "Changwang Tiger Essence Blood," and you comprehended a trace of special Sword Qi—Soul-Imprisoning Sword Qi.
Wherever the Sword Qi goes, the opponent will feel a sense of unease on the level of the Divine Soul for a while, with slow thinking and sluggish movements]
[Year two hundred and thirty, you’ve converted all the Profound Qi wrapped around the "Night Candle Soul Worm" Essence Blood in the Central Left Palace into Sword Qi]
[The Sword Qi interacted with the "Night Candle Soul Worm," and you comprehended a trace of special Sword Qi—Soul-Piercing Sword Qi.
The Sword Qi is formless, directly targeting the Divine Soul. Although its power is not as great as the soul collision of the Night Candle Soul Worm, it can cause a fleeting pain on the level of the Divine Soul during a battle, making it difficult to defend against]
Thus...
The cultivation was considered complete.
Song Yan stretched his body, feeling the Sword Qi surging within. Yet, with a single thought, it all returned to calm, truly "still like a virgin, moving like a fleeing rabbit," akin to a vast ocean, appearing calm, but if a tsunami arose, it could instantly display the strength of a natural disaster.
Although he had not yet made a move, Song Yan already felt a significant improvement in his power, but what level it was at, he was not yet sure.
However, he also sensed that this "Profound Sword Scripture" seemed to contain some external entity that could accelerate the speed of cultivation, but these things... were unrelated to him now.
He had trained well enough and no longer needed to exhaust his mind seeking those external items.
Having completed his cultivation, Song Yan recalled the matter of the array.
There are four whole years left in the five-year agreement...
But he had not found relevant information on "arrays" in the Library Pavilion of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
He could only seek elsewhere...
Yet, he did not know where this opportunity would be found.
Song Yan got up and sat by the window, lit a candle, glanced at the distorted character "sword" on the ground, and picked up the pen again, the brush moving like a dragon and snake, landing a new ink-written "sword" character on the paper.
The character was dignified and upright, as clear as a spring, yet as ethereal as clouds outside the sky.
With a thought of "Sword and Shadow," Song Yan’s clean eyes suddenly turned an eerie and fierce red.
Writing again, another "sword" character fell on the paper.
This time...
Song Yan turned back to Sword Qi once more, this continuous transformation gave him a bit of inexplicable irritation, it was evident... although the transformation was at will, the repeated drastic change in thoughts could also bring some inadequacy.
He casually destroyed the "sword" character written with a killing intent, then lay on the bed, with his hands under his head.
The "Jingzhe Day" of the duel between the Elder and Gu Huangzi was only two and a half months away...
If the Elder goes, it might be his chance to search everywhere for the "array opportunity."
...
...
The next day.
At the crack of dawn, Song Yan went to the bamboo house of the Kuye Sword Master, ready to work in the fields.
As soon as he reached the door, he saw the Kuye Sword Master waving towards the sky, and in the firmament, Meng Po Po was controlling a sword and leaving.
Soon, there was no one in the sky, but the Kuye Sword Master still stood there, smiling foolishly. It was not until he felt Song Yan’s gaze outside the door that he retracted his smile, looked at Song Yan with a serious expression, and beckoned to him.
...
...
Inside the house, the Kuye Sword Master recounted to Song Yan at a leisurely pace:
"The relationship between people is indeed strange and variable.
Back in the day, Meng Rong and I met, got to know each other, fell in love, and were full of youthful vigor. Later, we even joined forces and, very fortunately, obtained a share of Crimson Palace Demon Blood.
Originally, we thought, since we were not ordinary people, with our hearts united as husband and wife, we would surely pass the Pill Tribulation and completely digest the demon blood.
But unexpectedly, both Meng Rong and I failed.
Afterward, she blamed me, and I blamed her, and we couldn’t continue living together, so we parted ways. I came to Red Leaf Island in a fit of anger, while the family arranged for her to be in the Library. Though we were once in love in our early years, we lived the rest of our lives in perpetual hatred, never seeing each other again for decades.
But in truth, it’s long since passed, yet being too proud to acknowledge it.
Fortunately, you broke through this layer of paper."
Song Yan laughed lightly and said, "You two elders being like this makes me happy as well."
The Kuye Sword Master looked deeply at the man in front of him and suddenly said, "Could you show this old man your sword control again?"
Song Yan hesitated for a moment, then said, "Of course."
Immediately, he got up, walked outside, flexed his fingers, and controlled his sword. A sword shot up upright, breaking through the clouds, then rapidly descended, skimming across the water, truly like a flood dragon roaming the sky.
The Kuye Sword Master watched with his arms behind his back, discerning the sword extremely carefully, as if to examine every trace of Sword Qi and Sword Intent to see if there were any falsities or deceptions.
But whether Sword Qi or Sword Intent, all were incomparably pure, stunningly beautiful, and flawless.
After a long while, the Kuye Sword Master lightly stroked his beard, revealing a look of indescribable comfort in his eyes.
Once Song Yan sheathed his sword, the Kuye Sword Master looked at him and said, "You are still young, why not find a Dao companion?"
Song Yan: ...
"No, thank you."
"My dear embroiderer, this old man has already made plans. On Jingzhe Day, I will go to Konglan Mountain with the Elder. Surely, you can’t be left all alone in such a big house, with such a large plot of land, can you?"
The Kuye Sword Master sighed, "I have had enough of this lonely life. In my youth, I stubbornly refused to admit defeat, but now in hindsight, I truly regret it immensely. You have helped me let go, so why won’t you let yourself do the same?"

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 102. Both Righteous and Evil, Array Dao News (3.9K words - Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: 102. Both Righteous and Evil, Array Dao News (3.9K words - Seeking Subscription)_2
After speaking, the old man seemed quite enthusiastic, patting his chest boldly, "You tell me, what kind of girl do you want? In this vast Nanwu Sword Sect, there’s no matchmaking task that your Mentor Meng and I can’t accomplish."
Song Yan didn’t answer this question, but exclaimed: "Teacher, why are you going to Konglan Mountain too?"
Even though his identity was fake, he still cared quite a bit about this old man.
Master Kuye Sword said: "Why? Do you think this old man won’t come back once he goes?
I’m telling you, not only will I go, but your Mentor Meng will go with me. It’s been a full sixty years since she and I last joined forces against an enemy."
As he spoke, a look of anticipation and longing flashed in his eyes.
Song Yan advised, "Someone always needs to guard the Sword Sect, right?"
Master Kuye Sword said: "A sudden message came, Gu Huangzi seems tired of this back-and-forth and proposed a decisive battle, turning the skirmish from the original one-on-one to a four-on-four.
The masters of their four peaks will all appear at Konglan Mountain, and naturally, our Nanwu Sword Sect will also send our four strongest.
Although your Mentor Meng and I are not the strongest, we’re both seasoned veterans at the Crimson Palace Realm; it’s definitely necessary for us to set the scene."
Song Yan was momentarily stunned; he had never witnessed a proper face-to-face fight with Demon Sect disciples, so he said: "Demon Sect disciples are extremely treacherous, let alone the old demon Gu Huangzi. This kind of nonsense, I believe... is not credible."
Master Kuye Sword laughed, "You think we haven’t thought of what you have?
Heh...
When the time comes, we won’t head straight to Konglan Mountain but will only go after many Crimson Palace Realm auras are indeed sensed there.
And in the meantime, like two mortal nations at war, we’ll send out a large number of scouts to explore all around, to prevent being deceived by the opponent.
Puppet Sect is inherently powerful; we can’t win against them head-on, so we must not miss such a beheading opportunity at all costs.
Moreover, rumors are rampant outside that the Sect Leader and Sword Emperor have already fallen. If we avoid battle again, then... morale will plummet, leading to a catastrophic defeat."
Song Yan lowered his eyes, showing a look of contemplation.
He was too familiar with the Puppet Sect.
Originally, "one-on-one" was fine, but now it suddenly became "five-on-five, a decisive battle," which was almost like writing "trickery" on the face.
If there’s nothing wrong, then Song Yan would eat this table in front of him.
But where’s the problem?
Although he didn’t understand, he still said: "Teacher, if you know, wouldn’t the Puppet Sect know as well? They might just be using this as bait..."
"Let’s not talk about this; just take it as a lesson." Master Kuye Sword patted his shoulder and said, "After I leave, you’ll take care of this place. In this bamboo house, patients occasionally come by for treatment and medicine.
Over these days, I’ll impart my lifetime knowledge of herbs and alchemy to you.
As for the Sword Dao, everyone has their path; I won’t give too much guidance.
Alright, let’s talk about alchemy and discuss your new Dao partner."
Song Yan still wanted to refuse, but then reconsidered: If he asked for a Dao partner skilled in arrays, then... how would Master Kuye Sword and Mentor Meng respond?
Master Kuye Sword and Mentor Meng might think he’s intentionally setting a harsh requirement because he doesn’t want a Dao partner, but... as elders of the Nanwu Sword Sect, they would certainly go to great lengths to help him achieve his goal.
Truth and falsehood blend, who can discern them?
Song Yan squinted slightly and insisted, "Disciple doesn’t want it, disciple alone is enough, disciple really doesn’t need a Dao partner."
...
...
A few days later.
Evening...
Song Yan sighed, "If both teachers insist I find another Dao partner, then... Disciple is quite interested in the Array Dao but has never had the fortune to study it, so I’d like to find a Dao partner proficient in the Array Dao."
With these words, a peculiar expression appeared on the faces of Master Kuye Sword and "returning from work" Mentor Meng.
The two elders suddenly became quiet.
Spotting the shift in their demeanor, Song Yan decisively concluded, "Since there’s no suitable one, then..."
Mentor Meng suddenly interjected, "There is."
Master Kuye Sword hesitated to speak.
Mentor Meng said, "But as matchmakers, we can’t directly arrange it; I certainly can’t bring her over for you to interact. If you’re truly interested, you’ll have to go find her yourself."
Song Yan felt a surge of joy inside.
Just like finding a needle in a haystack; employing tactics proves more effective.
Yet his face betrayed none of it as he displayed a calm expression, "Then... never mind..."
Mentor Meng remarked, "I might as well tell you directly, the only one who meets your requirements is the Sect Leader’s daughter, Yu Xuanwei.
The surname Yu signifies the Sect Leader’s lineage, distinct from the Sun and Su clans, and her Innate Water Profound Root can only be passed down within this lineage...
Yu Xuanwei has already reached the Crimson Palace Realm, she’s a lot older than you, but her nature is reclusive and sees herself highly. Any common man who dares to express even a hint of affection before her would be beaten to the point where they couldn’t find their teeth.
The way of arrays in our Nanwu Sword Sect has always been exclusively mastered by the Sect Leader’s lineage. You want someone skilled in the Array Dao; in the entire Sword Sect, she’s the only one.
She currently resides at the forefront of Luoxia Bamboo Island... If she weren’t maintaining the grand array there, possibly spies would’ve long infiltrated the island to investigate the Sect Leader’s condition."
The joy in Song Yan’s heart was suddenly doused with a bucket of cold water.
However, he quickly became curious again...
Why is it that only the Sect Leader’s lineage can master the Sword Sect’s Array Dao?
And this lineage adopts the surname Yu, carrying a legacy of the Innate Water Profound Root?
Seeing his silence, Mentor Meng said, "Young lad, there’s no need to be disheartened.
As for Xuanwei, though she is older than you, she’s breathtakingly beautiful; she’s the most beautiful in our Sword Sect and even the entirety of Southern Wu.
I’ve heard the old man say your talent in swordsmanship is unparalleled, a future pillar of our Sword Sect...
Well, your intention, the old lady will convey it for you, the rest depends on fate."
Song Yan contemplated briefly; since he knew who held the key to the Array Dao, he would bide his time and seize the opportunity in the future. He still had time.
As for such an ostentatious pursuit of the Sect Leader’s daughter residing at such a core position like Luoxia Bamboo Island, he opted against it.
Should he pursue, he would undoubtedly have to make every effort to impress...
At that time, his display of skill would far exceed what Bai Xiuhu could achieve, this being one aspect.
Secondly, Yu Xuanwei, with a beauty capable of captivating entire realms, must have an endless stream of admirers pursuing her.
Were he to pursue, wouldn’t that be plunging headlong into trouble?
Thirdly, Yu Xuanwei, pursued by countless geniuses yet dismissive, would hardly take notice of him easily, and even if she did, should there be a day where he doesn’t pursue eagerly, there’d be havoc.
A beautiful and powerful woman, residing at the core, never short of suitors, is synonymous with immense trouble.
Countless thoughts flashed through, Song Yan slowly shook his head, "Forget it, Mentor, I’m not worthy."
Mentor Meng frowned, "Is that the sort of thing a Sword Cultivator should say?"
Song Yan gave a self-mocking smile, a trace of sadness in his eyes, "You’re right, Mentor."
Mentor Meng’s frown deepened, just as she was about to get angry, Master Kuye Sword hurriedly stood up to mediate, "Sister Meng, you should understand Xiuhu’s past, be considerate.
Since the great Miss Yu is beyond our reach, are there no other... suitable ones? You’re widely experienced, far beyond the likes of me. Help us think."
Song Yan’s lips twitched slightly.
Alright.
The form of address has changed to "Sister Meng" now.
Mentor Meng said, "As I’ve said, only the Sect Leader’s lineage can master the Array Dao, just two people in the entire Sword Sect truly excel in it, one is the Sect Leader, the other is Xuanwei."
Song Yan rose appropriately, respectfully saluted, and said, "Masters, then your disciple will take his leave."
Mentor Meng frowned and said, "That’s what a Sword Cultivator should say?"
Song Yan, unperturbed, turned and left the bamboo house.
It wasn’t a fruitless day.
An opportunity to break into the "Array Dao" in the hands of the right person was uncovered.
On the day of Jingzhe, storms will arise, in chaos there’s always hope...

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 103. Here it comes! (3.0K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: 103. Here it comes! (3.0K words - please subscribe)
Jingzhe day, snakes and insects emerge together, the earth rejuvenates.
This day draws nearer.
And there are fewer and fewer disciples on Red Leaf Island.
Under the guidance of Elder Kuye and Granny Meng, Song Yan’s alchemy experience grew richer, and he became increasingly adept at treating the ailments of foundational cultivators.
The treatment of these ailments was nothing more than using some decoctions to calm the mind, dispel poisons and evil qi, and cleanse wounds...
Elder Kuye also attempted to introduce this disciple to a Dao companion, as it was generally agreed among cultivators that "lone yin does not grow, lone yang does not survive, only dual cultivation is sustainable"... unless you keep using furnaces like the Demon Sect. Otherwise, having a long-term Dao companion of mutual interests is very necessary.
But Song Yan always refused.
He was always ready to run away, and a Dao companion would be nothing but a burden.
If he truly desired companionship, even visiting a brothel would be better than finding a Dao companion, unless... this Dao companion provided food and shelter and a safe place for him, like Lady Ling did before.
Elder Kuye could only sigh, seeing his repeated refusals, and gave up, not mentioning it again.
As Jingzhe day approached, Elder Kuye and Granny Meng also began to frequently leave the bamboo house, sometimes for two or three days at a time...
The bamboo house naturally was left to Song Yan.
Sometimes, injured disciples hurriedly came seeking Elder Kuye for healing, yet Song Yan handled these cases with no difference in outcome. Elder Kuye secretly watched twice and then completely let go.
...
...
That night, late at night...
Song Yan lay on his side on the couch, as usual.
Tonight, Elder Kuye did not return again.
Once again, he watched over the bamboo house.
Outside the window, mist lingered, and the shallow waves of Misty Sea slapped gently; inside, the faint scent of herbs still lingered...
Suddenly, the pattering sound of falling rain first came from the roof ridge, followed by ripples of intersecting sounds originating from flowers, grass, wood, leaves, water, and stones.
Though he was merely maintaining a false identity, his days on Red Leaf Island were far more peaceful than those on South Bamboo Peak.
The old pride of Elder Kuye could never appear in the Puppet Sect...
Su Yao’s cold, foolish temperament was also unique to the Righteous Dao...
And those disciples who acted with a generous willingness to die on the front lines couldn’t be found in the Puppet Sect either...
Song Yan turned over, closing his eyes to sleep.
He had just closed his eyes for the time it takes for one incense stick to burn when hurried footsteps suddenly came from outside the door.
Song Yan opened his eyes, quickly dressed, and went to open the door.
With a creak, the door opened...
Outside the courtyard came the urgent voice of a female cultivator: "Sword Master, Sword Master, please save my senior sister, I beg you!"
Song Yan found the voice somewhat familiar, looked closely, and saw that the female cultivator was Little Jiu Junior Sister, the one he met at the Wang Family, who scolded him most harshly without mercy.
Little Jiu Junior Sister looked up and saw Song Yan, her anxious expression instantly freezing in the rain.
Her hair was short, not particularly pretty, and now her entire body was not only soaked with rain but also blood, her small boots standing in muddy ground, filthy with grime.
She carried a female sword cultivator on her back, and that sword cultivator was already on the brink of death, while Little Jiu Junior Sister herself... was clearly injured as well.
Song Yan sniffed and detected a pungent, foul smell of blood, known to him if not others... it was the scent of evil qi.
"Come in quickly."
Song Yan said, "The teacher is not here; this place is under my care."
Little Jiu Junior Sister finally reacted, hurriedly "Oh" and then carried the female sword cultivator inside, placing her on a sickbed as per Song Yan’s directions.
Song Yan asked a few quick questions, then swiftly administered pre-prepared poison-dispelling and evil qi purification elixirs to the two. Little Jiu Junior Sister sat by the side, while he quickly treated the female sword cultivator’s wounds.
Some wounds were around the chest and abdomen, but he avoided any inappropriate contact, without the slightest intention of taking advantage.
After a lot of busy work, the female sword cultivator’s breathing became even, her complexion slightly better. Little Jiu Junior Sister, though weak, leaned against the bamboo house wall, looking at Song Yan who had paused, and said, "Thank you, Senior Brother Bai."
After thanking him, she turned her head slightly, not wanting to say more.
Even though Bai Xiuhu had become stronger and was relied upon, in her heart... strength and excellence could not offset past sins.
Sister Yutang and those senior brothers who died because of Bai Xiuhu’s cowardice would never come back.
She was very grateful for Senior Brother Bai’s healing, and she could stand up for him, but... forgiveness was impossible.
But then again, who would care about the forgiveness of a trivial, precarious little sword cultivator?
"I’ll... go wait outside."
Little Jiu Junior Sister supported herself to stand, then gritted her teeth, walked outside, and found a dry spot under the eaves, sat down, leaned against the wall, and looked up at the spring rain sliding down the tightly packed new leaves, pressing down the wild grass at the foot of the bamboo fence.
But after sitting for a while, the door opened again, and Little Jiu Junior Sister sensed a shadow emerging, the shadow sitting beside her.
She instinctively turned her head to look and saw it was Bai Xiuhu, words forming on her lips but ultimately kept to herself.
Song Yan took the initiative to ask, "Has Jianshui Capital been attacked on a large scale again?"
Little Sister Xiao Jiu, hearing him mention this, started talking, "Yes, Senior Brother Bai killed quite a few Demon Sect cultivators that time, and they quieted down for a while. But a few days ago, for some unknown reason, a large group of Demon Sect cultivators appeared in Jianshui Capital.
