The winds kicked up, sending sand and stones flying, along with numerous monsters wrapped in shadow puppets, brimming with evil qi. Our fellow disciples suffered heavy casualties... Every healing place on the islands was occupied, so I carried Senior Sister here to seek Sword Master Kuye."
Song Yan joked, "Didn’t expect to meet an annoying person like me, right?"
This was exactly what Little Sister Xiao Jiu was thinking, but she was startled and quickly waved her hands, saying, "No, no, Senior Brother Bai... Senior Brother Bai..."
It was very hard for her to say the words "not annoying" against her will.
As they were talking, hurried footsteps came from outside the courtyard gate, accompanied by anxious cries of "Sword Master, Sword Master."
Song Yan quickly got up, calling out, "Here! The teacher is not here today, I’m in charge."
Soon, a male and female sword cultivator appeared carrying a stretcher, a bloodied senior cultivator lying upon it.
Song Yan promptly brought them inside and carefully treated them.
He was busy with this until dawn.
Song Yan chatted idly with these unfamiliar "fellow disciples."
A sword cultivator said coldly, "Those demon cultivators must be creating a fuss in preparation for the battle at Konglan Mountain, so they attacked from many fronts!"
Another sword cultivator said, "Those little demon pests are the craftiest, they want to distract Uncle Elder Chang! Unfortunately, they’re playing away games. Although they’ve hurt many of our fellow disciples, they haven’t fared any better! I personally cut down a little pup controlling paper puppets, it was exhilarating, truly exhilarating!"
Yet another sword cultivator added, "Trying to distract Uncle Elder Chang? They’re delusional! Uncle Elder Chang will definitely win!"
Little Sister Xiao Jiu’s voice came from outside, "That’s right, evil never prevails over good since ancient times!"
Listening to Little Sister Xiao Jiu’s enthusiastic and fervent voice, Song Yan felt a bit speechless.
She was just half dead, and now she’s all fired up talking about this, right?
But immediately after, he narrowed his eyes slightly, falling into contemplation.
He was inherently a person extremely sensitive to information.
In the Puppet Sect, if he weren’t sensitive to information, he would have died countless times already.
Noticing the subtle signals before the coming change, adapting instinctively, these are all daily practices...
Amid the passionate talk among the hot-blooded sword cultivators, Song Yan couldn’t help but recall.
Recently, he had treated many injured Sword Sect disciples, and the situations were very similar, all severely wounded by attacks from Demon Sect disciples.
Sword cultivators are different from demon cultivators.
Sword cultivators rely mainly on themselves and the sword they hold.
But demon cultivators are complex, with various types of puppets and despicable methods, impossible to guard against.
In a direct confrontation, demon cultivators would definitely be at a disadvantage.
But in these alley fights, ambushes, sword cultivators might fight all day only to destroy the demon cultivators’ puppets.
No one understands this better than Song Yan...
After all, back then, it was Grandma Fox who destroyed his puppet, brought it into the treasure vault, and then it led to a series of bloody events.
This is why he knows the nature of "Demon Sect disciples" extremely well.
While ambush is possible, tasks like "kill a thousand enemies, lose eight hundred comrades" are impossible for Demon Sect disciples to undertake.
In this kind of high-casualty magical battle, demon cultivators would definitely break down faster than sword cultivators.
With so many vacancies in the bamboo huts of Red Leaf Island, Song Yan firmly believes... If a sword cultivator died on the Southern Wu’s territory, a demon cultivator would also have to die.
With such high fatality rates, they still come to risk their lives.
For what?
In the dimness of dawn, Song Yan seemed to doze off for a moment, but his expression turned slightly grim...
By calculation, demon cultivators can’t possibly rely on "faith" to fight. This kind of "high-casualty" chaotic scene is sufficient for them to act as only token participants, showing up without committing, only a fool would truly risk their life.
But since they did indeed risk their lives, then there’s a big problem.
Song Yan squinted his eyes increasingly, suddenly recalling that Granny Zhu had already made a deal with the "Two-headed Bilanshijin tribe" the year before last, and then sought him out.
This meant that, even if the incident of "Grandma Fox stealing Changwang Tiger Blood" wasn’t completely exposed, it had become a priority target of attention, and the fact that "Grandma Fox was frantically searching for him" had put him on the hit list of at least the Fox, Wolf, and Bilanshijin tribes.
This incident occurred the year before last.
It has been almost two years...
The Fox and Wolf races, haven’t they taken any action?
If they did..... then, is the Puppet Sect still an independent sect today?
Of course, soul searches won’t reveal much, unless... you search the divine souls of people like Gu Huangzi, then you might uncover the truth.
Song Yan closed his eyes, using this condition as a hypothesis, conducted a deduction, and discovered... the Demon Sect disciples’ uncharacteristic fervor could be explained.
All of a sudden, he could feel his heart beat faster.
On the day of Jingzhe, the battle at Konglan Mountain was about to happen... perhaps, there are greater depths to this than he imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 104. I am Song Yan (4.0K words - seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: 104. I am Song Yan (4.0K words - seeking subscription)
A few days remain until Jingzhe.
Sword Sect masters at the Crimson Palace Level have already begun their fasting rituals, aiming to face the demons of Konglan Mountain in their best state.
Scouts are indispensable, as can be seen from Song Yan’s constant busyness.
Initially, there were days when no one came, but now, wounded keep arriving almost daily.
The spring rain lingers, the path outside the bamboo cabin alternately wet and dry, with many footprints temporarily solidified, some of whom are alive, others perhaps dead after returning to the battlefield.
That day, Song Yan returned from the Profound Field, placing a few new herbs on the bamboo medicine shelf, then quickly moved them inside seeing the rain was about to fall.
A few injured people hurried over from afar, and Song Yan was busy once more.
Once finished, he sat on a rocking chair under the eaves, amidst the creaking sound, gazing at the dim gray sky for a short rest.
He’s been contemplating these past days.
"The Fox and Wolf Races have already entered the arena," "The battle at Konglan Mountain has shifted from one-on-one to four-on-four," "Demon Sect disciples attacking fiercely"..... With so many intertwined elements, how much hidden scheming lies within? What will the final outcome be?
He looked at the void, where the Fox and Wolf Races lay in darkness, the Sword Sect and Puppet Sect in scattered disarray...
He slowly gathered the three together, imagining them as three chess pieces.
The chessboard was: Puppet Sect, Konglan Mountain, Misty Sea.
He casually maneuvered the pieces, attempting to find a flaw in the simplest manner.
Suddenly, his pupils constricted.
Through unintentional manipulation in his mind: The Fox and Wolf Races landed at Konglan Mountain, the Puppet Sect fell into the Misty Sea, while the Sword Sect headed to Konglan Mountain...
Song Yan abruptly sat up in surprise.
In the next moment, he saw the Sword Sect elders heading to Konglan Mountain being completely consumed by the Fox and Wolf Races; and the Puppet Sect reaching Misty Sea devouring the Sword Sect entirely.
Then the Fox and Wolf Races devoured the Puppet Sect completely.
At this moment, there was no buffer between the Fox and Wolf Races and "him".
The Fox and Wolf Races jumped directly over and consumed "him".
The entire process was remarkably smooth.
’No, something’s not right... there are issues...’
Song Yan adjusted his thoughts slightly.
The Fox and Wolf Races consumed the elders of the Sword Sect at Konglan Mountain, while people like Gu Huangzi from the Puppet Sect feigned attacking the Sword Sect, actually fleeing instead, leaving the Sword Sect and Puppet Sect to resist the Fox and Wolf Races and buy them time.
But where were Gu Huangzi and the others fleeing to?
Song Yan pondered longly and added "Ancient Teleportation Array" to the locations.
The Ancient Teleportation Array’s matter is secretive, but Grandma Fox knows, and being a veteran overlord like Gu Huangzi across the Three Kingdoms, the probability of knowing is quite high.
However, does he know the Ancient Teleportation Array needs to be repaired?
Song Yan closed his eyes to relax, lying back on the rocking chair.
After a while, he shook his head; there are too many variables, and he cannot think too deeply into chaos anymore.
If he thinks incorrectly on any step there and makes a wrong judgment based on it, it’s over.
However, the first step must be prevented.
If the Fox and Wolf Races truly await the Sword Sect elders at Konglan Mountain, then the "Crimson Palace aura" without mistake, the elders will inevitably proceed, only to be entirely consumed.
’There won’t be any loss due to a wrong judgment.’
’But it must be guarded against.’
Just one Fox Grandma is enough trouble, Song Yan does not want to face the Fox and Wolf Races directly, nor the Bilanciao Insect Race, hence he doesn’t want to easily discard these buffers.
...
...
While pondering, two rays of light descended from the sky, revealing a pair of elderly figures.
Song Yan quickly returned to his senses, stood up and shouted: "Teacher Kuye! Teacher Meng!"
Blade Mentor Kuye and Granny Meng walked shoulder to shoulder.
Song Yan said: "I’ll go prepare some food."
Blade Mentor Kuye hurriedly waved his hand, saying: "Xiuhu, no need, I and your Teacher Meng are here to bid you farewell.
We are going to wait near Konglan Mountain, and when sensing the Crimson Palace aura, we will go to the mountain peak with the Grand Elder.
At that time, the Grand Elder and the five strongest from our Sword Sect will face off against the four Peak Masters of the Puppet Sect."
After speaking, he took out a storage bag from his bosom and threw it over a distance, saying: "Xiuhu, these are some items left for you."
Song Yan accepted, paused in silence, then laughed heartily upward, "Then... the disciple awaits here for the master’s victorious return!"
Blade Mentor Kuye laughed heartily upon hearing, and turning to Granny Meng said, "Meng Sister, I told you that child will not cry and plead for us to stay, see, I was right, wasn’t I?"
Granny Meng snorted coldly, "Just like your temperament, I truly thought today we would see a scene asking us to stay."
Blade Mentor Kuye laughed, "Though Xiuhu’s small virtues may be lacking, his grand virtues remain intact; this act of dealing with demons and ending calamities would not be blocked by him."
With that, air suddenly fell silent.
Song Yan cupped his fists and bowed: "Teachers, take care."
He harbors some gratitude towards these two elders.
He spent so long in the Puppet Sect without acquiring any decent cultivation techniques, yet these two elders imparted the core cultivation technique of Nanwu Sword Sect, "Profound Sword Scripture," to him completely. There may be some trickery involved, however... the two elders indeed had some genuine sentiment for him.
"Take care!"
He emphasized once again.
Granny Meng looked at him, a pleased smile appeared, muttering, "This child, values affection deeply."
Blade Mentor Kuye had a complicated look, softly saying: "Xiuhu, clarity with the heart of the sword, you’re a good child; no matter the future, do not stray from your path. When faced with indecision, consult the sword within your heart."

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 104. I am Song Yan (4.0K words - seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: 104. I am Song Yan (4.0K words - seeking subscription)_2
Song Yan nodded.
The two elders no longer hesitated, turned into rainbows, and flew away swiftly.
...
...
As night fell, spring rain returned, and the dim lamp lights stretched a weak, blurry aura.
The bamboo house surroundings, however, were shrouded in darkness.
A man stood beneath the misty waves of the Misty Sea, his left hand slightly raised, where a strange, pitch-black crow suddenly appeared— the Nameless Phantom Crow.
He gently lifted his arm, and the Nameless Phantom Crow took flight, merged into the shadows, and hurriedly flew towards Konglan Mountain.
Song Yan watched in that direction, then slowly turned and returned to the bamboo house.
The Profound Wood Charcoal in the furnace still glowed red. He grabbed a kettle, sprinkled in dried Moonlight Grass, and placed it on the charcoal furnace, quietly waiting.
After finishing this, he leaned comfortably back in the lounge chair, creaking as he rocked.
Kuye’s Sword Master’s storage bag contained many items.
Firstly, a "Library Pavilion Passage Order," this passage order allows borrowing of the many texts within the Library Pavilion and is exceedingly rare. It requires two elder-level figures to jointly vouch for it before one can be issued.
Obviously, Kuye Sword Master and Grandma Meng vouched for him.
Secondly, ample resources needed for breaking through after the Sixth Layer of Refining Profound, even including Refining Organ Pills.
Thirdly, many notebooks with fresh ink, written with insights into refining "Crimson Palace Pills."
Crimson Palace Pills are a major undertaking, with knowledge needing generations of sects, perhaps even dozens of generations, to explore and study.
The deeper this exploration, the stronger the sect’s foundation, producing more powerful practitioners.
Kuye Sword Master seemed particularly concerned about "removing soul poison." Although he hadn’t succeeded yet, he’d used Purple Crow Grass, Manji Grass, and other herbs to develop a decoction to alleviate soul poison, with records in the notes.
These items were numerous and scattered.
If Song Yan didn’t have the habit of quickly inspecting every nook and cranny of belongings, he might never have found the two small, unobtrusive letters sandwiched in the middle of the last notebook.
Words on the letter were each shocking.
...
The first letter:
Started with the three words "To my disciple."
The main text read:
My disciple, upon seeing this letter, I shall have died in battle.
Despite having regrets in this life, being able to reunite with the love of my life and fight hand in hand, not dying sick in bed, but fighting to the death on the battlefield, I am satisfied.
Yet I hold one regret, a regret hard to voice in life, but I can share with you in death.
With Bai Xiuhu’s disposition, stepping out of that mire is a miracle in itself, but his talent in swordsmanship couldn’t be as stunningly extraordinary as yours, my lord.
No matter your status in past lives, in this life, you and I have somewhat of a mentor-disciple relationship.
However... I firmly believe that a heart is clarified by the sword.
If you wield your sword with integrity, why need I inquire about your origin?
I only hope that regardless of future paths, you do not stray off course.
When indecisive, ask the sword in your heart.
Signed "Sun Kuye."
Song Yan put down the letter, staring into the distance in a daze.
Kuye Sword Master suspected he had taken over Bai Xiuhu as an old demon from the Crimson Palace.
Possession is rare, yet not impossible.
For cultivators above the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, possession can only occur once per lifetime and is incredibly perilous, often resulting in backlash.
Bai Xiuhu being at the Sixth Layer of Refining Profound makes possessing him extremely difficult, but with a shattered Dao heart and self-degradation, it’s possible.
Thus, Kuye Sword Master made such guesses.
Kuye Sword Master feared startling him, hence leaving the letter hidden until Song Yan discovered it, knowing Kuye Sword Master was no longer.
This was a hope that out of sentiment, Song Yan would truly pledge loyalty to the Nanwu Sword Sect.
...
The second letter:
The beginning and signature were the same as the first letter.
The main text read:
My lord deliberately mentioned "needing a Dao partner adept in arrays," I and your Mentor Meng have some guesses.
Your intentions are likely regarding those Ancient Teleportation Arrays.
The Sect Leader’s lineage studied arrays deeply, also aiming to restart the Ancient Teleportation Arrays as a retreat someday.
However, the array locations are elusive.
If you have ideas, showing these two letters to Xuanwei will suffice.
With the "Passage Order" token, Xuanwei will certainly believe you.
...
Song Yan stowed the two letters back into the Storage Space.
He silently marveled: Indeed, never underestimate anyone, as Kuye Sword Master didn’t guess the truth, yet came incredibly close.
Originally, if he was unaware or unprepared, the worst-case scenario would unfold: all Nanwu Sword Sect experts led by the Grand Elder would be annihilated, he’d have to reveal his identity to Yu Xuanwei, even if the identity were false; facing attacks from Gu Huangzi—which wasn’t significant; but crucially, the Fox and Wolf Races might enter the fray.
At such a time, he’d have to exert utmost effort, using all his trump cards to carve a bloody path.
Everything felt passive, helpless, swinging swords ceaselessly, yet filled with suffocation and rage inside.
But ah...
Creak, creak, creak...
On the rocking chair, the man suddenly grinned, baring a mouthful of ivory teeth, chuckling "Geh geh geh."
He, Song Yan, was never one to wake up late or sit and wait for doom.
...
...
The next morning, Song Yan tended to a wounded cultivator at the bamboo house, then after noon, controlled his sword and headed to Copper Sparrow Island’s Library Pavilion. After presenting the "Passage Order," he walked right in.
This library might not hold the Nanwu Sword Sect’s Supreme Ultimate Techniques, but surely contained some magic that intrigued him.
Since the "Passage Order" allows comprehensive reading, he showed no courtesy.
...
...
Meanwhile...
Somewhere in a barren land.
The white-robed Grand Elder’s eyes showed hints of subtle exhaustion, gazing towards Konglan Mountain, awaiting news.
This moment was immensely grueling; he had to wait until multiple Crimson Palace Realm auras definitively appeared at Konglan Mountain before deciding to lead people there.
Otherwise, this place was a strategic point, capable of advancing or retreating, with time to withdraw promptly.
Last night, he had quietly visited Luoxia Bamboo Island, preparing for "in case they all perish" post-event arrangements.
Yet he hadn’t opened the Sect Leader’s sealed door where Water Sol Sword Emperor secluded.
As long as the door remained closed, there was still hope.
The door was meant for when everyone perished, to be opened by Yu Xuanwei.
At this moment, the Grand Elder gazed at the heavens, robe sleeves fluttering, stature thin yet still filled with resilience.
And just then, his old eyes narrowed sharply, violet lightning shooting to the sky.
From the sky, a pitch-black demonic crow flapped its wings, openly descending from the white clouds, claws clasping old tree branches, swaying unsteadily.
The Grand Elder immediately recognized it as a Nameless Phantom Crow.
In his mind: the Nameless Phantom Crow had special significance.
Because among the higher circles aware of secrets, "Nameless Phantom Crow" became a synonym for the Stone Seat Elder’s lineage.
This particular Nameless Phantom Crow seemed so unusual.
The Grand Elder scrutinized the demonic crow on the branch, asked, "Who are you?"
The Nameless Phantom Crow spoke in a hoarse voice, "I am Song Yan."
The Grand Elder said blandly, "We’ve searched for you long enough, you don’t appear, now there’s no need to search for you, yet you show up. Upon reflection, I’ve never seen such a cunning boy as you."
Then he asked, "Now that you’re here, what’s your stance, and what do you propose?"
The Nameless Phantom Crow said directly, "The Multi-tailed Fox Race, Corpse-Eating Wolf Race are already at Konglan Mountain, waiting for all of you to come. As for Gu Huangzi and the exact whereabouts of the Four Peaks Masters, I also don’t know.
Perhaps they’re at Konglan Mountain.
Perhaps they’re ambushing near the Misty Sea.
Or perhaps they’ve embarked on the path to find the Ancient Teleportation Array."
The Grand Elder said blandly, "Cunning boy, you think I’ll believe your one-sided story?"
The Nameless Phantom Crow said, "Old man, think carefully, if you wish none of your sect to survive, feel free to venture to Konglan Mountain!"
After speaking, it spun around, flapped its wings, and flew away, far.
This news wasn’t necessarily true, even Song Yan himself was unsure, but he knew "Konglan Mountain definitely harbors deceit."
Since either way he’d be deceived, why not be deceived by himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
The Library Pavilion on Copper Sparrow Island is clean and bright, though usually bustling with people, it’s quite empty at the moment.
The inheritance of the Southern Wu Sword Sect is much like the disposition of its disciples, open for the most part, except for some special secret techniques, personal inheritances, and supreme ultimate techniques. Other spells can be found here.
However, no matter what spell you need, you must comply with the regulations and register it with the Tower Guard before you can delve into reading it.
This is the iron rule of the Library Pavilion.
Those who violate this rule are considered to have "taken without asking", subject to penalties and investigation at best, and expulsion from the Sword Sect for heavy offenses.
After Meng Po left, naturally, a new Tower Guard arrived.
This Tower Guard is dressed in a brocade robe and jade belt, kindly-faced and smiling, surprisingly an old acquaintance of Song Yan.
This was the Elder Sun—Sun Haofeng, who once showed a merchant-like face trying to "morally blackmail" him to get the Divine Face Hundred Defenses from him for nothing in the Cold Pool Valley.
It was this person who single-handedly changed Song Yan’s perception of the Southern Wu Sword Sect back then.
However, it later turned out that this person was indeed an outlier in the Southern Wu Sword Sect.
Song Yan thought silently: This is typically seeking benevolence and obtaining benevolence, those afraid of death need not die...
The Southern Wu Sword Sect’s bravest and most spirited went to the front lines, while hypocrites like Elder Sun, who talk of righteousness yet are the most cowardly, managed to stay behind.
The Grand Elder was skilled at employing people.
Knowing that if they perish in battle, the Sun Family needs groveling to increase the chances of survival, then relying on hypocrites like Elder Sun to kneel would be necessary.
But this... obviously didn’t serve him well.
He didn’t need a Southern Wu Sword Sect that kneeled to the Puppet Sect or the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, as this would completely eliminate the buffer between him and the enemies.
Song Yan’s thoughts flashed quickly, he raised the Passage Order casually and swiftly stepped into the building, started examining various spells.
After inspecting all day, he found that the Library Pavilion’s most precious item was indeed the Profound Sword Scripture.
Beyond some supreme ultimate secret techniques that he was still unaware of in the Southern Wu Sword Sect, the strongest were indeed the "Transforming Profound Qi into Sword Qi" described in the Profound Sword Scripture and the "Special Sword Qi nurtured by the blood of the Crimson Palace."
He already possessed these.
However, the "Special Sword Qi" was merely a one-time use, requiring continuous nurturing afterwards.
In real magical battles, sword system spells were still necessary.
As for Song Yan’s currently strongest sword system spell, it was the Black and White Double Evil, which underwent two perfect mutations, deduced from the White Snake Sword Technique.
The cultivation threshold for the White Snake Sword Technique is Refining Profound Fifth Layer.
’What’s the highest threshold then?’
Song Yan searched swiftly.
At the Crimson Palace Level, he found only one sword system spell in the Library Pavilion on the fifth floor, a spell with an entry-level threshold at the Crimson Palace Level—Sleeve Universe.
This spell also has a prerequisite condition for cultivation, requiring at least twenty percent of the total Profound Qi around to be transformed into Sword Qi via the Profound Sword Scripture because it is purely a spell for controlling sword qi.
The cultivation of the Profound Sword Scripture, on the other hand, requires understanding the "My Sword" from the Profound Transformation Sword Manual and unraveling the secret of Human Sword Unity as a premise.
It is a series of interconnected inheritances.
Song Yan decisively grabbed this handwritten booklet and quickly flipped through it.
A cursory glance showed it was indeed profound, but the gist was: Use the closed nature of two sleeves to accumulate sword qi, let the sword qi circulate continuously until the sleeves are full, and at that point, when a sleeve is flicked, the concealed nature and power surpass even a flying sword.
Song Yan immediately understood: charging, laser.
As for why it’s not a Jade Scroll, he didn’t know, nor did he care for the time being.
...
With the Sleeve Universe in hand, a Crimson Palace Manual, he glanced at other sword system spells and found they were not much different from the White Snake Sword Technique, similar in principle. Even if he cultivated them, they wouldn’t be particularly special, much like completing the Simulation One Test Paper and then going on to do the Simulation Second Set of Papers.
Song Yan pondered slightly.
Sword technique, sword system spells, he already possessed them.
But his spell system actually had a considerable flaw, which was—escape technique.
Sword control is fast, but that’s only in the eyes of ordinary cultivators.
In battles with those of the same level, escape techniques become very important.
Whether it’s entering, fleeing, or fighting while fleeing, escape techniques are indispensable.
But escape techniques are extraordinarily rare.
One could understand if Song Yan didn’t obtain any from the Puppet Sect, but even later at the Cold Pond City, nothing was found, indicating the rarity of escape techniques.
Song Yan searched back and forth, and again found a corner of the fifth floor where a Secret Box labeled Kan Water Escape was located, but the box was locked and required the Tower Guard’s assistance for unlocking.
...
Song Yan brought Sleeve Universe and Kan Water Escape to Elder Sun’s place and presented his token.
Elder Sun looked at him in amazement and said, "These are meant for the Crimson Palace Realm cultivation, especially Sleeve Universe. Will it be of any use to you? And Kan Water Escape, this escape technique is indeed precious."
Song Yan displayed the token again, asking, "Can I see them then?"
Elder Sun glanced at the token, hesitatingly saying, "It’s possible..."
Song Yan said, "Then may I trouble you to register them?"
Elder Sun replied, "I... I can’t decide on the matter, perhaps wait until the Grand Elders return to discuss further."
Song Yan asked curiously, "Is this token useless?"
Elder Sun replied, "It’s useful."
Song Yan asked, "Then can they be borrowed?"
Elder Sun said, "It’s possible, but you... you’re only at Refining Profound Sixth Layer, why do you need them?"

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Subscription Requested)_2
Song Yan patiently said, "Once you understand one form of magic, all forms become clear. I just want to see what high-level magic looks like."
However, Elder Sun didn’t respond to that and instead directly said, "Don’t look, just put the booklet back," and then slightly raised his head with impatience, adding, "Remember, don’t aim too high. Even though you have two Elders backing you, you mustn’t become arrogant."
Song Yan acknowledged with a sound.
Elder Sun didn’t answer any further but suddenly directed his gaze into the distance as a beautiful female cultivator came to the gate.
Elder Sun cheerfully approached, no longer seeing the borrower standing before him, and said with a smile, "Didn’t expect a Fairy to grace us with her presence."
The female cultivator curiously said, "I thought you would have gone with the Grand Elders."
Elder Sun chuckled, "The Grand Elder said there always needs to be someone strong in the sect, so I stayed behind. You know... someone has to deal with these trivial matters, for the greater good."
The two of them chatted happily together.
Song Yan put the booklet back on the shelf.
He intended... to try again tomorrow.
...
...
Night fell...
Elder Sun closed the doors of the Library Pavilion, yawned, stepped out of the library, and then thought about how his status might rise in the future, and he could have more beauties sharing his bed, which would be quite nice.
Why bother with the fighting and killing?
Why can’t we just sit down and have a good talk?
It’s better to talk it out nicely, why go to such lengths?
Who governs isn’t still governing? You can’t kill everyone in the Three Kingdoms, right? Such a big matter, why fight so desperately?
Elder Sun indifferently rose into the air on his flying sword, intending to visit other islands tonight to give some guidance to the beautiful female cultivators there, as he was also helping the younger generation.
The rainbow light swept across the Misty Sea.
Tonight, the moon was dark, and the fog was dense.
Elder Sun was enjoying the night breeze when suddenly his eyelids twitched. His divine soul seemed trapped, making him lethargic, and he unknowingly sank down a bit.
Then, a sudden pain shot through his forehead, making him sink even further, almost touching the lake’s surface.
’What’s going on?’
Elder Sun hurriedly held his head, a flash of confusion crossing his mind.
But in just a moment’s time, a crimson giant hand suddenly shot out from the Misty Sea, swiftly grabbing his leg like a shadow and yanking him into the lake with a "whoosh."
Before he could react, a finger had already pressed onto his forehead.
Though terrified, the second thought flashed through Elder Sun’s mind: ’Fool, you dare to search the soul of a Crimson Palace expert?’
In the next instant, he felt a dark spot pulling his soul out of his body.
The bloodthirsty creature conducted a soul search, devoured the soul, imprisoned the soul, and transformed it into a minion.
Next, a shake of its arm caused high concentrations of evil qi to climb over Elder Sun’s body like a living creature, rushing madly into his system.
Elder Sun, dead!
The creature shot downward holding a flying sword, pinning Elder Sun’s body, engulfed by evil qi, to a rock on the lake bed, preventing it from floating up.
After finishing, the blood-colored creature quickly vanished without a trace.
...
...
The next day.
Morning...
Song Yan wasn’t in a hurry to go to the Library Pavilion, and instead, as usual, wandered through the Profound Field, picking some fresh profound grass and profound flowers, planning to dry them in the good weather.
Returning to his bamboo cottage, he saw cultivators hurriedly approaching from afar.
A beautiful female cultivator and a male cultivator carried a stretcher in a rush, with a small female cultivator lying on it, covered in blood.
"Senior Brother Bai, Senior Brother Bai!" the female cultivator called out urgently, "Save her, quickly!"
Song Yan looked down at the female cultivator, momentarily stunned.
It’s Younger Sister Xiao Jiu again...
How long has it been, and she’s injured again?
Moreover, she seems to be in severe condition.
While he ushered the people into the house, he quickly started treating Younger Sister Xiao Jiu’s wounds and then began brewing herbal soup.
After a flurry of activity, he took a deep breath and looked at Younger Sister Xiao Jiu again, discovering that her already ordinary pretty face now had several new scars, slashing across her cheeks, leaving marks.
Yet disfigurement was the least of worries; Younger Sister Xiao Jiu’s body was as weak as a leaky sack, riddled with various wounds.
Looking at the worried male and female cultivators beside him, Song Yan said, "She’s not in mortal danger now, but still, it’s the Demon Sect’s doing... evil qi."
The beautiful female cultivator sighed, "It’s mainly those shadow puppets, each one like a frenzied demon beast, their evil qi can even somewhat devour the profound qi. If hit by those shadow puppets, the wounds are hard to heal."
The male cultivator, filled with remorse, clenched his fists, his eyes red, "Younger Sister Xiao Jiu got hurt protecting me... That blow should have been mine to bear. It’s all my fault."
Song Yan sighed, "Evil qi, truly terrifying."
The beautiful female cultivator said, "Exactly, before those shadow puppets joined the battle, the demon cultivators wouldn’t even dare to appear in front of us, but now it’s different... alas..."
Song Yan said, "Leave Younger Sister Xiao Jiu here for now; she has too much mixed evil qi on her body that needs to be carefully cleansed, and she... shouldn’t be moved."
Upon hearing this, the two cultivators immediately showed delight. They had heard about the past disputes between Younger Sister Xiao Jiu and this Senior Brother Bai, and seeing him act like this, they couldn’t help but feel he’d changed.
A prodigal son returning to the right path, a sudden enlightenment, truly lived up to the reputation.
After expressing their gratitude, the two cultivators left.
Song Yan brewed some more Washing Evil Soup, set it in a bowl, and placed it on the bedside table.
He had a fondness for girls like Younger Sister Xiao Jiu.
He hoped people around him could be like Younger Sister Xiao Jiu, not too cunning, a bit silly. It made his life much more comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: 105. Try Again Tomorrow (4.3K Words - Seeking Subscription)_3
...
...
After a while, Junior Sister Xiao Jiu woke up, she looked weakly around and asked, "Am I... still alive?"
A voice came from beside her, "You are alive."
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu turned her head to see a man’s face...
"Bai... Brother Bai?"
"Yeah."
"You... saved me again. Thank you..." Junior Sister Xiao Jiu murmured, "I thought I was already dead."
Song Yan said, "So eager to die?"
"Not really," Junior Sister Xiao Jiu replied, "Just so many brothers and sisters died, I thought I should die too."
Song Yan approached, reached out, and flicked her forehead with his finger, saying, "What kind of talk is that?"
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu didn’t hear what he said, only that sudden flick on her forehead shocked her into silence. She closed her eyes and said, "Brother Bai, I don’t like people being so frivolous.
Also... I hate you.
You are a murderer. You killed Sister Tang Yu, Brother Yun Ying, Brother Zi Heng...."
She reported each name.
These names were of the cultivators who died due to Bai Xiuhu’s cowardice.
She seemed delirious, unable to comprehend the situation in front of her, stubbornly repeating these names that might have long been forgotten, as if expecting Brother Bai to quickly tell her to get out.
Song Yan found it all the more interesting after she finished speaking.
All of her behavior was entirely opposite to him.
Everything she would do, he wouldn’t do any of it.
So no matter how fiercely she spoke, he wasn’t angry, because all her thoughts were so clear, so pure, very comfortable to hear.
He didn’t need to guess, didn’t need to probe, didn’t need to set traps, everything was so obvious and direct.
Thus, he waited for Junior Sister Xiao Jiu to finish speaking and glanced at the bedhead, saying, "Washing Evil Soup, drink the one on the left, apply the one on the outside to the wound.
The Evil Qi can’t be cleaned off in one go, it needs to be repeated."
After instructing, Song Yan walked out.
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu asked, "Where are you going?"
"Library Pavilion," Song Yan responded nonchalantly, then said, "Help me watch this bamboo house, if any brothers come later, ask them to sit down and wait for me to return."
"I..."
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu stammered.
Song Yan had already exited the door.
...
...
"Mas... Master, after I... after I die, Sun Su... Steward Sun should succeed me.
He’s a rule-abiding person, as long as you show the token, he’ll allow you to borrow those two magical books."
In Song Yan’s Divine Sense, Elder Sun’s ghost was kneeling, looking both fearful and subservient as he explained.
"Are there many like you, who seek peace?"
"Master, not many, there aren’t many in the entire Sword Sect with open minds, it was just back then the Sect Leader wanted the sect to have two factions, so he deliberately gave me some status and power. Just to provide Sword Sect with another route in case of a formidable enemy."
Song Yan nodded secretly.
Since even someone like Elder Sun counted as the leader of the peace faction, it made things easier for him.
At the Library Pavilion, many cultivators had already gathered around, discussing and chattering.
After a while, a stern-faced cultivator stepped forward and said, "Ladies and gentlemen, today Elder Sun is temporarily occupied, so the Library Pavilion will temporarily be under my supervision. If you wish to borrow magical texts, follow the usual rules and enter."
Song Yan entered the pavilion with the disciples ahead, taking "Sleeve Universe" and "Kan Water Escape" just as he did yesterday.
Indeed, this cultivator didn’t ask anything, saw his token, and directly unlocked "Kan Water Escape," then said, "Nephew Xiuhu, go read in the designated area, these two techniques are very valuable, copying or taking them out is prohibited."
Song Yan nodded, thanked him, and went aside with the cultivation technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 106. Sword Evil Demon Dragon, Battle Begins (3.7K words - Request for Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: 106. Sword Evil Demon Dragon, Battle Begins (3.7K words - Request for Subscription)
Song Yan’s current swordsmanship attainments were already extremely high. After studying for a while, he quickly brought the sword spell "Sleeve Universe" of the early stage Crimson Palace onto the panel.
Invested 31 years of life essence, and "Sleeve Universe" reached perfection.
Further invested 150 years of life essence, and "Sleeve Universe" underwent its first mutation, gaining the magic spell "Opening the Celestial Gate."
This spell conceals the sword qi to the utmost, and can only be used when reaching the extreme. It’s as if the celestial gate within the "universe" of the sleeve opens, with the divine sword flying out, significantly enhancing power, but also consuming more sword qi.
Continued to invest 3015 years of life essence, and "Sleeve Universe" experienced two perfect mutations, yielding the spell "Sword Evil Demon Dragon."
This spell is a terrifying magic based on the "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique," using the extreme condensation and devouring of evil qi, and the sharpness of sword qi, completely unleashed, mixed together. A great sleeve wave outwards, "evil qi inside, sword qi outside," like a blood-eyed demon dragon, charging and rampaging, looking down on the sky.
Moreover, because the cultivator of this spell had already reached the level of Human Sword Unity and Sword Control and Rainbow Transformation, "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" not only unleashes a blood-eyed demon dragon that seems to have life, but the caster can also merge with this demon dragon, as if riding a dragon.
Undoubtedly, "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" has completely replaced the original "Black and White Double Evil" in terms of power and function, and not to mention the power, its functionality already combines the characteristics of Black Death and White Death.
This is a spell that perfectly fuses sword qi and evil qi, a spell formed based on the "Southern Wu Sword Sect Swordsmanship System," and it is uniquely strong due to the existence of the "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique," capable of enhancing with the caster’s magic power, becoming a "supermodel" spell.
As for which is stronger, it or the "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
Song Yan himself estimated that he can only say the two spells have different "tracks," one is cunning and unpredictable, improving with the intensity of the shadow puppet; the other is straightforward and unmatched in ferocity.
Just like the two extremes of demon cultivators and sword cultivators.
...
...
Song Yan continued to study, but the "Kan Water Escape" didn’t seem easy to bring onto the panel.
There were still two days until the day of Jingzhe; there was time.
He planned to come again the next day.
Upon leaving the pavilion, a cry filled with fear had already echoed from afar.
A pockmarked corpse gnawed by evil qi was fished out from the Misty Sea.
And its face, though vague, could faintly be discerned as Elder Sun Haofeng...
The sword cultivators looked at this scene in horror, their expressions varied.
Standing at the back of the crowd, Song Yan glanced distantly and asked the sword cultivator beside him, "Did a Demon Sect disciple infiltrate?"
The sword cultivator, with a deathly pale face, reminded him, "Look carefully, that’s Elder Sun!!"
"Elder Sun?" Song Yan paused, rubbed his eyes, looked closely, then suddenly fell silent.
To kill Elder Sun silently in the heart of the Sword Sect, how could it possibly be a Demon Sect disciple?
This at least must have been done by the presence of a Peak Master-level existence from the four peaks.
He and the sword cultivators were engulfed in this inexplicable fear, then glancing at the sky, he urgently said, "I must quickly return to Red Leaf Island while it’s still daylight."
A disciple who recognized him quickly remarked, "Senior Brother Bai, quickly go back, be careful on the way."
Meanwhile, the skilled Crimson Palace guardian from the Sun family stationed on Copper Sparrow Island also had a bloodless face, then rapidly took out the communication stone.
The communication stone could transmit information only where Profound Qi was continuous.
Misty Sea and the Southern Wu Sword Sect’s Profound Qi weren’t continuous, so communication was impossible. But this stationed expert knew their great elder was already at the edge where the Southern Wu Sword Sect’s Profound Qi connected, awaiting information from all sides.
"Great Elder, Sun Haofeng died, devoured by evil qi twenty miles northwest of Copper Sparrow Island, body and divine soul annihilated."
Having said all this, the expert put down the communication stone, then immediately began mobilizing sword cultivators, fully defending, ready to meet a great enemy at any moment.
...
In the distance, having received Song Yan’s information, the great elder was still hesitating, for just moments ago, he sensed the powerful, unhidden aura of a Crimson Palace expert emanating from the distant Konglan Mountain direction, which matched the agreement.
But at this moment, he received the family information, also genuinely startled, then made a decision: create a false impression, secretly return, lying in wait.
If someone truly intended to sneak attack the Sword Sect during Jingzhe, then this time, they would play out the drama of "The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind."
But if... If there was no sneak attack at all, and the Puppet Sect four peak masters truly went to Konglan Mountain, then at that time, the entire Southern Wu Sword Sect’s morale might plummet to the bottom.
...
Song Yan returned to the bamboo dwelling, where Junior Sister Xiaojui had already gotten up, her clothes neat, and upon seeing him, she gave a salute and said, "Senior Brother Bai, no disciples came today."
Having said this, she saluted again and said, "My wounds are no longer an issue, I shall be leaving now."
Song Yan said, "Elder Sun has died, it’s dangerous outside now. If you truly feel well, why not stay here and keep watch for me through the night. I’m tired today and want to sleep soundly."
Junior Sister Xiaojui asked, "Which Elder Sun?"
Song Yan said, "Sun Haofeng, devoured by evil qi, retrieved from the water."
Junior Sister Xiaojui fell silent.
Song Yan said, "The demon who killed Elder Sun is still hiding in the shadows, so... I need someone to keep watch through the night."
Junior Sister Xiaojui couldn’t help but say, "Senior Brother Bai, you have tremendous talent and are destined to be a pillar of the Sword Sect in the future. You... should not risk staying here, you should go to Copper Sparrow Island.
The Sun family will surely allocate you a room to stay temporarily. With many Sun family members around, that demon will certainly be apprehensive and not dare to strike easily."
Song Yan said, "It’s dark outside now. If I go out and get ambushed on the way, what then?"

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 106. Sword Evil Demon Dragon, Battle Begins (3.7K words - Request for Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: 106. Sword Evil Demon Dragon, Battle Begins (3.7K words - Request for Subscription)_2
"This..." Little Jiu, the junior sister, fell silent. Then she gritted her teeth and said, "Alright! I will keep watch for you tonight! If a demon appears, I will shout with all my might before I die so you can escape."
After speaking, she ran outside the house.
Song Yan yawned and laid comfortably on the bed.
...
The next day.
During the day.
Little Jiu was bidding farewell again.
Song Yan said, "Your wound won’t heal in half a month, and I still need to go to the Library Pavilion to read during the day.
So, let me show you some simple treatment methods. If any fellow disciples get injured, you can treat them for me."
After saying this, he didn’t wait for Little Jiu’s reaction, directly throwing some elixirs and ointments onto the table, briefly explaining their functions and uses, and then left using sword control.
A day passed. "Kan Water Escape" was also moved onto the panel. Then he spent 12 years cultivating it to perfection.
However, when the cultivation technique mutated, he vaguely sensed that the mutation direction of "Ghost Profound Root" would only be offensive. This "Kan Water Escape" would also become an attack method, no longer improving speed. But no matter the attack method, how could the mutated "Kan Water Escape" compare to "Sword Evil Demon Dragon"? Hence, he temporarily shelved it.
As for the function of "Kan Water Escape," it allows the user to escape through water, spanning dozens of feet in an instant, making it extremely fast.
Upon returning to the bamboo house, Little Jiu was busy treating an injured sword cultivator.
Her hands were busy and nervous. Upon seeing Song Yan appear, she looked as if she saw a lifeline and hurriedly ran over, asking Song Yan to go treat the sword cultivator.
But Song Yan didn’t go; instead, he gave Little Jiu some pointers and then lay on the bed.
...
That evening.
Little Jiu did not mention leaving but made a wooden bed to sleep under the eaves outside the door.
Seemingly with no one to confide in, yet feeling really nervous, Little Jiu tossed and turned. Finally, in the middle of the night, she called out through the wall, "Brother Bai, tomorrow is Jingzhe, I wonder if the elders will win."
However... there was no response from Brother Bai on the other side of the wall.
Little Jiu sighed, then wrapped herself tightly in the blanket, turned over, and continued to sleep.
Just then, Brother Bai’s voice came through.
"Whether it’s Jingzhe or not, life goes on. Tomorrow you will stay at the bamboo house and treat people for me."
"Why?"
"Because I can’t manage it all."
"Can’t manage it all?"
"Back when Teacher Kuye was here, there weren’t many patients, but now with the war, there are too many.
Moreover, the Profound Field also needs someone to look after these days. I haven’t been there, I’m afraid the Profound Flower and Profound Grass might have been damaged by demon beasts."
"Then... Brother, you can find someone more suitable."
"You are quite suitable; in a few days, I will talk to the elder responsible in the sect to let you stay here."
"I think it’s better for you to find a Dao companion, Brother, that would be more reliable."
"I don’t want to. Alright, enough talk. Tomorrow I will go inspect Profound Field, and if nothing unexpected happens, I will move nearby to live."
Outside the door fell silent suddenly.
For a long time, Little Jiu mustered a sentence, "I’m not pretty, I’ve been disfigured."
But the response she got was a muffled laugh from behind the door.
Accompanied by Brother Bai’s explanation, "Sorry, couldn’t hold it in."
Little Jiu’s face turned completely red.
As dawn was approaching, she quietly got up, quietly wrote a letter, and then quietly left.
...
After dawn, Song Yan picked up the letter.
The letter said:
Thank you, Brother Bai, for your care these days. I know you’re being kind, trying to keep me from going to the front lines, but... I can’t do it. Besides, you shouldn’t be kind to me. Thank you for your misplaced affection; I am deeply grateful. If there’s any debt, I will repay it in the next life.
Song Yan lowered the letter, smiled helplessly, shook his head, and sighed, "Foolish..."
Just then, he suddenly sensed a chilling wind drifting from afar like threads of murder, caressing the neck, face, and arms...
Song Yan casually put away the letter and looked into the distance.
The faraway place where dawn was beginning to show had started to turn red, not the red signaling the sun’s imminent rise, but a strange, twisted red, with all the light dancing around, spinning as if it were a scarlet version of "Starry Night."
Suddenly, in the distance, it seemed to explode, an endless sharp whistling sound erupted, covering the sky and earth.
Among the burst of bright light at the horizon emerged many black dots, big and small, bizarre in shape.
In an instant, Song Yan recognized them as Demonic Shadow Puppets.
At that moment, he seemed almost to dream back to South Bamboo Peak, to the day he was sold by Shadow Puppet Peak to the Ghost Cultivator.
He guessed correctly...
Of the three possibilities, one was right.
The Puppet Sect took advantage of Jingzhe to completely exterminate the Nanwu Sword Sect.
So, was it truly the Fox and Wolf Races at Konglan Mountain?
If so, why didn’t Gu Huangzi seize the chance to escape? Could he truly believe "dealing with a tiger could lead to a good outcome"?
If not... who did Gu Huangzi leave at Konglan Mountain to emit a strong enough Divine Soul aura?
For a moment, it was all unclear and confusing.
And with that explosion, a transparent array shield suddenly appeared over the Nanwu Sword Sect.
The Demonic Shadow Puppets struck the array shield fiercely like torrential rain on a lake!
Ripples spread, waves surged, forming patterns intertwining with each other.
Numerous island sword cultivators also ascended into the air from various directions, going to support at the front of the array.
"The array" is like city walls; if no one defends and only leaves it for the enemy to attack, no matter how sturdy it is, it will soon be destroyed by the enemy targeting its weak points.
Song Yan did not move; he looked up at the sky.
In fact, the Puppet Sect’s attack on the Nanwu Sword Sect on Jingzhe was the least likely possibility of the three he had considered.
But it happened.
Thoughts clashed in his mind.
Suddenly, he thought of a fourth possibility.
Suppose Konglan Mountain indeed had the Fox and Wolf Races, and Gu Huangzi indeed wanted to escape, yet he still attacked the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Then, there could be only one reason.
That is, Gu Huangzi wanted to take something from the Nanwu Sword Sect before he left.
What could it be?
About to flee, what could be that important?
The answer is "key."
As a Three Kingdoms Dominator, Gu Huangzi likely knows of the Ancient Teleportation Array, knows it is damaged, and knows that the Nanwu Sword Sect’s Sect Leader lineage has been studying how to repair the Ancient Teleportation Array.
Thus, his attack on the Nanwu Sword Sect wasn’t genuinely about annihilation.
What he truly wanted was to abduct Yu Xuanwei.
Almost the instant he thought of this, Song Yan moved, his form blending with the water, rapidly escaping to Luoxia Bamboo Island in the depths of Misty Sea!
He is someone who always takes immediate action when "the possibility is high, and the logic is sound," and never needs "see it with his own eyes" as solid evidence.
If Gu Huangzi indeed appeared on Luoxia Bamboo Island this time, then... it was time to end it.
Gu Huangzi’s "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" was virtually a "Divine Soul battery," containing the essence of several generations of Puppet Sect’s old demons.
This item, it suits him well.
He’d been craving it for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 107. Long Time No See (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: 107. Long Time No See (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)
The distorted evil qi exploded fiercely on the distant horizon along with the rising morning sun.
The sunlight faded, the blood light rampant.
The air was filled with a mix of bizarre sharp sounds, thundering booms that threatened to shatter eardrums and churn brains.
The large barrier of the Nanwu Sword Sect’s array was opened, and demonic ghosts fell like a sudden downpour. The ripple upon ripple of the transparent barrier made the islands of the Sword Sect seem as if they had sunk to the ocean floor.
Looking up, the sky was nowhere to be seen.
A beautiful young woman slightly raised her head, watching the chaotic scene in the distance, her brows slightly furrowed, yet she continued to sit still on Luoxia Bamboo Island deep within the Misty Sea, unmoving.
She wore a vermilion brocade robe so ordinary that it couldn’t be more ordinary. Her face was dreamily exquisite, her figure voluptuous and full, yet her expression was as cold as snow. Any man who was still a man would undoubtedly be captivated by her flawless body the moment they saw her.
A young man awakened to love would be mesmerized by her enchanting face that could satisfy any fantasy; an old man seasoned in battle would fixate on the bosom and hips that would linger in their thoughts before bed.
But immediately, no matter what kind of man, they would be repelled by her demeanor that kept people at a thousand miles away.
If someone still disbelieved and wanted to get close, they would be cruelly pierced by the thorns of this flower.
She had many titles.
The first beauty of Southern Wu, the daughter of the Sword Sect Leader, Innate Water Profound Root, and a genius Array Master.
She was Yu Xuanwei.
...
Yu Xuanwei’s brows furrowed even tighter, but even the frown carried a beauty that moved the heart like Xizi holding her heart.
She frowned because things were far beyond her expectations.
The Great Elder had sought her out before he left, discussing with her for a long time about "what to do in case all top fighters of the Nanwu Sword Sect were dead".
First, she would open the door behind her to check if her father, the Sword Emperor Shui Bo, was still alive.
If he was, Shui Bo Sword Emperor would make the decision.
But... this hope was actually slim.
The blood Shui Bo Sword Emperor used to determine the "Third Palace" was far too risky; it was demon blood directed towards the divine soul.
During this time, Swordmaster Kuye repeatedly experimented with elixirs and decoctions to "repair the divine soul" and "remove the divine soul poison", and secretly sent them to Luoxia Bamboo Island every few days, hoping to increase the chances for Shui Bo Sword Emperor to break through.
However, others did not know, but Yu Xuanwei knew... as early as last year, the decoction she left in the secret room’s "food entrance" hadn’t been touched since.
In other words, either Shui Bo Sword Emperor had been immersed in some peculiar state for a whole year, or... the worst-case scenario had already happened.
Shui Bo Sword Emperor was already dead.
However, she had never disclosed this news to the outside.
Part of the reason why Nanwu Sword Sect, and even Southern Wu, could still hold on was because of the "Shui Bo Sword Emperor in secluded retreat on Luoxia Bamboo Island".
If the news of "Shui Bo Sword Emperor’s demise" leaked out, morale would likely collapse beyond recognition in an instant, and defeat would follow like a landslide.
Secondly, she would lead the elite from the sect to quickly withdraw from the Nanwu Sword Sect, then head south to the wilderness to search for the ancient teleportation array recorded in the Sword Sect Chronicles.
The "list of elite seeds in the sect" was given to her by the Great Elder.
As for the teleportation array, it was said that the other side of the teleportation array was where the Nanwu Sword Sect originated. The first sect leader of Nanwu Sword Sect also came from that side, which is why they brought mysterious and comprehensive cultivation techniques like the Profound Sword Scripture and the Chi Qiu Ring-Head Sword Array.
Unfortunately, the teleportation array had been damaged for reasons unknown for a long time. Fortunately, some details about the array were recorded in the Sword Sect Chronicles, and coupled with years of research by the sect leader’s lineage, by her time... she was confident she could repair it.
But ah...
She did not expect that, after the Great Elder and others went to keep the appointment at Konglan Mountain, the Puppet Sect took advantage of the situation and launched a surprise attack.
’What happened?’
’The Great Elder is careful in his actions. He would definitely wait for a significant presence of Crimson Palace aura at Konglan Mountain before going to the appointment; otherwise... he wouldn’t have gone.’
’The Puppet Sect should also know that a surprise attack is meaningless, fighting on foreign terrain would only increase their casualties.’
’Our sect is at a disadvantage in battles with the Puppet Sect; complete defeat is only a matter of time. If the Puppet Sect wanted victory, there is no need to be so impatient.’
’This trickery is pointless.’
Yet this unreasonable event happened regardless.
Yu Xuanwei watched the distance, deep in thought. She needed some time to quickly make a decision.
Whether to do nothing, play the empty fortress strategy, go to support, or quickly find the elite and quietly leave with them.
But in the next moment, all her considerations were interrupted.
Because outside the array of Luoxia Bamboo Island, a person suddenly appeared, a person enveloped entirely in pitch-black heavy armor, from whose visor seams blood-colored wisps were streaming.
As soon as that person appeared, shadows grew behind him, transforming into slender paper figures with the swish of the wind, forming lines of red and green-clad men and women. In front of these paper figures was a beauty in white clothes.
Only the beauty’s face was as pale as paper.
Clearly, it was a paper figure.
At this moment, a buzzing voice came from behind the pitch-black heavy armor: "Dear niece, this seat has already reached you. This move placed on the mortal world’s chessboard is called ’General’. Why don’t we lay down our arms?"
Yu Xuanwei stared coldly at him, saying, "Gu Huangzi?"
Gu Huangzi made no attempt to hide, nor did he waste time, directly saying, "Whatever seeds your Sword Sect has, take them all, we will flee south, this seat knows where the ancient teleportation array is."

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 107. Long Time No See (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: 107. Long Time No See (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)_2
This sudden statement left Yu Xuanwei slightly stunned.
She didn’t exactly believe the old demon’s words, but rather sensed something unusual in them.
Yu Xuanwei asked in surprise, "Why do you want to run?"
"The Mountain and Sea Demon Race is coming, and the fierce attack at the front is just for their show..." Gu Huangzi said quickly, then turned his head towards the depths of Luoxia Bamboo Island, glanced casually, and snorted with laughter, "The Sword Emperor has long fallen, something I’ve known for a while. You and I should save our energy and time, hurry along, so we can look after each other on the way. There’s no perpetual enemy, we can be partners now."
Yu Xuanwei said, "You said for me to take the Sword Sect’s seeds, just to ease my mind and trick me out of the array. As for saying my father has already fallen..."
She suddenly lifted her head, a smile on her charming face, her eyes sparkling, and said, "Why don’t you try yourself, and see what kind of scenery it is when the Nightmare Demon Blood sets the Third Palace and combines with our Nanwu Sword Sect’s Sword Dao."
The air suddenly went silent.
Gu Huangzi laughed sinisterly, "Water Lord Sword Emperor did have a good daughter, even this can’t deceive her.
Try it, let’s try!"
With that, blood light suddenly burst forth from the gaps in his pitch-black heavy armor.
Yu Xuanwei pinpointed an array flag, placed a Profound Crystal, and the shield light floated and became clearer.
In the next instant, Gu Huangzi suddenly descended like a black meteor from the sky, dragging a crimson "comet tail," raising an iron fist the size of a wine jug and "boom," pounding the atmospheric shield.
Chirp... boom!!! Bang bang bang bang!!
The entire array shield churned up with violent waves, retreating rapidly in all directions, while the most profound part of the array shield was revealed after the Profound Qi was torn apart.
Gu Huangzi didn’t wait for the Profound Qi to converge, continued to dive, swinging his fist mercilessly, and with a "thud," the gathered Profound Qi was scattered again, while the deeper layer of the array shield trembled violently.
This fighting method made Yu Xuanwei genuinely stunned for a moment.
"Paperman Peak’s Peak Master" Gu Huangzi’s combat method, is it really so simple and unadorned, brutish and wild?
She squinted her eyes, focused intently on the black-armored giant hammering on the array shield, analyzing the power...
There’s no doubt, the power of Gu Huangzi’s true form is terrifying, but it’s not enough to break through her array in a short time.
Then, there’s still time.
Swish!
Yu Xuanwei threw out dozens of Profound Crystals, then took out the array flag, and began setting up an "array within an array."
In this way, even if Gu Huangzi were to break through the outer array, he would still face a second array.
"Array" as such sacrifices mobility completely, but can rely on the mountains and rivers to exert great effect.
Even if there’s a huge power disparity between Yu Xuanwei and Gu Huangzi, if she is determined to shell herself in turtle shells one after another, Gu Huangzi would have to be worn down here, until the situation changes to the next phase.
In a prolonged stalemate, as long as it drags on, there will always be change.
That moment, it is the turning point.
Yu Xuanwei believed that would be a positive turning point, because this place is the home turf of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Her eyes were calm, she glanced at Gu Huangzi who was still hammering the array shield, quickly grabbed the second set of array flags.
And at that moment, her eyebrows twitched suddenly, a sudden panic hit her heart, fear and surprise piercing into her mind like sharp thorns.
Yu Xuanwei abruptly looked up, her beautiful eyes wide open.
An unbelievable scene suddenly entered her sight.
The white paper beauty split into two, two became four, four became eight, scattering rapidly, in an instant spreading out into dozens of papermen.
Paper can be layered.
But Yu Xuanwei never expected that "paper figures could also layer."
Now the separated paper figures, like the sharpest spike, during the moment she was distracted setting up a second array, joined forces and fiercely pierced into the weakest point of the array.
Clink!
A crisp sound entered Yu Xuanwei’s ears.
Cracks began to form on the transparent array shield covering Luoxia Bamboo Island.
This tactic is akin to two children fighting, one child’s every punch is solid, using what he has; the other is feinting a left punch, and when the opponent’s attention is drawn over, the right punch, already charged with power, is swung out fiercely.
Gu Huangzi, who was lying on the array shield, leaped, landed at the center of the crack, his fist came down again, "crash," he reached his hand into the crack.
His hands gripping the sides of the crack, pulling forcefully apart.
In the sinister helmet, a pair of blood-red pupils seemed to carry a mocking smile.
Yu Xuanwei hurriedly discarded the second set of flags, began to fully concentrate on repairing the array shield, otherwise... in the next moment, Gu Huangzi would crawl in.
Facing this Sect Leader of the Puppet Sect head-on, Yu Xuanwei knew she probably wouldn’t last even a single round.
But just then, Yu Xuanwei suddenly felt Gu Huangzi’s crawling motion stop.
The blood-tinged black-armored giant seemingly flipped over, quickly adjusted his position, hovered back into the air, lined up with over thirty white-clad paper beauties behind him, facing a certain direction together.
After a brief confrontation, Yu Xuanwei was already drenched in cold sweat, she hastily repaired the array shield, while also looking up into the distance.
She couldn’t imagine any of the experts left in the Crimson Palace of the Sword Sect that could make Gu Huangzi respond as if facing a formidable enemy.
On the horizon, a figure gradually slowed, appearing at a distance of over a hundred zhang, a Profound Robe fluttered, black hair dancing against the wind, a plain face facing the direction of the array shield.
For the "Number One Most Wanted in the Three Kingdoms" recently, Yu Xuanwei had long seen his portrait.
"Song Yan?!!"
Yu Xuanwei exclaimed.
But what surprised her even more was that Song Yan didn’t bother with any disguise, openly revealing his face to everyone.
A man whom all major powers of the Three Kingdoms turned the world upside down searching for, would he not care to hide himself?
A sense of profound oddity, mystery, and the unknown surged in Yu Xuanwei’s heart.
This man named Song Yan, his first appearance gave her a feeling she couldn’t see through at all.
"Teacher, long time no see."
Song Yan smiled, politely greeting Gu Huangzi.
Gu Huangzi was equally surprised.
He didn’t understand why Song Yan would appear here at this time, in a place he absolutely shouldn’t and couldn’t appear.
However, having experienced countless storms and waves, he also laughed and said, "Times change, the fox wolves are invading, you and I as master and apprentice united, let’s carve a bloody path."
"Fox wolves are invading? Is it the Mountain and Sea Demon Race’s fox wolves? When did that happen?
Nevertheless, since the master intends, the disciple naturally agrees."
While agreeing, Song Yan slightly moved his arms, deftly pulling out ten shadow puppets with his fingers.
Gu Huangzi’s blood eyes narrowed, staring at those ten shadow puppets.
The "Skin Control Technique" of Shadow Puppet Peak can only control two.
Ten?
What kind of dream is this?
"The younger generation is indeed impressive." Gu Huangzi’s voice boomed with appreciation.
However, even though the two were talking, appearing friendly, they both absolutely would not believe a word of what the other was saying, everything went in one ear and out the other.
Yu Xuanwei might still ponder, but Song Yan wouldn’t even process the words of Gu Huangzi in his head.
Whatever "the disciple naturally agrees," or "the younger generation is impressive," it was all deceitful, all meant to lull the other into lowering their guard.
Though the possibility was small, under the Puppet Sect’s cultural influence, such casual deceptive rhetoric had become the norm.
Both were keenly aware of this, so at this moment, they were mutually observing each other, seemingly wanting to see through the other’s cards, hidden tricks, and real strength.
War, it was about to erupt!

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)
Luoxia Bamboo Island.
The giant clad in black armor floated in mid-air, eyes fixed on Song Yan in the distance, fingers clad in Profound Armor twitched slightly, and over thirty beautiful paper figures surrounded him, forming a circular array.
Song Yan’s ten fingers moved as well, and due to the special technique of "Deformed Soul," the ten shadow puppets were equivalent in power to advanced demon beasts.
Though it was just two people, it seemed like two armies facing off.
Seeing Gu Huangzi’s gaze fall upon these shadow puppets, Song Yan smirked and said something that could infuriate anyone: "Thanks to the teacher’s blessing, all made at the Shadow Puppet Pavilion, otherwise, relying solely on me, I wouldn’t find so many intact demon beast skins."
As the words fell, he suddenly charged forward.
The ten shadow puppets followed closely behind him, ever-changing, and the illusions emanating from "Deformed Soul" created a bizarre, twisted scenery around Song Yan, making anyone who saw it dizzy and anyone who stared at it feel dazed.
Gu Huangzi raised his hand and pressed down.
Swish swish swish swish~~
The paper figures of beauties suddenly turned into streaks of white silk, shooting toward Song Yan.
The secret technique of Gu Huangzi, combined with the powerful divine soul support provided by the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet," allowed him to command a terrifying number of paper figures.
In an instant, the shadow puppets collided with the paper figures.
Boom boom boom!
The first wave seemed evenly matched, but the balance quickly tilted, and the shadow puppets were swiftly overwhelmed.
Gu Huangzi glanced into the distance, clenched his fists again, preparing to strike directly at Song Yan.
Just then, Song Yan’s speed suddenly increased sharply, and the shadow puppets, which had been confronting the paper figures, let out a sharp wail, transformed into afterimages, and were instantly absorbed into his maw.
The shadow puppet of Grandma Hu was already inside him, and now with the enhancement of over ten shadow puppets, the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" exploded in an instant, Song Yan’s figure rapidly expanded, transforming into a demon possessing various advanced demonic traits.
Whoosh!
Boom!
Air exploded, rings spread outward, and the towering demon accelerated once more in mid-air, transformed into a jet black light, a thick-skinned giant hand like a cannonball blasted out, straight toward Gu Huangzi’s heart covered in black armor.
This attack was so sudden, Gu Huangzi couldn’t possibly recall the paper figures in time, two fist-sized punches suddenly exerted force, pressing down to push away this giant hand, while using the momentum to open up distance.
This technique, he hadn’t seen before, nor did he have time to ponder it.
Yet, just as his fists were about to meet Song Yan’s big hand, Song Yan’s hand miraculously, in a bizarre manner, swiftly lifted from below.
This was the martial arts technique from Jianghu he utilized, this very style combined the "Sword Drawing Skill," "Wave-Treading Hand," "Heavenly King Tower Holding Technique," among other techniques.
Slam!
Gu Huangzi’s fists struck empty air.
Clank!!
Song Yan’s big hand knocked aside the face-covering helmet and advanced further, fiercely gripping Gu Huangzi’s face, with a point of his index finger, a strand of "special sword qi - Soul-Piercing Sword" was thrust out at close range.
At such a close range, the Soul-Piercing Sword could exert maximum power.
...
Inside the array shield, Yu Xuanwei watched with mouth slightly agape.
One was the Three Kingdoms Dominator, the other a top wanted criminal, and the two were in a mentor-disciple relationship. In this fight, whether in technique or strategy, it was entirely different from the Sword Sect’s bright and upright combat style.
She had just been deceived by Gu Huangzi, but now directly saw Gu Huangzi being deceived.
Gu Huangzi used his own body to deceive her, then used paper figures for a sneak attack.
Song Yan, in turn, used the shadow puppets to deceive Gu Huangzi, then suddenly swallowed the shadow puppets, erupting with his body for a surprise attack.
These were all cunning methods of "feinting with one move, concealing the killing intent."
...
Hiss!!
The "Soul-Piercing Sword Qi" nurtured by the blood of "Night Candle Soul Insect" deeply pierced into the center of Gu Huangzi’s brow.
Song Yan was prepared to effortlessly finish off Gu Huangzi.
He believed that "Changwang Hu" ranked highly in the realm of imprisoned soul transformed minion.
Once it reached the stage of divine soul combat, even with the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet," Gu Huangzi would undoubtedly be defeated.
With the piercing of "Soul-Piercing Sword Qi," a shrill scream emanated from Gu Huangzi’s brow, accompanied by a wisp of indistinct black smoke... emerging from Gu Huangzi’s seven orifices.
Then, something incredible happened.
Gu Huangzi, though his brow emitted screams and black smoke, seemed entirely unfazed, with a sly smile, his two iron fists that had struck empty suddenly rose, smashing fiercely into Song Yan’s ribs from both sides.
However, at this moment, Song Yan in the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" state had an overwhelmingly forceful aura, and his body was so solid that this strike only caused his flesh to slightly indent, causing some minor discomfort.
But the power was indeed real, and Song Yan’s figure was blown backward like a solitary boat on a raging tide.
Yet his right hand still held onto Gu Huangzi’s face.
Another fierce thrust with his left hand.
"Sleeve Universe," after two perfect executions, could invoke "Sword Heaven Gate" or "Evil Heaven Gate," the sword and killing intent following the heart, the thoughts guiding the actions.
This was a technique with extremely explosive power!
The blood-colored killing fist instantly fell on that face, with a bang shattering Gu Huangzi’s head, even the helmet broke entirely and fell into the water.
With the helmet shattered, Song Yan’s left hand took advantage of the momentum to grab the headless corpse out.
Look again!
What kind of body was this?!
Covered in white fur, terribly foul, with internal organs forming a tangled lump, wisps of blood mist were dispersing from this body.
Song Yan, having spent considerable time in the Puppet Sect, knew well the different grades of blood corpses on Blood Corpse Peak.
The lowest is the black-haired corpse, which has short and dense black fur, resembling mold.
Then there’s the purple-blood corpse, this type of blood corpse possesses immense strength, though unable to wield techniques, its body strength can tear intermediate demon beasts apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)_2
Then there was this kind of white-haired corpse. The white-haired blood corpse had long and sparse hair, even carrying a bit of a crystalline glow. In terms of physical strength, it was outstanding even in the Early to Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace Level.
Since Gu Huangzi’s true form is a white-haired blood corpse, then... this is not Gu Huangzi!
Gu Huangzi almost never appeared, and the few times he did, it was always in the form of this Profound Armor giant.
From the start, he didn’t trust anyone and was setting traps for everyone from the beginning.
Even if someone broke through the encirclement and attacked him with all their might, killing him, they would only have killed a blood corpse!
Just now, the reason his "Soul-Piercing Sword Qi" failed and brought about a scream and a wisp of black smoke was entirely because Gu Huangzi put on a full act, inserting a paper man into the Purple Mansion of this soulless blood corpse.
But a paper man is a paper man, and a blood corpse is a blood corpse.
The paper man doesn’t need a body.
But the blood corpse has no Divine Soul.
The paper man dies, but the blood corpse remains unaffected.
The moment Song Yan saw the white-haired blood corpse, he already understood Gu Huangzi’s "trick".
As he thought this, his hands didn’t stop moving.
His left hand was pressed on the headless white-haired blood corpse that had been pulled out, and he struck again with an "Evil Heaven Gate," swiftly delivering the coup de grâce.
Bang!
The headless white-haired blood corpse seemed to be hit by a shell at close range. Its entire abdomen shattered, but the rest of its body only showed slight cracks, and putrid venom was trickling down with a "drip-drip."
...
Song Yan’s gaze shifted slightly, sharp as a knife.
Where exactly is Gu Huangzi’s true form?
Is it among those thirty or so white-clothed beauties, or among the twisted, elongated paper figures of strange red males and green females behind them?
Yet, wherever it was, Song Yan knew he was about to face it very soon.
When he unleashed the "Evil Heaven Gate," Gu Huangzi would certainly be briefly stunned by the shock; but when he used the "Evil Heaven Gate" for the second time, Gu Huangzi would surely be ready to act.
Was he being passive?
Yes!
But passive doesn’t mean being coerced.
Being passive can be used to one’s advantage, turning the tables!
His left hand pounded again and again on the already shattered white-haired blood corpse. Everyone could see... this corpse, now even more tattered than a sackcloth doll, had no fighting capacity left, but Song Yan kept delivering blows.
He seemed relentless and tireless in dealing the final blow, appearing as if driven by fear to do so.
At least Yu Xuanwei, staring in disbelief from within the array shield, thought Song Yan must be afraid.
Because, at this moment, Song Yan’s face was full of horror and fear, as if unable to believe that after revealing all his cards and going through so much hardship to kill the enemy, it wasn’t actually Gu Huangzi.
...
All around Song Yan were many paper people.
Song Yan felt that Gu Huangzi was hiding among them.
But those paper people were too scattered, spread out all around, and no matter which direction he chased, there was always the possibility of a paper person escaping.
So he needed to bring the paper people closer.
This was his proactive move within passivity.
Catching something like this was already second nature to him.
It all happened in the blink of an eye, in just a few breaths.
In the next moment, circles of white-clothed beauties and elongated paper figures of red males and green females began swarming in, their faces ghostly pale, mouths twisted in eerie smiles, a cacophony of voices mingled together.
Men and women, young and old, all were shouting, screaming, hysterically laughing, exclaiming, "Song Yan, hahaha, Song Yan, hehe, Song Yan, jejeje"!!
The strange voices wove together, like eerie dolls holding hands, spinning around Song Yan; like the sharp gears of some gruesome meat grinder, spinning rapidly toward him.
