The sinister atmosphere and terrifying oppression coalesced into an invisible giant hand, whose ten fingers seemed to close, desiring to crush the person in the center to dust!
Song Yan gasped heavily, his demon-like enormous head swiveling left and right, seemingly filled with panic, not knowing where he should strike.
Seeing the paper people closing in, Song Yan seemed to reach a limit of mental endurance, screamed in terror, and tossed away the already ragged blood corpse in his hand.
Then...
It was as if he changed faces...
His gaze turned icy in an instant.
His large sleeves swelled in a moment.
From the expanded sleeve opening soared out a bizarre creature with blood-red eyes, camel head, deer antlers, rabbit eyes, ox ears, snake neck, clam belly, fish scales, eagle claws, tiger palms—interwoven with red and silver, silver on the outside, red hidden within—quickly transforming into a blood mist-enshrouded Silver Armored Demon Dragon.
With a whoosh, the demon dragon flew out of Song Yan’s sleeve, and like a magic trick, Song Yan disappeared as well, merging entirely with the demon dragon.
The demon dragon flicked its tail and leaped, traversing the void, turning the Misty Sea into a Vast Sea, waves rising dozens of feet high, crashing heavily onto the Luoxia Bamboo Island.
And this demon dragon, made of Sword Evil Qi, had already arrived at the farthest paper person.
It was a green, elongated, blush-cheeked, peculiar paper figure.
Boom!!
The Sword Evil Demon Dragon charged directly through the strange paper figure, devouring with Evil Qi, overwhelming with Sword Qi, and with one clash, the paper figure shattered.
The demon dragon’s momentum did not cease, spiraling rapidly, and amongst its swirling, the ring of paper people that had gathered and charged... were all torn to shreds.
It was as if torn white paper thrown into the air, swirling everywhere in a flurry, like colorful butterflies with clipped wings caught in a hurricane.
The demon dragon circled once and cleared the battlefield.
After the battlefield was entirely cleared, the dragon’s gaze immediately fixed on the last "thing."
It was a thin man.
Very thin, very thin, incredibly thin.
So thin that "skin and bones" couldn’t describe it.

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: 108. You are already a qualified Puppet Sect Leader (4.6K words - subscribe please)_3
But the skinny man’s eyes were tricky and sly, and there was a bracelet on his arms, like dry twigs.
A dragon’s eye met the gaze of the skinny man.
Confirmed by the eyes, this is the right person.
This is actually Gu Huangzi’s real body.
He is hiding within a slender, strange paperman of a green-clad woman!
Song Yan recalls the scene when he first saw Gu Huangzi at Paperman Peak.
He carefully stepped over the threshold, walked through a corridor resembling a memorial hall, with twisted tall strange papermen on both sides, men in red, women in green, pale-faced, painted with rouge, and smiling eerily. These papermen were tall enough to reach the ceiling, stooping to gaze down at the pedestrians in the corridor.
No one would have thought... Gu Huangzi would actually hide in this corridor!!
Who would have thought?
Until now, Gu Huangzi’s expression remained calm, his body flowing with Crimson Palace Blood, suddenly blooming in midair, layer after layer expanding, transforming into thick armor like that of an old crocodile.
But before the heavy armor could fully form, the Demon Dragon swung its tail and reached his front.
Soul-Imprisoning Sword Qi, Soul-Piercing Sword Qi, released in an instant!
Gu Huangzi’s body paused, stopping its transformation into armor.
Ssss, ssss, ss, ss...
Silver armored blood smoke Demon Dragon dispersed, transforming into the form of Song Yan.
Pa!
Song Yan’s hand firmly landed on Gu Huangzi’s brow.
Changwang Hu’s tiger stripes swiftly crawled, heading for the soul at Gu Huangzi’s brow.
Yet, within Gu Huangzi’s brow’s Divine Soul Space, soul after soul suddenly charged towards Song Yan, who maneuvered Changwang Hu’s tiger stripes to confine them one by one.
Victory seemed imminent, yet at that moment, Song Yan suddenly felt extreme danger.
He quickly withdrew from the Divine Soul World, steadied his gaze, only to see Gu Huangzi’s pupils still faintly watching him, with a gold-edged dagger unknowingly gripped in his palm.
The dagger "whoosh" fiercely stabbed towards Song Yan’s abdomen.
Despite being controlled by Changwang Hu’s soul, how could Gu Huangzi still have the consciousness to control his body to attack?
A flash of doubt crossed Song Yan’s mind, and suddenly his hand moved.
Evil Heaven Gate, unleash instantly!
Boom!
Gu Huangzi’s armor shattered, his body fragmented, revealing a skeleton.
Amidst the shattered flesh, the divine soul also vanished, but upon the bones... still remained a divine soul!
That was Gu Huangzi’s true divine soul.
...
"Kid, I lost.
I’ve exhausted all my cards.
The deceptive heavy armor white-haired blood corpse was my first card.
The many papermen controlled by the strengthened divine soul from the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet were my second card.
Hidden within an inconspicuous paperman was my third card.
My First Palace Blood is quite ordinary, capable of enhancing flesh power, thus even though my flesh appears withered, it is actually full of qi blood, able to quickly recover and form demon-like heavy armor. This is nothing special.
My Second Palace Blood is fairly good, soul in the bone. If the bone remains, the body remains.
I’ve linked my flesh with the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, while the true divine soul hides in the bone.
If you attack me, should you attack the soul, I could sneak an attack from outside... This was my last card."
Divine Soul Thought, transmitting quickly.
After Gu Huangzi’s divine soul finished speaking, he continued: "Kid, I’m really convinced.
Here’s the deal, I’ll be your servant, I’ll be under you, let me go, don’t turn me into a minion.
Anyway, the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet and such are already yours, and you already know all my secrets.
With your skills, controlling me isn’t a piece of cake?"
Song Yan’s divine soul replied: "Teacher, you are already in my palm, transforming you into a minion is just a moment away, so tell me... why should I take the risk?"
Amidst the dialogue, the whole world seemed to slow down, with two divine souls standing in the air, as a terrifying Changwang Hu patterned stripe grasping towards Gu Huangzi.
Even though the divine soul exchange was fast, the speed of the Changwang Hu patterned stripe matched it.
From afar, Gu Huangzi’s expression seemed to change several times, finally letting out a long sigh.
Soon after, a muffled groan echoed.
His divine soul began to shatter, revealing fractures.
Song Yan paused.
Crimson Palace Level masters could self-destruct their divine souls.
But he couldn’t have imagined Gu Huangzi would do such a thing.
"Forget it, kid, I should have known it would end like this.
Years ago, I rebelled against my mentor, betrayed my ancestors, the old one didn’t want to fall into my hands, so he self-destructed.
Now... it’s my turn."
"You...
are an eligible Puppet Sect Leader.
Goodbye."
"Forever... farewell."
With those words, the Changwang Hu stripe arrived, entwining and tangling, causing Gu Huangzi’s shattered divine soul to explode instantly, forming stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 109. Receiving the inheritance, entering the battle array momentarily (4.0K characters - requesting subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: 109. Receiving the inheritance, entering the battle array momentarily (4.0K characters - requesting subscription)
The sparkling Divine Soul Fragments flickered like fireworks in the deep night, gradually dimming.
Song Yan squinted his eyes tightly, staring at these souls, fearing that Gu Huangzi might play another trick.
Facing such an old thing, whose whole body was full of cunning, if he was slightly unprepared, he would be overturned, falling into a place of eternal doom.
Just now, in that brief skirmish, both he and Gu Huangzi were indeed in peril, almost in a constant extreme tug-of-war of "winning one moment but could be utterly defeated the next".
He took Gu Huangzi by surprise, using the Hundred Forms Demon Body, combined with his martial arts mastery, he managed to catch Gu Huangzi’s forehead closely and unleashed a move of "Soul-Piercing Sword Qi".
In this situation, Gu Huangzi must be dead, right?
However, Gu Huangzi’s body was not his real body but just a Blood Corpse.
The Blood Corpse had no soul at all, thus his strike landed entirely on a soft spot, leaving him exposed to attacks.
...
The Blood Corpse used immense force to attack his ribs fiercely.
In Gu Huangzi’s view, even if he wasn’t dead, he should be severely injured, and after getting injured, he would distance himself.
But his "Hundred Forms Demon Body" was too solid, and his battle experience was quite abundant.
He withstood two punches hard, his hand still not loosening, and also made a timely follow-up with a move of "Evil Heaven Gate", then continued to strike, thoroughly smashing the White Haired Blood Corpse that Gu Huangzi might reuse anytime.
....
Then followed another round of extreme pulling.
And when it came to him genuinely capturing Gu Huangzi’s real body, putting his hand on Gu Huangzi’s forehead, letting the Changwang Tiger’s black spot drill into his Divine Soul World, Gu Huangzi still had a trump card hidden for a counterattack.
If he was one step slower and was stabbed by that odd dagger with a golden blade, the outcome might have been completely different.
Anything that Gu Huangzi used as his ultimate dagger must be extraordinary!
If Stone Seat Elder gave him a lesson about "human nature", teaching him "never gamble on human nature, never trust anyone", then... Gu Huangzi gave him a lesson about "combat".
If it wasn’t for his luck in acquiring the "Changwang Tiger Blood";
Through sweat and intelligence comprehended the Secret Technique "Divine Face Hundred Defenses" to the level of "Hundred Forms Demon Body";
From the Nanwu Sword Sect’s "Profound Transformation Sword Manual" comprehending "My Sword", and turning his entire Profound Qi into Sword Qi from the "Profound Sword Scripture", further elevating the Crimson Palace technique "Sleeve Universe" to the level of "Sword Evil Demon Dragon"...
This battle, he was afraid he would lose.
In simple terms, he was actually just an ordinary person, it was Gu Huangzi who was the amazingly talented Demon Cultivator.
...
While Song Yan was pondering, Gu Huangzi’s soul had completely dissipated, even his body was crumbling, turning to ash.
As it vanished into thin air, three items fell from mid-air.
Golden Blade Dagger,
Storage Bag,
Cold Ice Hell Bracelet!
Song Yan’s fingers slightly moved, activating three Demon Bird Shadow Puppets, which swiftly shot out, aiming for the three items.
Both the Golden Blade Dagger and Storage Bag were caught in one gulp.
But when the last Demon Bird Shadow Puppet used its claws to seize the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, an unexpected change occurred.
Firstly, those two claws quivered violently as if electrocuted;
Moreover, countless lumps suddenly protruded on the surface of the Demon Bird Shadow Puppet;
Almost simultaneously, those lumps transformed into "inflated balloons", rapidly expanding and enlarging...
Demon Beast Skin is quite hard and full of resilience, hence even while being stretched, it did not burst immediately.
Song Yan swiftly fixed his gaze on this mutated shadow puppet.
Look closely!
However, the continuously swelling shadow puppet surface revealed bizarre patterns, those patterns were unexpectedly human hands and faces, bulging out densely, pushing left and right, continuously rising, as if countless little people were being quickly infused into that Demon Beast Shadow Puppet.
Initially, he was worried about Gu Huangzi’s backup, but upon seeing this scene, he actually let out a sigh of relief.
This was because "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" had lost its master, the prison that was restraining souls inside opened in an instant, and the souls were rushing out eagerly.
However, their numbers surpassed Song Yan’s expectations!
He glanced down at Yu Xuanwei who was quickly arranging the "second array flag".
Yu Xuanwei was also cautiously watching him.
Their gazes silently crossed in mid-air.
Song Yan unexpectedly showed a hint of disappointment.
Yu Xuanwei was stunned for a moment, a trace of confusion appeared in her big eyes.
Song Yan coldly said: "Foolish woman, why haven’t you quickly taken out some Profound Object to record my current appearance and what I’m about to do? Do you really want to be captured and soul-searched by Demons?"
Foolish woman?
Yu Xuanwei was taken aback again.
Having lived this long, grown this old, no one in this world had ever used these three words to describe her.
But thinking again about what Song Yan said, she suddenly understood.
The invasion by the Fox and Wolf Races, Song Yan’s appearance, those races would definitely investigate everything related to Song Yan to the death, no one could stop their pace.
As a witness, if she did not want to be soul-searched, her only option was to take out a Profound Object that could store appearances!
This way, regardless of the result, there would be an additional opportunity for negotiation.
Recalling Song Yan’s undisguised look of disappointment earlier, a complex emotion even surged in her heart, Song Yan’s expression clearly said "I thought you were smart, but didn’t expect you to be so foolish, do I have to remind you of this?"
"Alright, I’ll take it out."
Yu Xuanwei was no longer a rebellious little girl, she couldn’t do things like "I know you want me to do it, it’s right, but I just won’t do it". With this reminder, her hand quickly flipped, taking out a piece of crystal-clear jade.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 109. Receiving Inheritance, Instantly Entering the Formation (4.0K words - Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: 109. Receiving Inheritance, Instantly Entering the Formation (4.0K words - Seeking Subscription)_2
The jade stone emitted a glow, quickly recording the scene above the sky.
After finishing these tasks, Yu Xuanwei immediately felt something was off.
Previously when Song Yan appeared, she already felt something was amiss.
Now, Song Yan actively let her use the "Memory Jade" to record, which was even more peculiar.
Thoughts flooded her mind, but no matter how she pondered, she couldn’t figure out Song Yan’s intentions, making her increasingly fearful and vigilant.
She had witnessed the man eliminate Gu Huangzi.
She knew how cunning and terrifying that old demon Gu Huangzi was, yet even such an old demon was defeated by this man.
A few years ago, this man was the central figure in Granny Fox’s incident.
Looking at Song Yan, Yu Xuanwei felt a deep sense of awe swelling from within.
Thinking of it this way, the words "stupid woman" didn’t seem so bad.
Others might not have the right to say it, but this man... was qualified.
...
Above the sky.
The hide of the Demon Bird Shadow Puppet couldn’t hold any longer. With a bursting sound, the beast skin shattered.
Amidst the scattered fragments, ghosts emerged like hundred-petaled, thousand-petaled stark white flowers, spiraling out from the ruptures! Each petal twisted, with ghostly faces fearsome and elongated in malice at the tip of the petals.
Imprisoned for years, regardless of the world outside, they all wished to escape, to tear apart all life in sight.
Song Yan collected the Hundred Forms Demon Body, calmly hanging in mid-air.
Facing the swarm of ghosts emerging from the Ice Hell, he suddenly let out a low roar.
The roar was like a tiger’s growl.
The empty surface of his body abruptly floated with patches of colorful markings.
Blurred patterns composed those markings.
Each pattern was a fierce ghost wearing shackles, trudging along with their heads bowed, crawling with hands and feet.
"Come!"
Song Yan faced the tide of ghosts, his eyes shining, shouting loudly, then opened his arms, embracing the ghosts emerging from the Ice Hell.
The ghosts encountered their nemesis; any that touched his body were pulled into the patterns, making the markings around him grow even denser and more bizarre.
Song Yan raised his hand, swiftly grabbing the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, continuing to shove the transformed minions back into the Ice Hell.
His body couldn’t endure that many ghosts, so when he captured about three to four hundred, he temporarily reached saturation, so... the excess had to be stored inside the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet."
The ghosts were placated upon being transformed, and even when re-entering the cage, they no longer resisted.
Song Yan took the opportunity to look into the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet."
What a sight!
Inside, the "Ice Hell" resembled a miniature "Divine Soul Secret Realm," with a pyramid structure.
The "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" he held was the pyramid’s apex; beneath it was a massive cage imprisoning over two to three thousand divine souls.
The triangular cage contained three special areas, each appearing like a "miniature pyramid."
Song Yan quickly identified the empty "miniature pyramid" as his previous residence, and the other two... surprisingly held people.
A young man and an old woman, both demon cultivators.
The young man had a pale complexion, and his hollow eyes carried a touch of cruelty. Song Yan recognized him; he was the "Senior Brother" of Paperman Peak, Gu Huangzi’s disciple, with early-stage Crimson Palace power.
The other was a dwarf-like old woman whom he hadn’t met before. Judging by her divine soul’s formidable presence, far surpassing the Senior Brother. Song Yan speculated this old woman might be an Elder inadvertently put in the Ice Hell by Gu Huangzi due to reasons like nurturing the divine soul or expressing loyalty.
Soon enough, Song Yan collected all fleeing ghosts.
He stopped thinking, flicked his thumb.
A drop of Changwang Tiger Blood fell on the surface of the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet.
The surface rippled, transformed into a circle of black smoke, then vanished without a trace.
A deeper sense of connection with the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" arose within Song Yan, and all ghosts within the Ice Hell, including the "two demon cultivators," started providing power to him, nurturing his divine soul.
In the past, the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" and three "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelets" had only a hierarchical divine soul relationship, making direct control not easy.
But now, Song Yan’s "Changwang Tiger Blood" made him the true master of the Ice Hell, surpassing all previous Puppet Sect Leaders in control.
In other words, if he wanted to kill those two demon cultivators, he could just probe them with Changwang Tiger Stripes.
However, Song Yan didn’t plan on doing this immediately.
Transformed Minion is irreversible; once transformed... it might be detected, causing him to lose two valuable pawns.
He didn’t continue to investigate, quickly stored the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, and reached for Gu Huangzi’s storage bag. Strangely enough... only two items were inside.
The first was large quantities of Profound Crystal.
The second was a peculiar metal emitting a faint golden glow, in chunks and granules, ranging from pebble-sized to soy-sized, unclear what they were for.
This faint golden metal bore some resemblance in color to the dagger blade but was paler.
Gu Huangzi fled secretly, bringing only essential items to avoid alerting others.
This metal likely had something to do with the Ancient Teleportation Array?
...
Song Yan, after inheriting Gu Huangzi’s legacy, landed calmly on the array shield, gazed at the Female Cultivator cautiously watching him, glimpsed at the jade stone recording, then swiftly turned and left.
Yu Xuanwei understood, raised her hand, and gathered the Memory Jade.
After a moment, Song Yan returned, again landing on the array shield, fixed his gaze on Yu Xuanwei, suddenly tossed down an item, saying, "Ancient Teleportation Array Map."
The map slipped onto the array shield but couldn’t fall inside.
Yu Xuanwei watched Song Yan warily.
Song Yan smiled, raised his hands slightly, and quickly flew away, his speed akin to when he charged at Gu Huangzi, indicating... this should be his fastest speed.
After Song Yan left, Yu Xuanwei quickly operated the array plate, slightly opened a gap, allowing the map on the shield surface to fall inside.
As soon as the map entered the shield, she promptly closed the shield.
Yet...
It was still too late.
In the thin mist over the Misty Sea, a figure, seemingly teleporting, flashed inside, landing beside Yu Xuanwei within seconds.
This speed was far superior to the "speed at which he charged at Gu Huangzi."
Yu Xuanwei was immediately shocked, feeling remorseful. She knew all too well the need for utmost caution against such a demon, yet somehow she had inadvertently fallen into a trap.
However, she acknowledged her limitations, opting not to act but swiftly rose, respectfully bowed, and softly said, "Senior’s calculation is impressive, junior feels inadequate."
In her mind, Song Yan was clearly a youth possessed by an old monster, otherwise, he couldn’t possibly possess such profound insight and terrifying cunning.
"But senior being familiar with our Sword Sect Techniques suggests some connection, does this girl speak correctly?"
Song Yan didn’t act carelessly.
But when it came to Soul Searching, transforming into minions, he wouldn’t do it.
Post-transformation entities possess self-awareness and talent, but due to soul damage during transformation, they become ignorant of learned techniques as if through a fog, unable to recall details, let alone re-execute them after reclaiming control.
Otherwise, when he turned Granny Fox’s soul into a minion, he should have gained a plethora of techniques. The Changwang Tiger Race should have dominated the Mountain and Sea Demon Race long ago, not falling prey to the Fox and Wolf Races.
With so much "Changwang Tiger Blood," united in assailing strong ones, capturing strong ones, transforming them to gain their techniques, then controlling them post-resurrection, this world should have long been under "Changwang Tiger Race," not needing Song Yan to act and exert.
Therefore, he needed this woman but wouldn’t search her soul.
In response to Yu Xuanwei’s inquiry.
Song Yan nodded, saying, "Yes.".

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 110. Unexpected Joy, Blood of the Nightmare (3.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: 110. Unexpected Joy, Blood of the Nightmare (3.3K Words - Subscription Requested)
Luoxia Bamboo Island.
In the array.
Song Yan raised his sleeve and took out a dark broken sword, holding it up in front of Yu Xuanwei, then said, "I have already visited the ancient teleportation array. It was damaged, likely caused by this sword."
After saying this, he recalled a bit before saying, "The damage appears to be a groove as wide as a human arm, as if the array pattern on its surface was erased."
Yu Xuanwei quietly looked at the broken sword and asked, "May I have a look at it, Elder?"
Song Yan tossed it over.
Yu Xuanwei caught it, bringing her slender fingers together to gently stroke the body of the broken sword, then lifted it up, scrutinizing the break of the sword for a long time, before raising her head to glance at Song Yan, lost in thought.
Song Yan said, "I know you don’t trust me, even though I once helped the Su Family as Hua Rong to stab the Fox. Yet, you still think I used the Su Family, taking advantage of their bloody fight with the Fox Lady to achieve my own goals."
Yu Xuanwei sighed softly and said, "But if what Gu Huangzi said is true, the Fox and Wolf Races have already invaded. And now, Elder, you’re by my side. I seem to have no choice, either standing from the Sword Sect’s perspective or my own perspective."
She handed the broken sword back and said, "Our Sword Sect’s ancient records noted that the founding sect leader was teleported here via the ancient teleportation array, and the source of our Sword Sect is on the other side of the array.
However, why the ancient teleportation array was damaged and why its location was deliberately hidden remains a mystery.
But when I saw this sword, I already understood that the ancient teleportation array must have been destroyed by the first Sword Sect leader.
Because this sword is recorded in our sect’s ancient records as the sect leader’s sword, named the Selfless Sword.
The sect leader, upon arrival, fought a demon.
That battle was chaotic and fierce.
The sect leader won after a hard fight, yet his sword was lost outside.
From this...
I can guess a bit about the situation back then, but still don’t know if repairing the ancient teleportation array is a wise move."
Song Yan also fell silent.
The broken sword, along with the Sword Sect’s ancient records, made the situation quite clear: the founding sect leader of Nanwu Sword Sect might have escaped from the other side of the ancient teleportation array, and a demon escaped with him to this place before he finally slayed it after difficulties.
The sect leader’s broken sword destroyed the ancient teleportation array but also hid its location, not wanting future generations to repair the teleportation array and return to the Northern Land.
This is the most logical speculation.
And what this speculation reflects is also very clear—the other side of the ancient teleportation array is not safe.
Song Yan thought for a moment and then suddenly asked, "Does your Sword Sect’s ancient records mention what realm the founding sect leader reached?"
Yu Xuanwei replied, "The ancient records state that the founding sect leader sought the Purple Mansion Realm but never broke through, dying of old age. Therefore, he should have been in the Late Stage of the Crimson Palace."
Song Yan asked again, "How long ago was this?"
Yu Xuanwei answered, "It has been a thousand years."
Song Yan said, "No matter what’s on the other side of the ancient teleportation array, after a thousand years, things have certainly changed. And now the Three Kingdoms might face an invasion from the entire Mountain and Sea Demon Race. It’s destruction on both sides, so I genuinely hope Miss Yu can repair the ancient teleportation array as soon as possible."
Yu Xuanwei nodded and said, "What Elder said is right, I do understand the importance, but..."
Her beautiful eyes slightly raised, glancing into the distance.
The sharp whistling ahead did not cease; many Sword Sect disciples were injured and dying, and many forlorn shadow puppets fell like rain.
Song Yan said, "Don’t worry."
Yu Xuanwei was momentarily stunned and asked, "Why not?"
Song Yan answered, "The elders did not go to Konglan Mountain; soon, the attacking Demon Cultivators will face a two-sided attack."
Yu Xuanwei widened her mouth in astonishment, then nodded after a while and curiously asked, "How did Elder know?"
Song Yan said, "I sent the message."
Yu Xuanwei: ...
Song Yan glanced around, speaking in a low voice, "Remember my words. Once you have the opportunity, secretly repair the ancient teleportation array. It’s the only way out."
With that, he swiftly stood up, intending to leave decisively.
His time was running out.
And his goals were more than met,
First, by resolving Gu Huangzi and, to some extent, gaining the opportunity to "control the Puppet Sect";
Second, by establishing a normal connection with Yu Xuanwei and reaching a consensus;
Third, by presenting an accomplished fact, which is...
He, Song Yan, had successfully absorbed "Changwang Tiger Blood," even if they caught and killed him, they couldn’t extract "Changwang Tiger Blood" from his body.
Given that, does chasing me still hold any meaning?
This is why he showed his true face and let Yu Xuanwei record it.
He wanted to see how the Fox and Wolf Races would react to this news.
As for now, he intended to quietly retreat to a "low position of identity and power."
Wars have always been: soldiers against soldiers, generals against generals, kings against kings.
Assassinations are: kings against generals, generals against soldiers...
But someone as weak as Bai Xiuhu would never provoke the troubles of the Fox and Wolf Races at this level. Just like if someone were to assassinate Gu Huangzi, they would definitely, definitely not target those "decorative" paper figures along the way.
From beginning to end, Song Yan never mentioned half a word about "wanting to acquire the array’s inheritance."
If the elder in front of him or a person from the Demon Sect were not a Sword Sect disciple, then... he might have directly resorted to threats because he knew Demon Sect disciples would likely surrender out of fear of death.
But such tactics were not very effective on Sword Sect disciples.
Junior Sister Xia, Su Yao, Mr. Su San, and all the disciples from the Nanwu Sword Sect taught him a valuable lesson: In this world, there are indeed people with integrity who remain unyielding and unbending.
On the other side, when Yu Xuanwei saw this demon suddenly enter the array and, after just a few words, intended to leave, her thoughts stirred, her mind flashing with "this demon’s report to the elder," "this demon entering the array but not attacking her," coupled with earlier "Hua Rong’s assistance to the Fox Stabbing Alliance," and "this demon seemingly familiar with some Sword Sect techniques"...
Yu Xuanwei suddenly bit her lip and said, "Elder, please wait."
Song Yan stopped, frowned, and asked, "What else?"
Yu Xuanwei said, "I observe Elder seems skilled in Divine Soul attacks, so I’d like to ask Elder to take a look at my father, the current sect leader of Nanwu Sword Sect, the Water Uncle Sword Emperor."
She looked at Song Yan seriously and said, "If there is still someone who can help my father at this moment, it must be you, Elder."
After saying this, she bowed deeply.
Song Yan thought briefly and said, "Alright."
...
The bamboo forest was dense, deep greens and light greens clustered together to form a narrow path.
At the end of the path, the hall’s doors were tightly shut.
This was the "Blind Box" belonging to the Nanwu Sword Sect.
A "Blind Box" that no one dared to open.
Ka...
Zhizhizhizhi...
The "Blind Box" opened.
The hall’s doors opened, a mix of sunlight and red light gradually extended from a line to a column, and then opened completely.
Inside the hall, a figure with a lowered head gradually appeared on the meditation cushion.
Look again!
That wasn’t a figure, it was clearly a skeleton.
With the opening of the doors, a certain barrier seemed to reach its critical point, producing a crisp shattering sound of "kacha," followed by eerie rustling noises from behind the thick vermillion pillars in the hall.
"Dad!!"
Yu Xuanwei looked at that skeleton, despite feeling fear a thousand times, she was prepared in her heart, but upon truly seeing her father dead, she couldn’t help but cry out in pain.
Song Yan’s gaze fell behind the vermillion pillar, the rustling sound became even clearer, and in a moment, something darted out.
The speed of that thing was extremely fast, but Song Yan saw it clearly.
It was a red snake!
No!
Not a snake, but an Evil.
But not Evil Qi, it had become a flowing liquid form of Evil.
The chaotic and eerie aura emanating from it was incomparably stronger than Evil Qi.
In the next moment, the Evil Liquid darted and quickly flew into the air, and in mid-air, the "red snake head" was forcefully torn open, splitting towards the two of them! It greedily wanted to seize the bodies of these two.
Soul deceased for seven days, main soul departed, leaving behind Divine Soul Fragments containing cause and effect.
This Divine Soul Fragments, when encountering Profound Qi in dense or enclosed places, easily turned into Evil;
If lacking Profound Qi or in dispersed, open areas, they became wandering souls.
Evil was uncontrollable.
Even those summoned in Shadow Puppets were merely wandering souls.
The so-called "Evil Qi" within Song Yan was "Evil Profound," a special Profound Qi, and not a bunch of mad ghosts.
At this moment, seeing the exceedingly rare Evil Liquid darting towards him, Song Yan’s left hand gently tilted, and a nine-eyed boa Shadow Puppet immediately flew up, this Shadow Puppet was a soul-less Shadow Puppet, reserved by Song Yan.
As he raised his right hand, he summoned the Evil Liquid, hoping to make it enter the nine-eyed boa Shadow Puppet.
The trajectory of the Evil Liquid slightly twisted in mid-air, tilted towards the Shadow Puppet, but... halfway, it suddenly turned, continuing to relentlessly shoot towards Song Yan and Yu Xuanwei. Clearly, compared to the nine-eyed boa Shadow Puppet, these two living beings attracted it more.
Song Yan lost his patience, his left hand suddenly turned red, then he grabbed the Evil Liquid violently, stuffing it into the nine-eyed boa Shadow Puppet and suppressing it with the Slave Soul method.
Once inside the body and subjected to Slave Soul, the Evil Liquid struggled a few times, then fell silent.
Yu Xuanwei beside could only watch with her eyelids twitching...
Song Yan quickly placed it into a Storage Bag, pondering whether to transfer this thing into Grandmother Fox’s body, but soon dismissed the idea.
He could swallow the Shadow Puppet, but not this kind of Evil Shadow Puppet.
This thing was pure chaos, suitable for throwing out as a bomb to wreak havoc, but extremely uncontrollable.
"Thank you, Elder," Yu Xuanwei expressed her gratitude, then sorrowfully said, "Please, Elder, keep it confidential, do not let anyone know about the death of the Sword Emperor Shui Bo."
Song Yan intended to agree, but a glance revealed bowls on the floor of a food cave, the decoction within had dried, yet threads of scent still floated out.
He lightly sniffed and immediately caught the scent of "Kuye Sword Master’s repair Divine Soul Poison Soup decoction."
Anyone else wouldn’t be able to do it.
Looking again at the tragically deceased Sword Emperor Shui Bo, Song Yan suddenly said, "I wonder what kind of Demon Blood Shui Bo Sword Emperor used to fix the Third Central Palace?"
Yu Xuanwei was stunned for a moment, cautiously glancing at Song Yan, only to directly see a sliver of greed in that gaze.
She sighed lightly, said "Understood," then raised her hand and summoned a black stone bottle, saying: "Nightmare Blood, my father dared not use much at the time, only added a small amount to refine the Crimson Palace Pill, yet never expected failure. That’s why there was so much left.
This blood is of no great use to my Nanwu Sword Sect, so I gift it to you, Elder."
Song Yan took the black bottle, his gaze fiery as he looked at it, as if gazing at a beloved woman.
Nightmare, the injury to Divine Soul, this thing... was perfectly suitable for him.
Truly an unexpected joy!
Song Yan asked again, "Where did it come from?"
Yu Xuanwei replied, "The Demon my founder Sect Leader killed, was the Nightmare Beast.
The Nightmare Beast left behind an egg, which took hundreds of years to hatch, yet the sect forbears deemed it ominous and imprisoned it within a secret chamber.
Later, the Nightmare broke free, and after another great battle, was finally slain... This blood was left behind.
Now gifted to you, Elder, I hope you keep it confidential, do not let news of the death of the Sword Emperor Shui Bo spread."
Song Yanqi said curiously, "The Sword Emperor Shui Bo is dead? Who said that?"
Yu Xuanwei was stunned for a moment, then said, "Thus, thank you, Elder."

chapters.content:
Chapter 143: 111. The Peak Master Becomes a Slave, Breakthrough to Middle Stage (4.4K Words - Seeking Subscriptions)
Luoxia Bamboo Island, Yu Xuanwei watched as Song Yan soared into the sky and left.
With her left hand, she took out the array plate and gave it a slight adjustment. The exit, which once opened like a city gate, immediately sealed again, tightly shut.
The events of today offered her a wealth of information that required time for her to digest.
The immediate thought was: Since both Gu Huangzi and Song Yan needed to flee, it signaled dire circumstances. With the location of the ancient teleportation array now known, she naturally needed to follow the map to repair that array.
However, repairing an ancient array is no simple task. The materials required might have to be gathered from various places and acquired by any means necessary.
She must act quickly to avoid delay.
Yet, this Luoxia Bamboo Island still required someone who could at least maintain the array’s operation, disguised as her. The first reason was to continue borrowing the prestige of the "Water Uncle Sword Emperor"; the second was to conceal her departure from others.
Alas, in the lineage of the Sect Leader, she was the only one, leaving her no choice but to find another to pass on the array techniques.
"The array is not transmitted to others" was the strict rule her father set when teaching her the array techniques. However, under such special circumstances, special measures had to be taken.
’I’m sorry, Father.’
Yu Xuanwei turned around and softly apologized towards the distant hall at the end of the island, ’Your daughter has no choice but to find someone else to teach the array techniques, and then go seek the origin of my Nanwu Sword Sect.’
Having silently conveyed her thoughts, she slightly raised her head and murmured: ’Forgive me, Ancestor...’
’You set the rule for the Yu family lineage, forbidding the repair or search for that ancient array.
Yet, for generations, the Yu family has extensively studied Array Dao, all for this very day.
Now that there is no retreat, after a thousand years, the younger generation must take the plunge.’
’To open the door leading to the ancestral land of our Sword Sect!’
’Even if danger lies ahead, if one can glimpse a higher Sword Dao because of it, then... it is all worth it!’
Though Yu Xuanwei devoted herself to Array Dao, she was still a sword cultivator, having grown up steeped in the atmosphere of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Her heart was at ease, unburdened by guilt, pursuing a higher Sword Dao was nearly ingrained in every bone of a sword cultivator.
...
...
’An egg that takes hundreds of years to hatch.’
’Even if born a thousand years ago, its blood remains active, never having decayed or lost its effect.’
Song Yan’s Adam’s apple bobbed as he took a deep breath.
He was a man acutely sensitive to information.
Just this one bottle of "Nightmare Beast Blood" informed him that the ancient teleportation array’s destination was far from a pure land; it was a "world where time is stretched."
Simply put, it’s highly possible that "the changes between a thousand years ago and now are not significant," if an egg takes centuries to hatch, then who knows how long this Nightmare Beast can live?
Human cultivators entering the Crimson Palace typically have a lifespan of just two hundred years, yet this Nightmare Beast seemingly possessed a lifespan surpassing that of the cultivators of the Crimson Palace.
This was merely a demon brought here by the Sect Leader of the Southern Wu Sword Sect.
And what of the others?
What about the others?
The worst possible outcome is that the teleportation array’s destination is already "an advanced battlefield of demons and human race," with the first Sect Leader of the Southern Wu Sword Sect fleeing from there in haste, and then destroying the teleportation array to prevent demons from pursuing.
Of course, there may also be a favorable outcome, such as... the flight was merely a personal decision by the first Sect Leader of the Southern Wu Sword Sect, who stole a cultivation technique from the sect or something along those lines, and then got targeted by demons during his flight.
Possibilities like these, which Song Yan could easily think of dozens, were meaningless, yet they doused him with a cold bucket of water. It made him feel that "unless absolutely necessary, he did not want to risk his life by jumping into that ancient teleportation array and being sent to an unknown world."
As he pondered, suddenly two figures flew from afar.
Song Yan directly spread out his divine sense to scan them.
Those two figures—one tall and one short.
The tall one was a blood corpse with gleaming white fur all over, and looking at the face, Song Yan found it vaguely familiar, perhaps the grandfather of Gu Rufeng, the acting Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak—Gu Tianyang.
The short one was an old hag resembling a dwarf.
Clearly, this was a demon cultivator from Blood Corpse Peak. Judging by the manner in which she manipulated the white-furred blood corpse, her position at Blood Corpse Peak was surely significant.
The dwarf old hag stopped from afar, cautiously extending her divine sense as well.
"Song Yan!"
The dwarf old hag was overjoyed, her heavily freckled old face spread into a smile full of wrinkles. With a flip of her palm, she quickly grasped a dirt-yellow banner from the void. She grinned sinisterly, seemingly believing that Song Yan was already a fish in the barrel, a prisoner at her disposal.
However, puzzled by the sight of Song Yan, who not only did not flee at the sight of her but also displayed a look of delight himself.
Then, the old hag saw Song Yan retrieve an exceedingly familiar bracelet from the void.
That...
Was the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet!
The dwarf old hag almost doubted her own eyes, but how could she be mistaken? She immediately fell silent and glanced at her own left wrist, where the Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet encircled, her limbs stiffening slightly. It was thanks to this Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet that her divine soul could be nourished, allowing some extension of her life, and enabling her to act as a confidant of the Sect Leader in their most secret escape plan.
Yet, the Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet is merely a slave bracelet, while the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet is the master bracelet.
How was that master bracelet in Song Yan’s possession?
Song Yan gave it another wave.
The dwarf old hag: ...
Song Yan put away the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" and beckoned from afar.
The dwarf old hag was dumbfounded but still swiftly put away the banner.
Whether it was truly the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, she could still discern.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 111. The Peak Master Becomes a Slave, Breakthrough to Middle Stage (4.4K Words - Seeking Subscriptions)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: 111. The Peak Master Becomes a Slave, Breakthrough to Middle Stage (4.4K Words - Seeking Subscriptions)_2
Swoosh swoosh!
The dwarf old woman flew swiftly towards Song Yan with the white-haired blood corpse, looking at him with a cackling, eerie laugh and asked, "That bracelet, old lady couldn’t see clearly, could you let me take another look."
Song Yan didn’t bother with her chatter and directly said, "Gu Huangzi is already dead. If I weren’t afraid of you blowing your cover, I would have made you my ghost servant right now!"
With that, he slightly raised his left hand, and large clusters of multicolored tiger stripes appeared on his arm, a few strands extending toward the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, heading straight for the old woman’s divine soul.
The dwarf old woman instantly felt the danger, but she didn’t move, staring directly at Song Yan’s hand. Despite having gone through many things, today she was truly shocked, making her feel like a greenhorn, dumbfoundedly saying, "Gu... Gu Huangzi... is dead?"
Then she murmured, "Impossible, how could Gu Huangzi be dead? Such a terrifying person, such a powerful person, how could he die?"
Song Yan raised his head, looking proud and coldly snorted, "If he weren’t dead, how could I come to power?"
With that, he looked down at the dwarf old woman and said, "Old hag. Submit or die, choose one."
These words instantly awakened the dwarf old woman’s memories from a hundred years ago, recalling the scene when Gu Huangzi came to power.
She seemed like a veteran minister witnessing the sect’s change of succession.
A hundred years ago, Gu Huangzi’s rise already shocked her, and she had been obedient since then, not daring to act recklessly.
A hundred years later, Gu Huangzi, who she regarded as an insurmountable heart demon, had trodden the previous sect leader’s path.
Gu Huangzi betrayed his master and ancestors, only to be betrayed in turn.
And there was no doubt that the one who killed Gu Huangzi had already surpassed him in both power and temperament.
The dwarf old woman began to tremble, then knelt in mid-air and submissively said, "Blood Cliff, greets... Sect Leader Song."
Song Yan was slightly stunned.
He hadn’t heard the name "Blood Cliff," but he knew the Peak Master of Blood Corpse Peak had always been called "Blood Granny."
And the person in front of him was probably the Peak Master of Blood Corpse Peak.
He couldn’t help but sigh inwardly: Gu Huangzi really left him a considerable inheritance.
Previously, when Gu Huangzi said he was a "qualified Puppet Sect Leader," he didn’t take it seriously, only thinking of using the two people in the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet to control the Puppet Sect to some extent.
But he never expected that one of the people in the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet would be a Peak Master.
And controlling this Peak Master had taken Gu Huangzi quite some effort; at least the Yin Qi in the prison she and that Paperman Peak Senior Brother were in was significantly stronger than before.
Now, under his control, he could drive the disguised tiger stripes with just a thought to turn the two into ghost servants.
Basically, "Anyone who enters the bracelet becomes his servant."
Song Yan gestured, and the two corpses and a person landed on a sandy beach no more than several feet away; with a wave of his hand, he spread the four Array Flags of the "Traceless Array" to mask their presence, then asked, "So, what is the current situation at Puppet Sect?"
Blood Granny adjusted her mindset quickly.
First of all, the existence of Song Yan, who could replace Gu Huangzi, made her immeasurably wary; second, she was discerning, knowing the combination of the Tiger Ghost King with the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet left her no chance of rebound; third, she also had some expectations, thinking that following such a mysterious new Sect Leader might bring an unforeseen future.
Therefore, she cooperated extremely well, narrating the situation eloquently.
After a brief explanation, Song Yan roughly grasped the current situation of the Puppet Sect.
The situation was simple:
Internal affairs were autonomous but controlled by the Fox and Wolf Races.
Ghost Cultivators were the same.
A total of four came from the Fox and Wolf Races.
Blood Granny knew little about the strength of these four, but she knew Gu Huangzi once fought one of them but suffered greatly and willingly submitted afterward.
As for the process, no one saw it, because in fact, the "Nine Palace Blood of the Crimson Palace Realm" was a hidden trump card; when face down, it was terrifying, but once uncovered and exposed, it might not be so scary.
This is somewhat reminiscent of the martial arts novels Song Yan read before his transmigration, where no matter how powerful the techniques were, once exposed, others would find the flaws, then counter and eventually... the old gods fall, and a new god rises. Thus, people of the Jianghu always deeply hid their techniques, fearing others would see them.
Nine Palace Blood, nine types of blood.
Although only three types determine the Central Palace, the remaining six also produce many variations, making each existence in the Crimson Palace Realm possibly have unexpected killer moves.
Given this, who would willingly let others see their secrets?
Not to mention, if it were known that Gu Huangzi was hiding his true form as a "withered essence blood, skin and bones" concealed within a passageway paperman, his mystery would reduce by at least twenty percent.
As for this plan, it was almost as Song Yan had finally predicted.
Puppet Sect was controlled by the Fox and Wolf Races, and Gu Huangzi felt uneasy, hence setting up the "Battle of Konglan Mountain," inviting experts from Nanwu Sword Sect to stall the Fox and Wolf Races, while he feigned "attacking Nanwu Sword Sect, seeking Song Yan" to come to Nanwu Sword Sect and then take the opportunity to kidnap Yu Xuanwei and escape.
"Sect Leader, there should only be two waiting at Konglan Mountain, Gu... Gu Huangzi said there might be two Supervisors following us.
So, this escape plan, only he and I knew, and everyone else was kept in the dark."
Blood Granny explained in full detail.
Song Yan nodded, then took out his original "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet" from the storage space and threw it out, then said, "You should be the second most powerful under Gu Huangzi, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 111. The Peak Master Becomes a Slave, Breakthrough to Middle Stage (4.4K Words - Seeking Subscriptions)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: 111. The Peak Master Becomes a Slave, Breakthrough to Middle Stage (4.4K Words - Seeking Subscriptions)_3
Blood Elder wiped her sweat and said, "Now, below you..."
Song Yan said indifferently, "This bracelet is quite good at nurturing the Divine Soul. See which Peak Master from Mechanical Peak or Bizarre Poison Peak is suitable to wear it, and grant it to them."
Blood Elder respectfully received the bracelet and replied, "Yes."
She understood that Sect Leader Song intended to thoroughly control the Puppet Sect.
In fact, in the eyes of the high-level members of the Puppet Sect, the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" was almost equivalent to the "Sect Leader’s Token."
Putting away the "Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelet," Blood Elder respectfully asked, "How should we deal with the Fox and Wolf Races over there?"
"No rush," Song Yan replied calmly, "I have already cast a stone to ask for directions; there might be a turning point. Let’s wait and see.
For now, you should return first, rally the Puppet Sect’s army, and try to minimize casualties. The Elders should have returned already.
As for Gu Huangzi’s death news, it will soon be exposed, but it must not be leaked by you..."
Blood Elder paused for a moment before bowing deeply and said, "This old lady obeys the Sect Leader’s order."
Song Yan withdrew the Array Flag.
Blood Elder turned and quickly flew away with the white-furred blood corpse.
Song Yan glanced at several places, his figure vanished stealthily, heading towards Red Leaf Island.
...
...
Red Leaf Island...
A moment later...
[You successfully absorbed a trace of the "Nightmare Beast’s" blood, simultaneously operating the "Profound Sword Scripture" to absorb the blood using the magic technique within, setting it in the Central Left Palace.]
After proficiently ’dying’ several times, he fully absorbed the "Nightmare Beast" blood.
[You operated the "Profound Sword Scripture," continued to absorb Profound Qi to digest the "Nightmare Beast’s" blood, while simultaneously converting the Profound Qi into Sword Qi, and nurturing the Sword Qi with the blood.]
This is the effect of a high-tier Cultivation Technique; even though it’s the same absorption of Profound Qi and digestion of Essence Blood, it brings many additional benefits.
Since there was the "Profound Sword Scripture," Song Yan naturally no longer needed the previous fragmented "Blood Fusion Technique."
[In the first year, you absorbed 60 strands of Profound Qi, digested one strand of "Nightmare Beast’s" blood, and the Profound Qi completely transformed into Sword Qi...]
[In the fiftieth year, you absorbed 3000 strands of Profound Qi, successfully converted it into Sword Qi, and the "Nightmare Beast’s" blood had already merged into your position within the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, intertwined with the "Changwang Tiger Race" blood.]
[The Sword Qi interacted with the "Nightmare Beast’s" blood, and you comprehended a unique Sword Qi—Soul-Shocking Sword Qi.]
[The Sword Qi is formless; when it hits the opponent, they will experience an uncontrollable fright, as if in a nightmare, and fall into chaos.]
Song Yan recalled that previously, in Cold Pool Valley and the "Candle Land Secret Realm," it took him 100 years to complete the digestion.
But just by changing the location to Red Leaf Island, the time was halved.
If he were on a more advanced island, supplemented by a small Empowerment Jade, elixirs, and some Genius and Earth Treasures, the speed would be several times faster.
He did not have these things, but the top cultivators in various sects did.
However, even with abundant resources, they were still stuck.
No matter how plentiful the resources or how much time they accumulated, "Erysipelas" was enough to block their path to advancement.
After digesting the "Nightmare Beast’s" blood, Song Yan also spent 50 years successfully digesting the "Multi-tailed Fox Race" blood he got from Granny Fox, to settle in the "Second Palace"—the Lower Central Palace.
At the same time, he comprehended a unique Sword Qi—Splitting Sword Qi.
This Sword Qi enabled Song Yan’s Flying Sword to split into three swords while in mid-air.
Of course, the other two were merely shadows of the Flying Sword, but their power was only slightly less than the main sword.
It could be expected that if the number of tails increased, the number of swords would also increase.
And after settling the Second Palace, Song Yan finally broke through to the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace.
The increase in blood made his magic more unpredictable.
The increase in Profound Qi made... his power stronger.
Even with the same magic technique, now, its execution was far superior to before.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 112. The Deceptive Devil’s Heart, Kuye’s Shock (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: 112. The Deceptive Devil’s Heart, Kuye’s Shock (3.8K words - Subscription Requested)
Although the quality of Elder Fox’s essence blood was merely "three-tailed," after Song Yan absorbed it, he quickly gained the inherent talent of the Multi-tailed Fox Race—illusion technique.
Because of the Hundred Forms Demon Body, he swallowed Elder Fox and a Demonic Fox Shadow Puppet, thus obtaining the illusion technique, in addition to the illusion technique he practiced himself.
With the layering of illusion techniques, he now had stronger confidence.
Even facing Elder’s scrutiny, his illusion technique would not be seen through.
This gave him peace of mind.
The reason for choosing the "Multi-tailed Fox Race" essence blood as the critical "Second Crimson Palace Blood" was because it still held the potential for purification, unlike the unique "Nightmare Beast," which did not.
At this moment, he had already digested this battle, even the last one.
"Nightmare Beast Blood," "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet," and previously the "Multi-tailed Fox Race Blood," all significantly boosted his personal power.
Besides, the situation was undergoing subtle changes, at least there was more buffer between him and the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, giving him both time and opportunity to see things more clearly.
In the bamboo hut, Song Yan opened his eyes and looked at the distorted red light on the horizon outside the window, and the ripples generated by energy collisions on the sky.
Everything was slowing down.
With Elder’s joining, the restraining of Blood Granny...
This battle was nearing its end.
Song Yan flipped his palm, pulling out the storage bag left by Sword Master Kuye, cautiously flipping through the notes, folding the two previously read letters again, then carefully checking them, before placing them back towards the end of the last notebook.
Page number, position, angle, all without any discrepancy.
After doing this, he began to sit cross-legged and wait.
At this moment, he felt he had truly turned into Bai Xiuhu, an ordinary Sword Sect disciple with some talent in Sword Dao, yet with a heart as dead as ashes, while Song Yan... was just the identity he discarded outside.
If possible, he wished his peaceful life not to be disrupted by anyone.
Suddenly, it seemed as if Song Yan remembered something, hurriedly got up, and began quickly concocting healing decoctions, like Washing Evil Soup.
He knew how terrifying that Evil Qi thing was. For cultivators not yet in the Crimson Palace Realm, any wound inflicted by the Evil Shadow would cause the ghostly creature within the Evil Qi to try desperately to burrow into the flesh, making the wound impossible to heal.
And the Slaughter Liquid in the seclusion hall of Luoxia Bamboo Island was even more terrifying. In simple terms, Crimson Palace cultivators facing Slaughter Liquid were akin to Refining Profound cultivators facing Evil Qi.
Swish, swish...
Sizzle, sizzle...
Song Yan swiftly brewed the decoctions.
The stove in front of the courtyard flared up, and the medicine cauldron in the backyard burned bright.
Song Yan was busy here and there, picking medicines, cutting them, weighing by pound, calculating the amounts, casually tossing the pill recipe on the table.
He was sweating profusely while the fierce battle in the distance gradually slowed down over time, completely stopping by noon.
...
At the edge of the sky, silhouettes gathered inside and outside the array shield.
They were high above, like two opposing armies across a city wall, seemingly discussing and saying something.
From this distance, Song Yan couldn’t hear a word.
However, he couldn’t care less about that.
Because there was something more urgent, more important that appeared before him, urgently needing his attention.
Many disciples descended from the sky, some covered in blood, some deathly pale, others barely clinging to life.
"Brother Bai, Brother Bai!"
"Brother Bai, over here, over here!"
There were many places in the Misty Sea where ailments could be treated, but this battle was too brutal; elsewhere was already filled to capacity, prompting many disciples to head towards Song Yan.
Song Yan hurriedly ushered the disciples inside, taking out the prepared Washing Evil Soup, healing medicine, and quickly tending to the wounded.
Soon, the previously empty courtyard was filled with temporary beds.
Song Yan checked each one, disregarding the risk to himself, removing the Evil Qi for the injured.
Many sword cultivators had heard the story of this Bai Xiuhu, and witnessing his transformation, they were all filled with emotion, some accompanying companions, others actively helping Song Yan with serving the soup and applying ointments, joining in the healing efforts.
After such a busy ordeal, when slightly coming back to his senses, it was already evening.
Song Yan let out a long sigh, wiped his sweat with his sleeve, looked around, suddenly asking a sword cultivator beside him: "Have you seen Junior Sister Xiaojui?"
That sword cultivator shook his head and then looked around.
A senior Refining Profound sword cultivator then loudly asked: "Has anyone seen Junior Sister Xiaojui?"
Instantly, several people spoke up.
"I saw Xiaojui; she was at the northwest corner on Cyan Moss Island, resisting the Evil Shadows trying to break into the array with other disciples. I remember it was a group of four-eyed undead vultures."
"I remember Junior Sister Xiaojui was injured, scratched on the shoulder, Evil Qi leaking, the wound wouldn’t close, continuously bleeding. I told her to quickly retreat and go for treatment, then... didn’t notice further."
Song Yan glanced at those few people, his gaze quickly landing on a female cultivator who seemed hesitant to speak.
He remembered that female cultivator. It was Junior Sister Xiaojui who brought him to this Red Leaf Island when she was injured.
Song Yan cast his gaze toward her.
The female cultivator understood, looked at Song Yan, silent for a moment, then sorrowfully said: "Junior Sister Xiaojui is already dead. Her body is currently on Cyan Moss Island, being guarded by some disciples, waiting to be dealt with after things end."
A corpse tainted with Evil Qi must be handled promptly; otherwise, if it breeds a ghost cultivator, it would be troublesome.
This point, the Nanwu Sword Sect had long reached a consensus.

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 112. The Deceitful Demon Heart, Kuye’s Shock (3.8K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: 112. The Deceitful Demon Heart, Kuye’s Shock (3.8K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
Cremation is the fate of every disciple.
Song Yan was taken aback, he thought the little girl would get hurt again, come to this bamboo hut again, and he would treat her again.
When he hadn’t seen her for a long time, he thought that the reason she hadn’t come was because she was afraid of the awkwardness of meeting him, so she went elsewhere for treatment.
Beside him, the Sword Cultivator felt something, and patted Song Yan’s shoulder, saying in a deep voice: "Junior Brother Bai, Junior Sister Xiaojiu is a true Sword Cultivator, don’t be sad."
Song Yan looked at this Sword Cultivator, then at the crowd, and suddenly clasped his hands, saying: "Everyone, please help guard this place. If any brothers come later, please treat them with Washing Evil Soup and Healing Medicine. I’m going to Cyan Moss Island."
"Go ahead, Brother Bai."
"Junior Brother Bai, don’t be too sad. Everyone dies, and dying on the battlefield, dying in slaying demons and evils, is truly a fortunate thing."
Song Yan clasped his hands again, then took out a Flying Sword, controlled the sword to transform into a rainbow, and quickly flew into the distance.
Soon, he saw a circular island, quickly descended, hurriedly searched, and was quickly led by guarding disciples to a coffin.
The coffin was sealed, to prevent Evil Qi from leaking out.
Song Yan opened the lid, Evil Qi surged out, impacting his Protective Profound Qi, making a sizzling corrosion sound.
"Brother Bai, my condolences." said the guarding disciple.
Song Yan said: "Can I spend some time alone with Junior Sister Xiaojiu?"
After speaking, he added: "Don’t worry, I won’t let the Evil Qi escape."
The guarding disciple nodded and walked away.
When the surroundings were quiet, Song Yan looked at the little girl lying quietly in the coffin.
Her small body finally came to rest, the scars on her face still lingered, and there was a deep hole over her heart, pierced by the beak of a demonic bird, from which Evil Qi was continuously seeping out.
"I told you to guard the bamboo hut, but you didn’t listen."
"Why were you in such a hurry to die?"
"Such a stubborn... silly girl..."
Song Yan bowed his head slightly.
At this moment, he didn’t know what he was thinking, only felt his eyes strangely warm.
Perhaps, these were crocodile tears.
He turned his head to look at the guarding disciple, and asked: "When will these bodies be cremated?"
The disciple shook his head, but also said: "In the next two or three days, perhaps.
If there are friends or relatives to retrieve the bodies, they will. If not, the sect will arrange a Feng Shui Treasure Land for them to be properly buried."
Song Yan said: "Can I retrieve Junior Sister Xiaojiu’s body? I wish to bury her."
The disciple asked: "Brother Bai, what is your relationship with Junior Sister Xiaojiu?"
Song Yan said: "Friends."
The disciple was taken aback, and said: "Then please register, Brother Bai."
Song Yan nodded, moments later, he was carrying the coffin into the distance, eventually landing on a deserted island in Misty Sea.
At this time, the sun was setting, the water shimmering like rose-colored fish scales, exuding sadness.
He chose a scenic high ground, dug out a grave, placed the coffin inside, then opened the lid, gently stroked Junior Sister Xiaojiu’s forehead.
A mysterious tiger pattern appeared, lightly grasped inside, pulling out a Divine Soul.
The Divine Soul seemed shocked and surprised to see Brother Bai, as if meeting for the first time, but immediately it merged with the tiger pattern, becoming a ghost.
A body’s Divine Soul remains for seven days, even if not an ironclad rule, it’s beyond the escape by a Cultivator at the Refining Profound Level.
Having obtained Junior Sister Xiaojiu’s Divine Soul, Song Yan set the body ablaze, then called the wind to send the ashes into a spirit box, placing it into the coffin, burying it in the grave, erecting a tombstone inscribed: "Tomb of Junior Sister Xiaojiu."
...
...
On his way back, Song Yan heard cheers.
"The Grand Elder has returned!"
"Victory!"
"The Grand Elder did not fall into the trap, no matter how the Demon Sect plots."
"Evil cannot overcome righteousness!"
He silently returned to Red Leaf Island.
He remembered that the Fox and Wolf Races might have a "Supervisor" around, things were not over.
...
By the time Song Yan returned to Red Leaf Island, the sky was filled with stars.
The bamboo hut was still busy, Song Yan joined the hustle...
He was busy until the next day.
At dawn, sleeping in exhaustion in the corner of the eaves, Song Yan suddenly heard footsteps approaching, he opened his sleepy eyes, first seeing a pair of blood-stained boots, then a familiar figure, and above...
Was an old man’s face.
"Teacher!"
Song Yan woke up abruptly, hurriedly got up, excitedly approached to give the old man a hug, "Teacher!"
The visitor was indeed the Kuye Sword Master.
Kuye Sword Master looked at him with confusion, and said: "Come with me."
They went to a small grove outside the courtyard, Kuye Sword Master said: "Where is the Storage Bag I gave you?"
Song Yan hurriedly took it from his bosom and handed it over.
Kuye Sword Master sped through it, when seeing two letters nestled intact in the back of the notebook, he paused, then hesitated a bit, and directly took out the first letter from the notebook’s back, handing it out.
Song Yan took it with curiosity and read it carefully.
As he read, his pupils widened, his mouth slightly opened, then he looked at Kuye Sword Master with astonishment.
Kuye Sword Master sighed and said: "Your sword is noble and righteous, even if you’re not of our Sword Sect, you’re a Righteous Dao Cultivator. How could I have other intentions?"
Song Yan sighed: "Teacher, I wish I could admit it, but I’m really not the one who seized the body as you said."
Kuye Sword Master sighed deeply: "Are you really going to force me to question you and expose this?
You took possession, though knowing some recent things about Xiuhu, but when it comes to history, you are completely unaware."
Song Yan scratched his head: "If it’s historical, I... truly might not remember."
Kuye Sword Master said: "Not might not remember, but truly do not know. You might vaguely say something, but cannot do it."
Song Yan said: "Since Teacher does not believe, go ahead and ask.’
Kuye Sword Master said: "Good!"
After speaking, he assumed a serious expression, thought briefly, and then began to inquire about some earlier things of Bai Xiuhu.
How astonishing, the man before him answered fluently, even explaining some things he didn’t know, yet they made total sense given the context.
Kuye Sword Master didn’t believe it was fate and continued asking.
But the more he asked, the more puzzled he became.
Puzzled beyond recovery.
Kuye Sword Master gritted his teeth, muttering "I don’t believe it, I don’t believe it," then he grabbed Song Yan’s collar, agitated, "Tell me, you seized the body, right? You’re a predecessor of our Sword Sect, right? Why won’t you admit it?"
Song Yan smiled bitterly: "Teacher, I’m really not."
Kuye Sword Master released his hold, stepped back, and continued questioning.
The more he questioned, the more he felt he had made an error.
How could a predecessor who seized a body know such ancient matters?
After a while, he sighed, patted Song Yan’s shoulder: "Today, I truly understand the words ’rebirth’, how truthful they are..."
After saying this, he looked at Song Yan with gleaming eyes, and happily patted his shoulder, repeatedly saying: "Good child, good child, I never thought in my lifetime I would meet you again, truly wonderful!"
Song Yan glanced slightly at Junior Sister Xiaojiu in the Divine Soul World "feeling rather distressed for having sided with the tiger as a ghostly slave," then focused on Kuye Sword Master: "Teacher, I’m also very happy you’re back safely."

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Request for Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Request for Subscription)
For Song Yan, today is yet another endless day of busywork.
Whereas Kuye, the Sword Master, suddenly departed in the afternoon.
Before leaving, his face was stern, with a hint of uncontrollable tension flickering in his eyes. Such tension had not been revealed even when he went to attend the Jingzhe battle.
Song Yan immediately understood that the "Supervisor" of the "Fox and Wolf Races" had arrived.
The "stone" thrown to ask for directions was about to fall.
As for what results would come after it falls, he did not need to deliberately pursue them, because the outcome would naturally present itself in front of him.
Getting the information early and making a reaction early may not necessarily be a good thing because your "early step" might just be within someone’s calculations, where they have set up a trap waiting for you to get caught.
So, sometimes "a step late" is the true "early step".
At this moment, Song Yan had actually lost his sense of belonging to the identity of "Song Yan". What he liked and loved was the life of Bai Xiuhu in front of his eyes.
This life was very peaceful, and there was no fickle Stone Seat Elder, deceitful Gu Huangzi, nor the ever-boundary-breaking Susu Junior Sister, and Junior Brother Lu and Junior Brother Shangguan who would try to kill you one moment and flatter you the next...
As for the identity of Puppet Sect Leader, he did not care.
To him, "Sect Leader" was merely a stepping stone to acquiring High Tier Cultivation Techniques and resources.
However, the former he could obtain through other means, and the latter... could be compensated with lifespan.
This was not a necessity for him.
The reason he took control of the Puppet Sect was merely to have a "buffer he could control" between him and the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
Seeing that the day’s busywork had come to an end, Song Yan let out a long breath, standing akimbo at the courtyard entrance while gazing at the sky.
As dusk approached, no matter what was happening in the distance, at least at this moment... the evening glow in the sky was beautiful.
Song Yan greeted the fellow disciples recuperating in the bamboo hut, then performed Sword Control and Rainbow Transformation, swiftly arriving at a small deserted island above the Misty Sea.
A tombstone inscribed with "Little Jiul of Junior Sister" was nestled in the mountain peak’s twilight.
Several white flowers lay before the tombstone, indicating other fellow disciples had visited.
Song Yan slightly perceived the surroundings and found no one.
At least at this moment, the island was empty.
He took a jar of wine from his Storage Bag, sat before the tombstone, released the binding perception of "Changgui Jiul", then leaned back against an ancient evergreen tree, slanting his gaze toward the evening glow outside the sky, which was gradually dimming, deepening, and thickening.
’Master... Master...’
Changgui Jiul called tremulously in the Divine Soul World.
Song Yan responded: ’After so long, have you had the leisure to watch a sunset once?’
Changgui Jiul said, "No."
Song Yan said, "Then accompany me to watch a sunset."
He opened the sealing mud, held the fine wine to his lips, tilted his head and drank a mouthful, the alcohol like flowing fire burning into his organs, then fiercely blazed, incinerating all thoughts, briefly stepping out of joys and sorrows, three thousand worries.
Though the wine was mortal wine, after reading "Hundred Examinations of Profound Grass" and researching "Mortal Fire Refining Technique", he naturally added many ingredients to it, achieving the state that "mortals would surely die if they drank, but he drank it just right".
Song Yan said, "I order you to forget that you’re Changgui, speak and act using the tone and personality you had while alive, is that possible?"
Changgui Jiul sighed lightly.
Song Yanqi said, "Can’t do it?"
Such perverse ability of "Changwang Hu", he had witnessed long before. Once becoming Changgui, no matter how manipulative, chastity, or attitude one had in life, it would all be altered, becoming towards him, unable to defy any of his commands.
Changgui Jiul said, "Can do it, just afraid of angering Master."
Song Yan said, "I won’t be angry, say what you think, curse if you must, speak if you must."
Changgui Jiul took a deep breath and then was ready.
Song Yan drank another sip of wine, the evening breeze from the mountains and waters blowing, brushing his temple hair on both sides, showing a bit of the free and unrestrained knightly manner.
This scene fell into Junior Sister Jiul’s eyes, she coldly said, "Everyone has been deceived by your appearance! So was I! If I knew earlier you were a Great Demon, I would have fought desperately to tell Elder! Even if caught by you, skinning me, I would go!"
Song Yan was stunned for a moment, feeling secretly amused.
Switching to Fox Grandma, it was impossible to follow such a command from him.
Only silly Junior Sister Jiul was so honest, even after becoming a ghost.
He thought about it and said, "Born in Jianghu, life is beyond one’s control, I was captured by the Puppet Sect, forced to follow the current to survive."
"You are?"
"Song Yan."
"Song Yan? Song... Song Demon?!"
"Am I very famous?"
"Song Demon! You’ve driven us mad, you used Elder Su to blood battle with Fox Grandma, yet profited like a fisherman.
Later, everyone was searching for you but couldn’t find you at all.
I heard Uncle saying inadvertently that you might have taken a tremendous treasure, and that treasure could bring calamity to the entire Three Kingdoms.
Yet you ignored it, selfish, just like Gu Huangzi, a demon!
I just said, how could coward Bai Xiuhu be so powerful, turns out you were the Great Demon!"
Song Yan was silent for a while, patiently explained again, such as how he actually didn’t exploit the Fox Stabbing Alliance but helped it with all his might, his digestion of "Changwang Tiger Blood" was helpless, like an arrow on the string.
However, each explanation from him would make Junior Sister Jiul raise various astonished questions.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Please Subscribe)_2
Slowly, he understood.
Some truths are destined never to become answers.
He took another sip of wine and said, "Now... I’m giving you two choices.
First, follow me and see the world with me, gain more knowledge, and then talk with me about these matters. If there is a chance in the future, I will help you possess another. Although possessing at the Refining Profound Level is impossible, I promise that if there’s hope, I will help you with all my might."
Before he finished speaking, Junior Sister Jiu already said, "I will never possess another!"
Song Yanqi said, "Why? Maybe I’m just helping you possess someone who is about to die, or even... someone newly deceased."
Junior Sister Jiu said, "I don’t want to, no matter what!"
Song Yan said, "But you haven’t heard the second choice yet."
Junior Sister Jiu said, "Can I... can I refuse?"
Song Yan said gently, "I told you, you need to forget that you are a vengeful spirit and judge using the attitude you had when you were alive."
Junior Sister Jiu nodded.
Song Yan said, "Second, listen to you; whatever you say you want to do, I will help you."
Junior Sister Jiu was stunned for a moment, then quietly fell silent.
Song Yan continued sipping his drink.
Junior Sister Jiu glanced over at the tombstone beside her and suddenly said softly, "In my mind, Senior Brother Bai was a very scummy, useless person, but the Senior Brother Bai I met in the last moments of my life was a good person.
Bai... Senior Brother Bai, I actually still have some unfulfilled wishes, can you help me with them? Once these wishes are fulfilled, I will have no regrets."
Song Yan put down the wine jar.
Junior Sister Jiu hastily said, "It’s okay if you can’t, I will listen to the master."
Song Yan said in a muffled voice, "Of course! Who says it can’t be done?"
...
...
When Song Yan returned to Red Leaf Island, he found the array shield seemed to have been lifted.
Apparently, some sort of agreement had been reached, allowing the Nanwu Sword Sect to safely dismantle the array for the time being.
But what the agreement was, Song Yan did not know.
Although he didn’t know, he understood one thing: the visitors from the Fox and Wolf Races learned through Yu Xuanwei’s Memory Jade that Song Yan had already absorbed the Changwang Tiger Race’s Essence Blood, and they were completely stunned. They couldn’t give a subsequent response, so they left some blank time to discuss, or wait for instructions from the clan.
This point, not only the Fox and Wolf Races were dumbfounded, but even the Nanwu Sword Sect and the Puppet Sect were dumbfounded.
Anyone could guess with just their toes how terrifying the erysipelas from Changwang Tiger Blood was.
To absorb it is simply mind-boggling.
By now, Song Yan also understood that the "behind-the-scenes significance" of the Changwang Tiger Race’s Essence Blood had far surpassed the "surface power" of the essence blood. This thing must be entangled with something extremely important, because there’s only one of its kind left, which is why so many Great Demons are pursuing it.
Now...
His original single-minded desire to reach the other side of the teleportation array has somewhat waned; at least he doesn’t want to transport over until the very last moment.
Moreover, the enhancement of his Illusion Technique has endowed him with the possibility of living a "completely new life".
Early the next morning, Song Yan bid farewell to Elder Kuye, then left the Nanwu Sword Sect.
...
...
Several days later...
Song Yan picked a bouquet of the finest flowers on the mountaintop and placed it before the window of an old woman from the Wang Family in Jianshui Capital. The old woman was blind, but could smell the fragrance of the flowers, and then fumbled to get up, calling Little Jiu’s name.
Song Yan picked up the conversation, claiming to be Junior Sister Jiu’s senior brother. Then he chatted a lot with the old woman about daily life, explaining that Junior Sister Jiu didn’t come because she was valued in the sect and needed to practice swordsmanship diligently, then go to distant places to slay demons. In the future, she will be too busy to visit.
The old woman was stunned; she didn’t even know that Junior Sister Jiu was a cultivator. When she heard this, she just spread her toothless mouth and smiled, saying, "You must take good care of Little Jiu, she’s a good girl."
Song Yan smiled and said, "Certainly."
Then, he left behind an elixir for bodily nourishment and turned to leave.
...
...
By evening, Song Yan appeared again at a mortal gang in the suburbs of Jianshui Capital. After introducing himself as Little Jiu’s senior brother, a few children came running out, asking non-stop about "Sister Little Jiu".
Song Yan repeated to them the same story he had told the old woman, then made arrangements for each child, and later pulled aside a little girl.
He looked at this little girl.
This little girl’s brows and eyes bore some resemblance to Junior Sister Jiu.
According to Junior Sister Jiu, this was her niece, Tian Xiaoling.
Her parents were both people of Jianghu, but died tragically while resisting the Puppet Sect’s invasion, and before dying... her aunt entrusted the daughter to her.
