And because she had to run around, before leaving, she left her little niece in the care of an acquaintance in the sect.
Tian Xiaoling had a Profound Root and knew her parents died fighting evil people.
Junior Sister Jiu had originally planned, after the incident was over, to bring her into the Sword Sect, but... because she perished, this original agreement could never be fulfilled.
Originally, Tian Xiaoling would have spent her days in anticipation until one day she inadvertently learned that her aunt was already dead, and she would finally give up and cry bitterly.
But Song Yan’s appearance changed all this.
Tian Xiaoling was a thin little girl with two topknots, perhaps because her parents died young, she was very serious and mature. From a young age, she understood boundaries and would never ask or say anything she shouldn’t. She followed quietly behind Song Yan all the way.
When they arrived at Observing Mist Island, Song Yan descended and led her to a bamboo house, where he spoke to a female cultivator inside, "Junior Sister, this little girl is Little Jiu’s niece, and she has a Profound Root."

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: 113. Song Yan and Xiao Jiu (4.6K words - Please Subscribe)_3
The female cultivator recognized Song Yan and hurriedly said, "Senior Brother Bai, hand her over to me. The test will take a month, and if she truly has talent, she will be sent to Red Leaf Island where Senior Brother resides for cultivation."
Song Yan nodded, then turned to look at the little girl, saying, "Focus on cultivation, perform well, and don’t bring shame to your aunt!"
Tian Xiaoling bit her lip and stubbornly raised her head, mimicking an adult as she asked, "Uncle, where is my aunt?"
Song Yan looked into her eyes and said word by word, "She died in battle."
Tian Xiaoling’s eyes visibly reddened, tears welling up.
Song Yan glanced at the female cultivator.
The female cultivator said, "Senior Brother, leave her to me."
Song Yan patted Tian Xiaoling’s shoulder, then prepared to leave using Sword Control.
But suddenly, he paused as several figures landed on the other side of Observing Mist Island.
The leading woman was dressed in brocade, with a dignified appearance that showed some friendliness, and her almond-shaped eyes were filled with composure and grace.
In the Nanwu Sword Sect, only high-ranking members could dress freely without being constrained by the Silver Sword Robe.
When the woman saw Song Yan, she nodded slightly and smiled, "I’ve long heard of Kuye Sword Master’s adept disciple achieving Sword Enlightenment, full of righteous spirit. Today, upon seeing, indeed extraordinary."
Song Yan came to his senses, slightly bowed, and replied, "Xiuhu greets Miss Seven."
The visitor was none other than Su Yao.
After a long absence, she had completely transformed into a form unfamiliar to Song Yan.
The initial heroism, then the killing intent, later the chill, all faded... Finally conforming to the temperament fitting her identity as the eldest lady.
Song Yan knew the Su Family had suffered great losses; now Su Yao seemed to have finally made changes, ready to slowly shoulder the family responsibilities, hence her actions and words already showed some signs of "elder-like demeanor."
His gaze involuntarily shifted to the female cultivator behind Su Yao.
He immediately recognized the female cultivator as Cao Yuzhuang.
However, upon seeing strangers, Cao Yuzhuang nervously shrank back behind Su Yao.
Su Yao smiled faintly, saying, "Pardon us, friend. Yuzhuang fell into the Demon Sect in the past, suffering greatly, and has not yet recovered."
Song Yan continued to look.
Yet, as his gaze lingered a moment longer, Cao Yuzhuang suddenly pressed her five fingers onto the long sword at her waist, and her eyes glared at him fiercely.
Su Yao frowned, saying, "Yuzhuang!"
Only then did Cao Yuzhuang release her grip.
Su Yao sighed again, saying, "This involves past events. Yuzhuang becomes extremely fearful at the thought, so she holds a hatred towards men, not just singling out friend."
Song Yan:...
He realized he had been too naïve.
He thought he had offered small kindness to settle a woman, yet hadn’t considered how much suffering and nightmares she had endured.
He nodded slightly, smiling, "Miss Seven, it’s no concern. I came today to bring a friend’s descendent for a talent test, and so... I shall take my leave."
Su Yao smiled, saying, "Take care, friend."
Song Yan clasped his fist again, left using Sword Control, and landed back on the isolated island where Junior Sister Xiaojiu was buried.
...
Another day at dusk, the sky was filled with sunset glow.
In sight, the Misty Sea shimmered like scales, radiating a cold red.
"Any last wishes?" Song Yan asked.
"None now," Junior Sister Xiaojiu said, then softly added, "I have no regrets anymore."
Song Yan thought for a moment, then suddenly asked, "That day, you said you’re not pretty, you ruined your looks, was it because... at that time you had already fallen for me?"
Junior Sister Xiaojiu was silent for a long time, then candidly replied, "It was Senior Brother Bai that I was drawn to, but if it were Song Yan, I wouldn’t have."
She then said, "Alright, now Master can make me work like a beast, no matter what I’m asked to do, I won’t be unhappy at all."
Song Yan said, "What if I let you decide for yourself instead?"
Junior Sister Xiaojiu thought for a moment and said, "After watching the sunset, then leave this world."
Song Yan stood on the cliff edge, silently watching the distance until the sunset completely disappeared, the sky turned completely dark, and he lightly held, releasing a wisp of Divine Soul with a pattern of a tiger.
"Goodbye, Senior Brother Bai, the sunset is truly beautiful."
"Goodbye."
The tiger pattern released.
"Thank you... Senior Brother Bai."
Junior Sister Xiaojiu’s Divine Soul lost its confinement, whispered the final words, then drifted towards the high sky, soon disappearing.
Until her death, she never thanked "Song Yan."
However, Song Yan didn’t mind, because now he was Bai Xiuhu.
Moreover, this Bai Xiuhu’s "Righteous Points" were acknowledged by Junior Sister Xiaojiu.
This signifies he has already become a seasoned and true Sword Cultivator through various trials.
Junior Sister Xiaojiu’s gratitude towards Senior Brother Bai is gratitude towards Song Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 114. Turning the Guest into the Host (3.0K words - Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: 114. Turning the Guest into the Host (3.0K words - Please Subscribe)
Luoxia Bamboo Island...
Under the moonlight, the lake waves surged, crashing against the rocky shore, and in a bamboo house originally meant for Yu Xuanwei, many senior members of the Nanwu Sword Sect were gathered.
The Grand Elder was present, even Sword Master Kuye and Meng Popo were there.
The candlelight flickered, illuminating not only the solemn and serious faces of the senior members but also the list of elite seeds on the table.
This list was originally prepared for the younger elite members of the sect to retreat with Yu Xuanwei in the event of failure at the "Jingzhe Battle".
These people were also the hope for the revival of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
The Grand Elder looked at Yu Xuanwei sternly and asked, "Did you really see Song Yan annihilate Gu Huangzi with your own eyes?"
Yu Xuanwei nodded, then tried to describe the scene at that time, but soon found it extremely difficult.
Because the confrontation between Song Yan and Gu Huangzi ended in a very short time, the intricacies of the process she did not fully understand.
After hearing the description, everyone became even more serious.
An Elder sighed, "That demon Song is cunning and deceitful, incredibly terrifying. Nowadays, he should be considered the greatest cultivator of our Three Kingdoms, and no one can oppose him."
The Grand Elder said, "But Song the demon differs from Gu Huangzi. He is both righteous and evil, with unpredictable intentions. For example, during this Jingzhe Konglan Mountain battle, had it not been for his warning, we would have already been destroyed.
Furthermore, Xuanwei, if it weren’t for his timely reminder for you to use the Memory Jade, it would have been difficult against the monsters of the Fox and Wolf races."
Yu Xuanwei said, "Grand Elder, I observed that although Song Yan’s magic was terrifying, it vaguely had some shadows of our Sword Sect. Is it possible he’s a predecessor of our Sword Sect, who took over someone and cultivated anew?"
The Grand Elder asked, "What shadows?"
Yu Xuanwei immediately described the "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" scene she witnessed.
The Grand Elder pondered for a moment and said, "Not necessarily, such a terrifying secret technique that blends righteousness and evil, even though it’s using a sword, it might not necessarily be from our Sword Sect. It could be something Song the demon obtained from elsewhere or... learned before taking over."
Yu Xuanwei nodded.
The Grand Elder looked around and said in a deep voice, "Now that Gu Huangzi is dead and the Fox and Wolf races have temporarily retreated, our Sword Sect must prepare early.
Xuanwei and I have discussed it; she hopes to secretly instruct someone in array techniques, so that person can disguise as her and maintain the array on this island, while she goes to secretly repair the ancient teleportation array.
This matter is extremely important and cannot be undertaken by a disciple, only among those present...
Is there anyone willing to volunteer?"
When the words fell, everyone looked around.
The male cultivators all looked at the female cultivators, skipping over elders like Meng Popo, and finally settled on a young female cultivator with a similar build to Yu Xuanwei.
This female cultivator, having just broken through to the Crimson Palace Realm, appeared quite young.
The Grand Elder asked, "Sun Yuanqin, are you willing to do this?"
The female cultivator said, "I am willing."
As soon as she finished speaking, a man not far away snorted.
The Grand Elder looked up and asked, "Su family’s second, what opinion do you have?"
The man, with a face full of resentment, said angrily, "Sun Family, Sun Family, always the Sun Family, why don’t we, the Su Family, just merge into your Sun Family."
The Grand Elder was taken aback.
The surrounding air fell silent.
The man said, "Ever since my older brother died in the Puppet Sect battle and my ancestor died in the Imperial Capital war, haven’t your Sun Family bullied us enough?"
The Grand Elder sighed deeply, "Yingren, why be so distant?"
This man was indeed Su family’s second—Su Yingren, who had just broken through to the middle stage of the Crimson Palace.
Su Yingren said, "The Library Pavilion matter, how do you explain?"
The Grand Elder said, "There are many Demon Sect spies, placing them with the Sun family here is considered safe."
Su Yingren laughed mockingly, "It is safe, then all new entry-level disciples become your Sun family’s pupils? It won’t be long before my Su family has no successors or students."
The Grand Elder fell silent, raised his hand, and pinched his brow, saying, "You’re right, it was my oversight."
Su Yingren was stunned for a moment, then said, "Then Grand Elder, what do you think should be done?"
The Grand Elder thought for a moment and said, "Our Sun and Su families should not be divided."
Su Yingren said, "How is it not divided?"
The Grand Elder grabbed the list of "elite seed disciples," glanced over it, and said, "In the next thirty years, if there are new disciples entering, seventy percent will be allocated to your Su family’s side, and thirty percent to the Sun family, regardless of talent, by drawing lots.
Moreover, many of the disciples on this elite list do not have Dao partners, so... why not select Sun family’s elite students from among them and let them seek Dao partners from your Su family.
And vice versa.
This is also a form of integration.
These disciples are the hope for the future of our Sword Sect, and should be trained wholeheartedly. In the event of any changes, the retreat plan remains as usual.
So, no matter how the outside situation changes, we must not become disorganized.
Firstly, ensure Xuanwei secretly repairs the ancient teleportation array;
Secondly, cultivate these disciples well.
Does anyone have any opinions?"
Everyone discussed for a while and settled on some details, then went to implement them accordingly.
...
...
Moments later...
Swoosh~
Swoosh~
Two sword rainbows flew side by side.
Meng Popo looked at Sword Master Kuye and said, "The matter regarding the Embroidery Tiger, it seems you were overthinking it. Recently, I’ve quietly investigated what he has been doing."
Sword Master Kuye curiously asked, "What did he do?"
Granny Meng said, "Bury Tian Xiaojiu, go to Jianshui Capital to accompany the old man, and even took Tian Xiaojiu’s niece and escorted her to the sect. Such a person, no matter how you look at it, is definitely not the kind of person who would engage in soul snatching."
Swordsman Kuye sighed, "That would indeed be a rare sword genius, I was wrong back then."
Granny Meng said, "In that case, you need to talk to him, the merger of the Sun and Su families is an important plan in the sect, and he is a key member among the elites, he must not be missing."
Swordsman Kuye nodded, "I’ll talk to him tomorrow morning."
...
...
Midnight.
Song Yan was half-asleep when suddenly eerie wolf howls echoed over the Misty Sea.
The wolf howls were extremely penetrating, even drifting over the vast lake, they still gave him a slight throbbing feeling in his blood.
He felt his blood was throbbing, let alone others who would be scared out of their wits.
’Scared out of their wits?’
Song Yan suddenly narrowed his eyes.
In fact, he had heard Granny Fox describe it before, knowing that the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race had the ability to induce fear through sound waves.
Besides that, the Fox and Wolf Races had a very apparent tendency to collect "fear-related treasures."
No matter how you guard against it, how prepared you are, they will always find a way to make you feel fear.
The Fox and Wolf Races are simply a perfect match.
When these two join forces, their lethality is quite terrifying.
While thinking about it, a strange hoarse voice suddenly came through the air.
"All cultivators of the Sword Sect listen up..."
"Although we have come from the north, we mean to be friendly to humans and have no intention of offending."
"What we seek is only Song Yan."
"So, if any of you dare to hide Song Yan, we promise to make you, as well as those around you, your relatives, and mentors, live in misery beyond death!!"
"On the contrary, if any of you can provide information about Song Yan, you will receive many benefits!!"
Song Yan:...
Well, the demon is not only not stupid, but instead is "cultured."
But this kind of rhetoric is like a powerful enemy pressing, saying to a weak nation, "as long as you do this and that, there will be no trouble," and there will always be fools in the weak nation rushing to be the guides, meeting the demands of the strong enemy, yet not realizing they’re pulling chestnuts out of the fire without removing the firewood.
Weakness is a crime.
Harboring fantasies, hoping for the mercy of powerful foreigners to survive, are all jokes!
As long as Song Yan is around, the demons might still maintain some semblance of order; if he truly gets found out, then the entire Three Kingdoms will become a grand feast.
The voice of the wolf demons had just settled, when the laughing voice of the fox demon resounded again.
"Song Yan, you asked us a question, and we have an answer..."
"Whether you are here or not, listen up."
"Since you have already absorbed the Changwang Tiger Blood, killing you is useless, we need Changwang Tiger Blood, not your life."
"Now, we just want to invite you to take a trip to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, there are plenty of benefits for you!!"
Song Yan was stunned for a moment and looked thoughtful.
He suddenly recalled that when he encountered "Grandmother Chu" in the Candle Land Secret Realm, that "Grandmother Chu" also mentioned that he should visit the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
It looks like...
This unique "Changwang Tiger Blood" is indeed the "key" to something important.
And this also to some extent corroborates the fox demon’s words; it might be true.
The midnight spring breeze, still piercing,
Waves rolling in the heart of the lake, demon voices echoing.
Insects fall silent, shadows cast from the sky, as if a demon shadow is covering the entire Misty Sea.
Song Yan believed these words would soon spread throughout the entire Three Kingdoms.
No matter how he looked at it, he, Song Yan, was utterly passive, all he could do was wait for death, all he could do was risk everything to repair the ancient teleportation array and flee.
But why...
Why couldn’t there be another way?
For instance, quietly annihilating the Fox and Wolf Races.
Firstly, he could purify the Multi-tailed Fox Blood, and collect Corpse-Eating Wolf Blood; secondly, he could strip the demon’s skin and make it into a shadow puppet, enhancing his Hundred Forms Demon Body; thirdly, collect demon souls, transform them into wraiths, aiding him in dominating the Divine Soul World.
Become strong, endlessly strong.
He was no longer the inexperienced kid; his hands had been stained with Fox Granny’s blood, and he had once taken the head of Old Demon Gu Huangzi in a one-on-one fight.
His means of hiding power now not only included the fox demon’s illusion technique but also the "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique."
One thought sword, one thought evil.
Who’s to tell if I am righteous or evil?
Since he still had time, he could very well give it a shot.
In the past, it was impossible, but now...his strength has greatly progressed, and he has even partially taken control of the Puppet Sect, not to mention having Yu Xuanwei help repair the ancient teleportation array.
Either forward or back, he had plans, while his opponents had their hands tied. So why couldn’t he?
In the dark, Song Yan listened to the wolf howls and fox laughs, his eyes cloudy as he reviewed his thoughts several times, then began to coldly laugh with a "keh keh keh".
The Fox and Wolf Races thought this "capture but do not kill order" could isolate him, leaving him without anyone he could trust; little did they know it also exposed the biggest flaw...
Since the fox and wolf were capturing but not killing, why couldn’t he turn the tables?

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)
In the early morning, the wolf howls and fox laughter outside may have ceased, but Song Yan continued to ponder.
He had much to consider, on a chessboard interwoven with various unknowns and deceptions; charging forward with a piece shouting "kill, kill, kill" was undoubtedly the act of a child yet to enter the master level.
Ants have always believed that if there exists an entity capable of easily picking up food as large as a mountain, then they need not be diligent, nor spend effort thinking about how to cooperate to move the food. But the reality is quite the opposite; humans can easily pick up food that ants cannot, yet human thoughts are infinitely more complex than those of ants.
But are humans any different from this themselves?
Some people always assume that a powerful existence means they can abandon thinking, since they can "easily pick up mountain-sized food," what need is there for a brain—power alone suffices.
However, they may overlook one point, which is... strong, there are no fools.
Song Yan could guarantee that if he dared to risk killing a Corpse-Eating Wolf or a Multi-tailed Fox, then... all remaining demons would band together, perhaps even hide, and then, Purple Mansion Realm demons would arrive early.
Demons lining up for you to kill, helping you level up, then conveniently, a higher-level demon comes for you to continue killing—that only happens in fairy tales.
By the moment he cast the stone asking the way and revealed he had successfully digested Changwang Tiger Blood, he undoubtedly turned the situation around, yet did so exposing his cards.
No one understands what kind of ghostly existence Changwang Hu is better than the Fox and Wolf Races once under its dominion.
That implies the domination of the Divine Soul World.
Once killed, immediately captured, turned into a Changwang, for a Tiger’s ghostly servant.
This is a level of power even more terrifying than the Soul-Searching Skill.
Since Gu Huangzi was directly slain by him.
The reasonable inference is that Granny Fox was also killed by him, and turned into a Changwang.
Thus, he possesses knowledge concerning the Fox and Wolf Races.
And clearly, the Fox and Wolf Races would be aware of this.
So...
Song Yan squinted his eyes slightly.
Perhaps he would never see a solitary Multi-tailed Fox, or Corpse-Eating Wolf.
Should he face them, at least one pair, possibly... more.
And the Fox and Wolf Races here must number at least four, and these four should also be analyzing his circumstances while setting up various snares.
He closed his eyes, rubbed his brows in distress, rehearsing every possible outcome.
Then he couldn’t help but sigh softly.
Why does he favor little Sister Xiaojiu, who is without guile?
If everyone in the world were like little Sister Xiaojiu, how wonderful it would be.
He truly wishes the world were composed of good people.
Only a fool would voluntarily go into a snare.
He is a gifted individual, one who can quickly grow stronger with resources.
Being so, why not consider the Fox and Wolf Races as the ultimate feast?
And before that, he will deeply conceal himself. No matter how the Fox and Wolf Races may exhaust themselves, they do their own; Song Yan will absolutely not show himself, nor act rashly in response to any provocation.
He will first gather other Essence Blood as a "side dish."
Once the side dish is ready, then see if there’s a chance to enjoy the main course.
If he can break through directly to the Purple Mansion Realm, then all worries are unnecessary.
As for how to breakthrough to the Purple Mansion Realm, he believes that sects like the Nanwu Sword Sect, which possess significant heritage, must hide notes from predecessors.
When the time comes, if things really go wrong, he’ll escape.
Is there not still the Ancient Teleportation Array?
’Wait, Ancient Teleportation Array...’
Song Yan suddenly thought of something and couldn’t help but show a wry smile.
The matter of the Ancient Teleportation Array and the Sword Sect Leader’s lineage research in repairing it might be rather secret, but with the abilities of the Fox and Wolf Races, they can surely investigate.
Great, he’s identified his own vulnerability.
Just unsure of how the Fox and Wolf Races plan to exploit this weakness.
...
...
During the day, as soon as the sun rose, the senior members of the Sword Sect went to "meet" regarding the Fox and Wolf Races’ declaration last night.
Song Yan didn’t know what kind of meeting it was, he was busy between the bamboo dwelling and the Profound Field.
By noon, he took a slight respite and then took out the "Crimson Palace Pill Research Notes" acquired from Sword-master Kuye, starting to read diligently.
It was spring, the Misty Sea was the location of the Profound Vein, the air fresh, birds on branches chirping incessantly.
Song Yan, holding the notes, leisurely lounged in the old bamboo wicker chair.
The chair creaked and moved with the rustling forest breeze, accompanied by the lake’s moisture, quite comfortable.
"Oh, it’s quite leisurely for the Embroidered Tiger."
Meng Po’s voice came distantly, carrying rare traces of amusement.
Song Yan quickly set down the book, stood up, and looked at the approaching elderly couple not far off, smiling: "Teacher Kuye, Teacher Meng."
Perhaps because of the reconciliation with his loved one and experiencing battles together, Sword-master Kuye’s temperament seemed to slightly change, he too called with a grin: "Embroidered Tiger, come, come."
Song Yan approached, smiling: "Teachers, what good news has you both so pleased?"
Sword-master Kuye exchanged a glance with Meng Po, then Meng Po stepped forward and softly said: "Our Sword Sect, for unity, wishes to merge the Sun and Su families; the elite disciples from the Sun Family need to be paired as Dao Companions with elite disciples from the Su Family, and henceforth count as one family, indistinguishable."
Song Yan was slightly stunned.
Sword-master Kuye remarked unkindly: "Are you still thinking about Xuanwei?"
Song Yan quickly shook his hands, "How would I dare?"

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)_2
Old Lady Meng glared fiercely at Swordmaster Kuye, then kindly said, "Xiuhu, Xuanwei might not be suitable for you.
How about this, there will be a small sword competition for the elite young disciples of the Sword Sect, held on Rain Listening Island behind Observing Mist Island. Whether suitable or not, you can go and see."
Song Yan fell silent.
If it were before, he would have refused outright, because "Dao companions are too burdensome, they are stumbling blocks for escaping, completely unnecessary."
But the circumstances have changed. He inherited Gu Huangzi’s legacy and broke through to the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace; however, the Ancient Teleportation Array over there has become elusive, whether in terms of repair or the destination on the other side, it is not so secure and reliable.
The urgent need now is for him to hide better.
Swordmaster Kuye saw him still silent and said irritably, "Let’s go, let’s go, I’ll take you to meet Xuanwei, and you, Xiuhu, can get to know her well."
Song Yan said helplessly, "Teacher, stop it. I’ll agree, alright?"
Swordmaster Kuye snorted, and said, "You should have agreed earlier."
Then he patted his shoulder and said, "Child, if you have an epiphany, don’t waste your good talent!"
...
...
A few days later...
Rain Listening Island.
Sword Rainbows fell onto the island one by one.
Those who came were all young cultivators whose realm was above the Sixth Layer of Refining Profound but had not yet reached the Crimson Palace, both male and female.
Song Yan’s realm was actually among the lowest here; he had arrived early, secretly lurking to the side, observing the female cultivators descending from the sky.
He had a clear plan for his future.
These plans, projected onto a Dao companion, made him develop clear partner selection criteria.
First, this woman should allow him maximum access to Demon Beast Blood, so he can "pick the general among the dwarfs," selecting blood to fill his Left and Right Two Palaces.
He felt that he might not be so lucky to always encounter the Demon Beast Blood absolutely suitable for him.
The Three Kingdoms are only so big, "Changwang Tiger Blood," "Nightmare Beast Blood," and even "Night Candle Soul Worm Blood" are all unique. If he could obtain them, it was all due to luck.
If he really wanted stronger Demon Beast Blood and stubbornly refused to advance his realm, he would be playing with his life.
Second, this woman should not be trouble-prone, not looking for trouble when there’s none, causing a heap of issues; so her personality should not be too flamboyant.
Third, this woman should preferably be similar to Junior Sister Qi Yao on South Bamboo Peak in the earlier years, or Junior Sister Xiaojiu, a good person with not much of a scheming mind. He naturally had a liking for such women. But towards Miss Su Qi who had grown up, he didn’t feel much.
Of course, if things didn’t go that coincidentally, he would choose a female cultivator skilled in "Mechanical Casting." Because in his Storage Space there was still the Selfless Sword Fragment left at the Ancient Teleportation Array by the first Sect Leader of the Sword Sect, the Golden-Pointed Dagger left by Gu Huangzi, and a pile of unknown pale-gold metal. If he had a female cultivator skilled in "Mechanical Casting" by his side, he could easily access relevant knowledge.
If there wasn’t even a "Mechanical Casting" female cultivator, he would choose a female cultivator skilled in "Talisman." Multi-tailed Foxes and Corpse-Eating Wolves liked to work with "fear." If he had a Dao companion proficient in talismans, he wouldn’t have to worry about Slaughter Talismans or even higher-tier talismans. He could prepare plenty of talismans for any possibly impending war.
While Song Yan was contemplating, quite a few cultivators had already descended from the sky.
Everyone knew why they were here today, but in contrast to the directness of Demon Cultivators, Sword Cultivators appeared rather shy upon landing, with no one taking the lead to greet each other.
Yet, everyone was ultimately from the same sect, and quite a few had fought side by side, so eventually, some female cultivators and male cultivators slowly gathered together, starting to discuss some daily matters, before gradually shifting to discussions on "understanding of the Sword Dao."
However, talking a hundred sentences about understanding the Sword Dao couldn’t compare to trying Sword Control once.
Thus, very soon, the island of Rain Listening was filled with arcs of rainbow light.
Song Yan no longer hid, stepping out from behind the woods, looking around, suddenly spotting a familiar figure not far away.
It was Su Yao.
He hesitated for a moment but did not go over.
Su Yao was a pure Sword Cultivator, even though there had been some changes now, seemingly leaning more toward her family, she didn’t meet any of his criteria for a Dao companion.
Many years ago, he already thought Su Yao was a troublesome woman, and now... his feelings had not changed, only intensified.
If he really chose Su Yao, he couldn’t avoid dealing with the Su Family, essentially aiming to become the "Su Family Ancestor."
How could that be?
Just as he was thinking, a fragrant breeze wafted over from afar, a Sword Rainbow landed by his side, revealing a charming female cultivator.
The female cultivator saluted and said, "Martial Brother Xiuhu, long time no see, I hope you’ve been well."
Song Yan remembered this female cultivator, she was a famous talent from the Sword Sect, also a branch of the Su family, surnamed Su and named Yanqing, a cultivator whom Bai Xiuhu formerly knew, only back then he was far distant from this female cultivator.
He was the kind who tried to curry favor with her, but she didn’t regard him.
However, this female cultivator was also a pure Sword Cultivator with many friends and lots of trivial matters, not very interesting.
So, Song Yan slightly bowed in return, and greeted, "Senior Sister Yanqing, long time no see."
After a brief chat, they parted ways.
Song Yan was indifferent.
Su Yanqing, on the other hand, had the notion of "comparing many options," then went to another lone male cultivator. After a while, she engaged enthusiastically with a male cultivator, evidently considering him stronger than Song Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: 115. Dao Companion (4.7K words - please subscribe)_3
...
Song Yan looked around, and after a while, a pair of Sword Rainbows went side by side into the sky, indicating initial success.
As time passed, more people left.
Song Yan suddenly sensed something, slightly turning his head, he saw a single Sword Rainbow flying away in the distance, which was Su Yao.
Clearly, Su Yao was tired of such occasions and left directly.
Song Yan continued to wait.
During this time, he noticed a female Cultivator skilled in Talismans. But before he could make a move, she was surrounded by a group of male cultivators. The female cultivator chose one with a rather high Realm and left with him.
After a while, another rainbow light wobbled from afar, revealing a petite female cultivator upon landing.
The female cultivator was emitting a burnt scent, her cheeks were gray, and her hair had curled up naturally from the high temperature. Song Yan immediately smelled the scent of Profound Wood Firewood under the Medicine Cauldron.
It’s called Mortal Fire, but it still requires Profound Tree firewood to make Mortal Fire.
Only such fire has enough temperature to refine the elixirs in the cauldron.
Clearly, this was a colleague.
"Senior brothers, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I...I am An Li from Warm Water Island, I am late, I am sorry!"
After she finished, the petite female cultivator sneezed and sniffled. Despite being over twenty, she still had an innocent, childlike appearance.
The male cultivators took a glance and looked away, but a familiar one teased her, "Oh, little An Li, you finally emerged from the Alchemy Room today?"
An Li nodded seriously, "Yes."
Then she said dejectedly, "Just a little bit short."
The cultivator asked curiously, "A little bit short of what?"
An Li said, "A little bit short of refining it, ah...ah-choo..."
She sneezed again.
A puff of turbid gray air spread with her sneeze, and the cultivator quickly bowed and left.
An Li bit her lip, her eyes lacked spirit, standing in place with a sense of anguish and unease, feeling as if her heart had stopped beating, ready to die any second.
She occasionally turned her head to watch the sky, hoping to run away as soon as it got dark.
She had been forced to come here today.
Just as her head was buzzing, An Li suddenly heard a voice by her ear.
"Demon Blood of the Ghost Pattern Python, along with Iron Swallow Grass and Purple Sunflower, attempting the union of their Pure Yang Qi to neutralize the cold in the Ghost Pattern Python Blood to achieve the formation of the Crimson Palace Pill. Unfortunately, not only did the yin and yang not balance each other, but they collided. Junior sister, did you...just have a cauldron explosion?"
"Ah, how do you know?"
An Li was stunned, quickly turned her head, and saw a Sword Robe boy smiling at her.
Seeing him clearly, she was dumbfounded again, rubbed her eyes to see more clearly, then shouted angrily, "White Rascal?!"
Song Yan: ???
An Li, after venting her anger, said, "But you took care of Junior Sister Xiao Jiu’s last rights and buried her. Let’s forget it. Please leave, I don’t want to argue with you."
Song Yan asked curiously, "Was it you who placed the white flower in front of Xiao Jiu’s tombstone?"
An Li snorted, "It was me."
Afterward, she added, "Xiao Jiu was a good friend of mine, and she disliked you quite a lot."
Song Yan said, "How long have you been closed off refining elixirs?"
An Li replied, "I generally don’t go out, probably about three or four months."
After saying this, as if explaining herself, she said hastily, "I don’t go out because I need to practice Alchemy. Master said that if one day I can refine more powerful Crimson Palace Pills, Sword Sect will have many experts and can kill many bad guys and demons!
Also, although I don’t go out, many seniors bring Demon Beast Blood to me.
I tell you, many of the Crimson Palace Pills in Sword Sect were refined by me, do you still dare to underestimate me?"
Song Yan scratched his head and then asked, "Did Master force you to come today as well?"
An Li said, "Master... is no longer around."
Song Yan paused for a moment, then changed the subject, "A lot has happened these past few months."
An Li said, "I absolutely won’t listen to a bad guy like you."
Song Yan said, "It’s about Junior Sister Xiao Jiu."
An Li said, "Oh, then go ahead."
The two of them conversed...
After listening, An Li was stunned for a while, then lightly said, "I’m sorry," her eyes darted around, noticed the sky was dark, let out a long sigh of relief, and said, "White rascal...brother, it’s finally dark, let’s quickly run."
Song Yan sighed, "I’ve been researching the Crimson Palace Pill recipe, and it’s giving me a headache."
An Li said, "Me too."
Song Yan said, "Tomorrow I’ll come to find you, shall we study the Pill Recipe together?"
An Li looked at him suspiciously.
However, Song Yan, already proficient in the Mortal Fire Refining Technique and pill recipes like the Little Profound Spirit Pill, easily dispelled An Li’s doubts with a few words.
An expert reveals their ability immediately.
An Li instantly sensed a kindred spirit and said, "Then come, Brother White."

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 116. I think he is the real old fox (3.2K words - subscription requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: 116. I think he is the real old fox (3.2K words - subscription requested)
In the blink of an eye, two months have passed...
In a dimly lit palace, a conversation is taking place.
"Disappeared? How come we can’t find any trace of him anywhere?"
"Don’t worry, we’ve already sent many young foxes to infiltrate major forces across the Three Kingdoms, including commerce associations, gangs, the government, and even the marketplace—all are covered.
As for the desolate wilderness, haven’t we tried searching there in teams multiple times? Let’s keep looking; there must be some clues left behind."
"That boy really has patience. I thought he would come to ambush us, so I deliberately left an opportunity for him, but it turned out to be all for nothing."
"Patience? It’s cunning! If he weren’t crafty, how could he elude Hu Zhenzhen, making her search everywhere without finding him?"
"That wretched Hu Zhenzhen deserves to die. The last Changwang Tiger was actually stolen by her. She doesn’t even understand how important that Changwang Tiger is. Despicable, truly despicable!
By the way, did he last appear at the Nanwu Sword Sect? Do we have spies planted within the Sword Sect?"
"Almost there.
Besides this, I have another arrangement.
This arrangement will surely grip that cunning boy’s neck tightly, forcing him to jump out, hehehehe..."
"I’m curious though, where exactly is that boy hiding?"
"Nothing to be curious about. Since he has already absorbed the Changwang Tiger Blood, I have reason to suspect that Hu Zhenzhen has also been skinned and drained of her blood by him.
Hehe, now he’s just a little fox... hehehehe..."
"Even a little fox as strong can’t outwit an old fox like you."
"Of course, just wait and watch, the grand show is about to begin, hehehehe..."
A humanoid fox clapped its hands and leaped down from the seat, chuckling into the darkness: "Hide well, little fox, the real search is about to start."
...
...
Two months later...
"Still haven’t found him, not a single bit of news. Is that boy really still within the Three Kingdoms?"
"Don’t worry, I’ve already spread the news."
"What news?"
"Our Purple Mansion experts from the Fox and Wolf Races are coming soon."
"It will take at least three years for them to arrive, not that soon."
"That boy doesn’t know that, he must be anxious."
"And then?"
"I’ve already gone to take a look at that Ancient Teleportation Array before anyone else. Though I don’t understand array formations well, I know it surely needs one specific material for repair."
"You’re talking about the Soul Gold Stone?"
"Exactly. Only a stone as sturdy as the Soul Gold Stone can withstand the tremendous backlash force from the Ancient Teleportation Array; nothing else will do.
So, I’ve quietly spread news through some very hidden channels, all pointing to a mortal force in Jin Kingdom called Lucky Commerce Association.
The president of Lucky Commerce Association unexpectedly got hold of some peculiar stones, with quality no different from that of Soul Gold Stones."
"I see. That boy wants to escape, so he’ll definitely come back to find Lucky Commerce Association."
"You’re wrong. He won’t come. The only one who’ll come looking for Lucky Commerce Association is that young girl from Nanwu Sword Sect, Yu Xuanwei.
Then... I’ll personally wait over there. When Yu Xuanwei comes knocking, I’ll reveal just a little bit, while tearfully telling her that the rest of the stones have been stolen.
Yu Xuanwei can’t detect anything unusual about me, but I believe that boy certainly will because he has the blood of my Multi-tailed Fox Race inside him.
By then, even if I don’t discover him, he’ll take action on his own, because I’m holding the Soul Gold Stone he desperately needs."
"Don’t say anything more, my brain is about to explode. Anyway, I’ll follow you, then just wait for that boy at Lucky Commerce Association."
"Hehehe, good."
...
...
Three more months passed in the blink of an eye.
In the dimly lit palace...
"Sure enough, Yu Xuanwei found her way here, but where’s that boy?"
"The boy hasn’t come yet."
"It’s been half a month now... if he was going to come, he would have by now. Why hasn’t he come?"
"He will come eventually."
...
...
Afterwards...
"Still hasn’t come, he still hasn’t come. You’ve led Yu Xuanwei’s people around half the circle, and that boy still hasn’t appeared! Could he be unable to see through your Illusion Technique?"
"Probably not, I’ve already left enough flaws, hmm, starting tomorrow, I’ll expose even more."
...
"Has he come?"
"Let’s wait a while longer."
...
"Has he come?"
"Not yet."
...
"Has he come?"
"No."
"I think you are the little fox; he’s the old fox!"
"Maybe he’s already left the Three Kingdoms?"
"From where? Surrounded by seas on three sides, there are only two exits: one is the Desolate Wilderness to the north, and the other is through the Ancient Teleportation Array. Which one do you think he took?"
The humanoid fox paused in silence, then asked, "What about the other group? Have they noticed anything unusual with the Puppet Sect?"
"No, absolutely no one, no one has shown any abnormalities! That kid hasn’t contacted anyone from the Puppet Sect!" A bizarre giant black wolf with bristle-like fur licked its lips, its eyes glowing eerily, "Why not just kill them all? We’re basically just putting on a show right now; sooner or later, we’ll have to feast."
"Killing aimlessly will only waste our time."
At that moment, the palace door suddenly creaked open, and a fox demon agilely leaped inside, bowing down while saying, "Grandma Hong, General Gu, there’s news about Song Yan."
The fox demon and the wolf demon hurriedly looked at the little fox demon who entered, saying, "Quick, tell us!"
The little fox demon said, "Someone saw him near Flower Box Mountain in the Desolate Wilderness. There’s a treasure unearthed over at Flower Box Mountain, the radiant glow reaching the sky, attracting many loose cultivators."
The fox demon referred to as Grandma Hong and the wolf demon General Gu exchanged a glance, their forms transforming into two demonic lights, speeding towards the north.
...
...
At this moment, Flower Box Mountain...
The radiance from the center had grown increasingly blinding.
A significant number of loose cultivators were already gathered around.
Among the loose cultivators, there were many acquaintances, and now they spoke to each other with cold tones.
"This phenomenon might be a Profound Treasure of the Crimson Palace level, let’s rely on our capabilities."
"Whoever gets it, it’s theirs."
"You’re naive; whoever gets it will be the target of everyone, they can all attack it."
As these words were spoken, the radiance suddenly expanded, the mountains and forests shook, birds scattered in fright, and a column of light shot up to the sky.
As the clouds in the sky were tinted gold at that moment, many figures shot towards that location.
Some cultivators rode gourds or measuring sticks as profound artifacts, while others wielded swords and rushed forward.
However, just as they were about to reach the center of the radiance, a wild and rampant laugh echoed from above.
"Get the hell out of my way!!"
The cultivators raised their heads only to see a massive Profound Robe figure, wearing a grim smile, surrounded by ten advanced demon beast shadow puppets descending from the sky.
During the descent, that figure took a sharp breath, and the shadow puppets, like boats caught in a whirlpool, all surged into that huge mouth.
Boom!!
The body of the Profound Robe figure explosively expanded, showcasing various demonic features, sprouting wings on the back, transforming hands into claws, and covering itself in scales and armor, spikes standing tall and jagged, terrifying beyond measure.
"Get out! Get out, get out!!"
The demon shadow descended like a heavily armored giant crashing into the crowd, those who touched it were sent flying, those who were grazed fell.
That demon shadow charged forward, knocking away over ten cultivators, before reaching towards the center of the radiance.
With a grab, the radiance vanished.
The demon shadow let out a sinister laugh, "It’s mine," and then quickly fled far away.
Initially, some cultivators wanted to give chase, but the demon shadow casually tossed out two advanced demon beast shadow puppets, knocking the cultivators away, and no one dared to pursue further, leaving only puzzled expressions.
After a long while, someone smiled bitterly, "It’s Demon Song."
Next, someone said, "They say Demon Song killed Gu Huangzi, I didn’t believe it before, but now I do."
"What is that Secret Technique of Demon Song’s, it’s terrifying, right?"
"I don’t know, but I’ve heard Grandma Hong of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race and General Gu have been looking for Song Yan, turns out he was hiding in the north, no wonder they couldn’t find him."
"Keep your voices down, be careful he hasn’t gone far."
Instantly, the cultivators fell silent, frozen with fear.
To them, "Song Yan" was a name as notorious as "Grandma Fox" or "Gu Huangzi," if not more so.
...
...
While flying, Song Yan released his Divine Sense, quickly changing his appearance upon realizing no one was around, then pulled out two "Gale Charms" from his bosom and stuck them to his feet, followed by concealing his Qi and continuously flying at low altitude using sword control.
As such... after a day and a night, he returned to Qingxi Market at an unthinkable speed and began purchasing herbs according to a list.
Since this spring, after he met with his junior sister An Li, he had been visiting her frequently.
As time passed, An Li and Song Yan found themselves talking more and more, often delving into the Alchemy Dao, talking until dawn before realizing they had lost track of time.
An Li belonged to the Su Family, while Song Yan was from the Sun Family.
Being together aligned with the Sword Sect’s "policy," and no one disagreed, especially since they were both researching the "Crimson Palace Pill," which was very important to the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Soon, Song Yan had a bamboo hut on Warm Water Island, located next to his junior sister An Li, and the two were often seen together.
This time, they needed some materials for alchemy, but the Sword Sect didn’t have them, so Junior Sister An Li suddenly mentioned, "Maybe Qingxi Market has them," prompting Song Yan to smack his forehead and head to Qingxi Market.
After arriving there, he heard rumors of a Marvelous Treasure emerging from Flower Box Mountain in the north, and so decided to let the name "Song Yan" draw attention, shifting the focus northward, thus explaining this scenario.
Of course, he didn’t just show his face.
He went the whole nine yards, even creating a "burning the wooden hut" scene somewhere deep in the mountains, to leave behind some simple doubts, making those who came later think "Song Yan was hiding in the deep mountains nearby."
This deep mountain was quite close to the Desolate Wilderness, fitting his logic of fleeing northward.
...
...
A month later.
Song Yan returned to Southern Wu with the herbs.
The rainbow light landed on Warm Water Island.
He arrived at the familiar alchemy room, then entered, skillfully cutting and preparing the herbs, handing them to his busy junior sister An Li.
An Li hadn’t noticed initially, but after receiving them twice, she realized that someone was in the room, and upon a closer look, she saw it was Song Yan.
Song Yan took out a small bag from his storage bag, shook it in mid-air, and smiled, "I’ve bought everything, Sun Essence Chrysanthemum, Ice Wheel Vine, we’ve got it all, we can experiment now."
An Li stared at him in a daze, tears "dripped down" and then she rushed at him, punching him hard in the chest, saying, "Do you know how dangerous it is right now at Qingxi Market, how could you dare to go there? I was just saying it casually."
As she was hitting him, Song Yan gently embraced his junior sister An Li.
Her small body trembled for a moment, but this time, she didn’t break free.
Song Yan held his junior sister, feeling a strong sense of security.
If he were to rank the "levels of danger" of various environments.
Where Song Yan was would be "university level," the Puppet Sect would be "high school level," while around his junior sister An Li would be "kindergarten level."
Hiding in the "kindergarten," he felt very safe, with nothing to worry about.

chapters.content:
Chapter 156: 117. A Different Winter (4.4K Words - Subscription Requested)
After a moment...
"Senior Brother, try using just one qian of the Ice Wheel Vine, not too much!"
Younger Sister Xiaoli, who was controlling her sword, flew above the medicine cauldron, observing the situation inside.
Swish swish swish...
Song Yan precisely cut off a piece of the dried white dead vine, then flicked his sleeve to send it into the medicine cauldron.
Younger Sister Xiaoli said, "Senior Brother, you’d better weigh it first. Every time you don’t, I get nervous."
Her expression didn’t show anger because it was Song Yan; if it were anyone else, she would have cursed them out long ago.
She despised people who weren’t serious.
Song Yan was confident in his knife skills, but since his junior requested, he obliged.
Younger Sister Xiaoli continued observing over the medicine cauldron and then shouted again, "Senior Brother, Senior Brother, prepare two qian of Sun Essence Chrysanthemum, and give one qian first."
Song Yan quickly procured a tuft of golden dried flowers, plucked a few leaves, weighed them slightly, then raised his hand to send them into the cauldron.
Younger Sister Xiaoli monitored the fire’s temperature, then quickly grabbed some bottles and jars, poured them in, and when finished, flicked her sleeve to set the cauldron lid, closing the cauldron, then reached for a fan.
But when she reached out, she grabbed nothing but air. Looking up, she saw that her senior brother had already started fanning the fire.
When she looked, Song Yan smiled at her.
Younger Sister Xiaoli stared for a while, noticing her senior brother’s excellent technique, so she relaxed, but she didn’t rest. Instead, she began circling the medicine cauldron, muttering incantations.
Song Yan’s control of the fire was very good, making his fanning technique nearly perfect.
As for alchemy, he had the basics down.
Demon Beast Blood was highly toxic, and when refining a Crimson Palace Pill, the core lies in the contradiction between "purging evil and removing toxins" and "retaining medicinal effects."
If you want no toxins, that’s possible, but to remove the poison from Demon Beast Blood requires repeated efforts, and with just a little effort, the blood’s effects will be lost.
If you want to retain the medicinal effects but can’t withstand Erysipelas, it’s a direct ticket to the afterlife.
Therefore, using "Demon Beast Blood" in medicine, forming a balance with other Spirit Flowers and Herbs, results in the Crimson Palace Pill.
Even so, because each batch of "Crimson Palace Pill" contains different Demon Beast Blood, without successful experience, each time consuming a new Crimson Palace Pill is an adventure.
A Pill Master’s role is simply to make the Crimson Palace Pill "appear consistent," with no discoloration or odd odors, overall harmonious, and uniformly colored.
The current level of the Nanwu Sword Sect can roughly refine "Crimson Palace Pills of seven types of advanced Demon Beasts," but it’s only advanced Demon Beasts, not the strongest ones seen in the Crimson Palace.
True experts wouldn’t accept this.
Therefore, many people take risks.
Once the Crimson Palace Pill reaches "appearance consistency," they prepare numerous detoxification drugs, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, and then retreat to swallow them, resisting Erysipelas, hoping to survive.
Because once surpassed, the benefits are immense.
The hardships and pain involved are hardly conveyed to outsiders.
That’s why when Yu Xuanwei, through the Memory Jade, showed Song Yan using the power of the "Changwang Tiger," everyone was speechless—this was even more shocking than when they initially heard about "Song Yan stealing the old fox’s things and making fun of the world."
The Nanwu Sword Sect, Puppet Sect, and Three Kingdoms Loose Cultivators knew the "Changwang Hu" as a powerful demon.
But the Fox and Wolf Races were different; they were at a loss as to how a human could digest the "Changwang Tiger Blood."
This was simply unfathomable.
Initially, they didn’t even consider this, presuming that "Changwang Tiger Blood" was still in the little thief’s possession.
...
About half an hour later.
A faint exotic fragrance drifted from the medicine furnace, not causing dizziness when inhaled.
Younger Sister Xiaoli hurriedly flew up with her sword, lifted the cauldron lid, and once the smoke inside dissipated, she saw a pigeon-egg-sized, pale blue elixir lying at the bottom.
The younger sister lifted it up, looked at it, and said, "Senior Brother, it worked.
Indeed, using good Spirit Flowers and Herbs yields better results.
Ice Wheel Vine and Sun Essence Chrysanthemum are more precious than Iron Swallow Grass and Purple Sunflower, so with the same refining techniques, the latter won’t work, but the former will."
Song Yan said, "Unfortunately, Iron Swallow Grass and Purple Sunflower bloom once every year.
But Ice Wheel Vine blooms once every ten years, and is often found in cold places.
As for Sun Essence Chrysanthemum, it only grows in Fire Profound regions; although it blooms annually, it only blossoms for half an hour each time. Unless you time it perfectly and keep watch constantly, you’ll never get the Sun Essence Chrysanthemum."
Younger Sister Xiaoli sighed softly.
But there’s nothing to be done.
Rare medicinal materials are hard to find; if it’s just a geographic restriction, that would be manageable. However, some herbs only bloom after many years, with ten years being minimal. Some take a hundred years, a thousand years, or even legends speak of ten thousand years...
After carefully placing the refined Crimson Palace Pill into a sealed Jade Bottle and labeling it, Younger Sister Xiaoli exhaled in relief, then looked out the window, her eyes suddenly shining with excitement, "It’s snowing!"
With a shout, she opened the door with a "bang," spread her arms, and ran outside.
Song Yan also followed her out, and as he lifted his head, he saw tiny white salt-like grains falling softly, bouncing off his Silver Sword Robe silently.
Among the grains were clumps of snow like soft cotton that rolled on the white silk of his Sword Robe, and then quickly blew away with the wind, drifting into distant flower beds, woods, and lakes.
Suddenly...
Bang!

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 117. A Different Winter (4.4K Words - Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: 117. A Different Winter (4.4K Words - Subscription Requested)_2
A cold lump landed on his left cheek.
He turned his head and saw that Junior Sister Xiaoli was using magic to gather snow and then molding it into a snowball.
"This is..."
Song Yan watched as the snow slid off his cheek and murmured, "A snowball fight?"
He never thought that someone like him, who walked out of the Puppet Sect’s sea of blood and deception, would one day engage in a snowball fight, let alone have someone actively throw snowballs at him.
Song Yan slightly closed his eyes, and this year’s snow flashed through his mind.
Every year he watched the snow fall, with different people around him every year, but never once had he rushed into the snow for a snowball fight.
Smack!
Another snowball hit his right cheek.
He slightly came back to his senses.
Smack!
The snowball continued to hit his forehead.
Junior Sister Xiaoli laughed so hard her stomach hurt. She wrapped herself tightly in a silver sword robe, with a clean and pure face. Though she lacked the alluring charm of a mature woman, she exuded a natural innocence and lively youthfulness.
Her petite figure seemed like a blooming flower of light on the dark earth, softening the sharp outlines of the surrounding world, warming the bleak and desolate hidden in the cold wind and snow.
It seemed that regardless of the scene, as long as she was thrown in, the scene would become beautiful, lovely, soft, and gentle, like a white cloud, a ball of cotton wool...
Her eyes were very bright and lively, gleaming as they looked at Song Yan, and she laughed heartily, "Such a fool!"
Song Yan completely returned to his senses, raising his hand to gather and form a snowball, saying, "Just you wait!"
Junior Sister Xiaoli made a funny face, then put her hands on her hips and said, "Come on, come on, let’s see what you’re made of."
The way she called herself "godmother" and him "you rascal" made Song Yan’s vision go dark.
He immediately gripped the firmly molded snowball and threw it.
Smack!
Smack!
Smack, smack, smack!
The two of them played the game of snowball fighting outside the Alchemy Room, going back and forth and having a lot of fun.
...
...
Not far away, on a high place.
Three figures in brocade robes were overlooking the scene. The three of them were well-concealed, as if they were seamlessly integrated into the landscape.
The old woman on the left was the first to laugh, then said, "Xuanwei, do you think... he resembles that Song Demon?"
The woman in the center shook her head slightly and said, "It’s just a sudden whimsical thought after hearing about Bai Xiuhu’s affairs and Uncle Kuye’s remarks as jokes.
Uncle Kuye thought he was a body-snatching expert, enough to prove his amazing talent, which made me involuntarily think of that Song Demon who also achieved it by snatching bodies.
Uncle Kuye said he was looking for a female cultivator proficient in Array Dao, which coincidentally aligns with the goals of Gu Huangzi and the Song Demon.
So upon my return this time, I thought to come and see him."
The Kuye Swordmaster on the right said, "In the Memory Jade, the Song Demon came in person and battled Gu Huangzi. This is enough to prove that he hasn’t mastered the Multi-tailed Fox Race’s Illusion Technique."
Yu Xuanwei shook her head slightly and said, "Not necessarily. The Song Demon’s mind is cunning and changeable. I really don’t know what kind of person he is or what he’s plotting.
But I do know he certainly covets my array technique inheritance and wants to use the Ancient Teleportation Array to leave. That day when I met him, I was prepared for him to ask for the array technique inheritance, I had even thought of what to say...
I wanted to tell him that the research on the Ancient Teleportation Array is solely held by my Yu Family, and giving it to him would be impossible.
If I were to die, then everything would be gone.
I intended to use this to draw him to our Sword Sect.
But he never asked from beginning to end."
Granny Meng said, "Xuanwei, are you still going to keep an eye on the Lucky Commerce Association? This old lady suspects there is something strange about that association."
Yu Xuanwei said, "Even if it’s strange, there’s nothing we can do. The association chairman indeed threw out the Soul Gold Stone, and I must pursue it.
Granny, you don’t practice Array Dao, you don’t understand the immense power of space transmission’s backlash, at least it takes the Soul Gold Stone to withstand it.
As for the sect, the Elder, and the Su Family’s ancestor’s friend—Luo Wangsun, they should all be preparing to break through to the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace, right?
If they can break through safely, the sect will be much more stable too."
Kuye Swordmaster said, "Then...my disciple, Xuanwei, do you still want to see him? If you want to, I’ll bring him to you, and you can talk with him thoroughly?"
Yu Xuanwei smiled faintly and said, "Forget it.
I really cannot imagine the Song Demon getting close to a female cultivator like Tian Xiaojiu, and even less believe he would pair with someone like An Li, entirely untainted by the world, as Dao partners.
Birds of a feather flock together... These two kids together are fine. They are the future of my Sword Sect."
With that, Yu Xuanwei turned, controlled her sword, merged into the wind and snow, and moved far away.
Granny Meng and Kuye Swordmaster exchanged a glance and quickly followed.
Song Yan, who was playing snowball fight with Junior Sister Xiaoli, slightly turned his head, squinting to glance in the direction the three had left, and continued to scoop up snowballs to throw at his junior sister.
...
...
That night.
Song Yan held the junior sister’s hand, walking down a small path.
The snow on the trees and silver flowers rustled in the wind.
The two walked together until they reached the front of Song Yan’s bamboo house.
Song Yan looked at An Li and said, "Junior Sister, tonight..."
Before he finished speaking, An Li, like a startled little rabbit, quickly ran away, darting to the bamboo house next door, then turning her head to look at Song Yan and said, "Senior Brother, tonight, good night."
After speaking, she swiftly entered the bamboo house and tightly shut the door.
In that moment of entry, Song Yan could still see the blush on her cheeks, not knowing if it was due to the icy world or because of shyness.
He chuckled softly.
He wasn’t trying to play any "emotion must be slowly cultivated, the junior sister must be slowly conquered" kind of games.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 117. A Different Winter (4.4K Words - Subscription Requested)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: 117. A Different Winter (4.4K Words - Subscription Requested)_3
These are very boring.
The four types of "Fixed Palace Blood," which are exceedingly precious to ordinary cultivators, endowed Song Yan with a terrifying perception, allowing him to vaguely sense someone on the distant cliff and roughly hear their conversation without needing to extend his divine sense.
The notion of "birds of a feather flock together" once again corroborated his beliefs.
Junior Sister An Li was indeed a very good hiding place, and a place where he could take a brief breath amidst the treacherous and perilous situation.
He didn’t pay much attention to the rest.
After all, Junior Sister An Li really lacked that kind of seductive feminine charm, which even "Old Master Li’s two beautiful concubines" couldn’t compare to.
...
...
Song Yan returned to the room, extinguished the lamp but didn’t immediately go to sleep, as he was still pondering the few words Yu Xuanwei had just let slip.
Phrases like "coming back this time," "Lucky Commerce Association," and "Soul Gold Stone" suddenly reminded him of many things.
After sorting his thoughts a bit, he realized... maybe some old fox had set its sights on him.
Though he had been targeted, it was like dancing in front of a blind person, completely ineffective.
He had his own rhythm, and he’d never let anyone lead him by the nose.
His rhythm was to keep a low profile while becoming stronger, then seize opportunities to reverse the roles.
The simplest ideas, in the most complex situations, appear to be the most profound.
But...
’If the Fox and Wolf Races repeatedly target me and still cannot find me, what will happen if they head north in search and fail again?’ Song Yan contemplated deeply.
Soon, he muttered to himself: ’If it were me, since I couldn’t find it, I wouldn’t look for it anymore. I’d tighten my pockets, quietly awaiting the arrival of strong cultivators from the Purple Mansion, and then catch them in the jar.’
’To catch them in the jar, I’ll need to completely destroy the ancient teleportation array. Since they’ve thrown out the lure of the Soul Gold Stone, there’s no reason they wouldn’t know the location of the ancient teleportation array.’
’But regardless of any faction, the ancient teleportation array is not a cheap little thing; it represents the entrance to a new world, a new map, and also signifies the unknown and opportunity.’
’Thus, I won’t destroy the ancient teleportation array.’
’But to catch them in the jar, I would kill the person here who can repair the ancient teleportation array.’
’Yu Xuanwei.’
’When the time comes, it’ll truly sever the way back.
Not taking the way back and having no way back are two different things.’
Song Yan snorted coldly, then stood up, went out, and came to the lakeside, catching a bodiless phantom crow in the dark. After sensing no one around, he slightly raised his arm and sent the bodiless phantom crow into the wind.
...
The bodiless phantom crow flew and flew, quietly landing on a rock on the lake outside Luoxia Bamboo Island, blending into the night until the early morning when it saw a figure wrapped in a face-covering cloak approach by sword control, then flapped its wings to fly.
The figure paused upon seeing the bodiless phantom crow, slightly pulled open the face covering, revealing Yu Xuanwei’s face.
"Senior?"
The bodiless phantom crow spoke hoarsely: "Young girl, the Fox Wolf intends to kill you.
If you don’t want to die, stop repairing the ancient teleportation array, hide in the array on Luoxia Bamboo Island, and continue to let people disguise you.
Actually, your clumsy disguise techniques have long been seen through!
Yet amidst the real and the fake, as long as a fake version of you remains on Luoxia Bamboo Island, people will subconsciously believe the real version isn’t here."
Yu Xuanwei’s delicate body trembled, speechless with astonishment, seeing the bodiless phantom crow about to fly away, hurriedly said: "Senior, do you have the Soul Gold Stone?"
The bodiless phantom crow slightly moved its wings, revealing a small bean-sized piece of pale gold stone, and asked: "This?"
Yu Xuanwei said joyfully: "You have it!"
Having confirmed, the bodiless phantom crow spoke no further, spread its wings, and flew far, merging into the darkness.
Yu Xuanwei paused, but did not chase after it; instead, she began to carefully consider Song Yan’s words. The more she contemplated them, the more outrageous they seemed, and she felt this Song demon was terrifying.
In fact, Song Yan himself didn’t know whether the Fox Wolf had already begun "preparing to kill Yu Xuanwei," but he knew... if he were them, he would do it. Since he would do it, he had to close that gap beforehand.
As for the array inheritance...
Asking directly won’t work.
There will be ample time ahead.

chapters.content:
Chapter 160: 119. Pointing at a deer and calling it a horse, Sword Heart Shattered (4.4K words - Please subscribe)
The sound of battle shakes the heavens outside the door, with arcs of light shooting far away.
Song Yan squinted his eyes slightly, he wanted to open the door and look outside clearly, but then heard urgent footsteps coming from the bed behind him.
An Li, younger sister, rushed down wearing only her undergarments, grabbed his hand, and said, "Don’t go."
Song Yan: ???
An Li, younger sister, said: "Master once told me that as a Pill Master, my duty is to survive and refine better elixirs for the Sect.
If a great battle breaks out outside, hiding somewhere safe, not being discovered by the enemy, and not getting into trouble is what I should do.
Otherwise, if I’m captured, the Sect would have to send someone to rescue me, which would only create more chaos!
Senior brother, the same goes for you! No being reckless!"
After speaking, the younger sister’s other small hand hugged his waist from behind, afraid he might impulsively rush out to confront Song Yan demon.
In the darkness, Song Yan only felt behind him a soft and warm bundle of cotton, trembling upon it.
An Li, younger sister, was trembling.
She continued, "When senior uncle Xuanwei used the Memory Jade to reveal that demon, I saw it.
He is terrifying.
If you go, you certainly won’t be able to help, you’ll just be targeted by him. If he strikes carelessly, you’ll be dead!"
Song Yan stared at the gleam in the distant darkness, feeling the arrogant and grim laughter drifting in the air, a sound actually belonging to himself.
"Senior brother, don’t create chaos for the Sect!" An Li’s small hand firmly held onto him.
Song Yan secretly amused, didn’t expect An Li had quite the battle awareness, knowing not to be a burden.
He turned around, leaned back slightly, and "bang," the door closed.
From behind hugging him, the younger sister changed to the front; the two pressed closely together.
Suddenly, An Li seemed to sense something, her pretty face froze for a moment, blushed immediately, then jumped up like a cat touched by electricity, quickly separating from Song Yan, while angrily and coquettishly exclaiming, "Senior brother, what are you doing?"
After speaking, she softly added, "The Sword Manual says only once a day is allowed."
Simultaneously, she quickly took a silk scarf, cleaned some slightly sullied places on her body, and then changed into the Sword Robe.
Song Yan responded, "Weren’t you holding onto me not letting me go out?"
An Li tremblingly said, "Senior brother, although we aren’t going to the front lines, there will certainly be injured brothers returning later. We should go to the Alchemy Room now and prepare healing medicine."
Song Yan nodded, then leaned against the door and waited for the younger sister to finish, then quietly went out together, swiftly traversing the dark paths.
An Li suddenly said, "Don’t be afraid, senior brother, Warm Water Island is on the west side of the Sword Sect. If the enemy wants to attack, they generally won’t come from this direction."
Song Yan curiously replied, "I know, but wouldn’t attacking from both east and west be better? Who attacks a city from the main entrance?"
An Li gasped, turning white-eyed, sighed, "Senior brother, don’t scare me. I... even if you scare me, I won’t be afraid!"
Song Yan said, "Don’t worry, the sounds of battle are coming from the direction of Observing Mist Island, this means Song demon is attacking from the main entrance."
After speaking, Song Yan said, "Don’t you think it’s strange for Song demon? Sneaking into the Sword Sect, isn’t changing angles and stealth infiltration a better idea than such an ostentatious approach?"
An Li replied, "You wouldn’t understand! Evil demons are extremely cunning, especially Song demon who’s the sneakiest of them all. You’d think he wouldn’t come from the main entrance, but he chooses precisely that way, true and false, reality mingled with illusion. In short, you certainly wouldn’t guess. Senior brother, you didn’t guess, did you?"
Song Yan scratched his head and said: "Indeed, as younger sister states."
He turned his head to glance at the distant view, squinting slightly.
Framing someone, huh?
You do your framing, what does it have to do with me?
Am I someone who gets angry just by being cursed?
...
...
"Song thief! Treacherous thief! Evil thief! Dog thief!"
"Previously, when he slew Gu Huangzi, I thought perhaps he wasn’t so bad, but unexpectedly he has gone heartless to such an extent!"
In the Alchemy Room...
Song Yan listened to the injured disciples cursing Song demon while continuously treating them.
During treatment, he discovered a commonality in the injuries of these disciples, which was "flushed face, bulging blood vessels."
It’s worth noting, the body quality of cultivators in the Refining Profound Realm far exceeds ordinary Jianghu people many times over. If reaching the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, it becomes immune to blades, unaffected by fire and water. What kind of power brings such effects?
If you don’t understand, just ask.
Song Yan directly asked, "Senior brothers, what kind of demon technique did Song demon use?"
A tall senior brother who just took Concentration Soup looked at him, slowly shook his head, and said, "Embroidered Tiger Junior Brother, we don’t know either. But that demon technique seems to directly mobilize our internal Qi Blood."
Another disciple fearfully said: "I personally saw a senior brother controlling his sword upward, just when he was about to stab Song demon, Song demon turned around and with one sword, stabbed him.
That sword only made a minuscule cut on the senior brother, then suddenly he burst with blood, the body seemed... seemed like a squeezed dry bundle of cotton, directly turned into a dried corpse."
Another disciple also joined the discussion, smiling bitterly: "It’s quite shameful to say, my cultivation is inadequate, just standing afar, without striking, I felt terrified, even my eardrums heated up, nostrils bleeding... Song demon must have practiced some murderous demon technique on us Sword Sect as an experiment."
Song Yan found the brothers’ thinking angles quite unique, so he curiously asked: "How dare the demon appear? Isn’t he currently being hunted by Fox Wolf? The whole world is searching for him. How does he dare walk into a trap?"

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 119. Pointing at a deer and calling it a horse, Sword Heart Shattered (4.4K words - Please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: 119. Pointing at a deer and calling it a horse, Sword Heart Shattered (4.4K words - Please subscribe)_2
A junior brother said, "Brother Embroidered Tiger, are you suspecting that it’s not Demon Song? I’m telling you, that’s him! Even if he used an illusion technique that we can’t see through, the Grand Elder can surely tell, right?
He’s definitely driven mad by being hunted all over, which twisted his mind, and then he practiced such demon techniques that drove him insane.
Let’s lay it all out, no more hiding."
Sister An Li chimed in, "Senior brother is right! That Demon Song must be crazy!
These kinds of demons, they look powerful, but their minds are the most fragile!"
The nearby senior brothers and sisters immediately echoed this sentiment, joining the discussion enthusiastically.
Song Yan understood.
In this room, as long as you curse Demon Song, you’re a friend; otherwise... you’re an enemy.
Reviling the demon as despicable and shameless is a common hobby among the fellows of the Righteous Dao.
"Song the Traitor! Wicked Scoundrel! Vile Thief! Filthy Scoundrel!" Song Yan went along with the flow and cursed passionately.
Immediately, a senior brother beside him said, "Well said!"
Song Yan, with fervor, continued, "With so many of us here, that demon wouldn’t dare come, but if he did, one spit from each of us would drown him!"
This stirred the crowd, some saying "Brother Embroidered Tiger, very bold," some saying "I’d not be a sword cultivator if I feared him," and others saying "That Demon Song is alone, we are many, why fear him?"...
One thoughtful senior brother hesitated to speak, then smiled faintly, looking at Song Yan and the group of junior brothers and sisters, reflecting, "Youth is wonderful."
Song Yan took this opportunity to glance aside and saw Sister An Li was also blushing from the discussion, her eyes shining, her lips moving non-stop, clearly excited by the cursing.
However, amidst this corner discussion, he gathered quite a bit of information.
For instance, the opponent’s power.
The opponent could remain undetected even by the Grand Elder, and couldn’t possibly master the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" technique, which means their illusion technique must be very advanced, higher than that of Granny Fox, possibly even an old fox demon at the Late Stage of the Crimson Palace.
Yet this imposter posing as Song Yan might not be that old fox but someone else entirely.
The Multi-tailed Fox Race has many racial secret techniques, which he had already heard from Granny Fox.
Granny Fox, having turned into a ghost, had her memory precision compromised, unable to recall the innumerable racial secret techniques, but she could remember some effects, such as "casting illusions on others to change their appearance," or "making one’s own image uncertain, yet when seen by others, it becomes a specific form, like a favorite person or most feared person, etc."...
Thinking of this, Song Yan finally made up his mind.
Once he finds the suitable blood, he will quickly elevate his realm, not to delay advancement in pursuit of the "Perfect Nine Palaces."
A higher realm is certainly better than a lower one.
Gu Huangzi may be powerful, but in techniques, he’s not as good as his "Hundred Forms Demon Body" and "Sword Evil Demon Dragon." His ability to contend with Song Yan was purely due to being at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, whereas Song Yan was at the Early Stage.
Now he is at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, but if the Fox Wolf Demons he encounters are all at the Late Stage of the Crimson Palace, then... he has to at least reach the Late Stage too.
At this moment, a terrifying explosion suddenly sounded from afar, interrupting the discussion, and everyone hurriedly turned their heads to look outside.
In the northeastern sky, they saw two dragon forms suddenly manifesting, spiraling high in the sky, the sharp aura making the sky hum as if dragons were softly singing.
"What is that?" Song Yan felt a powerful force from those two dragon forms.
Among the disciples, there are those who recognized it.
Soon, someone said, "It’s the ’Chi Qiu Illusionary Head Sword Array’! Now that the sword array has appeared, Demon Song is probably in trouble!"
...
...
Bang bang!!
Bang bang bang bang!!
The successive fierce impacts forced the Profound Robe man in mid-air to take a few steps back, while two large dragon shadows danced relentlessly around him.
Sword Qi formed the dragon scales, Profound Qi filled the dragon’s body, reckless and powerful!
Five disciples held swords and advanced, the Grand Elder at the array core supporting the array plate.
The array plate twirled rapidly, seemingly pulling in the surrounding heaven and earth’s Profound Qi, transmitting it to the five swords.
The five disciples, following a certain magic technique, circled the Profound Robe man, attacking as if weaving brocade and threading flowers.
With their assault, the dragon forms also occasionally attacked the Profound Robe man.
Sometimes biting, sometimes colliding, sometimes lashing with their tails...
Another loud bang, and the Profound Robe man was pushed back a bit more, he looked far ahead, laughed wildly, "What bullshit sword array? In my eyes, Song Yan, it’s just so-so!
If someone else controlled the array, maybe they could kill me, but too bad... both the one controlling and those in the array are too weak. Hahaha!
I’ve had enough fun today, I’ll take my leave now!"
After speaking, he turned around, deftly dodging a collision from a large dragon.
Although he claimed he wasn’t afraid, being hit would indeed be quite hurtful.
Before leaving, the Profound Robe figure swooped from low altitude, suddenly raised a hand, captured a nearby sword cultivator, and whisked away.
"This is outrageous!" The Grand Elder’s face turned ashen, he withdrew the array and immediately chased with sword control, many Crimson Palace realm cultivators also gave chase.
However, the Grand Elder’s speed surpassed ordinary Crimson Palace cultivators, and the Profound Robe figure was also fast,
thus, they quickly widened the gap between them.
The ordinary Crimson Palace realm cultivators from the Sword Sect chased for a while, but soon realized that both the Grand Elder and the Profound Robe figure had disappeared without a trace.
...
