Meanwhile, as the Grand Elder and the Profound Robe cultivator played their game of cat and mouse, they quickly moved far away.

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 119. Pointing to a deer as a horse, Sword Heart Shattered (4.4K words - please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: 119. Pointing to a deer as a horse, Sword Heart Shattered (4.4K words - please subscribe)_3
Black clouds drifted, and in the instant they covered the moon, heaven and earth suddenly dimmed.
The Elder’s expression shifted, and he descended onto a moon-obscured mountain top, staring at a black shadow that had just landed in the distance. He asked coldly, "Who are you really?"
The night wind swept through, stirring eerie screeches in the deep mountains.
The shadow, holding a sword cultivator who was already unconscious with one hand, slowly turned around. The head above its collar suddenly transformed into a pitch-black wolf head. The wolf head turned, grinning, revealing gums streaked with blood and interlocking fangs.
The Elder froze.
Then, from beside him came a "tee-hee-hee" laugh, and a red-robed fox sauntered out, swaying, cradling its chin in its arms and leaning against a cold precipice.
These two were none other than General Gu and Granny Hong.
General Gu raised a hand and picked up the sword cultivator, lowering his head to bite fiercely into the cultivator’s neck.
The sword cultivator, in pain, abruptly opened his eyes, his gaze tearing toward the Elder’s position.
The Elder, burning with anger, lifted by Sword Control, shouted, "Demon!!"
Just as the words fell, he suddenly heard a dignified voice beside his ear.
"Xiaoming, how can you talk to your master like that?"
He was momentarily dazed, looked up, and saw a towering figure standing before him with hands folded behind its back.
That figure was incredibly tall, like a sky-reaching tower overlooking him, surrounded by blinding light that made it hard for him to gaze directly at it.
The Elder blinked, hurriedly shook his head, then suddenly stepped back.
Looking again, where was the towering figure? There stood only the red-robed fox, with three fluffy white tails swaying beneath the robe’s hem.
Accompanying it was the "crunch crunch" sound of chewing.
The sword cultivator’s abdomen had been split open, and General Gu was bending his head to enjoy the cultivator’s body, clutching the heart with one claw, taking a big bite at the mouth, then said, "The practiced one has a more potent taste, unlike mortals."
The Elder had not yet reacted when Granny Hong stepped forward and said, "As you can see, Elder, Song Yan was us in disguise. Our purpose was merely to force him out. You... wouldn’t refuse to cooperate with us and want to oppose the Fox and Wolf Races, would you?"
Elder: ...
Granny Hong raised her sharp face again, staring at the Elder playfully with vertical pupils. She lifted a claw to cradle her chin, glanced sideways at the jet-black giant wolf chewing on the sword cultivator, and asked, "Who is it really?"
The Elder clenched his fist tightly.
He wanted to draw his sword.
But he knew that once the sword was drawn today, the consequences would be too unpredictable.
How could his Sword Sect members possibly oppose the Fox and Wolf Races?
Even a single Granny Fox was enough to torment them severely. Now, four demons had come to the Three Kingdoms, and more Great Demons were on their way.
How could the Sword Sect be a match?
"Who is it?"
Granny Hong’s smile faded, her voice turning colder, her tone more aggressive.
General Gu’s chewing also quickened, seeming ready to act as soon as he finished.
And at this moment, the Elder’s voice arose.
"It’s Song Yan."
"Tee-hee-hee-hee, see, that’s the way."
Granny Hong cackled sharply.
General Gu also laughed.
After a long while, the two finished eating the sword cultivator and then turned around and flew away.
Only the Elder remained standing there, body and heart trembling, as if he still couldn’t believe the three words came from his own mouth.
Not only had the younger generation he was supposed to protect been eaten right in his face, but he was also yielding to help the demons cover up, no different from a traitor.
Crack...
Vaguely, he felt a fracture forming in a certain will inside his heart.
Originally, his plan was to break through to the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace next month.
...
A sly laugh from the fox and wolf echoed from afar.
General Gu licked his lips and said, "Your idea was good—disguising ourselves as others, how amusing."
Granny Hong sighed, "But Song Yan still hasn’t shown himself."
General Gu said, "Who cares."
Granny Hong said, "Then I’ll stir the waters more and see if he’ll come out!"

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 120. Two elders in one alchemy room, alchemy fails (2900 words - subscribe please)
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: 120. Two elders in one alchemy room, alchemy fails (2900 words - subscribe please)
In a flash, another half month had passed.
Song Yan lay comfortably in his bedding, his junior sister An Li in his arms as soft as a pillow, with her being pressed, hugged, or nestled against him, each having its own pleasant charm.
Perhaps due to her frequent dealings with the Profound Flower Spirit Grass, her unkempt long hair still carried a natural floral fragrance.
Song Yan breathed in this floral fragrance, feeling relaxed and at ease.
During this period, he took some time to examine the treasures he acquired on Flower Box Mountain that day.
It was a pair of boots that changed styles at will, driven by Profound Qi, but the consumption was considerable, not something Refining Profound cultivators could afford, clearly belonging to the category of Profound Treasures.
As for their function, it was "sudden eruption," enhancing speed in a short time.
Song Yan casually named these boots "Great Gale Boots" because wearing these boots felt like putting on an enhanced version of the "Gale Charm."
However, Song Yan couldn’t think of any use for these Great Gale Boots at the moment, because whether it was entering combat or escaping, these boots felt somewhat superfluous.
But if combined with the "Kan Water Escape," then they might be worth a look.
While thinking, Song Yan felt the petite body in his arms start to wriggle, each twist lightly scraping his body, the close contact and rustling friction bringing indescribable comfort.
An Li, his junior sister, seemed to be quite familiar with him, speaking rather casually now, grumbling, "That Song Devil is truly detestable, just half a month and I hear him killing people here and there every day. I hope the Fox Wolf catches him soon!
Ah, senior brother, let go, get up quickly!"
"No."
Song Yan embraced the little pillow from behind.
An Li wiggled her hips, finding she couldn’t move, so she turned around and pinched Song Yan’s nose, saying harshly, "Let’s see if you let go or not."
Song Yan let go, then together with his junior sister, they donned their Sword Robes and headed to the Cultivation Square to study Sword Dao, afterwards going to the Alchemy Room.
A lot of Essence Blood was placed on the wooden shelves in the Alchemy Room.
Song Yan’s gaze swept over two bottles.
One was the Ghost Shark.
The other was the Wind Spirit Finch.
Both were advanced demon beasts.
The former belonged to Luo Wangsun, and preparations for alchemy had already been found, set to begin in the coming days. As for that vat of ordinary blood, after refining and concentrating, it was divided into only three small bottles.
The latter was a demon beast from among the more mature seven kinds of Crimson Palace Pills of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
Both of these can enhance speed, and are presently what Song Yan has set his eyes on.
The Left and Right Two Palaces do not require Essence Blood.
The role of Essence Blood is to "allow for purification," "enable the casting of racial secret techniques," "grant racial traits," etc., but the Left and Right Two Palaces themselves cannot trigger the "Essence Blood effect."
Ordinary blood placed there at most weakens the power slightly, without affecting anything else.
In short, it means "although value decreases," it does not affect "function."
...
Song Yan had considered his Nine Palace arrangement.
The Central Three Palaces’ "Changwang Hu," "Night Candle Soul Worm," and "Nightmare Beast" were entirely Divine Soul oriented.
The "Multi-tailed Fox" in the Central Palace of the Lower Three Palaces was about "spell amplification and duration."
Various fortuitous encounters of the Fox Grandmother led to the augmentation of the Fear Secret Technique by the Three-tailed Fox, which in turn facilitated the Dragon Bo Illusion.
And if he wanted Dragon Bo’s blood, he’d have to infiltrate the Fox Race, which was obviously impossible now.
As for the Fear Secret Technique, he already had it at hand.
The secret technique brought by the "Nightmare Beast" was to "drag the target into a nightmare while they are weak and mentally dazed, making them fearful and frightened."
This allowed him to "at night, use the Changwang Hu to provide Chong Soul, the Night Candle Soul Worm to provide Chong Soul colliding with soul, thus making the target mentally dazed, then using the Nightmare Beast to drag them into a nightmare."
And, "Dragon Bo blood" was clearly a highly compatible piece of his puzzle, completing the "nightmare" segment.
But without it, he wouldn’t force it.
Song Yan was never obstinate; if one path didn’t work, he would change to another. Now he’d thought of another way.
That was "speed."
The Central Three Palaces can use all kinds of flashy Divine Soul attacks to bewilder the opponent.
And as long as he’s fast enough, he can grievously wound or even instantly kill the opponent in the moment they’re in a daze, leaving them no chance to take out treasures or use trump cards.
The "Ghost Shark" and "Wind Spirit Finch," though ordinary, if combined with the "Multi-tailed Fox" and external Profound Treasures like the "Great Gale Boots," can stack to a quite considerable speed.
And this would also have miraculous effects when escaping.
...
"Senior brother, today we’re going to refine Uncle Luo’s Ghost Shark Crimson Palace Pill, are you ready?" An Li, his junior sister, was very serious.
Song Yan nodded heavily.
An Li directed, "Then let’s begin.
To maximize the characteristics of the Demon Blood, I plan to spend three days and three nights slowly refining, then at a critical moment, you follow my orders and throw all the Fire Crystal Vine into the fire in one breath.
We cannot fail, there’s only one chance!"
Fire Crystal Vine is a rare plant containing Fire Profound, which cannot be made into elixirs but, when thrown into Mortal Fire, can briefly increase flame temperature, enabling the "Mortal Fire" to surpass its temperature limit.
Some elixirs can only be refined under high temperatures.
Song Yan said, "Don’t worry, we’re old partners."
Upon hearing the words "old partners," An Li, his junior sister, gave a sweet smile, feeling that it was truly a happiness in this life to meet a fellow cultivator like Brother Bai.
No matter how dangerous it was outside, with the Song Demon, Fox Demons, Wolf Demons, and the Demon Sect out there, as long as she was with Brother Bai, there was nothing to fear.
This place is not only the alchemy room but also a home belonging to her and Senior Brother Bai.
"Mm!"
Junior Sister An Li smiled radiantly, her pretty face showing confidence, and then took a deep breath, full of primordial energy, "Let’s begin!"
....
...
"Hehe, let’s start..."
The red-robed fox lightly raised its paw and tossed out a beam of light.
The light entered the Misty Sea and revealed its form.
Good heavens, it turned out to be a flood dragon covered in blue scales, with sharp teeth and a long tail, a body over ten zhang in length, and though hornless, a small ice-blue lump had appeared on its head.
As soon as the flood dragon entered the Misty Sea, it vanished, diving into the water, initially observing quietly from the edge, but before long, it opened its bloody mouth to devour fish and shrimp at the bottom.
Two days passed in a blur.
As it ate, the flood dragon suddenly noticed that the center of this water area seemed to have more food.
Besides the small demon beasts, there seemed to be plenty of food on the land.
Unable to resist temptation, it rapidly swished its tail, draining water, and moved away in a distance, the water flowers rising gradually, forming tides, and even the lake surface faced deep-sea tsunami-like waves over ten zhang high, raging and surging.
The surface of these giant waves seemed to be covered with a layer of profound qi, preventing the spray from dispersing easily, and through layered pushing, becoming even more immense.
In the sky, the clear light faded, grey mist shrouded, and the gloomy wind wailed.
The demonic waves raised seemed like a monster’s tongue, trying to lick tiny bugs from the ground into its mouth.
...
...
Luo Wangsun was anxiously waiting outside the alchemy room, twirling his bristly beard.
He had already prepared for the breakthrough to the late stage of the Crimson Palace, now just waiting for the "Ghost Shark Crimson Palace Pill".
Beforehand, the two little ones had repeatedly used ordinary blood to test, and the success rate was at least eighty percent, since the ghost shark was only an advanced demon beast, not a Crimson Palace demon beast.
Just as he was thinking, suddenly Luo Wangsun noticed the sky darken, immediately followed by a loud noise, causing the whole Warm Water Island to tremble, a water curtain covered the sky, making the island seem to sink underwater, with no sight of floating clouds but only black water stretching out.
Luo Wangsun’s heart shivered, thinking "Not good", he rushed into the alchemy room, and upon looking inside, his face turned white.
The earth’s tremor directly dimmed the fire under the alchemy furnace.
An Li’s eyes turned red, shouting, "It’s okay, Uncle Luo! Fire! Senior Brother! Fire!!"
Song Yan suddenly fanned, while An Li used magic to stabilize the alchemy furnace.
And at this time, the ground shook violently again.
Luo Wangsun was furious, grabbing a long spear from the void, and shouted "Courting death!", then flew out, soon seeing the culprit, his anger instantly vanished, replaced by a bit of excitement.
"Water Abyss Flood Dragon!! Crimson Palace Demon Beast! How can there be such a thing?!!"
He couldn’t help but rejoice.
Setting the Third Central Palace with the "Water Abyss Flood Dragon" would make his power soar, far beyond the "Ghost Shark".
Although knowing that the Crimson Palace demon beast erysipelas was extremely potent, Luo Wangsun still laughed and charged with his spear.
This "Water Abyss Flood Dragon" seemed tailor-made for him!
On the other side, a sword rainbow rushed over.
Luo Wangsun turned his head and saw it was the grand elder.
But today’s grand elder was unusual, hair disheveled, face haggard, eyes bloodshot.
Seeing the "Water Abyss Flood Dragon", the grand elder’s tired eyes suddenly emitted light: "Crimson Palace Demon Beast!!"
Since half a month ago, when a crack appeared in his sword heart, he sought every possible means to mend it, thinking over and over that only greater strength would suffice.
This led him to overthrow his original stable plan, and think of finding a Crimson Palace demon beast.
Only the strength of a Crimson Palace demon beast might help his sword heart heal.
To get what he wished for was unexpected.
The grand elder was increasingly pleased, wanting to ascend with the sword.
Luo Wangsun noticed his intent, slightly frowned.
Regarding family power, he could abstain from rivalry, but this was the path of seeking the Dao, so how could he yield?
...
...
Boom!
Bang bang bang!
Another series of continuous shaking.
The ceiling was further assaulted by currents, brushing back and forth.
And the flames beneath the alchemy furnace dimmed slightly.
"Fire Crystal Vine! Fire Crystal Vine!!" An Li shouted helplessly, yet gritted her teeth hoping to reverse the situation with intense fire.
Song Yan hurriedly sent vines to the furnace bottom.
Then a blaze, after lifting the lid, revealed the elixir was discolored.
An Li froze, muttering, "Failed....."

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 121. Intensified Conflict (4.1K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: 121. Intensified Conflict (4.1K words - Subscription Requested)
Swoosh swoosh swoosh~~
Water cascades from the sky, repeatedly washing over the roof of the alchemy room, cascading down like a heavy curtain of water, dark and gloomy, blurring the scenes even in the courtyard.
The alchemy room, as if sunk to the bottom of a lake.
An Li sat despondently on the ground, her sword robe spread out in a limp silver-white circle, eyes vacant, muttering repeatedly, "Failed, failed."
She hadn’t slept for two days and nights, and this sudden failure hit her hard.
This was the Crimson Palace Pill meant to improve Uncle Luo’s realm; she had failed, how could she face Uncle Luo?
Song Yan glanced at the wasted pill at the furnace bottom, raised a hand to retrieve it, and placed it in a bottle, then bent down to protect little Li Junior Sister, who was thoroughly dazed.
Seeing his junior sister in this state, he secretly found it amusing. He still remembered how earlier his junior sister excitedly cursed, "Song Demonhead appears powerful, but his mind is the most fragile," yet in a blink, she herself crumbled. If his mindset were like his junior sister’s, he would’ve died countless times already.
Seeing the roof in turmoil, Song Yan scooped up the soft-doll-like little Li Junior Sister with an arm, darted swiftly to a corner, and glanced outside, his gaze piercing the water curtain, faintly seeing several figures fighting a long monster on the water.
The monster emitted scorching qi blood from its body, far surpassing a Refining Profound Demon Beast, evidently a Crimson Palace level Demon Beast.
This made Song Yan marvel internally.
He continued to discern.
Realizing it was likely a water-type flood dragon barely entering the early stage of the Crimson Palace Realm.
Due to their bodies and other factors, demon beasts are naturally much stronger than humans. However, as humans comprehend various cultivation techniques and magic, this disparity gradually narrows.
Both being Crimson Palace Realm, demons prefer to exploit the inherent power of "Nine Palace Blood," at most paired with their clan’s secret technique. Humans, however, use "Nine Palace Blood" supplementary, accompanied by various secret techniques and profound treasures.
Like sword cultivators, even stepping into the Crimson Palace, the blood they absorb from demon beasts like "Wind Spirit Finch" in terms of strength certainly isn’t as potent as demon blood, yet if with the speed of "Wind Spirit Finch" paired with sword system secret techniques, they can battle.
As for Gu Huangzi, he thoroughly uses two types of "Nine Palace Blood" as a complete auxiliary: one allows him to hide inconspicuously in a paper figurine, the other lets him still wield power to kill when his body is destroyed. His reliance, however, is on "Blood Corpse," "Paper Figurine," "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet," "Soul Gold Stone Weapons," and many more...
Humans resort to using "Nine Palace Blood" supplementary, being without choice.
Because "Erysipelas" is too violent.
But precisely because of this, a "barely Crimson Palace early stage demon beast" holds far more value for human cultivators than "a middle or late stage Crimson Palace demon beast."
Due to the lower realm, the toxins naturally decrease too.
Thus, the Crimson Palace Pill refined from such is more likely to be absorbed by people.
Song Yan squinted at the fight outside, pondering: ’How is this a catastrophe arriving, this is clearly a treasure falling from the sky.’
The abundance of Water Profound can breed flood dragon species without surprise.
Misty Sea hadn’t birthed a flood dragon before; one popping up seems normal.’
However, Song Yan felt something odd in his heart.
He did not believe in "treasures falling from the sky."
Yet, he is not an omniscient immortal; for a while, he could not fathom the sudden emergence meaning of this thing.
Regardless of its meaning, he felt it unimportant.
He was just Bai Xiuhu.
No matter would target someone as insignificant as him.
Moreover, even if he were Song Yan, he saw no relation of this matter to himself.
"Failed, failed, failed..."
An Li Junior Sister continued her murmuring, eyes reddened, expression dazed, emitting an essence of being unable to extricate from immersion in failure.
Song Yan took a mat, sat together with Junior Sister, wrapped an arm around her shoulder, amidst the howling wind and rumbling battles, like two little finches tucked in a nest amid a storm.
About half a stick of incense time later, suddenly, the door of the alchemy room was opened, and a figure surrounded by many sword cultivators walked in.
The figure’s gaze swept over the two huddled in the corner, gently saying, "Don’t be afraid."
Song Yan looked up and was surprised to see it was Su Yao.
At this moment, Su Yao wearing brocade clothes, appeared calm, her demeanor imposing, clearly the leader among this group of sword cultivators.
Beside her, sword cultivators wore silver masks, their cold aura spreading out. Though not powerful, they gave a feeling of extremely sharp sword intent, undoubtedly set to be formidable sword cultivators given time.
However, even with the silver mask, Song Yan recognized it was Cao Yuzhuang at a glance.
Yuzhuang Young Lady had a harsh early life in the Puppet Sect, her personality twisted, now in a free environment, her character rebounded, shifting from one extreme to another.
Yet, it was quite good.
Such extremes suited sword cultivators.
Song Yan had no intention of disturbing her further; Yuzhuang Young Lady had already embarked on her own path.
His old friend Su Yao, too, had undergone a series of transformations, growing from naive to mature, finally becoming who she ought to be.
It appeared because he and An Li were pill masters, Su Yao came personally to console, softly comforting them. Even upon knowing about the alchemy failure, her calm expression remained unchanged, continuing to soothe.
She gently stroked An Li’s hair like a big sister, then instructed two sword cultivators to escort and move them to safety, away from the battle range.
...
...
A moment later.
They were escorted to the neighboring island, quietly waiting in a bamboo house.

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 121. Intensified Conflict (4.1K words - subscription requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: 121. Intensified Conflict (4.1K words - subscription requested)_2
This island is named Jingyi Island, a residence for the newly inducted disciples of the Sword Sect, indicating its safety.
Many sword cultivators stationed on the island have also flown towards Warm Water Island.
Song Yan’s perception is exceptionally strong, and even from scattered conversations, he can sense that the sword cultivators are more curious than fearful.
Though Misty Sea naturally has demon beasts, the appearance of a water flood dragon is indeed rare.
The sword cultivators are going with the purpose of observing and preventing harm from spreading.
Junior Sister An Li, after staying awake for two days and nights and in high-stress situations, finally reached a safe place and quickly fell asleep.
Song Yan sat cross-legged beside her, quietly regulating his breath and sensing the surroundings.
Suddenly, he paused, as he sensed something seemed to be crawling up from the nearby lake water, two of them, rustling quietly, with little movement and well-concealed auras. Once ashore, the two swiftly darted away.
He furrowed his brows slightly, remembering that Tian Xiaoling was still on Jingyi Island.
The little one is Tian Xiaojiu’s niece and was brought into the sect by him.
If unfortunate enough to die from this trivial matter, it would certainly unsettle his mood.
It’s like planting a seed in the soil which he usually wouldn’t care for, but if something devoured it right in front of him, he naturally would be displeased.
However, he had barely moved when he heard a startled shout from afar.
"Elder of the Crimson Palace?! How come there’s a sword cultivator of your level on this island?"
"Who are you?"
Though the voice was disguised, it bore a sharp edge.
Soon, a calm voice responded: "I’m but an ordinary island guardian for the Sword Sect, just on duty today."
Both sides quieted down.
The calm voice continued: "I know you two are fox demons, but I don’t intend to intervene. Our Sword Sect doesn’t wish to invite trouble, you should return to where you came from."
Listening to this, Song Yan felt speechless.
Not everyone in the Sword Sect is as reckless as Junior Sister Xiaojiu.
What is this Elder doing?
Not wanting to invite trouble, yet letting the fox demon spies slip away amidst the chaos, isn’t that inviting even greater trouble?
You should either not reveal yourself and swiftly eliminate the two fox demons. By showing yourself and explaining that "our Sword Sect doesn’t want to invite trouble", what is that supposed to accomplish?
However, he isn’t a caretaker of the Sword Sect, nor an ancestral figure; the Sword Sect has its own operational rules unless something akin to the "Jingzhe Konglan Mountain" event arises—"Puppet Sect high-level officials fleeing, Sword Sect high-level officials facing destruction"—he’d hardly bat an eyelid, not to mention take action.
...
...
The distant storm lasted for more than half an hour, the entire Warm Water Island appeared as if it had been washed by lake water, and eventually, the sounds of battle subsided.
Another hour passed, seemingly the sword cultivators completed their search around Warm Water Island and confirmed no danger, only then did Song Yan return with Junior Sister An Li.
As soon as they landed on the island, they saw a flood dragon lying in the center of the cultivation square, its scales were a deep blue, its body over ten yards long, with small ice-blue bumps on its forehead.
Many people were already standing around the flood dragon.
Water dripped everywhere from treetop to rooftop, further emphasizing the quietness of the place.
This quietness revealed a strange atmosphere.
Junior Sister An Li immediately saw the burly man leading on the left side of the flood dragon, thus she lowered her head to look at her toes, but when stepping forward, she gathered the courage to speak aloud "I’m sorry, Uncle Luo, I failed in alchemy", yet someone beside her spoke on her behalf first.
"Uncle Luo, the flood dragon struck the island and stirred up a storm, causing the temperature of the alchemy furnace to drop several times, despite the emergency use of Fire Crystal Vine, it was of no avail." Song Yan apologized sincerely, explaining the circumstances, then took out a pill bottle from his storage bag, poured out the mishmash pill, and smiled bitterly, "Uncle Luo, please have a look."
Luo Wangsun glanced at the wasted pill, knowing its toxic nature and strong taste, he had no need for it, thus he didn’t even take it, simply laughed, "No worries, let you two youngsters research it, might still have some uses."
"How is that possible?!" Junior Sister An Li suddenly raised her head, "Uncle Luo, punish us! It’s all our fault! We failed to do it right!"
Luo Wangsun gently looked at An Li, then slowly raised his head to look at the person opposite, saying, "Great Elder, you’ve seen it, the Ghost Shark Essence Blood I meticulously prepared is all ruined because of this monster.
The Water Abyss Flood Dragon and the Ghost Shark both belong to the water category demons, which suits me exceptionally well; this flood dragon should be given to me."
The Great Elder stared at the Water Abyss Flood Dragon, speaking in a deep voice, "I cannot agree with you due to certain reasons. However, preparation for refining this pill can begin..."
Luo Wangsun replied, "Alright! Then leave it to An Li and Bai Xiuhu for refining."
As soon as the words fell, the Great Elder said, "No way!"
Luo Wangsun asked, "An Li is a Pill Master of the Su Family, but Bai Xiuhu belongs to your Sun Family, why not?"
The Great Elder glanced at the flood dragon then replied, "But Bai Xiuhu now resides on Warm Water Island, which is the Su Family’s territory; perhaps because of An Li, he’s already completely biased towards your Su Family?
For fairness, an experienced pill master from the Sun Family must also participate in the pill refining, as these two youngsters inevitably lack experience, even a mere Ghost Shark Crimson Palace Pill would be a challenge to refine, having another experienced pill master would be beneficial."
The air suddenly became quiet.
Song Yan looked at the Great Elder in surprise, feeling the Elder was rather odd.
Upon saying this today, the once-close Su and Sun Families would directly forge a rift, wouldn’t they?
If it were ordinary disciples speaking, it would be one thing, but as the Great Elder, the weight is entirely different.
Suddenly, Song Yan recalled the scenario from the days before, "the attack of a fake Song Yan", and seeing the current demeanor of the Great Elder, he suddenly became enlightened.
The fox and wolf races are desperate, thus they are trying to stir chaos, aiming to cause disturbances and see if amidst the turmoil he, Song Yan, would surface.
He is sure that this Water Abyss Flood Dragon was deliberately released by the fox and wolf races, with intentions similar to "Two peaches kill three warriors".
In past history, those "three warriors" used to have a good relationship, yet someone simply exploited "face" to estrange and eliminate all three.
If "face" alone can kill, what about enmity hindering one’s path?
The overall "level" on the Mountain and Sea Demon Country side is bound to be higher than Three Kingdoms, Song Yan almost deduced the fox and wolf’s next step—the pill recipe for refining the Water Abyss Flood Dragon.
That pill recipe might suddenly emerge from somewhere within days, able to push "the Great Elder and Luo Wangsun’s conflict to the extreme", thereby inducing internal strife in the Sword Sect.
But internal strife isn’t outright chaos.
The Sword Sect may develop cracks but won’t straightforwardly collapse.
So, if he were the fox and wolf races, the next step is obvious—brothers quarrel within walls, then taking advantage of the chaos to attack.
As for the attackers...
Song Yan pondered for a moment and arrived at a small conjecture: the Puppet Sect, Sword Sect’s mortal enemy, might be the one.
And the Puppet Sect...
His Divine Sense flickered, scanning the three cages subdued beneath him within the Ice Hell.
One person, complexion pale, eyes vacant yet cruel, this is the Paperpeak Senior Brother— Gong Libai, Early Stage Crimson Palace.
One person, face full of rashes, a dwarfish old woman, Middle Stage Crimson Palace, who is the Blood Corpse Peak Master—"Blood Granny" Blood Cliff.
And the third cage originally belonged to him, had now one more person, this one was burly, injured all over, short-haired with a fierce face, appearing as if surrounded by flowing flames.
While parting with Blood Granny then, Song Yan had given her a secret order, which was to give "the third Ice Floating Life Bracelet to the Mechanical Peak or Bizarre Poison Peak Master".
Now, it seems Blood Granny succeeded.
This short-haired man looks very likely to be the Mechanical Peak Master.
Three of the Puppet Sect’s four peaks are now under his control, though not overt, doesn’t mean he hasn’t mastered the situation.
Then...
If the Puppet Sect wishes to use the chaos to attack the Sword Sect.
Then let them come.
Whether left hand to right hand, or right hand to left hand, he won’t be at a disadvantage.
By grasping the situation in the Three Kingdoms and occupying a good vantage point, a slight inference would reveal the whole picture.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 122. The Puppet Sect has attacked! (3.0K words - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: 122. The Puppet Sect has attacked! (3.0K words - Please subscribe)
A few days later...
As Song Yan had anticipated, the Crimson Palace Pill recipe of the Water Abyss Flood Dragon mysteriously appeared at a marketplace, only to be discovered by Sword Sect disciples out on errands.
Since both Sun Family and Su Family were present for purchases, no one could conceal it.
The recipe for the Crimson Palace Pill of the Water Abyss Flood Dragon was like a massive stone thrown into the Sword Sect’s pond, stirring up endless waves.
The tension between the Sun Family and the Su Family began to escalate.
Once all the herbs needed for the Water Abyss Flood Dragon’s Crimson Palace Pill were collected, neither side would allow the other’s Pill Master to perform alchemy, not even jointly, insisting first on deciding to whom the elixir should belong.
As for the essence blood of the Water Abyss Flood Dragon, it was locked away, sealed in a secret chamber, and jointly monitored by the experts of both Sun Family and Su Family, not allowing anyone to take it.
Luo Wangsun claimed that his Ghost Shark’s Crimson Palace Pill was destroyed because of this Water Abyss Flood Dragon, and as it suited him well, the flood dragon should belong to him.
The Grand Elder avoided mentioning the crack in the Sword Heart, only stating that the Water Abyss Flood Dragon’s Crimson Palace Pill was immensely important to him and couldn’t be given up, giving Sun Family’s promise of substantial compensation if Luo Wangsun would back down.
...
...
On the other side, during the journey back from purchases.
Sword Sect’s Elder Su Hongxian was looking at the Fox Demon and the Giant Wolf before him, smiling bitterly.
The Giant Wolf grinned menacingly, baring its teeth.
The Fox Demon in a red robe chuckled, its furtive eyes fixed on the Elder named "Su Hongxian," teasing, "Have you made up your mind?"
Su Hongxian took a deep breath after a long time, then nodded, saying, "Just this once, and let me make it clear, I’m doing this for my Su Family, absolutely not for you."
The red-robed Fox Demon said with a smile, "Even though it appears as provocation, it indeed benefits your Su Family. This talisman is called the Tiny Earth Element Talisman, obtained by our Fox Race from other cultivators."
"Use it, it can let you walk through earth unseen, to secretly take the Water Abyss Flood Dragon, aiding your Su Family’s Ancestor Luo."
Su Hongxian took it and swiftly departed.
This elder was the one who had let go "the two young Fox Demons, not wanting any trouble" earlier that day.
A fly doesn’t rest on an unbroken egg.
This elder is the crack on the egg.
A person who compromises once will compromise a second time.
Naturally, the Fox Wolf targeted him, and with some pressure and enticement, indeed... this elder agreed to work for them, while also justifying his actions as righteous.
The red-robed Fox Demon watched his departing figure, glanced at the Giant Wolf beside him, and said, "The Mortal World has been turned upside down by those young ones, so let’s stir things between the two largest sects in the Three Kingdoms. If Song Yan still doesn’t reveal himself, then we will just wait."
General Gu said, "The other two have already headed to the Desolate Wilderness, feasting daily under Song Yan’s banner, having a great time. Though, they’ve also made sure that the lad won’t escape."
...
...
Over a month later...
Su Hongxian extinguished the candle flame, then took out the "Tiny Earth Element Talisman."
The pure Earth Profound Qi within the talisman surprised and terrified him.
Because such "Tiny Earth Element Talismans" couldn’t be crafted here, nor was there any "Earth realm rich in Earth Profound Qi" here, it was evident... the outside world is much larger than he thought.
Countless thoughts flashed through Su Hongxian’s mind, and he gritted his teeth, injecting a large amount of profound Qi. The Tiny Earth Element Talisman ignited in flames.
The next instant, Su Hongxian disappeared from the spot.
When he reappeared, he was holding a box in his hand.
Inside this box was precisely the "Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood."
"Everything is for the Su Family."
Su Hongxian bit his teeth, then carefully stored the box into his storage bag, preparing to find a time to hand it to Luo Wangsun.
...
...
On the bamboo bed.
Song Yan hugged An Li Junior Sister from behind.
Junior Sister sighed gently, sorrowfully saying, "How could this suddenly happen? Today, cultivators from the Sun Family are calling you back to Red Leaf Island, saying that’s where you should stay.
Also, some Sun Family elites who had come to Su Family have already left.
The elites of Su Family have returned from Sun Family.
Why is it like this?"
An Li Junior Sister was grieving, but suddenly seeming to sense something, she was startled, turned, and heavily struck Song Yan, saying, "Senior Brother, at this time, how can you still be thinking about that!"
Then she said nervously, "Senior Brother Bai, you wouldn’t go to Sun Family too, would you?"
Song Yan shook his head, An Li Junior Sister turned and threw herself into his arms...
...
The next day.
The Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood was stolen, both Sun Family and Su Family were furious, and began searching everywhere.
...
A month later...
Luo Wangsun went out, only to be targeted, and it was discovered that the missing "Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood" was in his possession.
The Grand Elder struck out in anger.
Both sides fought fiercely.
The conflict between Sun Family and Su Family nearly reached a complete boiling point.
Song Yan did nothing, merely watched quietly, waiting, and suddenly, on this day, a Sword Rainbow descended from high in the sky, stopping far off the coast of Warm Water Island, and loudly declared, "Bai Xiuhu! Your venerable master is near his end, will you return to Sun Family, or not!!"
In the alchemy room, An Li’s face turned pale; her eyes were brimming with tears as she thought, "If my Dao companion goes this time, he might never return. But if my master’s time is near, how can I not go back?"
The two embraced tightly, bidding a reluctant farewell.
Song Yan returned to Red Leaf Island, initially suspecting the Sun Family’s deceit, but upon seeing for himself, found that Sword Master Kuye was indeed failing.
The elder’s hair was white, his frail and skinny body showed no signs of recovery from erysipelas. He had planned to die in battle at Konglan Mountain during last year’s Jingzhe but was fortuitously delayed.
But now, he could no longer hold on.
The old man tightly grasped Song Yan’s hand, tears welling in his eyes, and said bitterly, "Had I known the Sword Sect would end like this, I should have died at Konglan Mountain back then."
Song Yan patiently comforted him, engaging in conversation with Sword Master Kuye until Meng Po arrived, and he stepped aside. However... naturally, he couldn’t return to Warm Water Island either.
...
Several days later.
Sword Master Kuye and Meng Po both passed away in their bamboo dwelling.
Song Yan cremated them, placing their ashes in spirit urns which were sent to the Sword Sect’s ancestral hall.
Meanwhile, he was reassigned to an alchemy room on Copper Sparrow Island, working alongside other pill masters.
...
Days passed one after another, Song Yan remained patient. Unable to return, he focused on alchemy, eyeing a bottle of demon beast essence blood—Wind Profound Crane—at the Sun Family’s alchemy room.
This Wind Profound Crane, an advanced demon beast of Wind Spirit Finch, enhanced a cultivator’s speed and agility.
It’s said this ’Wind Profound Crane’ blood was used by the First Elder to designate the Second Central Palace.
The First Elder, being the top expert of the Sword Sect, had extensively used this ’Wind Profound Crane Essence Blood.’
Thus, Song Yan essentially confirmed ’Phantom Shark’ and ’Wind Profound Crane’ as the left and right Central Palace blood for his ’Multi-tailed Fox.’
As for the ’Third Central Palace,’ he placed his hopes on the ’Corpse-Eating Wolf Race.’
For the same reason as the ’Multi-tailed Fox Race,’ it allowed refining.
....
While Song Yan’s enthusiasm toward alchemy grew, Grandma Hong and old General Gu’s patience had been exhausted.
The two demons felt as if they were performing a solo act, setting flashy traps. First was the ’Auspicious Commerce Soul Gold Stone,’ and now there’s ’the internal strife within the Southern Wu Sword Sect.’ Beyond these, they commanded their underlings in various mortal cities to lay out plans, from large cities to small villages, traps were everywhere.
This wide search wouldn’t be possible outside due to hidden powers and too many dangers. But because the Three Kingdoms were in a remote southern wilderness, it was feasible.
Grandma Hong said, "I’ve found Blood Cliff, the current Sect Leader of the Puppet Sect, ready to take action."
General Gu replied indifferently, "Whatever, I’m done searching for Song Yan.
That name disgusts me, I’m uncomfortable with it, it’s vile.
I’ve never met someone who can hide better.
I have no interest here anymore. Anyway, another group is infiltrating the north; I plan to disguise as Song Yan for some amusement."
If it were last year, Grandma Hong would have energetically objected and proposed new schemes.
But now, even Grandma Hong felt thoroughly bored.
General Gu added, "I’m also uninterested in the Puppet Sect and Sword Sect skirmish. It’s so dull; I’ll return to glean some benefits after they’re through."
Grandma Hong said, "Fine, I’ll go with you."
After speaking, she sighed deeply, "Indeed, it’s terribly boring."
...
In a moment, autumn had arrived.
The Sword Sect conflict slightly subsided.
Luo Wangsun, defeated, was both ashamed and angry, leaving the Sword Sect.
The First Elder secretly ordered the Sun Family’s pill masters to overnight refine the ’Water Abyss Flood Dragon Crimson Palace Pill.’
Song Yan, naturally, was part of it.
This refining of Crimson Palace demon pills took quite a long time.
Whereas the ’Phantom Shark’ required three days and nights, the ’Water Abyss Flood Dragon’ needed a full ten days and nights to complete.
Various rare herbs and fire-enhancing spirit wood were placed in the Copper Sparrow Island alchemy room.
In the center, a grand cauldron burned fiercely.
Song Yan, along with two other pill masters from the Sun Family, took turns in vigilance, without resting a single day for fear of mishaps.
...
Suddenly, tumultuous battle cries echoed from afar.
The Sun Family pill master, standing beside Song Yan, looked out in astonishment, vaguely seeing the northern sky tinged with red.
It was a twisted and eerie kind of red, yet familiar to any Sword Sect disciple.
This red appeared during last year’s Jingzhe, causing a great battle, which ended with the Sword Sect’s joint effort and some external factors.
But now, the Sword Sect was no longer united.
The Sun Family pill master was shocked, and in the distant night came the panic-stricken cries of disciples: "The Puppet Sect, it’s the Puppet Sect! The Puppet Sect is attacking!!"
Song Yan glanced into the distance, resuming his alchemy work.
He gazed deeply at the alchemy furnace, feeling somewhat peculiar.
Unexpectedly, after all this time, the ’Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood’ was about to fall into his hands.
Thus, the ’Phantom Shark’ turned out to be unnecessary.
The Sun Family pill master, observing his calm demeanor, couldn’t help admiring him silently, saying: "Xiuhu Junior Brother, truly composed."

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 123. See the master, please enter the urn (4.3K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: 123. See the master, please enter the urn (4.3K words - please subscribe)
Late at night, the sky was filled with red light, obscuring the moonlight.
On the horizon, it seemed as if a gigantic red octopus had emerged, extending its long red tentacles into the deep sky.
In the distance, thunderous noises filled the air as sword rainbows soared through the sky. However, not all were heading to the frontline; some were hastily retreating to the rear.
Those heading to the frontline were naturally the more powerful sword cultivators, while those returning to the rear included new entry-level disciples, sword cultivators whose realm was insufficient, and important figures such as Pill Masters and Talisman Masters.
Without Luo Wangsun, a patriarch like him to guard, even the main island of the Su Family was no longer safe, so the current head of the family, the second in charge, Su Yingren, ordered some family cultivators to retreat to Luoxia Bamboo Island.
Others might not know, but Su Yingren was aware that Yu Xuanwei was currently on Luoxia Bamboo Island.
In this situation, it was highly likely that the latter had already stepped out of the hall and begun setting up more arrays.
With layers upon layers of arrays, coupled with the small size of Luoxia Bamboo Island, it was enough to become a safe haven.
As for the Sun Family’s line, they were retreating to Copper Sparrow Island.
On the frontline, where the Sun and Su families had originally been united as one, they were now tacitly divided into two sides, each fighting independently, ignoring each other.
The earlier battle between the Grand Elder and Luo Wangsun had unleashed true qi, as evident from Luo Wangsun being driven away. Such clashes between patriarchs inevitably affected other cultivators from both families.
For instance, Su Hongxian, who used a minor Earth Element Talisman to steal the Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood, got caught in the conflict and was severely injured. Currently recuperating on the island, upon hearing the battle up front, he too fled hurriedly to the rear.
...
Hoo, hoo, hoo!
Song Yan wielded a Peach Palm Fan, fanning wind into the alchemy furnace to increase the temperature of the mortal fire.
In these recent days, he had come to understand some additional information about flames.
It’s said that the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace marks a small qualitative change.
It’s not about a sudden surge in power, but once reaching the late stage, one develops a kind of Qi Blood True Flame within. This true flame far exceeds mortal fire, making it a certainty for casting a profound artifact, and even capable of casting a profound treasure. In alchemy, one can also attempt higher-level elixirs.
If before the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace, there were still subdivisions like Caster and Pill Master, by the late stage, it was purely a matter of personal skill.
This can actually be faintly observed from the Early Stage of Crimson Palace.
In the early stage, one’s hands can already generate high heat, directly melting ordinary iron, and free shaping it, let alone in the late stage?
Hoo!
Another gust of wind, and suddenly a shout came from outside the room.
"Uncle Bai! Uncle Bai!"
Song Yan looked through the window and saw a skinny little girl wearing a silver sword robe, holding a practice flying sword, nervously gazing this way.
It was Tian Xiaojiu’s niece, Tian Xiaoling.
His expression shifted slightly as he looked at the collaborating Pill Master beside him.
The Pill Master said, "Brother Bai, go on. This isn’t the crucial moment for the elixir, there’s no harm in it."
Song Yan put down the Peach Palm Fan and quickly went outside.
Seeing him, Tian Xiaoling’s eyes reddened, and she ran from afar, throwing herself into the arms of the man who had led her onto the path of cultivating profound, crying out, "Uncle Bai, Uncle Bai!"
Song Yan tenderly patted the little girl’s head, glancing around at the sword rainbows shooting through the sky. Suddenly, he saw an acquaintance and shouted from afar, "Senior Sister Zhang, please wait!"
In the distance, a sword rainbow paused as if identifying the voice. Recognizing Song Yan, it turned and approached but did not land, hovering above Copper Sparrow Island.
This Senior Sister Zhang was the beautiful female cultivator from the Su Family whom Tian Xiaojiu had escorted to Red Leaf Island and whom Song Yan had treated. She was currently escorting some Su Family disciples back to Luoxia Bamboo Island, passing by Copper Sparrow Island. Yet, mindful of her Su Family identity, she refused to step on a bit of the land here.
The female cultivator named Zhang asked from mid-air, "Brother Bai, what’s the matter?"
Song Yan inquired, "Have you seen Junior Sister An Li?"
The female cultivator named Zhang replied, "An Li is an important Pill Master of our Su Family; she has naturally been escorted to Luoxia Bamboo Island."
Song Yan breathed a sigh of relief, then patted the child in his arms and said, "This is the niece of Junior Sister Xiaojiu, take her to Luoxia Bamboo Island."
The female cultivator named Zhang was startled and then descended.
Song Yan ruffled Tian Xiaoling’s hair, saying, "Your aunt’s old friend, follow her, Luoxia Bamboo Island is safer."
Tian Xiaoling timidly nodded, then walked toward the female cultivator named Zhang with a gentle push from Song Yan. But she had only gone half the distance when a cultivator nearby admonished, "This is a seed of our Sun Family’s cultivators. Bai Xiuhu, what do you mean by letting her go with the Su Family?"
Song Yan glanced at him, flicked his fingers, causing a flying sword to clang out of its sheath, hovering around him, coldly looking at him and said, "Sun Family, Su Family, is this never-ending?"
After speaking, he glanced at Tian Xiaoling and said, "Go."
The female cultivator named Zhang looked deeply at Song Yan, took Tian Xiaoling, and quickly departed.
The Sun Family cultivator behind coldly looked at Song Yan, but seeing the direction of the alchemy room and the fierce battle raging in the distance, he merely sneered briefly before leaving.
Song Yan gazed into the distance, feeling a few inevitable emotions: For so many years, the Sword Sect hadn’t fallen during the time of Granny Hu or the time of Gu Huangzi. All those storms were weathered, but now... internal strife was rising, making it harder to resist external threats.
Today, there wasn’t even a need for him to act; the Sword Sect had already fallen.
...
About half an hour later, a crisp cracking sound came from the center of the northern array shield. A silver-white crack formed from the heart of the transparent shield, then quickly spread to both sides with cracking sounds, causing the sky covering the Sword Sect to be threaded with dense spider patterns.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 123. See the master, please enter the urn (4.3K words - seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: 123. See the master, please enter the urn (4.3K words - seeking subscription)_2
Boom!!
The array shield shattered!
The outer Evil Qi shadow puppets, papermen, blood corpses, and various demons quickly surged in.
The alchemy room on Copper Sparrow Island was in chaos, the Sun family pill master was so anxious he was drenched in sweat, but the alchemy furnace contained "Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood." If the alchemy were abandoned halfway through, it would all be ruined!
He muttered anxiously, "What to do, what to do?"
However, no matter how nervous he was, his junior brother Bai always appeared very calm in his eyes.
The shouts and sounds of killing from afar grew closer, soon arriving outside the Sun family’s Copper Sparrow Island.
In Copper Sparrow Island, Elder shouted angrily, and together with the two early stage Crimson Palace Elders still on the island, rose with their swords.
The Sun family pill master breathed a sigh of relief, murmuring as if to comfort himself, "With the Elder, plus Elders Zhao and Wang, everything will be fine, everything will be fine..."
But just as he finished speaking, he heard the Elder’s startled cry from above.
"Blood Cliff! Copper Beard! Now the Peak Masters of Puppet Three Peaks, two have come! Ha, there’s also quite a lot of early stage Crimson Palace young demons here, they really think highly of this old man! Come on!"
In the alchemy room, the Sun family pill master’s brow twitched, showing a bitter smile as he looked at the calm Song Yan and said, "Junior Brother Bai, will Elder... Elder be able to win?"
Song Yan said, "Of course, evil cannot prevail over good."
"Yes, yes, yes, evil cannot prevail over good, evil cannot prevail over good," the Sun family pill master took deep breaths repeatedly.
Just at this moment, a miserable scream came from the sky.
The Sun family pill master jumped up in shock, screaming, "Elder Zhao is dead!"
Moments later.
Another miserable scream was heard.
The Sun family pill master was dumbfounded, "Another one is dead!!"
Then, suddenly from outside came the Elder’s hoarse and slightly mournful laughter, along with a stern question.
"Was the Water Abyss Flood Dragon concocted by your Puppet Sect on purpose?"
"No."
A muffled voice responded.
The Elder was taken aback, then began laughing manically at the sky, standing suspended, his eyes full of devastation, witnessing the destruction and downfall of the major islands in the Misty Sea.
"My fault, my fault! If not for a moment’s mistake, if I hadn’t drawn my sword against my heart’s intent. If I hadn’t fought with my fellow disciples, resulting in injuries, how would it have come to this? How would it have come to this..."
"I am ashamed in the sect’s eyes, ashamed to my master."
"Demon, you seek my body to make blood corpse papermen, but don’t even think about it! And that demon Song, you want my soul to become a ghost, that’s wishful thinking!
Though I cannot protect my home in life, in death... I will not be used by you!!"
In an incredibly passionate shout, a soft bang was heard from midair, but it merely echoed lightly and then was silent.
Immediately following was Blood Granny’s "jie jie jie jie" laughter, and a hoarse strange laugh, "I was long prepared for your self-destruction."
She thought for a moment, then a blood corpse covered in glistening white fur suddenly appeared behind the extremely weak Elder, gently twisting his neck, then throwing it into the nearby coffin holding important corpse resources.
With the Elder’s death, the entire Copper Sparrow Island plunged into momentary silence, followed by countless sword rainbows madly shooting outward, desperately escaping, but numerous demon shadows pursued them.
In the alchemy room, the Sun family pill master also shouted in fear, abandoning any concern about alchemy.
The Elder’s death shattered his pillar of support, leaving him as lost as a stray dog, only concerned with fleeing southward, towards Luoxia Bamboo Island in a panic.
On Copper Sparrow Island, everyone was gone, scattering like birds and beasts.
On the island, houses and palaces collapsed one by one.
The alchemy room also instantly fell silent, leaving only one cultivator in a silver sword robe still fanning the fire under the alchemy furnace absentmindedly.
Knock, knock, knock!
A polite, even cautious knocking came from outside the alchemy room.
The knocking was neither heavy nor light, fearing to offend or that the person inside wouldn’t hear it, so the sound was just right.
After knocking three times, without receiving a response, it did not resume, but waited patiently.
Until there came a faint voice from the room saying "Come in," the person outside then pushed the door open and walked in.
In the center, there was a dwarf old hag with a face full of blotches, on the left was a burly man with short hair and a fierce expression, and on the right was a pale-faced youth with cunning eyes.
These three were precisely Blood Corpse Peak Master Blood Cliff, now the outward Puppet Sect Leader; Mechanical Peak Master Copper Beard; and Paperman Peak Master Gong Libai.
Their expressions varied as they fell upon the man fanning himself.
And Bai Xiuhu’s appearance had long vanished, replaced by Song Yan.
The three respectfully said in unison, "Greetings, Master."
Song Yan glanced over them with a smile and said, "I thought you might take advantage of the chaos to kill me."
Blood Granny shuddered and quickly replied, "I wouldn’t dare, wouldn’t dare."
Copper Beard lowered his burly frame, cautiously appraising the seemingly unremarkable man, chuckling in the earnest manner of a simple man, "Others may not know, but we three do, who among us doesn’t know the Master holds the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, and is infused with Changwang Tiger Race Blood.
Our lives are but a thought away from the Master.
Besides, the bracelet’s nourishing of the Divine Soul is truly useful, coupled with the Master’s strength, we all see limitless prospects, hehe."
Gong Libai instantly dropped to his knees, facing this junior disciple he had barely met a few times, joy filling his face as he said, "Congratulations, Master! My felicitations, Master!"
Song Yanqi asked, "What is there to celebrate?"
Gong Libai replied, "Past sect leaders held only the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, never had the Changwang Tiger Race Blood, but the Master controls both.
The old ghost Gu Huangzi only managed to strike down the Ancestor by ambushing him during weakness.
Yet Master defeated Gu Huangzi during his peak, one-on-one. Master, you are the strongest sect leader in the history of our Puppet Sect!"
Song Yan felt the flattering atmosphere starkly different from that of the Sword Sect, pondered for a moment, and looked to Blood Cliff, asking, "How many cultivators above Crimson Palace Realm do we have in Puppet Sect?"
Blood Cliff hurriedly replied, "Five in Middle Stage, eleven in Early Stage, but rest assured, Master, Copper Beard and I can maintain control, combined with Gong Libai, the Puppet Sect is already in hand."
Song Yan said, "Gong Libai, go out and manage things. On Luoxia Bamboo Island, make a show of attacking a few times, but don’t assault strongly."
Gong Libai chuckled and said, "I always follow the Master’s commands; if the Master asks me east, I won’t go west. Rest assured, Master, your orders will be carried out discreetly!"
With that, he turned and swiftly left the room.
Song Yan solemnly looked at Blood Cliff, then asked, "Have you gauged the power of the Fox Wolves?"
Blood Cliff said, "Should still be Middle Stage, after Gu Huangzi’s death, they want to establish dominance by mobilizing us Puppet Sect, making us heed their commands. So naturally, they would act. When they did, I perceived their realm vaguely.
Strong indeed, strange as well, but still haven’t surpassed the Middle Stage boundary.
Unless, they’re still hiding something."
Song Yan was a bit surprised, thinking they would be Late Stage Crimson Palace, but since there might be hidden strength, he wouldn’t be careless.
He continued to ask, "What news do you have about the Fox Wolf Nine Palace Blood?"
Blood Cliff said, "This time, the ones mobilizing us to attack Sword Sect were Red Granny and Old General from the Fox and Wolf Races.
Red Granny is much like the previous Fox Old Granny, multi-tailed, a dragon’s uncle, capable of devouring flesh to spawn many little fox pups, other details unknown.
Old General’s howling seems able to control blood, possibly a unique form of sound wave attack."
"Sound wave attack?"
Song Yan, upon hearing this unfamiliar term, truthfully, in the Three Kingdoms with cultivators and demon beast secret realms he’s visited quite a lot, but "sound wave attack" was indeed rare.
Beside him, Copper Beard with a booming voice said, "Master, give the order, I, Copper Beard, know you’re up to something big today, already brought all the gear.
Let me tell you from the heart, that fox wolf stench, I can smell it from miles away.
I assure you, in today’s chaos, it will be a banquet for them, without a doubt they’ll jump out to feast."
Song Yan glanced at the alchemy furnace, suddenly raising his sleeve to cast out the Traceless Array flag, the flag fell in four places, positioned unobtrusively around the alchemy room corners, then said, "Today, act as rehearsed. Using the Elder and other Crimson Palace Stage cultivators’ corpses, lay a trap near the alchemy room, then lead them into the snare!
I’ll say this upfront, on usual days you hide or linger as you wish, I don’t care, but today... if anyone thinks to keep cards up their sleeve or stay behind, I’ll certainly settle scores afterward."
In Puppet Sect, those shouting loudly "Charge" but retreating themselves were not few.
Blood Granny and Copper Beard paused, hurriedly agreed, then cautiously exited the alchemy room.
Once the door closed, Song Yan kicked the alchemy furnace over, retrieving the half-finished Water Abyss Flood Dragon Crimson Palace Pill inside, then walked into the array, his figure hidden, his aura gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 124. I’m hungry (2.8K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: 124. I’m hungry (2.8K words - please subscribe)
Outside the alchemy room, chaos reigned, with battles raging endlessly.
Inside the alchemy room, although the alchemy furnace had collapsed and medicine racks were in disorder, there was a strange kind of quietness.
And in its corner...
Swish, swish, swish!
"Wind Profound Crane Essence Blood", "Ghost Shark Wasted Pill", and "Half-formed Water Abyss Flood Dragon Wasted Pill" were laid out one by one on the ground.
Choose two of the three to build the Left and Right Two Palaces at the middle stage of the Crimson Palace.
As for abilities, whether intentionally or unintentionally collected over this period, Song Yan also had a more detailed understanding of them.
Now, with the great battle imminent, he needed to review it one more time to confirm his final choices.
The Wind Profound Crane can increase his speed and enhance agility, which is quite suitable for sword cultivators, but its primary trait is "agility" rather than "speed." Beyond that, its "speed" only works in normal environments; if underwater or such specific environments, the boost is severely limited, not to mention the mysterious "Earth Element" and so on.
The Ghost Shark increases speed when the surrounding environment is "aquatic", especially underwater; it grants refinement ability of Water Escape if not possessed, and enhances Water Escape if already possessed; furthermore, the essence blood refiner can increase "Concealing Aura" and "Perception Shield" in the ocean, making oneself truly ghost-like.
The Water Abyss Flood Dragon, as a Crimson Palace Demon Beast, though only at the early stage, excels over the previous two in strength augmentation. The essence blood refiner not only experiences speed enhancement in "aquatic" environments, but also strength enhancement, possessing the same "Water Escape enhancement" as the Ghost Shark; additionally, the refiner would instinctively perform "Water Spells" that previously required "Water Talismans", "Water Treasures", or "Water Profound Root" to cast and would enhance them if already mastered.
Clearly, both the Ghost Shark and Water Abyss Flood Dragon lean towards "aquatic" environments.
The presence or absence of an "aquatic" environment results in entirely different effects.
Yet their functions don’t overlap completely but have differences.
The former includes "Water Concealing Aura, Perception Shield", highly practical, combined with Song Yan’s "Sword and Evil Dual Form Technique" evolved from "Hidden Sword Technique", as well as "Condensing Evil and Controlling Profound Technique" evolved from "Qi Concealment Technique", forming a triple concealed aura effect like adding wings to a tiger;
The latter includes "Water Spell enhancement", enabling any "Water Talisman Treasure" owned by the essence blood refiner to be enhanced.
Song Yan considered abandoning the Wind Profound Crane and refining these two demon bloods instead.
In the battle against Grandma Red and General Gu, he must exert all his efforts; thus, using Misty Sea with its vast aquatic expanses as the battlefield, "Ghost Shark" and "Water Abyss Flood Dragon" are quite suitable, while "Wind Profound Crane" seems "though more versatile, it can’t compare to the former two in aquatic environments."
With his thoughts settled, Song Yan began refining.
...
After dying again and again.
He successfully absorbed both.
The wasted pill is only considered so for humans, indicating its toxins might not decrease but increase, ensuring death upon consumption; however, in truth... as long as one dies enough times, success can still be achieved.
Line by line, information and insights emerged.
[You operate "Profound Sword Scripture", absorb Profound Qi to contain and digest "Ghost Shark" blood, while simultaneously converting Profound Qi into Sword Qi, nurturing Sword Qi with blood]
[By the eighth month, you absorbed 60 strands of Profound Qi, digested one strand of "Ghost Shark" blood, which was completely converted into Sword Qi...]
[After thirty-three years, you absorbed 3000 strands of Profound Qi, which successfully transformed into Sword Qi, with "Ghost Shark" blood fused under your Crimson Palace’s Left Palace, entwined with "Multi-tailed Fox Race" blood]
[Sword Qi interacts with "Ghost Shark" blood, allowing you to comprehend a trace of special Sword Qi——Profound Water Ghost Sword Qi]
[This Sword Qi can only be used underwater, formless and shapeless, not weakened by being underwater]
In an instant, a feeling of further enhancement emerged, accompanied by a sense of being "like a fish in water."
Song Yan sat on Copper Sparrow Island in the Misty Sea, feeling "this is my home ground."
The speed of absorbing Profound Qi increased once again.
Previously in Cold Pool Valley, consuming "Changwang Hu" Essence Blood took him 100 years.
On Red Leaf Island, consuming "Nightmare Beast" Essence Blood took him 50 years.
But on Copper Sparrow Island, merely in an alchemy room, not even in a cultivation square or special seclusion place, his cultivation time shortened to 33 years.
This fully demonstrates how crucial "where you cultivate" is.
Cultivating in Mortal World with little Profound Qi for a hundred years might not even compare to cultivating for a month in the center of Profound Veins, not to mention cultivators have various elixirs, small empowerment jades, heavenly materials, and earthly treasures to speed up cultivation.
Moments later...
Song Yan followed suit, spending 33 years to once again digest "Water Abyss Flood Dragon Essence Blood", with Qi Blood enhancement, comprehending a trace of new special Sword Qi——River Splitting Sword Qi.
This "River Splitting Sword Qi" might be the most "unconventional" among the six types of special Sword Qi Song Yan has mastered thus far.
The effect of this Sword Qi is "powerful"; one sword strike can break the river apart, stir a tide in still water, akin to a flood dragon entering the sea during a summer thunderstorm, rumbling mightily, emphasizing great power and intensity.
...
The Crimson Palace’s Nine Palaces were already filled with Six Palaces, Song Yan glanced at the panel: "[Lifespan: 34/11663]", and then looked at the Wind Profound Crane Essence Blood before carefully storing it in the Storage Bag.
If, in case he still couldn’t defeat the Fox Wolf Demons even then, he would find a place and use the Wind Profound Crane Essence Blood to forcibly break through to the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace.
After completing these tasks, he calmly scanned the battle outside the window, took in the surrounding water mist, and suddenly had a thought. He raised his hand to pull out a Fox Demon Shadow Puppet, transforming it into his own likeness, and hid it within the "Traceless Array".
Taking advantage of the opportunity, he concealed his Qi and went outside, moving like a ghost, stealthily diving directly into the depths of the Misty Sea, standing quietly at the lakebed, and patiently waiting.
The addition of the "Ghost Shark" and "Water Abyss Flood Dragon" Essence Blood allowed him to move freely underwater, and his agility was no different from being on land.
As for "Killing Charm" and similar talismans, he had prepared countless ones long ago.
...
...
"Fight, fight, fight... hehe..." Granny Red sat on a waterside reef, watching the distant battle, unable to help but savor the scent of blood.
Sniffing again, she turned to a pitch-black giant wolf beside her, saying, "Didn’t I tell you? Looking for food outside can’t compare to here. Watching humans fight each other is so amusing, haha."
General Gu paused and snorted coldly, "Dogs fighting each other? What’s wrong with dogs? You seem close to humans."
Granny Red replied, "Just saying, don’t be upset. You are of the great Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, having nothing in common with those lowly dogs."
General Gu raised his head, sniffing the distant air, drool trickling from his lips, he chuckled, "Even from this distance, I can smell the sweet scent of flesh and blood. Surely many from the Sword Sect died today. I’ll say it now, that Elder’s meat is mine."
Granny Red paid no heed; only when the sounds of battle from afar began to recede did she step off the reef and dart away, saying aloud, "It’s time."
General Gu grinned maliciously, "I’ve been waiting for those words."
The two demon shadows swept towards the distant island; if they encountered cultivators along the way, they would capture them, cut open their bowels to extract their hearts, consuming them with blood staining their fur, then casually discarding the bodies.
Today was a rare feast of extermination, with ample fresh meat, so... they would only eat the choicest parts.
The two demons, drawn by the scent of Qi Blood, arrived around Copper Sparrow Island.
General Gu took a quick sniff and rejoiced, "Forward! Just ahead!
I knew those demon cultivators would stash bodies!
With such a strong scent of blood, there must be at least five or six Crimson Palace Realm corpses piled up?
Good! Very good!"
He was about to charge forth when the red-robed fox suddenly pulled him back.
General Gu turned suddenly, baring his teeth in anger, "You dare stop me from eating?"
Granny Red’s crafty eyes turned, "Just looking for a better dining spot."
Surveying around, she settled on a water-centered sandbank only a few spans wide, then said, "There, let the demon cultivators bring the bodies to us, and we won’t go there."
"Why be so cautious," General Gu complained helplessly, but still complied with Granny Red’s suggestion.
The Fox and Wolf Races had partnered for long; through countless painful lessons, the Wolf Race learned to heed the Fox Race’s advice, while the Fox Race refrained from deceiving the Wolf Race, instead using their power in complement.
Snap!
The two demons landed on a sandbank near Copper Sparrow Island, grinning at the distant sight.
Then, General Gu raised his head, unleashing a terrifying wolf howl.
The howl carried hidden ominous power, causing the blood of all the nearby creatures to begin boiling, and the accelerated heartbeat in the malicious howl naturally induced fear.
From the sandbank as the source, many fish began rising to the surface, blood spurting from their eyes and mouths, while Low Level Water Demon Beasts cowered in the mud at the water’s bottom, daring not to move.
...
"Awoo~~~"
The wolf howl continued, spreading fear.
Amid the spreading fear, a sharp, sinister laughter pierced the air.
Then, a demon shadow started rapidly growing.
Measuring ten yards, dozens of yards, until in an instant it stretched skyward, its raised claws casting a shadow over the blood-red moon stained by Evil Qi, and three fox tails, like raging wolf smoke, twisted upwards.
The giant fox shadow gazed down on the distant island, playfully uttering three words: "I’m hungry."

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 125. Flash Sale (4.0K characters - Please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: 125. Flash Sale (4.0K characters - Please subscribe)
The demon shadow overwhelms the heavens, with the howls of wolves and the sinister laughter of foxes.
A brazen and unrestrained "I’m hungry" echoes from afar, heavily pressing upon Copper Sparrow Island.
The cultivators of the Sword Sect on Copper Sparrow Island, and all those resisting nearby, turn pale.
Even though Luoxia Bamboo Island is quite distant, it too can feel the demonic sound emanating from there.
Within the array, many sword cultivators are frightened out of their wits, while others display varied expressions: some wear helpless smiles, and others clench their fists in impotent rage.
Everyone feels utterly bewildered, unable to accept the reality before them.
How many years has the Nanwu Sword Sect stood in the Misty Sea Capital?
Is it all destroyed just like that?
But the Puppet Sect has broken the array and entered, with fox wolves attacking. Even hiding on Luoxia Bamboo Island is just a temporary respite; no one dares to think about tomorrow or whether this array shield can withstand the external enemy.
A petite female cultivator runs everywhere, looking around, asking everyone she meets, "Where is Senior Brother Bai? Has anyone seen Senior Brother Bai Xiuhu?"
Finally, a cultivator fleeing from afar picks up the topic, trembling as terrifying and eerie demon laughter echoes in the distance: "Junior Brother Xiuhu was ordered to refine the Crimson Palace Pill of the Water Abyss Flood Dragon. He... he was still in the Alchemy Room when I left."
An Li, her face ashen, runs to the reef behind the array shield, clasping her hands tightly, biting her lip, holding back tears, and looks into the distance, silently praying for Song Yan.
Yu Xuanwei had somehow already emerged, still wearing her face-covering cloak. Seeing An Li, an important young Pill Master, approach the edge, she gives a glance to a female cultivator beside her.
The female cultivator understands, quickly moves to An Li’s side, softly comforting and covertly protecting her.
...
...
When the words "I’m hungry" resounded, in reality, the most troubled were not the sword cultivators of the Nanwu Sword Sect but Blood Cliff and Copper Beard.
Both knew well the meaning of those three words: wasn’t it fearing danger on the island, so they needed to send the Crimson Palace Realm corpses to the designated place for those beasts to devour?
But the problem was that the master had set up an ambush on this island.
The words "I’m hungry" directly sabotaged this ambush.
So what now?
Blood Cliff and Copper Beard’s lives were in Song Yan’s hands; no one dared to spoil the master’s plan.
Their eyes met, the cunning gleam instantly signaling a plan.
They decided to play dumb, pretending not to hear.
As long as they pretended not to hear, the fox wolves would get angry, and in their anger, they would charge the island; if not angry, they’d come closer to see more clearly, either way, they’d still fall into the ambush.
But they couldn’t just do nothing because, since the fox wolves had shown power in the Puppet Sect, some disciples had already been replaced by young fox demons. In other words, fox demons disguised as Puppet Sect disciples now existed on this island.
If they did nothing, they’d be exposed to the eyes of the fox demons.
So, in almost an instant, Granny Blood sharply turned back and shouted fiercely towards a dark direction: "Sword Emperor Shui Bo?! I didn’t expect you to still be alive!"
After shouting, she rushed into the depths of Copper Sparrow Island.
On the other side, Copper Beard mumbled a few times, originally wanting to shout "Sword Emperor Shui Bo," but Blood Cliff beat him to it. So, after hesitating for a few moments, he clenched his fists and cursed: "Elder, you old guy, you actually used a puppet to fake your death too, huh, you think you can fool my eyes? Come, come, let’s battle another three hundred rounds!"
After speaking, who knows where Copper Beard ran off to.
Soon, intense sounds of battle reverberated from within the deep mountains of Copper Sparrow Island.
The two of them had hidden the coffin containing the Crimson Palace Realm corpses deep within.
The scent could spread out, but even Puppet Sect disciples couldn’t find it for a while.
...
In the distance...
Granny Hong had shouted "I’m hungry," but found no response, so she narrowed her eyes, letting her divine sense spread boldly towards Copper Sparrow Island.
However, when probing into the island’s depths, she found the profound qi there was extremely chaotic due to intense fighting. Her divine sense could only detect that there were Crimson Palace experts fighting, but could not discern the details.
General Gu remarked: "Oh, so the fight isn’t over yet," then laughed ominously: "That’s good, more food is always welcome."
Granny Hong glared at this brainless brute and said, "Don’t you find it suspicious?"
General Gu asked, "Suspicious how?"
Granny Hong replied, "I just asked them to send the corpses, and then they start fighting."
General Gu twisted his neck, rubbed his claws, and said viciously: "Suspicious, suspicious? You worry too much! Are you afraid of food?
Tch, forget it, if you don’t dare, I’ll go.
We’ve rampaged through the depths of the Puppet Sect before. This layout doesn’t look like a collaboration between the Puppet Sect and the Sword Sect, so why fear?"
With that, General Gu moved his body, shooting off into the distance, but as soon as he leaped out, he heard Granny Hong’s voice behind him.
"Don’t go on the island! Check the perimeter first to be sure."
General Gu sighed deeply and said helplessly: "Fine! As you wish!"
Then he added: "As before, you stay outside to support, I’ll be right back."
What he referred to as before was when he previously disguised himself as Song Yan, causing chaos at the Nanwu Sword Sect, capturing a sword cultivator disciple, and eating him in front of the Elder, thus breaking her Dao Heart.
Granny Hong thought to herself and nodded, feeling it satisfactory.
General Gu let out a wolf howl, moved swiftly over the water, and soon reached the edge of Copper Sparrow Island.
Closing this distance now made many things clearer, revealing the true outlines of the previously unclear mountain skirmishes.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 125. Spike (4.0K characters - asking for subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: 125. Spike (4.0K characters - asking for subscription)_2
Almost at the same time, the Ancient General noticed the two seemed to be fake fighting, and the two pretending to fight also realized this, thus unanimously stopping their actions.
Blood Cliff’s face turned cold, levitating in the air, standing atop a tall white-haired blood corpse, taking a deep breath, just about to say something, but was suddenly gestured to silence by Copper Beard beside him.
Blood Cliff frowned slightly.
Copper Beard softly said, "I know you don’t want to be at the forefront, you want to order all sect disciples to encircle and annihilate the Fox Wolf duo! But have you ever thought... Master is being watched by a Purple Mansion power.
Right now, no one knows that he is the true controller of the Puppet Sect. If you shout that out, when the Mountain and Sea Demon Country’s Purple Mansion power comes, we will all be implicated and suffer the misfortune."
"Let’s go ourselves, then no matter what the outcome, there’s still a chance of survival."
Blood Cliff sneered, "You think Master can’t see through your little schemes?
Since we’ve taken action today, even a fool would know that our Puppet Sect is controlled by Master.
Are you saying that the Purple Mansion Realm is even more foolish than a fool?
Do you think there’s still a way out?"
Copper Beard’s expression changed multiple times, his chest rising and falling, he roared angrily, "Dammit, let’s do it!"
With his resolve made, he leaped up swiftly, rushing toward the distant Ancient General, grabbed out an array plate from the void with his left hand, the array plate spinning rapidly, suddenly linking with the previously scattered six array flags around the waters of Copper Sparrow Island, forming a great array.
