However, this array was not a normal defense array, but seemed to possess both Absolute Profound and defense functions.
The so-called Absolute Profound Array was to isolate all of the Profound Qi within a certain area.
The location of the Ancient General, naturally, was also included in this array.
As the Peak Master of Mechanical Peak, he naturally had some research on arrays, although it didn’t include the cold and obscure Ancient Teleportation Array, but he was proficient in his own type of array.
Copper Beard’s specialty was to let both himself and his enemy fight in an area devoid of Profound Qi, then rely on his strong physique to smash the opponent.
At this time, he swung his right arm, grabbed out a long-handled hammer towards the Ancient General, and grimly smiled, "Want to eat? Come on!
I’ve disliked you for a long time!
If you don’t dare to come, then eat shit, don’t dogs like to eat shit, hahahaha!"
Seeing Copper Beard take action, Granny Blood already knew what he was going to do, so she had raised her position in advance, and at the moment the Absolute Profound Array formed, she left its range, then stood atop the array shield, loudly commanded, "Puppet Sect disciples heed the order, the Sect Leader is not dead, by order of the Sect Leader, slaughter the Fox Wolf duo on the spot!! Those who disobey will be skinned alive and die!!!!"
Her voice rolled out like thunder.
As for how the master hidden in the Alchemy Room would deal with the "Absolute Profound Array," Granny Blood was not worried.
A master who could directly kill Gu Huangzi wasn’t going to be unable to handle such an unexpected situation.
But if just in case it couldn’t be handled...
Then, hehehehe...
...
Blood Cliff’s order spread out, rendering almost the entire Misty Sea Capital silent for a moment.
Everyone naturally thought the "Sect Leader" Blood Cliff referred to was Gu Huangzi.
But Gu Huangzi was dead, almost everyone believed.
Now suddenly saying he’s alive again, even Granny Hong and the Ancient General were stunned for a moment.
However, these two demons only paused for a moment, the next instant, they saw numerous ferocious shadow puppets, paper men, and blood corpses turning towards them.
The Ancient General found it amusing.
He fixated on two Puppet Sect cultivators not far away, who were commanding puppets to fight but were timid and hesitant, suddenly pounced towards them, easily tore through their abdomens with one claw each, then brought them to his mouth, tore their necks left and right, blood spurting out, dyeing the Ancient General’s wolf face red.
As for the Absolute Profound Array, it seemed he didn’t care about it at all.
Before Copper Beard could settle, he already easily killed five Puppet Sect disciples.
Seeing Copper Beard closing in, the Ancient General tilted his head back, letting out a fierce wolf howl, causing the remaining Sword Sect disciples and Puppet Sect disciples around to vomit blood.
Even cultivators close by bled seven apertures.
Blood flowing in the air, extremely bizarre.
Boom!!
Copper Beard’s massive hammer missed its mark, looked left and right but found the Ancient General had disappeared.
Copper Beard’s fierce eyes were darting everywhere.
In the distance, Granny Hong yawned, surveying the distant Absolute Profound Array, recalling the other’s action, couldn’t help but laugh mischievously, "Hehehehe."
It was clear these edge-dwelling cultivators, who hadn’t seen the world, didn’t understand the terror of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race.
A trap of this level, so boring.
Seeing the opponent revealing their cards, it no longer cared for the Ancient General trapped in the Absolute Profound Array of Copper Sparrow Island, but instead set its sights on Blood Cliff afar, licking its lips.
Just then, numerous attacks were already upon it.
Granny Hong started shrieking, raising a massive shadow hand smashing down, smashing down one by one, paper men, blood corpses crumbling upon contact, even fierce shadow puppets exploding upon slight contact.
It didn’t care about the attacks on itself, as its enormous fox eyes locked onto Blood Cliff in the distance, jeering and repeating, "I’m hungry."
Granny Blood, reaching into the void, pulled out a yellow earth banner, her entire body standing high on the white-haired blood corpse, wearing a very solemn expression, chanting under her breath, her dried twig-like little arms gripping the long pole of the banner and began to wave it.
This waving seemed to consume a lot of power, but the effect was also very evident, the wind roared suddenly, flying sand and rolling stones, stones and wood on the surrounding islands flew wildly, the white-haired blood corpse suddenly vanished into this tornado of sand.
Granny Hong just watched with interest, the three snow-white tails behind it began to blaze, it raised its head looking down at the dwarf floating in mid-air, just about to strike, suddenly a very subtle strange sensation arose in its heart.
It was a peculiarity felt only through the sly nature of a fox demon from the Crimson Palace.
But this strange notion had just arisen, it hadn’t even figured out the source of this peculiarity when an ethereal light burst from an unknown location.
But no matter where the light was from, at the instant it appeared, it seized all of its attention, and it no longer had the mind to bother with the Puppet Sect disciples aiming to surround it or Blood Cliff battling it afar.
Why?
Because even though it only saw a little of that light, it already had warning bells ringing frantically in its heart, all its combat experience since cultivation frantically warned it of an impending crisis.
It had to use all its mind to face this crisis.
Granny Hong no longer cared about Blood Cliff in the distance, frantically seeking the source of the light.
But it was no longer important, the light consumed all its sight, each fleeting thought making the light more intense, and the Misty Sea seemed to be boiling, but the bubbling had not yet reached the surface, frozen in its view.
It finally saw the source of the light.
And then it saw a towering dragon head, bulging with broken silver scales, wrapped in malicious intent.
An invisible sword light pierced right through.
Stabbing its soul!
Granny Hong paused a moment.
The Demon Dragon surged forward with a jolt!
Terror-stricken!
Granny Hong almost lost its soul; it wanted to scream, channeling all of its energy to respond to the crisis from an unknown enemy.
But even as it wished to look back, it found itself unable to.
For the fear that once fueled it was now vanishing, at least in facing this enemy...
Imprisoned Soul!
Whoosh!!!
A rumbling sound came from the sands within the burning tails behind it.
The frozen time seemed to start moving again, and the people who had been still around began to move.
The Misty Sea rose as if a real tsunami had emerged, ghostly waters leaping dozens of feet in the air, but the bubbling surf had yet to reach the surface, fixed in its view.
Granny Hong mechanically turned her head, wanting to glance back but finding herself unable to do even that.
There was a gaping bloody hole in her body, and Comrade Red Grandma fell dead!

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 126. Sovereign of the Misty Sea (3.5K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: 126. Sovereign of the Misty Sea (3.5K words - Subscription Requested)
Silence of crows and sparrows!
Deathly stillness on the islands!
Even the ancient General fighting within the Absolute Profound Array was stunned.
The Red Granny, wrapped in blood and rapidly falling from mid-air, had already revealed her true form, her three tails powerless against the wind, originally a source of extra mana.
Her corpse was swiftly pulled into the grasp of a mysterious silhouette emerging from the darkness, held firmly between its five fingers.
Her ruby-like essence blood was quickly absorbed, falling into the silhouette’s palm; the Crimson Palace soul, still lingering, was bound by several Changwang Tiger patterns.
And the corpse soon vanished, evidently stored into a storage bag.
The wind and sand abruptly stopped, revealing the white-haired blood corpse who had been hiding in the fiendish wind, intending to ambush the Red Granny, now hunched and bowing low.
Blood Cliff swiftly approached, deep reverence flashing in his old eyes towards the mysterious silhouette in the darkness, then respectfully kowtowed, shouting, "Greetings to the Sect Leader!"
The Puppet Sect disciples, commanded to attack, also hastily followed Blood Cliff in kowtowing.
The sound of "Greetings to the Sect Leader" reverberated, covering the entire Misty Sea.
In the distance, the Puppet Sect disciples on other islands also hurriedly kowtowed from afar, while the Sword Sect disciples, trapped and fighting, looked utterly bewildered, their morale plummeting to freezing point once again.
For Song Yan, in this battle, hiding his identity had lost all significance.
Clad in a profound robe, he stood in mid-air, his gaze indifferent, striving to exude the majesty of a sect leader.
Even though it was his first time, he would put forth every effort.
Not far away, Gong Libai, shocked, finally reacted, the scene of "Red Granny being instantly killed" had deeply imprinted into his divine soul, making any remaining vague thought of defiance vanish completely.
He raised his hand slightly, revealing in the void the magnificent and grand shadow puppet flying palanquin, veiled with gauze, luxurious inside like a private room, complete with tea sets and fruit dishes.
This flying palanquin was a specialty of Mechanical Peak, and as the eldest disciple of Paperman Peak, upon realizing they had a new master, Gong Libai had immediately ordered this luxurious palanquin, now finally put to use.
The palanquin swiftly moved forward, Gong Libai accompanying it with a smile, arriving beside the high-altitude shadow, ingratiatingly saying, "Please, Sect Leader, enter the palanquin."
As he uttered these words, he severed his connection with the shadow puppet flying palanquin, presenting it directly to the sect leader before him.
Song Yan accepted it unceremoniously, took control, and lifted the curtain to enter.
Although he did not particularly enjoy such pomp, the newly emergent Puppet Sect Leader required it, not only for grandeur but for other reasons as well.
The Emperor in the mortal realm wore a crown of twelve white jade pearls, concealing his face. Why do this? To prevent ministers from seeing his face, his joys and sorrows. If they knew the Emperor’s emotions were no different from theirs, how could he remain beyond their reach?
Deities and Buddhas, sitting in niches with golden bodies and jade statues, silent and unseen, for what reason? Because only deities and Buddhas who are not understood are true deities. If you knew their path to divinity, their process, knew they also had setbacks, knew you could become a deity if you had the chance, would they still be considered deities?
Of course, you could showcase your strength to tell everyone you are powerful, but that would merely make you ’measurable,’ which is incomparable to an unfathomable, unquantifiable, and invincible existence.
One does not govern with benevolence nor manage wealth with righteousness; a Sect Leader of the Demon Sect could not be all smiles.
Unbearable chill at the heights, this is the truth.
Besides, the "combination of shadow puppet and mechanical mechanisms, forming such a peculiar shadow puppet vehicle" was novel to Song Yan, although he hadn’t had the opportunity to learn about it before.
Now someone had presented it as a form of introduction.
The gauze curtains swayed, Song Yan reclined slightly, lying, and asked indifferently, "Can the fox cubs discern it?"
"They can."
"They can."
Gong Libai and Blood Granny hurriedly responded.
Song Yan’s tone remained constant, lacking even a hint of ferocity, as he casually said, like chatting at home, "Libai, you take people, and kill them all."
"Yes!" Gong Libai accepted the order with great delight, this command indicating that he would remain a leader in the sect thereafter, and he accepted the order willingly, no longer under the previous compulsion of "due to Cold Ice Hell Bracelet and Changwang Tiger Blood." Moreover, he felt a curious sense of privilege at being addressed with the intimate "Libai." Yet, considering the traditions of the Puppet Sect, he couldn’t help but feel a surge of apprehension.
Blood Granny wisely stood with her head bowed at the front of the palanquin, in a posture of leading the way for her lord, quietly awaiting directives.
Initially, she had been shocked upon seeing Song Yan wearing the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet and knowing he had killed Gu Huangzi, and today... she had completely yielded. Be it his swift and decisive actions, choosing unimaginable timing, places, and methods to instantly kill Red Granny, or his current demeanor, all were like so.
Within the flying palanquin...
Song Yan slightly closed his eyes, holding the Red Granny’s essence blood, focusing a thought on it, surprisingly choosing to absorb the essence blood at this moment amid the slightly calmed battlefield.
Great Granny Fox had told him, "Purifying ’same clan essence blood’ depends only on purity, not realm. A ’Three-tailed’ wanting to absorb a ’Five-tailed’ is dreaming. A ’Five-tailed’ absorbing a ’Three-tailed’ carries risks. As for ’fox cubs,’ they can absorb however they want. To prevent internal strife, the Fox and Wolf Races prohibit mutual slaughters within the same clan."
With the thoughts flashing, the purification began.
[You operate ’Multi-tailed Fox Blood,’ drawing the essence blood before you, which enters your body and merges with the already digested Multi-tailed Fox Blood, returning to the second Central Palace of your heart]
[Under the pressure of Profound Qi, the thin essence blood within the limited area begins to be squeezed out, leaving behind more pure essence blood]
[You misstep, injuring your heart during the purification process, reversing time]
[You continue the purification]
[Heart injury, reversing time]
...
Through repeated cultivation, Song Yan thoroughly digested Red Granny’s three-tailed fox blood within just half a year, transforming his own fox blood from ’Three-tailed’ to ’Four-tailed.’
The resulting ’Splitting Sword Qi’ evolved from creating three swords from one to four swords from one.
Moreover, this combination of ’Multi-tailed Fox Race Essence Blood’ and the ’Profound Sword Scripture’ resulted in a small anomaly in the ’Splitting Sword Qi,’ allowing it not to be limited to ordinary Sword Qi but to become... any Sword Qi.
In other words, if Song Yan employed ’Soul Piercing,’ ’Imprisoned Soul,’ ’Startling Soul,’ ’Profound Water Ghost,’ ’Water Dividing’ these types of Sword Qi, each could form four from one.
However, there was a prerequisite that four tails had to "burn" simultaneously to provide Profound Qi.
The "increase in the number of tails" in the Multi-tailed Fox not only signified quantitative change but also... qualitative change.
...
Though it speaks slowly, all these events transpired extremely quickly.
Soon, an unsuspecting Elder of the Puppet Sect from the Crimson Palace cried out, "You... you’re not the Sect Leader, Gu Huangzi! You’re Song Yan! You are Song Yan!!"
Chaos erupted instantly.
The disciples who were worshipping gasped in shock.
"Song Yan?"
"Is it Song Yan?"
"How did Song Yan become our Puppet Sect Leader?"
Blood Cliff stood at the front of the Flying Palanquin, hearing the whispers, he slightly squinted his old eyes and let out a thunderous hum: "Is deciding the Sect Leader up to you?"
Elsewhere, a bizarre figure wrapped in various fabrics, exuding venom and revealing only a pair of eyes, suddenly leaped out from an island yelling, "Song Yan is the Sect Leader? How come I didn’t know? How come I didn’t know?"
Blood Cliff glanced at the person and said, "Qu Yue, you’ve been practicing that technique, messing up your brain more and more. The old lady has mentioned this to you!
Song Yan was a disciple of Gu Huangzi; this is rightfully justified.
He openly killed Gu Huangzi, his power is the first of our Puppet Sect, which makes it reasonable.
Rightfully justified and naturally reasonable, he is the Sect Leader, naturally.
The odd figure scratched his head, found it reasonable, and laughed foolishly, apologizing repeatedly to the flying palanquin, "My brain was long gone, sorry, Sect Leader," then stood proudly beside Blood Cliff.
Song Yan moved the Flying Palanquin forward, landing outside the Absolute Profound Array on Copper Sparrow Island, accompanied on either side by two Peak Masters of the Puppet Sect.
Song Yan looked down without making a move, quietly observing the fighting within the Array shield, patiently watching the ancient general’s methods.
Copper Beard’s method is to drag you to a kindergarten level with the "Absolute Profound Array," then crush and annihilate you with his formidable body.
However, this method seems ineffective against the ancient general.
Or rather, this "Absolute Profound Array" isn’t cutting off completely.
At least both sides still have Profound Qi, though it’s quite thin.
This powerful Corpse-Eating Wolf’s form is ghostly, vanishing into the blood on Copper Sparrow Island’s surface, which has turned into a blood river, only to reappear behind Copper Beard.
Despite Copper Beard’s strong physique, he was covered in wounds after a short encounter.
The blood from his injuries kept drifting out, one strand after another, floating in the air, only to fall to the ground because of the scarce Profound Qi.
Song Yan watched this scene, feeling momentarily dazed, "Since when did werewolves practice vampire talents," but then he somewhat realized the Corpse-Eating Wolf could trigger fear by howling to provoke Qi Blood.
At the same time, when he looked at the ancient general, his gaze no longer held clarity but instead showed uncontrollable greed.
He wanted the ancient general’s blood.
His Third Central Palace required the Essence Blood of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race!
"Copper Beard seems unable to hold on any longer."
A light voice drifted into the ears of Blood Cliff and Qu Yue.
Blood Cliff said, "Sect Leader, the old lady requests to fight."
"Alright."
Song Yan responded.
Blood Cliff squinted at the Array for a moment, flew over a hundred yards, looked down at the ground, and shouted, "Copper Beard, let me in."
Copper Beard, struggling to hold on, heard Blood Cliff’s voice as if receiving a great pardon, quickly pulling out the Array Plate to manipulate it, but seeing the black giant wolf leap from within the blood, pouncing towards him.
Copper Beard hurriedly defended, barely managing to manipulate the Array Plate after a fierce battle, opening a gap in the "Absolute Profound Array."
Blood Cliff moved almost instantaneously, flying sand and stones swirled as a white-haired blood corpse rapidly leaped in.
But...
Too late.
At least, before the ancient general, it was too late.
The blood river, initially limp on the ground, suddenly surged fiercely, as if a blood streak was rushing into the sky, swiftly emerging, accompanied by an eerie, terrifying wolf howl, forming an unrivaled attack.
Blood Cliff rushed to hide behind the white-haired blood corpse.
The white-haired blood corpse raised its hand to block, but the blood streak "cracked" as it tore through.
A smooth mark appeared on the blood corpse’s arm, cleanly severed.
"Damn it!"
Blood Cliff roared in fury, preparing to strike again, yet suddenly saw the blood river that soared into the air halting, with a black giant wolf with bristle-like hair appearing in midair.
Strangely, the giant wolf’s eyes were dull and lifeless.
Whoosh!
The flying palanquin’s gauze curtain flung open, an image from within darted out, almost teleporting to that giant wolf in the misty sea.
The ancient general only felt a sharp, indescribable pain between its brows, and upon regaining clarity, its eyes were overtaken by a large hand that then "slapped" down on its brow.
"I’m hungry too."
There was greed hidden within these calm four words.
The Changwang Tiger Pattern on the arm behind his five fingers slithered like tentacles reaching from the abyss, hissing as it burrowed into the ancient general’s brow.
In mid-air, the ancient general shuddered fiercely a few times, then its limbs drooped, claws fell, and it was lifeless.
"I acknowledge my mistake, I acknowledge my mistake!" the blood granny realized, hurriedly bowing and confessing continuously at the side.
Song Yan said lightly, "No matter, it was to let you test, not truly intending for you to act."

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Old Friends as Prisoners (4.4K Characters - Subscription Request)
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Old Friends as Prisoners (4.4K Characters - Subscription Request)
Misty Sea.
Sun Family Copper Sparrow Island, blood flowed like a river.
Above, the veil of the flying palanquin was lifted and then fell again, concealing Song Yan’s figure within.
All around, it became increasingly silent, leaving only the sound of wind and water, giving a feeling akin to "absolute silence in the Golden Throne Hall."
Song Yan appeared calm, but in reality, he was quite tense inside.
His recent move seemed to instantaneously kill General Gu, but in truth, it was rather a clever ploy.
One must know, General Gu had been fighting fiercely within the Absolute Profound Array with Tong Huzi for a long time, then seized the moment when the array opened slightly to dash out. At that time, its attention was focused on Blood Cliff. Although Blood Cliff wasn’t as strong as it, he was still a formidable opponent that required effort to deal with.
Thus, when it made its move, it instantly broke through Blood Cliff’s blockade, not expecting Song Yan to be waiting in the wings, seizing the opportunity to strike, and his first strike was twelve special strands of sword qi directly attacking the divine soul.
During a momentary lapse, through burning the Four-Tailed power, donning the Great Gale Boots, using the Kan Water Escape, and further augmenting speed with the Water Escape bestowed by the ’Ghost Shark, Water Abyss Flood Dragon’, he instantly reached before it, directly using Changwang Hu’s power to soul search and transform it into a minion, a one-stop process.
The move appeared unremarkable, but the choice of timing and use of power contained many calculations.
Furthermore, Song Yan discovered one thing: although the fox wolf’s power was strong, the pressure he felt upon facing it was less than that of Gu Huangzi, yet Gu Huangzi seemed unable to best the fox wolf. While this had elements of power realm involved, there were undoubtedly other factors at play.
After pondering slightly, he figured it out.
Using words from before his transmigration, Gu Huangzi belonged to the "Clone System," with things like paper mannequins, blood corpses, soul hidden in bone, essentially like a nesting doll. In any case, good luck finding the true body, and as long as you can’t find the true body, he’ll have a way to kill you;
The fox and wolf races leaned somewhat towards "area attacks," whether it was the multi-tailed Dragon Bo Fox’s magical body slamming down a palm over tens of meters, or the Corpse-Eating Wolf’s howl that dispersed sound waves, stirred blood, and incited fear, regardless of where the target was, as long as you were in the attack’s range, you’d have to endure the hit.
Hence, they restrained each other.
However, the Sword Cultivator was quite special.
No!
Not only the Sword Cultivator, but also his own "Hundred Forms Demon Body" was essentially the same.
That is, strong in single confrontation, very strong in small areas.
This ensured that he would be restrained by Gu Huangzi, but facing the fox wolf, he could hold an advantage.
In today’s battle, he made just two moves.
One was to instantaneously kill Red Granny, the other to instantaneously kill General Gu.
Seemingly creating an image of an "indomitable golden body" in others’ minds, yet in truth...only he knew how perilous it was, moving cautiously as on thin ice, fearing that even a small problem would mean not an instantaneous kill but a hard-fought battle.
In the flying palanquin, Song Yan leaned back slightly, closing his eyes to regulate his breath, rapidly reviewing the recent battle, extracting lessons to improve himself while beginning to contemplate what needed to be done next.
He did not relish this feeling of being "above all like a sovereign ruling the world"; he felt only urgency and pressure.
His time was running out.
The arrival date of the Purple Mansion demons will certainly advance.
Being able to kill Red Granny and General Gu, the arriving Purple Mansion demons would likely also increase in strength, reaching an utterly insurmountable level.
Where before there was only "Changwang Hu," now undoubtedly there was another.
That is, "why was he so fortunately able to extract Changwang Hu’s blood, had he extracted multi-tailed fox blood, and did he extract Corpse-Eating Wolf blood after killing General Gu?"
Whether he did or didn’t, it was enough to show he possessed some terrifying chance or treasure.
This point would likely pique the interest of demons, righteous and evil human cultivators alike. After all, Song Yan was deeply aware of the human race’s suffering from the harm of erysipelas...
...
Thoughts flashed through Song Yan’s mind in the flying palanquin.
Outside the flying palanquin, the severed arm of the white-haired blood corpse, cut by the bloody light, suddenly grew fleshy sprouts on both sides, pulling and hooking, rapidly healing again.
A potent vitality has always been a characteristic of blood corpses.
Blood Cliff stowed the white-haired blood corpse, and together with the equally astonished Tong Huzi, Qu Yue, came to the outside of the palanquin and respectfully asked, "What other orders does the sect leader have?"
Song Yan said, "Kill all the fox cubs, then pile the corpses; I want them. Besides, arrange some people to go to the mortal dynasty to take care of the fox demons hiding outside."
The three responded in unison, "Yes!"
Blood Cliff stepped forward, respectfully asking, "Sect Leader, what about the Sword Sect?"
Song Yan asked, "How is the current situation?"
Blood Cliff quickly replied, "Some of the remnants are holding out on Luoxia Bamboo Island; Water Bo Sword Emperor has not appeared, surely dead by now. If we are to attack the island, breaking the array is only a matter of time.
On the other islands, many sword cultivators continue to hold out, but...at this point they must be either dead, wounded, or captured.
The old woman thinks, captured ones are quite numerous, after all, these sword cultivators are top-notch good furnaces, excellent for cultivation."
Song Yan fell silent for a moment.
Before attacking a city in the mortal world, promising the spoils to the soldiers is what drives them to fight fiercely; Puppet Sect is the same. Otherwise, what you seize isn’t yours, the people aren’t yours, what’s there to fight for?
As Song Yan, he didn’t like this.
But as the Puppet Sect Leader, he couldn’t dislike it, unless he could overthrow the thousand-year rules of the Puppet Sect and usher in a major transformation.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Old Friend Becomes a Prisoner (4.4K Characters - Request for Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Old Friend Becomes a Prisoner (4.4K Characters - Request for Subscription)_2
He was not interested in doing it, nor did he have the time, and he believed, "The world is unchanged; cleaning a room is merely self-deception. When I am here, the room stays tidy under my pressure, but once I’m gone, it will become more chaotic."
So, after thinking for a while, Song Yan said calmly, "When I was the senior brother on South Bamboo Peak, I set a rule."
Blood Cliff replied respectfully, "This old woman knows, no matter who takes away a furnace, they must remember to nurture it with elixirs and must not drain it dry or force it to suicide."
Song Yan made a sound of acknowledgment but before he could continue, Blood Cliff added, "All captured sword cultivators are always offered for the Sect Leader to choose first. Only after the Sect Leader has decided, do the others get their turn.
Today, here on this Misty Sea, all captives will be delivered to the Sect Leader shortly.
It doesn’t matter who captured the sword cultivator, if the Sect Leader takes a liking, it would be a fortune gained from their accumulated fate over eight lifetimes."
Song Yan neither agreed nor disagreed, then said, "Don’t attack Luoxia Bamboo Island yet; I have some arrangements to make."
Blood Cliff didn’t ask any questions and directly responded, "This old woman understands, currently, the main focus is on eradicating the residual fox demons and tallying the spoils of war; today’s great battle is already over."
Song Yan nodded and said, "Go do it then."
Beams of demonic light shot out from beside the flying palanquin toward the surroundings, while Song Yan’s flying palanquin stopped suspended in mid-air, settling amid the floating clouds.
Inside the palanquin, Song Yan flipped his palm and took out the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Essence Blood."
He greatly preferred to take time during battle to digest power, rather than delaying it until after the battle.
Unless there’s a strategic need, he would never prefer to be a second late in mastering stronger power.
The battlefield changes in an instant; having an extra trump card always provides some sense of security.
’Absorb, Corpse-Eating Wolf Essence Blood, establish the Third Central Palace.’
Silently reciting this in his heart, various insights and accompanying lines of information emerged.
Having died not once but multiple times, he fully absorbed the Essence Blood of the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race."
[Running the "Profound Sword Scripture," continuing the Profound Qi to digest and assimilate the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race Essence Blood, you are also converting Profound Qi into Sword Qi and nurturing it with blood.]
[In the eighth month, you absorbed 60 strands of Profound Qi, digesting a strand of Corpse-Eating Wolf Race blood, completely converting it to Sword Qi.]
[In the thirty-third year, you absorbed 3000 strands of Profound Qi, successfully converting Profound Qi into Sword Qi; the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race blood has fused into your Crimson Palace Upper Central Palace, becoming the Third Central Palace.]
[Sword Qi reacted with the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race blood, you comprehended a trace of special Sword Qi—Demon Sound Sword Qi.]
[This Sword Qi can attack via sound, not only formless but also executed in myriad unique ways, making it indefensible.]
[You broke through to the late stage of the Crimson Palace Realm.]
Song Yan quickly completed the digestion, casting a glance over the panel: [Longevity: 34/11630].
The remaining lifespan was ample.
Yet he had begun to realize, the most terrifying aspect of the "Remaining Life Dao Fruit" was not "using time to pile cultivation," but providing longevity and flawlessly correct cultivation.
Time may not hold meaning, as it is the cheapest thing within the boundless starry sky and infinite universe. A civilization may undergo a significant transformation in five thousand years, but some often overlook how many worlds have cumulatively evolved over trillions of years to give rise to such a civilization.
Opportunity surpasses time by far.
If Blue Star were likened to a cultivator, it has also spent 4.6 billion years, only in the recent few millennia successfully breaking through to the "Human Realm."
If the universe were likened to a cultivator, even after spending trillions of years, it cannot escape its destiny of "destruction," unable to achieve longevity, hence a failure.
At this moment, a subtle qualitative change emerged in Song Yan’s perception.
First is the enhancement of foundational powers.
Following is the advancement of Qi Blood level; if the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound is impervious to weapons and resistant to elements, then Qi Blood at the late stage of the Crimson Palace could withstand all attacks of the Refining Profound level. Simply put, even should Song Yan be asleep, allowing Refining Profound sword cultivators to attack frantically, he would remain unscathed as his Qi Blood would automatically fend off those feeble assaults. The Crimson Palace was always about breaking through limits with external blood, and now it truly revealed its hints.
Additionally, is the temperature of Qi Blood.
Feeling something within, Song Yan took a deep breath and slowly exhaled, forming a small cone of peculiar flame in front of himself. Though the color was identical to that of a mortal fire, all red, its temperature was incomparably higher.
’Is this the Qi Blood True Flame at the late stage of the Crimson Palace, capable of refining Profound Treasures and elixirs?’
Song Yan tested it slightly, then swiftly retracted the flame.
Again, closing his eyes to perceive, the power of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race bloodline surfaced broadly in his mind.
The "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race," like the "Multi-tailed Fox Race," has a racial talent, which is not "Illusion Technique" but "Bloodthirsty."
The "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race," regardless of how severe their injuries, as long as they consume fresh blood or flesh, their wounds will rapidly heal. The stronger the source of the consumed blood and flesh, the faster the recovery, but this healing is limited to "physical wounds"; injuries from "Divine Soul Attacks" are not affected.
The essence blood power of the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race" was something Song Yan had experienced before; it was about "using howls to manipulate blood, instilling fear causing the weak to bleed from their seven orifices and die on the spot."
After digesting the Corpse-Eating Wolf Essence Blood, Song Yan glanced outside; seeing there was still time, he swiftly summoned the "Ghostly Granny" and "Ghostly General" from the Divine Soul World to inquire, seeking more insight into the strength and situation.
The General spoke first:
"Master, our Corpse-Eating Wolf Race still has many racial secret techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Therefore Man Becomes Prisoner (4.4K Characters - Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: 127. Breakthrough Late Stage, Therefore Man Becomes Prisoner (4.4K Characters - Seeking Subscription)_3
The scattered small secret techniques are not valued by their master, but there are two powerful secret techniques.
The first one is called the "Blood Demon Seal."
Once this "Blood Demon Seal" is mastered, it can gather sound, concentrate it, and then suppress it somewhere. If the person being suppressed has no means of defense, even those of the same realm will have their blood explode throughout their body; if their physique is slightly poor, they might even be directly killed instantly.
This secret technique is the number one secret technique at the Crimson Palace Level of my Corpse-Eating Wolf Race.
The second one is called the "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma," which is a Racial Secret Technique at the Purple Mansion Level. I do not know much about it."
"Oh, there are a total of three ancestors at the Purple Mansion in our race, but only one of them is stationed in the race, the other two are all elsewhere..."
"I, I haven’t seen the ancestor for a very, very long time. The ancestor in my impression is the kind who is always in secluded cultivation, never going anywhere."
"Why?"
"I... I don’t know either."
"The order to capture you was given by the Clan Leader of my Corpse-Eating Wolf Race. He only said that you stole the Changwang Tiger Blood, that thing is very important, but where exactly it is important... I really don’t know."
...
Then, Granny Hong said:
"Master, my Multi-tailed Fox Race also has quite a few secret techniques. Although they are not as domineering as the "Blood Demon Seal" of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, they have their own strengths.
Firstly, the "Heart’s Desire Illusion," which allows illusions not only to be used on oneself but also on others. The reason why Ancient General pretended to be you before was because I used the Heart’s Desire Illusion on him.
Secondly, the "Heart Demon Illusion," which allows the target who sees you to regard you as the most important person in their life. Whether it is the person they respect the most or fear the most can be controlled by you.
Thirdly, the "Illusion Butterfly Robe," this is a strange Body Refining Technique performed with the ’Multi-tailed Fox Race Essence Blood.’ Once mastered, it can greatly increase the power of illusions, and those who could see through your illusions before will no longer be able to see through them."
"By the way, my Multi-tailed Fox Race also has Purple Mansion Realm Secret Techniques, but they are hidden very securely by the Clan Leader, I... I don’t know..."
"Our ancestor too is always in secluded cultivation, I have never even seen it, nor do I know how many there are."
"You know, our race is somewhat... crafty."
"As for the rest, I am the same as Ancient General..."
"Also, there are actually four of us here this time, and now there are two more stationed at the Desolate Wilderness to prevent you from escaping.
Their powers are similar to ours...
As for the ancient teleportation array, to prevent any unexpected occurrences, the two of them made a detour before leaving, and already destroyed the ancient teleportation array again.
They said that even though you possess soul gold stones as well, it’s absolutely not enough to repair this time’s destruction."
...
Song Yan poured out the soul gold stones from Gu Huangzi before, and then asked: "Are these, plus the ones in your storage bag, enough?"
Granny Hong carefully checked once more, and said: "It should be enough, they probably didn’t expect you to have so many soul gold stones reserved."
Song Yan waved his hand, putting away the materials to repair the ancient teleportation array.
After a little while, noises came from outside.
He looked outside and saw, under the moonlight in the northern sky, a huge shadow puppet void ship coming.
On the deck of the void ship, silver-robed sword cultivators, extremely weak, were trapped in cages, traveling through the wind. It seemed that these sword cultivators had been fed some kind of potion, rendering them unable even to seek death.
This scene reminded Song Yan of the time when he was at the marketplace at the foot of South Bamboo Peak, seeing the "Great Wei Royal Family in cages, offered to the Immortal Sect" sight.
Unexpectedly, the Nanwu Sword Sect also experienced such a day.
He swept his divine sense, quickly searching for acquaintances among these sword cultivators.
In doing so, he indeed found someone.
Miss Su Qi, and Yuzhuang, the young lady who had long been stripped of her mask, were unmistakably captives, trapped in cages, both women appearing as if soulless, their fair faces ashen.
And near the shadow puppet void ship, several pitch-black coffins, resembling small boats, were eerily floating.
Those coffins contained the important "materials" of the Puppet Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 128. Demon Name (3.1K characters - Subscribe please)
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: 128. Demon Name (3.1K characters - Subscribe please)
Song Yan swept his divine sense again and saw that during the "Rain Listening Island Sword Sect Elite Disciples’ Exchange," Su Yanqing, who had not favored Bai Xiuhu, was also present.
However, he did not choose that woman.
No acquaintance, no interest.
When Gong Libai humbly approached to inquire, he directly picked Miss Su Seven and the young lady Yuzhuang, while also instructing Gong Libai to call the cultivators who captured the two women.
Two iron cages soon floated in the sky, followed by a female cultivator in a black robe with a decaying face, who bowed from a distance and respectfully said, "Blood Corpse Peak, Lv Xingyan, paying respects to Sect Leader."
Song Yan glanced at the approaching Blood Granny and said, "This female cultivator is not bad, nurture her well."
Blood Granny hurriedly acknowledged.
The demon sect female cultivator named Lv Xingyan was also overjoyed, continuously bowing in thanks before retreating.
Capturing Miss Su Seven from the Su Family was certainly a significant achievement, but at this moment, a word from the new sect leader was already the best reward.
Song Yan waved his hand, and the iron cages approached, sticking to the front of the flying palanquin.
Within, Miss Su Seven, whose eyes were originally lifeless, showed a moment of hatred upon seeing him, but it was only for an instant, and after that, she sank back into silence like dead water, a doll seemingly without life or soul.
The bit of dignity and grandeur she had painstakingly cultivated before had vanished completely.
But this was no surprise; even the strongest person would collapse and feel dead inside when family members died one by one before their eyes and their clan was exterminated.
Song Yan looked into the distance and asked, "How many are at the Crimson Palace Realm from the Su Family?"
Blood Granny waved her hand, and three coffins floated over from afar, settling beside the flying palanquin, the lids opened to reveal two men and one woman.
Blood Granny said, "The Su Family’s second elder, Su Yingren; the Su Family elder, Su Hongxian, and Yuan Bixian."
Su Yao suddenly turned her head, looking at Su Yingren’s face in the coffin, let out a piercing scream, then collapsed at the front of the iron cage, crying and shouting, "Second Brother! Second Brother!"
Song Yan waved his hand.
Blood Granny closed the lids again and then withdrew.
Song Yan looked at the young lady Yuzhuang.
Cao Yuzhuang also looked at him with indifference.
Song Yan looked at this young lady who once obeyed his every word and said, "Do you not recognize me?"
Cao Yuzhuang closed her eyes, sighed softly, and said, "Kill me."
Song Yan squinted at the two women, with a casual wave of his hand.
Pa.
Pa.
The two cages opened, and the two women floated from the cages into his flying palanquin, landing on the couch opposite him, their bodies sinking into the luxurious carpet. But one was tearless and lifeless, while the other closed her eyes, not looking at the demonic Song Yan across from her.
Song Yan said, "In a moment, I will send you to Luoxia Bamboo Island."
Miss Su Seven seemed to hear nothing.
Cao Yuzhuang also kept her eyes closed.
Song Yan studied the two women, suddenly realizing that Su Yao’s Dao heart had completely collapsed. The Su Family was gone, so even if she returned to Luoxia Bamboo Island, what would it matter now? As for Cao Yuzhuang, her heart was dead, with no desire to live.
No wonder, Song Yan’s reputation had long been tarnished by the wolf demon, and now that his identity as the Puppet Sect Leader was exposed, everyone at the Nanwu Sword Sect probably wanted to skin him and eat his flesh.
As for the matter of the "Elder," he had learned about it from Red Granny and the ancient general. But knowing did not change things; the "Elder not having much to say" meant tacitly approving the imposter as real, endorsing "Song Yan’s evil deeds."
In this world, not everything can be explained clearly.
Nor is there a need to explain.
The air suddenly fell silent, a strange stillness emerging.
Suddenly, Song Yan raised his hand, and the seemingly soulless Miss Su Seven floated to his side.
Her posture proud, her legs long, her water apricot eyes lacking spirit, yet indeed a top beauty.
"Nice legs."
Song Yan suddenly praised.
Then...
Rip, tear~~
A crisp sound, like a sword robe ripping.
Song Yan picked up Su Yao with both hands, lifting her high.
Then slowly, slowly...
Inside the flying palanquin, suddenly, it became noisy.
He turned his gaze towards Cao Yuzhuang opposite him, summoned her, and said, "Come, together."
...
A long time passed, and then some more.
The two bodies lay crosswise on the carpet, covered with the ruined sword robe, Su Yao’s small foot still hooked on Song Yan, eyes that were lifeless now seemed to brim with new emotions.
Good emotions, bad emotions, they were emotions nonetheless, at least no longer empty.
Song Yan said, "Su Yingren’s corpse is quite good; I will refine it into a blood corpse to fight for me."
After speaking, he thought for a moment and said, "By the way, the elder’s corpse is also good; I will refine it into a blood corpse too, hehehe..."
"Monster!"
Miss Su Seven scolded.
Upon hearing this rebuke, Song Yan did not mind, bending down to pinch her chin, saying, "Do you know how foolish you are?"
After speaking, he started listing from South Bamboo Peak, recounting the foolish things Su Yao had done one by one, then mockingly laughed, "Look at everything you have done, look at the self-righteous growth you thought you had, look at the miserable end you have met.
Heh, I won’t kill you, nor will I imprison you. Once we reach the Puppet Sect, you will be my furnace; no matter where you go during the day, you must return at night to serve me.
But I think you will definitely commit suicide, as you wish.
You were always the type who seemed strong but was actually fragile, a young lady.
"You are too weak, not only is your power weak, but you are also a worthless piece of trash that only drags people down."
After speaking, he glanced at Su Yao with a disdainful look, then slowly looked at Cao Yuzhuang, smiling, "You, too, are just as foolish.
Well, you’ll receive the same treatment as your new master."
After speaking, Song Yan ordered outside, "Bring two robes of my Puppet Sect disciples, and also fetch two flying swords.
By the way, is Su Yingren’s flying sword still available?
If it is, then bring that one over."
Soon, the Profound Robe of the Puppet Sect and Su Yingren’s flying sword arrived.
Song Yanru tossed them onto the two women as if discarding garbage, saying coldly, "If you can still move, put on the clothes and use sword control to stay by my palanquin. Where I go, you go."
...
...
A moment later...
Song Yan’s flying palanquin began to move slowly towards Luoxia Bamboo Island.
Blood Cliff and Qu Yue cleared the way at the front, Copper Hu found a place to heal, while the other Crimson Palace level demon cultivators aligned themselves on either side, and many Puppet Sect disciples respectfully followed behind.
However, the palanquin entourage now included two people who hadn’t been there before—Su Yao and Cao Yuzhuang.
These two women shared many similarities.
They were both very beautiful and had both lost their entire families because of the Puppet Sect. For some inexplicable reason and pride, they obeyed Song Yan’s words and accompanied him at the sides of his flying palanquin like maids.
At dawn, instead of welcoming reinforcements, the besieged defenders of Luoxia Bamboo Island were met with a vast army of enemies.
The sword cultivators looked on desperately from a distance, especially at the palanquin in the center.
They already knew who the person inside the palanquin was.
But what surprised them were the two women beside the palanquin.
There was a buzz of discussion for a moment.
Song Yan slightly lifted the curtain, condescendingly gazing at the island, and only when Yu Xuanwei came out did he intend to speak.
Yet before he and Yu Xuanwei could say anything, a female cultivator rushed out from the crowd on the island.
The female cultivator shrieked, "Demon! Where is Bai Xiuhu, did you kill Bai Xiuhu?!"
Song Yan fixed his gaze and saw it was Little Li, his junior sister.
He hadn’t yet opened his mouth when a demon cultivator beside him shouted harshly, "Insolence!"
Song Yan waved his hand, and the demon cultivator respectfully stepped back.
Song Yan looked around and asked, "Who is Bai Xiuhu?"
Instantly, there was whispering among the Puppet Sect, and shortly after, Blood Cliff came forward and explained who "Bai Xiuhu" was.
Song Yan impatiently asked, "Is he dead?"
This time, quite a while passed, yet no one dared to speak because none of them had encountered Bai Xiuhu, and obviously Bai Xiuhu was on the Shadow Puppet Void Ship at this time.
Song Yan said coldly, "Did you miss someone?"
As soon as the words fell, Blood Grandmother hurriedly explained, "Sect Leader, the Misty Sea is too vast, plus the interference of the two fox wolf demons, perhaps... perhaps indeed, there are cultivators who escaped."
Even she truly did not know Bai Xiuhu’s true identity, after all, what they had seen upon entering the Alchemy Room was not Bai Xiuhu, but rather Song Yan.
At this moment, she was even prepared for her master’s fury.
However, upon hearing this, Song Yan merely nodded and looked at Little Li, his junior sister, and said calmly, "Did you hear that?"
Then he paid no further attention to Little Li, but instead looked at Yu Xuanwei, smiling, "See, am I not sincere?"
Yu Xuanwei said, "If you release my many fellow sect members, then that will be sincere."
She glared intently at the high palanquin and continued, "I know you want to repair the ancient teleportation array, and I agreed to help you, but now... everything from the past no longer counts.
I promise you, I am determined to fight to the death. If I die, even though your Puppet Sect has array masters, you will absolutely never repair the ancient teleportation array!"
Song Yan found it amusing and asked in return, "Little girl, do you think I might agree to your demands?"
Yu Xuanwei said, "Then release the people on this island?"
She initially intended to present an "absurd demand" before making her "real demand."
If the Puppet Sect insisted on attacking Luoxia Bamboo Island, it was only a matter of time before they breached it.
Song Yan lowered his gaze, seemingly pondering for a moment, then said, "Crafty little girl, you sure know how to negotiate.
Fine, I agree with you.
However, you must immediately go to the ancient teleportation array to conduct repairs, not a single day can be delayed.
The things you need, I have them, take them."
After speaking, Song Yan gestured, sending forward the storage bag containing "Gu Huangzi and Blood Grandmother’s soul gold stones" to the array.
Yu Xuanwei did not immediately retrieve it but quietly watched Song Yan, and only after Song Yan waved his hand, causing the Puppet Sect’s cultivator army to retreat, did she finally open the array by a narrow margin and let the storage bag fall through.
When she probed inside, she was startled.
There are so many soul gold stones inside?
Meanwhile, Little Li, his junior sister, also clasped her hands at her chest, silently praying for Brother Bai. She thought the demon Song’s words shouldn’t be false, which seemed to indicate Brother Bai had escaped injured.
As long as he wasn’t dead, it was good.
...
On the other side, Song Yan dispersed the cultivator army, leading Su Yao and Cao Yuzhuang to the Library Pavilion on Copper Sparrow Island, saying, "I’ve roughly gone through the books here, but couldn’t find any cultivation notes from the late-stage Crimson Palace realm elders or sect leaders. Do you know where they are?"
He needed to find information to break through to the Purple Mansion realm.
Su Yao looked at him coldly, eyes filled with killing intent.
Song Yan directly met her gaze.
After a long while, Su Yao said, "Demon, have you ever seen a family put secret notes in the Library Pavilion? Follow me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)
The crystalline wall of the lake glows dimly, casting clouds-like light and shadows across a small chamber beneath the island as the waves ripple through.
The murderous night has passed, and dawn arises.
Today is sunny.
Tap, tap, tap...
The three descended the steps and arrived at the chamber.
"Here it is," Su Yao said, "the thing you’re looking for is here.
This room is only known to the heads of the Su and Sun families.
My second brother feared he might die in battle, so he told me this secret just in case.
If not for that, I wouldn’t be able to bring you here."
Song Yan glanced at some book boxes piled on the distant bookshelf and asked curiously, "Why hide it so secretly?"
He understood the principle of gaining perspective from elevation, but the ancestral insights kept secret, not allowing the Elders to view, seemed out of character for Nanwu Sword Sect.
Su Yao said, "It’s not secret keeping, but a rule set by the ancestors. If the Nine Palaces haven’t reached perfection, one should not enter this room. They say it... will harm cultivation."
Song Yan said oddly, "Then... you bringing me here, is it to harm my cultivation?"
Su Yao gritted her teeth and said, "Exactly."
Song Yan raised his hand to pat his forehead and said, "Then why did you tell me?"
Su Yao vehemently said, "Because I know you, as a devilish man, are arrogant enough that even though I told you, you would definitely look, definitely ruin your cultivation."
If Song Yan were of lower realm and weaker power, facing Miss Su Seven’s unreserved malice, he would be cautious, he would act. But now, he only felt that Miss Su Seven’s resistance was like a small pet throwing a tantrum in a cage.
He watched as Miss Su Seven’s almond-shaped eyes narrowed like knives, cold and murderous. It reminded him of her exposing her Profound Root Talent to be chosen as the master of Shadow Puppet Peak, back when they were at South Bamboo Peak...
He raised his hand and gently lifted Miss Su Seven’s chin, saying, "Actually, it’s not bad."
Su Yao’s eyes remained cold, but there was a hint of doubt in their depths.
Song Yan didn’t play any games and said, "Had you hidden and kept silent, and if I discovered it, it would be worse.
If you feigned submission cautiously, you would obviously have changed, like a snake.
The way you are now, maliciously telling me about this room’s origins and issues, suits your temperament.
A devil like me not only wouldn’t be angered by someone like you but would like you more.
You could use this disguise to turn your real nature into a mask, win my trust, then suffer indignities while secretly growing stronger, and ultimately seize the chance to kill me.
Remember, Nanwu Sword Sect was destroyed by the Puppet Sect, and I am the Puppet Sect Leader. If you don’t do everything you can and fail to kill me, what face do you have to meet your ancestors underground?"
Su Yao knew she was far from being his match, and having already fallen to this man, even as he lifted her chin, she could only use all her willpower to glare at him fiercely, then she spoke, "Shameless!"
Her eyes now shimmered with life where once they were "loveless and full of resolve to die," as if before drowning, she reached out and grasped a straw named hatred.
As long as this straw stayed afloat, she would not seek death anymore.
Suddenly, Song Yan looked toward the girl Yuzhuang behind her and said, "Yuzhuang, why aren’t you cursing?"
Cao Yuzhuang suddenly asked, "Are you still Song Yan?"
Song Yan asked curiously, "What do you mean?"
Cao Yuzhuang said, "Brother Song, though talented, could never possess such power. He couldn’t kill Red Granny and the ancient general in an instant, not even a hundred or a thousand Song Yans could defeat them.
You’re... possessed since Cold Pool Valley, right?
You’re... not Fox Granny, are you?
I’ve heard the Crimson Palace demons can possess."
Song Yan looked at her oddly.
And Cao Yuzhuang glanced back at him coldly.
After a while, Song Yan flicked Yuzhuang’s forehead and said, "Would Fox Granny have done that with you in the flying palanquin?"
Cao Yuzhuang paused, then in a complex tone said, "Are you still Song Yan?"
Song Yan said, "I have always been."
Su Yao said, "So you were already possessed back at South Bamboo Peak? Who exactly are you?"
Song Yan said, "Your master."
He casually teased the two girls.
Not sure of the effect, but after his antics, the two no longer seemed inclined to seek death.
Living is better than anything.
Perhaps after becoming stronger and standing taller, when you look back at those life-or-death matters, you’ll feel relieved.
...
Song Yan paced over to the bookshelf, casually taking out a volume and holding it in his palm.
The book’s cover was ancient, and on top was a note from later generations saying "Su Changsheng," and the pages surprisingly emitted a faint scent of blood.
He furrowed his brows, opened it, and saw on the page, crudely written, a line of frenzied large characters: Divine Soul has first united with the heavens and earth, it’s done, it’s done, old man succeeded!!!
He tilted his head and asked, "Who is Su Changsheng?"
Su Yao responded coldly, "Five hundred years ago, my Su Family’s ancestor, exceptionally talented, Late stage Of Crimson Palace, Nine Palaces completed."
Song Yan asked, "Did he break through the Purple Mansion?"
Su Yao said, "He went mad."
Song Yan squinted, continuing to flip through the book’s pages, inside which recorded various cultivation techniques and insights.
He quickly picked up other volumes, flipping through them until he stopped at one.
This one was left by the first Sect Leader of Nanwu Sword Sect a thousand years ago—Yu Luo Mountain, and a passage was written on the first page: I once heard the founding patriarch’s secret words, the mysteries of Purple Mansion are hidden in fourteen characters: Profound Heart suffers through cultivation, Divine Soul first unites with heaven and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)_2
Yu Luo Mountain, naturally, was the ancestor of the Water Uncle Sword Emperor and Yu Xuanwei.
In the book, the word "Master Ancestor" proves that the Nanwu Sword Sect indeed had a source, and that source was on the other side of the Ancient Teleportation Array.
Similarly, this also indicated... that the first Sect Leader of the Nanwu Sword Sect did not have a high status in that sect, at least he was not qualified to touch the Cultivation Method of the Purple Mansion Realm.
As for the "Master Ancestor’s secret words," it likely wasn’t something he overheard secretly.
But even if it was overheard, he brought these words through the Ancient Teleportation Array to such a place, and he himself had already reached the peak of the Crimson Palace stage, naturally, he was thinking of a breakthrough.
The breakthrough point fell on the fourteen words "Profound Heart, endure hardship, never part, Divine Soul first unites with heaven and earth."
Below it were numerous notes left by Yu Luo Mountain.
Song Yan carefully read.
The first Sect Leader believed that the core of these fourteen words lay in the words "Profound Heart."
Because only by possessing a Profound Heart could one endure hardship and reach the point where the Divine Soul first unites with heaven and earth.
Only when the Divine Soul unites with heaven and earth has one truly reached the Purple Mansion Realm.
To achieve this, Yu Luo Mountain racked his brains and attempted to compile a set of "Profound Heart Technique" based on all he had learned in his lifetime. This "Profound Heart Technique" was initially crude but had been refined by generations of geniuses of the Nanwu Sword Sect over thousands of years.
The core of the "Profound Heart Technique" was a Visualization Map drawn on special paper.
Yu Luo Mountain said with great pride that he accidentally saw this map at the core of the forbidden area set up by the ancestors, and only Purple Mansion Realm cultivators were allowed to enter that core forbidden area.
As for how he saw it, he didn’t say, but Song Yan estimated that this Sect Leader Yu saw it during a chaotic escape, going against the flow into the forbidden area, where he accidentally saw this map. But this map was likely in a state that couldn’t be removed, perhaps carved into a mountain wall or on the verge of destruction. So, this Sect Leader hurriedly noted it down and fled.
Song Yan steadied his mind, ready to turn the page.
The Visualization Map was on the next page.
Before turning the page, it was solemnly stated on the page, "To view this map, one must be at the late stage of the Crimson Palace, have comprehended the sword, and have cultivated at least half of the Sword Qi."
Song Yan compared himself, determined his conditions were suitable, and thus lightly flicked his finger to turn the page.
Instantly, a desolate aura rushed forth.
The paper, despite passing through a thousand years, remained unchanged. The composition on it was extremely simple: black below, white above, with a gray slender sword in the center.
It seemed to be a sword that cleaved heaven and earth, but upon rubbing the eyes, it appeared to be just a line, like a horizon or sea line, clearly stretched across the palm-sized page, yet giving an impression of vastness and boundlessness.
But with a momentary distraction and another glance, the line disappeared, the sword... remained a sword.
On one side of the Visualization Map, two words were written in a bizarre script: Celestial Sword.
Almost in an instant, Song Yan confirmed: the visualization target was this Celestial Sword.
"My sword" followed by "Celestial Sword" indeed fit the cultivation path of the Nanwu Sword Sect.
It seemed that cultivating the "Profound Heart Technique" while visualizing the "Celestial Sword" was the method the Sword Sect’s powerful cultivators attempted to use to break through to the Purple Mansion Realm over generations.
Song Yan put down the book and the Visualization Map, asking, "Does your Sword Sect have any documented Purple Mansion Realm experts?"
Su Yao replied, "None."
Song Yan asked, "Never?"
Su Yao sneered, "They couldn’t, and neither can you. The one most likely to break through was actually my elder brother, Su Changyi, whom you impersonated to infiltrate our Sword Sect! Unfortunately, he died at the hands of you despicable Demon Cultivators!"
Song Yan listened to the dull girl’s poor attempt at provocation, feeling not the slightest anger.
He lowered his eyes, pondering, feeling that "one person failing might be that person’s issue, but if everyone not only failed but also went mad, it was most definitely a problem with the Cultivation Technique." Ultimately, this so-called "Profound Heart Technique" and "Celestial Sword" were just shoddy patchworks by Sect Leader Yu Luo Mountain.
However, being a person of talent, he felt it was still worth a try to undergo such cultivation through sweat and wisdom.
Who knows, there might be some gains?
...
Song Yan arranged the matters of Array Formation, retrieved the "Profound Heart Technique" and the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map," and didn’t linger in the Misty Sea.
He left before even finishing the morning.
Not because he didn’t want to stay, but because he had more important matters to attend to: swiftly heading north to kill the Fox Wolf entrenched in the Desolate Wilderness!
Firstly, seize the chance while it’s vulnerable, to take its life.
Secondly, to purify his own Essence Blood.
The Fox Wolves stationed in the Desolate Wilderness might get news, but their response speed may not be that quick, and they certainly wouldn’t think Song Yan would head north to find them so swiftly.
To coordinate with his actions, before leaving, Song Yan intentionally had a Fox Demon Shadow Puppet transform into his likeness and hide in a secret room.
He also released two pieces of information: the open information, stating "Sect Leader Song is in secluded cultivation," and the covert information, which required a thorough investigation to uncover, saying, "Song Yan was actually injured in the battle with Granny Red and General Gu, and the so-called secluded cultivation is just an excuse; otherwise, why not return to the Puppet Sect to close himself off but instead do so in the Nanwu Sword Sect?"
He didn’t expect this information to fool anyone, but if it could delay for a while, that would be enough.
Miss Su, Lady Yuzhuang, were left behind in the guise of "Sect Master’s Concubine." For Su Yao, this was a humiliation, but it was also a layer of protection. With this guise, no one in the Puppet Sect dared to lay hands on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: 129. Piecing Together Randomly, Mistakenly Practicing the Cultivation Technique (4.5K Words - Seeking Subscription)_3
...
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh~~
Song Yan, wearing the Great Gale Boots, moved at high speed. Having been to Flower Box Mountain beside the Desolate Wilderness before, he was quite familiar with the route.
After several days of continuous travel, he was already quite close to the Desolate Wilderness. As night approached, with thoughts of slightly recovering, he found a spot in a forest outdoors and sat cross-legged under a tree.
After a short adjustment, he turned his gaze to the panel.
After spending several days, he finally moved the "Profound Heart Technique" onto the panel.
Curiously, what was generated on the panel was not the "Cultivation Technique List" including the "Profound Heart Technique," but a spell called "Soul Opening Eyes" in the "Spell List."
The transformation from "Profound Heart Technique" to "Soul Opening Eyes" was truly strange, highlighting the fact that the Southern Wu Sword Sect’s Sect Leader Yu had pieced together something unknown, leading the entire sect to practice blindly for a thousand years.
Song Yan remembered the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" quite clearly.
He pondered for a moment and focused his attention on "Soul Opening Eyes."
He decided to cultivate "Soul Opening Eyes" first, and then comprehend the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map."
Familiar words appeared:
[Please choose to invest lifespan]
...
[In the twenty-first year, you have cultivated "Soul Opening Eyes" to perfection. You discover that even with your eyes closed, you have another pair of eyes, a pair that can see the Divine Soul World. All wandering spirits, whether formed or not, are in your eyes, unable to escape]
Song Yan was knowledgeable about wandering spirits.
The "Shadow Puppet" summoned these entities, but before, he was only responsible for summoning them and couldn’t see them.
Simply put, after a person dies, the "Divine Soul" and fragments mixed with cause and effect and pre-life power gradually separate.
Seven days later, the Divine Soul moves towards reincarnation, leaving cause and effect fragments in the mortal world, known as "death and the way disappears."
The cause and effect fragments left in the mortal world, if encountered with Profound Qi in relatively enclosed areas or lower ground, will form Evil Qi; otherwise, they might transform into wandering spirits.
Of course, this is not absolute, but it is typically the case.
However, truly Profound Qi-rich places in the world are not many, with most being mortal land.
Therefore, the number of "wandering spirits" far exceeds "Evil Qi." The two are simply not in the same quantity level.
As soon as Song Yan opened his eyes, he immediately felt some congestion in the distance. The originally bright moonlit forest suddenly floated up wispy white things.
Most of those wisps were still, but there were none around Song Yan.
Song Yan got up and walked a few steps away; where he went, the wisps scattered quickly, avoiding him entirely.
Having acquired a new spell, opened the soul eyes, curiosity arose, and he strolled more within the mountain. Besides wisps, he began seeing some white things developing "faces," clearly wandering spirits.
These wandering spirits were not conscious, drifting aimlessly, not knowing their destination, merely floating randomly, but upon seeing some mountain beasts, they would involuntarily be drawn, moving towards them.
But they could only get close, unable to enter.
Flesh and blood were like fortresses, wandering spirits could not breach them, and even if they did, they could not face the native Divine Soul of the fortress.
After simple testing, Song Yan sat cross-legged again, silently reciting in his heart:
’With the "Soul Opening Eyes" spell, visualize the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map," begin cultivation...’
He didn’t know how to reach the Purple Mansion Realm; this was merely "Profound Heart" cultivation, the Southern Wu Sword Sect’s cultivation method.
He decided to try it.
...
...
[You stared at the distant Sea of Suffering surface, slowly approaching, your Divine Soul was already out of your body]
[Before reaching the shore, the sea wind of the Sea of Suffering howled and pounded upon your Divine Soul, you felt dizzy, countless notions not belonging to you flooded in madly, you went insane]
[Return lifespan]
Song Yan opened his eyes.
Well...
No wonder Sect Leader Yu peered into the exclusive forbidden land of the Purple Mansion, it was indeed odd.
The "Profound Heart Technique" not being a technique is beside the point, but the "Celestial Sword" in the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" was absurdly skewed.
Not only was it not a sword, but also a sea.
The Sea of Suffering.
Although he didn’t know what the Sea of Suffering in the Otherworld implied, visualizing this thing without going insane was strange indeed.
No wonder the sword sect hasn’t produced a single Purple Mansion Realm expert in a thousand years; they were all miserably duped by their ancestors.
But if the sword sect were like this, what about the Puppet Sect?

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 130. Accident (2.8K words - Requesting subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: 130. Accident (2.8K words - Requesting subscription)
After several attempts, the "Profound Heart Technique" and "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" of the Sword Sect were labeled as "ridiculous" by Song Yan.
However, he did not entirely dismiss them.
Although they were pieced together, "Soul Opening Eyes" and the "Sea of Suffering," along with the phrase "Profound heart diligently cultivate, divine soul initially unites with heaven and earth," were genuine.
This information was genuinely obtained by the first Sect Leader of Yu Luo Mountain concerning the Purple Mansion Realm.
However, Yu Luo Mountain only had these elements, so they were awkwardly stitched together and then given a name through imagination, later supplemented with various additions from the entire Sword Sect over the millennia, which turned them into their current form.
Song Yan discovered another advantage of the "Remaining Life Dao Fruit," which was: providing crucial information.
He had no idea that the "gray line" was the Sea of Suffering, but during his deductions, he understood it directly.
Earlier, he also didn’t know the nameless blood he absorbed was the blood of the "Changwang Tiger," which he only discovered during his deductions.
If the geniuses of the Sword Sect over the past thousand years knew that the "Celestial Sword" was the "Sea of Suffering," they surely wouldn’t have foolishly visualized it, because it’s obvious there would be an issue.
This shows the importance of information.
A single word can lead to ruin.
However, Song Yan quickly thought of the "Crimson Palace loophole" he exploited, allowing him to sometimes avoid erysipelas and draw upon essence blood.
So now, could he possibly exploit a "Sea of Suffering loophole" to see if he could advance a little further, perhaps triggering something?
Thus, Song Yan started trying again.
As a result, after a thousand attempts, he found it truly had no effect.
But at the same time, he did not leave empty-handed; he at least understood that the sea breeze of the Sea of Suffering contained many "terrifying obsessions," and those obsessions would drag his divine soul into others’ most unforgettable experiences if contaminated.
Great joy, great anger, great sorrow, and great happiness, all are extremes that a life can experience.
When you experience such extremes once, perhaps you can barely recognize who you are.
But what if it’s twice, thrice, ten times, or a hundred times?
...
The bright moon had passed its zenith, and the light scattered like withered leaves falling.
Leaning against the tree trunk, Song Yan pondered briefly and suddenly made an adjustment:
’Using the "Soul Opening Eyes" technique, visualize the Sea of Suffering, consume the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" and the ghosts contained in the "Changwang Tiger Blood" below the Crimson Palace Realm, and begin cultivation...’
If the cultivation succeeded, the ghosts would be consumed; if it failed, nothing would disappear.
Song Yan had understood this rule long ago through countless deductions.
[You stare at the surface of the distant Sea of Suffering, slowly approaching, your divine soul is already detached from the body, but this time, you bring along your ghosts, totaling two thousand eight hundred and eighty-two]
[Before you reach the seaside, the sea breeze of the Sea of Suffering has whistled toward your divine soul, and the ghosts stand in front of you]
[The foremost ghosts quickly fall down, and the ghosts are rapidly consumed]
[In less than six breaths, all the ghosts collapse, once again you face the sea breeze of the Sea of Suffering, you only feel dizzy, countless obsessions not belonging to you madly flood in, you go insane]
[Return the remaining lifespan]
...
Song Yan opened his eyes and remained silent for a long time.
’Nearly three thousand ghosts, managed to last less than six breaths?’
’And I couldn’t proceed far on the periphery of the Sea of Suffering, it seems it’s not feasible.’
He temporarily dismissed the thought of continuing to try.
Having achieved such results in the first attempt, he was quite satisfied. After the battle in the Desolate Wilderness, he would also visit the Demon Sect as the Puppet Sect Leader to see the "experiences of the former old demons."
Besides this, the Three Kingdoms had also produced many powerful loose cultivators, who also had experience.
For instance, Zhang Han, who is now in the core of the Evil Land, is one such example.
With this resolution, Song Yan began to focus on recovery, preparing for the upcoming battle.
This battle, although his power had greatly improved, would inevitably be a hard fight.
Because his opponent was prepared and no longer careless.
...
...
In the autumn, long grass withered, and everything lay bare.
In the edge town, every household shut their doors tightly and extinguished the candlelight. The notorious name of "Song Devil" loomed like a cloud of darkness over the place, leaving children afraid to cry at night and strong men reluctant to venture out.
Ordinary people have no idea about "true or false goods." They only know that the Cultivation Realm has produced a demon named Song Yan. This demon, with a copper head and iron arms, three heads and six arms, can transform into various demons, loves to eat live humans, and transforms into handsome men and beautiful women to seduce the ignorant and then devour them, extremely terrifying. Recently, every disaster within ten miles and the nearby towns is associated with the ’Song Devil.’
In the distance, at the entrance of the Desolate Wilderness, there is an old tree among the tall grass.
Under the tree sits a giant shadow clad in a spiked armor, with the eerie moonlight highlighting the terrifying wolf head on its shoulders, and beside it sits a fox in a brocade robe.
Suddenly, the giant wolf stands up and looks back somewhat unwillingly, asking in a muffled voice, "Why not go south to find him? Afraid? Hardly so."
The fox in the brocade robe replies, "Don’t ask, don’t ask, it’s not fear, it’s just that there’s no need to stay here anymore."
"What do you mean?"
The giant wolf is quite dissatisfied with its partner’s cryptic ways.
The fox in the brocade robe responds, "It’s the meaning of the ancestors."
"The ancestors came?" The giant wolf is stunned, then exclaims in surprise, "So quickly? Impossible..."
"Hehehe..." The fox in the brocade robe neither nods nor shakes its head, continuing its cryptic ways, and adds, "The reason our Fox and Wolf Races’ alliance could overthrow the Changwang Tiger Race is due to secrets.
And to achieve this, the ancestors have set the rules in the first place.
What was it again, do you remember?"
The giant wolf’s face turns dark, replying in a muffled voice, "For actions outside, don’t consult with the Wolf Race, and don’t let them know too much."
With that, it starts grumbling aloud.
Despite the grumbling, it still follows the Fox Demon northward, gradually disappearing into the waves of grass without a trace.
...
...
Over a month later, Song Yan almost turned over every stone around the towns near the Desolate Wilderness but never found any remaining Fox Demons or Wolf Demons. Moreover, their criminal activities have completely ceased.
The strike felt like hitting into soft cotton.
Song Yan summoned Granny Red and General Gu for interrogation, and after understanding, he realized both Fox and Wolf in the Northern Land are unlikely to have fled because he killed Granny Red and General Gu. As for the reason, neither Granny Red nor General Gu could guess, only surmising they might be lying low to launch a deadly strike when he is careless.
For a moment, Song Yan wasn’t sure where the pair of Fox and Wolf went, but he couldn’t afford to waste any more time here, and thus, while remaining vigilant, he quickly returned to Puppet Sect.
On the way, something unexpected occurred: He encountered Qiu Lianyue, the woman who initially became his furnace.
At his encounter, Qiu Lianyue’s caravan was surrounded by a group of Jin Kingdom’s troops.
The Jin troops found "Wu Kingdom’s documents" in the caravan and prepared to rob them directly. In the emergency, Qiu Lianyue loudly shouted "Puppet Sect Leader Song Yan is my man, who dares to touch me," and the Jin soldiers laughed heartily.
They were not unaware that Puppet Sect had changed control. After all, Puppet Sect is as heaven to Jin Kingdom, and the change of its Sect Leader is a significant event, which, almost instantly, made the name "Song Yan" become an existence above the Sovereign in the hearts of Jin Kingdom’s ministers and soldiers, absolutely not to be provoked. The Jin soldiers laughed because they found this woman laughable.
However, Song Yan threw down a piece of fiendish "Puppet Sect token" along with a double-headed wolf shadow puppet from a distance. The token and shadow puppet appeared silently in front of Qiu Lianyue, blocking her way.
The ordinary soldiers hardly noticed, even if they did, they wouldn’t recognize it, but the leading Captain would.
That Captain glanced at the token and shadow puppet, noticing the Evil Qi on them, looking at the "Puppet" characters on the token, and seeing the appearance of the token blocking in front of Qiu Lianyue, he immediately understood.
He stopped the soldiers advancing, showing respect to Qiu Lianyue and chuckling, "All are misunderstandings, all are misunderstandings..."
Muttering a few words, the Captain noticed no one appeared behind, quickly bowed towards the sky, then waved his hand, withdrawing the soldiers.
