The Evil Qi on the token and shadow puppet dispersed, Qiu Lianyue picked them up, looking at the double-headed wolf shadow puppet, she immediately recalled the past days at South Bamboo Peak’s Cave Mansion making shadow puppets for that man to earn Contribution Points.
She looked around bewildered, shouting to the skies "Sect Leader Song, Sect Leader Song," but there was no response.
Meanwhile, her side’s caravan guards, attendants, etc. were full of fear, shaking all over.
The name "Song Devil" was enough to terrify them to the bone.
Nevertheless, Song Yan did not appear but quietly left.
Reuniting with him again wasn’t a soothing thought for Qiu Lianyue, "When immortals fight, mortals suffer" could very well happen to her, causing undue calamity.
And an "unnamed" Puppet Sect token was sufficient to safeguard her across lands, unchallenged in the mundane world, while the shadow puppet... was merely a memento.
Qiu Lianyue quietly put away the token and shadow puppet, and a close maid approached quietly asking, "President, are you really with that..."
The maid dared not speak the words "Song Devil."
Qiu Lianyue paused in silence, slowly shook her head, then gently said, "Used to serve as a servant in Puppet Sect, escaped during chaos, took some items, never thought they’d be useful.
Just shouted out that name to scare the Jin army by pulling tiger skins.
Moreover, how could I possibly know such an immortal."

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)
"Rejoice, rejoice! The Wu army stationed by the river has been defeated. General Jia, after detouring, first captured the key city in the rear, then launched a complete siege. The Wu army lost all morale and surrendered after minimal resistance."
"What’s there to rejoice about? General Jia acted on his own. Is he planning to conquer the Wu Kingdom and declare himself king?"
Two men, dressed in the robes of high ministers of the Jin Kingdom, were arguing.
Beside them stood a man in a red robe with short whiskers and a sinister glint in his eyes, listening intently.
No matter how the two argued, the man in the red robe remained utterly calm until a rotund martial artist clad in iron armor, with a menacing demeanor, approached him from the side and gave his report. Only then did the man in the red robe show a change in expression.
He seemed to have heard something delightful and laughed heartily, "Good, good, at last they’ve all been captured, finally all captured, hurry, hurry, hurry."
He hurriedly left the tent, only to see piles of iron cages not far away, filled with handsome men and beautiful women. Though they appeared despondent, they showed no signs of illness, indicating that despite being imprisoned, they were still well taken care of.
Outside the tent, three beautiful young women stood, each exuding charm and beauty of a different kind: one seductive, one pure, and one intelligent.
The man who had come to report earlier was almost glued to the sight of the three women, his eyes tracing their forms. He leaned towards the menacing rotund martial artist and asked, "Laughing Butcher, what kind of play is this?"
Laughing Butcher let out a cold snort, "You fools, all you think about is General Jia, but His Highness had everything prepared long ago."
He pointed towards the iron cages from afar, "Those are offerings for the Immortal Sect."
Then, pointing to the three women before him, he said, "This is Princess Yongjia of the Wei Kingdom, this is Princess Huaining of the Shu Kingdom, and this is Princess Qiushui of the Wu Kingdom, the greatest beauties of the royal families of the Three Kingdoms, offered to that great person."
With disdain, Laughing Butcher continued, "You only see the petty victories from afar without understanding the reason behind them. His Highness is truly farsighted..."
The other two quickly nodded, their expressions turning to one of realization, as they began to praise His Highness’s wisdom.
...
The "Furnaces" were soon transported to the market at the foot of Puppet Sect Mountain.
This market was no longer at the foot of South Bamboo Peak but under Paperman Peak instead.
Stalls, high buildings, iron cages, and the bustling presence of evil cultivators, great thieves, and Jianghu miscreants could be seen, along with the second prince of the Jin Kingdom—Ma Zhao.
The mingled scents of rouge, herbs, fine delicacies, and mountain mist, with a faint odor of decay from somewhere unknown, created an ever-growing, far larger marketplace than existed before.
The Nanwu Sword Sect was destroyed, leaving the Puppet Sect in sole dominance.
The Jin Kingdom had extinguished Wei, Shu, and now was on the verge of consuming the Wu Kingdom, thus unifying the Three Kingdoms.
To the mundane world, the Jin Palace was the center of political power in the realm.
But to the elites and the Jianghu, true power lay here.
Ma Zhao, full of ambition, sat in a pavilion, his leg crossed, nibbling on fruits and sweets, awaiting the return of that great person.
As he watched, he suddenly noticed a figure not far away.
The figure wore nothing but a simple face-covering cloak, wandering as if both examining goods and reminiscing.
At first, there was nothing notable until a gust of wind slightly lifted the cloak, revealing half of the figure’s face.
Ma Zhao, being the second prince of the Jin Kingdom, though delving into unscrupulous methods to climb the ranks, possessed some talent, and having a "good memory" was one such talent.
He took great care to remember the faces and names of anyone who might prove useful to him. Even after years apart, he could recognize them instantly, feigning a joyful reunion as if meeting an old friend.
Therefore, such a person would never make the blunder of not recognizing an important person standing before him, only to mock them and face retribution later.
Before coming here, he had etched that great person’s face in his mind. He might forget his father or his wife but never this great person.
Later, upon realizing that the great person was someone he had previously mocked at the South Bamboo Peak market, he had long planned on how to apologize and admit his mistake.
At this moment, seeing that figure, Ma Zhao’s entire body shook violently, his heart pounding, and the arm holding the teacup trembled. He leapt up and slid on his knees before the figure, exclaiming joyfully, "Greetings, Sect Leader Song!"
After speaking, he began to rub his eyes, tearily stating, "I’ve long admired you, and today, finally seeing you, my heart trembles uncontrollably, my clothes soaked with tears, sobbing... I’ve finally met you."
Suddenly recalling something, he started slapping his face left and right, saying, "Years ago, at the foot of South Bamboo Peak, I had the fortune to see you once. It’s a shame this fool couldn’t recognize the gold Buddha. Had I known, I would have knelt before you immediately, sobbing..."
This bout of sobbing drew the attention of those around.
They had assumed it was one of the captured Furnaces lamenting, but upon closer inspection, recognized the sobbing figure as the second prince of the Jin Kingdom. Seeing whom he knelt before, they rushed over, forming circle upon circle around Song Yan, kneeling him at the center.
In the distance, those within the cages, many Furnaces looked longingly at the sole standing man, displaying only two kinds of expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_2
Most of it was fear and despair, with a small part deeply rooted in hatred.
Song Yan lowered his head to glance at the man in the red robe who was the first to kneel.
He remembered, back when he was still a servant, he went to the foot of South Bamboo Peak to purchase some Martial Arts Techniques. The red-robed man, then a teenager, was called the young master by those in the pavilion. After Song Yan left, he might have been mocked a few times, but he didn’t hear it clearly and didn’t take it seriously.
Song Yan surveyed the surroundings, sighing inwardly.
’Indeed, I still don’t like this feeling.’
Suddenly, a sense arose in his heart: "Quickly find a way to break through to the Purple Mansion, infiltrate the Sword Sect at the Ancient Teleportation Array before the Great Demon from the Mountain and Sea Demon Country arrives, then go with Junior Sister Xiao Li to the other side of the Teleportation Array to lead a life free of scheming and plotting."
’I hope I can find the method for breaking through to the Purple Mansion, that Yu Xuanwei can repair the Ancient Teleportation Array in time, that it isn’t too dangerous on the other side...’
He hadn’t thought of resisting the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
Through the Grandmother Fox, Red Granny, and the Ancient General, he roughly understood the awkward geographical situation of the Three Kingdoms.
If the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country" were a mountain, then the "Three Kingdoms" would be one of the numerous little pitfalls pressed beneath it.
If the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country" were a normal country, the "Three Kingdoms" would be a small out-of-the-way village on a wasteland, and such villages were not uncommon.
Numerous, so...before the King Wei begged for help, before Changwang Hu lost something here, no demon cared to notice such a place.
Even if noticed, they wouldn’t come over.
And that’s determined by the national structure of the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country."
The "Mountain and Sea Demon Country" isn’t fully composed of demons, but is a "collective term for numerous human nations captive by demons."
In other words, the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country" truly lacks nothing to eat.
Vast lands, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, and fishery, all are abundant.
Yet, outside the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, there are formidable human forces.
Ordinary people and cultivators among those forces are not to be feared, but...there is a type of people who call themselves the "Ancient Race."
The "Ancient Race" is a huge race, with camps divided internally, much like the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country."
The two sides are like fire and water.
But the "Multi-tailed Fox Race" and the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race" being in the heartland of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race means they hardly encounter the Ancient Race.
As for the "Three Kingdoms" geopolitical situation, there is simply no hope.
Even if Song Yan withstood one wave of demons, he surely couldn’t withstand the next, and if he wanted to go north to connect with the "Ancient Race," he would have to carve a path through the great mountain of the "Mountain and Sea Demon Country."
If he could truly achieve that, would he still need the "Ancient Race?"
Besides, would the "Ancient Race" necessarily be any better?
Humans, after all, might not be much more merciful than demons.
Song Yan had thought a lot along the way.
He wanted to flee.
He still cherished the days with Junior Sister Xiao Li.
His ideal dao companion was someone like Tian Xiaojiu, An Li, or a silly girl with Su Yao’s temperament from early on.
Various thoughts flashed by, and he couldn’t help but sigh internally, "Before, as a servant, I thought about running, and now even as Sect Leader, I still think about escaping?"
Then he glanced again at the second prince of Jin Kingdom kneeling before him and the surrounding evil cultivators, bandits, and Jianghu villains, raising his hand to casually lift the hood, revealing his face in the bleak autumn sunshine.
In the distance, many shadow puppets, paper figures, and blood corpses appeared in the sky, clearly signifying that the Puppet Sect had heard of the Sect Leader’s return, coming to greet him.
However, the numbers were not many.
Not surprising.
Although Red Granny and the Ancient General were dead, there were still many little fox cubs scattered outside.
The "great battle is over" was only true for Song Yan; for ordinary cultivators, their war was just beginning.
The second prince of Jin Kingdom, Ma Zhao, was kneeling and suddenly saw some mud on Song Yan’s boots. He hurriedly crawled forward a few steps, then turned his cheek slightly, and began to rub it back and forth like a rag with his clean face.
Song Yan looked at this second prince, unable to help but sigh, "He should indeed join my Puppet Sect."
Ma Zhao was overjoyed, lifting his head to say, "Whatever the Sect Leader wants me to do, I’ll do it."
As a crafty villain and expert in underhanded ways, he deeply understood one truth: sometimes, kneeling before someone grants you power. And power would cause many to kneel before you.
Song Yan took out a Puppet Sect token from his bosom and tossed it out.
The token was inscribed with the character "Song."
This was the ’Sect Leader’s Proof’ hastily made by the Mechanical Peak. Naturally, there were different grades, and what Song Yan threw out was certainly the lowest grade.
But even the lowest grade could still label Ma Zhao as marked by the "Song Demon."
Ma Zhao took it and held it tightly in his arms, bowing deeply in gratitude.
Song Yan smiled, "Do well."
Ma Zhao shouted loudly, "Thank you, Master, thank you, Master!!"
Song Yan no longer paid attention to him.
Sometimes, bestowing grace is not a good thing. For instance, with the Jin Kingdom’s second prince holding Song Yan’s Sect Leader token, he would surely become a target for the little fox cubs seeking revenge; even if he didn’t die here, he would certainly be captured and tortured after the Mountain and Sea Demon Country arrived, then undergo a soul search.
Seeking benevolence gets benevolence, seeking death gets death.
He gave Qiu Lianyue an anonymous Puppet Sect token to avoid involving the girl; he gave Ma Zhao the "Song" character token to embroil him, letting him play both the role of a dog and die dreadfully.
He liked kind-hearted people, but his methods were increasingly dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_3
Song Yan stepped forward.
Ma Zhao called out obsequiously from behind: "By the way, Master, this humble one has also gathered the Three Kingdoms Princesses, the most beautiful women of today’s royal family, as a special tribute to you, you..."
Song Yan did not look but continued to walk forward.
The kneeling people hurriedly parted, and after he passed, they cautiously looked up at this legendary demon of the Three Kingdoms, eyes full of awe.
In the distance...
Rows of cultivators descended from the sky.
In addition to those who came to greet him, there were also "Song the Demon’s two concubines."
"Greetings, Sect Leader." The demon cultivators bowed in unison.
The young lady Yuzhuang slightly bowed.
But Su Yao stood coldly among the crowd, like a crane among chickens, lotus out of mud, completely motionless.
Song Yan paused his steps, suddenly turning his head towards the direction of the "Three Kingdoms Princesses."
As he turned his head, the Three Kingdoms Princesses were also glaring at him with hatred, but Song Yan saw another kind of hatred in the eyes of one princess, and the target was not him, but... Su Yao.
"Little Ma."
"Ah, Master, I am here."
"I accept your gift."
...
...
The next day...
Paperman Peak...
The most luxurious Cave Mansion with the densest Profound Qi.
The morning sunlight pierced the high mountain layers of clouds, sprinkling into this space.
In the bedding, Song Yan held the young lady Yuzhuang with his left hand, and Su Yao with his right.
The two women slept soundly, unconsciously entwined with him, like intertwined roots of trees, difficult to separate.
On the first day back to the sect, Song Yan did nothing because he was still observing.
Some came to pay respects, some came for "briefing their duties."
He opened his eyes at this moment but did not wake the women beside him, allowing them to continue sleeping.
He lay on his back, gazing at the hanging drapery, falling into contemplation.
Yesterday, he saw many people; almost every disciple still remaining in the Puppet Sect came to pay respect, even Mr. Wang, "Madam Wang’s husband," also came.
The identity of that husband was Gu Huangzi’s third disciple – Zuo Junqing.
Gu Huangzi had a total of five disciples during his lifetime.
The first disciple Gong Libai, early stage Crimson Palace;
The second disciple has died in battle;
The third disciple Zuo Junqing, Ninth Layer of Refining Profound;
The fourth disciple Wu Yintai, has died at Song Yan’s hands;
Song Yan was the youngest disciple.
Zuo Junqing, true to his name, was handsome, tall and sturdy; Song Yan knew it was the type Wang Susu liked almost at first glance.
And Zuo Junqing wasn’t someone who didn’t understand the circumstances, just like the other demon cultivators, he used flattering language to praise Song Yan.
Song Yan didn’t care about this, seeing Zuo Junqing but not Wang Susu, so he asked curiously: "Where is Madam Wang?"
Zuo Junqing sighed deeply, saying: "Susu and I have always been apart more than together, she often returns to the Evil Land to make shadow puppets, but over a month ago, Susu went to the Evil Land and never returned.
I went to investigate, but found the core area of the Evil Land was in chaos. The Evil Beasts, Evil Shadow Puppets seemed to be mad, killing whoever they saw. I almost lost my life before stepping into the core."
After speaking, he sighed heavily again.
...
As the memory flashed by, Song Yan’s eyes revealed a contemplative look.
The timing of "a month ago" was quite coincidental, pretty much right after he killed Granny Red and General Gu.
But he couldn’t see any possible connection between these two events.
He just liked to think a lot, not to think wildly.
As he was pondering, suddenly Miss Su Qi who was on his right arm opened her eyes.
Miss Qi suddenly loosened the legs entwined with him, showing disdain as she quickly exited the bedding, not looking at him, hurriedly wearing the robe and heading out.
Outside the door, the Wu Kingdom Autumn Water Princess was sweeping the fallen leaves in the courtyard like a maid, and upon meeting Su Yao’s gaze, Autumn Water Princess waved the broom, screaming: "Demoness, I’ll kill you!"
Su Yao, was stunned.
...
...
Snap!
The broom of Wu Kingdom Autumn Water Princess fell on Su Yao, but Su Yao didn’t even move.
Autumn Water Princess hadn’t really thought she could hit the target.
The two women stayed there dumbfounded.
For a long time, it was Su Yao who first snapped out of it, saying: "I came here to kill Song the Demon, to avenge my Su Family, my Sword Sect."
Autumn Water Princess said: "So, Miss Qi is enduring humiliation for her mission?"
Su Yao said: "Yes."
Looking at the princess before her, she still remembered how the young girl had been taken by the king of Wu to see her; back then Wu Wang laughed and said, "This is the future of Su Family and also the significant tree Wu Kingdom relies on." Since then, the girl had come year after year, admiring her deeply, but they never expected this confrontation upon meeting again.
Autumn Water Princess said: "So, you became Song the Demon’s favored concubine, wore Puppet Sect’s clothes, entered and exited freely during the day, and accompanied that demon to sleep at night, all just to find a chance to kill him?"
Su Yao began to realize something was wrong.
Autumn Water Princess looked coldly at her, continuing: "Men on the bed, always have their most negligent moments, did you make a move?"
Su Yao said: "He’s already too strong... Even if he sleeps and allows me to strike, I cannot kill him."
Autumn Water Princess said nothing more, yet suddenly bowed her head, for a long time she said: "I see now, I misunderstood Miss Qi."
She moved like a girl who had made a mistake.
But Su Yao’s heart suddenly turned to ashes.
Autumn Water Princess and she shared the same temperament, even the prelude to making a move was exactly alike.
Sure enough, as the two approached, Autumn Water Princess suddenly removed a dagger hidden in her sleeve, which she had intended for her suicide, and then fiercely stabbed towards Su Yao’s chest.
Clink!
Su Yao moved her fingers and blocked the dagger.
Autumn Water Princess exerted her force to pull it out, but it didn’t budge.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: 131. Sect Leader Returns, Evil Land’s Peculiarity (7.4K Words - Two-in-One, Please Subscribe)_4
The princess wore a furious look, mimicking the woman making a scene by the roadside, "Spat" a mouthful, spitting onto Su Yao’s face, then turned and ran away.
Su Yao painfully closed her eyes.
At some point, she realized the door behind her had mysteriously opened.
Behind the door, Song Yan, who was supposed to be on the collapsed bed, had actually gotten up, looking at her with keen interest.
When their gazes met, Song Yan raised his hand, waved, and smiled, "Demoness, good morning."
Su Yao left in anger.
Yuzhuang, the young lady, silently watched all this from behind. When she met the distant glance of Princess Yongjia of the Wei Kingdom and sensed the hatred in their eyes, she sighed softly, showing a contemplative look, then asked, "Did you foresee this, Dao brother?"
Song Yan said, "You’re calling me Dao brother again?"
Yuzhuang, the young lady, said, "Dao brother’s fierce reputation is well-known, and his methods ruthless, already no longer the person Yuzhuang once knew."
Song Yan said, "I am that person, as for the fierce reputation... it’s just someone pretending to be me causing trouble everywhere."
Yuzhuang, the young lady, slightly bowed her head and asked, "Then why doesn’t Dao brother try to change all this?"
She took a deep breath, hastily said, "Dao brother is already the Puppet Sect Leader, with unimaginable means, why? Could it be that Dao brother wishes to see this?"
"It’s just what you perceive as unimaginable," Song Yan said, "You can call me Dao brother again, I’m quite happy."
Yuzhuang, the young lady, lowered her head, softly said, "I can no longer remember the impressions of childhood, only some smiles of the emperor father and empress mother, but the Puppet Sect destroyed all of this.
The Sword Sect is my new home, where I regained my courage and found a reason to live again, and the Puppet Sect destroyed all of this again."
Song Yan said, "You have reason to hate me, for I am the Puppet Sect Leader."
Yuzhuang, the young lady, said, "But if you are still the person I knew, I... cannot hate you. The days spent with Dao brother were the happiest days for Yuzhuang.
Moreover, Dao brother’s actions, Yuzhuang probably sees through them.
Dao brother just pretends to be fierce, wanting to give me and Seventh Miss a belief to live."
Song Yan said, "Being alive is always a good thing."
Yuzhuang, the young lady, said, "But not everyone thinks so, some things... are more important than being alive."
Song Yan didn’t say more, everyone has their own thoughts.
He himself cannot become someone who sacrifices life for ideals, but it doesn’t prevent him from respecting such people.
...
During the day, some disciples who hadn’t returned yesterday came to pay respects.
But the two young disciples he had previously accepted, "Yueyang Luo" and "Shen Nongjia", didn’t come.
When Song Yan asked, he found out that after the "alliance between Puppet Sect and Evil Land Ghost Cultivators", not long after, these two were sent to the Evil Land, and since then, Puppet Sect had completely erased the "Shadow Puppet Lineage", needing Shadow Puppets only to seek them from the Evil Land.
Song Yan found it somewhat strange.
In his impression, Gu Huangzi wasn’t such a generous person.
So, he further inquired with the sect elders, and the elder said that at the time Gu Huangzi considered the Shadow Puppet Dao meaningless, and it was better to hand it over entirely to Ghost Cultivators to handle, so he sent his two young disciples away.
...
In the afternoon...
The pale autumn light swayed faintly with the desolate cold wind.
Traces of Evil Qi from a distant place mixed in the air, making the entire Puppet Sect’s color present a peculiar pale red.
The blood of the strong still soaked the paper pulp, the faint smell of blood evoking memories of Song Yan’s past.
He arranged to meet with Blood Cliff, because only Blood Cliff knew where Gu Huangzi hid the Demon Sect’s inheritance.
Blood Cliff, named as Master of Blood Corpse Peak, was actually a slave completely controlled by Gu Huangzi, making it easy for the latter to share these secrets, which benefited Song Yan now.
However, when Song Yan returned, Blood Cliff was not there.
She was out solving a "Fox Demon Nest" and wouldn’t be back until the next day at the soonest.
So, Song Yan merely wandered around today, did nothing, nor explored the Evil Land.
Back in his room, he took paper and pen, hastily wrote down some of his Sword Dao insights, and then wrote out the "Sword Heaven Gate" he realized from "Sleeve Universe", then handed it directly to Yuzhuang, the young lady.
After finishing all this, it was already dark.
Song Yan and Yuzhuang climbed into the bed, but Su Yao dared not defy his rules, reluctantly removed her pants and belt, then climbed onto the bed, eyes filled with hatred to serve him.
After the matter was done, Song Yan said, "Seventh Miss, now you too are a demoness, why insist on opposing me, the demon? Why not focus your mind on cultivation?"
Su Yao turned away in anger, showing him her back and buttocks, no longer looking at him.
Yuzhuang softly said, "Dao brother, Seventh Miss should have understood something, just that she’s thin-skinned, unwilling to admit it."
Su Yao said, "No way!"
Though she said no, she already knew "People are always helpless, and there are many things that cannot be explained."
Song Yan embraced her from behind.
Su Yao struggled a bit but let himself do as he pleased.
She was already a demoness, being toyed with by a demon seemed like nothing.
Thinking of the hateful eyes of Princess Qiushui, she felt a thorn in her heart.
...
The next day...
Blood Cliff didn’t return.
This old woman showed up in front of Song Yan until the third day, placing a large bag of "Fox Demon Skin" before him, respectfully saying, "Sect Leader, the little foxes were more than expected, ordinary disciples couldn’t handle them, so this old woman took some extra time.
These are the Fox Demon Skins you wanted, I’ve prepared them all.
As for the sect inheritance and cultivation techniques, please come with me."
Song Yan nodded, and the two of them flew off together.
...
Soon after...
In an underground secret room at Paperman Peak.
The secret room was empty,
but Blood Cliff stood at a desolate corner, her form shifted, rippling away, and vanished from sight.
Song Yan followed and found that inside was a small secret realm.
This secret realm was almost the size of a mountain top, and the cave mansion for storage was filled with traps.
Blood Cliff explained while leading Song Yan to bypass the traps, and then they reached a study at the end of the cave mansion.
On the shelves of this study were most of the important inheritances of the Puppet Sect.
Blood Corpse System Techniques, Paperman System Techniques, Shadow Puppet System Techniques, Mechanism System Techniques, and Exotic Poison System Techniques, all had backups.
Song Yan scanned through and suddenly asked, "Has our Puppet Sect ever had a Purple Mansion Realm expert?"
Blood Cliff shook her head, "This old woman doesn’t know."
Song Yan curiously said, "You don’t know?"
Blood Cliff said, "The sect atmosphere, you know, many things the subordinates are unaware of, matters separated by generations become unsolvable mysteries."
Song Yan browsed the bookshelf, quickly flipping through a "Sect Chronicles".
Flipping quickly, he found the start time of the Sect Chronicles was only two hundred years ago, then the sect leader’s ancestor was Gu Huangzi’s master, recorded as late stage of the Crimson Palace, anything prior was gone.
And when it came to Gu Huangzi’s master, that too was late stage of the Crimson Palace.
Gu Huangzi, because he hadn’t confirmed the Third Central Palace Essence Blood, was temporarily delaying, but breaking through to the late stage was only a matter of time.
Song Yan squinted slightly, continuing his search on the bookshelf for information regarding "breaking through to the Purple Mansion Realm".
Soon, he found a booklet.
The booklet was very old, and the paper used inside was the same as the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" drawn by Nanwu Sword Sect, also known as "Sea of Suffering".
The records were quite chaotic but indeed discussed the "Purple Mansion Realm."
Soon, his attention was drawn to a certain section.
This type of paper, lasting millennia without decay, yet had a section torn from the middle.
The torn edge appeared serrated.
Song Yan could completely imagine someone hurriedly trying to rip this page apart, but stopped just in time due to some accident, so a portion remained.
The uppermost part of the remnant described a sentence: Inferior Profound Root, Lower Grade Profound Root, unable to break through to the Purple Mansion Realm.
Following that was a record of a Secret Technique called "Washing Profound Divine Technique", roughly about using extremely precious Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, to go to the core of corresponding Profound Land, operate the Secret Technique, thereby enhancing the Profound Root. The success rate was influenced by the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.
Among them, Earth Profound Root was the most convenient, just needing to go to the Profound Vein’s core.
Five Elements Profound required going to the core of the corresponding Five Elements Profound Vein.
Ghost Profound Root needed to go to the Evil Land Core.
Song Yan gazed at the words "Evil Land Core", looked at the torn page, and simultaneously recalled the "Evil Qi Riot that caused Wang Susu’s disappearance", couldn’t help but squint his eyes a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: 132. Song Yan’s visit, please come out to meet (4.6K words - subscription requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: 132. Song Yan’s visit, please come out to meet (4.6K words - subscription requested)
Song Yan never believed in coincidences.
So, after he defeated and absorbed Grandma Hong and the ancient General, he felt a new abnormality coming from the Evil Land.
He wouldn’t be careless, especially when facing the unknown, even more so.
Thus, he began to analyze.
There were three apparent abnormalities that formed the coincidence:
First, after he defeated Grandma Hong and the ancient General, the Evil Land Core suddenly went into turmoil.
The turmoil of the Evil Land Core after defeating Grandma Hong and the ancient General could normally be attributed to "a backup plan left by the two Fox Demons," akin to the kind of act of "if I don’t return, blow up the opponent’s base." But both Grandma Hong and the ancient General had become his spirit slaves, and they hadn’t done any such thing at all.
Second, Wang Susu, who could provide him with information about the Evil Land Core, disappeared;
However, not only did Wang Susu disappear, but also his previous junior disciples. This doesn’t really explain anything because Wang Susu, Shen Nongjia, Yueyang Luo, and even those Skin Masters who merged with Shadow Puppet Peak had strength levels that were too low. No matter how they acted, it should not have caused such turmoil.
Third, he needed to use the "Washing Profound Divine Technique" to enhance his Profound Root at the Evil Land Core.
Whether "Washing Profound Divine Technique" was effective or not, he still didn’t know, but this point could be easily verified.
Song Yan grabbed the many Puppet Sect inheritances and stuffed them one by one into his storage space, ready to study them one by one, while holding the "Washing Profound Divine Technique" in his hand, ready to try it later.
The matter of the Evil Land had too many possibilities.
He pondered along the way and walked out of the secret chamber together with Blood Cliff.
As soon as they stepped out, a cold wind blew over from afar, mixed with fine snowflakes, carrying a sharp scent of blood.
Blood Cliff was used to it; spring, summer, autumn, and winter didn’t matter to her. She had little lifespan left and had planned to settle down a bit after fleeing with Gu Huangzi and then break through, but circumstances changed, and she returned here. Now, she also needed to help the demon cultivators below deal with the tricky Fox Demons.
Seeing that Song Yan had acquired the inheritance, and she had already killed quite a number of Fox Demons outside, she took the opportunity to make this plan.
Song Yan agreed.
Blood Cliff respectfully intended to step away.
Song Yan suddenly called her back, asking, "Blood Granny, you’ve lived long enough. I want to ask you two questions."
Blood Cliff quickly said, "Master, please ask."
Song Yan said, "First, which cultivators above the Crimson Palace Realm are in the Evil Land?"
Blood Cliff said, "Originally, there were two in the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace, Two-Faced and Ghost Chixia. One in the Late Stage, Zhang Han. But after the previous incident with Elder Miss Fox, Two-Faced died, and Zhang Han was seriously injured."
Song Yan had already obtained this information from various sources, and as he pondered, he really couldn’t see where this information could be falsified.
If Ghost Cultivator was hiding his strength, why secretly let Two-Faced infiltrate Shadow Puppet Peak and then abduct it? If Zhang Han were so powerful, how could he have been killed by Elder Miss Fox right in front of everyone’s eyes, along with Two-Faced and the Stone Seat Elder?
Song Yan said, "Second, how much do you know about Zhang Han?"
Blood Cliff paused, recalling, "When this old woman joined the Puppet Sect, Zhang Han had already disappeared for over a hundred years. However, I heard he was once a Loose Cultivator dominating the Three Kingdoms, overpowering both the Puppet Sect and Nanwu Sword Sect. Then he suddenly disappeared, but unexpectedly appeared in the Evil Land, possessed by an evil spirit and became a Ghost Cultivator.
I heard from Gu Huangzi that his kind of Ghost Cultivator is quite special, born of the land, hence bound to the land and unable to go out. Even during Lady Wang’s wedding, the alliance between our Puppet Sect and the Evil Land, he did not appear.
However, these should have nothing to do with the real Zhang Han anymore.
The current one is already Ghost Cultivator Zhang Han, a newly born entity with no relation to Zhang Han."
Song Yan nodded.
Blood Cliff saluted again and then left.
Song Yan stood alone on the spot.
The snowflakes continued to fall, lightly touching his body with coolness, which suddenly made him recall the previous scene of playing snowball fights with Junior Sister An Li. He raised his hand to touch his cheek, remembering that silly girl’s playful attacks on him with snowballs vividly.
...
Song Yan stopped thinking further. He quickly returned to his cave mansion, went to the cultivation chamber, and began to study the "Washing Profound Divine Technique."
Spending a lot of effort, he loaded it onto the panel and then invested life span to comprehend it.
[In the eleventh year, you’ve cultivated "Washing Profound Divine Technique" to perfection. You realize that it is merely a secret technique, and whether it’s perfected or not doesn’t really affect its application. The core of this technique is not the technique itself but the heavenly materials and earthly treasures that nurture your body, and the environment you are in.]
[To improve Ghost Profound Root, the core material listed in the "Washing Profound Divine Technique" is "Soul Drowning Grass." Grass has no soul, and through the wandering souls of lonely ghosts, the flow of Evil Qi remains soulless. With decades or a century, it may undergo a transformation and morph into Soul Drowning Grass. This grass can solidify the soul base, aiding in stabilizing the divine soul when enhancing the Profound Root Talent. If you desire to enhance it to Middle-Grade Ghost Profound Root, you need at least two nearly millennia-old Soul Drowning Grass. The older they are, the greater the success rate.]
Nearly millennia-old Soul Drowning Grass?
Song Yan didn’t need to look to know this was a rare commodity.
Having been a Pill Master, albeit a lousy one, he still had some understanding of Profound Flowers and Profound Grass.
In the Three Kingdoms territory, a few hundred years old grass is already rare, let alone nearly a millennia.
However, upon realizing that the purpose of "Soul Drowning Grass" was to stabilize the divine soul, not to enhance the divine soul’s strength, he suddenly felt he might not need this thing at all. His sweat, wisdom, and the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet could solve this problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: 132. Song Yan visits, please come out to meet (4.6K words - requesting subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: 132. Song Yan visits, please come out to meet (4.6K words - requesting subscription)_2
So, what’s left seems to be finding a suitable Evil Land Core for him.
And this place is right in front of his eyes.
...
On a snowy night, Song Yan did not go directly to the Evil Land Core; instead, he called Gong Libai over.
"Libai, I need you to find something for me."
"Master, please instruct."
"Soul Drowning Grass, must be over a thousand years old, two stalks."
Gong Libai’s expressionless and fierce eyes showed a trace of astonishment. He knew of Soul Drowning Grass, it was an essential ingredient for some ’Soul System Elixirs,’ but usually they were decades old.
Over a thousand years old?
This... not to mention Soul Drowning Grass, even other Spirit Flowers and Herbs are extremely rare, finding just one would be a stroke of luck.
But since it’s Song Yan’s order, he had no choice but to agree reluctantly, but he immediately added, "Master, these days, I’m still dealing with those fox cubs infiltrating the Three Kingdoms, I’m afraid I might not be able to fully help you with this."
Song Yan said, "No worries, if you can’t handle it, let the disciples come to me directly."
Gong Libai hesitated, surprised, "How can this be? Just a few fox demons, are they really worth your trouble?"
Song Yan said, "After several battles, the Puppet Sect is already short-handed."
Gong Libai hurriedly said, "I understand my mistake, I will speed up the training of the lower-level cultivators. Recently, I’ve recruited many new people, and quite a few promising seeds have emerged. Now that the Sword Sect cultivators are no longer hunting outside, these seeds should have a much higher survival rate. In less than ten years, our Puppet Sect will surely be full of talent again."
"Go," Song Yan waved his hand.
Gong Libai took his leave.
Song Yan watched his departing figure for a long time before retreating into the secluded chamber belonging solely to the Sect Leader, where he quickly began the skin-making of the Ancient General’s wolf hide.
An entire night passed, and dawn had yet to arrive.
Outside, the snowfall continued to grow heavier, and in this dim and hazy view, a malformed giant wolf shadow puppet silently emerged from the chamber, swiftly heading towards the Evil Land.
And above the giant wolf shadow puppet’s head, a bodiless phantom crow circled.
The Divine Soul Power provided by the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet allowed Song Yan to simultaneously use the "Divine Soul Hundred Defenses" to split his soul among fifteen shadow puppets.
Without this bracelet, and before absorbing the Changwang Tiger Soul, his limit was five.
It was obvious that the higher the difficulty of soul splitting, the more challenging it became; fifteen shadow puppets were already the limit.
After doing all this, he stretched his body, returned to his bedroom, shed his clothes, and seeing the two women still lying on the bed, he slipped in, turned to his left, not knowing who he was cuddling, he comfortably fell asleep.
As for the arrangement of the "Soul Drowning Grass"...
Song Yan had his own thoughts: he might not need this mystical herb, but he needed to know if "such a rare thousand-year mystical herb might just happen to appear within his obtainable range at this moment."
If it does, that would be interesting indeed.
If you need something rare, and this rare thing just happens to materialize in some way before you, and if you’re sure you’re not dreaming, then you need to be vigilant.
...
Morning.
Su Yao glanced at the two beside her, quietly lifted the quilt, put on her boots and clothes, wrapped herself in the Puppet Sect demon cultivator’s robe, and walked out the door.
The light snow outside had slightly stopped, and three beautiful princesses sent there were like maids, sweeping the accumulated snow in Song’s courtyard.
Before they arrived, they had been trained repeatedly, knowing what they must do to survive, whether they liked it or not.
Hatred, confusion, and fear constantly enveloped them.
Fortunately, until now, Song had not done anything to them.
Upon seeing Su Yao, the princesses from Wei and Shu kingdoms slightly bowed and called out, "Good morning, Madam."
Princess Qiushui from the Wu Kingdom, however, stubbornly stared directly at Su Yao, cursed "demoness" harshly, then turned and ran away.
Su Yao did not chase after her; she sighed softly, then walked silently along the road of Paperman Peak in the Puppet Sect. After a while, she unsheathed her sword and flew away...
A moment later, a sword rainbow landed atop a hill full of graves and tombs.
She walked disconsolately on the hill, and after a while, suddenly stopped at a high cliff.
The view from the cliff was quite nice, and directly opposite the distant snow-capped mountains was a tombstone.
The tombstone bore the inscription "The Tomb of Su Gong Changyi of the Nanwu Sword Sect," and the side was engraved with many names.
Su Yao looked at each, finding all the names very familiar, almost able to recall each person’s voice, appearance, and past memories just by seeing a name.
But her expression became increasingly bitter because these people were all dead!
And when her gaze fell upon the words "Seventh Sister, Su Yao," she could no longer hold back and cried out loudly, kneeling in front of the tombstone, wailing.
...
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh~
The "Ancient General Shadow Puppet," containing Song Yan’s aura, moved rapidly through the mountains.
The Evil Land was indeed eerie, but if compared by appearance alone, the malformed giant wolf far exceeded these specters in terror.
Yet even so, the entire Evil Land’s rampage surprised Song Yan a bit.
It seemed like he had plunged into a vortex of Evil Qi, filled everywhere with torrents capable of sweeping away ordinary people and leaving regular cultivators unable to stand firm.
But these had no effect on the Ancient General Shadow Puppet, which had a Middle Stage of Crimson Palace physique.
Since there seemed to be an issue with the Evil Land, Song Yan naturally had to send a shadow puppet to investigate first.
The demon shadow puppet had lost all its skills but still retained its physique and inherent racial talent.
Song Yan had three shadow puppets above the Crimson Palace Level: two foxes and one wolf.
The fox’s talent was Illusion Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 132. Song Yan visits, please come out to meet (4.6K words - requesting subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: 132. Song Yan visits, please come out to meet (4.6K words - requesting subscription)_3
The wolf’s talent is bloodthirsty.
Song Yan felt that the function of the "Illusion Technique" was stronger, while the wolf’s physique was superior, so he dispatched the wolf.
At this moment, he was getting closer and closer to the Evil Land Core.
As if crossing some boundary, suddenly Song Yan felt the atmosphere change.
The sky turned dark, sand and stones flew, and far away, amidst a chaotic dance of debris, visibility had completely disappeared, and one couldn’t see their own fingers in front of them.
But amid the clattering of leaves and stones, Song Yan acutely noticed an unusual sound.
The sound was a rustling, dripping, eerie noise, but the aura it carried felt oddly familiar.
The next instant...
Song Yan saw a flash of red light, and he sharply dodged to the side. Though it wasn’t easy, he managed to evade the sudden sneak attack without much danger.
Then, with a sidelong glance, he saw an extremely long red cord frozen and solidified in the space.
No!
It wasn’t a cord, but extremely abundant Slaughter Liquid!
The Evil Qi wouldn’t harm him, but the Slaughter Liquid would.
The Slaughter Liquid was countless times more chaotic than Evil Qi, and its harm to Crimson Palace cultivators was like that of Evil Qi to ordinary cultivators.
However, ordinary cultivators dealing with Evil Qi only needed to resist with Profound Qi. The greater the concentration of Evil Qi, the more Profound Qi was consumed. The Evil Qi that flooded the Suspended Room of South Bamboo Peak at night was nothing more than a drizzle.
Crimson Palace cultivators dealing with Slaughter Liquid, however, had to be more diligent. This stuff didn’t cover everything "evenly"; it attacked like swords and lances, highly aggressive. Crimson Palace cultivators not only had to mobilize Profound Qi but needed extra focus to dodge or concentrate their Profound Qi to block the "Slaughter Liquid Spear." If one were carelessly pierced by this "Slaughter Liquid Spear," it would penetrate the body fiercely, trying madly to occupy it.
Song Yan was familiar with this Slaughter Liquid because he had seen it before in the sealed barrier of the palace at the end of Luoxia Bamboo Island, which was produced after the death of the Sword Emperor Shui Bo.
Many thoughts flashed through, and while Song Yan’s body was still dodging in mid-air, his gaze remained fixed on that suspended red cord in the space.
He saw that the red cord seemed to be alive, starting to twist quickly, adjusting its direction, intending to continue tracking Song Yan.
On the other side, not far away from the swirling sands, came a rustling, strange noise again.
Whoosh!
Slaughter Liquid shot again.
Song Yan crouched down.
Swish!
The Slaughter Liquid swept across like tentacles.
Song Yan leaped up.
Both sides moved extremely fast, drawing afterimages in mid-air.
And at this moment, suddenly several points of red light exploded in the distance, and a few streams of Slaughter Liquid whizzed through the air, shooting at Song Yan from various angles, as if trying to penetrate this uninvited guest directly.
Song Yan transformed into an afterimage, retreating swiftly. Once he withdrew a certain distance, the Slaughter Liquid stopped.
Song Yan raised his hairy, abnormally black paw, licking the back of the wolf’s fur, his ghostly eyes staring into the distance.
The space he retreated from was like a spider web covered with Slaughter Liquid.
And this Slaughter Liquid, as if realizing the prey had left, retracted in strands, lowering, landing, retreating, like a tide of blood receding, or a blood-colored giant beast retracting its hunting tentacles.
Song Yan squinted at this scene, summoned Grandma Fox, and upon learning that "back when Grandma Fox came to the Evil Land Core, there wasn’t such ferocious Slaughter Liquid," he shouted loudly, "Elder Zhang, Master Chixia, Song Yan is here, please come out and meet!"
The words were penetrative, instantly piercing into the Evil Land Core, yet like a stone sinking into the sea, there was no response.
Song Yan shouted again, "Susu Junior Sister, are you here?"
Still no response.
He continued to shout.
"Little Shen, Little Yue, Master is here, aren’t you coming out?"
Still, no response.
The entire Evil Land Core seemed to have not only "upgraded" due to its ferocity but also turned into what felt like a true forbidden land of life.
As for the cultivators who once entered the forbidden land, are they already dead?
No one knows.
And why has this Evil Land Core become chaotic?
Still, no one knows.
But Song Yan knows that relying solely on the "Ancient General Shadow Puppet" can no longer further explore.
If he wants to improve his Profound Root Talent, he needs to come personally to the core of this place.
However, though it’s urgent, he isn’t panicked.
He plans to first assimilate the Puppet Sect’s heritage, then bring all the elders of the Puppet Sect here.
If it’s just a purely accidental riot, then there’s nothing.
But if someone is causing trouble, the troublemaker must at least be a Crimson Palace.
In the Puppet Sect’s stronghold, there’s only the Elder of the Crimson Palace.
Song Yan will bring everyone here, and by then, no matter who it is, is destined to become the vanguard, or reveal flaws.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 133. Puppet Inheritance, Comprehensive Enhancement (2.2K words - Seek Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: 133. Puppet Inheritance, Comprehensive Enhancement (2.2K words - Seek Subscription)
The deathly silent empty mountain.
The chaotic and noisy vortex of Evil Qi, with its hidden core of mysterious slaughter liquid, did not add any liveliness, but instead made the deathly silence even more intense.
In the courtyard, light snow fluttered down intermittently, and the princesses from the Three Kingdoms occasionally used their purple, frozen hands to grab brooms and clear away the accumulated snow, keeping the bricks and tiles clean.
Song Yan also got up, letting Yuzhuang, the young lady, arrange his attire. Once she finished, he had Yuzhuang practice a set of swordsmanship and offered some guidance.
In the end, Yuzhuang asked softly, "How does Brother Dao plan to handle the three girls outside the gate?"
Song Yan looked at the "grown-up young lady Yuzhuang," feeling a slight sentiment. The young lady used to never question anything, but now, she was beginning to worry about others. Moreover, the timing of her question was quite appropriate; she asked when she was serving him, and he seemed in a good mood upon waking.
This was undoubtedly growth.
The past torments had all become nourishment for her growth, making the once "mechanical young lady" more complex.
This sense of complexity, he felt, was a good thing for Yuzhuang, but... he didn’t quite like it.
He preferred those naive to the point of being silly girls, the kind who could easily get fired up.
He wouldn’t tease such girls, for he truly believed that having such a girl as a Dao companion would make him relaxed and happy.
"Leave it all to you, handle it however you want, even if you let them go down the mountain, I won’t mind."
Song Yan said casually.
Although those three princesses were beautiful, he had no interest.
"Thank you, Brother Dao."
The young lady Yuzhuang bowed deeply.
...
Song Yan returned once more to the cultivation chamber and took out a few volumes from the storage space.
Secret techniques of the Paperman System: "Papermaking Technique," "Paper Manipulation Skill," "Yin Yang Paper-cutting Skill."
Secret techniques of the Blood Corpse System: "Corpse Nourishing Technique," "Corpse-Driving Skill," "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill."
He browsed through them one by one.
For papermen, the core lies in "making paper," strong paper makes strong papermen, while the "Yin Yang Paper-cutting" explains the two methods of making "papermen."
Papermen with engraving involve those colorful, diverse papermen of all kinds that Gu Huangzi had before, characterized by their large numbers, moving in groups, and their size adjustable within a certain range, though individual strength tends to be weak.
Papermen with positive engraving are those most commonly seen beauties in white on Paperman Peak, characterized by their scarcity and singularity, but with considerable individual strength.
Usually, paper made with the blood of strong individuals is destined to become "positive engraving papermen," which is the true "mecha."
However, papermen with negative engraving are also outstanding, emphasizing a kind of "hidden" aspect.
Therefore, the paper-cutting techniques learned by the demon cultivators on Paperman Peak today are all "positive engraving paper-cutting," while "negative engraving paper-cutting" is secretly kept by Gu Huangzi, aiming to "hide" and obscure its mysteries from others.
Before, the "paperman" hidden within the blood corpse’s skull, pretending to be the blood corpse’s divine soul, was just such a thing.
However, due to the size restriction of "negative engraving" papermen, only one could fit inside the blood corpse skull.
Having understood this information, Song Yan couldn’t help but compare the "papermen" with "shadow puppets."
He found that:
Firstly, the making of papermen, compared to shadow puppets, significantly improved their safety.
For shadow puppets, due to various reasons, one might suffer backlash, such as the "skin" exceeding one’s own strength, inviting wandering souls that were incorrect, or accidentally summoning an Evil Spirit, all might lead to mishaps.
But making papermen only requires correct techniques, knowing how to engrave negatively or positively.
Secondly, in terms of operability, papermen are far safer than shadow puppets.
Controlling a shadow puppet improperly, or lacking strength, could result in a backlash from the puppet.
However, papermen, as long as one is proficient in the "Paper Manipulation Skill," there are no problems, because papermen are like a "mecha," connected to one’s own divine soul, how could there be backlash?
Thirdly, in appearance, papermen also surpass shadow puppets.
Shadow puppets generally resemble what the original was like in life, they might even be uglier, while papermen can be cut into beautiful figures like celestial beauties or strong figures like gods as long as one knows how to cut.
However...
Advantages naturally come with disadvantages.
Firstly...
Papermen can inherit certain magical talents from the "blood in which they’re immersed," but physical strength is notably weak.
While shadow puppets retain the original body’s strength.
Taking "Auntie Fox" as an example.
The paperman made from Auntie Fox’s essence blood could wield "illusion techniques," "multi-tailed burst," and some basic skills Auntie Fox excelled at, yet their physical attributes would not be at the level they should be at the Crimson Palace Level.
Meanwhile, the shadow puppet made from Auntie Fox’s skin not only wields "illusion techniques," but also has a physical strength equivalent to its former self. As for the essence blood, it could be put to other use.
If you pit the Auntie Fox paperman against the Auntie Fox shadow puppet, the latter would definitely win with ease.
Secondly...
Creating papermen is a lengthy process, with blood being soaked into the paper pulp taking months, with seventy-seven days being common.
While for shadow puppets, Song Yan could skin something yesterday and complete several by today.
Thus, Song Yan could secretly make shadow puppets anytime, anywhere, but not papermen.
The overwhelming bloody scent couldn’t be hidden anyway.
...
As for corpse refining, it requires enhancing physical strength with herbs, followed by adding one’s own blood for control.
If Auntie Fox’s body were used to make a blood corpse, the resulting blood corpse’s physical strength would even surpass Auntie Fox.
However, Auntie Fox is clearly dependent on "magic," so the value isn’t considerable.
Regarding the "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill," it’s slightly more advanced than the ordinary "Corpse Nourishing Technique."
The latter can nourish anywhere there is Profound Qi, while the former selects specific locations for refining, resulting in stronger characteristics in the refined corpse.
Flying in the air, moving underground, poisonous, five elements of water and fire, undead remains, all are possible...
...
Once Song Yan placed the six volumes on the panel, he began to consume his lifespan for comprehension.
However, this time, he chose his cultivation wisely, without striving for "Secondary Perfect Mutations" in every technique.
Because some content overlaps, like "Corpse Nourishing Technique" and "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill," where the latter is clearly superior.
Also, because some techniques are too low-level, even if he spends time mutating, it serves little purpose; "Paper Manipulation Skill" and "Corpse-Driving Skill" are obvious examples.
For these, he only intended to cultivate to "Single Mutation," adding more if he obtains ample lifespan later.
A deep understanding of each profound technique surfaced in his mind, with the vast knowledge giving him a sense of exhilaration like when he became the Puppet Sect Leader.
"Papermaking Technique," threshold: none; perfected after 5 years of deduction; mutated once with a technique "Evil Paper Technique" after 24 years of deduction; perfect technique "Evil Spirit Technique" achieved with secondary mutation after 470 years of deduction.
The "Evil Paper Technique," compared to "Papermaking Technique," merely makes the created papermen somewhat stronger physically due to the involvement of "Evil Qi," but it’s limited. As for the "Evil Spirit Technique," it further enhances papermen physically, and can incorporate a trace of devouring function in all used techniques.
This near 500 years of deduction left Song Yan feeling as though he regretted it immensely; if it were when his realm was low, it would have been fine.
Now, it was just akin to chicken ribs.
He originally thought that "Papermaking Technique" was the source of papermen and needed to be better, but facts proved that low-grade techniques remain low-grade techniques, even when mutated, they’re still low-grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counteracting Espionage (4.9K words - Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counteracting Espionage (4.9K words - Subscription Requested)
As Song Yan faced the multitude of magic techniques, he was not flustered.
Regarding cultivation, he felt it was like a seasoned farmer tending to his fields.
Meticulously and diligently, he sowed sweat, and though it seemed monotonous, he would be delighted to see the crops grow taller and more lush.
Now that he was the Puppet Sect Leader, he had to gain the benefits of being in such a position, acquiring all advantages and enhancing all potential power. He couldn’t just wander aimlessly, causing trouble everywhere without reaping the real benefits.
The knowledge Gu Huangzi and the other three Peak Masters possessed, he picked out the essence and fully mastered it all.
A thought flashed through his mind,
as he continued to comprehend the magic techniques he had deduced.
"Paper Manipulation Skill", threshold: Refining Profound Level 4, 5 years to achieve perfection; 27 years to deduce a single mutation technique "Paper Thunder Skill".
Normally, the number of paper figures a disciple practicing "Paper Manipulation Skill" can control is related to the strength of their divine soul; the stronger the soul, the more paper persons they can control. "Paper Thunder Skill" is a "magical" magic technique, for which the use of paper created with "Evil Spirit Technique" is necessary; it works by using the devouring nature of Evil Qi and paper’s capacity to absorb, quickly drawing in surrounding Profound Qi or even the enemy’s spells’ Profound Qi during the charge towards the enemy, and then it...explodes upon arrival.
Simply put, it’s like "piloting a mecha to self-destruct."
The power of this self-destruct is very strong, one might say "invincible at the same level," but it comes with a small price; that is, the tiny soul fragment within the paper figure will die too, causing extremely slight damage to your divine soul, but it’s not permanent damage.
This skill sounds powerful, seemingly promising, but every attack comes at the cost of depleting the divine soul and the paper figures. It’s a desperate, all-or-nothing skill.
No matter how extravagant Song Yan might be, he couldn’t possibly treat paper figures made from the blood of someone like Red Granny or Grand Elder as disposable items, right?
’Yet from another angle, it could be considered an unexpected trump card.’
Song Yan pondered for a moment and decided to develop "Paper Manipulation Skill" into a secondary perfect mutation, as "Paper Thunder Skill" seemed to have some utility.
Thus, he spent another 550 years to deduce the secondary perfect mutation magic technique "Paper Lock Thunder Shock Technique".
The so-called "Paper Lock Thunder Shock Technique" enabled the paper figures to perfectly display certain Illusion Techniques, causing the target to be slightly stunned, and then to entangle the opponent at the moment of contact, followed by self-destruction.
...
"Yin Yang Paper-cutting Skill", threshold: Refining Profound Level 4; 81 years to achieve perfection; 383 years to deduce a single mutation secret technique "Yin Yang Paper Technique"; 8320 to deduce a secondary perfect mutation secret technique "Paper-cut Celestial Palace".
This magic was truly formidable, absolutely not inferior to "Hundred Forms Demon Body" evolved from "Hundred Forms Divine Control".
The "Yin Yang Paper-cutting Skill" Gu Huangzi cultivated only cut colorful, size-adjustable engraved paper figures, and it was already inscrutable and unpredictable, but it could only cut paper figures and could not cut out other things.
However, "Yin Yang Scissors Technique" allows Song Yan to freely cut paper lanterns and paper weapons. If cut with Yin, everything drifts like a ghost; if cut with Yang, everything becomes harder than iron. Of course, the quality of the objects is entirely influenced by the quality of the paper.
"Paper-cut Celestial Palace" is the secret technique he has spent the most time comprehending so far, even more than the "Hundred Forms Demon Body", and the benefits it brings are terrifying.
Firstly, you can cut out paper buildings that integrate completely with the surrounding environment, and no matter the environment, as long as it is within the bearing capacity of the paper initially, the paper construction can be integrated into it, forming a space where people can live.
Secondly, these paper constructions make it extremely difficult for outsiders to discern that they are paper houses. For instance, if Song Yan uses blood from Granny Fox to make a paper-cut house, he just needs to place it somewhere, and it will grow in the wind, then anchor itself. And if a late-stage Crimson Palace cultivator comes, even careful observation would not reveal it to be a paper house.
Lastly, all paper figures within this paper house will have their power enhanced to a certain extent, the fewer paper figures, the greater the enhancement. In some cases, the power reaches its peak, far exceeding the paper figure’s original power, even surpassing the original power of the owner of the essence blood when they were alive.
...
Song Yan paused slightly and glanced at the panel.
His lifespan had directly changed from tens of thousands to "[Lifespan: 34/1833]," and this figure also factored in the skin he made from that ancient general.
It seemed overly ambitious to think he could absorb and elevate the entire inheritance of the Puppet Sect to a secondary perfect level purely through his long lifespan.
So, he spent 28 years, 35 years, and 392 years respectively to cultivate "Corpse Nourishing Technique", "Corpse-Driving Skill", and "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill" to a single mutation and then paused.
His lifespan also changed to "[Lifespan: 34/1378]."
It was already sparse.
Song Yan couldn’t help but sigh slightly, lifespan seemed plentiful, but cultivation was truly a bottomless pit.
Magic techniques were divided into normal magic and secret techniques, with the rank of secret techniques clearly higher than ordinary magic. "Hundred Forms Divine Control", "Yin Yang Paper-cutting Skill", and "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill" clearly were. The time required to thoroughly understand these secret techniques at the Refining Profound Realm even surpassed the magic of the Crimson Palace Realm. And these were merely secret techniques of the Refining Profound level; if it were for the Crimson Palace level or Purple Mansion level, who knows how much more time it would take.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counterintelligence Operative (4.9K words - Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counterintelligence Operative (4.9K words - Please Subscribe)_2
If he honestly only focused on refining his original cultivation technique, it wouldn’t consume much effort, but if he could comprehend a more perfect and powerful magic technique and chose not to, he’d never be satisfied.
’Once things settle down, I’ll seek Junior Sister An Li and start skin-making every day.’
Since his lifespan only allowed him to fully digest the "Paperman Inheritance" of the Puppet Sect, Song Yan decided not to comprehend further for now and instead headed to the papermaking house on Paperman Peak.
The thick smell of blood assaulted his senses. The servants inside were still busy, and upon seeing Song Yan, many of them looked fearful and quickly avoided him. Yet, some daring or opportunistic servants came forward, kneeling and expressing endless gratitude.
Upon inquiry, Song Yan learned that his rule of "treating Furnaces well and forbidding them to be forced into suicide" greatly helped these servants. It discouraged those Demon Cultivators who treated them as consumables from casually selecting Furnaces, forcing them to be more serious, unlike before when they’d pick one to die today and another tomorrow.
This provided the servants a slight assurance of basic survival, and even if chosen as a Furnace, it wasn’t necessarily a bad fate.
Song Yan felt a bit embarrassed, and the steward from the papermaking house soon ran out, grinning as he led Song Yan into the core blood pool of the papermaking house.
There were individual blood pools, limited in number, but each was relatively small in size, exuding more exquisiteness compared to the larger outside ones.
The steward chuckled and explained, "Sect Leader, outside are two blood pools: one contains the blood of mortals, used for making papermen for disciples to practice with; the other contains the blood of ordinary cultivators. Here, the blood pools mostly contain higher realm Refining Profound cultivators and demon beast blood."
Finishing, he tapped his head and said, "Yours is right here."
Following him, Song Yan glanced over the six core small blood pools, where the pulp floated quietly. Even without heating, waves of heat escaped from these pools, forming strands of hot smoke in the air.
Among them, one pool released particularly intense heat smoke, indicating the person’s formidable strength in life.
The steward, following his gaze, smiled and said, "This belonged to the elder of the Sword Sect, naturally different from others."
Continuing, he added, "The tree bark used for these pulps is from over three hundred years old White Snake Eucalyptus, originally prepared for Gu Huangzi. Since the blood in these six pools is from Crimson Palace Realm beings, they require an immersion of eighty-eight days, with fifteen more days remaining."
Song Yan nodded.
Papermaking was such a trivial and exhausting task that he naturally didn’t do it himself, leaving it to the papermaking house on Paperman Peak.
The blood in these six small pools came from the six Crimson Palace Realm elders who died in battle at the Nanwu Sword Sect.
...
After visiting the papermaking house, Song Yan went to Blood Corpse Peak.
By then, it was late, and he followed an elder to the "corpse fields" for observation.
The "six blood corpses" lay in the six corpse fields, right in front of the six Crimson Palace Realm elders from the Sword Sect.
However, making blood corpses took longer than papermaking.
Papermaking might take two or three months at most.
Whereas producing a blood corpse required two or three years, even at an accelerated speed, it would take one or two years.
Apart from that, papermen, puppets, and blood corpses all consumed "divine soul power."
In other words, the three puppets shared Song Yan’s divine soul power.
If Song Yan used the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" to manipulate 15 shadow puppets simultaneously in battle, he wouldn’t be able to employ papermen or blood corpses.
However, the consumption of the three types of puppets differed.
After mastering the techniques of the three systems, Song Yan roughly compared them in his mind.
unit of divine soul power could control 1 external shadow puppet, 10 external papermen, or 1 external blood corpse.
Of course, these needed soul division for external control and wouldn’t affect the direct connection of the "Ten-Finger Illusion Skin Technique."
At this moment, looking at those blood corpses being cultivated in the corpse fields, Song Yan showed a thoughtful expression.
Now, let alone whether the Purple Mansion demon of the Fox and Wolf Races would arrive early, even the countdown for the Biluo Twin-headed Gall Fly tribe’s arrival had already passed halfway.
He was very likely unable to wait for these blood corpses to mature.
His gaze swept over the six Crimson Palace blood corpses.
These six blood corpses might not end up in his hands but would create six experts for Blood Corpse Peak.
If stored in a storage space, they would fail for lack of earth energy, as blood corpse cultivation relied heavily on surrounding conditions. The reason that "Corpse Burial and Refining Skill" surpassed ordinary "Corpse Nourishing Technique" lay in its emphasis on environment selection and utilization.
Song Yan suddenly felt a little envy for Lady Ling’s "Personal Secret Realm."
With a "Personal Secret Realm," all these troublesome issues could be resolved.
But now... he already decided if these six blood corpses couldn’t be his, he’d come and destroy them before leaving.
Elder’s continuous chatter reached his ears.
Song Yan’s gaze scanned over, his thoughts racing, and suddenly landed on a blood corpse, pointing as he said, "I’m taking this corpse."
The elder hesitated for a moment but respectfully replied, "Yes."
...
That night, the sky was already deep.
The enthusiastic elder invited the sect leader to stay for the night.
Song Yan did not refuse either.
Because the "Song Demon" was infamous outside for having done various evil deeds, an ambitious steward from Blood Corpse Peak surprisingly jumped out and gave the elder some suggestions.
Soon after, women began to gather in front of Song Yan’s temporary chamber.
Among these women, some were Furnaces, while others were female cultivators with a bit of beauty, assembling from all directions in front of the chamber for Song Yan to choose from.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counterintelligence (4.9K words - Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: 134. Paper-cut Celestial Palace, Counterintelligence (4.9K words - Please Subscribe)_3
This made Song Yan feel rather helpless, he glanced into the distance and saw more women hurrying over.
He was about to dismiss these women, but seemed to think of something, and began to quietly wait without a word.
The Puppet Sect has never been a land of purity. Even when Gu Huangzi was still around, even the Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak was a ghost cultivator spy.
So now, the Puppet Sect has long been on the verge of collapse.
Ghost cultivators, demons...
Even though he killed the fox cub hiding with illusion techniques, Song Yan felt there might still be spies around.
If you want to see the dregs in a muddy pool, then... you’ve got to stir the water first.
He originally didn’t want to deal with this mess, because he was in a hurry to digest his inheritance, find a way to improve his realm, and then make a run for it.
But now the oddities of the "Evil Land Core" and the delays of "Paperman Making" held him back, and he also didn’t know the progress of the restoration of the Ancient Teleportation Array.
So... just take the opportunity to see if there really are any.
If there are, to what extent have they reached.
With such thoughts, Song Yan released his divine sense, flooding the surroundings, drowning half of the mountain.
Ordinary disciples were unaware, but the Elders on the peak all felt a chill, daring not to meet his gaze, allowing him to stare at them.
...
...
At this moment...
In a cave mansion on Blood Corpse Peak, a woman dressed in a goose-yellow coat was rushing toward the cave entrance but suddenly heard a cold inquiry by her ear.
"Where are you going?"
The beautiful woman in yellow looked at the Blood Corpse Peak disciple who had returned to the cave entrance without her knowing, hastily bowed, and said, "Master, the Elders have opened the doors of each mansion, saying Sect Leader Song has arrived, we concubines must hurry and go, waiting for the Sect Leader to choose.
I didn’t want to go, but I was afraid this would delay Master’s future, so I..."
Before she finished speaking, she was interrupted coldly by the Blood Corpse Peak disciple.
A cruel expression appeared on his face: "I’ve long been back."
The beautiful woman in yellow’s heart trembled, knowing her earlier nervous and excited expression had been seen.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple said, "What method did you use to evade the effect of the Fanatic Fans?"
The beautiful woman in yellow smiled, "I didn’t..."
Before she finished speaking, the Blood Corpse Peak disciple suddenly lunged forward, gripping her neck tightly.
The beautiful woman in yellow knew she was discovered, struggled and said, "The... Sect Leader ordered..."
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple sneered, "Not to force the furnace into suicide, right? But even if I kill you, then say you disappeared, what could happen to me?
You’re rushing away now to spill secrets, aren’t you?
He can’t protect himself, let alone you?"
The beautiful woman in yellow felt a great terror descend, pulling at his arm, but was powerless.
Her vision darkened, suddenly... she felt the hand choking her loosened.
Looking ahead, she saw the disciple who was choking her now looked dazed, drooling.
Looking up, she saw a man in fine clothes standing behind the disciple, when he arrived unknown.
Outside the cave came the sound of many footsteps, a group of disciples soon surrounded them.
The man in fine clothes released his hand.
The Blood Corpse Peak disciple fell to the ground with a "thud".
Song Yan took a deep breath, listening closely to the report of this ghoul.
This Blood Corpse Peak disciple was someone who had already defected to the demons, and now secretly reported dynamics to demon cubs using a Communication Stone every now and then.
There should be quite a few like him, but they only have single-line contacts, unaware of each other’s existence.
As for the disciple’s furnace, it was unknown what method she used to avoid the influence of Fanatic Fans, so she sought to report the secret to the Sect Leader during this unexpected "Sect Leader Selection" activity, trying to win her freedom.
A sense of impending demon invasion surged in his heart.
In this darkness, who knows how many pairs of eyes are staring at him.
It’s no surprise.
Demon Sect disciples originally had no boundaries, even acting as traitors isn’t impossible.
Song Yan pondered briefly, looking down at the beautiful woman in yellow, feeling the incoming Blood Corpse Peak disciples behind him.
Many eyes were focused on the now-idiotic disciple.
Song Yan suddenly bent slightly, looked at the beautiful woman in yellow, lifted her chin, and asked, "Do you love him?"
The beautiful woman in yellow, seeing this aura, already knew who the man before her was, she was so scared she couldn’t speak, her throat hoarse, as if drowning.
After a long time, taking several deep breaths, just as she was about to reply, seeing the man’s gaze, instinctively uttered, "Yes."
Song Yan let go, pointed at the idiotic disciple on the ground, turned angrily and roared, "I fancy this woman, but she just happens to fall in love with another, what do you think... should he die? Should he die?!"
The Blood Corpse Peak disciples were stunned.
Song Yan coldly turned, glanced at the Elders, and left a message, "Spread the word, from now on, no one is allowed to use Fanatic Fans on the furnace, violators, kill!"
Saying so, he strode away.
He didn’t need to spend a lot of time rooting out all the spies, but only needed to make them hesitant.
The hidden spies secretly lamented, without using Fanatic Fans, there existed the risk of being detected and reported by the furnace during conversations with a Communication Jade, and if outside, might be caught for abnormal behavior by colleagues. The unknowing Blood Corpse Peak disciples were dumbfounded by the Sect Leader’s arbitrary command.
Some naturally evil demon cultivators gazed with fanatical worship in Song Yan’s departing direction.
Ah.
Arbitrary killing under any excuse, indeed the Sect Leader!
...
The next day, the beautiful woman in yellow was sent to Paperman Peak.
Song Yan handed her over to Cao Yuzhuang, then didn’t bother anymore.
He knew if Yuzhuang, the young lady, couldn’t save these people, then no one could.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 135. Don’t worry, I will hold the line in the rear (3.0K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: 135. Don’t worry, I will hold the line in the rear (3.0K words - please subscribe)
Several days later...
The "looting" continued...
At dusk, Song Yan sat in the cultivation chamber.
On the wall beside him hung several new skins; skin making was his lifelong passion, so whenever he had some spare time, he would engage in it.
In front of him were bottles and jars arranged.
They contained various demon beast essence blood.
However, very few of them caught Song Yan’s eyes.
So, he merely picked out two bottles and then tossed the remaining aside, so that the steward from Paperman Peak who would arrive tomorrow could take them back.
The two bottles he picked.
One bottle contained the essence blood of an advanced demon beast called "Silver Armored Elephant." This demon beast originated from the depths of "Secret Realm Giant Elephant Plain," and its fixed palace blood belonged to the former Peak Master of Shadow Puppet Peak, Two-Faced Man. The skin was made into two shadow puppets, the good one left to Two-Faced Man, the inferior one given to Cheng Danqing.
The Silver Armored Elephant indisputably enhanced physical strength and was top-tier among the demon beasts at the Refining Profound level, and body strength was what the Skin Master lacked most.
With this blood enhancing the Nine Palaces, all body refining techniques could receive a boost.
For Song Yan, this blood was merely slightly better than none, the kind that "in case of an urgent need to enhance power and no suitable blood is available, it can be used."
The other bottle contained the blood of an early stage Crimson Palace demon beast called "White Bone Demon," which was quite rare and left behind by Gu Huangzi.
Back then, Gu Huangzi somehow acquired this "White Bone Demon," and after fixing its essence blood at the Central Palace, he discarded the ordinary blood at Puppet Sect.
