Song Yan had long known the purpose of the White Bone Demon blood.
It was: move the soul an inch, hide the soul in the bone, when the body is destroyed, the bone remains, and it can slowly heal.
Back then, he had already advanced to Gu Huangzi, thoroughly controlling the situation, yet almost lost the upper hand in that condition.
What Gu Huangzi relied on was this "naturally despicable and shameless" White Bone Demon blood.
This thing was pretty good, but the effect was evidently inferior to essence blood.
Song Yan naturally carried it as a backup blood for the Left and Right Two Palaces of the "Third Palace."
Of course, there was another bottle brought out from the Nanwu Sword Sect, containing "Wind Profound Crane Essence Blood."
In close combat, within a square inch, a bit of agility could be deadly.
As the fixed palace blood of the Grand Elder, the strongest in the Nanwu Sword Sect, the Wind Profound Crane naturally qualified as his backup blood.
After securing the essence blood, Song Yan stood up.
His spell system was currently of two types:
One, soul system.
Two, sword system.
His strongest attack methods were still "Hundred Forms Demon Body" and "Sword Evil Demon Dragon." However, with the Nine Palace Blood and newly learned spells, he could add many new offensive and defensive tactics during combat, encapsulating various attack methods, making his overall capabilities more comprehensive.
At this moment, he was still waiting.
First, for the paper infused with the blood of six Crimson Palace strong men to form;
Second, for news about the "Thousand-Year Soul Drowning Grass";
Third, for the elders outside to return one after another;
Fourth, for the repair progress of the ancient teleportation array, and to find a way to hasten it, though coming hard against the Sword Sect people wouldn’t work due to their mortal feud.
If the first three conditions were met, he would conduct a second exploration of the core of the Evil Land, then try to complete the enhancement of his Profound Root talent there. As for what was happening there, he would figure out if he could, if not, he wouldn’t mind.
Thinking briefly, he walked out of the cultivation chamber, stood in the courtyard, and awaited the sunset and Celestial Nether, intending to release the illusion crow without a body.
And at this moment, suddenly rapid footsteps came from outside, Song Yan paused his actions and turned his head, only to see Miss Su Seven hurriedly approaching.
When Su Yao saw him, she surprisingly sped up, and upon reaching him, deeply bowed, saying, "Thank you!"
Today, just like usual, she went to her eldest brother Su Changyi’s gravestone to lament but unexpectedly saw a second gravestone.
Engraved on the gravestone were the words "Tomb of Su Gong Yingren."
The tombstone was new, evidently recently erected by someone.
Su Yao then inquired further and learned that "one of the six bodies from Blood Corpse Peak seemed to have been taken away by the Sect Leader." She immediately knew what had happened, and hurriedly returned, a single "thank you" was enough to express her excitement and complicated feelings.
Song Yan stared at her for a moment before suddenly saying, "Do you want to go back?"
Su Yao was momentarily stunned.
Song Yan said, "Since you have already survived the hardest times, regained the belief in living and growing stronger, why remain here?
Puppet Sect is ultimately not a place for good people to settle for long, better to return home soon."
These days, seeing Song Yan’s demeanor, she roughly understood this Song devil was still the Song Yan she knew before, and the Fox Demon Illusion Technique could indeed transform into a fake Song Yan to damage his reputation, the Great Elder’s character before death seemed oddly disturbed and lost his path heart.
Yet since Song Yan was the Puppet Sect Leader, eradicating the debt with the Nanwu Sword Sect would be impossible to avoid.
However, Su Yao’s heart began to grow complex.
She hated Puppet Sect,
But she could no longer hate Song Yan.
This thought surged in her mind, her delicate body trembled, and looking at the man before her, numerous memories flashed by, and strange emotions began to emerge from her heart.
She wanted to ask him, "Are you trying to make me leave?"
But she also knew that if she said it, that tiny bit of emotion would be hard to suppress again, and this meant willingly becoming Song devil’s woman, truly standing on the opposite side of the remaining disciples of the Sword Sect, and she would have no face to meet the ancestors of the Su Family after death.
Su Yao slightly lowered her head.
Suddenly, she felt a large hand touch the side of her face.
"Let’s go, take Yuzhuang with you. If anyone in the courtyard wants to leave, take them along as well."
After Song Yan spoke, he put the "Bodyless Illusion Crow" before him and said, "Take this crow to the ancient teleportation array, then kill it in front of them to show that you’ve never truly joined the Puppet Sect. Otherwise, it will be difficult for them to accept you again.
Soon, I’ll prepare some intelligence on the Puppet Sect for you to bring back. This way... you’ll appear to be a cultivator enduring humiliation to infiltrate the Demon Sect and steal intelligence."
Su Yao:...
Song Yan said, "Isn’t this what you previously did at South Bamboo Peak?
But you failed that time, whereas this time... you will succeed beyond your wildest dreams.
Because I’ll prepare comprehensive intelligence for you, even including the Puppet Sect’s cultivation technique."
Su Yao:...
Song Yan said, "But remember, once you’ve done this, make sure they accelerate the repair of the teleportation array, as quickly as possible!
Tell them that if it’s not completed, Demon Song may come to kill them.
Then, find an opportunity to report the progress back to me in a timely manner."
After speaking, he took out a second "Bodyless Illusion Crow" shadow puppet and said, "This crow will be your contact."
Su Yao:...
Song Yan pulled her into his arms and softly said, "I believe in you."
Su Yao sighed gently, saying, "I truly can’t understand what kind of person you are."
Song Yan sincerely replied, "I’m just someone who wants to live a peaceful life."
Su Yao couldn’t help but laugh, nearly shedding tears, murmuring, "How could there be someone like you in this world, how could there be?"
Repeating this several times, she suddenly pushed Song Yan away, fiercely saying, "Fine, I believe in you!"
After saying that, she ran off.
...
Several days later.
Su Yao and Cao Yuzhuang, holding the Puppet Sect Leader Order, left with the princess and maids from the courtyard.
Song Yan sent a fox demon shadow puppet to follow secretly, in case of an accident.
Then he began to wait patiently.
Yet, patience was truly difficult at this time.
He felt like a grasshopper on a hot skillet, constantly thinking about moving quickly.
But for the entire Three Kingdoms, this was the only Evil Land Core.
If he wanted to breakthrough to the Purple Mansion Realm, this was his sole chance.
Though he couldn’t understand the meaning behind "Profound Heart diligent cultivation never separates, Divine Soul initially merges with heaven and earth," he knew that at least a middle-grade profound root was required to step into the Purple Mansion Realm.
He began creating shadow puppets to increase his number of trump cards and stabilize his spirit.
The shadow puppets were fox demon shadow puppets.
The skins of fox demon offspring slain by the Puppet Sect were being delivered to him one by one.
He made three cards every day, each extending life by several decades.
Thus, upon finishing the one hundredth card, the fox demon skin was depleted, and the paper soaked in the blood of six early-stage Crimson Palace experts has formed.
So, Song Yan cut the paper, while creating more shadow puppets from other demon beast skins.
He made one yang paperman, twenty yin papermen, one hundred paper tools, and one paper house with a small courtyard.
And his lifespan changed from "[Life Span: 35/1378]" to "[Life Span: 35/11625]."
Another month passed, and Su Yao’s message arrived from afar: the ancient teleportation array was destroyed again, severely damaged.
Su Yao even showed the situation to him through the memory jade.
Battered array patterns and cracked rubble were everywhere, making the ancient teleportation array resemble a ruin, while Yu Xuanwei looked haggard, her eyes reddened, as she searched the ground bit by bit.
Song Yan felt a chill in his heart.
At this point, Gong Libai finally transmitted information about the "Thousand-Year Soul Drowning Grass" back.
Sure enough, the market couldn’t find the "Thousand-Year Soul Drowning Grass," but luck wasn’t too bad; they found two "eight-hundred-year-old" plants.
Could the eight-hundred-year-old soul drowning grass vaguely meet the requirements of the "Washing Profound Divine Technique"?
At least, the age was close enough to try.
So, does this count as "getting what you wish for"?
If it does, the age doesn’t match.
If it doesn’t, it seems worth a try.
Meanwhile, the elders returned one after another, and Blood Cliff completed the Fixed Palace of the Third Central Palace. She chose just the refining profound level demon beast essence blood, making the Third Central Palace relatively safe.
Sixteen Crimson Palace elders assembled beside Song Yan, respectfully awaiting orders.
Song Yan led them to the edge of the Evil Land Core, looking at the distant dim, chaotic place where skins and bones flew about, and slaughter liquid silently lurked; the Life Forbidden Area. He waved his hand to summon a shadow puppet ancient general, looked ahead without saying things like "exploring for the Puppet Sect ally’s disappearance," instead calmly saying, "Enter, and find out what’s happened here."
His gaze swept across sixteen elders, saying, "Rest assured, I’ll be behind you to support the array."
After speaking, he stepped back, silently letting everyone stand in front of him then said, "Go ahead."

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 136. Profound Heart’s True Intentions, Tragically Trapped (4.8K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: 136. Profound Heart’s True Intentions, Tragically Trapped (4.8K words - please subscribe)
Puppet Sect, Core of the Dreaded Land.
Sixteen Elders, along with the Ancient General Shadow Puppet, almost gathered the Puppet Sect’s strongest power.
Although the Elders felt something was strange about this place, it wasn’t enough to instill fear. Moreover, the Sect Leader supported them from behind to ensure that "no one would slack off, and no one would stab another in the back," so they each prepared and then entered.
A rustling sound suddenly arose, with the Slaughter Liquid like a bizarre multi-headed Blood Serpent, or like a dense, hidden red web, started spreading across the core area’s space before crazily lunging at those who entered.
But the Elders were not easy targets, forming a round array, each displaying their skills.
Seventeen Crimson Palace experts spun like a revolving lantern to meet the enemy, then rolled like a wheel into the depths of the Dreaded Land.
Although the Slaughter Liquid was terrifying, the Elders, under pressure, began their exploration.
With Song Yan watching, no one dared to slack off.
And these cunning demons each grew up in an environment of mutual deception. Who among them doesn’t have a keen eye for detail?
Through their cooperation, the exploration was completed in approximately six or seven hours.
Among the sixteen Elders, one early-stage Crimson Palace Elder was lost. That Elder, lacking a countermeasure, failed to resist effectively when the Slaughter Liquid abruptly erupted. Thus, his ankle was torn by the Liquid, which then burrowed into his body, causing red patterns to surface all over his body, leading to a tragic death.
At first, the remaining Elders intended to rescue him, but seeing the Liquid had already entered halfway into his body, they decisively gave up and withdrew. Once the Liquid had fully entered, Blood Cliff even licked his lips and remarked, "It’s a pity."
The lament of "It’s a pity" was not for the Elder dying so soon after entering the Crimson Palace, but for not being able to bring back the body to make a powerful Blood Corpse due to the Liquid’s corrosion.
At this time...
The Elders had already retreated.
And once they left a certain boundary, the distant Slaughter Liquid ceased its hunting, stealthily retreating and reentering the shadows.
Song Yan, having the Ancient General Shadow Puppet, had a rough understanding of the internal situation. However, due to the rapid exploration, he couldn’t grasp all the details alone.
But the Elders made up for this gap.
After a consensus, they reached a final conclusion:
The long-term Slaughter Land had produced an Earth Demon eruption, "upgrading" the core’s concentration, resulting in the appearance of Slaughter Liquid.
In it, the Skin Masters making Shadow Puppets for Ghost Cultivators died miserably on the spot, their bodies now grotesque and tumor-laden, no longer recognizable. However, from scattered skinning tools and identity plates, their living identities could be discerned.
Besides, a very deep Rift Valley was discovered inside. The valley’s traces were clearly fresh and could only be created by a powerful Crimson Palace cultivator. Together with the surrounding top-grade Flying Sword, it further proved that the "Ghost Scarlet Mist Master" died here.
Of course, deep in the CORE, they also encountered some frenzied Advanced Demon Beast Shadow Puppets. That Shadow Puppet... many Puppet Sect Elders recognized it as Cheng Danqing’s "Silver Armored Elephant".
As the "Silver Armored Elephant" Shadow Puppet was now ownerless, guessing its owner’s fate was not difficult.
As for the whereabouts of the Ghost Cultivator leader "Zhang Han," it remained unknown. However, they suspected: Zhang Han, who previously fought with Fox Grandma, was heavily wounded and likely perished during the sudden Earth Demon eruption.
After all, when the Earth Demon eruption initially occurred, its power was exceedingly violent.
It was as though the Slaughter Liquid of the entire core gathered together and enveloped a single person.
Who could withstand that?
Neither Blood Cliff nor Copper Beard nor Qu Yue claimed they could survive such an Earth Demon eruption, let alone the heavily wounded Zhang Han?
The current eruption had already spread, its power not as intense as during the initial outburst. Coupled with the joint effort of the entire Puppet Sect’s Crimson Palace Elders, they completed the exploration with only one casualty.
Song Yan’s gaze swept across some already somewhat corroded "relics," stopping on the identity plate of "Wang Susu." He raised his hand to retrieve it, glanced at it, and tossed it to Gong Libai, saying, "Since it’s Junqing’s partner’s relic, return it to him."
Gong Libai took it and respectfully retreated.
All Elders quieted down, looking at Song Yan, waiting for the next steps.
To everyone’s surprise, Song Yan casually said, "Since the exploration is complete, let’s return. Mark this place as a forbidden zone, prohibiting anyone from entering.
Though the Dreaded Land is terrifying, as long as not many cultivators die here, it’s not a major concern."
The Elders, upon hearing they were to return, initially felt it was much ado about nothing, but on further thought, having figured out what was happening in the Dreaded Land indeed left no reason to linger.
...
...
Several days later, the Jin Kingdom capital sought aid from the Puppet Sect due to a "Fox Demon calamity."
Song Yan eagerly accepted the task under the pretext of "stretching his limbs" and then on his way back, circled back to the mountain region of the Puppet Sect and once more stood before the border of the core of the Dreaded Land.
No one knew he would appear here at this very moment.
The suspicion of Elder interference had been cleared.
The situation within had been understood.
The so-called "Earth Demon eruption" referred to "Evil Qi accumulated in the ground, gradually increasing to a point of transformation, leading to volcanic-like natural disasters amidst unknown crustal energy movements, akin to disasters Song Yan envisioned."

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 136. Profound Heart’s True Intentions, Tragically Trapped (4.8K words - please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: 136. Profound Heart’s True Intentions, Tragically Trapped (4.8K words - please subscribe)_2
Such natural disasters indeed lead to "Evil Qi upgrades."
Yet, the "upgraded Evil Land," from the results, is neither strictly good nor bad for Song Yan, as it means he has greater hope to elevate his "inferior Ghost Profound Root" to "middle grade Ghost Profound Root."
He stood at the boundary of the Evil Land core, his hands slightly moving, the shadow puppets of the Ancient General, Red Granny, and Fox Granny appeared one after another.
He swallowed them in one gulp.
The three shadow puppets in the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace made his power even stronger, as for those at the Refining Profound Level, there was no need to swallow them immediately, as he still needed to reserve Divine Soul power for other techniques.
After casting the Hundred Forms Demon Body, he took out two flying swords, hovering around him, ready to perform "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" at the first opportunity.
A talisman was attached to his body, enhancing his attributes, speed, and agility.
After doing these, he then took out a jade box containing "two pieces of eight-hundred-year Soul Drowning Grass" and examined it carefully before stepping into the core of the Evil Land.
Tap.
His footsteps echoed prominently in the chaotic core of the Evil Land.
Familiar rustling sounds came from all directions.
Soon after, a flash of red light, Song Yan’s expression unchanged, slightly tilted his head, the slaughter liquid solidified beside his head, and in the next instant began to split, twist, and claw, attempting to pounce on him again.
And from afar, more slaughter liquid, like a snake probing, was about to launch itself at him.
Song Yan’s peripheral vision glanced at the slaughter liquid by his head side, raised his finger, following the movement, gently pointed.
Boom!
That point seemed like the finger of a god, causing a tide in the void, an originally chaotic Evil Land suddenly produced a strange power. The advancing slaughter liquid suddenly caved, as if struck heavily, losing balance, flew out far, along with the swirling Evil Qi in that direction.
Song Yan waved his hand again.
Bang!
The Evil Land suddenly birthed tides, rolling loudly far out, all the Evil Qi around his body thinned greatly, and the remaining scattered Evil Qi would not invade him.
This was the Evil Tide Skill, perfectly deduced twice from the Qi Burst Technique.
This is a spell that can nearly transform one into the River God within the Evil Land. Evil Qi is like the sea, but you can push Evil into a tide, its power is exceedingly terrifying, it belongs to a "region-dependent" spell. Outside the Evil Land, this Evil Tide Skill is worthless, but in the Evil Land, it is indeed tremendously terrifying.
The Qi Burst Technique was merely a Third Layer Refining Profound technique, its adaptability was originally only in Refining Profound, but after two perfect deductions, Song Yan, even at the late stage of the Crimson Palace, could use it flawlessly.
Song Yan continued deeper, alertly observing all around as he walked and frequently waved his hand, casting the Evil Tide Skill, dispersing the terrifying slaughter liquid away from him, keeping it at a distance of several yards.
If it approached, a fierce battle would be inevitable, but "spell suppression" is indeed miraculous.
This made him exceedingly relaxed at this moment.
The Ancient General Shadow Puppet required hiding and dodging to barely evade, the Puppet Sect’s Sixteenth Elder needed to form an array to deeply probe the Life Forbidden Area, yet it was merely a stroll for Song Yan.
About half an hour later, he felt the surrounding Evil Qi extremely thick.
He seemed to be walking into a deep sea of slaughter liquid, continually casting Evil Tide Skill only managed to push away the surrounding slaughter liquid for a dozen yards.
But the slaughter liquid surged endlessly, even if the Evil Qi receded in waves, these ghostly entities that resembled sea beasts still coveted Song Yan’s body, crawling and pouncing greedily.
Song Yan glanced around, muttering to himself, "It should be right here."
Confirming the location, he took out a blood-colored paper house from his bosom and threw it forward.
The paper house enlarged with the wind, landing at the core of the slaughter liquid.
Squeak!
Boom!
Plop plop plop!
Sounds erupted, the walls of the paper house started showing signs of being crushed or destroyed.
Seeing the paper house being on the verge of destruction, suddenly all resistance around vanished, the house rooted in its place, merging with the surrounding environment, no longer attacked by the slaughter liquid.
Song Yan pushed open the door and walked into the courtyard.
Inside the courtyard, although the air wasn’t fresh, it was at least an environment suitable for human habitation.
This was the terror of the Paper-cut Celestial Palace; as long as the paper house made was of good quality and not destroyed by the environment at the first instance, it would quickly link with the surrounding environment, integrate and form a living space inside.
Song Yan scanned the house walls.
The walls initially cracked by slaughter liquid’s attacks had not healed, fine cracks like small buds, branches, or webs were everywhere. This meant if he stowed the house and redeployed it, it might not withstand the slaughter liquid again, being destroyed immediately.
Thus, the house needed frequent repairs, if not repaired well, it would need replacement.
In practice, Song Yan’s understanding of the Paper-cut Celestial Palace deepened further.
He looked around outside the courtyard sky.
Slaughter liquid flowed, skin and bones flew chaotically, giant rocks and dust pattered everywhere, yet everything seemed as if separated by an invisible film from before, like he was sitting in a submersible diving into the deep sea, looking through shields at those deep sea monsters.
’Right here, peacefully elevate the Profound Root talent.’
Song Yan exhaled, preparing to sit cross-legged.
Just then, a sharp, thorn-like sensation came from behind him, as if countless fine needles slowly twisted into his flesh, and his Divine Soul seemed to suddenly appear in an icy dungeon, then thrust into a vat filled with icy water, piercing and suffocating.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 195: 136. Profound Heart's True Intentions, Tragically Trapped (4.8K words - please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Accompanying this intense sense of crisis was a casual remark with a smile.
"This is not yet the core of the Profound Vein of the Three Kingdoms, you need to walk some distance further northeast."
Song Yan's throat moved.
He asked with sudden insight, "Old Zhang?"
"Just call me Zhang Han, the term 'old' does not befit me." The voice came lightly, yet the speaker was nowhere to be seen. The voice continued, "Your foundation is so deep, you must be a senior older than me, right?"
"Hmm... you should still be a Ghost Cultivator senior, just now that technique of pushing evil into a tide, though not of high level, was extremely effective. Only a Ghost Cultivator could have comprehended it.
The technique of this Paper House is even more miraculous, truly leaves me in awe."
Zhang Han seemed not in a hurry, leisurely chatting with Song Yan.
While Song Yan kept searching for the target's location, even though he expanded his Divine Sense, he couldn't find where Zhang Han was.
Zhang Han seemed to notice his thoughts, calmly said, "No need to hurry, I am merely entrusted by someone, hope you can visit the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
Your 'Changwang Tiger Blood' is the best blood to pick a Soul Threshold Evil Treasure, the Mountain and Sea Demon Race has long set their sights on you, you cannot escape.
You must be aware of the terror of the Soul Threshold and the importance of the Evil Treasure, I won't waste more words.
Regarding why 'Changwang Tiger Blood' is important, this can be explained to you, so that you understand how unrealistic escape is, to let go of your heart."
Song Yan:...
Zhang Han said: "The Changwang Tiger Race is a major race in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, its bloodline naturally possesses soul power, and can become stronger over time.
Many races have long coveted its blood, so the Fox and Wolf Races along with some others united to exterminate them.
However, the Changwang Tiger Emperor was a ruthless figure, would rather die than let the blood of his race be used by enemies, thus led the heavily injured clan into a Secret Realm rich in Profound Qi of their own, in a suicide manner exterminated the entire clan.
While the Changwang Tigers outside also received instructions, committing suicide, except... for the Emperor's little grandson.
The Emperor loved that little grandson, didn't impose too strict restrictions, so the instruction was invalid, which led the little grandson to fall into the hands of the Fox and Wolf Races.
The Fox and Wolf Races planned to slowly nurture for a few years, wait till the Essence Blood was nurtured well, before killing the chicken for its eggs.
Didn't expect it to be your gain.
However, although the Changwang Tiger Race is exterminated, how special is their race?
Their bodies entered the Secret Realm, due to numerous Crimson Palaces and Purple Mansions, formed a terrifying Fixed Evil, while the Divine Soul due to Chong Soul, tightly connected, embraced into a ball, due to the excessive number of Chong Souls, connected the Sea of Suffering, struck a pinhole, thus formed an extremely rare Soul Threshold.
This Soul Threshold covers the Void, its edges undefinable, and anyone who unintentionally touches a wisp of breath will be lured by Chong Souls, entering the Secret Realm.
These flesh and blood will further nourish the Secret Realm, the Divine Soul will become a Chong Soul, endlessly repeating, years have passed.
Of course, since connected to the Sea of Suffering, that Soul Threshold is no longer limited to the Changwang Tiger Race but is more bizarre and varied.
But regardless, Changwang Tiger Blood is still the best key to entering this Soul Threshold to pick the Evil Treasure.
Nowadays how many eyes are watching you, how can you escape?"
Zhang Han finished speaking, calmly said again: "You might have been strong in your previous life, but in this life, since you haven't entered the Purple Mansion Realm yet, coming here, you are already fish on the chopping board.
Rather than struggling, save some strength to deal with the Great Demons of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race. Before you step into the Soul Threshold and obtain that Evil Treasure, your life is still guaranteed."
Song Yan's pupils slightly shrunk.
At this moment, he suddenly understood why the Fox and Wolf Demons of the Desolate Wilderness disappeared. It was because, at that moment, their clan's Purple Mansion had established contact with Zhang Han. Since Zhang Han intervened, the Fox and Wolf Demons left.
And the reason they trusted Zhang Han was entirely because Zhang Han had already reached the Purple Mansion Realm!
At this moment, he suddenly understood what the fourteen words "Profound Heart hard cultivation shouldn't often leave, Divine Soul initially joins with heaven and earth" meant.
Profound Heart, Profound Heart...
Damn "Profound Mysterious Heart Realm"!!
This clearly refers to the "center of the Profound Vein"!!!
"Profound Heart hard cultivation shouldn't often leave" doesn't it mean "stay in the center of the Profound Vein to cultivate arduously, cannot leave", isn't this "Earth Binding"??
For a moment, he wanted to fiercely curse eighteen generations of Nanwu Sword Sect ancestors.
He merely thought the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" was outrageous enough, unexpectedly there's an even more outrageous "Profound Heart Technique"?
How treacherous is this!!
But at the same time, he couldn't help but think of Gu Huangzi.
Gu Huangzi so easily handed the entire Shadow Puppet Lineage out, had he already realized this? As for "Earth Binding", wasn't it spoken by Gu Huangzi's mouth?
What a good master indeed, to trick him ruthlessly even after death!

chapters.title: Chapter 196 196: 137. Unprecedented Danger (3.0K Words - Start of the Month Request for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Scenes of memories flashed through Song Yan's mind swiftly.
The sudden disappearance of the Fox Wolf duo, the sudden upheaval of the Evil Land, Wang Susu's sudden disappearance, the torn pages on the important book in the Puppet Sect's secret room, the Soul Drowning Grass with a thousand-year history that could be tried after eight hundred years, the false appearance of the total annihilation of Evil Land Ghost Cultivators, the second destruction of the Ancient Teleportation Array, and even the urgency brought by the sect's undercover agents colluding with demons...
All seemingly scattered beads were strung together, forming an entire scheme.
A scheme strategically set up, pushing along, and exploiting opportunities.
This scheme was designed to bring him to the core of the Evil Land.
Obviously, the Purple Mansion Realm, at least the early stage of the Purple Mansion Realm, holds high regard for "possessing the Profound Heart," so Zhang Han was willing to spend enormous effort to set up the layout waiting for him, rather than budging an inch.
As for why he could be so patient.
Song Yan took a deep breath and suddenly asked, "Was it you who destroyed the Ancient Teleportation Array?"
From the sky, Zhang Han's laughter floated from all directions: "Don't forget, I still have some subordinates; the Real Person of Scarlet Cloud is fast, and she can go to the South. Although the teleportation array was destroyed once, it wasn't enough, so I had Scarlet Cloud slice it two more times."
Song Yan continued, "Did you summon Wang Susu back?"
Zhang Han laughed, "Skin making is complicated, and I always need some Skin Masters. She is a very rule-abiding woman, yet she is the only living person who entered the core of the Evil Land and successfully became a Ghost Cultivator.
I knew that if you returned to understand the situation in the Evil Land, you would definitely figure it out from her. And even if she joined me to deceive you, her disappearance would still be preferable."
Song Yan sighed and said, "So, you are still Zhang Han."
Zhang Han laughed, "Indeed, I am still Zhang Han, the one who dominated the Three Kingdoms two hundred years ago. In those years, I sought a breakthrough method to the Crimson Palace Realm arduously, and after obtaining the method, I fervently sought the Profound Heart of the Three Kingdoms Profound Vein.
Don't think the Profound Vein center of Paperman Peak or Misty Sea is the Profound Heart; it isn't worthy.
In such a vast place as the Three Kingdoms, the true Profound Heart exists only in one place, which is where I am sitting now.
But then, I distressingly discovered that this Profound Heart is in the Evil Land, and to come here, one must become a Ghost Cultivator."
Song Yan said, "So you used a method, and this method turned you into a Ghost Cultivator, and afterward, you also used this method on the disciples of Shadow Puppet Peak, but only two succeeded."
Zhang Han laughed, "A mere Soul-Binding Array, not worth mentioning, all this is recorded in the inherited book of the Puppet Sect, including the understanding of the Profound Heart.
Once the cards were revealed, it was simple. But if not discovered, see, didn't you just come?
Though, this is also where I doubt; if you are a strong Ghost Cultivator who has taken possession, how could you not know the true Profound Heart?
When I ordered the book pages to be torn, I didn't see your just-used magic, Paper House, nor did I see your substantial wealth, so I made such an arrangement.
Fortunately, I didn't see it; otherwise... I would have changed my approach, which would have made you notice something was wrong.
But... why didn't you know?"
Song Yan said in a very normal tone: "Taking possession and reviving will always blur some memories; I chose to remember some, so I must forget some, nothing strange about it."
He earnestly narrated the story he had just concocted, his expression unchanged, and conveniently changed the subject, asking: "The eight-hundred-year-old Soul Drowning Grass was also arranged by you?"
Zhang Han seemed to accept his explanation, then said: "Indeed, to make you come, and to make you not suspect. Eight hundred years, just right."
Song Yan continued, "There's no need to mention the Grandmother Fox incident."
Zhang Han said: "Since there is a successor, whether Stone Seat Elder lives or dies doesn't matter. At that time, I was still consolidating my realm and didn't want to expose my true power for him. I also needed an excuse to retreat behind the scenes.
However, after the second batch of Fox Wolves arrived at the Puppet Sect, I was still discovered."
Song Yanqi asked, "Could they detect your realm?"
Zhang Han said, "You wouldn't think there are no secretly controlled Purple Mansion avatars among them, would you?
Your 'Divine Face Hundred Defenses' can divide the soul; do you think the Purple Mansion cannot?
Perhaps... they discovered long ago, which is why they deliberately reserved this piece of land from invasion, precisely because of my existence."
Song Yan said, "I now have one last question."
Zhang Han, very patient and polite, said: "What question?"
The victor, the one who thinks they have the odds in their favor, isn't always very graceful, very polite?
The truly terrifying vicious person relies on the viciousness of the mind, the viciousness of methods, the viciousness of power, not... the viciousness of expression, the viciousness of words.
Song Yan said, "Since we are both human, since the Soul Threshold has an Evil Treasure, why can't you and I go there together, instead of handing me over to the Mountain and Sea Great Demon?"
Zhang Han said, "Because I am not a rival, not even close, so I must follow their orders and hand you over to them."
Song Yan sighed and said, "It seems I can only break through."
Zhang Han said mildly, "You have not yet broken through the Purple Mansion Realm, while I am sitting at the Profound Heart."
Then he added, "If you've forgotten the power of the Purple Mansion Realm, I can help remind you, senior."
...
...
Song Yan forcefully calmed his mind, then looked up at the blood-colored mottled firmament where Slaughter Liquid flowed.
Even now, he hadn't figured out where Zhang Han was.
Even though his Divine Sense had already spread completely, he still hadn't seen Zhang Han.
Within the same great realm, challenging across realms was still possible.
But between different great realms, it was as if a country with differing levels of civilization clashing, wielding stone hammers... how does one fight against a sniper? How does a space fleet fight against water droplets? How does one even fight against a two-dimensional foil?
However, he must try.
He had to try.
His life was still relatively secure for now. Whether it was the earlier Zhunaolao, the two demon Fox Wolves later, or even now, Zhang Han only wanted to "capture him alive."
But if he truly fell into the hands of the Great Sea Demons, went to the Soul Threshold for them, and acquired that so-called Evil Treasure, he would undoubtedly die.
The faster he acquired it, the quicker he'd die.
He might even die trying due to the bizarre and lethal nature of the Soul Threshold, especially since he had no idea what the "Soul Threshold" was.
Information about the Purple Mansion Realm flashed rapidly through Song Yan's mind.
Thoughts are the key to the Secret Realm, and they can also be used for long-distance communication—this was known from Ling Madam.
And "Soul Opening Eyes," "Sea of Suffering," and the line "Profound Heart diligent cultivation, Divine Soul first integrates with Heaven and Earth" were known from the deceitful Nanwu Sword Sect.
Undoubtedly, the Purple Mansion Realm relates to "thoughts" and "Divine Soul."
The logic of "Profound Heart diligent cultivation, Divine Soul first integrates with Heaven and Earth" should be "the type of body corresponds to the type of Divine Soul."
The Refining Profound Realm is to explore the limits of the human body.
The Crimson Palace Realm is to break the limits of the human body.
But even so, a person is still a person, and the strength of the body cannot make the Divine Soul transcend. At this point, one must "borrow."
"Profound Heart" is undoubtedly the core area of a Three Kingdoms Profound Vein, almost like a heart. By sitting in the Profound Heart to cultivate diligently, one can be said to become integrated with this heart, possessing a more powerful body to practice the cultivation method, nurturing a stronger Divine Soul. This explains why "Zhang Han is Earth Bound, preferring to plan rather than change location."
A powerful body allows Zhang Han to fully control the "Profound Heart" to a certain extent, which is also the cause of the "Earth Demon upheaval."
A powerful Divine Soul, is it Divine Soul attack?
No wonder everyone covets "Changwang Tiger Blood," and no wonder the Changwang Tiger Race was exterminated. This thing indeed benefits the later realms.
So, if he breaks out from this paper house, would he face the "Earth Demon upheaval" and an unknown "Divine Soul attack"?
Song Yan closed his eyes and thought for a moment, suddenly raising his hand to throw.
A white shadow flew out, quickly transforming into a burly man with a crew cut within the paper house.
The burly man's muscles were knotted, extremely powerful, full of masculine vigor.
This was his Yang Paperman, made from a whole sheet of paper infused with the blood of a Crimson Palace Realm expert.
Song Yan stood in the courtyard, but his paperman had already shot outward.
In an instant, the paperman confronted the outside slaughter liquid.
Yet, focused solely on escaping, it quickly fled despite receiving several heavy blows.
However, Zhang Han did not take action.
As long as Song Yan doesn't try to escape, why should he act?
Song Yan reluctantly recalled the paperman.
Since he intended to act, he needed to probe as much as possible first.
For if he were Zhang Han, he certainly wouldn't kill this captive, but would seize the opportunity to injure him severely to stop his constant scheming.
So, he must either not act or go all out.
Because his opportunity only comes once.
Thinking of this, Song Yan suddenly said, "Fine, I won't run! But I want to eat something. If Junior Sister Susu is still alive, could you have her make some food for me, please?"
Zhang Han's voice floated over, "Wang Susu is indeed still alive, and of course... will not come to see you."
Song Yan goaded, "Ha, are you so afraid of your secrets being discovered by me?"
Zhang Han replied, "Yes."
After speaking, he mocked, "Does such a clumsy rhetoric from Your Excellency serve any purpose?"
Song Yan continued, "But if you don't show some means, how can I be at ease to stay?"
This time, Zhang Han no longer responded.
But Song Yan assured himself that if he acted rashly, left the paper house, he would surely be attacked.
And before attacking him, this old monster would never reveal any glimpse of power.
Song Yan found it exceedingly challenging to trick such an old monster.
He would never be misled or careless. Once he laid bare the situation and made it clear there was no escape, not another word would be wasted.
A lion uses full strength even to catch a rabbit. Song Yan had always held himself to this standard.
And now... he had become the rabbit.
Song Yan took a deep breath, deliberately sighing, "All right, I'll conserve my energy and make plans again in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
Only, Zhang Han, if you use this moment to deplete my power, don't blame me for being unruly!"
This time, Zhang Han responded.
Two simple, direct words.
"Very well."
...
PS: Asking for some monthly votes at the beginning of the month, thank you, thank you!

chapters.title: Chapter 197 197: 138. The Strongest Battle of the Three Kingdoms, Ultimate Counterkill (8.5K Words - Two-in-One Chapter)
chapters.content:
'The Profound Heart enduring hardship never leaves, the Divine Soul first merges with heaven and earth...'
'This Profound Heart, in the vast land of the Three Kingdoms, there is only one!
Only in this place can the Profound Root be refined to reach the Purple Mansion.
If it's an ordinary Profound Heart, that's fine, but if you encounter the Ghost Profound Heart of the Three Kingdoms, you have to first transform yourself into a Ghost Profound Root to break through here.'
'The position of this Profound Heart is extremely precious, perhaps it's only comparable to the legendary Celestial Profound Root; any other attempt at continuous enhancement requires a century of steadfast cultivating at the Profound Root.
Truly it's a case of one radish per hole; in the land of the Three Kingdoms, nurturing a second Purple Mansion Realm is simply impossible.'
'In addition, judging from Zhang Han's tone, simply sitting at the Profound Heart could greatly enhance one's power in the Purple Mansion Realm, which is why he confidently sits by and lets me be here, not fearing I might escape at all.'
For a moment, Song Yan felt truly helpless.
During the Third Layer of Refining Profound, he didn't have Skin-Stripping Ointment, which was still alright. After all, Skin-Stripping Ointment isn't considered rare among higher-level cultivators; even the Puppet Sect can exchange for it, and some underground markets can trade for it.
However, this "Profound Heart" of the Purple Mansion Realm is countless times more elusive than Skin-Stripping Ointment.
Because there is only one Profound Heart.
Only by sitting at the Profound Heart can one surpass the limit of the Crimson Palace to a certain extent, attaining a "Body of Heaven and Earth," thereby "borrowing the heavens and earth to nourish my divine," and thus nurturing a powerful Divine Soul.
For Song Yan to defeat a Purple Mansion Realm expert, he must first find an unoccupied Profound Heart to sit and cultivate on, to break through.
But to sit on the Profound Heart, he must first pull down the Purple Mansion already sitting there.
Isn't this just an endless cycle?
What should he do?
Song Yan suddenly recalled what Grandma Hong and General Gu had said about the "situation of the Purple Mansion Patriarchs of the Fox and Wolf Races." Grandma Hong said she hadn't even seen the patriarch, and General Gu said there is only one patriarch holding the fort, not knowing where the others are.
At this moment, Song Yan completely understood the reason.
One radish per hole; if the patriarchs can't hold their own hole, they have to go outside to find one.
And because the Profound Heart is extremely precious, all existing Purple Mansion Realm have a mutual understanding, which is: never reveal the method of breaking through to the Purple Mansion Realm, never let anyone know about the existence of the Profound Heart.
Thinking of this, Song Yan entered the paper house and sat cross-legged.
He could feel a surveillance.
It was the surveillance from Zhang Han.
Unrestrained, unconcealed!
Yet when he tried to trace it with his Divine Sense, he couldn't find where Zhang Han was at all.
This way, the two of them spent seven days and nights.
Song Yan sat, doing nothing.
Zhang Han watched him, not turning his gaze for one moment.
The patience of both was extraordinary, as if seven days were nothing, even seven months or years passed by without them moving or changing posture.
But Song Yan did gain something.
Because he learned what kind of person Zhang Han was, at least a part of his character: steady.
Whether it was his previous tendency to set up rather than move, or his patience now, both indicate this.
A person who does things steadily never likes to put himself in or possibly in a very passive environment.
So Zhang Han must really hope to hand him over to the Mountain and Sea Demon Race properly to avoid being blamed and causing trouble.
This character is a good thing.
But it's also a bad thing.
The bad part is the lack of decisiveness.
What does it mean to be decisive?
It means once you sense something unusual, you act first without hesitation, instead of waiting, chatting, or sipping tea first.
If he strikes with full force and Zhang Han perceives the crisis, would Zhang Han strike at the first opportunity, even if it meant hurting or killing him?
As of now, Zhang Han wouldn't; he would certainly wait.
If he and Zhang Han stood facing each other with drawn swords, tips pointing at each other, would Zhang Han unhesitatingly press down with his realm, killing him with one strike?
As of now, it's much more likely that Zhang Han would sidestep, attempting to subdue him rather than kill him.
Even if later Zhang Han would deal with him, at that moment... it's very possible he wouldn't.
Why?
Because that is what being steady means.
If Song Yan himself were in the Purple Mansion Realm, facing a Crimson Palace Realm lad already caught in a trap on home turf, would he?
He wouldn't either.
Because he is also steady.
Yet at this moment, he wishes to be unsteady just once, because he no longer has a stable position.
...
...
The sky shifted from cloudy to clear, continuously changing.
At the end of winter, snow fell once more.
Quiet snowflakes fell on the core of the Evil Land, and were soon swept up by the storms of the Evil Land, dancing furiously, swirling mid-air, never touching the ground.
Outside the paper house, the air seemed full of countless snow-white and scarlet spindles, rapidly, tirelessly weaving threads of two colors. The threads were sharp and keen, seemingly able to easily cut through a person's fragile throat.
Yet, the small house had seamlessly merged with the surroundings, quiet as if it were the abode of a hermit deep in the mountains.
Song Yan first operated the "Washing Profound Divine Technique," simultaneously using "800-year-old Soul Drowning Grass" as a cost, conducting "Profound Root Enhancement," yet despite spending a century, he couldn't succeed, not even a trace of success could be seen.
He didn't get discouraged, almost without pause he selected two bottles from his spare Essence Blood.
One bottle was "White Bone Demon Blood."
This blood could allow him to imitate "Gu Huangzi" once, to make an absolute counter-attack.
With the other bottle, he hesitated a long while between "Silver Armored Elephant Blood" and "Wind Profound Crane Blood."
The former made him tougher, able to take more hits; the latter made him faster, more agile.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 198: 138. The Strongest Battle of the Three Kingdoms, Ultra-Limit Counterkill (8.5K Words - Two-in-One Major Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
After much hesitation, he still chose the "Wind Profound Crane Blood".
He didn't have much confidence that he could withstand a strong attack from someone in the Purple Mansion Realm, so instead of seeking that, it was better to seek speed.
As for these two bottles of blood, and even the previous "Ghost Shark" and "Water Abyss Flood Dragon", Song Yan knew they weren't top-grade demon blood, only considered decent in a small place like the Three Kingdoms, but he had no other choice; he couldn't achieve a "perfect enhancement of the realm".
The two bottles of essence blood slipped into his sleeve, quickly digesting.
Lines of information, Dao insights appeared.
[You activate the "Profound Sword Scripture", absorbing Profound Qi to contain and digest the "White Bone Demon" blood, while simultaneously converting Profound Qi into Sword Qi, nurturing the Sword Qi with blood.]
[In the fourth month, you absorbed 60 strands of Profound Qi, digested one strand of "White Bone Demon" blood, which fully converted into Sword Qi.]
[In the sixteenth year, you absorbed 3000 strands of Profound Qi, which successfully transformed into Sword Qi. The "White Bone Demon" blood has integrated into the Right Palace of your Crimson Palace, entwining with the "Corpse-Eating Wolf" blood.]
[The Sword Qi interacts with the "White Bone Demon" blood, and you grasped a trace of special Sword Qi—Bone-Eroding Sword Qi.]
[This Sword Qi contains corrosive poison, capable of decomposing flesh and bones in an instant.]
'Cultivation speed has become much faster, even faster than when I was on Copper Sparrow Island.'
In the Land of Mortals, it would take thousands of years to successfully cultivate, but here it only took sixteen years... And that's without using any additional resources.
Song Yan mused silently, then felt a bit speechless.
'This Bone-Eroding Sword Qi is indeed a good move for eliminating traces, but what use is it to me now?'
He sensed this Bone-Eroding Sword Qi.
It is well known that while killing is easy, concealing the body isn't. Having Bone-Eroding Sword Qi while traveling in Jianghu makes things much more convenient.
But now, it was useless.
But that's alright; with the "White Bone Demon Blood" positioned in the Right Palace, he felt his power and Qi Blood speed had increased significantly.
Following the same method, Song Yan positioned the "Wind Profound Crane" blood in the Left Palace and realized a special Sword Qi named "Wind-Blending Sword Qi".
This Sword Qi's effect is: the body blends with the sword, the sword transforms into a long wind. The wind is not to be cut, therefore the body as well.
Once used, Song Yan can be in a state like the "wind" for a short time, simply put, the opponent's attack can change his direction and position, but cannot harm him.
Unless the opponent suddenly realizes the mystery of this move, stops trying to cut, and instead tries to trap.
Once trapped, the "wind" would naturally stop, and Song Yan would naturally reveal himself.
This Sword Qi is much better for him at this moment compared to the "Bone-Eroding Sword Qi", especially when combined with the "Splitting Sword Qi", it's like having an extra trump card.
And with the ninth blood entering his body, Song Yan felt unprecedented strength, a comprehensive sensation of powerfulness both physically and mentally, as if standing at the peak of his power.
But, "standing at the peak" also implies there's no further progress?
'Indeed, I still need the Profound Heart.
By borrowing the heavens and earth, to nurture the Divine Soul, only then can I break the realm.'
Song Yan sighed softly, then closed his eyes, testing slightly before getting up.
It was now noon, theoretically the calmest moment in the Evil Land.
By now, he had reached the peak he could achieve.
Thus, this was the moment for him to act.
If he waited any longer, his increase in strength might be detected by Zhang Han, causing him to miss out on a slight advantage. Though trivial, sometimes the slightest advantage decides victory or defeat.
If he could gain a little more advantage, even if it took several days, nights, or even months or years, Song Yan would be willing to do it.
He retrieved the strongest Shadow Puppet into his body, honestly transforming into the strongest form of the Hundred Forms Demon Body, containing it with an illusion, then walked to the courtyard.
He knew Zhang Han was watching him.
So, he shouted, "Zhang Han, I want to give it a try."
"Please."
A faint voice fell from the sky, neither rushed nor slow, neither proud nor dismissive.
Song Yan squinted, suddenly said, "Zhang Han, you as a Purple Mansion Realm expert, must control yourself well.
I'm just a mere Crimson Palace Realm, a far cry from you.
If you severely injure me, that would completely cut off my hope of living.
Rather than falling into the hands of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race and suffering humiliation, it's better to self-detonate like Gu Huangzi, dying with body and soul gone!
By then, not only will you fail to account to the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, but also lose the opportunity to learn the Paper House making, digest Changwang Tiger Blood and other secret techniques from me!
Think clearly about how to act!!"
As soon as the word "act" fell, the Puppet Sect Leader in a Profound Robe hesitated no more, rolled his left sleeve, causing the sizeable Paper House to distort and elongate swiftly, like a roll of white smoke retracting into his sleeve.
One push of his right hand, the rapidly swirling tornado-like wind and snow Evil Qi paused in the void as if time stopped, then rumbled forward, causing the Evil Tide Skill to activate, instantly turning the Evil Qi into a tidal wave, clearing an area in front of Song Yan.
However, the direction he pushed wasn't northeast, but... southeast!
Previously, Zhang Han said, "If he wants to reach the core of the Three Kingdoms Profound Vein, he needs to move a bit more northeast." During this time, he perceived that the Evil Qi in the east was indeed denser, but couldn't confirm if it was northeast or southeast.
So, he pushed directly towards the southeast instead of the northeast.
Because he believed in Zhang Han, just as he believed in himself.
He trusted that he would never generously disclose the correct location to the opponent, even when he was sure to win, so... Zhang Han wouldn't either!

chapters.title: Chapter 199 199: 138. The Strongest Battle in the Three Kingdoms, Ultimate Counterkill (8.5K Words - Two-in-One Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
As the tide of Evil Qi receded, Song Yan's gaze followed along.
This magic technique cleared the wind and snow Evil Qi but left behind some Slaughter Liquid.
The density of the Slaughter Liquid was clearly visible before his eyes.
His gaze swept quickly, and indeed, he saw a place with an abundance of Slaughter Liquid towards the southeast, surrounded by an area where the distribution was "gradually sparse."
This corroborated his view.
With a thought, the two swords at his side unsheathed themselves, one on the left and one on the right, one black and one white, intertwining as the Double Evil, propelling him towards the southeast.
However, he was only halfway when he met with an attack.
The attack from Slaughter Liquid was insignificant in his eyes; he saw two fog-like figures approaching swiftly from afar, each exuding an aura of the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace!
Two Late Stage Crimson Palace entities attacked simultaneously, with violent energies enveloping Song Yan.
Song Yan was stunned: Not to mention Ghost Chi Xia shouldn't be in the Late Stage Crimson Palace. Even if he were, where did this Evil Land conjure another Late Stage Crimson Palace? If he really had such subordinates, Zhang Han wouldn't have to move an inch to easily absorb Shadow Puppet Peak under his command.
But as he pondered this, his actions didn't slow.
He swiftly changed his technique; the extremely fast Black and White Double Evil suddenly shifted, the Sword Rainbow Escape Light entwined in Double Evil suddenly flared, transforming into a robust sword light mixed with red and silver, silver on the outside, red on the inside.
From afar, it appeared as a Silver Armored Demon Dragon billowing with blood smoke.
Sword Evil Demon Dragon!
Song Yan rode the dragon, becoming one with the sword, his speed surged beyond what it was before.
Hastily, he bypassed the two Late Stage Crimson Palace experts who came to intercept him, continuing forward.
Time seemed to have completely slowed; his speed was incredibly fast, yet it felt as if everything was moving slowly because, at this moment, his perception reached its pinnacle, and Zhang Han naturally noticed as well.
Having moved merely several tens of feet, he saw figures appearing in the distance again.
Figures exuding the aura of Late Stage Crimson Palace experts.
Four!
The four Late Stage Crimson Palace bodied seemed to discern the might of his technique, jointly attacking with extreme coordination, conjuring terrifying energies that rushed directly at Song Yan.
Song Yan was increasingly shocked but determined one thing: Those figures were never living beings, but Zhang Han's attack method, the technique of the Purple Mansion!
As for what method it was, he was clueless.
The four energies charged forth violently, and if he confronted them head-on, even as strong as Song Yan was, he would be heavily drained.
A weakened arrow reaches the end of its flight, what fear should the toothless tiger hold?
Indeed, if to fight, he must at least see Zhang Han first!
Thus, he bit down rapidly, changing his technique once more!
The blood smoke-sweeping Sword Evil Demon Dragon abruptly halted, reverting to the intertwined Black and White Double Evil, the speed slowed; the energy ahead landed on the position he would have been, causing a space-tearing explosion.
Sword technique switched again, returning to the Demon Dragon, following his heart's intent, attacking once more as the strongest wave of energy settled, charging forward with minimal cost, leaving those four figures behind, rapidly moving over a hundred feet.
Then...
Song Yan saw more Late Stage Crimson Palace experts.
This time not two, not four, not even eight.
But sixteen!
Sixteen indistinct figures had formed a wall ahead, each raising their hands towards Song Yan, their emitted killing intent unyielding in its concealment.
If it were someone else, especially an Early Stage Crimson Palace cultivator standing there, they'd be utterly terrified.
Yet Song Yan had earlier employed some small means to break through two barriers, knowing his opponent had defenses against repeat tactics.
He glanced at those figures, his peripheral vision scanned behind him, discovering the six figures that previously obstructed him had vanished.
In this moment, Song Yan suddenly realized something: These sixteen Late Stage Crimson Palace experts were not just not living, not even human, nor ghosts—they were an attack method he couldn't comprehend.
He focused, noticing those sixteen figures not only had blurred faces, but everything was vague, save for the sharp killing intent and latent energy.
Suddenly, an inspired thought sprang forth: They are thoughts!
These are Zhang Han's thoughts.
The principal difference between the Purple Mansion Realm and the Crimson Palace Realm is that the latter must rely on the body and Profound Treasure to wield Profound Qi, but the former can utilize thoughts to wield force.
Those thoughts dissipate independently, wielding magic.
But how quickly can a person generate thoughts?
If every thought could launch an attack, how terrifying would it be?
In a flash, Song Yan gritted his teeth, fiercely charging forward.
The sixteen Late Stage Crimson Palace entities no longer hesitated, launching impassively with perfect coordination.
The Demon Dragon surged and spun forcefully, shredding the energy confronting it one by one.
Shattering one layer, two layers, three layers, four layers...nine layers, ten layers, yet unable to break more.
Residual energy continued pressing on Song Yan.
But Song Yan had vanished.
He turned into a gust, a sword wind, blown away by the explosive force, then emerged from the sword wind, appearing briefly elsewhere, instantaneously using the Sword Evil Demon Dragon to push forward once more!
Then...
He saw thirty-two Late Stage Crimson Palace figures appear ahead of him.
As for behind him, all those who had previously acted had disappeared.
At this moment, Song Yan completely confirmed: These are thoughts—only thoughts could shift so recklessly, abruptly appearing and disappearing.
Employing these thoughts for attack might be quite taxing. Yet for someone sitting at the Three Kingdoms Profound Vein's core in the Purple Mansion Realm, it's mere whim.

chapters.title: Chapter 200 200: 138. The Strongest Battle in the Three Kingdoms, Ultimate Counterkill (8.5K Words - Two-in-One Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
A single thought of his could transform into an attack from a late-stage Crimson Palace master.
Such an existence, when sitting with a Profound Heart, could never be worn down by Crimson Palace cultivators.
No matter how many came, they couldn't exhaust him.
...
At this moment, a voice echoed in midair.
"As you can see, it's impossible for you to win. The outcome is set, just quietly go back.
As the price for sparing you once, why not teach me the method to transform your Sword Evil into a Demon Dragon at will?"
Zhang Han's voice carried sincerity, "On this journey to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, the road is long and dangerous. What if something happens? You wouldn't want to lose your legacy, would you?
Teach me and I will ensure your power continues to live on in this world, then see the future sights on your behalf."
He then laughed again, "Oh, if you want me to become your disciple, that's not impossible. Whatever formalities are involved, I can accept them.
If, by chance, you die in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, I'll also offer you some fine wine every year on your memorial day.
By the way, which kind of spirit wine do you like?"
"Shameless..."
"Shameless!!!"
Song Yan was furious, his eyes ablaze with anger, yet he could only repeatedly shout the word "shameless," looking powerless and enraged.
In the next moment, he held onto this state of "powerless rage, lost his mind," and summoned the "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" once more, while secretly glancing at his storage bag. Inside, all the papermen, paper tools, and collected treasures were ready to be used at any moment.
Zhang Han laughed, "No need for that, calm down, you're just making an attempt."
He was already certain of his victory.
However, he remained completely cautious.
In front of Song Yan appeared countless late-stage Crimson Palace masters.
Killing intent fell from the sky like rain, and a divine force descended like a mountain!
Yet he was merely like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
He shattered one figure after another, broke through one layer of energy after another, moving like the wind at times, merging with the sword at others. His sword and evil Qi were rapidly depleting, despite the support of the "Four-tailed Demonic Fox," he couldn't withstand such a high consumption.
The various treasures still usable in his hand were being thrown out without reservation.
The Yin papermen joined hands, exploding the moment they appeared in an energy field, but they managed to delay that energy to some extent.
The numerous shields within the paper tools emerged around Song Yan's body, but they all shattered one after another, appearing in one moment and disintegrating in the next.
The rapid sound of explosions echoed in Song Yan's ears, mixed with the distant retreating Evil Tide, creating a breathtaking, epic scene. In such an environment, even the elders of the Puppet Sect of the Crimson Palace would certainly be severely injured or even killed by the shockwaves.
Through all this depletion, Song Yan grew closer and closer to his destination.
He felt his body starting to go numb, but perhaps his earlier words had an effect. Despite this, Zhang Han still withheld the final blow.
But it was only temporary.
In just a moment more, even just a few breaths, Zhang Han might change his mind.
Boom!
Another casual Evil Tide Skill was unleashed, clearing the surrounding Evil Qi and making the view slightly clearer.
Amid the dense figures of late-stage Crimson Palace fighters, Song Yan finally saw a man sitting cross-legged on a blood-red cushion.
His appearance was ordinary, nothing remarkable.
Upon seeing Song Yan, Zhang Han immediately discerned that he was at his last gasp, and sighed, saying calmly, "I know you haven't given up, trying to get close to me and use the power of Changwang Hu and the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, but... even so, it's futile."
After saying this, he suddenly smiled and added, "Moreover, I won't even give you the chance to get close.
However, as the Sect Leader of the Puppet Sect, you've already been quite competent. Gu Huangzi is nowhere near your level; I quite admire you."
Song Yan, his face full of fury, suddenly roared with intense anger, "Then let's go down together!"
He entered a more irrational state, preparing to self-destruct his Divine Soul, charging towards Zhang Han.
The chance was only once.
Today, if he used up all his cards and still couldn't get close to Zhang Han, there would be no more chances!
Zhang Han smiled faintly, slowly shook his head, unmoved, like a deity in a shrine watching a trapped beast struggle within the five-finger cage.
Suddenly, silhouettes appeared around him, then lunged toward Song Yan.
Song Yan's mind stirred, and the shadow puppets stored in the storage bag began to emerge one by one, activating and transforming into shields in front of him.
Shadows, destroyed!
Flying sword, destroyed!
In the end, he even spat out the shadow puppets of Grandma Fox, Red Grandma, and the Ancient General, to block as long as they could.
The Hundred Forms Demon Body, though powerful, was utterly insufficient under such attacks, it was better to release the shadow puppets.
And when the shadows were completely exhausted and shattered, as his body began to collapse, he finally reached Zhang Han.
Zhang Han could dodge.
But if he dodged, his position on the Profound Heart would shift.
For someone who hadn't moved in at least a hundred years, and with a "cat playing with mouse" mentality, he wouldn't move.
Not only did he stay put, at the moment he saw Song Yan, he counter-attacked, a finger like light, it shot towards Song Yan's brow.
Accompanied by an indifferent, calm phrase, "You really won't shed tears until you see the coffin.
Forget it, let's put your hopes to rest for good, but don't wish for death.
Also, remember to teach me these secret techniques of yours."
At this moment, Song Yan gathered the remaining Profound Qi, operating with all his might, four Soul-Piercing Sword Qi swiftly shot out, followed by another four Soul-Imprisoning Sword Qi, and four Soul-Shocking Sword Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 201: 138. The Strongest Battle in the Three Kingdoms, Ultimate Counterkill (8.5K Words - Two-in-One Chapter)_5
chapters.content:
But the twelve strands of sword qi that could leave General Gu and Granny Hong momentarily stunned seemed to vanish without a trace.
Clearly, it had struck its mark, yet it felt as if it hadn't.
And at this moment...
Snap!
Zhang Han's finger already touched Song Yan's forehead.
This marked the stage of "soul duel."
In an instant, their consciousness worlds seemed to erect a bridge.
Song Yan's Changwang Tiger Stripes, along with the accompanying specters of Ice Hell, surged madly toward Zhang Han.
But Zhang Han dispersed his thoughts one after another.
These thoughts, like phantoms, darted into Song Yan's divine sense space, while the Changwang Tiger Stripes only managed to capture them.
The thoughts appeared and disappeared, but after all, they were thoughts of the Purple Mansion Realm, existing atop the Profound Heart.
Once these thoughts touched the Changwang Tiger Stripes, they were captured but also occupied a space.
The Changwang Tiger Stripes soon reached saturation.
The specters, too, began to retreat as if pushed by waves.
Perhaps the Changwang Tiger Stripes and specters would play a more terrifying role once Song Yan reached the Purple Mansion Realm, but right now... it wasn't enough.
...
...
Zhang Han's divine soul stood like a sovereign at the entrance of the bridge connecting their consciousness worlds, still emitting thoughts.
"Senior, I forgot to tell you, I actually served as a Puppet Sect Leader two hundred years ago in the shadows. Otherwise, why would I be so well-acquainted with Puppet Sect's heritage grounds?
Otherwise, why is there no information from two hundred years ago in the Puppet Sect Chronicles?
By the way, I'm also familiar with the White Bone Demon Blood Gu Huangzi used to anchor the palace, and I know he left blood in the sect.
Not only that, but I also know about your secret technique to quickly digest Demon Blood, so... I've already taken your tricks into account.
If your trump card is truly this, let's not waste any more energy. Do you really want to fight until your body shatters, then use bones to strike me anew?
How awkward it would be if I blocked it.
Preserve your body if you can, tend to your wounds, you're not a child anymore, why risk everything?
When you reach the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, you'll still have a chance."
His earnest persuasion carried an air of superiority.
He had already won, but found nothing to be particularly proud of.
But just then, suddenly, Song Yan's divine soul world altered. The domain filled with specters and Changwang Tiger Stripes vanished, replaced by a gray line.
The line was like a celestial sword, cleaving through dusk and dawn.
Above was gray, below was black, stretching endlessly.
The wind picked up...
Zhang Han felt the "wind."
But it was certainly not "wind!"
For in that split second, hundreds of thoughts collapsed.
Zhang Han's calm demeanor vanished, he sprang up as if pricked by a needle, roaring in disbelief: "Sea of Suffering?!!!"
As his words fell, hundreds more thoughts crumbled.
"How did you visualize the Sea of Suffering?"
"Are you mad?"
His voice was no longer calm, but filled with urgency.
His roar sounded as if he was questioning a madman.
Though the Sea of Suffering was distant, the sea breeze was near.
In the nearby sea breeze swirled immense joy, anger, sorrow, and grief, carrying endless obsessions, making anything they touched collapse.
By now, Zhang Han could see Song Yan.
Undoubtedly, if Song Yan wanted to drag him into the Sea of Suffering, he too had to enter.
At this moment, specters around Song Yan fell rapidly, disappearing quickly.
The wind of the Sea of Suffering blew gently.
Enveloped by specters, Song Yan gazed calmly upward, as if surveying the eternally gray sky.
"Madman..."
"Madman!!"
Even if Zhang Han was steady, he no longer remained. He knew his mission had failed; he could neither deliver Song Yan to the Mountain and Sea Demon Race nor obtain anything from him!
Song Yan was indeed a complete madman, crazier, more demonic, and more unpredictable than all the Demon Cultivators Zhang Han had ever met or known!
The specters around him were rapidly dying, and soon, he would perish too!
Zhang Han swiftly began searching for an exit. Even within another person's divine soul world, he could find a way.
And indeed, after a mere breath, he found it.
He sped toward it.
He must leave immediately.
But suddenly, he froze.
Because outside, the doorway was densely blocked by specters.
Ordinarily, even with so many specters blocking the door, he could never be stopped.
But now, he needed to endure the exhaustion from the Sea of Suffering while breaking through the door.
This was utterly impossible.
"Song Yan!"
Zhang Han turned to look in the distance, roaring, "Surely, we're not at the point of mutual destruction, of soul flight dispersal, are we?!!"
However, Song Yan did not respond.
Zhang Han could only see a slight smile on his face, a very wicked and cold smile.
Then he saw Song Yan breathe out, and then... disappear.
Zhang Han: ???!!!
...
...
The function of White Bone Demon Blood is to shift the soul slightly, hiding the soul within the bone; even if the body is destroyed, the bone remains, allowing slow healing.
A soul within bones becomes a door.
A soul at the forehead is yet another door.
Song Yan opened the forehead's door, then visualized the extremely outrageous "Celestial Sword Visualization Map," dragging Zhang Han into the Sea of Suffering, and then blocked that door with specters from the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet, while he left the Sea of Suffering through the bone door.
Thus, Zhang Han's divine soul was completely trapped, achieving a balance with the Sea of Suffering and the specters of the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet.
Realizing this, Song Yan opened his eyes, now weakened to the extreme, so much so that even moving a finger would strain his body and divine soul.
But still, he gritted his teeth, fiercely kicked Zhang Han off Profound Heart, and then threw out the Paper House, seating himself atop the Profound Heart.
Without the support of the Profound Heart, Zhang Han's divine soul thoughts would weaken, disrupting the balance.
The Paper House creaked, but fortunately, it hadn't collapsed, appearing ready for no more than one additional use.
Song Yan considered taking out a paper figure or a shadow puppet to guard him.
But upon looking, he found an emptiness, everything consumed, even the twin-headed wolf shadow puppet was gone.
He couldn't help but show a bitter smile.
And at this moment...
The "crackling" sound came again.
The surface of the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet revealed cracks, and with a "boom," it shattered. Briefly, Song Yan could vaguely hear Zhang Han's voice echoing as if from the far shore.
"Song Yan, you won't die well!!!"
Song Yan lay back in the courtyard of the Paper House.
'Everything's gone, even the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet shattered.'
'I truly don't know if exchanging a body full of treasures and wounds for a Profound Heart was worth it.'
His gaze swept toward Zhang Han's remains. Though the divine soul was gone, there might still be fragments of cause and effect and wandering thoughts, allowing him to glimpse into the past of this domineering figure, to see if there were any gains to be made.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 202: 139. Entering the Purple Mansion, Secluded in the Deep Sea (8.0K words - Two Chapters Combined, Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
The sky quietly drifted down with snow.
White snow.
White snow blanketed the land that had long been divided but was now mostly unified.
The people of the Mortal World seemed to have finally awaited the dawn in the darkness, watching the light snow gently brush the fields with "salt frost."
A timely snow promises a good harvest, no matter how harsh the past, spring will always come.
They cried and laughed, their expressions complex yet joyful, looking forward to the new year.
And in the Puppet Sect, which the common people might view as a land of Immortals and Demons, there was also joy.
No!
It wasn't the Puppet Sect that was joyous, but three people who were.
In the secret chamber, Gong Libai, usually the most ruthless and cruel, was now filled with an uncontrollable ecstasy; he hadn't been this happy for a long time.
The last time was when he was accepted as a disciple by Gu Huangzi.
Now, in the secret room, Gong Libai was pacing like he had a disorder, rubbing his hands constantly, muttering: "Dead?"
"Truly dead?"
"Really dead?"
"How is it possible?"
"Hahaha, wonderful, wonderful!"
"Hahaha..."
"Wait, could it be faked?"
"Old Demon Song is incredibly cunning, even more so than Gu Huangzi, could it be an act?"
He was incoherent, experiencing a range of emotions, a sign of intense agitation.
Imagine you had resigned to being someone else's dog for life, unable to turn your fate, but suddenly one day your master dies, the hand holding the leash loosens. Are you surprised, happy? Yet, this sudden freedom fills you with a touch of fear because your fear of your master is ingrained deep within you. Even seeing your master dead, you still find it hard to believe.
In the other corner of the secret chamber sat a tall dark shadow, a burly figure with short hair and a vicious face, appearing to ponder deeply. When he glanced up, his tone lost all warmth, his words devoid of the "me" idiom, replaced by a suppressed cruelty.
"We saw him enter a terrifying place, and Elder Zhang Han was dragged in as well. Afterward... I heard Zhang Han say something about perishing together, vanishing in soul."
Blood Cliff picked up the conversation, saying: "Then, the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet shattered, and the ghosts within perished. As a result, our three Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelets broke free and are now independent entities."
Bronze Whiskers laughed bitterly: "I thought we were ruthless enough, but compared to those old guys, we're still lacking. Old Demon Song, Old Demon Zhang Han really taught us a lesson."
The three, although not participating in the great battle, understood little of its processes but intervened during the soul fight, learning a lot just from fragmented words.
Gong Libai was both happy and nervous beside them, suddenly asking: "What is the Sea of Suffering?"
Blood Cliff glanced at him, paused, and said: "I've heard this legend."
Bronze Whiskers perked up his ears.
Among the three, Blood Cliff had lived the longest.
People who live long often know things unknown to others.
Blood Cliff continued, "After one dies, the Divine Soul returns to reincarnation, but the lingering thoughts mixed with Cause and Effect remain in the world.
However, some unresolved obsessions cling to the Divine Soul, refusing to be forgotten, seemingly wanting to follow the Divine Soul to the next life."
Self-mockingly, she smiled and said, "But how is that possible?
The world has its own rules; reincarnation doesn't allow such obsessions to carry forward.
That's why there's a place in the world that specifically strips away obsessions.
Endless years, endless beings, endless obsessions... That place is the Sea of Suffering.
Once submerged within, if you touch an obsession, you'll enter another's deepest emotions, experiencing their obsession once again.
Once or twice, perhaps you can maintain your true self, remember who you are.
But eventually, you will lose that certainty, completely lost in the cycle of obsessions.
And at that moment, you'll be a part of the Sea of Suffering, mingling with the infinite drops of water."
Gong Libai exclaimed joyfully, "So, Old Demon Song directed us to explore the Evil Land, then diverted attention by pretending to leave for another place, but ended up falling into the trap.
Old Demon Zhang Han tricked Old Demon Song into the Evil Land, and Old Demon Song dragged Old Demon Zhang Han into the Sea of Suffering, both... perished together?"
He clapped with joy.
For he had recognized the horror of the Sea of Suffering.
Anyone who falls in cannot possibly survive.
Blood Cliff's wise old eyes shifted, and she said gravely, "This matter is known only to the three of us, and in the future, we are destined to be allies together. Now, let's go take a look."
When they act, they act decisively, quickly reaching the Evil Land Core.
Yet, the core's upheaval hasn't ceased.
Previously, sixteen Elders barely managed to enter; now with just three, it's extremely difficult.
After advancing several miles, Gong Libai was the first to be unable to bear it, requesting to return to the original place.
Blood Cliff and Bronze Whiskers also felt that continuing like this might lead to severe injury before discovering anything, so they retreated as well.
The three exchanged glances.
Bronze Whiskers took a deep breath and said in a booming voice, "Master, we are here to help you!"
His voice thundered into the core of the Evil Land but was met with silence, as if cast into the sea with no echo.
Blood Cliff said, "Let's wait for now, until the upheaval calms slightly, then we'll venture inside."
Bronze Whiskers gazed at the stormy world of the Slaughter Liquid, speaking in a pot-like voice, "We have no other choice."

chapters.title: Chapter 203 203: 139. Entering the Purple Mansion, Secluded in the Deep Sea (8.0K words - Two Chapters Combined, Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
...
...
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
The Earth Demon riots seemed to have lost support from some source of power and gradually calmed down.
