Though the Evil Land had upgraded, the Slaughter Liquid no longer hunted everywhere but rather settled into silence. They seemed like fierce beasts guarding their own territories, as long as you didn't step into their attack range, you generally wouldn't be attacked.
Blood Cliff, Copper Beard, and Gong Libai finally stepped onto this land.
After some searching, the three of them saw some already tattered and crushed flesh on a blood-red ground, with the flesh already reduced to residue, while on another side, numerous scraps of skin were flying about, revealing with just a glance how powerful their original owners once were.
Blood Cliff, sharp-eyed, suddenly bowed her head, grabbing a Storage Bag from the desolation.
The Storage Bag was now ownerless.
She looked inside and showed an expression of wild joy.
Copper Beard, unwilling to be outdone, also started rapidly searching the ground and soon found several more.
He went through them one by one, sometimes frowning, sometimes sighing, but when he got to the last one, he too showed joy.
Blood Cliff, clutching her Storage Bag tightly, suddenly sighed and said, "It seems Song Yan is truly dead."
Copper Beard sneered, "Yet the inheritance he took from the Puppet Sect, even some of his own legacy, is in the Storage Bags on my side."
With a laugh, he glanced at the dwarf old woman opposite him, saying coldly, "Old Blood, we're all in the same boat now, what are you still hiding for? The stuff in that bag of yours is Zhang Han's, isn't it?"
Blood Cliff's expression changed slightly, pondering for a moment, she said, "You're right, we are indeed in the same boat now. The stuff in this bag of mine is indeed the Purple Mansion Realm's inheritance, it seems to be Zhang Han's old devil's.
Speaking of which, Zhang Han could be considered an ancestor of our Puppet Sect. Though dead now, his legacy has indeed returned home."
Though Gong Libai was also tempted, he didn't dare to snatch from Blood Cliff and Copper Beard. Upon hearing this, he only exclaimed in wild joy, "They really perished together?!"
Blood Cliff looked around, saying in a low voice, "It seems so."
As soon as the words fell, there was a sudden ripple in the air not far away, and a cultivator in a crane cloak and ancient hairpin with a composed face yet a hidden strangeness swept out.
As soon as the cultivator stepped out, he breathed a sigh of relief, but then suddenly saw the three people opposite, and instantly exerted Sword Control with his fingers.
Yet there were still people stepping out behind him, muttering some words as they walked.
"The Secret Realm's prohibition is actually open."
"I thought I would die in the Secret Realm."
"Finally came out."
Soon, a large group of people gathered around the cultivator with a crane cloak and ancient hairpin. Among them were men and women, old and young.
This large group of people who had just come out from the Secret Realm found themselves face to face with Blood Cliff and the other two, with expressions both guarded and strange.
Neither side expected to meet at this moment.
Blood Old Woman said, "Crimson Elder?"
The cultivator with the crane cloak and ancient hairpin also said, "Blood Cliff? Copper Beard?"
Suddenly, a man with disheveled hair yet somewhat handsome features among the crowd shouted, "Uncle Beard!!"
Copper Beard glared over, momentarily dumbfounded, for that man turned out to be one of the Skin Masters taken in the first wave, Lv Hong.
This Lv Hong was one of those who competed with Gu Rufeng for Stone Seat Elder's mantle and was the youngest Elder of Shadow Puppet Peak back then, truly full of enthusiasm and drive.
Yet no one knew that this Lv Hong was a descendant of one of his old acquaintances, otherwise... no matter how extraordinary his talent, how could he become an Elder so young, and with a Realm not even reaching Crimson Palace?
On the other side, a charming and enchanting young woman jumped up, waving her hand, shouting, "Grandma!"
Blood Old Woman squinted her eyes and chuckled, "Susu, I knew you weren't going to die so easily."
Both sides laughed together, as if strengthening their connections, yet there always seemed to be a barrier that hadn't been broken.
But Wang Susu ran over first, holding Blood Old Woman's hand, affectionately saying, "Grandma, back in the Puppet Sect, you took the most care of me. I've missed you these days."
Blood Cliff smiled.
Yes.
Back then, she was the puppet of Gu Huangzi, and Wang Susu was the Dao companion of Gu Huangzi's disciple, so they did indeed meet.
An old woman always has a soft spot for a particularly charming young girl, especially when that girl reminds her of her past self.
Also wretchedly cautious, also ruthless and cunning.
She grabbed Wang Susu's hand opportunely, gently patting the back of her hand, saying, "Good girl, you've got quite a life."
In her eyes appeared a rare kindness, as if recalling her own past experiences of narrowly escaping death.
Thus, both sides completed the "ice-breaking" process.
Ghost Crimson glanced at the jade-like Three Kingdoms Profound Heart, remembered that Zhang Han who had never left that spot since his memory was gone.
He sighed softly, clasped his fists, saying, "Since the prohibition has broken, Old Ancestor Zhang Han has probably gone west, but looking at this situation, Sect Master Song Yan should have perished too.
These two accompanied each other, chatting and laughing all the way, so they wouldn't be lonely."
Copper Beard, in high spirits, laughed heartily, "Indeed, indeed."
Immediately, the two sides began sharing information.
After an exchange and cross-verification, they had no more doubts.
Song Yan and Zhang Han had indeed perished together.
With that, the air fell silent once more.
Ghost Crimson suddenly laughed, "Today seems to be a good day."
Blood Cliff said, "Oh?"
Ghost Crimson said, "The Puppet Sect has always had Five Peaks, is today not a good day for Shadow Puppet Peak to return to the Sect?"
Everyone glanced at Lv Hong, Wang Susu, and some remaining Skin Masters, then laughed together.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 204: 139. Entering the Purple Mansion, Secluded in the Deep Sea (8.0K words - Two Chapters Combined, Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Laughter hid a few sinister secrets that no one knew, but everyone was aware that the Puppet Sect was about to turn over a new leaf and needed to enter an era of stable development.
The existence of Profound Heart, the inheritance of the Purple Mansion, would further advance the Sect, officially stepping into the era of "Purple Mansion Ancestor overseeing the Sect" in many years to come.
However, there was still a thorn in their side, and that was: the Mountain Sea Great Demon.
The Mountain Sea Great Demon had always been searching for Song Yan.
Song Yan is dead, will they still come?
If they come, under what kind of humility should they kneel to continue surviving?
...
...
The news of "Song Zhang and the Demon dying together" was a secret among secrets, but considering the existence of the Mountain Sea Great Demon, Blood Cliff and others quickly spread this news, making it known to all.
To "avoid suspicion," Blood Cliff and others not only spread the news but also started to furiously curse Song Demon, saying that demon was despicable and shameless, committing numerous evil deeds, to the extent that even they couldn't stand it. The infamous name of the Puppet Sect was entirely brought out by Song Demon alone. In life, Song Demon controlled them with means, and they wished to devour that demon alive.
At the same time, they sent emissaries with a large number of gifts to the Multi-tailed Fox Race in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, reporting the situation in the posture of slaves, and then actively pleading for mercy from the Upper Kingdom, hoping they could station an Upper Envoy permanently in Jin Kingdom to give orders, lead the masses, to prevent another unpardonable demon like Song Yan from offending the Upper Kingdom.
The first envoy had just left when, a few days later.
The second envoy quickly set off again.
And the gifts this envoy brought were even more lavish, that is Profound Heart.
Pleading for the Mountain Sea Ancestor to personally come to Jin Kingdom, oversee Profound Heart, allowing such a small country as Jin to join the great Mountain and Sea Demon Country, becoming a member of the Demon Country.
If you can't beat them, join them. As long as you can become a part of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, you can avoid the disaster of annihilation.
Blood Cliff and others had an extremely strong desire to survive, "Profound Heart" was a treasure, the only position to advance to the Purple Mansion, but how could they possibly guard it? Since they couldn't guard it, they might as well give it as a gift to the Mountain Sea Great Demons.
...
...
The news of Song Yan's death quickly spread to the south.
In fact, Su Yao already had a feeling.
Because when she went to the place to connect with the "Bodiless Phantom Crow" some months ago, intending to routinely report to that Song Demon that the "Ancient Teleportation Array repair progress was still at a standstill," she found the Bodiless Phantom Crow seemed soulless, fallen on the ground, frozen in the snow.
At that moment, she felt something was wrong, and now the news confirmed her thoughts.
Su Yao recalled some moments spent with Song Yan, feeling a mix of emotions, but she had experienced too many separations and reunions, having one more Song Yan didn't make a difference, nor one less.
Yuzhuang felt quite saddened, setting up a clothing tomb in a picturesque spot on a desolate mountain.
Yu Xuanwei felt both admiration and fear.
In her heart, Old Demon Song was an unfathomable existence, yet such an existence could die one day.
He died just like that, seemingly dropping dead.
She sensed the impending arrival of the Mountain Sea Great Demon, so while hastily arranging for the remaining disciples of Nanwu Sword Sect to hide their identities, concealing themselves in the Land of No Profound in the Southern Wilderness, pretending to be ordinary reclusive villagers, she sought another opportunity to continue repairing the Ancient Teleportation Array.
An Li, initially intending to search everywhere for Brother Xiuhu, gradually gave up hope and instead focused more on alchemy.
Pain is the greatest catalyst for growth.
Growth means forgetting.
If one can't forget the suffering and endure the pain, how can they grow up?
An Li had grown up.
She realized that even if Brother Xiuhu had not died on that day in the Misty Sea, he probably hadn't escaped far and had already perished.
Time is the best healing medicine; no love is eternal.
Even if An Li remembered Brother Xiuhu, his figure would gradually blur, because she was no longer a child. There isn't any obstacle too insurmountable; people... always have to look forward, right?
...
...
The warm wind of July gently blew across the azure sea surface.
Shallow waves covered the beach, continuing forward to wash over and engulf the wet gravel, bringing the small shrimp, crabs, and fish hiding in the sand pits back to the sea.
Song Yan lay on his back against a huge rock, stretching his body to feel the warmth brought by the warm water and scorching sun.
The surroundings were deserted for a hundred miles, only sometimes a fishing boat would lose its course and pass by from the distant sea.
In such a place, even the pungent scent of blood could disperse widely, becoming so faint it nearly vanished completely.
Without subordinates, everything had to be done by himself.
Even making paper was the same.
Now, Zhang Han's blood was soaking into the pulp, about to take shape.
But making his blood corpse was extremely difficult, Song Yan hadn't found a "Feng Shui Treasure Land," so he could only follow an ordinary Corpse Nourishing Technique to keep the corpse in a self-made stone coffin.
When the blood paper formed, he planned to use this paper to make a paper house, then hide in the deep sea, as deep as possible, and after that... he intended to stay underwater for a very long time, until the Mountain Sea Great Demons forgot about Song Yan's existence, until old acquaintances were long gone.
This was his plan.
He had the blood of a "Ghost Shark" and a "Water Abyss Flood Dragon," living underwater was no problem. And the skin of sea beasts in the sea could also be used to create shadow puppets.
By then, he would live in the sea.
Of course, he had already successfully broken through to the early stage of Purple Mansion.
In Zhang Han's storage bag, there was an inheritance of the Purple Mansion.
Through that inheritance, he sat in the Three Kingdoms Profound Heart, spending sweat and wisdom, closing his eyes for three hundred years, naturally enhancing Ghost Profound Root to a middle grade, and successfully breaking through and consolidating the early stage of the Purple Mansion realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 205: 139. Entering the Purple Mansion, Secluded in the Deep Sea (8.0K words - Two Chapters Combined, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Zhang Han's cultivation technique is called the "Ghost Infant Scripture."
This scripture contains the complete cultivation of the Purple Mansion Realm, allowing cultivators to gain certain advantages in the Evil Land, and provides a boost when using evil qi treasures and magic.
The end of the scripture is the formation of an existence called the "Divine Infant."
Humans borrow from heaven and earth to nurture the divine soul.
The divine soul enters heaven and earth, then freely enters the womb, thereby nurturing a second life within this "womb of heaven and earth."
The newborn is naturally an infant, but different from the ordinary infant, hence referred to as ——— Divine Infant.
Thus, Song Yan naturally understood that above the Purple Mansion Realm is the Divine Infant Realm.
The "Ghost Infant Scripture" also describes the Purple Mansion Realm in detail.
The overview states that the Purple Mansion's three realms, early, middle, and late, involve cultivating three types of thoughts.
The thought of the early stage is the killing thought.
When the killing thought arises, it can leave the body, absorb surrounding profound qi, and independently complete an attack equivalent to the late stage of the Crimson Palace, then immediately disappear.
However, casting spells independently with thoughts requires considerable expenditure, unless seated upon the Profound Heart for strong replenishment, otherwise consumption is rapid.
The thought of the middle stage is the protective thought.
The thought of the late stage is the self thought.
As the name implies, the early stage of the Purple Mansion can only use thoughts for attack, unable to defend or perform more agile operations, and it also appears and vanishes quickly, unable to endure. This does not completely align with Song Yan's understanding of the Purple Mansion realm.
After all, he learned from Madame Ling that the Purple Mansion can carry a secret realm with oneself. After digesting Zhang Han's lingering thoughts, he knew there was a secret realm hidden in the Evil Land, and that it housed many ghost cultivators. However, he could not take it with him. This means Zhang Han merely knew of and utilized the secret realm but couldn't carry it with him.
There are certainly many things that need exploring here...
After all, the thought in the Purple Mansion Realm lasts a hundred or thousand years without death, which he found quite absurd.
That thing does not seem like the power of the Purple Mansion Realm, at least not the power that can be possessed in the early stage of the Purple Mansion.
How can a thought appear and vanish, yet achieve millennial immortality?
What a joke?
Song Yan thought the insect thought Madame Ling received should at least be of the Divine Infant Realm.
And after breaking through the early stage of the Purple Mansion, he was stuck, not needing an elixir this time but a catalyst.
The killing thought has been abundant, making breakthroughs easy.
But protective thought seemed exceedingly scarce for him.
This thought certainly couldn't be cultivated by isolating oneself.
He needed a catalyst.
Such a catalyst likely required wandering the human realm, adventuring outside, to obtain it by chance in moments of fortune.
Others obtain the catalyst needing resources and time and have to return to the Profound Heart to possibly succeed, but he need only sit back at the Profound Heart, achieving it almost instantly.
But the current circumstances did not allow him to do so.
...
As for the death scenario of mutual destruction in the core of the Evil Land, it was intentionally orchestrated by him.
That day's battle cost him everything, but he successfully stepped into the Purple Mansion Realm.
He was in a completely desperate state at that time, bringing Zhang Han the old demon to the Sea of Suffering, while also taking all the Chang ghosts in his Divine Sense Space with him, which included Grandma Fox and Grandma Red, even the great elder... Those individuals should have already sunk into the Sea of Suffering, stripped of their obsessions, returning to the cycle of rebirth, right?
And at the gate were the Chang ghosts from the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet.
But due to these connections and blockades, even the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet could not withstand the gentle breeze of the Sea of Suffering, directly exploding.
The Chang ghosts inside were completely annihilated!
However, the three connected Cold Prison Floating Life Bracelets prospered from adversity, breaking free from the main bracelet, allowing Blood Cliff and the others to regain freedom.
With many thoughts flashing through his mind, Song Yan suddenly sat up, barefoot, stepping on water, excitedly heading toward the nearby seashore.
He pried open some large rocks, grabbed shy crabs and prawns, then washed them clean in the clear seawater, preparing to eat some seafood.
Now he was waiting for the paper to form.
Once the paper house was complete, he would explore the deep sea.
Upon finding a "home base," he would place the paper house down, and then return to accompany the "Zhang Han Blood Corpse" there as well.
Ordinary blood corpses require years; Purple Mansion Blood Corpse might take longer.
To him, the ocean was a foreign territory, also seeming to be humanity's forbidden land; even previously, Southern Wu Sword Sect's Su Family's Elder Luo dared only hunt sharks in shallow seas.
He dared not be careless, because sometimes... the place you choose to flee might exactly be where others wish to escape from.
...
...
Another year, at the end of winter.
Heavy snow fell from the sky, bleaching the mountains, freezing streams.
Yet the vast sea continued to surge, currents brimming from afar, reaching toward unknown regions.
Whoosh!
A head suddenly emerged from the sea, Song Yan breaking out from the waters, settling back on the shore.
This year was his loneliest.
He spent it entirely alone and was alone in his sea explorations as well.
Half a year of exploration gave him some impression of this sea:
There are Sea Demons in the sea.
Sea Demons refer to sea monsters, not sea demon beasts.
Creatures like the Ghost Shark are referred to as sea demon beasts.
Creatures like Multi-tailed Fox, Corpse-Eating Wolf, Changwang Hu are truly monsters.
How did he know?
On an autumn day, completing his shallow sea exploration, he gradually descended in a gorge at the edge of the continental shelf, continuing along the continental slope toward the deep sea, passing through a fan-like giant slope before entering the depths.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 206: 139. Entering the Purple Mansion, Secluded in the Deep Sea (8.0K words - Two Chapters Combined, Please Subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
At first, he was quite happy because there were also many mountains in the sea, and those mountains had caves, very suitable for seclusion.
When he explored further, he became even happier, seemingly because of being closer to the crust, the Profound Qi under the sea was even more abundant than on land.
He was just at the edge of the deep sea and already felt Profound Qi no less than the Misty Sea. If he went deeper, the concentration of Profound Qi would be unimaginable.
But just as he decided to go deeper and live in seclusion, he saw the Demon Beast tide.
Demon Beast tide under the sea!
A magnificent tide of Demon Beasts, carrying a multitude of ordinary Sea Beasts, like enormous tornadoes touching the sky, going towards a certain place... he vaguely heard singing.
The singing was ethereal and enchanting, extremely alluring. If he hadn't reached the Purple Mansion Realm, perhaps he would've been lured away by this terrifying alluring Demon's Sound.
His fortune was shattered.
Where Profound Qi is thick, there must be Great Demon born.
How could it be possible that there are no Demons in the sea, as the place is extremely rich in Profound Qi?
If there were no Demons, wouldn't the cultivators have already developed this area?
Not to mention anything else, just the Sea Demons attacking with Demon's Sound must be of the Purple Mansion Realm.
The Purple Mansion Realm has the ability to clone... He lives at the bottom of the sea, with such a large house, would it not be as conspicuous as a candle in the dark to the Sea Demons?
For a moment, he thought of the Ancient Race that had enmity with the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
Clearly, there also exist powerful human races and forces in this world, only the place he's in is too remote to encounter them.
But even if encountered, would it be a good thing?
Song Yan couldn't help but sigh secretly.
At this time, he looked into the distance, thought for a while, decided not to use the Paper House, and instead make Shadow Puppets of some sea Demon Beasts, then swallow them with the Hundred Forms Demon Body, transforming himself into a bizarre-looking Demon Beast, and so shrink into a sea cave.
At least get through this period of hardship.
When the Mountain and Sea Great Demons come and go, he would return to the human world, become Mr. Li, with a beautiful concubine, living by slaughtering pigs.
...
Days passed one after another, Song Yan felt quite helpless in the deep sea.
Because he discovered that the deep sea not only abounded in Profound Qi, but also... the frequent eruptions of "Earth Qi".
"Earth Demon" is indeed a type of Earth Qi.
Besides this, eruptions of Water Profound and Earth Profound were also frequent here.
And once erupted, it seemed to attract quite a few Demon Beasts.
Although Demon Beasts lack intelligence, they are instinctively attracted to more abundant Profound Qi, especially Water Profound and Earth Profound.
Thus, Song Yan understood how the Su Family's ancestor Luo waited for a year to catch the Phantom Shark.
Apparently, that time the underwater eruption of Water Profound was closer to the near-sea, and the Phantom Shark came over to cultivate, ending up caught by Ancestor Luo.
Refining Profound Sea Beasts, Crimson Palace Sea Beasts are nothing much; Song Yan paid them no mind at all.
But he knew this kind of eruption might also draw in Sea Demons.
The probability wasn't high, but over so much time, any small probability event could become a certainty.
...
...
After living in such apprehension for a year...
One winter's day.
Song Yan was sitting cross-legged in the underwater canyon cave at the edge of the continental shelf.
That cave was created by him, quite comfortable to sit inside.
This year his impression was: "Those who claim there's no sense of time in the mountains must never have lived underwater. If they did, they'd find that time underwater flows much faster than in the mountains; a day's time is almost gone in a blink."
Right now, as he watched the fish swimming back and forth in the distance, feeling the swirl of underwater currents, he thought today should be another ordinary day, but suddenly, a strange and indescribable feeling arose.
A thought emerged in his mind.
No!
Not emerged, but it was right there in his mind!
He had gathered a lot of thoughts from Zhang Han, many having been digested. They involved parts of Zhang Han's memory and important thoughts concerning the understanding of this world, which were quite helpful to him.
And now the thought suddenly arising was from one he confirmed he had completely digested.
That thought seemed to cross a great distance and directly surfaced in his mind in sentences.
Those sentences carried a hint of impatience.
"Zhang Han, I know you messed things up, the kid has already died in the Sea of Suffering, soul scattered."
"But what are you up to? Do you think by faking death and hiding, I won't find you?"
"Get out here, even without Changwang Tiger Blood, there's other blood to make up for it! I'll give you a chance to redeem yourself right now!"
"You go to the Chu Kingdom for me and bring back a kid. Although that kid doesn't have Changwang Tiger Blood, the blood's good, it's also important for entering the Soul Threshold and acquiring the Evil Treasure. Then, you'll go to the Soul Threshold with us."
"After this, I'll return the Jin Kingdom's Profound Heart to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 207 207: 140. Purple Mansion Gazes at Qi, Chu Capital Medical Pavilion (7.2K words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
In the span of a single thought, just a mere instant, life is born and then extinguished, how can it possibly endure?
Yet the thought that Zhang Han's fragmented soul brought into his mind has not only evaded his scrutiny but also persisted until now?
"Late Stage of Purple Mansion," these words suddenly surfaced from the depths of Song Yan's heart.
Using the "Ghost Infant Scripture" and the information left behind in Zhang Han's soul fragment, Song Yan had some understanding of the Late Stage of the Purple Mansion.
"Spiritual Thought" is a characteristic of the Late Stage of the Purple Mansion.
This is a very special thought; the so-called avatar of the Late Stage of the Purple Mansion comes from this.
When one thought enters a mortal's body, it forcefully suppresses that person's divine soul and then takes over the dominant position, akin to possession.
However, this method of "One Thought Possession" can only be used on those below Refining Profound, and if one hasn't seated the Profound Heart, the consumption would be quite significant, and it is a continuous consumption.
As for the thought leaving the individual, wandering alone outside, eternal for a millennium, storing information, and still serving as a key to the Secret Realm, that is simply unachievable. Therefore, the thought from the Insect Race in Ling Madam's mind must at least be Divine Infant Realm.
Moreover, "Spiritual Thought," due to its independence and persistence, can naturally also serve as a means of communication.
But this communication can only be used on those of the Crimson Palace and above; for lower realms, it is simply "possession."
The Crimson Palace that has received the "Spiritual Thought" will have its thoughts and contemplations in its mind peeked to a certain extent.
The Purple Mansion, having accepted the "Spiritual Thought," will not have its thoughts spied upon due to its own strong thoughts. However, by being more cautious, it can confine the "Spiritual Thought" within its own thoughts.
Without a doubt, the "Spiritual Thought" in Zhang Han's mind was confined tightly, hidden deeply; otherwise, Song Yan wouldn't have missed it.
At this moment...
Song Yan suppressed his heartbeat and the urge to respond hurriedly, quickly organizing his thoughts, as the next statement might decide the environment he would confront.
Is it good or bad? Is it life or death? Is it a future full of possibilities, or destitution? Sometimes, isn't it all just within a single sentence?
Fragments of memory about Zhang Han flashed through his mind again; these fragments were obtained from the fragmented soul.
In a snowy land, an Earth Demon heart, a Fox Demon traveling from afar, bowing from a distance...
Zhang Han sat poised with a demon heart, surrounded by howling spinning red demon bones, concealing his face...
A brief exchange, the manifestation of Spiritual Thought, made Zhang Han realize he was no match...
Then, Zhang Han accepted the task.
'So, the others did not see Zhang Han's appearance.'
'Just like how the ancestor of the Purple Mansion and Ling Madam communicated while dealing with the two-headed Bilanspirited-devouring insects, they confirmed each other's thoughts, not through anything else.'
'Since that is the case, if Madam Ling can pretend to be Aunt Zhu, why can't I pretend to be Zhang Han?'
Song Yan let out a light breath, but then his heart tightened again.
'What if there's deception?'
'What if the others don't know where I am and are trying to lure me out?'
'Or, perhaps the others are unsure whether I'm alive or dead, so they're probing?'
'Should I respond, or not?'
As Song Yan was contemplating this, more intriguing thoughts brought forth a new voice.
The voice carried a growing impatience along with a hint of contempt.
"A small place, after all, has little insight.
Right now... are you in the east?
Hmm, toward the sea, the edge of the deep sea."
Song Yan nearly jumped up like a cat with its tail stepped on upon hearing this information.
An indescribable helplessness arose from his heart, almost halting his breath.
It was like the old guard of the Purple Mansion, a powerful race with abundant heritage and countless resources crushing him, just a newcomer to the Purple Mansion, an impoverished youth.
Nevertheless, he did not respond.
If you have the ability, keep talking.
As expected, the owner of this voice, wanting to use him, continued talking.
"The Purple Mansion Realm has a treasure known as the Qi Observation Pearl. This pearl can distinguish the aura above the Crimson Palace; anything below the Crimson Palace appears white, above it as red. Additionally, it can detect racial aura to some extent.
This item is not of much use in the Mountain and Sea Kingdom because everywhere is filled with strong auras, chaotic and overwhelming, akin to a sky full of red clouds, at best having a small-range function, used primarily to prevent Ancient Race invasions. However, the Ancient Race has several ways to counteract it, disrupting techniques, overall... quite useless.
But, in a small place like the Jin Kingdom, it's very useful.
Imagine in a land of mortals, a patch of red clouds suddenly appears; isn't it noticeable?
Imagine the East Sea, a forbidden place for mortals, where a group of sea beasts reside, suddenly a Human Race aura appears, and it's a red cloud; isn't it noticeable?
Your luck is good, no sea demon has taken notice of you, otherwise, if you were targeted, you wouldn't have good news."
Song Yan: ...
Purple Mansion Realm Qi Observation Pearl?
Can observe aura above the Crimson Palace?
Can distinguish between Human Race and Demon Race aura?
No wonder Granny Hong and the Ancient General are so convinced about the idea that "once a Purple Mansion arrives, he simply can't hide."
So that's what's going on.
Who can possibly hide here?
If he were like Master Li, hiding in a Land of No Profound, wouldn't he be dragged out in an instant?
Song Yan sighed lightly, displaying a self-mocking bitter smile.
At the same time, the deep-sea edge he considered relatively safe suddenly felt less so.
Perhaps, he's already been targeted by sea demons; they just haven't had the manpower to deal with him, or maybe he hasn't yet entered the sea demons' "kill zone."
After all, he is of the Purple Mansion Realm, not so easy to kill.
But on second thought, if the sea demons learned that his Purple Mansion Realm is "empty-handed, without any treasures or background," would they come for him immediately...

chapters.title: Chapter 208 208: 140. Purple Mansion Gazes at Qi, Chu Capital Medical Pavilion (7.2K words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
At this moment, the voice continued to ring out.
"Still not responding?
You don't want the opportunity I'm giving you, do you really want me to drag you out? The terms will have to change then."
Song Yan sighed deeply and responded, "I failed; that kid had too many trump cards. And somehow, he learned the Visualization of the Sea of Suffering, dragging me into it. Then he used the Cold Ice Hell Bracelet to block the way, wanting to perish together with me. Had I not escaped at the last moment, I would've perished too."
"Cold Ice Hell Bracelet? Tsk, just a mere Soul Artifact. Your little place truly has nothing to offer," the voice carried a hint of mockery, then continued, "Don't worry, the Purple Mansion Realm is still rare, and there aren't many ghost cultivators in this realm. That you've managed to achieve this realm makes you a genius of sorts."
"Mere Soul Artifact... this Cold Ice Hell Bracelet is a treasure in my land of the Three Kingdoms!"
"Hahaha..."
"Master, today I realized that I, Zhang Han, am just a frog in a well that has never seen the broader world, having wasted several centuries without knowing the height of the sky and the depth of the earth, alas."
"Alright, Zhang Han, work for me earnestly in the future, and I won't treat you poorly.
My title is Infant Wail Master, waiting for you at the Desolate Wilderness entrance for a month.
Hurry over, hehehehehe..."
The voice changed abruptly, becoming shrill, like a baby's cry.
A baby's cry, coupled with the title "Infant Wail Master," ought to be somewhat amusing, yet Song Yan found it impossible to laugh. All he felt was a chilling dread, a hair-raising sensation.
He had once heard Granny Hu and Granny Hong say: the deeper the cultivation of the Multi-tailed Fox Race, the more tails they have, the more their voices resemble babies, and the more they crave human flesh.
...
...
A month later...
A figure cloaked in a silver mask appeared in the Desolate Wilderness.
On a large rock in the wilderness sat a red fox demon with its six tails raised proudly. Its eyes were narrow, and in front of it, a pot was bubbling, cooking human limbs and heads.
Those limbs were evidently fried, their surface coated with a golden crust.
"Greetings, Master."
Song Yan bowed.
The red fox demon smirked, revealing densely packed sharp teeth inside, and glanced slyly at the newcomer, "Take off the mask."
Song Yan removed it, revealing a face destroyed by Sword Qi.
All this Sword Qi was wielded by his own Sword Evil Demon Dragon, yet... despite the destruction, for a Purple Mansion cultivator, restoring a face was still quite easy.
"Forgive the unsightliness, Master," Song Yan sighed lightly, a look of reminiscence in his eyes, and then lamented, "He was really a cunning kid. I was careless. These scars, I left them as a constant reminder not to be complacent, even against weaker opponents."
Having said that, he abruptly pulled open his shirt, revealing several fine sword scars on his body.
Within the sword scars, a hint of surging Evil Qi could vaguely be seen, weaving like red threads sewing densely across, which... was the mark of a powerful ghost cultivator.
Infant Wail Master slightly raised his chin, squinting at those threads of Evil Qi, and said, "If you can challenge across realms to this extent, then Song Yan truly is an old ghost renewing his path.
You've also turned misfortune into fortune; this battle has surely solidified your realm, right?"
"Yes." Song Yan put his clothes back on.
Infant Wail Master dipped both hands into the boiling water, picked up a human hand, and began to gnaw at it, licking his tongue while emitting a shrill, baby-like nasal hum. As he ate, he said, "The people from this small place come with a scent of earth lingering on them, very fresh. Once you eat them, you can't help but want more. I've already ordered Puppet Sect to offer me three thousand people annually; this trip hasn't been in vain."
Saying this, he cast a glance at Song Yan.
Song Yan looked into the pot, abruptly seeing a human head just turned by the bubbling water.
That head could be none other than Jin Kingdom's second prince, Ma Zhao.
Indeed, those associated closely with Song Yan, located near the north and still alive... it's impossible for them to escape a fate of brutal murder.
However, his expression remained indifferent, neither sad nor joyful.
"Would you like some?" Infant Wail Master giggled.
Song Yan showed a somewhat difficult smile.
As Infant Wail Master talked, he had already finished a hand. He wiped his claws slightly, made a gesture in the void, and tossed out a Storage Bag.
Song Yan quickly caught it.
Infant Wail Master said, "Inside, you'll find a map of the Great Chu, a Qi Observation Pearl, Soul Threshold guidance, and the Mountain and Sea South Land Passage Order.
Go to the Chu Kingdom, capture that boy named Tang Fan alive, and bring him to the Chang King Soul Threshold to meet me.
The deadline is five years; by the winter of five years from now, you must appear at the Chang King Soul Threshold entrance.
By the way, Tang Fan's power and potential should be similar to Song Yan's. Having failed once, surely you won't fail a second time, will you?"
Song Yan asked, "Is there anyone at the Purple Mansion Realm in the Great Chu?"
Infant Wail Master replied, "If there were, I wouldn't be sending you there. That place's Profound Heart hasn't formed, and they can't step out into the Purple Mansion."
"Yes."
Song Yan respectfully stowed the Storage Bag, briefly scanning through it to confirm that the route to the Chu Kingdom was north through the Desolate Wilderness, past the outskirts of the Multi-tailed Fox Race, then west. After confirming, he didn't hurry off as if fleeing but instead started to lament, "Master, I'm just a little place's Purple Mansion. Besides killing intent attacks, I truly don't have any treasures worth showing, very limited in means.
Earlier, when I fought that kid Song Yan, if it weren't for the fear of hurting him, being so cautious, it wouldn't have been like this... alas..."
Infant Wail Master said, "You haven't even completed the task, yet you're already asking for rewards."
From the void, he grabbed and quickly tossed out two ropes made of unknown sinew, saying, "These are Blood-Binding Ropes.
Once subdued, bind them, and the Crimson Palace Blood will be as if frozen, unable to be used, making it very easy to take them away.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 209: 140. Purple Mansion Gazes at Qi, Chu Capital Medical Pavilion (7.2K words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
But this rope itself can't withstand a single blow from a Crimson Palace cultivator, so be sure to use it only after suppressing them."
Song Yan took it with one swift motion and repeatedly expressed his gratitude, then respectfully said, "Time is of the essence, I shall depart at once."
The Infant Crying Master waved their hand and said, "Remember to report your progress to me, don't go missing again."
"Understood." Song Yan replied, then saluted and headed swiftly northward.
The Infant Crying Master watched his back, squinted slightly, scratched their chin with a fox paw, and then shook their head.
Whether Song Yan is a Ghost Cultivator or not, they didn't know, but he is definitely not in the Purple Mansion.
Someone who could reach the Early Stage of the Purple Mansion could only possibly be Zhang Han.
After thinking it over, they once again focused on eating.
...
...
Two years later...
Autumn.
Chu Imperial City.
The luxurious debauchery, the riverside with its dazzling lights and bustling nightlife.
The young ladies draped in neon garments, with a fragrance of rouge, lifted their gentle hands to beckon the passersby whom they fancied, calling and waving, "Young Master, come along, have some fun, it's delightful."
The Red Fragrance Tower's renown in the Imperial City was significant, and as evening approached, the autumn scenery, though desolate, marked the beginning of the bustling activities of the pleasure quarters.
A small pharmacy diagonally opposite Red Fragrance Tower also finally began to welcome customers at this time.
Sobriety potions, strength-enhancing elixirs, contraceptive medicines, these types were the best sellers.
Of course, this little pharmacy named "Changchun Hall" didn't only stock these, but as a new store with little reputation, naturally, there were no regular customers to support its business.
Moreover, the owner of Changchun Hall was an unremarkable-looking young man, making it even less likely for people to visit.
As some of the older folks put it, a person without the hair on their mouth isn't capable of doing a reliable job.
The young owner was naturally anxious. He tried lowering prices, made extravagant boasts, but after botching the treatment of a few patients—causing them to take lots of medication and have their conditions neither worsen nor improve—few people came by.
Just a few days ago, the third madam of the Qin Family in the Imperial Capital ruthlessly threw a packet of medicine he prescribed at the shop's entrance, cursing "damn quack," and Changchun Hall became even more deserted.
Fortunately, this young owner still had some cunning methods, beginning to offer special concoctions targeting the Red Fragrance Tower, thus barely keeping the pharmacy operational.
The young owner was already feeling disheartened, and had thus hired a simple lad with some medical skill to man the counter and sell medicine for him, while he himself no longer even consulted patients, as if resigning in despair.
Fortunately, this young owner was still quite popular.
Because he was young, and despite his ordinary appearance, being young and having the title of a doctor was enough to be fancied by the young ladies from the neighboring Celestial Fragrance Tower.
At this moment, the young owner once again sighed deeply as he walked out of Changchun Hall, with the lad in the store calling after him: "Doctor Li, business was good today, we sold six potions just as Celestial Fragrance Tower opened!"
Song Yan slapped his forehead, his eyes filled with a look of remorse, muttering to himself: "If only I knew to study for a few more years, now my money is all tied here, what am I going to do, this is really worrying me to death."
As a master of hiding, Song Yan naturally understood the "Way of the Hidden".
Being mediocre, having small flaws, enduring some unattainable desires—these are the best ways to blend into the masses.
Being a Divine Doctor wouldn't work; setting high prices and advertising as "treating only three people a day" doesn't either; being ordinary still won't work, because ordinary means he'd be busy.
If busy, how can he still find Tang Fan?
The Qi Observation Pearl can only lock onto an area, not precisely locate a target, so he could only come here to search.
Fortunately, Tang Fan clearly also didn't know there existed such a treasure as the "Qi Observation Pearl", so he should be hiding with the idea of "the great hermit hides in plain sight, or amidst the court", in this most prosperous Great Chu Imperial Capital.
And there are still some small differences between Great Chu and the Three Kingdoms.
The Profound Veins of the Three Kingdoms may lie deep in the mountains or within lakes, but in Great Chu, the Profound Veins are beneath the Imperial Capital.
This made it even more troublesome.
Because there were not only many people here, but also Sects, the scale of which is roughly the same as Nanwu Sword Sect, but not as large as Puppet Sect.
If he intended to wipe out an entire sect, it wouldn't be so troublesome.
The Purple Mansion Realm isn't something the lower-level cultivators could exhaust to death.
If he really decided to act, he could basically kill an Elder with a single thought, as effortlessly as slaughtering chickens.
However, to stir up a storm with much thunder but no rain without achieving anything wasn't his way.
He patiently waited, observed.
Purchasing supplies, going into the mountains, giving up on himself, finding chaotic methods to save Changchun Hall could allow him to take many steps as possible.
The name of a Quack also granted him enough time.
Being a doctor allows him access to many places.
And if he encounters Red Cloud City, he can even follow to take a look, after all... there are only about a dozen or so Crimson Palace cultivators in the whole Great Chu Imperial City, among them a fox and a wolf sent by the Fox and Wolf Races.
This fox and wolf, like when they originally captured him, were feverishly infiltrating the Great Chu Imperial City, but... because there were Sects here and the upper management was pushing hard, the Fox and Wolf Races were restrained and didn't randomly eat people in the streets like Granny Fox, Red Grandma, and General Gu once did.
However, he knows where the fox and wolf are, but they don't know about him.
The fox and wolf only know that a powerhouse from the Purple Mansion was sent from their race, but they don't know where the powerhouse is.
At this time, Song Yan also understood why the Infant Crying Master didn't come personally.
It's truly too far, just hurrying on the road takes a year, and that's from Jin Kingdom to Great Chu.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 210: 140. Purple Mansion Gazes at Qi, Chu Capital Medical Pavilion (7.2K words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Isn't it better to spend this time on cultivation?
After coming here, he spent a year confirming that the geography of Great Chu was similar to that of the Jin Kingdom. It was as if it were an isolated pit buried in the soil by the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, unable to escape from here. Moreover, after seeing the "Qi Observation Pearl" and understanding the existence of Sea Demons and the like, he temporarily restrained the urge to run around. During this year, he also established the Changchun Hall.
At this moment, he felt a sense of indescribable drama in his heart, a feeling of turning from a "mouse" into a "cat". As for the rest, he could only hold on to the mindset of "better his friend than him dying".
He gave himself a year and a half to get from here to the Soul Threshold of the Wandering King, meaning he would continue to stay in the Great Chu Imperial Capital for another year and a half.
If, after a year, he still had no news about Tang Fan, he would start killing the Crimson Palace cultivators of the Great Chu sects.
Once he had killed them all, the one remaining red cloud would be Tang Fan.
At that time, he would reveal himself slightly to demonstrate the power of the Purple Mansion Realm.
Tang Fan would certainly take the opportunity to flee.
Upon his escape, he would be able to catch him.
Song Yan was quite confident about "escaping".
If he were in the same situation, unaware of the existence of the "Qi Observation Pearl", and saw that a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator was in the city where he was hiding, he would definitely seize the chance to flee.
Just as he was thinking, he suddenly heard a "meow meow" sound coming from not far away.
Song Yan looked down and saw a pitiful-looking calico cat shaking its tail and huddling in a corner of the wall, seemingly expectantly looking at him.
When he moved, the calico cat shrunk back.
But when it realized he wasn't approaching, the calico cat ran back, looking at him expectantly.
At that moment, a faint scent came wafting from behind him.
The fragrance was not delicate but rather garish, obviously not a rarity in Chu Imperial City.
He turned his head slightly and saw a young girl running over while covering her face with her sleeve, then squatting beside the calico cat and taking out a small bag with food from her sleeve, opening it.
As soon as she opened it, it was like a cat nest exploded.
A bunch of cats, including those only three or four months old, came running out from behind the calico cat with "meow meow meow" sounds.
The cats gathered around the small bag and began to eat.
Only then did Song Yan realize that the calico cat wasn't expecting him but this kind person.
Only then did the young girl notice someone nearby. Looking up and seeing the young man's face, she exclaimed, "Doctor Li!"
Song Yan awkwardly scratched his head.
He recognized this young girl.
This young girl's name was Shuang Yun, and she was a courtesan from the Red Fragrance Tower, known for being quite cheap. Ten taels of silver would get a table of dishes and drinks, and she would keep you company overnight. If only keeping you company without the drinks, it would be three taels of silver, which was really cheap for having a companion in Celestial Fragrance Tower of Chu Imperial City.
He... had slept with her.
"It's Shuang Yun..."
"Doctor Li..."
The two of them remained silent and speechless.
Song Yan broke the awkward silence with a smile, "Feeding the cats?"
Shuang Yun replied with a bitter face, "Don't let madam know."
The madam she referred to was the procuress of the Celestial Fragrance Tower.
After speaking, her eyes brightened and she said, "Next time, Doctor Li, when you come, I'll be attentive and not just lie there, making sure you're quite comfortable."
Song Yan asked, "Why feed the cats?"
Shuang Yun said, "They're pitiful. In this cold winter, those kittens who were just born and raised, without being fed, they'd die. But even if they're fed, they might still freeze to death."
Saying so, her expression turned somewhat gloomy, then she added, "All this food was left by the guests. Even if I don't give it to the cats, it'd just be thrown away."
Song Yan nodded lightly, then squatted down, attempting to pet the cat's head, but the calico cat gave him a fierce look, so he withdrew his hand.
Shuang Yun was startled for a moment, then squatted down as well.
When she raised her hand to touch, whether it was the calico or the other kittens, they all obediently let her touch their heads.
Song Yan took a deep breath, revealing a genuine smile he hadn't shown in a long time.
The market was filthy, yet there were clean places.
Suddenly, he ran off to Changchun Hall, grabbed some of the midday food, and quickly returned, piling it up beside the cats as Shuang Yun looked on in surprise.
Shuang Yun exclaimed in astonishment, "You... you..."
Song Yan said, "I'm feeding the cats too."
Shuang Yun was dazed for a while, then laughed, "Doctor Li, you're truly kind-hearted."
Song Yan sighed, "Just a damn quack."
Shuang Yun, hearing his self-mockery, giggled and said, "Quack or not, you're still a doctor, much better than us."
The two of them chatted intermittently while watching the cats eat.
Time flew by, and seeing the Red Fragrance Tower getting busy, Shuang Yun hurriedly grabbed her skirt and ran back.
As Song Yan stood up, the calico cat, who had looked down on him earlier, came over, tail raised, meowing while gently rubbing against his leg.
He stretched his arms comfortably, then ran off into the distance, eventually arriving in front of the "Wang's Butcher Shop."
When the butcher in the shop saw him, he said, "Hey, Doctor Li is here."
Song Yan smiled, "Did you save some pig skin for me today?"
The butcher smiled, "Knowing you love jellied skin, of course I saved it for you."
The two exchanged money for goods, and since Song Yan was generous with his payment, the butcher would always save the pig skin for him.
Song Yan took the pig skin, returned to Changchun Hall, closed the door, and began the process of making the pig skin, then proceeded to make jellied pig skin. Pairing it with a pot of white liquor from Celestial Fragrance Tower, along with the new snow of this deep winter, he drank by himself, savoring it.
While he was drinking, there was a sudden urgent "knock knock knock" on the front door.
"Open the door quickly!"
"Open the door!"
Song Yan hurried over, opened the door, and saw several guests in raincoats and hats standing outside.
The guests had knives at their waists but carried no Profound Qi, clearly Jianghu people.
Behind them, there was a pungent smell of blood mixed with a strange decaying odor.
A patient was quickly brought before Song Yan.
He saw a middle-aged man with a body covered in claw marks, the wounds beginning to corrupt.
Those wounds were clearly the result of a Demon Beast's claw, and a Demon Beast of Intermediate level at that.
For someone who wasn't a cultivator to have survived a claw attack from an Intermediate Demon Beast was indeed not easy.
He asked, "What happened?"
The guest with the hat said fiercely, "Can you treat it?"
Song Yan, startled, immediately began treating him with the techniques of an ordinary doctor.
But how could such a wound be treated by an ordinary doctor?
After some busy effort, the patient had already taken his last breath.
The guest with the hat angrily drew his knife, roaring "quack," and was about to tear apart the roof of Changchun Hall when he was fortunately held back, then left without paying, running to the door, leaping high with their skills, and slashing down the plaque of "Changchun Hall" with a single stroke.
...
Meanwhile.
In the sect of Chu Kingdom — the Thousand Crane Sect, an elderly ancestor was lying down.
Even with the use of many medicines, it was still of no use.
"That was a Crimson Palace Demon Beast, extremely skilled in stealth attacks..." The old man coughed as he spoke, "Luckily, luckily he was also slain by this old man... cough cough cough..."
This old man was none other than the Supreme Elder of the Thousand Crane Sect, "Crane Ancestor," at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, and had lived for a long time.
Even though many medicines had been used, it was still useless.
He caught hold of the arm of a middle-aged man beside him tightly and said, "Take me to the forbidden closing ground. From today onwards, I will enter a death closing. To the outside... cough cough... say the same. We absolutely cannot let the Fox and Wolf Races know that this old man... this old man is dead!"

chapters.content:
The light snow quietly fluttered down in this distant land, far from the Jin Kingdom, as Song Yan looked at the shattered "Changchun Hall" sign, torn in two, with a smile that was both amused and helpless.
Should you be angry?
Not really.
He had conjured up storms, walked the path between life and death, been the Sect Leader in an Immortal Sect; seen mortal dynasty princes kneel and wipe their shoes with their faces, witnessed an entire sect revere him as if he were their ancestor; could decide life and death with a mere glance, could topple a strong-looking Chu Imperial City like a toy block...
Where does anger come from?
Simply can't feel angry at all.
Toys are easier to destroy than to build, but a mortal imperial city is indeed a wondrous place.
At this moment, the troubles that plague mortals seemed to provide him with a sense of novelty.
Joy, anger, sorrow, and delight; riches and poverty; the hustle and bustle of the streets; the joy and sorrow of partings and reunions—all imbued with magic.
'No wonder many old immortals enjoy disguising themselves as mortals, immersing in the dust of the world; it truly is amusing, this kind of thing... it's truly relaxing.'
Song Yan looked at the sign broken by people from the Jianghu and not only was he not angry, he even felt a sense of relief and amusement.
If every day you were fighting with a bunch of cunning creatures with hearts full of schemes, and then one day, you suddenly saw a kindergarten child hitting you for a childish reason, you would only feel relaxed...
At that moment, Song Yan mused to himself, "Old masters and nobles long to become immortals, yet immortals wish to become old masters and nobles again. As they say, once in the martial world, you can't help yourself, but being an immortal, you are even more helpless..."
He bent down slightly, picked up the broken sign pieces, dusted off the snow on them, wiped them clean, then grumbled a few curses, "This ailment, clearly caused by a demon beast, how am I supposed to cure it, how am I supposed to cure it!"
Then, he picked up the sign once more, humming, "Oh... my sign, my sign."
After his grumbling, he seemed to think of something that made him shiver and murmured, "Will they seek revenge again? These Jianghu people, swords in and out, completely unreasonable, I... I'd better avoid them for now."
...
...
A moment later.
Celestial Fragrance Tower.
"Can it be a bit cheaper."
"Three taels."
"How about two taels and eight coins? It's already so late..."
"Three taels."
"Hey, it's already past the third watch, and I didn't just come when it got dark, Auntie, can't you lower the price a little?"
The madam rolled her eyes, glanced at him, and said, "Aren't you here to hide? Doctor Li's place is not far from us, that ruckus... click, click, click, do you really think I'm deaf, Auntie? Not charging you more is already a neighborly courtesy."
"Hey, I am a doctor."
"Come off it, who can you cure?"
"Alright, three taels it is."
Song Yan carefully counted out the silver, then was led into a room.
Soon the door opened, a young maiden dressed in red gauze stepped barefoot onto the warm floor, walking in with cat-like grace, then turned around and jutted her hip.
With a snap, the door closed.
She placed her small hands behind her, flicked her alabaster fingers, quickly locking the door, then looked at Song Yan and giggled, "I won't break my promise."
As she spoke, she pounced forward like a cat, approached Song Yan, and whispered charmingly in his ear, "Even though I'm sleepy, since I promised to accompany you wholeheartedly, I will do so earnestly. A promise is a promise!
Quickly, feel how comfortable it is, it's freshly changed gauze, never worn during the day."
As night passed, Song Yan lay comfortably on the bed, snuggled up to a soft, fragrant beauty, but his mind was still pondering: What happened last night was unusual, something might happen in the Chu Imperial City.
After all, the Fox and Wolf races aren't to be trifled with.
Back when he hid in the Nanwu Sword Sect, Red Granny and General Gu were constantly stirring up trouble, from using the Soul Gold Stone as bait, impersonating him to commit atrocities, even releasing demon beasts to kill three warriors, really gave him a huge pressure.
By chance, he managed to utilize the timing, location, and the opponent's negligence to swiftly kill the two demons.
Now that such a thing has occurred, if the Fox and Wolf in Chu Kingdom don't do something, it wouldn't make sense, and there might even be their hand behind this incident.
So, what will Tang Fan do?
Speaking of which, he's quite curious about Tang Fan.
He knows he possesses talents and wisdom that others can't match, but Tang Fan?
Is he really a favored child of heaven with innate talent? Or does he have some kind of treasure?
As he was pondering, the woman in his arms softly murmured as she awoke, playfully hitting him, then said, "You devil, didn't expect you to be so fierce, nearly broke my bones. Yawn, time's up, I have to leave."
With that, Shuang Yun turned over, put on her embroidered shoes, changed clothes, and walked out.
Song Yan also got up energetically.
...
A moment later, when Song Yan returned to Changchun Hall, he saw the honest clerk sitting and staring blankly at the sign, muttering, "This... this..."
Song Yan stamped his foot and said, "Xiao Pan, what are you standing there for? Go get a sign craftsman, we need a new sign!!"
The honest clerk named Pan Yu quickly nodded and then ran off.
After a busy day and spending a considerable amount of money, the new sign for "Changchun Hall" was finally hung up.
But business turned even more dismal.
After Pan Yu learned the truth, he didn't suspect "those Jianghu folks were poisoned by demon beasts," but rather doubted "the family doctor is indeed incompetent, unable to rescue promptly," though he didn't say anything, his gaze was always one of suspicion, as if wanting to hang the words "Doctor Li, can you do it or not?" right on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 212: 141. Can't hide it like this? Idiot! (8.3K words - large chapter, please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Song Yan patted his shoulder and said earnestly, "Anyway, in this Chu Imperial City, my medical skills are definitely not the worst."
This time, he wasn't lying.
Before entering this profession, he had looked into it.
Now, with his so-called "quack" level, he could still rank mid-level in the Chu Imperial City.
His medicines neither caused deaths nor delayed or worsened ailments, and they never drove anyone to bankruptcy.
Hearing the shopkeeper speak this way, what else could Pan Yu say? He just kept sighing.
It wasn't until Song Yan assured him, "No matter how the clinic's business is, you'll get your due money," that Pan Yu thanked him profusely. But upon leaving, he was still sighing continuously.
He needed to provide for his family and wanted a stable job.
Looking at the current situation, he honestly didn't know how much longer Changchun Hall could remain open.
Seeing that it was already late, Song Yan prepared to close up.
At this moment, hurried footsteps suddenly approached from afar.
Pan Yu ran over from the alley, pale-faced. Upon seeing that Changchun Hall was still open, he stumbled and fell, then scrambled and crawled his way over the threshold of the clinic.
Song Yan quickly helped him up.
Pan Yu was so terrified he could barely speak, only repeatedly looking at the door, saying, "Close...close..."
Song Yan hastily shut the door.
After a while, Pan Yu caught his breath a little and said, "A monster...a monster, so terrifying."
Song Yan asked, "What kind of monster?"
Pan Yu stammered, "A fox head, devouring people, and it lifted its face to me, blood dripping all over its mouth."
Song Yan shivered.
Both of them fell silent.
Song Yan squinted into the distance.
If even his honest assistant encountered a Fox Demon, it meant last night's events had indeed had repercussions; at least, the demons in this area were stirring.
And though the local sect, the Thousand Crane Sect, didn't boast the "high moral standards" of the Nanwu Sword Sect, being based in the Chu Imperial City entailed a certain "National Guardian Sect" duty.
A Fox Demon disturbance warranted their intervention.
'It seems some old cultivator got seriously injured last night. The Fox Wolf is testing the waters to see if they're still capable,' he thought.
"Xiao Pan, don't go home tonight."
"But my old mother, wife, and kids are at home. How can I not go back?"
"I'll escort you," Song Yan sighed. At times like this, if Xiao Pan went out alone, he might be eaten by the Fox Demon and never return.
"How...how can that be?"
"Stop fussing. Let's go. We'll try a different route."
"Doctor Li, aren't you afraid?"
"I am."
"Oh...oh...I'm scared too..."
Soon, Song Yan supported his assistant, hoisted a lantern, and they trembled their way out the door.
He didn't even need to deliberately avoid danger or extend his Divine Sense; just relying on Perception, he could evade the dangers in the streets.
Upon entering the Purple Mansion Realm, one transcends the mortal realm both in Divine Soul and physical form, so how could such minor dangers pose a threat?
He escorted Pan Yu to the door; Pan Yu thanked him profusely, with but one thought in mind: to stick with this shopkeeper, ensure Changchun Hall remains open even if it means earning slightly less!
Song Yan turned and left.
In his hand was a blood-red lantern.
The lantern swayed in the deep winter night's breeze.
Perhaps in the alley separated by a mere wall, demons ran rampant, and there was Jianghu strife.
Yet the path he took remained utterly peaceful and unperturbed.
On his way, Song Yan sensed many little demons, confirming his earlier supposition: the Fox Wolf...had made a move.
...
...
Several days later, late at night.
Song Yan, having just finished making pigskin jelly, was lying in his room when he suddenly heard an evil laugh resounding from above the sky outside, followed closely by a man's voice enveloping the area.
"Tonight, I, Tang Fan, shall go against the heavens. What is your Thousand Crane Sect even worth!"
Then there was the thunderous sound of fighting.
Song Yan ran to the courtyard, watching the distance with great interest.
The Fox Wolf's tactics truly boiled down to three hammer blows indeed.
Was he starting to use the Illusion Technique to impersonate Tang Fan?
He watched for a while, then returned indoors to fetch the Qi Observation Pearl and observed from afar.
He saw the red cloud growing richer in hue.
Yet this richness was due to layering.
This meant that all the Crimson Palace cultivators in the Chu Imperial City were converging in one direction.
Naturally, that direction was the Thousand Crane Sect.
Presumably, Tang Fan was heading there too.
'Afraid that they have the same idea as I do, wanting to use the Thousand Crane Sect as a buffer to resist the Fox Wolf,' he mused.
Seeing fish flocking to the net, Song Yan was quite pleased, but he wasn't in a hurry, so he did nothing, instead getting a peaceful night's sleep amidst the rumbles of combat.
...
...
The next day...
The Celestial Fragrance Tower was so terrified it didn't open for business.
Naturally, business at Song Yan's Changchun Hall was also extremely poor. Xiao Pan stayed at the clinic for a while before being sent home by Song Yan while it was still daylight.
This situation persisted for several days.
One day, at dusk, Song Yan collected some silver taels and went to buy pigskin at the butcher's shop. Having walked only a few steps, he saw a familiar figure at an alley corner.
A tall, graceful figure, wrapped in a sapphire blue jacket, stood at the alley exuding a putrid odor.
In her hand, she held a basket of coarse grain buns.
In the alley, there seemed to be someone else.
Song Yan approached and looked in, seeing five small beggars, all dark-skinned, indistinguishable between boys and girls.
The one offering coarse grain buns to the beggars was none other than the Young Mistress Shuang Yun.
Seeing someone approaching, the little beggars were startled, and the slightly larger one at the forefront even drew a knife without a handle from his waist.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 213: 141. Can't hide it like this? Idiot! (8.3K words - large chapter, please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
A so-called knife, it was actually just a sharpened piece of iron.
The little beggar clung to it tightly, looking at him coldly, only letting go when Shuang Yun called out, "Doctor Li."
Song Yan rubbed his hands and said, "Coming out in this weather?"
Shuang Yun replied, "They usually wait outside for leftover food from guests, but the building hasn't opened for several days. It's freezing cold, already hard to bear, and I'm afraid they'll starve to death."
After a moment of silence, Shuang Yun suddenly said, "They once helped me deal with a troublesome guest, avenging me.
That wretched guest was a drunkard and a son-in-law who, after being belittled at home, came here drunk to bully people.
For just ten pieces of silver, he thought of me as cheap and lowly, and despite the bruises and swelling from the abuse, my grandmother did nothing.
After venting his anger, the wretched guest left, but they... ambushed him hard on the road, preventing him from returning home promptly. He was later discovered by his wife at home, and the consequences are easily imagined."
Shuang Yun smiled slightly, looking at the little beggars with an especially gentle expression, then patted the head of the child at the front and said, "They're like my little brothers and sisters."
The taller little beggar in the lead frowned and said, "Auntie Shuang, why tell him all this?"
Shuang Yun replied, "Doctor Li is a good person."
A dirty, short little one at the back made a face, stuck out their tongue, and said in an innocent tone, "Blah blah, a quack can be a good person too?"
Song Yan's face darkened instantly, rushing over to grab the little one.
The lead little beggar's expression changed dramatically, a fierce look flashed in his eyes, and he grasped the piece of iron like a knife firmly, about to charge over, but was held back by Shuang Yun.
Indeed, not far away, Song Yan, after pulling out the little one, simply cradled him in his arm, ruffling his hair fiercely and asking, "Am I a good person, am I a good person?"
Everyone could see that he meant no harm, wasn't even angry, nor did he mind the filth on the child, playing with the kid like teasing.
The little one cried out, "Big Brother, Auntie Shuang, save me!"
Her cry revealed her voice had changed this time, becoming soft and tender, clearly showing she was a girl.
Song Yan snorted coldly, carrying the little beggar further away, saying as he walked, "Today, even if you scream your lungs out, no one will come to save you."
The lead little beggar hurriedly followed, anxiously saying, "Hey! Li, what are you going to do?"
Song Yan said, "I'm taking her to eat wontons and change her into something warmer. Are you coming?"
The lead little beggar was stunned.
Shuang Yun smiled, and upon seeing the little beggar looking at her, she nodded slightly.
The little beggars immediately followed Song Yan forward.
They left the filthy alley, walked into the dusk sunlight, yet felt a bit fearful and timid, like field mice stepping onto the street.
But soon, they weren't field mice anymore.
They had new clothes.
Although they were cheap second-hand goods, they looked clean and warm.
The group of seven sat under a sign that read "Fish Soup Wontons," and began to eat.
The little beggars devoured the food ravenously, and after eating their fill, they looked at Song Yan, their gazes filled with brightness and gratitude.
Song Yan felt that even if he asked these little beggars to do something particularly dangerous at this moment, they would not hesitate. Not only would they not refuse, but they would also pat their chests and say they could definitely do it. Even if it meant death, these children would surely strive to accomplish the task for him before dying!
They were destitute, but all they had left was their dignity and loyalty.
He liked these children and liked Shuang Yun, just as he liked Xiao Jiu and An Li.
As long as he was with these people, he would feel genuinely happy and relaxed.
By the end of the meal, he naturally knew the names of those five little beggars.
The tall beggar who held a piece of tile was named A Huai. He picked the name himself, believing that only by telling others loudly, "My name is A Huai, as in 'bad guy'," would they be a little more fearful and less likely to mess with him.
The little beggar who made faces and stuck out her tongue was named Xiao Huan. Even with a clean face, she wasn't particularly cute—a little girl with a yellowish, emaciated face, but with distinct brows and eyes, indicating she'd be quite pretty if nurtured properly.
Seeing Xiao Huan still licking the wonton bowl desperately, Song Yan said, "Greedy little thing, don't lick it."
"I will lick it."
Xiao Huan muttered.
Shuang Yun laughed.
Song Yan said, "Business hasn't been good at the clinic these days. Come find me at the store entrance tomorrow at this time."
"This..." A Huai wanted to refuse, but he clamped his mouth shut, suddenly knelt down, and said, "Uncle Li, if you can take care of us brothers and sisters, my life will be yours from now on!"
Song Yan naturally didn't want his life, nor did he need him to gather any information. He simply liked these children, that's all.
However, he still nodded lightly.
Only then did A Huai stand up joyously, thanking repeatedly, "Thank you, Uncle Li, thank you, Uncle Li."
...
...
The next day...
"Uncle Li, this...this is way too difficult, isn't it?"
"Didn't you say your life is mine?"
"But...but...ugh..."
In the backyard of Changchun Hall, Song Yan threw a few medical books to the five little beggars, teaching them to read, also instructing them in herbal identification, medical theory, and skills.
Pan Yu was doing business in the front courtyard.
After a few more days...
Changchun Hall had only a sparse number of people coming to buy medicine each day. If Song Yan hadn't taken over the shop, they would have long been unable to pay the rent and forced to close down and leave.
On this day, a group of people suddenly arrived outside, and at the forefront was the Third Madam Qin, who had previously bought medicine from Song Yan. Seeing the poor business at Changchun Hall, she intended to purchase the shop at a low price. After Song Yan refused, she sent Jianghu people to take action.

chapters.title: Chapter 214 214: 141. Can't hide it like this? Idiot! (8.3K words - large chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Ah Huai directly grabbed a knife and blocked the door, saying to Song Yan, "Uncle Li, don't be afraid!"
Xiao Huan quietly slipped out through the back door.
The fight quickly broke out, and Ah Huai defended the door with the fierce energy of a mad dog, surprisingly keeping those third-rate Jianghu people at bay for a moment.
Seeing Ah Huai getting beaten black and blue, covered in bruises, Xiao Huan's figure appeared at the distant alley entrance.
And behind Xiao Huan was a group of beggars.
The beggars rushed forward, and those third-rate Jianghu martial artists, who usually relied on fancy fist techniques and bragging, quickly retreated when outnumbered, then fled.
Several days later...
The servant of Madam Qin San went into a frenzy, killed Madam San, and was then killed himself under the siege of the Qin family warriors.
After an investigation, the government concluded it as a "crime of passion" and did not pursue it further.
Song Yan, the small boss of Changchun Hall, was seen as having "some connection with the lower echelons of Jianghu," but... that's all. In the "pyramid of status" in Chu Imperial City's top tier, dominated by Thousand Crane Sect cultivators, Song Yan was only in the middle-lower tier, and no one paid any attention.
...
...
The battles among cultivators in Chu Imperial City grew ever fiercer.
Initially, the Thousand Crane Sect considered the civilians, but gradually they also ignored them.
Many people in Chu Imperial City began to relocate, fleeing from the city.
Song Yan, calm and collected, used the Qi Observation Pearl to watch the Qi above the Imperial City.
As long as the red cloud didn't leave the city, everything would be fine.
Chu Imperial City, sitting atop a Profound Vein and being the Thousand Crane Sect's millennial foundation, faced with the Fox Wolf siege, could it easily be abandoned?
With the outcome yet to be decided, how could a Thousand Crane Sect elder not rush back, and how could a Crimson Palace cultivator flee?
If anyone were to flee, it might just be Tang Fan.
From this bystander's perspective of the battles, Song Yan also saw many things. Particularly eye-catching was the "Array Dao" of the Thousand Crane Sect.
The Thousand Crane Sect differed from the Nanwu Sword Sect.
The arrays of the Nanwu Sword Sect were mostly "traditional Defense Shields" and Sword Arrays jointly displayed by the disciples of the Sword Sect.
But the Thousand Crane Sect could, to a certain extent, utilize Array Flags to mobilize the "Wood Profound."
Wind belongs to wood, and once the Wood Profound condenses, the speed of the Thousand Crane Sect increases significantly. This is also one reason the Fox and Wolf Races, "waiting in vain for the Purple Mansion not to arrive, dogs jumped over the wall," could not conquer the Thousand Crane Sect.
Song Yan was cultivating the "Ghost Infant Scripture," a cultivation technique whose power could increase by one or two levels in the Evil Land, so he was quite interested in arrays that "mobilized special Profound Qi," because if he could change his combat environment to the Evil Land, it would give him an extra one or two points of advantage against his enemies.
Besides, he was still filled with deep longing for the ancient teleportation array at the extreme south of the Three Kingdoms, wondering if with a greater understanding of Array Dao, he might one day visit that ancient teleportation array again?
Various thoughts flashed through, and Song Yan came to his senses.
It had been over half a year since he adopted the five children.
At this moment, he was leading these five children to the government to handle household registration.
Household registration in Chu Imperial City used to be extremely difficult to obtain, but with so many people fleeing, the government, perhaps prompted by some influential yet reckless decision, issued a strict order: Anyone leaving the Imperial City would have their registration canceled and would not be allowed to return, while those who stayed and had some economic foundation and a stable residence could apply for registration.
So, Song Yan brought the five children to register.
Though it was the lowest class of registration, after Song Yan slipped a little silver, it was still a good registration.
After completing the registration, he took the five children to the wonton shop to celebrate.
Business at the Red Fragrance Tower wasn't good, and even when there were customers, they only went for the courtesan, not for Shuang Yun's business. Shuang Yun, being idle, was looking down from the second floor, and upon seeing Song Yan and Ah Huai walking by, she waved. Learning that "the five beggar children had obtained registration," she was very happy and ran down to join them for wontons.
More than half a year later, the seven of them sat together again in front of the wonton shop.
Ah Huai had changed a lot, with a steadier look in his eyes, which Song Yan often joked was like that of a "Jianghu big shot." Indeed, Ah Huai was heading in that direction, getting up before the rooster crowed to practice his knife skills a thousand times, then going to work, cleaning Changchun Hall spotless, and helping his younger siblings entertain guests. Under his busy efforts, Changchun Hall was actually developing for the better.
In addition, he secretly gathered the scattered beggars around the Imperial City, giving small benefits and gathering many beggars. Being bold and righteous, he had already been nicknamed "Brother Huai" outside in just half a year's time.
Ah Huai and his four siblings wanted to recognize Song Yan as their father, but were repeatedly refused. He had since stopped mentioning it, but silently regarded the benefactor as family. He thought that when this family member grew old, he would take care of him well.
"Uncle Li, take your time eating." Ah Huai handed over a bowl to Song Yan, then prepared his chopsticks, and went to help his siblings with wontons.
Shuang Yun smiled prettily, looked at Song Yan, took a deep breath, feeling a bit inexplicably nervous, and joked in a seemingly relaxed manner, "Doctor Li, with five little burdens, aren't you planning to marry?"
Song Yan also smiled but didn't answer because he had already seen deep expectation, intense inferiority, and a certain fear in the eyes of this young woman.
How should he answer?
And today, although Shuang Yun seemed ordinary, she was dressed with great care. The fragrance she exuded was neither gaudy nor cheap, a refreshing scent of white plum.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 215: 141. Can't hide it like this? Idiot! (8.3K words - large chapter, please subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
He seems to have said something like "Bai Mei smells nice" at some point.
On the other side, Shuang Yun thought for a moment and then said: "I've saved enough money already, a lot of money! Once I redeem myself from my grandma's place, I'll..."
She bit her lip, suddenly mustered up courage and said: "This city is already chaotic now, how about we... leave together and go to a small town, where you don't need much money to live nicely.
