These cultivators and demons are too terrifying, too terrifying. In their eyes, we're just like ants; if we die, it would be for nothing. The government can't control it, Jianghu can't control it, no one can control it! I... we..."
Before finishing her sentence, she suddenly stopped speaking.
It wasn't that she suddenly lost her courage.
The words had already left her mouth, they should be completed all at once.
However, an even louder, more frightening voice suppressed her voice, everyone's voices, even the entire Imperial City's commotion.
It was a wolf howl.
A wolf howl so intense that it made the blood nearly boil.
Accompanied by a deep fear.
Fear is contagious, in such a densely populated place like the Chu Imperial City, it's like a spark falling into an oil pot, erupting fiercely and turning into an ocean of fear in an instant.
In the sea of fear, a gigantic demon shadow rose from the ground, one, over ten, several tens, nearly a hundred zhang tall, connecting to the heavens, and its demonic claws spreading out to cover the sky.
Song Yan turned his head to look.
It's in the direction of the Thousand Crane Sect!
The fox wolves finally couldn't wait any longer!
They only know a human race cultivator at the Purple Mansion Realm is coming. But his delayed appearance probably gave the fox wolves a wrong prediction, which is: has he escaped? Has he not come at all? If not, why hasn't he shown up? Clearly, there isn't much time left until the Soul Threshold is opened, why hasn't he appeared?
In fact, the fox wolves here are somewhat different from the ancient generals of the Three Kingdoms; at least, the wolf demon never used its sound wave attack.
At this moment, it's directly used as a trump card.
And using it had an extraordinary effect!
Fear was greatly stimulated, and Long Bo's blood was operated to the extreme, thus creating a more terrifying demon shadow.
The wonton shop owner was already scared stiff.
Shuang Yun held his arm tightly in fear, her body trembling uncontrollably.
Among the little ones, except for Ah Huai, the other four were already frozen like wooden figures, motionless, just looking at the sky with fear.
"Ah!!!"
The screams from somewhere added fuel to the fearful atmosphere.
Song Yan also stood motionless.
But he was staring fixedly above.
There's actually nearly a year left before the time he set for himself.
Yet he always felt that maybe today he could capture Tang Fan.
The sky rang like a Thunder God drunk, beating drums randomly, continually producing ear-splitting big noises.
Profound artifacts' rainbow lights densely intertwined, crisscrossing like sudden rain, forming a brocade pattern.
The sunlight scattered, dark clouds like mist, in the gray, cold wind, the figures of the little fox cubs appeared from the market, then rushed toward the Thousand Crane Sect direction from all directions, either running upright or with four limbs.
The fighting probably lasted for a stick of incense's time, suddenly the sky brightened, wild explosions like breaking winter thunder.
In front of the hundred zhang fox demon shadow, unexpectedly appeared a golden armored divine figure dozens of zhang tall.
With the appearance of the golden armored divine figure, people's fear also began to dissipate.
The Thousand Crane Sect resounded with excited shouts.
"Old Ancestral Guardian!"
"Crane Ancestor!"
"Crane Ancestor has come out!"
"The old ancestor isn't dead after all!"
In the midst of the loud, ecstatic voices, the golden armored divine figure suddenly swung a sword, this sword directly slashed across the fox demon shadow, causing its figure to shrink abruptly.
This moment seemed to cut off the chains of fear in everyone's hearts.
The entire Imperial City was invigorated!
Song Yan felt Shuang Yun clinging to his arm "thaw," looking at the sky as if she survived a disaster, her eyes burning.
While the wonton shop owner on one side, along with the other customers eating wontons, suddenly fell to their knees, looking upward, praying continually, whispering things like "bless, bless, the divine appeared."
Shuang Yun was also moved to tears, rose to kneel, and when she saw Song Yan not kneeling, she gave him a surprised look, then respectfully gazed at the golden armored divine figure in the sky.
Ah Huai quickly said: "Uncle Li, don't offend the divine."
Song Yan scratched his head.
He understood what those two said.
Good intentions or bad intentions, he also understood.
The concern in the words, anyone not deaf can hear it.
But, why should he kneel?
He sighed deeply, rose with hands behind his back, and ascended from the most ordinary wonton shop like a pillar of light, cursing as he went: "Tang Fan, you damn brat, can't you hide? Why act all divine in front of people, ay... there's still a year to go! I haven't lived enough yet!"
Although he was cursing, his movements weren't slow, with just a showing, hundreds of figures emerged around, each releasing the terrifying aura of the Late Stage Of Crimson Palace.
The next instant, they rushed toward Thousand Crane Sect like a world-ending meteor swarm, carrying power more terrifying than fox demon shadow and golden armored divine figure combined countless times over.
Time seemed frozen, the entire Chu Imperial City, and Thousand Crane Sect, both frozen.
A moment ago, it was an all-powerful golden armored divine figure like a saint descending, instantly shattered by a blast, smoke and dust scattered, the original place of the golden armored divine figure suddenly transformed into two people.
An ordinary looking man, with an unhappy expression, hanging his hands.
And in his hand was a golden armored boy tightly bound by ropes.
The boy's face was dull, suspended in disbelief in mid-air.
And far away, the fox demon and wolf demon finally reacted, stepping forward.
Leading fox demon respectfully said: "Thank you, Old Ancestral Guardian, for saving our lives!"
Song Yan snorted through his nose "hm," then glared nastily at the golden armored boy he was holding, sighed, and cursed: "You foolish thing!"

chapters.title: Chapter 216 216: 142. Solitary Distant Shadow, Array Dao True Understanding (8.1K words - Two-in-One Subscription Request)
chapters.content:
Shuashuashua!
The Golden Armor youth was lifted in mid-air, and after a brief moment of daze, he finally reacted. He struggled slightly, realizing he had lost all strength, and then recalled the phrase he had just heard, "you stupid thing." Suddenly, his whole body shivered, and he instinctively turned his head to look at the suddenly appearing Ancestor of the Demon Race.
Song Yan wiped his face, and the plain face of Doctor Li disappeared instantly, replaced by a face with sword wounds crisscrossed. At this moment, he was Zhang Han. Zhang Han didn't know the Fox Demon Illusion Technique, so he simply used some pharmacological knowledge to slightly repair his face, and that was all.
"Senior... heh... heh..."
The Golden Armor youth grinned cheekily and asked, "Where did you come from? How did you appear so suddenly?"
"What a brat who knows how to cozy up." Song Yan also somewhat understood how this kid managed to hide for so long. Not to mention that transforming into the Golden Armor Divine Man could directly resist the Secret Technique of Dragon Bo Fox, but having such a good mindset was really a shameless thing.
He slapped the kid on the forehead and said, "Pretending to be Crane Ancestor wanting to repel the Fox and Wolf Races, using the Thousand Crane Sect to buy time for you. Ha, was it fun, Ancestor Tang?"
The Golden Armor youth was stunned, and the once cheeky smile on his face showed some deep fear, secretly thinking: 'This old monster is terrifying, how did he see through it?'
This thought flashed and disappeared. Tang Fan hurriedly shrunk his head and said, "Little Tang, Ancestor just call me Little Tang. If Little Tang doesn't sound good, calling me Fanzi is fine too. Ah yeah, my grandfather used to love calling me Fanzi."
Song Yan looked at him strangely and asked, "Are you a Demon Cultivator?"
Tang Fan chuckled and said, "I'm just a smooth talker."
Then, he quickly added, "However, I don't talk like this to everyone. The senior seems amiable, so I talked like this."
Song Yan suddenly shook the rope.
Tang Fan only felt a complete loss of strength, his body seemed to fall apart, and he couldn't speak anymore. He blacked out and actually fainted.
Song Yan glanced at the Fox Wolf in front of him, raised his hand, took out a Passage Order engraved with a fox head from the Storage Bag, and shook it. This was the "Southern Land Passage Order to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country" given by Baby Crying Lord.
The Fox Wolf opposite saw this Token and had no doubts left.
Though not an ancestor of their race, he was truly a strong Purple Mansion expert.
The Wolf Demon licked its lips, looking at the Thousand Crane Sect behind Song Yan with drool at the corner of its mouth, eyes showing a vicious light, seeming to be prepared to massacre the sect and feast today.
The faces of the cultivators from the Thousand Crane Sect changed drastically.
They couldn't hold off even the two demon races of Fox and Wolf, let alone plus an unimaginable ancient Purple Mansion monster emerging here, there was no need to fight at all.
The two gray-haired Elders at the forefront just stood firmly, eyes glaring angrily, as if already determined to die.
The Fox Demon had reverted to its original form, saluting Song Yan once again.
Song Yan said blandly, "Aunt Fourteen, I've long heard of your great name."
As a Purple Mansion expert living in Chu Imperial City for over a year and a half, how could he not have heard the name "Aunt Fourteen"?
This Aunt Fourteen, just like Fox Granny and Red Granny, was a respectful term.
The Fox Demon was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly said, "My name is Hu Shisi. It's just these little cubs who randomly called me that, so they called me Aunt Fourteen. Ancestor can just call me Shisi, adding the word 'aunt' is really too flattering."
At this time, the Fox Demon's right claw was still covering its shoulder.
That snow-white fur had already a tuft dyed red, blood spreading outward like a flower blooming on the shoulder.
Hu Shisi also said, "I almost got killed by this little thief today, thankful for Ancestor's action, that's why I survived. Fourteen will remember this life-saving grace."
After saying this, it glanced over the back of the Thousand Crane Sect and asked, "How does Ancestor intend to handle this?"
Song Yan asked, "How do you want to handle it?"
The Wolf Demon roared viciously, "Of course... eat them all!!"
Song Yan said, "I'm not interested. I came here just to catch someone, and it's still early. After catching the person, I even plan to wander around Chu Kingdom."
The Wolf Demon was stunned, its ferocity slowly fading.
Hu Shisi was injured, and forcing the usage of Dragon Bo also greatly reduced the power. Moreover, there were several solid Middle Stage Crimson Palace experts in the Thousand Crane Sect, much less it was their territory, who knew what trump cards they might have. Without the action of the Purple Mansion monster, how could they fight?
And the sentence "not interested" already indicated the attitude of this Purple Mansion monster.
No one could ignore the attitude of the ancient monster.
Suddenly, Hu Shisi signaled the Wolf Demon with her eyes.
The Wolf Demon, who was just excitedly prepared, unexpectedly sighed, then retreated.
Hu Shisi hovered over the Thousand Crane Sect, coldly saying, "Ancestor is of your same race and reluctant to harm you. Therefore, giving Ancestor face today, sparing your lives, allowing the Thousand Crane Sect to extend its lineage!
But from now on, Chu Land is also a vassal to our Fox and Wolf Races, and yearly tributes must not be lacking, or next time... you won't be so fortunate!"
The two gray-haired Elders couldn't even speak their angry words, and a middle-aged man in a Crane Feather Robe suddenly stepped out from behind, cupped his hands towards the sky, and said, "Thousand Crane Sect understands, we will definitely follow Upper Envoy's instructions."
Then, once more, cupped his hands towards Song Yan and said, "Thank you, Ancestor!"
Hu Shisi looked at Song Yan again and said, "I do not know if Ancestor has anything else to instruct Fourteen to do?"
Song Yan looked deeply at this Fox Demon, intentionally softening his voice and said, "Take care to heal."
Hu Shisi said, "Ancestor also take care."
After saying so, she added, "Some humans are not in our eyes. Whoever Ancestor wishes to protect, let it be so. When words are spoken, it's equivalent to an imperial decree in the vassal states of the Fox and Wolf Races.
This little matter cannot cause any rift between us.
I got information from the Upper Person and know some of Ancestor's background, fearing Ancestor might misunderstand, so... I specifically clarify here."

chapters.title: Chapter 217 217: 142. Solitary Empty Distant Shadow, Array Dao True Understanding (8.1K words - Two-in-One Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Song Yan smiled and nodded.
Hu Shisi and the Wolf Demon saluted again.
The Wolf Demon raised its head and let out a howl, and the fox cubs attacking the Thousand Crane Sect from all sides retreated as if the tides had ebbed.
And all of this was caused by just one sentence from Song Yan: "Not interested."
As someone at the Purple Mansion Realm, his status had already reached a very high point.
Even if he frowned slightly, people below him would consider his mood and avoid offending him.
However, Song Yan did not feel proud, he only thought: The higher you stand, the harder you fall, and it's lonely at the top.
At this moment, he squinted his eyes and watched the Fox and Wolf retreat, then grabbed the fainting Tang Fan and landed at a scenic pavilion on the mountain.
Even though he was in the Purple Mansion Realm, he couldn't easily delve into other's territories.
And soon, several figures flew from a distance, bowing to him from afar.
Leading them was a middle-aged man in a Crane Feather Robe.
"Sikong Le, Sect Leader of the Thousand Crane Sect, pays respects to the Ancestor."
Song Yan's gaze swept over the Sect Leader of the Thousand Crane Sect, his expression slightly moved, and he said, "Your sect's Array Dao inheritance is impressive. May I have a look?"
Sikong Le was stunned, then hurriedly said, "Yes, of course!"
After that, he glared fiercely at the fainted Tang Fan on the ground, and said coldly, "This little thief dared to impersonate the Crane Ancestor of our sect, which is truly despicable! Fortunately, the Ancestor intervened, or we would all be left in the dark."
Song Yan waved his hand and said, "Enough with the hollow words. Go get the inheritance and find someone reliable to come here every day to await my message."
Sikong Le immediately stopped insulting Tang Fan and respectfully said, "Yes!"
Song Yan glanced at him and said indifferently, "You are already a Sect Leader, so don't do anything foolish to force me to take action.
To extend the legacy, there is hope for the future. Do not be shortsighted and fail to endure, sacrificing the greater for the lesser.
The path of cultivation, the continuation of the legacy, surpasses governing a country, and is never smooth sailing. Do not... strive for immediate results."
Sikong Le bowed deeply again and said, "Ancestor, Sikong has been taught. Rest assured, I will not do those foolish things."
Then, he turned to look at the elders behind him and said coldly, "If any of you dare to do so, you will be traitors to the Thousand Crane Sect, and I vow to kill you!"
Since the Fox and Wolf Races invaded, Sikong Le had long foreseen the outcome.
But not the outcome of this battle, rather the fate of the sect.
Even if Tang Fan impersonating the Crane Ancestor won a battle today, what could it change? It would only deepen the hatred of the Fox and Wolf towards the Thousand Crane Sect, and when a true Demon Race Purple Mansion appears, the Thousand Crane Sect would be annihilated without a trace.
Now, having such a Human Race Purple Mansion entity show up and save the Thousand Crane Sect was already a great fortune, an outcome far better than he could have imagined.
So how could he allow anyone to change this outcome?
...
...
A little over half a month later...
In the deep mountains of early summer, the cicadas sang like urgent rain, noisily unending, and when the real mountain rain poured down from the sky, it was silent, leaving only the quiet, meditative sound of the mountain rain.
Song Yan finished his work and should have hurried to report in.
But he stubbornly wanted to find some opportunity in the Chu Kingdom, and who could blame him?
Even the Infant Crying Senior only praised him after hearing of his success and reminded him not to be late.
And so he stayed.
With the mindset of "finding opportunities wherever you go," at this moment, he sat quietly in an ancient mountain pavilion, holding a volume titled "Array Dao True Understanding," reading patiently, waiting patiently.
The Array Dao inheritance of the Nanwu Sword Sect was in the hands of Yu Xuanwei, and he did not obtain it.
The Mechanical Peak of the Puppet Sect didn't really have much of an inheritance, only some superficial knowledge, and a set of "Absolute Profound Array." There were also basic formations with wind-blocking and stabilizing functions, the foundational knowledge for designing Shadow Puppet vehicles together with shadow puppets.
But the Thousand Crane Sect truly had an Array Dao inheritance.
This inheritance was now in Song Yan's hands.
On the other side, Tang Fan had long since awakened, and his hands had broken free from the Blood-Binding Rope, but his power had fallen to the Refining Profound Realm, unable to use the Crimson Palace Realm's power at all.
The Blood-Binding Rope could make a Crimson Palace master's blood freeze completely, and to untie this rope, one would need at least the power of the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace.
Without external help, Tang Fan was destined not to untie it.
But this kid did not resign himself to fate and attempted to escape every now and then.
He knew that the Purple Mansion elder had no intention of killing him.
And today, just as he made a move, Song Yan understood his intention.
"Little Tang, do you want to have lunch before escaping? The meals the Thousand Crane Sect sends daily are quite good."
"Ha... haha..." Tang Fan forced a laugh and gave a thumbs up, "That's why you're the senior, none of my thoughts can escape your eyes."
While flipping through the Array Dao book, Song Yan said lightly, "Your Golden Armor Divine Technique, what is it? I want to take you as my master to learn a thing or two."
Tang Fan: ...
In that moment, he understood.
Before him sat an elder with a skin thickness no less than his own.
Escaping from such an elder's grasp was a nightmare difficulty.
He forced a smile and said, "How could I let you become my disciple."
Song Yan said, "There is precedence in learning, and specialization in skills, that's all there is to it, so why can't I?"
Tang Fan felt that the elder was quite right.
This rank was truly a bit higher than his, even shamelessness was so straightforward and upright, upon deeper thought it actually held some philosophy.
Song Yan continued, "Going to the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, the mountains are high and the roads are long, the future uncertain.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 218: 142. Solitary Empty Distant Shadow, Array Dao True Understanding (8.1K words - Two-in-One Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
If something happens to you, this secret technique will be lost.
Pass it on to me, at least I'm from the human race, and perhaps I can kill more demons for you afterward to avenge you."
Tang Fan sighed deeply and said with a bitter smile, "It's not that I don't want to tell you, but because it's a one-time bead, containing a mysterious power, seemingly left by ancient cultivators. You should understand, elder, ancient cultivators always have some very peculiar things."
"Oh."
Song Yan responded but didn't ask further.
This kid is too slick; his storage bag only contains some basic profound crystals and profound artifacts, none of that 'golden armor divine person's' power from that day.
And this power is not some kind of Crimson Palace blood; it seems more like a strange secret technique.
As for a one-time bead?
Do you take me for a three-year-old child?
He has a hunch that Tang Fan has been able to hide for so long under the pursuit of the Fox and Wolf Races because of this mysterious secret technique.
In recent days, he asked Sikong Le.
Sikong Le also didn't know about Tang Fan's secret technique, only saying that this young man lived under a hidden identity in the sect, normally just a talented disciple, never expecting him to stand out at such a crucial moment.
As for the blood in Tang Fan's body, coveted by Master Yingti, it was a kind of 'Mountain-moving Ape' Crimson Palace demon blood.
This 'Mountain-moving Ape' is not the blood of any demon from the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, but an extremely rare demon blood.
Tang Fan being discovered was quite amusing.
This brat, after making a breakthrough in his cultivation, felt so delighted that he roared to the sky, which happened to be overheard and recorded by the Inspection Envoy sent by the Fox and Wolf Races.
The ape's roar was so loud, accompanied by the rumble of a collapsing mountain.
It quickly attracted the attention of the Fox Demon clan, who sent people to investigate and discovered a hair over ten feet long deep in the mountains. After bringing it back for examination, it was confirmed to be 'Mountain-moving Ape.'
And 'Mountain-moving Ape' is prized for extracting an evil treasure from the 'Changwang Soul Threshold' and is excellent demon blood, not as good as Changwang Hu but decent.
Of course, from his conversation with Yingti, Song Yan learned that the 'Changwang Soul Threshold' is quite significant; the demons' search for 'suitable blood candidates' isn't limited to just him and Tang Fan; there are many more.
And that's precisely why this long and challenging task was passed onto him.
Since the discovery of the 'Mountain-moving Ape' bloodline, a complex series of events led to the name 'Tang Fan' finally catching the attention of the Fox and Wolf Races.
The two were having an on-and-off conversation when suddenly a white-robed figure approached from afar, gracefully landing outside the pavilion. It was a charming and dignified female cultivator.
This female cultivator was Fang Qingmeng, the "dream partner" of almost all the unmarried cultivators of the younger generation in the Thousand Crane Sect.
As someone seated under the command of the Purple Mansion elder, Sikong Le didn't dare to act rashly and sent Fang Qingmeng over.
Not only because of Fang Qingmeng's good looks and her early-stage Crimson Palace Realm, but also because she had a previous 'record.'
Fang Qingmeng, an ordinary outer disciple of the Thousand Crane Sect, caught the attention of the Crane Ancestor during an encounter, received guidance on cultivation techniques, and was admitted into the inner sect. She did not disappoint the Crane Ancestor's trust and indeed advanced all the way, successfully breaking through the Crimson Palace Realm to become the youngest elder in the sect.
Sweet-talking and adept at pleasing the elders, along with a good mind and power, she was naturally the best choice.
In everyone's eyes, Song Yan was naturally considered a centuries-old monster; no one could know his actual age was just 39.
At this age, in the cultivation realm, let alone being called an ancestor, even encountering Fang Qingmeng would require calling her Aunt Fang.
Yet...
At this moment, the female cultivator, who ought to be called Aunt, was pretending to be a little girl, using a lively girl's tone to sweetly call out, "Grandpa Zhang, I've come to find you again!"
Song Yan looked at this old 'aunt', using a grandfather's doting tone to his granddaughter, said, "What brings little Qingmeng here again?"
Fang Qingmeng said, "Someone is looking for Grandpa at the mountain gate, saying it's from the Changchun Hall..."
She didn't elaborate, just adding, "A woman and five children. Because they mentioned Grandpa, I didn't dare to handle it on my own and let them rest first."
Song Yan was silent for a moment, not responding.
Fang Qingmeng had ample patience to wait.
After a long while, Song Yan suddenly said, "I heard from Sikong Le that your Thousand Crane Sect plans to establish a branch sect moving south?"
Fang Qingmeng sighed gently and said, "Yes, we have no choice. The Demon Race is like a sword hanging in the north. We small sects can't afford to provoke them, so we plan to hide. If one day disaster strikes, we can at least leave some elite lineage and not sever the heritage."
Song Yan laughed and said, "Such a secret, yet you tell me directly?"
Fang Qingmeng giggled and said, "Isn't it because it's Grandpa Zhang?"
While they were talking, a violent vomiting sound came from the side.
Tang Fan, teasingly laughing, said, "Fairy Fang, you always act so aloof in the sect. Why are you so demure now?"
However, neither Fang Qingmeng nor Song Yan looked at him, completely ignoring his retching.
Song Yan gazed deeply at Fang Qingmeng, suddenly saying, "That woman, a girl, and four boys, I don't recognize.
But your southern relocation plan is pretty good, do it quickly.
I'll only stay here until next summer at most, there's not much time left."
Fang Qingmeng's pupils narrowed slightly, nodding, "Understood, Grandpa. The sect's southward migration plan indeed needs to be expedited. I'll take care of it right away."
With that, she retreated.
Tang Fan remained stunned for a long time, looking at Song Yan, saying, "So, the elder is a good person.
You clearly know those six people but pretended not to recognize them to avoid involving them.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 219: 142. Solitary Distant Shadow, Array Dao True Understanding (8.1K Words - Two-in-One Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Yet, it gave Fairy Fang a hint, allowing her to lead them southward together, and even... welcome them into the sect.
Just six mere mortals, mortals who could die with just a breath, and the elder... still cares?"
"Arrogant." Song Yan responded indifferently.
Logically speaking, Tang Fan ought to have proved himself as a good person by now.
But Song Yan had long surpassed the phase of recognizing people through words.
Tang Fan's every move was merely for self-preservation, as for his true character, true intentions, or hidden secrets, Song Yan neither knew nor could know.
Knowing a person's face doesn't mean knowing their heart.
There are times when he doesn't even know what he's thinking, how could he possibly try to judge others as good or bad?
Song Yan was sure of only one thing: If he showed any flaw now, the boy before him wouldn't hesitate to take advantage of him while he's down, even though this boy couldn't achieve it.
After he explained the matters of Shuang Yun, A Huai, and A Huan, he continued to browse through the "Array Dao True Understanding."
This "Array Dao True Understanding" not only explained the heritage knowledge of arrays and the making of array plates and array flags, but it also described an exceptional array—— "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array."
The so-called "Five Elements Gathering Profound" focuses on gathering special Profound Qi, which was several times more advanced than the simple "Gathering Profound Array."
Yet which type of Profound Qi the "Five Elements Gathering Profound" accumulates depends on the Crystal Jade at the core of the array plate.
This kind of Crystal Jade is extremely special and is named—— White Cave Crystal Jade.
What is White Cave Crystal Jade?
A piece of Crystal Jade originally "filled with some special Profound Qi" that revealed a white hole in the center due to some unknown reason.
This hollowness gives it a strong attraction toward "the corresponding special Profound Qi." When placed in the core of the array plate, it causes the plate to leverage its "recognizability" and expand its "attraction," thereby starting to gather the corresponding special Profound Qi. However, in the array plate, a layer of isolation cover is formed on the surface of the White Cave Crystal Jade, allowing the special Profound Qi to be attracted but not enter the White Cave Crystal Jade, thus continuously pulling in.
This White Cave Crystal Jade is extremely rare, it might appear during periods of "earth energy eruption." If no one timely detects and retrieves it, this White Cave Crystal Jade would fill up due to its attraction and lose its function.
Yet, places of "earth energy eruption" are highly dangerous, hence this kind of Crystal Jade is truly scarce.
Thousand Crane Sect possesses a piece of "Wood Profound White Cave Crystal Jade," allowing it to activate the "Wood Element Gathering Profound Array."
Song Yan slowly studied and pondered.
By evening, he looked up to find Tang Fan, who had been opposite him, had run off again. He released his divine sense slightly and swiftly retrieved the boy within a few leaps.
Tang Fan could only smile helplessly and then obediently leaned back against the pavilion post, his eyes darting around, clearly planning his next escape.
Why continue running, knowing there's no escape?
This question, Song Yan didn't bother to ask.
It's just a "blatant distraction" trick.
Tang Fan thought that after running several times, he would get accustomed, and on one of those occasions, when he truly adapted, Tang Fan would use his trump card without hesitation and truly escape.
This trump card might be some sort of secret technique of his, or maybe... someone outside awaiting.
In any case, the possibility of escape seemed considerable to Tang Fan.
Otherwise, he's not foolish; if there's no hope, no goal, why bother making such a fuss?
Thinking of this, Song Yan took a closer look at Tang Fan and found the youngster quite handsome.
Could it be... some woman waiting for him?
Fang Qingmeng?
It's unlikely.
The Thousand Crane Sect's Sect Leader wouldn't be foolish to such an extent.
But what if the Thousand Crane Sect's Sect Leader was unaware?
Song Yan squinted, recalling Tang Fan's recent "vomiting sound," believing more firmly in his conjecture.
At this thought, he felt speechless, wanting to flip the boy over and give him a solid beating.
You howled skyward and attracted the Fox and Wolf Races.
You emerged in your golden armor, showed off publicly, which attracted me.
And now you use this idle vomiting sound, drawing my attention to your relationship with Fang Qingmeng.
You truly... have no memory at all.
Currently, Song Yan only hoped this pair or individuals wouldn't go too far and genuinely infuriate him, otherwise... he would let Tang Fan know what a Ghost Cultivator truly is.
As for Tang Fan, he had long been secretly imbued with a tracking aura by Song Yan.
This is a small secret technique of the Puppet Sect, also taught by Gu Huangzi. Learning it posed no challenge.
However, deployed by him now, it's many times stronger than Gu Huangzi's previous use when dealing with Tang Fan; as long as Tang Fan's Divine Soul Power isn't strong enough, he won't be able to detect it.
As there's still time, he's quite intrigued by Tang Fan's secrets, so... he doesn't mind a little attempt at "letting the tiger return to the mountain."
Qi Observation Pearl, tracking aura, Purple Mansion power, all gave him the confidence to proceed.
He truly needed to "replenish his trump cards."
Tang Fan's time is limited, and his time... is also limited.
...
...
The sunset like blood.
The mountains deeply enveloped in dusk.
The overlapping shadows of Cuiwei Mountain spread out layer upon layer.
Shuang Yun, desperately waiting on the stone steps of Thousand Crane Sect, finally received a response.
A beam of rainbow light fell before her and the five children.
The aloof fairy in white revealed herself, looking at the six people waiting in bow on the stone steps, and said lightly: "There is no Changchun Hall Doctor Li here."
Shuang Yun bit her lip, knowing Doctor Li was definitely here. That day... everyone saw where Doctor Li landed, how could he not be here?
The only explanation is that the one she knew as Doctor Li is no longer here, only that mysterious and terrifying cultivator remains.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 220: 142. Solitary Empty Distant Shadow, Array Dao True Understanding (8.1K Words - Two-in-One Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Ah Huai reacted quickly. Seeing Shuang Yun's silence and the atmosphere turning cold, he hurriedly stepped forward and bowed respectfully, repeatedly saying, "Thank you, thank you, we made a mistake, thank you very much."
Fang Qingmeng suddenly said, "About half a month later, our Thousand Crane Sect will head south. The six of you should get ready and come with us, and then stay at our Thousand Crane Sect.
First, we'll test your Profound Roots. Those with Profound Roots can enter my sect and become my disciples.
Those without, become stewards."
"Ah?"
Even with Ah Huai's steady temperament, he was shocked and opened his mouth wide with disbelief, almost unable to believe his ears.
The Thousand Crane Sect, what a colossal entity it was up high!
A steward of the Thousand Crane Sect was so prestigious outside; he not only imagined it but had seen it with his own eyes.
That was simply... like an emperor touring.
But now, he might become a disciple of the Thousand Crane Sect, and even if not, at worst, a steward of the Thousand Crane Sect.
This...
Not only Ah Huai, but Shuang Yun, Xiao Huan, and others were all stunned, as if in a dream, turning into wooden people for a while, with their minds buzzing.
Fang Qingmeng smiled faintly and said, "I'm at least a Crimson Palace cultivator, just so insufficient, would you be unwilling even if I want to take those among you with aptitude as my disciples?"
Ah Huai, Xiao Huan, Shuang Yun, and the others hurriedly tried to kneel.
Fang Qingmeng did not accept their kneeling, lifting a hand slightly, the ground seemed to have a refreshing spring breeze lifting the six of them up.
Then, Fang Qingmeng tossed out six small Jade Tokens, saying, "Get ready in the next few days and come to the sect in advance. Don't miss the time."
With that, this white-clothed fairy turned and elegantly left.
In the distance, a faint voice floated in the wind.
"Just call me Qingmeng Zhenren. If bullied, report my name, and I'll... back you up."
...
...
Half a month later.
The cicadas' chirping grew more urgent.
The blazing sunlight penetrated the forest shade.
A massive Yellow-skinned Gourd was surrounded by strands of Profound Qi, with a three-story pavilion standing on it, floating on the long wind like a boat riding the waves.
A gust of wind blew, and the Yellow-skinned Gourd pushed through the sea of clouds, heading south.
On the gourd were many Thousand Crane Sect cultivators, along with Shuang Yun, Ah Huai, and others...
However, Ah Huai is no longer called Ah Huai now. How could one who joined the Thousand Crane Sect not have a surname?
He is now called Li Huai.
The rest of the children who were beggars also took the surname Li.
On a lonely cliff, Song Yan watched the Yellow-skinned Gourd disappear into the distance, his Divine Sense heedlessly sweeping over everyone on the gourd, watching Shuang Yun, Ah Huai, and Xiao Huan leave...
He had long known his karmic ties were too great, that even a little involvement would cause mortals to perish miserably, their souls scattered.
So, he could never again sit at a table with those children eating wontons; Ah Huai could no longer bring a hot bowl to him, concernedly saying, "Uncle Li, eat slowly"; Shuang Yun could no longer look at him with that gaze, eager to confess, afraid of rejection; Xiao Huan could no longer be held in his arms, having her hair ruffled, making funny faces, and saying, 'A quack is also a good person, right'...
Song Yan couldn't imagine the courage those six people mustered to dare to come to the Thousand Crane Sect to seek him.
But the reply they received was that "there is no Dr. Li."
At that moment, what their mood would be like, he couldn't imagine either.
Song Yan withdrew his Divine Sense, sighed softly, shook his head, and then smiled, murmuring to himself: 'Got used to it.'
...
The Yellow-skinned Gourd was large, and each separate room was quite nice.
Xiao Huan was lying in front of a window looking out, happy but with a hint of sorrow hidden within her happiness.
Shuang Yun, Li Huai, and the three other children no longer beggars were also looking at the sea of clouds.
This was a view they had never seen in their entire lives, never even thought they could see.
Xiao Huan in her babyish voice muttered, "It would be nice if Uncle Li were here too."
Li Huai went up, patted the little girl's head, and said, "Uncle Li is always here."
Xiao Huan looked around in surprise, suddenly excitedly shouting, "Uncle Li? Uncle Li?"
She shouted while running, even crawling on the floor to look under the bed, opening the wardrobe to peer inside, but found no trace of Song Yan. Eventually, she stood foolishly in place and suddenly heard footsteps in the corridor outside, so she hurriedly ran, tiptoed to open the door, and nervously called, "Dad?"
But outside the door was empty, naturally with no response.
Xiao Huan's face flushed red with anger, "Liar! Bad brother lies, Aunt Shuang lies, Uncle Li... also lies!"
As she spoke, her eyes reddened, tears falling continuously.
Shuang Yun closed the door, held her in her arms, and comforted her softly.
She already understood that person's thoughts.
Also understood that person's arrangements.
Not only her, but Li Huai also did, and the other children would understand a bit more when they grew up.
But she wondered whether that person would know they already understood?
If they could meet again, she must say "thank you" to him.
...
Song Yan stood for a long time before withdrawing his gaze. Out of the corner of his eye, he noticed that Tang Fan, who was originally sitting on a distant rock, had already disappeared.
This place was not in his original pavilion but elsewhere.
This place was told to him by Fang Qingmeng.
Fang Qingmeng said the Yellow-skinned Gourd would go south from here.
So he brought Tang Fan here and then watched the distance, seemingly immersed in memories, for a moment ignoring the subtle changes in the outside environment.
And then...
Sure enough, Tang Fan was gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 221: 143. Can you bear this cause and effect? (8.1K words - Large chapter, please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Thousand Crane Sect.
A secret realm...
Tang Fan was gasping heavily.
The pressure from that Purple Mansion elder named Zhang Han was immense. Though the escape was brief with no fighting, it felt like the most dangerous situation he'd ever been in, far exceeding the peril when encircled by fox wolves previously.
Fortunately, he succeeded.
Having calmed down, he attempted to remove the rope wrapped around him.
He channeled his Profound Qi at his fingertips, but once it reached the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, he couldn't advance any further.
"Damn it, what is this strange thing? My power from the Six Paths Blood in the Crimson Palace can't even be utilized!"
"But, if my Crimson Palace power is unusable, does it mean I can't untie this rope?"
"Open for me!"
His gaze sharpened, his fingertip's Profound Qi pierced like a sword with a "whoosh" as it sliced across the rope.
Yet, there wasn't even a white mark on the rope.
He continued to channel his energy and strike repeatedly, but the rope showed no damage.
Switching tactics, he tried brute force pulling, but the more he pulled, the tighter the rope bound him.
He suddenly had an idea, attempting to completely retract his Profound Qi, then carefully tried pulling the rope, but... he still couldn't move it.
Tang Fan fell back helplessly, and after waiting for two days and nights, he suddenly sat up and took out a Communication Stone from his bosom, shouting into it.
Moments later, a response came from the other side of the Communication Stone.
...
"Hmm?"
Fang Qingmeng's voice echoed in the Communication Stone, yet she didn't ask "did you succeed" or anything of the sort.
Tang Fan excitedly said, "Sister Meng, I've escaped!
Your plan really worked.
Unexpectedly, that old monster actually has feelings and righteousness, even caring for mortals.
You didn't see how he stood on the isolated cliff, lost in thought... it was when he was distracted, coupled with his usual negligence towards my escape that allowed me this chance.
Hehehe, I said it, even if a divine being came, it wouldn't be able to trap me, Tang Fan!"
"Bragging, again." Fang Qingmeng said helplessly, "That day in front of the old monster, you made retching sounds and said I was cold. I was almost scared to death by you."
Tang Fan proudly replied, "Your name, Fairy Fang, is renowned in Thousand Crane Sect, which disciple doesn't know you're cold? Seeing you like that, expressing my opinions is only natural. How could the old monster be suspicious?"
Before he finished, he hastily added in a fawning tone, "Of course, Sister Meng, your divine insight and discreetly arranging the southern point near this secret realm was masterful.
Now, that old demon searches everywhere for me but fails to find, probably thinking I secretly boarded the yellow-skinned gourd and left.
When he chases there, conducts a thorough search, it will be all for nothing.
I'm already gone without a trace. Hehehe..."
Fang Qingmeng said, "Stop chattering, did you untie the rope?"
Tang Fan said helplessly, "I can't. I've never seen such a strange rope. Once completely bound, powers above Crimson Palace can't be wielded.
However, Crimson Palace Early Stage...
No!
I estimate that the power from the Middle Stage Crimson Palace is needed to help untie this rope.
Sister Meng, do you know any Elder willing to help me untie it?"
There was silence on the other end of the Communication Stone for a long time before Fang Qingmeng's voice came again.
A soft sigh followed by a somewhat helpless tone.
"Don't think about it, all disciples wanting to fight fox wolves, the Elders with me are heading south together, those remaining in Thousand Crane Sect are the old and steady ones putting the overall situation first.
If you dare to run in front of them, they'll immediately capture you and then find Zhang Han, appease him and apologize, then hand you over to Zhang Han."
Tang Fan smiled bitterly, "Doesn't it mean I have to come south to find you to untie the rope?"
Fang Qingmeng contemplated briefly, responded, "Hide for a while, wait until things calm down. I noticed they seem to have a time limit for capturing you. Once past the limit, they won't be as urgent. They can't afford it."
Tang Fan said, "Sister Meng, hiding here is fine, but not seeing you for so long, how can I sleep at night?"
Fang Qingmeng teased impatiently, "Smooth talker! I'm focused on pursuing the Way, who would engage in such emotional games with you."
Tang Fan chuckled, "I'm not like this with every lady; it's because Sister Meng is too..."
His words just ended when the Communication Stone hung up directly.
Tang Fan breathed a sigh, feeling a bit helpless.
Originally he planned to show concern, urging Fang Qingmeng to be careful when heading south.
Great Chu's political center, the Sect is in the north, but the south isn't devoid of Profound barren lands, otherwise unable for the southern migration.
Having spent early years in the south, he vaguely knew... the south also had some cultivator sects, but they were vastly different from Thousand Crane Sect, malicious and high-handed, resorting to any means for power.
Thinking again, Fang Qingmeng's team had Thousand Crane Sect's two most senior Elders, both Middle Stage Crimson Palace, how could such a lineup fear some small southern sects?
At this moment, Tang Fan looked down at the rope on him, sighed helplessly.
The path of cultivation must not be slack; waiting for years would be a significant loss.
As he was thinking, something caught the corner of his eye, his body stiffened abruptly, pupils gradually contracted. Upon confirming afar the secret realm entrance where a heavily scarred Profound Robe man's figure appeared, his eyes seemed ready to pop out, showing an extreme disbelief.
Wasn't that Profound Robe man Song Yan?

chapters.title: Chapter 222 222: 143. Can you bear this cause and effect? (8.1K words - Large chapter, please subscribe) _2
chapters.content:
Tang Fan felt his heart almost stop.
At this moment, he just froze there, his mind and body plunged into extreme fear. Yet, his nature still forced him to squeeze out a smile uglier than crying.
"Senior, I... I... hahaha... I..."
Bang!
Tang Fan suddenly clapped his hands, praised enthusiastically, "You found me again! No wonder you're the senior, impressive. I was just wondering why you hadn't found me yet. Hehehe..."
Song Yan looked at the boy and sighed.
He had thought Tang Fan might have a way to undo this "Blood-Binding Rope."
Turns out, that's it?
As for the Secret Realm...
For a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator, the Secret Realm could no longer be hidden.
Not only that, by standing at the entrance of the Secret Realm, he could use his powerful mind to even listen to conversations inside the Secret Realm.
Moreover, the Qi Observation Pearl was still effective for those experts hidden in the Crimson Palace within the Secret Realm.
If the Secret Realm and the human world were truly two separate spaces, that would be one thing, but in reality, there wasn't a true "space barrier" between them, just a layer of very thin "paper."
On second thought, he felt it wasn't that Tang Fan was useless, but that the power and treasures of the Purple Mansion Realm were simply too strong.
If he were tied up by a "Blood-Binding Rope" back then, he wouldn't have been able to break free either, right?
But speaking of which, since Tang Fan intended to stay in the Secret Realm, his idea of wanting to see Tang Fan's cards and secrets was naturally dashed.
Thus, he naturally walked in, with a stern face, dragging Tang Fan out of the Secret Realm.
...
...
Days later...
Two figures swiftly flew across the sky.
Heading south.
Song Yan had gathered a lot of information about the Chu Kingdom from the Thousand Crane Sect.
The Secret Realms that could be explored in the Northern Land of the Chu Kingdom had long been "open secrets," and if he wanted to find more things, he had to head south.
In the Sect Chronicles of the Thousand Crane Sect and the records of the Chu Kingdom government, the south was described as "barbarian lands," not only with robust characters but also wild cultivators, and countless poisonous insects and demon beasts.
They established the capital in the north not because the Profound Qi was insufficient in the south, but because the south was too chaotic.
From the records, Song Yan saw the names of several small sects.
Names like "Blood Corpse Sect," "Ghost Slaughter Sect,"...
At a glance, he felt these sect names were indeed "familiar," and fated with him.
Not for anything else, primarily because as Ghost Cultivator Zhang Han, he had too few treasures, not even one worth displaying.
As for the previous techniques of the "Sword Evil Demon Dragon" and "Hundred Forms Demon Body," they were too identifiable; once used, he would be exposed.
Now, he relied only on some simple ghost cultivation magic recorded in the "Ghost Infant Scripture."
Other than that, there was nothing left...
How embarrassing could it get?
Before heading to the "Tiger Chong Soul Threshold," he at least had to prepare some cards for himself, right?
...
...
It was evening.
The two people flying in mid-air slowly landed, stopping in a desolate forest.
Just not far away, a few wild deer were running, Tang Fan's eyes lit up, he got up, and said, "Senior, I'm good at this, let me get you some venison."
Song Yan glanced at him and said, "What's there to eat?"
Tang Fan confidently laughed, "Hehe, you'll know once you taste it, I guarantee it's a delicacy you've never had before!"
Song Yan looked at the boy, chuckled, then skillfully grabbed the wild deer and started preparing the venison himself.
In no time, there were three dishes from one deer.
Roasted, stewed, soup, each with its distinguishing feature.
His cooking skills were truly practiced; when he was Lord Li, his culinary skills were famous far and wide, and over the years, they had become adept.
Tang Fan had thought this old monster probably didn't eat earthly food, intending to showcase his skills to shock his taste buds and try to improve his regard. But unexpectedly, one bite of the old monster's food, and his eyes almost popped out with freshness, continuously exclaiming "delicious, too delicious, more, it's amazing."
Song Yan then took out a jar of fine wine from his storage bag, scraped off the sealing mud, and started drinking.
Tang Fan, shocked, looked at him, then ingratiatingly said, "Senior, could you give me a jar too?"
Song Yan contentedly took a few big gulps, grabbed a piece of golden-roasted venison, bit into it, and sighed comfortably.
Tang Fan's Adam's apple bobbed as he swallowed.
He had already smelt the aroma of wine.
He grinned and shamelessly edged closer, "Grandpa, let me have a sip."
Song Yan smiled at him and, as if chanting, said, "Golden Armor God, Golden Armor God..."
Tang Fan fell silent, fetched some clean water himself, and continued eating meat with it, having to admit: the old monster's roasted meat was better than his.
He felt like he had been "screwed," reminiscing how, during his adventures, he used his exquisite roasting to attract demon beasts in the forest, but never imagined he'd be outclassed by an old monster, making him feel "demon beasts were roasting meat, drawing him over."
While grudgingly drinking water, a voice suddenly came from afar.
"Hey."
Tang Fan looked up to see the Purple Mansion old monster raise his hand and toss a jar of fine wine over.
He instinctively caught it, then mumbled, "Senior, I won't tell you what you want to know.
Everyone has secrets... and I assure you my secret is of no use to you.
You would gain nothing from knowing, and it wouldn't benefit me to tell, so why bring it up, okay?"
Song Yan said, "Not okay."
Tang Fan reluctantly showed a bitter smile, about to return the wine jar.
Song Yan, however, raised his own wine jar, made a gesture of a toast from a distance, and said, "Fussy."
Tang Fan was stunned for a moment, then unexpectedly burst into laughter, boldly knocked the seal off, clasped the inside of the wine jar with his fingers, raised it high, and boldly said, "Cheers!"

chapters.title: Chapter 223 223: 143. Can you bear this cause and effect? (8.1K words - Large chapter, please subscribe) _3
chapters.content:
Song Yan laughed and said, "Cheers!"
The two of them drank large gulps of wine and ate large chunks of meat, occasionally bragging with phrases like, "Back in the day, when I was just a mortal, I could down three jars of strong liquor by myself."
After finishing two jars, Song Yan took out two more and continued drinking.
In the blink of an eye, two jars turned into four, and four into eight, with the two drinking more and more.
Tang Fan let out a comfortable burp, his head tilted, and he fell over to the side.
Song Yan put down the wine jar and looked at the young man who had fallen to the ground.
Over the years, he hadn't been without progress in the study of herbal medicine. At the very least, he managed to recreate a unique drug called "True Fans" by mimicking the pharmacology of "Fanatic Fans" and utilizing the pharmaceutical experience left by Kuye Swordmaster.
This drug had no other effect than making people speak the truth, and it was a sure hit for cultivators below the Crimson Palace Realm. If paired with wine brewed from Profound Flower Grass, the effect would be even better.
However, the opportunities to use "True Fans" were exceedingly rare.
But today, he used it on Tang Fan.
Initially, it had no effect.
But firstly, Tang Fan's realm had dropped to the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound due to the "Blood-Binding Rope," and secondly, he genuinely enjoyed drinking today and drank a lot. Because he was swept up in the atmosphere, because he knew... if an old monster at the Purple Mansion wanted to kill him, it wouldn't take so much effort.
So, he let his guard down.
Song Yan sat beside Tang Fan and said, "You can't beat Aunt Fourteen."
Tang Fan smacked his lips and said, "How could I not beat her? What is she? What am I? How could I not beat her?"
Song Yan said, "Bragging."
Tang Fan patted his chest drunkenly and said, "You don't understand this, it's called Innate Inheritance Secret Technique, something you're born with from the womb. My mother said I actually belong to a vast race called the Ancient Race.
But I absolutely can't let anyone find out because there are far too many people and demons in this world who want to kill the Ancient Race.
Great Chu is not the domain of the Ancient Race and cannot offer protection. If I were to leak this, I'd be undoubtedly doomed.
Hey, Sister Meng, don't tell anyone, okay?
I... hehehe... only told you."
Song Yan: ...
He continued, "What Innate Inheritance Secret Technique?"
Tang Fan said, "My mother said there are many within the Ancient Race.
Unlike the demons' innate Demon Blood, everyone in the Ancient Race possesses an Innate Secret Technique, imprinted on the soul.
Each Ancient Race has a different secret technique.
And my clan, my mother said it's called the Formless Race.
Hehe, any magic used in front of me, I can imitate to some extent, and incorporate my clan's unique secret technique power for counteraction.
This is called 'When the devil is a foot higher, the Dao is a yard higher. Turn their path onto them.'
That day, when Aunt Fourteen transformed into a hundred-zhang Demon Shadow, I imitated her magic, transformed into several dozen zhangs myself, and with my clan's secret technique, my whole body shone with a golden light. A single sword slash took it by surprise. If it weren't for that dog of an Elder Demon Zhang, I'd have taken her down long ago.
Elder Demon Zhang wanted to learn my secret technique, but I can only use it, not explain it, so how could I possibly teach it to him."
He mumbled and then let out another drunken burp.
Song Yan continued asking questions.
Tang Fan was responsive to every query.
As the questions went on, he fell silent, instead leaving only heavy snoring.
Song Yan sat cross-legged, his expression solemn.
The Ancient Race?
The Formless Race?
Turn their path onto them?
Innate Secret Technique?
The waters of this world run indeed very deep.
...
The following day, at dawn.
Tang Fan awoke, and after some effort to recall, remembered the events of the previous night.
He looked at Song Yan in shock, suddenly shouting and cursing like a damsel taken advantage of after drinking, "Elder Demon Zhang, do you have any shame? Do you have any bit of shame at all? Using such underhanded tactics!"
"You've already reached the Purple Mansion Realm, yet you still use such despicable and shameless methods?"
"Shameless!"
"Utterly shameless!"
Song Yan glared at him and said, "Making a fuss again?"
Tang Fan looked at him with resentment, whimpering, "You... bully people... you bully people... this isn't right.
We were just drinking, it clearly seemed you were so straightforward, I can tell real straightforwardness from fake, clearly... clearly..."
Song Yan interrupted, "Next time, be more cautious. I won't randomly spill your secrets."
With that, he looked at the dawn floating over the broken clouds and said, "Let's go, keep moving."
...
In a blink, several days had passed.
The stars were like water.
The two of them rested again by the campfire.
Tang Fan mocked coldly, "You're at least a Purple Mansion Realm powerhouse, what? Can't even have a proper flying vehicle? Every day it's fly, fly, fly!"
Song Yanqi asked curiously, "Are you perhaps disguising as a man?"
Tang Fan: ...
The young man snorted and said nothing, folding his arms and leaning against an old tree to sleep.
Since that day when Song Yan got him drunk and he accidentally spilled his secret, he had been speaking like this.
Song Yan didn't bother with him either.
Everything that needed to be asked was asked that day, unless the kid was acting, his secrets had basically all been exposed.
What Tang Fan relied on to resist the Fox and Wolf Races was entirely the "Innate Inheritance Secret Technique of the Formless Ancient Race."
That kind of secret technique, just thinking about it a bit made Song Yan realize how terrifying it was.
For ordinary techniques, the Formless Ancient Race would learn instantly just by mimicking once.
For the more complex ones, a few repetitions would suffice.
But as for bloodline secret techniques, they require the opponent to release it first, which provides at least a bit of limitation.
Otherwise, Song Yan could hardly imagine.
At this moment, he continued reading the book "Array Dao True Understanding."
He glanced at the status panel:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 39/15812]
[Realm: Early Stage of Purple Mansion]
[Cultivation Technique: Array Dao True Understanding]

chapters.title: Chapter 224 224: 143. Can you bear this cause and effect? (8.1K words - Large chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
[Magic: Array Dao: Five Elements Gathering Profound Array (Entry-level Not Achieved)]
Over the years, he used skin making to gain about four thousand years of longevity for himself.
And after days of effort, he finally managed to bring the complex Array Dao onto the panel.
At this moment, he focused his attention on the "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array."
[You invested 61 years of longevity, "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array" has reached Perfection, you can skillfully use the array and craft array plates and flags]
[You are not satisfied with the perfection of a single array, continuing to invest longevity, after 1 year, you begin to realize that "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array" possesses potential for improvement, but you lack the opportunities to find out]
Song Yan slightly opened his eyes, took out the array plate, flags, and that Wood Profound White Cave Crystal Jade from his Storage Bag, obtained from the Thousand Crane Sect, and fell into contemplation.
He needed to "gather evil."
Hope this southbound journey yields some harvest.
After playing with the array plate and flags for a while, he put them away and closed his eyes to rest.
Meanwhile, opposite him, Tang Fan took out the Communication Stone and shouted into it several times.
After spending these days together, he discovered that Old Monster Zhang didn't restrict such freedoms, so he became much more casual.
"Dream Sister?"
"Dream Sister?"
Tang Fan shouted loudly.
The voice of Fang Qingmeng came from the other side of the Communication Stone.
"Stay honestly in the Secret Realm, don't go anywhere, be careful not to be discovered by Old Demon Zhang. I'm still busy on my side, won't talk to you now."
After finishing, without waiting for a response, the Communication Stone hung up.
Tang Fan helplessly put away the Communication Stone, then also rested.
...
Half a month passed.
The season clearly headed toward midsummer, but the south grew colder and colder, especially the direction where Song Yan and others traveled, which had a feeling of chilling winds.
The cold wind occasionally coming through the gaps of tree branches carried a piercing eeriness.
Tang Fan habitually took out the Communication Stone and shouted, "Dream Sister, I'm so bored!"
However, the Communication Stone did not connect.
Tang Fan kept shouting.
Still not connected.
He couldn't help rolling his eyes, tossed the Communication Stone aside, then turned his head to Song Yan saying, "Senior, have you ever liked a woman?"
Song Yan didn't answer.
Tang Fan spoke boldly, "What do you do when you meet a woman you like, who doesn't pay attention to you?
You say Sister Dream, if she doesn't like me, how could she help me so much and assist me in getting out of trouble?"
Song Yan glanced at the boy speechlessly, then closed his eyes.
After spending these days together, he already confirmed... this kid's acting is quite ordinary, secrets aren't much either. Compared to the level he initially imagined, it was far inferior, capable of being tricked and helped to count money by characters like Big Granny Fox, Red Granny, Gu Huangzi, and Zhang Han under equal power.
And Tang Fan, after experiencing phases of resentment and contradictory feelings, was now increasingly casual with Old Demon Zhang. Plus, he's naturally talkative, now speaking freely.
Seeing Song Yan not speaking, Tang Fan thought for a moment then said, "Why do you think she's suddenly ignoring me? Is it because she finds me annoying?"
Song Yan said, "Stop talking about her, I also find you annoying."
Tang Fan laughed, "In that case, how about you let me go?"
Song Yan said, "If I let you go, what about me? What about the people of Great Chu?"
Tang Fan said curiously, "Oh, you care about the people of Great Chu?"
Song Yan said, "In my eyes, it's either you die or countless others die, I'm definitely choosing to let you die."
Tang Fan said, "But what about you, if you were me, would you be willing to die for the people of Great Chu?"
Song Yan said frankly, "Unwilling."
Tang Fan snorted coldly, "Hypocritical."
Song Yan said, "Although I'm unwilling to use my life to save others, I'm very happy to use someone else's life, especially when it's convenient."
Tang Fan said, "But what if you can't save them?"
Song Yan said, "Then don't save."
Tang Fan said, "Are you going to say if I escape, I'll be the killer of countless Great Chu people, right?"
Song Yan said, "Yes, you must understand this."
Tang Fan jumped up saying, "But if you escaped, you wouldn't be a killer, right?!"
Song Yan laughed, "You finally understand."
Tang Fan stood stunned for a long while, muttering strangely, "No wonder you're a demon," then raised his hands to the sky, loudly wailing, "Oh heavens, am I truly beyond salvation?"
Song Yan said, "Before the Evil Treasure is removed, you're still saveable."
Tang Fan lamented, "Isn't that just talk? I'm just a minor character, how can I play tricks among so many old demons and monsters like you all?
All of you have cunning minds deep as the sea, faces thicker than city walls; how can I compete with you? Isn't this a certain death for me?"
Song Yan said, "Not just you."
Tang Fan was stunned for a moment, suddenly his mood improved a lot, he got up with a leap and took out the Communication Stone, shouting to the other side, "Dream Sister! Dream Sister? I love you."
Seeing the Purple Mansion old monster closed his eyes, Tang Fan laughed smugly, "Senior, you don't understand our youthful feelings."
Saying this, he continued saying into the Communication Stone, "Dream Sister, I love you."
He said it repeatedly.
Anyway, the Communication Stone hasn't connected, doesn't matter.
But suddenly, the Communication Stone lit up.
Tang Fan just finished saying "I love you."
He was startled because "Communication Stone lighting up" meant it had connected, and his confession, which he didn't intend to convey, was transmitted.
He blushed slightly.
However, on the other side of the Communication Stone came strange "rustling" sounds, and its glow only lasted for one or two breaths before dimming instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 225: 143. This Cause and Effect, Can You Bear It? (8.1K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Tang Fan was momentarily stunned, then scratched his head and muttered with a frown, "What's happening? Did Dream Sister accidentally connect?"
Yet when he looked again, he saw Song Yan suddenly rise.
The old monster of the Purple Mansion raised his hand and grabbed him fiercely, Evil Qi swirling around him, transforming into a blood-colored demon rainbow, shooting far away.
This was the Evil Qi Escape recorded in the "Ghost Infant Scripture".
He knew the southward migration route of the Thousand Crane Sect; he also had the map of Great Chu.
The southward route would pass by a place called the "Blood Corpse Sect".
Although the records of that sect state that their strongest expert is but Early Stage Crimson Palace.
But if something happened to the southward migration team, the Blood Corpse Sect would not be able to escape responsibility.
The route, he was already very familiar with.
Now, it was time to hurry on the road.
...
...
"Sikong Seal! Did you bring us here just to refine this evil thing?"
Fang Qingmeng, clad in a white robe, stood at one corner with the other three Elders, barely holding up a barrier, protecting the people moving south, isolating the surging black smoke outside.
And in the black smoke stood two Elders dressed in Thousand Crane Sect robes, a Blood Robe Cultivator, and a brawny man in Skeleton Armor.
The Blood Robe Cultivator snorted coldly and said, "This is not an evil thing, but a Soul Treasure — the Myriad Souls Banner."
Another white-robed man, the leader, said, "You are too stubbornly ignorant. In this world now, if you cannot become stronger, you can only be at the mercy of others.
If we cultivators fail, how can ordinary people survive?
Rather than that, wouldn't it be better to turn them into our power..."
As he spoke, he waved his hand, pointing to the roll of black smoke enveloping the full city, to those who had already tragically perished within the smoke, those who staggered, those who crawled, gnawing on the ground, and those completely twisted, saying, "This small city has over two hundred thousand people, normally considered good and kind. I plan to use them to refine the Myriad Souls Banner.
Because they are so kind, if they knew they could become a treasure in my hands to slay demons in the future, I'm sure they would be willing.
I initially thought they would understand, but after I cut off their food supply, they actually began to resist, riot? And then, when they found they couldn't escape, they started to cannibalize each other, the hideousness, tsk tsk tsk...
However, the Myriad Souls Banner, as a legendary Soul Treasure, is not so easily refined. It still requires the souls of the Crimson Palace to enter the banner for success."
Within the Defense Shield, an elder of the Thousand Crane Sect with white hair angrily said, "Sikong Seal! You are still the Sect Leader's brother, how can you do such a thing?"
Another elder said, "Wouldn't it be better to establish a branch sect in the south than to do this?"
The white-robed man called Sikong Seal laughed disdainfully, "What use is there in establishing another Thousand Crane Sect?
By the book, can it withstand the northern demons?!
Only my alliance of branch sects united with many demon cultivators of the Southern Land is the path for the cultivators of Great Chu!
Don't blame me for not giving you the chance, I discussed with you how to establish the sect in the south.
Each of you disagreed with my views.
What else could I do?
If you discovered that I encircled a city to refine treasures, you would not tolerate me!
In that case, I struck first."
After saying this, his gaze fell on the white-robed female cultivator, seemingly sizing up her body, his eyes showing a hint of licentiousness, he suddenly said, "Immortal Qingmeng, if you are willing to dual cultivate with me, I'll spare your life, anyway, the souls of three from the Crimson Palace are enough to refine the Myriad Souls Banner."
Fang Qingmeng stared coldly at him, suddenly her eyes moved, and she sneered, "Sikong Seal, aren't you curious why I put six mortals in the southbound team?"
Sikong Seal was momentarily stunned.
He indeed found it strange.
The team heading south was set, but suddenly adding six mortals was very peculiar.
Those six mortals were smuggled in by Fang Qingxue at all costs, and after boarding the Yellow-skinned Gourd, they were given much care.
He had never understood why, but since they were just mortals, he didn't pay much attention.
Fang Qingmeng stared into his eyes and said word by word, "It doesn't matter if you kill me, even if you kill all the fellow Thousand Crane Sect members here, but if you dare touch those six people, guess how much cause and effect there will be?"
Sikong Seal's eyes widened suddenly, stunned on the spot.
The Blood Robe Cultivator beside him, who was the Sect Leader of the Blood Corpse Sect, frowned and said, "Mere mortals, what kind of formidable background could they have?"
The brawny man in Skeleton Armor, who was the Ghost Slaughter Sect Leader, laughed disdainfully and said in a muffled voice, "Sect Leader Sikong, don't be fooled by them, if this chick's mouth is so active, why not let her move it more later. Tsk tsk tsk, I haven't tasted the Yin essence of the Thousand Crane Sect's Fairy of the Crimson Palace yet."
But no matter what the two Sect Leaders said, Sikong Seal no longer responded.
He doubtfully and hesitantly thought, then suddenly roared towards Fang Qingmeng, "This is impossible!"
Fang Qingmeng said lightly, "Not only do you find it impossible, I also find it impossible, but... it happens to be true."
She spoke more and more confidently, even with a smile.
"Can you bear this cause and effect?"
The moment her words fell, Sikong Seal was already drenched in cold sweat.
Beside him, the two Sect Leaders of the Southern Land of Great Chu looked at him in amazement, not knowing what kind of riddle he was playing.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 226: 144. The so-called destiny, Demon Ancestor (8.0K characters - large chapter subscription request)
chapters.content:
A city of a hundred thousand people, clearly committing no sin, yet besieged by cultivators, deprived of supplies, driven to cannibalism, forced into a state of human depravity, seemingly a true hell on earth.
At this very moment, Sikong Seal, the instigator, was not faring well either. His triumphant expression had long since vanished, leaving only impatience and trepidation. His face twisted and morphed within the swirling black smoke, and his eyes rolled about, evidently pondering what to do.
The two sect leaders of the Early Stage Crimson Palace, from the Blood Corpse Sect and the Ghost Slaughter Sect, finally came to their senses.
Both looked towards Sikong Seal.
One said, "What level?"
The other said, "Even if it's the Late Stage of Crimson Palace, this is our territory. We can exhaust and kill him slowly. What is there to fear, Brother Sikong?"
Along with Sikong Seal, another young elder named Bi Chuanfei had also defected from the Thousand Crane Sect.
This elder never liked the Thousand Crane Sect's idea of protecting the Chu Kingdom, feeling it was too elevated and should do as it pleased. Thus, the plan to refine the Myriad Souls Banner naturally aligned with Sikong Seal's intentions.
However, Bi Chuanfei's face also turned pale at this moment.
After a moment, Sikong Seal beckoned, and the other three knowingly stepped aside, huddling together.
Sikong Seal then said, "It's the Purple Mansion Realm."
The words "Purple Mansion Realm" fell, and the faces of the two sect leaders finally drained of color, instantly turning pale, and they couldn't help but exclaim.
"How could it be?"
"Our Great Chu has never produced a Purple Mansion Realm!"
Bi Chuanfei quietly explained the recent events happening in the Imperial Capital of the Chu Kingdom.
All four fell silent.
For a long while...
The Sect Leader of the Ghost Slaughter Sect said harshly, "Now that the refinement of the Myriad Souls Banner has reached the most critical moment, abruptly halting it is out of the question! The only plan now is to accelerate the refinement!"
The Sect Leader of the Blood Corpse Sect rolled his eyes and said, "Indeed, but I think we should still keep those six mortals and entertain them well.
If the old monster truly comes, it will serve as an explanation.
Should there be a karmic bond, it would be for the best.
If the old monster is dissatisfied and still wishes to fight, once our Myriad Souls Banner is refined, brandishing it should make him reconsider."
Sikong Seal pondered for a while and then nodded slightly, saying, "The Myriad Souls Banner is extremely difficult to create. The core object was something we obtained by accident during an earth-energy eruption. Without it, crafting such a soul treasure would be beyond our capability.
The Soul Artifact is already exceedingly rare for Crimson Palace cultivators. A Soul Treasure, even more so. With just a wave, it can directly launch a Divine Soul attack. With ten thousand evil souls striking simultaneously, even a Purple Mansion old monster would be injured.
Admittedly, our usage burns considerable resources, but once we wield this Myriad Souls Banner, the old monster will indeed have to second-guess."
Bi Chuanfei nodded along.
Soul-type treasures were indeed rare.
He had read in ancient books.
From low to high, they are: Soul Artifact, Soul Treasure, Evil Artifact, Evil Treasure.
A Soul Artifact stores souls in small quantities, with limited range and no enhanced Divine Souls stored within.
A Soul Treasure holds not only large quantities but also allows direct release to drive evil souls to attack within a defined area, and these evil souls are considerably more powerful for certain reasons.
An Evil Artifact is terrifying.
It is said that an Evil Artifact contains endless sinister energies; because "Evil" has no soul but is rather fragmented karma, these evil qi can completely attach to the owner, transforming them into a fearsome "Giant Soul."
As for Evil Treasure...he only saw its name mentioned in ancient books and didn't understand its capabilities, but it was also far beyond the reach of the Crimson Palace Realm.
Forget about an Evil Treasure, even wielding an Evil Artifact...a cultivator of the Crimson Palace Realm would be instantly consumed and perish.
...
The four, having made up their minds, quickly returned to the defense shield.
Sikong Seal gazed inside, his eyes sweeping over the six mortals in the distance, then turned his gaze back to Fang Qingmeng, and reaching into the void, he pulled out a piece of jade - Memory Jade.
Fang Qingmeng paused for a moment.
Sikong Seal directly said, "Fang Qingmeng, since you know those six are related to a Purple Mansion elder, and you can't protect them now, would you be willing to hand them over to me?
I, Sikong Seal, swear, if those six come to me, I will treat them well, absolutely without any oppression."
After speaking, he looked wistfully at the white-robed fairy opposite.
Fang Qingmeng didn't expect the opposite party to come up with such a move, sighed softly, looked at Li Huai, Shuang Yun, Xiaohuan, and others she'd brought, and said, "I gave you my promise, but I can't protect myself now, so you...may go with him."
The six looked at each other.
Shuang Yun glanced at the black smoke outside, then at the purgatory-like scene in the distance, filled with fear.
Li Huai said, "Immortal Fang, despite my humble origins, I can still distinguish good from bad, good from evil."
He suddenly pointed at Sikong Seal in the distance, saying, "These people commit atrocities and do evil. Even if I die, I will never go with them!"
As Li Huai spoke, Xiaohuan and the others, despite being frightened, each lifted their heads, declaring, "We will not go with bad people."
Sikong Seal coldly glanced at these ant-like mortals but still smiled. He closed his eyes slightly, suppressing his inner anger, and said, "You are too young to discern right from wrong.
True, I killed a city of people, which is evil.
But if, as a result, I refine a powerful treasure to protect this nation, making the northern demons wary.
Where they would have killed one million people, but because of us, only a hundred thousand were killed, haven't we saved nine hundred thousand?
Thus, isn't this good?
And the Thousand Crane Sect, unwilling to sacrifice this city of citizens, but in turn causing millions to die, isn't that...evil?"

chapters.title: Chapter 227 227: 144. The so-called destiny, Demon Ancestor (8.0K characters - large chapter subscription request)_2
chapters.content:
He forced a smile, looked at Li Huai and the others, and said, "That's why we are truly good people."
Li Huai looked at him coldly and said, "Good is good, and evil is evil. How many people in this city are like me, and did you ever consider their feelings when you killed them?
If it weren't for Uncle Li, I would just be an ant for you to crush at will.
But does being an ant mean you deserve to die?
Even though I am humble, I have my own scale of good and evil in my heart!
I know what you're up to, but I, Li Huai, would rather die than join you."
In these few days, their Profound Root testing had actually ended.
The test results showed that Li Huai had a lower grade Earth Profound Root, and the other six did not have any.
At this moment, Li Huai suddenly knelt towards Fang Qingmeng and respectfully said, "Master Qingmeng, my aptitude is poor, would you still be willing to take me as your disciple?"
Fang Qingmeng was truly stunned; she never expected that a mortal in front of her could have such a tenacious mind.
Then she smiled and gently said, "Of course, I am willing."
As she spoke, she took out a storage bag and a flying sword from her bosom and handed them out, "These are gifts from your master for our first meeting."
Li Huai said firmly, "Thank you, Master!"
Sikong Seal looked at this scene with green eyes and said bizarrely, "Li Huai, is it?"
"Yes!"
Li Huai answered confidently.
Sikong Seal said, "You keep saying I am evil, but... do you really understand Uncle Li whom you speak of?"
Without waiting for Li Huai's answer, Sikong Seal continued, "If we are evil people, then we are just small evil, but that Uncle Li of yours is the great evil, ha... hahaha..."
Li Huai remained silent because on that day he indeed saw Uncle Li destroy the Golden Armor Divine Man who was resisting demons as soon as he appeared.
Sikong Seal smiled as he reached out his hand, saying, "I'll give you one more chance. Come, child, join me."
Li Huai slowly shook his head.
Sikong Seal's face turned icy, his patience completely exhausted, he snorted angrily, then crushed the Memory Jade, closed his eyes, turned around, and shouted, "Hasten the sacrificial refinement!!"
Fang Qingmeng gently looked at Li Huai and said, "Good child, stand behind me, it's not that easy for them to refine us."
"Yes, Master." Li Huai's tone was full of respect for his teacher.
The other three cultivators at the triangular position also seemed infected, nodding frequently and becoming increasingly determined to resist the Myriad Souls Banner's erosion.
...
...
In the blink of an eye, several days had passed.
Sikong Seal was becoming increasingly irritable.
He had personally sat within the Sacrificial Refining Array, hoping to increase efficiency.
But inside and outside were four Crimson Palace cultivators, and among them, there were three at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, and one at the Early Stage; their overall power was stronger than his side.
To gnaw this hard bone naturally wouldn't be easy.
Inside, the cultivators were like in a tug of war, refining and resisting at the same time.
Fang Qingmeng was staring outside intently, struggling to hold on, not daring to show any fatigue for fear of breaking the morale, but she knew... she couldn't hold on much longer.
