Within three days, she would certainly be refined and become part of the Myriad Souls Banner, then suffer torment and turn into a vengeful ghost. During this time, she couldn't even self-destruct her divine soul.
This is the horror of the Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array.
Sikong Seal raised his hand to increase power, enjoying the process of slowly torturing people to death, watching as hope on their faces gradually turned to despair.
His eyes were fixated on the defense shield, watching as it became thinner and cracks began to appear and disappear on its surface.
Sikong Seal curled his lips into a sinister smile.
And just then, without any warning, not even at the critical moment, a wind suddenly arose from the horizon.
A gust of wind came from afar, like waves crashing onto the Sacrificial Refining Array at this moment.
The black banner suspended at the center also flapped violently.
Sikong Seal's smile instantly froze, a foreboding feeling flashed across his heart, and he nervously looked into the distance.
A blood-colored demon rainbow suddenly appeared, followed by rolling bloody smoke approaching through the sky, accompanied by a greedy laugh.
"Good stuff! There's indeed something good!"
"I knew that silently devouring the Thousand Crane Sect meant there must be a treasure!"
"This treasure is actually a soul-type artifact!"
"Fate brings us together from across a thousand miles, without some fate, how could we meet? This treasure should be mine by fate!"
"It's mine!!"
Sikong Seal's heart pounded, suddenly standing up, swallowing, then taking a deep breath, standing with hands behind his back, facing the rolling bloody smoke in the distance.
In the midst of the blood smoke, a terrifying figure resembling a Demon God seemed to float faintly.
He urgently shouted, "Senior!"
But the senior paid him no mind and suddenly raised his hand.
A blood-colored large hand immediately appeared in the void, using a simple power application recorded in the "Ghost Infant Scripture", which strictly speaking didn't even count as a magic of the Purple Mansion Realm. This power was formed by using thoughts as the core and Profound Qi as the surface, each independent thought absorbing Profound Qi elevated to the Late Stage of Crimson Palace level, then interlinking to form a Profound Evil Hand equivalent to several Late Stage of Crimson Palace striking simultaneously.
This hand had no technique, but carried a violent aestheticism of using sheer powerful numbers to overwhelm.
The blood-colored large hand suddenly manifested in the clouds, unabashedly reaching for the central black banner.
Sikong Seal hurriedly said, "Senior, with you there is a cause related to six..."
Snap!
The blood-colored large hand grasped firmly.
Song Yan's face immediately showed a look of delight.
Such a good thing!
This was clearly an upgraded version of the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet", though it lacked three sub-bracelets and several refined processes, but the amount of evil souls contained within, as well as its power, were far beyond what the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" could compare with.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 228: 144. The so-called destiny, Demon Ancestor (8.0K characters - large chapter subscription request)_3
chapters.content:
However, the banner is clearly still lacking some refinement before the ritual can be successful.
He was once the Puppet Sect Leader and has read quite a number of the Thousand Crane Sect's texts, so he is proficient in various basic techniques. Although artifact refining is complex, he understands the fundamentals.
The process of "refining the banner" before him is extremely intricate, but now it's at the final step.
He glanced around, pondering on what to do next.
Soon, he understood: he needed some Crimson Palace souls.
Sikong Seal saw him fall silent, thinking his words had an effect, quickly said, "Senior, those six mortals are currently in the formation..."
Before he could finish speaking, Song Yan waved his hand, and a crimson hand suddenly reached across the void.
This time, the target was Sikong Seal!
Sikong Seal swiftly flashed down to the defense shield below, thinking to himself: 'Within the defense shield are several Thousand Crane Sect cultivators, and those six mortals that the Purple Mansion elder cares about, perhaps... the opponent will slightly restrain his attack, right?
Although I used mortals to threaten the Purple Mansion elder, there was no other choice.'
However, the crimson hand showed no sign of slowing down.
Its momentum was fierce, and while it grasped Sikong Seal, its back also brushed against the defense shield.
The surface of the shield cracked with long fissures.
Fang Qingmeng, the white-haired elder, and others were spitting blood, faces red, but forcefully endured, hurriedly attempting to repair.
Outside the cave, the formed Myriad Souls Banner evil soul instantly surged inwards.
A dozen or so Thousand Crane Sect cultivators near the fissure were struck by the soul attack, clutching their heads in agony. Soon, their divine souls were shattered, dragged outside by the attacking evil souls, becoming muddled.
Fortunately, the defense shield was repaired in time.
Above, Song Yan seemed oblivious to the events, merely clutching Sikong Seal.
Sikong Seal was shocked, struggling, attempted to speak again.
But as his lips moved...
Bang!!
This cultivator, who had schemed for so long, planning to become the uncrowned king of the Great Chu Southern Land, had his body crushed!
His Crimson Palace divine soul was pulled by a powerful soul-soaking force, rushing towards the black banner.
At this moment, he finally understood one thing: which elder would fear threats? Which elder truly cares about mortals? Which elder would bother wasting words with you? All along, he was playing his little game alone; the elder didn't even listen.
At this moment, the person he hated the most wasn't Song Yan, but Fang Qingxue.
In his heart, he roared: 'You deceitful woman, if it weren't for you fooling me, how could I truly believe that those six mortals were related to the Purple Mansion elder and use them as shields at the last moment?!'
His divine soul violently trembled upon touching the black banner, electric shock-like intense pain surged, filled with endless rage, lost all reason, memories blurred, his soul ferocious, desiring to tear apart every life he saw.
The last scene he witnessed was Profound Robe floating above the blood smoke, overlooking the rolling black smoke in the city, expression cold, gaze greedy, as he pulled a coffin from the void, carefully placing his body inside, like he was storing a piece of quality material.
Afterwards, the elder let out a fierce laugh, swooping down from the sky...
Below, Bi Chuanfei, engrossed in his refinement, along with the two Sect Leaders of the Demon Sect, seeing the soar like frightened chicks beneath an eagle, jumped up in terror, scattered in frantic escape, and the sect disciples involved in aiding the ritual were so terrified they couldn't move.
Bi Chuanfei, take off.
A large hand crushed, death!
Body placed in coffin, flown into storage bag.
The Sect Leader of the Blood Corpse Sect, fused into the black smoke.
A large hand slapped, death!
Body placed in coffin, flown into storage bag.
The robust man in Skeleton Armor used some kind of treasure, evil qi swirling around, countless skin-and-bone ghosts began flying chaotically, blocking the view.
A large hand reached in, grabbed, lifted the man like pinching an ant.
The man screamed miserably, shouting, "Senior spare me, spare me."
Song Yan looked at the evil qi around him and asked, "Which sect are you from?"
"Ghost... Ghost Slaughter Sect."
"What position?"
"Sect Leader."
"Ghost Slaughter..." Song Yan showed a thoughtful expression, then glanced at the banner, sensed briefly.
With the three Crimson Palace souls inside, the banner was satisfied, any more wouldn't make a fundamental change.
He thought for a moment and said, "A ghost cultivator, hmm?"
"Yes yes yes... Little Crow is a ghost cultivator."
"I am fate with my station." Song Yan showed a gentle smile, then kindly said, "Don't be afraid, I am also a ghost cultivator."
The robust man in Skeleton Armor showed a face full of joy, trembling with delight, "Ancestor, Little Crow finally found the ancestor. With the ancestor here, the sky is bright! With the ancestor here, our ghost cultivator lineage can finally be peaceful and strong!"
The ghost cultivator named Little Crow wept with emotion, unsure if it was out of fear, pretense, or joy.
Song Yan landed from mid-air, dusting off Little Crow's armor, tidying his collar, kindly smiling, "Boy, don't be afraid, I am not a murderous person."
"Yes... Yes, ancestor!" Little Crow's voice trembled, hastily followed respectfully behind Song Yan.
Tang Fan watched in awe at this scene, then revealed an expression of realization.
This elder just came to snatch the treasure.
Song Yan's eyes moved slightly, looking at the defense shield on the other side, meeting the gaze of Fang Qingmeng at the lead, casually said, "Begone."
Fang Qingmeng and others quickly withdrew the defense shield then swiftly retreated.
From beginning to end, Song Yan stood with his head high, eyes filled with cunning and indifference, never glancing at Shuang Yun, Li Huai, or Xiao Huan, not even once.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 229: 144. The so-called destiny, Demon Ancestor (8.0K characters - large chapter subscription request)_4
chapters.content:
But Shuang Yun saw his expression was already full of fear.
She had envisioned countless reunions with Doctor Li and had prepared that "thank you" in her heart for a long time, but at this moment, she was so terrified she couldn't utter a word. Simultaneously, she realized how ludicrous it was to say "thank you" to such a terrifying demon.
The Doctor Li she admired, perhaps... never existed.
Li Huai also looked incredulously at this foul and sinister man, who was now surrounded by ominous smoke. His lips trembled, and the "father" he had kept in his heart for so long could no longer be called out.
The father he revered, perhaps... was a mere facade.
The same was true for both of them, not to mention Xiao Huan and the others.
A group of people hurriedly fled from this Sacrificial Refining City with the Thousand Crane Sect led by Fang Qingmeng.
Song Yan stood with his hands behind his back.
And behind him, Xiao Wu had been watching silently. It was only now that he realized how miserably Sikong Seal had been deceived.
This Purple Mansion old monster would not care about any mortal, would he?
Even if there were some connections, they were probably just casual teasing, how could it be serious?
And a group of Demon Cultivators gathered from all directions, respectfully kneeling and shouting, "Greetings, Patriarch!"
Song Yan did not reply, merely lifting his head to gaze at the black banner in the sky.
Malevolent souls blazed like fire, burning fiercely.
The city was like a furnace, with the souls of hundreds of thousands of innocent beings sacrificed to forge this Soul Treasure.
Song Yan watched for a long time, closed his eyes slightly, and said in a deep voice, "Still lacking skill, all return to your positions, continue the sacrificial refinement."
...
...
Several days later, the black aura showed signs of restraint.
Throughout the city, the stench of decay and blood was everywhere.
Song Yan sat cross-legged, quietly sensing the evil sacrificial refining array.
An unusual feeling suddenly arose in his heart: the Soul Absorption Technique within the sacrificial refining array bore some resemblance to the Gathering Profound Array of the Five Elements.
Both absorb some peculiar existence.
As his thoughts swept past, the black aura completely gathered, merging into the fathom-deep banner.
Song Yan raised his hand in summons, and the banner descended, but as it fell halfway, it seemed to have some intelligence of its own, flickering with black light, suddenly generating a repulsive force, attempting to flee.
Song Yan frowned slightly, abruptly raised his hand skyward, and in the void appeared a large blood hand, the hand cupped slightly, enclosing the escaping Myriad Souls Banner.
The Myriad Souls Banner charged left and right to no avail.
Song Yan seized the opportunity, grabbing it fiercely and tightening his grip.
Within the scarlet hand, a mass of black smoke surged violently, only calming after a while.
Only then did Song Yan pull down the Myriad Souls Banner.
The Myriad Souls Banner obediently descended, transforming instantly into a palm-sized flag landing in Song Yan's palm.
Song Yan slightly perceived it and sensed within this Myriad Souls Banner a Divine Soul Space far larger than the "Ice Hell."
It was a pool of pitch-black stagnant water, in which countless malevolent souls floated.
The malevolent souls appeared agonized and hideous, filled with malice.
The Sect Leader of Ghost Slaughter Sect shuddered at the sight; they only knew the method to refine the Myriad Souls Banner but never expected that this Soul Treasure would resist after its completion.
If it were them, how could they possibly stop the Myriad Souls Banner's escape?
Even if it were refined, it would be a futile endeavor.
At that moment, a voice unexpectedly came by his ear.
"Xiao Wu, I am quite interested in this sacrificial refining array, take me to have a look."
"Yes, Patriarch."
The Sect Leader of Ghost Slaughter Sect hastily replied. At this point, he dared not even utter a "no."
...
...
A month later.
Tang Fan was thrown into the Celestial Prison of the main sect of the Ghost Slaughter Sect, or rather, the Great Chu Demon Cultivator Alliance.
The fact that the Ghost Slaughter Sect had an old Patriarch of the Purple Mansion sitting was already spread around, with a multitude of Demon Cultivators flocking to join, and sects like the Blood Corpse Sect had completely become branches of the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
And the name of Sect Leader Wu Fangtian of the Ghost Slaughter Sect had become as illustrious as the sky, appearing extremely powerful and influential.
At this moment, Song Yan was in the core area of the Ghost Slaughter Sect, holding a scroll related to sacrificial refinement and studying it meticulously.
"Patriarch, is there anything else?"
Beside him, Wu Fangtian asked with trepidation.
Song Yan beckoned with his hand.
Wu Fangtian hurried forward but didn't dare get too close.
Song Yan continued to beckon, saying, "Come closer."
Wu Fangtian, a sturdy man, broke into a cold sweat over these three words but dared not disobey, moving forward extraordinarily slowly as if shackled by weights of ten thousand jins.
Upon reaching Song Yan, he knelt down with a "thud," his face a picture of mourning, "Patriarch, spare my life, Patriarch, spare my life, I genuinely regard you as my patriarch."
"Genuinely?"
Song Yan laughed, reaching out to tap this sturdy man's forehead, and from the wide sleeve, a strand of bizarrely colorful patterned imp emerged, significantly thicker and darker than during the Crimson Palace times.
But just as this patterned imp was about to touch the man's skin, it suddenly retracted.
Song Yan's thoughts swiftly morphed and shifted, changing unpredictably.
Initially, he thought transforming this Sect Leader Wu into a spectral slave was the best option.
Externally, the reasoning seemed sufficient, being drawn into the Myriad Souls Banner, that was.
However, at the point of completion, he changed his mind.
Indeed, the disappearance of Wu Fangtian could be explained as being absorbed into the Myriad Souls Banner, but his continued existence further proved that "he is utterly not Song Yan." At the same time, it also better protected "Shuang Yun, Li Huai, Xiao Huan" and others, letting it be clear that having crossed paths with him didn't automatically tie them to cause and effect, preventing them from being used to threaten him.
Song Yan had grown wary of being hunted, thus he perpetually harbored the thought of "leaving beneficial evidence, such that even if demons investigate, they could never trace it back to him being Song Yan."

chapters.title: Chapter 230 230: 144. The so-called destiny, Demon Ancestor (8.0K characters - large chapter subscription request)_5
chapters.content:
So, at the last moment, he changed his mind again.
Pa!
Pa pa!
He kindly patted Wu Fangtian's head and said with a smile, "Of course the Ancestor knows that you are sincere; otherwise, how could you still be alive, kneeling here? The Ancestor came here because of the affinity with the Myriad Souls Banner and also because of the affinity with you, the Ghost Cultivator of the same lineage."
Wu Fangtian was so startled that he could hardly breathe and quickly laughed, "Little Wu regards the Ancestor as his own kin! If the Ancestor asks Little Wu to go east, Little Wu wouldn't dare to go west."
Pa!
Song Yan continued patting his head.
Wu Fangtian lifted his head naively, trying his best to show a grandchild-like cute smile.
Song Yan withdrew his hand and said lightly, "As long as you behave, the Ancestor won't treat you poorly."
After saying this, he suddenly closed the book in his hand, stood up, and said, "Come."
Immediately, the two of them, one in front and one behind, left the core area and appeared in an Evil Land near the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
This Evil Land was almost similar to that outside South Bamboo Peak; if you went deeper, the Evil Qi would also become more intense, except it lacked that blood jade-like Evil Land Core.
Song Yan slightly placed his right hand behind him and casually waved with his left hand.
As his sleeve swayed, a loud "boom" echoed in the void. The previously drifting and unstable Evil Qi was suddenly seized by a tremendous force, turning into a stormy tide in the deep sea, roaring towards one direction with impressive might.
Wu Fangtian watched this scene in shock.
As the Sect Leader of the Ghost Slaughter Sect, he naturally had some insights.
He could discern that this magic was only at the Refining Profound Level, but its power was at the Crimson Palace Level, and it had unimaginable effectiveness in an Evil Land.
It could be said that this magic was a perfect match for a Ghost Cultivator stationed in an Evil Land!
"Evil Tide Skill."
Song Yan said lightly.
Wu Fangtian knelt down and said, "Please teach me, Ancestor."
Song Yan said, "Behave and don't get any crazy ideas. I won't stay here long, but I'll teach you before I leave."
Wu Fangtian hurriedly said, "Yes, Ancestor!"
...
...
A few days later.
Song Yan continued to browse through some books in the core area of the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
He repeatedly studied the Array for the Sacrificial Refinement of the Myriad Souls Banner.
This time, he felt a strange premonition in his heart.
"Magic Mutation" was actually an effect brought by the "Ghost Profound Root."
Otherwise, even if he spent years working behind closed doors, pondering blindly, he wouldn't have figured out anything.
But the inability to understand was just due to "insufficient information."
However, this time, a subtle connection emerged between the Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refinement Method and the Five Elements Gathering Profound Array.
He was just waiting for the Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refinement Method to appear on the interface so that he could take both as targets for contemplation and see if he could discover something new.
As he was thinking, there was suddenly a commotion outside the door, and two female cultivators' voices, one enchanting, the other pure, rang out.
"Ancestor."
"Ancestor."
Song Yan waved his hand, and the curtain lifted, revealing the forms of two female cultivators from the Demon Sect outside the door.
Indeed, they matched their voices perfectly.
The one on the left in red was enchanting, with a fox-like face, her fiery ribbon wrapped around her like lotus hugging jade, revealing legs as white as snow, shaping out hill-like buttocks...
The one on the right, in white, was slender and graceful, with a lovely and pitiful face yet hiding deep allure, glancing at him secretly with tightly closed legs slightly wriggling, in a nervous and expectant manner...
Song Yan immediately understood and beckoned them closer.
The two female cultivators from the Demon Sect cheered and leaped to his side, each sitting on either side, beginning to offer their utmost service.
Night, deepened.
Outside the window, the Evil Mist and foul wind twisted the moonlight, spinning gently, as if forming a boundless and infinite crimson Moon Sea. Skins and bones flew chaotically, skimming the ground; Evil Beasts went mad, drooling at the mouth, howling grotesquely.
Inside the room, however, was a completely different scene. Two phoenixes faced one dragon, after overturning the seas and rivers.
Reluctantly settling down, Song Yan quietly lay there, with a demoness entwined on each side.
He looked outside, watching the rolling Evil Qi in silence.
Though without clothes, no longer in white or red, the purer demoness more keenly grasped the Ancestor's thoughts at that moment. She propped her chin with her hand, elbow on his strong chest, asked softly, "Ancestor, thinking about the past?"
The red-clad demoness giggled, "The Ancestor's past must have been incomparably glorious."
Song Yan said nothing, but he recalled the scene many years ago in that Suspended Room for the first time.
Time flows like water, quickly passing by over the years.
But there was nothing worthy of nostalgia.
Because whether then, or now...
He had no way back, only forward.
As if some inspiration came from the revelry, a line of information suddenly appeared on the panel before his eyes:
[Magic]
"Array Dao: Ten Thousand Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array" (Not Entry-level)
"Array Dao: Five Elements Gathering Profound Array" (Perfection)
Song Yan quietly looked at the bold words "Array Dao: Ten Thousand Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array."
In fact, as long as he followed the records of the book, the Myriad Souls Banner could be refined, but if he wanted to delve further into its mysteries, it would be extremely difficult.
At this moment, he fixed his eyes on "Array Dao: Ten Thousand Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array," silently saying in his heart.
'Cultivation.'

chapters.title: Chapter 231 231: 145. Celestial Dao Characters, Seizing Opportunities (7.8K words - long chapter, please subscribe)
chapters.content:
[You dedicated 75 years of your life span to comprehension, completely memorizing eighty-eight thousand nine hundred and twenty-one array patterns, making it nearly impossible for you to write them incorrectly at any time. You have comprehended the "Array Dao: Ten Thousand Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array" to Perfection, allowing you to proficiently utilize this array and craft array plates and array flags.]
[After comprehending this array to Perfection, you felt a strange sensation in your heart. Among the complex array patterns, you perceived something more detailed beyond the surface. It seemed like a main trunk running through the tens of thousands of array patterns, resembling an ancient tree, with the array patterns being no more than branches growing from this old tree.]
[Moreover, on this ancient tree, you also saw some similarities with the "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array." There seems to be a mystical overlap between the two, which you feel may be the key to further advancing the array. However, when you attempted to grasp this overlap, you found yourself unable to understand or even remember it, and you felt intense fatigue during the process.]
[You gave up on understanding and abandoned the entire memory, using simple horizontal, vertical strokes combined with math and self-created symbols to memorize the overlap. Yet it remained exceedingly difficult, as any attempt at holistic memory brought about extreme exhaustion. During this time, you would recover by sleeping. However, upon waking, you found that all previous memories, even those cunningly memorized with "horizontal and vertical strokes combined with math symbols," had been forgotten. You knew you had discovered something remarkable, something that first required you to study the array map to Perfection, then fortuitously discover two array maps with common points, and subsequently extract the core within. You called this core the core array pattern. This task was extremely challenging. Sometimes you spent an entire month accomplishing nothing worthwhile.]
[You dedicated 450 years, and on this day, you finally succeeded. The core array text in your mind turned into an extremely complex and obscure series of symbols and numbers, understood only by you. Scrutinizing these symbols and numbers, you found them reminiscent of the mathematical formulas from before your transmigration; they were cryptic to outsiders. You concluded that the term core array pattern might not suit this, and thus renamed it array pattern formula. You recorded this array pattern formula on paper, knowing well... you would soon forget it again.]
The unprecedented comprehension finally ended.
Song Yan slowly opened his eyes, feeling that a piece of leather suitable for writing in his storage bag had the "array pattern formula" inscribed on it. He glanced at the panel, revealing an astonished expression.
Because under the "Magic" section on his panel, a new line of information had emerged.
The information appeared entirely frozen in a gray color.
"Little Heavenly Dao Texts - Introduction" (Incomplete) (Unavailable)
'Little Heavenly Dao Characters?'
Song Yan's pupils narrowed slightly.
This was the true advantage of the "Remaining Life Dao Fruit": it accurately indicated what he had been cultivating. If you cultivated "Soul Opening Eyes," it would never display "Profound Heart Technique"; if you visualized a Sea of Suffering, it would never say you were visualizing the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map."
As for "unavailable," it was because Song Yan couldn't actually remember the heavenly dao character representing "Introduction" and was instead using the "array pattern formula" to utilize it.
Therefore, although "Little Heavenly Dao Texts - Introduction" appeared on his panel, it was displayed as "unavailable."
Song Yan was certain that if he destroyed the piece of leather recording the "array pattern formula" in his storage bag at this moment, this line of information would vanish completely, as if it had never appeared.
And the five words "Little Heavenly Dao Characters" were enough to ignite his imagination.
He was no longer an "Array Dao Novice" but someone well-versed in "Array Dao True Understanding" and who mastered two kinds of array maps. So he understood that the so-called "Array Dao," apart from the scattered materials forming it, actually consisted of three parts:
One, array patterns;
Two, the array plate bearing the array patterns;
Three, array flag.
Among these three, the most core and mysterious was, indeed, the "array patterns."
Any practitioner of the array dao couldn't help but ask why engraving array patterns grants special power? Why do some things in the world yield to the control of the array? Even those without much power can wield it, empowering it with sufficient profound stone? When a mistake in these numerous array patterns can be irrevocable?
Now Song Yan understood the answer to this question.
Because the so-called "array patterns" are indeed little celestial dao characters, which, being little celestial dao characters, naturally can manipulate the powers within this world.
But such power comes with significant backlash; hence, the metal suitable for being an array plate must be extremely hard.
As for the array flag, it is like an extension of the array patterns, determining the scope of efficacy.
With this in mind, Song Yan couldn't wait to try out this more core array.
However, just as he moved slightly, a delicate moan echoed by his ear.
"Mmm..."
He turned his head slightly and found the red-dressed demoness on the left stirring.
A soothing sensation immediately emanated from there.
He felt the embrace and entwining of the two demonesses beside him, their warm and soft bodies exuding the luxurious, light fragrance of profound herbs, and even after such fiery passion, there was not a trace of lewd atmosphere.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 232: 145. Celestial Dao Characters, Seizing Opportunities (7.8K words - long chapter, please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
"Ancestor~~"
It seemed as if she sensed his movement, the red-clad demoness opened her eyes and looked at him coquettishly, even though his face was full of vicious and ferocious sword scars at the moment, the red-clad demoness still looked at him with the same expression as her first love, affectionate, like autumn water.
Song Yan asked, "What's your name?"
The red-clad demoness showed surprise and said coquettishly, "Slave Yun Xiang."
On the other side, the white-clad demoness also woke up and said charmingly, "Ancestor, you're so bad, you didn't even ask my name."
Song Yan said, "Then what is your name?"
The white-clad demoness said, "Slave Yan Rong."
Song Yan suddenly pulled the quilt, indistinguishable who was who, and turned over to pounce on one of the demonesses.
The quilt turned into waves and suddenly started moving.
In an instant, rocks pierced the sky, raging waves hit the shore, and thousands of piles of snow were raised.
After a long while, the bed calmed down.
The curtains lifted, and a strong man walked down, wrapped himself in the Profound Robe, walked to the door of the room, turned around and said blandly, "Tomorrow you go find Wu Fangtian to retrieve a treasure you want from the sect, or a cultivation technique. Whatever it is, just say I said so. If he uses eyes to threaten you and don't dare to get good things, tell me."
After speaking, he added, "Repeat my original words."
The two demonesses, even though they had no strength, were still overjoyed and sweetly said in unison, "Thank you, Ancestor."
Song Yan opened the door and stepped out.
He quite enjoyed this environment, feeling a sense of "seize the pleasure of the moment, let not tomorrow's worries" just like every desperado licking blood off a blade.
Now, anyone who got involved with him wouldn't end too well. So, for those who had brought him joy, he would always give a bit of help.
And for those he truly appreciated, cared slightly, he would secretly protect while proactively staying away, avoiding, even making them forget about him.
He couldn't be a good person, so he didn't need good people around him. Like bad women such as Lord Li's concubine, or the scheming demonesses before him were the right women for him.
Good women, he would not harm, not covet.
If he met Junior Sister An Li once again, he probably couldn't make a move because back then he actually wanted to leave with Junior Sister An Li through the Ancient Teleportation Array, he was thinking of staying together with Junior Sister An Li for long.
But now, he understood, he accepted fate.
Song Yan arrived at the core treasure trove of the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
This treasure trove, as the Great Chu South Demon Cultivator Alliance, already had many treasures put into it, including the Blank Array Plate.
Song Yan picked through and surprisingly found a Soul Gold Stone, so he took it, and also took the corresponding Array Pattern Pen, entered the secret room, and started drawing "Little Heavenly Dao Texts - Introduction."
Even making the Array Plate, even when he did it personally, couldn't be completed without a month or two.
So, he needed to stay in this secret room for a while.
As for Tang Fan, who was imprisoned in the Celestial Prison, he didn't let him idle, instead arranged some beneficial and healthy activities for him so Little Tang won't feel bored.
This targeting was known through chatting after the other party got drunk that night.
Hope Little Tang could enjoy it.
...
...
A little over half a month later...
"Injustice has a head, debt has a master, it has nothing to do with Xing'Er, let her go!!"
Tang Fan's delicate face was full of anger, his brows furrowed, and his eyes full of flames.
He struggled desperately, but the new shackles were the Ghost Slaughter Sect's specially made shackles, once attached at the Refining Profound Level, power would be mostly suppressed.
These shackles made Tang Fan's power fall again from the "Ninth Layer of Refining Profound" to the "Fourth Layer of Refining Profound."
Not far from him, a green-clad female cultivator raised her hand to block him.
That female cultivator's tear-filled eyes were evidently the Xing'Er Tang Fan mentioned.
A group of demon cultivators surrounded the two.
A leading demon cultivator sneered, "You are the prisoner that the Ancestor instructed us to guard over strictly. But Xing'Er, as one of our Ghost Slaughter Sect, actually helped you escape.
Hehe... We can't touch you because you're the Ancestor's person. But we can't touch Xing'Er?"
Speaking, this demon cultivator stepped forward.
Xing'Er used a Profound Artifact, but was slapped away by the demon cultivator.
The demon cultivator stepped down in two steps, instantly arrived in front of Xing'Er, raised his hand firmly gripping the neck of this green-clad young lady, and said coldly, "Oh, does this little floozy have feelings too?"
Xing'Er said, "You don't understand."
The demon cultivator said, "Fine, even if I don't understand. But letting this boy go means wanting us all to die! So... don't blame me for this."
His face gradually turned hideous, fingers tightening around that white neck, seemingly the next moment it would vanish like smoke.
Xing'Er looked grievously at Tang Fan, her lips moving slightly.
Although unable to make a sound, Tang Fan could distinctly discern she was saying three words - I'm sorry.
Tang Fan was dumbfounded.
What's she apologizing for now?
Was she sorry she couldn't bring him to escape?
Laughably, he had always regarded such a woman as a demoness, coldly mocking, completely distrustful, yet the opponent still really did it.
Watching as those fingers quickly tightened, just as Xing'Er was about to die completely, Tang Fan roared, "Stop!"
The demon cultivator said indifferently, "You're not allowed to escape anymore."
Tang Fan said, "Don't escape, absolutely not!"
The demon cultivator snorted coldly, let go, tossed Xing'Er aside with a "plop" as if throwing away trash, then sinisterly smiled, "Since you like this boy so much, why not join him in the Celestial Prison."
Xing'Er coughed heavily.
Tang Fan moved closer, grabbing her hand, asked, "Are you alright?"
Xing'Er shook her head with a pale face, "I'm sorry, I..."
Tang Fan nearly jumped up in anger.
"Sorry for what? Don't be so foolish next time!"
His status was humble, he came from a difficult journey, later mixed into the Thousand Crane Sect, and was always cared for by Fang Qingmeng. To not expose his "Formless Race" identity, he didn't dare reveal too much power, so... even within the sect, he was always an ordinary young man with average talent. Coupled with his circles being incompatible with those cultivating Profound disciples, he had no friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 233: 145. Celestial Dao Characters, Seizing Opportunities (7.8K words - long chapter, please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
However, he was naturally optimistic; even though he didn't have many friends, he was always cheerful. The thing he looked forward to the most each day was bumping into Fang Qingmeng and exchanging witty banter with Fairy Fang. As for disguising himself as Crane Ancestor to come out of seclusion, this was not Song Yan's idea of "using Thousand Crane Sect as a barrier against Fox Wolf Demons," but rather he didn't want Thousand Crane Sect to perish, especially after Fang Qingmeng found him.
And Xing'Er was the second woman who treated him so well.
If he doubted Xing'Er just because she was a female cultivator from Ghost Slaughter Sect, then he wouldn't be human!
...
...
In the late autumn, dried yellow leaves quietly floated, fell, and piled up outdoors.
In the secret chamber, Song Yan raised a face-sized array plate and six flags, examined them again and again, and then let out a long sigh: "Finally done."
He looked at the array plate with a peculiar gaze.
Logically, this array should be more powerful, but it has only "nine thousand two hundred and thirteen patterns," nearly ten times less than "Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refinement" and "Five Elements Gathering Profound."
'Since it has no name, I'll give you one; let's call it "Celestial Dao Gathering Introduction Array."'
He carefully put away the array plate and stepped out of the chamber.
Soon, the top demon cultivators of the Demon Cultivator Alliance arrived to pay their respects and report on the tasks he had previously assigned to them.
These tasks were nothing but deeply exploring the "secrets of the Chu Kingdom," clarifying where treasures might be hidden, or investigating mysterious unknown forbidden areas or peculiar secret realms.
Song Yan was not careless about this.
The Three Kingdoms all hid many secrets, the Chu Kingdom couldn't have none.
The top demon cultivators reported one by one, Song Yan listened quietly and casually "generously bestowed" gifts using the Alliance's treasures. If he liked someone, he'd give more; if he didn't, he'd give less.
As for rules, fairness, standards, clear rewards and punishments?
He didn't give a damn.
Different people were treated differently.
He might even reward someone with an elixir because he found it pleasing when they stepped in with their left foot.
That's how it was.
He did this to let everyone know he, this old ancestor, wouldn't stay for long; those who desperately tried to win his favor during this time would reap the benefits.
People came extremely nervous one by one, but left joyfully.
Yun Xiang and Yan Rong once again stayed by his side, sticking to him as if seeing a beloved one after a long separation, clinging to him and refusing to leave.
Soon, a graceful woman in green entered from outside.
The woman's appearance was charming, her chest was full, and her slightly disheveled hair seemed hurriedly tied up.
The woman approached Song Yan's seat, bowed gracefully, and said sweetly, "Xing'Er, greetings to the ancestor."
Song Yan replied indifferently, "How did it go?"
Xing'Er respectfully reported all that Tang Fan had said, not skipping even the part where he cursed him as a "sly, shameless, cold-blooded, heartless old monster."
After saying that, she giggled and said, "I've given him plenty of chances, but he insists he wants to wait for a proper marriage before feeling comfortable with me and forming a partnership.
I told him I'd wait for him, no matter how long, he was deeply moved. Hehehe...
However, I actually don't want to wait. If only..."
She suddenly flashed a bright gaze, looking up with longing at Song Yan, and said coyly, "Ancestor, why don't you take me first?"
Song Yan said curiously, "He has remarkable potential, or I wouldn't be focusing on him. If he truly has feelings for you, you wouldn't cherish it?"
Xing'Er replied, "What's the point of cherishing or not cherishing him? I only know that he's the ancestor's prisoner, and afterward...he's bound to die.
How can I care about someone with potential if they're dead?
Anyway, the reason I approached him was at ancestor's arrangement. How could I lose myself and forget my task in such arrangements?
On the contrary, should I latch onto the ancestor, wouldn't there be countless benefits?
Moreover..."
She suddenly covered her mouth to act shy, her cheeks turned red immediately, her voice indescribably charming.
"The two older sisters said the ancestor truly made them experience the joy of being a woman. I'd...also want that joy."
The final word "joy" was spoken so seductively it was almost dripping with allure.
Song Yan froze for a moment, feeling that "Susu's method was indeed not solitary," and then suddenly burst into laughter, saying "Reward!"
Xing'Er joyfully raised her skirt, eager to approach.
Song Yan said, "There's no need for that, just do your work well. Yan Rong and Yun Xiang can go to the treasury and pick one item unconditionally, and this rule applies to you too. Go find Wu Fangtian."
Xing'Er's eyes flashed with disappointment, but hearing his words made her very happy again, she said coquettishly, "Thank you, ancestor."
...
...
Xing'Er's report gave Song Yan a deeper understanding of Tang Fan, such daily interactions naturally surpassed his hurried questioning after drinks.
He even knew where Tang Fan had lived as a child, the neighbors next to his family, and what embarrassing things those neighbors did.
The map of Chu Kingdom was already etched in his mind.
With a slight comparison, he discovered something interesting.
Tang Fan moved once as a child, and right after that his parents disappeared.
Before moving, it's likely that his home was just separated from Ghost Slaughter Sect by an Evil Land.
Even more coincidentally, the core material for Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refinement discovered by Sikong Seal was also found in the Evil Land...Reportedly, it was during a burst of earth energy that a peculiar material called "Soul-Gathering White Cave Crystal Jade" appeared, which they hurriedly gathered, and after years of preparation, began refining the Myriad Souls Banner.
What does that imply?

chapters.title: Chapter 234 234: 145. Celestial Dao Characters, Seizing Opportunities (7.8K words - long chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
It suggests that his parents probably encountered a mishap in this Evil Land.
This Evil Land is vast and comes with mountain miasmas, sometimes extremely difficult to distinguish, with quite a few surrounding mountain villages.
For someone in the Purple Mansion Realm, finding that place might not be a difficult task.
Tang Fan might have wanted to come and search too, but with many demon cultivators around the Evil Land, he had to be well-prepared. However, before he could act, he got captured.
In Song Yan's heart, if there is a major opportunity in the Chu Kingdom, it must not bypass Tang Fan.
As part of the mysterious Ancient Race's "Formless Clan," Tang Fan is filled with secrets.
Whether it's his background or his parents, it is all the same...
Song Yan has a vague premonition: some opportunities originally belonging to Tang Fan might fall upon him.
...
After some playful banter with Yun Xiang and Yan Rong back at the sect, Song Yan departed from the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
He lay low outside for three days, and seeing no change at the Ghost Slaughter Sect, and Tang Fan not planning to escape, he swiftly headed towards the Evil Land.
The center is hard to define, but he could still distinguish the concentration of Evil Qi.
He simply headed towards the densest Evil Qi.
During his journey, whenever he reached a secluded spot, he tested the "Little Celestial Dao Gathering Introduction Array," discovering that only when the "Wood Profound White Cave Crystal Jade" is placed at the center of the Array Plate does it pull in the thin wood attribute Profound Qi nearby, functioning almost the same as the "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array."
And if nothing is placed, the "Little Celestial Dao Gathering Introduction Array" is completely ineffective.
Song Yan wasn't discouraged; he knew he seemed to lack experiment materials, and during the engraving of the Array Plate, he vaguely sensed that his Array Plate should at least be compatible with the gathering of "Five Elements" and "Divine Soul."
Perhaps, other items can be gathered too.
But the premise is the need for corresponding "White Cave Crystal Jade."
Song Yan walked and stopped, searching everywhere, and soon time moved swiftly from late autumn to deep winter.
...
The Cang Mountain carried snow, boundless and traceless.
Suddenly, from afar came a rumbling sound, black and white mixing together, rolling down from a high place.
It was an avalanche!
Yet, in such a place, deserted in all seasons, even an avalanche would not cause any casualties.
The snow fog lifted long-standing dust.
And it seemed the avalanche triggered something, another intense tremor shook the mountains, but it stopped after just ten breaths or so.
Yet shortly after, the mountains were hit by another even fiercer vibration, succeeded by consecutive avalanches and landslides.
This went on until most of the day had passed when it finally subsided.
The landscape in the deep mountains slightly changed, the surface rocks appeared with several deep fissures, blood-colored Evil Qi seeped out from them, shrouded in pink mist, with a few strands of extremely fine slaughter liquid threads faintly visible.
Soon, a figure broke through the sky, stopping at the crack of this "geothermal eruption."
Song Yan had been searching here for nearly three months, found nothing unusual, but caught an instance of "Evil Qi eruption."
The Three Kingdoms didn't have the "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array," so no one would intentionally search for the "White Cave Jade."
But now...
After searching, Song Yan indeed saw a blood-red exterior, blank inside jade stone on a scorched land filled with rolling evil smoke.
He grabbed it urgently, and then took out the "Little Celestial Dao Gathering Introduction Array" plate.
Flags scattered all around.
The red hollow jade stone was placed on the Array Plate.
"Activate the array."
As soon as the words fell, the entire array domain seemed to transform into a monster's big mouth, starting to suck in aggressively, with evil qi frantically pouring in, instantly turning the array domain blood-red, invisible fingers.
"Hahaha!"
"Success!"
"Truly a lucky coincidence!"
Song Yan felt quite elated, not just because he found the "Slaughter Profound White Cave Crystal Jade," but because he proved that the "Little Celestial Dao Gathering Introduction Array" could gather more than just "Five Elements" and "Divine Soul."
As long as you insert the corresponding "White Cave Crystal Jade," it can help you gather the corresponding object.
With this "Slaughter Profound White Cave Crystal Jade," his power in battles can increase by one or two percent!
Song Yan was about to collect the array flags when his eyes suddenly narrowed.
In the distance, where a cleft originally filled with evil qi had been cleared by his array, revealed a deep narrow opening inside.
The narrow opening was only about half the length of a branch, but extremely deep.
Song Yan immediately extended his Divine Sense, probing inside, he saw a cave, vaguely with a qi shield inside which lay three skeletons.
The skeletons piled together, two skulls facing outward, and the last one was crushed at the very bottom, indistinguishable.
He was genuinely stunned for a moment.
If not for the avalanche, if not for his array to clear the evil qi here, he wouldn't have discovered this cave.
No one would discover it.
He instantly collected the array flags, grabbing with his right hand, and swiftly cracked open the rocks above the cave, then leapt inside.
Clatter...
Clatter clatter...
Rocks rolled, but when they hit that cave's qi shield, they bounced off again.
Song Yan glanced at the qi shield, instantly recognizing it as the most basic "Isolation Array," its function simple: defense, internal and external isolation.
Song Yan's gaze swept over the three skeletons already turned to bones, his vision suddenly landing on some strange red powder on the skeletons.
He frowned slightly, unable to deduce anything.
This red powder was something he had never seen.
Suddenly, he felt a strange staring sensation, this feeling coming from the skeletons.
As this feeling emerged, the skeletons suddenly began to move, with evil qi rising among their bones!
Blood-red slaughter liquid even emerged at the joints of the bones!
It was like a white armored blood light "bang" fiercely hitting the array shield, shattering the entire defense shield, then directly rushing towards Song Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 235: 145. Celestial Dao Characters, Seizing Opportunities (7.8K words - large chapter seeking subscription)_5
chapters.content:
It seemed that Song Yan had a fatal attraction to it.
This ghostly creature had been sealed here for who knows how many years, perhaps due to the undetectable darkness, lying dormant... yet it reemerged into the light because of Song Yan's intervention.
Time seemed to slow down, and what soared into the air was not a single skeleton, but a "fusion of three" skeletons.
This skeleton had three heads and six arms, but it wasn't the evenly distributed kind traditionally known, instead, it was a ruleless skull demon.
Suspended mid-air, the skull demon faced Song Yan with two of its heads filled with red qi, while the last head was turned away from him.
If Song Yan, who hadn't yet broken through the Purple Mansion Realm, faced this ghostly thing, he might have turned to flee.
But now...
In a single thought, two shadows emerged from nothingness.
Song Yan slightly backed away, and the two shadows, containing his Late-stage Crimson Palace power, immediately lunged out.
However, the expected loud crash did not happen where it should have but landed on a distant stone wall, causing the earth to shake, rocks to roll, and dust to rise!
Amidst the smoke, a ghastly red shadow rushed at him with indescribable speed.
The skull demon had actually dodged his attack!
At that moment, whether in speed, skill, or power, it had reached a terrifying level.
Whoosh!
The Blood Evil Bone Hand aimed directly at Song Yan's face, and blood-colored slaughter liquid burst forth from between the bones, enveloping Song Yan entirely.
The amount of this slaughter liquid was even more than when the Evil Land had erupted with earth energy!
In the next instant...
Boom!!
A flawless loud crash ensued.
The violent Evil Qi suddenly dispersed.
The skull demon shattered!
Yet Song Yan felt no joy of success, for he saw among the dust, some red powder rising.
This red powder rose as if it were alive, rushing toward him.
In the blink of an eye, he raised his hand and directly summoned a coffin.
Slam!
The coffin lid opened, revealing the corpse of Sikong Seal.
Song Yan raised his right hand sharply, quickly beckoning to the red powder.
The speed of the red powder slowed, its trajectory twisted, changing from "toward Song Yan" to "toward the corpse of Sikong Seal."
Yet the red powder seemed unwilling, still trying to rush at Song Yan.
After a brief tug of war, it finally drilled into the "corpse of Sikong Seal," whose originally closed eyes suddenly opened, a pair of eyes rolling around and then becoming still, staring fixedly at Song Yan.
Slam!
The coffin lid closed!
Song Yan put it back into the storage bag.
At the instant this ghostly thing went into the storage bag, Song Yan confirmed his thought: this red powder was Fixed Evil.
Only things devoid of a Divine Soul can be stored in the storage bag; evil is merely cause and effect fragments combined with Profound Qi, although innately desiring to seize bodies, it itself has no Divine Soul.
The air suddenly became quiet, with only the mountains reverberating from the recent disturbance.
He had actually been forced to use the Skin Master's unique "Summoning."
After a brief moment of silence, Song Yan sighed inwardly: 'Just this little bit of Fixed Evil is so terrifying, I wonder what the scene is like inside Changwang's Soul Threshold.'
He quickly scanned the surroundings, his gaze landing on an intact object amidst the shattered skeleton pieces.
It was a mask.
Song Yan picked it up, examined it briefly, and then probed it with the striped mark of the Changwang Tiger, finding no abnormalities, before inserting a wisp of Divine Sense inside.
Several pieces of information surfaced.
He temporarily put it aside, leaping to a relatively stable place on a distant mountain, then took it out again for a closer look.
After a long while, he understood.
This mask was called the "Faceless Mask," an important inheritance of the Formless Race.
The Formless Race had a peculiar rule.
Partners could only be chosen within the clan, and marriage must result in offspring, with only two offspring allowed.
Why?
Simply because the "Faceless Mask" worn by the parents would be passed down to the next generation.
This mask stored all the "Magic" information collected by this lineage.
The Formless Race learned magic extremely quickly, and having this mask was like adding wings to a tiger.
Song Yan held the mask with a strange expression.
Alas.
He had indeed seized the fortuitous opportunity that belonged to Tang Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 236: 146. Formless Ancient Ancestor, A Wedding Banquet (8.1K characters - Big Chapter, Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
At the snow-clad peak, Song Yan held the Faceless Mask. Even though he had already thoroughly scanned it with his Divine Sense, he still dared not put on this type of treasure mask lightly. Therefore, he spent more time moving toward the edge of the Evil Land, looking for a suitable person to help him test the mask.
Whenever he could mitigate risk by passing time, he would persistently do so.
On this day, with the first clear skies after the snow, a mysterious village faintly emerged in the distance. The autumn straw stacks covered in snow were no taller than a person's height, settled in the golden, warm sunlight, exuding a cozy charm.
Children ran around the stacks, their faces rosy, throwing snowballs with laughter echoing from afar...
This scene suddenly calmed Song Yan, an inexplicable lightness filled his heart, and a joyful smile appeared on his lips.
But then he couldn't help but wonder, why is there a mortal village here?
After a moment of reflection, he suddenly realized that he had long crossed the entirety of the Evil Land along with its mountains and had arrived on the other side of the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
This was a place known as "Nanhua City."
Calling it "Nanhua City" might be unfamiliar, but if one said it was where the Southern Sect of the Thousand Crane Sect was established, it would be much more well-known.
The Thousand Crane Sect is the National Guardian Sect of Chu Kingdom; the Northern Sect is based in the Imperial Capital. Even though the Southern Sect was only attempting establishment, it would only do so in a large city in Chu Kingdom situated on a Profound Vein.
This city is Nanhua City.
Unknowingly, he had arrived here.
Song Yan shook his head, not believing that there was anyone here "suitable to help him test the Faceless Mask."
But holding onto a sense of possibility, he released his Divine Sense and started searching while walking.
...
In a dim little grove.
Three demon cultivators gazed toward the distant city while exchanging ideas quickly.
"The Thousand Crane Sect wants to establish a sect here; did they ask us?"
"Though the Demon Cultivator Alliance is powerful, we can't allow this Thousand Crane Sect to rise!"
"I've heard that the old ancestor of the Ghost Slaughter Sect is incredibly generous, rewarding anyone who accomplishes something significantly. Why don't we lay an ambush around Nanhua City to see if we can catch a lone wanderer? We can interrogate them about the city's situation, which would count as a great deed."
"Great idea, it's not hard to do, sooner or later someone will do it, but if we act first, we'll surely be rewarded. Heh heh heh..."
"Everyone, be alert and see which unfortunate soul comes out soon. If none, let's capture a nice Furnace..."
Before the words could finish, they were unable to continue.
Because suddenly, a person clad in a Profound Robe appeared before the three demon cultivators.
Wrapped in a face-covering cloak, just appearing made the three unable to breathe or move, as if frozen.
But what froze them was not the cold, but a shiver emanating from their Divine Souls.
To them, the terrifying awe was beyond the King, resembling a Demon God.
The Demon God threw out a mask.
The demon cultivators, almost involuntarily, caught it.
The Demon God said calmly, "Put it on."
The demon cultivator dared not, yet the words of the Demon God seemed to have an enchanting force; he didn't dare disobey, not even daring to utter a few words of plea.
Fear and awe had already caused him to lose the ability to speak.
The demon cultivator's mind went blank, yet his hand obeyed the Demon God, obediently putting on the mask.
After a few moments, nothing happened.
Song Yan said, "Try it."
The demon cultivator quickly began to try.
In an instant, his face began to change at will, sometimes male, sometimes female, sometimes another form. Though his physique did not change, and his realm aura remained the same, the changing face showed no flaws that even Song Yan could discern.
In other words, even if this demon cultivator truly transformed into a female face before him, unless he got very close and carefully explored with his hands and Divine Sense, he absolutely could not tell the face was fake.
Song Yan said, "What else?"
The demon cultivator panted for a while, then said, "Cultivation... techniques, so... many."
Song Yan said, "Anything else?"
The demon cultivator shook his head.
Song Yan waited a moment longer, removed the Faceless Mask from that demon cultivator's face, and also tried it on the other two. Once confirming nothing was amiss, he split light into three strands with a sword, the Bone-Eroding Sword Qi instantly activating, turning the three into three pools of putrid water. Then he slowly placed the Faceless Mask onto his own face.
Upon a slight attempt, he indeed found his face changing at will, far surpassing the Illusion Techniques of the Multi-tailed Fox Race in sophistication.
Although his body shape could not change, and his aura could not be concealed, the face's appearance, once altered, was extraordinarily hard to detect.
The demon cultivator he just killed had power only at the Refining Profound Level, but after putting on the Faceless Mask and altering his appearance, even though Song Yan was at the Purple Mansion Realm, he still couldn't distinguish that something was wrong with that person's face.
This indeed was somewhat terrifying, truly deserving of the title "Formless."
For him, this was extremely "fitting." Although it couldn't completely replace "Illusion Technique," it was safer and more reliable; even if in the presence of a mighty one, it couldn't be seen through.
Moreover, hidden within this mask was a small Divine Soul World, inside resembling a tower-like Library Pavilion.
Song Yan quickly observed, finding that there weren't a massive number of techniques, yet there were still many, comparable to a sect's library, with the key point being "the upper limit of magic here is quite high."
Refining Profound, Crimson Palace were included.
Early, middle, and late stage of Purple Mansion were there.
Even the Divine Infant was included.
In other words, with this mask, Song Yan lacked nothing in cultivation techniques and could cultivate all the way to the Divine Infant Realm.
He arrived at the Early Stage of Purple Mansion shelf and quickly pulled out three spell books.

chapters.title: Chapter 237 237: 146. Ancient Formless Ancestor, A Wedding Banquet (8.1K characters - Big Chapter, Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Volume One: "Canxing Finger".
Volume Two: "Heaven-Shaking Hand".
Volume Three: "Mountain and River Bow".
These three volumes, each is rather profound, and all are about the use of power at the Early Stage of Purple Mansion.
Song Yan quickly scanned through them.
The "Canxing Finger" enables killing intent to be less rigid, less easy to dodge, and when cultivated to the highest level, can even form an array, trapping people. With every use, the opponent's standing area shrinks, trying to escape? No way.
If Zhang Han had mastered this technique back then, Song Yan would have had no chance of a counterattack because... he would have been trapped the first time Zhang Han struck, unable to get close.
The "Heaven-Shaking Hand" allows a cultivator to unleash a killing intent far beyond the ordinary in a short period of time, condensing it into a spot and dropping it from the sky, with incredible power.
Compared to the Blood Hand Song Yan learned from the "Ghost Infant Scripture", the Blood Hand is like a "chicken claw", while the Heaven-Shaking Hand is like a "bear paw".
The "Mountain and River Bow" is a technique specifically targeting the Early Stage of Purple Mansion technique "Sitting in Profound Heart". As the name suggests, Mountain and River Bow, uses mountains and rivers as the bow, and killing intent as the arrow. Once drawn, both the range and power are extremely terrifying.
However, sitting in Profound Heart is a prerequisite. Because only when you sit in Profound Heart, borrowing the power of the mountains and rivers, can you perform this technique.
Song Yan felt a sense of joy in his heart.
These three magic techniques truly filled the predicament of him "entering the Purple Mansion without techniques to use".
He looked up at the bookshelf of magic techniques for the Middle Stage of Purple Mansion, only to find a barrier separating it.
After a bit of thought, he understood.
Without reaching the realm, you're not allowed to see it.
This is also a measure by the ancestors of the Formless Race to prevent descendants from pursuing grandiose goals or going astray.
But as Song Yan looked away, he suddenly noticed something peculiar.
At the top of this Early Stage bookshelf, there seemed to be a blur of mist.
Within the mist, there was vaguely a book lying quietly.
He couldn't make out the name, but judging by its appearance and placement, it's likely above "Canxing Finger", "Heaven-Shaking Hand", and "Mountain and River Bow".
He then looked in the direction of the Crimson Palace Realm and found that all bookshelves had such a special place, and behind some mists, there were even two or three books.
After a brief thought, he quickly raised his hand to grasp it.
But as soon as he touched the mist, it flared up like oil meeting fire, spreading instantly, turning from quietly floating to a roaring surge, forming a sesame-sized golden dot.
This golden dot, Song Yan remembered, was similar to what emerged from the body of Madam Zhu after he killed her.
Memories flashed by, and the dot rapidly expanded, like a magic trick, transforming into a kind-faced old man with white hair.
And the books disappeared with him.
Song Yan looked at the white-haired old man.
The old man also looked at him.
Suddenly, Song Yan respectfully bowed and said, "Junior Tang Fan greets senior. I wonder if senior is an ancestor of my Formless Race?"
The old man looked at him, with a benevolent expression no longer there, frowning as he said, "If you are truly my descendant, how could you be without our clan's innate inheritance? How could you fail to touch this top-level Secret Technique without waking me?"
Song Yan looked at this old thing, speculating internally, it seemed like this was a strong predecessor from Tang Fan's lineage in the Formless Ancient Race, locking his intent into a Faceless Mask before the end of his life, to guide descendants, becoming a "grandfather-at-hand".
However, he was not afraid, and after a long sigh, he said with shame, "It was taken by thieves, a shame to ancestors."
The old man was stunned for a moment and said, "Explain in detail."
Saying more means more mistakes, so naturally, Song Yan wouldn't say anything complicated. He only mentioned that the Fox Wolf from the south of the Chu Kingdom was causing chaos, forcing him to flee south for safety. During this, he developed feelings for a girl named Xing'Er, who then took him to a place for a date, after which he unexpectedly fell unconscious. When he woke up, he found that he no longer had the innate inheritance of the Formless Race.
The old man asked with a gloomy face, "What sect does Xing'Er belong to?"
Song Yan was silent for a while and said, "Ancestor, though Xing'Er is a Demon Cultivator from the Ghost Slaughter Sect, she is not a bad person and would never harm me. Moreover, when I woke up, I found Xing'Er unconscious as well, with signs of Soul Search. If it weren't for her luck, she would have long gone mad."
He spoke with some excitement.
The old man lowered his gaze, his expression unpredictable. After a long silence, he sighed and said, "Just like your father."
Since they talked about "Tang Fan's father", Song Yan began to delve into memories.
He wouldn't originally know these memories, but unfortunately, a lovesick man and woman in the Celestial Prison had too much to talk about, so... Xing'Er had already shared much about Tang Fan's childhood during their chats.
And now, these memories became Song Yan's talking points.
In the end, he sighed, "Back then, my parents suddenly disappeared, and I moved with the villagers. All these years, I don't know where my parents are."
The old man asked, "Then where did you find this mask?"
Song Yan had long been prepared, saying he returned to search and found it in the Evil Land after an earthquake. Then he excitedly asked about any news of his parents.
The old man said, "In my Formless Race, marriage is only allowed among clan members, but your father fell in love with an outsider, then left for a distant land under a disguised identity. Fortunately, they had you, and you still have our innate inheritance.
Your father was not ambitious and was eventually plotted against by a close Formless Race servant, resulting in your parents' death at the servant's hands. But that servant was also killed by your father after claiming success."

chapters.title: Chapter 238 238: 146. Ancient Formless Ancestor, A Wedding Banquet (8.1K characters - Big Chapter, Subscription Requested)_3
chapters.content:
Your father should have been in the Formless Race, but he ended up here because of a woman.
Unexpectedly, you are the same.
The heavens are vast and boundless. How did my lineage of Feng Chengzi end up like this?
Why? Why? I'm truly unsettled!"
Song Yan lowered his head and muttered, "So this is how it is," but immediately clenched his fist, looked up towards the thought of the ancient ancestor of the Formless Race who called himself Feng Chengzi, and said, "Even without the Innate Inheritance, I, Tang Fan, can still achieve the Great Path!"
Feng Chengzi gently stroked his white beard, quietly watching him.
Song Yan's eyes were filled with determination and vigor, a vigor that belonged to a fearless young man.
For a long time...
Feng Chengzi said, "Good!"
Then he continued, "Cultivating Profound depends on talent and fortune, but also on personal effort and mentality. You have endured hardships, lost your talents, but gained in mentality. Perhaps... you can truly walk a path that our Formless Ancient Race has never walked before."
Song Yan clenched his fist and said, "The things I have lost, I will retrieve them with my own hands!"
Feng Chengzi showed a relieved smile, praising three times, "Good, good, good!"
After praising, he said again, "Good child, I will now teach you the Secret Technique for the Refinement of the mask, allowing it to connect with your Divine Soul, manifesting and retracting at will, so as to prevent the coveting of those with ill intent."
Song Yan respectfully said, "Please speak, Ancestor. I will listen attentively."
A moment later, a Secret Technique entered Song Yan's mind.
This Secret Technique, possibly because it only pertains to the "Special Refining Technique of the Faceless Mask," was not displayed directly on the panel.
Feng Chengzi nodded and said, "Good child, now begin the refinement. The key technique here is to separate a part of your Divine Soul, touch the core area of the Divine Soul Book Pavilion, and thus incorporate it into your Divine Soul."
Song Yan nodded slightly.
He closed his eyes slightly and silently recited, 'With this Secret Technique, refine the Faceless Mask.'
[Your Divine Soul enters the Faceless Mask, guided by the thought of the Human Ancient Race Divine Infant, it enters the core area of the Faceless Mask. Just as you are about to touch the core area, the thought of the Human Ancient Race Divine Infant suppresses you. You begin to transform into an Artifact Slave of the Faceless Mask...returning life span]
Song Yan opened his eyes and glanced at the kindly Feng Chengzi beside him.
The old man wasn't in a hurry, nor did he urge, only brimming with expectations for the younger generation.
Song Yan couldn't help but think to himself, 'Old thing, your acting skills are truly superb. I didn't see a single flaw.'
Seeing his hesitation, Feng Chengzi encouraged again, "Good child, don't be nervous, reconsider the steps I taught you. If there are any mistakes, I am here and won't let you fail."
Song Yan pondered slightly, suddenly had a flash of inspiration, and closed his eyes again, silently reciting, 'With this Secret Technique, together with the Myriad Souls Banner, refine the Faceless Mask.'
Instantly, new information emerged.
[You wield the Myriad Souls Banner, more than twenty thousand evil spirits follow the Secret Technique into the Faceless Mask. You blend among them, easily arriving at the core area and touching that place. However, you were unable to refine the Faceless Mask because the core area is not there. The thought of the Human Ancient Race Divine Infant was deterred among the evil spirits; though hindered, because it was always near the designated core area, it swiftly reached you. It grabs you and suppresses you. You begin to transform into an Artifact Slave of the Faceless Mask...returning life span]
Song Yan: ...
Truly worthy of being an old thing.
Even with just a thought remaining, it's hard to hear a single truth!
One trap after another.
He continued to try.
[You wield the Myriad Souls Banner, more than twenty thousand evil spirits follow the Secret Technique into the Faceless Mask. You blend among them, seizing the chaos to start exploring the true core area. You failed...]
[You failed again...]
[You failed once more...]
After failing a full thirteen times, the outcome finally changed.
[You succeeded, you found the true core area. You have completely refined the Faceless Mask. Although the thought of the Human Ancient Race Divine Infant could not be refined by you, it can no longer cause any harm to you.]
Feng Chengzi was still encouraging him.
"Good child, you are the descendant of Tangfeng City. After refining the Faceless Mask, we will join forces to retrieve the things you have lost and return to the Formless Race together."
Song Yan nodded and said, "Alright, I will try my best."
Feng Chengzi smiled reassuringly and nodded repeatedly.
In the next instant, Song Yan raised his hand to disperse the "Traceless Array" around him.
Although this Array was already "outdated," it was still quite useful in "blocking vision."
The Myriad Souls Banner's power was immense, and even with his utmost control, it was bound to cause a stir.
But with this Array, it would be much better.
In an instant, an invisible barrier rose up, separating everything within.
In the next moment, his right hand grabbed in the Void, pulling out a banner emitting evil black smoke, which he waved in the wind. The banner grew to a length and was thrust into the ground.
Woo-woo ghost cries immediately echoed, countless distorted and elongated evil souls flew out from the banner, densely packed, resembling a black tide crossing a river. Rolling thick smoke like wolf smoke filled the Traceless Array, blotting out the sky.
Song Yan raised a finger to the Faceless Mask.
Swish swish swish!
Swish swish swish!
Countless evil spirits obeyed the command and frantically drilled into the Faceless Mask.
Feng Chengzi was initially waiting for Song Yan to enter. Upon seeing the first Divine Soul enter, he was slightly delighted, but that joy was immediately frozen, chilling to the core.
Endless evil souls appeared before him like a tidal wave.
Song Yan naturally entered with the ghost tide, unhesitatingly heading straight for the correct refining location.
Upon seeing the ghost tide, Feng Chengzi knew that the facade was over, and angrily shouted, "Acting against nature, condemned by heaven and earth! You devil, knowing so much about Xiao Fan's affairs, Xiao Fan probably met a mishap long ago! Today, with me here, you shall never refine the Faceless Mask!"

chapters.title: Chapter 239 239: 146. Ancient Formless Ancestor, A Wedding Banquet (8.1K characters - Big Chapter, Subscription Requested)_4
chapters.content:
After speaking, the white-haired elder quickly darted towards the so-called "false core".
Upon reaching the "false core", he guarded it desperately, fending off the attacking ghosts one by one, as if he was afraid Song Yan might come over.
Even now, he was still fishing.
But Song Yan had already reached the correct "true core".
It didn't take long for the Faceless Mask to truly integrate into his Divine Soul.
This inheritance from the Ancient Race, imbued with the thoughts of the Divine Infant, was clearly extraordinary, and it was the first time Song Yan had encountered such a method hidden within the Divine Soul.
He stood within the Divine Soul Book Pavilion of the Faceless Mask, waved his hand, retrieved the ghosts from the Myriad Souls Banner, and then smiled at the distant white-haired elder, saying with a slight bow, "Junior Zhang Han, greets Senior Feng Chengzi."
The white-haired elder looked at him coldly.
At this moment, he already understood that the Faceless Mask, which belonged solely to his lineage, had truly changed its master.
This had never happened in the history of the Formless Race!
A feeling of "great humiliation" emerged from his thoughts.
If his thoughts weren't geared towards "mentoring juniors", and incapable of killing, he would have already torn the wicked thief before him to pieces and scattered his bones to the wind.
He snorted coldly and said, "The magic outside is for you to see, but don't even think about touching the core secret techniques!!
You wicked thief, I feel sullied just by looking at you another second!
I won't bother anymore, I shall go sleep, and once I wake up, you wicked thief will likely have met your tragic end.
When the next person finds the Faceless Mask, then I'll have a chat with them."
As he said this, Feng Chengzi was about to disappear.
However, he suddenly paused.
Because Song Yan uttered a single sentence that stopped him.
Song Yan said, "Tang Fan isn't dead, let me take you to see him."
Feng Chengzi sneered, "Do you think I would believe that?
As for making a fake Tang Fan appear, you're overthinking it.
Every Formless Race person born, their parents will awaken the ancestor within the mask, to have the ancestor remember the descendant's aura.
Even after many years, as long as the name and aura match, it's still accurate, the inheritance continues."
Song Yan smiled and said, "I swear I'm not lying, besides... it won't take long. What do you say, senior?"
Feng Chengzi was silent for a long time, then suddenly said, "If Tang Fan is alive, you'd definitely use him to threaten me.
If I pass the secret technique to you and teach you cultivation, you still wouldn't keep Tang Fan.
Do you think I am foolish enough to make such a deal with you?"
Song Yan said, "I really can't guarantee Tang Fan can survive because he's already involved in a bigger event.
But I promise, I will ensure he leaves behind descendants before he departs.
Afterward, even within that event, I will try my best to protect him."
Feng Chengzi asked, "What bigger event?"
Song Yan replied, "Changwang Soul Threshold."
Feng Chengzi asked in amazement, "Changwang Soul Threshold, what kind of Soul Threshold is it?"
Song Yan explained the matters regarding the "Changwang Tiger Race" one by one, and after Feng Chengzi finished listening, his expression changed drastically, and he said sternly, "If you can just prevent Tang Fan from going, then I will make a deal with you.
I may not know what kind of danger lies within such a place, but the upper limit of the danger is too high and unpredictable.
Let alone Tang Fan, even if you, the demon, go, there's barely a chance for survival!
How will you protect him?!
How could you possibly protect him??
You take Tang Fan and flee, and I'll help you!"
Song Yan said, "If I could run, I would've already run, but I can't."
Feng Chengzi fell silent once again.
After a long time, he said, "After you let me see Tang Fan, I will grant you the secret techniques corresponding to your current realm, and you must find a way for Tang Fan to leave descendants, and then... do your best to protect him in the Changwang Soul Threshold.
If Tang Fan survives and leaves the Changwang Soul Threshold, then I will provide the subsequent secret techniques, which you may view when your realm is reached.
By then, with Tang Fan in hand, you don't need to fear me going back on my word.
Aside from that, I still don't trust you; now that you've become the master of the Faceless Mask, you have the authority to access the external permissions.
From now on, activate the permissions so I can see with my own eyes, watch your surroundings, to prevent any further deception.
Is that not too much to ask?"
Song Yan laughed, "Not at all."
With a thought, the outside scenery fell into Feng Chengzi's sight.
...
Winter's snow, the forest all white.
The Myriad Souls Banner was retracted, and several puddles of rotting water vanished into the mud.
The sunset fell from between the tall trees, casting a vivid red hue across the snowy ground.
Song Yan ignored the old man within the mask, pulled on his hood again, and glanced in the direction of Nanhua City, suddenly pausing for a moment.
Because on the distant city wall, Flying Swords suddenly streamed out, each line like Immortal Cranes soaring into the clouds, reflecting the twilight glow, carrying a hint of ethereal immortal aura, led by Fang Qingmeng.
Behind Fang Qingmeng was Li Huai.
The two stood together on a Flying Sword.
Li Huai was extremely tense, remaining motionless at the back of the Flying Sword.
And from within the city gate emerged a carriage, which stopped beneath the Flying Sword, its curtains lifted, revealing a group of familiar people to Song Yan.
Xiao Huan, Shuang Yun, along with three children...
They all waved toward the sky, with smiles and anticipation.
The originally tense Li Huai seemed to sense something, also lowered his head, and waved below.
Song Yan stood afar, silently watching their smiles, and smiled along, murmuring in his heart, "Goodbye."
Everything he saw was naturally also seen by Feng Chengzi.
And just as Feng Chengzi thought this demon might charge forward to kill, Song Yan suddenly turned around, heading towards the direction of the Evil Land.
He wanted to pass through the Evil Land and return to the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
Feng Chengzi asked in confusion, "Zhang Han, what are you here for? To attack that city, act as a scout? It doesn't seem so; those little guys leaving the city, you could crush them with a wave of your hand. Is there a strong presence in the city?"

chapters.title: Chapter 240 240: 146. Ancient Formless Ancestor, A Wedding Banquet (8.1K characters - Big Chapter, Subscription Requested)_5
chapters.content:
"Song Yan said, "You should wait to see Fanzi."
...
...
Over half a month later.
Ghost Slaughter Sect.
Celestial Prison.
"Stop! What are you doing?"
"The ancestor just returned. He said you're important to him. Xing'Er tried to save you, which is severe. So... naturally, we must kill her as a warning to others."
"Ancestor? Which ancestor? Zhang Han?"
"Presumptuous! You dare speak the ancestor's name?!"
