"Heh... hahahaha... I want to see him." Tang Fan laughed angrily, looking at the indifferent demon cultivator outside the cage, he shouted sternly, "Otherwise, without lifting a finger, I can make your soul scatter!"
The demon cultivator said, "What do you want to do?"
Tang Fan said, "Even though my realm has fallen, and I can't escape. But if I don't want to live anymore, there are still ways to achieve that. Guess, if something happens to me, will the ancestor you speak of skin you and draw your tendons?"
The demon cultivator was stunned, his expression changed several times, clearly starting to panic.
Tang Fan looked at the dragged Xing'Er, said coldly, "Aren't you letting her go? Then... I want to see Zhang Han!"
The demon cultivator's eyes swiveled back and forth, hurriedly waving his hand.
Xing'Er was pushed back into the cage, stumbled to Tang Fan's side, silently shedding tears.
Tang Fan raised his hand, protecting her shoulder, said gently, "It's okay now, it's okay."
Meanwhile, the demon cultivator outside hurriedly left to report.
...
A moment later...
Filthy Tang Fan, his hands bound, entered a luxurious warm pavilion, where the fierce Profound Robe man sat prominently, legs splayed out, a charming young lady beside him, occasionally feeding him fruit.
Seemingly aware of his presence, the fierce Profound Robe man shifted his gaze, smiled and asked, "Little Tang, are you not used to the prison?"
Tang Fan said coldly, "Release Xing'Er."
Song Yan was silent.
Tang Fan said, "To you, Xing'Er is merely a dispensable minor figure, you should release her."
Song Yan raised his hand, gesturing, "Come forward."
Tang Fan grunted coldly but complied, stepping forward.
Once standing before Song Yan, Song Yan shook his legs, arching his plump, soft rear.
Yun Xiang and Yan Rong understood, giggled and stood up, gave Song Yan a slight bow, then retreated.
Song Yan looked at Tang Fan, Feng Chengzi was also looking.
Song Yan asked silently, "Elder, have you seen clearly?"
Feng Chengzi nodded, then said, "If you break your oath or raise your prices. No matter if you kill Little Fan or even his descendants, I will never frown, nor waste more words with you."
Song Yan said, "Naturally," then looked at Tang Fan, brushed the dust off his clothes, said, "Xing'Er is just a demoness, how much do you know of her? How do you know she's not out to harm you?"
Tang Fan said, "There are things you wouldn't understand."
Song Yan quietly watched him.
Tang Fan met his gaze without flinching.
For a moment, Song Yan hesitated, his intended mocking words unsaid.
He stood up, patted Tang Fan on the shoulder, said, "Then marry her.
You will accompany me to the Soul Threshold of the Pack King, and this journey, who knows if you can return.
Among the three unfilial acts, having no heir is the greatest.
Leave behind offspring, I will have Wu Fangtian treat them as his own and train them well."
Tang Fan was stunned.
Song Yan said, "If you don't agree, I'll have Xing'Er killed, anyway... she's not of much value."
Tang Fan was silent for a long time, amidst the sighs of ancient Faceless Mask, Feng Chengzi, resolutely said, "I agree, but... I still need to ask Xing'Er, if she agrees, then it's okay."
Song Yan said, "Alright, as you wish."
Tang Fan deeply bowed, simply said, "Thank you."
With that, he turned and left, back straight.
"Foolish! Utterly foolish!" Feng Chengzi roared angrily, at first thinking Tang Fan's performance was an act, but astonishingly... he nailed the essence with perfection!
Song Yan said, "He's a good youth, I'm beginning to like him."
...
Seven days later.
Auspicious day.
The yin-filled Ghost Slaughter Sect rarely embraced festivity.
Red ribbons danced, "Double Happiness" pasted, amidst firecrackers, fireworks surged to the sky like springs, their colorful hues illuminating, warming the early spring night.
Xing'Er, clad in red makeup, was breathtaking.
Tang Fan, however, was in this evil cult's stronghold raising his glass, mingling with others, drinking heavily, recklessly.
He drank until tears fell, yet continued drinking.
He was drunk.
Drunk, he knew nothing.
Suddenly, Xing'Er felt moved, quietly stepped behind a fake mountain, saw Song Yan gazing at the moon, said coquettishly, "Ancestor, he's drunk, should Xing'Er attend to you?"
Song Yan looked at her coldly, said, "If you betray him, I will not spare you."
Xing'Er was startled, frightened, repeatedly said "Yes," then returned to the banquet, stood elegantly, silently awaited the night's end.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 241: 147. Leaving Great Chu, Chang Wang Outer Domain (8.1K words - large chapter seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Late at night...
In the bedchamber, Song Yan and two demonesses indulged in a fervent union, like two phoenixes and a dragon chasing each other in the waves, only calming down after a long time.
He casually embraced one demoness, took a short rest, then got off the bed and headed towards the cultivation secret chamber.
At this moment, Tang Fan should be in the bridal chamber, giving birth to offspring amidst debauched ecstasy.
Tang Fan had no choice.
Nor did he.
In times like this, Feng Chengzi was naturally shielded from external permissions.
Song Yan opened the stone door and sat cross-legged in the center stone platform of the cultivation chamber.
It was a stone platform engraved with skulls, situated at a good position of the profound vein here.
Just a while ago, he had spent 580 years of lifespan perfecting the "Canxing Finger" and "Heaven-Shaking Hand," and another 1045 years selecting and cultivating 15 useful magics from previous Crimson Palace Techniques, perfecting them as well.
One must admit, a single branch of the Formless Ancient Race's heritage is far richer than that of the Nanwu Sword Sect or the Puppet Sect.
Among these 15 Crimson Palace Techniques were "Fire Escape," "Gen Earth Escape," "Wood Escape," "Golden Light Escape," "Profound Wind Escape," each specializing in different aspects apart from the Five Elements, as well as the routine "Profound Wind Escape" independent of the Five Elements. This allowed him to escape faster than anyone else regardless of the environment.
As for the remaining eleven techniques, they were scattered, each with its own wonders...
Among them was a special secret technique known as the "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman," which had extraordinary effects.
This "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman" is a special magic created by an ancient cultivator, with the minimum requirement to cast being: Late stage Of Crimson Palace Realm.
This magic uses one's own blood to cast, imprinting it into targets whose realm is lower than their own. With others' cooperation, it can be converted into "blood slaves."
For blood slaves, having this "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman" makes cultivation significantly more effective. The stronger the master's blood, the greater the cultivation results.
However, what they must offer is absolute loyalty, for the master only needs a thought to turn the "blood slave talisman" planted within them into a life-taking talisman, causing it to explode and make them perish instantly.
But for the caster, there is also a slight cost, which is the loss of blood.
Though "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman" doesn't require core essence blood to cast, it cannot be cast with ordinary blood either. If the blood explodes, it impacts the caster slightly. As long as there are only a dozen instances, it's manageable. But if the number grows, it leads to real damage.
Moreover, if the combined power of all the "blood slaves" exceeds that of the master, it can cause a certain backlash; if close to the master, it can cause a strange sense of oppression for the master.
Therefore, the "blood slave talisman" is destined not to enslave targets in large numbers and cannot enslave multiple targets only slightly lower than oneself.
Yet, even so, it remains remarkably effective.
You must understand, items like the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" can only control three people, and require a "Hell Floating Life Bracelet" as a medium, whereas the blood slave ancient talisman saves all that trouble for direct control.
If this secret technique is used in combat, it naturally has little effect. But if used to seize control of a local power to root oneself quickly, it's particularly effective.
In the secret chamber...
Song Yan raised his hand to demonstrate.
In the void, magic flowed continuously, eventually fading into nothingness.
...
A month later...
Song Yan sensed signs of life in Xing'Er's womb.
And Feng Chengzi not only sensed the little life but also perceived the unique divine soul fluctuation of the Formless Ancient Race from this small life, which made the Ancient Formless Ancestor ecstatic.
Xing'Er looked anxiously at this ancestor.
She instinctively wanted to further allure the ancestor.
But remembering what the ancestor said to her before, and her foolish husband's attitude during this period, she hesitated, standing obediently for the first time.
In front of Feng Chengzi, Song Yan raised his finger, pointed at Xing'Er's forehead, and a drop of scalding blood seeped from his fingertip, then began to inscribe the "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman" on her forehead.
"Old... Ancestor... did Xing'Er do something wrong?" Xing'Er panicked and asked.
Song Yan said solemnly, "Focus your mind, concentrate on absorbing it, it's beneficial for you."
"Yes..."
Moments later, a blood slave ancient talisman was branded into Xing'Er's forehead.
Song Yan said, "From now on, your cultivation will be twice as effective with half the effort, and even breaking through the Crimson Palace Realm will be more promising than others. However, your life is now completely in my hands. With a single thought, even from thousands of miles away, I can kill you."
Seeing Xing'Er's frightened and uneasy look, Song Yan added, "Take good care of the child in your womb, raise it well, and you'll have nothing to worry about."
Xing'Er looked up at the ancestor before her, only to feel an odd connection forming between them, a perception of life and death being controlled by the person in front of her, and she said in horror, "Yes... Ancestor."
Song Yan continued, "Wu Fangtian will also be subjected to this technique, and then you and he will be as if on the same string. If you need anything from him, he won't dare refuse. If anything happens to the child in your womb, he will also die instantly."
Xing'Er repeatedly said "Yes," but then hesitated until Song Yan said "speak," at which point she hesitantly said, "Old... Ancestor, may I ask who my husband really is, and why is this child in my womb so important?"
Song Yan asked, "Didn't Tang Fan tell you?"
Xing'Er said, "He only told me to raise the child quietly and... not to let this child cultivate."

chapters.title: Chapter 242 242: 147. Leaving Great Chu, Chang Wang Outer Domain (8.1K words - large chapter seeking subscription) _2
chapters.content:
Song Yan was momentarily stunned...
Understanding has dawned, he knows not to reveal anything about the "Formless Race," but what does "do not let him cultivate" even mean?
Before he could speak, the Ancient Formless Ancestor, Feng Chengzi, in the Faceless Mask was already fuming with rage.
"A calamity for the family, a calamity for the family... Who gave him the authority to prohibit my descendants from cultivation?"
Song Yan said calmly, "Listen closely, the child in your womb carries the bloodline of the Formless Ancient Race. You may not know what the Formless Ancient Race is, but you only need to know that should these four words be leaked, you... will neither be able to live nor die. Unless one day, you encounter other members of the Formless Race."
"Formless Ancient Race..." Xing'Er muttered this unfamiliar term.
Feng Chengzi then shouted from within the mask, "Zhang Han, leave some cultivation techniques for my descendants to cultivate."
Song Yan responded, "Already prepared," and then took out a storage bag, handing it to Xing'Er, saying, "Inside are some cultivation techniques of the Formless Ancient Race, and resources, how to utilize them... as a mother, you should ponder carefully.
Whether mother rises with child's prestige soaring high or perishes with the path dissipating and soul shattering, all depends on a single thought. This is both a danger and a great opportunity, make the most of it."
Trembling, Xing'Er received the storage bag, respectfully responding, "Thank... you, Ancestor."
Once these words were spoken, Song Yan had already left, striding away.
...
Within the Faceless Mask, the highest level secret technique of the early stage of the Purple Mansion was "unlocked."
Song Yan looked over, and saw a line emerge on the cover———— "Mind Escape Technique."
An unremarkable name, yet it contained the word "escape."
Song Xuan read it carefully, growing more pleased as he read.
This "Mind Escape Technique" states: By merging into thoughts, one can escape far in an instant. The thoughts it can attach to are not limited to "killer thoughts" but can also be used for "protective thoughts," "my thoughts."
More remarkably, the "Mind Escape Technique" does not conflict with the "Five Elements Escape Technique," since the carriers are different.
In other words, you can completely let your thoughts utilize the "Five Elements Escape Technique," and then use Mind Escape on this "thought that has used the Five Elements Escape Technique."
This can be considered double acceleration.
In addition, if the "Mind Escape Technique" is attached to "my thoughts," it can produce other variables, which is—to hide within my thoughts.
In this way, you can completely hide within the divine soul of others without being discovered by them. This point is almost indistinguishable from the Divine Infant realm.
He spent some time transferring the "Mind Escape Technique" onto a panel, then spent a full 600 years cultivating it to perfection.
Feeling the shortcoming of his "speed" being remedied, he let out a long sigh and felt quite good.
At this moment, Feng Chengzi in the Faceless Mask suddenly asked, "How could you use the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman?"
Song Yan laughed, "As I said, I am a member of the Formless Race, and you didn't believe me, what could I do?"
Feng Chengzi commented strangely, "Are you saying that you cultivated this after seeing it in the library?"
Song Yan nodded with a smile.
Feng Chengzi laughed with a "hmm hmm hmm," then burst into laughter, finally saying, "Clumsy!"
Song Yan knew the old man's remark implied his lie was too obvious.
He had done it deliberately, with no intention to argue, merely smiled, looked out the window, and saw the peach tree was already budding.
Spring has arrived, and before long, he would turn Wu Liantian into a blood slave too and teach him the "Evil Tide Skill," then it would be time to set off for the Mountain and Sea Demon Country.
Though he did not know what the Soul Threshold of the Chaotic King truly looked like.
...
...
Over a month later.
Song Yan set off with Tang Fan.
...
...
About a year and a half later...
The two of them traversed the long journey, passing through several Mortal Realms under the control of the Fox and Wolf Races, until they finally reached their destination.
Though said to be the destination, it was still not the entrance to the "Soul Threshold of the Chaotic King."
At the foot of the desolate yellow earth cliffs, a large army was stationed.
The armor of ten thousand glinted coldly, banners waved in the wind.
The words "Xiongwei" appeared amidst the unfolding scene, swaying in the breeze.
This was within the territory of the vassal state Xiongwei Kingdom of the Dragon Bo Many-tailed Fox Race in the southern realm of the Soul Threshold of the Chaotic King.
Along the way, Song Yan had gained considerable understanding of this southern land of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, at least the outline of the territory map of the Fox and Wolf Races.
The two races ruled over no less than fifteen Mortal Realms, and these realms were within the territory of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, not counting Great Chu, the Three Kingdoms, etc...
Originally, the fifteen Mortal Realms were governed by the Fox, Wolf, and Tiger Races.
But since the Tiger Race's annihilation, its lands have been divided by the Fox and Wolf.
From a high vantage point, the territories of the two races resemble a bizarre scorpion with its head facing southwest and its tail raised northeast, with the "Soul Threshold of the Chaotic King" located in the center, surrounded by the territories of the two races, all currently... guarded by large armies.
The army of the Xiongwei Kingdom was one of them.
The forces below quickly noticed the two figures above.
Song Yan descended with Tang Fan, raising the Southern Land Passage Order previously given by the crying infant superior, and the leading general of Xiongwei Kingdom immediately dismounted and knelt, then respectfully pointed the way.
After pointing the way, he added, "The crying infant superior has long entered within.
Before the superior entered, the road ahead was still smooth, but recently strange occurrences have started happening... I've lost many people consecutively, and the encampment has had to retreat again and again. We have now retreated over ten miles, please be cautious, Upper Envoy."
With that, he suddenly "oh'd," as if recalling something, turned his head, and ordered in a mighty voice, "Bring the map!"
Immediately, a scholar brought a scroll on which the terrain ahead was recorded.
The general said, "This entrance here is called Chopper Ridge, previously it was all part of a city domain.
Many years ago, it was lush with vegetation and teeming with wildlife, but now it has turned into a land of yellow sand, with many strange occurrences, causing the surrounding populace to have long relocated, leaving behind many deserted villages and lonely cities.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 243: 147. Leaving Great Chu, Chang Wang Outer Domain (8.1K words - large chapter seeking subscription)_3
chapters.content:
This is a map from the past, but it's unknown if anything inside has changed now. The Upper Envoy has it, so it should be useful.
The Baby Crying Immortal and the others will be visible once they cross this ridge, which is less than a hundred miles from here..."
After speaking, the General clapped his hands again and called out, "Wen Gao, Shao Lou."
Immediately, two riders stepped forward.
The General said, "You two have lived here before and are familiar with the environment, having served as scouts for years. This time... take the Upper Envoy inside."
The two riders' faces turned ashen but did not refuse; instead, they cupped their hands in salute, saying, "Yes."
The General said, "Those who die for the Upper Envoy's mission will be generously compensated. Both of you have elder brothers and mothers at home; they will live well because of you."
The two riders saluted again, then spurred their horses forward, quietly waiting.
Tang Fan looked at Song Yan with a reluctant expression, provoking: "Demon, we've become familiar along the way, haven't we? When did you need these two mere mortals to lead the way?"
Song Yan said, "You're quite right."
He waved his hand, signaling the two riders to withdraw.
However, the two riders hesitated, seemingly unwilling to miss this opportunity to court death.
But compared to the opportunity, they were even more afraid of disobeying the command of the Upper Envoy, so they respectfully withdrew.
Song Yan then led Tang Fan to the front of the army.
Once at the entrance of Chopper Ridge, he casually unlocked the shackles on Tang Fan's hands, pulled out the "Blood-Binding Rope," and said, "We've come this far; escaping is pointless."
Tang Fan twisted his neck and wrists, feeling his gradually returning power, then glanced at Song Yan and suddenly said, "I really don't know what kind of person you are.
You can drink with me heartily, yet act despicably and shamelessly without regard for means; you're ruthless and cold but can easily spare two ordinary soldiers... I don't believe you were provoked by me."
Song Yan smiled faintly, patted his shoulder, and said with concern, "Be careful once inside. After all that's happened, don't be so childish."
Tang Fan scoffed and said, "Being with you, I've learned only one thing. In this world, some people change faces faster than flipping pages. But... thank you."
Song Yan suddenly threw a Storage Bag and said, "Inside are your belongings, along with some Clear Heart Pills and Soul Cleansing Pills that might be useful in this Soul Threshold."
As he observed the place, he took some elixirs and said indifferently, "It's forbidden to fly here; it seems we must walk in."
Tang Fan took the Storage Bag, took a deep breath, swallowed a Clear Heart Pill and a Soul Cleansing Pill, then walked forward.
What he didn't know was that the old demon behind him... was actually more nervous than he was.
...
...
Yellow sand rolled wildly, rising and falling.
Mortals here couldn't even breathe deeply, as a single breath would fill their nostrils with sand...
This place is an already cracked and parched desolate world.
Song Yan and Tang Fan were unaffected.
Song Yan walked while keeping an eye on Tang Fan beside him.
So, they traveled many miles.
Suddenly, his expression changed because he sensed that everything around him was beginning to exhibit a strange blurriness and distortion.
Turning his head, he found the path he had come from had disappeared.
He raised his hand and unleashed a blood evil giant hand forward.
This grab felt like grasping at cotton, with no sensation and no effect at all.
He turned his head again, finding Tang Fan had also disappeared.
"Illusion Realm?"
He frowned slightly.
Illusion Techniques are common, but Illusion Realms... he was seeing for the first time.
Illusion Techniques are usually aimed at individual targets, often oneself.
But an Illusion Realm changes multiple elements, making it naturally more complex, especially one that could envelop him in the Purple Mansion Realm.
"Tang Fan?"
"Tang Fan?"
Song Yan called out twice, but no one responded.
Song Yan immersed himself in the Faceless Mask, calling, "Feng Chengzi, come out and see, what is this?"
But strangely enough, the always responsive Feng Chengzi gave no reply.
Fog rolled at the top of the bookshelf, indicating that Feng Chengzi had fallen asleep again.
"We haven't even entered the Soul Threshold, and haven't met Baby Crying Immortal, what's going on?"
Song Yan frowned slightly.
Suddenly, his pupils narrowed, as the Chopper Ridge in front of him had somehow morphed into a "twisting, wriggling intestine" with the light slowly diminishing and the surrounding darkness increasing, as if something bad would happen once the light completely disappeared.
Song Yan instantly used Escape Technique, flying swiftly forward.
He wasn't hopeful, but the result surprised him.
He landed on a bright sandy lawn.
On the lawn, four figures were standing.
Three demons and one human.
Among them was the Baby Crying Immortal.
The other two were a Wolf Demon and a Deer Demon.
The human was a middle-aged man, visibly nervous and hurried, clearly another person captured to obtain the "Evil Treasure."
The Baby Crying Immortal's expression cooled upon seeing Song Yan alone, just about to say something when another person suddenly emerged from behind.
It was Tang Fan.
The Baby Crying Immortal then said, "Zhang Han, keep an eye on the people you brought; if they perish before entering the Soul Threshold, you'll pay!"
Song Yan faintly smiled and replied, "Okay."
As time passed, he fully understood: he was still inside an Illusion Realm; everything before him was false. Though this Illusion Realm seemed harmless, it had an incredibly terrifying realism, at least so far, he hadn't found a means to break it.
Since he was here, he decided to stay calm.
His mood stabilized, with no panic, as he began contemplating ways to break the realm, looking around.
Just then, two more people appeared from behind the Chopper Ridge.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 244: 147. Leaving Great Chu, Wang of the Outer Domain (8.1K words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
A person like him is a member of the Human Race, appearing to be in the Purple Mansion Realm.
And the other person, still shackled, is undoubtedly an "Evil Treasure Taker" like Tang Fan.
However, Song Yan was stunned when he saw her.
He almost exclaimed out loud, calling out her name.
"Junior Sister Xiao Jiu?"
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu evidently noticed his gaze as well, but she only gave him a cold glance before lowering her head.
...
...
"Heaven and earth have their own rules; the Sea of Suffering is a place specifically for stripping away obsessions, terrifying beyond measure after countless ages and countless beings.
If the Sea of Suffering were to connect with the Mortal World for some reason, heaven and earth would have new means to compensate.
This means is the Secret Realm."
Master Infant Cry spoke eloquently, "Whenever the Sea of Suffering overflows a little, a Secret Realm will naturally come to block it, preventing the water of the Sea of Suffering from entering the mortal world and only entering the Secret Realm.
But how can the Sea of Suffering be easily guarded against?
Therefore, with each leak, the external Secret Realms will stack up layer by layer, like strange labyrinth tumors.
This place where many Secret Realms are linked together, we call the Tumor Realm.
The Soul Threshold of King Zhang is at the end of the Tumor Realm.
The Evil Treasure we are to take is also there.
Once inside here, we will randomly enter a Secret Realm and may not be able to travel together.
However, only three people can take the Evil Treasure!
No matter which of us encounters them, we must protect them as much as possible, then proceed quickly with them to the end.
Understood?"
...
...
Swish, swish.
In the Secret Realm of gray mist, two figures appeared.
Song Yan quickly looked at the figure beside him, it had the appearance of Junior Sister Xiao Jiu, a female cultivator.
But he knew this female cultivator was not Xiao Jiu, but named Tian Yao.
Before he could speak, Tian Yao looked at him and coldly questioned, "Why, as a powerful member of the Human Race, do you assist the demons?"
Song Yan, knowing this place was an Illusion Realm, ignored her, raising his hand to cast various magic spells, but each spell had no effect, instead attracting a horde of strange monsters.
Those monsters were connected by Fixed Evil, extremely terrifying.
Song Yan protected Tian Yao while fighting.
Gradually, the gray mist thickened, and a strong sense of corrosion struck.
Suddenly, Song Yan had an idea, raising his hand to take out a Paper House and threw it out.
This Paper House was made from Zhang Han's essence blood, and although Song Yan placed Zhang Han's blood corpse in the Three Kingdoms to let it naturally form, he always carried the Paper House with him. This Paper House couldn't be easily destroyed and immediately expanded a safe area in this eerie Secret Realm.
Song Yan swiftly brought Tian Yao inside, but Tian Yao was already injured.
Initially, Song Yan didn't care, but he gradually found that Tian Yao not only looked like Junior Sister Xiao Jiu but also had similar personality and temperament...
Therefore, he couldn't help but treat her injuries with a cold expression.
The two didn't advance further, but began cultivating inside the Paper House, cultivating feelings in the process, though each kept their feelings hidden in their hearts.
Finally, one day, the gray mist dissipated, and the entrance to the Secret Realm revealed light.
Song Yan put away the Paper House and left with Tian Yao. Outside, he didn't encounter any demons. Master Infant Cry was also absent, likely lost in the Soul Threshold of King Zhang.
A few days later, Song Yan left with Tian Yao.
Outside, though there were countless soldiers, how could they find the two?
The two then traveled south all the way back to the Three Kingdoms to help Yu Xuanwei repair the Ancient Teleportation Array.
When the array was formed, the two went together to the other side, which was the source sect of the Nanwu Sword Sect, a larger Sword Cultivation Sect.
Song Yan and Tian Yao naturally joined the sect, formally becoming Dao companions, upholding justice, slaying demons, and cultivating together, progressing together, and both becoming Elders of that Sword Cultivation Sect, an admired couple in the Cultivation Realm.
...
...
"My disciple, my time is near, and the sect will be entrusted to you and Xiaoyao in the future."
The short white-robed old man sat solemnly on the Sect Leader's Lotus Platform, his seriousness softened by a benevolent smile as he looked at the two opposite.
Song Yan quietly looked at the old man.
He didn't move.
He floated beside like a transparent person, still aware this was an Illusion Realm, thus seeming unaccepted by the Illusion Realm, floating beside.
However, another corporeal Song Yan had already knelt down, respectfully shouting, "Yes, Master!"
That old man looked exactly like the Stone Seat Elder.
"Hahaha, with little Yan and little Yao here, our sect will surely grow stronger and stronger."
"Indeed, we watched these two kids grow, they're both good kids, with upright minds and intentions, full of noble righteousness. This old woman is most satisfied to witness you like this."
Song Yan turned his head and saw the other Elder's seat occupied by a cultivator looking exactly like Kuye Sword Master and Granny Meng.
"Brother Song, let's work hard together in the future."
Tian Yao turned her head, smiling like a flower at him.
And that corporeal Song Yan had already tightly embraced her.
"I know, Brother Song did many bad things in the past, but he was forced to. Now those things are behind us. Together, let's protect the sect, protect everyone, protect the Human Race..."
...
...
A year later...
The Sect Leader's time had come.
Song Yan and Tian Yao buried him, then came to the entrance to assume the position of Sect Leader.
Tian Yao smiled expectantly at him.
Song Yan pushed open the door, striding boldly outside.
Outside, golden light dazzled, countless disciples looked up at him, shouting "Sect Leader Song's" name.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 245: 147. Leaving Great Chu, Wang of the Outer Domain (8.1K words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
...
...
Many more years passed...
Tian Yao bore Song Yan a son and a daughter.
As time went by, the children grew up and also entered the sect of sword cultivators.
Later, the children each got married, and the Song family grew more prosperous.
Song Yan's transparent figure sometimes floated outside, sometimes overlapping with the tangible Song Yan.
But he did not get lost, constantly reminding himself, "This is an illusion, this is an illusion."
Until one day...
....
"Dad! Dad?"
"Brother Song? Husband?"
Anxious shouts echoed in the Song family.
Whether it was Tian Yao or Song Yan's children, all the descendants were searching for him everywhere.
But Song Yan was nowhere to be found.
At this moment, the tangible Song Yan completely vanished, leaving only his transparent figure floating outside.
He could see those people, but they couldn't see him.
...
"It should end now."
Song Yan sighed lightly because he had already sensed the weakness of this illusion, which is time limit.
Even though it's flawless and hard to break free from, once the time is up, if he hasn't completely succumbed, waking up will be quite easy.
He stood in the small courtyard.
The courtyard was filled with familiar sights, and there were even snowmen piled up in the corner.
Just then, a trembling voice came from outside the courtyard gate: "Dad, you... you're back? Where have you been for so long?"
The voice quickly turned joyful, shouting, "Mom! Mom! Dad's back!"
Soon, Tian Yao's figure appeared in front of Song Yan, her eyes brimming with tears. She looked at the snow on the ground, suddenly bending down, quickly molding it into a ball, and threw it at Song Yan.
Thud!
The snowball landed on his left cheek.
Song Yan did not evade, and at this moment, he was no longer transparent.
Tian Yao ran over crying, throwing herself into his arms, saying, "Where did you go? How could you leave without saying a word? Do you know how much we missed you?"
Song Yan gazed at the "Junior Sister Xiao Jiu" in his arms, took a deep breath, and tightly closed his eyes, while in the distance, their children and juniors quietly withdrew.
When he opened his eyes again, the sky had already turned dusky.
The crimson glow stood at the end of heaven and earth, and by his side, a dear companion kept close, an intense sense of happiness filled Song Yan's heart.
Recalling all the events after succeeding as Sect Leader of the Sword Cultivation Sect, he felt he had nothing to be ashamed of.
"Brother Song, what are you thinking?"
"Junior Sister Xiao Jiu" leaned against him, watching the sunset together.
Song Yan said, "I'm thinking, if all this were true, how wonderful it would be."
"Junior Sister Xiao Jiu" said: "How do you know for sure this is false, Brother Song?"
Song Yan closed his eyes, greedily feeling the warmth, comfort, beauty, and peace of this moment; here was the life he wanted, everything he wanted...
"The children have grown, it's time to pass on the position of Sect Leader, and we should find a blessed place to peacefully cultivate and breakthrough," the gentle voice of Junior Sister Xiao Jiu sounded in his ear.
Song Yan remained silent.
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu continued, "Are you still thinking about the past?"
Song Yan remained silent.
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu said, "It's all over now."
Song Yan let out a long sigh, slowly opened his eyes, and met Junior Sister Xiao Jiu's mischievous eyes.
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu smiled and asked, "What does Brother want to do now?"
Song Yan said, "Watch the sunset, then leave this world."
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu tilted her head slightly.
Song Yan felt tears wetting his lapel, and the arms holding him tightened more.
Junior Sister Xiao Jiu cried out, "Why do you have to leave?
Why?
Does it really matter what's real and what's not?
Can't we just stay together as a family?"
Her voice was hoarse, choked with sobs, the more she spoke, the more she could not stop crying.
Song Yan released her from his embrace, looked at her gently, wiped away her tears, then gave a self-mocking smile, paused, and finally stared determinedly at the "Junior Sister Xiao Jiu" before him, softly saying, "Goodbye, the sunset is truly beautiful."
"Thank you, Xiao Jiu..."
He didn't call out the name "Tian Yao," because... he always remained lucid, always knew all this was false.
In the next moment, Song Yan suddenly closed his eyes.
He felt the time in the illusion had reached its end.
If he succumbed, he would continue to fall into it; without external force, he feared he might never wake up.
But he did not succumb.
He had always been terrifyingly lucid.
He took a deep breath, raised his hand, his hand turned into a blood claw, coldly commanding, "Break for me."
The previously flawless world was now torn apart violently.
The sunset faded, yellow sand filled the sky, and steep cliffs rose on both sides of the unfinished road.
He was still in Chopper Ridge.
However, in front of him was a strange hunched figure, seemingly a novice monk, but the familiar aura made him recognize it as a ghost.
The ghostly novice monk's surroundings were swirling with strange power of thought, probably a monster mixed from the "ghosts of the entire Changwang Tiger Race, the Sea of Suffering, and some other unknown things."
"Is it you, this ghostly thing?"
Looking at the ghostly entity inexplicably appearing here, Song Yan suddenly raised his hand and struck indifferently.
Boom!
The ghostly novice monk, extremely formidable within the illusion, was shatteringly destroyed with no real resistance, disappearing from its place.
Song Yan looked to his side again, only to see Tang Fan standing immobile with a smile on his lips and tears streaming down his cheeks, unknowing of what he saw in the illusion.
However, with the shattering of the ghostly novice monk, he suddenly opened his eyes, as if waking from a dream, and upon waking, he looked around in shock and pain, anxiously shouting, "Meng'Er! Xing'Er!"
Song Yan raised his hand, giving him a slap on the back of his head, saying, "Stop daydreaming, let's go."

chapters.title: Chapter 246 246: 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large chapter seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chopper Ridge.
Tang Fan was slapped awake and quickly realized he had fallen into an illusion realm.
He felt no joy from escaping the illusion realm, for in that realm he not only saw his parents but also the beautiful life with Meng'Er and Xing'Er, and even saw himself walking hand in hand with children across famous mountains and great rivers...
Everything there was what he desired the most in his heart.
Life is but a fleeting hundred years, and after the Crimson Palace only two hundred more, how is living different from experiencing? If it's all an experience, why not choose the better one?
True or false, how much does it matter?
Living is but a grand dream, and still a nightmare at that. If one can swap it for a sweeter dream, why not?
Yet, the sweet dream has ended, and the path ahead turns into a falling sandstorm, raining from the sky.
Song Yan squinted at the road ahead, quickly communicating with Feng Chengzi inside the Faceless Mask.
When he fell into the illusion realm, Feng Chengzi was also directly cut off from external perception.
However, Feng Chengzi could remember the precise time.
Thus when Song Yan asked, he found out that he and Tang Fan had spent a full two days in the illusion realm in real-world time!
If you exchange the proportion, roughly speaking, spending a hundred years in the illusion realm would equate to one day outside.
"But how is that possible?"
"Two days..."
Song Yan could hardly imagine it. He thought it was just a moment.
Feng Chengzi asked for more details, then said: "You encountered a Sea of Suffering Apparition, which can also be called a Sea of Suffering Pseudo-Monk.
Luckily, it was only a Sea of Suffering Pseudo-Monk. If you had fallen into the Sea of Suffering, even with great divine power, you would have been killed by the monsters in the Sea of Suffering.
Those monsters kill not in the usual way you understand, but by stripping you of everything at the level of thought, helping you sever cause and effect, and aiding your divine soul to ascend."
After saying this, he was silent for a moment and continued, "They are monsters, but they never think so.
Throughout endless ages, there are many and varied types of obsessions submerged in the Sea of Suffering, and from them, they have selected the kind of obsession most suitable for their behavior.
That obsession is Buddha.
They... call themselves the Buddhist Sect."
Song Yan said: "There are intelligent beings in the Sea of Suffering?"
Feng Chengzi said: "They are not intelligent beings, not even life. You can think of them as obsessions within obsessions, monsters created by time and years."
Song Yanqi said: "Monsters?"
Feng Chengzi said: "You've seen demons, seen devils, seen ghosts, but this is the first time you've seen monsters, right? That's what these are."
He seemed to recall some memories and smiled bitterly, "These Buddhist Sect monsters never pick up knives to kill. They only enlighten.
They help you achieve great enlightenment, devoid of cause and effect, reincarnation... which means making your cultivation in this life go to waste.
So, even if you stayed in their illusion realm for two days or even two years, you wouldn't suffer any other harm.
Because they value those they are enlightening very much, if someone interferes, they immediately turn their attention to enlightening the interferer."
Song Yan swore, in both past and present lives, he had never heard of such a bizarre 'Buddhist Sect.' It was truly "The sea of suffering knows no bounds, lay down the butcher's knife, the Lord helps you transcend to rebirth..."
...
...
Though Chopper Ridge spans over a hundred miles, the road afterward was smooth and without further encounters with the strange monster called 'Pseudo-Monk.'
In the pale moonlight, a green meadow emerged in the distance, one that Song Yan had seen in the illusion realm.
That meadow seemed like an oasis amidst a desert, an emerald amidst the scorching yellow sands.
On the meadow stood four figures.
The Infant-crying Elder, the Wolf Demon, the Deer Demon, and a middle-aged man with a bitter smile.
These scenes were almost identical to what Song Yan had seen in the illusion realm, with the difference being: whether it was the Infant-crying Elder, the Wolf Demon, or the Deer Demon, they were cheerfully eating human flesh. Before them was a large pot in which oil bubbles were bubbling, and from time to time, human hands and legs floated up...
Clearly, the illusion brought by the Pseudo-Monk only made the realism extreme but stripped away the violent scenes as much as possible, embodying the principle "Monks do not speak lies, nor commit killing."
A six-tailed red fox sat cross-legged on a high rock, stirring the pot with a long knife. When it noticed movement in the direction of Chopper Ridge, it glanced sidelong and said, "Zhang Han is here."
Song Yan clasped his fists and said respectfully from afar, "Elder."
The Infant-crying Elder waved, "Taste a flavor from your hometown?"
Song Yan replied, "Thank you for the kind offer, Elder, but that's not necessary."
He stepped forward and glanced at Tang Fan, who had stopped in fright, his face pale, sweat the size of soybeans beading on his forehead.
The Infant-crying Elder said flatly, "Ancient Tooth, what are you doing? Don't give the youngster too much pressure, making it seem like you're going to kill him."
After saying that, it raised its head, a smile appearing on its fox face, and beckoned Tang Fan with a claw dripping with soup, "Cultivating Profound isn't easy, cultivation techniques and treasure are hard to find. But in this King Apparition Soul Threshold, there are many treasures.
The finest Blood Cleansing Pill can significantly reduce the toxicity of the Crimson Palace Poison; there must be extraordinary essence blood stored in various unknown secret realm blood pools. Besides these, there are countless Profound Treasure Techniques, even soul artifacts are not lacking..."
As it was speaking, it suddenly received a message from the Wolf Demon named Ancient Tooth.
"This kid has the scent of the Ancient Race on him."
The Infant-crying Elder's fox eyes narrowed, scanning Tang Fan, then suddenly glanced at Song Yan.
Song Yan almost reacted instantly upon seeing the Infant-crying Elder's expression change, saying directly, "Elder, during my investigation, I discovered this kid also harbors some secrets. He is a lost member of the Formless Race, his parents long gone, making him the sole survivor."

chapters.title: Chapter 247 247: 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large chapter seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
As he spoke, he sneered again, "To use it for having children, there's a chance we could raise a branch of the Formless Race that obeys us."
The suspicion in the expression of Yingteng Master disappeared, and he chuckled, "Zhang Han, you think well, but you still don't know much. This Ancient Race, passing down from one lineage to the next, if they have already birthed offspring with the bloodline, they can give birth no more."
Having said that, he slightly raised his chin, looking at Tang Fan, smiling, "Young man, are you married?"
Tang Fan wasn't foolish enough to tell the truth at this moment, so he clenched his fist and said, "Even though I am not, my heart already belongs to someone, and you shouldn't think of having me marry another."
Yingteng Master laughed loudly, waving his claw, and said, "Don't just stand there, come sit. Even if you don't eat human flesh, having some Profound Wine and Profound Tea is good. Wait for those behind."
Song Yan, Tang Fan quickly walked over.
Song Yan found a place to sit.
Tang Fan glanced at the middle-aged man not far away who seemed to be in the same situation as him, hesitated for a moment, but then thought it safer to sit next to the old demon Zhang, so he walked towards Song Yan. However, just before he sat down, Yingteng Master in the distance waved his hand, saying, "My young friend, sit by my side."
Tang Fan showed a wry smile.
Yingteng Master chuckled, "Come on, I'm fond of you.
Quickly come and chat with the ancestor, what sort of young lady do you like?"
Tang Fan helplessly sat down, like a large ice block, beside the Six-tailed Red Fox Demon, not daring to move.
Yingteng Master suddenly raised his hand to remove the pot of cooking human flesh and replaced it with a delicate tea table.
The items on the table were exquisite, full of ancient charm and each had its own characteristics.
On the tea table, there was a toad exhaling white mist, resembling cold air floating, hazy and indistinct.
Yingteng Master skillfully brewed the tea, handled the tea, distributed the tea, and then personally brought a cup to Tang Fan, smiling, "My young friend, it's beneficial for you."
Tang Fan dared not refuse...
Meanwhile, by the distant old tree, Song Yan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
He knew that if he hadn't killed Zhang Han back then and was mistakenly taken for Zhang Han due to an unexpected turn of events, now the one being called a young friend and served tea by Yingteng Master would have been him.
Little Tang was walking into the script that should have been his...
Song Yan closed his eyes, meditating, adopting a posture of complete indifference to the outside world.
However, he dared to wager that if there weren't any issues with the tea, he'd eat the tree behind him.
As for Little Tang, he had done his best; whether he lived or died wasn't really his concern. Although he was quite tempted by the Secret Technique in the Faceless Mask, he could live without it, and at worst, he wouldn't have it.
Compared to his quiet side, the other side was indeed as lively as a tea party with laughter and chatter.
Clearly, Yingteng Master was an old hand at hosting "tea parties."
After a long while, Yingteng Master suddenly asked, "Zhang Han, did you encounter anything strange on your way here?"
Song Yan opened his eyes, recounting the matters of the Illusion Realm.
Yingteng Master remained silent for a moment, then said, "Just in time, let me tell you about it."
He continued, "There are rules in the heavens and earth, reincarnated souls are not allowed to carry the causes and effects of their past lives, but if there is a great obsession it will not dissipate, hence the world has the Sea of Suffering to specifically strip away these obsessions.
If the Sea of Suffering inadvertently connects with the Mortal World, the heavens and earth will naturally activate a Secret Realm, or even generate a Secret Realm to accommodate the overflowing aura of the Sea of Suffering.
However, the aura of the Sea of Suffering is often beyond what a single Secret Realm can accommodate.
It continuously drills outward, just like the owner of the obsession in their past life, wishing to return to the mortal world to fulfill their obsession.
Thus, they break open Secret Realms again and again, and the outside Secret Realms pile up over and over, densely packed, like a maze of nodules.
This is called the Tumor Realm.
And the Tumor Realm is the Soul Threshold."
Song Yan was taken aback for a moment.
Because the words of Yingteng Master were almost identical to an explanation he had heard in the Illusion Realm.
Yingteng Master continued, "Previously, the Soul Thresholds were often simpler Tumor Realms, perhaps only two or three Secret Realms stacked together inside, thus completing the blockage of the Sea of Suffering.
But the Changwang Soul Threshold is different, the Changwang Tiger Race is inherently a race adept in Divine Souls, over time they have also collected countless ephemeral ghosts, among which are even Crimson Palace Divine Souls, and even... Purple Mansion Divine Souls.
They are completely united, extremely difficult to disassemble, continuously creating openings to the Sea of Suffering, causing the aura inside to leak more and more severely, and the number of Secret Realms in the Tumor Realm to increase evermore.
The Illusion Technique you fell for, the Illusion Realm you saw, was just a further leakage caused by it.
The monster you saw is called the Sea of Suffering's Chang'e Mi."
Song Yan couldn't help but say, "Then isn't there a lot of Sea of Suffering's Chang'e Mi in the Tumor Realm?"
Yingteng Master said, "The creation factors of the Sea of Suffering's Chang'e Mi are extremely complex, but not so easily formed. Most of them linger at the periphery of the Tumor Realm because they urgently desire to reach the mortal world..."
Speaking to this point, the six-tailed red fox ancestor couldn't help but roll his eyes, saying speechlessly, "The mortal world has many living people, and also many causes and effects. For these monsters who take enlightenment as their duty, it is simply paradise... so, they always walk at the forefront of the leaking aura of the Sea of Suffering."
Beside him, the Deer Demon laughed and said, "Zhang Han, don't say it was just you, we were enlightened when we came in, but... as long as you don't get captivated, you can naturally leave when the time comes.
The Sea of Suffering's Chang'e Mi you killed, might also have been the one we killed when we entered."
Song Yan was stunned and said, "That thing can't be killed?"
The Deer Demon said, "It can't be killed. At least... it's not something we can kill."

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_3
The Infant Crying Master said, "But don’t worry too much, even though that thing can’t be killed, as long as you can withstand its first illusion, its harm will reduce significantly. If it senses that you can completely ignore its illusions, it won’t attack you anymore."
As they were speaking, a fluctuation suddenly arose from the direction of Chopper Ridge.
Song Yan turned his head to look, only to see a male cultivator and a female cultivator appearing at the entrance.
This scene had also appeared in the illusion realm before.
He instinctively glanced at the Profound Robe female cultivator, only to find that her figure was petite, her face was a mix of cuteness and aloofness. Although she didn’t look like Junior Sister Xiao Jiu, their physiques were remarkably similar.
But then, Song Yan felt puzzled.
Because, in the illusion, this female cultivator was a "captive," but now... the aura she emitted was of the Purple Mansion Realm.
Needless to say, this female cultivator, like him, belonged to the "lackeys of the demons."
Sure enough, the female cultivator walked briskly, looked into the distance, and saluted, saying, "Master, General, Sir..."
She clearly knew more demons than Song Yan.
After saluting, the female cultivator nodded slightly at Song Yan and said, "Han Yuling."
Song Yan returned the salute, saying, "Zhang Han."
After speaking, the "treasure hunter" brought by the female cultivator tactfully met with the middle-aged person who had been captured before, while the female cultivator sat beside Song Yan, choosing a spot opposite to him.
The group waited for several more days...
Newcomers started pouring in from the direction of Chopper Ridge again.
Most of these newcomers were of the Crimson Palace Realm, scatteredly totaling fifty-three, an amount nearly five times the number of Elders in the Nanwu Sword Sect.
However, in the fifteen kingdoms under the Fox Wolf’s control, this number seemed not to be too many.
What’s more intriguing was that all fifty-three Crimson Palace cultivators wore sect uniforms, and the names of their sects were clearly displayed on these uniforms.
Song Yan swept his gaze over them, discovering that they came from fifty-three different sects, and most wore a bitter expression, evidently not volunteers but coerced into responding to the Upper Envoy’s orders.
As his gaze swept through these fifty-three individuals, he suddenly noticed a gaze returning his.
Song Yan looked and saw it was Han Yuling.
She did not avoid his gaze but met it with a friendly smile.
Song Yan also returned the smile.
His eyes moved again, realizing that although only the Infant Crying Master was talking and laughing, everyone was actually communicating with their eyes, forming small circles and alliances invisibly among them.
The demons gathered together.
The fifty-three Crimson Palace level elders each formed their own circles.
The "treasure hunter" brought by Han Yuling was mingling with the middle-aged man who arrived initially.
And Han Yuling herself was with him.
Truly a gathering of like-minded individuals, with a strict hierarchy.
In the Jianghu, there are techniques to transmit messages in secret, and both the Refining Profound and Crimson Palace possess such secret techniques, but no one dared to use them here, for any sneaky transmitted messages would be overheard by the Purple Mansion elders.
However, the Purple Mansion elders could transmit thoughts.
The exchange of thoughts was one-on-one, impossible to eavesdrop on.
The powerful entities of the Purple Mansion Realm naturally learned to convey information through their thoughts upon mastering the power of thoughts.
Han Yuling was the first to transmit a thought, saying, "Comrade, how do you serve the masters?"
Song Yan replied, "And you?"
Han Yuling said, "I am from the National Guardian Purple Mansion of the Great Qi, sent by order."
Song Yan said, "What a coincidence."
Han Yuling said, "Then, comrade, we are truly kindred spirits; we should get closer. After entering the Soul Threshold, why not form an alliance?"
Song Yan asked, "Did you encounter anything strange on your way here?"
Han Yuling replied, "I entered an illusion, fortunately broke free, but I have no idea what it was."
Song Yan said blandly, "Sea of Suffering phantom."
Han Yuling asked in amazement, "What is that?"
Song Yan explained everything he knew, causing Han Yuling to be dumbfounded, and after a long while, she burst out cursing, "That damn thing nearly killed me, such a pain, looks like this Soul Threshold won’t be easy to conquer?"
Song Yan: ...
A cute face, a petite figure, a National Guardian Purple Mansion, a generation of ancestors; none of these elements fit with that statement.
Han Yuling laughed, "Comrade, don’t mind my words. Great Qi is a land of rampant bandits; even the immortal cultivators are robbers, so speaking crudely is no surprise.
In the past, I have to maintain the appearance of an ancestor in the Qi Kingdom, and in front of these demon masters, I must be respectful and cautious. It’s only in front of a comrade like you that I can speak this way.
I’m finally relieved, feeling comfortable now."
As she spoke, she stretched her body.
And at this moment, Chopper Ridge suddenly shook violently, with the forest on both sides quaking like piles of dirt, and the rocks on the ground bouncing up and down like beans on a drum surface.
Following this, a fierce wind rushed from afar, and when it settled, it revealed a giant demon wolf about a zhang tall.
The fifty-three outermost Crimson Palace cultivators hurriedly bowed their heads in salutation.
The giant demon wolf ignored them but eagerly walked towards the Infant Crying Master, then grinned, revealing a mouth full of fangs.
"Ancestors, Little Gu is late."
The Infant Crying Master laughed, "Little Gu is not bad, about to reach the middle stage of the Purple Mansion Realm, isn’t it?"
The giant demon wolf nodded and then said, "Those useless things, before I could react, they were directly killed by the illusion!!"
Saying this, the giant demon wolf lifted its paw and scooped out from the void, throwing out a full seven corpses on the ground.
All these were clearly Crimson Palace cultivators.
The giant demon wolf said, "Trash! All of them are trash! Couldn’t even hold out until I came to wake them up! These sects only know to send trash over here; I must trouble them later!"

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_4
The face of Tang Fan, who was beside Elder Yingti, turned slightly red. If it weren’t for Elder Zhang Mo, he might have ended up like this too.
The Giant Demon Wolf licked its tongue and swaggered over to sit next to the three demons, its oily green eyes slightly swiveling as it looked directly at Song Yan and Han Yuling sitting opposite. It shouted boldly, "What are you doing sitting there?"
The two turned their heads at the sound.
The Giant Demon Wolf raised its neck, and its blood-red eyes, as large as copper bells, stared directly at the two, baring its teeth with arrogance, "Why don’t you come and pay respects to the future Wolf Race Ancestor, Lord Ancient Ghoul?"
Beside them, Ancient Tooth laughed heartily, turning his head to the Deer Demon, "This child surely has the aura of a leader, worthy of being a member of my Corpse-Eating Wolf Race."
The Deer Demon praised, "Born with a giant body, overflowing Qi Blood, and with nine Crimson Palace Blood, is utterly perfect. The future achievements might surpass even General Ancient Tooth."
Hearing these words, Ancient Tooth didn’t get angry but instead looked at this younger generation with a smile. It was clear there was some connection between it and the Giant Demon Wolf.
Seeing that Song Yan and Han Yuling on the other side remained motionless, they couldn’t help but widen their eyes. Calmly, they said, "You two, being from the Vassal State Purple Mansion, if you wish to secure your positions and continue cultivation in the future, you must first understand hierarchy and respect.
Ancient Ghoul is at a level similar to yours, and might accompany you on an expedition later. If you don’t make connections now, when will you?"
After these words, Ancient Ghoul agreed, "Your opportunity is me, why don’t you come over?"
Han Yuling and Song Yan exchanged a glance, then stood up simultaneously to pay respects to the Giant Demon Wolf.
The Giant Demon Wolf hunched its giant body, yet even so, it was still taller than the two. Its green wolf eyes suddenly fixed on Han Yuling, its gaze wandering over her cute and beautiful face, suddenly mumbling, "Humans from the Purple Mansion Female Cultivators are indeed rare..."
After speaking, it licked its big tongue again and said, "A female cultivator like you surely doesn’t have a dao partner, right?"
Han Yuling’s eyes flickered sharply. Just as she was about to speak, the voice of Song Yan suddenly echoed in her mind.
"Even if you say I’m your dao partner, or say you fell in love with me at first sight and there’s no room for anyone else in your heart, I will never acknowledge it. Don’t bother wasting your effort."
Han Yuling: ...
She awkwardly replied with her thoughts, "You’re so damn cautious, but I don’t fancy you anyway."
After saying this, she took a deep breath, raised her head, and said to the Giant Demon Wolf, "Reporting to Lord Ancient Ghoul, I do not have a dao partner."
Before the Giant Demon Wolf could speak again, she continued, "However, I do not wish to seek a dao partner either."
Ancient Ghoul looked at her in surprise, seemingly not expecting this female cultivator to daringly refuse directly. Its expression turned dark and, without holding back, it said bluntly, "Although I don’t fancy you either, Purple Mansion Female Cultivators are rare. So, how about this, you accompany me for three years, and then you can leave after that."
Han Yuling: ...
She suddenly said coldly, "Elder, I’m working for the sake of the lords like this, yet I’m met with such an outcome. Isn’t it discouraging?"
The Six-tailed Red Fox tapped its claws on the table and said, "Alright, leave it like this for now. Other matters will be discussed after exploring the Soul Threshold."
Its gaze swept around, saying, "The numbers are about right, I’ll explain the rules."
Soon...
Elder Yingti began to speak melodiously.
He first explained the situation of the "Tumor Realm."
Then he clarified the rules — once inside, everyone enters the Secret Realm randomly, but no matter how the allocation goes, if you encounter three "Treasure Hunters," you must do everything you can to protect them and then quickly enter the next Secret Realm.
"Before reaching the end of the Soul Threshold, the real potential deadly dangers actually come from four sources."
"The first source is the various monsters formed by Shagu.
These monsters might be Demon Beasts from the Secret Realm itself or corpses of the original Changwang Tiger Race, which have mutated because of Shagu. But they generally have a regional presence. As long as you carefully scout and avoid entering their regions, or leave quickly if you do enter, it should be alright."
"The second source is the changes caused by the Sea of Suffering’s aura.
You may never have heard of the ’Three States of the Tumor Realm.’
These three states do not refer to the appearance of the Sea of Suffering, but the changes to the Soul Threshold when its aura enters.
The first state, Fog, if you stay in the fog for too long, you might be attached to a foreign cause and effect. Simply put... you might go mad. However, if you return to an area without fog in time, you will recover gradually over a period.
The second state, Snow, if you encounter snow and enough places are touched by snow, your cause and effect will freeze. Simply put, you’ll lose your memory. Only by moving to an area without snow and spending some time there will you recover.
The third state, and also the most terrifying state, is Rain. This rain is typically a sudden downpour. If hit by it, the cause and effect on you will be quickly washed away, only to be replaced by new causes and effects, but these will also be washed away repeatedly... until the rain stops. Whatever cause and effect lands on you last when the rain stops, that will be it. While your Divine Soul hasn’t changed, you will become a completely different person than you were before."
"The third source is other Purple Mansions of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
They sneak in from elsewhere, possibly also aiming for the ultimate Evil Treasure. Although I have tried my best to divert their attention elsewhere, some of them may have still entered."
"The fourth source is the Ancient Race sneaking in.
Although we are far from the territory of the Ancient Race, and it’s generally improbable for them to reach our side, much less for Purple Mansions among them to risk getting involved in this mess. But... we cannot rule out the possibility."
"With these words said, proceed to the realm; we shall meet at the end."
After Elder Yingti finished speaking, he stood quietly to the side while the fifty-three Crimson Palace level Elders entered first one by one, followed by Song Yan and Han Yuling.

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: 148. Sea of Suffering Buddha Country, Three States of the Tumor Realm (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_5
Until these people entered, the infant-crying Elder, Ancient Tooth, and Deer Demon each grabbed one "Treasure Hunter," then looked at the ancient skeleton and stepped in together.
...
...
Boom!
The shocking thunder seemed to overturn the clouds, coming from afar, followed by lightning darting down like a snake tide, weaving a brilliant purple glow in mid-air.
Song Yan had just entered the Secret Realm and heard the thunder, saw the lightning.
Swoosh!
Swoosh swoosh!
His speed was extremely fast, almost flashing with Escape Technique, where his gaze reached, he was already there, quickly landing under the eaves of a long-decayed mansion.
The mansion was of the ancient style, as if it was built by a wealthy man tired of the Imperial Court, retreating to the mountains and forests.
And as Song Yan’s boots hit the ground, the lanterns on either side of the eaves bizarrely lit up, swaying eerily in the wind, casting an eerie red light downward.
Song Yan raised his hand, took out a paperman, and tossed it out.
Ghost Cultivation Association’s papermen, this was normal, nothing to say about it.
And this paperman was made from the Essence Blood of the corpse of the "Blood Corpse Sect Leader" and that of the "Traitor Elder of the Thousand Crane Sect," styled as Yin Paperman, totaling twenty.
The Yin Paperman quickly pushed open the door and rushed inside.
Soon...
A rough and terrifying flash came from the side, too fast for the Yin Paperman to dodge.
Boom!
The Yin Paperman directly exploded.
And at that moment, dense gray raindrops suddenly appeared in the sky, resembling a cracked, pitch-black cauldron bottom, suspended in mid-air without falling, while Song Yan had already moved.
He hadn’t even expected that just entering the Secret Realm, he would encounter the "Rain State"—the most fearsome among the Three States of the Tumor Realm.
In the next instant...
Song Yan once again used the "Profound Wind, Thought" dual escape techniques.
This dual escape technique burst, making him unbelievably fast, so fast that although time was not slowed down in the least, the sudden rain fell like snails slowly inching downward, while the mansion’s dark space inside where the Yin Paperman burst, the monster’s figure seemed frozen.
The monster was frozen, but Song Yan was not.
Though Song Yan couldn’t see the monster clearly through the Yin Paperman, he could make out a bizarre silhouette.
He arrived, his finger arriving.
A point of Canxing Finger, several killing thoughts instantly formed an array, attacking the monster from different directions, different angles, with different attack methods.
Crack!
Boom!
Monster shattered!
Amid the shattered bones emerged thick Slaughter Liquid and specks of Fixed Evil dust.
Song Yan reached into the void, grabbed the Sikong Seal corpse, and pushed the body roughly against the dust, then swiftly scooped it into the Storage Space.
After completing this extremely familiar set of actions of "explore monster, kill monster, collect corpse, absorb Fixed Evil," the rain in the sky finally started to fall.
Pat, pat, pat pat...
A torrential downpour, as if the sluice gates of the sky’s reservoir had been opened.
Song Yan quickly walked into the house.
Inside was pitch black, the furnishings complete, yet as Song Yan entered, moving around, the air flowed, many tables and chairs simply turned to dust, and the slightly hard places shattered upon hitting the ground.
In an instant, the house was empty again.
Song Yan looked at the rain in the distance.
He could feel a strange force of thoughts in the rain.
Refining Profound uses Profound Artifact.
Crimson Palace relies on blood.
But from the Purple Mansion onwards... it naturally starts relying on thoughts.
Suddenly, he saw a figure appear in the distance, the figure dressed in a sapphire robe, the robe emblazoned with a Sect’s name, obviously one of the fifty-three Crimson Palace cultivators from before.
That cultivator also seemed to want to take shelter from the rain here, but his speed was not enough, hurriedly stopping under a bizarre dead tree outside, raising his hand to take out an umbrella-shaped Profound Treasure.
The umbrella instantly opened a thick protective shield, but the rainwater was not affected, falling through the shield, hitting the cultivator.
And the cultivator seemed to be immobilized, instantly motionless, standing in place as if stunned, face-up to the sky, letting the heavy rain pummel his face.
Song Yan paused for a moment, then suddenly turned to look at the house he was in.
Although all the furniture in the house was destroyed, the house itself was perfectly intact, even the walls without any damage.
But after only a brief look, Song Yan felt a weird "sizzling" sound, the sound of corrosion, coming from the eaves direction.
Clearly, this house could only temporarily resist the rainwater, once fully corroded it would be uninhabitable.
It’s easy to imagine, the deeper one goes into the Tumor Realm, places that can resist rain, fog, heavy snow will become more scarce...
He’s not planning to go deeper just yet.
Previously in the Illusion Realm of the Sea of Suffering, though most were false, there was one thing true.
That is... he really won’t hurry to go further into the first Secret Realm.
He has a Paper House made from "Paper-cut Celestial Palace."
The abnormality of this Paper House lies in that, as long as it’s not destroyed immediately, it can create a suitable environment for living...

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)
Song Yan stood in the ancient house of unknown age, the dark floor entwined with the dust of tables and chairs along with the skeleton fragments crushed due to loss of Evil Qi.
Song Yan could vaguely discern that nine out of ten of these monsters were once humans.
The appearance of Demon Beasts in the Secret Realm is not unusual, as "using Secret Realms to breed Demon Beasts" might be a highly sophisticated commonplace trick, at least it was in the past.
But the appearance of a residence, the appearance of humans, was somewhat strange.
He instinctively raised his head, releasing his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
Yet, as soon as his Divine Sense exited the house, it was quickly blocked, and at this moment, the torrential rain had completely obscured his Divine Sense’s investigation.
However, he could still vaguely distinguish some other residences in the distance.
Not many, but definitely not few.
Considering his view was merely a corner of the Secret Realm, then clearly these houses intended for human habitation were numerous.
An ancient group residing within a Secret Realm?
Song Yan couldn’t help but come to an initial conclusion.
It’s important to know that this Secret Realm was drawn out from an unknown corner of the world to fill the "Sea of Suffering", and its existence should be extremely ancient, and from the furniture in the houses that shatter upon a mere shock from air, yet remaining intact, it can be seen that no one has been here for a very long time.
The Tumor Realm is layered.
One layer after another.
The further outside, the more recent it is dragged in.
Thus, he was among the very first to enter this place in countless years.
’Could it be Ancient Cultivators?’
Seeing as the rain wouldn’t be stopping anytime soon, Song Yan began exploring this residence, attempting to find some treasures.
The residence wasn’t particularly large, with two doors, and Song Yan was currently in the main room behind the first door. Judging by the overall structure, this house should be something akin to a reception hall.
He made a round, naturally finding no treasures, after all... no one would hide treasures in a "reception hall".
Song Yan arrived at the back door, looking towards some buildings in the backyard.
Through the rain curtain, he could vaguely see some strange outlines moving behind the back house’s door, appearing to be "abnormal skeletons assembled from Evil Qi".
Further back, there were tables and chairs, bookshelves, obviously a place like a study.
Song Yan really wanted to take a look, so he acted on the thought of "perhaps tearing down the roof to use as an umbrella," raising his hand like a blade to cut toward the roof, but upon trying slightly, he found something wrong.
The building materials here were terrifyingly hard. If placed outside, they’d all be excellent materials for casting Array Plates.
He tried for a while, gave up, and began quietly waiting.
He couldn’t go anywhere on rainy days.
And the abnormal skeletons in the distant study also instinctively didn’t want to enter the rain, so they stayed inside.
...
Listening to the rain fall all night without cease, yet instead, it grew even heavier.
Song Yan patiently waited.
Though the Paper House was useful, even one made from Purple Mansion Blood in places like this could only be used once less each time, possibly being a one-time object, so he had to use it at a critical time.
...
After three days, the rain still hadn’t stopped, and the water on the ground had accumulated to a high level.
Song Yan, who was sitting cross-legged in the house, suddenly heard some abnormal noises, he abruptly opened his eyes, seeing that the threshold of this reception hall unexpectedly could no longer block the outside accumulation of water.
The water overflowed the threshold, swaying with the wind, broke surface tension, soaked into the house, and began spreading inward, making the entire floor of the reception hall wet in no time.
Song Yan moved, leaping directly to the roof beams, and then began waiting on the beams...
This rain fell with absolutely no reason.
Listening to the sole sound of rain between heaven and earth, watching the increasingly accumulating water beneath his feet, a sudden premonition of misfortune surged in his heart.
He didn’t know the terrain of the Secret Realm, but he knew... a sudden downpour lasting several days could potentially lead to some kinds of natural disasters, like "dragons flooding tides", or "mountain flood avalanches".
The water here wasn’t inherently scary, but if it were infused with rain carrying the aura of the Sea of Suffering, then it would turn into a small Sea of Suffering.
Song Yan didn’t know how other people or demons entering the Secret Realm were faring, but such unlucky matters shouldn’t befall him alone, right?
But there were always unlucky people, he couldn’t be certain.
...
In the blink of an eye, another five days passed, and the rain still hadn’t ceased.
And the ground had turned into a stream...
Suddenly, Song Yan’s brow twitched, as he heard a sound from the distance like "mosquito flies" buzzing, but the sound quickly heightened, sharp, from insect chirping to gongs and drums, and then to bustling market noise, eventually transforming into endless drumbeats.
Flooding occurred!!
But there was no sound of houses collapsing.
Song Yan swiftly picked up the Paper House, preparing to place it down at the crucial moment.
Soon, the flood tide arrived.
With a monstrous roar.
Submerging most of the house, yet the water stopped two or three feet beneath Song Yan’s feet.
The abnormal skeleton next door didn’t manage to timely leap on the beams like Song Yan, and was swept into the flood.
Song Yan only saw the Evil Qi emitting a mournful scream, the surrounding Evil Qi rapidly dissolving, first dispersing the Evil Qi, then the Slaughter Liquid began fading, transforming into Evil Qi, subsequently evaporating, and some red Evil Qi powder within frantically floated to the skeleton’s outermost layer, seemingly extremely afraid of touch by the flood.
Song Yan squinted his eyes, suddenly grabbing from the Void the "Sikong Seal corpse", manipulating the corpse at the entrance near the Evil Qi.
The struggling Evil Qi seemed to have grasped a lifeline, rapidly shooting towards the Sikong Seal corpse.
Song Yan immediately stored the corpse in the Storage Bag, retrieving it into his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 149. Slay the Ancient Remains, Grievances Resolved! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: 149. Slay the Ancient Remains, Grievances Resolved! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
After completing this set, he looked again at the study that had been swept away.
Everything in the study turned to dust, but only one thing remained impacted by the water flow.
It was a mysterious wooden plaque.
Song Yan raised his hand to capture it.
As soon as he touched the plaque, his fingers released it as if electrified, accompanied by a terrifying thunderous sound exploding in his mind.
"You are not of my race, do not touch this item!"
Looking again, the plaque had transformed into a rainbow light, flying to an unknown destination.
Song Yan looked at his hand, then at the distant rainbow light, falling into slight contemplation.
Undoubtedly, hidden in the plaque was likely an immortal thought, and the reason this thought could immediately discern he wasn’t of the "race" was most likely due to the Divine Soul.
Much like how no matter how he lied, Feng Chengzi could tell he wasn’t a member of the Formless Race.
So, was this an unknown Ancient Race’s legacy?
...
Time flew by, and another half day passed.
The rain finally stopped.
During this time, Song Yan silently observed the water surface, hoping to discover some treasures, given that finding treasures in a Secret Realm was quite normal...
But the result was nothing at all.
He speculated that the unknown Ancient Race knew trouble was brewing for their race, so they sealed all their treasures somewhere unknown, waiting for their descendants. Naturally, it was impossible to find anything outside.
Song Yan was not discouraged. He slightly perceived, waited to confirm the rain had completely stopped, then flew out and landed on the rooftop.
Where the sunlight shone, a shimmering lake had formed.
The lake surface gleamed with golden light, exuding tranquility, yet hiding danger, while many houses had sunk halfway.
Suddenly, Song Yan was startled, he saw a person floating on the water not far away.
That person was the Crimson Palace cultivator who had rushed to the residence but didn’t make it in time, he was washed by the rainwater, his eyes dull, confused, but not dead.
Although not dead, his body became a concentration camp for "Slaughter Solid".
Floating on the water surface, his body was coated with terrifying red dust.
The reason the Slaughter Solid had not yet occupied his body was entirely because most of his body was still submerged in water.
Perhaps by luck, the person "smacked" into a rooftop, and in the next instant, the Slaughter Solid crazily drilled into his body, then controlled his hands to desperately grab the rooftop, mechanically climbing up. Once on the roof ridge, his appearance started changing, streams of Slaughter Liquid flowed within his body, and his eyes turned into congealed red.
First, he was cleansed of Cause and Effect by the rain, then his body was covered by Slaughter Solid.
And at this moment, an even more bizarre scene unfolded.
On the vast water surface, a gray figure stepped upon the water, that gray undoubtedly seemed a layer of aura, yet fluctuated intensely, like a Hundred-Patch Robe in an ink wash painting.
Song Yan recognized it; this gray figure was the Novice Monk from the Sea of Suffering.
The Novice Monk quickly reached the cultivator’s side, pressing his palms together.
The cultivator that had been moving suddenly froze.
He did not move, and neither did the Novice Monk, presenting a scene of enlightenment.
