After a long while, Song Yan saw the cultivator, whose body had been seized by Slaughter Solid, begin to emit red smoke from all over, and as the red smoke dispersed, there appeared a feeling of returning to normal...
After a while, the Slaughter Solid within the cultivator dissipated completely, and the frenzied sheen in his eyes vanished entirely, his head tilted, and he died.
When the Novice Monk finished enlightening the cultivator, the gray on his body seemed slightly denser, he turned to look at Song Yan, but seemed to discern Song Yan as a "stubborn, not easily enlightened" being, and thus turned away and walked off.
Rain after a lonely city, stepping upon water to enlighten, ending with a flick of the robe, leaving no trace for thousands of miles...
This scene was full of Zen meaning yet indescribably eerie and sinister.
...
Song Yan watched the Novice Monk leave, continuing to observe the surroundings when suddenly a powerful voice echoed from the sky.
"Those who are alive, come over!"
Song Yan slightly frowned: it’s the Ancient Remains!
As soon as he entered the Secret Realm, it began to rain; everyone was hiding.
Now, after some time since the rain, those randomly brought into the Secret Realm began to appear one by one.
The words from the sky fell, and shortly after, a figure flew up, it was a silver-robed female cultivator, a sword cultivator.
Her figure was tall and slender, the silver robe fluttered, her face charmingly beautiful, captivating the surrounding lakes and mountains, and her sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes showed a hint of vibrant righteousness. However, she currently looked scared, timid, appearing quite pitiful.
"Junior Pei Xuehan, greets... ancient ancestor."
After the silver-robed female cultivator flew up, she slightly bowed and stood to the side waiting for others.
But after waiting for a long time, she didn’t see anyone.
The Ancient Remains suddenly locked his gaze in Song Yan’s direction, saying: "Don’t you come out yet?"
Song Yan had no choice but to rise and fly over.
The silver-robed female cultivator, who introduced herself as Pei Xuehan, was clearly one of the fifty-three Crimson Palace cultivators from before, and the words "Listening Rain Sword Sect" embroidered on her back further indicated which sect she was fulfilling the quota for.
Pei Xuehan initially thought her companions were coming up, but upon looking she saw a terrifying man with a Profound Robe and disfigured face, her heart fell into shock, revealing a bitter smile. Among the squad, there were only six Purple Mansion old monsters, and she was directly assigned to two.
At this moment, she felt both fear and joy. Upon seeing Song Yan, she immediately performed a greeting, loudly saying: "Junior Pei Xuehan, greets Elder Zhang."
After completing the greeting, she carefully lowered her head, retreating to the perimeter of the two old monsters.
Overlooking the surroundings, the Ancient Remains shouted sharply: "Is there anyone else?!"
The voice roared, spreading around, yet there was no response.
The Ancient Remains glanced at Song Yan, saying: "Go take a look."
Song Yan nodded slightly, transformed into rainbow light, spinning around the area, extending his Divine Sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
The rain had stopped, and the surrounding scenery was unobstructed...
This Secret Realm was not large, about the size of a human village, and it was now all submerged in water.
The origin of the flood was quite peculiar upstream, as the water seemed to gush out from another Secret Realm, and at the mouth, two corpses floated, soaked for who knows how long.
These two corpses appeared to be stuck at the Secret Realm’s exit, or perhaps something from the other end of the Secret Realm was holding them, so only half of their bodies were swaying outside.
One had its legs exposed, the other had its head exposed.
The head had long been soaked to the size of a giant’s head, the pale swollen eyeballs floating in the water, tethered by nerve lines, appearing eerily suspended.
Song Yan squinted at the person, he could discern the high level of body strength, indicating that they were at least at the Late stage Of Crimson Palace, possibly even Purple Mansion.
Yet such a powerful person died here at some unknown time...
What caused his tragic death?
Song Yan did not know.
But he understood that anyone who wanted to reach the next Secret Realm had to pass this entrance, encounter these two bizarre corpses, and face the unknown dangers on the opposite side of the Secret Realm.
After a brief contemplation, he began to turn back.
...
The ancient remains had already fallen onto a rooftop, while Pei Xuehan stood far away.
The ancient remains said, "This place is so strange, and you definitely won’t make it out alive. You were sent by the sect as cannon fodder, so why not come over and serve me well?
If you serve me comfortably, once I get out, I’ll consider taking care of your sect due to your body."
Pei Xuehan cowered and kept standing, not knowing what to say, just kept giggling pitifully.
The ancient remains were inherently lustful, this was evident from how it teased Han Yuling before, and with the fifteen countries under the Fox and Wolf Races’ command revering them, it had long expropriated everything here as its own. It decided whom to kill, whom to eat, and if anyone dared to defy, it would mean betrayal.
At this moment, the ancient remains impatiently spread its legs wide, revealing sharp fur-covered wolf legs, stuck its hand into its groin, frowned, and said in irritation, "Come over and relieve me."
Pei Xuehan was like a fool, continuing to giggle without any response ability.
Just then, a gust of wind swept in from afar, and Song Yan’s figure appeared.
The ancient remains’ expression turned cold, and smacked the rooftop, "Why are you back at this time? Can’t you see what I’m doing?!"
Song Yan said, "Ancient master, the Secret Realm has only the three of us left, but the entrance to the next Secret Realm seems peculiar, I suggest we wait a while, observe and then act."
The ancient remains unexpectedly calmed down, asked about the situation, and then, in a natural tone, said, "Go and check what those two corpses are stuck with, report back to me."
Song Yan cast his gaze toward Pei Xuehan.
Pei Xuehan shuddered, her breathing halted.
Song Yan frowned and said, "Let her go. She was chosen by the superior, wasn’t she meant for this?"
Pei Xuehan was already scared out of her mind.
She... she felt quite righteous when she left the sect, even patted her chest saying, "You all don’t dare go, then I’ll go," but now she regretted it, her sense of righteousness and courage had long vanished, leaving only intense fear.
Both of these old monsters, one wanted her to serve, the other wanted her to die.
Just then, the ancient remains turned its head, its blood-red copper bell-like giant eyes stared at Song Yan, articulating slowly, "Are you defying my orders?"
Song Yan said, "The corpse’s power is really not weak, most likely also at the Purple Mansion Realm, which suggests there might be some unknown monster on the other side. Ancient master, it’s really not wise to move rashly."
Anyone else, any person who has fought their way to the Purple Mansion Realm, would understand... this is the time to stop.
But each person has different personalities and growth environments.
To a Wolf Demon, who has long been used to being domineering, smooth sailing, and even invincible, the lives and deaths of all creatures within the fifteen countries of the Fox and Wolf Races, as well as other vassal states, were within its whim.
At this moment, upon hearing Song Yan’s suggestion, it didn’t even utter a word, just looked at him in astonishment, seeming incredulous that he dared to retort with so many words.
In those giant eyes, there was mockery, amusement, peculiarities, and a sense of lofty overlook.
The brief silence was broken, the ancient remains faintly asked, "Have you gone crazy?"
The air instantly turned quiet and tense.
Until Song Yan slightly bowed, and said, "Alright, I’ll go take a look."
The ancient remains laughed heartily, then looked at Pei Xuehan and said, "Did you see? In this place, my words are like an imperial decree of the Wolf Race, like divine commands! Even a human Purple Mansion must listen obediently. Whatever I want him to do, he must do."
Song Yan turned and flew towards the Secret Realm entrance.
Saying goes, endure and the calm persists...
Take a step back...
Take a step back, the more I think, the angrier I get.
He didn’t want to go to the next Secret Realm so early, seeing the ancient remains was an unavoidable matter, originally pretending to be peaceful would have been fine, endure a bit and endure a bit.
But at this moment, this Wolf Demon was completely set on using him as cannon fodder, and the danger of this Soul Threshold of the Ruler was far beyond his imagination.
His mind rapidly weighed: on one side is being consumed as cannon fodder and then dying tragically, on the other is lurking in the first Secret Realm, waiting for the opportunity to act.
Which seems better, doesn’t it?
Song Yan slightly squinted his eyes, then suddenly halted, began to turn back.
...
Pei Xuehan’s Sword Robe had already been torn open, exposing large patches of snow-white flesh, the ancient remains was about to act when it saw the returning human Purple Mansion, slightly tilted its head, and said coldly, "I remember."

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
Song Yan squeezed out a smile, saying, "Elder Gu, there’s a new discovery, very important, related to the Evil Treasure."
Gu Hai was indifferent at first, but upon hearing "Evil Treasure," his spirit suddenly lifted.
Song Yan glanced at Pei Xuehan, saying blandly, "She doesn’t deserve to listen."
Gu Hai uttered an "Hmm," casually discarding Pei Xuehan, saying, "You die, the Sect perishes with you, understand?"
Pei Xuehan, choked with tears, had long been crying like a rain-soaked pear blossom, yet dared not rebel and stepped aside submissively.
Gu Hai looked towards Song Yan, his pupils revealing delight, saying, "If you truly have news of that Evil Treasure, consider it a great merit!"
Song Yan swiftly approached, then lowered his voice: "Who would have expected, the Evil Treasure supposed to be at the Tumor Realm’s end, actually..."
He spoke softer, as Gu Hai reflexively leaned closer.
Yet, even leaning closer, he still couldn’t hear the rest.
Because Song Yan had already made his move.
Profound Wind Escape and Thought Escape, utilizing both escapes in unison.
In an instant, countless thoughts formed an array, encircling Gu Hai with Canxing Finger technique, enveloping him layer upon layer.
Gu Hai was quick to react, dark shadows burst around him, each emitting bizarre roars. The overlapping sound waves rapidly blurred the shadows, transforming into starry specks like snowflakes, or bees clustering together as if forming a strange tower, an unknown bizarre martial art technique.
Yet, even his quick reactions were far slower compared to Song Yan.
Thus, before his martial technique could take shape, Song Yan in his sight had already turned into a spiraling, blood-red, giant dahlia, a massive whirlpool across the sky.
The petals spread open, and the whirlpool descended.
With a "boom," the attack Gu Hai hadn’t yet formed was forcefully broken apart.
This occurrence, rare enough among opponents of the same level in the Purple Mansion, since everyone acts within a thought, who could be faster?
Yet, with "Profound Wind Escape and Thought Escape," coupled with the close distance and calculated against unexpectedness, it made taking the "initiative" possible.
"In Jianghu, it’s said, ’Speed is the ultimate martial skill,’ which holds true, and still holds true at a high Realm, but it’s often harder to gain speed in high Realms compared to Jianghu martial artists."
Being one move behind, Gu Hai began passively enduring Song Yan’s countless thought attacks.
’How dare he?’
Gu Hai roared in his heart.
’My Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma!’
’Let me unleash it!’
’My Corpse-Eating Wolf Race’s unique Purple Mansion Racial Secret Technique — Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma!’
He continued to form thoughts, thoughts expanded, but before accumulating, they were shattered by Song Yan’s thoughts.
In this clash of thoughts, the distance between them grew closer.
Gu Hai stared fiercely at Song Yan, and Song Yan also looked at Gu Hai.
Finally, when they were close enough, Gu Hai suddenly showed a sinister grin, and the attack that had failed to form abruptly transformed. Dense blood-colored seals appeared around him, pushing outward heavily!
Each of these blood-colored seals was enough to make a Crimson Palace cultivator’s blood boil to death. As they descended, even a Purple Mansion cultivator had to retreat.
He was the perfect Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, a giant wolf born with abundant Qi Blood. The "Blood Demon Seal" he cast with his thoughts was more terrifying than ordinary Corpse-Eating Wolves.
If it weren’t for the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, naturally skilled at using sound waves to control blood, one wouldn’t survive such a seal without shedding layers of skin!
Even for Purple Mansion, it couldn’t help but retreat!
And as soon as it retreated, as soon as he unleashed the Purple Mansion Secret Technique "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma," this human would undoubtedly die!
Yet in the next instant, an unbelievable thing occurred.
In Gu Hai’s eyes, the human actually broke through the "Blood Demon Seal," neither easily nor extremely difficultly, just like other Corpse-Eating Wolf Race’s Purple Mansion existences.
Simultaneously breaking through, the human even had the energy to raise his hand and gather thoughts, and within the instant of thought birth and death, a large radiant blood-colored hand appeared in front of him, then struck downward.
The hand bore with unstoppable force, evidently an extremely exquisite killing thought technique.
Boom!
This palm hit Gu Hai’s brow, precisely the weakest point of the Purple Mansion body.
It’s like the city gates broke, no longer able to protect the divine soul behind it.
In Gu Hai’s heart, an unimaginable terror arose for the first time.
He didn’t want to die!
He didn’t want to die!
He was the future overlord of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, he still had many good things to claim, many humans to eat, many beauties to enjoy, how could he die?
He had never lost!
This was just the first time!
Why would the first time end like this?
Why was this person not affected by the Blood Demon Seal?
In an instant, his mind traveled back through countless memories, those numerous memories spinning like a lantern, yet every memory contained scenes of "him oppressing and killing human race cultivators."
When he was in the Early Stage of Crimson Palace, he could kill those in the Middle Stage; when in the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace, he coveted a Late Stage’s treasure, and when the person hesitated slightly, he struck and killed them cleanly and ate them; scenes such as coveting something leading to murder, annihilating a city over a disagreement, defiling wives and daughters while cultivators witnessed, he had done not for the first but countless times.
Everything on this land was his.
Was he wrong?
But why would this time be different?
Gu Hai’s heart emitted a roar of unwillingness!
However, no matter how much unwillingness or confusion... his divine soul had already drifted out.
And across from him, the human Purple Mansion was expressionless and merciless, turning his hand, a dark banner rapidly expanded with the wind, soon reaching over a yard, surrounding eerie winds and ghostly mist.
Gu Hai heard a voice by his ear.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: 149. Slaying Ancient Remains, Grudges Settled! (8.0K Words - Major Chapter, Please Subscribe)_5
"This banner is yet to have a Purple Mansion to oversee it, I’ll trouble Lord Gu."
The calm voice, courteous and polite, hid an indescribable teasing ferocity.
...
...
General Ancient Tooth held his head high, accompanied by several Crimson Palace cultivators, as well as a "Treasure Hunter."
As the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race’s old ancestor entering this time, he was at the same cultivation level of the Late Stage of Purple Mansion as Master Infant Cry.
Though Changwang’s Soul Threshold was terrifying, he had made some plans, and coupled with the luck of having a Treasure Hunter beside him, he was in a rather good mood.
At this moment, a mysterious tremor from a thought struck his Divine Soul,
General Ancient Tooth was stunned, then his expression drastically changed.
This was the "Unity Seal"!
The use of "Unity Seal" was extremely demanding, only applicable between same-clansmen, blood relatives, and both of Purple Mansion level, its function simple: at the moment of life-and-death, one could see the other and temporarily occupy the other’s body with one’s thoughts to launch an attack.
Ancient Skeleton was his junior, and among his juniors, the one with the most monstrous talent.
He always valued him highly!
At this moment, he felt the deathly sensation from the other end of the "Unity Seal," he instantly closed his eyes, his thought flew towards that unknown side, then opened his eyes, seeing Old Skeleton being drawn into the Myriad Souls Banner and Song Yan holding the grand banner.
"Youngster, won’t you stop?!"
Ancient Tooth’s eyes burned with rage, he roared fiercely, regardless of whether Song Yan would stop, lifting his hand and sending a palm towards Song Yan!
This palm was exceedingly profound, manifesting three different thoughts in the void, instantly weaving into the shape of a blood-colored Treasure Pagoda.
Treasure Pagoda, also called Pagoda!
The three-thoughts woven "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" was the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race’s strong killer move.
The pagoda immediately smashed towards Song Yan.
Song Yan felt his scalp tingle, an unprecedented crisis rushing towards him.
This scene far exceeded his imagination, something he had never encountered before.
How could there still be an old ghost able to strike from afar, aiding the attack when Old Skeleton’s Divine Soul was about to be extracted?
Numerous thoughts flashed, he quickly retreated, simultaneously waving the Myriad Souls Banner forward!
But before the souls could touch Old Skeleton’s body, the blood-colored Treasure Pagoda already fell.
Song Yan couldn’t dodge, pushed with his left hand, weaving Heaven-Shaking Hand with his thoughts to push upwards.
Bang!
The pagoda pressed down solidly.
Song Yan felt as though he was bearing a thousand mountains, he couldn’t be bothered with using the Myriad Souls Banner, focusing entirely on using his thoughts, his right hand also sent up another Heaven-Shaking Hand.
Heaven-Shaking Hand, his strongest direct technique at the Purple Mansion level.
Two blood hands propped up the blood tower.
As the tower descended, Song Yan felt intense pain throughout his body, bleeding all over, his seven orifices like balloons about to burst, "puff" with blood seeping out, his Divine Soul’s layer shaking fiercely.
Time seemed to have passed a few breaths, or perhaps days, months.
Song Yan glared, gritted his teeth, stubbornly arching his back.
On the brink of being crushed into dust by the pagoda, yet still holding on with all his might!
But the strike of the blood tower finally passed.
Song Yan slumped to the ground, warmth flowing from his eyes and nose, the sweetness of fresh blood on his tongue, his expression dazedly nodding, the surroundings all turned into vague, fractured blood-hued outlines.
Ancient Tooth seemed utterly unprepared for this Early Stage Purple Mansion of the Human Race to survive its unreserved strike, seeing the Myriad Souls Banner still absorbing Old Skeleton, quickly shouted out: "Zhang Han! Stop at once, release Old Skeleton’s Divine Soul! I may spare your life, or else... I’ll have your Divine Soul obliterated, making you regret coming into the world!"
These words seemed to awaken Song Yan.
He suddenly lifted his bloodshot eyes, staring at Ancient Tooth like a fiend from hell, then gave a sinister smile, suddenly forming a seal.
Instantly, the Myriad Souls Banner’s pull intensified, the almost entirely absorbed Old Skeleton’s Divine Soul showing an unimaginable fear, its gigantic wolf head opened as if crying out, pleading for help.
Ancient Tooth watched its state, reached out, only to see Old Skeleton fully absorbed into the Myriad Souls Banner.
And the Myriad Souls Banner "whoosh" quickly returned to the blood-covered man’s hand.
Unable to remain in this body any longer, Ancient Tooth gazed coldly with the utmost hatred towards that man, indifferently saying, "Zhang Han, I’ll wait for you on the road ahead."
The words bore no warmth, permeating with absolute chill.
Seeming to sense others around, Ancient Tooth turned his wolf head, glaring towards Pei Xuehan, harshly declaring, "Old Skeleton is in trouble, you, as a servant, not helping, should die! Hear Rain Sword Sect? Prepare to be buried!"
Pei Xuehan: ...
The next moment.
Bang!
Old Skeleton’s massive body tilted over, lifeless.
Song Yan darted over, storing this body within a storage bag.
Having done all this, he felt utterly dizzy.
Yet he also felt his blood burning.
He never flaunts, nor courts trouble, but never fears it.
Either don’t do it, or do it to the fullest!!
This is not the outside world, but Changwang’s Soul Threshold.
Here, he is the most suitable to seize Changwang’s Evil Treasure.
’Old dog, wait and see.’
He could no longer sustain himself; a Late Stage Purple Mansion’s strike indeed reached the peak of what he could bear, if not for the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Race" essence blood within him, Ancient Tooth’s strike could have killed him.
With the least amount of consciousness remaining, Song Yan lay collapsed on the rooftop, beginning his recovery.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - please subscribe)
Song Yan felt incredibly weak, as if he were burning with fever in a previous life, lying on a bed. The power of that strange tower had not dissipated and continued to invade his body, forcing him to exert force to fight it, while his wounds kept opening and bleeding.
He quickly became a blood-soaked figure, even the rooftop he lay on turned into a pool of blood...
Blood dripped down the slope, fell with a drip-drop into the floodwaters flowing below, and the dense smell of blood spread around.
Pei Xuehan finally reacted, looking at the old freak from the Purple Mansion in the distance. Although she was afraid, she knew that old freak was her last straw to clutch at for survival... even for the Sword Sect.
So, she moved quickly to the roof where Song Yan was, took out a Cyan Smoke Jade Box from her arms, with a look of heartache in her eyes, yet still rushed forward, opened the box, and handed the elixir inside to Song Yan, saying, "Senior, this is an elixir refined from Thousand-Year Profound Milk, please take it."
But she could not get close enough to Song Yan before a cold voice exploded in her ear.
"Scram."
Pei Xuehan was so frightened that she jumped back as if electrocuted.
And the voice, full of killing intent and strong vigilance, came from afar again.
"Behave yourself, don’t try any tricks."
Pei Xuehan pitifully replied, "Oh, understood."
Seeing that the female cultivator was no longer approaching, Song Yan finally breathed a sigh of relief and fully focused on digesting the remnants of power left by Ancient Tooth.
He already knew that the tower was the secret technique of the Wolf Race at the Purple Mansion level — the Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma.
The "Slaughter Tower" itself was a tower. By splitting thoughts, one constructs a tower; once the tower falls, it suppresses the enemy. Even if the tower disperses, the power within remains like a lingering miasma, as if countless bees are frantically drilling into one’s body and divine soul.
At this moment, Song Yan was enduring these "bees."
If not for Ancient Tooth using this strike through an ancient corpse body, and because he carried the bloodline of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, he would have long been dead.
This Slaughter Tower also enlightened him on some directions beyond the Purple Mansion.
The secret techniques used by the Purple Mansion experts are in themselves magical treasures, and the power woven by thought far surpasses external items.
The Profound Artifacts of the Refining Profound, and the Profound Treasures of the Crimson Palace, no matter how ingeniously crafted, still can’t compare to a strike by a Purple Mansion expert using a secret technique.
Therefore, why would a Purple Mansion expert need such cultivation techniques or treasures?
Perhaps what truly matters to a Purple Mansion expert are Soul Artifacts and Soul Treasures.
It’s easier to forge a Soul Artifact, but forging a Soul Treasure is extremely difficult.
The core material for crafting a Myriad Souls Banner is the "Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade."
The "White Cave Crystal Jade" can only occur at places of elemental turbulence, such as "Fire Profound White Cave Crystal Jade" potentially forming around a volcanic eruption, "Water Profound White Cave Crystal Jade" around a deep-sea tsunami, and "Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade" only at locations of divine soul shock and eruption.
Thus, it is exceedingly rare.
Soul Artifacts and Soul Treasures assist the divine soul thoughts and are no longer directly used for attack against the Purple Mansion.
As for Evil Treasures, he was still unclear, but it seemed that such treasures must exist beyond Soul Treasures, and appeared to form by certain unexpected events of nature.
With all these thoughts, he grew weaker. Clearly, the strongest backlash of the "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" had arrived.
He fought with all his might...
And at that moment, he suddenly saw the silver-robed female cultivator leap nearby again.
Song Yan’s eyes grew cold, just as he was about to get angry, he suddenly saw the female cultivator raise her hand in Sword Control.
His pupils contracted, about to divert his attention, even if it meant suffering further injury, to strike this female cultivator down. Yet he saw that the rainbow glow from the Sword Control was not aimed at him, but instead shot into the distance.
Puff!
The rainbow settled, piercing a corpse that was floating closer, then carried the body further away.
But just then, her flying sword couldn’t return, for as the sword had just pierced the corpse, a wisp of red sand flew from the wound. The red sand clambered onto the sword hilt in an instant, then rose high, as if wanting to fall on the rooftop where he was.
Song Yan’s gaze moved rapidly, and he saw that several corpses had appeared around his rooftop without him knowing.
These corpses were likely cultivators from the Crimson Palace who randomly entered this secret realm, but they weren’t as lucky as Pei Xuehan to escape. They were either directly killed by Evil Monsters hidden in the darkness, or became dazed in the Tumor Realm’s great rain and were possessed by the Evil Binding...
With the flood rising, these corpses became the life-saving straw for the Evil Binding. Just by wandering around the vicinity, they were covered in Evil Binding, each becoming a terrifying bomb.
And he was bleeding extensively, the smell of blood making those many Evil Bindings try to find ways to approach him.
However, they did not dare to touch the lower half of the corpse, so they couldn’t fully control the corpse, thus moving much slower.
But even so, those corpses were still moving towards the rooftop at the speed of a fast human.
Song Yan glanced at the female cultivator again and saw that although she was in a hurry from losing her flying sword, she still had many treasures in her Storage Bag, which she hastily took out one by one and threw into the distance.
But with every throw, she lost one treasure.
Song Yan watched and was furious!
He said in a low voice, "Let the corpses get close, as soon as they get close, they’ll stick together, making it easier to deal with."
"Oh oh oh oh..." the silver-robed female cultivator hurriedly agreed, then attempted to approach the corpses using Song Yan’s method.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_2
But it’s obviously not that easy.
The Fixed Evil clearly has hunting instincts. Now, before the Profound Treasure has even fallen, they rise from the corpses like extending arms to grasp the Profound Treasure.
Once the Profound Treasure is touched, it instantly stiffens.
Pei Xuehan had a flash of inspiration and suddenly formed a technique with her fingers. Whether it was magic or the power within her blood, she heard a rush, and water waves rippled outward, reversing to forcefully stop the corpses’ approach.
Pei Xuehan stomped her foot and said, "How did my Great Tsunami Technique end up like this!"
Song Yan squinted at the dead water ripples that carried the aura of the Sea of Suffering, musing silently. He believed the "Great Tsunami Technique" must possess great power, but such a powerful Crimson Palace Technique had little effect in this flood, like a child playing with water, truly frightening.
"Get closer, use the water waves to gather them!"
Song Yan commanded.
"Oh oh oh!"
Pei Xuehan said, "I also have the Great Vortex Technique."
With that, she shouted softly, causing the Profound Qi overhead to churn violently, yet the violent motion only formed a small vortex at the heart of the water.
Even so, the vortex managed to pull the two corpses closer to each other.
Song Yan continued to resist the onslaught of the "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" while focusing on the corpses.
He knew that if today went poorly, they might end up being killed by the Fixed Evil.
Thus, he was exceedingly cautious.
Suddenly, he shouted, "Where’s the elixir?"
Pei Xuehan was taken aback.
Song Yan repeated, "The elixir!"
Pei Xuehan reacted quickly, grabbing the elixir refined from the Thousand-Year Profound Milk and brought it to him, seeing his body frozen as if unable to move. The silver-robed female cultivator considered and raised a hand to feed him the elixir.
Song Yan frowned, scaring Pei Xuehan into quickly letting go.
The elixir fell back into the box.
Song Yan said, "Just put it in front of me."
Pei Xuehan hurriedly arranged it and then continued with the Great Vortex Technique.
Song Yan gazed at the elixir before him, silently thought, "Using this elixir as a target for cultivation"...
After confirming the elixir was non-toxic and effective, he consumed it. Instantly, a faint power burgeoned within him, small though it was, helping accelerate his recovery.
He endured the strongest backlash from the "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" and, afterwards, recovery was just a matter of time.
Song Yan let out a long breath and looked again at the corpses being gathered by the Great Vortex Technique, seemingly everything was going smoothly. The water’s pull made the encircling tendency of the corpses dissipate, binding them closer to each other.
Between them formed a weird aggregative force, causing them to temporarily abandon moving toward Song Yan.
Pei Xuehan joyfully said, "Senior, it’s working!"
Yet Song Yan’s expression showed no joy.
Since transmigration, he has been tense at every step, and had long developed the instinct that the smoother things go, the more something seems wrong. In this unfamiliar, risky environment, this instinct operated in full force.
Suddenly, the thought of "Evil Shadow Puppet" flashed through his mind.
The Ghost Cultivators devour Shadow Puppet Peak for the Skin Master’s craft where the Skin Master’s creation can be easily possessed by Evil Qi, thus unleashing the power the Shadow Puppet wielded in life.
As this thought settled, Song Yan suddenly said, "Let them not gather together!"
Pei Xuehan:...
"Oh oh oh, understood, senior."
She had painstakingly gathered the corpses together, this method indeed resolved the immediate crisis, dispelling the original tendency of corpse attacking. Now, she hurriedly employed the "Great Tsunami Technique," trying to break their gathering force.
In her heart, she was speechless towards these ancient Purple Mansion eccentrics, always changing their minds, just a moment earlier saying to gather, then after she finally gathers them, saying not to, truly capricious and unpredictable.
Quickly, Pei Xuehan exclaimed, "Senior, not good, these corpses’ pull is too strong, they’re gathering quickly."
Song Yan said, "Hold them off for a while."
"Oh, okay!"
Pei Xuehan anxiously began throwing Profound Treasures.
One after another Profound Treasure, yet like meat buns thrown at dogs, they went and never returned.
During this process, Song Yan continued recovering.
Yet, the pull was too strong.
Finally...
Pop.
A light sound, two corpses collided.
Immediately following this, a strange scene unfolded.
One of the corpses flipped over under a bizarre force, lying atop the other corpse, with a whispering of red powder falling fully onto the corpse beneath, then quickly plunged from its surface into the body.
The next moment, the surface of the corpse began to swell, as if many red particles were rolling underneath. Once settled, its pallid eyes abruptly opened, only the black pupils became red.
The corpse eerily stood up, twisted its neck, and raised a hand to grasp the flying sword stuck between its kidney, with a hand brushing over it, the flying sword emitted buzzing sounds.
Pei Xuehan watched the scene with fright.
She already realized the corpse could still wield the flying sword!
Another instant later.
Swish!
The Fixed Evil corpse indeed controlled the sword, morphing into a streak of blood light, shooting straight towards Song Yan.
Song Yan’s deduction was correct; if such newly deceased corpses were seized by Fixed Evil, they could indeed use part of the corpse’s powers from life; moreover... due to the Fixed Evil’s presence, the power would exceed what it had in life.
Pei Xuehan hurriedly took out another Profound Treasure, intending to meet it, only to feel a wild blood column surging from behind her.

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_3
She turned her head and saw a blood-colored giant hand filled with terrifying power grasping through the air, catching the corpse like a fly and then crushing it fiercely.
Bang... bang bang bang...
The corpse was crushed to pieces.
And the fingertips of the blood-colored giant hand began to turn into sand, blood-colored sand.
The sand fell from the sky, drifting with the wind, wildly towards the direction of the Purple Mansion old monster.
They were the true body of the attack, and also the most terrifying aspect of the Fixed Evil!
But the Purple Mansion old monster was unhurried, raising a hand to grab a corpse from the void, and quickly rubbed it against the powder of the Fixed Evil.
During the rubbing process, time seemed to slow down, and Pei Xuehan only saw more Fixed Evil seem to awaken from the grabbed corpse, breaking outwards, like a blooming flower.
If that flower broke through the corpse, the Fixed Evil inside would escape outside, rebounding onto the corpse manipulator.
However, if the corpse touched the Fixed Evil powder in the air in advance and was then placed into the Storage Bag, nothing would happen.
Pei Xuehan was horrified, thinking to herself: ’What kind of crazy method is this!’
She looked again at the cross-legged, blood-soaked Purple Mansion old monster, yet saw the latter’s calm and composed expression, clearly not the first time doing such a thing.
’Monster, madman!’
Pei Xuehan was somewhat frightened, yet speechless.
Swish!
Song Yan’s speed was extremely fast.
The "Eraser" of the "Sikong Seal" once again smoothly erased the Fixed Evil powder in mid-air.
But just as he was about to place the "Sikong Seal" back into the Storage Bag, an accident occurred.
The vast lake surface, with water vapor chilling, apart from the towering ancient roofs, and the strange tree tops, was a water surface imbued with the aura of the Sea of Suffering. Even Song Yan dared not touch this water, but... the water surface rippled.
A monk shadow, wearing a gray Hundred-Patch Robe, came from afar, stepping on the water, and grabbed hold of the Sikong Seal’s corpse.
Obviously without touching, yet the Sikong Seal’s corpse became completely still.
The Fixed Evil within the corpse started to struggle madly, seemingly wanting to escape this body, but the eerie gray-robed novice monk already bowed to this corpse.
The corpse... didn’t move, clearly trapped in some unknown state.
However, this action made Song Yan displeased.
He used the Sikong Seal’s corpse to absorb the Fixed Evil not purely for containment, but with hopes of research, seeing if it could become one of his own cards.
In this Secret Realm, he didn’t want to miss any opportunity, because the road ahead was truly perilous.
Naturally, the Sikong Seal was not something to be easily discarded.
At this moment, seeing this uninvited Sea of Suffering novice monk trying to enlighten his "treasure", suddenly he recalled "if the Sea of Suffering novice monk is attacked, it will turn its spearhead, and instead enlighten the attacker", hence he looked at Pei Xuehan and said coldly, "Attack him, take a trip to the Illusion Realm."
Pei Xuehan: ...
She was extremely helpless, yet still let out a delicate shout, raising her hand to cast a spell towards the Sea of Suffering novice monk.
The Fixed Evil dormant within the corpse moved slightly, the Sea of Suffering novice monk slightly turned its head, eyes without any expression or pupils looking at Pei Xuehan.
It bowed to Pei Xuehan, hands clasped together.
Pei Xuehan was instantly frozen in place, and Song Yan immediately grabbed the Sikong Seal’s corpse, forcefully shoved it into the Storage Space.
He looked again into the distance, those many Fixed Evil corpses that had thought of approaching seemed extremely afraid of the Sea of Suffering novice monk, and actually began to actively retreat.
Song Yan frowned and scrutinized this ghostly entity, silently pondering: How was this ghostly thing formed? Why does it have the scent of a Changwang ghost?
No one else could smell the scent of a Changwang ghost, but he had "Changwang Tiger Blood" within him.
At this moment, although still weak, he had already recovered quite a bit.
The elixir Pei Xuehan gave him was indeed effective, initially only a small portion of its power erupted, the subsequent eruption of power was what was truly strong, allowing his recovery speed to increase by at least eight or nine times.
And right at this moment, the Sea of Suffering novice monk slightly turned its body again, looking towards Song Yan.
The next moment...
Song Yan felt everything around him begin to change, the world darkened, the novice monk vanished.
"Another illusion."
Song Yan knew that this thing couldn’t be broken, so he steadfastly guarded his true self, beginning to endure...
This time, in the Illusion Realm, he and Pei Xuehan narrowly escaped the Soul Threshold, then hid outside, living under assumed names, gradually coming to know and love each other, eventually becoming Dao companions, and then moving to a sparsely populated area, free from Profound Qi, yet similarly far from disputes beyond the border, herding horses and sheep, watching the rain and clouds. In spring see the flourishing flowers, in summer gaze at the Star River, in autumn leaves form a sea, in winter admire the fresh snow.
Slowly, they bore offspring, who clashed with the indigenous nomads of the frontier. They annexed those nomadic tribes, thereby forming a large family. But ultimately, there was no Profound Qi in this place, Pei Xuehan was unable to cultivate, gradually she aged.
Even though Song Yan constantly reminded himself it was an illusion, during this time he truly felt as if he had experienced all these emotions, the accumulated experiences of these feelings even overshadowed his own memories. Even as he crazily reminded himself it was an Illusion Realm, he would naturally still be moved, because everything in this Illusion Realm was genuinely the life he truly yearned deep in his heart. This is human nature, unless one’s heart becomes like iron or stone, otherwise... how could one escape?
Just as he sat in front of Pei Xuehan’s bed, holding the hand of his now aged Dao companion, an illusion scene suddenly appeared before him: On a sunny grassland, lush grass swallowed horse hooves, young Pei Xuehan galloped on horseback, stopped when passing by him, looked at him with a smile like a blooming flower, and extended her hand saying, "Husband, come!"

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_4
Song Yan closed his eyes.
Beside his ear, Pei Xuehan’s voice continued to echo.
"Is the truth or falsehood really that important?"
"Have these hundred years truly meant nothing?!"
"Why must you leave?"
"Stay for me, will you?"
"Will you..."
Song Yan let out a light sigh.
A familiar feeling welled up.
He knew the "Illusion Realm time" had arrived.
Once trapped, he would sink into it, but if he ignored it, he could break free.
The next moment, he opened his eyes, and before him, the floodwaters still surged, the black rooftops neared.
The Sea of Suffering’s jianmei stared at him straightly, with an expression that seemed to say "obstinate and beyond enlightenment."
This was the only time the Sea of Suffering’s jianmei could be temporarily shattered.
Song Yan did not miss this opportunity, slapping the jianmei into dust, then giving the female cultivator beside him, who’s still immersed in the Illusion Realm, a slap.
"Time to wake up."
Pei Xuehan opened her eyes, and upon seeing Song Yan, a strong sense of joy suddenly welled up within her, instinctively wanting to approach but stopped quickly, merely looking at him with a complex expression, then she subconsciously asked: "Senior, is the sword wound on your face...fake..."
Song Yan was silent for a moment, in the Illusion Realm he had spent a hundred years with this woman, and treating her as a complete stranger was indeed difficult.
So he said: "Everything in the Illusion Realm is fake, the Sea of Suffering’s jianmei only knows how to deceive people."
"Did...did the senior also fall into the Illusion Realm?" Pei Xuehan, not knowing what she dreamt, suddenly seemed less afraid of Song Yan.
Song Yan did not answer.
Pei Xuehan suddenly bit her lip, as if summoning courage, asked: "Senior...did you go beyond the frontier?"
Song Yan suddenly looked at where the Sea of Suffering’s jianmei disappeared.
He suddenly understood.
That ghostly thing not only created illusions but also exploited the cracks in people’s hearts!
Could it be that it forced Pei Xuehan and himself to experience the same illusion?
It "copied" his behaviors to Pei Xuehan, then "copied" hers to him, thus making the two, even when awake, question the reality, making further enlightenment easier.
Real or fake, fake or real, if fake can birth truth, then what truly is truth? Is it genuinely that important?
Better to transcend into the cycle of rebirth and detachment!
Song Yan instantly realized this terrifying possibility.
However, his response was decisive.
"The frontier? What’s so great about such a place? I just dreamt I left."
"Then...what about me?" Pei Xuehan couldn’t help but ask.
Song Yan said: "You...after you went out, you parted ways with me, of course, I don’t know where you went."
Pei Xuehan was stunned for a long while, letting out a soft "oh," her eyes showing a hint of sadness.
Song Yan continued meditating, and before closing his eyes, he glanced at Pei Xuehan, suddenly gesturing for her to come over, saying: "I’ve learned a magic called the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman, once this talisman is applied, I can control life and death with a thought, but it requires the target’s cooperation. You...come here..."
Pei Xuehan dared not resist, obediently approached, occasionally glancing at him covertly.
Song Yan raised his hand, his finger landing on her brow, then said: "Don’t blame me for not trusting you, in the Cultivation Realm, people’s hearts are deceitful; those who trust others easily tend to die faster. But...once we leave this place to a safe location, I will remove the talisman."
Pei Xuehan gave a wry smile and said: "Is there really any safe place left? The Corpse-Eating Wolf clan is inherently violent, with every general being like a tyrant. The Ancient Tooth patriarch is the most extreme among them.
When it says it will destroy the Sword Sect, it won’t give up. Even if I return to the sect, I am dead, I’ve implicated the sect."
She took a deep breath, closed her eyes, and said: "Senior might as well let me die sinking into the Illusion Realm."
Song Yan was briefly startled, finally understanding why Pei Xuehan hadn’t woken up timely earlier. At this moment, his finger drew a drop of blood, swiftly marking her brow, while saying: "Relax your mind, accept it calmly."
Pei Xuehan closed her eyes.
From the corners of her eyes, two lines of tears gently flowed.
A moment later, the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman was complete.
Pei Xuehan also became Song Yan’s Blood Slave, the latter though even a thousand miles away, could extinguish her with a single thought.
Seeing the female cultivator shedding tears, Song Yan said: "Alright, stop crying, since we both left in the Illusion Realm, we might as well carve a bloody path here too."
With that, he added: "Since you’re my Blood Slave now, you’re my possession. I won’t abandon you or use you as cannon fodder."
Pei Xuehan paused, for she suddenly noticed the senior spoke more words.
She wiped her tears, said: "Then senior, rest assured, I’ll guard you."
With that, she stood aside, seriously monitoring the floating corpses nearby.
If any of the floating corpses showed signs of approaching, she would immediately use the "Great Tsunami Technique" to push them away.
Suddenly...
A heavy sound echoed by her ear.
Looking down, she saw it was a bundle of Flying Swords.
The quality of each sword in that bundle was surprisingly decent.
The aloof voice of the Purple Mansion’s old monster came floating over from not far.
"Take these, next time don’t carry just one Flying Sword.
My Blood Slave can’t be left without a weapon."
Pei Xuehan nodded heavily, then took the Flying Swords, starting to refine them one by one.
As she refined them, a slight smile appeared at the corners of her mouth.
...
...
The cold moon loomed high, luckily, with no more rain nor fog.
However, at the end of this Secret Realm, by the entrance of the next Secret Realm, occasional strange vibrations would happen, and the two bodies stuck there kept floating with the waves, their eyes being dragged by nerves, floating back and forth aimlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: 150. If the full banners are all vengeful spirits, then what should be done? (8.6K words - subscription requested)_5
The atmosphere of eerie mystery descends upon this place.
Pei Xuehan remains tense, ready to unleash her Divine Sense to scan for any abnormalities such as strange noises.
With her protection, Song Yan can recuperate with greater peace of mind.
A night passed, and the corrosive power of the "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" had been entirely depleted by him.
After another night, his power had almost recovered completely.
The morning golden light pierces through the clouds, illuminating this ancient Secret Realm, yet the flood shows no sign of receding; instead, it appears to be rising.
Song Yan noticed that in just two days, the roof, once completely exposed, had been submerged, leaving only a small circle.
The circle barely allows a few people to stand, and Pei Xuehan had moved from guarding at a distance to standing in front of him, carefully stepping back with her silver boots, afraid of touching the rising waters.
Song Yan looked over the water surface and then stood up with his hands behind his back.
In these two days, besides healing, he had some thoughts.
At this moment, he slightly closed his eyes, looked towards the Faceless Mask, and directly said, "Feng Chengzi, stop sleeping!"
Feng Chengzi, as a lingering Divine Thought, existed for a long time but couldn’t stay awake constantly. After overseeing Song Cheng "leaving descendants for the Formless Race," he frequently fell asleep, responding only during crucial moments or when Song Yan called him.
The Divine Thought floated out of the book pavilion, saying, "Ran into trouble?"
Song Yan directly turned on his "external visibility" permission and told him what had happened, then said, "If you want me to save Tang Fan, don’t hold back, bring out some real stuff."
"Real stuff?" Feng Chengzi’s Divine Thought said, "The ’Thought Escape’ you took is not real stuff? This Escape Technique, once you master it, you’ll stand undefeated among those of the same tier! You can escape when you wish or strike first when you wish."
Song Yan directly said, "The bookshelf in this Faceless Mask, the lower layer books are the first-tier inheritance, the upper layer is the second-tier inheritance, but the most important inheritance should be passed by you, the Ancient Formless Ancestor, right? That’s the most crucial thing in your lineage."
Feng Chengzi said, "I’m just a Divine Thought... it’s already difficult to remember many things."
Song Yan asked, "What’s with the Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade?
Without a large-scale Divine Soul explosion, it’s impossible to produce this Crystal Jade.
Tang Fan’s father’s Realm shouldn’t be higher than mine, right?
May I ask what Magic and power he used?"
Feng Chengzi couldn’t help but say, "Kid, you’re really cunning.
But even if I teach you, if you won’t move forward, what then?"
Song Yan smiled, "You should at least give it a try.
Little Tang is ahead, little Tang is still in my Blood Slave’s hands, and I... have already made a deal with you.
We have a foundation of trust, don’t we?"
Feng Chengzi was silent for a moment, then said, "You’ve provoked the Late Stage of Purple Mansion, you may not survive even if you escape from here. Even if you make it out, what then?"
Song Yan said, "And what about you? What then?
When I’m killed, my Divine Soul will surely explode. If this Faceless Mask isn’t blasted by my Divine Soul, it’ll certainly fall into the hands of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race.
Then, are you going to teach the Corpse-Eating Wolf these Secret Techniques?"
Feng Chengzi’s expression changed multiple times, then cursing and muttering said, "These Secret Techniques in my lineage require many tests before learning... alright, alright... I’ll teach you, is that not enough?!"
In an instant...
Feng Chengzi began to speak slowly.
"Actually, this lineage, these Secret Techniques, aren’t taught to everyone; it depends on the person.
Some juniors aren’t suitable to learn, so I don’t teach, suitable ones, I might say a thing or two and see their reaction.
Tang Fan’s father is considered a genius in my lineage too, and extremely suitable for these Secret Techniques, which is why he created the ’Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade.’"
Song Yan asked, "What is that?"
Feng Chengzi said slowly, "Soul Burst Technique."
Song Yan: ...
Feng Chengzi chuckled, "Unexpected, right? My Formless lineage also dealing with souls.
The Sacrificial Refining Array of the Myriad Souls Banner in your hand was deliberately released by Tang Fan’s father, meant for those with ulterior motives to refine the banner, and then handed to little Tang Fan.
Just an accident occurred, he was attacked by servants when creating the ’Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade,’ otherwise, how could he have died so easily?"
Song Yan: ...
Alright, there’s more to this matter.
He went to the Chu Kingdom and robbed all of Tang Fan’s fortunes.
Then, he said, "Little Tang is quite righteous. Does he know his father is like this?"
Feng Chengzi chuckled, "Of course not, his father always wanted to find a chance to tell Tang Fan, but couldn’t until the end.
Well, let’s not mention it; let’s talk about Soul Burst Technique."
"Soul Burst Technique, one soul explodes to shatter all causality and thoughts, its power is incredibly fearsome!
The shock from the explosion of many souls is terrifying, thus having the chance to birth Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade."
Song Yan said, "No wonder it requires the Myriad Souls Banner."
Feng Chengzi said, "The most difficult part of Soul Burst Technique isn’t the soul explosion, but concentrating the soul explosion.
Now you also control the Myriad Souls Banner, naturally you know, even if you use the banner, you can only give the evil souls inside a simple command, as for how these evil souls execute it, you cannot control.
Like a general commanding troops, shout kill and the army will charge, but afterward... if you want to maneuver the army, you can only use a flag to roughly maneuver.
To birth Divine Soul White Cave Crystal Jade requires soul explosion stacking, i.e., causing evil souls to self-destruct at the same location, which is extremely difficult.
Back then, Tang Fan’s father worried about this a lot."
Song Yan raised his hand, suddenly grabbing the Myriad Souls Banner.
The banner was over a zhang long, with gloomy frost and mist, eerie and indistinct.
He glanced at Pei Xuehan beside him and suddenly said, "I have too many secrets... I’ll give you a chance, leave now, and it’ll be as if we’ve never met. But if you wish to stay, I’m afraid I won’t be able to unlock your Blood Slave Ancient Talisman."
Pei Xuehan was stunned, nodded and said, "Then don’t unlock it, I’ll always be a Blood Slave to the senior."
Having said this, a sense of relief appeared on her face, as if someone finally helped her make a choice.
Song Yan also paused for a moment, looked at her with some suspicion.
Pei Xuehan blinked and subtly glanced elsewhere, deliberately avoiding eye contact with him.
In the next instant, Song Yan suddenly raised his head under the banner of over 200,000 evil souls, and mysterious multicolored tiger stripes crawled from his skin, covering his entire body.
He took a deep breath, as all the evil souls converged towards his brow.
With each one that came, he bound one.
Binding one meant transforming one evil soul into a Changwang.
But soon, his Divine Soul World was filled, so Song Yan returned the already transformed Changwangs to the Myriad Souls Banner, repeating the previous actions.
He continued this while looking at Feng Chengzi, who had completely been rendered speechless in the Faceless Mask, and lightly asked, "If the entire banner’s evil souls become my Changwang, then what?"
"You... you... you..."
"This is the Changwang Tiger Blood!!"
Feng Chengzi exclaimed in shock, already losing composure.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Changmi have awareness? (8.3K words - major Chapter requesting subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Changmi have awareness? (8.3K words - major Chapter requesting subscription)
It’s been five years, and for the first time, Song Yan used his original power, but the process of turning over two hundred thousand evil spirits into transformed minions wasn’t as swift.
Initially, he could digest five to six thousand minions a day, but slowly... the sheer exhaustion slowed down the transformation speed.
But Song Yan was full of patience.
Exploration at such a high realm could hardly be completed in a day or two; months or even years were the norm.
On this journey, his goal had changed to kill "Ancient Tooth" as much as possible, even "Yingti Shangren," and to seize the Evil Treasure, then escape.
However... firstly, he absolutely did not believe that the "Evil Treasure" could be so easily seized; secondly, he hadn’t forgotten the inherent dangers of this Transformed Minion Soul Threshold.
If he lacked patience, he would have died in the Secret Realm long before reaching Ancient Tooth and the others.
The immediate task was to find a temporarily safe place to face the imminent crisis.
After spending a whole three months, Song Yan finally gradually transformed the Myriad Souls Banner into the Myriad Souls Ghost Banner.
At this moment, all the evil spirits in the banner were ready to attack wherever pointed.
During this time, the floodwaters gradually rose, having long submerged the rooftops.
But Song Yan, watching the gradually rising water, never used the Paper House.
Throughout the three months, the water level rose without receding. If he used the Paper House to sink underwater, what if the water never receded? Wouldn’t he be trapped here forever?
If the external environment suddenly changed during this period, and the power of the water increased, could the Paper House still withstand it?
"The first time it wasn’t damaged, it can create a long-lasting safe environment" doesn’t mean "If the external environment changes, this Paper House doesn’t need to be tested again to determine if it can remain undamaged the first time in the new environment."
...
At this moment, the Flying Sword unfolded a band of misty light in mid-air.
Song Yan and Pei Xuehan sat on that misty light.
Song Yan focused on refinement, while Pei Xuehan continued to perform Sword Floating in the Air.
Sword Floating in the Air was a physically demanding task, fortunately, Profound Qi was abundant here, and Pei Xuehan herself had brought quite a few Profound Crystals, which was enough.
As the last evil spirit was successfully transformed, Song Yan abruptly stowed the banner, simultaneously looking at his panel.
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 41/8640]
[Magic]
"Giant Soul Swallowing Technique"（Perfection）（Single Mutation）
If the "Soul Burst Technique" was purely about detonating the cause-effect of the Divine Souls he enslaved, thereby producing a terrifying energy explosion, the "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique" was about using evil to drive soul swallowing soul, soul linking soul, forming a temporary giant soul that also exploded, but with an energy explosion power boosted by more than one level.
Song Yan spent as much as 650 years comprehending the former to Perfection, clearly a Magic Technique useful in Xiaocheng, powerful in Great Success, but requiring a lifetime of understanding to achieve Perfection.
He spent 4310 years comprehending the latter.
No wonder.
Because the so-called "giant soul" was entirely a concept in "Evil Artifacts."
Profound Artifact, Profound Treasure, Soul Artifact, Soul Treasure, Evil Artifact... Evil Treasure.
Among them, "Profound Artifact Profound Treasure" and even "Soul Artifact" are still within the "craftable" range.
But starting from Soul Treasure, the difficulty of acquisition increases progressively, as some core items within, without opportunity, are impossible to obtain even in death.
As for Evil Artifacts...
Ancient texts rumored, "Evil Artifacts" were treasures containing infinite evil, as evil has no soul, it can attach to the owner’s Divine Soul, thus turning the owner’s Divine Soul into a "giant soul."
What use does a giant soul have?
One, the Divine Soul is wrapped with its own cause and effect, and if there are many more causes and effects controlled by oneself attached outside, its strength can directly manifest in the "Three States of the Tumor Realm."
Even standing in a heavy rain, letting the raindrops wash away the cause and effect, it would merely wash away the cause and effect outside the "giant soul" that didn’t belong to oneself.
Two, the power produced by the explosion of the giant soul is unimaginable.
One could say, the "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique" allowed Song Yan to forcibly transform a Soul Treasure into a manufacturing machine of numerous "Evil Artifacts," with both offensive and defensive utilities, providing protection, allowing explosion, and because the minions entirely obeyed his command, these explosions were pinpoint overlapping explosions.
Unfortunately, each use of the "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique" for offense and defense inevitably caused the loss of evil spirits within the banner, a category of decreases with each use.
And for the first time, Song Yan experienced the feeling of "lifespan not being enough."
Clearly, completing the secondary perfect mutation of the "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique" required a time calculated in tens of thousands of years, already exceeding the maximum lifespan he had at this point.
Even so, this "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique" had already replaced the initial "Hundred Forms Demon Body" to become the most powerful magic within his "soul-based spell system."
In simpler terms, the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" might carry the beauty of "numerical values," but in the face of "mechanism," it fell short by half a notch.
After completing the "Myriad Souls Banner" and "Giant Soul Swallowing Technique", Song Yan looked to the side at Pei Xuehan, asking: "Can you still hold on?"
Pei Xuehan nodded, but her lovely face turned towards Song Yan, her eyes looked at him gently.
When she noticed Song Yan’s gaze also coming her way, she quickly lowered her head.
It seemed as though before she met this man, her former life was all about wandering, and now she finally found a home, as for the matter of being a blood slave, she didn’t care at all... She didn’t know why she felt this way.
But that’s just how it was.
So even as she bowed her head, turned into a blood slave, and stood in the terrifying Soul Threshold, her heart suddenly filled with joy.
"Are we going to the next Secret Realm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Changmi have awareness? (8.3K words - major Chapter requesting subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Changmi have awareness? (8.3K words - major Chapter requesting subscription)_2
Pei Xuehan casually asked.
Whether to go or not, where to go, she no longer cared.
Song Yan shook his head and said, "Let’s wait a bit more."
After speaking, he took out the corpse of the Ancient Tooth from the Storage Space and began peeling the skin, making leather.
In his Storage Space, besides the Ancient Tooth’s corpse, there were many resources he previously took from the Ghost Slaughter Sect, including many pieces of Demon Beast Skin.
For many years, he hadn’t made Shadow Puppets, but he had prepared quite a lot of materials.
...
...
Bang!
Boom!
Master Infant Tiar licked its paw, looked at the remnant of the Sea of Suffering she’d torn apart, and with a slight turn in her eyes, said, "This pesky thing, is it only targeting me?
Did it follow me all the way from Chopper Ridge?
Is this interesting?
Little Tang, what do you think is the reason?"
Next to her, Tang Fan directly responded, "Grandma, I don’t know either."
As soon as the words left his mouth, Tang Fan suddenly froze because he had spoken purely on instinct.
The instinct was because he had once again sunk into the Illusion Realm, and within it, he and Master Infant Tiar had somehow become family!
The twists and turns were significant, but the overall story was that after failing to explore the Chong Soul Threshold, Master Infant Tiar grabbed him, who should have been destined to die, and escaped. Although she imprisoned him, she treated him well. An internal conspiracy within the Mountain and Sea Demon Race forced Master Infant Tiar to escape, and before fleeing the Multi-tailed Fox Race, she took him along. Subsequently, Master Infant Tiar was hunted down and severely injured, and he did not betray her, instead, he carefully took care of her. A human and a demon, one at the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, the other at the Late Stage of the Purple Mansion, formed a bond over a hundred years together.
In the Illusion Realm, Tang Fan referred to Master Infant Tiar as "Grandma," and Master Infant Tiar would casually call him "Little Tang."
Now, clearly, Master Infant Tiar also heard Tang Fan’s address and couldn’t help but frown and glance at him.
At this moment, she, like Song Yan, recognized one thing, which was: the "Tang Fan" she encountered in the Illusion Realm could likely be the true choice of the real Tang Fan.
The Chong Soul’s doing was creating some bonds within her otherwise unassailable Mental Realm.
The "Turmoil within the Mountain and Sea Demon Race" has always been a deep-seated concern, not from the Fox and Wolf Races, but from foreign races...
As for her kindness and care towards Tang Fan, it came naturally.
But this emotion was born inexplicably.
Master Infant Tiar thought for a moment, then suddenly rubbed Tang Fan’s head, giggling, "That was just an Illusion Realm, you focus on picking treasures, Grandma won’t mistreat you."
Perhaps before the Illusion Realm, she was just indulging Tang Fan, but at this moment... her heart experienced some inexplicable change. For to her, Tang Fan no longer was just an object.
...
However, neither Song Yan nor the current Master Infant Tiar could have ever expected that those who bound themselves to Cause and Effect because of the Illusion Realm were not only the two of them.
The Sea of Suffering remnant would appear whenever it found an opportunity, binding individuals who remained stubborn, who refused to sink into the Illusion Realm, by using the same method, throwing two people into "the same Illusion Realm" in a strange manner, letting them experience "the same life," and then forming emotions through the passage of time in the Illusion Realm.
At this time, even the Deer Demon, Ancient Tooth, and Han Yuling had already formed inexplicable bonds with the people around them. No matter how cruel or cold they were, they could not completely sever ties with someone who had shared a hundred years of life, with someone who had once been through glory and shame together.
...
Several days later.
Song Yan used Ancient Corpse Skin as the material to hurriedly make a Shadow Puppet.
This Shadow Puppet was very crude, definitely not capable of utilizing the power it had in life.
Only because his "Skin Making Skill" seemed somewhat inadequate for the current skin strength.
But it was barely usable.
Song Yan continued making Demon Beast Shadow Puppets.
These Shadow Puppets were very perfect, each nearly capable of exceeding the power they had in life.
Once finished, Song Yan let out a sigh, then fixed his gaze on the exit of the next Secret Realm in the distance.
Suddenly, he also noticed Pei Xuehan secretly watching him.
In those luminous eyes was a gentle affection, like a hidden autumn water, but it wasn’t the youthful heart-fluttering of a girl’s first love, rather a warmth steeped in the passage of a hundred years.
In Song Yan’s heart, there naturally arose a sense of joy, relaxation, and even warmth.
To spend over a hundred years with someone, to regain youth, to do it all over again, was inherently joyous. And familiarity with each other’s temperaments brought ease and warmth.
But the source of this emotion was strangely complete from the Illusion Realm.
Suddenly, Song Yan seemed to think of something and called out to Feng Chengzi.
"Zhang Han, what do you want to do?
The Secret Techniques I was to teach you, I’ve taught.
As for the breakthrough opportunity at the Middle Stage of the Purple Mansion you mentioned, I have also told you.
Regarding Protective Thought practice, it emphasizes not rushing but rather waiting for conditions to mature naturally.
The best way to break through is to eliminate all dangers, go to a peaceful and safe place without any burdens, far from fights, and peacefully live for decades.
Maybe one day while eating or sleeping, you’ll suddenly feel a breakthrough opportunity, then quickly sit in Profound Heart, practice for a few more years, and you’ll break through.
Your current state, carrying the pressures of the Fox and Wolf Races and threats, will get you nowhere.
Alright, even my waking hours are limited, I’ve nearly exhausted all the forces of these years of sleep for Little Tang Fan in recent days.
Zhang Han, unless it’s urgent, don’t call on me again...

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_3
"If this keeps up, I’ll sleep for a hundred years and won’t wake up, no matter how much I’m called."
After the elder had spoken, Song Yan asked, "Could the Sea of Suffering Transformed Minion be tempting people?"
"Tempting people?"
Feng Chengzi paused for a moment, then shook his head, "The Buddhist Sect only offers enlightenment, never temptation.
Besides, isn’t the Illusion Realm you see all your inner expectations?
If it’s an expectation, it’s a possibility for the future. Otherwise, how could you sink into it?"
Unconsciously, Song Yan tilted his head slightly, looking at Pei Xuehan beside him, thinking: ’If I hadn’t been lured by some power, then... would I really develop feelings for her? Would I truly go beyond the border, herding horses and sheep with her, listening to the rain and watching the clouds, staying together for life?’
Pei Xuehan was very beautiful, with a personality of the kind he liked.
And escaping all sorts of crises in the world to a carefree place was indeed the life he longed for.
These two combined together made perfect sense logically.
But...
Song Yan persisted in asking, "Is it possible, but you don’t know it?"
Feng Chengzi said, "At least I haven’t heard of it."
Song Yan asked, "What was your Realm before you died?"
Feng Chengzi said, "Early Stage of Divine Infant."
Song Yan asked, "What is the Early Stage of Divine Infant?"
Feng Chengzi yawned, tilted his head, and fell asleep.
As a Divine Thought, he had already stayed awake longer than usual.
Song Yan squinted his eyes, pondering.
Within the Soul Threshold of Changwang, the Ancient Tooth, the Infant Cry Elder, and the Deer Demon were strong, but he hadn’t forgotten... the Soul Threshold of Changwang itself was more terrifying than these three old monsters.
Like a mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind it, even further behind was the eagle and hunter...
When these cunning old monsters gathered together and ventured into a dangerous place, even a hint of purity in such a place would be a miracle.
If the "Evil Monster and Three States of the Tumor Realm" are the immediate crisis, "Ancient Tooth, Infant Cry Elder, Deer Demon" are unavoidable crises down the road, then... is there an even more distant "third party" or "fourth party" existing?
If they exist, who are they, and what are their intentions?
"What are you thinking?" Pei Xuehan gently asked.
Song Yan suddenly transformed various newly made Shadow Puppets, and the Ancient Corpse Shadow Puppet, swallowing them all. Instantly, his body expanded, with a long wolf tail, strange sharp claws, and long wings sprouting from all around him.
Pei Xuehan looked at him in horror.
But Song Yan swiftly used the Illusion Technique to revert back to his original form, and then drew out the Ancient Remains Essence Blood. After multiple attempts, he thoroughly digested the Ancient Remains Essence Blood within a year, enhancing the "Corpse-Eating Wolf Blood" at the Upper Central Palace.
The "Demon Sound Sword Qi" evolved from the "Profound Sword Scripture" also transformed into the "Blood Demon Chaotic Sound Sword Qi."
Originally, one sound could carry one Sword Qi; now, dozens of sounds could carry dozens of Sword Qis. If Song Yan used this type of killing power, his strength would increase by one or two levels, proving Ancient Corpse indeed was the most monstrous among the younger Corpse-Eating Wolf Race.
"Are you scared?"
Song Yan looked at the silver-robed female cultivator, asking mildly.
Pei Xuehan suddenly embraced him, saying, "I’m not scared."
Evidently, even with her slow reaction, the months spent together had made her understand one thing: the man before her was the same one she shared a century-long companionship within the Illusion Realm.
Song Yan suddenly asked, "When you were in the Sect before, did you always venture into the Secret Realm with your fellow disciples?"
Pei Xuehan’s chin gently nodded against his chest, saying, "Do you think I’m naïve?"
"No." Song Yan answered with a lie, letting her embrace him for a while, then said, "Focus on Sword Control, don’t let us fall."
Pei Xuehan’s pretty face beamed with happiness. She nodded heavily, responding with an "Hmm," and then her face was also radiant when controlling the sword.
Song Yan then raised his hand to grasp the banner.
"Open!"
In an instant, a chilling wind wailed, ghostly entities loomed. Countless evil souls expanded from the banner, covering the sky and dimming the sunlight over this Secret Realm.
’Transformed Minion, Transformed Minion, since there’s the character Minion... there must be some kind of change.’
’The novice monks of the Buddha Country within the Sea of Suffering enjoy enlightening people’s cause and effect, and the character representing a minion is undoubtedly a significant cause and effect.’
’Is it a case of "If I don’t enter Hell, who will?" Wanting to enlighten the Transformed Ghost but unable to break free, thus becoming a Transformed Ghost in order to enlighten the Transformed Ghost?’
For a moment, Song Yan’s thoughts soared.
He finally began to understand the terror of the "Changwang Tiger Race."
Perhaps it couldn’t be fully seen at the Crimson Palace Stage, but upon entering the Purple Mansion, its vast potential was indeed frightening.
...
A day passed, and not a single Transformed Minion appeared.
The Transformed Minion liked to enlighten people, yet did not come to see under his Myriad Souls Banner.
Countless thoughts flowed into Song Yan’s mind.
’What’s going on now?’
’Am I overthinking it?’
’Or is it...
Has a Transformed Minion that already became someone’s "Transformed Ghost" under ownership not allowed to come to me anymore?’
When this thought inadvertently emerged, Song Yan was almost shocked.
He followed this wild guess based on: ’If the Transformed Minion is already someone’s possession, most likely owned by the Tiger Emperor of the Changwang Tiger Race, the creator of this Soul Threshold. Is it not dead? Is it seeking revenge?’
However, all of this was unfounded, and even knowing it, he couldn’t counter it.
Moreover, this entirely sprang from his own deduction based on a single character, "Minion."
Just as he was thinking...
From the distance, a sudden loud explosion occurred.
Following the sound, Song Yan fixed his gaze on the entrance to the next Secret Realm.
The sudden explosion was akin to a burst dam.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_4
But not just one spot!
Song Yan suddenly turned his head, looking in a completely different direction.
That direction was the way they had come.
Song Yan quickly released his divine sense, reaching far away.
Miles away, he saw a hole.
He sent his divine sense into that hole again.
To explore!
It turned out to be a new secret realm!
Within that secret realm, demon beasts were startled, turning into a beast tide rampaging wildly.
The outermost layer of the Tumor Realm had been continuously stacking, as the aura from the Sea of Suffering this time was inexplicably intense, constantly leaking outwards, as could be seen from the flooding explosions.
Previously, the secret realm he was in was the outermost secret realm, but now... it wasn’t anymore.
Song Yan’s heart raced with thoughts.
Should he try to run back to that outermost secret realm?
Although he could never run outside the Tumor Realm, as he couldn’t traverse an entire secret realm in such a short time. However, he could use this to keep himself always at the outermost part of the Tumor Realm.
But was being at the outermost part worthwhile?
He instantly dismissed this idea.
Because "outermost" does not mean safety.
The "outermost" is where later cultivators might arrive, and in case there’s a strong one among them, he’d have to confront that sudden arrival.
Yet, doing nothing was not Song Yan’s style either.
His spirit stirred, and using dual escape techniques, he swiftly moved towards that hole, then grabbed into the void, pulling out two freshly crafted "Shadowless Phantom Crows", instantly invoking the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" to connect the souls, and then threw them towards the connection point of the new and old secret realms.
The "Shadowless Phantom Crow" skin was obtained from the Ghost Slaughter Sect, and similar to the "Shadowless Phantom Crow", they are all demon beasts skilled at hiding themselves.
Swish!
Swish!
Two black shadows swept across to the other side of the secret realm, Song Yan’s eyes briefly following them.
At this moment, a sharp, piercing sense of danger appeared behind him.
Song Yan suddenly looked back, only to see the entrance to the next secret realm bursting open, a...
No!
There were three!
Two!
Or three!
It was a cultivator stuck together with "two heads, four arms, and four legs," but the "four arms and legs" were extremely bizarre because they were wearing treasured clothes and trousers from before death; through those treasured garments, it was clear that these "four arms and legs" belonged to three people.
This strange cultivator held a fishing rod in two hands, with two half bodies hanging from it.
These two half bodies were those floating in the water, and were the owners of the "two arms" and "two legs".
The other two hands of the strange cultivator held two flying swords respectively.
’Sha Gu! And it had captured the full bodies of three cultivators!’ Pei Xuehan exclaimed in shock.
Over these days, spending time with Song Yan had increased her understanding of Sha Gu, and naturally, she understood that "if Sha Gu could occupy the full body of a cultivator, not just its corpse, it could wield that cultivator’s magic and treasures from when they were alive."
Reflecting on the fact that the two bodies had been floating at the secret realm’s entrance, seemingly as inexplicable bait.
