But who would take such bait?
Thinking settled, she saw the strange cultivator turning into a bloody rainbow, rushing towards Song Yan, throwing away the two bodies that had been soaked by the Sea of Suffering’s waters to an unrecognizable state, and then flicking the void.
Hiss!
A fishing hook suddenly appeared in front of Pei Xuehan.
Luckily, Pei Xuehan had been on guard, hastily using sword control to block.
Sword Rainbow shot out, blocking the hook, yet she heard a "ding" as the fishing line completely bypassed the Sword Rainbow, hooking onto the sword’s body, twisting like a spindle forward, continuing to hook down.
Pei Xuehan was astonished; the last time she saw this technique was during her time mingling in the Jianghu.
Only people in the Jianghu would use this magic technique.
But after becoming a cultivator, everyone engaged in coarse magical and treasure confrontations; who would still unlock other’s magic with such precision?
She quickly withdrew, but the fishing line did not shorten, still arrogantly spinning in mid-air.
She continued to throw out treasures, trying to block the fishing line.
But her thrown treasures were also entangled by the fishing line, and once caught, their connection with her was severed.
Pei Xuehan raised her head in shock, only to find that the cultivator was not even bothering with her, merely using a casual strike...
The two-headed cultivator was frantically rushing towards Song Yan.
Its eyes were fixed on the pea-sized hole.
Though lacking intelligence, it had instincts.
Its instinct was to escape the Sea of Suffering.
It had waited at the other end of the secret realm for a long time, waiting for the secret realm to open.
The Tumor Realm can be entered but not exited, unless when a new secret realm stacks outside, a brief passage opens.
But...
Ultimately very short-lived.
The two-headed cultivator had not yet reached the pea-sized hole when it disappeared.
It angrily looked towards the floating figure beside the hole, the scorching flesh and life aura making it greedy, instantly splitting into many black shadows with a "swish, swish, swish".
This was the most powerful technique it had sensed for itself.
In the distance, Pei Xuehan was shocked, shouting, "Be careful! This monster has a Purple Mansion Realm body!"
The words had barely been spoken when she heard a loud explosion.
Looking again, the black shadows of the two-headed cultivator were gone, and its abdomen blown open.
Pei Xuehan looked only at Song Yan, who floated in the air, expression indifferent and still motionless, with evil souls abruptly falling like rain around him, and for a moment, a giant soul formed in front of him, dozens of times larger than ordinary evil souls.
Boom!
The two-headed cultivator tilted again, its head blasted away.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: 151. Giant Soul Devouring, does Chang Mi have awareness? (8.3K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_5
Song Yan raised his hand, tapping lightly.
Boom!
The dual-headed cultivator had already been blown apart, limbs separated.
Boom!
The dual-headed cultivator had been completely blown to pieces.
Even the blood within was turned into a mist of red, with only specks of evil monsters still struggling in their final throes.
In this Secret Realm, the Purple Mansion level evil monsters fishing on the other side were no match for Song Yan at all!
Pei Xuehan was stunned.
Song Yan skillfully rubbed the Sikong Seal, absorbing the multitude of evil monsters within, and then placed it into the Storage Space to keep them silent, always in a state of "about to possess but not possessing."
After finishing these tasks, he retracted the fishing rod, collected the Flying Sword wrapped around it, and threw it back to Pei Xuehan, then held it in his hand for a look. Afterward, he quickly refined it and claimed it for himself.
Looking again at the two Flying Swords held by the Purple Mansion corpse, they were good items too, so Song Yan continued to store them in his Storage Bag.
After completing these tasks, he contemplated briefly and skimmed over the floating corpses above the flood, used the Sikong Seal to absorb all the evil monsters in this Secret Realm, and also swung the fishing rod to collect the corpses of the Crimson Palace cultivators who died tragically here.
A total of five bodies!
Song Yan scanned the surroundings, noticing that due to the opening of the next Secret Realm, the flood had receded considerably, revealing some treetops which could support his landing.
He was about to release two more Shadowless Phantom Crows when he suddenly realized he had lost the ability to monitor the previous Secret Realm.
He could sense that the two Shadowless Phantom Crows were still present, evidently... the Secret Realm in the Sea of Suffering blocked the small trick of Soul Splitting Investigation.
Song Yan hesitated slightly, yet still placed one Shadowless Phantom Crow there, and then looked towards the distant next Secret Realm entrance, sighing inwardly: ’If I had recklessly gone in and gotten caught by that Purple Mansion monster, not dying would have been a blessing but I’d definitely be skinned...’
At the same time, he pondered cautiously: ’But where did these human Purple Mansion cultivators from the Soul Threshold of the king come from?
Did they sneak in over the years?
Where did they come from? And why did they die so easily here?
Does Yingti Shangren know about this?
If so, what is it plotting?’
"Hiding true motives" is something Song Yan has become accustomed to seeing.
But such methods are often the most effective.
Because, as long as the card bottom remains uncovered... then it remains in play.
Song Yan couldn’t help but feel troubled.
And this trouble, transformed into flames, made him feel anxious.
But his hand was quickly grasped.
The silver-robed female cultivator soared on a sword from afar, gently grabbing his hand.
Lifting her charming face slightly, she healed his unease with a smile and radiant warmth.
Song Yan no longer refused, embracing the female cultivator into his arms tightly.
Pei Xuehan also extended her hands, spinning delicately around his bear-like waist, forming a small circle with her fingertips, then intertwining her hands, hugging tightly, her cheek pressed close, a smile at her lips.
Everyone needs rest, needs a harbor.
Even the most heinous, conscience-less person must have tender memories, must have someone they yearn to protect.
And someone like Song Yan, who has walked with barely any respite, can only momentarily sip a drop of their own "nectar" in the midst of a crisis from all sides.
"Senior... do you practice Dual Cultivation?" Pei Xuehan suddenly asked.
After asking, she continued, "Or... do you only know how to gather energy?"
Song Yan replied, "Both."
He leaned back slightly, wiping his face, revealing his original countenance now free of sword wounds.
Then he bent down, peeling off the layers of robes on this familiar yet strange female cultivator like tender onion, slowly...
The night deepened.
...
...
The flying shadow puppet carried the "bed" through the torrent of the Sea of Suffering’s aura, as the seemingly doomed male and female cultivators finally established a Dao companion relationship.
The shadow puppet flapped its wings, carrying the "bed" up and down.
Pei Xuehan nestled in his arms, quietly regarding his unmarred face, asking softly like a cat: "After we leave, will you still go to the frontier?"
Song Yan recalled Feng Chengzi’s words regarding "breaking through the Purple Mansion middle stage," nodding slightly, saying: "But this time, you must cultivate."
Pei Xuehan’s voice was so soft it seemed capable of dripping water, she whispered: "I’ll listen to you."
As she said this, she exhaled a breath beside Song Yan’s ear.
"It’s wonderful, like living anew.
The Sea of Suffering Enigma is really an unexpectedly good monster."
The last sentence exploded in Song Yan’s ears.
An ominous premonition, like a dark cloud, emerged inexplicably in his heart.
Because he realized one thing: the Sea of Suffering Enigma... had successfully carved a flaw in his mind.
If the Sea of Suffering Enigma wasn’t targeting him alone.
If the Sea of Suffering Enigma had a master.
Then... what does this master intend to do?
"Let’s go to the next Secret Realm."
"Mm!"
...
The Profound Robe and silver robe transformed into two streaks of rainbows moving in parallel, passing through the now bait-less Secret Realm entrance.
No!
There’s still bait.
Five Crimson Palace corpses were placed at the Secret Realm entrance, but the hand holding the fishing rod belonged to Song Yan.
Entering the new Secret Realm, Song Yan immediately understood the function of this fishing rod and the motives of the evil monster.
The other side wasn’t fishing, but using the connection of this fishing rod treasure to transfer a thread of warmth across.
This fishing rod treasure can "seize treasures," can "kill," but its greatest function is to link the atmospheres of both Secret Realms so that the boundary becomes somewhat blurred.
A new Secret Realm had entirely changed the world.
Frozen skies.
Snowy ground.
Snow was still falling from the sky.
The snow state among the Three States of the Tumor Realm.
But where the fishing rod was, the boundary was blurred, so it wasn’t snow-covered.
Pei Xuehan hugged her chest, gently stomping her feet, looking at the snowflakes near yet not falling onto her.
Song Yan released his Divine Sense.
Unexpectedly, his Divine Sense couldn’t penetrate the icy land.
Suddenly, his pupils constricted because he saw someone frozen underground not far away. Though frozen, the person’s eyes were wide open, bizarrely staring at him.
In the next moment...
Myriad Souls Banner emerged.
Soul Burst.
There were two booms.
The person staring at Song Yan had been blown to bits, and their Divine Soul was forcibly drawn over by Song Yan, transforming into a soul ghost.
The snow in the Tumor Realm only freezes the cause and effect, doesn’t change it, so... this Divine Soul remembers events from its life.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 152. The sinister force solidifies and refines the sword, hiding the Soul Banner; wolves ahead and tigers behind make it hard to rest (8.5K words - a large Chapter seeking subscriptions)
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: 152. The sinister force solidifies and refines the sword, hiding the Soul Banner; wolves ahead and tigers behind make it hard to rest (8.5K words - a large Chapter seeking subscriptions)
Killing cleanly and directly, soul searching, transformed minion, the techniques incredibly skillful.
In the past, Pei Xuehan might have trembled with fear.
However, although she broke free from the illusion realm, her heart had already sunk.
If it were someone else doing this, she would still be terrified, but if it were Song Yan, she wasn’t afraid.
It’s just that, since her youth, she was a straightforward female knight roaming the Jianghu, and later in the sect, she was always one to despise evil and sympathize with the weak. At this moment, she couldn’t help but slightly turn her head, unable to bear watching.
Just then, an explanation came from beside her.
"In such perilous places, everything poses a great danger, so when encountering anyone, the first thing is to be cautious. If the other party has power, good intentions, and can communicate a bit, then try to communicate first.
But this person was already frozen in the snow, staring at us with a strange gaze. If I don’t kill him, I can’t possibly take my time to understand him, right?"
Pei Xuehan said: "But he was already frozen, not his fault that he couldn’t blink his eyes shut while staring at us..."
Before she could finish, the man in front suddenly turned his head, staring at her with a pair of eyes, and heaved a long sigh: "The Sword Sect being destroyed is just that, with your temperament, your sect just sent you to your death."
Pei Xuehan argued: "It was my own decision to come, nothing to do with the sect."
The air suddenly fell silent.
Song Yan raised his hand and slapped his forehead with a "pa", then immediately laughed, asking: "Why?"
Pei Xuehan started counting on her fingers, listing how some junior apprentice sisters couldn’t miss crucial cultivation moments, some senior apprentice sisters were expecting and couldn’t leave, some senior apprentice brothers appeared too cowardly for her liking, and some sect uncles had a big family to care for and couldn’t afford any mishap...
She listed many excuses for others, but she had none for herself.
Her tone even held a slight hint of pride, as if "being able to step up for the sect" was a glorious thing.
After Pei Xuehan finished, she cautiously asked: "Senior, I..."
Song Yan said: "There’s not much age difference between us, you might even be older than me, just call me Dao Brother."
"Oh, Dao Brother... Did I do something wrong?" Pei Xuehan asked.
Song Yan said: "You did nothing wrong."
Pei Xuehan said: "Then why is Dao Brother laughing?"
Song Yan said: "Was I... laughing? I wasn’t laughing!"
Pei Xuehan stared at him for a while, let out an "oh".
And then Song Yan turned his head, taking a deep breath.
Amidst the snow and ice, all is white in sight, everything frozen in cause and effect, even taking a step forward is immensely difficult, but his mood really lightened up.
With some people, being with them no matter how dangerous or desperate the environment, you can feel the warmth of time, genuinely feeling a sense of ease from within.
Just then, Pei Xuehan suddenly realized something, suddenly exclaimed: "Dao Brother, you’re already at the Purple Mansion Realm, is your age really similar to mine? What a monstrous talent you must have."
Song Yan said: "Maybe you’re even older than me."
Pei Xuehan gasped in surprise, covering her slightly open mouth, her beautiful eyes looking at him with astonishment.
Meanwhile, Song Yan was already enthusiastically starting to interrogate the dazed ghost.
The dazed ghost that was pulled out was still a "dazed ghost", yet now seemed somewhat regained to its senses.
"Still human?"
"Yes."
"Where are you from?"
"I’m a cultivator from a vassal state of the Baihong Ancient Race."
"Baihong Ancient Race?" Song Yan’s eyes suddenly squinted, saying: "Continue, tell me everything you know."
The dazed ghost recounted in full.
The Baihong Ancient Race is an extraordinarily large ancient race located north of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race. The tribespeople possess mysterious and powerful forces, but due to certain reasons, they have formed a deadly feud with the three races: the Fox, Wolf, and Tiger races.
Hence, after the Changwang Tiger Race was exterminated and the Changwang Soul Threshold was formed, the clan secretly sent subordinate cultivators into the soul threshold. The official version from above was "to reclaim some interest from the Changwang Tiger Race and ambush the entering Fox and Wolf Races."
They successfully hunted some Fox Wolf Demons, and this dazed ghost, when alive, accidentally got caught in the heavy snow during retreat, and without realizing, was frozen within it.
Before being frozen, he consumed numerous fasting pills while secretly operating a technique to reduce bodily consumption. Even after several years, he wouldn’t perish. His plan was to regain his memory slowly after the snow melted and then leave. However, unexpectedly, this snowstorm lasted who knows how long, he himself didn’t know how long he was frozen...
As for why he was staring at Song Yan with a strange gaze.
Because... he was a Crimson Palace cultivator, even though frozen, he still retained consciousness, and his eyes could still move, albeit like an idiot. When Song Yan arrived, naturally, he’d look at Song Yan with an idiotic gaze by instinct.
Song Yan pondered slightly, but asked two questions.
"Did any tribesmen from the Baihong Ancient Race arrive?"
"The Mountain and Sea Demon Race is so vast, how did you cross the Mountain and Sea Race to reach the south?"
However, this cultivator was at a complete loss.
The first question, he only speculated "there should be tribesmen who came", but he hadn’t seen them.
Regarding the second question, he followed a covert route to infiltrate, encountering no ambush along the way.
Song Yan then asked a third question: "Which race does that route belong to?"
The cultivator shook his head.
"Don’t know?" Song Yan frowned.
To him, this should’ve been a very simple question.
The cultivator bitterly smiled: "The Mountain and Sea Demon Race’s vassal states crisscross, frequently being treated as trade commodities, the master should know which race it belonged to when we passed through.
But... to my knowledge, that border state, being close to the ancient race’s vassal state, wasn’t appealing and had changed hands so many times it was countless.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 152. The solid evil refines the sword to hide the Soul Banner, with wolves in front and tigers behind making it hard to pause (8.5K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: 152. The solid evil refines the sword to hide the Soul Banner, with wolves in front and tigers behind making it hard to pause (8.5K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_2
Even if you ask the citizens of that kingdom, asking people from ten cities might yield ten different answers.
Sometimes even if you ask the sovereign, the sovereign might not know to which race he has been sold.
Because some transactions between the Mountain and Sea Demon Race are very secretive.
Withdrawal and occupation are merely transfers of important puppets to facilitate governance, while establishing oaths.
Song Yan’s expression deepened with seriousness.
In the eyes of the demon race, or perhaps the ancient race, human kingdoms are merely items, commodities for trade.
Having only stayed in two small cornered countries, his understanding of what the "Soul Threshold of the Servant King" invoked was quite shallow.
Even though he never believed that "entering the Soul Threshold of the Servant King for treasure was only for the Fox and Wolf Races," the current situation is evidently more complex.
This involves not only the acquisition of treasure but also revenge, war, and even... betrayal.
He was skeptical: if the demon race hadn’t opened the back door, the cultivators of the White Rainbow Ancient Race could have easily infiltrated this place, and it seemed that quite a few have come.
After stripping the information value from this cultivator, he summoned the Myriad Souls Banner.
Observing the cultivator’s fearful look, he gently said, "Don’t be afraid, someday when I explode you, you will be able to reincarnate, isn’t that better than waiting here frozen to death?"
With these words, he waved his hand and sent the cultivator into the Myriad Souls Banner.
With the entry of a third divine soul from a Crimson Palace cultivator, the black smoke surrounding the Myriad Souls Banner grew slightly denser.
...
The sky gradually darkened.
At this place of nightfall, cultivators’ vision is no different from mortals.
As for divine sense, it cannot be extended.
Song Yan and Pei Xuehan sat cross-legged at the entrance of the secret realm.
The snow fell silently, drifting quietly.
Song Yan suddenly spoke, "Tomorrow I’ll explore ahead, you stay here. I had thought of stopping at a certain place, hidden away. But the environment in the Tumor Realm is too harsh, if we stop, we might not be able to move forward."
He gently sighed, "Whether it’s the flood in the First Realm or the frozen soil in this realm, it’s the same. Plus, new secret realms are forming outside the Tumor Realm, newcomers could enter at any time."
"Brother Dao, my Crimson Palace Blood has water-related amplification, maybe I can help pave a path for us to go together," Pei Xuehan smiled, "At most, I will be frozen temporarily losing memory, brother Dao just pulls me along."
"Are you so confident that I won’t lose my memory?"
"Brother Dao, with your vast divine power, in Xuehan’s mind you are akin to a deity."
The brief conversation slowly calmed down, leaving only the sound of distant whispering snow.
Gradually, Pei Xuehan nestled into Song Yan’s arms, their clothes slightly loose, her skirt and pants lightly undone.
Like a divine ice snow statue, her arms entwined, her legs wrapped around, her face burned, cuddling for warmth, cultivating together.
Every now and then accompanied by whispers like "Brother Dao, am I pressing on you," "Maybe I should stay curled up"...
...
The next day.
The sky was bright, but the snow had not stopped.
The extended duration of the "Three States of the Tumor Realm" could only indicate one thing: the aura of the Sea of Suffering was constantly escaping.
This aura was strange, first invading the cause and effect of life, but directly corroding dead objects, even the sturdy houses of the previous secret realm slowly vanished, and the remnants of the current secret realm were just a few broken structures without roof ridges.
As for the distant mountains, resembling melted ice peaks, their original height was unknown, but now they were low like small mounds.
This power that leveled green hills, froze vast seas, and erased everything that once happened brings a shocking and terrifying feeling.
Pei Xuehan’s cheeks were flushed, eyes filled with joy, she raised her hand making a gesture, pointing out with a cute shout, "Split the sea!"
As the two words fell, the distant quietly falling snow parted around ten feet.
This scene was quite amusing.
The two rode the same flying sword.
Pei Xuehan continuously parted the flying snow while controlling the sword.
Song Yan sat at the rear end of the sword rainbow, holding the banner surrounded by black energy.
With the presence of sword rainbow, the actual space to sit on the blade far exceeded the sword’s own area.
Suddenly, Song Yan’s expression tightened, noticing something seemed to exist within the frozen soil and said, "To the left, slow down."
Following the voice, Pei Xuehan approached.
Upon arriving close...
Song Yan raised a finger to point.
A myriad of souls flew out from the Myriad Souls Banner behind.
With two booming sounds.
The unknown existence within the frozen soil was blown apart.
A fragmented demon beast head flew up, captured by Song Yan from a distance, inside were dozens of sesame-sized red powders.
What could these powders be if not Evil Monster?
However, at this moment, the Evil Monster had lost its vitality, as if frozen stupid.
Song Yan discarded the demon beast head, holding those Evil Monsters in his palm.
It was his first time seeing Evil Monster this quiet.
Suddenly, a thought sprang into his mind: could he control the Evil Monster?
He had always stored collected Evil Monsters using the Sikong Seal, yet hadn’t thought of how to use them.
Because the Evil Monster was too active, lacking any wisdom, if you dared to release it, it wouldn’t care about your realm, it aimed to kill even at the cost of mutual destruction.
The "quiet Evil Monster" provided him with some inspiration.
Suddenly, he recalled the White Rainbow Ancient Race vassal cultvator frozen at the entrance.
Knowing that at the entrance stood a "double-headed four-armed" Evil Monster, with its insatiable thirst for life, if any possibility existed, it would have dragged the cultivator out of the ice to fuse.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 152. The evil force solidifies and forges the sword, concealing the Soul Banner; facing wolves in front and tigers at the back, hard to rest (8.5K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: 152. The evil force solidifies and forges the sword, concealing the Soul Banner; facing wolves in front and tigers at the back, hard to rest (8.5K words - large Chapter seeking subscription)_3
But there was nothing.
The cultivator was alive and well.
Song Yan continued to ponder.
The essence of malice is the fragments of karma lingering in the world that react over time within a sealed environment of Profound Qi.
The karma fragments of ordinary people and Refining Profound cultivators are weaker, so they merely form Evil Qi; Crimson Palace cultivators yield Slaughter Liquid; only Purple Mansion cultivators can form Frozen Malignant Energy.
Of course, there might be other ways this forms, but after all, he had only come from a small place and had not seen much.
Ultimately, malice is a special manifestation of cause and effect.
So it can be frozen, it can be washed away.
And every divine soul is densely covered in karma.
’If so...’
Song Yan suddenly had an idea.
...
By dusk, Song Yan and Pei Xuehan returned to their original spot.
Today’s harvest was rather good.
Altogether they collected the frozen malignant energy from six demon beasts, and another Crimson Palace cultivator’s divine soul.
After some inquiries, Song Yan learned that the information was similar to the last; this cultivator also hailed from a vassal state of the Baihong Ancient Tribe.
So, he once again sent the cultivator into the Myriad Souls Banner, then planted the banner behind him and said, "Unleash."
Countless souls surged out, blotting out the sky, a ghostly wind howled, the surroundings instantly turning eerie and dark.
Song Yan took a deep breath, raised his hand, and summoned a coffin.
The coffin was thick and made of metal.
But soon, red spikes protruded from inside the metal.
With a cracking sound, the entire coffin, as if made of paper, was pierced a thousand times by the red spikes within.
Song Yan squinted, watching, and when the red spikes came toward him, he raised a finger, and dense numbers of evil souls immediately lunged at those red spikes.
The red spikes were frozen malignant energy.
When encountered by evil souls, a fierce reaction ensued between the two.
Frozen malignant energy instinctively seeks to possess life, sensitive to divine souls, and in every body, it prefers to bind rather than kill the soul.
At this moment, the frozen malignant energy was like molten steel, and the evil souls like icy water, and with a sizzling sound, the weak evil souls were easily bound by the strong frozen malignant energy.
Normally, by this time the fusion would be complete.
But this was the Myriad Souls Banner.
Within it were more than twenty thousand souls.
Song Yan expressionlessly continued to maneuver the evil souls towards the frozen malignant energy.
The frozen malignant energy was like a rat in a rice jar, crazily binding the divine souls.
Binding and binding, it became saturated and couldn’t move anymore.
Song Yan beckoned with his hand.
The wraith autonomously drove the frozen malignant energy to his side, then transformed it as he wished, sometimes into a knife, sometimes into a sword.
And then, in that moment, a fierce red light flashed in an opening.
Song Yan tilted his head slightly, the red light brushed past his ear and then looped toward the back of his head.
Thinking briefly, Song Yan summoned an evil soul at the Crimson Palace level from the air and adhered it to the frozen malignant energy to strengthen it.
This time, the frozen malignant energy stopped moving.
Song Yan’s mind stirred, and that frozen malignant energy transformed into what looked like an ordinary flying sword, floating in front of him.
With another flick, the flying sword actually returned to the Myriad Souls Banner, merging into it to become a "Sword in the Banner."
’It worked?’
’It really worked!’
’This is a flying sword entirely controlled by me, solidified with frozen malignant energy and evil souls!’
’No, it can be a flying sword, it can be any weapon.’
’It hides within the banner, mingles among the ghosts, and can indeed raise the danger level of my Myriad Souls Banner one notch.’
’Moreover, when I get new frozen malignant energy, I can continue to enhance it!’
A kind of indescribable joy rose in Song Yan’s heart.
In this soul threshold of the wraith king, any enhancement of a method would make him happy, for he didn’t even know if he could leave here alive.
"Xuehan, tomorrow let’s explore in another direction, see what we can dig up in this frozen ground." Song Yan, rare to speak much, said, "I can tell, this land, as the secret realm’s outskirts, should have frozen many frozen malignant energies, many people. Those people were escaping from inside, only to be caught in a heavy snow here."
Pei Xuehan nodded and softly replied, "Hmm."
...
...
Several days later...
Amidst the desolate snow, in the midst of ruins, appeared a strange aura shield.
The flying snow, stained with the breath of the Sea of Suffering, gently fell, but it was just like ordinary snowflakes, sliding off after landing on the shield, covering the surroundings.
Inside the shield, there was a man and a woman.
Outside the shield, lay the body of a man.
The three of them wore the same sect robes, clearly comrades.
Yet, in such a place, comrades could also kill each other.
The female cultivator, with a lovely face, was solemnly looking afar after cultivation.
The male cultivator suddenly said, "Still looking at him?"
The female cultivator said, "In the same boat, we must see if this boat can carry three people. Since it cannot, there must be someone who dies. I don’t want to die, so he had to."
The male cultivator said, "But he is your senior brother, always caring for you, and yet I am your enemy. You killed him just because I can control this array and find a sliver of hope in this snow... I didn’t even make any earlier arrangements with you."
The female cultivator shook her head, leaned willingly into his arms, and said, "Let’s not talk about this anymore."
The male cultivator put his hand into her clothes, grabbing tightly, but after the brief excitement, he let out a long sigh.
"The people of the Baihong Ancient Tribe must have sent us to die! It’s been so long, we probably can’t get out. I don’t even know whether the outside secret realm has layered again, and if so, how many more times... There’s just no way to go inside."
"I think the Baihong Ancient Tribe must have sent someone. It’s not easy for them to cultivate talents in our sect, they wouldn’t just abandon us here."

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 152. Refining the sword with the Soul Banner, with a wolf ahead and a tiger behind, unstoppable (8.5K characters - long Chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: 152. Refining the sword with the Soul Banner, with a wolf ahead and a tiger behind, unstoppable (8.5K characters - long Chapter, please subscribe)_4
"Not easy? If it’s not easy, it won’t be abandoned?
The difference between the Ancient Race and the Demon Race is that the Demon Race eats humans, while the Ancient Race doesn’t, that’s it."
The two exchanged complaints.
But there was no way.
The heavy snow blocked all roads, and they couldn’t go anywhere.
At that moment, the female cultivator suddenly lifted her eyes, focused her gaze into the distance, with a strange light flashing in her eyes.
The male cultivator was startled, quickly turned his head, also showing delight.
On the snow-laden sky, a flying sword was approaching, with a female cultivator in silver robes, beautiful and graceful, evidently skilled at "Water Spell", managing to part the snow in such a harsh Tumor Realm.
This technique, if outside, could part the sea for several thousand feet with a single gesture.
It must be said, those skilled in "Water Spell" hold an advantage in the Tumor Realm.
The female cultivator hurriedly waved her hand and shouted loudly: "Fellow Daoist!!"
The male cultivator also showed delight.
The two saw the silver-robed female cultivator on the flying sword evidently showing joy, swiftly flying towards them, seemingly wanting to meet.
But for some reason, the flying sword suddenly slowed down.
Only then did they notice another male cultivator sitting on the rainbow light behind the flying sword.
But before they could see the male cultivator’s face clearly, before they could discuss a strategy, before deciding whether to "cooperate with these two" or "kill the male cultivator and threaten the silver-robed female cultivator to part snow and take them out", they saw a cloud of black smoke.
In the black smoke, they vaguely saw a tall banner rising, and a man taking shape, grasping a sword emitting an eerie aura from the banner.
The silver-robed female cultivator seemed to instruct, as the flying sword only approached from afar, no longer descending.
The next moment...
Whizz!
Several evil spirits flew out from the black smoke, heading directly towards the pair of cultivators.
Both the male and female cultivators were taken aback.
The female cultivator exclaimed in shock: "Attacking without even asking, is too overbearing!"
The male cultivator quickly activated his array, while coldly snorting: "Don’t think we are easy to bully!"
Surprisingly, the evil spirits crashed into the barrier and bounced off abruptly.
Confidence grew in the male cultivator’s eyes, ready to oppose with treasure, when suddenly... a sharp, terrifying red glow appeared before him.
The red light descended from above, landing on the barrier momentarily, yet was still blocked.
The male cultivator sneered, ready to make a move, yet in the next instant, the obstruction shattered instantly, and the red glow ferociously descended.
The male cultivator only felt a chill in his body, then saw the overwhelming red glow again.
’This... is this Demon... Demon Fixation?’
Chichi! Chichi!
All over red fell.
The cultivators who had survived for a long time in the unknown array were instantly turned into a beehive.
And the last doubt lingering in their minds was "why this person could control Demon Fixation, why"...
Song Yan raised his hand to retract the red sword.
He wasn’t wrong, many Demon Fixation monsters fled from the secret realm inside but were all frozen here. Over these days, he gained greatly.
The Demon Fixation powder he gathered, if coagulated, could already form a solid short sword. Such an amount of Demon Fixation is already quite extravagant.
To ensure the stability of the Demon Sword, he even filled it with the Purple Mansion level Chong Souls of "ancient remains".
Exploring further today, encountering the living was unexpected.
"Why did Brother Dao kill them directly?" Pei Xuehan couldn’t help but mutter softly, even though she already knew the answer.
Song Yan said: "Human nature is too complicated. And here, the cost of trust is too high, neither of us can afford it. So it’s better they remain dead."
As he spoke, he turned the pair into Transformed Minions, pulling out the nearby frozen cultivator as well, though the latter was already dead, with no Divine Soul, so there were only two Chong Souls.
A slight inquiry revealed to Song Yan the "relationship of the three", nothing more than "one person mastered the means of survival, but could protect only a few, so the female cultivator backhandedly killed her senior brother, turning to the enemy".
As for the array, it was something the male cultivator acquired by chance, named "Soul-Sealing Array", mainly used to seal evil spirits, malevolent forces, and such.
He encountered heavy snow here, using the array hurriedly, and found that the "Soul-Sealing Array" unexpectedly had the effect of cutting off the heavy snow, so he waited here for the snow to stop.
As to why the "Soul-Sealing Array" could isolate the snow of the Tumor Realm, he completely didn’t understand, having looked through some array books but found no corresponding information.
Song Yan picked up the array plate, studying it carefully.
The array patterns on the plate were complex, numbering in the tens of thousands.
But Song Yan already knew: the complexity of arrays usually inversely correlated with the number of patterns.
The fewer the patterns, the more terrifying.
Because the fewer patterns, the harder to remember, or rather simply impossible to remember.
Array patterns numbering a thousand already approached the level of "fragmented Little Celestial Dao Characters", unable to be drawn without using formal symbolic notation.
While the "Soul-Sealing Array" before him, with tens of thousands of array-pattern levels, was generally on par with "Five Elements Gathering Profound Array", "Myriad Souls Banner Sacrificial Refining Array".
He showed a contemplative look in his eyes.
...
Nightfall.
Frozen Secret Realm entrance.
Pei Xuehan nestled in Song Yan’s arms.
Due to "fishing rod", "proficiency in Water Spell", the Frozen Secret Realm seemed safer than the last secret realm.
Yet only seemed, this place already served as a grave for many cultivators and Demon Fixations.
The vast snow not only lacked any beauty, but instead brimmed with a cold despair, a cemetery’s silence.
In the illusion realm, Pei Xuehan and Song Yan escaped this place, but she never really saw the details in the illusion realm, whereas now... she simply leaned as close to Song Yan as possible, gazing absentmindedly into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 152. The sinister force solidifies and refines the sword, hiding the Soul Banner; wolves ahead and tigers behind make it hard to rest (8.5K words - a large Chapter seeking subscriptions)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: 152. The sinister force solidifies and refines the sword, hiding the Soul Banner; wolves ahead and tigers behind make it hard to rest (8.5K words - a large Chapter seeking subscriptions)_5
She no longer felt she could leave this Soul Threshold alive.
If it weren’t for Song Yan, her fate would have been to be desecrated and toyed with by ancient corpses, then turned into a corpse stained with evil in the flood.
Suddenly, she noticed that Song Yan seemed unusually serious tonight.
He was earnestly and repeatedly examining the "Soul-Sealing Array" plate.
Pei Xuehan didn’t disturb him, merely greedily drawing a sense of security from the warmth emanating from him.
It was unknown how long had passed when she suddenly heard a loud crack. She hurriedly opened her eyes, only to see Song Yan had crushed the "Soul-Sealing Array" plate.
And Song Yan’s fingers picked through the shattered array plate, soon settling and extracting a strange Crystal Jade the size of a soybean, gray on the outside and white on the inside.
Pei Xuehan was just about to say, "This array plate could block out snow; is it not a pity to destroy it?" but saw a peculiar light flashing in Song Yan’s eyes.
There was great delight, coldness, but more so... madness.
Pei Xuehan couldn’t help but ask, "What is this?"
Song Yan held the soybean-sized Crystal Jade, repeatedly examining it, as if confirming something, letting out a chilling laugh, then murmured, "Can you believe that there’s actually a Causality White Hole Crystal Jade in this world?
What I have here is a Causality White Hole Crystal Jade. This cultivator fortuitously obtained this formation after several turnovers; the original owner is unknown...
But this is indeed a Causality White Hole Crystal Jade.
I speculate that such a Crystal Jade likely requires disturbance from the Sea of Suffering to occasionally gain it within a connected Soul Threshold.
And the so-called Soul-Sealing Array is essentially repulsion that corresponds to gravity.
It uses array patterns, this Causality White Hole Crystal Jade, to repel all causality fragments, including the aura of the Sea of Suffering."
Pei Xuehan was bewildered, then curiously asked, "If that’s the case, why did you destroy it?"
Song Yan said, "Because it’s too small. Although the Soul-Sealing Array could block snow, it couldn’t block rain, let alone the real aura of the Sea of Suffering.
I dismantled it to prove my hypothesis, and secondly... to put it into the array I modified."
With that, Song Yan quickly took out an array plate from his bosom.
Pei Xuehan looked at it.
She saw that the array patterns on this plate were fewer than any array plate she had seen before.
But the moment she looked away, she had already forgotten those patterns, unable to recall even the slightest bit—they were just a shadow.
"Dao brother indeed is a master of arrays."
What Song Yan took out was the "Lesser Heavenly Dao Gathering Array," an array that could gather corresponding material when the appropriate White Hole Crystal Stone is placed inside.
He immediately took out an array pattern pen to carefully consider how to add something to this "Lesser Heavenly Dao Gathering Array."
...
After three days of tireless effort, Song Yan finally completed the modifications.
His modifications merely shrank the "gathering" range as much as possible, leading to the maximum possible "gravity," making it relatively easy since it was going towards a "lower difficulty."
The amount of a particular substance in any area is limited, and everyone thinks about expanding the "gathering range" to absorb as much of the corresponding material as possible.
But why did he shrink it?
The array plate of the modified Lesser Heavenly Dao Gathering Array was completed, and Song Yan carefully placed the "Causality White Hole Crystal Jade" into the array plate’s core, then holding it like a nuclear bomb, silently chanted in his heart: ’With this array plate, and using the Myriad Souls Banner as the target, engage in cultivation.’
His use of talent was becoming increasingly proficient.
[You activated the Lesser Heavenly Dao Gathering Array, the surrounding wind and snow swirled into a vortex, furiously pouring in, you activated the Myriad Souls Banner]
[The evil souls in the banner were continuously frozen, sinking into the permafrost repeatedly. You captured them back, reinserting them into the Myriad Souls Banner, thus seemingly achieving balance]
[A year later, nothing happened]
Song Yan frowned.
This was different from his expectation.
In his mind: this place was very close to the Soul Valve of the Sea of Suffering, and the moment the Lesser Heavenly Dao Gathering Array with the Causality White Hole Crystal was activated, it should have induced the Sea of Suffering.
This was like a needle gently pricking the space very close to the Sea of Suffering. Usually, it wouldn’t pierce, but here... it constantly emitted the aura of the Sea of Suffering.
He didn’t hope to truly draw up the sea water from the Sea of Suffering, only to draw up the aura. Such would already be terrifying enough.
He wanted this array to become an "all-destroying ultimate move," essentially betting: if I can’t live, then no one else can.
At that time, he could still rely on the evil ghosts within the Myriad Souls Banner to barely hold on, but others would find it much harder to persist.
’Could it be that it’s still too far from the Sea of Suffering?’
’Maybe only by going deeper into the Soul Threshold would it be effective?’
Song Yan put away the array plate, planning to try it in the next Secret Realm.
He frowned, with an obscure urgency in his eyes.
Pei Xuehan, having become intimate with him, could naturally discern this urgency, so she asked, "What’s happened?"
Song Yan said, "I’ve learned something."
"What is it?"
"The name of the demon country that lent passage to the subordinate cultivators of the White Rainbow Ancient Race."
"What... is it?"
"The Two-Headed Vilan Man-Eating Insect Race." Song Yan’s expression was very solemn, "Those two cultivators happened to know this secret."
"This means that the situation here is very deep and implies that the whirlpool we’re in isn’t just the Soul Thresholds of the King of Wraiths but also others..."
"Before, Elder Yingti said that other Mountain and Sea Demon Races were also eyeing the Evil Treasure, only to be diverted elsewhere by his machinations."
"But since the White Rainbow Ancient Race had already entered the Soul Thresholds of the King of Wraith through the Vilan Jiao Insect Race, how could Elder Yingti... adjust?"
Having spoken, he sighed lightly, "Old fox, it’s impossible for him to be truthful.
What exactly he’s here for, I can no longer discern.
Maybe... he’s just scouting the way for his king.
Or perhaps, he’s caught up in someone else’s schemes as well.
And we are just two small boats on the waves of the Vast Sea, caught in the battles of these gigantic forces."
Just as he was speaking, Song Yan’s expression suddenly changed dramatically...
Because, he sensed that the split souls he placed in the "Shadowless Phantom Crows" at the outermost Secret Realm... had vanished.
That meant someone outside had come in, easily discovering his Shadowless Phantom Crows and wiping them out effortlessly.
Who is it?!
"Go!"
Song Yan grabbed the fishing rod.
Pei Xuehan asked, "Where to?"
"To the next Secret Realm!" Song Yan hastily replied, "Hurry, it seems we’ve got some old thing chasing us!"

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
Whoosh~~
A beam of light wrapped in black smoke swept across the frozen wasteland.
The falling snow here is certainly terrifying, but it can only freeze, strip away, and drop a few evil spirits from the outer layer of the black smoke.
The man in the Profound Robe and the Female Cultivator in the silver robe inside were left unharmed.
For exploration, Pei Xuehan would naturally need to use the "Sea Splitting Technique" to fly slowly, but to pass through this place swiftly, the previous method can’t be used slowly.
"Hold tight."
Song Yan gently said.
Immediately, he felt a pair of delicate hands carefully wrap around his waist, and the gentle body pressed against his back.
This emotion is not rootless but cultivated from spending a century together in that Illusion Realm.
One could say Pei Xuehan has already surpassed any woman in the time spent with him. But clearly, the two haven’t known each other for long.
The intense feeling of strangeness and contradiction rose alongside the increasingly entrancing tenderness.
...
In the next moment, the beam of light entered another Secret Realm.
Unlike the silence of the frozen wasteland, upon entering this Secret Realm, shouts of battle rang in the ears like drums and gongs.
The temperature shifted from cold to warm, but it was an extremely uncomfortable warmth; the gray fog quietly floating in the air seemed filthy, prompting an irresistible desire to avoid it.
But with fog engulfing the world, how could one avoid it?
Song Yan extended his Divine Sense, yet still faced obstruction.
But actually, Divine Sense was unnecessary, since a mere glance revealed numerous cultivators and demon beasts fighting fiercely.
However, the battle wasn’t between cultivators and demon beasts but... a "chaotic battle".
All the cultivators and demon beasts were crazed.
Song Yan squinted, focusing on a headless cultivator, and frowned slightly, confirming a thought: these cultivators aren’t just crazed, even in death, they continue battling, because the Slaughter Liquid and Evil Qi are also crazed.
Cultivators and demon beasts die, generating Evil Qi.
The crazed Evil Qi reclaims the bodies of cultivators and demon beasts.
Endlessly in cycle.
The thin fog continuously refreshes any existing memory.
What the fog covers is a world where death knows no rest.
Pei Xuehan promptly pinched her fingers, casting the Controlling Technique, her whole body tensed, preparing to attack, because she realized they were being watched by a monster.
A demon beast with brown wings and a bear’s head flew into the sky, roaring fiercely, swooping down towards them.
Pei Xuehan was about to make a move but was stopped by Song Yan, who gently pressed down on her hand, skillfully avoiding the attack with the black smoke beam, arcing away in the fog sky.
"Don’t attack just yet."
"Alright, brother."
Throughout the journey, Pei Xuehan had listened obediently to Song Yan because she realized this Dao brother not only had great power but also a mental fortitude and calculative skills surpassing her own, so she simply gave up on thinking.
Song Yan transformed the beam into flight, skillfully evading the attacks of various demon beasts or cultivators.
Fortunately, those crazed demon beasts and cultivators easily shifted their targets; their memories and thoughts were always overwritten by new ones, unless Song Yan was in their sight; otherwise, they would aimlessly engage in frenzied battles.
Whoosh~
Whoosh whoosh~~
The beam of light traversed the sky, the substitute death souls outside the Myriad Souls Banner began to mutate, crazed, starting to fly away from the banners, devouring anything they could find.
Though it was few at the moment, over time it would increase, and if Song Yan did nothing, aimlessly wandering with the Myriad Souls Banner, the entire banner would be corroded by the fog.
This was only possible because Song Yan transformed the Myriad Souls Banner into the Myriad Souls Craze Banner; for someone else, they would have been overwhelmed by its uncontrollable nature, dispersing souls across a vast area.
After circling for some time, Song Yan found the entrance to the next Secret Realm.
The increasingly dense Sea of Suffering aura seeped from the Secret Realm...
The aura exceeded the sum of the Sea of Suffering aura from previous Secret Realms, to the point of being unable to contain it.
Perhaps, beyond the Mist Realm lay the endpoint of the Craze King Soul Threshold.
What should he do?
Suddenly, Song Yan’s eyelid twitched because he found he lost contact with the "Shadowless Phantom Crow" he left in the Flood Secret Realm.
This indicated the outsider had already entered the Flood Secret Realm.
This speed showed no obstacles, no scruples, seemingly just rushing through.
Song Yan’s heartbeat raced, a tingling sensation pierced his scalp, and a long-absent dryness rose in his mouth.
Between wolves and tigers, it’s just like this!
What to do?
He took a deep breath, his eyes swiftly scanning for a solution.
The Mist Realm terrain was mountainous, with significant undulations, extending widely.
Upon closer inspection, the fog’s density was uneven.
Thick in deep gorges, thin in the sky, dense in deep mountains, sparse on plains.
Song Yan maneuvered briefly, gritting his teeth, muttering "I’ll risk it," then suddenly opened the Myriad Souls Banner fully, and darted towards the next Secret Realm entrance.
But he entered.
He only stopped at the entrance briefly, and upon seeing the crazed souls scattered around the banner, he abruptly said to Pei Xuehan, "Use the Sea Splitting Technique."
Pei Xuehan hastily cast the technique, splitting the fog in front of them, forming an empty space of about ten feet.
Song Yan put away the Myriad Souls Banner, scanning the surroundings, thinking, ’with this, if anyone chases, they might assume I’ve hurried into the next Secret Realm.’
Then, he used Sword Control while Pei Xuehan led the way.
The two spent roughly half an hour reaching a gorge shrouded in dense fog.
Upon entering, finding a cave, Song Yan took out the Paper House and threw it into the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_2
The paper house instantly expanded, its walls only produced a slight crackling sound under the fog’s corrosion, yet there was not a single crack.
Song Yan took a deep breath and took out the "Mini Heavenly Dao Gathering Array", scattering array flags across the gorge. The array plate rotated slightly, causing the surrounding fog to gather slightly here, thus further protecting the paper house.
The fog fluctuated in density, still within the normal range. A "Mini Heavenly Dao Gathering Array" is just a small "suction device" and does not cause abnormalities.
In the next moment, he pulled Pei Xuehan into the paper house. Seeing the latter about to speak, he raised a finger, making a "silent" gesture.
Pei Xuehan moved her beautiful eyes, staring at the mysterious paper house in astonishment, but was soon startled. Although she made no sound, she still raised her hand, pointing to the wall not far away.
Song Yan had seen it already.
As the fog thickened, the paper house endured a new wave of "intensity test", but this time it was not just a "slight crackling", but there was a bit of a small crack. It was manageable, withstandable.
After doing all this, Song Yan pulled Pei Xuehan into the house.
Since there were wolves in front and tigers behind, he might as well hide and let the tigers confront the wolves.
He wasn’t entirely confident, but since the opponent aggressively seemed to be in a rush and extinguished the three "Shadowless Illusion Crow Shadow Puppets" he left behind, then... it’d make sense for him to have "quickly entered the next Secret Realm" because the opponent was not targeting him, so they wouldn’t deliberately linger here to search for him valley by valley.
Now, he stood at the paper window in the paper house, watching the thick fog outside the courtyard flowing like gray silk on the sky.
Inside the house, it was eerily quiet.
Neither of them spoke.
Song Yan intertwined his fingers, realizing: he knows nothing about the people or events linked to this Soul Threshold of the Specter King!
He felt as terrified now as when the "First Raid on Nanwu Sword Sect" happened on South Bamboo Peak.
Back then, he was panic-stricken, sprinting frantically, resembling a little punk, even burrowing into the snow, pretending to be a snowman to hide.
At that time, he was only Refining Profound Third Layer, while outside were high-level Refining Profound cultivators, even Crimson Palace cultivators.
Now... it’s about the same.
He thought entering the Purple Mansion realm already gave him a say, but... that’s only in small nations.
As he pondered, he suddenly felt a pair of soft hands gently covering his, looking up to meet Pei Xuehan’s tender eyes, where decades of companionship and memories quietly flowed, possessing a healing magic for the soul.
Those eyes seemed to be telling him "Whether in life or death, accompany you, never leave nor forsake".
This sweet emotion akin to "legendary love" suddenly invaded Song Yan’s heart, making him feel the deeper bond with this woman within his divine soul.
So deep... that he began to be wary and frightened.
Because he has realized: their acquaintance and love happened within a mere few days, as if a hand forcibly connected a red string between them.
...
Time seemed to have passed very long or perhaps just a short while, when suddenly a weird and noisy shrill sound came from afar.
It seemed like the sound of countless mosquitoes and flies sticking together, buzzing like a long bell toll, roaring like a deep-sea volcano, whistling like a pitch black whirlwind, exuding a heart-throbbing natural disaster aura, full of powerful oppression.
This oppressive feeling, even the cries of strong cultivators pale in comparison.
Pei Xuehan hugged Song Yan tightly.
Song Yan’s own face turned a bit pale.
But he quickly calmed himself, staring outside coldly with relentless and ruthless eyes, while secretly grasping the Myriad Souls Banner, ready to strike at any time.
A moment...
An instant...
The time of a stick of incense...
An hour...
A day...
Time passed quickly, but after the sound arose in the distance, it never appeared again.
Song Yan simply sat cross-legged, unable to probe outside the valley with his divine sense, better to conserve energy.
He had a subtle feeling that maybe... the major changes at the Soul Threshold of the Specter King were not far off.
With the entry of strong cultivators and Ancient Tooth, many things were heading towards the endpoint, drawing to a close.
But he knew very little about these matters, relying only on guessing.
Yet he couldn’t even recognize all those involved, how accurate could his guesses be?
The paper house remained pale, its dim light only outlining the silhouettes of the two.
Outside the courtyard were drifting dense fog, beyond were endless clashes.
This moment was already the most dangerous and unknown situation Song Yan had ever encountered.
In Cold Pool Valley, at least he knew Fox Granny and Gu Huangzi wanted him dead.
In Misty Sea, he at least knew his opponents were Red Granny and Ancient General.
But now, he wasn’t even sure who his opponents were because in their eyes... he might not even qualify as one.
He wasn’t the center of this event.
Now, he had no choice but to delay entering, stay out of it for now.
Yet he knew, if the Soul Threshold of the Specter King was destined to end, then even hiding here, how long could he evade?
But he kept hiding, or waiting.
He’s always been patient.
His mind didn’t weaken with the passage of time; instead, it grew more frenzied.
His eyes filled with murderous intent, borne from fear, anger, despair, excitement, even viciousness.
His brain raced, yet he quietly suppressed it with conserving energy, only waiting... for the rebound moment.
...
After an uncertain amount of time...
Song Yan heard a faint "click-click" sound again, a sound of cracking.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_3
The air quieted down slightly.
In the next instant, the shattering sound, like drops of water falling into a pan of oil, suddenly exploded with a "crackle", seemingly spreading across the sky and coming from all directions.
He quickly scanned the surroundings and discovered that the walls of the paper house were shockingly covered with numerous cracks.
Those cracks spread like a spider web and soon crawled all over several walls.
This indicates that the atmosphere of the Sea of Suffering outside is rising at a terrifying rate, rising to the point where the paper house can no longer withstand.
Song Yan raised his hand and withdrew the "Small Heavenly Dao Gathering Introduction Array".
Immediately, the appearance of the cracks stopped.
But both he and Pei Xuehan knew: the cessation was only temporary. Something had already occurred deep within the soul threshold, hence the large-scale eruption of the Sea of Suffering aura.
As for the secret realm outside, it was unknown how many layers had stacked up.
Pei Xuehan looked at the temporarily static cracks outside and softly called out: "Brother Dao..."
Song Yan said: "What’s the matter?"
Pei Xuehan looked at him seriously and said: "I know you’ve been worried, worried that the sudden bond between us would become a trap.
These days, I’ve seriously thought about it, Brother Dao’s concerns must be correct."
Song Yan looked at her silently and said: "So, what are you suggesting?"
Pei Xuehan grasped his hand, smiling: "Kill me."
Song Yan said: "Killing you would only leave a bigger flaw in my heart. This... is unsolvable."
Pei Xuehan suddenly laughed with joy.
She closed her eyes, her cheek resting on Song Yan’s chest, and said softly: "I finally know Brother Dao and the illusionary realm are the same, both with sharp tongues but tender hearts. You clearly have a way, yet are unwilling to act.
I, such a naive and foolish female cultivator, after witnessing Brother Dao’s methods, could think of a solution. How could Brother Dao not?
I won’t survive the next secret realm.
And this trap, I don’t want Brother Dao to fall into it.
So..."
She suddenly bent her fingers for sword control, gently looking at Song Yan and said: "Xuehan willingly becomes a vengeful spirit, to accompany Brother Dao forever. This way... Brother Dao’s mental realm will be flawless, and can no longer be exploited."
Outside the house, the fog increased again, the sound of cracking on the walls resumed, and the paper house reached its limit of support.
Pei Xuehan had already raised her sword.
The sword radiance turned cold but was suddenly clamped by Song Yan’s two fingers.
Crack...
Crack-crack-crack...
The cracking sounds outside the courtyard grew more frequent.
Pei Xuehan chuckled lightly: "We’ve known each other for hardly half a year, right? It’s someone planting a heart demon in Brother Dao’s heart..."
Song Yan said: "I know."
Pei Xuehan said: "I’m bound to die, if Brother Dao cares for me, he’d instead be burdened."
Song Yan was silent for a while and asked: "Do you hate me?"
Pei Xuehan smiled and shook her head: "I had already planned to die when entering the soul threshold.
In the ancient tooth place, I should have died long ago.
Being able to meet Brother Dao, spending a hundred years together, sharing these days, I’m already very content.
Thank you..."
Song Yan suddenly bent his fingers, a flying sword whirred out from his storage space, levitating in mid-air with overwhelming sword qi.
Pei Xuehan looked at him in surprise, seemingly realizing for the first time that he was also a sword cultivator.
Then, as if she understood something, she slowly closed her eyes.
Song Yan raised his hand, two fingers pointing at her brow.
"My people, I kill myself."
"This way, my mental realm will never be considered perfection, because... I must, must kill the person who caused all this.
No matter how the novice monk drags me into the illusion realm again, my ties will only be with it, or the person behind it.
Perhaps... it’s the entire Buddhist Sect!
A hundred years, a thousand years, ten thousand years...
It will never deceive me again!"
He took a deep breath, and his fingers slowly pulled a divine soul from her body, transforming it into a vengeful spirit.
He dragged it slowly, like slowly cutting his own flesh with a serrated knife.
He wanted to remember the pain and resentment at this moment forever.
The novice monk used hundreds of years in the illusion realm to plant a heart demon in him, but he turned the heart demon into an absolute grievance against Buddhism, an eternal inability to be enlightened.
Moments later...
Rolling black smoke flew out from the incredibly dense fog of the deep valley and went toward the secret realm ahead.
...
...
Space ripples spread, drawing the black smoke in.
The secret realm behind had already been cleared, revealing an unobstructed gray sky with a gigantic gray sun floating.
Look closely!
That’s not a sun, but a terrifying gray "ball", with countless vengeful spirits hovering inside and out. Wrapped inside it were countless divine souls.
But this "gray sun" already had an opening, inside which floated a string of gray dark gold beads.
There were nine beads in total, scattered and floating, seemingly directing the entire operation of the "gray sun".
Without a doubt, these nine beads are the evil treasure.
And beneath the beads, Song Yan swept by quickly.
He saw the infant-weeping on top.
Besides the infant-weeping person, there was an even more terrifying seven-tailed demonic fox whose arrival was unknown, facing a masked, red-robed eccentric.
Oddly, all three seemed to be asleep.
Ancient tooth, deer demon, Han Yuling were also present, yet motionless, also asleep.
As for Tang Fan and the other two treasure hunters, though they were also asleep, they were well protected.
That unknown identity and realm seven-tailed demonic fox, despite being in the illusion realm, continued to protect those three, ensuring they were merely within the illusion realm without suffering other harm.
The desolate gray sun rotated in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_4
The nine dark gold beads moved like stars.
No slaughter, no battle...
In the sky, on the ground, there was a strange harmony and silence.
And at the moment Song Yan appeared, a gray-robed monk’s shadow came from afar, appeared before him, clasped his hands in a slight bow, and Song Yan immediately fell into an illusion realm.
His last remaining thought was: Indeed, I was right, this novice monk is acting with purpose.
He re-entered the illusion. No matter how the illusion realm tempted him, he only wished to find the novice monk who lured him and then kill him.
Ten years.
Twenty years.
Fifty years.
A hundred years.
Chasing from youth to old age, he was always searching for the novice monk. He wanted to kill that novice monk.
This time, when the time was up, nothing came to find him, nothing asked him, "Does it really matter if it’s true or false?"
And at the first moment he opened his eyes, he grabbed out with a blood hand, exploding the novice monk.
But, unexpectedly: another novice monk appeared!
He fell into the illusion realm again.
And a brief glance before falling into the illusion was... he saw the Sea of Suffering aura increasing, saw the demons still continuing their slumber.
If the Sea of Suffering aura keeps increasing to the point where it would drown him at the moment the novice monk removes the illusion, that... would be certain death.
Song Yan discovered that even though he planted a deep hatred for the novice monk and the entire Buddhist sect in his heart, making him immune to the novice monk’s illusion realm, leaving no deeper heart demon flaws, it was still useless.
Completely useless!
His power, his calculations, were too weak in the face of stronger, more bizarre power.
Another century of chasing the Buddhist sect...
Another awakening...
Another instant killing of the novice monk before him...
Seeing more of the Sea of Suffering aura again...
If no novice monk appears at this time to drag him into the illusion realm, he would immediately raise the Myriad Souls Banner to counteract that terrifying Sea of Suffering aura.
But, as expected, another novice monk appeared.
He fell into the illusion realm again.
And this time, in the illusion, he was controlling his sword, searching around for the novice monk, when suddenly the sky shattered like a bright mirror, as if violently torn apart by some powerful external force.
Before Song Yan could react, he heard a shrill cry: "Insect King, let’s set aside our grudges and strike together!
You must be here because you couldn’t find the person to meet you. You were also lured here by the Tiger Emperor! The Tiger Emperor’s divine thought hasn’t dissipated; it wants revenge!
Let’s suppress the Tiger Emperor together, then let the three treasure hunters retrieve the evil treasure in the core!
Once it’s done, we’ll withdraw together.
The beads, you take four, I’ll take five. After all, I’ve contributed more.
As for how to divide them in the end, we’ll discuss it after we get out!
Our next battle, after we get out as well!"
The shrill cry was made by the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox.
And "Insect King" clearly referred to the person in the red robe opposite it.
Beneath the face-covering mask, the billowing red robe revealed a swirling, icy cold whirlwind. You couldn’t even see that it consisted of countless strange little insects.
"Alright."
The Insect King responded, its voice peculiar.
Infant Cry Sage suddenly turned to look in Song Yan’s direction, saying, "Your grudge with Ancient Tooth, we will discuss once we’re outside! Let’s strike together first to suppress the Tiger Emperor, otherwise... no one will leave here alive! Our Seven-tailed Ancestor from the Multi-tailed Fox Race is here, and won’t deceive us!"
After saying this, it fiercely glanced at Ancient Tooth, who was staring coldly at Song Yan, and shouted, "General Ancient, think of the bigger picture!"
Ancient Tooth replied in a muffled tone, "Alright."
Immediately, all the strong ones present took action, sending torrents of energy towards the gray blazing sun in the sky.
Countless wandering ghosts and wicked souls flew out from the blazing sun towards these energies, forming a boundary balance in mid-air.
The balance began to shift quickly, but it was towards the gray sun.
Clearly, the strengths of the Insect King and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Ancestor were truly terrifying; they might already be at the level of a Divine Infant being, or at least at the half-step of a Divine Infant.
Suddenly, a violent tiger roar erupted in the sky.
A massive tiger head phantom emerged outside the nine beads.
The balance was pressed back again.
Both sides struggled for a while, using all their trump cards, for at this moment, no one could hide their tricks anymore.
The balance seesawed back and forth.
That tiger head suddenly emitted a mournful cry.
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox stared at the tiger head, seeming to verify the truth of its cry.
After a brief moment, it confirmed and shouted sharply, "Now, seize the evil treasure!!"
As the voice fell, Tang Fan and the other three treasure hunters had no choice but to act.
But strangely, the three of them no longer showed any reluctance in their eyes. Along this journey, and in the several hundred years of illusion realm just past, the three had formed deep bonds with several demons of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
They had familial affection, master-disciple relationships, and even... love.
Time can ferment emotions infinitely, making them inseparable.
Who can resist such power?
For instance, Tang Fan, he had formed a bond with Infant Cry Sage for nearly a thousand years in the illusion realm. He no longer dreaded the idea of "killing the donkey once the millstone is done," because he believed Infant Cry Sage would never kill him. In fact, Infant Cry Sage felt the same way. In the eyes of the Six-tailed Fox Demon, Tang Fan was no longer just a tool but a very important junior.
Perhaps, among all the people present, the only one who hadn’t born such emotions in the illusion realm was... Song Yan.
The longer time passed, the deeper his hatred grew.
His hand gripped the butcher’s knife, the hilt fused with his flesh and blood, how could he possibly let go?
The three treasure hunters, three figures rose swiftly from the ground, breaking towards the nine evil pearls high above.
Tang Fan was among them.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: 153. The End of the Soul Threshold, Seizing the Evil Treasure (8.6K Words - Major Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_5
At this moment, Tang Fan suddenly felt a fierce heartthrob and intense pain. Before his eyes appeared a scene: Infant Cry Master was dead!
The scene vanished in an instant, and Infant Cry Master was still standing alive and well.
However, that moment of emotional impact was huge. The impact would only make Tang Fan feel sad, but for unknown reasons, the sadness was infinitely magnified, so much that his vision went black, he fell from a high place and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Everyone felt something inside them collapsing...
It was the Dao Heart.
Someone had created a crack in their hearts and then desperately tore it open.
At this moment, everyone felt their realm deteriorating, except... Song Yan.
...
Just then, the weakened Tiger Emperor shouted from above, "Strike!"
As the words faded, a white rainbow curved out from behind the gray sun.
The white rainbow traversed the sky, swiftly spiraling, threading through the various Chang ghosts outside the gray sun like a needle and thread.
Whoosh!
A treasure hunter died!
Whoosh!
Another died!
Whoosh!
Tang Fan gazed incredulously at the hole in his chest, slowly reaching out his hand, only to let it fall.
The white rainbow did not cease, and it not only moved quickly but could also discern who was the weakest at the moment.
The white rainbow chose the Deer Demon.
Whoosh!!
The Deer Demon was severely injured.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
The white rainbow swept past rapidly, several people were injured, Song Yan included.
This white rainbow’s body strength was terrifyingly strong, seemingly ignoring the evil souls’ sniping entirely.
He saw in the white rainbow a figure, a woman’s, but her eyes harbored countless resentment.
After several exchanges, the white rainbow retreated, hovering beside the Tiger Emperor, revealing the form of a cold female cultivator.
Red-robed Insect King raised his head and said coldly, "Since when did Dongjun of the White Rainbow Ancient Race cooperate with Tiger Emperor, even tricked me into entering? It seems the deep-seated animosity you mentioned is nonsense."
Dongjun, the chilly female cultivator, said, "All demons of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race deserve death! And..."
A cold smile curved at her lips, "I’m not cooperating with Tiger Emperor."
Infant Cry Master looked helplessly at the three dead treasure hunters.
It had spent an immense amount of effort on these three treasure hunters!
Moreover, seeing Tang Fan dead, it felt an indescribable pain emerging. Each time that pain surfaced, it felt its realm deteriorate slightly, as if some mysterious power was at work here.
It suddenly recalled everything shared with Tang Fan in the Illusion Realm, those exceedingly strange feelings that were born. But the Sea of Suffering Novice Monk wouldn’t entice, nor could he entice, everything should have been natural feelings.
"Retreat!"
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch suddenly spoke.
Yet from above, a mocking voice rang out, "Where would you retreat?"
The laughter mingled with a painful tiger roar.
The tiger head gradually faded, revealing the figure of a strange monk emitting black smoke, with the powerful Dongjun of the White Rainbow Ancient Race standing beside the monk, coldly overlooking the red-robed figure and saying, "Insect King, you’re knowledgeable, do you recognize this one?"
Insect King looked up at the monk and, slightly losing his voice, exclaimed, "Demon Monk!
Within the Sea of Suffering, a portion of terrifying obsessions uphold Buddhist principles, enlightening the world.
Yet another portion entices the world.
They can easily draw out human desires, leading them astray, and then, through these human weaknesses, destroy their Dao Heart."
The smoky monk taunted, "This old monk drifted on the Sea of Suffering, and finally reached this Changwang Pearl.
But within the Changwang Pearl, the Tiger Emperor’s remaining thoughts were too heavy, holding too much Evil Treasure; this old monk couldn’t compete.
Therefore, I invite you all to help...
Many have come over these years to assist this old monk.
This old monk is very grateful to them, therefore allowing them to become submerged in the Illusion Realm, and so slowly, I’ve gained some strength to contend with the Tiger Emperor.
After that, I captured Novice Monks from the Sea of Suffering.
The Buddhist Sect is foolish, adhering to that philosophy of ’If I don’t enter hell, who will,’ so they wanted to resolve the cause of the Chang ghosts, ending up becoming Chang ghosts themselves.
They transformed from novice monks into Chang monks, obeying this old monk’s commands.
Afterward, I enticed people, they enlightened people, it was all smooth.
Your strength is the last step to break the balance between this old monk and the Tiger Emperor.
Now...where do you all think you’re going?"
The smoky Demon Monk raised his hand to cover, and countless novice monks surged out.
The red-robed Insect King and Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch exchanged a glance, suddenly bursting with extremely strong powers.
Infant Cry Master, Ancient Tooth, Deer Demon, and others also struggled to attack.
But these have already declined in realm, their efforts now are futile.
Meanwhile, the white rainbow swiftly passed, continuously weakening their powers.
Song Yan may be at the early stage of Purple Mansion, but he consumed the Ancient Corpse Shadow Puppet, so his body strength was still decent.
At this moment, the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch suddenly groaned, blood mist rising around him, the seven tails seeming to burn.
Infant Cry Master beside him was the same.
The two foxes unexpectedly started dancing.
With the dance movements, the Demon Monk’s attacks surprisingly slowed down, even seemed to no longer fall upon the two.
"Swallow!"
Suddenly, a loud roar was heard.
The pitch-black Demon Monk transformed into a giant face, opened wide and sucked, drawing the Fox Demon, Insect King, Wolf Demon, and others into its mouth rapidly, instantly... a row of Purple Mansion on the ground were sucked in.
Including Song Yan.
Including... Dongjun.
Terrifying contention began.
Everything seemed to enter a sticky state; no one could move.
The Demon Monk looked like a satiated person, with a stomach full of food, moving at all would make the stomach explode.
A group of Purple Mansion was concentrating on coping, unable to break free.
"There’s no one left here who can seize Evil Treasure, it’s time everything ends."
The Demon Monk grinned ferociously.
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch suddenly looked at Song Yan, Han Yuling, and said, "Self-destruct your divine soul, blast open a gap!"
Both being from the Human Race and the weakest, naturally it was time for sacrifice.
Han Yuling’s face changed dramatically, unwilling to face inevitable death.
Song Yan suddenly said, "Patriarch, I have a technique, can break open a gap."
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch coldly snorted, "Really?"
Song Yan said, "Cover me."
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch said, "Good! If you succeed, I will preside over your matters with Ancient Tooth!"
Song Yan had been using the magic from "Ghost Infant Scripture," but now suddenly grabbed the pitch-black Myriad Souls Banner.
He raised his hand, pointing in one direction, evil souls danced wildly, successive explosions targeted one place.
The demons saw the power of Soul Burst Technique was astounding, knowing there was hope, they concentrated their strength together, aiming at where Song Yan detonated.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Continuous explosions and concentrated power landed on the same point.
That point finally opened.
Song Yan’s figure shot out like lightning towards that spot, while the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch was about to follow, he suddenly flung the banner, a series of divine souls recklessly refilling the gap.
The rumbling explosions blocked the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox Patriarch.
And the gap in the Demon Monk quickly healed.
Song Yan did not stop, suddenly charging at the nine dark gold beads in the distance, raising his hand to swiftly seize in everyone’s incredulous eyes.
Yet he only touched the first one, and intense pain struck.
He grasped tightly, thrusting thoughts, divine soul into the dark gold bead, commencing its refinement.
The Demon Monk’s mouth closed, continuing to digest the demons inside, but his eyes abruptly turned towards Song Yan, meeting his gaze.
One digesting Evil Treasure, one digesting demons, the air quieted, time... seemed to stand still.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)
The aura of the Sea of Suffering surged from the other side of the space, with strands of gray wind billowing outward.
Yet, the gray sun-like ball composed of the entire Changwang Tiger Race, all the Chang Ghosts, the Demon Monk novices, and various accidents still quietly rotated in midair.
A fragile balance was reached among the three, clearly the most intense and brutal battle to the end, yet it strangely presented a kind of eerie tranquility.
