The Demon Monk was frantically absorbing the many Purple Mansion Cultivators who had already fallen from their realm, in hopes of gaining the upper hand in the struggle with the Tiger Emperor, thereby completely taking over these nine Evil Treasures.
However, not to mention the Insect King, and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox, even Infant Crying Master and Ancient Tooth are not ones to be easily dealt with.
Both sides were engaged in a frenzy of competition, yet their gaze was fixated on the man alone who had broken through the encirclement and was now lifting his hand to press on the Evil Treasure.
If looks could kill, Song Yan would have been slain by the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox countless times over.
Earlier, when the Demon Monk’s seal broke a bit, it was briefly almost able to escape, but was blocked by that young man.
If it could get out of the Soul Threshold, it would abandon everything to kill this young man, then extract the soul and torment it for a hundred years.
At this moment, while resisting the Demon Monk’s digestion, it coldly mocked, "Kid, stop dreaming. You’re not a Treasure Hunter, let alone the fact that this Evil Treasure still has the Tiger Emperor’s thoughts, forcibly refining it is just seeking your own death, not a way to escape to safety. Otherwise, how could it be your turn?"
Even with all the hatred in its heart for this man, the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox displayed a benevolent smile and said, "Your banner manipulation skills are indeed impressive, why don’t we cooperate once more, and I can forgive your past actions. Return to the Demon Country, and there will be hefty rewards, even your affiliated nation will receive preferential resources, how’s that?"
Just as the words fell, its pair of fox eyes suddenly narrowed tightly.
For it saw the man suddenly surge with a multitude of brilliant shadows.
The pitch-black tiger patterns awakened the fear imprinted deep within its memory.
All demons turned pale suddenly, including the Demon Monk.
Because everyone had recognized that the man refining the Evil Treasure actually possessed pure Changwang Tiger Blood!!
Expressions instantaneously surfaced on everyone’s faces and eyes.
The most common was disbelief.
"Song..."
"Yan!!!"
Infant Crying Master almost in an instant gritted his teeth and shouted these two words, then frantically crashed towards the edge of the Demon Monk’s giant face, sticking to that transparent faceplate, viciously shouting, "Song Yan! You are Song Yan! Junior! Crimson Palace junior, how dare you!! Anyone here can crush you to death with a flick of their fingers! How dare you make a fool of everyone!?"
Ancient Tooth’s expression suddenly turned ferocious, just about to speak, but was glared back by the Seven-tailed Ancestor’s eye beside him.
The Corpse-Eating Wolf Race had a brash "attitude," and once they spoke, they were bound to offend people.
The Corpse-Eating Wolf Race knew this themselves.
They were used to behaving imperiously in their own territory, who cared about offending people? The anger of others became the perfect spice for their amusement.
But Ancient Tooth, being at the level of the ancestors of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race, knew well to let the fox demon partners handle things at times like this, while he just had to follow along and not fall behind.
However, Ancient Tooth couldn’t help but mutter, "Infant Crying already cursed..."
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox ignored him and while resisting the Demon Monk, giggled as it gazed into the Demon Monk’s eyes, "Oh, working for nothing!
And moreover, being interrupted by a Crimson Palace junior.
You can crush him with a flick of your finger, but... you have to linger with us, watching helplessly as your cherished Evil Treasure is seized by someone right in front of you.
Pitiful, how pitiful."
Ancient Tooth suddenly understood that Infant Crying Master wasn’t cursing, he was setting up for the Seven-tailed Ancestor, it was a double act...
The Demon Monk remained unmoved, eyes sternly fixed on Song Yan.
Suddenly, four gray-robed Monk novices swept out from the gray sun, standing at four corners to surround Song Yan, hands clasped together, slightly bowing.
Unprecedented illusion power enveloped that man.
The man closed his eyes, seemingly caught in an illusion.
The Demon Monk let out a sigh of relief.
But in just a few breaths, it suddenly sensed something wrong, because... the first of the nine dark gold beads had already been completely enveloped by the Changwang Tiger Pattern and disappeared.
The man had already placed his hand on the second dark gold Evil Treasure Pearl.
...
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox glanced over, only to see that besides the Chang Tiger Pattern, the man’s body was densely packed with Chang Ghosts.
The Chang Ghosts layered within and without, covering countless layers, shielding him from the novices’ enlightenment.
The man pretended to close his eyes and immerse himself in illusion, but was in fact focusing all his strength on refining the Evil Treasure!
Whether it was the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox, Infant Crying Master, or Ancient Tooth, a chill rose from their hearts.
The image of the youth before them overlapped with the former Changwang Tiger Emperor who once dominated the world.
The most terrifying and envied aspect of "Changwang Tiger Blood" was not its power in the Crimson Palace Realm, but after the Purple Mansion Realm...
Step by step, exerting strength, the deeper it was dug, the more terrifying it became.
The insoluble nature of "Chang" lay in its innate precise control over the Divine Soul, which allowed many originally chaotic soul-type magical treasuries to be controlled, thereby crafting infinite possibilities.
The current "Chang Ghost Armor" was indeed one of the most frequently used techniques by the former Changwang Tiger Emperor.
Song Yan, unknowingly, had already mastered the proper use of "Changwang Tiger Blood," which even frightened the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox. Though the human man’s realm was still not high now, given time... it was beyond estimation.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
At that moment, a strange gleam suddenly flashed in the hollow, icy eyes of the Demon Monk, shrouded in black smoke.
Even it seemed to be in some haste.
So, it coldly uttered: "Make the move."
No one knew to whom it was speaking.
Because everyone at the end of this Soul Threshold had already appeared.
Who else could it be?
As the word "move" fell, a white light appeared from the Demon Monk’s mouth.
A white light that was beyond everyone’s expectations!
This white light abruptly pierced into Infant Cry Master from behind, then shot out through the chest, and at the moment the sword tip broke through, a powerful force erupted like aftershocks.
The sword hilt emitted waves akin to a tidal fury, with each drop of tide containing a unique power, causing the body of Infant Cry Master to rapidly explode.
And the one holding the sword hilt... was unexpectedly Dongjun!
It was Dongjun who had been swallowed by the Demon Monk together!
Everyone thought she had been consumed by the Demon Monk and swallowed altogether, for if they were the Demon Monk, they would have done the same.
But unexpectedly, there was a variable in this.
Infant Cry Master reacted quickly, barely protecting the body, and resisted the sword.
However, regardless of whether it was human or demon, the body was the best fortification.
The body suffered such severe injuries, leading to flaws in the Divine Soul.
The Demon Monk, in perfect coordination, simultaneously attacked Infant Cry Master, intensifying its digestion.
"Dongjun?! Are you crazy? You’ve already been swallowed by the Demon Monk, yet you’re still working for it?"
The demons turned their gaze to the cold female cultivator who made the move.
Dongjun gave a cold smile and said, "If I hadn’t been swallowed together, how could I help the Demon Monk digest you?
I’ve been waiting for this moment.
You demons, playing tricks, now find yourselves being played, huh! Hahaha!!"
With a laugh of madness, Dongjun’s expression turned frenzied as she attacked again.
A flash of white rainbow passed, and the weakest Han Yuling barely propped up a mental shield, but facing the Ancient Race with their gifted magic, her shield was not so effective, bursting with a "boom", and soon she was covered with injuries.
"Working for demons, deserves death!"
The white rainbow shouted fiercely, then swiftly darted in another direction.
In the distance, a mysterious voice of praise came.
"Good!!"
Though Dongjun was in the midst of a sneak attack, she was able to glance at who was speaking from the corner of her eye.
Then, she saw Song Yan.
Song Yan looked at her from afar and praised, "Well said, ’working for demons deserves death’! Never thought I’d meet a fellow here! Dongjun, as fellow Human Race, shall we... join forces?"
After speaking, a bright smile unexpectedly appeared on his face, which was in immense pain from the refinement of the Evil Treasure, especially those eyes, clean and pure, easily evoking trust.
Dongjun:...
She found this man truly shameless, as if they were old acquaintances at their first meeting, yet what he said seemed quite reasonable.
Because this man not only stood against demons but also against the Demon Monk, wasn’t that on the side of humans?
Dongjun said, "Better take care of yourself first."
Her response made the Demon Monk squint its eyes slightly from a high place.
In fact, whether she responded or not, when Song Yan uttered that sentence, the thorn was already planted.
The crucial point of the thorn is not whether it can harm.
Any nonsense about joining forces, spoken forgotten.
The key is, these words could indeed cause obstruction.
At this moment, the camps and stances of everyone present were swiftly shifting, fully explaining what ’four people in six groups’ meant...
While speaking, Dongjun’s actions were not slow, and the balance against the Demon Monk was swiftly being disrupted.
With a scream, the weakest human female cultivator, the patriarch from Great Qi, died tragically.
Right after that was Infant Cry Master.
Although Infant Cry Master was not dead yet, he was merely hanging on.
On the other side, the Insect King was desperately suppressing Dongjun, while strenuously supporting against the Demon Monk’s digestion.
Freed from restraint, the Demon Monk then unhesitatingly attacked Song Yan.
It remembered planting a Heart Demon in everyone’s mind.
No reason this man wouldn’t have one.
The trickiest part of dealing with Heart Demons is slaying them out of fear, as doing so leads to permanent gaps in the Mental Realm, even more than leaving the Heart Demon alive.
Before, amongst everyone below, Song Yan was the weakest, the Demon Monk didn’t bother with him, but now it was targeting all the remaining strength it could muster at Song Yan.
Buddhas take a lifetime to enlighten people perhaps.
But demons tempt in just an instant.
Becoming a Buddha or turning into a demon with a single thought isn’t just talk.
If a devoted monk saw the love of his life naked atop him, whispering in his ear, "I’ll never tell anyone," would his heart not ripple?
Life is short, how to live, after a century, it’s all but dirt. Given the chance to enjoy immediately, why refuse?
But was the monk wrong?
No.
Because only desire is the most human thing.
’Let me see your Heart Demon.’
All illusions are Demon Monk’s enticements, it could naturally see what transpired within the Illusion Realm.
After watching, a treacherous smile suddenly appeared on the Demon Monk’s evil face, then he said in a pained voice, "The cattle and sheep on the frontier, a mere dreamscape, now that you’re here, the one to accompany you beyond the frontier is gone, isn’t she?"
The voice lingered, filled with endless melancholy, every word containing terrifying tempting power.
Then it abruptly changed expression, harshly questioning: "How did she die?! Was it your failure to protect, or...did you kill her?!"
As the words fell, it saw the man across showing an expression of pain, trembling all over from agony.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: 154. A Land of Certain Death, Open a Path! (8.1K Words - Major Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
The Demon Monk shouted angrily like a bolt from the blue, "Speak!!"
The man grew increasingly pained.
Seeing it worked, the Demon Monk continued, "Hurry and speak!!"
Sssss...
Sssssss...
The second Dark Gold Evil Treasure Pearl was completely engulfed by the Changwang Tiger Pattern and disappeared.
Refinement progress, plus one!
...
The Demon Monk noticed a fleeting yet obscure mockery and mischief in the eyes of the man who was previously in deep agony, and then he placed his hand on the third Dark Gold Evil Treasure Pearl.
The Demon Monk fell silent.
And at that moment, the man who had shown mockery and mischief suddenly took a deep breath and said in a trembling voice, "She... she was killed by me. She was killed by my own hands! I... I had to do it! I was not wrong! I was not wrong!"
His voice trembled extremely, as if he was forcibly holding himself together.
If it were just a few breaths ago, the Demon Monk would certainly have used this as a flaw to shatter the opponent’s Taoist heart at once.
It estimated that the person before it was someone extremely cold-hearted and ruthless, but since a Heart Demon indeed arose in the Illusion Realm, it could infinitely amplify his emotions, and even a tiny flaw in the heart could turn into a collapse.
But now, it had realized that this man was actually acting for it.
This man had no Heart Demon!
This man merely intended to "cooperate with its performance" to stall for time, allowing him sufficient time to refine the third pearl.
The Demon Monk abandoned its original plan, instead gazing sharply at those around it, its gaze suddenly sweeping towards Winter Lord.
Before it could speak, Song Yan had already spoken up.
Song Yan’s voice was incredibly sincere.
"Winter Lord, hold off the Demon Monk for me, help me buy time, if I get out, the Human Race shall undoubtedly flourish!"
Demon Monk: ...
It quickly followed with, "Winter Lord, speed up! You and I have already sworn a Soul Oath, there’s no way I could betray it. I will help you kill all demons!"
Song Yan said, "Evil demon, full of lies!"
The Demon Monk couldn’t help but think, "You’re not much different," but continued, "This kid’s Realm is too low; even if he takes the Evil Treasure, it will only lead to his doom! He can’t gain any benefit!"
One man and one demon, retorting against each other.
Winter Lord was clearly an "emotional type" of person, evident in her desperate vengeance against demons, and at this moment... she was being torn repeatedly by the words of Song Yan and the Demon Monk.
So, her actions were neither fast nor slow, just maintaining the status quo.
Song Yan quickly withdrew his gaze, knowing he didn’t have much time left.
His thoughts rapidly spread, exploring the Dark Gold Pearl, and soon he felt a remnant thought, the remnant thought of the Tiger Emperor!
Song Yan hurriedly communicated his thought over: "Clan Leader, I am also a member of the Changwang Tiger Race, with Changwang Tiger Blood flowing in my veins. I will definitely annihilate the Fox and Wolf Races, and kill the Demon Monk to avenge our kin. Clan Leader, assist me!"
The Tiger Emperor’s thought quickly returned, saying, "Open your mind, no need for refinement, I shall carry the Evil Treasure directly into your Divine Soul."
Song Yan accelerated the refining pace, with numerous Changwang spirits aiding him almost self-destructively to cleave through the heavy spirits on the Evil Treasure, then drilled inside, responding respectfully, "Then... Clan Leader, please prepare, the junior shall also adjust. You count to one hundred, and the junior shall open his mind and let you in."
The Tiger Emperor, being merely a remnant thought, although holding the advantage on its home ground, was but an inspector type of figure. It could prevent others from taking the Evil Treasure but could not take it itself, only partly controlling it, stopping others from invading.
After continuous invasions, especially the serious depletion from the Insect King and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox wave, it had become extremely weak, weakened to the point of being vulnerable to having the Evil Treasure seized.
The Demon Monk originally intended to digest those Purple Mansion powerhouses, then swallow all nine Evil Treasures at once.
The Tiger Emperor’s mind was indeed not as clear as it had been in life, seeing Song Yan being so earnest, it actually started counting.
"One..."
"Two..."
"Three..."
When it reached "thirteen," it suddenly felt something was amiss.
And the third Dark Gold Evil Treasure Pearl was already completely enveloped by Song Yan’s Changwang Tiger Pattern.
Refinement progress, plus one!
...
The Tiger Emperor finally realized, knowing that its plan had been seen through, and angrily roared, "You daring junior, how dare you fool me!"
Song Yan ignored it, placing his hand on the fourth pearl.
To Song Yan, the Tiger Emperor clearly intended to use the remnant soul to possess him or control part of his body, so how could he agree?
The Tiger Emperor began mobilizing the remnant soul to oppose with all its might.
While the Tiger Emperor was roaring in anger, not far away the Demon Monk let out a scream, it was the scream of the Infant Wailer.
The six-tailed fox had finally been completely digested.
And seeing only six of the nine Evil Treasures left, the Demon Monk grew even more furious, accelerating digestion and targeting the weaker "Deer Demon" and "Ancient Tooth."
Its limit of endurance was "four pieces."
It had already felt the Tiger Emperor’s rage.
The Tiger Emperor’s remnant thought initially harbored a hint of indulgence and schadenfreude towards that bearer of "Changwang Tiger Blood," but now... the Tiger Emperor began opposing that person.
Though the Tiger Emperor was weak, it was extremely tenacious.
It actually gained some extra time.
Amid numerous power struggles, everyone was an enemy, everyone had a stance.
Interwoven massacres, differing slaughters, erupted in every direction.
And the surging aura of the Sea of Suffering increased endlessly, transforming into a gray curtain that swept out from behind the "Changwang Embroidery Ball."
Evidently, the massive change of the Changwang Embroidery Ball was intensifying the penetration towards the Sea of Suffering.
The distance between this Secret Realm and the Sea of Suffering became increasingly narrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 154. A Land of Certain Death, Carve a Path! (8.1K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: 154. A Land of Certain Death, Carve a Path! (8.1K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
Song Yan seemed calm, but was actually crazed.
On one hand, he was frantically wrestling with the Tiger Emperor, while on the other, he was calmly observing the distance.
One was the Demon Monk, the other was the entrance and exit of the Secret Realm.
He could feel that if he got one more pearl, he could freely open the entrance and exit of the Secret Realm and leave.
That pearl was the fourth one, and it was the last one he intended to refine.
He’s not greedy!
Refine it and then leave!
Only after refining can he leave!
The flow of time seemed to have slowed down to the extreme.
Everyone was struggling desperately, racing against time, yet it was inexplicably so quiet.
He didn’t know how long it had been, maybe just a few breaths, maybe several incense sticks’ time had passed, Song Yan was drenched in sweat, his whole body tense, seemingly in control, but in reality, he was extremely nervous, feeling as if he was being roasted on the fires of hell.
A considerable number of the two hundred thousand evil souls from the Myriad Souls Banner around him were already lost.
His own expenditure was reaching the extreme.
This was supposed to be a battle beyond his power.
Suddenly...
It seemed that some critical point had been reached.
An abrupt change occurred again!
Three heartrending screams came from the Demon Monk’s giant mouth.
The first was from the Deer Demon, it was the weakest among those left.
The second was from the Ancient Tooth, it hadn’t even had the chance to settle scores with Song Yan and had already fallen.
The third was surprisingly from Dongjun.
Dongjun screamed mournfully: "We have a soul oath!"
The Demon Monk laughed softly and said: "I have no soul."
With no soul, the soul Dongjun saw was naturally fake...
The Demon Monk wasn’t even considered a living being, but a creature nurtured by the Sea of Suffering over countless ages, most adept at seduction.
Dongjun, bearing deep hatred and a thirst for revenge, how could he not be tempted?
At this moment, the Demon Monk swallowed the Deer Demon, Ancient Tooth, and Dongjun in succession, rapidly elevating its power. It couldn’t wait any longer and suddenly loosened its grip, releasing the hardest foes, the Insect King and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox.
In choosing between options, it decided to quickly digest the Evil Treasure Pearl and then deal with the Insect King and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox.
The pitch-black demonic hand traversed the sky without immediately grabbing the Evil Treasure Pearl, but instead performed a technique in the void, overlaying the Sea of Suffering’s aura to reinforce this Secret Realm by one more layer.
If it was the Insect King and the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox in their prime, there might have been a chance to break open the Secret Realm and escape, but now...with their weakening and strengthening balance, they were unable to do so.
However, neither the Insect King nor the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox took action, instead deploying secret techniques to resist the Sea of Suffering’s aura while quietly observing the distance at the sealed entrance of the Secret Realm.
In the next instant, the Demon Monk’s hand suddenly landed on the Evil Treasure Pearl.
Swoosh!
In almost a breath’s time, the first Evil Treasure Pearl was already refined.
The gap between him and Song Yan was originally sky-high, incomparable.
And at that moment, the Tiger Emperor perhaps got distracted by his grapple with Song Yan.
Swoosh!
The fourth Dark Gold Evil Treasure Pearl was refined by Song Yan!
...
Swoosh!
The second Evil Treasure Pearl was refined by the Demon Monk!
The monk enshrouded in black smoke showed a ferocious grin to Song Yan, those mocking eyes seemed to say ’Even if your calculations are intricate, even if your luck isn’t bad, with absolute power, it’s all empty.’
Song Yan had already refined four Evil Treasure Pearls, and now he had the ability to break through the Secret Realm and leave.
However, when he raised his head, he met the smiling fox eyes of the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox.
Then, the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox and the Insect King suddenly split apart, but not too far, and stared intently at Song Yan.
At this moment, no one needed to speak anymore, not even thoughts needed to be used.
Everyone there was a deeply calculating old demon.
So, just from one glance, Song Yan understood.
The Seven-tailed Demonic Fox seemed to be smilingly saying: "Open the door quickly, what are you waiting for, do you have any other choice?"
But after opening the door?
Facing the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox and the Insect King, could Song Yan escape? This chance was less than when he was forced to challenge Zhang Han in the Crimson Palace Realm years ago!
He couldn’t defeat the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox, let alone the more powerful Insect King.
Swoosh!
The third Dark Gold Evil Treasure Pearl was refined by the Demon Monk.
The Demon Monk’s cold eyes slightly raised, scanning those three with hidden agendas, and suddenly smiled.
In the next instant, it abruptly locked its gaze on Song Yan, its eyes shooting terrifying and mysterious thought energy, the powerful seductive force belonging to the Demon of the Sea of Suffering.
Those with slightly lower realms, just by meeting its eyes, their desires would inflate infinitely, shattering their Dao hearts directly.
At this moment, it no longer needed to deal with the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox, Insect King, Infant Sobbing Master, Ancient Tooth, Deer Demon, Han Yuling, and others, nor did it need to guard against Dongjun betraying, this power was countless times stronger than the previous engagements.
In an instant, the ghostly minions around Song Yan cleared a direct line.
The end of the line touched Song Yan.
Infinite desires tore open within him.
He saw the world beginning to turn into a narrow cave, winding paths like sheep intestines with light at the other end, outside the light is clouds beyond the frontier, is boundless grassland, deer crying in yonder, is herds of cattle and sheep. A girl riding a white horse with a sweet smile, waving a whip, as if unintentionally discovering him, thus waving from afar, opening her little mouth, seemingly shouting something?
What is she shouting?
Too far away to hear clearly.
But her face, Song Yan remembered very clearly.
It was Pei Xuehan.
He instinctively wanted to get a little closer, to hear what his beloved was saying.
He was already exhausted, seeming normal, but body and mind were already at the brink of collapse.
After all, he was just an ordinary person.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 154. A land of certain death opens a path! (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscriptions)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: 154. A land of certain death opens a path! (8.1K words - large Chapter seeking subscriptions)_5
He also wanted a wife, to quietly spend his life, even without great wealth and status, as long as there was peace and happiness, he would be satisfied.
What’s wrong with that?
"Heh..."
"Hahahaha..."
Suddenly, laughter rang out, tearing everything apart.
The lands beyond the border shattered...
The cattle and sheep shattered...
The girl also shattered...
Everything became fragments flying in the sky, the light and shadow on the fragments quickly dimmed, turning into ashes.
Just a mere illusion realm!
All that was left was a secret realm exuding an endless sea of suffering-like aura, on the verge of collapse.
The Demon Monk was surprised to see the man across from him glaring with red eyes at him.
"Is it the power of those four Evil Treasure Pearls?" the Demon Monk said coldly, "If it stays on you for a few more breaths, it’ll soon be mine."
In the distance, the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox was anxious and shouted, "Song Yan, what are you waiting for? Hurry over here!"
Its confidence was also falling short, and it had become anxious, its mind in chaos!
Song Yan ignored both the demonic fox and the demon monk, not speaking a word. At the moment his gaze flickered, without knowing where he glanced, he swiftly grabbed an array plate from the void.
Small Heavenly Dao Gathering Introduction Array!
He smirked, emitting a "ji ji ji ji" laughter, simultaneously placing the array flags in a small space, then started the array plate embedded with "Cause and Effect White Cave Crystal Jade".
This was his "needle".
This needle was very fine, useless outside the secret realm.
But this place was the end of the Soul Threshold, very close to the Sea of Suffering, and because the Evil Treasures blocking the sea’s entrance were violently turbulent, this secret realm was on the verge of being washed away.
If it received another needle now,
what would the result be?
The Demon Monk, Insect King, and Seven-tailed Demonic Fox all had their eyes fall on the array plate, and before they could react, they saw the secret realm’s space breaking as if shattered, with ancient and majestic aura surging in.
The world beyond gradually became clear, with black above and white below, like an infinite sword splitting dusk and dawn in the center.
That long sword completely severed this secret realm.
Song Yan raised his head, smiled at the three in the distance, waved goodbye.
He must cause a mental shock with this gesture, making the three believe he could go on living well in this world, making them think he had a way out.
As long as this seed was planted, the will of the three would be obstructed, and they would die faster.
The Demon Monk, Novice Monk came from the Sea of Suffering, but they never wanted to return there; otherwise, if they could climb out, wouldn’t the human realm have already fallen?
As for him, he had tested using Talent when refining the fourth bead.
Those carrying Evil Treasures could survive on the Sea of Suffering’s coast, as long as they weren’t blown into the sea, there was hope.
And he could barely control the direction.
In the next instant, Song Yan summoned the four newly refined Dark Gold Beads, and in a moment, countless vengeful souls and even the spirits of the Changwang Tiger Race clansmen who lost their minds appeared, forming a fast-rotating circle around him.
Making him fly to the coast of the Sea of Suffering like an embroidered ball.
Countless obsessions pounced madly, but the four Dark Gold Beads spun rapidly, seemingly sharing the damage from the sea breeze of the Sea of Suffering.
But during this rotation, the four Dark Gold Beads started showing further strange changes like metal falling into a melting furnace.
Song Yan’s Myriad Souls Banner also fell into it, becoming a part of it.
The embroidered ball rolled and flew, like tumbleweed undulating on a boundless gray wilderness.
Song Yan’s body began to crumble.
Even the coast of the Sea of Suffering was absolutely not something an early stage Purple Mansion Realm body could withstand.
His Essence Blood imprinted into his Divine Soul.
He desperately controlled himself not to go towards the Sea of Suffering.
However, the coast of the Sea of Suffering was also a small Sea of Suffering, even with Evil Treasure’s protection, obsessions would sneak in and penetrate Song Yan’s mind, making him experience others’ obsessions.
During this, he vaguely heard the Seven-tailed Demonic Fox ancestor’s desperate scream, but... that was no longer important.
Now he had already begun to fully stabilize his mind, striving with all his might to survive on this Sea of Suffering coast.
As time passed, his Divine Soul also began to strengthen at a terrifying speed...
...
...
Outside Chopper Ridge...
The flags were still there, and ten thousand armors shone brightly in the warm spring sun.
Suddenly, a violent energy surged in from afar, sweeping away the entire Chopper Ridge like a toy bloc.
The towering green mountain crumbled vulnerably to flat ground, mushroom clouds of dust exploded one after another in the sky.
The soldiers of the Xiongwei Kingdom were all startled and ashen-faced, their mouths dry.
And at this moment, a dilapidated, utterly disheveled figure wrapped in black smoke flew out from the smoke.
That figure, accompanied by the croak of insects, swiftly landed in a camp at the rear of the Xiongwei Kingdom’s army, then stumbled and rolled into the main tent.
The Xiongwei Kingdom army all knelt down, looking as if they were welcoming a deity.
Yet they were clearly part of the army influenced by the Fox and Wolf Races, so why did they worship a foreign race?
There was only one answer, the Xiongwei Kingdom had already become a vassal state of this foreign race.
For a long time...
And a moment longer...
A strange voice of a female cultivator came from outside the main tent door.
"Zhu’Er requests to see the Insect King..."
But there was no response from inside the tent.
And a faint light veil appeared around the tent, obviously showing that the person inside was gravely injured to the point where they couldn’t speak, now disregarding the place, healing on the spot.
The female cultivator, calling herself Zhu’Er, wore a silver mask, her eyes flashed with hidden contemplation, she saluted again, withdrew, then turned her head to gaze toward the distant Chopper Ridge direction, her mood uncertain as she pondered something unknown.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 155. Soul like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: 155. Soul like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, please subscribe)
Purple Mansion Realm, borrowing the Heart of a Nation’s Profound Vein to merge oneself with the heavens and earth, thereby nourishing the Divine Soul, allowing it to initially merge with the heavens and earth, and thus making one’s thoughts stronger.
From this, we can see the importance of the body.
The saying "with the death of the body, the path vanishes" is by no means empty words.
But at this very moment, Song Yan’s body is destroyed.
He was also supposed to dissipate, yet the outcome... is just the opposite.
His Divine Soul is protected by four Evil Treasures, and in the exceedingly unique environment of the Sea of Suffering Coast, it has begun to produce a wondrous reaction.
These four Evil Treasure Pearls are not a complete Evil Treasure; they are only a part of one. Yet it is precisely because of this fragmentation that it has brought about this change "possibly unprecedented".
Within the four Evil Treasure Pearls lie four-ninths of the Divine Soul Ghosts from the Changwang Tiger Race, and also four-ninths of the Divine Soul Power extracted from the Changwang Soul Threshold...
These powers were originally in constant rotation, thus giving the impression of a "ball", or a "gray sun".
But now, in the sea breeze of the Sea of Suffering Coast, they are like iron fragments meeting fire, those originally separate Divine Soul Ghosts begin to blur together...
And Song Yan is desperately resisting to avoid losing consciousness, his entire being like in a vortex of a storm, each time hit by the strong sea wind of the Sea of Suffering, he would exert all his might to retract the four Evil Treasure Pearls that protect him, and then slightly release them once he successfully resists, allowing the four Evil Treasures to expand.
Thus...
A cycle of contraction and expansion, just like breathing, or like a blacksmith swinging a hammer, constantly "slamming down, lifting up, slamming down again, lifting up again"...
Using the four Evil Treasure Pearls, Myriad Souls Banner, Faceless Mask, Song Yan’s own Divine Soul, and even the permeated great obsessions in the sea wind of the Sea of Suffering as materials...
Using the wind of the Sea of Suffering as the fierce fire...
Forging!
Forging again!
Without a body, unless one reaches the Divine Infant Realm, otherwise the realm would directly fall.
But now Song Yan is incredibly strange.
He has no body, yet his Divine Soul Power is rising at an alarming speed.
A terrifying whole is gradually forming over a long period.
...
No one knows what year or month it is.
Suddenly...
Song Yan saw a white shadow within the Chong Soul.
That white shadow seemed to have been carefully hidden deep within the Divine Soul World by him, hence until now it was pulled out.
The white shadow swirled with him in the storm of the Sea of Suffering.
At this moment, every thought of Song Yan was continuously shattering, so when he saw the white shadow, he was momentarily stunned.
Somewhat familiar...
But also unclear...
An illusion realm, after all, is an illusion realm. Even if hundreds of years pass, it is still an illusion realm, thoughts propped up by falsehoods can be very strong under the magnification of the Demon Monk.
But when the influence of the Demon Monk disappears, those thoughts fade considerably, to the point where it’s hard to clearly manifest in the storm, but instead, the hatred towards the Demon Monk and the Buddhist Sect is deeply imprinted in Song Yan’s mind.
Yet amidst the storm, Song Yan still brushed past that white shadow ghost, the two being inches apart while spinning swiftly, then instantly separating.
Seeing the white shadow ghost about to merge into the outer four Evil Treasure Pearls, becoming part of the Evil Treasure Pearls, thus unable to reincarnate, Song Yan’s expression slightly shifted.
He remembered.
It is Pei Xuehan!
The white shadow ghost’s thoughts had long been shattered beyond repair, now looking around blankly as if completely amnesiac, seemingly dazed and foolish. And upon meeting Song Yan’s gaze, she suddenly became terrified, for any ghost with even a shred of consciousness would only be fearful and absolutely obedient upon seeing Song Yan at this moment.
Song Yan sharply exerted his power, moving bit by bit forward in the storm, and when he got in front of the white shadow ghost, he grabbed her hand.
The emotions no longer burned intensely, but the sentiment and reflections remained.
He paused briefly, softly sending a thought: "Go to the reincarnation.
Also, I command you... strive to be reborn in a good family, and live happily in your next life.
If you can, remember to often look at the white clouds beyond the borders, and look at them on my behalf."
The white shadow ghost seemed to move her lips.
Song Yan could discern that she was saying, "Yes, master."
He took a deep breath, looked at the ghost with a gentle smile, then controlled the outer four Evil Treasure Pearls to separate, and forcefully lifted the white shadow ghost, saying, "Go!"
The white shadow ghost flew out through the gap of the separated Evil Pearls.
She had no strong obsession; the Sea of Suffering merely instantly stripped away the cause and effect of her current life, allowing her Divine Soul to smoothly leave for reincarnation.
And at the very moment when the Evil Pearls parted, a wisp of the sea wind from the outside crashed into Song Yan.
Song Yan opened his arms, letting the sea wind smash into his fragile Divine Soul, his expression calm, then suddenly burst into wild laughter, shouting, "Come! Come on! More!"
Then, he drew his power to retract the Evil Pearls, simultaneously beginning to bear the great obsession brought by this wisp of sea wind.
To sink is to reincarnate.
To let go is to be reborn.
Yet Song Yan neither sinks nor lets go, enduring the great obsessions of others, dragging out his fatigued Divine Soul again, dim-witted and repetitive, as if in... Eternal Hell.
...
...
In a pitch-black palace, insects crawl, strange bugs hum.
A masked figure sits in the deepest part of the palace, surrounded by black smoke that has completely subsided, using a voice trembling seemingly with utmost anger, muttering to itself: "Four more to go... but those four have already fallen back into the Sea of Suffering. Without those four, I will never be complete, and will forever be unable to step into the next realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 155. Soul like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: 155. Soul like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, please subscribe)_2
It tried hard to calm its state, then seemed to feel its body, nodding slightly.
It was somewhat satisfied.
At least, the body of the Insect King was strong. Although severely injured, given time it could recover to the level of half-step Divine Infant...
"Let’s hope that boy can escape back from the Sea of Suffering."
"By then, I will find him and reclaim what belongs to me!"
This figure was naturally the Demon Monk who possessed the Insect King at the last moment.
The Insect King was extremely weak, and the Demon Monk, having fused five Evil Pearls, with one decline and one rise, together with many things happening in that instant... The outcome was, the Demon Monk possessed the Insect King and narrowly escaped the pull of the Sea of Suffering, returning to the human world.
And at this very moment, no one in this world hoped more for Song Yan to return to the human world than it did.
Because only by consuming the four pearls on Song Yan could it reach perfection.
And for Song Yan, it was the same...
This time might be very long, but the Demon Monk, or rather the current Insect King, had no other choice.
In his eyes, Song Yan was extremely cunning, with layered methods. The fact that he was able to gain the most benefit in the Early Stage of Purple Mansion Realm in the Changwang Soul Threshold, a place he could not touch, was proof enough.
If Song Yan could return to the human world, it definitely wouldn’t give Song Yan any time to grow.
Fortunately, the Changwang Evil Pearl divided into nine, and as long as they were both in the human world, they would sense each other’s direction.
And once it sensed Song Yan’s return, it would immediately go to kill him!
But can Song Yan really return?
...
...
Floating and sinking, sinking and floating...
Song Yan rolled like tumbleweed across the vast wilderness of the Sea of Suffering.
Splash...
Splash...
Splash...
Just as he rolled to a spot, Song Yan suddenly felt the sea tide during high tide slap against a touch of gray.
That gray did not dissipate like other seawater, instead standing up, transforming into a human shape.
Gray Hundred-Patch Robe, face blurred, hands clasped, and upon seeing him, suddenly attracted, madly rushing towards him.
After a long time...
A piece more joined the four fused Evil Pearls on Song Yan... Sea of Suffering Chang Mi.
It liberated one Chang Ghost, but could not untangle the powerful cause and effect of the "Chang," so it adhered to the principle of "If I don’t go to hell, who will?" and became Chang Mi.
...
After another long time...
An extremely conspicuous white pebble in the gray tones of the Sea of Suffering Coast also stuck to the four Evil Pearls...
...
After yet another long time...
The second Chang Mi attached to the Evil Pearls was captured by Song Yan...
...
...
Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, it has been a hundred years since Song Yan fell into the Sea of Suffering Coast.
At this moment...
In the south region, the old site of the Three Kingdoms, Wu...
"Hey, didn’t expect that after much searching, there’s actually hidden treasures under the Misty Sea."
A voice from the shadows was filled with excitement.
He surprisingly found a place sunk into mud and sand at the bottom of the lake, surrounded by hidden Talismans—a Crystal Chamber.
He quickly slipped inside; the door isolated lake water.
The sight inside shocked the young man.
There were rows of neatly arranged bookshelves.
"I’m gonna be rich, I’m gonna be rich..."
"Could this be the remnants of a Sect’s heritage? Thus, in the Hidden Dragon Association, I must achieve a good place, maybe even get noticed by members of the Ancient Race and follow them."
The young man thought excitedly.
For a moment, he forgot his initial purpose, rushing to the bookshelf, casually pulling out a book, opening it, seeing pages written in mad characters: "Divine Soul first merges with heaven and earth. Done, done, old man is done!!!"
The youngster was delighted, quickly flipping through, wanting to see what this senior had accomplished.
But he didn’t see.
He frowned, tossed the book aside, continued searching.
After a long time, he hadn’t found the Cultivation Technique, so hatred showed on his face, he snorted coldly, finger pinched a sign, summoned a Flying Sword Profound Artifact, then began venting, slashing around.
While slashing, he said: "No opportunities here, gone is gone. Really wasted my excitement, deserved to be destroyed!"
Crack! Crack!
Bang!
Sawdust flew, bookshelves collapsed, the preserved book pavilion inside the Crystal Chamber rapidly destroyed.
Yet at this moment, a strange "boom" suddenly entered the youth’s ear.
In a space beneath a bookshelf that had been hacked away, a very hidden dark layer appeared.
The youth hurried forward, reached out, and unexpectedly pulled out a Secret Box.
On the cover of the Secret Box it read: "The Celestial Sword Visualization Map within is a stone wall replica from the Purple Mansion Forbidden Land. If obtained, next generations should treat it with caution, don’t show it to others..."
"Celestial Sword Visualization Map?"
The youth was exultant, quickly opening the Secret Box, revealing a specially crafted metal engraved map.
Upon it floated an unimaginably vast ancient aura, while the composition was very simple: black on top, white below, with a thin, long sword in the center that cleaved the heavens and earth, split the twilight, boundless.
"This is the Celestial Sword? Good stuff!"
The youth took a deep breath, instinctively looked around, seeing nobody, his eyes fervent as he said: "Quickly take this opportunity, visualize this map, might gain greatly! This is my chance!"
Speaking, he stared intently at the Celestial Sword Visualization Map, beginning visualization.
He wanted to try.
After all, just a map, trying shouldn’t be an issue, can’t possibly go wrong, right?
As he watched and watched, after a long while, the youth’s eyes suddenly became dazed, he didn’t even struggle, eyes rolling white.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 155. The Soul is Like a Melting Furnace, Seizing the Body in the Sea of Suffering (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: 155. The Soul is Like a Melting Furnace, Seizing the Body in the Sea of Suffering (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_3
His divine soul, upon seeing that Celestial Sword, was inundated with countless memories that did not belong to him. Those memories were etched into his bones, and almost instantly, he lost himself.
And at the end of his last glimpse was a terrifying gray sun over the boundless wilderness...
That sun slowly approached him.
’What is that monster?’
The final thought burned into his mind, but he could no longer see what followed.
He was already completely mad.
...
"Huff..."
"Huff..."
Sounds of panting echoed in the crystal house at the bottom of the dark lake.
The young man sat on the ground, leaning against a dark, collapsed bookshelf, suddenly furrowing his brow and murmuring.
"Who am I?"
"Who... exactly am I?"
After a long time...
He opened his eyes, and his confused gaze regained clarity: "I am Song Yan."
He tilted his head back, the corners of his mouth curling into a sinister yet joyful grin, revealing his stark white teeth.
"How many years has it been, I... have finally come out."
"Finally..."
"Out!"
His gaze swept over, and he casually picked up a scattered book, glancing through it to grasp the gist.
"’Celestial Sword Visualization Map’, again with the ’Celestial Sword Visualization Map’, this visualization map really saved my life once more, I truly have a fateful connection with the Nanwu Sword Sect.
I wonder where my old acquaintances are today, whether alive or dead, whether they have progressed further, or become bones beneath the yellow earth?"
He glanced at the panel.
The lifespan on the panel changed from "[Lifespan: 41/8639]" to "[Lifespan: 141/8639]", indicating a full hundred years had passed.
And the realm was the "Seventh Layer of Refining Profound," clearly the realm of this body’s original owner.
However, Song Yan’s terrifying Divine Soul Power had long surpassed the concept of the "Seventh Layer of Refining Profound," not even the Purple Mansion Realm could compare to his soul’s strength, making him stand out even within the Divine Infant Realm.
Yet at the moment he manifested, he also sensed an "incompleteness," a lack in life, in the soul’s completeness.
This incompleteness made him feel extremely uncomfortable.
At the same time, a fleeting and mysterious feeling arose in his heart.
He subconsciously looked towards the north.
He felt his opportunity lay in the Northern Land.
In the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
As long as he assimilated that opportunity from the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, he could become whole.
Meanwhile, he suddenly felt that someone in the north... also abruptly opened their eyes, gazing at him across the distance.
"Demon Monk."
Song Yan’s eyes became sharp in an instant.
Though only faint impressions of why he hated the Demon Monk remained, the hatred was etched into his bones.
He took a deep breath, looking at himself now.
’Although my divine soul preserved all my past cultivation techniques, magic, and even my bloodline talent, transforming them into talents bound to my soul during the Sea of Suffering Coast journey.
But my current body is merely at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, too weak...
And since the Demon Monk can be in the north, it implies he likely escaped back then, after all, the Demon Monk does not possess Changwang Tiger Blood to manipulate the Changwang Evil Pearl with precise control like I can.
Over so many years, the Demon Monk’s power must be incomparably strong.
Going directly north to confront the Demon Monk would be suicidal.’
Song Yan pondered, feeling a sense of fortune after surviving the ordeal, mixed with a bit of reflection.
He exchanged his realm for a terrifying divine soul, unsure if it was worth it or not...
But the die was cast, overthinking was useless.
Song Yan began quickly searching through the original owner’s memories.
Indeed, the original owner’s memories were fragmented by the obsessions from the Sea of Suffering, and others found it impossible to restore them. Yet Song Yan easily pieced together the fragments of this person’s cause and effect, and after careful examination, combined with his own thoughts and understanding, outlined a general picture.
...
Decades ago, the Puppet Sect likely felt the oppression from the Mountain and Sea Demon Race and thus collaborated with Yu Xuanwei and others from a reclusive Nanwu Sword Sect village. After much arduous effort, and combined with the sufficient Soul Gold Stone gifted by Song Yan at the time, they finally repaired the Ancient Teleportation Array.
The other side of the ancient teleportation array was teeming with demons, yet it was also the extreme north of this continent, where many ancient races resided.
The ancient races’ governance model over the mortal world was similar to that of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, likely all reclusive, with each race managing several or even more than ten nations.
Overall, they were referred to as the Ancient Country.
The opening of the ancient teleportation array drew quick attention from the Ancient Country, as it was a rare passage leading to the southern part of the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, a strategic location.
Therefore, the Ancient Country immediately dispatched people to the Jin Kingdom, using miraculous means to alter the Profound Veins in its southern region, making the once nearly barren Southern Land suitable for cultivation.
Simultaneously, the Ancient Country also forcefully ordered some sects in the north to relocate here.
However... this area, bordering the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, could already be considered the front line. Furthermore, for reasons unknown, the Mountain and Sea Demon Race paid special attention to the Jin Kingdom, invading almost every year. Thus, the former Jin Kingdom had long perished, with its human nations fragmented into various small regimes, each leader self-styled as a marquis, collectively known as the Nine Hou.
Plus the five sects in the region.
This made up the Five Sects and Nine Marquis.
It’s just that the five sects are now all in the Southern Land, while the Northern Land... has long become a chaotic scene unattended by anyone.
The young man whom Song Yan possessed was a disciple of the Mo Sword Sect, one of the five sects.
Coincidentally, he shared the same surname, named Song Han.
However, Song Han was not a great character.
Originally a refugee, he was adopted by a family in the Southern Land at the age of five. But his adoptive parents died early from an epidemic, and he was then cared for by his elder brother, later by his brother and sister-in-law.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 155. Soul Like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: 155. Soul Like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_4
By a stroke of luck, he was found to have a lower grade Earth Profound Root and was sent into the Mo Sword Sect.
Such a person should be eternally grateful to his brother and sister-in-law, but... he considered himself an Immortal now, while they were mere mortals. The sacrifices they made for him, if converted to silver, were actually just a small amount, something any mortal could do, nothing significant.
So he directly gave them a thousand taels of gold, making them wealthy in their region, which was tenfold repayment of their kindness.
Therefore, he thought if he still had to care for them in every aspect, wouldn’t he be at a loss?
Besides, he had inexplicably developed inappropriate desires for his sister-in-law.
This wasn’t the end. Later, he orchestrated an accident that caused his brother to die tragically, and then let his sister-in-law unwittingly believe it was the work of bandits. When his sister-in-law pleaded with him to avenge his brother, he naturally agreed.
Because this was his plan all along.
His method was to take his sister-in-law to the wilderness, then have the colluding bandits kidnap her and drug her. After killing the bandits, he could justifiably "take" his sister-in-law, then bring her into the Sect, enslave her as a maid, and use her as a Furnace.
During this process, he passed by the Misty Sea, casually diving to the lake bottom, where he unexpectedly discovered the Crystal Secret Chamber of the Nanwu Sword Sect from bygone times, and by sheer chance found the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map" manuscript hidden beneath the bookshelf.
He couldn’t wait to browse through the "Celestial Sword Visualization Map," because next month was the "Hidden Dragon Association."
The so-called "Hidden Dragon Association" is where the Ancient Race selects potential cultivators from the Southern Land to teleport to the Northern Land. It is said that if one is extremely lucky and possesses great potential, one might be noticed by a member of the Ancient Race and directly becomes a follower beside them, thus... it’s truly a leap to the heavens.
Having digested all this information.
In a hundred years, the events on this land can truly be described as "earth-shaking."
"If that’s the case, I will first head to the Northern Land Ancient Country through the Hidden Dragon Association.
Among the numerous Ancient Race there, even if the Demon Monk desperately wants to catch me, it must weigh its options.
Because whatever its current identity, it surely cannot be a small figure of the Mountain and Sea Demon Race.
As long as it dares to invade the Ancient Country, it will be hunted down."
Song Yan suddenly thought of the Winter Lord of the Baihong Ancient Race he had seen before.
Just this one person showed him how the Ancient Race and the Mountain and Sea Demon Race are perpetually locked in mortal combat.
And the Ancient Race would become his best shield against the Demon Monk.
"No matter what, it’s best to be as far away from the Demon Monk as possible at first.
Once the time is right, I’ll devour the Demon Monk to complete my cultivation."
...
Having settled his thoughts, Song Yan looked again at the Faceless Mask.
Inside the mask, Feng Chengzi’s Divine Thought was still asleep, hence the bookshelf was already shrouded in mist.
Song Yan strolled to the mid-stage Purple Mansion place, gazing up at the sealed highest bookshelf.
Perhaps he got too close and entered some restricted area of the Formless Bookshelf inheritance.
In the next instant...
Swish!!
The sleeping Feng Chengzi abruptly woke up, and upon seeing Song Yan, his eyes widened.
In his eyes, Song Yan’s Divine Soul emitted a terrifying gray glow and heat, like a terrifying giant Melting Furnace; upon closer inspection, wrapped around the furnace were numerous Divine Souls, causes and effects, even... obsessions, and gray-robed fiends!
"You... you... what exactly are you now?"
"I just returned from the Sea of Suffering."
Song Yan said calmly.
Feng Chengzi was stunned for a while, then seemed to remember something, and said: "No need to say, Little Fan must be dead, as per the agreement, I won’t let you see the rest of the secret..."
Before he could finish speaking, Song Yan reached up directly towards the highest-level Secret Technique of the mid-stage Purple Mansion.
The mist touched his hand and scattered in fear.
Song Yan smiled faintly and continued towards the late stage of Purple Mansion.
He raised his hand again.
The mist scattered again in fear.
He kept walking until he reached the end of the Library Pavilion, at the late stage of Divine Infant, all the mist no longer needed Feng Chengzi to unravel it.
Then, under Feng Chengzi’s already dazed gaze, he raised his hand... slowly reached out towards him.
Feng Chengzi realized and abruptly asked: "What are you going to do?"
Song Yan smiled: "Don’t be nervous, I’m just testing if I have the ability to digest you now. You can start defending yourself now..."
With that, he grabbed Feng Chengzi’s shoulder directly.
Feng Chengzi shouted angrily: "You!"
Song Yan said: "Old Tang, children and grandchildren will have their fortune, no need for you to worry anymore."
The mad gray flames instantly crawled all over Feng Chengzi’s body. Even though he resisted desperately, it was all in vain, and defeat was just a matter of time.
Slowly... slowly... another golden droplet appeared on Song Yan’s Divine Soul, as terrifying as a gray flaming furnace. Though the droplet was indestructible, it was slowly pulled apart and gradually became a part of the furnace.
After a long time...
Song Yan suddenly reopened his eyes, a flash of terrifying gray light in his pupils, then grabbed the Flying Sword that originally belonged to Song Han, turned into a rainbow light, and shot outwards, breaking through the lake.
...
...
Nearby the Misty Sea, in a mountain hollow.
In a hidden mountain stronghold, dozens of bandits were each busy with their own tasks.
Among them, a burly bandit with a big head and ears was sitting on a rock at the stronghold’s entrance, chatting with a fierce and strong bandit leader beside him.
He smacked his lips and said: "Boss, that little lady is really nice, those long legs wrapped in silk, so smooth. Just thinking about tearing it open, the sound it would make, and the little lady’s frightened screams, makes my mouth dry."
The strong bandit leader chuckled: "You’re not the only one, even I think that woman must be wild, once you open her up, it’ll surely be fun."

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 155. Soul Like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: 155. Soul Like a Melting Furnace, Sea of Suffering Seizes the Body (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Seeking Subscription)_5
The fat bandit said, "Boss, what are we waiting for?"
He hurriedly got up, with a bulge in his crotch.
But seeing the strong bandit leader not rise, he curiously asked, "Boss, you?"
The strong bandit leader said, "Just be obedient, I have my reasons for not moving. Don’t ask why, if you ask... you die."
The fat bandit nodded.
In a tent not far away, a beautiful woman with her hands and feet tied listened intently to the distant conversation, feeling a sense of despair.
She wasn’t stupid.
It was her brother who brought her here.
But her brother was an Immortal, capable of easily killing these bandits, yet he contrived to leave her here with some excuse to seek fortune, resulting in her capture by the bandits.
Initially, she hadn’t thought much of it, but the strong bandit leader’s words forced her to reconsider.
The strong bandit leader said nothing overtly, but clearly... there was someone behind him.
What kind of person could make such bloodthirsty bandits say "Don’t ask the reason, if you ask, you die"?
Recalling how her brother sometimes looked at her with peculiar eyes...
The beautiful woman began to understand something.
She clenched her fingers tight, her sharp nails digging into her flesh, even drawing blood.
Suddenly, she lowered her head and laughed softly, then tears streamed from her eyes as she looked upwards and let out a hysterical scream.
It was a scream of pain...
A scream of being betrayed by a loved one...
Just then, she felt the wind rise.
The wind blew open a corner of the tent.
Outside the tent, there came a series of short, sharp cries.
These were the cries of the bandits.
It seemed each bandit only managed a single cry before their throats were crushed, leaving them unable to speak again.
In the past, the beautiful woman would have been terrified.
But now... her heart was already dead.
If the heart is dead, what is there to fear?
Then, she heard someone shouting "Immortal, spare my life," but the voice was cut off, lifeline severed, clearly killed.
The beautiful woman finally turned her head slightly and vaguely saw that familiar figure: plain-looking, but wearing the disciple’s robe of the Sword Immortal Sect, exuding a certain ethereal aura.
Yet, that aura now only made her feel nauseous.
She closed her eyes, for she had seen through everything; she was now waiting for her brother.
No!
She was waiting for Song Han, she wanted to confront him, then take her own life.
But at that moment, she suddenly heard the strong bandit leader’s voice: "You... you can’t kill me?"
Then, she heard her brother’s voice: "Why?"
The strong bandit leader said, "You... you should be Song Han.
I’m working for your senior brother, he wants me to capture your sister-in-law.
He said you respect your sister-in-law the most, as long as she’s captured, you wouldn’t participate in the Hidden Dragon Association a month from now, but search for her instead...
You can’t kill me!
If you kill me, your senior brother won’t let you go!
You..."
The strong bandit leader wanted to continue, but couldn’t, as a Flying Sword had already effortlessly killed him.
Song Yan stepped forward and killed all the bandits in the mountain hideout before coming to the tent, lifting the curtain and seeing the stunned beautiful woman there, looking guilty, he said, "Sister-in-law, I’m sorry, I came too late."
After he spoke, he scratched his head in embarrassment, saying, "I got caught up in an opportunity on the way and lost track of time, I’m sorry..."
The beautiful woman just stared at him blankly, her mind in chaos because everything seemed... different from what she thought.
On the other side, Song Yan suddenly slapped his head as if remembering something, and realized, "That’s right, just now while killing a bandit, I finally figured it out, my elder brother’s death is also connected to my senior brother.
My senior brother was jealous of my fast cultivation speed and wanted to disrupt my mental realm, so he thought that as long as he killed my loved ones, I would collapse..."
His voice slowed, tears welled in his eyes, he lowered his head and bitterly smiled saying "collapse," then closed his eyes and said, "I caused elder brother’s death, I caused sister-in-law’s suffering. Even though I’ve avenged you, it’s still all my fault."
The beautiful woman stood up, tightly grabbing his hand, and cried out, while calling, "Xiao Han, Xiao Han..."
Song Yan gently patted her back, softly saying, "It’s all right now, sister-in-law, it’s all right."
After speaking, a glint of cold light flashed in his eyes, "That senior brother, I won’t let him go."
The beautiful woman said, "Xiao Han, forget it, you’re both Immortals. Since these bandits are dead, just let it..."
Before she could finish, Song Yan coldly said, "No, I must kill, the person who killed my elder brother must pay with blood! The elder brother is like a father, the sister-in-law is like a mother, if I don’t avenge this grudge, can I still call myself Song Han?"
This senior brother was no baseless accusation, but another person Song Yan found in his memories. It was this person who strategized, making Song Han commit such vile acts.
Since he is Song Han, this cause and effect must be settled, otherwise... how could his mind find peace?
Hearing his fierce words, the beautiful woman felt a sweetness in her heart, thinking that this brother wasn’t doted on in vain. And previously, she had actually misunderstood him, which was truly too excessive.

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 156. Racing Against Time, Coincidentally Meeting an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: 156. Racing Against Time, Coincidentally Meeting an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)
The abandoned Wu Land, now the frontline confronting the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, bandit camp...
Song Yan looked around, found a horse, helped the beautiful woman mount, and then asked, "Sister-in-law, what are your plans from now on?"
The beautiful woman’s gaze swept over the blood-stained bandit camp.
With the great vengeance repaid, she felt a bit lost inside.
She couldn’t help but lower her head to look at her brother, asking, "Xiao Han, I don’t know either."
Song Yan said, "The hearts of people in the Cultivation Realm are unpredictable; it’s not the extraordinary and transcendental place Sister-in-law imagined. If I take Sister-in-law to the Mo Sword Sect, one wrong move could drag Sister-in-law into an endless abyss."
The beautiful woman lightly nodded. After this event, she naturally understood the ruthlessness of cultivators. If she went to the Mo Sword Sect, her own life would be in danger, and she might become a burden to Xiao Han.
Song Yan suddenly said, "Sister-in-law, let me make the arrangements."
The beautiful woman was taken aback, looking at the boy she raised, seeing the blood behind him, the rolling heads, she realized that he had grown up.
She lightly nodded.
Song Yan found a straw hat to cover his face, skillfully emptied the bandits’ gold and silver, then finger-controlled the sword, taking the beautiful woman with him, heading south on a ray of sword light.
...
Several days later.
The southern major city, the capital where the "South-stabilizing Marquis" among the nine marquises resides...
On a street not considered prosperous, yet far from desolate.
An estate agent was excitedly introducing, "Immortal elder, rest assured, our Forest Sea City is famous for its safety.
I’m not boasting, but everyone in this area is thinking of settling in our Forest Sea City.
But this is quite rare, only a few succeed each year.
Fortunately, you’re an Immortal, and the South-stabilizing Marquis has a provision allowing Immortal families to move in at any time, making it much easier.
Take a look at this house, what do you think?"
Song Han glanced around, looked at the beautiful woman, and asked, "Sister-in-law, what do you think?"
The beautiful woman lightly nodded, saying, "It’s very nice."
She was genuinely satisfied.
Forest Sea City is a pure land in everyone’s heart.
She also knew how difficult it was to settle in such a place.
This was all because of Xiao Han’s involvement; otherwise, it would have been impossible.
She had some skills in tailoring clothes, and there happened to be a "Brocade and Silk Clothing Shop" nearby, maybe she could give it a try. If noticed, she could start a new life here.
Seeing the beautiful woman’s satisfaction, Song Yan tossed the money to the agent, bought the house, and then bought two maids, handing over the property deed and maid contracts to the beautiful woman.
The beautiful woman grabbed the contract, surprised, asking, "Xiao Han, you bought it, why didn’t you write your name? And... why do I... need maids?"
Song Yan smiled, "This is Sister-in-law’s home. Sister-in-law will live here in the future, naturally needing someone to take care of her."
The beautiful woman couldn’t help but laugh, "Why do I need maids? I... I’ll be busy here, waiting for Xiao Han to come back."
Song Yan smiled slightly, had a meal at home, and then prepared to leave.
In the twilight, the beautiful woman stood in the small courtyard, bidding farewell to her brother.
Song Yan looked at her, softly said, "Sister-in-law is still young. If my brother were here, he wouldn’t want you to live alone and lonely for the rest of your life."
The beautiful woman smiled sadly, "I’ve been with your brother for nearly ten years, where could there be room for anyone else in my heart?
Xiao Han, don’t worry about it, just go...
Your senior brother’s matter, don’t be reckless. Just stay safe, and I’ll be satisfied."
Song Yan nodded gently, thought for a moment, and said, "Sister-in-law, there’s one more thing you must remember."
The beautiful woman said, "Xiao Han, tell me, I will keep it a secret."
Song Yan said, "Others only need to know you have an Immortal brother; you must never tell anyone my name."
The beautiful woman blinked, not quite understanding.
Song Yan said seriously, "Sister-in-law, remember it well, never forget."
Though puzzled, the beautiful woman nodded affirmatively.
Only then did Song Yan use Sword Control and Rainbow Transformation to break through the sky and leave.
The beautiful woman returned to the house, with maids busy front and back in the courtyard, but a faint sense of loneliness lingered in her heart, the emptiness after the great vengeance was complete enveloping her...
It was the transition from autumn to winter, the weather warming yet still cold, the hardest time to adjust.
She was still young, with a long life ahead, yet at the moment didn’t know how to spend it.
Xiao Han had grown up and didn’t need her anymore.
She sighed softly, took a deep breath, and mustered some strength, for life still had to go on.
That evening, she went to bed early, but soon fell asleep without knowing why. In her dream, she successfully joined the Brocade and Silk Trading Company and gradually fell in love with the shopkeeper...
She couldn’t accept this affection, unable to betray her deceased husband.
The shopkeeper, though filled with love, couldn’t force it, so he married another woman.
But ten, twenty, thirty years passed...
The shopkeeper’s wife passed away due to illness, and he never remarried.
Another twenty years passed, they both had grown white hair. Reuniting, they gazed at each other, with countless words unsaid. The shopkeeper gently asked, "In this life, you wouldn’t marry me; in the next life...be with me, alright?"
The now elderly beautiful woman nodded.
They held each other’s hands tightly, lamenting the lack of time left in their lives.
...
Cock-a-doodle-doo~~
The crowing of a rooster woke the beautiful woman.
She slowly opened her eyes, recalling the strange and detailed dream from last night, gently shaking her head.
She quickly got up, washed, and upon exiting the courtyard saw the Brocade and Silk Trading Company not far away, hesitated slightly, but walked over.
Just entering the company, she saw the shopkeeper rushing out from the inner courtyard.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 156. Racing Against Time, Unexpected Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Major Chapter Asking for Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: 156. Racing Against Time, Unexpected Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Major Chapter Asking for Subscription)_2
The two of them made eye contact in mid-air, their bemused expressions in the morning gradually changing into complex ones, and then they both froze.
The shopkeeper’s lips trembled, and he suddenly asked, "Next life... is this the next life?"
The beautiful woman’s breath became rapid, and, frightened, she turned and ran, her heart in turmoil.
The shopkeeper caught up from behind, grabbed her hand, and said, "I won’t let you leave again."
"Let go! Let go!"
The beautiful woman struggled.
Yet slowly, the two walked together, the shopkeeper’s face brimming with happiness, and the beautiful woman lowering her head, somewhat shy. The sunlight fell, casting their figures onto the autumn earth, slowly merging into one.
In this world, what is there that time cannot change?
...
In the distance, a young man leaned against the most luxurious tavern tower in Forest Sea City, holding the most expensive fine wine, gulping it down.
This wine was true Immortal Brew, a special tribute.
This body was only at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, so there was still a hint of drunkenness.
By the side of the intoxicated young man, there was a novice monk dressed in a gray Hundred-Patch Robe, with hands clasped together.
The novice monk seemed to be looking into the distance with the young man at that happy couple.
The Sea of Suffering novice monk, Song Yan had two, both were refined into the Divine Soul Surface at the Sea of Suffering Coast by him, and he could command them at will.
And now, the first thing he did with them was "fulfillment."
Fulfilling the happiness of others.
Such happiness, he long since didn’t covet; he didn’t even wish to see the white clouds beyond the border. But if he could make the ones around him happy, he would still feel a faint sense of joy.
Such joy, worthy of a grand toast!
Bang!
He slapped the table vigorously and called out heartily, "Waiter, another jar of Immortal Brew."
Very soon, more fine wine was served.
The young man tore off the clay seal and gulped down a jar of fine wine, then tossed out a gold ingot, laughing loudly as he performed Sword Control and Rainbow Transformation, rising toward the azure sky and white clouds, as mortals looked up in awe.
...
...
A few days later.
At the Mo Sword Sect, in a hidden place on the back mountain...
"Elder Ma, this is my humble offering to you, ha..." A cultivator spoke with a fawning expression.
The other, a white-robed elder with a mustache, grunted, then asked, "And Song Han’s?"
The cultivator hastily replied, "Song Han went to the mortal world, saying he wants to take a Furnace."
He then chuckled slyly, lowering his voice, "Elder Ma, he has his eyes on his sister-in-law, so this trip is to bring her back to the sect. Here’s how it is..."
The cultivator drew closer and recounted how Song Han murdered his brother and framed his sister-in-law in detail.
Unexpectedly, Elder Ma nodded and said, "Well done."
The cultivator smiled obsequiously, "Our Mo Sword Sect may not be part of the Righteous Dao, but if such a scandal were known, Song Han’s future is still worrisome.
With this leverage, and with your status, Elder, he will naturally obediently take your Hundred Insect Pill, and from then on be under your control...
Song Han’s talent is decent, astonishingly reaching the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound in the years since his entry-level.
However, even if he is selected by the Hidden Dragon Association this time, he will always be your dog."
Elder Ma laughed indifferently, "Just like you, correct?"
The cultivator repeatedly agreed.
Elder Ma looked up at the sky but saw the sky turning gray and heavy as if it were made of iron, with a chilling atmosphere gathering in the air, indicating an impending snowfall.
He waved his hand and said, "Keep an eye out for any talented newcomers recently in our Mo Sword Sect who have good talent and no background. If there’s such a person, see what he likes. Attract him with what he likes, and bring him to see me."
"Yes, Elder."
After a brief conversation, the two were about to part ways.
Suddenly, Elder Ma stopped walking, his gaze directed at a spot.
In the gray mountain hue, a figure emerged.
Elder Ma had not yet spoken, when the other cultivator exclaimed joyfully, "Song Han!"
After shouting, he hurriedly waved, "Quick, come and pay respects to Elder! We were just talking about you, Elder Ma even quite admires..."
Before he could finish, a strong sense of eeriness arose within this cultivator’s heart.
He suddenly realized that nobody else was supposed to know of his meeting with Elder Ma here.
The back mountain of the Mo Sword Sect was vast, and this place was very secluded, so how did Song Han know about this?
Just then, the cultivator suddenly noticed Elder Ma’s pupils contracting tightly, an expression of utmost fear on his face, followed by a groan as he fell to the ground, bleeding from all seven orifices, dead.
The cultivator was stunned.
In his eyes, the young man drew closer and closer, stopping in front of him, then lowering his head and bending over, reaching out to take Elder Ma’s storage bag.
The cultivator’s Adam’s apple bobbed, speaking in a trembling voice, "Song... Song Han... Han?"
He was already speaking incoherently, stammering.
Because he simply couldn’t believe what he saw.
Song Han was only at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, while he was at the Ninth Layer, and Elder Ma was at the Early Stage Crimson Palace...
What on earth was happening here?
Why did Elder Ma suddenly die violently?
And why could Song Han so calmly pick up his storage bag?
In his heart, no matter how he thought, he couldn’t conceive the notion of "Song Han killed Elder Ma."
Because it was absolutely impossible!
Just then, a faint voice exploded in his ear.
"Still not running?"
The cultivator’s mind shook violently, his head buzzing with fear, then without thinking, he suddenly turned, controlled his sword, transformed into a rainbow, and quickly fled several miles away.
Then...
Whoosh!
He suddenly felt a searing gray light streak through the sky, piercing his forehead, his Divine Soul searing with pain, and then he knew no more.
Song Yan took off Elder Ma’s storage bag, turned it inside, his pupils slightly contracted, seeing some strange elixirs, seemingly containing insect corpses within them.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 156. Racing Against Time, Unexpected Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Major Chapter Asking for Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: 156. Racing Against Time, Unexpected Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K Words - Major Chapter Asking for Subscription)_3
At this moment, Elder Ma’s eyeballs suddenly emitted a strange hiss, and a centipede-like monstrous insect crawled out.
Song Yan flicked his hand, and the monstrous insect exploded.
A look of seriousness flashed in his eyes.
Both in his own knowledge and in Song Han’s memory, it was clear that the only force in this area that used insects as elixirs, magical treasures, and tools for control could only be the ——— Mountain and Sea Demon Country’s two-headed Bilanzhao Bug tribe.
After pondering for a while, Song Yan came to a sudden realization.
’Indeed, whether it’s the Demon Monk or the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, they would undoubtedly think of infiltrating the ancient country’s forces, and Elder Ma was one of them.
He wants to control cultivators without background but with talent to further infiltrate...
This Hidden Dragon Association is an opportunity.
And naturally, Song Han would be one of his targets.’
While thinking, strange bird calls suddenly echoed from the forest not far away.
It was a bird demon beast, attracted by the bloody scent here.
Song Yan slowly raised his head, and a scorching gray electric light shot from between his brows.
Bang!
The bird demon beast, dead.
Suddenly, a rustling sound came from the forest again.
A wolf-shaped demon beast was approaching.
Swoosh!
Another gray electric light.
The wolf-shaped demon beast, dead.
Song Yan slightly sensed, analyzing secretly in his mind.
He had killed Elder Ma, the cultivator, and the demon beast just now, respectively testing the strength, attack distance, and consumption of his current power.
Found it to be satisfactory.
This electric light of his was a purely divine soul attack.
