The killed divine souls even directly transformed into transformed minions, merging into the surface of his divine soul, like a melting furnace, becoming part of his divine soul’s surface.
Above the Purple Mansion, he knew not.
But even if he was just in the Refining Profound body, under the Purple Mansion, he was completely invincible.
Without entering the Purple Mansion, the divine soul is not merged with the heavens and earth; how could they possibly withstand his divine soul attack?
Though his body strength was a flaw, he could instantly kill anyone he targeted.
Moreover, his divine soul attack was currently limited by his body strength, and as his realm improved, the attack of this gray electric light would become even more terrifying.
As for the attack distance, it was roughly several miles, but the further the distance, the greater the consumption naturally.
Additionally, consumption was also related to body strength.
At the seventh layer of Refining Profound, the consumption was not insignificant, but if the realm is improved, consumption could be reduced.
Song Yan thought, quickly packed up the storage bag and dealt with the bodies.
He glanced at the strange centipede he killed and the bottles of insect pills, a trace of seriousness in his eyes.
’Unexpectedly, the Mountain and Sea Demon Race has spies everywhere, inciting traitors...’
’Must hurry and leave here through the ancient teleportation array via the Hidden Dragon Association, otherwise... the consequences are unimaginable.’
’Moreover, if there’s an opportunity, I must quickly find out what exactly my current state is and if there are things to be mindful of in cultivation in this state.’
’I wonder if there were others like me before?’
If it were only within the Three Kingdoms, Song Yan could guarantee there weren’t.
But he had already stepped beyond this small well of "Three Kingdoms" and glanced at the vast world outside, knowing... in this magnificent and mystical Cultivation Realm, anything could happen.
And he knew very little about both this world and his own situation.
...
Amidst numerous thoughts, Song Yan quickly returned to the Cave Mansion by sword control.
Fortunately, there was no one else in the Cave Mansion.
Song Han had intended to bring back his sister-in-law as a furnace on this trip, so he had cleared out the Cave Mansion early, sparing Song Yan a lot of trouble.
He lay on the stone bed, closed his eyes to rest, and then recalled the cultivation techniques of the Mo Sword Sect from memory.
Possession is different from transforming minion or soul search.
Neither transforming minion nor soul search can acquire cultivation techniques.
But with possession, one can inherit almost all the legacies of the predecessor, naturally including the cultivation techniques they possessed.
Currently, he focused on two disciplines.
One is a cultivation technique, the other a spell.
The cultivation technique is called: "Ink and Water Sword Manual," absorbing Profound Qi, visualizing artistic conceptions of ink and wash paintings, not seeking the sword in the clouds, but seeking to roam the mountains and rivers with delight.
The spell is called: "Silver Stream Sword Technique," and this sword technique is entirely different from the "White Snake Sword Technique" of the Nanwu Sword Sect in the past.
"White Snake Sword Technique" and the subsequent "Sleeve Universe" emphasized "unmatched sharpness, sword qi rampant," while "Silver Stream Sword Technique" took the sword in another direction — softness.
A strong sword is unmatched in sharpness.
A soft sword is endless and continuous.
If the subsequent "Sword Heaven Gate" of "White Snake Sword Technique" pursued momentary burst, then "Ink and Water Sword Manual" and "Silver Stream Sword Technique" pursued continuous sword qi, resembling long rivers and great rivers, surging continuously and endlessly.
In the Hidden Dragon Association, Song Yan naturally had to use the Mo Sword Sect’s cultivation techniques.
Therefore, he naturally needed to hasten his study of this cultivation technique and spell at this time.
Soon, the panel appeared...
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 141/8639]
[Cultivation Technique] "Ink and Water Sword Manual"
[Spell] "Silver Stream Sword Technique" (Xiaocheng)
He looked at the "Silver Stream Sword Technique," pondered for a while, gestured slightly with his fingers, and mobilized Profound Qi...
The "Xiaocheng" on the panel astonishingly turned into "Great Success," and in less than half a day it became "Perfection."
’A low-level spell can be learned so quickly?’
’No! Not just that, low-level spells... I can easily grasp their trajectory and then learn them.’
’If someone uses other low-level spells in front of me, I can also grasp them in the blink of an eye, like the Formless Ancient Race.’
’However, this is not the Innate Divine Soul Secret Technique of the Formless Ancient Race.’
’Tang Fan earlier was able to imitate the Longbo Power of the Multi-tailed Dragon Bo Fox Race and therefore use the Golden Armor Godman... in that alone, I cannot do so.’

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 156. Racing Against Time, A Chance Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K words - Big Chapter, Requesting Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: 156. Racing Against Time, A Chance Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K words - Big Chapter, Requesting Subscription)_4
Song Yan shook his head slightly, just feeling that the "Innate Divine Soul Inheritance" of the Formless Ancient Race must contain significant secrets.
Suddenly, his mind stirred again, and another thought emerged.
In the past, his Techniques could mutate entirely relying on the "Ghost Profound Root".
But now he has the "Earth Profound Root".
He lost the "Ghost Mutation" of the "Ghost Profound Root", but now possesses a terrifying Divine Soul, so... could he perhaps further deduce it?
With a slight contemplation, Song Yan privately analyzed in his heart: ’If in the past, Techniques like the "Silver Stream Sword Technique" took several decades for the first mutation, then I’ll just try using a hundred years.’
After a moment...
Panel changes:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Longevity: 141/8633]
[Technique]"Silver Stream Sword Technique Secret Skill - Shallow Stream Concealed Flood Dragon" (Perfection) (First Successful Deduction)
An unprecedented change appeared on Song Yan’s panel.
The "First Mutation" became the "First Successful Deduction", while the longevity consumed was merely 6 years.
He carefully perceived, and after a moment, suddenly understood the difference between now and the past.
If the "Ghost Profound Root" was a mutation, it was like building a tall building on the original Techniques, making this building progress towards "Devouring" and "Illusion Technique", thereby becoming a more aggressive Technique;
Then a powerful Divine Soul is deducing upon the original Techniques, not abandoning the original Techniques, but making further progress. In layman’s terms, it’s a bit like the "Thirteen Life-taking Swords" from a story Song Yan read before transmigration, deducing a Fourteenth Sword and Fifteenth Sword.
The former turns into a new Technique, while the latter... is a deep excavation on the existing Technique.
As for other "functions", they still need to be unearthed.
Which of the two is superior?
Song Yan couldn’t say, but the latter is obviously more suited to be "Sect Inheritance".
Because the powerful Cultivation Techniques comprehended from the former, others simply couldn’t learn.
For instance, that "Hundred Forms Demon Body", or the "Paper-cut Celestial Palace", could others learn?
But the latter is step-by-step, at least giving people hope.
However...
Song Yan was never one to enjoy making choices.
He decided to find an Evil Land after the "Hidden Dragon Association".
Zhang Han knows how to use the Soul-Locking Array and the method to transform the "Ghost Profound Root", there’s no reason not to try, no reason... not to "have the best of both worlds".
But all these must be discussed after he enters the Ancient Teleportation Array.
While pondering about the "Hidden Dragon Association", he spread his Divine Sense.
Only a Crimson Palace Realm expert can use the Profound Qi for Divine Sense probing, yet now he can use it effortlessly. Not only that, but he is also in a state where he can probe others, but others cannot probe him.
Why? Because his Divine Soul Power is too strong, it’s an overwhelming strength.
How could others possibly detect him?
Because of this, he could easily perceive Elder Ma, while Elder Ma didn’t know he had arrived until he physically saw him.
’This Hidden Dragon Association cannot afford any failure, I must leave here promptly, absolutely without any fluke mindset.’
’Time is running out.’
...
...
Shua!
Shuashua!
Shuashuashuashua!!
Many eyes opened simultaneously, opening eyes were all cultivators. Most of these cultivators were in a Cave Mansion, currently staring into the darkness, receiving the same information and then each providing feedback.
How was this possible?
Simply because they all bore a "My Thought" Purple Mansion avatar.
That one "My Thought" typically suppresses their own Divine Souls, and influences their thoughts, now no one knows how long it’s been, these people have long since become slaves of that Purple Mansion Lord.
They work for that Purple Mansion Lord, at critical moments, they can even be possessed by that Purple Mansion Lord... but it’s purely body control, unable to inherit a single extra power.
Admittedly, such means indeed require some effort, but apparently, that Purple Mansion Lord does not care about this investment. Simply because there is something extremely precious to him on this land, and he... is strong enough.
These Purple Mansion slaves reported on the situation there one after another.
On the other side of the darkness, that Purple Mansion figure silently listened.
After a long while... all the slaves heard a sentence.
"I will need some more time to arrive, I fear I will not make it in time.
You... remember the names of all the winners of the Hidden Dragon Association, find a way to get close, and plant a soul-chasing worm in each of them.
That soul-chasing worm is bestowed by me, imperceptible below the Purple Mansion.
Even above the Purple Mansion... unless it’s on oneself.
Of course, if you can build friendships with any of them, leave means of contact, ascertain their whereabouts, that would be best.
If someone strongly dislikes your approach, note their name.
If anyone achieves something, I will record your great merits, and there will certainly be heavy rewards afterward."
The voice on the other side of the darkness flickered away...
Immediately after, the owner of the voice picked out a few slaves, letting them take the token and head to an Elder’s residence in their respective sect. Once the door opened, the slaves presented the token, and the Elder hurriedly welcomed them in.
No one knew... the real identity of these Elders was that of a Vengeful Ghost.
That mysterious Late Stage Purple Mansion powerhouse collected numerous Crimson Palace Realm Vengeful Ghosts, letting these ghosts possess Refining Profound, then cultivate step by step, returning to the Crimson Palace Realm, and successfully infiltrated into the high ranks of the Southern Land’s "Five Great Sects".
Although there were mutual spies between the Mountain and Sea Demon Race and Ancient Race, the means of this one were particularly ruthless.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 156. Racing Against Time, A Chance Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K words - Big Chapter, Requesting Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: 156. Racing Against Time, A Chance Encounter with an Old Friend (8.2K words - Big Chapter, Requesting Subscription)_5
On regular days, this mighty figure from the Purple Mansion never bothered with those servant ghosts, nor did they issue commands to them.
But now... the first command had emerged.
"If you discover that any Elder exhibits unusual behavior, or their power surges rapidly, plant a Soul Pursuit Insect on them.
Also... follow my instructions, and seize the opportunity to kill after the Hidden Dragon Association.
Among these people, there might be someone... considered a seasoned monster.
You’re no match for them.
However, as long as you find him, prevent his passage through the Ancient Teleportation Array to the Northern Land, that will suffice.
Heading to the Northern Land is his only escape route.
How could I possibly let him accomplish that?"
The Elders among the scout ghosts of each sect nodded repeatedly.
After a while, that being in the Purple Mansion, through a subjugated voice, began asking questions like, "If you combine all your strength, can you destroy that Ancient Teleportation Array?"
But the answers were all "Probably not."
Because currently, that Ancient Teleportation Array, being a strategic array of the Ancient Country, is guarded in turns by the Purple Mansion cultivators of the Ancient Country.
It’s akin to a General guarding a pass.
That "teleportation array" is their "pass."
As long as the Purple Mansion cultivators are present, how could the pass be broken?
...
...
Song Yan tossed and turned on the stone bed.
His gaze fixated on the empty darkness, he pondered from time to time.
He knew that his current enemy was a "terrifying monster born from the Sea of Suffering," the one most familiar with human hearts and best at stirring up human desires.
Now, through the four Evil Pearls on his Divine Soul, he could feel the opponent approaching with all their might.
Luckily, to cross the Desolate Wilderness and reach here in the Southern Land would still require time.
The adversary’s attention was completely locked on him.
And the opponent’s methods?
"Purple Mansion’s thralls..."
"Servant ghosts..."
Having assimilated five-ninths of the Changwang Tiger Race’s Demon Monk, naturally, he also possessed the power of a "servant ghost."
"If he instructed the servant ghosts to seize bodies, over this century, probably quite a few among the servant ghosts have already stepped into the Crimson Palace Realm, perhaps even within the Mo Sword Sect."
"Who knows how they will take action?"
Contemplating for a while, Song Yan devised a plan.
"Since the Hidden Dragon Association is for selecting talents from the Ancient Races, then... I’ll first find out which Ancient Races are present."
"If the Formless Ancient Race is among them, perhaps... I can attempt a new path."
"Although I cannot mimic high-level magic, the Refining Profound Level is still within my grasp, and with the Formless Mask, it’ll be enough to prove my identity."
...
...
The next morning, Song Yan arrived at the Sword Cultivation Platform of the Mo Sword Sect.
This platform was built high on a location abundant in Profound Qi, with a breathtaking view.
Four stone tablets had ancient carvings of mountains and rivers, remarkably expressive, very unique. Even mortals would feel as if they were truly experiencing it, feeling relaxed and happy just by taking a glance.
This Sword Cultivation Platform was a feature of the Mo Sword Sect, and all disciples loved coming here to cultivate.
One for the Profound Qi, the other for visualizing the essence of mountains and rivers.
Following his memory, Song Yan chose a spot where Song Han would usually sit, sat cross-legged in meditation, without speaking, only slightly dispersing his Divine Sense, paying attention to every movement in the surroundings, and watching for any strange behavior from Elders or disciples.
Soon, he noticed a disciple.
That disciple was named Liu Man, who seemed unusually talkative at the moment, asking about who would attend the Hidden Dragon Association this year.
However, in Song Han’s impression, this disciple named Liu Man was not usually so talkative.
Soon, Liu Man approached Song Yan, cupped his hands, and smiled, "Brother Song, are you going to the Hidden Dragon Association this year?"
Song Yan’s eyes glinted suddenly, and he said, "Who wouldn’t want to go?"
Liu Man laughed, "With Brother’s talent, you might catch the attention of the Ancient Race’s nobles."
Song Yan replied, "Brother Liu, are you going?"
Liu Man said, "Of course."
After a simple conversation, the two parted ways, and Liu Man moved to another spot, his expression somewhat urgent.
Song Yan coldly chuckled to himself.
’Little brat, with just this skill, you come out as a scout?
Not only did you fail to gather information, you ended up revealing it and exposing your purpose.’
A hidden severity flashed in his eyes.
’But the Demon Monk’s response is really quick, it seems... everyone who wins at the Hidden Dragon Association this year will be targeted and then face endless pursuit and killing.
Perhaps the Demon Monk is even more ruthless; if he can destroy the Ancient Teleportation Array, he certainly will.
Not good, I need to think of another way.’
After a long time...
Song Yan contemplated to himself: ’Continuous body snatching might damage the origin of the Divine Soul, but if I can bypass the Hidden Dragon Association by changing my identity and enter the Ancient Teleportation Array ahead of time, it’s not impossible.’
As he was thinking, his expression suddenly changed, because he saw clouds rise, and everyone from the Mo Sword Sect, from the ancestor and sect leader to the Elders, leaped into Sword Control, seemingly to welcome someone.
Above the clouds, celestial music echoed, female cultivators dressed as Celestial Maidens led the procession, followed by three Flying Palanquins...
The ancestor of the Mo Sword Sect respectfully said, "Welcome, Upper Envoy of the Ancient Race."
Song Yan gathered back his Divine Sense, merely blending in with the disciples, gazing upwards.
Suddenly, a strange connection emerged within his Divine Sense.
That connection formed between him and the last Flying Palanquin.
The connection expanded rapidly from being vague to solid and firm.
Song Yan recognized it.
It was the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman!
He never expected the ’Blood Slave Ancient Talisman’ to still be effective!
And at that moment, the curtain of the last Flying Palanquin was lifted, revealing a beautiful woman who peeked out, eyes flashing with subtle terror, and gazed below, seemingly searching for someone in the crowd.
She... a hundred years ago, was just Xing’Er of the Ghost Slaughter Sect.
Now, by merit of her son, she had ascended to great heights.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, Under the Purple Mansion, I Am Invincible (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, Under the Purple Mansion, I Am Invincible (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
Swish!
Xing’Er finally found that figure among the cultivators of the small sect in the Outer Domain.
Her heart began to race wildly.
An overwhelming terror swept over her.
Since the teleportation array in Ancient Jin was repaired, people of the Formless Race could come from the Northern Land again, subsequently searching everywhere for missing clansmen. By a stroke of chance, she and her son were discovered, then brought back to the clan.
It is said that a thousand years ago, this ancient teleportation array was intact, and later destroyed for some reason, causing many from the Ancient Race to fail to retreat, and among the losses of the Formless Race was one of whom was naturally Tang Fan’s father.
It should be noted that the Ancient Race always has its bloodline passed down from generation to generation, their number never increasing, so even a single scattered clansman would receive significant attention.
Xing’Er, thus along with her son, was brought back to the Ancient Race, and then she, leveraging her son’s position, rose to become the "Immortal Mother Xing" today, and broke through to the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace with ample resources.
Her son, Tang Yi, was even more of a prodigy. His experiences in the Southern Land of Chu Kingdom not only did not suppress him but rather fostered his tenacity. Now he has already broken through to the peak of the Crimson Palace.
Tang Yi was different from his mother; his Nine Palace Blood was far stronger than his mother’s, making his cultivation extremely challenging. At this moment... he was at the final step before entering the Purple Mansion.
This step would be accompanied by elders of the clan since "how to break through the Purple Mansion" was a secret outside. Before reaching the Purple Mansion, without elders, one could not hope to know.
The elders of the Formless Race told her that entering the Purple Mansion was easy, but to stabilize that early stage realm would take at least decades. Although there might be those with terrifying talents who could speed up this process, such individuals were a millennium rarity.
For decades, Tang Yi was extremely worried about being separated by life and death from his mother, so he hoped to take this opportunity of the Hidden Dragon Association to select some attendants.
Firstly, to solidify his own faction;
Secondly, although the Great Chu is far from Ancient Jin, after all, he traveled to the Formless Ancient Race through the ancient teleportation array, and now it counts as a return trip. Looking back on the path he came, he might gain more insights;
Thirdly, to see if there were any cultivators whom his mother might find pleasing to accompany her in his stead.
Since entering the Ancient Race, he had spent very little time accompanying his mother, and his mother had lost the companionship of his father after his birth, which was quite pitiable. Therefore, over the years, even though there were rumors outside about "Immortal Mother’s Dalliance," he only heard one ear and let it out the other. As long as his mother was happy, that was all that mattered. As for his father, he had never met his father, how could he care?
Of course, Tang Yi’s selection of attendants was not limited to Ancient Jin. In fact, he had already traveled around the vassal states of the Formless Ancient Race and had already gathered a few attendants. By this stop, it was already nearing the end.
...
...
That night, deep in the night, in the back mountains of the Mo Sword Sect, in a secluded small grove...
The barely perceptible divine soul power made it nearly impossible for the grove to be detected.
Externally high and lofty Immortal Mother Xing appeared so timid as if she had become the demoness facing the old ancestor again.
The arrogance brought on by "status and power" was instantly stripped away before the young man in front of her, leaving only awe.
"Master, back then, I suddenly felt the connection of the Blood Slave mark disappear without a trace.
I thought you had already gone into reincarnation, so I told Yi’Er about your matters.
However, Yi’Er had long since thought you were dead..."
"So, you have reached the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace already?"
"Yes.
But in front of the Master, I am always the servant.
The Master can always call for my service..."
After saying the last sentence, Immortal Mother Xing quietly lifted her head, sneaking a glance at the young man before her.
The youth’s exterior was handsome, yet within lay a mysteriously terrifying elder.
For a moment, her mind started calculating, thinking that if she could get along well with this old monster, and then have him help Yi’Er, it wouldn’t be bad.
In her youth, she was a demoness, and having experienced the ups and downs of life, she naturally had some calculations in her mind.
Yi’Er’s foundation was shallow, requiring stronger power support.
And this old monster’s current form might be seen as a tiger fallen to flatland, and since calling her over, he naturally needed the power in her hands and her support.
Thus, it might not be a disaster, but rather a mutually beneficial agreement.
Song Yan squinted his eyes at her, thinking to himself, ’The Blood Slave Ancient Talisman can control the life and death of others with a thought, but what if the person doesn’t care about death at all, then what?
After a hundred years, who knows what kind of person this demoness named Xing’Er has grown into.
Forcing, after all, is not as good as voluntary.
Because if this Xing’Er resolves not to live and only seeks death, threatening me at the same time, that would be troublesome.’
Song Yan was never one to back "allies" into a corner, and he wasn’t a pretentious person.
Seeing the current Immortal Mother Xing sneak a look at him, he thoughtfully waved his hand.
Immortal Mother Xing was startled, her beautiful eyes starting to blur.
Song Yan smiled and praised, "You have progressed quite a bit."
Immortal Mother Xing completely understood what the youth was referring to, shyly saying, "It’s all thanks to the Master’s blessings..."
Song Yan said, "Tang Fan was not killed by me. Back then, I was overwhelmed myself, couldn’t protect even if I wanted to."
Immortal Mother Xing’s impression of Tang Fan had always been faint, and after a hundred years, she had pretty much forgotten. She nodded at this moment and said, "I know, Master."
Song Yan further stated, "You listen to me obediently, and I will naturally protect Tang Yi."
This statement precisely hit the heart of Immortal Mother Xing. Hearing this, the young woman was overjoyed. She suddenly looked up, her shy and blurred eyes revealing uncontrollable happiness and bold initiative.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
She softly said, "I will exhaust all my efforts, considering everything for my master."
Song Yan beckoned again.
The Immortal Mother Xing quickly stood up, drew back her grand yet conservative dark gown, and, as if partaking in some sacred "blood pact," gracefully seated herself atop the young man.
Nervously and shyly, she adjusted her posture, settled into position, and then began this "mutually beneficial union."
The night deepened.
A very deep night had already passed the third watch.
For a long time...
The winter moon hung high, with frost and snow radiating a pure white glow.
The Immortal Mother Xing attentively tidied up Song Yan, then donned her luxurious and dignified gown, ensuring not a hint of her snowy skin was exposed.
After all, she was the mother of a member of the Formless Ancient Race, and even when she descended to the Mortal World, her status was far above the Queen of the Country; thus, no mortal or common cultivator could envision her allure.
When she haughtily lifted her face, she resembled an iceberg, unapproachable. Should anyone dare speak words of desecration to her, she would furrow her brows and glare like a pure maiden, angrily rebuking "bold," and then ensure they paid the "painful price for insulting the Immortal Mother."
She had become the Immortal Mother, not a Demoness.
If anyone wished to see her demoness side, they would first have to break through her Immortal Mother facade.
And undoubtedly, the old monster before her could easily do so.
Even though this old monster now appeared only at the Refining Profound Realm, she did not underestimate him.
At this moment, the Immortal Mother Xing, while tidying her skirt, softly asked, "Master, how should I assist you?"
At this moment, she was not only controlled by the "Blood Slave Ancient Talisman," but her "heart" had also been entrusted to Song Yan. As long as Song Yan did not betray the "pact," this heart’s allegiance would remain quite stable.
Song Yan said, "Tell me in detail about the Hidden Dragon Association. You should not only be selecting talents from ordinary disciples, but also from the Crimson Palace Elders, right?"
The Immortal Mother Xing nodded and then began to speak smoothly.
A moment later, Song Yan roughly understood.
For the ordinary disciples, it involved selecting talents by regularly observing their martial prowess.
Those chosen may not necessarily be the victors, but their age, cultivation time, talent, and other factors are comprehensively considered...
But for the Crimson Palace Elders, the Ancient Race especially values the assessment of "Divine Soul orientation." If a Crimson Palace Elder has something special in their Divine Soul, they may be noticed.
As for the investigation method, it involves a "Divine Jade Scroll."
Holding that Divine Jade Scroll greatly stimulates the power within the Divine Soul, allowing the ancient race members to easily discern the strengths and weaknesses therein.
Song Yan earnestly inquired and then quickly contemplated.
The Immortal Mother Xing softly said at his side, "If the master has thoughts, feel free to share them with me. Over the years, I didn’t live in vain, for I have also grasped some means."
Song Yan said, "The less harmony between you and me on this matter, the fewer flaws there will be. Once your blood slave matter is exposed for me, neither you, I, nor Yi’Er will escape a tragic end. Let me think..."
Upon hearing this, the Immortal Mother Xing suddenly stopped inquiring.
Upon becoming the Immortal Mother, she had learned about major matters concerning the Mountain and Sea Demon Country’s magic, and she vaguely guessed that both Zhang Han the Ancestor and Tang Fan must have fallen within the "Chong King Soul Threshold."
And the matter of the "Chong King Soul Threshold" had caused a major upheaval in the Mountain and Sea Demon Country, bringing much power restructuring.
Such levels of strategic slaughter had long exceeded her imagination.
Although she was conceited and considered her means quite capable, she never thought she could be compared to the master before her—the one who crawled out from the center of a storm of blood and conspiracy.
At this moment, Song Yan slightly closed his eyes.
Many thoughts flashed through his mind.
If he were to escape to the Northern Land via the Ancient Teleportation Array, he could now have "Xing’Er claim discomfort, run straight to the Ancient Teleportation Array, and quickly transport to the north" with him.
But then what?
Anyone with a mind would check and know that the cultivator Xing Immortal Mother took away was named Song Han.
Why did the Immortal Mother Xing take him away?
This point would arouse great curiosity among the powerful beings, and he would have no place to hide.
The Demon Monk would not even need to wonder but would directly conclude that Song Han was Song Yan. In this way, both he, Xing’Er, and Tang Yi would become living targets.
The most direct path actually holds endless repercussions.
All other methods also come with significant risks and numerous traces.
Song Yan contemplated for a moment, his mind suddenly fixed, and he said, "The Immortal Mother need do nothing.
Just inform me in advance of the testing locations and times for the Divine Jade Scroll, and the inspection order of each sect.
Afterward... the Immortal Mother will naturally see me again."
Hearing her master’s respectful address, the Immortal Mother Xing immediately beamed, blooming like a flower. She nestled in Song Yan’s arms like a tiny bird, softly saying, "Xing’Er will henceforth be the master’s woman."
She nestled in the young man’s arms like a maiden, pondering that once they had crossed the Ancient Teleportation Array, she would immediately order all her courtiers to be slain.
Afterward... she could confidently proclaim, "The master is the second man in her life, also the most important one."
...
...
Several days later...
Winter snow gently danced, pure and crystalline.
Song Yan raised his hand to catch one, watching as the snowflake slowly melted in his palm.
The cold chill turned into a drop of warm water by the temperature of his palm.
The young man smiled slightly, withdrew his gaze, and then drew a yellow-skinned wine gourd from the void, tipping back to drink.
For some reason, since emerging from the Sea of Suffering, he had truly fallen in love with drinking.
He felt as if he were a floating leaf on water, a piece of wind-blown dandelion fluff, a rootless wanderer...
And the best companion for a wanderer was, of course, wine.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
Strong liquor!
What could be better than drinking a pot of fiery strong liquor in the dead of winter, and then snuggling up with a beautiful woman for a comfortable sleep?
The identity of this woman doesn’t matter at all.
What’s important is that as long as she’s pretty, doesn’t ask for anything in return, and preferably isn’t a good woman, that’s enough.
He suddenly thought of An Li.
He regretted having been a partner with An Li.
If he could do it all over again, he would undoubtedly never get involved with An Li.
An Li was the kind of girl one needed to stay with for a lifetime, never to part even white-haired.
And he simply couldn’t do it.
Thus, he had wronged her.
He didn’t mean to wrong anyone else.
But he ended up doing so anyway.
That was the only person he had truly wronged in his life.
Song Yan suddenly found it odd that someone who dealt daily with schemes, was vile and unscrupulous, and yet cared about a "little female cultivator he once wronged a hundred years ago," worried about whether "she has waited long and if she’s heartbroken."
Why did such trivial matters weigh heavily on his mind?
Making him think of that Refining Profound Level female cultivator, wondering if she survived the Crimson Palace Realm.
And if she did survive, what she might look like now.
Song Yan didn’t think any further, he lay back comfortably, pouring himself another drink, as for the woman to accompany him to sleep... he didn’t have one right now, but he soon would.
Because he had already asked the Outer Sect Steward of the Mo Sword Sect to check if there was any young lady from the mountain willing to become an "Immortal Sect Maid."
If there was, the young lady would be sent to his Cave Mansion to become his Furnace, and he would provide some simple cultivation methods as a reward.
If she had Profound Root, he would willingly recommend her to the Sect; if not, he would also gift her numerous elixirs and martial arts sought by mortals.
Thus, everyone would think that "Song Han" intended to stay longer.
Those Purple Mansion servants and Changwang cubs would, of course, not think that "the old monster eager to leave is, instead of clearing out the Cave Mansion, arranging staff within it to show he’s planning to reside here leisurely..."
To desire leaving, first make people think you plan to stay long.
This kind of maneuver was already second nature to him.
Gulp... Gulp... Gulp...
The strong liquor infused with Moonlight Grass trickled down his throat, entering his five viscera and six bowels.
A shallow flame burned quietly, lulling him into a daze.
Song Yan comfortably belched after drinking, but his Divine Sense remained locked on the "Moyun Palace" several miles away.
Even though his Divine Soul was strong, if he didn’t focus on a certain place at a certain time, no matter how strong, he couldn’t possibly know what happens there.
If it weren’t for the Immortal Mother informing him about "the joint testing of Mo Sword Sect’s Elder by the three Ancient Races today at the Moyun Palace," he wouldn’t have known that the testing was at this time, in such a remote place as Moyun Palace.
The distant testing soon commenced...
Song Yan’s powerful Divine Sense enveloped the area, everything inside was clear to him.
He could see everyone inside, but none could detect him.
Song Yan was very interested in exploring the changes within himself, but not now, as the current Mo Sword Sect couldn’t provide such information.
There were a total of sixteen elders from the Mo Sword Sect, and each was now taking out their "Divine Jade Scroll" for testing.
They resisted the pressure from the Jade Scroll with their Divine Soul Power, and when they achieved balance, the Jade Scroll would display the result.
In recent days, aside from Tang Yi of the Formless Ancient Race, the emissaries of the other two Ancient Races had arrived, watching together to see if any of the testers had good "Divine Soul Talent."
In the halls, judgmental voices echoed intermittently.
"Average."
"Next one."
"This one is alright, but not enough."
"Next one."
The Ancient Race emissaries carefully observed the Divine Soul Talent displayed by the "Divine Jade Scroll," yet they didn’t realize that the one watching above them was looking for something else.
Song Yan was discerning aura.
Changwang aura!
Changwang is cause and effect, entangled with the Divine Soul, it’s extremely difficult for outsiders to discern if a soul has been seized. Because the black tiger Changwang mark has already fused into the Divine Soul, how could anyone pry open the Divine Soul to look?
But Song Yan was different.
He might be one of the only two beings in the world who controlled the "Changwang Tiger Blood," making him extremely sensitive to the Changwang aura.
Normally, if the Changwang ghost didn’t use Divine Soul Power, he might find it hard to detect, but the moment they held the "Divine Jade Scroll" and had to use Divine Soul Power to resist, the faint Changwang aura could no longer hide.
As for the excuses of "feigning illness" or "absenteeism," those didn’t exist here either.
The Ancient Races were the Upper Envoy.
Which elder of the small Mo Sword Sect dared to be absent?
"Reversing positions" was Song Yan’s plan.
Without the Immortal Mother, he couldn’t execute the plan because he had no chance to identify which cultivators were Changwang ghosts.
But now, the opportunity had arrived.
As for why he needed to do this?
The reason was simple.
It’s because he wanted to preserve the winners of this "Hidden Dragon Association," allowing them to successfully pass through the Ancient Teleportation Array into the Ancient Country, and then disperse across various places, thereby becoming his "shields."
The Demon Monk wouldn’t know who he was but would see many cultivators heading north through the Hidden Dragon Association.
The Demon Monk would definitely acquire the list of these cultivators, and then... pursue and kill them one by one.
If these people hadn’t gone north and died here instead, wouldn’t that be reducing a lot of work for the Demon Monk?

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
Therefore, he must kill all the Crimson Palace-level spirits to prevent them from secretly attacking and prematurely killing those talented young cultivators who excel in the competition.
’One of them...’
’Oh, this one too?’
Song Yan muttered as he drank.
The differentiation of the aura went smoothly.
Among the sixteen Crimson Palace cultivators of the Mo Sword Sect, surprisingly, three were spirits; two at the Early Stage Crimson Palace and one at the Middle Stage.
He identified them but didn’t rush to act, quietly seeking opportunities to plant a Divine Soul tracking aura before returning to the cave mansion.
...
...
The next morning...
The Outer Sect Steward of Mo Sword Sect led a young maiden to the stone gate, knocking respectfully.
As the stone gate rumbled open, Song Yan walked out yawning, and the steward hurriedly said, "Brother Song, see if this maidservant is suitable?"
Then, the steward hurriedly handed over a dossier, which recorded the maiden’s family background, origins, even what her parents did, and detailed family assets.
Song Yan didn’t even look at it, pushing it back with a wave of his hand, and glanced at the maiden.
She had a sweet appearance, clothed in snow-white attire, with a fluffy fox tail wrapped around the collar, enhancing her snow-white, pinkish face.
Her small face quietly lifted at his gaze, but upon realizing the cultivator was a young man, she secretly felt relieved...
"Immortal Sect Maid" holds no status in the Immortal Sect but can bring great benefit to the family in the mortal world.
However...the immortals recruiting maids are not necessarily young; many are middle-aged or even...old men.
If an old man, there wouldn’t be much choice; but how can they compare to young ones?
"Zuo Yuzhu greets the Immortal,"
The maiden gracefully bowed.
Song Yan looked at her and said, "Follow me from now on. If I can go to the Northern Land through the Hidden Dragon Association, you will accompany me."
The maiden named Zuo Yuzhu didn’t know what "Hidden Dragon Association" was, but it seemed a great opportunity, making her even more delighted, "I am willing to follow the Immortal."
Song Yan took out a handful of Little Profound Jade Beans and tossed them to the steward, saying, "Thank you for your effort."
The steward chuckled, "You will surely pass, Brother Song. Everyone knows you are a genius."
Zuo Yuzhu listened with eager ears, her joy growing upon hearing the word "genius."
The next moment, her joy turned into a gasp, as the cultivator suddenly lifted her up and quickly hurried to the depths of the cave mansion.
The stone gate rumbled closed.
The maiden was tossed onto the bed.
Her garment slipped off, revealing a curvy body.
Seeing the Immortal pounce, she diligently complied and started moaning...
...
...
Over the following half month, nearby cultivators of Mo Sword Sect learned that "Song Han" had recruited another maidservant. Meanwhile, Song Yan, under the guise of "going out to train," followed the Ancient Race’s flying palanquin, identifying the spirits in the other four sects similarly.
Timing it right, he returned to the sect.
The Hidden Dragon Association was underway.
On the performance stage, contestants took turns.
Refining Profound cultivators stepped up one after another in the duel.
Various profound artifacts displayed dazzling brilliance!
Song Yan was watching when he suddenly felt someone looking at him. Glancing back, he saw a young cultivator in a brocade robe.
The cultivator was similar in build and coldly smiled at him, then arrogantly raised his head, showing extreme disdain.
Song Yan searched his memory to see if there was any grudge between him and the cultivator.
Upon finding it, he was speechless.
This cultivator named Dongfang Sheng was a typical "second-generation Immortal genius," who had little regard for "talents born in poverty" like him. The difference in status, along with being fellow talents naturally sparked some minor conflicts.
As Song Yan pondered, his name was already called on the other side of the stage.
The other name was Dongfang Sheng.
Both stepped onto the stage.
Dongfang Sheng sneered, "Ants should know their place. If you stayed in your hole, I wouldn’t care. But if you stand in my way, prepare to be humiliated."
Song Yan coldly retorted, "Not necessarily."
Then the two unleashed their flying swords, swiftly engaging in battle.
After a long fierce fight, one mistake, along with Dongfang Sheng suddenly pulling out a bell-shaped treasure, caused Song Yan’s flying sword to fall.
Seizing the opportunity, Dongfang Sheng, holding the bell-shaped treasure, fiercely activated it.
Dong~~~
A dull sound wave rapidly approached, striking Song Yan.
The protective aura shattered, sending the youth flying backward, lying among the crowd spitting blood, unable to get up.
Dongfang Sheng gave him a faint smile, then bowed towards the Ancient Race observers above.
High above...
Tang Yi sat at the top, nodding lightly at Dongfang Sheng’s victory, commenting, "Not bad."
The Immortal Mother of Apricot watched speechlessly as her master lay in the dust, unable to stand.
She had expected to see her master triumphantly beat opponents today, so she could immediately hint to her son that she fancied this youth upon receiving orders, naturally integrating him beside them and bringing him back once her son secluded himself for training; then she could fully assist the master’s recovery...thus securing her and her son’s position.
Instead, she witnessed this scene...
The deeper meaning here was beyond her comprehension...
But she knew her master would not act in vain.
Elsewhere, a Demon Monk’s Purple Mansion servant in the crowd discreetly removed "Song Han" from the "Hidden Dragon Association winners" list.
No matter how promising his victory was before, now...he lost, ensuring he could no longer be that formidable elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: 157. Turning the Guest into the Host, I Am Invincible Under the Purple Mansion (8.1K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_5
...
...
"I lost... I just want to be alone for a while..."
Song Yan bid farewell to the little maid in the Cave Mansion.
Zuo Yuzhu comforted him, "Immortal Elder, victory and defeat are common..."
Before she could finish, she was rudely pushed aside.
Song Yan yelled with a contorted face, "Common thing? What common thing?!"
He rushed out of the Cave Mansion, shouting, "You don’t understand, you understand nothing!"
His voice spread, audible to the cultivators in the surrounding Cave Mansions.
After that, Song Yan left in anger, controlling his sword as he flew away.
And after leaving Mo Sword Sect, he quickly began searching for the wandering ghosts using the aura he had previously planted.
...
Several days later...
An elder from a sect was controlling a sword, flying through the air.
A gray light shot up from the ground.
The elder, as if struck by lightning, fell to the ground, dead!
...
An elder from a sect was meditating with eyes closed in a Profound Land.
Gray light appeared!
The elder, dead!
...
An elder from a sect was practicing alchemy.
Gray light emerged!
Dead!
...
Two elders were on a cliff, seemingly plotting something.
Gray light appeared!
Dead!
The other person suddenly turned his head, simultaneously unfolding a defensive profound treasure.
Gray light appeared again!
Completely ignoring the profound treasure’s defense.
Dead!
...
Death, death, death, death, death!
Death, death, death, death, death!
...
Song Yan moved along, killing along the way.
He killed these Crimson Palace elders as easily as squashing ants.
Those Crimson Palace elders didn’t even see the person or feel the enemy’s attack before their lives ended.
His current state was very strange.
Clearly, his body was extremely weak, only at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound. Any Crimson Palace cultivator could easily crush him, but his Divine Soul was astonishingly strong.
Above the Purple Mansion was untested...
But below the Purple Mansion, he was completely invincible. Hardly anyone could withstand even a single strike from him.
No matter the kind of Crimson Palace Blood, it was impossible to block the gray light shooting from his brow.
This was a complete Dimensional Reduction Strike.
...
More than a month later...
Fifteen Wandering Ghosts from five sects were all completely wiped out by him.
Now, he had returned to Mo Sword Sect but did not head toward the Cave Mansion. Instead, he went to a wilderness area.
In the thin mist of that wilderness, Profound Qi was swirling, where Dongfang Sheng was cultivating.
Dongfang Sheng’s face was calm, but inwardly he was overjoyed.
Because he was chosen!
He had become the winner of the "Hidden Dragon Association" and would follow the Ancient Race back to the Northern Land.
He dismissed the Furnace, packed his belongings, and was waiting for the Ancient Race to set off.
Now, in this place where he used to practice swordsmanship, he revisited the past, as it seemed... he wouldn’t be returning this way again.
Dongfang Sheng thought of all these years of cultivation, and couldn’t help but sigh to himself. He then thought of Song Han, whom he defeated in the competition of the Hidden Dragon Association, and couldn’t help but feel a secret pride.
His mind was finally at ease.
As for Song Han, he had inquired and found that it seemed Song Han couldn’t bear the humiliation and left the Cave Mansion in anger, not knowing where he went.
Now, this place bordered on the front line with the Mountain and Sea Demon Race, and it was indeed normal for him to die outside in such a state.
Dongfang Sheng shook his head, recalling his past opponent with the pity of a victor, then smiled faintly, stood up, and said, "It’s all in the past."
He felt his mental realm was rapidly elevating.
He had stepped over his past opponents to reach higher grounds.
"Thank you."
He softly said to the sky, then raised his hand, casting a spell, letting his flying sword hover.
Just as he was about to transform into a rainbow and return to the Cave Mansion, a sudden sharp pain struck from his brow.
In a flash, in an instant, his consciousness was gone.
If he still had consciousness, he would definitely hear the footsteps approaching from not far away.
Someone was walking in the mist.
That person came before him, bent down to pick up his storage bag, quickly dealt with his body, and then... left.
...
...
Half a month later...
The Ancient Race dispatched a Void Ship.
The Void Ship stopped at each point to pick up people.
Dongfang Sheng also boarded a void ship and then went to a cabin to rest.
Three flying palanquins of the Formless Ancient Race were proceeding ahead, with the Void Ship following behind.
In such a front-and-back manner, they soon reached the Ancient Teleportation Array.
The once desolate and uninhabited lush forest had long been developed, the surroundings resembling steep and mighty passes, with a Purple Mansion cultivator stationed there.
At the Ancient Teleportation Array, Immortal Mother Xing looked on with a strange expression, her beautiful face showing both anticipation and anxiety, while beside her was her son’s voice.
"Mother, I will go with the elders of the clan to cultivate. This trip might take decades. If you fancy any little cultivator, feel free to bring him over."
Immortal Mother Xing softly replied, "Yi’Er, focus on your cultivation, no need to worry about your mother."
Tang Yi nodded, standing proudly, waiting to see the distant void ship emerge from the clouds, then faintly stated, "Here it comes."
And at that moment, Immortal Mother Xing felt a strong connection from a blood slave emerging again. Her gaze swept across, watching the void ship approach and descend, watching the cultivators disembark from the void ship, until she saw an entirely unfamiliar face on a cultivator exuding the aura of her master, and she was utterly stunned.
She looked again, unable to discern any falseness in the master’s face, as if... it was indeed the master’s own face.
Despite being an Immortal Mother, well-informed and knowledgeable about various matters of the Formless Ancient Race.
So, in that moment, a word suddenly burst in her mind.
With an expression of surprise and incredulity spreading slowly across her beautiful eyes.
’That is... the Faceless Mask?!’
’Only the Faceless Mask can change appearances so effortlessly, with everything according to one’s wishes. But... how is this possible?’
Immortal Mother Xing’s heart raced wildly.
She felt as if the world had gone mad.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 158. Today I finally realized I am myself, and I have returned ’home’! (8.2K words - a large Chapter, please subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: 158. Today I finally realized I am myself, and I have returned ’home’! (8.2K words - a large Chapter, please subscribe)
Twelve Refining Profound disciples favored by the Formless Ancient Race through the Hidden Dragon Association, but only one Crimson Palace Elder passed the "Divine Jade Scroll" test.
As for the others who were favored, they naturally left with other ancient races.
The Void Ship and the Flying Palanquin of the ancient race descended onto the Ancient Teleportation Array.
The Purple Mansion Cultivator stationed there actually came personally and saluted the Flying Palanquin.
He was not of the ancient race, but a Purple Mansion Cultivator of the Ancient Country, so even if there were juniors of the Crimson Palace inside the palanquin, he had to salute, even if the latter ignored him, it was normal.
However, at this moment, the curtain of the Flying Palanquin lifted, and a tall and handsome figure leaped out, seeing the Purple Mansion Cultivator, respectfully saluted, and smiled: "Greetings, Mr. Wang."
The Purple Mansion Cultivator called Mr. Wang returned the salute with a smile: "Young Master Tang Yi."
The handsome figure smiled and said: "I do not dare to be called Young Master, in front of you, I am just a junior."
After that, Tang Yi saluted again, saying: "Sir, I will return to the palanquin first. If there is an opportunity in the future, I will visit specially."
Mr. Wang stroked his beard, nodded, and laughed heartily: "Young Master Yi, you’re too polite. I acknowledge you as a friend."
Though he had no deep connection with Tang Yi, the other’s special gesture of stepping out from the palanquin to salute made him feel a spring breeze brushing his face, secretly thinking "judging by character, this young one’s future seems quite bright."
He knew Tang Yi was a descendant that the Formless Ancient Race had found in the Southern Land of this continent decades ago.
Such descendants often suffer greatly outside, and once they become part of the ancient race, it’s normal for them to act arrogant and haughty outside.
Over a thousand years ago, the descendants that the ancient race lost here were far more than those found nowadays. Even now, as he serves as the rotating guard of this Ancient Teleportation Array, he is also tasked with continuing the search for ancient race descendants.
During these times, he had succeeded once, seeing the "foolishly triumphant faces" of some people, so seeing Tang Yi being so humble and polite, he couldn’t help but sigh inwardly that this young one is different.
The hardships of turbulent times hadn’t made him feel inferior, nor had the news of becoming part of the ancient race driven him mad. Instead, it all forged his character.
Mr. Wang praised with a laugh: "When we meet next, Young Master Yi should have already become a Purple Mansion."
Tang Yi replied: "Thank you for your kind words, sir."
With that, he let down the curtain.
A moment later, the Ancient Teleportation Array began to activate.
As several beams of light rose, the Flying Palanquin and the Void Ship were enveloped.
...
In the next instant...
Whoosh whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Amidst the clear sky in the Northern Land, on a teleportation array, the Void Ship and Flying Palanquin suddenly appeared.
Song Yan stood by the railing, looking at the green mountains and waters here, feeling a momentary relief as the sense of "shackles, oppression, danger" that had been far from him temporarily lifted.
He slightly turned his head, just in time to meet the gaze of the Immortal Mother of Apricot who was discreetly peeking out the window of the last flying palanquin.
Their eyes met from afar and quickly withdrew.
Song Yan turned back, returned to his private compartment, and sat cross-legged.
The trace of thought from Feng Chengzi had almost been assimilated by him and could now be mobilized at will.
However, he still needs to familiarize himself with its mysteries as it might be another "key" to infiltrating the Formless Ancient Race besides the "Faceless Mask."
But how to infiltrate?
He needs a foolproof plan.
And, for this, he needs the Immortal Mother of Apricot.
On the other side...
Inside the flying palanquin, the Immortal Mother of Apricot’s heartbeat has gradually calmed, and she quickly took out a Communication Jade, secretly transmitting messages.
She was no longer alone now.
She held control over certain forces of her own.
Many cultivators looking to advance or gain favor with the Formless Ancient Race tried to find her and please her, hoping she would introduce them with a few words like "this person is quite talented and might be useful." If these cultivators were indeed used by the ancient race, they would be marked with the Immortal Mother of Apricot’s imprint and seen as Tang Yi’s people.
Among them, there were many death warriors loyal to the Immortal Mother of Apricot.
"Kill those three paramours and clean up, leaving no traces," the Immortal Mother of Apricot instructed lightly.
Her expression was cold, one cheek illuminated by sunlight, the other shrouded in shadows, giving her a variable appearance.
From the other side came a respectful response.
"Yes, Immortal Mother."
After transmitting her message, the Immortal Mother of Apricot quickly retrieved an Immortal Mirror from the void and began to groom herself slightly.
She must find a way to retain that old monster.
At the same time, she had some guesses about the old monster’s purpose.
After all, at this point, with the map fully revealed and the dagger drawn, knowing the origins of the old monster, it would be foolish not to see through it.
...
...
Half a month later...
In a city temporary under the Formless Ancient Race’s jurisdiction where they could rest...
Array Flags that concealed auras were placed at the corners of a pavilion.
On the great bed in the pavilion, waves surged as scheming men and women indulged...
It was a long time before they stopped.
One wants to cling to a great tree to stabilize his own and his son’s status, the other wants to use the other to integrate into the Formless Ancient Race. It was mutually beneficial with no love involved; this union was merely to strengthen their alliance, and it was but a way to add warmth and credibility to their cold interests.
At this moment, the Immortal Mother of Apricot lay in Song Yan’s embrace, like a little bird depending on someone, or an obedient wife.
She gently hugged the young man’s broad waist and softly said: "These years, I have been alone. Even as the old tree grows more rings, and the vast sea turns to mulberry fields, I have never sought another man."

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_2
Song Yan said, "Why?"
Immortal Mother Xing playful chided, "Having once seen the elegance of the ancestor, how could other common folks catch my eye again?
If not for the ancestor insisting on me doing that back in the day, I... I truly wished to serve the ancestor with all my heart."
Her ten fingernails were soaked in dark Profound Flower Juice, and on her pinky was a sharp, ornate dark gold finger cover, showing hands that were unmistakably those of a noblewoman, untouchable and delicate.
Yet these delicate hands began to softly caress and rub Song Yan’s body.
Immortal Mother Xing continued to rub him while softly cooing, "Reuniting with the ancestor has truly made me so happy. From now on, Yi’Er and I will rely on the ancestor, hee hee hee..."
She could tell the young man before her was merely at the Refining Profound Realm.
However, her Blood Slave Ancient Talisman did not react at all.
This indicated that his true power was far beyond her own, surpassing even the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace, otherwise, it would’ve backfired.
It was precisely for this reason she exerted herself so diligently to please this old monstrosity, displaying utter devotion akin to "eternal love, sharing the same nest, growing old together," because she had no clue what realm this monster truly inhabited.
And regarding such "scheming Immortal Mothers evolved from demonesses," Song Yan was very well aware. Therefore, no matter what the other side expected, he could always respond appropriately with fierceness and actions rather than putting on a facade of "untainted by the mud" with stern rebukes.
If it were when he first transmigrated, he would only feel disgust and discomfort towards such demonesses, his heart only accepting women as pure as Su Yao was in the early days.
But now...
He felt his heart was gone.
Or rather, his heart had turned black, and he was filthy beyond repair.
He was a demon king.
A demon king matched with a demoness; isn’t that a perfect fit?
Those who slay dragons inevitably become one, thought Song Yan as he gazed at the squirming, tender "big white worm" before him, feeling an inexpressible self-mockery within.
Suddenly, Immortal Mother Xing rose slightly, pulled a veiling robe around herself, and drifted off the couch, reaching for a Storage Bag on the side.
Then she retrieved a peculiar Jade Scroll, cradling it with both hands before kneeling and presenting it to Song Yan.
Song Yan looked at the Jade Scroll.
The Jade Scroll bore resemblance to the previous "Divine Jade Scroll" he had seen, yet it seemed different as well.
Immortal Mother Xing looked at him with a sense of achievement.
The demon king and the demoness exchanged glances, but neither spoke a word.
Song Yan suddenly grabbed the Jade Scroll.
The demoness took the chance to snuggle into his embrace, rubbing her small foot against his calf, and softly said, "It was quite hard to obtain from Yi’Er, wasn’t it? Doesn’t the master want to reward Xing’Er well?"
Song Yan countered, "Is this the thing that tests the bloodline of the Formless Ancient Race?"
Immortal Mother Xing softly replied, "Yes, it is."
Song Yan chuckled, "I didn’t even mention it, yet you knew to bring it out. You’ve improved."
Immortal Mother Xing giggled, "If I didn’t improve, how could I be worthy of the master?"
With that, she flipped over once more, half-pressing on the young man’s body, earnestly explaining, "To this day, there are still descendants scattered across the Southern Land who have not been found. So, the Formless Ancient Race distributed these bloodline testing Jade Scrolls to every clansman.
Their aim is to recover the clansmen from back in the day as soon as possible. If the master can pass this Jade Scroll’s test, it will verify the identity... At most, add a Faceless Mask, and that would be enough."
At the mention of the Faceless Mask, Immortal Mother Xing feigned nonchalance while subtly observing Song Yan’s reaction.
Song Yan bluntly said, "This mask, in terms of inheritance, should have been your son’s."
Immortal Mother Xing hadn’t expected the master to be so direct, pausing momentarily before smiling and saying, "Aren’t Yi’Er and I both yours as well?"
Song Yan ignored the demoness.
As long as the interests weren’t completely at odds, as long as he wasn’t pushed into a corner, this demoness would never oppose him.
As for the backlash of the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman?
Song Yan had confidence in this.
Relying solely on Immortal Mother Xing, it was absolutely impossible to backfire against him.
This is the advantage of a demoness.
No matter how intimately you’ve shared pleasure, you can still calmly calculate the interests between each other without considering emotions, thus avoiding any cause and effect, or heart demons.
At this moment, he carefully examined the "Formless Ancient Race Bloodline Testing Jade Scroll" before him.
He attempted to grasp it casually, immediately feeling a surge of Divine Soul Power from within, forcing him to mobilize his Divine Soul Power to resist.
Then, that power instantly vanished.
The Jade Scroll showed no response.
Song Yan squinted and began to ponder.
Immortal Mother Xing sweetly said beside him, "Master, if the test is passed, the Jade Scroll will emit golden light. The stronger the Divine Soul, the brighter the golden light."
Song Yan nodded, briefly recalling the process just now.
His Divine Soul was extremely sharp, quickly grasping the core principle of this "testing Jade Scroll."
This principle was similar to "recognizing kin by blood."
Of course, "recognizing kin by blood" wasn’t very reliable, but this "testing Jade Scroll" was indeed reliable.
The "Divine Jade Scroll" used a moderate diviner soul invasion to naturally induce a divine soul resistance in the target, thus allowing the testing of the "Innate Divine Soul Strength," "Divine Soul Talent," etc.
The "testing Jade Scroll" added an additional step on the foundation of the "Divine Jade Scroll," which was: sampling.
Taking a wisp of aura from the divine soul and comparing it with the aura of the clansman stored within the Jade Scroll, if it matched, then it would pass.
Song Yan secretly rejoiced that he hadn’t only relied on a Faceless Mask to recognize kin. Otherwise, this very step would have already unmasked him, resulting not only in failing to join the Formless Ancient Race but also being relentlessly hunted down by them.
Immortal Mother Xing leaned slightly forward and suddenly said, "Master, it’s not absolutely necessary to join the Formless Ancient Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_3
Yi’Er is going to break through to the Purple Mansion, and he’s considerate to look for someone to accompany me.
I introduced you to Yi’Er, saying that I like you very much. Then you can naturally join me openly, afterward..."
Before the words finished, the Immortal Mother’s beautiful eyes suddenly reflected a faint golden light. She was shocked and covered her mouth, exclaiming in disbelief, "This... how is this possible?"
In her eyes, the Jade Scroll in the youth’s hand was emitting golden light, and the golden light fluctuated between dim and bright, sometimes like a candle flame illuminating a small area, sometimes like a fireball illuminating the entire room.
"Is this impossible? Is the Jade Scroll broken? This... no... impossible..."
The Immortal Mother was dumbstruck by this unbelievable scene.
Song Yan said, "I am originally from the Formless Race, so this is naturally not difficult for me."
Immortal Mother couldn’t help but say, "But your surname is Zhang..."
Song Yan calmly said, "It’s merely because a farmer who adopted me hundreds of years ago had that surname. My real surname, I do not know. I... am just an abandoned infant."
Earlier, he took a chance and sent a trace of the Divine Infant’s aura from Feng Chengzi into the Jade Scroll. Unexpectedly, the Jade Scroll accepted it directly.
As for the strength of the light, it was entirely under his control.
Now, his Divine Soul had reached a terrifying level that a mere Jade Scroll couldn’t test.
If he wished his Divine Soul to be strong, it was strong.
If he wanted to feign weakness, no one could see through it.
What’s even more wonderful is that his realm is currently only the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound.
Who would suspect a little guy at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound of deception?
Thinking of the subtlety, Song Yan grinned, revealing his lustrous white teeth, and laughed, "Jie Jie Jie," then raised his hands to the sky excitedly, "Today I finally know who I am!
Today I finally know I am from the Formless Race!
I’m going home!
I’m finally going home!!"
The Immortal Mother was already stunned.
She completely didn’t understand what was going on.
In her eyes, the master’s mysterious and terrifying power had reached a higher level, making her both awed and delighted.
Demonesses are naturally fond of the strong, especially those strong in their own camp, whom they favor even more.
After a brief moment of astonishment, she threw herself onto Song Yan, giggling, "Congratulations, Master, congratulations, Master, but please don’t forget Yi’Er and me."
Song Yan, rubbing her hair, fell into thought, then began exchanging information and making plans with the Immortal Mother...
...
...
In the blink of an eye, several months passed.
Summer was at its peak.
The sounds of cicadas were like a torrential rain, echoing in a quaint garden.
The garden was not in the human world but connected to a Secret Realm.
Without the keys, one could never enter this Secret Realm, and from the outside... even the most advanced Qi Observation Skill could not detect anything unusual.
At the garden entrance, three figures suddenly appeared.
They were: Song Yan, Tang Yi, and the Immortal Mother.
Tang Yi patted Song Yan’s shoulder, saying familiarly, "You don’t need to be nervous, Xiao Han. Although this is the Ancestral Vein Secret Realm of my Formless Ancient Race, it is also your home. Now, I will take you to meet the elders of the clan. You just need to pass the test and enter the clan register, then everything will be fine."
He exuded a naturally irresistible charisma, like a born leader, lamenting, "When I first came here, I was like you, trembling, even feeling inferior to raise my eyes.
But it will all pass.
You and I are both from the Southern Land and are both of the Formless Ancient Race, truly destined. Though we share the same clan, our relationship should indeed be deeper, so why don’t we..."
Tang Yi thought for a moment, a hint of contemplation flickered in his handsome features, but he did not pause much as he said, "Why don’t we call each other brothers in the future, I’m slightly older, you can..."
Before he finished speaking, the Immortal Mother interrupted, "Yi’Er, your age difference is so vast, how can you call each other brothers?"
Tang Yi, who always listened to the Immortal Mother, smiled at the words and said, "Then, we can’t address each other as uncle or grandfather, can we? That would be too distant?"
The Immortal Mother said, "You’re both from the Southern Land, not only co-clansmen but also from the same hometown, naturally close; why need these mundane titles to over-complicate?"
She couldn’t even imagine the old monster calling her son "big brother, uncle, or grandfather," so she hurriedly interrupted.
Tang Yi laughed heartily, "That’s true."
Then, patting Song Yan’s shoulder with a demeanor fit for a senior, earnestly said, "Song... no, you should be called Tang Han from now on. Rest assured. I have completely covered up the matter of Dongfang Sheng for you.
In this trial, cultivators from my clan have suffered substantial casualties, and Dongfang Sheng has died in it too. As for the person you mentioned who is watching you, your vendetta, that would be for you to deal with. I will not interfere or overstep.
To have this enemy, to nurture this enemy, and to avenge it later, will be beneficial for your Mental Realm."
Song Yan cupped his fist and said, "Thank you, Brother Yi."
The Immortal Mother couldn’t bear to watch this scene.
After that night’s secret discussion, she naturally found a chance to pull Tang Yi into the small circle.
Song Yan’s reasoning was "Dongfang Sheng had a grudge against him, he dared not expose his Faceless Mask, and a Loose Cultivator seemed suspicious of him, wanting to get treasures from him. Therefore, he killed Dongfang Sheng, impersonated Dongfang Sheng, then secretly found the Immortal Mother for help. The Immortal Mother, benevolent as she is, hastily brought him to meet Tang Yi after confirming he was from the Formless Race."
Afterward, Tang Yi slightly increased the difficulty of the "Hidden Dragon Association Winner’s" entry-level test.
Of course, these winners were not only cultivators of the Five Sects of Ancient Jin, but also many cultivators from vassal states under the Formless Ancient Race.
Scattered here and there, over a hundred people participated in the test.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: 158. Today I finally realize that I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - large Chapter asking for subscription)_4
Afterwards, more than twenty people perished within.
This kind of death toll is quite normal, as the Ancient Race is very strict in selecting its subordinates.
Thus, after Dongfang Sheng’s reasonable death, Song Yan returned to his "original appearance" and then came to the Ancient Clan Manor with Tang Yi and Immortal Mother Xing.
Tang Yi thought for a while, his eyes glancing at Immortal Mother Xing, and suddenly said, "Xiao Han, it was thanks to my mother this time. And after today, I need to follow the elders of the clan to break through the Purple Mansion Realm. My mother will be left alone here, with no one to take care of her. How about... you acknowledge her as your adopted mother?"
Immortal Mother Xing: ...
Song Yan: ...
Song Yan took a deep breath and was about to speak when Immortal Mother Xing interrupted again and said, "What adopted mother, Yi’er, are you trying to control your mother’s affairs too much?"
Tang Yi was momentarily stunned, casting a peculiar look at his mother, hurriedly saying, "Your son wouldn’t dare."
As for Song Yan, his reaction was quite normal, nothing unusual.
At this moment, a kindly voice came from the garden.
"Come in."
Tang Yi patted Song Yan’s shoulder, saying, "Xiao Han, this is the third grandfather who will test you. Go on."
Song Yan nodded and strode inside.
Once his figure disappeared behind the archway, Tang Yi softly asked, "Mother, why did you refuse Tang Han acknowledging you as an adopted mother?"
Immortal Mother Xing snapped, "You should focus more on your cultivation.
Just know that as long as Tang Han shares our intentions, there’s no need to bind with such empty names.
In the future, you should get closer, support each other on the path of cultivation, and get along well."
Tang Yi understood his mother.
If someone isn’t truly trustworthy, she wouldn’t say such things.
But why does that boy earn his mother’s trust so much?
Suddenly, he thought of a possibility and then bitterly smiled, "Mother, are you really going to... Ah, Xiao Han is a clansman of our Formless Race. What is going on here?"
Immortal Mother Xing glared at him and angrily said, "Do you think your mother is a woman full of capricious whims?"
Tang Yi repeatedly shook his head, hastily apologizing.
Immortal Mother Xing thought to herself without a word: ’If there’s any playing happening, it’s that old monster playing me, not the other way around...’
...
While the two were quietly waiting, birds suddenly scattered skyward above the garden not far away, exotic beasts flapped their wings.
Countless glaring golden lights spread out from the forest, appearing like the morning sun rising in the courtyard, casting a golden sheen over the leaf-laden trees.
In the courtyard, a middle-aged man who had been leisurely lying in a deck chair, fanning himself, suddenly sat up, gazing in disbelief at the scene before him, his eyes locking ever more brightly onto the young man.
That young man was merely over twenty, yet the Jade Scroll he held was emanating a glaring golden light.
The strength of the golden light indicated the strength of the Innate Divine Soul.
Such a level of golden light could already rank among the top in the history of the Formless Ancient Race.
The forefront individuals have all successfully stepped into the Divine Infant Realm.
But in this generation of the Formless Ancient Race, there is only one Divine Infant!
The middle-aged man gazed dumbfounded at the youth enveloped in golden light, suddenly bursting into laughter, his laughter like the roar of thunder, following with three exclamations: "Good! Good! Good!!"
He jumped up abruptly, clapping his hand on Song Yan’s shoulder, saying, "From today forth, you are part of the Formless Race, and I shall add your name to the genealogy.
Now the Clan Leader is in seclusion, many clansmen are scattered outside, and it’s impossible to recognize each one individually.
But that doesn’t matter, in fifty years, there will be a family gathering.
On that day, all clansmen will return regardless of how busy they are or where they are, for this is our Formless Ancient Race tradition.
A tradition of gathering once every hundred years!
Everyone respects this tradition...
Ah, look at my babbling nature.
Come, child, let’s walk and talk.
My name is Tang Xiaokong, you may call me Third Grandfather."
The Formless Ancient Race elder named Tang Xiaokong had now drastically changed his original attitude, becoming extremely amiable.
Initially, he had intended to put this newly recognized junior in line, since he’d heard some younger members of the Ancient Race were insolent and arrogant outside.
Who the junior harmed or killed didn’t really matter.
What mattered was, how could the junior possess such an "insolent and arrogant" Mental Realm?
This is extremely unsuitable for future cultivation!
So, upon knowing another junior had been found, Tang Xiaokong, although happy inside, planned to sternly admonish to temper the other’s heart. Yet he never expected this junior to be an extremely rare prodigy.
Such Divine Soul intensity in today’s Formless Ancient Race is perhaps comparable only to the Clan Leader and the genius nurtured with all the clan’s resources.
No!
Even that genius might fall slightly short.
While it’s said two tigers cannot coexist on one mountain, a family is not just one mountain; here, prodigies should coexist, and should never become enemies.
Tang Xiaokong delighted inwardly, contemplating how to preemptively resolve the "potential conflict between these two geniuses."
But this resolution would have to wait until fifty years later.
At this time, he familiarly hooked the boy’s shoulder, smiling warmly, "Child, I’ll take you to the ancestral hall to pay respects, then enter your name into the genealogy. On the way, I’ll talk to you about some things."
Song Yan was respectful and courteous, neither humble nor arrogant, saying, "Please speak, Third Grandfather."
He dared not underestimate the person in front of him in the slightest.
For he couldn’t discern the cultivation realm of the one before him, nor whether the person was strong or weak.
He couldn’t tell if the person was Refining Profound Realm, Crimson Palace Realm, Purple Mansion Realm, or even higher?
Such a situation was something he was encountering for the first time.
Tang Xiaokong, seeing his demeanor and expression, was increasingly satisfied, saying, "My Formless Ancient Race governs a total of sixteen Mortal Countries, more than a hundred sects, too numerous to count.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 158. Today I finally realize I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: 158. Today I finally realize I am myself, I have returned "home"! (8.2K words - big Chapter asking for subscription)_5
They all regard us with great respect, as ordinary people in the Mortal World would see an emperor.
Such honor can easily lead one astray, indulging in pleasures and neglecting cultivation.
At worst, one’s power would stagnate, and at worst... become a short-sighted fool.
You must absolutely refrain from this."
Song Yan sincerely replied, "Third Grandfather, rest assured, I will certainly not."
Tang Xiaokong said, "Additionally, while you’re outside, you may seek women at will, but must not leave any descendants, nor may you form a Dao companion.
At the family gathering fifty years later, you will naturally find a family Dao companion of like mind. This is very important, do not forget it."
