Song Yan was astonished, "I always maintain my purity and would never act recklessly outside, risking my family’s reputation."
Tang Xiaokong nodded with satisfaction, adding, "Family reputation is not important, such trifles cannot destroy a bit of it, but you must focus on cultivating your Mental Realm.
Regarding the Mental Realm, it’s of little importance at your current Realm, but once you enter the Purple Mansion, it can be deadly. Without achieving that Mental Realm, you cannot break through to the next Realm."
Song Yan looked at him with a gaze full of curiosity.
If it were an ordinary clan member, Tang Xiaokong would surely say "Don’t aim too high," but for the family prodigy before him, he was indeed quite intrigued, so he explained: "That Realm is still far from you. If you were aware, it would only influence your current cultivation.
But you can know; humans have good and evil, and a self too.
Evil thoughts are killing thoughts, which our kind of cultivators naturally lack not.
Good thoughts are Protective Thoughts, which must slowly form amidst the ordinary.
As for the self-thought, one must firmly establish the Dao heart, not to be lost in worldly allure."
Song Yan shuddered, slightly nodding: "Junior understands."
Yet in his heart, he couldn’t help but sigh.
He had always been struggling in the most desperate environment, filled with evil killing thoughts, truly clueless on how to cultivate good thoughts.
This step, he feared would be ten times or even a hundred times harder than for other cultivators.
Tang Xiaokong naturally did not know his concerns. As they walked far, he suddenly lowered his voice: "Child, there’s one more thing you must keep in mind.
Every Ancient Race has its own characteristics, not only with the inheritance of Innate Divine Soul Secret Techniques but also the clan’s own inheritance within.
And the inheritance of our Formless Ancient Race is the Faceless Mask."
His voice became lower: "Although Tang Yi, who brought you here, has commendable talent and adequate effort, he is incomplete because he lacks the Faceless Mask, so... everyone knows he, Tang Yi, is of our Formless Ancient Race. However, no one knows me..."
His face rapidly changed, no longer a middle-aged man but an elderly man, with a low and transformed voice: "I am not Tang Xiaokong."
Another change, the old man became a youth, with a carefree and magnetic, hearty voice: "I am Tang Xiaokong."
In a moment, his face changed over ten times, the voice oscillating between "I am not Tang Xiaokong" and "I am Tang Xiaokong."
Finally, Tang Xiaokong reverted to his original appearance and smiled: "Mystery is the greatest trait of our Formless Ancient Race. Should I ever approach you under a different identity, you wouldn’t be able to detect it.
Everyone knows us Formless Race people are formidable, but don’t know which people are of the Formless Race, to which the Faceless Mask plays an extremely critical role.
And there’s also a companion Secret Technique to hide one’s aura, which I’ll share with you later.
Without this mask, one is incomplete.
Though Tang Yi lost the mask inheritance, he has our blood in him, so the clan took this opportunity to thrust him out, letting him represent our Formless Ancient Race, which now makes it convenient to carry out affairs.
This time, he went to break through the Purple Mansion Realm, and after extending his lifespan by a thousand years, he can handle some external family affairs, but this... is actually the most lowly of matters for our Formless Ancient Race.
Keep this in mind, do not speak of it further."
As they spoke, they had already arrived at the ancestral hall of the Formless Ancient Race.
The ancestral hall was not luxurious, yet adequately ancient.
Song Yan looked at the ancestral hall and couldn’t resist recalling the empty rooms seen in the Tumor Realm’s first Secret Realm.
Tang Xiaokong looked through the family records.
The family records clearly listed identities of the ever lineage members.
As for the clan members who wandered outside, they can be noted on a single line with reasons indicated.
But evidently, the treatment for the prodigy before him was unsuitable.
Thus, as Tang Xiaokong flipped through the records, he pondered whom to affiliate the younger generation with.
Suddenly, his eyes lit up, he closed his eyes seemingly communicating with someone.
After a stick of incense time, he opened his eyes and hesitantly said: "Child, I will first enroll you in the registry; as for whom you’ll be attached to, let’s discuss it after fifty years."
Song Yan respectfully said, "I await Third Grandfather’s arrangement."
Soon, Tang Xiaokong picked up the broad pen attached to the records, touching Song Yan’s brow. Song Yan hurriedly stirred Feng Chengzi’s aura beyond the Divine Soul.
He sensed the pen seemingly directly reaching his Divine Soul.
After that, Tang Xiaokong inscribed the words "Tang Han" in the family records.
After completing all this, he led Song Yan to bow to the clan’s spiritual tablets, then took out an odd gold wooden token and a Storage Bag, handing them to Song Yan, and said, "This token is our clan’s identity proof, once bound it belongs entirely to you, if encountering strong enemies outside, you may directly use this token to resist. Our clan’s Late Stage of the Purple Mansion, even the clan leader leaves thoughts within. They will act remotely through this token.
As for the Storage Bag, it contains some secret techniques accompanying the Faceless Mask. You can stay in the garden for some time, when you learn them all, I’ll arrange follow-ups. As for Tang Yi, I’ll send him back first, he... is not yet qualified to walk very close to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 159. Good Days Have Come! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: 159. Good Days Have Come! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)
Formless Ancient Race, Ancestral Vein Secret Realm, at the entrance...
Tang Yi and Immortal Mother Xing were still waiting.
But time had passed for so long, long enough for the young man who entered to have come out.
Suddenly, Tang Yi sighed lightly and said, "Mother, there’s no need to wait anymore. I’m afraid Brother Han won’t be coming out."
He closed his eyes in pain, but when he opened them, he reverted to his original positive demeanour, sunny and approachable.
Immortal Mother Xing showed a look of astonishment and was about to inquire, but was interrupted by Tang Yi.
Tang Yi softly said, "If Brother Han were just an ordinary member of the Formless Race, it wouldn’t be so. But that golden light just now is enough to prove his terrifying talent. He... is truly a prodigy of our race."
After speaking, he smiled and said, "To have found such a prodigy for our race, I, Tang Yi, feel deeply honored!"
Immortal Mother Xing immediately understood, feeling somewhat silent, but subconsciously thinking that no matter what happened to the old monster, it was not surprising because... he was a monster who survived from the Soul Threshold of the Zombie King—a monster who, even at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, could still control her with the Blood Slave Ancient Talisman without being counterattacked.
Such a monster is naturally strong in Divine Soul.
But then, Immortal Mother Xing seemed to suddenly realize something, and a faint trace of fear appeared in her eyes.
As her thoughts became clearer, the fear grew increasingly intense.
She originally thought that the old monster needed her and Yi’Er, but the old monster was able to pass the test of the Formless Ancient Race. Even so, she was not panicked because even if the old monster became a member of the Formless Race, he lacked a foundation and needed to ally with her and Yi’Er. This was beneficial for everyone.
But now, everything has changed!
That old monster suddenly became a prodigy of the Formless Ancient Race; he no longer needed such an alliance.
In other words, to that old monster, she and Yi’Er... already had little value.
Instead, she... knew too much.
’I don’t want to die... I still don’t want to die...’
Immortal Mother Xing felt her heart pounding furiously, and intense fear made her limbs weak, her mouth dry.
She had already calculated clearly for that old monster: Only if she died from an accident could the old monster’s secret be completely hidden.
But she couldn’t tell anyone, and if she didn’t want to harm Yi’Er, she had to tactfully create a false "accident" for herself to avoid making things difficult for him.
"Let’s go, Mother."
Tang Yi smiled, seemingly genuinely proud and honored to have found a prodigy of his race.
He smiled brightly, turning around.
Immortal Mother Xing also turned stiffly.
The person they had brought here was already of little relevance to them, and even if there was, it was merely superficial.
And just at this moment, footsteps suddenly came from the archway.
Hurried footsteps, without any concealment.
The two turned back simultaneously and saw a young man running from the Profound Jade Dao in the shade, standing at the entrance, gasping and smiling as he looked at them, saying, "Yi brother, Aunt Xing, why didn’t you wait for me?"
Tang Yi looked at him in surprise, his face full of astonishment, muttering, "Brother Han, you... why did you come out now?"
Song Yan smiled and said, "If not now, when should I come out?"
As he spoke, he walked forward, and upon reaching Tang Yi’s side, he said, "I haven’t properly thanked Yi brother yet.
Furthermore, if I continued to stay in that manor, I’m afraid it might make it difficult to see Yi brother off.
Yi brother is going for a great adventure worthy of decades of time.
If I meet Yi brother over those decades, shouldn’t we have a big toast?
But I am merely a low-level Refining Profound junior, would Yi brother do me the honor?"
Tang Yi:...
An inexplicable emotion rose from within his heart.
Having walked a difficult path, he rarely felt moved.
But he had to admit that at this moment... he was truly moved.
He knew very well the role he played in the Formless Ancient Race.
He knew even more that if the Formless Ancient Race discovered a prodigy, what would happen to this prodigy.
At this moment, the young man before him should not have come to see him off. Instead, he should have stayed in the courtyard, continuing to receive guidance from Third Grandfather, inheriting some Secret Techniques of the Formless Ancient Race.
The reason why this young man appeared here was obviously because he had stubbornly made such a request to Third Grandfather, even after Third Grandfather had made the relationship clear to him, he still chose stubbornly.
How dared this young man?
If it were him, would he have done it?
Tang Yi thought perhaps not, because such an opportunity was too rare, he was reluctant to waste it, so he was more likely not to leave. It was precisely because of this that a sense of indescribable warmth suddenly surged in his heart, he took a deep breath, looked at the young man before him, and smiled.
Song Yan also smiled.
The two looked at each other, their smiles growing happier, then hooked each other’s shoulders, laughing out loud as they walked out of the Secret Realm together.
Sometimes, happiness is just that simple, no need for many words, because everything is in the heart.
As the three figures disappeared from sight, Tang Xiaokong leisurely walked out from behind the door, fanning himself and looking at the empty entrance, couldn’t help but smile and say, "Interesting young fellow."
...
...
Song Yan and Tang Yi agreed to have a good drink together, and indeed they did.
But not in a restaurant, rather in a scenic verdant wilderness.
A bonfire burned, surrounded by four people.
Besides Song Yan, there was Tang Yi’s partner, and Immortal Mother Xing.
Tang Yi’s partner was named Huo Lanxin, the sole descendant of a Sect founder, considered to have monstrous Talent in the Sect with a high status, and precisely because of this... she could marry into the Formless Ancient Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 159. Good Days Are Coming! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: 159. Good Days Are Coming! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter Subscription)_2
She has married into wealth, but Tang Yi has not.
The people of the Formless Race were supposed to marry among themselves, but the clan tacitly allowed him to be with Huo Lanxin... naturally, there were other intentions behind this.
Merely having the bloodline is not enough; without the mask, one cannot be considered a true member of the Formless Race.
At first, it was Song Yan and Tang Yi drinking and eating meat, while Huo Lanxin cooked on the side, and the Immortal Mother Xing was buzzing in thought, wondering how long this old monster intended to keep up the pretense.
But soon, Song Yan became the one cooking.
Song Yan skillfully flipped the roasted meat.
His culinary skills were exceptional, and now, they had reached perfection.
Soon, Tang Yi and the others were eating with total abandon.
Immortal Mother Xing also forgot her worries and happily ate, thinking to herself, ’The old monster’s cooking is really delicious, oh my, it’s so delicious.’
There was a minor incident when a demon beast in the mountain was attracted to the scent of the roast, only to be slain by Huo Lanxin with one stroke of her sword, turning into roasted meat as well.
After their meal, they discussed cultivation experiences and anecdotes from ancient countries for a while, during which Song Yan mostly listened, and then seeing the sun set, he got up to clean.
Previously, Tang Yi might have harbored a trace of a heart demon, a trace brought by the "last straw of Song Han," but at this moment, that heart demon had dissipated.
Taking advantage of the wine’s influence, he asked his wife and mother to wait there while he and Song Yan went for a stroll further away.
As they walked away, a drunken Tang Yi said, "Brother Han is so sincere to me; I am truly grateful."
Song Yan replied, "Why say such things?"
Tang Yi laughed heartily, "What a fine ’why say such things’!"
He closed his eyes deeply and suddenly said, "Brother Han, may I ask you a question, and you answer truthfully."
Song Yan said, "Please, go ahead."
Tang Yi hesitated, a bit struggling, and said, "You and my... mother... could it be that you have..."
Song Yan widened his eyes at him.
Tang Yi mustered his courage and blurted out the last two syllables: "Dual Cultivation?"
Song Yan looked surprised, shaking his head repeatedly, "How could that be? Yi, what are you thinking?!"
Tang Yi blushed and stammered, "Then... then... why does my mother trust you so much?"
Song Yan’s eyes lowered slightly, he sighed softly, and then said earnestly, "I’m not a lone man, I have close relatives back home. These connections are known to the Immortal Mother. That’s the first reason.
The second is, the Immortal Mother can discern my character; one who gives me peaches, I will repay with plums.
Therefore, there is this trust."
The last little knot in Tang Yi’s heart was instantly untied.
At this moment, he felt his heart was clear and open, without any obstacles.
Although the Purple Mansion Realm was distant, he felt no longer bound, and his journey would undoubtedly be smooth.
Tang Yi said deeply, "Brother Han, from now on, you and I are true brothers. No matter what happens in the future, I, Tang Yi, will definitely stand by your side. Thank you very much!"
The two of them soon returned, and the four of them took a carriage back.
That night, Song Yan would temporarily stay at Tang Yi’s residence, and later... would be escorted by Immortal Mother Xing to the Ancestral Vein Secret Realm.
The Secret Realm required someone from the Formless Race to activate, but Song Yan’s realm was low, so he needed escorting.
...
...
Late at night.
Tang Yi’s residence...
Every pavilion in the rear residence was hidden, preventing inspection, including the one where Song Yan stayed.
Immortal Mother Xing moved silently, and when she arrived at a pavilion, her expression changed several times, finally taking a deep breath, she pushed open the door, twisting her graceful body, revealing a wanton look, with a charming smile she looked at Song Yan who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, and with a tap on her tiptoes, she drifted forward.
She had thought all day, thinking that the only thing she could do was to try to please this old monster with her body.
However, halfway there, she heard a faint voice.
"Aunt Xing."
Immortal Mother Xing twirled around, landing opposite Song Yan, biting her lip, she said, "Master..."
Song Yan said, "Aunt Xing, you and I no longer need to maintain a relationship through union."
Immortal Mother Xing of course understood.
She had already lost her value.
The old monster before her, if he wanted to kill her, he wouldn’t need to go to such lengths.
Song Yan said, "These past days, I helped Tang Yi eliminate the heart demon that might have erupted. His path to the Purple Mansion should be smooth and unimpeded."
Immortal Mother Xing said deeply, "Thank you, Master."
Then she added, "Since the Master is the prodigy of the Formless Ancient Race, my son and I will truly rely on the Master."
Song Yan nodded slightly, "I am always good to my people."
Immortal Mother Xing’s face showed joy.
She realized not only would she not die, but she had also exceeded her original goal, moving from being by the old monster’s side to being by the side of a prodigy of the "Formless Ancient Race."
She sweetly said, "Then Master, what else do I need to do?"
Song Yan suddenly said, "Will Huo Lanxin leave with Tang Yi this time?"
Immortal Mother Xing didn’t know what the Master meant, but she answered truthfully, "She is Yi’Er’s Dao companion, of course together."
Song Yan said, "Then... if you have any powerful cultivators under your command, gather them as soon as possible. If there are any Purple Mansion Cultivators who are friendly with you, it’s best to invite them here within the next few years. Because... very soon, you will have trouble."
Immortal Mother Xing was taken aback, "What trouble?"
Song Yan said, "This trouble would originally target you, Huo Lanxin, and Tang Yi, but since the latter two are leaving with the Formless Ancient Race seniors, it’s no longer an issue. But you will become the sole target."
He then said seriously, "There will be mysterious cultivators coming to capture you, their power should be at the Purple Mansion Realm."
Immortal Mother Xing: ...
Song Yan said, "Can you handle them?"
Immortal Mother Xing’s face turned cold, "If outside, I might be afraid, but here it’s the home ground of the Formless Ancient Race.
In this territory, having received your warning, if I still get killed by some outsider minions, I might as well write my name backward.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 159. Good Days Have Come! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: 159. Good Days Have Come! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
Just...
"Master, do you need those people captured alive?"
Song Yan said, "Absolutely not, kill them as you see fit, and don’t worry about the Formless Ancient Race finding out. In fact... if they end up offending the Formless Ancient Race, all the better."
Immortal Mother Xing said, "Understood."
Song Yan suddenly raised his hand, reaching forward lightly.
Immortal Mother Xing was momentarily stunned, but then she straightened her delicate figure proudly.
However, as that hand was about to touch her chest, it slid to the side, grabbing the silk fabric on both sides to cover up the snow-white curves.
"Aunt Xing, you are a senior; wear more clothes in the future. What kind of propriety is this?"
"Yes..."
"Moreover, the one who comes to capture you might not be just an Early Stage of Purple Mansion, but someone stronger.
For this, we might need to borrow the power of the Formless Ancient Race."
Song Yan gave a thoughtful look, tidied Immortal Mother Xing’s disheveled hair, and said in a deep voice, "You being attacked, this matter is obviously unrelated to me."
"Naturally unrelated to the Master."
"Do not disappoint me."
Immortal Mother Xing stiffened and said, "I will certainly not disappoint Master. If... if by any chance, I fail, I will immediately seek death and not reveal a bit about Master."
Song Yan softly said, "Aunt Xing, be careful."
Immortal Mother Xing nodded.
However, her little head was full of confusion.
How could the Master be so sure that mysterious cultivators would come after her?
Who are those cultivators anyway?
...
...
Ancient Jin, Southern Land...
The dense buzzing formed a roar like a massive tsunami; it was the sound of countless insects flapping their wings.
The sky was covered with shadows, and sunlight could not penetrate a bit.
The cultivator checkpoint where the Ancient Teleportation Array was located had been blood-washed, corpses of cultivators dropped to the ground, with strange black dots wriggling on them.
Look closely!
Not only the cultivators’ corpses, but even the Profound Treasures were no exception.
And they were shrinking at a visibly fast pace.
They were being gnawed by the insects.
Those black dots were the insects.
These insects covered the sky, banding together, appearing like pitch-black tornadoes across heaven and earth.
And at the center of the tornado stood a masked stranger in a red robe.
The stranger looked coldly at the Purple Mansion Cultivator struggling within the light shield filled with the Power of Thought not far away.
That Purple Mansion Cultivator was the stationed guard here, previously referred to as Mr. Wang by Tang Yi.
Mr. Wang was usually elegant, but now his face was ferocious, and his eyes were full of despair.
"Insect King! You come here personally to attack this array; are you trying to incite war?!!"
The usual frictions hardly count as war.
True war is when both sides continuously send cultivators to the battlefield, and High Tier cultivators fall like rain.
Clearly, no country wishes for such a war to break out.
Unless..."It’s worth more than it costs."
The masked stranger in the red robe looked at the Purple Mansion Cultivator inside the light shield, speaking in a bizarre voice, "Five months and eleven days ago at the hour of Chen, a group of people used the Ancient Teleportation Array here. I want all the information on them."
Mr. Wang said, "Just some people from the Ancient Race and some cultivators selected by the Hidden Dragon Association. Why do you want this?"
The Insect King said, "I only need the information of those who used this Ancient Teleportation Array at the hour of Chen on that day!"
Mr. Wang was not of the Ancient Race, so naturally, he understood that this Mountain and Sea Race demon was looking to cause trouble for the Ancient Country.
If he disclosed it now and brought some unnecessary losses to the Ancient Country, he would be unable to face the Ancient Race.
What method should he use?
Just as he was thinking, suddenly, he heard a terrifying scream.
The pitch-black whirlwind formed by countless insects violently corroded the light shield formed by his Power of Thought.
Amidst the roaring red robe, a hand tightly clasped his forehead.
The black insects swirled, obscuring all detection, and that strange hand began to manifest mysterious variegation.
Those variegations seemed like shackles, piercing into Mr. Wang’s glabella instantly.
"Chang? Wang? Tiger Blood?"
"Insect King, you even have Changwang Tiger Blood?"
Mr. Wang seemed to see a world of terror, an unimaginable disbelief.
Soon, a Divine Soul was dragged out of his body.
The Insect King’s glabella opened, revealing five rotating Dark Gold Evil Pearls inside.
Those beads separated, equidistant, rotating slowly, covered in famined ghosts.
And as this Divine Soul entered among them, it was also thrown into the array of famined ghosts, beginning to slowly honestly disclose everything it wanted to know to the Insect King.
In a moment, the list of sixteen names appeared in the Insect King’s hand.
Yet it looked at the Ancient Teleportation Array before it but dared not enter it personally.
After a long silence, it decided to find some Loose Cultivators to infiltrate separately and investigate them one by one.
...
...
A few days later...
Morning light penetrated the gray clouds, falling upon the nearby waking mortal towns.
The sky suddenly had a Flying Palanquin gliding over, making everyone instinctively look up and then return to their daily routines.
The Flying Palanquin stopped at the entrance of the Formless Ancient Race’s Ancestral Vein Secret Realm.
"Aunt Xing, this is where I leave you."
"Xiaohan, I’ll be off then. Take care of yourself."
"You too, Aunt Xing."
The young man waved, his expression warmer than the sunlight at that moment.
After the Flying Palanquin departed, he took out his Identity Token.
The secret realm rippled, and the young man’s figure disappeared into it, appearing before an ancient garden.
...
A moment later...
"Boy, finally willing to come back?"
The squeaky rocking chair echoed with Tang Xiaokong’s voice.
He always lay comfortably in one position.
And the entire garden of the Formless Ancient Race was built in a way that was habitable and in harmony with nature.
Not luxurious, not ostentatious, but at first glance, you would know: living here would surely be comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 159. Good Days Are Coming! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: 159. Good Days Are Coming! (8.0K Words - Big Chapter Subscription)_4
Tang Xiaokong straightened up as the rocking chair rocked, and said with a smile, "Did you enjoy the wine?"
Song Yan replied, "Yes, it’s good."
Tang Xiaokong said, "I was negligent that day; you don’t want Tang Yi to be left with a heart demon."
Song Yan said, "It’s not just that; there’s also the sentiment of returning favors."
Tang Xiaokong’s expression became increasingly gentle, and suddenly he asked, "Would you be willing to be listed under my name in the clan lineage?"
He continued with a smile, "I’m at the half-step Divine Infant Realm, and this time guarding the ancestral vein is the last. After this, I will seek to break through to the Divine Infant Realm. My status in this generation of the clan is not low; even the clan leader must call me third brother.
My Dao companion is also at half-step Divine Infant. She and I have a son and a daughter, both entered the Purple Mansion.
The children also have grandchildren, scattered around, along with my mother from the previous generation still alive, and my Dao companion’s older generation. This large family is quite prosperous.
If you are willing to join my line, nod your head, and from now on you will be my adopted son."
He was originally hesitant, planning to discuss it at the family gathering fifty years later.
But this child has not only high talent but also good character, truly unprecedented, which made Tang Xiaokong have a love for talent, so after Song Yan returned, he directly made such an invitation.
Song Yan respectfully knelt down and said, "Child greets foster father."
Tang Xiaokong gently lifted his hand, and a soft power lifted him up.
Tang Xiaokong walked closer, bent down, and brushed dust from his knees, smiling, "Han’Er, don’t kneel next time, that’s not our family’s custom."
Saying so, he patted the youth’s shoulder and said, "Come, let me take you to another place."
He revealed a mysterious expression and smiled, "This place is the origin of the rise of our Formless Ancient Race and the true location of the ancestral vein.
Usually, clan disciples must achieve great merits to enter.
But the old man here has a slot, and this slot is yours.
Tsk tsk tsk, a boy at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound is protected by the ancestral vein, what the future holds, the old man truly can’t imagine, hahahaha."
Song Yan:...
Ancestral vein?
He suddenly felt a bit intimidated.
His plan was: the Demon Monk has already seized the advantage; if he wants to swallow the Demon Monk, he must cling to the tiger skin of the ancient race, the higher the identity and status, the better.
But this place of the ancestral vein was somewhat beyond his expectations.
Yet, when the time came, he could only brace himself.
...
...
The ancestral vein is a mountain.
A mountain deep within a secret realm.
But more precisely, it’s a place at the mountain’s core akin to a celestial pool.
Under the sunlight, the surrounding peaks stand tall, white clouds flow, and in the celestial pool... rippling waves, some water demon beasts are even nurtured in the tranquil waters.
Suddenly, the waves began to rustle, then surged violently, as a pair of giant horns emerged from the water, then floated up, with mighty pressure spreading like a tide, silencing the mountain’s faint insect noises instantly, leaving nothing but dead silence.
Song Yan watched this scene in astonishment, while promptly smearing Feng Chengzi’s aura over his divine soul.
Fortunately, he had not only a strong divine soul but also precise control, so this application was flawless...
And now appearing before him was a dragon!
A dragon, black on the left, white on the right!
The two tones not only did not make this dragon appear ugly, but instead held a mysterious and terrifying charm.
This black-and-white dragon scanned the two people.
Song Yan felt a gaze sweeping over his divine soul.
He dared not move.
The black-and-white dragon soared a hundred feet, slightly arched its long body, lowered its head as if seriously and deeply examining him.
A long time...
Plop!
The black-and-white dragon returned to the celestial pool, diving beneath the water.
Tang Xiaokong was not surprised by this scene; seeing the dragon returning to the pool, he patted Song Yan’s shoulder and said with a smile, "Old man, I’ve never seen the Yin Yang Profound Dragon staring at a junior for so long.
Ten breaths, the Yin Yang Profound Dragon looked at you for a full ten breaths!
The last time it was so long, it was the clan leader.
However, the clan leader was only looked at for six breaths, quite less than you.
Hahahaha, very good, very good, you are excellent.
But you still need to remain humble and diligent in cultivation.
You must know, even with potential, if it doesn’t turn into power, it is all for naught."
At this moment, Tang Xiaokong was exceedingly joyful.
Being stared at for ten breaths by the Yin Yang Profound Dragon also proved this junior’s potential from another angle.
This was also a recognition of his discernment!
Song Yan said, "Foster father, what is this really about..."
Tang Xiaokong said, "It is said that our Formless Ancient Race was born here in this celestial pool, and it has been over five thousand years. Legend has it that the ancestor opened the Lifebound Secret Realm with earth-shattering power."
Song Yan was dumbfounded...
Apparently he still underestimated the Personal Secret Realm.
Lady Ling truly has great fortune, her single thought might be beyond the Divine Infant Realm...
Tang Xiaokong continued, "The secret realm to the world is like a fetus to a mother.
And this place is the origin of the secret realm, also the beginning of our Formless Ancient Race.
It is said that our Formless Ancient Race was all conceived by the ancestor’s divine soul; the ancestor split his soul to nurture sixty-four strands, and the initial clan members of the Formless Ancient Race were only sixty-four.
The Faceless Mask was crafted from the ancestor’s placenta, totaling sixty-four, passed down through generations.
This was also the reason why a thousand years ago, due to certain events, the Ancient Teleportation Array was completely destroyed, severing the passage between north and south, causing our clan to lose three veins fully in the Southern Land!!
Tang Yi was one vein.
You are one vein.
There is one more vein, perhaps never to be found."
Tang Xiaokong lightly sighed, and then said, "The ancestor’s divine soul nurtured our clan, and the placenta not only turned into masks but also transformed into this Yin Yang Profound Dragon and the celestial pool here.
Any member of our clan cultivating here can solidify their innate talent, as if blessed by the ancestor.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 159. Good days are here! (8.0K words - big Chapter, please subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: 159. Good days are here! (8.0K words - big Chapter, please subscribe)_5
Don’t ask anything else right now, just sit here in meditation for seven days.
After seven days, I’ll come to find you."
After saying this, Tang Xiaokong patted Song Yan on the shoulder again and then drifted away.
Song Yan stood by the Ancestral Vein Celestial Pool of the Formless Ancient Race, paused for a moment, then sat down cross-legged in meditation.
Since he’s here, he might as well settle in, taking one step at a time, thinking too much is useless.
He sat cross-legged and closed his eyes, feeling the breeze caress the water, lifting the hair at his temples, sensing the fish and dragons leaping from the deep pool, thrilling waves hidden beneath.
The day alternated between light and dark, dawn and dusk recycled.
Suddenly, he felt a strange warmth.
Dotted with numerous golden light points appeared before his eyes.
Is it raining?
No!
It’s not rain!
Those golden light points were rising from the Celestial Pool, once emerged, they passed through his skin, heading towards his Divine Soul, and upon attaching to the Divine Soul Aura of Feng Chengzi, they actually merged together, making the thin golden glow on the outside become thicker and more magnificent.
Song Yan sensed that these golden light points seemed to contain some information, and as the golden light grew stronger, the information became more complete, as if... it was a Secret Technique.
...
Seven days later...
In the morning.
Song Yan slowly opened his eyes.
The golden light points had disappeared, and the Celestial Pool returned to normal.
Yet, faced with such an ordinary scene, Song Yan’s eyes were filled with a stern look.
He glanced at the panel.
Unprecedented changes appeared on the panel:
[Name: Song Yan]
[Lifespan: 142/8633]
[Talent 1: Remaining Life Dao Fruit]
[Talent 2: Formless]
The font color of Talent 1 appeared in a faint gray, while Talent 2 was a faint blue, clearly, the latter could not compare to the former, but this scene was shocking enough.
At the same time, Song Yan also felt as if his eyes gained some bizarre power, this power allowed him to easily perceive the flow of Profound Qi, and then by imitation, he could use the corresponding Magic.
The Ancestral Vein of the Formless Ancient Race not only truly blessed him but also transformed him into a real Formless Ancient Race member.
Song Yan suddenly remembered the gaze of the Yin Yang Profound Dragon upon him seven days ago, and a heavy feeling arose in his heart.
He was seen through!
The reason why the Yin Yang Profound Dragon observed him for so long was that it discovered he was not a member of the Formless Race.
However, the Ancestral Vein actually transformed him into a real Formless Race member.
Such a thing, Song Yan believed, even Tang Xiaokong, and the Clan Leader might have never encountered before, otherwise, they wouldn’t have been so eager to find members of the clan.
But there is absolutely no such "pie from the sky" good fortune in the world.
What is all this for?
Or perhaps, he was overthinking, this is just a normal blessing?
Perhaps the Ancestral Vein discovered he had the Divine Soul Aura and inherited mask of the Formless Race but lacked talent, so it automatically completed the talent for him?
No one answered.
No one knew.
All of this was filled with an enigmatic aura akin to a hint or a metaphor, like a hidden thread tracing for thousands of miles, yet its purpose remains unknown, difficult to fathom its profound meaning.
Song Yan always considered himself ordinary, once an ordinary person, now an ordinary devil, so he couldn’t decipher the meaning within.
But instinctively, he felt alert.
He gazed deeply at the Celestial Pool, as if waiting for something to happen.
But until Tang Xiaokong appeared, what he felt should happen did not show any trace.
The Yin Yang Profound Dragon did not appear, it felt like he entered a dangerous place, yet not only did he not suffer, he instead received an unexpected benefit.
But how is that possible?
Suddenly, an image of the scene from the "First Realm of the Tumor Realm he had seen before" surfaced in Song Yan’s mind.
That Secret Realm... was a completely decayed Ancient Race Secret Realm, its Token still held thoughts, yet it had no heirs.
What led to the complete extinction of an Ancient Race?
Did the Formless Ancestral Vein detect his uniqueness, trying to drag him down with it, or was it unintentional, destined to be so, or perhaps with ulterior motives, ill-intentions, or some other purpose?
Song Yan couldn’t figure it out, so he temporarily stopped pondering it.
After all, he not only didn’t lose out, he gained a great advantage.
He had learned to "drink today while there’s wine," otherwise... thinking of those desperate situations, those enemies who still look at him with a predator’s gaze, would only sadden him to death?
"Godfather!"
The young man lifted his smiling face and said, "The Ancestral Vein has blessed me greatly, I feel my talent has strengthened significantly."
Tang Xiaokong laughed and said, "Come, I’ll teach you the Secret Technique of our clan, along with some important points about navigating the vassal states, so you can go out to experience and cultivate.
These past few days, I’ve informed the Clan Leader about your situation, and the Clan Leader has decided to send a Purple Mansion Female Cultivator to you, she will obey your every command. This counts as our Formless Ancient Race’s protection for a prodigy.
After all... you’re only at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, even though you have our Formless Race Token, you’re still susceptible to encountering some reckless, suicidal fools!"
Song Yan understood.
He really had become an ancient second-generation.
And one with strong henchmen and a formidable backing, a prodigal ancient second-generation.
Anyone who dared to provoke him would trigger the scenario of "attack the young, the old will come out..."
The wheel of fortune turns, regardless of the path ahead, his miserable days seem to have temporarily come to an end.
Good days... have arrived!

chapters.content:
Chapter 306: 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)
The Formless Ancient Race, Ancestral Vein Secret Realm...
Outside the round oiled paper window, the shadows of trees overlapped heavily.
The flower branches rustled and swayed in the wind, creating a sound that lifted one’s spirits.
In the small study, Tang Xiaokong crossed his legs, brewed a pot of tea, and poured two cups. Upon seeing Song Yan, he suddenly seemed to remember something and smiled, saying, "Forgot, forgot, this old man loves tea, so I brewed a cup for you as well. However, I also have wine and spiritual liquid here; you can drink whatever you like."
Saying this, he raised his hand, and one by one, exquisitely crafted jade bottles were arranged on the old wooden table.
Tang Xiaokong leisurely shook his leg, picked up a cup of tea, and sipped it with a "tsk tsk," then sighed comfortably and looked up at the sky, as if pondering some question.
Song Yan took the tea and sipped it.
The tea was very mild.
It had no special effects.
Most likely, it was just tea for mortals to drink.
The water was also ordinary, perhaps mountain spring or rainwater, but not any special kind of water.
This kind of tea could be found everywhere in teahouses within the Mortal Realm, but it should never appear in a place like this.
Tang Xiaokong came back to his senses, noticed Song Yan’s slight perplexity after drinking the tea, and smiled, saying, "No need to think, no need to remember. Don’t rush rice seedlings to become rice; water flows its natural course. The mind recognizes it when the time is right, and outside its realm, the Dao will not be understood. Otherwise, it brings no benefits, only harm.
To tell you the truth, what I drink is not merely a cup of ordinary tea, and what you drink can only be a cup of ordinary tea, or else... there would be problems, hahaha."
Song Yan pondered for a moment and immediately understood that Tang Xiaokong was contemplating the Divine Infant Realm, so he didn’t say much, merely replying, "Han’Er has been taught."
Tang Xiaokong nodded with satisfaction, then fanned himself like a village elder, grabbed the teapot, and drank directly, saying, "Our Formless Ancient Race has existed for over five thousand years. From its initial birth, there has been the Innate Divine Soul Secret Technique, as well as the Faceless Mask as a heritage.
And since two thousand years ago, when the Yin Yang Profound Dragon Jade Stele emerged in the Ancestral Vein, the jade stele recorded the third inheritance of our Formless Ancient Race — the No-Self True Technique.
This technique cannot be learned by anyone outside our race."
As he spoke, his palm moved slightly, as if activating some mechanism, and a jade stele suddenly appeared in the void.
Tang Xiaokong said, "Han’Er!"
Previously, Song Yan might have felt guilty.
But now, he was a genuine member of the Formless Race, recognized by the current Clan Leader and former ancestors as part of the Formless Race.
Hence, he raised his hand to touch the jade stele, his Divine Sense scanned it, and soon a mysterious stream of colored light surged, attaching to the golden Soul Chart of the Formless Race, then... moved according to his will, shifting unpredictably.
Simultaneously, a line of information appeared on his panel:
[Magic]
"Ancestral Blessings of the Formless Shattered Immortal Position" (No Cultivation Required)
A slight perception revealed that this newly added magic was immensely powerful, capable of enveloping the Divine Soul with a single thought, obstructing the fluctuation of one’s own aura, rendering it utterly hidden and imperceptible.
Not to mention that he previously couldn’t perceive Tang Xiaokong’s realm at all, even Tang Xiaokong... now couldn’t discern his realm.
This was truly miraculous.
As for the No-Self True Technique, as for outsiders finding it exceedingly difficult to cultivate, it was all a lie.
Tang Xiaokong looked at his bewildered expression and said, "Do you know what the No-Self True Technique is now?"
Song Yan nodded and revealed a strange smile, saying, "It seems I don’t even need to practice it."
Tang Xiaokong laughed heartily, saying, "Exactly, but outwardly you still have to pretend to be practicing it, and if this topic arises, you must say it’s the No-Self True Technique."
Song Yan thought briefly and said, "Other ancient races don’t have this?"
Tang Xiaokong looked at him in astonishment and praised, "Amazing, amazing, strong talent, good disposition, and even such a clever mind?
Indeed, many ancient races don’t have this secondary blessing from ancestors."
Yet, our Formless Ancient Race has always been a race that doesn’t like to expose its trump cards, so it is deceitfully proclaimed as magic rather than ancestral protection to the outside world."
Song Yan asked, "Why are our ancestors able to give us this second blessing?"
Tang Xiaokong shook his head, then said, "These matters are still too distant for you, far enough that you don’t need to consider or explore them."
For the next half year, you will spend it in this garden, reading books, learning about realm information.
Half a year later, when the Purple Mansion Female Cultivator arrives, you can venture out for training and cultivation.
"Even though our Formless Ancient Race starts far above mortals, a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, and you must remember to take one step at a time."
"Child understands."
Tang Xiaokong nodded, then clapped his hands.
The small study suddenly transformed, with rows of bookshelves appearing in the once empty air.
"There are no techniques here, only the understanding of realms from our Formless Race ancestors, for you to contemplate, to prevent straying from the correct path later on.
This step is indeed crucial, but only great families like ours can achieve it. When others are still trying to discern and find their path, you will already be clear on your direction, thereby not wasting time and not shooting aimlessly."
"Yes."
After Tang Xiaokong finished speaking, he continued to fan himself, carried the teapot, hummed a tune, and leisurely stepped outside.
Song Yan watched his departing figure, and in a moment of fleeting illusion, it seemed as if this third master Tang had already merged with heaven and earth, indistinguishable from them.
He withdrew his gaze and silently looked again at the newly added line of information on the panel: "Ancestral Blessings of the Formless Shattered Immortal Position."
His gaze slowly converged on the word "shattered," displaying a contemplative expression.
