chapters.content:
Chapter 307: 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)_2
He vaguely remembers, when he first transmigrated here, there was someone who gave him many benefits, and although that person was not "broken," they were "dying."
That person valued his talent and bestowed him with gifts, which he reciprocated. To some extent, he had already regarded that person as his true mentor.
Mentor, mentor, both a teacher and... father.
Toward that person, he felt no guilt, but it still took him a long time to realize he had been betrayed.
That person... was called Stone Seat Elder.
He was the first elder who truly taught him a life lesson.
With his eyes narrowed, the youth walked devoutly beneath the bookshelf, letting the sunlight from outside fall, shadows and light criss-crossing the shelves.
He moved within the interplay of light and shadow, looking at the shelves full of books and notes, slowly stretching out his hand.
...
...
Summer departs, autumn arrives, after the fallen leaves wither, winter snow follows.
Snow falls layer by layer; the old courtyard of the Formless Ancient Race remains silent, unattended, and unasked. But this silence does not evoke a sense of decay or desolation, instead, it melds with the heavens and earth.
The youth returned a book to the shelf, closing his eyes in contemplation.
This half-year was crucial to him; from the collection of books of the Formless Ancient Race, he learned a great deal.
These things might require breaking one’s head to comprehend outside, or perhaps might never be obtained, as no one would painstakingly explain so thoroughly to you.
Only the foundation of a great family can achieve this.
Foundation is not only about treasures and magic, but also knowledge and experience.
...
First, he understood his current state of Divine Soul.
Speaking of this, it starts with magical treasures.
Profound Artifacts and Profound Treasures are commonly used by low tier cultivators, yet these types of treasures become meaningless upon reaching the Purple Mansion Realm, where skills formed by thoughts far surpass the effects of any Profound Treasure or Profound Artifact.
This aspect, Song Yan knows clearly, because back then, that strike of "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" by Ancient Tooth, that treasure pagoda formed by thoughts descending from the heavens, nearly took his life, even when executed from a distance.
Soul Artifacts, Soul Treasures, Evil Artifacts, Evil Treasures mark the new path.
Soul Artifacts are akin to "batteries" nurturing souls with souls, but their construction is not necessarily like the "Cold Ice Hell Bracelet" that enslaves souls, rather they are intentionally manufactured using Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, not wholly evil.
The difference between Soul Treasures and Soul Artifacts is, the former allows Divine Soul to be externalized, and has greater capacity, similarly... the manufacturing method is not entirely like that of "Myriad Souls Banner," there are other normal types. However, Soul Treasure’s biggest flaw is "lack of precision," you can command and use them, but cannot finely control the power within.
Evil Artifacts resolve the shortcomings of Soul Treasures, allowing for certain command over fragments of cause and effect, letting them adhere to oneself, forming a "Giant Soul."
As for Evil Treasures...
The realm they correspond to is actually the Divine Infant Realm.
Their greatest function is not for slaying, but... defense.
The principle is "many Divine Souls entwine oneself, sharing all Divine Soul-directed damage, protecting the main soul as a whole."
The books of Formless Ancient Race state: ’Evil Treasure, born of heaven and earth, like a lone boat on a vast sea, drifting along, ferrying guests across.’
This section is quite metaphorical, not overtly mentioning the Sea of Suffering, merely providing the clan’s juniors with a general concept.
But for Song Yan who had wallowed on the coast of the Sea of Suffering himself, this statement was crystal clear.
Evil Treasures are indeed the little boats aiding the Divine Infant Realm in crossing the Sea of Suffering.
The source of Evil Treasures is indeed born of heaven and earth, absolutely not by humans.
Now here arises a problem...
Normal Evil Treasures are heaven-born, but "Changwang’s Soul Threshold" Evil Treasure is obtained by the "Changwang Tiger Race" sacrificing an entire race due to its special nature. This is a standard deviation from the norm.
Normal Evil Treasures are only a single boat. People are on the boat, boat crosses the sea, and after reaching the shore, people remain people, boat remains boat, but he... seems to have forged half an Evil Treasure onto his Divine Soul. Is this "Unity of Man and Boat"?
Normal Evil Treasures are meant to share all Divine Soul-directed damage, yet the center of his forehead can directly emit terrifying Divine Soul attacks; this seems slightly skewed, a hint of wildness in this path can be sensed.
Moreover, the books of the Formless Ancient Race do not mention Evil Treasures being capable of absorbing power from the Sea of Suffering, and fusing together; nor do they mention if one holds half a wild-road Evil Treasure, falls into the Sea of Suffering, and merges half of the Evil Treasure onto one’s own Divine Soul while absorbing much of the Sea of Suffering’s essence, what might occur.
But this level of power can indeed absorb the thought of an Early Stage Divine Infant.
"An unprecedented, or at least extremely rare state," is Song Yan’s conclusion regarding his own state.
...
Secondly, Song Yan has also deepened his understanding of the Purple Mansion Realm.
Early Stage of Purple Mansion, is the killing thought.
Killing thought, most cultivators tread a path of slaughter, abundant with such intent. The core lies in borrowing the "Profound Heart" to enhance the Divine Soul using the Body of Heaven and Earth.
Middle Stage of Purple Mansion, is the protective thought.
Protective thought, best acquired by peacefully living through several decades with tranquility and harmony to gain such insight.
Song Yan pondered what "tranquility and harmony" meant, and the first thing that sprang to his mind was "Junior Sister An Li," indeed those days at the Nanwu Sword Sect counted as tranquil and harmonious.
If An Li were still present, if the hearts of acquaintances remained unchanged, it would be his greatest chance to break through to the Middle Stage of Purple Mansion.
Late Stage of Purple Mansion, is the self thought.
Self thought, as the name implies, recognizing the existence of "self."

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)_3
How to see clearly?
Only through distinction.
The core seems to lie in understanding that "I" is independent of "Heaven and Earth," rather than being like flowers and grasses, mountains and rivers, which exist within "Heaven and Earth."
Only by understanding and achieving this can "I" truly be called "I."
And precisely because my mind is so independent, it can exist continuously over time, rather than wandering aimlessly within Heaven and Earth, with thoughts fleeting in and out of existence.
The best way to break through my mind is to use the "Purple Mansion Secret Technique," weaving a powerful secret technique power with my own thoughts, enveloping myself within it, completely severing the connection with Heaven and Earth.
However, at the moment when you truly achieve it, you need to withstand a peculiar attack from Heaven and Earth, known as the small celestial tribulation. If you make it through, you successfully break through to the Late Stage of Purple Mansion.
This reminds Song Yan once again of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race’s "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma," that pagoda-like thought power, wasn’t it some predecessor of the Corpse-Eating Wolf Race who realized this power?
...
Again, Song Yan also learned about some combinations of the Crimson Palace Nine Realms.
The book from the Formless Ancient Race says that there is no perfect combination for the Crimson Palace Nine Realms, but there are the most suitable combinations.
Among them, there are two paths: one focuses on the divine soul, and the other focuses on the physical body.
The book from the Formless Ancient Race records some important bloodline combinations, locations, methods of obtaining, and so on...
If the members of the Formless Ancient Race want to acquire these bloodlines, besides obtaining them personally or sending subordinates, there is another way, which is to issue an "Ancient Order" to the vassal states.
To put it bluntly, an "Ancient Order" is a bounty.
There are contribution points in the Ancient Race, but the Ancient Race has no contribution points for its own people, only externally.
Different contribution points can be exchanged for different rewards.
The greatest reward from the Formless Ancient Race is the secret technique of cultivation techniques.
Many of these secret techniques are coveted by other sects; in addition, there are some resources, privileges, and so on...
The most important privilege is the duration of cultivation on the "Profound Heart."
To enter the Early Stage of Purple Mansion, you only need to sit on the Profound Heart for a few years, but at that time, the Early Stage of Purple Mansion is very unstable. To stabilize it, you either continue to sit on the Profound Heart, or you spend a massive amount of Profound Jade to maintain it, and the effect is not as good as the "Profound Heart."
The "Profound Heart" is hard to find, but the surrounding positions of the "Profound Heart" are also important resources and can be distributed.
Therefore, controlling the "Profound Heart" means controlling the greatest resource for all sect powerhouses in the vassal states to advance, and it is a monopolistic resource.
Each member of the Formless Ancient Race can issue an "Ancient Order" to a certain extent. If there is a conflict over the "Profound Heart," one can queue, wait, or mediate...
However, very few Profound Hearts are reserved by the Formless Ancient Race for subordinate sects, ensuring the "credibility" of the "Ancient Order."
However, regardless of the cultivation environment or quality, these Profound Hearts are naturally much inferior to the Profound Hearts reserved by the Formless Ancient Race.
...
Song Yan put down the book. He felt the time had come.
Footsteps came from outside. Soon, Tang Xiaokong appeared at the door and said, "Han’Er, your people have arrived. You should also go to train and cultivate.
Outside, remember the old man’s words.
We Formless Race people are always mysterious, do not let others know your true identity and appearance.
In this regard, the Faceless Mask and the Formless True Skill can completely help you achieve it.
And in any place of my Formless Ancient Race’s vassal states, whether you face a Mortal Sovereign or a Sect Leader, as long as you present your Identity Token, they must acknowledge it. You can also instruct them at will, even intervene in their affairs for tasks that aren’t too costly. If it’s too big, then issue an Ancient Order.
Of course, all of this presupposes that they haven’t offended you. If some blind fool dares to disrespect us, then there’s no need for them to exist.
If you encounter a strong enemy and the female cultivator beside you is unable to help you block them, just use the Identity Token. The token contains the aura of many Late Stage of Purple Mansion and even Divine Infant members from our clan. Whoever takes action, first see who is closer in relations. You are in the old man’s line, and when action is needed, it naturally comes from this line. If there’s no time in this line, then see who’s available, but you needn’t worry about no one taking action.
No one who could kill my Formless Ancient Race on this patch of land has been born yet, humph!"
"I understand, foster father." Song Yan said respectfully.
Tang Xiaokong smiled kindly and said, "I hope to see you give the old man a surprise fifty years from now."
"I will, foster father."
"Alright, Han’Er, you go now." Tang Xiaokong nodded, then seemed to think of something else and stopped mid-sentence, but still said, "That female cultivator isn’t ordinary, her combat power is quite formidable, an ordinary Purple Mansion couldn’t stand in front of her. She is also loyal to my Formless Race, and this time following you, she just wants to relax and comprehend the thoughts of the Late Stage.
However, you needn’t worry, she will never go against you, and... after hearing that the Yin Yang Profound Dragon targeted you for ten breaths, she even voluntarily applied, wanting to be your person."
Song Yan asked, "What does she want to get from me?"
Tang Xiaokong smiled faintly, didn’t answer, only said, "She would only fall in battle before you, and never harm you."
Song Yan then asked, "Then, how should I address her?"
Tang Xiaokong said, "The ancestor calls her Xiyi... you just have to call her Aunt Xi."
...
...
When Song Yan walked out of the garden, he saw Aunt Xi standing in the middle of the snow.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: 160. Humanoid Fierce Beast, Playboy’s Code (8.1K words - Big Chapter Request for Subscription)_4
Aunt Xi really has a jolly appearance.
It’s the kind of jolliness like a humanoid savage beast.
She stood eight feet tall, exceptionally stout, almost square in shape.
Layers of fat draped down like a hundred steel heavy armors, her legs thicker than elephant’s, with tiny bean-sized eyes embedded in the center of her plump face, sparkling with a chilling cold light. The aura around her was as if tens of slaughterhouses stacked together, filled with an unsettling sense of killing intent and a bloody smell.
Upon seeing the young man, Aunt Xi fell to the ground, shouting, "Master."
The reason she fell was because... she could no longer manage to perform a half-kneel or bowing posture.
Yet on such a woman, Song Yan felt an extremely terrifying prowess in her flesh and blood.
Tang Xiaokong’s words, "not ordinary," were indeed very accurate.
This Aunt Xi was clearly an anomaly within the Purple Mansion Realm.
Song Yan even thought that if Aunt Xi pressed down on Infant Crying Master, the latter would be crushed until his eyeballs popped out, bouncing several tens of feet away...
"Aunt Xi, we’re family, no need to fall over next time."
Song Yan said.
Aunt Xi’s belly quivered, bouncing herself up, and with a cute tone said, "Alright, Master."
Then she asked, "Master, where are we going?"
Having been here for half a year, Song Yan already had plans in mind, so he smiled and said, "One thing at a time."
If he were a fake, he’d surely be very nervous now, even trying to cover it up.
But he wasn’t.
Whatever the reason, he was given the identity of a Formless Race member, and now he was truly a prodigy of the Formless Ancient Race.
...
...
Winter passed, spring came.
A cultivator in the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace was expressing immense gratitude, yet the person seeing him off simply said, "No need to thank me, it’s an arrangement from a higher authority. You, ah, really don’t know what kind of luck you’ve stumbled upon. Coming from a small sect in the Southern Land of Ancient Jin Kingdom, now you’re appointed as an Honored Guest Elder in one of the top five major sects of our ancient race."
This cultivator in the Middle Stage of the Crimson Palace was one of the thirteen who came with Tang Yi, named Jiao Yifu.
Under Tang Yi’s arrangement, Jiao Yifu was initially doing some family affairs to get accustomed, but just a few days ago, he suddenly received a secret order, instructing him to head to a major sect as an Honored Guest Elder.
It was practically a meteoric rise.
"It’s the master’s benevolence, the master’s benevolence indeed. I, Jiao Yifu, will never forget the master’s kindness, even as I serve another sect, I will always be the master’s man." The cultivator patted his chest, extremely moved.
"Go quickly, cherish this hard-earned opportunity when you reach the sect, cultivate diligently, and don’t wander around aimlessly."
"Of course, of course! I will definitely break through the realms as soon as possible!"
After a few more words, Jiao Yifu clasped his fists, took the transfer order, and flew away with his artifact.
The person seeing him off stood there, spring wind blowing his long hair, his face changed rapidly into another look, seemingly ordinary yet with eyes holding a different kind of allure.
Suddenly, the air here quieted down, all insects’ low hum since the awakening of insects ceased, a fishy wind brushed by, and a great plump figure fell with a crash, sounding as if a deity swung a hammer hard against the earth.
Song Yan helplessly said, "Aunt Xi, can you walk a little lighter?"
Aunt Xi said, "I’m sorry, Master, I’m already walking very carefully."
Song Yan firmly believed that, put outside, this Aunt Xi would surely be a terrifying beast that would frighten anyone.
If it were an ordinary person, confronted with Aunt Xi’s appearance and voice, they would probably have collapsed already. Even if not, they would feel fear and disgust.
Yet Song Yan treated her with normalcy.
Because after this time, he had understood that Aunt Xi was definitely a formidable enemy, but seemed to regard him highly and extraordinarily... protective.
Song Yan believed that anything trying to approach and harm him would be furiously smashed by Aunt Xi.
After a simple exchange, he looked toward the departing cultivator.
Aunt Xi did not ask why he did so, merely swept her bean-sized eyes around.
And when sensing some demon beasts with ill intent, she would lick her lips, and the demon beasts, even if still far away, would be so scared they would flee, rolling away in fear.
As for Song Yan’s purpose, it was quite simple.
That day, thirteen people accompanied Tang Yi to the ancient race. Due to trial accidents, three died, leaving ten.
These ten... he had obtained from Immortal Mother Xing, arranging them to ten major powers, advising them to cultivate well in the sect, and not to "wander" outside.
Among these ten, he even had Immortal Mother Xing recognize a "godson," forming a Daoist couple with a girl from a big character family of a certain major power.
Anyone who wanted to offend these ten major powers would have headaches.
So anyone wanting to grab those ten people from these forces would find it absolutely challenging.
He knew the Demon Monk was surely having people probe the situation here.
Thus, he didn’t mind making it a bit harder for the Demon Monk, even if... he himself wasn’t within the Demon Monk’s search range. But as long as he could trip the Demon Monk up a bit more, he would go to any lengths to do so.
Song Yan thought for a moment, then asked, "Aunt Xi, any progress on what I asked you to investigate?"
Aunt Xi nodded her gigantic head, moved her palm, and took out a map.
The map of the ancient country was extremely convenient: by locating with Divine Sense, no matter where one was, they could blend that Divine Sense, observe that map, and accurately find the destination.
What Song Yan needed to find, of course, was the whereabouts of the "Nanwu Sword Sect."
Old acquaintances and the like were secondary.
Most importantly, he had realized that the core of his breakthrough to the Middle Stage of the Purple Mansion Realm lay with the "Nanwu Sword Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 160. Humanoid Ferocious Beast, Rules of the Profligate Son (8.1K characters - large Chapter, please subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: 160. Humanoid Ferocious Beast, Rules of the Profligate Son (8.1K characters - large Chapter, please subscribe)_5
His goodwill, his protective thought, can only most easily take root in the soil of the "Nanwu Sword Sect".
He first needs to move this opportunity to a safe place, otherwise... finding another opportunity might take an unknown amount of time and effort.
In the past, he would have been cautious and sneaky, lurking past carefully.
But now, there’s no need!
Song Yan’s gaze swiftly scanned across the map, finally settling on a spot.
That spot was not within the vassal state territory of the Formless Ancient Race, but further east, near a force called the "Night King Ancient Race", separated from the Formless Ancient Race by a wholly blood-red place — the Ice Mirror Wilderness.
The Ancient Teleportation Array leading to the Ancient Jin Kingdom is also in that direction.
Previously when Song Yan came, he actually traveled over the Ice Realm Wilderness.
He would rather take the long way around than travel through the wilderness, which clearly shows... the Ice Mirror Wilderness is a dangerous place.
And the Nanwu Sword Sect is near the Ice Mirror Wilderness, it seems that the surrounding area is quite barren.
"Happy Aunt, I want this sect."
Song Yan raised his hand and pointed at the "Nanwu Sword Sect".
Happy Aunt hunched over, tilted her head, stared at the map for a moment, thought for a while, and simply said one word: "Okay."
Song Yan asked, "Is it difficult?"
Happy Aunt showed a thoughtful expression, as if considering whether it’s truly difficult, and after a while, she lifted her chubby hand, measuring a small gap with her thumb and forefinger, and said: "Maybe, a little, just a little."
After speaking, she grinned and said: "There is actually a bit of ancestral ties with that Nanwu Sword Sect."
Song Yan: ???
This... was truly unexpected for him.
Seeing his curious gaze, Happy Aunt explained: "Five thousand years ago, there were two powerful ancient races on this land, one called the Dragon Elephant Ancient Race, the other called the Lingbo Ancient Race.
I am a descendant of the Dragon Elephant Ancient Race.
And the little sect leader of the Nanwu Sword Sect is a descendant of the Lingbo Ancient Race."
Song Yan said: "Then... where are the Dragon Elephant and Lingbo clans now?"
Happy Aunt said: "They are gone."
Song Yan said: "How did they perish?"
Happy Aunt sweetly said: "The master needs to work hard to become stronger to find out."
After speaking, she changed the subject and laughed: "Both the Sword Sect and I are descendants of perished clans, and this is that bit of ancestral ties.
As for that little bit of difficulty, it’s the Night King Ancient Race. Back then, the Night King Ancient Race was a subordinate clan of the Lingbo Ancient Race. At the time of the Lingbo Ancient Race’s demise, the Night King Ancient Race didn’t miss the opportunity to add insult to injury, capturing some living members of the Lingbo Ancient Race, attempting to use their racial strength to strengthen themselves.
Nowadays, that little sect leader of the Nanwu Sword Sect is really separated by several generations, and isn’t that important anymore, yet she is still famously beautiful, known by many cultivators who wish to take her as a furnace.
Unfortunately, being so close geographically, the Night King Ancient Race has already set their eyes on them."
Song Yan asked: "Have they taken action?"
Happy Aunt said: "The Nanwu Sword Sect helped repair the Ancient Teleportation Array, the Ancient Race Alliance granted them fifty years to recuperate and ten years of the Profound Heart’s usage. Now, that time has long passed."
Song Yan fell silent for a moment, then suddenly said: "Happy Aunt, I don’t care, I’ve only heard of that little lady’s fame, I just want her as my furnace, I don’t care, I don’t care about anything!"
Happy Aunt nodded emphatically and said: "It should be so."
...
...
A month later...
Night King Ancient Race, Northern Land, a sect.
A sullen young master sat with legs crossed, eating a Profound Fruit and drinking Immortal Brew, when suddenly someone stumbled in from outside, shouting as they ran: "Not good, young master, something bad has happened!!"
The sullen young master frowned and pointed at the person, saying: "Why the panic?"
The one who rushed in said: "It’s about that little lady from the Nanwu Sword Sect, Yu Xuanwei."
The sullen young master was indeed a member of the Night King Ancient Race, named — Ye Fu.
The person continued: "Someone... someone flew to the skies above Nanwu Sword Sect, proclaiming they want the young lady Yu as their Dao partner, and they want the entire Nanwu Sword Sect as dowry."
Ye Fu was taken aback, then anger rose to his brow, he slammed the table, shattering it, and said with an uncontrollable fury: "Impossible! Who on this land dares to challenge me?
I’ve already declared that the young lady is mine, who would dare to touch?"
The person gave a bitter smile and said: "It’s someone from the Formless Ancient Race."
Ye Fu’s expression slightly froze, muttering: "This makes sense."
But as he continued, he became enraged again: "Does being a member of a powerful Ancient Race allow one to act so wantonly? I must inform the elders and have them seek justice!!"
The one who rushed in could only smile bitterly, as such divine clashes were beyond him, he could only deliver the message.
...
...
At this moment, above the Nanwu Sword Sect...
A beauty in a Vermilion Brocade Robe gazed peculiarly towards the sky.
The years had not left a trace of age on her, instead adding more allure, like an immortal peach that took centuries to grow and ripen, now plump and juicy, more enticing than ever.
Yu Xuanwei had already fallen into despair.
Because she was targeted by a wastrel from the Night King Ancient Race.
That wastrel had long declared to those around that she was destined to be his woman.
Yu Xuanwei, relying on various means, barely held out until now, and just when she could no longer hold on, there was suddenly a turn of events.
The wastrel from the Formless Ancient Race sat in the flying palanquin, floating in the sky, unreasonably declaring she was his woman, and whoever dared touch her would perish.
Beside that wastrel, a woman resembling a deadly beast silently hovered, her gaze looking South, as if waiting for those who dare not comply.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader "Midnight Lance" book friend)
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader "Midnight Lance" book friend)
Beside the Nanwu Sword Sect...
The flying palanquin hung in the air.
One person, one palanquin, waiting silently.
Inside the palanquin, the young man leisurely stretched his body, letting every part of his body feel relaxed and joyful, occasionally grabbing the jug of fine wine beside him for a sip.
The wine jug was made entirely of Profound Jade, and the wine inside often exuded a faint cold mist, cold upon smelling, icy down the throat, yet once in the stomach, it transformed into a fierce blade churning through the five internal organs.
"My adoptive father was right; he drinks an ordinary tea, yet that tea isn’t ordinary.
But when I drink it, it’s just ordinary.
So... someone at my realm can only drink such a superior brew to truly appreciate its taste."
Song Yan chatted absentmindedly with Aunt Xi outside the palanquin while drinking.
Aunt Xi grinned and said, "There’s still good wine out there. Let’s find a chance to seize it."
Song Yan was startled and asked, "Why seize it? Are we... that kind of people?"
He let out a cold snort and said, "On this land, no matter what I take, it’s acknowledging him, giving him face.
If he doesn’t want this face, then I’ll teach him well, make him understand more principles, more right from wrong, to avoid suffering a great loss in the future."
Aunt Xi: ...
Her plump face couldn’t help but turn sideways, glancing at the young man behind the curtain.
Song Yan continued with a tone of sentiment, "Ah, back in Ancient Jin, I heard of the fame of this beautiful young lady Yu, said to be the most beautiful woman in the land of Ancient Jin for a hundred years.
Not to lie to Aunt Xi, before sleeping, five out of ten days I think of her.
Wondering how beautiful her face is, how long her legs are, how large her bosom is.
Tsk tsk tsk, I didn’t expect to fulfill my wish today, dream come true, hahahaha."
Laughing heartily, the young man continued drinking, then fetched another jug of new wine, humming a tune as he did.
With a sidelong glance, he scanned the terrifying Purple Mansion Cultivator standing in mid-air outside the curtain.
Aunt Xi’s small pea-like eyes also rolled over to him, meeting his glance, then softly said, "That young lady Yu has already entered the Pseudo-Mansion stage of the Purple Mansion. When the master gets intimate with her, it’s best to be careful... not to get hurt by her."
Song Yan naturally understood that "Pseudo-Mansion" referred to someone who used "Profound Heart" to initially ascend to the Purple Mansion, but couldn’t continue to stay in Profound Heart, instead had to use a vast amount of Crystal Jade to maintain the realm, leading to an extremely unstable realm, one careless move might even fall back to the Crimson Palace.
At this realm, the lifespan increased from the original 200 years of Crimson Palace to 1000 years of the Purple Mansion, but... they were completely unable to wield the power expected at the early stage of Purple Mansion.
Thus called... Pseudo-Mansion.
Song Yan uttered an "Mm," then said no more, instead intertwining his fingers and comfortably closing his eyes.
He was a bit puzzled.
This woman called Aunt Xi, what on earth was she plotting?
Although from the overall situation, this scheme should not be the type to kill or undermine him, yet he found it quite abnormal.
Today, he had been acting so playfully. Not cultivating, thinking of finding a woman as soon as he gained power, and even wanting to have conflicts with other clans. Yet Aunt Xi wasn’t the least bit angry, not a bit disgusted, not a word of advice, acting as if he could do whatever he wanted.
Why?
There is no love or hate without reason in the world.
The more you give, the more you seek.
Yet now, although he had talent, he certainly hadn’t reached a level where such a strong person would follow orders so obediently.
After a moment of thought, Song Yan said, "Aunt Xi, I want her now, can’t wait another moment!"
Aunt Xi said nothing, only uttered a faint "Mm."
At the Nanwu Sword Sect, the young lady in the vermilion brocade robe lost focus for a moment, feeling as if a mountain was pressing down from high above.
The gale was pressing the earth to the brink of collapse, and then that terrifying humanoid beast stood before her.
Aunt Xi spoke in a deep voice, "Sect Leader Yu, a discourse in the palanquin."
Yu Xuanwei bit her silver teeth secretly, but then cupped her fists and said, "Senior, there is still the Ancient Race Alliance on this land, the alliance once promised me..."
Aunt Xi waved her hand, interrupting, "The time has long passed, no one will care about such a trivial matter of yours. Being with my master is your fortune, don’t be ungrateful.
Now, I’ll give you two choices.
One, come up to the palanquin with me.
Two, I’ll destroy the Sword Sect, then cripple you, and take you to the palanquin."
Yu Xuanwei was stunned, looking at the terrifying woman in front of her.
She had never seen such an arrogant and domineering person, even the Night King Ancient Race folks treated her with patience, never this kind of ruthless destruction.
Aunt Xi coldly said, "Calling you Sect Leader Yu is giving my master face. Don’t refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit."
With that, her eyes flashed with ferocity, coldly scanning that Sword Sect behind her, which couldn’t be considered dilapidated, yet absolutely unfit for a sect, letting out a cold snort, "Do you really want me to take action?"
Yu Xuanwei bit her lip, suddenly feeling perhaps that rogue from the Night King Ancient Race wasn’t so bad.
However, at this moment, she had no choice, so she respectfully bowed and said, "Junior is willing to come."
Aunt Xi said, "That’s more like it, serve the master well, otherwise... death!"
A moment later, a Sword Rainbow arrived in front of the flying palanquin. Before Yu Xuanwei could speak, the curtain was lifted, and a hand eagerly reached out to grab her wrist, pulling her swiftly into the palanquin with a cry of surprise from her.
Yu Xuanwei felt incredibly disgusted, her wrist tingling with goosebumps, and just then, a low hum suddenly came from the distant sky.
"Coming to my Night King Ancient Race’s territory, seizing our women, my friend, do you not regard my Night King Ancient Race at all?"
The curtain lifted...
Yu Xuanwei saw dozens of figures rushing from the distant sky.
The leaders were a middle-aged man with white hair, his eyes wrapped in black cloth, clad in multicolored brocade, and a young man wrapped in black cloth.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_2
"Ye Fu!"
Yu Xuanwei couldn’t help but shout, feeling as if she had found a savior.
The boy with the black cloth around his eyes was indeed Ye Fu.
Ye Fu naturally heard many things from Yu Xuanwei’s tone, his mood was complex, for he never thought Miss Yu would ever seek his help one day, showing how tyrannical and what a rascal that scion of the Formless Ancient Race in the palanquin must be!
Song Yan held onto Yu Xuanwei’s wrist without letting go, casually spreading his legs while looking outside and giving a hard tug that made the young lady stumble into his embrace and then sit begrudgingly on his lap.
Song Yan felt the soft plushness of her behind on his thigh and hooked his finger towards the outside as if provoking.
He was here today not only to recover the "opportunity for his Purple Mansion’s Protective Thought" but also to test Aunt Xi’s limits... and if possible, he wanted to test the ancient monster within the Formless Token.
Yu Xuanwei sat in the unfamiliar young man’s embrace, her face pale, with an instinct to kill bubbling up, but recalling the words of the humanoid beast, she dared not move, forced to endure the humiliating close contact between them.
"No!!!"
Ye Fu shouted in furious grief, then turned to the white-haired middle-aged man beside him, saying, "Second Uncle, Second Uncle!!"
The white-haired middle-aged man did not respond, instead carefully scrutinizing the proud and stout woman standing beside the Flying Palanquin, and suddenly asked calmly, "Is that Princess Xi in person?"
Aunt Xi did not answer, coldly asking, "Fight or not fight?"
The white-haired middle-aged man said, "I am Ye Shuangcheng..."
"Fight or not fight?"
"Since Princess Xi is here, forget it..."
"Don’t forget it! Let’s fight!"
At these words, Princess Xi suddenly charged forward, with her fat fleshy rolls boiling like hot water, layer after layer, surging endlessly, her robust legs stomping violently in the void.
With that stomp, it felt as if the entire void shattered, with fragments swirling into a giant elephant’s hoof shaped by the Power of Thought.
The elephant’s hoof was not complete, giving a sense of incompleteness, yet even so, it was exceptionally powerful.
Before the hoof landed, below it mountains and rivers were like paper houses caught in a typhoon, crashing down with a roar, flattening peaks and valleys.
The white-haired middle-aged man who called himself Ye Shuangcheng was shocked, quickly exerting power to counteract.
However, upon coming into contact with the murderous elephant hoof, he was like a bird smacked away by a steel plate, plummeting downwards rapidly, submerged ten or so yards into the ground, creating an extensive pit thick with rolling smoke.
Princess Xi frowned, saying, "Boring."
In the pit, Ye Shuangcheng climbed out in a state of disarray.
Princess Xi looked down upon him, saying, "You lot are only formidable at night, why not wait until nightfall to fight."
Ye Shuangcheng did not reply, instead closing his eyes slightly, seemingly contacting someone by some means.
A moment later, he opened his eyes and sighed, saying, "Princess Xi, in trying to breakthrough the Late Stage of Purple Mansion, seeks a path through battle, I... shall not accompany you.
As for this descendant of the Lingbo Ancient Race, she lost her inheritance long ago, just an ordinary woman, of no use to my clan. If Princess Xi desires her, take her."
Without waiting for Aunt Xi to speak, he turned and blandly told Ye Fu, "Xiao Fu, call upon the elders, we are leaving."
In the just-completed communication, he had figured it out.
Princess Xi, this madwoman, seeking breakthrough to the Late Stage of Purple Mansion, is going around picking fights, he didn’t want to tempt fate and waste his trump card in such a place for no reason.
Ye Fu looked at the Flying Palanquin.
The palanquin curtain was intentionally lifted by Song Yan.
The young man, holding a beauty, drank while laughing heartily.
The beauty furrowed her brows, seemingly enduringly serving with her head lowered, occasionally lifting her eyes slightly, sending signals for help with a pitiful look.
Ye Fu cried pleadingly and indignantly, "Second Uncle!"
"I told you to call Princess Xi!" Ye Shuangcheng criticized him in frustration, "If you can’t let go of one woman, what great thing can you achieve?!"
Ye Fu angrily said, "No, Second Uncle! Isn’t there any justice here..."
Before finishing, he suddenly felt a surge of killing intent, looked up but only saw a pair of eyes the size of soybeans.
Those eyes replaced the heavens and the earth, like two enormous beast pupils stretched across the front, shimmering with brutality.
Ye Fu’s Adam’s apple bobbed, trembling, he lowered his head, saluting in a shaky voice, "Pre...prestigious Senior Xi..."
And then he mustered up his courage, unwillingly asking, "I don’t know which... which brother of the Formless Ancient Clan is in that flying palanquin beside you?"
Princess Xi did not answer, only curled her lips playfully.
Ye Fu’s heart twitched, hastily turning away, scurrying off in a panic.
Princess Xi shifted her gaze back, suddenly feeling someone watching her, her peripheral glance matched Song Yan’s, she rumblingly said, "Master need not feign a dandy act to test me everywhere.
I have a request of you, but it is related to my Dragon Elephant Ancient Race, or rather the entire ancient races...
Master, being of the ancient races, cannot escape this calamity either.
The master was watched by the Black Dragon for ten breaths; this talent is something unmatched by this and the last generation, even among the living, of the Formless Ancient Race.
That is why I follow you.
I follow not the present you, but the future you."
She slightly closed her eyes, saying, "Every three thousand years a change, two thousand one hundred and twelve years have passed since now, time is running short. Master need not overthink, no need to test these trivial matters, just quickly become stronger."
Song Yan, having his intentions seen through, was not surprised, only narrowing his eyes slightly.
He suddenly recalled what Tang Xiaokong had said.
"My Formless Ancient Race, for over five thousand years now since its birth, has had the Innate Divine Soul Secret Technique, as well as the Formless Mask as its inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_3
"And two thousand years ago, when the Yin Yang Xuan Dragon Jade Stele appeared at the ancestral vein, what was recorded on that jade stele was the third inheritance of my Formless Ancient Race — the No-Self True Technique."
One for over five thousand years, another for two thousand years, indeed, a change every three thousand years.
Princess Xi suddenly pointed at Yu Xuanwei, who was sitting on his lap, and said, "Her Lingbo Ancient Race was an overwhelmingly powerful ancient race eight thousand years ago, only surpassed by today’s Formless Ancient Race in this land.
But... two thousand years ago, they encountered a sudden change, barely surviving for a millennium, and still were unable to escape their fate, leading to their downfall.
The Night King Ancient Race, however, rose precisely two thousand years ago, as a new emerging ancient race, so... they have a bit of reverence for the Formless Ancient Race, as their foundation is not as deep."
Song Yan said, "And what about Aunt Xi?"
Princess Xi replied, "My Dragon Elephant Ancient Race perished around the same time, but although I was born over a thousand years after the extinction of my race... I am the only one who still retains the innate secret technique inheritance of my race. I want to understand why this all happened."
After speaking, she said lightly, "These matters, I didn’t plan to tell the master so early. But I didn’t expect, not only does the master have extraordinary talent, but his whole body is also full of wit. If I don’t say it, it will instead arouse the master’s suspicion, causing the master to continue living indulgently and consuming energy internally."
The two of them stared at each other for a moment.
Suddenly, Song Yan pointed at her and smiled, "You are mistaken."
Then, he pushed Yu Xuanwei onto the horizontal seat in the flying palanquin, pressing his body down hard, but only touching slightly without moving further. He then quickly lifted himself and helped Yu Xuanwei up, straightening her wrinkled dress, apologized with a "sorry," and then looked at Aunt Xi, sighed deeply, and said, "You are not wrong."
The two again gazed into each other’s eyes.
Princess Xi laughed, "I knew I didn’t misjudge you."
Song Yan shook his head with a wry smile, took out two wine cups, and filling one, he politely asked, "Does Miss Yu prefer to drink wine or tea?"
Princess Xi waved her hand, covering the flying palanquin with curtains.
Inside the flying palanquin, Yu Xuanwei had already come to her senses. At this moment, she was scrutinizing this young man who had just disgusted her incredibly, though she had also heard of the legends of the Formless Ancient Race, knowing that the appearance of those in the race was often not their true form.
But demeanor, posture, and bearing cannot be faked.
The previously profligate, lustful-looking youth now had sleeves fluttering with the wind, a calm demeanor, an elegant and composed temperament, exuding an innate majesty, as if unperturbed by the falling sky or an earth that might open and swallow him.
"Master..." Yu Xuanwei couldn’t help but say.
Song Yan said, "Drink tea."
After speaking, he poured tea for Yu Xuanwei and handed it to her.
Yu Xuanwei accepted the tea.
The fragrance was rich, of extremely high quality, far beyond what the present Nanwu Sword Sect could afford.
She sipped gently and carefully asked, "Master, do you know me?"
Before, she thought it was a story about a hedonist taking a fancy to her and trying to forcibly seize her, but now... it was obviously not.
Song Yan looked at this once-familiar person, slowly shook his head, then said, "It’s just a chance for Aunt Xi and me to get to know each other anew."
Outside the palanquin, Princess Xi rolled her tiny eyes, secretly thinking: ’Nonsense!’
Yu Xuanwei, however, took it seriously. She lightly nodded, responding with an "oh," then said, "Then... Master, I..."
Since it was just a chance, not targeting her, she could no longer think of any reason to stay here.
Winding and winding, she still couldn’t avoid being swallowed by the Night King Ancient Race, becoming the fate of the Ye Fu Furnace.
Truly laughable.
Her face showed sadness.
Song Yan said, "You? You’ve already called me master, so naturally, you will follow me. Not just you, but the entire Nanwu Sword Sect will follow me as well. This place is close to the Ice Mirror Wilderness, a bitter cold land, let’s find a better place."
Yu Xuanwei could hardly believe her ears, looking at the young man in surprise.
Outside the palanquin, Princess Xi didn’t care.
She did not need to be concerned about the past of this genius.
Because she cares about the future of this genius.
...
...
More than a month later.
Though it was supposed to be the end of spring and the beginning of summer, the sky started to sprinkle snow.
The luxurious flying palanquin slowed its speed, surrounded by many swords.
However, it was not because of the snow, but because there was something unusual in the distance.
A thin mist of blood was mingling with the snow that fell slowly from the sky. Inside, one could faintly see blood corpses standing still, paper figures flying, and cultivators sitting high atop giant shadow puppets.
Yet, whether it was the blood corpses, paper figures, or shadow puppets, all emitted a peculiar warm aura.
This aura, carried by the wind and snow, expanded outward, alternately hot as the height of summer and chilling as a biting winter, making people around feel uncomfortable.
Looking closely, one could see that this warm aura all originated from within the blood corpses, paper figures, and shadow puppets — a "fire," a blazing "fire."
"Master, it’s the Demon Sect recruiting," Yu Xuanwei said softly, after making a slight identification, and continued, "This should be the Fire Worship Demon Sect of the Snow Country here."
Song Yan extracted information from his mind.
The Fire Worship Demon Sect is the guardian sect of the Snow Country, one of the fifteen nations under the Formless Ancient Race.
This Snow Country is actually ranked slightly lower among the Formless Fifteen Nations, due to its location west of the Ice Realm Wilderness, thus also considered bitter cold.
But the attitude of the people of Snow Country towards the Fire Worship Demon Sect differs entirely from that of the previous Three Kingdoms.
In the Three Kingdoms, everyone feared the Demon Sect, and even the recruitment of servant disciples by the Demon Sect was done forcibly.
But here, the people have an immense reverence for the Demon Sect.
The Demon Sect recruits people, and the people scramble to join.
This land is infused with a peculiar power.
Song Yan lifted the curtain and looked into the distance, seeing a vast ocean-like mountain range, with peaks soaring into the clouds and touching the sky, appearing as stone pillars hanging down from heaven amidst the thin snow mist at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K words - thanks to the book friend "Midnight Lanz" for being the alliance leader)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K words - thanks to the book friend "Midnight Lanz" for being the alliance leader)_4
As for the Profound Qi here, it is quite abundant, far surpassing the previous Puppet Sect, Nanwu Sword Sect, and this place... is also Song Yan’s destination.
He came here because there is Evil Land here, there is Demon Sect.
And the Demon Sect seems to possess a higher-level Shadow Puppetry Technique.
Back then, after the Puppet Sect arrived from the Ancient Teleportation Array in the Jin Kingdom, although granted fifty years of stable development by the Ancient Race Alliance, they voluntarily joined this Fire Worship Demon Sect, becoming part of it. Compared to Nanwu Sword Sect, you could say they were smart.
But the Nanwu Sword Sect actually also wanted to merge into a major power, yet the sensitive identity of the descendants of the Lingbo Ancient Race, and the claim of "protected asset" by the Night King Ancient Race clansmen, made no surrounding major power willing to accept it.
After all, it is not a significant power, and offending a clan member of an Ancient Race for it is worthless.
At this moment, a cultivator was flying over on a shadow puppet, but after merely glancing at Princess Xi in the crowd from afar, quickly turned around and left. Then, a man draped in a Fire Pattern Cloak transformed into a blood rainbow and flew to this place, saluted from afar, and said, "Greetings to Princess Xi!"
Princess Xi replied impatiently, "I have already told your Sect Leader that my master wishes to borrow your Sect’s ground for cultivating.
As for these twenty cultivators, they are from your neighboring Nanwu Sword Sect, and now belong to our master, settling here altogether.
No more nonsensical words, hurry and lead us to the foothills."
The man evidently heard of this matter, he looked far into the distance, and soon a golden token floated out from the flying palanquin. As soon as the token floated in the air, it immediately shone with golden light, and the two ancient script characters "Formless" broke forth from the token, emitting shimmering brilliance like a blazing sun in the sky.
The Fire Pattern Cloak man and surrounding cultivators who saw this light hurriedly bowed down.
The mortal populace, though puzzled, imitated the action.
Almost instantly, within dozens of miles around, every life form possessing even a little wisdom kneeled down.
Yu Xuanwei dared not look outside, the vast might gave her a feeling of trepidation.
Song Yan was also witnessing the power of the "Formless Token" for the first time.
On this land, whenever he showed the token, it was like an emperor in disguise suddenly donning imperial robes.
He retrieved the "Formless Token."
The Fire Pattern Cloak cultivator who had bowed down quickly got up, then took the lead at the front.
Below, the mortal populace and the newly joined Demon Sect disciples looked up at the luxurious flying palanquin that moved across the sky, all feeling a deep awe, their Divine Souls evoking a sense of the vastness of the world and their smallness.
...
...
Song Yan remembered his first visit to the Puppet Sect, when he was captured as a servant.
After several twists and turns, he became Skin Master, then Sect Leader’s disciple, then contemporary Sect Leader, and even Sect Leader from hundreds of years ago...
Now, he had come to this larger world’s Demon Sect, but entered as an "honored guest of a transcendent power."
...
Elsewhere...
When a clan member of the Formless Ancient Race chooses your sect as a ground for cultivation, how does a Sect Leader feel?
Mu Lieyang might know best.
Mu Lieyang, as the newly appointed Sect Leader of Fire Worship Demon Sect, had always deeply yearned for his status to be consolidated and desired for Fire Worship Demon Sect to expand.
The arrival of this Formless Ancient Race member was truly a timely help to him.
There are fifteen countries under the Formless, with over a hundred sects.
And every sect with a Formless clan member experiences a sense of "climbing high." Because a Formless clan member is in itself a "great principle." Even if conflicts arise between sects, if the other party knows there is a "Formless clan member," they dare not recklessly attack.
This undoubtedly gave this newly appointed Sect Leader a chance to catch his breath.
Moreover, having the notorious Princess Xi as this Formless clan member’s attendant made it even more astonishing.
With Princess Xi presiding, Mu Lieyang felt he could also breathe a sigh of relief, not overly worrying about being exploited by surrounding forces. After all... every time the Demon Sect "changes terms," it invariably accompanies "decline in sect power," with losses ranging from a few experts to complete disintegration.
At this moment...
A man in a Fire Pattern Cloth Robe, barefoot, stood in a pitch-black wilderness beneath a sect, attentively gazing at the crimson flames rising from the center of the wilderness.
Within the flames, numerous skeletons could be vaguely seen.
Mu Lieyang bowed to those skeletons, grinning as he said, "Master, you came in good time. If a moment later, the sect’s internal struggle, if not yet concluded, would have deterred the Formless clan member from coming here to avoid trouble."
After paying respects, he turned away.
And the flames continued to burn quietly in the silent underground, emitting soft crackling sounds, resembling the sharp whispers of evil spirits, or poisonous curses.
...
Soon...
Mu Lieyang appeared before Song Yan, with a benevolent expression, dressed as an ascetic, smiling kindly as he introduced to this honored guest.
"This place is named Zhengyang Peak and is specially prepared for the Upper Envoy as a ground for cultivation, where the Upper Envoy and the envoys can settle in the future.
I will have a batch of tokens created promptly, for your people to use for entry and exit.
For the style of the tokens, later..."
Song Yan said, "Xuanwei, you can discuss it with Sect Leader Mu."
Mu Lieyang glanced at the female cultivator beside him, likely his woman, and then laughed, "Well, alright, alright."
Song Yan continued, "I wish to view the Fire Worship Demon Sect Magic Techniques, which can be exchanged for Cultivation Techniques and Ancient Race Contribution Points."
Mu Lieyang was momentarily stunned; he knew the Formless Ancient Race always had its own inheritance, so why was the Upper Envoy interested in other sect’s cultivation techniques?
His gaze briefly swept over the young man before him, then again over the almost entirely female sword cultivators behind him, suddenly having a thought, and smiled, "Alright, of course, I will arrange for an Elder to be at your disposal. Whatever you wish, just speak to her, she... will also temporarily reside on your peak."

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: 161. Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant, Fire Worship Demon Sect (8.7K characters - Thanks to the alliance leader “Midnight Lance” book friend)_5
...
...
Evening...
The female cultivator from the Fire Worship Demon Sect arrived.
Even before she appeared, the fragrant breeze had already wafted over.
Her snow-white skirt was like flowing clouds and flying snow, a crimson umbrella slightly opened, resting on her shoulder. Her bare little feet were without shoes, yet seemed like ice crystals and snow jade. Treading lightly, she pranced across the snowy ground.
Her steps were light and delicate, swaying with each step, reminiscent of graceful lotus leaves on a breeze-swept pond.
Song Yan had a premonition, but when he saw this female cultivator, he still felt a sense of disbelief, thinking "No way..."
This female cultivator was none other than Wang Susu.
At this moment, Wang Susu appeared extremely pure, her large eyes bashfully lowered, avoiding eye contact with the young man from a distance. Only when she approached did she softly say, "Susu greets the Upper Envoy, whatever the Upper Envoy wishes to do, you can tell Susu."
Anyone seeing Wang Susu for the first time would surely think she was exceptionally pure, but in reality... she was absolutely a woman whose very bones were as black as coal.
Mu Lieyang had sent Wang Susu to his side, obviously wanting her to accompany him to his bed. After all, Wang Susu’s ability to entice men was not weak, making many things proceed smoothly.
And Wang Susu herself was also doing her utmost to cling to this thigh, so her every word and action was full of feminine charm.
But as Song Yan looked at her, he only felt a faint, inexplicable joy of reuniting with an old friend.
The first person he truly got to know upon his arrival was Wang Susu.
Now, he wanted to use this "old friend" to comprehend the "Protective Thought" of the Purple Mansion’s mid-stage, but he didn’t expect Wang Susu to appear before him again.
Of course, he had chosen the Fire Worship Demon Sect as his venue partly with this expectation, but when it came true, he still found it somewhat incredible.
Wang Susu’s Qi Concealment skill was not good, so Song Yan could see that she was now at the late stage of the Crimson Palace Realm, likely amidst the hurried battle for the "Profound Heart usage rights."
As long as the resources were suitable and the Profound Root appropriate, in just a few years, one could use the Profound Heart to step into the False Mansion Realm.
First extend life, and discuss the rest later.
Of course, this price was not light, at least... The Nanwu Sword Sect had already been "impoverished" by Yu Xuanwei.
After Yu Xuanwei stepped into the False Mansion Realm, she needed a massive amount of Profound Jade, thus... Nanwu Sword Sect was already destitute, having almost nothing, nearly becoming the beggars of the Cultivation Realm.
"I have a slight knowledge of skin making and want to learn more advanced levels."
Song Yan looked at Wang Susu, articulating his thoughts word by word.
Wang Susu was momentarily stunned, lifting her gaze. Before she even saw Song Yan, she saw Yu Xuanwei beside him.
She only felt that time inexplicably paused for a moment; her eyes rolled back and settled on Song Yan, smiling shyly, "What a coincidence, Susu also has some research in making shadow puppets and can surely help the Upper Envoy."
...
A moment later...
At Zhengyang Peak, a cave mansion was vacated specifically for skin making.
Wang Susu carefully held a carving knife and approached Song Yan, softly explaining her knowledge of skin making over a piece of beast hide. To prevent this honored guest from losing patience, she directly introduced the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" the moment she started talking.
During this, they inadvertently approached one another, and just as their little fingers were about to touch, Wang Susu suddenly withdrew her hand as if electrocuted, stealing a glance at him with feigned indifference, then continued her earnest explanation as if nothing had happened.
Song Yan felt at ease.
However, he was not interested in the "Hundred Forms Divine Control," but rather in the bizarre secret technique "Shadow Puppet Fire."
He vaguely felt it should be a unique cultivation technique of the Fire Worship Demon Sect, an advanced version of ordinary skin making skills.
Yet no matter how he asked, Wang Susu cautiously avoided the topic, clearly having been given a gag order.
That night, Song Yan directly summoned Princess Xi angrily, "Xi Aunt, let’s just leave!"
Princess Xi frowned and asked, "Who had the audacity to upset the master?"
Song Yan replied unhappily, "The sect leader here won’t grant me the secret technique I want to see. Clearly, we’re not welcome."
Princess Xi:...
She wordlessly glanced at this clearly-not-a-playboy master with her bean-sized fierce eyes and said in a boorish voice, "I’ll go fetch it; my Formless Race’s contribution point is the most expensive currency here, enough to exchange for his secret technique."
Song Yan said, "We need to prepare the Nine Bloods of the Crimson Palace first."
As he spoke, he took a list from his pocket and handed it over, "Xi Aunt, can you get these?"
Princess Xi looked at the nine kinds of blood on the list, her pupils slightly contracted, then she lifted her head in astonishment, looking at the young man in front of her, saying in surprise, "You... you... this..."
She was at a loss for words.
Song Yan smiled and said, "I see Xi Aunt is very powerful and I want to be strong like Xi Aunt, so I chose this blood which is the most perfect for the Dragon Elephant Ancient Race."
Princess Xi said, "But, master, you don’t have the innate secret technique of my Dragon Elephant Race; you’ll not succeed in digesting these nine types of blood, and there could even be fatal danger."
Song Yan asked, "What secret technique?"
Princess Xi answered, "The innate secret technique of my Dragon Elephant Race is to forge a robust physique, born to be immune to all poisons. Even a child will not fear the toxins exerted by a Purple Mansion Cultivator.
Therefore, when choosing the Nine Palace Blood in the Crimson Palace Realm, my race only considers the strength and not the toxicity...
But some of the essence blood here, even scouring the entire ancient race, no one could sufficiently refine the corresponding Crimson Palace Pill."
They silently stared at each other.
After a moment, Song Yan said, "Xi Aunt, I want that, that’s what I want; I don’t care."
Princess Xi looked deeply at him and said, "Alright, I will help you get these nine types of blood. Though it’s listed in the book, I imagine obtaining them won’t be easy.
I will have people undertake trade, issue an ancient order, hire loose cultivators to hunt in the Mountain and Sea Kingdom, consult the family ancestors, and even access our Ancient Race’s dedicated secret realm to search for this blood. Even so, it’s impossible to gather it all in a short time."
Song Yan laughed and said, "Xi Aunt is the best."
He felt a sense of nostalgia.
Back then, each of his Nine Palace Bloods was obtained through great difficulty, many acquired amidst life-threatening chances.
But now, Aunt Xi was going to help him.
And he, on the other hand, just needed to stay here, achieve all his goals, and swiftly...restore his realm and break through to the mid-stage of the Purple Mansion.
Whoosh~~~
The figure of Princess Xi disappeared without a trace.
Song Yan looked out in the direction she left.
Endless falling snow, skyward streaming void.
In the familiar faces from the Nanwu Sword Sect, besides Yu Xuanwei, there was actually one more...
Thinking of that person, his heart instantly softened, even his breathing became slightly tense.
He was no longer Bai Xiuhu, while An Li, due to taking Forgetful Pills excessively as a test, was deeply affected by erysipelas, much like the Sword Master Kuye back then, hopeless to break through, stopped at the Crimson Palace.
How would he face her?
And what should he say to her?

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)
Snow Country, Fire Worship Demon Sect, Zhengyang Peak.
Song Yan took a deep breath, summoned his courage, and stepped forward to the palace where the cultivators of the Nanwu Sword Sect resided—Tingxue Palace.
The young cultivators cheerfully decorated Tingxue Palace and, upon seeing him, called him lord before leading him directly to Yu Xuanwei.
Yu Xuanwei was making an array plate.
The Profound Qi here was abundant, far better than the bitter cold of the original sect’s location. Yet despite this, she still struggled to maintain her pseudo-mansion realm, compelled to consider reselling some items in exchange for Profound Jade.
What she resold was naturally "arrays."
These years, since she entered the pseudo-mansion realm, she had lived by "selling arrays."
Hearing footsteps and seeing someone approach, Yu Xuanwei paused her engraving of the array, gently exhaled, then changed her serious demeanor to greet him.
"Master."
She respectfully called.
Song Yan glanced at her array; the array patterns were intricate yet exuded simplicity, clearly showing that the young lady before him had greatly advanced in array Dao.
"Did you gain inheritance from the Lingbo Ancient Race?" Song Yan casually asked.
Yu Xuanwei hesitated briefly before quickly taking out a golden special sheet from her bosom, presenting it with respect, "An unintentional find in the ruins of my race."
Song Yan accepted the golden paper, examined it repeatedly, and asked curiously, "It’s been over a thousand years; can anything still be found in the ruins? Could someone have set you up?"
Yu Xuanwei respectfully replied, "I followed some ancestral oral traditions to find the secret place, but unfortunately, this is the only discovery. As for a setup...this array has extraordinary power, works well in practice, and aligns with the Water Profound aspect of the Lingbo Ancient Race. I haven’t seen any issues so far."
Song Yan asked, "What’s the name of this array?"
Yu Xuanwei said, "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array.
In the Profound Water Land, it’s extremely powerful. Once activated, those in the array freeze rapidly, their life force burns. Even against a Purple Mansion Main Array, as long as it restrains for a moment, the opponent will quickly weaken and perish within the array.
I managed to earn some Profound Jade by creating this array, barely surviving."
Song Yan returned the golden paper, along with a pouch of Profound Jade, and said, "Make a copy for me later.
Additionally, use this array to set up some mechanisms at Zhengyang Peak for defense.
By the way, where is the Lingbo Ancient Race ruins you mentioned?"
Yu Xuanwei nodded in agreement and then said, "In the Ice Mirror Wilderness now."
Song Yan acknowledged with an "Oh" and didn’t rush to leave, instead sitting down to chat about array Dao idly with her.
Yu Xuanwei initially answered questions as ancient clan members do, but regarding "array Dao," she didn’t expect the young man before her to say anything significant, so...in many aspects, she even planned to exaggerate her praise against her true feelings.
People change, she had to change.
Yet as they chatted, she suddenly discovered that the young man genuinely understood array Dao, even having insights more profound than hers in certain areas.
At this moment, Song Yan took a pen, and on the paper where she had rough sketched array patterns, he moved his pen like a dragon and a serpent, deftly outlining some patterns, which was exactly a corner of her recently crafted "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array."
"Xuanwei, look at these array patterns."
"What’s about them?"
"They contain even more concise and mysterious trajectories. If refined, they become...Celestial Dao Characters."
"Celestial Dao Characters?"
"Celestial Dao Characters; the mystery of mysteries, impossible to memorize. Your Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array has tens of thousands of strokes, but even fragmented Celestial Dao Characters would have only a few thousand strokes, a complete set might only be hundreds, or even just dozens of strokes."
"Master, have you seen them?"
Yu Xuanwei widened her beautiful eyes in astonishment.
Song Yan nodded and said, "I’ve seen them."
Yu Xuanwei’s breath quickened.
Having been entwined with arrays all her life, hearing that there are Celestial Dao Characters beyond array Dao, and the array’s functioning is merely the manipulation of worldly power by Celestial Dao Characters, made her heart race.
"Master, do I...do I have a chance to see the Celestial Dao Characters you mentioned?"
"What the clan has seen and knows about. When there’s an opportunity, I’ll lead Xuanwei to have a look."
"Thank you, Master."
Their chat fell into a brief silence.
Song Yan suddenly asked, "Are you comfortable living here?"
Yu Xuanwei nodded and began talking about the hard days of the past, about how the Nanwu Sword Sect was initially alright when they first arrived, but after fifty years passed, suppression began. The disciples left, scattered, perished, leaving only a few dozen.
Song Yan wanted to ask about Su Yao and Cao Yuzhuang but restrained himself. After all...the basic principle of identity he must adhere to. If the woman before him found out he was Song Yan, too many complications would arise, leaving him unable to quietly cultivate his Protective Thought.
So, he continued the awkward chat technique.
At first, Yu Xuanwei thought this ancient clan youth wanted to develop affection or conquer her. After all, for these aristocratic sons, women’s bodies weren’t lacking, but women’s hearts were scarce.
Yet the more they chatted, the more Yu Xuanwei realized the youth’s mind didn’t seem to dwell on her, unsure of what he was thinking.
As time wore on, evening came, Song Yan proposed another request, asking Yu Xuanwei to show him around the current Tingxue Palace.
After visiting place after place, they arrived at the corner’s alchemy room.
Inside the room, a dainty female cultivator, with a blank expression and disheveled hair, used magic to blow wind into the alchemy furnace.
The blazing fire dyed the female cultivator’s cheeks a faint red, her temples having wisps of white hair falling down.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_2
Yu Xuanwei introduced with a smile: "An Li, the Pill Master of our Sect.
Master, don’t blame her. She is obsessed with alchemy, and when she starts refining pills, even if the world around her were to crumble, she wouldn’t notice... Ahem, An Li, An Li!"
She called out.
But the figure of the distant female cultivator stiffened, as if trapped in hesitation.
To go, or not to go?
If she goes, alchemy has reached a critical point, and it might ruin this batch of pills.
If she doesn’t go, it seems... it’s not very good either.
However, Song Yan didn’t let her continue to be conflicted. Instead, he sniffed the fragrance of the pills and said: "This is a good batch of pills, they must not be wasted."
Yu Xuanwei secretly breathed a sigh of relief and was about to say something more when she saw the young man wave his hand at her, saying: "I happen to have an interest in alchemy, you go about your business, I’ll wait here to consult the Pill Master An."
Yu Xuanwei: ???
Song Yan ignored her, found a seat beneath the window, and sat down.
Yu Xuanwei naturally knew An Li’s temperament and was afraid this stubborn Pill Master would annoy this scion of the Ancient Race, so she smiled: "There’s nothing much to busy with, I’ll stay here as well."
The furnace quietly burned...
No further movement inside the room.
Song Yan secretly observed the female cultivator at this moment in her alchemy, his mind flashed with past images.
Upon first meeting, she was a girl who emitted a burnt smell all over, with ash-gray cheeks and hair curled naturally from the high temperatures. She flashed her eyes and stuck out her tongue, saying she was late and then exclaimed him a wicked person. After the "matchmaking segment" ended, she hurriedly wanted to flee.
Later, when they were familiar, Junior Sister An Li became a light for him, causing a flower of brightness to bloom in his dark and hopeless heart. No matter the scene, as long as she was there, sharp contours would soften, icy cold snow would become warm, scenes would become lovely and soft, like clouds outside the sky, cotton wool in the wind, cotton candy in hand...
When parting, she cried so much, never expecting that farewell, for her, would be forever.
And now, her eyes are already hollow, stubbornly refining pills in front of the furnace with a focused appearance, as if she’s dead to the world, not caring about what happens outside.
Song Yan regained his clarity, and the gaze he turned to An Li contained a few uncontrollable softness.
Previously he didn’t understand, but this moment he realized one thing: If he still had pure goodwill, that goodwill should fall upon the female cultivator before him.
Not just because of that brief time spent together, but also for his expectations, his memories, his imagination... all entrusted upon the woman before him.
Sometimes, you like someone not because that person is uniquely singular, but because your illusions, your longings, have dressed her with the most luxurious attire in the world, making her unique.
She may have already aged, but in your eyes, she remains forever the image from first meeting.
An Li is the breakthrough opportunity for Song Yan’s Purple Mansion Middle Stage.
Yu Xuanwei noticed this trace of softness, she began to feel puzzled but couldn’t understand why. Yet today, she felt that this unfathomable young man of the Ancient Race showed a fidgety and fussiness different from his usual self.
Until a long time, when the pill was formed, the fragrance of the pill overflowed, An Li finally came over from afar, rigidly bowed and said: "Greetings, sir."
No response.
Beside her, Yu Xuanwei spoke: "Master?"
Song Yan returned to his senses, softly said: "Seeing Pill Master An reminds me of an old friend."
With that, he laughed: "Pill Master, could you perhaps make me a bowl of noodles?"
In the past on Warm Water Island, Pill Master An, who was skilled at exploding alchemy furnaces, could only cook plain-tasting noodles that were rather ordinary...
An Li was stunned for a moment, then coldly said: "No noodles."
Yu Xuanwei hurriedly said: "I... I’ll have someone go to the Demon Sect for some."
An Li took a deep breath and stubbornly said: "It’s been over a hundred years since I’ve touched those things..."
She slightly bowed and said: "Forgive me, sir. I need to organize the furnace, I’ll go ahead and do that."
Having said that, she turned around and left, without care for how the young man could decide the fate of the entire Nanwu Sword Sect, nor how he would deal with her.
Yu Xuanwei said: "Master, I’ll make you noodles..."
Song Yan closed his eyes, having understood why the Pill Master before him hasn’t touched those things in over a hundred years, he waved his hand and laughed: "This temperament, is cut from the same mold as my old friend."
He stood up, spoke a sentence "I’ll come again tomorrow," then glanced at Yu Xuanwei, lightly said: "You need not come."
Yu Xuanwei: ???
...
...
Early the next day.
Song Yan did a little deduction, and with resources, he spent 8 years raising his Realm from the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound to the Ninth Layer of Refining Profound, and then it was time to wait for Crimson Palace Blood.
He vaguely recalled, he previously broke through at the Snake Corpse Market, at that time he spent a full 67 years breaking through just one layer, but now... even though he is just lower grade Earth Profound Root, yet with excellent Profound Vein and abundant resources, he remarkably reduced the time by more than tenfold, spending only 4 years to break through a layer.
Outside the door, there was a knocking sound.
Princess Xi was outside the door.
Besides her, stood Sect Leader Mu Lieyang of the Fire Worship Demon Sect.
Mu Lieyang, upon seeing Song Yan, respectfully bowed and smiled: "The Upper Envoy misunderstood me. What the Upper Envoy wants is not a secret technique, but a kind of local specialty, Fire Crystal."
With that, he took out a storage bag and presented it.
Song Yan accepted it, scanned it, and found it contained many little red-black crystals.
Mu Lieyang said: "These crystals can greatly enhance power whether placed on shadow puppets or paper people, only there is a cost. That cost is that shadow puppets and paper people quickly decay, becoming completely useless.

Chapter 318: 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_3
And the Skin Making Skill that the Upper Envoy wishes to learn, Elder Wang is an expert in it, even this old man cannot match her craftsmanship.
As for cultivation techniques... I have brought them for you.
You may take a look, and if needed, they can be exchanged for Ancient Race Contribution Points."
Song Yan nodded.
Mu Lieyang immediately took out several Jade Scrolls, waved his hand, and the scrolls glowed, projecting words into the void like a projector, revealing the names of the cultivation techniques and basic introductions.
"Fire Observation Technique": Refining Profound Cultivation Technique, Introducing Fire into the Body, Fire Profound Good at Invading
"Fire Worship Technique": Crimson Palace Cultivation Technique, Fire Burns Blood, Extremely Powerful Burst
"Ghost Infant Scripture": Purple Mansion Cultivation Technique, Fake Ghost Infant Connects to Divine Infant, Able to Condense Ghost Infant at Purple Mansion Realm, Smoothly Breakthrough to Divine Infant Afterwards
Song Yan’s gaze lingered on "Ghost Infant Scripture", his pupils contracted, then he looked back and asked lightly: "Aunt Xi, what do you think of these three techniques?"
Princess Xi said: "I heard that the "Ghost Infant Scripture" is incomplete, Sect Leader Mu, am I right?"
Mu Lieyang sighed: "Yes, I don’t hide it from the Upper Envoy and Princess Xi, the core of "Ghost Infant Scripture" is Nascent Soul Refining, it’s said that with this Nascent Soul Refining Technique, one can smoothly breakthrough to Divine Infant Realm.
My ancestor Wu Huan Zhenren stepped into the Divine Infant Realm with it a thousand years ago, then wandered north, though contact was lost, he left a good story.
Wu Huan Zhenren said that this technique’s breakthrough is particularly stable, far superior to other cultivation techniques, but unfortunately, the breakthrough method was erased, which is an unspeakable disgrace of the sect."
It’s unfortunate for the family, causing you, the Upper Envoy, and Princess Xi to laugh at us."
As he spoke, the man in the fire robe bowed with a face full of sorrow.
Princess Xi grinned, revealing a mouthful of sinister teeth, and said with a smile: "Could it be that Sect Leader Mu erased it himself?"
Mu Lieyang smiled bitterly: "Princess Xi is joking, the ancestors never erased the inheritance, why would this old man do it?"
Princess Xi said in a muffled voice: "The master’s coming to your sect for cultivation is your fortune, don’t miss it."
Mu Lieyang said: "If it exists, this old man will certainly present it."
Princess Xi said: "Then bring the Inheritance Jade Scroll, don’t use these replicas to fool people."
Mu Lieyang said: "The power inside the Inheritance Jade Scroll is immense and cannot be borne by the current realm of the Upper Envoy. But I assure, if the Upper Envoy breaks through to the Crimson Palace Realm, Purple Mansion Realm, I will personally present the Inheritance Jade Scroll to him for viewing."
The two kept bickering back and forth.
Until Song Yan said "exchange," they finally quieted down.
Princess Xi exchanged Contribution Points with Mu Lieyang, who then pushed the three replica Jade Scrolls to Song Yan, simultaneously assuring "this Jade Scroll is identical in content to the Inheritance Jade Scroll, except it can only extract information once, and if Song Yan breaks through the subsequent realms, he can seek him anytime for the Inheritance Jade Scroll for viewing and comparison."
Song Yan raised his hand to place the three Jade Scrolls into his Storage Bag, when suddenly a strange thought flashed in his mind.
The Fire Crystal that can "burn shadow puppets, stimulate shadow puppets, causing them to burst with greater power," and the Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array that can "debilitate people, burn life"... seem to have some hints of commonality.
If he hadn’t just come from Yu Xuanwei’s place yesterday and seen the Fire Crystal today, he might not have had such a thought.
However, the two seem completely unrelated, purely some wild associations.
Besides, was Zhang Han’s "Ghost Infant Scripture" passed on from this Fire Worship Demon Sect?
Song Yan’s expression changed slightly.
He had always liked to remember these coincidences.
In his mind, every sect has its own secrets, and every nation as well, his current identity just adds a talisman of protection, preventing others from easily making a move against him.
