But if he wants to obtain something core from a sect, from a nation, then... he will inevitably get entangled in those secrets, no matter that he is from the Formless Ancient Race.
At this moment, a white figure flickered from afar.
Miss Susu’s jade feet touched the ground lightly as she gracefully arrived, right on time, ready to "accompany the Crown Prince in reading," and make shadow puppets together.
Mu Lieyang gave her a cold glare and said: "Elder Wang, take good care of the Upper Envoy."
He specifically emphasized the word "take care," as if holding some unknown threat.
Wang Susu’s delicate body trembled, and she bowed her head, saying: "Susu... understands."
...
That day...
The two once again made shadow puppets together, the hides were from junior demon beasts.
Wang Susu carefully taught him, and due to their proximity, occasional physical contact was inevitable.
A few days ago, whenever Song Yan accidentally touched her, even if it was just the sleeve, she would recoil like a startled rabbit or a cat whose tail was stepped on, and then pretend nothing happened to continue teaching him.
But today, after an inadvertent touch, she did not react.
Accompanied by rapid breathing, her chest heaved.
Song Yan, recalling the earlier "interaction between Wang Susu and Mu Lieyang," suddenly understood.
Junior Sister Susu wanted to convey that she was originally a pure woman, now forced by circumstances, she was trying hard to get close to him, and then half-heartedly serve him.
Song Yan was amused.
If he didn’t know what kind of old fox Junior Sister Susu was, he might have been fooled by her performance now.
Gotta admit, the act is pretty deep.
So, soon after...
When their pinkies were about to touch again, Song Yan pulled his hand back like a startled rabbit.
Wang Susu was stunned for a moment, then bit her lip, her eyes showing a pitiful look of disappointment, but the disappointment quickly vanished as she restored her smile as if not hurt by the boy’s slight action at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_4
Song Yan simply sat across from her, took out the skin, and pretended to clumsily work on it.
For him, this was a hard-won "legitimate extension of life time."
The higher the realm, the more lifespan is needed for deduction. He wanted to make good use of this time, to be as stable as possible, not to provoke anyone, and did not want any accidents to happen.
In the afternoon...
Song Yan voluntarily ended today’s skin making and went to Tingxue Palace.
...
...
The noodles came up quickly.
Song Yan took a bite.
Something was off.
The taste was too good, and it was made with too much care, definitely not An Li’s craftsmanship, but someone afraid he might become disgusted had tried to "pass off fish eyes as pearls."
He instinctively wanted to release his divine sense to verify his suspicion, but after thinking about it, he refrained.
If he wanted to find "protective thought" in ordinary and stable days, he should avoid this kind of "cheating technique" as much as possible.
An Li didn’t accompany him to eat the noodles, nor did she look at him; she was still afar, expressionlessly refining pills.
After finishing the noodles, Song Yan thought for a moment, and then voluntarily washed the bowl and chopsticks clean, then went to the alchemy room to say goodbye.
An Li remained unmoved.
Song Yan left alone.
Outside, Yu Xuanwei gave him the rubbing of the "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array," while cautiously asking, "How is Pill Master An’s craft?"
Song Yan glanced at her speechlessly and said, "You cooked the noodles, didn’t you?"
Without waiting for Yu Xuanwei to reply, he left Tingxue Palace directly.
...
...
At night, Song Yan picked up the "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array" and "Ghost Infant Scripture" to read.
It was quite difficult for the former to imprint onto the panel, thinking it would require some time.
The latter was much more comprehensive than Zhang Han’s version of the "Ghost Infant Scripture."
Yet comprehensive, not entirely different.
This was enough to indicate that Zhang Han’s "Ghost Infant Scripture" likely originated here.
But it’s not surprising since more than a thousand years ago, when the ancient teleportation array was intact, there indeed was exchange between the two sides.
This "Ghost Infant Scripture" of the Fire Worship Demon Sect, aside from descriptions similar to "killing thought, protective thought, my thought," adds some Purple Mansion spells.
And the ultimate purpose of these spells is the Purple Mansion Secret Technique—the Ghost Infant Statue.
The "Ghost Infant Statue" and "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" both belong to the Purple Mansion Secret Technique, a kind of power formed by one’s thoughts, seemingly like a "treasure," and are the key for practitioners of this cultivation technique to pass through the minor celestial tribulation.
The "Bee Cloud Massacre Miasma" is to sacrifice a thought to form a treasure pagoda, used to slay others.
The "Ghost Infant Statue" is similar, but according to the "Ghost Infant Scripture," its greatest function is not in combat or magical battles, but in increasing the success rate of advancing to the Divine Infant Realm.
Song Yan browsed for a while, gained a rough understanding, and then lay down to sleep...
...
...
The next day, when Song Yan again came to the Tingxue Palace alchemy room, there was another bowl of noodles on the table.
Cooked very poorly, and the taste was far less delicious than yesterday.
But Song Yan, after just one bite, exhaled a long breath.
It seemed that yesterday, after being pointed out by himself, Yu Xuanwei had done a good job of reasoning with An Li, and today’s noodles were indeed cooked by An Li herself.
However, An Li deliberately acted mischievously and made the noodles extremely poorly...
Yet, Song Yan still finished the noodles cleanly, washed the bowl and chopsticks seriously as he did yesterday, put them in the cupboard, and then said goodbye to An Li.
And An Li just focused on staring at the alchemy furnace, as if the young man at the door did not exist at all. In short, she had an expression as if resigned to her fate, doing things her own way, indifferent.
After Song Yan left, Yu Xuanwei quietly walked in from outside the door, glanced at the washed bowl, and asked puzzledly, "An Li, do you know him?"
An Li shook her head.
Yu Xuanwei said, "I was afraid he would fly into a rage today. Even though there was a wall between us, I could smell the noodles you overcooked. Yet he ate it all. Why?"
An Li said, "I don’t know, and I don’t want to know."
Yu Xuanwei said, "Make the noodles better tomorrow. We’re completely relying on him now."
An Li was stunned and said, "He’s coming again tomorrow? He..."
Yu Xuanwei sighed and said, "He told me when he left, not only tomorrow, but the day after tomorrow, and the day after the day after tomorrow, even every other day he will come."
An Li closed her eyes and after a long while said, "I understand."
Yu Xuanwei fell silent for a moment, then suddenly said, "A hundred years have passed..."
An Li said, "I’m not thinking about Senior Brother Bai, I just want to focus on alchemy."
The air went silent for a moment, and An Li continued, "I’m tired of alchemy, let the Sect Leader let me rest for a while."
Yu Xuanwei left, the room was empty, the female cultivator gazed blankly at the faraway snow, as if some memories flashed across the snowy landscape, some figures, some laughter. But upon reflection, those beautiful things had vanished, shattered, like foam, very fragile...
Suddenly, she lowered her head and covered her mouth, coughing heavily, a few flecks of blood splattering on the back of her hand.
To make the Crimson Palace Pill, she devoted her life and compiled many insights.
Yet, her erysipelas was also very severe.
...
...
Another day, when Song Yan arrived in the afternoon, he did not see noodles on the table, only An Li.
Today An Li hadn’t refined any pills, and when she saw his arrival, she got up to salute, and tried not to keep a stiff face, saying, "If you wish to mock An Li, please tell An Li how I should act to make you happy."
Her complexion was pale, and her eyes showed defiance.
Her innocence was gone, leaving no sadness or joy.
Suddenly, Song Yan realized that perhaps he liked naive female cultivators in the past because that made him feel comfortable, but now... he suddenly realized he might like An Li’s naivety.
If An Li lost this naivety, he would still like her defiance.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: 162. Recognizing An Li, Demon Infant Sacrifice (9.1K words - Major Chapter Subscription Requested)_5
If he lost his stubbornness, he would still like other things.
Seeing that Song Yan hadn’t answered, An Li continued, "If you are looking for a Dao companion, Sect Leader Yu is much more suitable than I am.
I’m not beautiful, and I’m already one hundred thirty-two years old, plus I suffer from erysipelas.
I don’t have much longevity left, sir... what do you hope to get from me?"
Song Yan was silent for a long time and then said, "Make a bowl of noodles."
Seeing a flash of anger in An Li’s eyes, not knowing what nonsense she was going to say, he added, "For the last time."
An Li bowed respectfully and said, "Yes, my lord."
She turned and went into the kitchen, carefully making a bowl of noodles.
But even with care, her culinary skills were still very average.
Song Yan took the bowl of noodles, grabbed the chopsticks, and lowered his head, slurping as he ate.
He closed his eyes, eating the noodles seriously, as if for a moment, time had turned back, and he was once again in the small bamboo house on Warm Water Island a hundred years ago. The reflection on the lake, Celestial Cloud falling into the sea, a life as tranquil as a frog in a well, days filled with nothing but alchemy and them going out together, the simplicity of it all was slow yet unforgettable.
He wanted to play tricks, but he understood that "tricks cannot earn goodwill." Having reached this point in his cultivation, he needed to genuinely put his heart into it rather than face things with cunning as before.
He reminisced, eating every strand of noodle, finished the soup, licked the bowl, and then put it down, saying, "Delicious."
An Li stared at him blankly.
At that moment, she saw a familiar shadow on the youth before her.
The way he ate noodles was so familiar.
She closed her eyes, controlling herself not to think too much, and then said lightly, "I hope you keep your word."
Then she hurriedly took the bowl and walked toward a water jar.
...
...
After a night, the snow rarely stopped, and the sky was full of sunshine falling on the ice and snow. The reflected mountains and rivers were all white, as if emitting light.
Today, An Li didn’t perform alchemy because she was missing an important medicine.
Once, a fellow sect member ventured into a dangerous place to get the medicine for her, but that dangerous place was in the Ice Realm Wilderness and never returned...
Now that she was in the Fire Worship Demon Sect, she naturally could see if the sect could exchange for such medicine.
As for the method of exchange, of course, it was Contribution Points.
The token from Zhengyang Peak had already been made, and the sect could convert items into Contribution Points; she brought many elixirs she made, which should be enough.
In the morning, she went out and busied herself for a day. Upon returning at dusk, she found the figure of that Ancient Race youth again appearing in the alchemy room.
An Li frowned slightly.
However, the youth ran to the kitchen and started making noodles.
He made two bowls and said, "From now on, I’ll do it."
An Li was taken aback, her small hands clenched into fists, yet she forcibly suppressed her anger.
After a moment, the two sat facing each other.
Song Yan cleaned his bowl of noodles, while An Li sat motionlessly.
But... the way the young man ate noodles before her began to awaken some of her memories more and more.
If it was something she occasionally saw, she wouldn’t think much of it, but clearly, he was an Ancient Race person, so why was he treating her, such a low-status young female cultivator, this way?
After Song Yan left, An Li sat for a long time before picking up the chopsticks, catching a strand of cold, almost frozen noodles and putting it in her mouth. A strange familiar taste came from her taste buds.
Senior Brother Bai... would also make noodles and they were very delicious.
But how could it be?
An Li’s eyes reddened, her nose twitching, yet she didn’t eat any more nor did she go to perform alchemy. Instead, she sat stiffly in the same place, staring blankly at the snow stained red by the sunset until darkness fell.
...
Time flew by, and a year passed.
Half a year later, Song Yan’s longevity stably changed from "[Longevity: 143/8623]" to "[Longevity: 143/16523]." Princess Xi had also successfully collected three of the Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant.
Song Yan secretly took Princess Xi to see An Li and made only one request: to use all her power to detoxify An Li, help her elevate her realm, and enable her to reach the False Mansion Realm before her final limit arrives.
Princess Xi couldn’t agree.
Because An Li’s erysipelas could potentially be cured, but breaking through to the False Mansion Realm before the limit arrived was absolutely impossible.
A female cultivator at the Early Stage of the Crimson Palace, tormented by erysipelas, her body was already frail. Even without the erysipelas, her longevity would last at most thirty more years, so how could she possibly break through to the False Mansion Realm in the remaining time?
Song Yan himself had no way; if it were in the past, he could use the power of "Changwang Hu" to turn people into wandering spirits, but now... his Divine Soul World was entirely like a gray melting furnace, and anything drawn into his Divine Soul World would be refined by his furnace. Even if he were extra cautious and controlled, any divine soul couldn’t escape his control, couldn’t... reincarnate again, and couldn’t possess ordinary people anymore.
With gains come losses.
He had grown stronger, yet he had also lost the basic power of the Changwang Tiger Blood, so he could no longer turn An Li into a wandering spirit.
Because from the depths of his divine soul, he was a demon who was skilled in devouring, skilled in destruction.
...
One year finally made An Li reluctantly accept this youth who insisted on cooking noodles.
It wasn’t just noodles; the youth would start bringing other delicacies, even elixirs.
There were some elixirs she could recognize and some she couldn’t, but undoubtedly... they were quite expensive.
Their effects were either detoxifying or enhancing cultivation.
An Li refused to eat them, but the youth would force her to.
Today, the two had finished eating noodles once more.
As usual, Song Yan prepared to leave.
An Li looked at his back and suddenly said, "I don’t quite understand."
Song Yan stopped, turning his head sideways.
An Li said, "You clearly can’t be Senior Brother Bai."
Song Yan lowered his eyes.
An Li continued, "But you, everywhere, are just like him, except... appearance."
Song Yan turned, looked at the snow-covered courtyard, and smiled, "Want to come?"
An Li paused, and then she followed him to the courtyard in confusion.
Very soon, she saw the youth pinch a snowball, throwing it in a distant arc, "pop," and it lightly hit her right cheek.
The youth was smiling.
An Li mumbled, "Impossible..."
As she said "impossible," her eyes reddened, tears welling up but still saying "impossible, it’s impossible."
Pop!
Her left cheek also got hit.
Instinctively, she closed her eyes, and the tears that were held back slid down her cheeks instantly.
When she opened her eyes again, the youth was already standing in front of her, looking at her worriedly.
An Li stared at him, a thoughtful expression in her eyes, softly uttering a sentence, "Take me to possess; I want to choose a big bad person."
She had reached the Early Stage of the Crimson Palace, naturally having an opportunity to possess an ordinary person, even ordinary cultivators, and now she wanted to take this opportunity while her limit hadn’t been reached.
Not for anything else, because she understood who the person in front of her was.
Possession is risky, but she had already gathered the courage to do it once for the person before her.
She understood she absolutely couldn’t say the name of the person in front of her.
Senior Brother Bai possessed a Formless Race person, and if people found out, Senior Brother Bai would surely be hunted to the ends of the earth by the Ancient Race and then have his soul vanish.
Thinking of this, the young female cultivator suddenly became frightened; she hurriedly reached out to push Song Yan, saying while pushing, "You’re acting too strangely, you can’t keep doing this; those elixirs of yours were all brought by Princess Xi, right?"
She became more and more angry as she spoke, and then said crossly, "How could you do this?!"
Song Yan grabbed her hand, pulled her into his arms, and said, "No problem."
...
That night, Song Yan returned to his own room and continued studying the "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array."
Suddenly, his panel lit up, and new information floated up.
However, the name that appeared was not "Array Dao: Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array."
But rather... "Array Dao: Demon Infant Ice Profound Sacrificial Array."
Song Yan’s pupils shrank tightly, staring steadily at the words "Demon Infant" and "Sacrifice."
A long-nurtured intuition at the edge of danger made him feel something was wrong, and he immediately deduced: Someone had set a scheme in this land, whether it’s the "Ghost Infant Scripture," the fire of the Fire Worship Demon Sect, or whatever this "Ice Coffin Profound Killing Array" is, they might all be parts of the scheme.
This scheme is huge, starting thousands of years ago...
Otherwise, Zhang Han wouldn’t have obtained the "Ghost Infant Scripture."
The snow fell white; on the land of the Snow Country, the eerie red flames still burned silently, providing warmth to the people, driving the shadow puppets to madness, giving power to the cultivators, but in essence... it was just a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that demon infant!
What is the demon infant?
Song Yan happened to know.
He didn’t stay in the Ancestral Vein Secret Realm of the Formless Ancient Race for nothing; he naturally saw a lot of information during that time.
The demon infant was one of them.
This being was similar to the demon monk, both belonging to the Sea of Suffering, but it was not a novice monk formed by Buddhist obsessions; instead, it harbored hidden outer realm evil thoughts, belonging to... the Celestial Demon Lineage.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 163. "Enhanced Version" Formless Talent (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Subscription Requested)
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: 163. "Enhanced Version" Formless Talent (8.1K words - Large Chapter, Subscription Requested)
Fire Worship Demon Sect...
Underground Secret Realm.
In the wilderness, Mu Lieyang’s usually kind and gentle face flickered uncertainly, one side in darkness, the other illuminated intensely by the blood-red flames. His high nose was outlined by the firelight, casting a shadow at the corner of his mouth, giving him a bizarre and ferocious look.
His eyes eerily watched the flames burning the bones, and after a moment, he sat cross-legged and began to circulate the "Ghost Infant Scripture".
Suddenly, as if recalling something pleasant, the corners of his mouth slightly curled, but soon he calmed down.
That pleasant thought was nothing special.
It was just that last year, by relying on the incomplete "Ghost Infant Scripture", he deceived that second ancestor of the Formless Ancient Race out of a lot of Ancient Race Contribution Points, and then exchanged some of them, along with his own savings, for some important rare materials to strengthen the array before him.
Separation Fire Gathering Array!!
With the sacrifice of a powerful cultivator as the core, it extracts the life force of the entire Sect and even the people as a price, to help him take the final step — transforming the Ghost Infant into a Divine Infant.
This step is one that has been pursued by successive Sect Leaders of the Fire Worship Demon Sect, either by training powerful disciples to throw into the fire or by being backstabbed by disciples who throw the master into the fire instead.
In short, either you become nourishment, or I become nourishment.
The struggle has never stopped.
Yet it must be done.
Because only a cultivator who has practiced the "Ghost Infant Scripture" can undertake the core of the Separation Fire Gathering Array.
But even so, the time never seemed right, because the fire wasn’t strong enough! Thus, through twists and turns, it eventually fell into Mu Lieyang’s hands.
At this moment, as the "Ghost Infant Scripture" circulated, Mu Lieyang felt strands of blood-red flames twitching from the air, crawling through his body, and slowly spreading through his flesh and even to his divine soul.
An indescribable sense of excitement emerged from his body and mind.
To this, Mu Lieyang had once been puzzled, wondering if this excitement came from "burning life" or from "extracting life," but after repeated studies, he believed it was the latter.
Others burn life, this array gathers life, while he sits at the array core, extracting these lives to refine the Ghost Infant.
After a while, Mu Lieyang exhaled a long breath and slowly stood up, reached into the void to grab a special piece of paper, examined it repeatedly, then put it away and stepped out of this underground secret realm.
Soon, outside the hall, a beauty wrapped in a snow-white veil stepped gracefully forward, saw him, and let out a joyous cry, tiptoeing lightly into his arms, her plump soft buttocks settling familiarly into his strong thighs.
Her delicate hands gently wrapped around his neck.
"Don’t let him get suspicious." Mu Lieyang spoke coldly.
Wang Susu pouted pitifully, saying, "It’s just that I miss the Sect Leader, that little brat doesn’t have a man’s charm at all, he can’t compare to even a hair of the Sect Leader."
Mu Lieyang asked, "Did he ask for anything again?"
Wang Susu replied, "Just something about fire, he wanted some and said he was interested in it."
Mu Lieyang snorted coldly, "Seems he’s not completely a second ancestor, has some sharpness, give him some time to grow, he might have potential in the future."
Wang Susu giggled, "He can’t compare to you, Sect Leader."
Mu Lieyang said, "Let’s talk business."
Wang Susu said, "I followed your instructions, it took some effort to turn him around, otherwise he’d really start practicing the ’Fire Observation Technique’."
Mu Lieyang said, "He’s a second ancestor here to deliver Contribution Points, a mud Bodhisattva to help me hold the Sect, but he can’t be allowed to really practice the ’Ghost Infant Scripture’. If something goes wrong, won’t those old monsters from the Formless Ancient Race come looking for trouble with me?
Susu, you managed to seduce him onto the bed, that’s a great achievement. With your skills, you can surely make him enchanted with you.
Find some opportunities to apply your tricks, sell him more of our Sect’s techniques, and get him to spend more Contribution Points. I have great use for them.
Meanwhile, keep an eye on Princess Xi’s movements, if there’s anything special, remember to report to me."
"Yes, Sect Leader," Wang Susu responded flirtatiously, then asked, "When will the Purple Mansion opportunity you promised me be fulfilled?"
Mu Lieyang said, "Soon, don’t rush."
Wang Susu nodded, then with a swing of her hips, she slid off him, swaying her waist, and sashayed out the door.
Mu Lieyang’s eyes fixed on those swaying hips, a nameless evil intent rising in his heart.
This woman is indeed a top-notch seductress on the bed, perfect to beguile that naive kid.
Get that naive kid to cough up Contribution Points, meanwhile... with him in the Snow Country, no matter what I do, he’s bound to me, if trouble comes we face it together, heh...
Mu Lieyang started to chuckle sinisterly.
The blood-red flames burned in the side lamps, consuming already tattered paper puppets, and even some fine bone fragments, indistinguishable as to whether they were human or beast digits. Following the principle of waste utilization, Mu Lieyang needed to use up all their remaining power in a sacrifice.
While contemplating this, suddenly, a heavy breath came from outside the hall, footsteps thundered, and the ground trembled.
Mu Lieyang frowned slightly, then changed to a friendly smile and hurried outside the hall.
He saw Princess Xi standing at the doorway.
Mu Lieyang cupped his hands and smiled, "What wind blew you here today?"
Princess Xi said in a muffled voice, "I come to bid farewell on behalf of the master."
"Farewell?"
Mu Lieyang was stunned as if struck by lightning, and after a moment he said, "Have I been an unsatisfactory host? You’ve only stayed for a little over a year, why so soon..."
Princess Xi said in a muffled voice, "The master said he’s tired of staying, wants to change places."

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_2
Mu Lieyang: ...
He felt like all his schemes had failed, and his calculations were completely disrupted.
He chuckled, saying, "I... I’ll go meet the Upper Envoy myself; there’s still a lot of fun to be had in my Snow Country that the Upper Envoy isn’t aware of."
Princess Xi said, "The master says every day it’s just mountains and waters, all white and monotonous, sick of seeing it, no fun at all. Can Sect Leader Mu stop the snow in the Snow Country?"
Mu Lieyang said, "That’s impossible."
Princess Xi continued, "The master is very fond of Elder Wang serving in bed, so name your price."
Mu Lieyang angrily said, "This, this is one of our sect’s Elders, how could we sell her?"
Princess Xi said, "She doesn’t have much lifespan left, right? And all her Nine Palace Blood is ordinary, she’s a waste among wastes. I suppose the Sect Leader doesn’t really want to give her the usage rights of the Profound Heart, correct?"
Mu Lieyang grew even angrier: "She’s an Elder we painstakingly cultivated to the Late stage Of Crimson Palace!"
Princess Xi coldly threatened, "Really not selling?"
Mu Lieyang immediately fell silent.
Quickly calculating in his mind, after confirming that Wang Susu didn’t know the true secrets of the Fire Worship Demon Sect, he sighed and nodded, saying, "Since the Upper Envoy likes her, it is Wang Elder’s good fortune. How about this, I won’t ask for much, just this amount."
He raised three fingers, sighed, and said, "Three..."
Before he finished speaking, a token was already thrown over.
Grabbing it, Mu Lieyang found that there were only three hundred Ancient Race Contribution Points, and he immediately frowned; he had asked for three thousand. What is three hundred?
Before Mu Lieyang could speak, Princess Xi directly sneered and scolded, "Selling a broken Cultivation Technique, you profited so much Contribution Points, I won’t pursue it any longer, don’t be greedy!"
With that, she stomped on the ground, and with a rumbling thunderous sound, went away.
...
...
Several days later...
The sword cultivators of the Nanwu Sword Sect, who had only settled on Zhengyang Peak for over a year, were once again setting off, following the flying palanquin into the distance.
The sword cultivators had some resentment in their hearts.
Because Zhengyang Peak was actually quite good in all aspects, they couldn’t understand why the young master of the Ancient Race would change places on a whim, without having encountered any danger.
Not only that, there wasn’t even a sign of danger.
The Fire Worship Demon Sect was in the midst of a leadership change and was on the rise, wasn’t that pretty good?
The sword cultivators could only feel that the young master of the Ancient Race was too capricious, doing things on a whim, really spending all the cultivation time on such toss-ups.
Song Yan didn’t care about the thoughts of others, and at this moment he wasn’t leisurely sitting in the flying palanquin but was sitting carefully and respectfully because sitting across... An Li was watching him.
As the saying goes, a wise man does not stand near a dangerous wall, much less a devil?
Song Yan was the type who, if he sensed something was wrong, no matter the effort required, he would never be too lazy to leave, maintaining the status quo with thoughts like "it should be fine."
He preferred stability, but if he smelled danger, he would immediately conduct a risk analysis internally. If he felt that the crisis could kill him, he would respond, decide, and act as quickly as possible.
Upon seeing "Demon Infant," "Sacrifice," realizing that the entire Snow Country or even the Ice Realm Wilderness and the extinction of the Lingbo clan might all be a grand scheme spanning a millennium, his first reaction was... to jump out.
In the past, he had no choice; each "jump out" he made came with enormous difficulty and inevitably required a price. But now... he could jump at will.
Not only could he jump at will, he could even take away the elders without hesitation.
Ascending in status brings many conveniences, even for those cultivating the profound.
This is power.
An Li was still watching him.
An Li was different from before, no longer innocent, even when looking lovingly at her lover, there was still the accumulated desolation of these years in her eyes.
Those eyes, filled with a sorrow of a heart turned to ashes.
That sorrow was the twilight of waiting for a hundred years.
Originally, this twilight would have continued forever, but at the moment of recognizing Brother Bai, it seemed she began to grow backwards, and tender buds sprung anew from the sorrowful twilight in her eyes.
She fluttered her big eyes, as if the first time she saw the "wicked Bai," now curiously staring at the young man in front.
Song Yan coughed, and a shadow puppet flew over from outside the palanquin.
"Come in."
The shadow puppet fell upon the curtain, taking the form of a beauty in a white dress.
Song Yan said, "Tell me, did I ever touch you? I order you to tell the truth!"
Wang Susu was taken aback, praised, "The master is truly a special man. Unlike Sect Leader Mu, that lecherous old man, who pounced on me as soon as he saw me, but the master remained indifferent, unmoved even by my numerous provocations. Sect Leader Mu truly cannot compare to even one hair of the master’s."
Song Yan looked at An Li and said, "So, what you heard, what you saw, were all... cough cough... all to coax that Sect Leader. Otherwise, why would he so easily sell Elder Wang to me?
If he has no greed, he must have a request.
If I’m not lusting after Elder Wang’s beauty, then it must be the secrets of his sect.
Thus, he would not have let her go."
Wang Susu clapped her hands and said, "The master is truly wise and mighty."
After saying this, she raised her hand to flip from the Void, revealing an Array Tracing Map, presenting it with both hands, saying, "Please take a look."
Song Yan took it, squinted his eyes, seeing Wang Susu lower her gaze as if she wanted to speak but hesitated, and seeing An Li seemingly wanting to get up to avoid, he said, "Speak directly, no need to avoid her."
Wang Susu surprisingly glanced at An Li.
She truly didn’t understand why such a young lady would earn the master’s favor?
However, she still directly said, "The old fool thought I didn’t know anything, but after so many years, how could I not catch an opportunity?

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_3
I secretly took down this array map.
I’m not quite sure what this array map is, nor did I dare to ask anyone, but I know it must be a core secret of the Fire Worship Demon Sect."
Song Yan said, "You betrayed your old employer so decisively?"
Wang Susu covered her lips with a silver bell-like laugh, "Someone who desires me, wants me to cheat my master out of money, and yet drags on without giving me what they promised. Can it really be considered a betrayal? I was just deeply wronged."
After saying this, she looked at Song Yan with beautiful eyes and said with a smile, "Master is the only one who hasn’t touched me or bullied me; naturally, I will be fiercely loyal, swearing allegiance unto death."
Upon hearing the words "fiercely loyal, swearing allegiance unto death," Song Yan burst into hearty laughter.
If he rose by killing a boss, progressing step by step; junior sister Susu would rise by sleeping with a man, progressing in the same way.
Now, junior sister Susu surely wanted nothing more than to sleep with him earnestly.
At this moment, Wang Susu’s eyes showed a hint of injury, and she sighed softly, "Susu knows Master won’t believe it, but time will prove everything Susu said to be true."
Song Yan glanced at An Li, found An Li looking at him, so he reined in the wild laughter he intended to let out, took a deep breath, and said blandly, "Alright."
After thinking for a moment, he added, "Reward."
He waved his hand, and Wang Susu unwillingly retreated from the flying palanquin.
Song Yan took out the rubbings of the array map for a look, then temporarily put it away.
No matter what, he didn’t need to be so hasty anymore, he didn’t need to walk a tightrope, or dance on the knife’s edge like a desperate fugitive.
He still had plenty of time.
An Li was still looking at him.
As she looked, An Li suddenly showed a pained expression.
In her heart, Senior Brother Bai was actually quite naive, and now... how much pain had Senior Brother Bai gone through to become like this?
Originally, she was worried that Senior Brother Bai would be exposed after possessing a disciple of the Formless Ancient Race.
But now it seemed, how could Senior Brother Bai be exposed...
Senior Brother Bai was completely a true child of a noble family, unfathomable and at ease, everyone else thought Senior Brother Bai left out of willfulness, but she knew he had a deeper meaning.
...
Night fell.
The flying palanquin was still in the Snow Country area, currently resting temporarily on a mountain land abundant with Profound Qi.
A bonfire blazed, and sword cultivators sat cross-legged, surrounding the central flying palanquin.
Inside the palanquin, Song Yan and An Li whispered, listening to the latter talk about past events at the Nanwu Sword Sect.
The past was nothing more than the Puppet Sect shifting from an original struggle to cooperation with the Southern Wu Sword Sect, then jointly opening the ancient teleportation array, linking north and south. The struggle arose because the land only housed the Puppet Sect and the Nanwu Sword Sect, and knowing of the ancient teleportation array, Puppet Sect wanted to control it through the Southern Wu Sword Sect, while cooperation was... the demons pressed south, giving no respite.
And some people’s stories gradually unfolded before Song Yan’s eyes.
Tian Xiaojiu’s niece, Tian Xiaoling, missed the opportunity to cultivate entirely due to the sect’s hidden seclusion amidst entry-level destruction, thus she and a fellow senior brother fled into the mundane world, never returning.
Cao Yuzhuang, after fleeing from Old Devil Song Yan and bringing back many Demon Sect cultivation techniques, has since been managing those techniques, including corpse rearing, paper figures, and shadow puppet arts. Then, when demons moved south and the Jin Kingdom was on the brink of collapse, Cao Yuzhuang left alone with a sword, ambushed and annihilated the fleeing Jin royal family, avenging the kingdom’s downfall. He later became hunted by demons, whereabouts unknown. The last communication stone transmission seemed to suggest he was near the East Sea.
Su Yao had been cultivating diligently, and after reaching the new territory near the Ice Realm Wilderness with the sect, she continued to cultivate, reaching the Middle Stage of Crimson Palace thirty years ago. Unwilling to see the sect decline, she wanted to risk taking a powerful demon blood-infused Crimson Palace Pill, thinking she’d be able to support the sect if she grew strong. An Li listed more materials to improve the pill yield and detoxify the erysipelas, but those materials were prohibitively expensive, leading the impoverished Southern Wu Sword Sect unable to afford them. Thus, Su Yao ventured alone into the ruins near Lingbo Ancient Race in the Ice Realm Wilderness, hoping to try her luck. But she did not return.
As for the Puppet Sect...
Wang Susu didn’t say much, but Song Yan roughly guessed the trajectory.
Blood Granny, Copper Beard, and other elders, after joining the Fire Worship Demon Sect, did not receive the right to use the Profound Heart due to being outsiders, and subsequently died of old age one by one.
Wang Susu actively sold all Puppet Sect inheritances, then ingratiated herself with the old Sect Leader, and later in the new and old struggle, helped Mu Lieyang kill the old Sect Leader, thus clinging onto Mu Lieyang’s favor.
Of course, junior sister Susu would never admit these, it’s all Song Yan’s speculation.
Junior sister Susu was adept at following the wind, currying favor, evading calamities, highly skilled in surfing the treacherous currents; she was truly a calamity that would live a thousand years. If not for her being unable to bypass the hurdle of Crimson Palace Poison, making her Nine Palace Blood common, Mu Lieyang might genuinely have been tempted to help her break through to the Purple Mansion Realm.
An Li felt fatigue as she continued speaking.
It had been a long time since she slept as peacefully as she had recently.
After she closed her eyes, Song Yan gently took a blanket and covered her, these actions making him feel the thoughts in his heart begin to change.
At that moment, he suddenly sensed a thought arriving.
It was a thought from Princess Xi.
"Master, I’ve mentioned your request to the clan, the clan...
Song Yan lifted the curtain and strode out, walked to where Princess Xi was in the shadows of the snow forest not far away, and said, "Speak directly."

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_4
Princess Xi said, "You want to reside permanently in the kept land of the Formless Ancient Race, but even for people of our own race, it’s not easy to enter."
"Easily?" Song Yan replied, "Just tell me the requirements."
Princess Xi said, "Either make a great contribution or pass the talent test. Even the owner needs to be tested. This isn’t a test of Divine Soul Talent, but a... test of our Formless Race’s innate talent.
The specific test content involves randomly selecting a few Techniques, executing them once, and then having the tester simulate them using the Formless Secret Technique. Based on this simulation, evaluations are made. Those who pass can reside permanently in our kept land with up to five attendants."
Song Yan closed his eyes slightly.
After randomly selecting the Fire Worship Demon Sect and discovering dangers even in casually chosen places, he naturally turned his gaze towards "the best place in the domain of the Fifteen Vassal States of the Formless Ancient Race"—the kept land of the Formless Ancient Race.
The kept land of the Formless Ancient Race is a mountain region rich in Profound Qi and of exquisite terrain, known as—Gusha Mountain.
Gusha Mountain is not large, with a total of three peaks, yet it encompasses the Five Elements Profound Qi, and has two Hearts of the Profound Vein on the left and right. It is a top-tier blessed land that captures the essence of heaven and earth, unparalleled in its time.
Under the arrangement of arrays by the Formless Ancient Race, the Five Elements Profound Qi forms five special Profound Qi cultivation grounds, encircling the three peaks.
Below the peaks lies a grassland.
On that grassland is a simple and honest small country, under protection—Qinghuan Kingdom.
Besides, there are also numerous Secret Realms.
The Demon Beast Blood harvested in those Secret Realms is rather rare, belonging as a tribute to the Formless Ancient Race, and outsiders are not permitted to enter.
One of the "Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant" that Song Yan needs is obtained from a Secret Realm here.
Because this area is very small, it always exists as a reward ground for the Formless Ancient Race. The ancestors do not really need such places, but it is an excellent blessed land for the younger ones below.
Various thoughts flashed by, Song Yan opened his eyes and said, "Inform the clan, I want to take the test."
Princess Xi scrutinized the youth before her and said in a muffled voice, "Alright."
...
Several months later, the flying palanquin crossed over half of the Formless Ancient Race’s vassal states, arriving at the far western grassland, stopping on a clearing at the foot of Gusha Mountain.
After waiting for a day, Princess Xi led Song Yan to the testing site.
An elder, a middle-aged man, and a youth also soon arrived.
The middle-aged man is naturally Tang Xiaokong.
"Is Han’Er going to challenge Gusha Mountain now?"
"Yes."
"I remember when you left, you were at the Seventh Layer of Refining Profound, what about now?"
"Ninth Layer."
Song Yan slightly exerted his power, displaying the aura of the Ninth Layer.
The blessing of the Formless Race ancestors can only conceal Qi, but cannot enhance it.
Tang Xiaokong glanced at Princess Xi, with a look of puzzlement in his eyes, and asked, "Little Xi, is this what you meant by little cultivation?"
Princess Xi scratched her head honestly and said, "He... he hasn’t really practiced much."
As she said this, she was looking at Tang Xiaokong, but as she spoke, she subconsciously looked at the youth.
The youth remained silent.
The elder then said, "Two years from the Seventh Layer to the Ninth Layer, even if resources were consumed, the qualification is still monstrous, could it be the Celestial Profound Root?"
Tang Xiaokong said, "This is your fourth uncle, Tang Xiaoping."
Song Yan said respectfully, "Fourth Uncle, I am merely an Earth Profound Root."
He had already discerned that the one with the highest status here was surprisingly not Tang Xiaokong, nor the white-haired fourth uncle, but that youth.
Cultivators cannot determine age by appearance.
For example, one who lives a thousand years, though over four hundred years old, still appears as a youth.
Five thousand years old, although two thousand years old, still a youth.
The youth appeared handsome, with eyes vast as the sea, brighter than the stars, standing there, seemingly blurring the boundary between oneself and the world, as if in the world, yet also outside it.
Tang Xiaokong looked at the most noble youth, seemingly wanting to retreat two steps.
The youth said indifferently, "I just heard that the Yin Yang Profound Dragon watched him for ten breaths and also heard of his arrogant and tyrannical behavior, actually wanting to test Gusha Mountain at the Refining Profound Realm, so I grew curious.
As it happened, I intended to head east, passing this place, so I made a detour to bear witness and casually watch.
You need not mind me, nor call me anything.
Our Formless Ancient Race is not a place to rank by seniority, don’t let any ancestor or grandfather extinguish your spirit.
Youths should have the arrogance of youths, if one can take steps amid the clouds, they should stand above all beings, why yield?
Ancestor? Grandfather? They’re merely to be trampled underfoot.
If you don’t even have this bit of spirit, why cultivate Profound, why battle with Techniques?"
Within the calm tone, there was an inherent domineering aura, everything seemed so naturally justified.
And yet Tang Xiaokong and the fourth uncle didn’t refute the youth’s words in the slightest.
The youth casually sat on a piece of green stone, as though he had been plucked from the world, although present, he seemed to have utterly vanished, as long as you didn’t focus on him, even the Divine Sense couldn’t perceive his presence.
Tang Xiaokong also stepped aside, and the elder stepped forward, looking steadily at Song Yan, "Since you are in the Refining Profound, this old man will demonstrate Refining Profound Techniques...
These Techniques have been gathered by our race for millennia, they are the most difficult, most obscure Secret Techniques in the Refining Profound Realm.
Even Formless Race people of the Crimson Palace Realm can’t expect to use them after seeing them once.
Of course, some of which the Purple Mansion couldn’t replicate after observing several times.
Isn’t that right, third brother?"
The elder glanced at Tang Xiaokong.
Tang Xiaokong said speechlessly, "That’s my son, not me."
The elder said, "Didn’t you also have to watch it a full two times to imitate it?"
That said, the elder then looked at Song Yan, saying earnestly, "What I just mentioned is merely the first test Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: 163. ’Enhanced Version’ Formless Talent (8.1K characters - major Chapter seeking subscription)_5
Today, there are three challenges, each more difficult than the last.
I learned these techniques specifically to test disciples, and let me tell you, it’s very hard.
Young men should have ambition, but also spirit.
Don’t let arrogance destroy your spirit; you need to be steady in doing things. Without a near-certain grasp, don’t take action lightly, lest you damage your spirit.
The spirit is easily damaged and hard to mend.
With that said, are you really sure you want to try?"
Song Yan nodded.
The road ahead is long and full of uncertainties; he doesn’t think he’ll always have time to rest. Naturally, he must seize the opportunity provided by this favorable situation to accumulate more resources and cultivate more strength.
Tang Xiaoping said, "I’ll demonstrate once, give you the time of an incense stick, and then you fight me.
We’ll use the same moves.
I will suppress my power to match your realm. As long as you can draw with me, you pass."
Song Yan said, "Fourth Uncle, please."
With that, he took a deep breath, gathered his strength, and watched intently.
In an instant, the elder in front of him, as well as all the Profound Qi contained in the surrounding air, transformed into strands of threads.
Soon, the Profound Qi in the air dissipated, leaving only the elder.
All the tracks of Profound Qi around the elder were captured by his eyes.
Tang Xiaoping said, "Watch closely!"
With that, he suddenly raised his hand, his palm quivering, causing the Profound Qi to stack, the palm quivering continuously, and the Profound Qi stacking continuously.
The elder spun once like hugging stars and embracing the moon, but the stacked Profound Qi did not disperse. Instead, it seemed to enter reincarnation, starting a new round of stacking.
In the stacking, the power in the elder’s hand was increasing at a terrifying speed, because he was only accumulating and not dissipating it, so it grew stronger and stronger.
Song Yan emptied his mind of all thoughts; everything and everyone around him seemed to disappear, leaving only the tracks of Profound Qi on the elder’s body.
The Formless Talent swiftly extracted these Profound Qi tracks, automatically rehearsing them in Song Yan’s mind.
A moment later, the elder stopped.
Song Yan closed his eyes.
The world was silent, the wind blowing over sweeping clouds, and tall grasses like blades.
As the time of an incense stick was about to pass, the panel in Song Yan’s mind suddenly jumped, and new information appeared.
[Technique]
Profound Mountain Nine Stacks (Not yet entry-level) (Imitate mode)
"Imitate mode" indicates that Song Yan can directly use the technique, but it’s merely imitated, and he cannot grasp its true essence.
The words "Not yet entry-level" clearly explain this point; he can only imitate it with his own strength and has not truly learned it.
Song Yan didn’t hesitate; his attention fully focused on "Profound Mountain Nine Stacks," beginning direct life span calculation.
In fact, with his current Divine Soul strength, previously at Mo Sword Sect, the "Silver Stream Sword Technique" was mastered just by one glance, achieving perfection after a day of cultivation.
But "Profound Mountain Nine Stacks" took him a full 10 years to perfect.
He was not satisfied and spent another 55 years to advance further.
In the blink of an eye, the panel changed:
[Technique]
Profound Mountain Tenfold Transformation into Mulberry Field (Perfection) (First successful calculation)
"Is it done?"
Tang Xiaoping asked.
Song Yan opened his eyes and said, "Yes, Fourth Uncle."
The word settled, and the young man and elder stood separately.
Tang Xiaoping beckoned, indicating Song Yan should take the first move.
Song Yan shook his head.
He’s being tested now, not killing. Testing requires straightforwardness; killing demands cunning.
Tang Xiaoping smiled, then stepped forward.
One step like the wind, body light and agile, hands swirling, hugging stars and embracing the moon, Profound Qi stacking.
Song Yan almost replicated his movements.
The two quickly approached each other.
Tang Xiaokong nodded with satisfaction, but just then, he seemed to see something, gasped, then bent over, leaned forward, squinting, carefully watching Song Yan’s actions, as if distinguishing something.
Soon, Song Yan and Tang Xiaoping engaged each other.
It was merely a contact of hands, yet it brought about a collision akin to two mountains.
Their palms continuously rotated, movements not complex, and speed not fast, yet each rotation increased the mountain’s weight.
The weight on their hands grew increasingly exaggerated, clearly just air displays, but each turn brought a swift escalation of pressure.
Techniques at the Refining Profound Level are mostly one-time use, where is this kind of snowballing one?
Tang Xiaokong watched closely, only to see his younger brother’s face showing a serious expression, eyes deeply furrowed. Although there was no hindrance in his moves, his body was tight, showing a sense of passively confronting the challenge.
Obviously, he’s the tester, but at this moment, he seemed more like the one being tested.
Because the youth’s hand was always rolling over like a mountain, and he was quickly countering.
After nine hands, all the stacked power broke out completely.
Tang Xiaoping was directly shaken back, both hands behind him, floating with the wind, landing far away.
As he looked forward again, his pupils suddenly contracted.
Not just him, but Tang Xiaokong and Princess Xi had their eyes widened too.
Because... Song Yan hadn’t moved.
The explosive power vanished into thin air before him.
As if thousands of mountains suddenly... transformed into flat land, no power left.
How is this imitation, how is this formless?
This is clearly "using their technique, plus three points, then applying it back"!

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)
The long wind pushes the grass, the grass reaches knee-high, the young man takes off the crown he usually wears and carelessly throws it aside, letting his black hair dance wildly. Facing the four gazes suddenly focused on him, he clasps his hands together and bowing respectfully, says: "Fourth Uncle, the next technique."
"To be proud yet modest is easy, but not to lose decorum is difficult. To still be able to infer from one instance another, truly excellent, good!!"
Tang Xiaoping praised, then looked at him deeply, and kindly said, "Little Han, even if you don’t pass the next two tests, you need not blame yourself. The name of Yin Yang Profound Dragon Ten Breaths is well-deserved, given time, you will surely become a pillar of our Formless Ancient Race."
His words carried a gentle sense of care, serving as a mental safeguard for the young man in front of him, to prevent losing heart if he didn’t pass the next two tests.
Tang Xiaoping couldn’t help but glance at Tang Xiaokong and praised, "Third Brother, you have acknowledged a good son."
Tang Xiaokong laughed heartily.
Tang Xiaoping turned back, saying, "Little Han, the second technique, watch closely."
Song Yan replied politely, "Fourth Uncle, please."
Tang Xiaoping responded with an "hmm," then raised his hand.
The trajectory of Profound Qi around him began to flow.
Yet, it was merely flowing and did not require the hand gestures needed for "Stacking Qi" like the Profound Mountain Nine Stacks.
Tang Xiaoping stood quietly, but this time the flow was not only complex but also special. To ordinary cultivators, it seemed like nothing was happening as the old man stood leisurely.
Song Yan hurriedly activated his "Formless Talent" to observe carefully.
He appeared calm, but in his heart, he was actually nervous. He indeed needed residency rights in Gusha Mountain because the cultivation realm was fraught with peril. Even choosing a random spot could unintentionally draw one into local conspiracies, becoming someone else’s pawn or being implicated. Only this Formless Ancient Race’s enclave could be a relative haven.
In his eyes, the trajectory of Profound Qi around the old man not far away presented itself one by one.
The trajectory quickly wove into a peculiar funnel.
The upper end was at the old man’s position, and the lower end was rooted in the earth.
As a result, though the old man stood there, he quickly became one with the surrounding earth.
Such a technique was truly unheard of. Even though Song Yan had scoured through the Three Kingdoms, Great Chu, and even Feng Chengzi’s lineage of books, he had never discovered a technique of this level. Obviously... this technique was a rare gem uncovered by the Formless Ancient Race in the last five thousand years from some obscure nook.
The next moment, the old man slowly walked, stopping before a small mountain several dozen feet high, and lightly lifted his hands at the mountain’s side...
Boom!
The ground trembled.
The earth crumbling, surrounding demon beasts fled rapidly.
The mountain grew taller, and cracking sounds emanated from the soil, clearly indicating the mountain’s roots were breaking.
Afterward, the old man let go, pressing the mountain back down, causing the cracking sounds to cease.
Tang Xiaoping completed all of this, turned, and smilingly said to Song Yan, "Little Han, this mountain bearing is but a small application, with infinite mysteries within.
In my research of this technique, I became so engrossed that it felt ingenious, even forgetting cultivation, leading to my current white hair with no hope of reaching the Divine Infant Realm in this lifetime.
Yet, this also testifies to the technique’s intriguing nature.
Who would have thought the Refining Profound Level could bear mountains?"
He raised his hand, his old eyes glowing with light, smiling, he said, "This small Refining Profound Level truly contains a lot of intricate and fascinating techniques, even surpassing the complexity of Crimson Palace techniques."
As he finished, it seemed he wanted to continue speaking at length, but was abruptly interrupted by Tang Xiaokong beside him.
"Old Fourth, don’t misguide the child!"
Tang Xiaoping was momentarily stunned, then lightly sighed, saying no more.
Tang Xiaokong then looked seriously at Song Yan and said, "Han’Er, what your Fourth Uncle said makes sense, yet also doesn’t.
The sense lies in the fact that the Refining Profound Level indeed harbors many extremely intricate techniques; to bear a mountain at the Refining Profound Realm is truly astounding.
But the nonsense is that Refining Profound is ultimately just Refining Profound, even the Crimson Palace Bloodline Technique can overpower it.
Refining Profound and the techniques of the Crimson Palace are the foundation for attacks by the Purple Mansion.
The Purple Mansion attacks with thoughts, and each thought is an independent casting by you.
The techniques you cast can only be found within the Crimson Palace, impossible to deploy at the Refining Profound Level again.
Therefore, no matter how intricate the techniques at the Refining Profound Level, they are but trivial tricks.
Your Fourth Uncle was indulgent in these trivial tricks, neglecting his pursuits, which hindered his cultivation.
In the future, on your cultivation path, be sure to pay attention to these; do not linger over roadside wildflowers and forget to move forward, thus walking the old path of your Fourth Uncle."
After speaking, he raised his hand, saying, "Old Fourth, Han’Er’s talent is exceptional, what I said is also for the clan. You two may continue."
The air grew quiet.
Tang Xiaoping said lightly, "This technique, half an hour."
Then, he began to wait.
Song Yan closed his eyes, using the Formless Talent to rehearse Tang Xiaoping’s recently demonstrated profound technique trajectory in his mind, over and over.
Funnel-shaped Qi form.
Man and earth, as one.
He repeatedly deduced, yet couldn’t fathom it.
Suddenly, a thought barged into his mind: That Qi was not ordinary profound Qi but Earth Profound Qi extracted from the ground. And when Fourth Uncle was walking, he wasn’t moving fast because he had already merged with the surrounding earth, rooted far deeper than even lofty mountains and ancient trees. That’s why he moved slowly; thus, when he acted, it wasn’t merely his action but was also augmented by the power of the earth.
But, is this... really a power that can be wielded at the Refining Profound Realm?
This technique, without enlightenment, could take a lifetime to master, couldn’t it?
Amongst Song Yan’s Refining Profound Techniques, he primarily practices "Hundred Forms Demon Body" deduced from "Hundred Forms Divine Control."

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_2
The "Hundred Forms Demon Body" can be cultivated at the entry-level of Refining Profound, which can be considered extremely accessible, yet if one possesses a sufficiently powerful Shadow Puppet, it remains formidable even at the Late Stage of Crimson Palace. After reaching the Purple Mansion Realm, although this technique can no longer enhance the attack of the mind, it can continue to reinforce the body.
However, Song Yan felt that compared to this technique, the "Hundred Forms Divine Control" was not even worthy to carry its shoes.
What kind of terrifying power could be deduced from this technique?
A trace of joy flashed in his heart.
Strong power is the source of his sense of security.
He cast aside distractions and devoted himself wholeheartedly to the deduction process.
After nearly half an hour, a drop of sweat had already formed at his temple.
Perhaps as the time was nearing its end, his urgency drove him to a moment of insight, allowing him to barely display the name of the cultivation technique on the panel at almost the last moment.
[Magic]
Chenggen Mountain Technique (Not Entry-level) (Imitation State)
Song Yan quickly utilized his wisdom to continue comprehending.
After investing 70 years of life essence, he perfected the "Chenggen Mountain Technique".
After investing 350 years of life essence, the panel was updated.
[Magic]
Wind Mountain Movement (Perfection) (First successful deduction)
At the moment of comprehending this technique, Song Yan also understood its characteristics.
Gen means mountain.
Continual mountains imply mountains both above and below.
Therefore, this technique weaves profound qi from the depths of the earth, connecting to oneself, allowing one to merge with the earth and possess its power.
However, in the first deduction, he used the "weaving method" in reverse, from above to below.
Above, represents wind.
Wind belongs to wood.
By weaving downward with the wind, one allows oneself to merge into the wind.
Thus... focusing on two tasks, weaving both, as if merging with the earth, as if in the wind, seemingly still yet moving, both light and heavy.
This is called... Wind Mountain Movement.
Anyone who engages with him feels as if they are contending with the earth beneath him and the wind around him simultaneously.
Song Yan felt that this technique was already at the same level as the "Hundred Forms Demon Body", yet the "Hundred Forms Demon Body" relies on accumulating with shadow puppets, while this "Wind Mountain Movement" harnesses nature. If this "Wind Mountain Movement" can be further deduced, it would surely far surpass the "Hundred Forms Demon Body."
"Time is up."
Tang Xiaoping’s voice came through.
Song Yan said no more, stood still, and directly performed the Wind Mountain Movement. In an instant, the two qi, Wood Profound and Earth Profound, arose, forming two overlapping "funnels" up and down.
Song Yan fixed his gaze on the mountain peak Tang Xiaoping had moved earlier and took a step forward.
Swish!
In an instant, he was in front of the mountain.
Tang Xiaoping frowned.
For just that instant, he realized that this lad likely didn’t understand at all. The "Chenggen Mountain Technique", because it merges with the earth, is very slow, how could it be so fast?
In the next instant, Song Yan clasped his hands on the mountainside, slightly lifted his waist, and gently pulled.
Immediately, the earth trembled, wild winds howled, and the mountain roots cracked.
Tang Xiaoping blinked, a very strange feeling arose in his heart.
It was a strong sense of contradiction.
On one hand, he thought this lad was imitating incorrectly, but on the other, he felt this lad seemed correct, not just correct, but couldn’t be more correct.
The mountain lifted slightly, then settled back down.
Song Yan asked, "Fourth Uncle, have I passed?"
Tang Xiaoping thought for a while before saying, "Xiaohan? What exactly happened here? Why does it feel like you both did and didn’t do it right?"
Song Yan cupped his hands and slowly conveyed his understanding, concluding, "I observed Fourth Uncle weaving from the earth, so I spent a stick of incense’s worth of time to comprehend this technique, but seeing I still had time, a whim hit me. I thought about what if a similar method was slightly adjusted, starting from the sky, what would happen? Then... here we are."
Tang Xiaoping:...
Princess Xi:...
Tang Xiaokong, who was listening nearby:...
The seated youth suddenly stood up.
These four, each more monstrous than the next, but at this moment, they all felt crushed by the innate talent of a greater monster from a higher plane.
This talent wasn’t even something like Profound Root’s aptitude, but a kind of comprehension from the Divine Soul, something others couldn’t take away from you no matter how they tried to seize it.
Tang Xiaoping said tremblingly, "You... you can even deduce from the ’Chenggen Mountain Technique’? And connect it above the skies? Not only connected but also succeeded?"
His tone grew higher with each sentence, and his words carried a resonant, odd quality.
Tang Xiaokong said, "You... you not only imitated but also created? And created successfully?"
Princess Xi blinked, looking at Song Yan as if seeing him for the first time.
The three simultaneously glanced towards the youth not far away.
The youth earnestly looked at Song Yan, after a long pause said, "My name is Tang Yanzhang, had I met you a thousand years ago, we would surely be brothers, and even today, we would travel together. Alas... alas..."
He sighed and shook his head, then said, "Alas now I must journey east and cannot wait for you."
As he spoke, he then smiled, saying, "But I believe you will surely come, so... I shall wait for you in the east for five hundred years."
Song Yan asked, "Why must you head east?"
Tang Yanzhang contemplatively gazed at the sky and said softly, "The east... is where the truth of birth and extinction of the Ancient Race lies. Every person from the Ancient Race, if they do not wish for their clan to perish, must go east."
Song Yan asked, "Has the Lingbo and Dragon Elephant clans ever gone there?"
Tang Yanzhang replied, "The Lingbo Ancient Race was originally a member of the mountain Ancient Sword clan community, which was once the most powerful dominant alliance on this land, the leader of the Ancient Race Alliance.
But ever since the extinction of the Lingbo Ancient Race over a thousand years ago, the Ancient Sword communities in the mountains have all moved north.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_3
As for me, I must first visit the ancient site of the Ancient Sword Community of the Mountain Range, then head north to explore its mysteries, ensuring the everlasting stability of my Formless Race."
Tang Xiaokong suddenly said, "Xiaohan, this is our ancestor."
Earlier, he did not mention it because the young man was reluctant to reveal it. Now that the young man had introduced himself, he certainly had to come forward for the junior to address him.
Song Yan bowed, just about to salute, when Tang Yanzhang waved his hand and said, "Don’t call!"
Tang Xiaokong knew the ancestor’s temper was eccentric and often surprising, so he said no more.
Tang Yanzhang said, "Five hundred years later, we will meet in the East, and it will be fine if you call me Big Brother then. For now... don’t call anything, it’s meaningless!"
Song Yan bowed and said, "Yes."
Tang Yanzhang raised his hand and flicked a Five-Colored Token out.
Tang Xiaoping was surprised and said, "Ancestor, only two of the three tests are completed."
Tang Yanzhang said, "Whether or not he passes the third test doesn’t matter; this kid is qualified to live here."
After speaking, he nudged his mouth, "Residence token, shouldn’t you take it?"
Song Yan took the token and said, "Thank you."
In his heart, he also breathed a sigh of relief.
He hadn’t expected that after two tests, he would already have successfully obtained the "residency rights of Gusha Mountain."
However, he couldn’t help but marvel at the vastness of the world. The ancestor before him was clearly of the Divine Infant Realm, and yet... even he had to travel east to investigate. And according to what he himself said, the Ancient Sword Community of the Mountain Range must also have the Divine Infant Realm. Yet they... have entirely disappeared from this continent, heading north.
Since the North can be related to the life and death of the Ancient Race, there is no doubt it’s something that can completely control the Ancient Race.
He entered the Formless Ancient Race, gaining a protective umbrella and immense benefits and conveniences, but he also simultaneously took on some of the Formless Ancient Race’s cause-and-effect. Just like those who are close to him, Song Yan, will inevitably also bear his cause-and-effect. If a crisis to suppress him arises, those involved will be implicated.
The Formless Ancient Race is no different.
In the Jianghu, one cannot act on their own accord.
In the Cultivator Realm, is there truly no difference?
While pondering, a faint voice came from afar, interrupting his thoughts.
"If you want to thank someone, thank yourself." Tang Yanzhang replied, sitting down again, watching the distance with interest, glancing at Tang Xiaoping and saying, "Continue."
Tang Xiaoping did not know what more to say, as the clan rules clearly state that one must achieve great merit or pass all three tests to reside in Gusha Mountain.
But this ancestor is notorious for "treating etiquette and law as dirt." He doesn’t care about any clan rules, otherwise, he wouldn’t do things like "giving the token early just because he found someone agreeable" or "letting the junior call him Big Brother."
At this moment, Tang Xiaoping could only hope Song Yan could successfully pass the third test.
After a brief digression, Tang Xiaoping looked at Song Yan and said, "The third technique, although based on the principles of refining profound techniques, has never been successfully used by anyone in the Refining Profound Realm. This technique, founded on the previous two, uses the visualization of military formations and harbors intense hatred and killing intent to activate it, not just mere mimicry of technique trajectory."
Song Yan listened intently to his uncle’s explanation, then said calmly, "Uncle, please."
Tang Xiaoping said, "Watch closely!
This technique is called Three Steps to Heaven."
With that, a light suddenly shone before his eyes as he took a step forward.
In one step, he tread atop Chenggen Mountain, his hands flipping the Profound Mountain Nine Stacks, gathering the Earth Profound Qi, and twisting the Profound Qi, making this seemingly calm elder momentarily appear like a battlefield war god.
Two steps, three steps...
With each step, his aura grew, and the Profound Qi stacked up, deepening further in its integration with the earth.
After three steps, he held his left hand behind him, raised his head, and clenched his right fist, gathering all his power at that point, then lightly tapped towards the sky.
The sky, originally a sea of flowing clouds with Xuanque birds flying, but with his light tap, the sea of clouds immediately fell, becoming empty; a moment ago, clouds covered the sky, now the sky is cloudless, even the Xuanque birds in the clouds all fell like rain, even if they were not within the range of this punch, they plummeted from high above.
This was not merely a one-time shock but a power with immense penetration and spreading force, involving profound and advanced uses of Profound Qi.
Knocking the heavens, sweeping the clouds from the sky.
If used to attack enemies, the outcome would be clear.
After performing this move, Tang Xiaoping said, "Three Steps to Heaven, this technique’s power has surpassed most Crimson Palace Techniques, even with a bloodline, it’s at most equal. Xiaohan, you have half a day to comprehend this body and spirit technique, focusing all into one. If you can achieve the semblance of it in half a day, it will be considered a success."
Song Yan did not overestimate himself, nodded, then sat cross-legged, and began to ponder.
This technique is extremely difficult.
Its difficulty surpasses that of "Chenggen Mountain Technique."
If "Chenggen Mountain Technique" and "Profound Mountain Nine Stacks" were the seed and green leaves of a flower, then... this technique is the blooming flower.
The flower, resplendent, dazzling.
If the flower hadn’t bloomed, everything before it would seem meaningless, even ridiculously comical.
Without this technique, regardless of "Profound Mountain Nine Stacks" or "Chenggen Mountain Technique," they are just clever tricks.
But with it, this power instantly breaks through the Crimson Palace.
This... is a technique capable of allowing one in the Refining Profound Realm to leap a major realm and take down the Crimson Palace Realm purely with technique power.
However, this technique is ultimately not within the Nine Palace Blood, it belongs solely to the use of Profound Qi, truly, there wouldn’t be someone who would spend a lot of time understanding this technique.
Those without comprehension won’t figure it out in a lifetime.
Those with comprehension, have long gone to break through the Crimson Palace, the Purple Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_4
Who would linger for this technique, wasting time?
Therefore, although this magic is powerful, it is destined to be a mere chicken rib. Only someone like Tang Xiaoping, a Purple Mansion Cultivator, unintentionally obsessed with its research, would practice it and pass it down to this day.
The Formless Ancient Race never intended for their youngsters to enter Gusha Mountain for cultivation. After all, in their view, external experiences are very necessary for clan members of lower realms. Entering the family’s self-preserved "Greenhouse" early is meaningless and ought to be rejected.
Hence, the difficulty of this "Gusha Mountain Test" is hardest for those in the Refining Profound Realm.
Next comes the Crimson Palace, Purple Mansion...
The "Refining Profound Realm’s Gusha Mountain Test" is not designed for anyone to successfully pass. If Song Yan weren’t a prodigy who caught the attention of the Yin Yang Profound Dragon for ten breaths, his request would have been outright rejected, let alone arranged for a test.
Time passed by, second by second.
Princess Xi quietly watched the youth sitting among the long grass. Originally, she chose this youth because of his powerful talent, but as she got to know him, she increasingly felt her choice was correct.
This youth is not only powerful in Divine Soul Talent but also in comprehension, to an unbelievable degree.
Her heart was thoroughly settled.
If this youth cannot help her explore the truth of the Dragon Elephant Ancient Race’s survival, then perhaps no one in the world can.
Now, this youth is still very weak. Her every effort to protect him, every completed order, is accumulating cause and effect...
Song Yan knew his performance today had thoroughly rooted him deeply within the Formless Ancient Race.
Even the trace of "evaluation" that might have existed in Princess Xi’s heart had vanished.
He had no other choice.
Having the fertile land of the Formless Ancient Race for breathing and development was already enough.
Half a day later...
Words appeared on Song Yan’s panel:
[Technique]
Three Steps to Heaven (Uninitiated) (Simulation State)
He skillfully utilized wisdom and sweat, spending 100 years to perfect it, and then 530 years to change it to "Two Steps to Heaven."
When time ended, it was already deep into the night.
The sky was filled with stars, brilliant starlight and moonlight intertwining.
Song Yan stood up.
The crowd said no more words, just quietly watched him.
Song Yan took two steps forward, raised his hand, and punched, shattering the starlight across the sky, causing a misty light to spread. The world presented a fragmented feeling, with penetrating power like a vast net, precisely locking in mid-air and not descending a bit further.
Otherwise...the forest here would be completely shattered by this punch.
No one said anything else, nor could they say anything.
The four people looked at Song Yan with varying expressions.
Tang Yanzhang only left one sentence: "The prodigy of our clan ought to be concealed, let him be known to the world once he enters the Purple Mansion."
Tang Xiaokong and Tang Xiaoping nodded one after another.
Princess Xi looked at Song Yan with a few more traces of genuine respect, a respect for a future strong figure.
...
...
Days later.
Song Yan settled at Gusha Mountain.
He brought four attendants: Princess Xi, An Li, Yu Xuanwei, Wang Susu.
There is one more spot, which will be dealt with later.
The next step was to find a body for An Li to seize.
His matters had spread among the upper echelons of the Formless Ancient Race, so...finding a body for An Li became the Formless Ancient Race’s business.
The Formless Ancient Race quickly selected some Refining Profound Cultivators with excellent Profound Roots, compiled a roster for Song Yan to choose from.
But An Li refused upon receiving the list.
She didn’t want to kill, especially these talented cultivators with ordinary backgrounds.
Song Yan seemed to sense something, directly communicating through his godfather, then clearly stating "There’s no need to find, there’ll be arrangements."
He derived a sense of benevolence from An Li.
Due to An Li, he began to treat others with kindness.
If the Formless Ancient Race truly played "forcing some prodigy to be seized," then...if An Li learned of this, she’d likely fall into darkness, even if not, she’d no longer be his source of benevolence.
This would be a case of a good intention backfiring, directly destroying the hard-earned opportunity of a Purple Mansion Middle Stage.
Tang Xiaokong trusted him extremely, whatever he said would be done, so when he said not to look, they simply stopped searching.
For a while, Princess Xi continued collecting the "Nine Bloods of the Dragon Elephant" for Song Yan;
Wang Susu and Yu Xuanwei, thanks to Song Yan’s favor, began officially lining up for the use of "the two Profound Hearts of Gusha Mountain";
While Song Yan engaged in Skin Making, traveling with An Li disguised as a common couple, left Gusha Mountain, and began searching for suitable targets in Qinghuan Kingdom and nearby sects.
Song Yan’s Divine Soul was extremely formidable; his Divine Sense spread out easily, locking onto places where Profound Qi erupted. In other words...once there was conflict, he could sense it immediately. And conflict often accompanied demise. Seizing someone who has fallen and avenging them shouldn’t be considered evil, right?
During this time, he intentionally or unintentionally investigated those ten cultivators he had deliberately sent out.
Of ten, only five died.
While Immortal Mother Xing was attacked, she resolved it with ease.
Evidently, the Demon Monk, even if having seized the Insect King, could not extend his hand so long to cause chaos on the territory of the Formless Ancient Country.
As for why the Insect King.
It was because Song Yan easily learned that the only escapee of the "Soul Threshold of the Servant King" was the Insect King.
Isn’t the Demon Monk, yet who is it?
Song Yan, to hide his identity, set up layers of barriers, and the Demon Monk is still unable to breach even the first layer.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: 164. Talent Overwhelming, Twin Demons Meet (8.2K Words - Large Chapter Seeking Subscription)_5
For a moment, he settled his mind temporarily, thinking of fully absorbing all the power he could digest, reaching a level of "breaking the unbreakable".
The tree desires calm, but the wind never ceases.
Moreover, his Divine Soul had fused with four-ninths of the Soul Evil Pearls, while the Demon Monk held five-ninths.
He and the Demon Monk must have a confrontation.
Either you devour me, or I devour you, only then can there be completeness.
Now, the Demon Monk is searching for him.
And by that time, wouldn’t he also have to seek out the Demon Monk?
...
...
Silent night, pale snow.
Yet the fire was red, a tragic red.
The tragic red fire was a sacrificial fire, this Song Yan already knew.
