But he did not know that this sacrificial fire was not only burning in the Snow Country, but also silently burning right now in a distant Earth Realm far, far away from the Snow Country.
That place was not far from the Ancient Jin Land, just need to cross the Desolate Wilderness, turn west, and it would take only one year by horse to reach it.
This place, known as Great Yong, was once under the rule of the Fox-Wolf Alliance, now a Vassal State under the Insect Race Alliance.
In the mountains...
Bang!
A shirtless strong man threw the corpses of dead cultivators into the tragic red flames, then turned and bowed to an old man as thin as a withered bamboo, respectfully, "Master, they’ve all been thrown in."
The old man was exceedingly good to him, saved him many times, helped him, acting both as a master and a father.
The old man nodded, suddenly moved his palm slightly, a giant hand imbued with powerful thoughts grabbed the strong man, then coldly pressed him into the tragic red flames under the latter’s disbelief and desperate questioning, only saying when he saw his vitality fading, "The Dao is ruthless, raising you was for this moment, or else you would have died long ago, in a way... you also profited."
The tragic red flames gradually devoured the shirtless strong man, the old man sat cross-legged, immediately moved his thoughts, weaving a massive, ghostly cold Ghost Infant Statue in the void, he sat within the Ghost Infant Statue, taking a deep breath, strands of tragic red threads surged from all directions, coating the Ghost Infant Statue, causing its icy body to emanate a red flesh tone, exciting his body.
But as he grew more excited, he sighed, for the number of sacrifices was not enough to complete the final step. Because this kind of sacrifice cannot be piled up with just ordinary lives, it requires strong ones.
But where on this land are suitable strong ones?
This scene, however, was witnessed by a mysterious figure in a red robe observing from above.
The Insect King, or rather the Demon Monk, in a way was like Song Yan, both no longer cultivating.
Only that Song Yan’s "no longer cultivating" was due to his wisdom compensating for it, while the Demon Monk had reached a point where there was nothing more to train.
He had reached the limit.
To breakthrough to the Divine Infant, he had to seek completeness.
His completeness was Song Yan.
He had to devour Song Yan to breakthrough the Divine Infant.
So, ever since Song Yan crawled out from the Sea of Suffering and fled north, he started doing many things.
For instance, hiring Loose Cultivators, attempting to capture the Formless Ancient Race’s Immortal Mother, Tang Yi, Huo Lanxin, attempting to assassinate the scattered thirteen suspects, but... the former was entirely ineffective, and the latter was extremely difficult.
Just because those ten people actually scattered across ten major powers of the Formless Ancient Race, to make a move was truly challenging, how could this be achieved by Loose Cultivators?
The Demon Monk immediately realized this path was a dead end because numerous traps had long been set by the opponent.
He could only capture the boy unless he himself could go into the Formless Ancient Race.
And it was during this time, he suddenly noticed the "tragic red flames" within his own Vassal State.
Then naturally, he obtained the "Ghost Infant Scripture" and tried every means to acquire the Array Map.
He discovered several different Vassal States all had people practicing this.
Obviously, those people belonged to different Sects, even without previous connections, yet they were all doing the same thing — sacrifice.
Sacrificing others’ lives, fulfilling their own power, forging Ghost Infants, to reach higher realms.
The Demon Monk wasn’t someone who cared about life, but he found a familiar aura in this sacrificial fire.
He came to the side of the greatest practitioner of the "Ghost Infant Scripture" in his own Vassal State, quietly observing.
This master was in the Late Stage of the Purple Mansion.
He had already mastered the Ghost Infant Statue.
Now, that Ghost Infant Statue was glowing brilliantly, emitting a strange flesh tone.
Through that hue, he vaguely sensed something, a strand of the Demon Monk’s essence silently probing afar, delving into the Ghost Infant, connecting to an unknown other side.
He heard a cold rebuke.
"Who?"
The Demon Monk felt that aura and was overjoyed, then humbly said, "Demon Monk."
The cold voice did not chase him away this time, but appeared to ponder, saying, "Oh, a little thing from the Obsession Layer, what do you want to do?"
The Demon Monk said, "I just want to ask, have you arranged sacrifices on the Formless Ancient Race’s territory?"
This time, the cold voice fell silent, then said, "I’m right there, just can’t get out. Have you... already gotten out?"
The Demon Monk grinned, coldly yet happily saying, "I’ve come out! But I’m not complete! My target is in the Formless Ancient Race! Would you like to cooperate?"
"How to cooperate?"
"You need sacrifices, yet you’re short of offerings. And I, excel at inciting wars. I will help you procure offerings, help you sacrifice, and help you get out. But after you are free, will you join me in finding my target, help me complete, is that okay?"
"Alright."
The exchange between the two monsters did not alert the old man of the Purple Mansion in the slightest.
The snow continued to fall quietly.
From a high vantage overlooking the continent, one could see that the continent’s edge was surprisingly all red, with many places where such tragic red fires were burning.
On the ground, there were Ghost Infants, or rather... Demon Infants coming into being, possessing life.
Yet the Demon Infants were still sacrifices, offerings on the way to... a higher level.
And that higher level held the strings, each line connected to a Demon Infant.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 165. Gathering and dispersing are constant, an unprecedented realm breakthrough! (8.6K words - major Chapter seeking subscription)
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: 165. Gathering and dispersing are constant, an unprecedented realm breakthrough! (8.6K words - major Chapter seeking subscription)
The Formless Ancient Race, an ancient secret realm...
Mountains eroded, rivers dried up, all things decayed.
Air currents suddenly stirred up gray dust, swirling around.
In the sand, "Fourth Uncle" Tang Xiaoping was standing.
In front of him was a broken stone tablet.
The stone tablet was extremely sturdy, as if protected by some strange force, hidden, and he wouldn’t have discovered it if he hadn’t walked up to it.
Moreover, this tablet couldn’t be copied or inscribed; it could only be studied for cultivation.
At this moment, he was staring intently at the ancient characters on the stone tablet.
"Chenggen Mountain, so it can be used in reverse, intersecting with the sky, allowing one to merge not only with the earth but also with the wind?"
"Is that possible?"
Tang Xiaoping muttered intermittently, growing more and more excited.
Since the day he tested with that youngster, he seemed to have sparked inspiration.
In this life, he no longer pursued the Divine Infant Realm, having lived more than half of the Purple Mansion’s millennium lifespan. What he tirelessly sought was these ancient secret techniques.
Now, he discovered an opportunity to advance further, like a youth seeing his first love, unable to look away.
"Mountain is earth, wind belongs to wood; if earth and wood in the Five Elements can fuse, could more be fused?"
"If more could be fused..."
Tang Xiaoping could no longer imagine.
"Did people in ancient times really cultivate such magic?"
"Are there even more comprehensive, more systematic magic techniques?"
"For what purpose did they cultivate these techniques?"
"Were they just as obsessed as I am, solely researching?"
Countless thoughts flooded into his mind like a dam bursting.
And just then, he suddenly felt the entire secret realm start to tremble.
The realm, already turning to dust, began to experience a cracking sensation. The land’s surface split open, quickly forming a ravine, with sand and dust from the decayed mountains and rivers rapidly pouring into it.
In the sky above the secret realm, gray clouds had formed into a vortex, with strands of red lightning snakes rapidly darting through the gray cloud threads.
Tang Xiaoping recognized the terrifying red lightning, his pupils shrinking, exclaiming: "Celestial tribulation!! How is this possible?!"
This wasn’t the "minor celestial tribulation" for "passing the late stage of the Purple Mansion realm," but a genuine celestial tribulation.
If a "minor celestial tribulation" was a small fruit knife, the current celestial tribulation was a giant Dragon Slaying Saber!
"How did this happen?"
"I’m afraid this secret realm can’t withstand it!"
Faced with this sudden change, Tang Xiaoping couldn’t think much more and wanted to quickly grab the ancient stone tablet inscribed with "Profound Mountain Nine Stacks," "Chenggen Mountain Technique," and "Three Steps to Heaven" and escape.
He hadn’t previously taken it for fear of ruining the ancient stone tablet by forcefully handling it.
But now, with the secret realm about to be destroyed by the celestial tribulation, he couldn’t care less.
Tang Xiaoping manifested a giant hand with his mind’s power, reaching to grab the stone tablet. But before he could touch it, he felt an immense pressure enveloped on the stone tablet.
His body froze, showing disbelief.
"The celestial tribulation’s target is actually this stone tablet!!"
In his eyes, the hidden power that protected the stone tablet was rapidly disintegrating, and the red thunder slurry above the clouds was ready to strike.
Tang Xiaoping, disregarding everything else, turned and sped toward the secret realm’s exit, and just as he stepped out of the realm, he couldn’t help but glance back.
In that glance, he saw the celestial tribulation descend from the sky, the characters on the stone tablet blazing like a scroll thrown into a furnace, words being erased one by one. The solid stone, as fragile as paper, burned dark red by the thunder fire, then scattered into ash in the airflow.
And the entire secret realm... began to shatter at that moment.
Puff!
Tang Xiaoping returned to the mortal world, gasping for breath, still showing signs of fear.
If he had been a step slower or greedier for a moment, he would have been left in the secret realm.
He tested the secret realm’s entrance.
Sure enough, the entrance had already disappeared.
Tang Xiaoping let out a long sigh.
But then, as if he thought of something, he suddenly showed a hint of joy.
The more he thought, the happier he became, like an old child discovering a new toy, jumping and skipping away, conveying his excitement through his thoughts as he ran.
"Clan Leader! Clan Leader! I told you, there’s definitely something about these obscure, hard-to-learn secret techniques. Now that even the celestial tribulation wants to destroy them, I was right! Clan Leader!! I believe these three secret techniques should be incorporated into the spell system of our younger generation of the Formless clan, and they should practice diligently!"
Before long...
A thought was sent back in response.
In the late stage of the Purple Mansion, they only needed to leave thoughts to communicate directly without meeting in person.
And the responder at that moment was the Clan Leader of the Formless Ancient Race, the strongest of this generation—Tang Xiaoxuan.
After a brief discussion.
Tang Xiaoxuan said, "First select some talented youngsters below to try. If it can indeed greatly enhance combat power, then it’s not too late for our clan’s younger generation to use it."
Tang Xiaoping happily left.
Any magic that even heaven and earth cannot tolerate must surely be something valuable, right?
If something worthwhile can be successfully researched, the descendants of the Formless Ancient Race will undoubtedly become stronger.
...
...
Song Yan truly felt the presence of kindness.
The presence of An Li made him feel that the world had softened entirely.
Because of his goodwill towards one person, he extended it to everyone he met.
At this moment, he was in the Moon Sea Kingdom, outside of Qinghuan Kingdom.
Moon Sea Kingdom was dozens of times larger than Qinghuan Kingdom, even larger than the original Ancient Jin territory of the Three Kingdoms.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 165. Gathering and dispersing are constant, an unprecedented realm breakthrough! (8.6K words - major Chapter seeking subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: 165. Gathering and dispersing are constant, an unprecedented realm breakthrough! (8.6K words - major Chapter seeking subscription)_2
The environment of Moon Sea and Qinghuan are similar, primarily grasslands.
However, in the hearts of the people of Moon Sea, Qinghuan is considered a superior country, the one closest to the Immortal’s abode.
At this moment...
A common tent in Moon Sea.
A little girl wrapped in a fur apron ran in from outside, carrying a jug of chilled beast milk, her eyes sparkling with enthusiasm as she looked at the boy and the woman not far away, and happily said, "Brother, um..."
She seemed to hesitate over how to address the woman.
Song Yan smiled and said, "Sister just has prematurely white hair."
The little girl joyfully exclaimed, "Brother, Sister, this is what Mother asked me to bring you."
After speaking, she placed the beast milk on the table. It was a long-necked curved bottle decorated with shells, made of porcelain, and the beast milk inside was obviously taken from a cellar, exuding a chill that, in this scorching heat, was just like immortal air.
Song Yan poured the beast milk for himself and An Li, then cupped it in both hands and drank it in large gulps.
He had adapted to the local customs, wearing attire in the style of the Moon Sea Kingdom, and it was quite a bold choice.
A beast fur skirt wrapped around his waist, and on his upper body was a beast fur strapless garment that left much of his skin exposed, thus... his strong physique was presented to the outside, attracting many gazes as he walked through the roads of Moon Sea Kingdom.
In contrast, An Li wore a relatively conservative beast fur dress.
If it were in the past, she would certainly be described as an adorable girl wrapped in beast fur, but now... there was a hint of mature womanly grace.
An Li held the porcelain cup, sipping the beast milk in small mouthfuls, and softly said, "So comfortable..."
Song Yan smiled faintly.
He also felt very comfortable.
It was a relaxation of both body and mind.
He had left Gusha Mountain for some time now, hiding among the crowd, entering the red dust, while using his terrifying Divine Sense to sense the surroundings, searching for a suitable body for An Li to possess. Meanwhile, he lingered among mountains and rivers, human fireworks, being kind to others, and being kind to himself.
The evil thoughts of killing, the sly plots, all seemed to temporarily fade.
He greedily absorbed the honeydew dripping from the vines, only hoping such days could last a little longer.
Before transmigration, he never managed to complete his dream of a long-term journey even until death, yet in this Otherworld, it was unexpectedly fulfilled.
After finishing the beast milk, the two held hands and walked out of the tent.
Outside, the green grass was like silk, the azure sky scattered with clouds, and the two ran for a while, then lay down on the ground looking up.
"I really wish it could always be like this." Song Yan said.
He raised his hand, thumb and index finger forming a circle, and said, "The sky is so vast, and we are so small. But being small is not necessarily a bad thing. The larger it is, the heavier it becomes; only by being small can one avoid bearing so many shackles."
An Li lay beside him, turning her head, her eyes gazing at the boy through the dancing long grass.
After these days of companionship, after Song Yan revealed his heartfelt thoughts without pretension.
She had started to slowly understand some things: Senior Brother Bai was definitely not that simple.
Every move, every speech of Senior Brother Bai exuded a feeling that was hard to describe, a profound charm that should not appear on a cultivator with a little Talent but certainly not a genius.
Occasional silence, deep gaze, gave An Li the feeling of looking at a statue in a temple.
Senior Brother Bai... had too many stories.
At this moment, hearing Song Yan’s words, she said nothing, only reached out her hand.
The two of them interlaced their fingers.
Song Yan felt that the once soft little hand had already changed, but he didn’t mind.
An Li suddenly whispered, "Being small still has many shackles."
She didn’t want Senior Brother Bai to lose his upward momentum because of her.
She was no longer the person she used to be, and neither was Senior Brother Bai.
Nobody can go back to the past.
Everyone should look forward, move forward.
Everyone should grow, mature.
Ignoring these is nothing but self-deception.
Song Yan fell silent for a moment, then gave a faint smile, responding "Mm," and then lying on his back, quietly watching the floating clouds of the moment, feeling the swaying long grass at this moment, wild horses running, shepherds shouting, and insects busy in the soil humming low...
He hummed a childish, off-tune nursery rhyme.
This was a nursery rhyme from Moon Sea Kingdom, sung by mothers to lull their children to sleep.
At this moment, he was humming it.
The melody of the nursery rhyme, the lyrics were quite simple, yet very gentle.
An Li found it strange, she felt that Senior Brother Bai seemed too eager to return to the An Li from a hundred years ago, the An Li whom Senior Brother Bai deeply cherished, who might have been clumsy and dopey in the past.
Although Senior Brother Bai loved her because he loved the silly little An Li, and thus he still cherished her now, it was not the truth.
What Senior Brother Bai truly yearned for was the carefree feeling with little An Li a hundred years ago.
He loved the feeling of carefree freedom.
That little An Li gave him the carefree feeling, so he liked little An Li, and therefore liked her now.
Everything was just like the childish nursery rhyme that Senior Brother Bai was humming at this moment...
’Just like a child who doesn’t want to grow up...’ An Li privately chuckled.
Suddenly, she felt their clasped hands go still.
Song Yan suddenly sat up, and in an instant, the kindness in the corner of his eyes disappeared, glinting a streak of deep evil light, yet this evil light turned kind midway because... An Li was watching him.
An Li was like a corrector, able to constantly correct him to prevent excessive killing intent, maintain kind thoughts.
"What’s wrong?"
"I’ll take you to see a good show, maybe there is your body."
With that, Song Yan grabbed An Li and transformed into a white rainbow, heading far away.
...
...
Moon Sea Kingdom, outskirts.
Flame Fragrance Sect.
Amidst a pile of corpses, a disheveled man in red armor, bleeding all over, stands firmly while a white-robed silhouette blocks his front firmly, confronting an old woman wielding a Flying Sword.

Chapter 333: 165. Gathering and dispersing are constant, an unprecedented realm breakthrough! (8.6K words - major Chapter seeking subscription)_3
The old woman said, "Yiyi, step aside."
The figure in the white dress revealed a determined look on her delicate face, "Master, I won’t step aside. Brother Quan Yan was merely swayed by the Evil Demon, these actions are not his true intentions. Besides... it’s also my fault. As his junior sister, I failed to watch over him properly, leading him to commit this wrongdoing today."
"Wrongdoing?"
The man in the red armor suddenly burst into laughter, then angrily shouted, "They humiliated me, mocked me, shouldn’t I kill them?"
The old woman rebuked angrily, "Did the entire Flame Fragrance Sect humiliate you, mock you? Did the whole sect deprive you of your resources? Perhaps you had conflicts with some disciples, but you... went on to kill so many people! Did they do wrong? Did they deserve to die?"
"They did!"
The man in red armor shouted angrily, "They shouldn’t have stood in the way of my revenge! By blocking me, they became accomplices! Who... who can understand my suffering!
Old hag, you don’t know how much I suffer, you don’t understand, you deserve to die! All of you should compensate me with your lives!"
The old woman’s expression turned cold, she spoke no more, forming gestures with her hands, and numerous Flying Swords emerged from the Void, which then formed a rotating light wheel behind her, concealing a hint of Array Dao change within.
"Unrepentant, slaughtering your comrades! Die!"
"You deserve to die!"
The young girl in the white dress immediately rushed forward, blocking between the two, crying out tearfully: "Master!"
The old woman looked at the familiar face of the young girl in front of her, recalling how she raised her with her own hands, remembering the expectations she had for her, she slightly bowed her head, feeling compassion, and finally sighed, halting the Flying Sword slightly.
This pause put her at a disadvantage. The man in the red armor did not stop, seizing the opportunity to launch a full attack. Evil Qi surged around him, suddenly exploding, and a blood-red spear tore apart the old woman’s Profound Qi shield, followed by countless spears raining down.
Before long...
The old woman was dying, her eyes dim, and she fainted.
The young girl in the white dress again turned, rushing to the old woman’s side, looking at the man in the red armor, she said: "Brother Quan, she is my master! You... please spare her."
The man in the red armor hovered in mid-air, Blood Evil swirling around him, but this Blood Evil seemed controlled by some Secret Technique force, merely stimulating him temporarily to enhance his Power, without affecting his mind or possessing his body.
The man in the red armor said indifferently, "Junior sister, step aside."
The young girl in the white dress, tears streaming down her face, said: "She has done nothing wrong to you!"
The man in the red armor said, "She must die today."
With that, he summoned the Blood Spear again, a fierce look flashed in his eyes, throwing it down without caring for the young girl in the white dress.
Pff!
The young girl in the white dress was struck, spat out a mouthful of blood, and was dying.
The man in the red armor looked indifferent, his hand condensed another Blood Spear, ready to throw again when suddenly, three figures emerged from behind the collapsed Central Medicine Furnace of the Flame Fragrance Sect.
The three figures quickly landed, their oppressive aura descended, all were skilled hands from the Crimson Palace.
The man in the red armor sneered, "Taking advantage by numbers! Do you think you have people, and I have none?"
He yelled, "Brother Zhao, Brother Wang, Sister Ma, lend me a hand!!"
When the words fell, gloomy winds suddenly rose, and three figures swiftly flew over.
The leader snorted coldly, "What a Flame Fragrance Sect, what a so-called noble sect, but so unjust, should be annihilated! Wipe them out!!"
As they spoke, they stormed into the Flame Fragrance Sect like a whirlwind, cruelly slaughtering all ordinary disciples who were still on guard.
The three skilled members of the Flame Fragrance Sect hurried to act, but were not opponents to the four, soon defeated or injured, yet each one gritted their teeth, arranging for the disciples to retreat, blocking the four Evil Demons.
Seeing the defeat was settled, today the Flame Fragrance Sect of Moon Sea Kingdom was doomed to be destroyed, suddenly... two figures appeared on the rooftop of a shattered pavilion of the sect.
Song Yan pointed at the white dress young girl named Yiyi and said, "Take her."
An Li nodded lightly.
On the other side, the man in the red armor immediately noticed the uninvited guests, but when he scanned with Divine Sense, he couldn’t discern their Realm, couldn’t help but ask, "Who are you..."
Before he finished the last word "person", he suddenly felt a gray light shooting towards him.
His Divine Soul was in excruciating pain, everything went dark, and he fell from high altitude.
Die!
Song Yan turned his gaze to the remaining three Evil Demons.
The three also noticed him.
The first demon was about to say something.
But before he spoke.
The gray light arrived.
Die!
The other two sensed something amiss, about to flee.
The gray light arrived again.
One, die!
The last one just flew a few more yards...
The gray light arrived once more.
Die!
Song Yan almost instantaneously obliterated the four Crimson Palace demons, then suddenly raised his hand and grabbed the white dress young girl named Yiyi in front of him, without wasting words, raised a hand to point.
The terrifying Divine Soul Power frantically invaded, scouring all memories of the girl, who was now dying, life force dwindling, soon to dissipate into nothing, the perfect object for possession.
In the next moment, amidst the shocked and reverent gazes of the remaining disciples and elders of Flame Fragrance Sect, he gathered An Li, turned into a rainbow light, flying into the distant open forest area.
Upon landing, he threw down the white dress young girl, and said: "She’s at the seventh level of Refining Profound, her Profound Root is of Middle Grade Wood, quite suitable for Alchemy, a nice surprise. Now she’s about to die, you may begin."
An Li nodded lightly again, then looked at Brother Bai in astonishment.
Brother Bai just seems to be at the Refining Profound Realm...
Yet those demons in the Crimson Palace, why do they seem like ants before him?
With a flash of thought, An Li raised a hand and pointed at the girl’s forehead, commencing possession.
Song Yan slightly turned his head, finding indeed a section of Evil Land in the back mountain here.
